reviews.author: Patricia Reno
reviews.text:
Bought 1953 rancher in Catonsville in November. Moved in dec 15

OMG Dec 16 can you image having to call BG&E because you smell a strange odor.  They arrive saying yup there's 4 gas leaks you've gotta leave and we are shutting down the gas.  Can you believe the house didn't blow up???  To top off the entire family is coming to your new house for christmas!!!
In comes Michaels Plumbing, Mike Coleman the tech.  First glance only a few leaks we can fix.  Now it's Thursday a week before the 25th.  Inspector can't come till Monday. Monday arrives gas line fails to hold air pressure.  Mike comes back. Now what. Up the attic we go. There are leaks at every coupling, seal and bend in gas line. Replacing entire line. No heat for Christmas.   Friday 26th Mike arrives works thru Saturday  by 5pm the lines replaced.  Pressure is holding at 20 psi.  Called left message get an inspector out immediately.   Inspector arrives Tuesday 30th 11ish.  Passes. Mike is there to meet Inspector Tom.  Mike messages I'll be back in morning to hook everything up and get gas up again.  Later today 12/30 he messages I'm leaving supply and heading to your house to finish now. Lining up Inspector to come back tomorrow morning. Lines all hooked up.  Heat on
Hot water on!!  Gas holding pressure zero leaks!!!
Did we have heat on Christmas,  no.  Do we have a home that didn't blow up, YES!!! Do we have heat for 2026 you betcha!!! Its truly a blessing that we don't smoke, light matches or have candles in our home.  Christmas would have been much different.
Mike was awesome. He didn't have to come back today, he did!!!
Did I flip out on the 21st, you bet I did.  No heat, failed inspection, holiday 3 days away.  We had to go to my brother's house.  I slept on twin bed with husband 4 nights and we didn't divorce over that!!!  I deserve a medal!!
How can you stay angry, we are all alive.  2 extra holidays shut things down.  All issues where out of everyone's hands.
We managed. We got together. We had a lovely meal.
Michaels and Mike C. Came through and got us heat. It took a bit, no one's fault, just life. We are all alive. House intact.  Lives intact.
Thank you Michael's and Son and especially Mike Coleman. You went above and beyond.
Thank you from our entire family, close and far.  We wouldn't be here today without your help.

However, when John Renta came to my home as scheduled to install the light unit, he had not been told a taller ladder would be needed because my unit is attached to my garage’s very high ceiling. It took several additional reschedules plus follow-up with a manager to ensure they did not reschedule John to other jobs during my scheduled timeline -luckily there was some time flexibility on my side as I work from home periodically during the week. As for the price.. much higher than expected,  higher than $$ quoted on Google for this service -at least David pulled up the prices online so I knew it was their universal pricing (not client specific as I’ve experienced in the past from other home repair technicians). They did provide a small discount for locking in annual maintenance plan and waived the initial service fee to clean my unit so appreciated the consideration. Really counting on this UV light part preventing mold and bacteria from growing inside my AC unit as it should  improve my air quality.. needed for someone with allergies. Overall- David and John made this experience a pleasant one. I’d recommend them to others with the hope that all technicians with frank Gay are as knowledgeable and easy to work with.

reviews.author: Bryan Blanchard

Now to say how Robert ops-15 handled our emergency. Robert was very professional and well liked by our family. He came in and got the job done. I would highly recommend asking for Robert for any of your repairs needed. Robert is a good guy and very talented in the trade. He should be recognized for his outstanding customer service and dedication. Robert is the reason I'm giving 5 stars. Thank you Robert and Merry Christmas. God bless......from Bryan

reviews.author: Swenke Family

I plan to use them exclusively for our plumbing, HVAC and electrical needs.

reviews.author: Jonathan Stariha
reviews.text: My plumbing technician was excellent; friendly, knowledgeable, helpful, and professional. He even offered to try and quickly help with something I didn't hire for, going above and beyond in providing excellent customer service. As far as quality of work, it was excellent--he replaced a shower valve and installed a drop ear elbow with shower riser, replacing all the old copper with new PEX for the connections and shower riser line, and everything looked pristine. Would highly recommend based on quality of work and excellence of service. And he was in and out in about 90(ish) minutes, including offering the extra help that he did and checking my water heater as well. Only reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is price. Berkey's was actually the cheapest option out of the 5+ companies I got quotes from (once I applied their coupon), so their price is very competitive; I just feel like skilled labor prices have gotten exorbitant the past few years across the country, so that's not necessarily a mark on Berkey's so much as the economy.

reviews.author: Dani G
reviews.text:
Berkeys was pretty quick to respond to my water heater issue earlier this year. They were great and on top of things. They replaced my water heater with a tankless one, and shortly after that they replaced my AC system. The AC system did not pass inspection since the installer tried to take a dangerous short cut. We were not happy to hear that news from the city inspector as getting the right part was not difficult. Instead, doing it wrong and moving on to the next job was the obvious solution.
Berkeys recommended (pushed) a dry- out company to get moisture out of the house from the water heater. DRY FORCE was sent to my home at Berkeys insistence. Do not use DRY FORCE. They are a nightmare if home owners insurance is involved. Berkeys has some sort of a deal with Dry Force. Read the Dry Force reviews that have to do with house floods and insurance and then find someone else.
Anyways, Berkeys will insist on signing you up for their $20 a month system maintenance program. Sounds like a great deal until you find out how difficult it is to get an appointment. Like a few months out. We need our filter changed out for the AC system they installed. We have the filter. They want $59 to install it. And we can’t cancel the $20 a month program until we have had it a year. $240 total payments while it’s a pain in the butt to get an appointment.

Should have stayed with Veterans AC. Will go back as soon as the year is passed in April 2026. Only giving two stars since they showed up quickly when my house flooded.

John Wagg & Gabby

He quoted several levels of new equipment & repairs to existing airflows. We accepted quote for the system that would work best for us within our budget. reviews.text: During a carpet installation our cat apparently fell into a furnace vent that was open while being worked on. Finn Hartley our technician was able to get Jack the cat out in less than 30 minutes and repair the duct.  He was in good shape but, hungry of course.  We are so happy with the service. Thank you Finn and Atlas Butler!

reviews.author: Matt Schmeichel
reviews.text: Back in December 2024 I had my gas valve replaced by Black-Haak. They came out right away with many notifications, got the job done without issue, and they offered me a free cleaning.  I took them up on the free cleaning a year later in December 2025. The same technician was back again, she said it was fine at the moment but noticed a potential crack inside that could cause me issues in the future.  Now March 2026 I noticed that the furnace did not prove ignition a few times so I went to look inside the panel and noticed that this black rubber gasket was not it the place.  The flame inside was very orange and when I would push the gasket against the hole it would go back to a nice blue flame.  So I called Black-Haak to let them know that the technician had accidentally left this gasket out.  The receptionist told me that it would be $99 to get someone out there to fix this. I told her the situation again and explained that the technician had left the gasket out when they did either the gas valve or the cleaning. No one else had ever touched the unit.  If this was work that I had done but not finished, I would run right over and get it done. Unfortunately this receptionist instead told me that it was not under warranty. I put the gasket back where it should have been myself and now I will be looking for a HVAC contractor with integrity.

reviews.author: Sandra Sanchez

I was very satisfied with the service, I will definitely be calling black Haak again for any future services I may need.

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Amrendra Kumar
reviews.text:
I am very disappointed with the recent service and the overall handling of my account. If a technician cannot replace a clearly dirty filter or at least document the issue on the work completion form, how is a customer supposed to trust that the rest of the job was completed properly? The new filters for both the humidifier and furnace were readily available in the home at the time of the visit. When I called the main office, I was told the technician “did not want to be rude” by changing the filter. That explanation is not acceptable. He could have asked my wife, who was present, informed her that the filters needed replacement, or at minimum documented it before obtaining her signature.
In addition, two maintenance visits in 2025 were missed despite our prepaid contract for biannual service. When I brought this to their attention, the initial response was, “You could have called us if we had not called you.” That is not a professional way to handle missed contracted services. We paid in advance with the expectation that your company would track and fulfill the agreed-upon visits. The minimum expected response would have been an apology and a reasonable solution, such as extending the contract by another year or offering a refund for the missed services. This experience raises serious concerns about accountability and customer service.

I am editing this review 45 minutes later to add that the heater is now not blowing hot air; only the fan is running. The furnace was working properly before the technician arrived, and the service document states that everything was functioning fine at the time of inspection. This raises even more concern about the quality and thoroughness of the work performed.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text:
I feel compelled to update my original review after learning something that truly shocked and angered me. A neighbor around the corner, whose home is nearly identical to mine, recently had Piedmont Gas install the same gas line setup I requested — with a quick disconnect (which Waldrop told me I’d need to do myself afterward). His final cost? $300. Yes, you read that right — $300, compared to the $1,700+ I paid Waldrop for a similar setup.
When I heard that, I was stunned. I felt taken advantage of. I had hoped that by writing a detailed letter to Waldrop’s CEO about my experience, someone would respond — but I never heard back.
If you're considering Waldrop, I strongly encourage you to read my original experience below. I hope it helps others avoid what I went through..
________________________________________
Original Review (from December 3, 2024)
We hired Waldrop to install a gas line for a portable generator. What followed was over four weeks of delays, poor communication, and subpar service.
•	Initial quote: On October 4th, a technician quoted us just under $1,800. I asked about cost reduction options (we’re on a fixed income), but none were offered. My wife and I agreed to move forward for the sake of safety and professionalism.
•	Missed deadlines: Work began October 11th. We were told the inspector would come the following week. No one showed, and it took repeated calls to even get a response.
•	Communication issues: Calling the office was frustrating — constant recordings, AI, or long hold times. When we did get someone, they often lacked answers or never followed up. I finally spoke to James Kirby, who admitted the inspector hadn’t even been contacted and was surprised by the poor quality shown in their own technician’s photos.
•	Rework and mess: The crew returned October 24th to reinstall the line “properly.” They left a mess, chipped our sidewalk, and got paint on our siding. Even the state inspector commented that a regulator was missing, though he passed it due to the low pressure of our setup. Waldrop did install the regulator after the inspection and final adjustments.
•	I have many more details, though this should explain the basic reasons I am posting such a negative review.
We wrote to Jamie Porterfield (Waldrop) on November 7th. As of December 3rd — still no response.
This experience left us sadly disappointed. Others may have had better outcomes, but our experience was unprofessional, overpriced, and extremely frustrating.

reviews.text: Very fast response time! Water heater died and started leaking on Sunday morning. I waited until 7:15AM on Monday to call. Though I’m not a fan of having to talk to a virtual assistant, it was VERY easy to get through to a “real” person. (Actually, she sounded so nice I had to ask if she was real.) Emily dispatched a technician and Zachary Cameron (hero) was at my home before 8:30AM. I knew the job would be a challenge because of the tight space, but he was not intimidated - he smiled! Zach took great care to cover the carpet as he brought in his equipment and the new tank and removed the old. Zach showed me two code violations from the previous install (vent and gas line) and then got to work. He installed new copper water line, black gas line, a total of four new shut-off valves (3 water, 1 gas) and a high quality Bradford White water heater. A friend of friend told me that he would have done it for less, but I know it’s been done RIGHT this time. Excellent customer service, excellent plumbing work done by a professional (and nice) Zach. My thanks to everyone. I’m a new customer for life. ❤️

reviews.author: Jason Turowski
reviews.text: Amazing work. 13 yr old water heater finally went. Called Jackson Comfort and they were right out to my home to make the swap. He did an excellent job, was very meticulous at my property, put down drop clothes to protect the floors and carpeting and cleaned up all around the area in the basement after installation. A big job done in about 3 hrs or less. Very appreciative. Almonte Patrick, the technician who worked in my home was the best. Very appreciative.

reviews.author: Ruffkins
reviews.text: John Untisz was great! He was friendly, professional, and very knowledgeable. He quickly identified the problem with my HVAC system and took the time to explain it in a way that was easy to understand. I really appreciated his help and expertise. It's clear that he cares about his customers and takes pride in his work. If I need HVAC service in the future, I wouldn't hesitate to call Jackson Comfort again.

reviews.author: Laticia Jolly
reviews.text: Jackson Comfort Services were awesome. After being cheated out of 1650 by another company, they reassured  me that they were going to help me. They were here on time and explained the process completely.  They added a few upgrades that my previous furnace did not come with. Anthony  and the other tech was friendly and knowledgeable.  I am glad I went with them for my furnace needs.

reviews.author: Dustin Fout
reviews.text:
Robert Griffin (furnace salesman) and Thomas Rogers (furnace technician) were amazing.

Our furnace went out on Monday, and I had a different company come out to take a look at it. After 30 minutes the technician for that company, gave me a list of parts that needed replaced, totaling $3,000. He then brought up buying a new furnace vs paying to get the parts replaced.

After having their furnace salesman give me a quote, I decided to have Jackson Comfort come out and take a look for me. Robert (furnace salesman) came out first, took a look at the furnace and instead of immediately pushing a new furnace on me, he walked me through the parts the other company said needed replaced. Robert decided to have their technician come out again with him.

Thomas (furnace technician) spent over an hour looking at my furnace walked me through what was going on, and told me that only the capacitor needed replaced way less expensive than $3,000. At no point did Robert push me to get a new furnace. He seemed happy that we were able to just replace the one part.

I will be using them again. They are honest, and transparent. I have one of their plumbers coming out because we have to get a new shutoff valve for our water main.

plumbers.name: Red Cap Plumbing, Air & Electric
plumbers.address: 7218 E M.L.K. Jr Blvd, Tampa, FL 33619, USA

reviews.author: Wayne Wells
reviews.text:
After spending $14,000 one time and $10,000 the next, they texted me if they could give me another quote. I replied several times they could still fix my bathroom sink like they promised multiple times but never did. I still have not received a response.
Om the first picture the sink drain is wide open but without turning off the water it will overflow. 2nd picture is after turning the water off and waiting. It will eventually finish draining today. Not good after paying $24,000.

reviews.author: Carol Via
reviews.text: Shortly before Thanksgiving, I thought I had a hot water leak after finding water on my floor. Leak detection felt I had a leak in a copper pipe in my wall. Aaron and Jamie discovered the leak was actually under the slab. I was given the option of jackhammering my foundation to find and repair the leak or rerouting the water through my attic and replacing all my old copper pipes that are bound to start getting pinholes. After much anxiety, I opted for new pipes. Red Cap(Jamie) worked with me on financing. I'm a retired senior on a very limited income. So grateful to Red Cap(Jamie). The Red Cap plumbers came out Friday, the day after Thanksgiving, and changed out all my old copper pipes and rerouted the water bypassing the slab pipes. I'll NEVER have to worry about a future slab leak and my slab is in great shape. I had water by time the team left. They were wonderful. Very professional, worked non stop, orgainized, very nice and very informative. I felt in good hands. Thank you Ermion, Nelson and Tyler.

reviews.author: Stephanie Polk
reviews.text: Our technician, Jaxon Newhall, was great to work with. He worked around our schedule to see us and was very understanding with our situation.  We were able to agree on a unit and price and were lucky to have it installed the very next day.  Both installers were really nice and personable.  They did a great job, cleaned everything up like they’d never been there and were very thorough with explaining how to use the warranty if necessary and the unit itself.  Very happy we used them.

reviews.author: Beverly
reviews.text: Tyler Warrington and his fellow worker installed my water conditioner today.  They were very professional, knowledgeable and courteous.  Finding a contractor who balances quality work with helpful service is a rare find"

reviews.author: Marcio DaCosta
reviews.text: Justin and Nate did an amazing job installing the Lennox Signature series HVAC. Everything was done exactly as promised. Greatly appreciate the professionalism and thoroughness in how everything was handled. Highly recommend!!

plumbers.name: Airco Service
plumbers.address: 4444 S 91st East Ave, Tulsa, OK 74145, USA

reviews.author: Jessica Corbin
reviews.text:
We had an Excellent experience with AIRCO Service. From the beginning, their pricing was upfront and transparent with no hidden fees, which gave us confidence moving forward.

Luke Helm, the project manager, was amazing to work with. He came in, thoroughly assessed our needs, and clearly explained the process and recommendations. His professionalism and attention to detail set the tone for the entire project.

There were two separate teams involved, and both were outstanding. The team in charge of the ductwork installation, led by Justin, was extremely professional and efficient. Justin even took the time to walk us through the new control panel (thermostat)—which was well above our level of expertise 😂—and graciously explained all the features it was capable of. His patience and kindness did not go unnoticed.

Together, the teams installed a new HVAC heat pump along with new air ductwork, worked hard, respected our home, and cleaned up after themselves. What was expected to be a three-day job was completed in just two days, without sacrificing quality.

If you’re looking for a professional company, look no further than AIRCO Service. We Highly recommend them for anyone needing ANY HVAC work done right.

reviews.author: Sterling Thomas
reviews.text:
It’s rare that I’m on the negative side of reviews, especially with a company who has been around for a while.

My first and will be only experience was agreeing to a $99 diagnostic. The technician came and went into the attic to assess the problem.

He came back down about 15-20 minutes later to tell me what he found. He said while he was doing the diagnostic (moving things around) he found an insect where it shouldn’t have been and it fixed the problem

He said usually he’ll come back down and communicate how much it would be to fix the issue (which I confirmed with Jane before the appointment) but he decided to just go ahead and fix it.

In my mind I was thinking he was just going to charge the diagnostic fee because that’s all he did and happened to fix the issue while doing it. That is also all I agreed to beforehand. So I was very surprised to see a invoice of $288 on the tablet

I will say, I made the mistake of signing off and paying it because of my headspace of waking up in the cold. Did not think it through until after the fact

I called the office 20 minutes later to speak with a supervisor about the situation. Just wanted to ask if that’s their normal business practice. I was told a message was sent and someone will reach out to me

That was Saturday, it’s now Thursday and I haven’t received any form of contact. But I’m done waiting on a call and going to shrug it off and take the loss

I will also add everyone I spoke with were pleasant to talk to (including the technician). I seem to be an outlier of negative experiences here but it is what it is

reviews.author: Myra Seeber
reviews.text:
They were wonderful!!
We were having a tankless water heater put in a small closet in our master bathroom.
They let us know everything they were doing and why it needed to be done. Even apologized that my asma was acting up due to the insulation.
There was no mess for me to clean up after they left. And I love my new water heater. If you are thinking of investing in a tankless water heater. Do yourself a favor, and call this wonderful team.

reviews.author: Michelle Rombow
reviews.text:
Jordan was exceptional! He was the most thorough technician I have ever had.

I have a Smart thermostat that I have never been able to use. The technician who installed it could not get it to work via my phone. Jordan went above and beyond to figure it out. What I had to take a bank loan out to use my heat/air unit is now something I can fully use. I appreciated the extra time and effort by Jordan.

reviews.author: Marlene Hall
reviews.text: The technicians were very polite and explained everything that they were going to do before replacing the water heater.  They were efficient in getting it replaced.  They showed me the repairs after they completed it.  They explained all of the new features and recommended maintenance.  I will definitely continue to use AirCo Service for the maintenance of my HVAC and water heater systems.

plumbers.name: Len the Plumber Heating & Air, LLC
plumbers.address: 6598B Fleet Dr, Alexandria, VA 22310, USA

reviews.author: James Toles
reviews.text: I was extremely impressed with the work completed by Mr Mark Martin from Len Plumbing.  He was very pleasant and extremely professional.  He arrived on time, assessed the plumbing issue I needed addressed, and completed the work in less than an hour.  I wanted a valve to be replaced and we discussed a moving a second valve to make it more accessible.  He completed both tasks and now both valves are functional and accessible. I will definitely contact Mark for all of my future plumbing needs.  Excellent, excellent professional to work with.  Thank you Len the Plumber for sending Mark Martin my way!!

reviews.author: Ruth Ashlock
reviews.text: From the First Moment that Aturo Rivera arrived at our home this morning he was a True Gentleman. Thoughful , Articulate, and Kind. He explained in detail how the process of repairing our ‘Downstairs Toilet Issues‘would take, and gave us Useful Advice/Tips on the Different Plans that Lens Plumbing Services Offered. After settling on our choice of offers he Diligently and Smoothly went about bringing in the equipment ( By Himself) and Resolved our Plumbing problem. The toilet is Working and we’re 💯 Overjoyed that Aturo was our serviceman. Also, Shoutout to Brittney for taking our phone call on a Sunday. We  Highly Recommend Him and your company to our family and friends. Thanks again Aturo You Provided us with Excellent Advice and Service.

reviews.author: Alice Wilson
reviews.text: Daniel Aguirre did an amazing job replacing our water heater. He truly Exceeded our expectations In his work, detailed explanations, speed and professionalism. We have a 1959 home and are so impressed. When you think about before and after pictures, you don’t usually think about your plumbing and utility closet , but if you could see ours you would get it. Neat, tidy efficient, clean, and most importantly- Up To Code =SAFE.  After this experience, I honestly can’t imagine having anyone else work on our plumbing. Thank you, Daniel Aguirre, passionate plumber extraordinaire, and another decade of working with Len The Plumber.

reviews.author: Amy Thomas
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Mustafa at  Len the Plumber! Our water heater started leaking and Mustafa came out the next morning, on a Sunday. He was extremely professional, honest, and took the time to walk us through several replacement options at different price points so we could make the best decision. There was no pressure—just clear, straightforward information. Once we decided, he completed the work the same day. We really appreciated his professionalism and efficiency. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Stephen Pezzetti
reviews.text: James Milligan came back to my home to perform a leak test on the main line to the house after I consulted with him. I am in the process of selling and the buyers had two “plumbers” come and look at a “suspected” leak. Neither performed an actual leak test, but both said it was leaking and the main would need to be replaced at a cost of around $10K. James told me although the test would cost me $309 it would be money well spent if it demonstrated there was no leak (he suspected it was not leaking). After 30 minutes of watching the meter after shutting off the main it hadn’t moved. NO LEAK! James saved me from having to argue about a $10K subsidy/main line replacement. 5 stars just doesn’t cut it…10 stars!! Jim is a huge asset to Len the Plumber, no question about it!

reviews.text:
We have had excellent service from Thomas and Galbraith and the technicians have been friendly and knowledgable. Most recently we had a broken pipe under the basement floor of our 135 year old house. Shawn arrived quickly and pinpointed the problem area with a flexible camera system. John and the crew completed the repair in a day and a half and thoroughly cleaned up the work area. We were very happy with the whole process.

We have had a maintenance contract for several years for both HVAC (3 units) and plumbing. We have been very satisfied and would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Toriano Franklin
reviews.text:
Review long overdue as I have been a T&G customer and monthly member for over 2+yrs now. Simply our every technician has been phenomenal. I've used plumbing and heating. And soon I'll use the electrical service.

Every technician has been informative, answered every question I've had. Never felt pressured to get something I did not need. Very clean and very professional.
Always

Recently I had a service repair for my HVAC by  Dion Bruce. OUTSTANDING. Not just was the service or repair correct and quick, he was clean and caring but he discovered an error neither my account. Worked with the company to get that resolved.

Never would have known there was a small error unless he pointed it out.

Folks over the years I've had my AC, HVAC, Plumbing, Sump pumps replaced and repaired: all with T&G. Every single technician has been as outstanding.

Use T&G for all your Heating, Plumbing, and Electrical needs .

reviews.author: The Truth
reviews.text:
I had a plumbing problem today, and needed help fast. My main drain was backing up into my basement. So knowing that most plumbing companies are way too expensive and usually have long waiting times, I wasn't sure who to call. Then I remembered that Thomas & Galbraith had a Commercial that talked about be knowledgeable, fast and affordable. So I gave them a call, and I'm so glad that I did because they fixed my problem, fast and affordable. And will be following up to inform me on what caused the problem, and if there's any solution to prevent it from happening again.
And their price was very fair and affordable, VERY AFFORDABLE!

If you've used them before then you already know, but for those of you like me, you must give them call.
You won't believe their service and fees!

And this isn't a discount for a review like most companies would have you do, which isn't a true review at all. I don't participate in those.
We need more true reviews, so that people know who the good companies really are, which helps all of us!

Clemy Lee

reviews.author: Tristen St. John
reviews.text:
TLDR: 5/5 service fee/Diagnosis value, 1/5 value for everything else

Had a very odd issue with my furnace, after days of troubleshooting, I called Thomas and Galbraith. They were able to successfully pinpoint the issue after 2 techs over 2 separate visits.

I am rating them a 5/5 on diagnosis and value:

Their service call/diagnosis fee of 100$ is very fair and I was only charged a singular fee even with the extensive troubleshooting it took to figure out my issue. Their diagnosis was accurate and the two techs I worked with were very respectful/kind!
For this I would use their diagnosis services again.

I am rating a 1/5  on their cost for labor/parts/etc.:

I am fairly familiar with HVAC equipment and operation, I was quoted $1,350 for JUST LABOR to install a new inducer motor/housing. (part is normally around $200)

The part was covered under warranty as my unit was only 2 years old, this was JUST LABOR.

I was able to source the part through a licensed tech and install it myself in 10 MINUTES.

4 bolts, a new gasket (included), and connecting quick-connect power for almost $1400???

This may be a fair price in the HVAC industry but in no way could I ever justify paying that price for a 10-minute plug and play install that only required a screwdriver and some common sense.
Do your research before accepting a quote, you may be able to save yourself a lot of money.

reviews.author: Jacqulyn Drake
reviews.text: Not sure if the company is Galbrath and Thomas or prestige air and heat repair, but today 1/14/26 I had a tech by the name of Dave come by and fix my heating system within 30 mins. He was very professional and equipped. His service was speedy and done properly. I didn’t not get his last name and I’m hoping I have his first correct but I anted to give him a nice review because he definitely deserved it!

plumbers.name: Appleton Campbell
plumbers.address: 285 Alwington Blvd, Warrenton, VA 20186, USA

reviews.author: redslay5
reviews.text:
Our journey to Appleton started when DIY troubleshooting did not resolve the issues and after seeing all positive reviews, called up. That day we were able to get a tech out and sales to explain all the options. When I tried doing the same with other companies it was 2-3 days lead time.

The decision to go with Appleton was because everyone on the team is very knowledgeable and is easy to talk to. It really felt like you were not just another number in the system. David was awesome! He answered all my many many questions and told us that our house would support zoning with one unit. This was an absolute game changer for us! We were also told it was take 2 days to install everything but, on the day of the install extra techs came and they all worked hard to get it all done in 1 day! Our system has been running strong with it cooling or heating the house exactly to our comfort level.

If you read this far, in your research you might see that Appleton is slightly more expensive than other companies but, I believe you truly are getting your monies worth due to the skills and the way you are treated as a customer compared to others. For us, that was worth the extra cost.

Thank you for the amazing service!

reviews.author: Peter Son
reviews.text:
We had an outstanding experience with Appleton Campbell Plumbing when they replaced the water heater in my dental office. From the very first phone call to the final installation, everything was smooth, professional, and truly impressive.

First, I really appreciated that Appleton Campbell provided a free estimate. Some of the other plumbers I contacted charged dispatch or diagnostic fees just to come out. I also received estimates from Dad's Plumbing and Heating, All Tech Services, and Home Service Doctors. Not only were their quotes more than double the cost, but they only offered flat-rate pricing without any itemized breakdown or transparency. That was a major red flag for me.

A special thank you to Ken Keller, the Comfort Consultant, who was exceptional. He patiently answered all of my questions and clearly explained the estimate line by line. The transparency and honesty made me feel completely confident in moving forward.

On installation day, Jeff and John arrived right on time and were extremely efficient and professional. They wore shoe covers and laid down floor tarps to protect my office floors — something I truly appreciated in a dental office setting. Their work was clean, organized, and respectful of our workspace.

From the call receptionist, Erin, to the consultant Ken, and the installers Jeff and John — every single person delivered fabulous, fantastic service. This is what true professionalism looks like.

I would give them 10/10 without hesitation and highly recommend Appleton Campbell to anyone looking for honest pricing, transparency, and top-quality plumbing service.

reviews.author: John T
reviews.text: Appleton Campbell delivered outstanding service and support. We were tired of our old plumbing company and their questionable sales tactics. Chris, Jeff and John did a fantastic job! Scheduling was professional and the timing was fast. Chris walked us through our water heater service, expansion tank replacement, replacement valves and water filtration system. His approach was professional and answered all of our questions. Jeff and John arrived on time, protected all work areas and final results were great. They also took the time to answer all questions with our new filtration system. This is a solid company. Very satisfied with the high quality work, professionalism and customer service.

reviews.author: Eric Mellinger
reviews.text:
Update:  Just had the Appleton Campbell Team back to install a water softner, new pressure valve, master turn off valve, and two new sinks after an expert MVP inspection by Chris.  Awesome, professional job by Austin and Devon.  You guys continue to impress!

Stuart Deary, Seth, Scott, and "V" did an awesome job installing our new furnaces, air scrubber, and steam humidifier.  Their professionalism and Competency was very evident.  Wonderful technicians who answered all of our questions.  The job looks super!!

reviews.author: Brandon Kidwell
reviews.text: Technician Riley Woodward was very knowledgeable and added a great sense of security knowing that our HVAC was performing optimally. He explained everything in great detail and didn't make us feel like we were asking useless questions. He expressed his love for being able to explain the way equipment works and that is great to see the enthusiasm. Keep up the good work Riley, appreciate your visit today.

reviews.author: TOEY JAY THE OWNER OF ASIANA HOLMES
reviews.text:
THE HAPPY GUYS HOUSE is definitely the SLOGAN from Arlinghaus HVCA. I called them first thing Monday morning and they came to service call in the afternoon.
My Service technician, Tyler was very friendly and knowledgeable on his profession and explained to me what needs to be done on my Gas Heating. I was impressed on how fast it came out. Thank you, thank you Arlinghaus. I even signed up for a monthly service call membership. I highly recommend Arlinghaus heating and air-conditioning. 5 Five Star.

reviews.author: Dana Burkart
reviews.text:
Austin provided great service, arrived on time, polite, clean, very patient with our many questions. Made evidenced based recommendations, taking our concerns into account. Arranged for a project manager to do a consult same day.

Sam arrived to consult on a new HVAC unit. Also excellent service. More questions answered, honest about what we needed as well as what we didn’t need. Heard our concerns about challenges with heating/cooling our historic home and offered solutions without inappropriate add-ons.

Overall, very pleased with our first experience!

reviews.author: corey sharp
reviews.text: Extremely professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. Could not be happier with our new install. Not only is it a noticeable difference in comfort, but the technicians that installed it had incredible attention to detail ensuring the unit inside the home and outside the home looked as professional as possible. I would recommend Arlinghaus to anybody who wants reliable, efficient, and professional results.

reviews.author: Lindsey H
reviews.text: Pricing structure is deceiving. We called with a clogged kitchen sink and were told $89. We ourselves had already tried clearing the p-trap and snaking the branch pipe before having them come out. We asked if it could be the main line. The plumber walks in, doesn’t even turn on the sink or other faucets to diagnose issue himself and says with certainty it’s not the mainline, it’s a clog in the branch. Their deal is only for the mainline so it’ll be an additional $217 for basic snaking of the branch pipe (which should work since his “is better spin rate than ours”) or $1100 to jet clear the pipe if it doesn’t. I’m sorry, that is ridiculous pricing without any guarantee or trying to confirm the issue first. We refused to proceed without any further validation or assurances so he made us still pay the $89 “for his estimate” and left. Definitely not how you should be doing business. (Yes, we filled out the survey. Yes, we called and were told a manager would call us back. No, no call and all we’ve gotten is a text estimate re-forwarded to us)

reviews.author: Taylor Krmmer
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with this plumber. From the start, they were extremely professional and respectful of my home. They took the time to thoroughly inspect the issue, clearly explained what was causing the problem, and walked me through the best options to fix it. I really appreciated how they made sure I understood everything before moving forward.
The work was completed efficiently and with great attention to detail. It was obvious they cared about doing the job right the first time rather than just rushing through. I feel confident that the repair will hold up long-term, and it’s reassuring to know I can rely on them for future needs.
If you’re looking for someone who combines professionalism, skill, and clear communication, I highly recommend this plumber.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 4480 Bridgeway Ave STE B, Columbus, OH 43219, USA

reviews.author: Nick Lilly
reviews.text:
The technicians that finally showed up saved the rating.

Their offsite call center is among the worst. They quoted me a tech would arrive in 2 hours at 9am on Thursday. I called again at 1pm and they couldn’t tell me anything other than they were behind due to high volume of calls which I understood because of the rain storm. The problem arose when I called again at 7pm and she told me the tech assigned to me was off at 6pm and no one was coming. I had to call for that info. That should have been a phone call to me.

Robert finally arrived at noon the following day and quickly addressed the problem. Quoted me a price that was pretty high based on reviews I’ve read from other companies. I was fine with paying because he was there and had the parts ready and we’re expected to get rain again soon. Robert and his partner did a great and timely job.

reviews.author: S P.
reviews.text:
After dealing with recurring plumbing issues, we feel incredibly fortunate to have connected with Christian from Roto-Rooter. What began as a service call for a standard toilet leak has evolved into a trusted professional partnership; he is now the only plumber we call. Christian consistently makes a stellar impression from the moment he arrives. He is punctual, friendly, and always introduces himself before getting to work. He has earned our complete confidence to the point that we trust him to work unsupervised, which speaks volumes about his integrity and professionalism.
Over the past few months, Christian has navigated us through several complex issues, including a sump pump failure. His approach is both strategic and highly technical. While waiting for parts to arrive, he expertly locked down the affected systems and installed new lines to ensure we remained functional with minimal disruption. He takes the time to explain the "why" behind an issue in plain English and lays out all available options and recommendations without any pressure.
Christian returned to install the new parts the moment they arrived, ensuring everything was back to peak performance. It is rare to find a technician who combines high-level technical skill with such genuine care for his clients. While we hope we won’t need a plumber anytime soon, we know exactly who we are calling if we do. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Kevin Jankowski
reviews.text: We had our garbage disposal go out suddenly and start leaking.  We called on Saturday at around Noon, and our tech, Terry came out ASAP.  He quickly diagnosed the problem, and went to get a new disposal for us.  He installed it fast!  He was extremely nice and very personable.  I'd highly recommend and would use them for future services.  Thanks!

reviews.author: Margaret Hall
reviews.text: Travis did a great job.  He arrived well within the time frame, he diagnosed the problem, and then gave a clear explanation of how to fix it.  He was very upfront about the pricing and what needed to be done.  He was personable, approachable, and easy to work with.  Very friendly and caring.  I appreciate his expertise and hard work.  After he finished with the emergency in the bathroom, he installed a new kitchen sink.  The job took all day and involved back-up help and several trips to Home Depot.  Travis stuck with it and worked hard.  Everything looks great and works perfectly.  Thank you, Travis.

reviews.author: Tayy Fink
reviews.text: Terry came out promptly after my initial call to Roto Rooter and was very polite and answered all of my questions to help me understand my situation. He was able to give me a very well explained estimate today. I just unfortunately did not have the funds at this moment to move forward with work. But I would absolutely recommend Roto Rooter to anyone who needs a responsive and reliable plumber!

plumbers.name: 1-Tom-Plumber
plumbers.address: 24 Whitney Dr Suite A, Milford, OH 45150, USA

reviews.author: Angie Baby
reviews.text: Our 85 year old home has old steel pipes. I was draining dishwater from kitchen sink and water pouring out the basement ceiling. My husband ran upstairs to see what I had done. An hour later (now midnight) he had sawed thru back of under-sink cabinetry and found a rust hole in original drain pipe. The pipe turned a sharp left behind dishwater and down to basement. We knew it would require more than my husband to do all this repair. I checked BBB and Google reviews and 1-Tom Plumber had excellent comments. I made an appointment and Brad was out the next a.m. He did a thorough inspection of the problem and worked out an estimate with the office. He said the job was going to take a big chunk of the day as well as another worker. We paid $99 for his time and efforts. Once we agreed to the work to be done, this money was deducted from our total when the job was done. Brad and Parker did a TON of working; moving dishwasher and stove away from wall, checking roof vents, installing and removing pipes. About 6 hours and everything looked good. Even though the job entailed more work than expected, the estimate stayed the same. This really made a good impression on us. So very satisfied with the professionalism and the skill level shown by these young men. Thanks so much.

reviews.author: Jeff Stover
reviews.text: Totally professional quality work and done when stated for a reasonable price. New water heater and water treatment system installed today and totally satisfied. Brad the plumber gave us an estimate and he came back and installed the job which was great to have the same guy both bid and do the work. I have had One Tom plumbing do all my work over the past 2 years and they are fantastic.

reviews.author: Katlynn Weeks
reviews.text: Cullen came out today to check out our backed up line. He was professional and did a great job, I love workers who come and leave the place without trace of their work. A+ he also has some great jokes!

reviews.author: Tamika Perryman
reviews.text: My family was in need of a pluming company and a friend of mines told me  call 1 ton plumber . I called the dispatch ( Jennifer ) was amazing and another young lady I spoke with. reviews.author: M O
reviews.text:
After I had my first visit, that was part of my HVAC maintenance membership, Casteel recommended over $3000 of changes. I did want to avoid clogs and I did want to avoid mold or bacteria in my system, so I okayed the changes. After they made the changes, there was a weird smell that they told me it was normal and was going to last forever. I then started doing more research. First, their prices were very high compared to other companies, and I wished that I had done more research first (I am including comparative prices below.) Second, they never told me that I would have this weird smell if I did the update to the system. Third, another company said that I probably didn’t need both the capacitor and the hard start kit because they do the same thing. I feel like I paid way too much. I’m stuck with this smell, and I am wishing that I chose a smaller company that would’ve made more reasonable recommendations and had more reasonable pricing.
1. Capacitor replacement – $487

Typical installed cost: $150–$350

2. iFLO automated drain cleaner – $550

Optional equipment most homes do not need.

3. RM2 UV system – $1,911

This is the biggest cost.

Typical installed UV systems:
•	Coil UV light: $150–$400
•	Whole-duct UV purifier: $400–$1,200
•	High-end systems: $800–$1,500

Learn from my mistake here and do better research or choose a different company.

Next, I learned only after The City came to inspect the work, how my cabinets which houses my hot water tank and AC/Heat unit were full of insulation. How dangerous was that! So you see, I would have wasted a day from work waiting at home when the inspectors came the next day instead. This was not because of bad weather. There needs to be a better stream of communication and understanding in the process between ACS and The City so the customer has some idea. I am sure I left a bad taste in my supervisor's mouth, being so out of sorts and leaving work without proper notice. Good customer service comes before, during and after the service, and is more than being nice. These are very kind and friendly folks, TRUE. reviews.author: Sean Ball
reviews.text: After 1 year, this system started to leak. The installer used a stainless supply and coupled it with galvanized connectors for the expansion tank. As a consumer I should not have to double check your work. If it was intentional to create a system that was doomed to fail or negligence on the part of the installers, this should have been caught when the salesman came to inspect the work. Do better.  The labor alone was 2.5x the cost of the entire previous tank replacement.

I'm satisfied and grateful.

reviews.author: Gregg Williams
reviews.text: I must of just been unlucky after looking through all of these reviews. My wife and I just moved into our home and one of the toilets were leaking from the backside. To start off, my appointment was scheduled any time between 10-2. 2 o'clock rolls around, no call/text about the plumber running late because of another job. I waited till about 3 and called their number to see what was going on. The woman I spoke to said she was going to reach out to dispatch or plumber, I can't remember. Another hour passes, still hadn't heard anything. I called again around 4 and they said the plumber was running behind because of another job. I said, "do you guys normally let people know that kind of thing?" The woman said, "yes sir." That's all she said. Anyways, the plumber gets here at 6:30 that evening, you know, only 4.5 hours after the appointment window had closed. He said he needed to change out the bolts and gasket. I said, "okay great." He finishes the work and goes on his way. An hour later I use the restroom and hear dripping from the back of the toilet. So here we are present day. My appointment window was this morning from 8-12. I stayed home from work hoping that they'd get here early enough so I could go in for a half day. It is now 4:16 and 1 phone call later, still no plumber has shown up. Completely unacceptable. The picture shows how much water has leaked since this morning around 7 a.m.

reviews.author: Marco Montalvo
reviews.text: We have used ARS in the past for our AC installation and we continue to use them due to the nature of good work quality and best in service. Our service representative Kevin and are two install technicians  Saul and Paul made our situation and  experience pleasant. Saul and Paul are very knowledgeable and understanding of what to do.  I asked questions and they automatically had an answer and was up to par with the installation. Overall ARS knows how to build their team to provide a good service and product to us consumers. Thank you ARS now our family can stay warm and cool at the same time.

reviews.author: Amiracle Johnson
reviews.text: I needed my main line cleaned out because it was clogged due to some flushable wipes so I tried cleaning it myself for three hours and I saw I wasn’t getting anywhere so I looked on the internet and saw they were running a special for $79 main line clean out and gave them a call. I called them at 4:30 and they were at my house by 6:45. Elijah was out technician and he was great! So polite, knowledgeable, and efficient! Elijah was in and out within 45 minutes! I was super impressed!! What could have been a multiple day issue was resolved in a matter of a few hours. Thank you to this company and thank you Elijah ! Definitely will use this company in the future!

plumbers.name: Stan's Heating, Air, Plumbing & Electrical
plumbers.address: 6016 Dillard Cir, Austin, TX 78752, USA

reviews.author: Chris Lindley
reviews.text: Stan's is great. They are quick to resolve issues with my AC, most recently a total and complete AC replacement.  This job costed near $16,000 and Stan's guys had it up and in the attic, all new ducting, and an outside unit installed in about seven hours. The only reason I wouldn't give them five stars, is a small hiccup caused by a hardware issue.  I don't blame Stan's for the hardware issue that they resolved in 48 hours. I wasn't a huge fan of being asked for payment when my AC wasn't working. I called the sales representative to kindly speak about the hardware issue, and he skips over my concern and starts talking money... well, that was a downer.  Overall result, very expensive job, house seems cooler than it has ever been, work crews and follow up technicians were great.  I highly recommend Stan's for HVAC.

reviews.author: Steph K
reviews.text:
I had Stan’s out on 9/12/25 to replace a metal sheet, clean my drip pan, and replace styrofoam from my previously failing evaporator coil—damaged components from an earlier leak. This should have been covered under warranty, as I had Gold Plan maintenance in March 2025 and renewed.

When they corrected some of the components, they damaged my ceiling and insulation by forgetting to glue condensation tubes, causing a second leak that same day. Weeks of my requests for insurance or reimbursement have been ignored. I had to cut a hole in my ceiling myself on 9/13/25 to prevent mold and have already spent over a thousand dollars on inspections and property damage, with total damages in the thousands.

The HVAC unit still isn’t fully fixed, and I’m left to handle the property damage myself - including mold. As a Gold Plan member, I should be reimbursed directly—not forced to go through my builder, as they suggested. This is untimely, unprofessional, and unacceptable. I cannot recommend Stan’s.

Update 10.23.25: still no direct reimbursement or insurance from Stan’s AC with the property damages.

reviews.author: Larry Dash
reviews.text: Mr Robert Mendoza and Mr Daniel did an amazing Job replacing my evaparator coil which leaked with the new one. He took the time out to explain to me every detail he was doing as I asked questions. They both did a outstanding job. They made sure they put plastic down on my wooden floors as well

reviews.author: Cameron Helweg
reviews.text:
What a horrible experience. Stan's came recommended. At first they seemed great. I spent THOUSANDS of dollars with them. Having them remove my septic system and install lines to the city plumbing. There were some challenges but they stepped up and resolved. Gave them a chance to do some work on my AC but they dropped the ball in getting a fan motor and the work done timely. I was a maintenance director for Target, so I am not unfair in my expectations for service and I have had licenses in both fields so know the challenges.
They just collected 1100.00 for jetting my drain lines again. They had done so right after the septic service 4 years ago (with camera work) so the condition of the lines was known and there was no "build up" concern at either event. Now 4 months after cleaning and with just one person in the house, the tech out yesterday claims the lines are too clogged and will need new lines run. Stuck me for 189 dollars, didn't clear the line and left. Clearly they think I have free cash to just hand over. And if their jetter work is so crappy that it can't clean pipes (as the tech also indicated that jetting now will not work) why was this not a discussion after they jetted it. I called and asked to speak to someone about this, but no one has contacted me. Might seem like a good company if you have money to spend and don't know about plumbing, however, GET A SECOND OPINION before spending with these folks.

reviews.author: Aimee Babbs
reviews.text: Showed up the next morning to check out the situation. Julian Rodriguez showed up later that afternoon with the new hot water heater. He explained everything he was doing during the process. Very thorough, polite & professional. Cleaned up the area he was working in and removed all the debris and old parts.

plumbers.name: Service Experts Beavercreek
plumbers.address: 799 Space Dr, Beavercreek, OH 45434, USA

reviews.author: Tom Rice
reviews.text:
Stan Foss did an excellent job. He knows his stuff. He installed a tankless hot water heating system.
Five days later Stan returned with Miles to make an adjustment and do a checkup. Everything seems good with the dedicated re-circulation line now operating. Thanks!

reviews.author: Roger Holmes
reviews.text: Miles did an excellent job. He was professional, on time, and explained everything clearly before starting the work. The issue was fixed efficiently, and the quality of work was solid. I really appreciated the honesty and attention to detail. I would definitely recommend Miles to anyone needing reliable plumbing work.

reviews.author: Charles Baugh
reviews.text: I was in need of some plumbing work in order to get my house ready for sale.  I had a company scheduled to come out today but they canceled due to all the rain and flooding we've had the past few days.  I called a few places but Stevenson was the only one that could get out to my house today.  Within an hour, Stan was at my house and assessing the broken knob on my main shutoff valve.  He quickly found that I had an outdated main valve and they don't make knobs for it anymore (that's why I wasn't able to find a knob for it!).  He installed a new valve, with a 1/4 turn handle.  The other issue I had was a cold-water hose to our washing machine was locked-tight on the shutoff valve and could not be removed without possibly busting the water line. Stan also couldn't remove the hose with a wrench so he came up with an idea to cut the copper fitting, and the hose was off within a few minutes.  He also went ahead and installed new hot and cold shutoff valves for the washing machine.  Stan is very experienced and knowledgeable, and explained everything he did to me before doing it. He did a great job and he'll be the first one I call in the future.

reviews.author: Aub Holley
reviews.text: Mack Baca from Stevenson Service Experts recently completed my HVAC maintenance service, and I couldn’t be more pleased with the experience. He was extremely thorough and clearly very knowledgeable, taking the time to inspect and clean every component carefully. What stood out most was how much he genuinely cared about the condition and longevity of my equipment. Mack explained exactly what he was doing throughout the service and made sure I understood what steps I should take to keep my system running at peak performance. His professionalism and attention to detail gave me complete confidence in the work being done. I highly recommend Mack and would gladly request him again for any future HVAC maintenance needs.

reviews.author: Diana Battigaglia
reviews.text: Stan Miles did some drain and pipe repair for me.  I had never used Stevenson before, but was impressed with their workmanship.  They even took pictures of before and after as I could not go down to the basement.  Very respectful and knowledgeable.  The only thing I was disappointed was I was not given an itemized invoice or offered one online.  I would, however, recommend them to friends.

plumbers.name: Williams Plumbing & Drain Service
plumbers.address: 10321 E 47th Pl, Tulsa, OK 74146, USA

reviews.author: W Ba
reviews.text: Totally great prices and work from really knowledgeable people. Amazing work on our master bath. Shower a 100% recommend William's plumbing to all my friends and family and anyone looking at this review. This is the second time they've done work for us.

reviews.author: Megan Abbott
reviews.text:
I had three leaks after the freeze last week. I was provided fast efficient service. My technician went over all options with me and got my leaks fixed/pipes replaced with pex for a reasonable price.
Update- changing to zero stars if I could. First off the plumber told me his repairs were under warranty but apparently wrote in the notes he informed me they were not. I don’t appreciate being lied to, but I do take responsibility for not asking to read everything in full as he only gave me the pad with the signature page pulled up. Claimed not having good service and said I would be sent the receipt via email after signing. I was verbally told the work had a one year warranty. (Photo posted because I was never shown this when I signed the electronic pad) I now have leaks where he made new connections because he did not do the work he claimed. I should have inspected myself.
I called Friday and they informed me that it was not under warranty. ( At this time I looked up the receipt via email that was sent well after the service and knew I had been deceived) I informed them I was lied to about the warranty and they said they would have a project manager give me a call to schedule a time to come out. I never received a call. I have been without water all weekend thanks to faulty repair work. Video showing the leaking at the connections. All I wanted was them to send someone out to make it right. I’m being avoided instead. Beware.
**Update again- they called me and claimed they tried to get someone out Friday but were short staffed. I never got a phone call. They said they wanted to get a project manager out to make it right. I went ahead and scheduled and missed a third partial day of work for this. The project manager insisted that the work of the technician was good and it was the polybutylene pipe that was leaking, but as you can see the technician only put in 2” of pex in this area when I was charged for 30 feet total . I asked why I didn’t have pex ran to the connections to the bath connections that were easily accessible with an access panel knowing polybutylene is weak, and I paid for 30 feet and only had maybe 3 feet in total put in. ( picture of cost attached). I was told he didn’t have an answer for that. I just ordered 100 feet for $47. They are having the supervisor look into it. I’m still without water. They didn’t make it right. Instead I’m quoted over 11,000 to replace everything which I am sure was the end goal for the company. Again beware… this company wants to take advantage of people and try to make money. I have everything ordered to fix this myself for less than $100.  Will update when I have it fixed myself which I should have done in the first place. Crooked company.
***Last edit, I fixed the leak myself. I went ahead and ran pex up both sides because I don’t trust the other connection he made would not fail as well. I should have fixed it myself to begin with. I will never use this company or recommend them to anyone.
They could have done the right thing and fixed the leak in ten minutes that was not properly fixed, and I grossly overpaid for to begin with. What kind of company doesn’t take care of their customers? Outrageous. Fixed the leak myself for $100 bucks, and I have 90 feet of pex leftover for future repairs. Thanks for nothing but ripping me off Williams plumbing.

reviews.author: Logann
reviews.text: Ross was awesome! Very nice and helpful! Explained what he was doing and how the system works in a way that I (a non-plumber) could understand. Got here super quick and took care of everything! Also gave me a 30 warranty to come back if the drain continues to have issues. Would recommend and use again!

reviews.author: Kacy Bear 333
reviews.text: Trevor came in a timely manner, was very professional and fixed the problem! He was also very friendly and knowledgeable. Will most definitely call again if I have any other issues! I even got a special price they were running that was almost 50% off!  I appreciate you guys and will send people your way!

reviews.author: Kaity Mackey
reviews.text: I am writing to share my appreciation for the quick and professional service I received. While I initially called for a quote, I was informed of a current promotion that was so competitive I knew I didn’t need to look elsewhere. In addition to the excellent deal, the team was able to come out the same day to assist me. I had previously tried to resolve the issue myself, but I certainly will not be making that mistake again. I am so impressed with our technician Ross and the company as a whole. Thank you so much!!!!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 3961 Pell Cir, Sacramento, CA 95838, USA

reviews.author: Will

Jalen, Raul and Andrew did an amazing job at a fair price. They kept us informed and updated with their progress along the way and did everything they said they would do.
Thanks again guys and we won’t hesitate to refer our family and friends.

reviews.author: Peas and Carrots with Jenny
reviews.text: David was wonderful. Professional knowledgeable and handled the job expeditiously. Truly appreciated his help with a flange replacement to prevent leaking at the base of the toilet in our guest bathroom.

reviews.author: Tyler Ryan
reviews.text: Erick was awesome and had great communication with me. He was very genuine and made sure the job got done correctly and was very friendly. I would recommend to anyone who is looking to have quality service done! I also would like to leave a review for Jeff as he was very kind and thorough and also had great communication and made the process go smoothly. I also worked with Greg who helped the drain cleaning, he knew what he was doing and got the job done in a timely manner. He also was fun to talk to and friendly. Overall had a great team to assist with my issues!

reviews.author: Josh Douglas
reviews.text:
Kelvin was phenomenal. He arrived ahead of schedule. I gave him a break down of the issue. He gave me a step by step of what he was going to do, along with how much each step cost. He was very professional, detailed, and really nice guys. He finished the job and the finished product was exactly what he said it would be.

Jeshua was great. Very transparent and honest. Explained the contract thoroughly. He made sure everything I was signing was detailed and explained. Articulate and professional.

Both exceeded all expectations and will definitely be doing future business with Roto Rooters.

reviews.author: Elias Palacios
reviews.text: Eric and his crew came out and did a water mitigation at our house two weeks ago so our home owners insurance plumber can fix a pipe that burst. Eric did a thorough job removing water and adding absorbent as well to make it easy for our plumber. This past week that repair the plumber did failed and we knew who to call for fast friendly service to once again do a water mitigation. Eric and his team. They came quickly and got the job done. I highly recommend Eric for any restoration project you may need.

plumbers.name: Jim Needham Heating Cooling Plumbing and Drain
plumbers.address: 8700 Grant St STE 300, Thornton, CO 80229, USA

reviews.author: Andrew Land
reviews.text: Joe came out and installed a whole water filtration system at our house.  Joe did a great job and did really great work. Very happy with our decision to use Jim Needham to address our issues with our water.  Joe showed up early and worked all day until the job was done.  Very happy for the results that we got.  We also had them install a reverse osmosis filtration system.  It makes a world of difference.

reviews.author: Ty Hodge
reviews.text: Tyson was great 👍!! Took care of the job fast at a reasonable price. Had a ball valve that gave out for my sprinkler system that was before the house main shut off. Tyson was able to cap the pipe and move the sprinkler system shut off to after the main shut off. I would recommend Jim Needham HCP for your job.

reviews.author: Shawn Vallejos
reviews.text: Isaiah was very informative and forthcoming with what we needed for the installation of our Freedom Water Systems filtration unit.  His planning and execution for our project was amazing.  Do not hesitate to have this team quote your project too.

reviews.author: Morgan Batliner
reviews.text: If you’re searching for a dependable, trustworthy company, look no further. Tyler Weston is the best tech I have ever worked with! When our heat stopped working, he quickly diagnosed and fixed the issue, which was such a relief! From start to finish, he provided excellent communication, also friendly while remaining polite and professional throughout the entire process making everything completely stress-free. I cannot recommend this company enough if you’re looking for top-notch work at a fair price. I’ll definitely be referring them to friends and family.

reviews.author: Randy Sanchez
reviews.text: Jonathan Markus was excellent. Called at 8 and he was here by 10:30. Very friendly, very informative and got my sink drain unclogged in no time. Excellent service from Jon from Jim Needham! I would absolutely recommend and will use them again.

plumbers.name: Lion Home Service
plumbers.address: 4868 Innovation Dr, Fort Collins, CO 80525, USA

reviews.author: Lizet Vasquez
reviews.text: I recently had maintenance work done at my home that involved plumbing (Jerry), electrical(Kyle), and HVAC(Jeff) services, and I couldn't be more impressed. Each technician was highly skilled and professional, addressing the issues efficiently and effectively. They arrived on time, were respectful of my property, and clearly communicated the work they were performing. The quality of their work was outstanding, and I've noticed a significant improvement in my home's systems. I highly recommend their services to anyone in need of reliable and expert home maintenance.

reviews.author: Kelsey
reviews.text:
Dagan and Maddix from Lion Home Service did an amazing job cleaning our ducts! From start to finish, they were professional, friendly, and extremely thorough. They took the time to explain the entire duct cleaning process, including inspecting the system, cleaning all supply and return vents, using powerful vacuum equipment to remove built-up dust and debris, and brushing out the ductwork to make sure everything was completely cleared.
They were very respectful of our home, carefully protecting floors and surrounding areas while they worked, and they left everything spotless when they were finished. You can really tell they take pride in what they do.
We’ve already noticed a difference and feel much better knowing our system is clean. Highly recommend Lion Home Service and especially Dagan and Maddix for anyone needing professional duct cleaning!

reviews.author: Julia Kirby
reviews.text: Jerry Hearn provided the best service and experience.  Very helpful, knowledgeable, and was very diligent in his investigating of the issue. He found and fixed the repair quickly. We highly recommend Lion Home Services and Jerry is your guy. Thank you

reviews.author: Corey Lynham
reviews.text: I was needing a new ac and furnace system and contacted Keith Evans. When Charity came out and looked over our system on a Sunday, she gave us her honest review was kind and courteous and professional.  We ended up needing a new system and Lions was able to send out a team the next day to install a new ac and heating system. Ben Sterkel the electrician was fast, efficient and easy to talk to, Savana Lucas and Pat Yanes were very efficient with the removal of the old units and and installing the new ones. Dagan Chabot and Maddix Torres did a great job with the duct cleaning.  I want to thank all of them for such great work and professionalism.  Thank you all.

reviews.author: jim nelson
reviews.text: I had asked your office to send your your man out with a tall ladder cause I have a 11 foot six ceiling and I need a couple lights, new bulbs and Bella and them which I had which I told your office and he should have a no ladder at all and I had a 10 foot and a 7 foot he picked up the 7 foot complained about it all the time and I told her he would not use the 10 foot because he said he he can’t so he couldn’t reach the ceiling. He said he couldn’t work on it. He said he had to have new fixtures because these are older than used. They’re not older than you. They’re very, very new but way newer than my home said he couldn’t use the bulb even though they’re still in the cage never been used never out of a brand new cage he couldn’t use the ballast because they were still in the box. He didn’t buy them and he couldn’t give up on the ladder cause he didn’t have enough ladder and everything. He said he couldn’t do. It was not a thing that he said he could do so I sent him home.
