plumbers.name: 3 Mountains Home Services
plumbers.address: 9800 SE McBrod Ave, Milwaukie, OR 97222, USA

reviews.author: Lish B
reviews.text: Arin did excellent explaining the work that would be done and was able to answer all my questions. The work was definitely done to our satisfaction and all installation of our equipment, including sinks, and re-piping in the kitchen, as well as gas lines for our range and for outside were done perfectly. This company provides excellent quality control and communication was amazing throughout this whole experience. I would definitely recommend using this company if you want your project done right!

reviews.author: Kira Landar
reviews.text:
Chloe came out to snake my bathtub drain and was very friendly and helpful. She got the job done quickly. She was also able to help me set up a free diagnostic appointment for a bigger issue.

Xerxes then came out and quickly realized our whole pipe system was at risk, even finding a huge crack in a sewer pipe. He took the time to throughly explain everything to us and answer all of our questions, which helped me feel confident in moving forward with the work. He also managed to fix the leak that was the initial issue.

I ended up needing a full re-pipe, including replacing our sewer drain system and a new water heater. Xerxes worked diligently all week and I am incredibly happy with the results. He even went the extra mile by replacing our sink faucets for us, adding an icebox behind my refrigerator for water access to it, replacing our outside faucet with a frost resistant one, adding separated hot and cold faucets to my downstairs sink which previously only had a single faucet, and placing the water shut-off valve in a much more convenient spot. He was also extremely considerate about making sure our four cats didn’t get outside or downstairs where they were working, which is always a source of anxiety for me when people are going in and out of the house.

The finished work is clean, everything is working great, and the inspector was very happy with it. I feel very lucky that Xerxes came by and caught the ticking time bomb that was our previous setup, and am very relieved to be going into the winter season knowing that our pipes shouldn’t have any issues. Xerxes is a legend!!

reviews.author: Loren Guerriero
reviews.text: We called 3 Mountains to fix an issue with the toilet running, and were delighted with everything about working with our technician Megan. She started with the bad news - that we had a larger problem on our hands than a simple leak - the toilet was old and had many components needing replacement or repair. We came to the conclusion that it was time for a new toilet. Megan walked us through the entire process step-by-step, and made it super straightforward for us. She was professional, funny, personable, honest, and knowledgeable, and got the entire job done in a single visit. She even helped us fix a water temperature issue with our bidet. Best of all, the pets loved her, adding their stamp of approval to our own.

reviews.author: julie ward
reviews.text:
I lucked out getting Xerxes to help with my plumbing issues. His communication was excellent, he always showed up on time, and his clean up skills were top notch.
He does very good work.
When the inspector saw the finished job, he was impressed. Everything was done correctly and inspector noted the excellent insulation work and attention to detail.
All around 5-star service.
Great job, thanks Xerxes!

reviews.author: Elin Michel
reviews.text: I cannot say enough EXCELLENT things about 3 Mountains Plumbing. Steven, Felix, Lars, and all of the people who I've worked with on my drain line replacement project have been exceptional. They are professional, communicative, do the highest quality work, and provide the best results. I couldn't be happier with them. Would highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Black Hills, Inc.
plumbers.address: 1003 85th Ave SE A, Olympia, WA 98501, USA

reviews.author: Don Freeman
reviews.text:
Hired to flush slow draining driveway pipe.  Quoted $1500 for hydrojet service.  Technician then refused to flush line due to existing type of pipe.  Only option offered was replacement drain pipe, costing $4500.  Technician was hand digging the drain field.  Since it was nearly noon on a short day I urged him to start next day to avoid being rushed.  Tech "guaranteed"  work finished "before dark".  I asked how much damage to expect was told "you will notice there was a trench".
Unbeknownst to me he had ordered a large backhoe to do the job, not the small ditching machine I thought appropriate.  Excavating badly damaged the root system of the large shade tree that graces our lawn, I expressed concern to be told " tree has lots of roots".  As a former arborist I recognize the peril of such drastic damage.
Little effort was made to mitigate impact to our property, border blocks thrown carelessly on existing plantings, spill dumped widely, turf buried in mud.  Trench was mostly filled in an hour after dark, I  stated that the project was very poorly restored and was told that he "thought it was pretty good considering the time frame".  Remember that I had requested a full day for the work.
The company has offered to send the same plumber out next week to work on the damage, but I have little faith in a worker that reminded us several times that he :is not a landscaper".  I appreciate the offer but will hire a local service, as I am 76 year old disabled veteran and can't do this work myself.
Photos show damage to lawn, plantings, and extent of support and feeding roots destroyed.

reviews.author: Jonnita Thompson
reviews.text: Thank you so much Bryan P! You saved the day! Black Hills will always be my FIRST call from now on! Not only did you fit me into a tight timeframe but you were fast, friendly and efficient! I’m happy to brag about your work! You exceeded my expectations with customer service, excellent communication and quality of work!   Jonnita T.

reviews.author: Trena Brown
reviews.text:
We have had work done with Black Hills in the past. Very pleased with that work.
We had 2 heat pumps installed, this time. What a difference to what we had in a new build.
The lead HVAC tech was Brady.  An amazing and professional young man.  As well as TJ.  Very personable and friendly.  Great eye contact and great care explaining their actions.  To even asking if and what bathroom they may use. Brady is going places in this company.  Our home was his 1st lead job.  I would have never known.
They were on time.  Their truck was immaculate.  They were efficient and cleaned everything up perfectly.  Wore their shoe covers in home. Took off every time they went outside.
We have had the pumps for a few weeks. They are wonderful.
The electrical work we had done in past and these heat pumps did not disappoint. So much so we had a generator installed.
Highly recommend Black Hills.  If they send Brady and TJ they will not disappoint.

reviews.author: Ashleigh Thornburg
reviews.text:
We have had an excellent experience with Black Hills, Inc so far. Fred C came out to help with the install of a new thermostat but after finding an issue with the compatibility he reinstalled our other one. He did a thorough check of the furnace at my request and gave me so much helpful information. Answered every single question i had, made somw reccomendations etc He suggested based on thr 26year old HVAC system that we have in our new home we sit down with a tech and go over what we may want. He was so kind and so helpful.
Alex M came next day to sit down with us to discuss what we are looking for. Like Fred, he was very kind, easy to talk to, funny and well informed. He went over all our options, addressed all our concerns and answered every single question we had. He even looked at our generator and a wall outlet and wil be sending a seperate quote for that.
He got us scheduled right away for the HVAC system install. I can update later on how that goes but I just wanted to shout out both those men as they were both highly professional, kind, informative and thorough. We feel great about choosing to do business with Black Hills, Inc.

reviews.author: Gaspar Garrido
reviews.text:
My experience with Black Hills, Inc. was exceptional from beginning to end.

It began with Devin, who serviced our HVAC systems and recommended the installation of a split unit in our sunroom. From there, David Griffis took the time to provide thorough information and answer all of our questions. He was consistently helpful, knowledgeable, and highly professional throughout the entire process.

Melissa did an excellent job coordinating and scheduling the installation team. One aspect of their communication that particularly stood out was the consistent updates provided through both text and email, including photographs of the technicians and notifications regarding their arrival times. This level of professionalism and customer service was truly impressive.

Brian and his assistant arrived promptly, conducted themselves courteously, and completed the split unit installation efficiently and professionally. Joshua, the electrician, and his assistant then completed the electrical work seamlessly.

Overall, this team of professionals provided us with an outstanding temperature control system that we will greatly enjoy in our sunroom. To further demonstrate their appreciation for their customers, they even sent us a thoughtful gift afterward.

plumbers.name: Jarboe's Heating, Cooling & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 4111 Champions Trace Ln, Louisville, KY 40218, USA

reviews.author: Christina Mercado
reviews.text: I booked an appointment this morning because I was having issues with the water temperature in my bathroom. I was able to book an appointment for them to come within 2 hours. The technician, Jonathan D, was great! He was very communicative, nice, and respectful. He quickly fixed the issue and did not charge me an arm and a leg which I was worried about with plumbing. Highly recommend Jarboe's and will definitely go back again if I have any issues.

reviews.author: Matthew Brett
reviews.text:
I recently had new HVAC units installed by Jarboe’s and couldn't be happier with the experience! Even though I wasn't home during the installation, their team treated my house with the utmost respect, as if it were their own. They completed the entire installation efficiently, all in a single day, which was incredibly impressive.

A special shout-out to Ronnie, who was fantastic. He listened to my needs and only recommended what was truly necessary, without any pressure to buy additional services or products. It's refreshing to work with a company that prioritizes honesty and customer satisfaction.

Highly recommend Jarboe’s for their professionalism, efficiency, and integrity!

reviews.author: melissa Goss
reviews.text: Called because we had no heat (flame issue) and they were able to schedule us in 2 days. They came on time and Matt was amazing! He was able to give me some pointers to help avoid our reoccurring issue and helped save me some money! He was friendly and helpful and the repair was fast. He listened and didn't mind answering any of my questions. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Jaime Bronfman
reviews.text: Very friendly, professional and efficient team. Really appreciated the updates leading up to our appointment. Reasonable rates and we actually paid nothing in the end because they couldn’t diagnose/find the problem. Our issue may have just been ice/temperature related. We will definitely use Jarboe’s again in the future.

reviews.author: Rita Koontz
reviews.text: Drew did a wonderful job explaining our power vent gas water heater and a tankless water heater. He was very professional and efficient. He wore shoe covers and explained everything he did thoroughly.  Thanks Drew! Thanks Jarboe Heating, Cooling and Plumbing!

plumbers.name: Wolfer’s Home Services
plumbers.address: 9025 SW Hillman Ct #3126, Wilsonville, OR 97070, USA

reviews.author: Kara Keels
reviews.text:
Cody from Wolfers did a great job servicing my furnace! He was professional, friendly, and took the time to explain everything he was doing. He also gave me helpful recommendations for a new filter system that will improve air quality and efficiency. I really appreciated how thorough and knowledgeable he was. Highly recommend Cody and the Wolfers team for HVAC maintenance and advice!

Updated 11/25/25
Wolfers recently installed a Pristine Air filter system on my gas furnace, and the whole experience was excellent thanks to both Cody and Greg. Cody handled the HVAC portion, and he was fantastic from start to finish, he is knowledgeable, professional, and easy to work with. He took the time to explain how the Pristine Air system works, what I can expect from it, and how to keep everything running smoothly. He completed the installation efficiently and made sure everything was functioning perfectly before he left. I’m already noticing cleaner air and better airflow throughout the house.

Greg, the electrician, was just as impressive. He was polite, professional, and clearly very skilled. He made sure all the electrical components were installed safely and neatly, and he double-checked everything to ensure it was done right. He also took time to answer my questions and explain each step, which I really appreciated.

Thanks to Cody’s and Greg’s expertise, the system came together seamlessly and looks great. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend either of them, or Wolfers, for any HVAC or electrical work. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sam Berrett
reviews.text:
I recently had a leak under my sink that caused damage. I had no idea how to fix this and called for help from Wolfer's. Within very little time, Joel here with a great attitude and was able to fix the plumbing quickly! He even taught me what the problem was and what to look for in the future. Highly recommended, especially Joel Boren.

2nd visit was today for a completely separate issue with the dishwasher, and once again not only did he show up very quickly, but he was able to once again fix the problem completely and teach me what to look for. Big thanks to Joel Boren!! 😃

reviews.author: RE Bernknopf
reviews.text:
Sept 26th: Wolfer's on site for our annual heating maintenance. Francisco found that the fiber-glass insulation inside our furnace was dropping into our air vents along with some mold. He took photos and videos of the issues so that I could see for myself and he answered all my questions thoroughly. We decided to bring forward our plans to replace our whole HVAC system.

At 5pm, Allen (HVAC sales) arrived to give us a quote for a new system. Allen was super knowledgeable, friendly and genuinely down to earth. No pushy sales tactics here! Talked us through each of the options, and payment plans and we made the sale.

Sept 29th: Wolfer's crew (Andrew, Juan, Tyler, Henry and Enrique) were on site ripping out and installing our new HVAC system. Couldn't believe we could get it scheduled so quick (thanks Allen!). They were respectful of our home and tidied up when they were done. Absolutely amazing team, very thorough, answered all our questions on the new system and quality of the work is second to none! The new system is a dream :)

We're super happy with Wolfer's since we found them a few years ago. Will not go anywhere else!

reviews.author: T.J. Stinson
reviews.text: What can I say except that Wolfer’s is the best! We had multiple electrical projects of various sizes that needed completing including installation of a Ring Camera. Johnny and Enrique were knowledgeable and completed each project thoroughly and were always willing to answer any questions we had. The bid was fair and flexible. They positioned the ring camera perfectly and we get the maximum available view. They also installed two bathroom fans, reconfigured our kitchen wall outlets and upgraded our electrical panel. I highly and unreservedly recommend them.

reviews.author: Sydney Glenn
reviews.text: So professional and straightforward! I had electricians Braxton & Joseph & Tim help me with tuning up my electrical box, fixing a dimmer, installing a vanity light and adjusting my dining room pendant light. They were lovely to work with and did an excellent job. Would recommend to anyone!

reviews.text:

reviews.text: I don’t typically leave reviews, but I have to brag on Louis from Pipe Wrench. This guy is awesome. We called in after hours for an emergency clog and he was on site in under an hour. reviews.author: Spice N WerkoutGloves
reviews.text: Contacted Roto Rooter when I lost the contact info from another company, who had given me an estimate for some cast-iron pipe sewer work on my home. To begin,  Mike & Jonathan showed up on time,  were very courteous, answered all my questions, & addressed my concerns without taking offense. When they actually looked at the issue, they found a completely different situation than what the previous company said. They took their time and spend several hours diagnosing & finding the right repair option. I have no doubt that the previous company did not know where they were talking about. I am happy I was not able to locate their information. Mike & Jonathan were transparent & openly discussed several repair options in an attempt to save me money. We decided on one that worked best, considering my split level home and the way that my waterlines are set up. They struck me as having a lot of pride in their work, being quite honest,  and very professional. So in the end, I will be going with them over anyone else because of this fact and that their work is also guaranteed. Not everything that is cheaper is bette…I highly recommend 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

reviews.author: Jason Murphy
reviews.text: The Roto Rooter team was excellent! Mike (technician) was incredible with communicating the plumbing issues and how to best resolve them. He was prompt, thorough, respectful of my home, and worked intently until the issues were resolved. Nice guy as well! I am pleased with the high quality work Mike and Roto Rooter provided and the price was very fair for such a great service. I will use Roto Rooter again if ever necessary, and would certainly recommend their service to anyone else. Definitely a 10/10.

reviews.author: Miguel Sanchez
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with Jamaal and could not recommend him enough! From start to finish, he showed great professionalism and was extremely respectful. He took the time to explain what the issue at hand was and how he could fix it. We are beyond grateful for his hard work, especially for going above and beyond to make sure the job was done right!

If you are looking for a plumber who is honest and hardworking, Jamaal is who you are looking for.

reviews.author: TaKnesha Hubbard
reviews.text: As you can imagine, having a major plumbing issue first thing in the morning is NOT an ideal start to the day. I called Roto-Rooter and they sent a plumber within an hour. The plumber, AL, was the absolute best that they could’ve sent. He explained what was happening and made the complicated easily understood. He fully replaced my water heater and thoroughly went over the details & warranties of the new equipment. In my time of crisis, AL made me feel at ease. I am grateful for the attentiveness, knowledge and professionalism of the Roto-Rooter staff. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: David Loftus
reviews.text: We have had problems with clogs and slow drains in our basement bathroom for the past few years but other plumbing fixtures in our house were perfectly fine.  Other plumbers have repeatedly plunged and snaked, but our problems have always returned within a few weeks.  Enter Vince from Roto Rooter.  He asked very intelligent diagnostic questions about exactly what we were experiencing, and immediately pinpointed a sewage backup valve sunk in our basement slab.  He explained how a normally protective flapper in the valve can break down and collect debris.  Sure enough, when he disassembled the valve, all manner of debris and backed up sewage came spewing out.  Turns out the other plumbers probably even damaged the valve further as they crudely snaked the lines.  He gave us a less expensive option to try to rebuild the 34 year old valve, or a reasonable price to replace it.  With the repeated problems we've had, we opted to fix it right and replace it. Vince was very polite and conscientious about keeping his work area clean, especially challenging given the nature of the work.  With a new valve installed and our lines verified clear with his sophisticated camera, we are now finally confident that we have the problem solved.  We will be calling for Vince for any future plumbing problems we have!

plumbers.name: Len The Plumber Heating & Air, LLC
plumbers.address: 7 Chelsea Pkwy #709, Boothwyn, PA 19061, USA

reviews.author: Nancy R. Angelucci
reviews.text: Ever do a "happy dance" because the plumber's van is backing up in your  driveway? That's exactly what I was doing.  Never knew how  difficult it is to get service from any plumbing company on the weekend. Have an emergency and it's your worst nightmare! My sewerline was backup and finally exploded. At first there was miscommunication and due to shortage of technicians, holidays and sickness. Doesn't help that I wasn't tech savy enough to reply to text messages once they're sent. No response, they're off to the next assignment. While you're seating at home wondering whats taking them so long to get to your house. When I spoke to the office of Len the Plumber.  I was instructed to shut off my water on Saturday. Unfortunately, no one's available to address my issue until Sunday. Again, no one was available till Monday. Long story short version. Monday morning, I received a call and a text message from Len the Plumber,  I was on the list for a visit. The Ben Harris company apologized via text and offered an $80 coupon😜. The three technicians from Len the Plumber were polite, professional, informative of what needed to be done. So, for now the water is on, showers must be quick. However, laundry and dishes will have to wait until the sewerline is replaced. That's when I'll give out the final stars once the job complete. Job well done 5✨️

reviews.author: Patricia Smith
reviews.text: The service we received was exceptional. My husband and I are incredibly grateful for your company's assistance during one of the most severe snowstorms in over a decade. Your servicemen demonstrated remarkable professionalism. Upon completion of the work, they provided a thorough explanation of all relevant details. Their meticulous approach resulted in an outstanding execution of the task. The area was left nice and neat.

reviews.author: Glenn Sarsale
reviews.text: Jason Green from Len the Plumber came to assess the issues with my existing hot water heater. He was professional, communicative, and punctual throughout the entire process. When it came time to replace the unit, he arrived on schedule, completed the work as promised, and left the area clean and tidy. I had hot water again right on time! I highly recommend Len the Plumber for their excellent service and reliability.

reviews.author: Drew Clark
reviews.text: I feel i was way over charged especially when i pulled the sink from wall and they didn’t reattach sink to wall i probably won’t go back and will cancel my plan i can’t honestly give 5 stars because my clog is cleared, but because i don’t have a functioning sink and i paid a tad under $500. How much would they charged for removing and reattaching the sink another $500? Idk do better this.

reviews.author: Steven Sottung
reviews.text: Mike was outstanding in the service he provided. While he thought it was one issue with our heater, he quickly determined that it was another after troubleshooting. Once he had what he thought was the main issue resolved, which turned out to be a clog in the intake pipe, he found another issue with the thermostat board in the basement. He promised to be back the very next day, which he was, and he and his assistant repaired the thermostat main board. He was cordial and took the time to explain to us the issues and what he was doing to repair the unit. Once we had the new thermostat installed, he walked me through the proper use of the new thermostat. I would recommend Mike to anyone who asked me about Len the Plumber. He was fast but thorough in hisrepair and the system is working fine now.

reviews.text:

They are top notch professional, from our check up with Cori to our consultation with Julian. And HVAC install with Joshua and his team and Electric panel install with Ron’s team, they are all very knowledgeable, installed our systems the next day, with no issues and their labor warranty matches the manufacturer’s warranty 12 year warranty which makes it convenient and gives our family the peace of mind knowing we have someone to call in the event that something happens with our system. His professionalism, attention to detail, and calm demeanor made this a completely stress-free experience. The quality of the work is excellent—everything looks great. I highly recommend Rainer to anyone looking for reliable, top-tier plumbing service.

reviews.author: Alexandra Workman
reviews.text:
We are impressed. We got several estimates for the replacement of our 39-year-old boiler, and we feel that we got excellent workmanship at a great price from Snell. The gentleman who arrived to give us our estimate was able to come the same day we called, and we felt that his wisdom and appreciation for ancient boilers such as ours, combined with his very competitive estimate, made Snell the right choice.
Gabriel and Josh were the technicians (engineers/scientists/artists) who completed the install. These gentlemen did their work with an unexpected level of expertise and care. They were so friendly, and so kind, and took time to ensure that we understood our entire new system. LOOK at our new boiler. It's incredible, and with three separate heating zones in our house (one of which is under the floor), this can not have been an easy job. It was evident in our interactions with these guys that they take a great deal of pride in both the quality of their work and the service they provide to customers. This has not always been our experience with technicians from other companies; Gabriel and Josh are a cut above. Our house is now toasty warm, and we will most certainly be bringing our business to Snell again. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Lori Lenehan
reviews.text: I had Snell install my new HVAC system today. The team of Dan, Victor and Greyson did an amazing job! They arrive probably in the morning, and walk me through the process. They walk me through both the inside and outside installation and systems. They were courteous, extremely knowledgeable about everything and cleaned up the site to where it was better than it even was before. I had looked at a few other companies, however Joseph, the engineer and sales person who came over to make the recommendation was also exceptional. And he’s scheduled an amazing team. I’m switching over to Nell for all my home services. I gave them a 10 out of 10.

Wanting a second opinion, I contacted another reputable and well known HVAC company, and the issue ended up being a simple part replacement costing around $300. That alone speaks volumes.

reviews.author: William Cavnar
reviews.text:
I wanted to add a generator cut-over switch for my natural-gas-fueled heating system so that we could still get heat during power outages by powering the furnace system from a battery backup or a generator. On Dec. 17, 2025 Haley Mechanical sent out a technician, Dustin, to look at what I wanted to do. He understood immediately what I wanted, and he was in and out in under 10 minutes. A few hours later I got the quote for the work. It was a little higher than I had hoped, but I decided to accept the quote, because I was confident that the work would be done correctly.

Because of the holidays, it took a little while to get the work scheduled, but finally on Jan. 15, 2026, another technician named Kaydin came out to install the switch. Again, he knew exactly what to do, and installed the new hardware without difficulty. The whole operation took about two hours.

Kaydin also helped me test the cut-over switch, which we did by turning off the furnace power, connecting an extension cord between my Jackery battery backup system and the cut-over switch. When we flipped the switch from "LINE" to "GEN", the furnace immediately turned on, fired up the boiler, and within a few minutes the system was successfully pumping hot water to all of the radiators in the house. The Jackery indicated that the power draw was between 60 and 70 watts, so I figure that the Jackery could power the furnace for roughly 14 hours, even without re-charging it with the solar panels. So, I was completely satisfied that this cut-over switch gave me the heat security that I wanted. I have attached a picture of the switch and how it is connected to my furnace's power.

I especially appreciated how Kaydin handled the bitterly cold weather that we had that day. I had asked him to bring his equipment in and out through the garage, but to also make sure to close the garage door whenever he was done moving things to prevent heat loss through an open garage. I heard him open and then close the door multiple times, and so our home stayed nice and warm despite the frigid weather.

reviews.author: David Floyd Merchant
reviews.text:
Mark G txted and called to let me know he was 20 minutes out. He arrived during the first hour of the window of time in which I was told to expect him. From the start he was friendly, gracious, patient and kind with my dogs, and very thorough.

He spent about 2 hours going over the AC unit, both the interior and exterior portions. He also did some peripheral inspection of the furnace and water heater. He did both a visual inspection of all of the parts, as well as a lot of diagnostic testing of the electrical components and analysis of air in the intake and outflow pipes. I know this because he was kind enough to let me tag along and watch what he was up to.

Along the way he explained everything, gave me maintenance tips, and offered advice about how long certain things should last and what I might consider doing, and what might not be worth the expense given the age of the system.

I appreciated him explaining things to me because this is the first home with central air that I have owned, and in the months since we bought the house I had realized how ignorant of the system’s  working I am. Also, because we bought the home in the winter, it wasn’t possible for the home inspector to properly evaluate the AC, because it was too cold to switch it on.

For what struck me as a very reasonable fee of $150, Mark not only evaluated and cleaned the AC system, and to some extent the furnace, he also educated me on how this portion of my house operates. Within a couple of hours after our meeting he sent an email with attached docs letting me know the pricing of various replacement options if I decide to go that route. I have a lot more peace of mind now, and for that I am grateful. Many thanks to Mark, and to Haley for making the scheduling easy!

A guy came in after they were all done and ran a camera down the line to show us some damage in our lines and where some roots were growing, which is why we called them to get the roots out of our line, and gave us a price to have that fixed.

Of course Roto Rooter being a name brand is very expensive. We can not afford a price that would be a third of value of our whole house to reline the  existing pipes.  17,000 was the quote for that.

However, they did clear the drain and the toilets flush once again. I mean without filling up our basement I know that’s gross. This clean out by it's self was a $500 service which is about triple what my regular local guy charges who has been or guy for 30 years and twice as much as any independent people.  I paid because Roto Rooter is trusted name and none of the others could get there soon enough.

Although the price was high, the service was great. It was certainly worth it to me to be able to use my plumbing again in a timely manor.

Well, I’d always recommend my regular guy big Josh, plumbing. Because he’s all the things that these guys were a little over half the price if you can’t get josh. Try Roto Rooter

I’ll give him five stars because my technicians were excellent.

Here some pictures and one of an eagles cause I got out in time to go take the pictures

reviews.author: Ron J
reviews.text: Prompt service.  Although the technician was unable to clear this outside underground drain, he made a good attempt and gathered enough diagnostic info to determine that the corrugated tubing had probably collapsed.  I was totally satisfied with the effort.   He was totally up front with the chances of success (didn't make any wild promises) and the initial costs ($499 for service call and first hour).

reviews.author: Angela Roberts
reviews.text:
Tim B. (Tech 617) came out and repaired issues I had in 2 bathrooms. He was patient, thorough and explained everything and the repairs didn't take long at all.
Greatly appreciated, fixed issues ive been dealing with for years.
Will definitely use again for future repairs.

reviews.author: Zain Khan
reviews.text:
I scheduled a service appointment with Roto-Rooter for an 8:00–10:00 AM window and not a single person showed up. This is easily one of the most frustrating and disrespectful service experiences I’ve ever dealt with.

I sat around waiting the entire morning while they kept changing the technician’s ETA over and over. Every time I called, I got bounced around on the phone with no real answers. It felt like they were just wasting my time. The technician wouldn’t even pick up the phone when I tried to call.

If you give someone a time window, show up or at least communicate honestly. Don’t leave customers waiting around for hours with no explanation. This kind of service is unacceptable and completely unprofessional.

Since nobody from this company could handle a simple appointment properly, I will also be issuing a formal complaint to corporate and filing a complaint with the Better Business Bureau. People deserve to know what kind of service they might be dealing with before wasting their time.

plumbers.name: Steve’s Plumbing & A/C Service
plumbers.address: 99-1265 Halawa Valley St, Aiea, HI 96701, USA

reviews.author: jean creadick
reviews.text: Jeremy and his assistant James were awesome, they installed my new water heater and timer with great attention to detail.  Jeremy, as the lead, is very knowledgeable and respectful of his assistant, which says so much right there.  He was thorough, knowledgeable, focused and respectful throughout the process.  I would call him again if I had any other plumbing issues.  Highly recommended.  Thank you, Jeremy and James!

reviews.author: Janice Kamai
reviews.text: Jeremy my plumber was awesome! He explained in detail the options on my shower valve and washer pipe fixture’s where I could understand. Excellent service, very respectful, and fast at getting the job done. He came immediately on an after hours on-call and I appreciated that. I would recommend this company and him to many. I chose Steve’s Plumbing because I see the van mostly everyday in Waianae and knew they must do great service and…he proved it. Very satisfied customer. Thank you Jeremy.

reviews.author: Sarah Lee
reviews.text:
The technician came to look at my AC unit and find out what is wrong with and fixed it. It took him about 90 minutes all together except for the time he was waiting for his coworker to drop off the part.

This company charges a flat rate for the job they do and will not itemize the cost of parts or labor.

My invoice only stated that it cost $533.00 to
replace the electrical connector.

I got a $100 discount because they had cancelled my appointments twice previously.

The technician was suppose to get back to me about returning to clean the AC, but I never heard from him and he never replied when I texted him.....it makes me regret giving him a tip the first time.

However, it worked out better because I don’t wanna spend another $500 just for the cleaning.

In my opinion, this company is a total rip-off.

reviews.author: Cathleen Matsushima
reviews.text: Was able to book same day on a Sunday.  From dispatch to appointment the customer service was outstanding.  Finally after living in our home for 20 plus years a plumber took the time to explain why our water valves weee failing so often.  Calcium!  We could tell this plumber cared about us and not just about getting paid.  Jeramy Thomason was amazing! 100 plus stars for caring and explaining how we can prevent this cycle of valve failure.

reviews.author: Tara Lynn
reviews.text:
Could not have asked for better service. Zach was able to get to the house and provide quotes and a clear explanation as to what was needed. He answered every question and explained anything that a non-plumber  wouldn't understand.

Soloman was outstanding. Showed up on time, worked efficiently, communicated clearly, and handled unforeseen issues professionally. When he finished, he left the space spotless.

plumbers.name: Logan Services A/C, Heat & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1200 Industrial Park Dr, Vandalia, OH 45377, USA

reviews.author: Jeff Dekker
reviews.text: Install team showed up promptly and started replacing the furnace, they explained what to expect while they were here.  They cleaned up very thoroughly and explained the work they had done, and how to change the filters, care for the humidifier and operation of the thermostat.  Was very impressed with their friendliness and professionalism.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Brian Bernhardt
reviews.text: We had a very professional installation of a new HVAC system from our comfort consultant Steven J. to our installers James an Blake. Price was unbeatable! All 3 were friendly and explained everything that was going to happen. Installers took their time to ensure everything was correct. Then did an excellent job of cleaning up.

reviews.author: ITz DewieJR
reviews.text: Logan Services did a fantastic job assessing my heating problem with my 31 year old Trane furnace. It was discussed with Anthony (repair) what my options were and he was honest and friendly trying to find the best solution for me. Brett came shortly after and was extremely thorough and a pleasure to work with when deciding which new furnace to get. Installers Nathan and Devin did a fantastic job installing my new Trane furnace and the finished product not only looks clean but performs top notch. Thank you Logan Services for your help and great staff members!

reviews.author: Mya Litt
reviews.text:
*** update*** Beyond pleased with the system I had installed today. For 2 years, I would not get good heat upstairs in my Cape Cod. Tonight, so much heat blew that I had to turn down the temp to 68! I never imagined my upstairs could get so hot!!! Thank you Logan for changing this!!!

As a former employee when I needed a new furnace Logan was my first choice to call. Honest, trustworthy, customer centric, and reliable would be how I described my experience.

The home warranty company would not cover a cracked heat exchanger and the company they sent wanted an exorbitant amount to replace. Logan, gave me an honest and beyond fair price for the same replacement. Logan also included updating my flue pipe that the other company wanted to charge me extra for.

If you are on the fence about an having to replace or repair your heating, cooling or plumbing needs, I would definitely recommend this company.

Thank you Steven Jones for getting me a great price along with quick and easy financing. Also to Bobby & Blake for doing an awesome job with the install. You all rock!!!

reviews.author: Cheri Lavender
reviews.text: Professional work! Replaced our 21+ year system and identified a coolant line that was too small per new code. Work was completed in 8hrs. Including stringing a new coolant line without breaking through walls. They cleaned their area and hauled the old systems away.  New "Trane" system is definitely superior. reviews.author: Lindsay Jazwinski
reviews.text: Best experience I’ve had with any home maintenance problems. Quick with scheduling, even quicker and more efficient during actual appointment. Will be having them back to assist with a non emergency issue next month. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Phillip Withers
reviews.text: Ethan was very professional as well as the entire team... from assessment to estimating and scheduling, the process was seamless and I was kept in-the-loop the entire time. I've been calling on A1 for many years for my plumbing needs and they have never failed to deliver quality workmanship. In this case, they were dealing with the gas water heater I had purchased and they had to modify the height of the stand due to height differences from old to new, which was done in short-order. reviews.author: Christina Porter
reviews.text: OMG! FAST! I’m a short term rental Airbnb host. I had gas leak on my water heater. The gas company shut the valve off and RED tagged it! I had a house FULL of guests that were at work. I GOOGLED and found A1. Took a chance and called. I managed to get squeezed in same day! The young man came in to fix the problem just before the guests came in from work! I never had to alert my guests about the issue and didn’t have to lose in my reviews! A COMPLETE WIN! A1 lives up to the hype!! My technician was AMAZING! He shared pieces of jerky for my fur babies! He was professional, unbiased, and clean. He was in and out! My boys needs a raise or promotion to lead technician or something!

reviews.author: Amber Wirth
reviews.text: I’ve used A1 many times through my job and have always had great experiences, so when I had a major water leak at my home, they were my first call. Adam arrived quickly and got straight to work. He was extremely professional and took the time to explain exactly what was causing the issue and how he planned to fix it. I was very impressed with how knowledgeable he was and how efficiently everything was handled. I’m very pleased with the outcome and how fast he was able to help during a stressful situation. Highly recommend A1 and Adam!

reviews.author: Lauren Loomis
reviews.text: As a local Realtor, I confidently refer my clients to A1 Sewer & Drain for all their plumbing needs. Their customer service is outstanding, they are incredibly responsive, and they always handle issues with professionalism and expertise. It’s so important to have vendors you can trust in this industry, and A1 consistently delivers. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jeanne Palanci
reviews.text: We had a major plumbing issue in the kitchen. Technicians Charlie and Logan spent 10 hours completing the job. Even on hour 10 they were upbeat, friendly and finished the job perfectly. Great Techs, great company!

reviews.author: Barney Rowe
reviews.text:
I had a frozen and busted water line in my wall. The service was prompt, very professional and Charles had a wonderful attitude, very friendly and knowledgeable.
He wore booties through the house so he didn't track in snow and mud. The pricing was super fair and affordable. I could not be happier and I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Erin
reviews.text: New HVAC unit installed today—both furnace and AC—and the entire experience was outstanding from start to finish. Our salesperson, Mark, was incredibly helpful, knowledgeable, and kind, answering every question and guiding us through the process with ease. The installation team was just as impressive: punctual, efficient, and extremely respectful of our home. Everything was completed smoothly and with great care. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Whitey Kollmeier
reviews.text: Woke up to no hot water on a Saturday with a 1 degree temperature outside and called your service line. Nick was here in less than two hours to replace the thermostat on our tank. Professional, courteous and competent. Outstanding service!! Thank you.

reviews.author: Dana B
reviews.text: I called Schneller Knochelmann when my furnace stopped working.  The technician told me it could be repaired, but strongly pushed replacing the entire unit instead.  They used aggressive same-day sales tactics, saying the quoted price was only valid that day. I agreed to the replacement and have regretted it ever since.  From the moment the new furnace was installed, it was problem after problem.  Right away, it couldn’t cool the upstairs at all. We had multiple nights where the upstairs temperature was over 80 degrees.  Schneller Knochelmann sent several different technicians, and required multiple follow up calls from me before they admitted that the furnace had been installed incorrectly and sent a more senior tech to fix it.  Only then did it finally cool the upstairs properly.  Fast forward to the following winter where we called them again due to an odor. Their technician said there was a gas leak in the furnace and that a special part had to be ordered to fix it.  After the part was installed, though, the odor continued, so we called a plumber, thinking it might be a plumbing issue.  The plumber could not find any plumbing issue and when I mentioned the previous gas leak in the furnace, he asked if he could check it.  Good thing he did because he discovered that it was still leaking gas.  He said the gas line connection at the furnace was done terribly and was leaking - he fixed it immediately.  Unfortunately, it didn’t end there.  A couple of months later, the furnace stopped blowing hot air altogether.  I called a different HVAC company, and once again, the issue was traced back to incorrect installation by Schneller Knochelmann.  The new HVAC company fixed the problem and I will be using them from now on.  Between the aggressive sales tactics, repeated installation errors, constant follow-ups required on my end, and a gas leak that was never properly fixed, my experience was extremely frustrating and alarming.  I strongly recommend staying as far away as possible from Schneller Knochelmann.

plumbers.name: Superior Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3991 Royal Dr NW, Kennesaw, GA 30144, USA

reviews.author: Doug Lynn
reviews.text:
Fantastic experience with superior today!
Water heater was leaking it was Saturday and Chelsea answers the phone immediately no holds at superior and was able to get me in same day with the most fantastic tech
Joel came and took out the builder installed water  heater and installed the new one. His work is a work of art . He took a bunch of jumbled pipes and elbows fittings and cleaned them up and re installed everything to perfection. He is talented, experienced and  I was fortunate to have  a dedicated master plumber perform the replacement especially on a Saturday
Thanks to superior plumbing once again for being there !

reviews.author: Andrew King
reviews.text: Superior plumbing was fantastic from start to finish. 1) No issues with required COI. 2) Easy and quick appointment scheduling. 3) Great communication from both the home office and texting about technician arrival.  4) Kyle was a great plumber who fixed our issue quickly, quietly, and thoroughly.  He was very friendly and helpful including great tips to prevent the issue from happening again.

reviews.author: Tom Vadnais
reviews.text:
I've been using Superior Plumbing since I bought my house new more than 35 years ago. They've done everything from rebuilding toilets and replacing faucets to installing a sink with pump in my basement/garage below drain level to replacing the entire drain piping from the house to the sewer. They have always been timely, efficient, and clear about the services they recommend and their prices.

I'm fortunate to have Seth Gregory as my regular plumber. It's great that I've gotten to know him and that he knows what has been done previously. He really does care that the right things are done and done properly. Their office phone is always answered live and all are helpful—even just to answer questions or get advice. True pros. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Dominic Capraro
reviews.text: Went with Superior to install two faucets. Booking was easy and they were able to get me scheduled right away.  They also listened to my directions and arrived precisely on time.  My plumbers--Andrew and Damon--were professional and up front with pricing.  They did a terrific job with the installation and it was completed very quickly.

reviews.author: Justajanine Hagans
reviews.text:
Ronnie was excellent.  He was
Professional and did a great job.  He was kind and knew what he was doing.  Loved that he had everything he needed on the truck and got it all done in one day.  Great service.  Loved that I called yesterday and was able to get an appt and he even got here early.  He took his time and knew what he was doing.  He explained everything in detail.  I’m was happy that I got it fixed right.

reviews.author: Chris Zentz
reviews.text: Today is Tuesday. Last Wednesday woke up in the wee hours to no heat. Long story short, called during regular hours, tech came out, fixed the problem. He asked some questions that I answered honestly. My furnace was on borrowed time as was my water heater (that I knew). He gave me a quote for both to which I agreed. Today, lead tech calls me at 8:30 AM, arrives at 9:15. We go through everything. Not sure when the other 3 techs showed up, but they were done and gone by 1:45. All were respectful of me and my property, and they explained it all to me and answered all my questions. Yeah, I am very happy! I did business with them when it was just Falls Heating and Cooling and I will continue to use them now that they are Sal's. I do recommend them and will do so to anyone who asks or who tells me of needing  someone that does what they do. I'm a boomer. I've dealt with a lot of companies that do the same stuff. I will stay with Sal's.

reviews.author: Carolyn Pettus
reviews.text: My technician was Mark Capitoni, he phoned to let me know his ETA,  my appointment time was between 3-5pm and Mark arrived around 3:15, which I was happy with not having to wait an hour or close to the scheduled appointment time. My gas furnace couldn't be repaired, so I had to buy a new one. Mark was pleasant and very personable; he patiently took the time to make sure I understood exactly what equipment I needed and why to complete the job and informed me about the different financing options available as well as providing additional discounts that helped lower the total cost in getting the job done properly.

reviews.author: Ski Ba
reviews.text:
Called Sals from a reference. They sent a tech out and he camera'd my furnace. Showed me the massive split in my heat transfer. He explained thoroughly my options. Let it run and risk real bad stuff or replace the unit. I replaced the unit. Cody dispatched them out within a week and I had a new furnace installed no issues. Been a few months since the install and everything works perfectly. They are fast, efficient and honest. If you are looking for a review of Sals that isnt AI generated or an angry Customer mad they let their furnace go and dont have the immediate funds to cover, here is your review. The only issue I had with the service was that the guys didn't accept my tip, or the white monster cans I left for them as a gag gift.

If you want a cheap service that will leave you hanging try another business. If you want a fair price for a reasonable turnaround that is covered under warranties, give Sals a call.

reviews.author: Jessica Alban
reviews.text: Furnace stopped working mid morning and they were able to schedule a technician to come out same day (hector was SO great!!), he was able to troubleshoot our issue quickly and efficiently. I was very pleased with the expertise and swiftness of response & action and although we needed a new furnace, I felt all of my questions were answered, discounts were applied where applicable, and it was a fair deal. Very satisfied with my experience and will request hector moving forward.

reviews.author: Toni Monroe
reviews.text: The salesman was nice, very polite. He promised he had emailed me an estimate for the replacement of my hot water heater, but it was really just a short message about visiting the place. There was not a single bit of the information I needed and not a single number related to the $2500 estimate he showed me on his tablet. He did tell me Sal's was no local company but a corporation out of Texas. I also knew from my own research that his estimate contained many upcharges and is possibly the reason why I didn't get a written record of things I didn't need. Theirs was the highest estimate of many. I decided to use a local company.

reviews.author: Tara Falcone
reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience from start to finish with my HVAC installation, and I want to recognize a few people who truly went above and beyond.

Jason Fortney and Cory Glacé were the technicians who installed my system, and they were absolutely top-notch.

They were professional, respectful of my home, and clearly very knowledgeable about what they were doing. They took the time to make sure everything was installed perfectly, explained things clearly, and left everything clean and in great shape. You can tell they take pride in their work, and it shows.

I also want to give a big shoutout to Brett Yeagley, the sales representative. From the very beginning, he was professional, honest, and easy to work with. No pressure, just straightforward information and great communication the entire way through.

The entire experience from sales to installation was smooth, efficient, and exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend HL Bowman to anyone looking for quality work and a team that truly cares about their customers.

Tara Corbin

reviews.author: Maryann Brunner
reviews.text: My husband, Troy, was the one that dealt directly with everyone. He says, "5 stars, everyone was just perfect!" From the swift response when our furnace went out, to the end result, we couldn't have asked for better service. In these frigid temps, they even replaced our AC unit! There were 4 different employees at our home, and every one of them was simply wonderful. They were even great with our dog! My home was left clean, neat and undamaged. If I wouldn't have known that the furnace and AC unit were replaced, "I wouldn't have known."  Simply FANTASTIC SERVICE, for which we are so thankful!

reviews.author: Janelle Normand
reviews.text: We recently had a geothermal unit installed by David J and his team. They were outstanding from start to finish. Arrived on time, were kind and courteous throughout the entire process, and clearly very knowledgeable. Our job was complex with many moving parts and it was all seamlessly handled. They took the time to explain things, worked efficiently, and kept everything clean and organized while in our home for multiple days. The pricing was fair and honest, with no surprises. We truly appreciated their professionalism and would recommend them to anyone needing HVAC or geothermal work done.

reviews.author: Scott Thatcher
reviews.text: I had Ryan and Corbin come out to replace and haul away my furnace and AC. These guys were very friendly and worked swiftly, but diligently. They arrived in the early morning and we finished up by mid afternoon. Ryan took time to show me how to use the new thermostat and explained thoroughly. Overall, their work looks great and my house is back to being warm.

reviews.author: Jane Iaderosa
reviews.text: We had HL Bowman come and install a UV light and a HEPA filter on our HVAC system in March. Part of the package is to have a complimentary system check. The tech came out today and inspected the outside unit and the unit in the basement. We were told the compressor  was not working properly and would need to be replaced.  We didn't have any issues prior to him coming out, so  I called Bowman to explain this. I received a call at 6:30 PM the same day from the service manager, Bob Seeger. He took ownership of the issue and  asked me how they could make things right. Even though it was late in the day, he offered to have someone come back at take a look at the unit. He said to give him 10 minutes and he would call be back. True to his word, he had Kiel come out and he was here within 40 minutes. Kiel did a thorough inspection of the unit and it turned out the capacitor was bad. Kiel had one in his truck and within minutes, we were back in business!! Bob kept checking back with me to make sure I was satisfied with the resolution and that we were up and running. I can't say enough good words about how he handled the customer service aspect of this. Both Bob and Kiel earned my utmost respect. It's refreshing to find a company that exhibits the true meaning of customer service and instills confidence in their customers.

plumbers.address: 518 Running Pump Rd, Lancaster, PA 17601, USA

reviews.author: jr111965
reviews.text: Needed kitchen and bathroom faucets replaced. Easy to schedule with a convenient time for installation. Very satisfied and Jon was very pleasant and easy to deal with. All are highly recommended!

reviews.author: NUTELLY woo
reviews.text:

He was professional, courteous, and clearly knowledgeable about his work. Matthew took the time to complete the job efficiently while still paying attention to detail, and everything was finished in a timely manner.

I especially appreciated his kind and respectful demeanor throughout the visit. He worked neatly, communicated clearly, and made the entire process smooth and stress-free. It’s always refreshing to work with someone who is both skilled and personable.

I would absolutely recommend Matthew Stover to anyone in need of plumbing services and would gladly have him back for future work.

reviews.author: Christina Fleisher
reviews.text: Todd did a fantastic job when he came out.  He explained the process of the work he was doing and was very thorough to ensure it was done correctly. They timely sent out a crew to dig up the pipe that was causing problems.  Everyone was very kind and hard working. They were even careful to leave our sidewalk intact,  when we had anticipated it being demolished.

reviews.author: Nathan Hollenbach
reviews.text: I had a Friday night plumbing problem. I called BFP and Joe was there in an hour. He was polite and honest, he worked till 9pm to get my shower valve replaced, added a new faucet kit! He interacted with my wife and 3 children in a friendly and thoughtful manor. I will certainly recommend him! 5🌟s!

reviews.author: M Wlms
reviews.text: Todd was extremely professional. He took the time to help me understand what the issues were along with the options for repair. reviews.author: ryan suanico

We scheduled the work to be complete the following day. Zach arrived with another worker (Tanner) right on time. The two got to work and completed the job without issue. Thank you.

reviews.author: Jamal Stewart
reviews.text: Called this Saturday at around 11am and Tom was at my house to assess the situation by 2pm! Hot water heater needed to be replaced! Tom came back on Sunday to ensure me and my family had hot water immediately on his day off and we are very grateful for that level of commitment and support!  Customer service was outstanding and installation was outstanding! I would 1000 percent recommend R&R Plumbing for your issues! Make sure to ask for Tom! Thanks again!

reviews.author: Marissa Orr
reviews.text: We have hired R & R for several plumbing issues. They were always readily available, professional, and knowledgeable. Recently, we hired them to repipe the house. They finished the work quickly so that we wouldn't be without water for too long. They also did a great job staying after the job was done to make sure that the house was clean and all of our furniture was moved back into place. They are definitely all about having excellent customer service and quality work. Thanks R & R!

reviews.author: Jeremy Smith
reviews.text: Turner and Monique were fantastic!  Turner was very professional and friendly and did great work.  We will definitely use them for our next remodel and would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Angela Busybee
reviews.text:
Need a plumber? Jason’s your guy! They just opened up servicing Riverside and they just happened to give me a same day appt! I got lucky…No fee to come and check out my little plumbing problem under the bathroom sink.

Jason was super nice. As a female, I felt comfortable being alone with him in my home. He explains everything in simple terms and is not over bearing like talking too much or too little.

He gave me a quote, which I’m not sure if it was reasonable because I’m selling the house and just needed it done. He was able to replace all the pipes underneath the sink so I was relieved he didn’t have to come back another day. Then I had him quickly fix a clogged sink in the other bathroom!

He explained that everything was functioning properly and if any problems arise in plumbing, heat/air and electrical equipment, just give them a call. I promise I will.

reviews.author: Michael Zibert
reviews.text:

Marion showed up on a rainy day and was very courteous and professional being very careful not to track mud into our home.  Marion made quick work of the quote and repair and informed us of our various options along the way.  I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Marion and
Five Star again.

reviews.author: Yvonne Littlejohn
reviews.text: The technicians were personable, professional, and explained everything until I had a thorough understanding of the situation. Today my new heating system was installed. Tony and Kevin were excellent. They were prompt, worked diligently, very friendly and respectful of my property and me. They answered all questions in a knowledgeable manner. They were so easy to communicate with, GREAT young men! Rolando was great. He was everything I expect from this company_ personable, professional, expert, etc....!

reviews.author: Cam C
reviews.text: The initial interaction with the company started a little rocky for full transparency. However, they responded well and promptly. The service technician that came out in response was very capable, apologetic and accommodating. He solved our HVAC issue and miscommunication with the company. His name is Luke Eichmann, for those interested. This company is worth looking into and worth the try. Ms. J Pulphus

reviews.text:
Recently, Donnell came to our house to do a yearly inspection of our furnace.

reviews.author: Michael Mabe
reviews.text: Having the right light fixture in a room makes all the difference, hiring the right person to install it is twice as important. Ethan Knoer, the electrician who installed my dining room light,  embodied the perfect professional for the job! Professional, courtesy and attention to detail were his trade in stock! Five star review for this young man. From moving the fixture to the center of the room, solid installation, clean up, even having the right cap for where the old fixture was made for the perfect experience. Even offering to help move furniture back was what  elevates the experience. If I could give him 6 stars, I would! I would go with Advance Services again and would request  Ethan every time. Thank you Advance Services and a big thank you to Ethan Knoes for a job well done

reviews.author: Ashley Louden
reviews.text:
We can’t say enough great things about Joseph Redmond with Absolute Services. Because of how much we trust his work, we purchased their lifetime membership (a one-time $100 fee), which includes free yearly maintenance and free inspections, and it has been more than worth it.

During his most recent maintenance visit, Joseph took the time to thoroughly inspect everything and helped us understand that our hot water heater is over 20 years old and past its life expectancy, allowing us to plan ahead before it fails unexpectedly. He also helped us figure out why our toilet wasn’t working properly and explained that it needs to be replaced. What really stood out was that he never once pressured us to buy anything or upsell services—he simply provided honest, knowledgeable advice so we could make informed decisions.

This wasn’t our first great experience with Joseph. Last year, he came out to help us fix our outside faucets that broke during the winter, and once again he was professional, efficient, and incredibly helpful.

Joseph’s customer service has been outstanding every single time we’ve worked with him. He is knowledgeable, patient, honest, and genuinely cares about his customers. Absolute Services is very lucky to have him, he is a huge asset to their company, and we always feel confident knowing Joseph is handling our plumbing needs. We will always request him for our plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Dedra Thomson
reviews.text: Thank you Brad and Absolute Services. Brad arrived on time, was easy to talk with to make sure we were on the same page installing my chandelier and he even insisted on cleaning up! Ask for Brad. Thanks for a job well done

I had plumbers, workers that took out the pipe, some with cameras, some that put in the new pipe and mixed the cement to cover it all up.  I have pictures and an estimated bill that they went over with me. I am now going to file a claim with my Insurance company to see if I can get some of the money back and they have a special person who just does claims that is working with me. reviews.text: We had a leak in our circulation pipe. A team came out to assess and determined it was a break in the pipe in the slab. It was going to require a different team to come out. He used a small hand  jack hammer to do the job.  He replaced the pipe and then came back the next day and filled in the cement. He did a very clean job and it looks great. He is an excellent plumber. Very experienced and personable.  Our only complaint was We felt the price was high considering it took in all about 5 hours.  We thought the price quoted was because they thought they would have to pull our hot water tank but Mullins standard slab leak price “starts” at $3500. If cost isn’t an issue I would highly recommend using Mullins; however if cost is an issue then you might want to check with other plumbers.  We have used Mullins on several jobs over the years.

reviews.author: Cristal Herrera
reviews.text: Fernando Garcia provided optimal customer service. He conducted a thorough inspection of my air conditioning unit and figured out what was causing the circuit breaker to trip. He explained what he was doing each step of the way and what the numbers, that were coming up on his gadgets, represented. He provided me with detailed recommendations based on his findings and a clear explanation so I could understand why these recommendations were needed. All in all I am very satisfied with the service Fernando provided. I would definitely recommend this company!

reviews.author: Astrid Ruefli
reviews.text: We had our HVAC tune-up service today. The tech left greasy finger prints all over the access panel (see picture). All he did was take picture of our system and said we needed to get it replaced. He called a project manager who arrived within 30 minutes and gave me a quote for 42k to replace our current system with a heat pump system. No need for new ducts or electrical panels, so this price was just for labor, permit, and two 4 ton heat pumps. The quote was not itemized and this was after a $2k ‘discount’ for being members of their annual maintenance plan. The project manager then proceeded to tell me that if I waived the 3 day cancelation they could install on Monday and he could reduce to $35,980 because he had a job that they finished a job early and needed to get the crew on a project Monday to fill a scheduling gap. I felt pressured and the lack of transparency on the breakdown of cost of labor and the heat pump system made me feel really uneasy. I don’t doubt that we need a new system but the sales tactics and pressure was very unprofessional and I can see that a lot of vulnerable people with good credit ratings would end up using their financing option and just going for this type of sales tactic. Be careful and make sure you ask for break down if cost of labor vs equipment.

reviews.author: Tanya Byers
reviews.text: I recently had an HVAC Service home appt with Technicians Joshua and Raul. Both young men were professional, friendly and very respectful of my home. They spent an adequate amount of time with me, listened to my concerns and explained the next steps. I loved that Joshua took photos of my furnace after he inspected it, pointed out and explained the problem areas of concern. He also provided me with solution based options. I felt like they understood my concerns and Joshua went as far as to reach out to his superior who also scheduled an appt to come out to my home the following day. I appreciate that Anderson has been in business for many years and have employed many skilled technicians with expertise  in various specialized fields.

I would highly recommend Kristina for any of your plumbing needs.

Then the manufacturer failed to put in the vent that goes on top of the heater. After half an hour of looking then another twenty minutes of phone calls with me helping him on a couple he found one at Red's Plumbing. He drove up there and bought the last one. Rheems fault.
Things happen. We have water though.
I work nights. It's going to be a long night  on two hours of sleep.
The install looks sharp. Thank you.
The end. Zzzzzzzzz

reviews.author: Kelly Williams
reviews.text: Amazing company, amazing service. I had an emergency plumbing issue, a sewage stoppage, so I contacted 5 Star due to the great reviews. Amir came out the next morning and cleared everything for me. He explained everything he needed to do and was so friendly and professional about it. He cleared the problem, which I thought would take all day but he was done in hours. The pricing was very reasonable for the problem I had. They are now my go to plumbers. Thank you 5 Star!!

plumbers.name: Neffsville Plumbing, Heating & Cooling Services
plumbers.address: 1208 Harrisburg Pike Ste 101, Lancaster, PA 17603, USA

reviews.author: Diana Knouff
reviews.text: Everyone I interacted with throughout the entire process was incredibly kind, knowledgeable, and professional. During the installation, the technician discovered some unforeseen issues, promptly resolved them, and continued without any interruptions.  I highly recommend participating in the maintenance program.  We had to get a new furnace and AC unit, during a cold snowy weekend we cuddled in blankets and an electric space heater. John made sure we had our heat back and did it with a smile. Thank you to the 6 gentlemen I came in contract from the first visit, sales visit and installation team. Top Notch job!

reviews.author: Randy Balram
reviews.text: Our water heater was not heating and was leaking alot. Gabe came out the same day and clearly explained what needed to be done and some options that we had. The pricing was upfront and clear, and it included all taxes and fees so there was no miscommunication. It was a difficult install due to the tight space where the water heater was placed. Gabe recommended that we install a pressure regulator which was also in a tight space. Once a selection was made, a second technician came out to deliver the equipment and they had it all installed within a few hours. They cleaned up after themselves and the install looks very professional. I’m happy with the service and will definitely be using Neffsville again.

reviews.author: Stephney Johnson
reviews.text: Davide did a fantastic job. He was on time. He explained everything and showed me my options. He was patient as I thought about the best price and option for me. He did a great job installing my new Delta faucet. The extra was that he was concerned and took care, making sure that I was satisfied. He also also gave me information on services that I might need at a later date. Excellent great job! Thank you, Davide

reviews.author: Keyshla Vu
reviews.text: Macoi came to help finish a project my husband tried to do on his own. He helped with our AC wiring and made sure it was all hooked up  and set up my app properly. He was friendly and nice, much appreciated! Love this company as a whole and all their service workers are fantastic! Will use them for future needs!

reviews.author: Deb Salinger
reviews.text: If I need a plumber I want Brian to come back. He not only did a great job but also walked us through the issues and resolved them. He has a great personality, polite, considerate and did everything plus, to please us. He’s a great guy and the Company should be happy to have him as an employee.

Kyle O was the plumber that came out to do work on my place . He replumbed all of my sinks and drains  kitchen and both bathrooms.  He was great guy to communicate with . He did great work the first visit and also the second time he came out to do a bit more work . Super cool dude. Will definitely  be recommending him to anyone I know  that is having plumbing issues .   I give this man 5 star's plus  for sure.
Thank you Kyle O you rock man !!!

I had backflow from our washing machine overflow into laundry room.  It was 4th time this happened and I needed it checked out and resolved.  I called Apollo based off a recommendation of their work.

Keenan showed up and was my tech.  He was very thorough.  He took extra time and care to make sure he was able to deduce what the problem was and clear it. reviews.text:

Debbie

reviews.author: Daniel Filice
reviews.text:
(Updated) Art Kelly was the service tech for my Healthy Home care plan inspection and he created a great experience. He was personable, thorough and articulate, didn’t try to oversell me and went the extra mile to get me a fair price on my PRV replacement.

Wilson Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electric just earned a lifelong customer thanks to two outstanding technicians who serviced my home today.

Hithem replaced my PRV valve and was incredibly thorough and thoughtful throughout the entire visit. He clearly explained what the new water pressure would mean, what to expect going forward, and made sure I understood everything before he left. While he was here, he also noticed a few other small issues around the house, corrected them on the spot, and didn’t charge me for those quick fixes. Alan was very down-to-earth, efficient, and clearly great at what he does. reviews.author: Amy Norris

reviews.author: Ian Whitesel
reviews.text: Yovel came to look at my furnace, and he did a fantastic job. Very personable and friendly, very knowledgeable. Gave me a fair and honest break down of my set up. He is a credit to his employer!

reviews.author: Khyle Halstead
reviews.text: Cole, Ryan and Chuck all did a fantastic job installing my new High Efficiency Furnace! They kept me in the loop with everything they were doing, were very respectful, clean and walked me through how to operate my new thermostat and some cool features that come with it. reviews.author: Justin McLoughlin

plumbers.address: 7525 Hub Pkwy, Valley View, OH 44125, USA

reviews.author: Chris Stergar
reviews.text: First I was told my window was noon to 4 pm. I got a call at around 10:15 that the tech would be at my house at 11AM, making me hurry to get home in time. Tech reviewed kitchen sink, tub, and recommended a valve replacement for the kitchen shut off and provided the quote. Tech started in the tub. I heard him talking to himself. After a little while, he got his stuck snake out of the drain. He then started on the kitchen sink. After a while, a second tech showed up to help him with the sink. They worked together and got the sink working well. The second tech must have left. First tech showed me the stacks for the toilet and tub, and explained why he recommended replacement and said he would send a quote. He told me about his stuck snake, he wasn’t going to charge me for snaking it, but it was draining slowly still. I told him it wasn’t draining, but he insisted he put more water in it. I then went to the shutoff and asked if it was replaced. He thanked me for reminding him. Fixed it, I paid and he left. I went into bathroom. Tub was not draining at all. I grabbed my auger. Sent it down five times. Pulled out three large clumps of hair. Tub is now draining. Not as big of a deal to me since I wasn’t charged, but if it was someone incapable of clearing it, just wanted to let you know.

reviews.author: Timothy Jones
reviews.text: I called Mr. Rooter on 12/28/25 and advised them that I needed a technician to come out same day.  I had to shut the water off to my house to change a Moen shower faucet cartridge.  The cartridge was stuck and would not come out.  Mr. Rooter showed up around 6 pm.  He spent no more than an hour.  He said the cartridge was fixed and asked me to turn the water on only to tell me to immediately turn off the water.  He said he installed the cartridge upside down.  He later said he corrected the problem.  I asked him is any water dripping from the spout.  He said no.  He turned the water on quick and turned it off.  The water some water coming out of the spout, but I assumed that was from the technician just turning off the water.  He immediately left.  I went upstairs into the bathroom and watched a steady flow of water coming from the spout.  I called Mr. Rooter about 2 to 3 minutes after the technician left.  I was wanting the technician to turn around and fix the problem he created.  Customer service said he cannot turn around and I would have to wait until 8 am to 12 pm the following day even though they advertise they are 24/7 service.  All she kept doing was apologizing like some AI operator.  So, I paid $370.00 (with a senior discount) for work that made the situation worse.  I uploaded a video so you can see how much water is leaking.  It is not a drip; it is a flow.  I would shut the water off to my house, but family members need access to the bathroom and water.  I'm sure this will jack up my water bill on top of getting ripped off.  I thought Mr. Rooter had a good reputation.  I tried uploading a video put this review put out by Mr. Rooter would allow me.  So, I several pictures and they uploaded them.  Not ask good as video, but the pictures show the constant flow of water.

reviews.author: Halle Esson
reviews.text: Mr. Rooter was able to schedule a technician very quickly to assist with clogged plumbing with our kitchen sink.  They both snaked the line and did a high pressure flush which doubled the price I was paying.  It was great service and they were able to fix my problem quickly, I just thought the price was a bit high.  But maybe that is common when you need someone there quickly.  Overall I would recommend them for a job where you need something fixed quickly.  Very professional and courteous.

reviews.author: Ybr2020
reviews.text: My experience with Mr. Rooter was a pleasant one. They came out fast and gave me a quote. Very professional! I appreciate how they made me feel like a priority.

reviews.author: Austin Cassill
