He was very knowledgeable and happy to answer any questions that I had. He brought several items up to code - such as adding a shut off valve to the pipe feeding the heater. He thoroughly checked for leaks and provided us with a high level of confidence in reliability and safety. We would definitely hire Mr. Rooter (and Matt) for plumbing related issues again in the future. Thank you!

My experience with Metro as a first time customer highlighted their smooth and convenient scheduling process as well as the quality of their certified professional staff.  Brayden (McFall) was knowledgeable and he clearly provided me with evidence in support of his recommendations for remedying the cause of our leak (a damaged water fixture supply line). He provided repair in a timely and efficient manner. I will gladly seek out Metro and b their certified plumber, Brayden, for our future plumbing and HVAC needs.

plumbers.name: Blue Sky Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electric
plumbers.address: 9830 Interstate 70 Frontage Rd S, Wheat Ridge, CO 80033, USA

reviews.author: greg bortz
reviews.text:
I have waited to do any kind of comment or review.
It is often said to never review anything while angry. Don't "YELP" angry.
The work done by Blue Sky Plumbing was done in September 2025
It is now mid January 2026.

I've had a great deal of time to look at all aspects of the work and formulate my opinion.
Right after the work was "completed" I called the representative who originally estimated / Sold the job
He came to our property to look over the work and listen to my concerns / complaints.

To start the two people who performed the work were polite enough with me, the home owner.
While on the job there were all kinds of mixed communications between the two. I noted at times they were conflicted and would appear to argue.
Other times over the few days here the seemed to be on the same page.
On at least one occasion one of them seemed possibly ill or lacking much if any motivation to work.

All of this is what resulted in the condition our property was left in at the conclusion of the job.
The approach to the job seemed to be to get things done as quickly as could be done.
I've found that most contractors take this approach to save as much in labor cost as possible, regardless of work quality at times.

I've taken several pictures of the finished work as well as the condition of the property upon completion of the job.

Here is a list of my concerns and complaints expressed to the Blue Sky Representative for this job.

A great deal of over spray  due to neglect of proper prep prior to painting the installed gas line
This left our brick, foundation, and cedar gate painted with gloss black.
I consider this to be damage to our property that could have easily avoided with attention to detail.
Blue Sky got paid, our property got sprayed.

According to the licensed inspector who reviewed the work, it was not even necessary, according to code,
to paint many of the unions and valves that were painted in whole. That being said, the very last piece of black pipe installed
was left unpainted and left to rust in the rain. Left unpainted after it was explained to me by Blue Sky
how it was required that the entirety of the gas line be painted (again, not necessary) Again a lack of attention to detail.

During excavation the downspout drain to the garage was destroyed . No repair or replacement was offered.

Debris was left on the property from work performed.

When a Blue Sky crew returned to fill the trench that was dug by a company they contracted. A few people showed up to refill the ditch by hand with shovels
as opposed to using the same contractor that dug by machine. It took a much longer amount of time, and the yard was left considerably uneven. This again, I assume
was in an effort to save expense, where as bringing a grader back for a fill and a few passes to even things out would have left our yard as it was prior to the work performed.

reviews.author: Jamie Miller
reviews.text: We had such a great experience with this team! From start to finish, everyone we worked with was respectful, knowledgeable, and clearly took pride in their work. Daniel, Joseph, Phaylan, Fernando, and Jayden were all fantastic—professional, friendly, and extremely thorough. From the initial visit and quote to the completion of the project, their attention to detail and care really stood out. It’s so refreshing to work with people who genuinely care about doing a great job. Highly recommend this company and this crew!

reviews.author: Haley Clark
reviews.text:

The company was very responsive, he arrived right on time, and he left the area clean when he was done. reviews.author: Stacy Rihel
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about the service we received from ARS.  Our water tank basically blew out and we had water all over the garage.  We called several places for a quote on a Sunday.  Not only was their quote free of charge (even if we decided not to go with them), they responded immediately.  They had a technician, who was authorized to give full quotes on extra large tanks, out to our house within just a few hours.  The office also called twice to give us updates on his arrival.

The service technician,  Jerad, was so very nice and very professional.   He was knowledgeable about the entire process and answered every single question we had.  Even when we had to ask more after he left.  Jerad made the process so easy.  The quotes were very reasonably priced.

Casey, the installation technician came with the new unit the very next day!!  Customer service called to confirm his arrival time and kept me informed.   Casey arrived on time and was super personable.   He was polite,  funny, and professional.   He made the installation look easy!  He even cleaned up the water from the old tanks mess!

I would hire this company again without question!

Thank you, team ARS, for such a wonderful experience.   You made spending money not hurt so bad.. lol!

reviews.author: Jeanie Saffer
reviews.text:
Corey Jones plumber was amazing! Our water heater died and we had no hot water.  He was so knowledgable and professional and really cared about our situation. He got us taken care of so quickly.  He was so mannerly and respectful as well.  Thank you Corey!  Also plumber Rogelio was assigned to us at first and he also was very helpful.
We have used Lightfoot for 10 years and always liked them.  However since they were bought out I had issues with their new answering service somewhere out if state.  However the plumbers were amazing.

plumbers.name: Essig Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 448 Snyder Rd, Reading, PA 19605, USA

reviews.author: Clarissa Nichols
reviews.text: Did wonderful work and was very knowledgeable. Answered all our questions and the install was done so well and quick.

reviews.author: Pat Conner
reviews.text:
Darren P. from Essig Heating & Air‑Conditioning delivered outstanding service from start to finish. His professionalism, deep technical knowledge, and genuine care for the customer truly set him apart. Darren took the time to clearly explain what he was doing, why it mattered, and what options were available — all without any pressure or upselling.

What impressed me most was his attention to detail and commitment to doing the job right. He worked efficiently, respected my home, and made sure everything was running perfectly before he left. It’s rare to find a technician who combines skill, honesty, and great communication the way Darren does.

Essig is lucky to have him, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Darren to anyone needing heating or air‑conditioning service. A true professional and an excellent representative of the company

reviews.author: Bob
reviews.text: I contacted Essig based on their customer ratings and reviews and was able to set up an appointment with a technician the very next day. When Joel arrived at my residence, he was prompt, courteous, kind, and professional. He diagnosed and repaired my issue quickly. I am extremely pleased with Essig Plumbing and Heating and already have plans to bring them back for future projects. I highly recommend them to anyone! A+++++

reviews.author: Dave Geiger
reviews.text:
I was not very happy with the diagnosis from the tech. It was totally incorrect and I pretty much figured out what my own issue was by myself. Very nice, courteous tech
But I would suggest some additional training.  This is the first time I have done business with this company. Although I was not happy with the upfront situation, I will say, this company has the absolute best communication and support network that I have ever experienced with a plumbing company BY FAR. The scheduling staff was nothing but courteous, pleasant and extremely accommodating. I am sure I was a pain with having to reschedule a couple times but you would never have known.  I wish I knew her name,so I could recognize her outstanding customer service.Totally awesome communication and appointment reminder system. So I had the pleasure of speaking with Jim about my situation and again, he was very professional, knowledgeable, and he took the time to talk through my issue. It was a very good conversation and he did the right thing as a professional.  I was very appreciative and grateful for these actions and that is why I provided this rating, and I will say, I absolutely would do business with them in the future and would recommend this company to anyone. I can clearly see why they have been in business this long.  Good to see there are still the good companies out there that value the customer with integrity.

reviews.author: Tom Rush
reviews.text: Amazing and friendly service. My technician Joe was incredible. He was polite, had wonderful explanations for my questions and used terrific analogies to break down the info he was providing. Had them come out for an annual inspection for heat and cooling. Company was clear from the beginning on what was covered and I felt no pressure on any upselling of services. Just straightforward information on what preventative measures could be put in place to increase the life of my system. Will absolutely use them in the future and will recommended to anyone. Thank you for some amazing service.

plumbers.name: F.H. Furr Plumbing, Heating, Air Conditioning & Electrical
plumbers.address: 11200 Houser Dr Units 19-22, Fredericksburg, VA 22408, USA

reviews.author: Anthony Kaercher
reviews.text:
Paul was awesome, professional and efficient.

The technician gets 5 stars for his work. He was very knowledgeable and was a pleasure to talk to. Problem is that one of the repairs recommended did not fix the issue I am having with my HVAC system.

New tech came out. Was honest and recommended a different repair. Will update later.

reviews.author: Mala Ramnarain
reviews.text: Ethan was very knowledgeable and explained what was causing the issue. He made recommendations on what needed to to be done and avenues we can pursue. Friendly, great communication and outstanding customer service. He worked on flushing our water heater tank and he replaced and installed a thermal expansion safety tank.

reviews.author: Christopher Janus
reviews.text: Our Service Technician was Sean Zuniga.  He was outstanding!  He spent time to discuss each part of the repairs we needed and provided several options with varying costs to help us choose what was best for us. No pressure.  He also discovered one future repair we needed. He was courteous, respectful, professional and most of all very friendly.  Thank you!!!

reviews.author: LaTonya Malloy
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable technician. He walked me through the whole process and explained the airflow of my system to include how to use the dampers. Very personable, respectful and pleasant. Great job E.Jones!  I signed up for a special to have FH FURR do three system checks in a year.  The price for the checks were reasonable; The cost of the repairs, IMHO, were astronomical!  I might as well buy a whole new system.

reviews.author: Val Mullins
reviews.text:
I am EXTREMELY HAPPY with the Service Specialist, Chris Pruitt from F.H. Furr! Came out in Christmas Eve! I was in a panic 🫨 wondering what I was going to do about my faucet and how to have water in the kitchen. The faucet operates on a “new” type of touch technology.
Chris figured it out and got it working in no time!

plumbers.name: Ace Hardware Home Services
plumbers.address: 780 5th Ave Ste 140, King of Prussia, PA 19406, USA

reviews.author: Eileen Brady
reviews.text: Wonderful staff from beginning to end. Curt was accurate with placing my order. Scheduling was at my convenience. The install had a couple of hiccups but the 2 installers were pros and found the correct solutions. The water tank deliverer was professional and she jumped right in to assist the installers to help with the hiccups and removed the nasty old tank. They worked well together and communicated with me and each other during the process. These pros were very knowledgeable, kind, cleaned up everything and they definitely take pride in their jobs. Thank you Ace!

reviews.author: David Tessier
reviews.text: Honestly, I do not even know where to begin! The team here are ANGELS! From Chris Wilson, who did the initial assessment and oversaw the project, to Mariano Flores-Serrato and Pat Cushin who were the AMAZING installers, and even Brian Brady, the Brand Ambassador. They were all kind, compassionate and professional. They had posted a very special giveaway on Facebook for a new Weil McLane boiler and we entered. When we won, we were blown away and so very grateful. I had to hug them, because it was such a blessing. With seven children, our A/C going this year, and our boiler overdue for replacement by decades, we were beyond thankful. The whole experience was wonderful. From their generosity of the boiler, installation, and parts all being covered, to the kindness and patience they showed, was something they deserve recognition for. With having 2 severely autistic children who characteristically elope, it is the top priority to keep our doors locked, alarms engaged, and more. And as you can imagine, that dramatically increases the difficulty level of their job. And we have had other contractors here, and even with their best they left things unlocked or slightly ajar. Not this team! Every single time they came in and out, they locked the door and were aware of their surroundings. They not only did a superb job installing, but they also treated our home and family with the respect and dignity as if it were their own. From now on, for every and any home repair or maintenance, these guys are it.  I've included photos so you can see the old boiler and how we went from the prehistoric era into the 21st century. Additionally, you can see the sharp, clean work they did. THANK YOU AGAIN ACE HOME SERVICES TEAM!

reviews.author: Christine Gammage
reviews.text:
We used ACE home services twice in January.

Heating system repair:
Our under floor radiant heating system in the kitchen only had not worked since the first season after installation. We had a number of reputable HVAC/ plumbing professionals look at it but they all shook their heads and suggested an expensive split system. We contacted ACE Home Services and are so glad we did! Chris Wilson was not only interested, but positively enthusiastic about diagnosing the problem and looking for a solution. Despite the fact that we had given up and were considering a different type of heating system. He drew up plans and provided several options and did not pressure us to go with the most expensive one.  A week later the team of Alex Acevedo and Juan Rodriguez Bernal transformed Chris’s drawings into a heating system that has been working beautifully! We especially appreciated having a warm kitchen given the subfreezing temperatures these last few weeks. Our kitchen went from 58 degrees to a consistently comfortable for us 68.

The entire team was polite, considerate and excellent at explaining the process and what we could expect every step of the way.  Each step of this process, from the initial phone call, to the diagnostic visit and the repair phase were timely and accommodating to our schedule.

Clogged Drain: Ken Kulp arrived at the expected time, was courteous and promptly diagnosed our problem. He explained how we could easily solve the problem ourselves at a fraction of the cost, and it worked like a charm! We are grateful to have found a company with technicians who are so interested, knowledgeable and honest.  We’ll definitely be calling Ace Home Services again.

reviews.author: gerald brown
reviews.text: Spencer and Dom are the best duo and great guys great conversation very knowledgeable about the heating system solved a problem that would fix my heating system and I would have no more problems. Thanks to Jeff Mccraken who help me with the financing for the heating project.

reviews.author: Lauren Tabas
reviews.text: After getting 4 quotes, we chose to hire ACE to install a new furnace, AC unit and hot water heater. They sent Curt out within a couple days and he spent an hour walking around the house, taking measurements and assessing the job. We appreciated his diligence and awareness of  the structural challenges in the space and our pre-existing ductwork, narrow pipes, etc. Knowing that he understood potential issues gave us comfort that there wouldn’t be any surprises during installation. We called Curt late on Friday, put the deposit on Monday and were scheduled for installation Wednesday. Debbie called Tuesday to let us know that the heater had to be sourced from out of state but would be there Thursday, even if they had to drive to Maryland to get it! They were also able to set up City parking permits and a crane with such quick notice. The crane company and Spencer’s team were there bright and early Wednesday to start - getting the AC unit up on our roof. All day, they worked diligently without any disruptions. They were super efficient, put down drop cloths, and cleaned up after themselves. Like Debbie promised, they came back on Thursday and spent 7 hours installing our heater. At the end of the day, Spencer walked me through operation, parts, install and the new thermostat. My husband and I were super impressed with how smooth it went and glad there were no surprises. I couldn’t be happier!

plumbers.name: Carolina Conditions Heating Cooling Plumbing Electrical
plumbers.address: 415 Cedarcrest Dr, Lexington, SC 29073, USA

reviews.author: Nestor Alvarez
reviews.text: As a homeowner finding a reliable contractor is a task. My home HVAC needed to be replaced. I mean from top to bottom. Including the set lines. I found this company by asking AI Gemini. Long story short. They installed two Trane units with UV lights, new set lines which included a vacuum for overflow ( new to me). It was a big job. It literally took three days. But I know by watching and talking to the technicians that I got a great system. The amount of details during the install was amazing. I paid a lot of money for this, but honestly It was worthy. Great equipment, incredible installation and nice experience. Just so you know I verified all the equipment and prices using AI just to make sure I was getting value. And I did. If you are looking for an HVAC company, look no further.

reviews.author: Mary Hollis Stuck
reviews.text: Russell came out to give me an estimate for a new water line. He was very informative and friendly, and they also beat the estimate I’d received that day from Cassell Bros. It took a few days to schedule (mostly due to the utility company taking so long to mark out buried gas lines) but they communicated with me the whole time. Russell and David replaced my water line to the street in about 5 hours, and did a great job. They filled in the hole very nicely and even laid grass seed down over the trench! Had an excellent experience. (Photos of standing water from leak, the trench that was dug, and how things looked after.

reviews.author: Courtney Varn
reviews.text:
Carolina Conditions did an excellent job resolving my issues with my HVAC system. Allison was very fast to responding to my call and getting me on schedule for the same day. She was awesome!
My heat had went out a day or two before I called and knew we had some very cold weather on the way. Mathew Carter was my technician and called to let me know that he was in the way and expected arrival time. He came in, found the problem to why my system wasn’t working and told me how much it would be and how long it would take to fix it. I was very happy with the quote he gave me and had my unit up and running within 45 mins. He also went through and informed me he looked at the rest of my system and that everything looked great so that was a big plus! From start to finish Mathew followed the process to a T!
I will highly recommend Carolina Conditions to all my family and friends and will be using them in the future for my HVAC, plumbing and electrical needs!

reviews.author: R Parsons
reviews.text:
I have never reviewed any other company but I feel I must warn people about this company. They did a terrible job at my home in Lexington, S.C. I had to have all the work redone by another company and it cost a lot of money. The county inspectors, Dominion Energy and two master electricians from other companies looked at their work and were shocked at the poor workmanship. They left the outside meter box in an unsafe condition with exposed wires and dangling master on/off switch. They used the wrong wiring and the wrong sized breaker in the inside breaker boxes. They destroyed every surge protector in the house as well as several appliances. They offered to fix some of it, but after seeing the quality of their work, I was not willing to trust them again. They were also way too dismissive of the scope of the problems they had caused; arguing that it wasn't going to require much to fix things. I felt like they focused on the need to avoid costs of repair rather than how to make things right in what was clearly a major screw up by a new employee who was way in over his head on this job.

Add to all this, they said they would compensate me for some of the cost of fixing their mess and I never saw a cent.

The company may be okay for HVAC work but I sure don't recommend them for electrical work.

reviews.author: Nicole White
reviews.text:
David K with Carolina Conditions was fantastic during our HVAC survey. He was incredibly knowledgeable, took the time to explain everything clearly, and made sure all of our questions were answered. He really went above and beyond to make sure we understood our options and felt confident about the system.

The whole experience was professional, helpful, and stress-free. I highly recommend Carolina Conditions to anyone needing HVAC services, and especially appreciate David’s outstanding customer service.

plumbers.name: S and J Plumbing & Sewer
plumbers.address: 1156 W Shure Dr Suite 130, Arlington Heights, IL 60004, USA

reviews.author: John Yousif
reviews.text:
I recently hired this plumbing service for a leaking pipe under my kitchen sink, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From the first phone call, Justine was professional, friendly, and quick to schedule an appointment. She made the whole process smooth and stress-free.
When Brandon arrived, he was right on time, explained the issue clearly, and provided a fair estimate before starting the work. He was knowledgeable, efficient, and made sure everything was fixed properly. What really impressed me was how clean and organized he kept the workspace — no mess left behind.
The repair was completed faster than expected, and the pricing was transparent with no hidden fees. It’s such a relief to find a reliable team you can trust.
I will definitely use their services again and highly recommend Brandon and Justine to anyone looking for honest, high-quality plumbing work

reviews.author: Tammy Motin
reviews.text:
I called S&J Plumbing as I had a great experience with them in the past.  Plumbing issues can be so stressful, and Art, the technician that came to our home today, was so patient and thorough in every area, from diagnosis, to a repair that took several hours, coordinating a *second team for another issue, and in offering multiple recommendations to make sure the problem with our lines wouldn’t happen again.

Art told me that he really enjoys his work, and it is very satisfying when he can help resolve issues for customers, and that truly showed today.  I am never at a loss for words, but I can’t begin to tell you what a great job he did today, and today involved a lot of hard work.

In addition, *Mike N and Justin arrived a few hours into the job to replace a key piece of cast iron that sits between the toilet and the main line.  I had no idea how many aspects there were to that piece of the job, and Mike and Justin also exceeded my expectation in every way.

Mike and Justin were equally friendly and knowledgeable, and told me they also really enjoy their work and find it very rewarding to help solve customer’s plumbing issues.

These gentlemen didn’t miss any details and at the end, didn’t rush out, but thoroughly cleaned the job site, and put everything away for me.  It is very obvious these three gentlemen take great pride in their work and in their company.
I highly recommend this company.

The picture that I included in my review is “after”.  Had I been able to take a picture of the “before” you would have seen piles of sopping wet towels trying to stop a flooded floor from causing additional damage.

reviews.author: Eleanor Park
reviews.text: Nick Y and Nick L did a massive 2 day job in my crawl space with excellence, professionalism, and great craft. They explained everything as they worked, left my place very clean during and after, answered all my questions and concerns. I feel like my home is safe for years to come.

reviews.author: BOB SMITH
reviews.text: I called S&J Plumbing to repair a leak that developed behind the wall in our bathroom. Joe was able to get me on the schedule and sent Mark Lindeman out a few hours later. Mark was very nice, very knowledgeable, talented and informative. He noticed our tankless water heater and knew the unit and started telling us about it and how it needs to be maintained (I had no idea) and suggested other items he noticed that could be issues in the future. He wasn’t being a pushy salesman - just an experienced advisor. He did an excellent job with the repair and he was a pleasure to speak with. I definitely recommend S&J Plumbing and, in particular, Mark Lindeman. Thank you for fitting us into todays schedule.

reviews.author: Georgia McGuire
reviews.text: Had to have all our galvanized pipes replaced with copper pipes. Starting with Nick who came out to check out the problem and give us an estimate to Dennis and Robbie who came to our home and did a phenomenal job. Both Dennis and Robbie  were pleasant, professional and courteous. Answered all our questions and gave us a tour of what they did and what they were going to do. I felt comfortable with both of them and their knowledge of our problem was exceptional. The clean up afterwards was wonderful and I would recommend SandJ for any plumbing problems you have or may encounter in the future. They are definitely our go to plumbers for any future problems. All three men were great representatives of the company.

plumbers.name: Mighty Plumbing Heating Air and Electric LLC.
plumbers.address: 4730 Paris St #100, Denver, CO 80239, USA

reviews.author: Elizabeth Planas-Kerr
reviews.text: Very happy with the service and professionalism. I reached out through Thumbtack and was called back just a few minutes later. Nick was able to come the same day, look over the project area and the fuse panel, and  gave several options for how to complete my lighting project. Price was fair and scheduling was very flexible. Justin came to do the installation a couple of days later and he was also quick, clean, and professional. I plan to use this company again for future projects. Before photo with ugly fluorescent lighting and after with new pretty LED light.

reviews.author: Todd Schlafer
reviews.text: I cannot say enough, good things about my experience with mighty plumbing. I got a new mini split in my workshop, which was installed very professionally and cleanly. When the electrician came to connect it I had him look at my breaker box in the workshop because I had a feeling some things were not up to Code. He opened it and we immediately saw there was arcing in it. Ishmael Gonzalez was the electrician. He told me that I should get a new subpanel and that whoever had done it before the wiring was under gauged. He then went in my crawlspace and saw that my house was also not grounded and up to Code since it is an older house. My main breaker box was only rated for 125 Amps and we could upgraded it to 200 Amps. He told me he could get everything done the next day. He arrived at 9:45 AM and didn’t leave till after 10 PM. The guy just crushed it. He was awesome to work with. I kept asking him if he could get it all done in one day and he kept reassuring me I am not leaving till it’s all done. Sure enough he got everything done. I will be requesting him for any future electrical jobs. I do believe they are a bit expensive but when I received the quality of work he provided, I am more than willing to pay more for it.

reviews.author: Brian Howard
reviews.text:
Johnny and Elliot were awesome with explaining the replacement of our furnace. Our furnace is 50+ years old so it is time. I like the fact they are locally owned and operated. Installation is scheduled for Monday, so I can do another review post install. Pre-Install photo attached.

Post-Install
Christoper was awesome. I will recommend him any time. He completed a huge amount of work in a short time frame. He replaced my boiler and water heater at the same time. You can tell he really takes pride in his work and does a great job. He kept me updated throughout the day so there were no surprises, just a great finished product.

reviews.author: Zachary Nelson
reviews.text: We could not have had a better experience with Mighty! Ryan, Eugene, and Eddie were amazing. We had our entire plumbing redone from the house to the city sewer line. These guys made an incredibly stressful situation seamless. Definitely won't be going to anyone else for any future plumbing needs. Thanks again guys!

reviews.author: Drew Morell
reviews.text: Furnace installation. My experience with Mighty Heating was very good. Johnny did a thorough job of diagnosing the problem and explaining the work that needed to be done. He was friendly and easy to talk to. Angel and Cody were efficient, polite and profession during the install and got everything up and running as quickly as possible. Elliott (project manager) did a great job of explaining all of the options for the repair. Everyone listened well to my questions and concerns.

plumbers.name: Precision Plumbing Heating Cooling Electric
plumbers.address: 413 S Arthur Ave, Louisville, CO 80027, USA

reviews.author: Kay Ray
reviews.text: I needed to get water heater maintenance done. Did some research and Precision at a decent price of $49. Tyler arrived exactly at 8:01 AM and did outstanding work and explained everything. Now I feel confident my water heater works well and I know what to look for for any issues. Thanks Precision and Tyler for a great work. I am a very satisfied customer.

reviews.author: Jennifer Haller
reviews.text: Justin and Anthony from Precision Plumbing provided outstanding service for me today. I needed to have both my water heater and furnace replaced! They were very emphatic, kind, and professional. They provided me with options, and were not at all aggressive with their approach. They were extremely patient with my questions and concerns, and left me feeling assured that I had chosen the right people and company to manage the work I needed to have done in my home. Thank you Precision Plumbing for always being there for our plumbing, heating, and AC service needs since 2007! Precision Plumbing also has excellent customer service! When you call to schedule service, you truly feel like the person on the other end of the line truly cares about your issues. To me, that level of service really matters!! Thank you, Precison!!

reviews.author: Davis Clemence Schreiner
reviews.text: Devon was amazing and extremely professional. The original service he came out here to do was not what I needed, so we spoke through the options of what could be done and did a switch up. He knew what he was doing and explained it well so that I knew what I was paying for and the outcome that was expected. He was respectful of my home, pets and family. I recommend Precision Plumbing Heating Cooling Electric and especially Devon.

reviews.author: Thomas Faughnan
reviews.text: The technician, Tyler explained the issue and solution clearly and was upfront about the cost. He gave an honest evaluation of my options. He returned several days later when the part came in and finished the repair quickly. The furnace sounded significantly quieter as he had predicted. Very satisfied with the result.

reviews.author: Patti Masterson
reviews.text: Justin was very knowledgeable and explained several options to us and how they worked.  We were very comfortable with Justin and confident in the installation of our new system.  I would highly recommend Precision Plumbing the team was very professional.

plumbers.name: Advantage Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning
plumbers.address: 992 St Charles St, Elgin, IL 60120, USA

reviews.author: Matthew Kooperman
reviews.text: I’m a new homeowner and six months into homeownership the thermostat and sensor on the old 9 year old water tank died. I called Four Seasons and they were out within 2 hours to evaluate my situation and make recommendations. I could either repair the old water tank which would be the band-aid approach with no guarantees something else wouldn’t go wrong or I could opt to replace with an entirely new water tank. I went with the second option and 24 hours later one of Four Seasons’ affiliated companies Advantage Plumbing was back at my house removing the old tank and installing a new tank that will hopefully last for as long as I own the home. I appreciate that Four Seasons was there for me when I needed help in an emergency and the level of communication from the service technician who came out to evaluate my situation was great. He didn’t try and upsell and he was honest and straightforward about my options. The service was really excellent. The install job 24 hours later went smoothly. I was relieved to have hot water again!  I ended up having a question about the billing invoice that customer service was unable to answer and I requested a callback from a manager and the manager called back which helped and I appreciated. Thank you. Five star experience. I definitely recommend Four Seasons and Advantage Plumbing.

reviews.author: Keshara Tyson
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Four Seasons, and I truly appreciate their outstanding customer service. From start to finish, the team was professional, responsive, and reassuring during a stressful situation. They took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure I felt informed and supported throughout the process.

I especially want to recognize Madani, my technician, who did an amazing job. He was knowledgeable, respectful, punctual, and very thorough in his work. Madani went above and beyond to ensure everything was done correctly and took the time to answer my questions with patience and professionalism. His positive attitude and expertise made a big difference.

I highly recommend Four Seasons to anyone looking for reliable, high-quality service. Thank you again for a great experience!

reviews.author: Patricia Davis
reviews.text:
Excellent service from the salesperson Mr. Williams who came out to my home. The next day followed by the two technicians came out to install my furnace. Excellent performance all across-the-board they get a 10 out of 10. Thank you so much for having qualified technicians who come out to my home to guarantee safety and make sure that I am safe in my home after they leave by doing qualified work!!
Thank you Four Seasons your Company and your Services are the BEST ( 10 ) all across the board!!

reviews.author: KJ Johnson
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Four Seasons 😊. I required prompt service and they were able to accommodate me for the same day to tend to my furnace service. As the temperature has been so cold, this worked out greatly. Alex fixed my issue quickly and is very knowledgeable in his trade. Appreciate the great customer service from Alex and from the teammates at the office. I highly recommend all to use their services!

reviews.author: David Montee
reviews.text: Excellent work replacing my full HVAC system with new furnace, air conditioner, humidifier and UV lamp.  Install was done and looks very professional.  My installer Kasper was polite and did exceptional work.  Thank you!  New system is operating perfectly and exceeds my expectations.  Thank you Four Seasons

reviews.author: Paul Boykin
reviews.text: Vincent is very professional, knowledgeable and patient. He took the time to explain everything he was doing to repair my mother's drain and assured her he would come back if she had an issue

reviews.author: Chris Litz
reviews.text: Had an emergency hot water heater replacement done today, It's Saturday and they were here within about an hour after I called, excellent. Paul the technician did a great job. He was very friendly and explained everything that needed done, with cost upfront. He had me up and running again in just a few hours and cleaned everything up, very professional. Thanks Paul.

reviews.author: Raymond Keys
reviews.text:
Netch was very knowledgeable and may it simple for me. He was also quick with replacement my faucet and clean up everything without  me having to ask or worry. I’m overall happy with the results and yeah I would use him again. But no time soon.

Very Respectfully,
Ray

reviews.author: Sonia McCleary
reviews.text: Zauza Dochung was the technician that came out and fixed the reported link. He showed up with a smile and a good since of humor. He assessed the issue and was able to fix it without an issue. He was very patient and able to walk me through the issue and the way he was going to fix it. Thank you Mr. Dochung for getting the job done and for your hard work.

reviews.author: Sergei Ponomarev
reviews.text: Israel did a great job unclogging our kitchen sink drain. He was courteous, clean and friendly and did a superb job (the clog was 50 feet away). We would definitely recommend him as a professional to those in need of plumbing related services.

plumbers.name: Texas Quality Plumbing
plumbers.address: 10814 Woodedge Dr, Houston, TX 77070, USA

reviews.author: GabbyKat Creations
reviews.text:
From beginning to end, my experience with Texas Quality Plumbing was handled with professionalism, courtesy, and clear communication.
Richard Garcia was outstanding. He took the time to go into the attic, explain each step, and ensure I understood what was needed. His follow-through truly stood out.
Michael Salinas and his partner, Michael, did an excellent job with the installation. They worked efficiently and made sure everything was properly cleaned before leaving.
The gentleman who returned the next day to install the sheetrock did an exceptional job. Thank you also to Rose for keeping us informed on timing.
Special thanks to Richard for making sure everything went smoothly. I would recommend this company.

reviews.author: John T
reviews.text:
I had a leak under the driveway and Texas Quality Plumbing  sent Antonio to do the job. My house  has pavers so he had to remove it  to fix  the leak .  He was able to put four 90’s in
and the job was completed.
I am very satisfied with the  results.
He has the pavers put back to the  original place.
Antonio was very professional and courteous, he cleaned up after completion.
The job was done in a timely manner.
I highly recommend using this company.

reviews.author: David Galvez
reviews.text:
Five-Star  for Texas Quality Plumbing

I recently had the pleasure of working with Texas Quality Plumbing, and I’m thrilled to share my experience. From start to finish, the service was outstanding, and a big shout-out goes to their service technician, Oscar Mata.

Professionalism:** Oscar arrived on time, well-dressed, and ready to help. He was courteous, patient, and took the time to explain the issue and the proposed fixes in clear, non-jargony terms.
Expertise:** He demonstrated deep knowledge and skill, quickly diagnosing the problem and presenting multiple options. He recommended the most efficient and cost-effective solution, without pressuring me into unnecessary work.
Quality of Work:** The repair was completed with precision and care. Oscar used high-quality parts and ensured everything was tested thoroughly before finishing the job.
Communication:** Clear updates throughout the process, including what to expect after the service. He left the workspace clean and organized.
Value:** Fair pricing for the level of service provided. It’s refreshing to encounter a company that prioritizes doing the job right.

If you’re in need of plumbing services, I highly recommend Texas Quality Plumbing, especially Oscar Mata. Their commitment to quality, transparency, and customer satisfaction truly stands out. I will definitely call them again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: La Nell
reviews.text:
Daniel was awesome! He was thorough in looking at all the plumbing not just the problem area. He was patient and knowledgeable with all our questions.

Sergio and Jojo came out today and completed the work that Daniel gave estimate on. They were awesome! Jojo even swept and my place looks better than before! Super satisfied with the craftsmanship and professionalism. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Tu Pham
reviews.text:
We recently hired Texas Quality Plumbing to replace my old kitchen sink, and I couldn’t be happier with the result. From the initial quote to the final cleanup, the experience was seamless. Cedric, Brandon, Michael and Arnold did a fantastic job. What really stood out are:

· Punctuality: The plumber arrived right on time and explained the entire process before starting.
· Skill & speed: The old sink was removed and the new one installed properly and timely.
· Cleanliness: They laid down drop cloths, wore shoe covers, and cleaned up every scrap of debris and caulk.
· Fair pricing: No hidden fees. The quote matched the final invoice exactly.

The new sink functions well and I’ll definitely call them again for any future plumbing needs. Highly recommended!

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Columbus
plumbers.address: 405 Brice Rd N, Blacklick, OH 43004, USA

reviews.author: Lise Wadkins
reviews.text:
So, who do you call when your husband tells you on the morning of Christmas Eve that both of the downstairs toilets in your condo are non-functional?  And we were expecting nine people on Christmas morning!  After looking online for Same Day Plumbers, I called Mr. Rooter - Columbus.  They were helpful in starting the process of getting us on the list — and never mentioned that I was calling at a busy holiday time.
We were given a four hour window and Brandon arrived about two hours later.  Since these were the original toilets from the 2007 construction, he explained that there were several options.  We had already tried to ‘solve the problems’ by replacing various parts several times, but that wasn’t working.  So, we decided that they this time they needed to be replaced.  Brandon left for about a half hour to get what was needed, then returned and installed the two toilets.  He was careful to clean up as he worked.  We
were so thankful that we were able to get kind and courteous help the day before Christmas!  We felt that the price was reasonable.  If there happens to be another plumbing situation, we NOW know who to call!

reviews.author: Mike Clouse
reviews.text: Woke up to frozen sump pump drain lines. Mr. Rooter was able to send someone out and remedy the issue same day. Anthony, the tech who did the work, was great. Very personable and professional. Kept me informed every step of the way. Will call them again if needed.

reviews.author: Harold Akers
reviews.text: Simply the best.  We had our Sewer back up.  Gave them a call.  They came out asap.  Very professional.  Diagnosed the issue, and showed me on the camera what was wrong.  They got to work right away.  Treated our home like it was theirs.   Over the four days we only had a couple hours of downtime which was awesome.  Super friendly, knowledgeable, respectful, and professional.  We had no worries.  The final product looks and functions great.  Price was more than fair.  If we need to have anything else done Rotor Rooter will be the ones we call.  They also give a military discount. Great guys!

reviews.author: Chelsea Belknap
reviews.text: We had two people out from this company and both were happy to help, friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. So happy with the work done today- old gas pipe replace and gas logs installed. Quick to respond and easy scheduling, arrived on time. Thank you!

reviews.author: Robert Mcpheron
reviews.text: happy over all did leave the house muddy inside they did offer to clean but relized they had nothing to clean with so i told them i will take care of it, also i had to catch them to patch the bathroom floor up where they went threw but the work was very good on repairs, thought the ground they filled back up could of been flater kinda hi

reviews.author: Vanessa Cruz
reviews.text: Really impressed with Roto Rooter (especially the work from Noah!). He was professional, kind and super efficient! He explained things carefully and really took the time and pride to take care of our issue. 10/10 would definitely recommend. Shoutout to the manager Bryan who provided incredible service and truly made an effort to take care of our plumbing concerns. Thank you!

reviews.author: Alonso Velarde
reviews.text:
Justin from Roto did an outstanding job with my water heater. He was punctual, professional, and clearly knew exactly what he was doing. He explained the issue in simple terms, walked me through the options, and completed the work efficiently and cleanly.

What I appreciated most was his attention to detail and the fact that he made sure everything was working perfectly before leaving. No shortcuts, no surprises — just solid, honest work.

Highly recommend Justin and the Roto team if you need plumbing help. Great experience from start to finish.

reviews.author: Christin Scott
reviews.text: Kenrick arrived same day as needing repair, assessed the issue of our broken hose pipe and made me feel at ease that it could be fixed, and on same day with labor and parts. He made described what he would need to do, gave a quote and made sure we were okay with price before beginning repairs. I appreciate that he not only fixed the issue, he reinforced the installation so the same situation wouldnt occur again (hose ripping from outside wall so that when turning on & off the fixture wasnt rotating pipe each time). He worked swiftly, completed the task and was friendly throughout it all. Together with the water restoration team there was a procedure in place and quick action, turning our not so great day into a better one!

reviews.author: Kris D
reviews.text:
I'm adding to my previous review below to also recognize Michael and Louis from the Restoration Team at Roto-Rooter. Michael was super friendly and communicative and Louis was such an incredibly hard worker. Together they made an extremely talented and efficient team. Thank you both so much for solving the issue with such professionalism and competence!

‐----------------------------------------------------

I want to recognize Tom Burke for delivering the most exceptional plumbing service I’ve ever experienced. As a long‑time renter who has dealt with countless plumbing issues and numerous plumbers over the years, Tom immediately stood out as a true professional.

From the moment he arrived, his professionalism, presentation, and communication skills were outstanding. He was courteous, funny, knowledgeable, and genuinely kind—qualities that make a stressful situation feel manageable. What impressed me most was his efficiency and technical expertise. He diagnosed and resolved the issue in under an hour, a job that previously required three separate visits from another company. That level of competence, problem‑solving ability, and work ethic is rare.

Tom was also incredibly supportive throughout the process, explaining what he was doing and why it mattered. His combination of customer service excellence, technical proficiency, and reliability reflects someone who takes pride in their work and represents Roto‑Rooter at the highest standard.

Employees like Tom are the reason customers trust and return to a company. I will be using and recommending Roto-Rooter going forward. Tom's performance clearly demonstrates high value, strong leadership qualities, and a commitment to quality that deserves recognition. I sincerely hope management considers him for a raise or advancement—he has absolutely earned it.

reviews.author: Christopher Herbert
reviews.text: Rodolfo was superb. My home warranty provider could not provide service in a timely manner and Roto-Rooter provided such same day - within an hour. They also gladly worked with the warranty company for a partial reimbursement as well as finished the job faster and cheaper than estimated.

plumbers.name: Mattioni Plumbing, Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 202 W Uwchlan Ave, Downingtown, PA 19335, USA

reviews.author: Ken Kram
reviews.text: I had a plumbing inspection triggered by a toilet valve leak. Cris the inspector identified a number of issues. The most critical was the PRV and high pressure in the system. The inspection was thorough, we negotiated pricing which was reasonable and Cris performed the repairs over 2 days. I am very happy with the work and recommend Mattioni and Cris.

reviews.author: Peggy
reviews.text: Mattioni's are my maintenance service provider for HVAC and plumbing. I've had a service technician out for a plumbing repair lsst year and just today my HVAC system received it's winter checkup. My heating is a hybrid oil/heat pump system and the technician that came out did a great job explaining to me all of what the tune up entailed. I highly recommend anyone looking for a service provider for HVAC and plumbing, Mattioni should be considered. They are a family owned and operated business. Every person I've dealt with has such a kind, personal touch. Their technicians are highly trained professionals. My experience with both technicians was very positive.  Their pricing is fair and transparent. I don't post reviews very often but this company truly deserves a shout out. I am impressed with the priority they place on customer service. Give them a call.

reviews.author: Melina Kurtz Diggett
reviews.text:
Willi from Mattioni Heating and Air was absolutely outstanding. He came to my parents’ home and went above and beyond in every way. From the moment he arrived, he was professional, respectful, and incredibly knowledgeable. He took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all questions with patience, and made sure my parents felt comfortable and confident in the work being done.

His attention to detail was exceptional, and it’s clear he truly cares about doing the job right—not just getting it done quickly. The service was thorough, honest, and efficient, and the results were excellent. It’s rare these days to find a technician with this level of skill, integrity, and customer care.

If you’re looking for someone you can trust with your heating and air conditioning needs, Willi is hands down the best. We couldn’t be happier and would recommend him without hesitation to anyone. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Amber Atkinson
reviews.text: We had a pipe leak in our crawl space in our basement. I called mattioni’s around 6 pm because they had good reviews! A technician was sent out on an emergency call for a very reasonable price. Our technician was Matt, it was pretty late and my husband works third shift so I was a little nervous! He was really nice and personable. He fixed our pipe and gave us some great tips on how to reduce our water bill. We will be back to have those items repaired. Hopefully not so late and not in frigid temps. Thanks Matt K. and Mattionis! Stellar service all around!! ☺️

reviews.author: Dan DiLiberto
reviews.text: My experience with Mattioni and there team was excellent. From my initial contact with Zach who was up front and honest with his fair priced quote to the installation day with Julian, AJ and the other young man whom I forgot his name. All was professional timely and all and all a great experience.. I have been with a nother larger company for years now and since dealing with Mattioni I have learned what a true professional family owned company is to deal with.. Not only was there initial quote significantly lower then my "loyalty price" was from the other company but everything was done on time, organized and very easy to deal with. From now on I will only deal with Mattioni for all my HVAC needs and also look forward to using there plumbing dept in the future.. Thank you for being a refreshing company to deal with..

reviews.author: Yeonsu Ha
reviews.text: I’m so impressed with Maher! He quickly found the problem and fixed it perfectly without any unnecessary work. He explained how to take care of things going forward, cleaned up perfectly, and left everything looking great. His professionalism, skill, and care were truly remarkable. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Azhoon Abdulghani
reviews.text:
I recently had a plumbing issue and called this company – they were able to schedule a visit for the very next day, which was a huge relief since I needed it fixed quickly. The plumber who arrived, Jamil, was outstanding!
Jamil was extremely courteous and took the time to thoroughly explain the problem, walking me through what was causing it and exactly how he was going to fix it. There were no surprises with the pricing – he shared the pre-set fixed price upfront, which I really appreciated for the transparency.
The work itself was done quickly and professionally. He was efficient without cutting any corners, and afterward, he even gave me some helpful tips on maintenance to prevent future issues.
Everyone I dealt with was friendly and professional from start to finish. Yes, the price was on the higher side, but that’s unfortunately the reality with quality plumbing services these days, and it certainly didn’t detract from the exceptional experience. The value came from the expertise, reliability, and peace of mind.
I highly recommend them and will definitely call them again for any future plumbing needs – especially if I can request Jamil! Thank you for the great service!

reviews.author: Z
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter was awesome, super fast service. Lucanes was extremely efficient and friendly. They charged $632 to unclog a shower drain, which is a lot of money but being able to shower in peace is priceless! Would definitely use the company again for any plumbing needs. We have also worked with Kirtis for a kitchen drain and he was awesome. That cost around $820.

reviews.author: Diego Moraes
reviews.text: Our technician Sai is great. Great communication, helpfulness and understanding. He was able to asses and fix our problem and give us full details of the issues and what needs to be done. 100% would recommend to anyone who needs work done.

reviews.text:
We had a clog in our kitchen sink.

Sai was very professional and extremely polite.
Everything was fixed quickly and smoothly.
I will definitely use this company again. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Thomas DuBois
reviews.text: I got a few quotes for a new heating system and 128 Heating was the middle price and they did an amazing job. Great communication from the beginning to the end. The workers were very professional and explained everything as they were doing the install when I asked questions. I will be signing up for the yearly maintenance check.

reviews.author: Lynne Thompson
reviews.text:
This is two reviews of 128 Plumbing.  Last week, ANDREW performed annual maintenance on my tankless hot water, and AC condenser.  This week, STEPHEN came and due to an old leaking garbage disposal, replaced it with a new one.  128 obviously has a great training program.  Both Stephen and Andrew immediately donned shoe covers - this is def a unique practice in the industry, and one I have never seen in my 30+ years of hiring plumbers for my multiple properties.  This shows respect for keeping customers properties clean which I appreciate.  Both technicians explained things in a comprehensive fashion - very helpful to me!  They carried out their tasks quickly, efficiently, professionally.  I signed up for their home maintenance program so now I have them 'on retainer.'
:)
I can highly recommend 128 Plumbing, and feel confident having them on board for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Ben Watkins
reviews.text: We had 128 out for replacement of our AC/furnaces and the team was great. I had a few small plumbing issues as well and because of that great experience I called in a week later to have someone come out to quote me. Kenny came out the next day and gave me a fair and honest assessment which included that we really should replace our 13 year old water heater. He gave a fair price and we had Chandler and Steve out a couple of days later to replace that and do some other items as well. The team as always is friendly, respectful and informative of what they are doing. 128 will continue to be my go to provider for home services!

reviews.author: Kathryn Martin
reviews.text: I had a full gas furnace/heating system installed on short notice. 128 Plumbing & Heating was extremely responsive and efficient. They came out immediately because of a carbon monoxide danger. They then installed a new heating system promptly and efficiently.  Buck, Loeut, Albie, and Derek provided incredible service installing my new heating system. They were very professional, kind, knowledgeable, neat, polite, and hardworking. Buck came back for the next 2 days to make sure my gas was back on, the plumbing inspection was completed, and I felt safe with all of the new heating equipment.  They will install the a/c system in the warmer weather. In addition, Makayla provided good communication, and Darren and RJ were a big help at the start. This was the first time I used 128, and I am thoroughly impressed and happy with their service. I already are recommending them to others. Thank you!

reviews.author: Jim Hunter
reviews.text: I had a new heating and cooling system inst system installed last year by 128 plumbing, heating, cooling  & electric. They did an excellent job and I was extremely satisfied. I called them becaust I needed a new toilet installed. The plumber Steven L. Arrived at my house earlier than I expected. Was able to find a toilet that matched my existing fixtures. He left for a short while and returned with the new toilet. Steven L. did an excellent job with the installation everything went very well. The area was clean when he left. I highly recommend 128  plumbing, heating,  cooling & electric and their plumber Steven L.

plumbers.name: M.E. Flow
plumbers.address: 12 Cardinal Park Dr SE STE 107, Leesburg, VA 20175, USA

reviews.author: Ajay Batra
reviews.text:
Super pleased with the service and care I’ve received from ME Flow. I joined their maintenance plan, and the experience has been exceptional. The staff is friendly, professional, and genuinely focused on solving the problem—not rushing off to the next call (they don’t even get their next assignment until your job is complete).

Among other things, they helped me install and configure smart thermostats and properly balance temperatures throughout the home, all at a reasonable price. They also performed a thorough electrical and plumbing inspection, which was included in the plan.

Overall, two thumbs up—and many thanks to the ME Flow team for their support.

reviews.author: Ron Wood
reviews.text:
Guillermo arrived promptly and did a great job. He was very friendly, efficient and pleasant.
I would like to add an additional note on Guillermo. He was here several  months ago to do a plumbing inspection. As he was leaving, he noticed that I was carrying a very large plant indoors. He kindly offered to help, and I greatly appreciated the assistance. His kind act gave me a very positive impression of ME Flow,  and I would highly recommend this company
However, we did feel the bill was on the high side, especially since we have a maintenance contract

reviews.author: Fernando Quijiano
reviews.text: Had water heater replaced. Job was done the same day I requested, very professional. I specially like that someone is always available on the phone. The 2 year guarantee for labor is reassuring, overall I would highly recommend ME Flow.

reviews.author: Merlin Starz
reviews.text: Excellent company with a variety of innovative problem solvers. Alex, Emerson & Elmer (to name only a few) have all assisted in diagnosing and upgrading my mother’s complex aging in-floor heating system. Their crew also installed new AC units for the whole home

reviews.author: Steven Curry
reviews.text: Incredible turnaround time for my water heater installation! Our sales rep, James, was incredible and managed to coordinate with the team to get the install scheduled for the very next day. The installation crew, including Jake and his partner, were professional, courteous, and did a very neat job. They worked quickly and made sure the entire job site was cleaned up before they left. Highly recommend this team for their speed and quality.

plumbers.name: Service Champions
plumbers.address: 4430 Yankee Hill Rd, Rocklin, CA 95677, USA

reviews.author: Sarah Poliana
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Service Champions. When I called, they were able to send Patrick out very quickly, which was incredibly convenient. He arrived the same day, diagnosed the problem with my water heater, and even went out to get the part that was needed. He came back and fixed everything the same day.

Patrick was very professional, friendly, and efficient. It was such a relief to have the problem solved so quickly without waiting days like with many other companies.

If you need something fixed quickly, I definitely recommend Service Champions. They are reliable, convenient, and provide excellent service.

reviews.author: Terry Driver
reviews.text:
I'm new to Service Champions. A friend told me about her complete satisfaction. I used to be with another company (name starts with G) and decided to try Service Champions and glad I did. They are always patient, courteous and accommodating.
The consultation with the Advisor at my home was very professional and respectful.
The technician that installed my hot water heater was VERY skilled and respectful. The heater is running excellent! Also, the tech treated me as if we've been friends for a while. I didn't get additional bids but did a quick online research and I think the price was good. So, below I just indicated a reasonable price because I didn't have any other actual bids/estimates.

reviews.author: Carolyn Wright Dobson
reviews.text: Big compliment to Service Champions Amber Felicio our Technician today. We are on a  service plan for our heating and air conditioning system. With that we receive a maintenance check up twice a year. Amber was very professional in every way. She showed up as scheduled and got right to work servicing our equipment. She actually discovered a short in our system that would have really run up our SMUD bill. We were completely unaware of it. With the Service champion contract, we got a super discount on the part, an Electromagnetic Relay and even more important the extra labor and time it took to really troubleshoot our system. That Amber works very hard. I was getting dizzy, watching her run up and down the stairs from the inside furnace of our system to the outside part of our system. I highly recommend Service champions and the training and expertise of their team.

reviews.author: Patty Cake
reviews.text:
Not happy with the sales side of Service Champions. Originally we called in because our hot water heater was going out, and just wanted a simple replacement. They did an inspection, and upsold us saying the pipes were old and needed to be completely replaced. In reality we should have received a 2nd or even 3rd opinion as we learned from the install team the sales guy work off commission. However our grandmother used service champions for her AC system, and trusts these people. Also the house is old so it’s not completely unbelievable. We were told the guys would do their thing, and a few days later the county would inspect the work.
We wish the sales team provided better expectations on the whole process. We would have gotten a hotel for the install first off. We felt we were in the guys way. Now we are being told the county will not inspect until March 3rd. While our house is a mess, and driveway is in shambles. More work is needed on this house,and we will not be going through service champions again nor providing any referrals to our friends and family.

reviews.author: DeAnna Rosenthal
reviews.text: Sam Munguia came out yesterday and he was very knowledgable about the heater system he was checking on and how the vents work.  I love when I get detailed information on work done to my house.  He is top notch.  I hope when'd I need service on my AC he comes again.  Thank you again Sam

plumbers.name: Jazz Heating, Air Conditioning and Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2158 Rheem Dr, Pleasanton, CA 94588, USA

reviews.author: Johana Mercado
reviews.text:
I needed a new AC/HVAC system. I went through Home Depot and they sent Jazz Heating, Air Conditioning and Plumbing to install the system. I met Jesus Prado who did an amazing job installing the heating system. However they came across a challenging task installing the AC system because it needed to be in the a new spot that would have enough space to pass the 5 feet code. They decided to put the AC on the opposite side of the house.  Because of the  high ceiling that has no access to the attic,  they had to go through the gutter line to insert the wirings. They ran the wires through the attic, come out on the other side of the house breaking the 2nd gutter line. Then they made another hole to go into the garage. The system works great but now  I have broken gutters with holes on my walls.

I was told by Jesus that Jazz will send someone to fix the gutters. Days passed and no one came or called. The rain was coming and I have leak points that will create water damage. At that point I was beginning to panic when the office was ignoring my calls despite of multiple messages. It was really hard to get through to get that taken care of and I felt that they didn’t know how to handle the situation they put me in.  Until I called Jesus and told him that they have not sent anybody to fix the gutter line or to weather proof the leak points. He understood my concern and he came right away to patch the broken cement around the insertion site, sealed it and artistically cut out pieces of metal to shield the site from the rain.  He took the time and made sure he was meeting my expectations. Finally the gutters need to be artistically fixed. Jazz does not do gutters, so I called quality roofing services, Inc. to get an estimate. Jesus said he will run it by his boss to cover the expenses.

Thank you Jesus for making sure that this job gets done!

Jesus you make Jazz company look good. People like you who knows customer service and the importance of protecting their property needs to be recognized. You have the capacity of pleasing your customer even if it’s not your line of work. Thank you for  listening and acting to make sure I am happy doing business with Jazz.  You made that possible when I was almost regretting it.

Otherwise the price was great, it took some hoops but the installment was done as it should. One happy jazz customer here thanks to Jesus.

reviews.author: Joe Guch
reviews.text: Scheduled an appointment with Jazz for a heating and air inspection at the Cal Expo Home & Garden show. Senior technician Nolan arrived at our house and did a great job of checking our heating and AC system for issues and testing everything to make sure it was in good working order. He also swapped out our old 80’s unit for a new Nest Thermostat and It’s like night and day! He was very knowledgeable and courteous, and I was thoroughly impressed with his knowledge of HVAC and electrical systems. Will definitely call on Jazz in the future!

reviews.author: Wafi Ullah Popalzai
reviews.text: had a great experience with Jazz Heating, Air Conditioning and Plumbing. The technician Q did an excellent job. He was very professional, respectful, and knowledgeable. He explained the issue clearly and fixed everything carefully and efficiently. His work quality was outstanding, and he made sure everything was working perfectly before leaving. I really appreciate his professionalism and great service. I highly recommend this company, especially technician Q.

reviews.author: Elle Ghini
reviews.text: Tony V.and Ivan B were fire and flame!. They came, they took names, they kicked water heater butt! I feel like had plumbing superheros come to my door. I couldn’t be more pleased. Just look at those sleeve compressed copper joints and bright new ball valves. I finally feel secure when I shut off my mains that they wont leak or drip everywhere. Two thumbs up lads👍👍

reviews.author: Melissa Cox
reviews.text: Alex was awesome! I have never used Jazz services before, but we needed a quick 2nd opinion about our heater. Booking online was quick and easy- we even lucked out with a same day appt. Before his arrival we received a nice text giving us a heads up with a bio about our service engineer (nice touch Jazz). Alex worked cleanly and efficiently and provided us with honest information about our heating unit. Now we are hooked. Thanks Jazz you have customers for life!!

plumbers.address: 17500 S Sunnylane Rd, Norman, OK 73071, USA

reviews.author: Deby Johnson
reviews.text: They were prompt, friendly, knowledgeable, and respectful of our property. They took care of our problem, spent time discussing our unit, and future needs. They helped me set up my smart thermostat, that they installed For Free, made sure I understood how to work it. I was really impressed with Michael, and Jake. On top of everything professional, We really liked them both. Very personable guys. We Thank you so much for such a positive experience. We do not take that for granted, these days. I highly recommend Norman Air.

reviews.author: Pamela Harjo
reviews.text: I scheduled a routine maintenance appointment on my HVAC system. They offer competitive pricing and I was impressed with how quickly I got an appointment. Services were thorough and only took about an hour. Jake and Michael did a Fantastic job! The entire team is professional and wonderful to work with! An easy 5 stars!

reviews.author: Linda McG
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of having Alea and Taylor perform our furnace service. They worked with my schedule and kept me updated on their arrival. They were efficient and friendly. Explained everything to us in a way that I could understand. Pricing was clear and reasonable. We have used Norman Heating and Air in the past for a hot water tank replacement also. Great service. We would recommend Norman Heating and Air

reviews.author: aaron salas
reviews.text: Michael S. Was the technician we were assigned and I’m happy to say he did a great job. He was very knowledgeable and did a good job of explaining the issues and offering several different repair options. He even changed all of our air filters and installed a new smart thermostat. We also took advantage of the monthly subscription for tune ups/inspections and the discounted price!  Overall a great experience, I would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Ruchi Chakrabarty
reviews.text:
Dakota did our electricity safety inspection and also did a few other things like:
1) Changed some defective electrical outlets
2) Replaced two of our garage fluorescent lights which were not functioning properly by LED tube lights and bypassed the ballasts

Second day he had a young assistant by the name Anderson, I think (please forgive me if I am wrong). He is also very polite and friendly, learning his job very well. He was also very helpful like Dakota.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 3515 Frankford Ave #1, Philadelphia, PA 19134, USA

reviews.author: Amanda Staples
reviews.text:
UPDATE: After posting this review, Roto Rooter reached out and apologized and offered to send me back my $300. Thank you. I appreciate the accountability and response.

I first want to say, before I say so many bad things about this company, that the two men I dealt with were very, very nice.

Roto Rooter sends a plumber to unclog my sewer drain at 9pm on Sunday, thankfully. My toilet and sink are backing up into my tub. He tells me he has to remove the toilet and snake the drain, and it'll be $948, which seems insane but I'm not in my right mind so I approve. He removes my toilet and all of the water goes everywhere until it is pouring through the ceiling in my kitchen and onto the floor. I run upstairs and he's doing nothing to stop the water flowing. I bring him towels. He has no towels of his own. It seems like the flooding situation is the new problem but he's not doing anything about it, so I'm grabbing every piece of absorbent cloth in the house to keep this in check. He starts shop vaccing up water from the tub, where water is contained, and not from the floor, where water is still freely moving and pouring into the downstairs, and he throws it over the railing of my second floor porch, onto the walkway below, which nearly instantly freezes. This seems unprofessional, but I like the guy so I just tell him I have a working sink downstairs, remember? He starts shuttling the water down to the sink downstairs. After trying to snake the drain, he tells me the pipe is actually frozen. We're gonna have to open up the wall to get at it.

Meanwhile, water mitigation guy comes over to tell me that I'll have to file an insurance claim so that roto rooter can come fix the ceiling damage, and to open the wall so the plumber can fix the pipe. Nobody knows anymore how much this will cost, because now it is a huge job, but they assure me they can offer discounts.

I tell them I need to think about it and they leave. Because the plumber didn't fix the problem, I didn't pay the full price, but he did make me pay him $300 for a service charge (discounted from $418), which I guess is for the pleasure of having my bathroom and kitchen flooded with sewage water.

I ended up just waiting for the pipe to thaw, which took three days. I'll never use this company again, not just because the plumber doesn't carry towels and charges $1000 to unclog a drain, and not because the mitigation people tried to charge me for damage they caused, but because I shouldn't have had to pay them anything. They didn't fix the problem, and they caused a new problem.

reviews.author: Christopher Liddle

reviews.author: Adrianne
reviews.text:
I had an emergency situation when I noticed one of my dogs kept going to the same spot outside. When I walked over, I could hear water running before I even saw anything. I went into the basement and found water spewing everywhere from a split pipe connected to our outdoor spigot. I immediately shut off the main water valve and called J & J Plumbing Heating Cooling & Electric.

They were able to dispatch David C. to my home in LaGrange, Ohio the same day within a few hours. David was extremely professional, friendly, and patient. He explained everything in detail as he assessed the situation and showed me where the pipe had split in multiple places, even though we had turned off the shutoff and removed the hose well before winter.

He didn’t have PEX on his truck that day, so he safely capped the PVC pipe so we could turn our water back on and scheduled a return visit to complete the permanent repair. When he came back, David replaced the damaged section with PEX to allow for better expansion if freezing occurs, installed a much better shutoff valve, and even relocated the pipe farther inside the house to reduce the risk of this happening again. He confirmed there were no leaks and waited to make sure everything was working properly, which gave me real peace of mind.

He wore boot covers every time he entered the house, kept the area clean, and was very respectful of our home. Pricing was explained upfront with full transparency. While they may be slightly higher than some, the quick response, professionalism, and quality of work absolutely made it worth it.

I would definitely call J & J again and highly recommend David C. and their team.

reviews.text: Have always been happy with this company and their service.  However after paying a lot for a new water heater and water filtration system I thought the technicians could’ve been better.  There was a lot of slamming doors and after 3 hours in our home I asked how much longer it would take they said they would be done soon.  Then an hour later I asked again and asked do you think 30 min or an hour and they answered yeah.  I’m not saying I wanted them to finish up faster than necessary but they arrived at 8:30am and weren’t finished until 2pm.  I just wanted an estimate on how long it would take.  They also didn’t clean up the mess where the old water heater was moved to and the area where they replaced valves in our main floor bathroom.  Also we received very minimal information on the new filtration system.  A Google search talked about how you can set it for the number of people in your home and it wasn’t clear how to know when to put more salt in.  They only said to make sure there’s salt in there.  They never shared where to even buy more salt… again I’m sure I can google it, but it should’ve been something that was communicated.
