The option I chose was going to be a bit more work to install but Josh did a great job and adjusted some pipes to make repair in that space in the future easier. He got the job done quickly and answered any questions about the new system along the way. All staff in person and over the phone were awesome.

reviews.author: Angela Rotundo
reviews.text: Absolutely thrilled with Nytech from beginning (estimate) to end of installation! Technicians, Mike and Austin were extremely professional, knowledgeable, courteous and kind. Very respectful working inside the house, using shoe covers and left everything looking tidy and clean. Such a great experience working with this company and would highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Hurlburt Heating & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2524 Alpine Rd #A, Eau Claire, WI 54703, USA

reviews.author: John Pavel
reviews.text:
Hurlburt Heating, AC, Plumbing and Electric has some very qualified people working for them. The two that did the great plumbing job at my house are just that! My wife and I were very pleased with their work! They were very pleasant and knowledgeable and also considerate!
Logan the main man answered any question with a smile and his coworker Mike was also very friendly!
We had our water heater replaced along with new pipes and shutoffs due to corrosion and age plus they replaced a broken water meter along with new pipes and shutoff valves!
They came out the same day I called and stated working on the problem!
It was amazing watching them work plus hearing them enjoy their work!
I must give a plug to Rebecca the person that helped get these two amazing workers! She was so thoughtful about our problem and gave me so many good suggestions!
I would not hesitate to contact Hurlburt again!

reviews.author: Chris Howard
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with the Hurlburt team as Dylan Olson laid out some great options for replacing our 40 year old furnace/water heater/heat pump - including rebates and tax credits.

The crew was on -time, efficient, and clearly experts in their craft.  When finished, Dave reviewed all the new equipment thoroughly with me, including the thermostat options and capabilities.

I highly recommend this team.

reviews.author: Dan O
reviews.text:
Had an unusual issue with my furnace. Called Hurlburt heating and they sent Mike B out.  Mike was wonderful, nice, knowledgeable, professional and a true craftsman at his trade. Troubleshooting was fantastic. Although we had a couple different problems he easily found the problems and fixed both of them. Parts where in his vehicle and has the furnace working better than we can remember. Thanks Mike. It was wonderful getting to know you. We truly appreciate you.

Dan Olson

reviews.author: Jeanne Larson
reviews.text: Bryson did an awesome job unplugging my sink and even cleaned both sinks out. Very professional and explained everything in detail. He even asked me if there were anything else he could help with. I plan on getting him again in the future.

reviews.author: PXGrDn
reviews.text: Highly recommended! Every step from diagnosing the issue of our furnace to installing. It was laid out and no pressure. Shout out to Mike for the initial check up, Dylan for coming out for the logistics, and Austin and co for the amazing work!

plumbers.name: Lancaster Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical
plumbers.address: 1184 Enterprise Rd, East Petersburg, PA 17520, USA

reviews.author: John Penny
reviews.text: I have been a customer of Lancaster Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical for several years.  The Customer Service representatives are very professional and courteous. Their technicians have been wonderful!  My latest need was a 29+ year   old well pump that was sending warning signs that the end is near.  My water system tech (Robert R.) was/is awesome!  Robert has provided service in the past on other plumbing service needs and was the lead on this project. He and the other technician replaced the well pump, piping, electrical wiring and incorporated additional features and safeguards (not standard 29 years ago) with the replacement service.  He performed all the water system checks and verifications. All is good!! Koodoos to Robert!  Very much appreciated!

reviews.author: Amy Novack
reviews.text:
Mike D. was excellent. He was punctual, professional, and extremely knowledgeable. I honestly have nothing bad to say.

To be transparent, I had another plumbing company out prior to this visit, and while the outcome ended up being the same, I didn’t get the best vibes. Mike was the complete opposite. He took the time to explain everything clearly and thoroughly, which made a huge difference.

Despite the cold weather, Mike went outside and removed the vent cap from the pipe in our front yard. He explained that it wasn’t technically up to code, and once he educated me on why, I completely agreed. He then had me flush a toilet so he could watch the water flow and reassured me that everything was moving properly — even showing me visually, which I really appreciated.

He made a simple but effective fix by adding ventilation holes to the cap, secured it back in place, and then walked through the house with me one last time. He flushed the toilets again and explained that the remaining issue is the roof vent pipe being covered in snow and ice.

I felt very confident in Mike’s work, his explanations, and his professionalism. I would absolutely recommend him and would not hesitate to call again.

reviews.author: Andrew Lopez
reviews.text: I’ve been using Lanc Heating and Plumbing since I got my house a few years ago. They provide the best customer service all around. They’re honest, kind, and personable. They also educate so you don’t damage your equipment and can keep maintenance up to par. Quality of the work is also worth every penny. I highly recommend them if you’re in the market for any of the services they provide.

reviews.author: Amanda Ortiz
reviews.text: Had a plumber come out to fix a water valve for my washer 3in1. He was able to move my new washer into the space I needed(was charged for this). During the process he damaged my floors. I didn’t noticed it until I moved out the dryer. When I tried to use the washer it started shaking I noticed he forgot to take the shipping bolts out so he came back out the next day and while moving the washer again he made the floor damage worse and then tried to fix it to hide it. Very careless.

reviews.author: Elijah McNaughton
reviews.text: Our aging high velocity central air system failed and we needed a new heating and cooling system in our home. We had several companies come out and give estimates for replacement systems but in the end we selected Lancaster Plumbing, Heating, Cooling and Electrical (LPHCE) and I am so glad that we did. LPHCE did an excellent job for us from start to finish. Our initial contact Ian supplied us with a wealth of knowledge regarding what our options were moving forward. He took the time to answer all of our questions and made sure to have multiple estimates drawn up before he left our property. He also kindly made himself available via text messaging when we had more questions later regarding our options. The estimate that we received was very fair and I got the sense that LPHCE was going to do everything that they could to secure our business. After considering our options we decided to have mini split heat pumps installed. Ian came out to our property again, this time with installation specialist Rick. They helped us finalize our plans for the installation and directly addressed a few lingering concerns that we still had. A week or so later a well organized installation team made short work of the project over the course of two days. While all of the techs assigned to the job were professional and courteous a special shout out goes to Ben for going up into the attic area and out on the roof to get the job done right. The end result is a system that operates as good as it looks. We are anticipating many comfortable years in our home thanks to the efforts of everyone at LPHCE. We plan to call on them in the future for our heating, cooling, plumbing, and electrical needs. I submit this review as a hardy recommendation to try out their services, particularly if you are in the market for a new heating and cooling system. They are family owned and locally operated. Most importantly they cared about doing the job, and they cared about doing it right.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 50 Franklin St #407, Boston, MA 02110, USA

reviews.author: April Gorey
reviews.text: Atef was here in less than an hour on a Sunday night! He was very professional. He explained everything gave a great price and was finished very quickly. We are definitely going to be using Roto Rooter for every plumbing problem and will request Atef every time! Thanks so much!!!

reviews.author: Mike A
reviews.text: Service was scheduled quickly with plenty of date/time options to choose from. Technician arrived on time and had my drain fixed quickly. No issues since then. Price was a little higher than I hoped it would be, but what doesn't cost a few extra bucks nowadays? Totally worth it though for the quality of work and willingness to stand behind the results for 6 months. I'd go with these guys again for sure.

reviews.author: Ashley Blades
reviews.text: I cannot thank Ron, Gilbert, and Joe enough. Our first experience with Roto Rooter was not good - the following day, Joe, the manager, came out to assess & rectify the situation himself. He apologized for our previous situation & within a few hours Gilbert was there to help. He worked for over 3 hours, was unable to fix the problem but left us with a plan. He even called the next morning to check in. Ron came that evening and within two hours he was able to fix our clogged pipe. Ron & Gilbert were phenomenal. They talked us through everything, showed us the issue, and wouldn't leave until it was fixed. I cannot thank them enough!

reviews.author: Joe S. Adams
reviews.text: He did an exceptional job clearing the sewer drain blockage in our home. The work was handled quickly, efficiently, and with a clear level of skill and know-how. He took the time to make sure everything was done right, explaining things along the way and paying close attention to the details. His professionalism really stood out and made what could have been a stressful situation completely hassle-free. When he finished, our plumbing was running perfectly again. Overall, a smooth, stress-free experience with results we’re very happy with.

reviews.author: Linqian Qiu
reviews.text: Ron was my technician and came on a raining night and helped the bathtub issue at my apartment! He tried to trouble shoot before we really had to tear down the walls, floors/downstairs ceiling! I truly appreciated him! He know what he is doing and even if it does not work out, $99 is pretty fair in my opinion! Thanks so much Ron!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 2300 Hammond Dr, Schaumburg, IL 60173, USA

reviews.author: Michael Touhy
reviews.text:
We had sewage coming up from our basement laundry drain and called Roto Rooter to help us. They did anything but. Eddie arrived on site and called in his supervisor, Max Corner. Max said that he was unable to open up the main basement clean out so they had to run equipment from the main floor bathroom. This added 8-10’ to how far they attempted to rod which apparently weakened their equipment enough that they were not able to properly determine where the actual damage was. Max drew up a proposal and told me once I signed they would be able to get a crew out the next day to begin work. I signed the contract trying to get my home back in order and Max then called to tell me they actually wouldn’t be able to start the next day because he had already left and did not map out the yard (never received an explanation as to why this was not done when he was on site). He returned the next day and due to the cold weather he could not get his equipment or spray paint to work leading him to pace my yard yelling curse words for 20+ minutes getting to the point where a neighbor had to call and ask if everything was ok at the house. Max then came back in to do the same inside because he was not able to get the toilet back on (photo attached). He left it like this and said it was fine because it wasn’t actively leaking.
The next day a crew was supposed to arrive by 10am and they showed up around 2pm. They dug a hole and cracked my line and despite this area not being the issue, put in a clean out and left. Public Works actually told them that that do not appear to be the issue spot and they told him that that was the spot they were contracted to dig. They sent in a jetter who said that the issue was actually 8-10’ farther down the line and max would have to come back. The jetter also would not hook up his equipment to the main line because it was only accessible under my porch and he would not go under there. So he cut a hole in my basement window screen and hooked up to a near 100 year old laundry tub which is now leaking.
Max came back and confirmed that the issue was actually 10’ farther down the line and immediately quoted me an additional $7000 even though I was already out $8500 FOR WORK THAT DID NOT HAVE TO BE DONE!
I told him that I was not going to use them and called a local plumber who said that the job was actually $3500.
I’m getting in touch with an attorney as I now have more damage than when I called in Roto Rooter and they did unnecessary work for which they overcharged.

reviews.author: Ieasha Mccullough
reviews.text: So grateful for Mike! He did an excellent job explaining what the possible reasons for my sink backup could be and an even greater job providing me with reasonable and affordable solutions. Extremely satisfied with the service provided. Got my water flowing and sink draining in no time! Huge thank you to MIke!

reviews.author: immari hysaw
reviews.text: Mike at Roto-Rooter did a fantastic job! Took time to explain the process, periodically informed me of his progress, resolved the issue and cleaned up after himself. Got here quickly and completed the job quickly as well. Highly Recommend!

reviews.author: Keith Schultz
reviews.text: Had a utility sink in basement that would not drain. House built in 1921 so pipe is very old cast iron. Your technician worked on the clog diligently for over 1.5 hours trying multiple rodding bits and sizes. He was not giving up without a fight, and fight he did. He was very proffeaional, cleaned area after he finished, and apologized for not being able to clear the drain. He is a great asset to your company, and I commend him for a heroic effort. I would give him 6 stars if I could. Since he could not clear the drain he did not charge me, which I honestly felt bad about.  Bravo Roto Router! Luis, tech # 6165 is an outstanding employee for you guys!

reviews.author: Jeff Therkelsen
reviews.text: Mike, my technician, was awesome. He was extremely courteous and kept me informed throughout the repair. Mine was a very difficult main drain to open. He put every effort into clearing it. He just wouldn’t give up. I’m sure many other companies would have thrown in the towel and recommended that I call an excavator. Not Mike; he kept at it until he was able to clear it out. There is one set fee and he gave me that upfront. And then he proceeded to spend four hours working on it. This is the second time that I’ve needed their service and was more than satisfied with their. On a scale of one to five they are a ten!

plumbers.name: Roto Rooter Plumbing Service
plumbers.address: 5189 King Hwy, Kalamazoo, MI 49048, USA

reviews.author: Britt Hartenberger
reviews.text: Very helpful and persistent in fixing a stubborn clog. Dairyion was polite and courteous and kept the path to the bathroom clean. He also explained a bit about our particular pipes and plumbing in old houses such as ours. Would recommend to others! They were also able to provide same-day service which I was not expecting.

reviews.author: Tom Cochran
reviews.text:
Robert (Rob), from Roto-Rooter worked twice at my house. Once to install a new toilet and second to cut out old kitchen piping and install new plumbing along with a new outside hose attachment.

Both well within estimated times of completion. He worked alone, but did all cutting, removing, and installing new piping quickly and efficiently. The cost was much lower than expected. I wouldn't hesitate to have Roto-Rooter and Robert back again.

Thanks, Tom

reviews.author: Lorrie M.
reviews.text: We appreciated Ray's punctuality and friendly demeanor. He took care of our problem efficiently and cleaned up nicely before he left. Thanks for a job well done!

reviews.author: Abby Monroe
reviews.text: Today we had an unexpected backup at our home. We called Roto Rooter and our experience was amazing from the beginning starting with the customer service call with Karen. They notified us when our technician Kaiden was on his way. It wasn’t an easy job and Kaiden kept us well informed of the progress. He worked extremely hard until the backup was cleared. Roto-Rooter was honest and worked with us and got the job done successfully. I would highly recommend them to anyone in need of their services. Thank you for the job well done.

reviews.author: Danielle Acker
reviews.text: Our experience was amazing. He got our appointment soon and situation handled efficiently. Robert Dolnik was amazing. He was quick, thorough, and informative. He made sure we understood what he did and was polite enough to ensure he didn't track snow/salt into the home. Hopefully we won't need him back😁, but if we do we know who to call! Thanks again

reviews.author: Tony Da Taiga
reviews.text: Bill did an awesome job diagnosing my problem and coming up with a solution with my landlord that didn't involve any delays. Was able to repair my rotted waterline in no time. Feel bad cause it was so muddy but he powered though no problem! 👌

reviews.author: Kingston dias
reviews.text: These guys are the best, I always call them for help with my house and they come out fast, they keep in touch, the plumbers are great and very knowledgeable and friendly. Today they helped replace a very corroded and rusted (falling apart) kitchen faucet with this nice new one. I know the guy had a hard time so I appreciate the good work. Thank you!

reviews.author: Urs C
reviews.text:
I called A-1 Budget Plumbing this morning and Justin came this afternoon!
He initially came to fix my leaking toilet tank, then I asked if he could check my basin faucet. He was so patient and such a super kind person. I got my toilet fixed and a brand new faucet too!!! He had all the parts he needed for the job in his van!
Mahalo plenty Justin. I appreciate you! And to the woman I spoke with on the phone who fit me in today, big Mahalo.
Happy New Year!!!

reviews.author: x
reviews.text: Thank you so much Louis ! My home is messy and cluttered and Louis still was patient with me and my kids.  He listened to what was wrong with the bathroom sink and checked it right away.  He gave me tips for bottom of cabinet and how to take out drain to clean it.  Thank you so much for coming early and being patient with all of us , We are so happy we have a new faucet.  There is no more leak and we are so happy !  Thank you again Louis and  A - 1 Budget Plumbing :)

reviews.author: Hughman Bean
reviews.text: Austin was an awesome plumber. He came to check out the leaky faucet in our bath and fixed it within the first 20 mins. Our bath now functions smoothly and sparkles!

plumbers.address: 5126 N Ravenswood Ave, Chicago, IL 60640, USA

reviews.author: Michelle Tyler
reviews.text: I had a great experience working with Clayton G. From the start, he really listened and understood what I was hoping to accomplish, and did everything possible to make sure the work aligned with my goals. He explained the process clearly, was respectful of my time and property, and paid attention to every detail. Super friendly and easy to work with — I never felt like the initial plan was being altered or going in a direction that would cost more than I agreed to. The finished result is exactly what I needed. I would absolutely use him again and highly recommend to anyone looking for a reliable and thoughtful plumber.

reviews.author: Robert Koehler
reviews.text: Emmanuel, Gio, and Greg were a great team. Handled the job with complete professionalism and left confident the money was well spent with the right people.  Fixed the sewer line using the best method and technology. Good interpersonal skills. Thank you.

reviews.author: Jose Flores
reviews.text: Christian and Julian stopped by for maintenance, my wife and I had been complaining about a running toilet for a few weeks. Christian changed out our flapper, and even tightened down the toilet bolts while he was at it, at no extra charge! I love having a plumbing company that doesn’t try to upsell on everything possible. Thank you Christian and Julian!

reviews.author: Susan Bledsoe
reviews.text:
My technician Andreas Pastos showed up on time. He was friendly and personable. He thought he was there to do a sewage line clearance but I really needed a toilet unplugged. I had tried to plunge the toilet myself but due to a recent hip surgery was unable to do it without increasing my pain exponentially.  Andreas used my plunger, gave me a lesson and how to use less energy to get the line clear and took care of my plumbing issue quickly and efficiently.  On top of that he was a great neighbor and would accept no money. He would not even let me give him money to buy him breakfast.  Who dies that any more?  I am so grateful.   This company will definitely be on my go-to list.

I also love their security. They text me a picture of the guy who was going to show up at my door and let me know exactly when he was coming.  First class.

reviews.author: Seth Maybury
reviews.text: Super helpfull.   They called back on a Sunday late afternoon and came out that evening.   3 plumbers came to the house on Monday to finish the job.   Joe, George and Anthony.   Highly recommend them.   No one wants to have Sewage backing up, they treated it like an emergency and kept at it.    Thank you.  Highly recommended..  (and the price was 100% fair).

plumbers.name: Rodenhiser Home Services
plumbers.address: 325 Hopping Brook Rd, Holliston, MA 01746, USA

reviews.author: DCUO-GodFlame
reviews.text:
We woke up Monday morning to frozen pipes in our kitchen on Monday, December 29, 2025.   Frantic, we searched the internet for a reputable plumbing company.   We immediately came across Rodenhiser Home Services.

After receiving an appointment the same day we were greeted by Brendan O’Malley.  He arrived in his truck professionally prepared to get the job done.

He carefully explained the job needed and what steps he would take to complete the job.

After assessing the job and handing me the quote he immediately began the task at hand.

As I patiently waited for him to finish the project he took care in answering any and all questions I had.  He explained everything in detail even to the point of showing me the foundation problem areas.

I must say Brendan is an asset to Rodenhiser!   Without his expertise and professionalism this holiday season would have been a disaster!

Thank you for your wonderful workmanship and dedication!  My family and I thank you and will pass you and your company along to those that are looking for the expertise we experienced in your hands!

As I told you, you are what a TRUE human being is supposed to be!  Never did you treat us a $ grab!  You treated us with respect, dignity and we are Blessed to have had you to service our home.  Thank you, Brendan!

reviews.author: Lindsey Granlund
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough great things about Rodenhiser! We needed help with a few kitchen faucet issues, and they absolutely delivered. From the moment we called, they were responsive, professional, and easy to work with.

Corrine arrived on time, quickly diagnosed the problems, and explained everything clearly before getting started. They fixed multiple faucet issues efficiently and made sure everything was working perfectly before leaving. The quality of work was excellent, and they left the kitchen spotless.

Honest pricing, top-notch service, and true professionalism. If you need plumbing work done — especially kitchen faucet repairs — this is the company to call. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.text:
I could not be more disappointed in their work installing my HVAC system. I worked with Rick to define the plan, the pricing was higher but he assured me that it would be fast and seamless. It has been anything but. It has been over a month and I’ve still not heard back about them finishing. They were supposed to take two days and instead tool three then had to come back three times with no resolution still. They are not communicative, extremely messy, do not listen to the homeowner, and if you aren’t an HVAC installer yourself directing their every move expect maybe 50% of what is supposed to work to work. The temp varies +\- 6 degrees after them “fixing it” 3x. The attic unit is in the completely wrong place. The inspection still hasn’t taken place. The outlet for the air purifier was installed wrong and after 3x tries to fix it and they just bold face lied to me and said it was working but isn’t. To add insult to injury, they left trash buried in the attic insulation. There’s more but I cannot stomach continuing because of the absolute absurdity. DON’T HIRE THEIR HVAC TEAM. I cancelled the 10 year warrantee I was going to do with them and the over $100k worth of other projects.

August 2025 Update:
While the company posted a response here, they did not respond to the 93A demand letter I sent via certified mail and email within the 30-day legal window. Since posting my initial review, I have obtained a professional assessment stating that:
•	The attic system was installed backwards.
•	The purifier was installed contrary to manufacturer instructions.
•	A sharpie arrow was drawn on the unit in the opposite direction of the manufacturer’s indicated airflow.
•	The metal contact plates on the air purifier were bent.
•	The thermostat was placed in a suboptimal location for comfort settings.
•	Critical components on the branch box were not activated.

I had to request the town complete the electrical inspection, but the mechanical inspection remains incomplete, the system warranties have not been submitted, and my MassSave rebate is on hold. A repair estimate from another contractor places necessary corrections at $25,550. Since I'll need to use another contractor, that will need to be out of pocket as I will lose eligibility for MassSave’s 8-year 0% financing for the balance. The company has sent my account to a debt collection attorney without a prior written or verbal request for the balance and filed a mechanic’s lien on my home.

Again, based on my experience, I would not recommend hiring this company.

reviews.author: Pamela
reviews.text: I am incredibly grateful for the awesome service I received from Donquor at Rodenhiser. In addition to responding quickly to the emergency call I had placed, Donquor did such an amazing job repairing the pinhole leak in one of my baseboard heating pipes. He even captured before-and-after photos for me to submit to my insurance company and was so unbelievably kind. I couldn't be any more satisfied with the service I received and highly recommend Donquor and everyone at Rodenhiser!

reviews.author: Heidi Gilmore
reviews.text:
Rodenhiser sent us very skilled, personable, helpful plumbers for the replacement of our old hot water heater. We are very pleased with the job they did and with the attitude they conveyed of partnership. Corinne and Josh did a good job explaining what they were doing. Where warranted, they explained the ramifications of choices we had to make and associated cost. This was our first time using Rodenhiser and we are fans.

I am checking "overpriced" but that is because I think everyone is overpriced. There are not enough plumbers and it shows in everyone's pricing. I will say, though, that Rodenhiser was not the highest priced of the four quotes we got.

plumbers.name: Nicholson Plumbing, Electrical, Heating, and Air Conditioning
plumbers.address: 71 Whitney St, Holliston, MA 01746, USA

reviews.author: Karen S
reviews.text: This was my first time using Nicholson. We had 3 new faucets to be installed. The customer service was excellent. They notified me when the plumber was leaving so I had time to clean out under my sinks. Jimmy did an outstanding job--neat, professional, explained everything clearly, and was great with my dogs. He found that the shutoff to the hot water in one bathroom was broken and offered me options. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Andrea Lebron
reviews.text: Jimmy did an excellent job replacing our water heater after it started leaking. He was patient, explained everything clearly, and was very professional. This is my second major service with Nicholson (previously replaced boiler) and am happy once again.

reviews.author: Rob Lucier
reviews.text:
We replaced both our upstairs and downstairs furnaces, and despite a small initial mix-up, the company handled it quickly and professionally. They installed new Daikin/Goodman furnaces, added two Nest thermostats along with a Honeywell Home thermostat in the basement, and—best of all—fixed our zoning so it finally works as it should.

The service team was courteous, knowledgeable, and genuinely friendly. They took great care to protect our floors, worked neatly, and left everything spotless. Solid workmanship, great service, and a company that stands behind its work. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Andy Wong (Ryv)
reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience working with Nicholas Brodeur and the team from Nicholson Plumbing. From the moment they arrived, Nicholas was professional, communicative, and very thorough in walking me through the game plan for repairing my master bathroom shower drain which leaked below into our garage. He made sure I understood the scope of work and confirmed the pricing before getting started.

The job itself turned out to be more involved than expected due to a cracked PVC trap behind the old strainer, but Nicholas handled the situation expertly. He and his team carefully cut out the damaged sections, added the necessary coupling, cleaned the shower stall surfaces to ensure a solid connection, and installed the new strainer. They allowed proper curing time, ran multiple tests including filling the entire shower stall and confirmed everything was completely leak-free.

I was especially impressed with how Nicholas coordinated around the MA Restoration team when they came by to take ceiling samples for testing, pausing when needed and picking right back up without missing a beat. Once the work was finished, Nicholas showed me the results, answered all my questions, and left the area clean and tidy. The shower drain is working perfectly now, and I’m happy with the outcome.

It’s clear Nicholas takes pride in his work and genuinely cares about customer satisfaction. I would absolutely recommend him and Nicholson Plumbing. Excellent experience from start to finish.

reviews.author: Joshua Morgan
reviews.text:
Great all around! This is now the fourth different company we’ve used since purchasing our home, and Nicholson has been the best by far. From scheduling and customer service to pricing and quality of work, they outperformed the other three companies we worked with.

When we had an emergency clogged kitchen drain, they were quick to send someone out. Oliver was outstanding — knowledgeable, honest, and hardworking. He took the time to answer all of our questions and addressed other areas of concern we had around the house when we weren’t sure who to turn to.

I mentioned that I had spent four hours trying (and failing) to replace a kitchen faucet that was completely rusted through. Oliver took one look at it, quickly pulled up an estimate, and replaced it seamlessly in a matter of minutes. His experience was obvious.

He was also very respectful of our home — mindful of cleanliness, noise levels, and even our pets — which we truly appreciated. Oliver’s approach put us completely at ease and made us feel confident we chose the right company. Because of this experience, Nicholson has gained lifelong customers.

plumbers.name: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing of Nashville
plumbers.address: 207 Century Ct, Franklin, TN 37064, USA

reviews.author: Ben Watts
reviews.text: Jessy and Jeremy are truly outstanding plumbers who exceeded every expectation. They arrived on time, were professional and friendly, and immediately made me feel confident in their expertise. They carefully explained the issue, diagnosed it thoroughly, and fixed it flawlessly without cutting corners. Their attention to detail and commitment to quality really stood out. They worked efficiently while still taking the time to answer my questions with patience and clarity. Best of all, they left everything spotless when the job was done. If you want reliable, skilled, and genuinely great professionals, Jessy and Jeremy are the ones to call.

reviews.author: Tracy Evers
reviews.text: We have used this company for years.  They have not let us down. Our most recent work had a minor issue that kept the solution from working and they showed up pronto and made the simple fix and bingo. Awesome.  They are really, really great.

reviews.author: Vicky Seapker
reviews.text: I NEVER give 5 stars because I don't believe "perfect" exists, but I had a bathroom remodel done and had to outsource plumbing to get the results I wanted. We'll start with Scott... friendly, fun, light hearted and filled with corny jokes. Scott accessed what my project and was very confident it could be done and let me know it was a 3 step process. An appointment was then made to have the work done. Zach and Tyler showed up promptly, handled their business and told me to call when I was ready for the second visit. The remodel was complete and it was time to call the plumbers in to install the toilet and sink. I called and  my appointment was set up for the next day. Zach and Tyler showed up promptly handled their business and told me there was no need for a third visit. I was in agreement. Upon installing my toilet Zach noticed there was a clog in my system. He then called the company to see if a technician could be sent out to address the clog issue. They were able to come out later that day. Meanwhile it was lunch time and I recommend a restaurant and told them what I usually ordered from the menu. After lunch they returned and finished up. During the lunch hour I went to the grocery store and returned just as they were packing to leave. I was putting my groceries away in the refrigerator and saw a to go plate with writing on it. Zack left me the lunch I had mentioned to him with a thank you. Such a sweet gesture. Joe M was the technician who came to ease my (p)drain. He worked diligently in the cold until he cleared my (p)drain. This was a long post to say my experience with Benjamin Franklin was a good one. From the initial assessment, to the plumbers and the technician... all were respectful, knowledgeable, and caring. I will recommend them to anyone who approaches me with plumbing issues. Thank you Benjamin Franklin for a stress free experience.

reviews.author: Gyuzel Fedorov (Gyuzel Fedorov)
reviews.text:
Our tankless water heater under guarantee. I’m cover heater in my blanket. After my water comes out warm not hot. Technician come to my house, take off blanket and water start coming hot. They charge for it $99
It’s ridiculous. Be careful. Looks like scam. We finished build another house and I want buy another heater from this company. Now of course I’m not buying anything from this company

reviews.author: S. K.
reviews.text: Ryan communicated when he was en rout and showed up on time. I explained my issue and he immediately understood the situation. Offered a great solution and executed the work in a professional and timely manner. Would highly recommend.

plumbers.name: Len The Plumber Heating & Air, LLC
plumbers.address: 2091 Springdale Rd, Cherry Hill Township, NJ 08003, USA

reviews.author: Cathy Young-Pepe
reviews.text: Talk about clean professional plumbing work and Josh Howe is the man. Professional, kind and even showed our 3 dogs some TLC. I would highly recommend Josh and the entire team at Len's. Josh assisted another plumber from Len's who drove 40 minutes to pick up a tool Josh had to ensure he could be successful at his job site. Just look at his work attached! Thanks Josh for making my husbands aquarium changes much easier now. Utility sink installed in our basement, we are septic and well water.

reviews.author: Kristin Faranca
reviews.text:
Danny Allen did an excellent job. He was polite,  friendly, professional, and very respectful of our home. From the moment he arrived, he clearly explained the issue and walked me through the steps he would take to fix it, which I really appreciated. His work was clean, thorough, and efficient.

I want to commend Danny for the quality of his service — he’s truly one of the best. I will absolutely request him again in the future (though hopefully I won’t need another plumbing issue anytime soon!). It’s reassuring to know we’re in good hands when he’s on the job. Thank you, Danny! 👏

reviews.author: Grace Walker
reviews.text: We had an emergency water leak. Called and had immediate attention given to us. A certified plumber was assigned and arrived within an hour. Mark came in and assessed and gave us a quote. He proceeded to fix the problem. Mark gave excellent service. He  deserves a five star rating. Very happy with his workmanship. He is a great plumber.

reviews.author: Mandy Stirparo
reviews.text: Brian B was excellent. Prompt. Profession. Courteous. So friendly that two of my cats followed him around the whole time. He explained what he thought was going on with our toilet, presented me with a few options from replacing pieces to doing a full replacement, along with the prices of each option and then completed the one that I chose.  He is an asset to the company and we will request him again if we have plumbing issues. Our regular person wasn’t available this week, so Len the Plumber was our next choice and I was worried, but did not need to be. Great service and a great tech.

reviews.author: Gigi A.
reviews.text: They were fantastic,  especially Mr. Phil and Mr. Verdel is the best. I would definitely recommend.  Kept everything clean, wore bootie, and very professional. The best

plumbers.name: Cardinal Plumbing Heating & Air Inc
plumbers.address: 104 Carpenter Dr Suite D, Sterling, VA 20164, USA

reviews.author: ROBIN H.
reviews.text: Kyle was very professional! He knew the details about the unit he was installing, reviewed the contract terms and explained his work upon completion. He was prompt and even cleaned up after the work was completed. Also , he offered to help me replace the contents from the cabinet under the sink! Much appreciated!!

reviews.author: Sara McLaughlin
reviews.text:
We recently used Cardinal Plumbing, Heating & Air for the first time as new homeowners and had such a great experience! We noticed our toilet kept running and our shower had a small leak, so we called for help. Angelo came out and was absolutely fantastic to work with. He took the time to carefully inspect our toilet, water heater, and shower, and then provided us with multiple quotes and clear options for how to fix everything.

Once we decided which route to go, Cardinal got us scheduled quickly, and Angelo had everything fixed in no time. He was knowledgeable, professional, and very friendly throughout the whole process.

We are so glad we chose Cardinal and will definitely use them again and again. The attached photos show one of the items used to fix our issue - a new Pressure Reducing Valve to make sure our water pressure is just right.

Thanks so much, Angelo! We really appreciate your hard work and look forward to working with you again!

reviews.author: Andrew Williams
reviews.text: Great experience with Cardinal! We were long overdue for HVAC routine maintenance and were able to quickly schedule this week. Jay was our tech and he truly went above and beyond. Not only did he do a very thorough take down of our now 20+ year old furnace to inspect/troubleshoot, he also provided a lot of practical and helpful tips for overall HVAC and home maintenance. He was very detailed in his explanations and recommendations, we didn't feel pressured whatsoever. Highly recommend Cardinal for any HVAC needs - and thank you again Jay!

reviews.author: Robert Lindner
reviews.text: As new, first-time homeowners, we called on Cardinal HVAC & Plumbing for an inspection and service on our new home's HVAC unit. James did a thorough inspection of our system, finding several urgent issues that he presented as genuinely needing immediate addressing for not only our unit's health, but our own as well. With more than reasonable pricing, James was able to begin making the necessary upgrades same day, working quietly and quickly, and didn't leave until the other needed services were scheduled. After just one service appointment and install, we feel in great hands with Cardinal and their Nest Protection Plan in our home going forward!

reviews.author: Matthew Brooks
reviews.text: Had an issue with my hot water and needed help fast. Stephan came out first to figure out what was going on and provided a clear estimate without any pressure. Danny handled the install and did a great job — professional, courteous, and worked efficiently. They got everything up and running quickly and left the area clean. Appreciate how smooth and straightforward the whole process was. Would definitely use them again.

plumbers.name: Schrader Plumbing
plumbers.address: 5520 Davis Blvd, North Richland Hills, TX 76180, USA

reviews.author: Natalie Spoelstra
reviews.text: Cody and Hunter were very professional and explained everything clearly. Not our first time with them and def not our last. They replaced our water heater in 3 hours and made sure we were comfortable with all decisions. Amazing customer service. Fast service. Genuinely wanted us to be happy. Highly recommend. Arrived early. Estimated cost is what I paid. Trustworthy. If you’re looking for a solid company. Call Schrader. They’ll take care of you. PLUS! They made sure the codes and permits were all taken care of. One cost for everything and I live in a strict district. Thanks yall. Has and will be our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Steph C
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about our experience with Andy and the Schrader Plumbing team. Andy carefully evaluated the issue, explained everything clearly, and resolved multiple clogged drains without unnecessary work. It is rare to find this level of honesty and customer care. I truly appreciate the professionalism and would recommend them without hesitation.

reviews.author: Glen Campbell
reviews.text:
We had backed up sewer drain and toilet overflow problem. Schrader very efficiently got us scheduled. High marks for texting and email and phone notifications regarding appointment.

The plumber, Weldon was on-time and very polite and professional. He told me everything he was going to do. He took beforehand pictures. He was very good at identifying my level of knowledge and then speaking clearly at my level if understanding.

We got the immediate problem addressed and also talked about pros and cons of possible next steps. Weldon provided clear & useful information, an estimate of recommended work, and no sales pressure.

So, homeowner stuff costs money but it hurts less when  I have reason to believe I'm dealing with an honest professional. Schrader is a solid choice. Five stars.

reviews.author: Qua QUA
reviews.text:
Alec came out with another technician, and both of them were extremely helpful and knowledgeable. Alec took the time to explain everything clearly and gave me great insight into the situation instead of rushing through it. You can tell he has real experience and takes a lot of pride in doing things the right way.

Safety seemed to be his number one priority, and I really appreciated that he was honest and even redirected me to other resources when needed to make sure the job would be done properly. That level of integrity goes a long way.

Both technicians were very respectful in my home, professional, and easy to trust. I definitely feel confident using their services again in the future and will absolutely be referring them to others. Thank you for such great service!

reviews.author: Linda Giles
reviews.text: I’ve tried numerous plumbing companies over the years and can honestly say I am done searching, this plumbing company was fast and efficient. The plumber that came out was John. John listened to what is was trying to explain, verified we were on the same page, he gave me a reasonable quote and proceeded to get the job done in less than 15 min. This job was the exact job that a plumber from a different company told me the day before that I should just replace my 2yo bidet, that he’d try to fix it but he might break it!  He said all that even with a video the mfg sent with step by step instructions.  His quote was $600.  I sent him on his way. So glad I did vi found my forever plumber today. John was efficient, courteous, polite and most of all he did a great job for a price that didn’t break the bank. Highly recommend this company!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 505 20th St N #125, Birmingham, AL 35203, USA

reviews.author: Matt Sajpel
reviews.text: Todd the field supervisor was able to come out and assess my problem and had someone come and fix my leak the same day. Phil came to repair a leak in my concrete slab. Technician Phil was outstanding! He was very quick, efficient, and professional. Highly recommend! The time that this was able to be done exceeded my expectation.

reviews.author: Maher Qashou
reviews.text:
Unpleasant experience with this company. Their tech busted a drain pipe inside the wall; it started leaking inside the wall and it took us few weeks to notice when our kitchen hardwood floor started buckling. His manager offered no help and didn’t want to be responsible for any of it. Had to hire contractors to fix my plumbing, cabinets, wall and floor.
Not to mention the inconvenience since our kitchen was out of commission for few days

reviews.author: Fredrick Williams
reviews.text: Contacted Roto-Rooter  today and requested same day service due plumbing was backing up. Representative assured me someone would come out today and at my convenience. The technician that showed up was Mr. Alex, he arrived precisely on time and after I explained the trouble he immediately explained the possible problems and prior to beginning the work he advised the exact cost. Mr. Alex went straight to work and within several minutes the job was completed. Due to his professionalism I will definitely be calling on Roto-Rooter again whenever the need arises and I will request for Mr. Alex. Five Stars and above to you Mr. Alex!!

reviews.author: Chris Fletcher
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter was fantastic in our time of need. They came out day-of to assess our plumbing emergency, offered immediate recommendations on how to address the issue and put us on their schedule quickly to get our water back up and running. Everyone we worked with was professional and we haven't had any issues since the repair. Would absolutely recommend this team if you need emergency plumbing work.

reviews.author: Lyn whitte
reviews.text: After having two plumbers to come out 6 times to no avail. Roto Rooter came out once for a consultation, once to repair and a 3rd time to fix the shattered pipe that another company did in the street. I’ll recommend them to anyone. They ran their camera in our line and found the problem immediately. Jose and his helper did an awesome job. The supervisor Kevin was very professional and informative. There were two other guys and they were helpful also. Their team work made our dream work!!! Thanks for all of your professional, hard work. The pictures don’t do any justice to the hard work they preformed.

plumbers.name: Hiller Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical
plumbers.address: 2555 Pulaski Hwy, Columbia, TN 38401, USA

reviews.author: Chris Stout
reviews.text:
I was in the Nashville area visiting my son and his bathroom had a leak. I checked reviews and Hiller  Plumbing had great reviews. I was able to make an appointment online and they came out the next day. The plumber, Joseph, was friendly and professional. He took the time to diagnose the problem and fix the issue. I was very impressed!
My son now knows who to call if he has any other plumbing issues. Well Done Hiller!

reviews.author: Christine Minton
reviews.text: Steven came out to our house this morning (in the snow) and fixed our leak very quickly! He was very kind, had a great personality, made sure we understood what services he was performing for us today, and just made us feel like he’d known us our whole lives! Truly a great service specialist and an awesome guy! Thanks for the wonderful work today!

reviews.author: Miki Peek
reviews.text: Christopher with Hiller Plumbing deserves the best review! After finding a gushing leak in the water line directly to the house - he came up with a solution and worked in terrible weather with pouring rain until way past a normal business day and in the dark! We have water now and are so very grateful!

reviews.author: Elena Wisniewski
reviews.text:
I want to thank Mitchell Davis! I got a flat trying to go visit family for my birthday and he stopped and changed my flat tire on his way home from work. I couldn’t be more grateful. I got home safely and was able to get the tire fixed the next day. He was exceptional. If he does his job and treats people the way he treated me in a time of chaos and stress, then I know he is the man to call for any of your repair needs.

Thanks again, Mitchell, and thanks for the birthday gift card!

reviews.author: Adam Horky
reviews.text: My tankless heater sprung a leak on a Friday and they were able to come out in less than an hour after I called. They were able to replace the unit first thing the following Monday. Quick, professional, and friendly. I will happily use them again if needed.

plumbers.name: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing of Denver
plumbers.address: 1020 W 124th Ave #700, Westminster, CO 80234, USA

reviews.author: Jeff Vaughn
reviews.text: Had an emergency with our water heater springing a major leak. All three service technicians (Christian, Tony, & Dylan) did a great job! Super fast response, very friendly, and professional.  My wife really appreciateed the use of shoe covers as they entered the house and the care they took to keep everything as clean as possible. Great higher grade products, service, warranty,  and very competitive pricing as confirmed by our son who is also in the same industry but outside of our area.

reviews.author: Jeanne Lafoe
reviews.text:
Both Ilija and Dylan were great!  Ilija first came as we did not have hot water.  He handled that problem efficiently and then checked all 4 bathrooms, kitchen and laundry room.  Ilija identified quite a number of items that needed replacement and since our home is older it was very good to be made aware of those issues.  Dylan then came a couple of days later and fixed all of the problems in one day!  He worked all day and did an excellent job while treating our home with respect and went above and beyond to help us.
Excellent company and Ilija and Dylan both super!!

reviews.author: Michael Hayenga
reviews.text: Alex and Joel both did a nice job. They were available when I needed them and arrived on time. The work was done professionally and the cost was very reasonable. I'd use them again.

reviews.author: Bill Selby
reviews.text: The hot water tank was installed in an extremely tight space. They navigated the puzzle with out a problem. Work was well done and complete

reviews.author: Trent Hickes
reviews.text:
Christian from Benjamin Franklin Plumbing was absolutely outstanding. He fixed both our garbage disposal and toilet today with professionalism, efficiency, and a great attitude. He arrived on time, clearly explained what was going on, and walked us through our options without any pressure.

Christian worked quickly but thoroughly, left everything clean, and made sure everything was working perfectly before he left. It’s rare to find someone who combines technical skill with such excellent customer service.

plumbers.name: DEAR Services Plumbing
plumbers.address: 26840 78th Ave S, Kent, WA 98032, USA

reviews.author: Deshawn Williams
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience with Daniel R. from Dear Services! Daniel was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly efficient from start to finish. He arrived on time, quickly diagnosed the plumbing issue, and clearly explained what needed to be done before getting started. His workmanship was excellent, and he made sure everything was working perfectly before he left.

What really stood out was his attention to detail and the care he took to keep everything clean and tidy while working. It’s clear he takes pride in his work and genuinely wants to make sure his customers are satisfied. The whole process was smooth and stress-free.

If you need reliable plumbing service, I highly recommend asking for Daniel R. He’s skilled, courteous, and delivers top-notch service. I wouldn’t hesitate to call Dear Services again because of the great experience I had with him!

reviews.author: shahd abdoun
reviews.text: Jayden Q from DEAR Services was amazing! Super professional, respectful, and friendly throughout the entire visit. He explained everything clearly, arrived on time, and made the whole experience stress-free. You can really tell he cares about doing quality work and helping customers. I truly appreciate his patience and positive attitude. Highly recommend Jayden and DEAR Services!

reviews.author: Rip Aroni
reviews.text: Called Dear services on Tuesday morning and they came withing 40 minutes they have replaced my panel and multiple outlets in my house the service with this company is amazing! The staff is supper friendly and talkative! Anthony Ashton Augastine were super professional and hard workers. Good Value for the price we paid.

reviews.author: Tammy Walston
reviews.text: Jayden Q has been amazing! He made a good assessment on what needed to be done. Checked the overall plumbing. Very personable and kind. He made a plan and began. He did need to order a part but will come to install it asap he states. I will update this as we finish the project.

reviews.author: Donna Green
reviews.text:
Jayden went above and beyond in every way. I had been dealing with a frustrating plumbing issue, and he came in with a calm, confident approach that immediately put me at ease. He walked me through what was happening, gave me a fair and transparent estimate, and got to work right away.

Not only did he fix the issue quickly, but he also checked a few other things to make sure there wouldn’t be future problems. That level of care and thoroughness really impressed me. On top of that, he was respectful, friendly, and left everything clean and organized when he was done. It’s hard to find this kind of service these days. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Jayden to anyone looking for a reliable and knowledgeable plumber.

Thank you for helping us out!

plumbers.name: Reliant Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3841 Ranch Rd 620 S, Austin, TX 78738, USA

reviews.author: Christy N
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience with this team after they installed a new outdoor spigot in my backyard. When I noticed a connection issue a few months later, their office staff was incredibly helpful and managed to fit me in for a follow-up appointment the very next day. My tech consultant, Carlos, did an amazing job. He was prompt, professional, and took the time to be thorough while still working impressively fast. I really appreciated his clear communication throughout the process and highly recommend their reliable service. This is probably the fourth or fifth project I’ve had completed with reliance and they continued to do a great job.

reviews.author: Dayne Thornicroft
reviews.text: Steven and Jason F did a great job clearing a clog in my kitchen drain. They cleaned up after themselves and also scoped the line with a camera to show that it was clear. Transparent, efficient and polite. 5 star service

reviews.author: Mitch Cuningham
reviews.text:
This place is a scam, and the reason they have so many reviews is they relentlessly follow-up until you leave one.

I had avoided leaving one until now because I was hoping to have this resolved. I had a tech come out to evaluate a leak and was quoted about $2600 for the repair. We were informed that we would be charged 50% up front and then on completion of the work. However, we decided to cancel (same day) because we found a much cheaper quote elsewhere.

That was November. As of today, I cannot get a return call for a refund. The customer service department is excellent, but they cannot approve refunds and require approval from a manager in the field. I have called multiple times, and still no resolution.

I intend to take them to small claims court and file with BBB next week.

reviews.author: melissa bartholomae
reviews.text:
Great experience from the time I called  I spoke with Alan he was very nice and professional told me a price and said his guys would be here the next day! Victor Garcia and Carlos Fuentes
Showed up the next day on time, it was not an easy job pipe in my foundation these 2 worked hard to figure out the best solution very polite, hard workers best experience I have ever had .. it was a very stressful situation but they made sure to take their time and figure out the best possible fix for us. I will never use anyone else again best company, best experience! Thank you

reviews.author: Ashley Lawton
reviews.text: Huge thank you to Reliant and especially Carlos for coming out during the 2026 freeze! He quickly diagnosed the issue and took the time to explain how I can troubleshoot it myself if it ever happens again. He was kind, thorough, professional, and right on time (and even reassured me that since our unit is under Reliant’s warranty, there was no charge for the visit). He also made sure all my questions were answered before leaving. Truly excellent service from start to finish!

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Huntsville
plumbers.address: 1330 Fletcher St NW, Huntsville, AL 35801, USA

reviews.author: sharon Brown
reviews.text:
Professional! Courteous! Timely! And very reasonable price. My cousin recommended us to you and we are very pleased. Myron was amazing! I don't remember the person that I spoke with over the phone but she was awesome, too!
Thank you!

reviews.author: Emily Davis
reviews.text: My experience with Mr. Rooter was nice. 1st let me start off with that I appreciate Mr. Rooter coming out on a Saturday moring. There were two men one was Mike and the other was Michael. They were both extremely polite and happy to help us with our plumbing needs. The only thing I did not like would be that they called at 8:30 in the moring. When I had made the appointment the receptionist said they would call 45 minutes before coming over, once I had answered the phone they said they would be over in 10-15mins and I kid you not. They immediately showed up two minutes later. Which I am impressed but I had no reaction time to even brush my own teeth. I wish this company would have a schedule instead of just showing up. I am extremely lucky they did come because I know where some plumbing places don't show up for hours or even cancles your appointments. But they did a wonderful job. But an hour later when. I went down stairs to check our bathroom shower the shower handle started to leak immediately after. 😅  I turned it on and off to see if it was still leaking big mistake the water would not turn off. I had to shut it off myself. I called them at 10:50am for them to come back and they came back 2 hours later. In total. The whole job had costed us 875$. I would recommend Mr. Rooter but I would change a few things. But at least they have a 90 day warranty.

reviews.author: Ron Lewis
reviews.text: Michael did a great job. I had a water leak (9,000 gallons on last bill!) and pointed to a squishy place in the yard. He dug there but there was nothing. My bad. Must have been the rain. Then he did it correctly. Step by step eliminating the line from the street to the house, isolating the hot side. Then hot in vs hot out and identified the problem methodically and smartly. It was the blowoff valve. In my defense, my builder put the blow off line and heat pump condensation line together and I thought the water coming out was from condensation. In any case, Michael quickly replaced it. Did good, honest work without trying to upsell anything. I would recommend him and Mr. Rooter, whom we've used for years.

reviews.author: Kevin Nishimuta
reviews.text: Had an emergency septic system backup while we had visitors late on a Friday evening.  Mr.  Rooter was there within an hour and emptied the tank and was able to fix the plugged line.  Great job; reasonable price; professional technician!

reviews.author: Karen Thompsen
reviews.text: We had a water heater that was starting to leak, and the tech came to our house quickly. He replaced our 2 old 50 gallon water heaters with 1 80 gallon heater. The installation was well done. and the old equipment and pipes were neatly removed. Very courteous and professional with good quality work.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Sewer & Drain
plumbers.address: 2410 W 9 Mile Rd, Pensacola, FL 32534, USA

reviews.author: Cana Carisse
reviews.text: Customer service out of this world! I feel like I attended a master class in plumbing from Trevor. He showed me exactly what was wrong with my pipes and how he planned to fix it. To top it all off, VERY reasonable price!

reviews.author: Lieutenant Dan
reviews.text: We had an issue with a back-up from our septic tank to our home on a Sunday.  Within 5 minutes of calling in for assistance, Chris Maxwell called and let us know he’d be on the way to assist.  He was transparent on pricing and what potentially would need to be done.  Upon his arrival, Chris was able to determine the issue and rectify it quickly.  He also provided numerous pieces of useful information to keep our system healthy and running to its full potential.  Of course, with it being after hours service, there was cost involved but given the professionalism and promptness of the service, I was more than willing to pay to get things back up and running.  Will recommend Chris for services of anyone needing them and will request him in the future.

reviews.author: C. T.
reviews.text: A big shout out to Jacob with Roto-Rooter. He came out in less than 24 hours to repair a pipe that had burst in the washroom. This was an emergency call late on a Friday night. Not only was he courteous enough to keep us updated as to when he would arrive, he was extremely polite and professional. He did an excellent job, and got us back up and running in a couple of hours. I would highly recommend Jacob with Roto-Rooter plumbing.

reviews.author: Amy Hamilton
reviews.text: The gentleman that Roto sent was very knowledgeable. He explained everything and updated me on the things he found while working. I was very impressed and would be grateful if he came out to perform the additional work that my plumbing system needs.

reviews.author: Rhonda Fenn
reviews.text: We needed to have our septic tank serviced and we used Roto Rooter . They were on the job in no time and gave me an estimate the was very competitive so we chose to use them because they were highly recommended. They lived up to their recommendation! We were very satisfied !

plumbers.name: Discount Plumbing Rooter Services
plumbers.address: 570 Sylvan St, Daly City, CA 94014, USA

reviews.author: Wilson You
reviews.text:
I recently had my garbage disposal replaced, and I couldn’t be happier with the service!

The technician Saul and his coworker Carlos  were punctual, professional, and very knowledgeable. They explained the process clearly, worked efficiently, and left everything clean and tidy when the job was done. The new disposal works perfectly, and the whole experience was stress-free. Highly recommend this service to anyone needing plumbing work—they truly know what they’re doing

reviews.author: Emanuel Vasquez
reviews.text: I couldn't be happier with the work of Carlos Chavarria! From the very first moment, his communication was flawless: he was very flexible, super clean, and attentive to every detail. He was incredibly professional, with a respectful attitude at all times. The result was simply outstanding: there is nothing he could improve, it was all perfect. I recommend Carlos without any doubt; he is a true professional and a talent. Thank you, Carlos, for a phenomenal job!! and Magda the dispatcher. Very professional and great communication.

reviews.author: susana cortez
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Saul! He was very kind, helpful, and professional throughout the entire process. He took the time to answer all of my questions about the shower repair and made sure I understood everything that needed to be done. I really appreciated his patience and willingness to help. Highly recommend Saul if you’re looking for someone reliable and knowledgeable!

reviews.author: Eric Shyong
reviews.text: Adan was very professional, efficient, and friendly. He explained everything about the repair process and was done with his job within a few hours. I would definitely hire him again for any plumbing issues in the future.

reviews.author: Robert Ayrapetyan
reviews.text:
I had a leaking pipe under the sink that required cutting the pipe and soldering in a new section. The technician, Mike, was very knowledgeable and completed the repair quickly. The location was difficult to access and even required cutting a bit of the cabinet, but he still finished everything within an hour - truly a professional.

On the downside, some basic soldering parts weren't available and had to be substituted, and the torch he used seemed worn out and in need of an upgrade.

I would have given 5 stars, but the price ($600) felt a bit high for a one-hour job, even in one of the most expensive areas of the Bay. I know that people around here pay $700 for something as simple as replacing a showerhead, which makes it hard to argue for what I believe would be a fair price (around $300 for this type of work). Still, it was an urgent situation, and overall I'm satisfied with the service.

plumbers.name: High 5 Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electric
plumbers.address: 800 E 73rd Ave Unit 2, Denver, CO 80229, USA

reviews.author: Evan Giovanni
reviews.text: Ruth!! What a savior!!! She was so smart and knew everything so fast! My place is not easy to deal with and she didn’t hesitate one bit! She worked so late just to make sure my townhome was taken care of! She explained everything she was doing to help a homeowner learn instead of just leaving me in the dark! Ruth you are the best and if you call high five ask for her ! You won’t be disappointed!! Great hire high five ! I’ll be recommending her to everyone !

reviews.author: Juanita Hill
reviews.text:
Peyton was the technician who worked on my plumbing issues.  He was prompt, courteous and informed me of what was happening.

The office also was very thorough as well and communication was top notch.

Highly recommend them for any plumbing issues you may have.

reviews.author: Lindsay Stenzel
reviews.text: All of the workers we’ve interfaced with have been friendly and competent, but I no longer will be using this company because the workers seemingly get pressure from higher-ups to upsell. They tried to tell us that a new furnace would cost $20,000, and when we said we (obviously) would be getting other quotes, they tried to make the matter seem urgent and that any company quoting lower wouldn’t do a good job. We just had another company come out for a quote - not only was the quote less than half of that, they mentioned we likely don’t even need a furnace replacement (which makes sense, our furnace has been running fine, it just needed some maintenance).

reviews.author: Carrie Brown
reviews.text: Manny is a fabulous technician! He was prompt, thorough, and kind, which I truly value.  He did an amazing job making sure  we were up to code AND made sure we had heat before leaving for the day on a two day job.   Manny and Leo worked together on the a/c unit on day 2 and were awesome! Thanks for the prompt and friendly service.  We are grateful.

reviews.author: John William Barnett
reviews.text: High Five is an excellent company.  I have used them three times for plumbing and heating.  All technicians that have been to my home are very competent.  They let you know when your technician will be arriving for the appointment.  They keep the work site clean while providing services.  They wear protective covering over their shoes to keep your floors clean.  The work performed is excellent.  When at your residence they will give you options from what they call basic repair, to mid road repair, to peace of mind repair, and the cost for each.  I have used the mid range twice and peace of mind option once.  My latest technician was Michael Keebler for a hot water heater issue.  He saved me about $3500 from having to get a new water heater, when he could have sold me on getting a new one.  That is integrity that I can trust.   I believe High Five provides quality service.  I will continue to use High 5.  I recommend them.  Five stars.

plumbers.name: Mendel Plumbing, Heating & Electric
plumbers.address: 3N640 N 17th St, St. Charles, IL 60174, USA

reviews.author: Chris Synal
reviews.text:
Mendel came out when the original home filter casing finally broke and started pouring out water. No other service company was willing to come or care for concern.

Within 25 minutes the technician showed up after I shut of the main to the house.  After a an unsuccessful install of the replacement the new housing was faulty also.  After listening and spending beyond the time to care and explain some future issues that might occur in other areas while he waiting couple of hrs for a new housing to arrive we finally have water (note was not the technician fault to wait to hrs it was the gentleman delivering the canister)

Thank you and look forward to working with Mendel in the future.

Attached is some before and after shot.

reviews.author: Brandon Gentile
reviews.text: Tonight I came home and heard running water.  I called Mendel to the first time and my experience couldn't have been more awesome!!  Jenna took my call and was so professional!  I was all worked up when I called and after she reassured me that a tech would be dispatched, I hung up with her feeling a little more at ease!  Jared was the technician that came out and he was just absolutely great from the second he walked in my door.  He quickly assessed the issue and gave me several options!  He showed me several pictures of the issue(I wasn't getting in the crawl space).  He explained every option and weighed the pros and cons of each option with me.  Once I decided, he had everything needed in his van and he got right to work.  Had the repair done in a fair amount of time and showed me pictures of all the work he did after.  I have future plumbing work that I will need and I will be asking for Jared to come do the work!  10/10 Recommend!

reviews.author: Ed Dziewior
reviews.text: Unfortunately woke up on Saturday morning to find our pipes had frozen due to the weather. Called for service and was assured that a technician would be arriving later this morning. Received a text with the technicians' name and estimate  time of arrival. Dave was the technician that arrived and promptly evaluated the situation we were having. He gave us an estimate for the repair and mentioned that if unseen issues appeared we would have to reevaluate the repair cost. This was acceptable to my wife and I. His inspection did not turn up any water leakage. He isolated the area that he felt was the area of concern. He went his truck to get a piece of equipment that would place a electrical charge to the copper pipe to try to heat the pipe and breakup the ice blockage. He was successful in removing the blockage. No damage to the drywall, no split pipe, and running water again throughout the house. Thank you Dave for your experience and dedication in resolving our issue. He has a pleasant personality, listens to your concerns, and does his job professionally and with efficiency which is reassuring.

reviews.author: Andrew Nickel
reviews.text:
My 78 year old mother, who lives alone, has used Mendel for years.  Recently moved and had them come inspect the furnace.  Technician said it was fine and just needed servicing.  A couple months later, the furnace seemed loud, so she had another tech come out.  This guy said the furnace (less than 10 years old) had deadly problems.  Actually turned the unit off and said he did not want to be in the house with the unit on.  Said needed full replacement right away.  A sales person came out later that day and quoted $25,000+ for new furnace and install.  Said they could come out the very next day, take her money, and put in the new one.  Rush, rush.

She had another company come out the next day and they said the humidifier needed a new part, but otherwise the furnace was perfectly fine.

Draw your own conclusions.

reviews.author: Kenneth Weber
reviews.text: They sent Paul out on very short notice. He solved our problems quicker than expected was super friendly and gave us great information and technical advice for how to avoid problems in the future. Will absolutely call them the next time we need a plumber.  And definitely I would request Paul if he is available he was OUTSTANDING!

plumbers.name: Canady's Heating, Air, & Plumbing
