reviews.author: rebecca dasher
reviews.text: Brandon Deal went over and beyond excellent service! He fixed our combo A/C & Heater plus installed a new filter system. He educated in every step. I had no questions when he had left. Brandon is extremely professional and has a down to earth personality. 1 million percent would recommend him!!

reviews.author: Ryckie Madden
reviews.text: We had our heating and air unit checked for regular maintenance.  Justin was professional, efficient, thorough and very informative with everything he did on our unit.  He gave us a detailed report.  Justin was a very patient professional as well as being polite and courteous too.  We would recommend Canady's Heating and Air Service to all our family and friends too.

reviews.author: Linda Thompson Bakhsh
reviews.text: Our Plumber, Ka Lee was excellent, today! He is knowledgeable, patient, polite and professional. Ke Lee was methodical when investigating our leak. He provided us with our options and clear and understandable estimates for what needed to be done. Ka Lee explained everything and worked diligently, alleviating our stress. Ka Lee and Screven worked well together and worked hard for hours and left the area perfectly clean. We can't thank them enough! Canady's services are expensive but it is worth it when the job is done right the first time by professionals like Ka Lee and Screven.

reviews.author: Ronald McHenry
reviews.text:
I must admit that I was very impressed with the professionalism of my technician,  Zach Kuehn. Though I realize the call was only for preventative maintenance, I felt very confident that my HVAC system was in the best possible hands. He was very informative and clear in his recommendations as well as quite friendly and respectful. Zach not only seemed well trained but also very experienced. I'm normally not one who even takes time to post reviews, but I can say that I am fully impressed.

Great technician!

Thanks again,

Ron McHenry

reviews.author: Sarah Nestor
reviews.text: I am so impressed with  all of you, from the receptionist to the technician andcthe installer. They was no surprises, everyone was on the same page. KIA lee, i apreciate you. You got  my watertank installed and back up with hot water and no more leaking.  You did what  Locgan said tou would do.Again, i am very impressed with all these young people. They were all very polite, respectful and very  professional. Canady, whatever you are doing, keep on doing, you have a great team of people.

plumbers.name: Proven Plumbing & Air
plumbers.address: 300 Brushy Creek Rd Suite 402, Cedar Park, TX 78613, USA

reviews.author: Stanbo Miller
reviews.text:
Hooray for Zachary C! Routine maintenance turned into an urgent situation. We contacted Proven Plumbing based on the stellar Google reviews and nothing but positive recommendations from our community FB page.  40+ year old house, time for some routine bib and spigot replacements. The scheduled the consultation for the next day and by the end of the day we had received a quote.

We accepted the quote but were planning to wait until after the freeze / ice storm to schedule the service since nothing was urgent.  About 3 weeks later we received a call from our MUD that our usage was 5x the average and our meter was running constantly and we should check for leaks. Nothing in the house, I went around the perimeter and discovered an unplanned, small pond in the corner near our gas meter. I called late in the day and Proven scheduled us for the next morning. I should point out the communication is amazing via text updates and even a call when they were running 20 minutes late.

Zachary C was our plumber and he greeted us cheerily. I had spent the previous night fretting over how they would even fix this.  Zach took at look, didn't blink,  joked about not having any ducks yet, grabbed a shovel, and got to work. I'm not sure how he dug it out so fast but just like that the pipe and leak was exposed.  He also pointed out a kink in the pipe where it entered the slab, from the original installation, and took the time to chisel out some of the slab so he could round out the pipe and make the repair on the other side of the kink.

We're extremely happy with the work and the service and we have them scheduled to come out next week to do the maintenance items.

reviews.author: Austin Marino
reviews.text:
I’ve used Proven Plumbing & Air for every plumbing job I didn’t feel comfortable handling myself. They consistently deliver high-quality work at reasonable prices. I also really appreciate that they’re upfront about costs before any work begins and they don’t charge just to come out and provide an estimate.

If you’re researching plumbers, I recommend checking multiple review sites, like Google & Yelp. What stood out to me is that Proven Plumbing & Air has amazing reviews across all major review sites!

I recently had them come out to my house to fix a water leak near my main shutoff valve that was caused by some pesky tree roots. Fortunately, Zachary C. was able to come out quickly and resolve the issue. He took the time to clearly explain what caused the leak, what he did to fix it, and the additional steps he took to help prevent it from happening again.

He did an excellent job, and I plan to request him for any future work I need around my house. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: David Moreland
reviews.text: These guys are a great find.  Highly recommended for plumbing.  They showed up fast when I needed them and replaced my old water heater in just over an hour!  Really.  I got three quotes and they were by far the best price for a quality unit.

reviews.author: Efren Palacios
reviews.text:
I recently woke up to every homeowner’s nightmare… my water heater was spewing water everywhere. It didn’t just make a mess, it affected the water throughout the entire house. We needed it fixed immediately.

I called Proven Plumbing and they were at my door right at 8:00 AM. That alone was impressive. Devin and Michael were professional from the start. They took the time to clearly explain what had happened, what needed to be done, and what my options were. There was no pressure, just straightforward communication and confidence in their work.

Even better, they had the issue diagnosed and repaired within an hour. Quick, efficient, and done right. The pricing was fair, especially considering it was an urgent situation.

If you’re dealing with a plumbing emergency and need a team that shows up fast, communicates clearly, and gets the job done, I would absolutely recommend Proven Plumbing. They turned a stressful morning into a smooth fix.

reviews.author: Manjunath Shamanna
reviews.text:
I was trying to get my water heater replaced through AHS. However, the plumbing company assigned gave me a huge out-of-pocket expense quote for installing a lower quality water heater. They were going to charge me for stuff that is a standard install for a new water heater :-(. Instead i took the cash out from AHS and approached Proven Plumbing. I have had several friends and relatives that I had recommended Proven Plumbing  based on what i heard but i personally had not had a chance to use them. Now it was my chance :-). Anyways, the price that Proven plumbing quoted was only a 100 dollars (parts + labor + warranty)  more than the out of pocket expenses that the company from AHS had quoted but i was going to get a better water heater, longer warranty and also lesser cost overall (with the cash out option from AHS). Based on my overall research, Proven Plumbing had the most reasonable quote amongst other plumbing companies. More importantly, many of the plumbing companies in Austin appear to be very difficult to work with -- my way or the highway attitude as opposed to Proven who are very very customer oriented. We had Enrique to come by our house who did a fantastic job of replacing the water heater and spent a lot of time answering my questions. Many other companies who had come by to provide a quote were trying to gouge me by saying that they will charge extra for a tall-narrow water heater or wanted me to make framing changes (our water heater is in the attic and we have truss-roof). Enrique and Proven plumbing accomplished everything without charging me any extra. So I have no qualms in recommending Proven plumbing for any plumbing jobs.
Also Proven Plumbing management (if you are looking at this review) -- I would like to give a shout out to Enrique for a tremendous well done job and for his professional expertise, courtesy etc. At the end, it is the technicians' attitude/behaviour that make/break public perspective about any company. In this regard Enrique gets an Excellent and the top-most grade !!! Pl. continue to do your good work.

plumbers.name: Herman's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1545 Republic Cir, Midwest City, OK 73110, USA

reviews.author: Kaura Thomas
reviews.text:
5-Star Review for Herman’s Plumbing!!!
I recently reached out to Herman’s Plumbing for a second quote on a pipe repair, and I can’t say enough about the exceptional service I received. From start to finish, they exceeded all expectations. They were incredibly prompt, sending someone out the same day I emailed, which was a huge relief.
Josh, the plumber who handled the job, was absolutely phenomenal. He was professional, courteous, and incredibly knowledgeable, walking me through every step of the process with clarity and patience. His attention to detail was impressive, and he even took the time to clean up after himself — a rarity based on past experiences with other plumbers. Speaking of which, we’ve had several disappointing plumbing services in the past, but Herman’s Plumbing, and Josh in particular, stood out as the best by far.
I was so impressed that I made sure to grab Josh’s business cards to share with friends and family. If you’re looking for reliable, high-quality plumbing services, I highly recommend Herman’s Plumbing and ask for Josh! They’ve earned a loyal customer in me.

reviews.author: Paige Morton
reviews.text: I have had Herman’s out 3 times now and it has been the best experience. Wiston and Jack are a very knowledgeable great dynamic duo. The front office people are so nice and flexible. A project I have been losing sleep over was a shockingly reasonable price. I got pictures after. I just can’t say enough.

reviews.author: ChristopherC
reviews.text: Friendly, quick and efficient! Both men were very knowledgeable and explained the scope of work that needed to be done! They were in and out very quickly as well! I’m came away very impressed with Caleb, his assistant and Herman’s Plumbing!

reviews.author: Matthew “MStub” Stubbs
reviews.text:
Super nice and chill dude, would have a few beers and talk about life with him 👍🏻
And at the same time respectful and efficient! He even let me watch, I learned a lot today.
Will hire again in the near future, I have 1-4 mini split units that will need to be installed 😱

reviews.author: s d
reviews.text: Herman’s is great! They were available quickly, the office communicated well, confirmed the appointment, and let me know the plumber was on his way, including a photo of who to expect - very helpful. They have consistently sent the same plumber, who is familiar with my system. He’s professional, polite, respectful of me, my home, and my time.  He’s knowledgeable and fair.  I would highly recommend Herman’s.

reviews.author: Brandy Kemp
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Jerred when he repaired my sewer line. From start to finish, he was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly thorough. He took the time to explain the issue clearly, walked me through the repair process, and made sure I understood every step.

The quality of his work was outstanding — the repair was done quickly, cleanly, and with great attention to detail. It’s clear that Jerred truly cares about doing the job right. He was respectful, punctual, and easy to communicate with throughout the entire project.

If you need sewer line repair or any plumbing work, I highly recommend Hull Plumbing. Reliable service, fair pricing, and exceptional workmanship!

reviews.author: Sandy Kirkpatrick
reviews.text:
We have used Hull for our past 3 plumbing issues and I have had exceptional service Cecil, Nial, and most recently Aaron. All 3 showed extreme professionalism and knowledge of the work needed.

We just underwent a major job with Aaron. A gas line replacement. From start to finish he was professional, kind, knowledgeable, and actually took the effort to explain what the plan was in a way I understood. Any gas line issue is stressful, Aaron remained calm and in control. Couldn't recommend Hull more.

reviews.author: John Whistler
reviews.text: Definitely will use Hull Plumbing again if I need it.  We had a frustrating situation with the bathrooms in our new house.  Aaron showed up within an hour, gave us an honest and fair estimate, and started work right away.  His knowledge and professionalism was outstanding.  Within a couple of hours he had all of the problems fixed and looking good.  The amount of stress and frustration he took off of our family today was tremendous.  Thank you Aaron and Hull Plumbing!

reviews.author: Brian Eberle
reviews.text: Great and Professional service. Our Plumber Aaron was timely, Professional and addressed all of our concerns. New hot water heater in less than 3 hours.

reviews.text: I decided to use Hull Plumbing after reviewing and speaking with many plumbing companies. I had a slab leak and determined that Hull Plumbing was the place to give my business. To the families of the gentlemen who assisted us today, thank you for sharing them with us and give them grace if they show up after usual scheduled time.  I am confident in the work that was done and also confident that in the off-chance something goes awry that Daniel’s Plumbing will take care of it and us. Thank you to the entire Daniel’s team!

reviews.author: Natalie Won
reviews.text:
It was nice to have both Marvin and Randy show up at our house for the diagnostics estimate when our air conditioning was not working. It turned out to be a piece of wire which was broken which made the fan not work and caused mold to build up.  Marvin installed an ultraviolet light to kill the mold and bacteria in the vents. We have cooler air now in the house.  They helped us get a membership to help discount the fees.  We are grateful for the diagnostic day. They remained a company of integrity.
We are satisfied with cooler temperature in the house and that the problem got fixed right away.

reviews.text: Victor Medina came to finish the job of replacing the electrical box, hard start assist and a surge protector on my condenser unit.  He was fast, thorough and very polite. He took time to explain many details about the system.

reviews.author: Spaceposium
reviews.text:
Denis S & Eliab did a great job with my air conditioner. We had a problem today and they came out quickly and stayed late into the afternoon to fix the issue.  These guys are great! They're professional and they really knew what they were doing right away.  They had a great attitude and it was nice knowing the job was done right.   ABC is lucky to have these Technicians working for them.
Thank You!!

reviews.author: Karen Hutek
reviews.text: I have to let Super ABC Plumbing, Air & Heat know what an asset their technician, Chris McNab-601, is to their company!  My AC system was not blowing cold air, Chris showed up late afternoon on a Saturday and after a thorough inspection, he found a leak in the system, obviously I had lost the refrigerant. He let me know that he could repair the leak however he did not have enough refrigerant with him in order to refill the system, that he would have to go to Tampa and come back. I live up in New Port Richey, which meant it would take him at least 1 to 1.5 hours to go get the refrigerant and return. By then it was 7:15 PM, so I thought that I would call ABC and see if it would be possible to schedule someone to come the next morning just to refill the system so that Chris would not have to go all the way to Tampa and come back. I won't go into details as to what happened with my phone call, but Chris assured me that he did not mind, that it was part of his job as he did not want me to be without air conditioning for the night. He proceeded to repair the leak and then, needless to say, he did go back to Tampa and returned at around 9:00-vacuumed out the lines, and recharged the system.  He stayed around for about 15 minutes to make sure that everything was working properly, the temperature in my house dropped several degrees in less than an hour. During his service call, he was nothing but professional, courteous, thorough and on top of all of that,  just very nice and friendly. He truly went out of his way to make sure that my system was working properly and that I was comfortable before he considered the job "completed". I don't know if it's possible but if I can, I will ask to have Chris sent as my technician when I need service again. Thank you Chris!

reviews.author: Notbot
reviews.text:

They have maintained continuous contact with me with great coordination and cooperation.  I have been BEYOND impressed with their  knowledge, kindness, honesty!
Also, I'm incredibly thrilled with the service I received from both "MY HERO'S"..... The best A/C technicians around !   Thank you Super ABC ..... Vickie F  🙂👏👏👏👏👏👏👏

reviews.author: Josue Torres
reviews.text: I met Zay  when he came out to check my AC, and he was very polite and professional. He took the time to explain what was going on with the system and informed me about a few things I didn’t know. He even gave me a cool light which was a nice touch. Overall great service — I’ll definitely be reaching out to Super ABC again soon.

plumbers.address: 600 N 500 W D, Bountiful, UT 84010, USA

reviews.author: D Robinson
reviews.text:
So pleased to leave this review for the install of a tankless water heater. Marty promptly responded to my inquiry, gave me a highly competitive bid right out of the gate, and made a site visit shortly thereafter.  I initially reached out to Black Diamond Experts. The BD bid was shocking, over $10,500 for the same brand water heater.
Rocky and Nick did the entire install. Very competent, affable professionals, they did an excellent job. No shortcuts, copper fittings (not plastic) all around.
It makes sense that BlueBest won Best of State recognition. They performed well above my expectations. Their business model is first-rate and they clearly respect and appreciate their customers.
Best service I have received in many years, will use BlueBest for all my HVAC needs going forward.
Note: black plastic elbow fitting in second pic from earlier water softener install.

reviews.author: Lucia Pham-Milovic
reviews.text:
My house was remodeled before I bought it, & I’ve slowly had to fix bad wiring, sloppy plumbing, & a furnace install that doubled as a trash bin. When my furnace died, I knew it was time for a full comfort overhaul: whole-home air filtration & humidifier, a gas tankless water heater, water purification, & reverse osmosis for my sink. Utah’s hard water was making me ugly by wrecking my skin & hair, & winter inversion made my asthma miserable.

I spent an entire week getting bids for this big, complex project. Each company had a different take. Lowe’s was professional but the brands they offered didn’t seem like the best value. Costco’s partner, Superior, was the biggest letdown. Didn’t really inspect the system or ask the right questions, & their recommendations felt expensive & disconnected from what my home needed. Western & Larsen were professional w/decent bids. My neighbor had done a major remodel moving her furnace from a crawlspace to the attic, all done by Blue Best. She raved about Nick & his team & told me not to skip a bid from them.

Marty from Blue Best immediately stood out from everyone else & quickly became my favorite. Incredibly knowledgeable, thorough, & kind. My dirt crawlspace isn’t exactly fun to work in, but he went in anyway & took detailed measurements. He noted uninsulated ductwork, poor drainage slope, & even drywall chunks & Tupperware inside the blower compartment-so yes, I had been breathing through construction leftovers for 6 yrs.He designed a new system with a high-efficiency heat pump, 4-inch filter, gas tankless water heater, whole-home purification, &reverse osmosis. He explained rebates &tax credits that make high-efficiency systems cost about the same as mid-range ones. I also loved his honesty about the humidifier-he said adding one in an uninsulated crawlspace could freeze & cause issues, so he advised waiting to see how the new system performs first &we can revisit.Saving me money for other projects.

Blue Best handled everything-permits, rebates, &inspections-made the process seamless. Tami was communicative, organized, & kept me updated with text messages & clear arrival times. What I expected to take a week was finished in just TWO days. Annette has been great too, keeping me updated on permits &inspections.

Day 1 was HVAC installation with Nick, Rocky, & Kasey-the dream team!My neighbor had bragged about Nick’s skill on her attic conversion, &now I understand why. Rocky & Kasey are just as impressive; together they’re three experts balancing each other’s strengths & double-checking every detail. They relocated my AC/heatpump, ran new copper lines, cleaned up years of bad installation work, removed and took away all the old equipment, professionally installed the new systems, & left everything spotless.

Day 2 was R.O. Plumbing & water heater installation with Rocky again, plus Shawn & Alma. The mix of experience was perfect-Shawn clearly leads with decades of expertise, Alma & Rocky worked with precision & teamwork. They removed my old water heater, engineered venting for the new tankless gas system, installed the purification setup, & made sure my reverse osmosis line also feeds my fridge ice maker for clear ice. They worked long hours, stayed positive, & left the space immaculate. And still took the time to walk me through the basics of my systems and what to look out for.

Every person I worked with-Marty, Tami, Nick, Rocky, Kasey, Shawn, Alma, & Annette-was incredibly professional, caring, & clearly proud of their work. They didn’t oversell, rush, or leave a mess. Their employees seem happy & properly supported. My home finally feels evenly heated, the air feels fresh, my skin looks better, & my asthma hasn’t acted up once.If you’re collecting bids, save yourself the time & start w/ Blue Best. Whether your project is simple or complicated like mine, you’ll be in excellent hands. Take advantage of a top-efficiency system for nearly the same cost as a mid-range one with rebates/credits before they expire this year. THANK YOU, Blue Best-I truly appreciate you all! 😊

reviews.author: Madeline Cleveland
reviews.text: Rocky, Kyler, Britton, and Riley were phenomenal. Besides being knowledgeable they’re also very cool people. They were efficient and communicative during the entire install process(we got a new heat pump and furnace.) Thank you Dallin for not sitting on my couch for over 2+ hours trying to win me over like some other companies. It was refreshing! Marty, it was also good talking with you- I appreciate the honesty and willingness to answer all my questions. Overall we are so happy! Can’t wait to be warm lol Best of luck to all of you!

reviews.author: Jocelyn Todd
reviews.text:
Update 2/3/2026:
I decided to use BlueBest again for plumbing concerns and again had a fantastic experience. I had a leak in a bathroom faucet and was able to schedule easily in a few days. The technician, Alma, did a full plumbing inspection and found that my main water pressure reducer had also gone bad. He was very honest about what he found in around my house, clearly explained my options and the cost, and then did the requested work in a very timely and professional manner. I seriously recommend BlueBest to all of my friends. :)

Original review:
I had a great experience with the BlueBest team from start to finish. Marty helped assess my tricky 1890s attic space and located a great solution to help heat/cool the space effectively. Nick and Kyle did a fantastic job installing the unit. They were also very sweet and courteous to my cats (and did not let them crawl into the wall!) Tami was prompt at scheduling and answered all my billing questions. I would absolutely recommend this team!

reviews.author: Brian Jeffs
reviews.text: Shawn is absolutely amazing! I was blown away by his knowledge and expertise of the Hague WaterMax and how quickly he got my water softener back up and running.  I was thoroughly impressed by his professionalism and him taking the time to explain everything. This is my first experience with Blue Best and because of Shawn, they have a customer for life!

plumbers.name: EK Coggin Plumbing
plumbers.address: 650 Eyster Blvd, Rockledge, FL 32955, USA

reviews.author: Richard Zygmont
reviews.text: Robbie was great to work with on my water heater installation. Everything looked perfect after he was completed, and I could not be happier with the results.

reviews.author: Susan Stinson
reviews.text: Service Appointment was set “next day”. Kyle arrived on time with advanced notification. Very efficient worker. Completed job and cleaned it up immaculately. Provided estimate for phase 2 sink faucet replacement including recommendations for a plumbing supply provider with similar excellent customer service.

reviews.author: Tom Elwell
reviews.text: Robbie was on-time for our appointment and actually texted us when he was on his way.  He did an excellent job in installing two new faucets in our master bathroom sinks.  He also added fresh caulk between the countertop and the sink top which the builder neglected to install. This enhanced the look and beauty of the sinks.  He totally cleaned up and took the debris from the old sinks with him. We were exceptionally pleased with Rob’s work! We highly recommend Coggin Plumbing!

reviews.author: Tina Bresnahan
reviews.text: This is the 2nd time I've used EK Coggin Plumbing.  I am so glad that I found this company.  I would give the company a perfect 10. From the lady, I'm sorry I did not catch the name that answered the phone to take my info, but was all about customer service and to the technician Jack who was very respectful and knowledgeable.  He assessed the situation and took care of the issue. I'm  so thankful that my husband and I do not have to worry about having a major issue. After Jack told us that we nee to run the water in a bathroom that we normally do not use  for showers.  We will from now on, at least run the water. Charges are very reasonable. Thanks again would highly recommend! You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: c koviack
reviews.text:
From the moment I called to make the appointment until Kyle walked out the door, the customer service was exceptionally friendly and professional.
Kyle installed a new shower head and replaced a water connection, and he went above and beyond what I was expecting! He was incredibly knowledgeable, polite, and friendly throughout the entire visit.
I'm so glad to have found a reliable local company like E.K. Coggin Plumbing with such a competent and courteous employees. The work was done efficiently and to a high standard. I'll definitely be calling Kyle back as soon as I pick out my new kitchen faucet.
Thank you, E.K. Coggin Plumbing, for the outstanding service!

plumbers.name: Legacy Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1101 E Eldorado Pkwy, Little Elm, TX 75068, USA

reviews.author: Richard Glenn
reviews.text:
I rarely leave reviews, but Legacy Plumbing earned this one.

I contacted five plumbing companies when I thought I had a slab leak after receiving an extremely high water bill. Legacy Plumbing immediately stood out because they allowed me to speak directly with a plumber the same day, giving me valuable information before I ever scheduled a service call.

Based on that first interaction, I chose Legacy Plumbing, and I'm glad I did.

Brandon Blake and his apprentice, Jonathan O'Dell, came out the next day and spent a significant amount of time diagnosing the problem. What I thought was a slab leak turned out to be a leak in my water service line. Brandon took the time to explain exactly how they determined the source of the leak and walked me through every available repair option.

No one enjoys spending over hard earned money on plumbing repairs, but I appreciated Brandon's honesty, professionalism, and transparency. He provided realistic low and high estimates, explained the pros and cons of each option, and never made me feel pressured or upsold. As someone who is naturally skeptical of major home repair projects, that meant a lot.

Throughout the process, Brandon kept me informed, answered every question, and made sure I understood what was happening and why. By the end of the project, I felt confident that the repair had been done correctly and that I was receiving real value for my investment.

Jonathan was professional, hardworking, and a great representative of the company as well.

If you're looking for a plumbing company that values integrity, communication, and quality workmanship, I highly recommend Legacy Plumbing. Brandon Blake and Jonathan O'Dell represented the company exceptionally well, and they earned both my trust and this review.

reviews.author: Steven Paladino
reviews.text: Philip Arlinghaus from North Texas - Legacy arrived on time, as promised and went right to work examining the work I needed to have accomplished on my toilet.  Philip then offered a better solution than what I had imagined and at a better price than I had been prepared.  Philip then set to work and in a short period of time had resolved all my issues and cleaned up the work area. No surprises, just conscientious and thorough attention to detail and excellent workmanship.  High recommendations to both the staff at Legacy for the quick and accurate scheduling and Philip for great communication, work and attention to detail!

reviews.author: David Spofford
reviews.text: My experience with Legacy Plumbing was excellent in every aspect. When I called, I was able to speak to Theron, a master plumber, about my leaky pipe issue. Then Hubert and his assistant came out the next morning to begin the work. After visually accessing the situation, I was given an action plan of potential fixes and their costs thereby knowing the best and worst case scenarios they might encounter in advance. Lucky for me, my fix landed on the best case scenario side. The whole team was polite, professional and fair. I would highly recommend Legacy Plumbing.

reviews.author: REBECCA DEEN
reviews.text:
I had an exceptional experience with Legacy Plumbing! I spoke with Cliffton around 8:30 this morning, and even though I was outside their normal service area, he went above and beyond to make it work and scheduled a technician to come out. That level of customer service immediately stood out.

Daniel, the technician, was fantastic. He kept me informed every step of the way, arrived exactly on time, and thoroughly explained all of my options—breaking down the pros and cons so I could make a confident decision without feeling pressured.

Once we decided how to proceed, Daniel handled everything quickly and professionally. He also cleaned up so well you would never have known there had been an issue in the first place.

From start to finish, the service was outstanding. Legacy Plumbing has absolutely earned my trust and will be my go-to plumber moving forward!

reviews.author: B Foster Blair
reviews.text:
Exceptional Service During a Stressful Emergency

I called Legacy Plumbing this morning facing what every homeowner dreads: water flooding my front yard from a cracked exterior pipe. Joey arrived promptly, assessed the situation quickly, and explained the problem and got down to work!.

What separated this experience from typical emergency service calls was Joey's professionalism. He clearly prioritized our best interests over upselling unnecessary work. His technical knowledge was evident, but more importantly, he understood that I was dealing with an unplanned expense during an already demanding day with back-to-back commitments.

Joey handled the repair efficiently while I managed work obligations. He turned what could have been a nightmare scenario into a manageable inconvenience. The quality of his work matched the quality of his character.

Legacy Plumbing has earned a permanent place in my contacts. When you find a company that combines technical competence with authentic integrity, you hold onto them. Joey and Legacy Plumbing delivered both.

Highly recommended without reservation.

plumbers.name: Safe Electric and Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3208 Morse Rd, Columbus, OH 43231, USA

reviews.author: Iris Shades
reviews.text: Jeremy is Awesome! My first impression of Jeremy .....I was like I like this guy he has a great vibe. He is very knowledgeable, Friendly and did not make me feel pressured and he helped me stay within my budget. I will definitely ask for Jeremy for my next project and shout out to his co-worker Corey who also assisted Jeremy and did a Awesome job!!!!

reviews.author: Jennifer Mills
reviews.text: Chris Roberts helped us with several electrical projects today, including installation of a new light fixture, repair of existing fixtures, and diagnosing and repairing some nonworking lights. He did a terrific job.  He was knowledgeable and worked very hard. We appreciated his insights on future projects and their relative value. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Tom Smith
reviews.text:
Had several electrical concerns. Basement lights not working. Smoke detectors needing replaced. Surge Protector installation. 2 GFI and a light switch replaced. Adam and Chad were thorough and professional. They explained and solved our electrical problems. We appreciated their timely arrival and the quality of their work. Safe Electric also utilizes a high quality communication system that informs who is coming and when. Their uniforms are easily recognizable. The work was a little pricey, but worth it.
Thanks, Adam and Chad for a job well done.  We’ll be glad to refer your work to others.

reviews.author: Kayla
reviews.text: Corey and Joel were absolutely outstanding! From start to finish, the job was done quickly and correctly, with zero shortcuts. They kept us informed every step of the way, clearly explaining what they were doing and why, which made the whole process stress-free and reassuring. On top of their excellent technical work, they were incredibly friendly and respectful in our home—and they were amazing with our dogs, which truly meant a lot to us. It’s rare to find technicians who are this skilled, communicative, and genuinely pleasant to have around. We couldn’t be happier with their work and customer service and would highly recommend Corey and Joel to anyone needing electrical services! & to both of you guys i truly  hope both sides of your pillow are always cool, your socks always match, your coffee (or tea) is always the perfect temperature, and your Wi-Fi never cuts out during important moments. We could use more people who do thier job so well. Thank you!

reviews.author: James L. Black
reviews.text: Good company. Very detailed and easy to work with—which is refreshing and dare I say unusual in these times. The problem was identified quickly and my technician, Matt, because of extensive experience, was able to use some tricks of the trade to keep from performing major surgery, like cutting holes in my ceiling or pulling out my dishwasher. Saved me a lot of money and best of all, at least to this point, no leaks. I highly recommend them.

plumbers.name: Evergreen Plumbing & Mechanical LLC
plumbers.address: 2245 McGilchrist St SE, Salem, OR 97302, USA

reviews.author: Ash Porter
reviews.text:
So I bought a house that one might consider a "work in progress." Plumbing was shot before I moved in, though it passed inspection, and I had an excellent team install a new water heater, insulated pipes, the whole shebang, within a few days of the initial call. Very costly to me after having just bought the house of course, but they offered financing I could afford + there's a long warranty that stays with the residence. Might as well add value to my house, right?

And then - the water heater failed at the electrical connection within DAYS. I only got to take one good shower with it! And so, the next morning I called begging for help, and they came out AGAIN! New temporary water heater installed with same-day service, I couldn't believe it. Both the electrician and the plumbers (from Evergreen of course) said they'd never seen that happen with that model before. Just my luck, but the point is that they got me back up and running right before the weekend.

Everyone I've talked to here has been polite and really seems to take customer service seriously - which I can give or take with most businesses, but it's a very nice experience being treated like a valued customer. I am so lucky the first plumber I called never called me back because at this point I want to stay with this team forever. They've got real experience on the team and people who you can tell genuinely love the work they do fixing up peoples' homes.

reviews.author: Kelly Koellermeier
reviews.text: This guy is great. Eric is easy to talk to very polite and professional. Very understanding. Our 6 month old kitten had never visitors before and Eric was so kind to him and they even played.

reviews.author: doug schoonmaker
reviews.text: A big thanks to all the guys at Evergreen. First of all, each person was very nice & friendly. They were very conscious of keeping our house clean inside as they worked. Clean up after as well. Showed up on time. Worked their butts off and workmanship was perfect. They explained everything that was going to be done to us before work started, during the job and after work was done. Also the price was very reasonable and no hidden extra charges. A BIG shout out first to Peter. A great leader of his crew. Thanks to Carson, Mason, Daniel, Ryder, Kyle, Marcus & Tom. Really appreciated that they made double sure our dogs did not escape out the doors or gates as they were going in & out all day. Thanks again to all you guys, Doug

reviews.author: Robert Miles
reviews.text: Excellent service and professional. Quick, timely fix for a broken sewer line. They came to the rescue and were flexible in considering I had put the job out for bids from several providers.

reviews.author: RL Zordan
reviews.text:
The plumbers do an excellent job; professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely friendly. They show up ready to work and clearly know what they’re doing, which immediately puts you at ease.

I’m not entirely sure how their pricing compares to other companies. At first glance it did seem a bit expensive ,but they also did a lot of work, and in my opinion it was worth it. You definitely get quality service and thorough attention to detail.

When the first technician comes out to assess the job, they do walk you through different options and upgrades. Yes, there’s some upselling , but it’s low pressure. It felt more like being shown choices than being pushed into something. If I had an unlimited home-improvement budget, I’d probably be living that Platinum Package life. 😄
Overall, great experience, solid work, and a team you can trust. I’d use them again.
I might still get a couple of estimates just for comparison, but honestly, when your plumbing goes sideways, the easiest and most reliable route starts looking pretty great, even if it costs a little more. Peace of mind counts for a lot.

plumbers.name: Atlantis Plumbing
plumbers.address: 691 John Wesley Dobbs Ave NE UNIT W, Atlanta, GA 30312, USA

reviews.author: Adrienne
reviews.text: If you're looking for a plumber, look no further than Atlantis Plumbing! Brandon did an amazing job! He was also very nice and left everything very clean. We are new to Atlanta and I found this company on Google reviews. You always take a chance with someone new, but from the first inquiry speaking with Cristiana until we squared away what needed to be done, everyone I spoke to was so nice and so helpful! Thank you Robbie, Carol, Alex, Cory and Ivy!

reviews.author: Jessie
reviews.text: Our toilet flooded at Prestige Jewelers a couple days ago. We contacted Cody with Garrett Mechanical yesterday, and he came out first thing this morning…on a Saturday and on Valentine’s Day!! He and his partner quickly found the clogged pipe, replaced the toilet, and had everything handled efficiently and professionally. Great communication, no stress, and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. Thanks to Cody, we can keep our diamonds sparkling and our floors dry. Highly recommend Garrett Mechanical!

reviews.author: denise haeseler
reviews.text: We’ve used Atlantis for years and highly recommend them. So when we knew we had a fairly big job - replace a leaking main pipe outside from meter to home, we had great confidence in Atlantis. Thank you to Bryan and his crew! They were very timely, and most importantly you can be assured that they will do a great job. Very reliable.

reviews.author: nichelle joyner
reviews.text: Dylan was exceptionally great with customer service and helping out with a sewer line that was damaged in my yard. He was knowledgeable and friendly as well as helpful in managing costs and best case scenarios decisions for the project in my home. I highly recommend him and his team for any plumbing needs!!

reviews.author: Ron Russell
reviews.text: This company is the very best.  I had a water leak that a leak detector could not find.  Therefore,  I had to replace a 1,500 foot water line to correct the leak!  Atlantis Plumbing came out quickly and ran the new line.  The men worked tirelessly to get me hooked up again, working until 9:30 PM one night and until 2:30 AM the following morning (wearing head lamps) to restore my service.  I had wonderful responses and services from the telephone contacts (Kayla and Carol), the plumbers, Bryan, Jamaka, and Dale.  Everybody was kind, respectful, on time, and did all services with SMILES.....even at 2 AM in the morning.  This was a very tough job, and everyone came to my rescue.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 5125 MacArthur Blvd NW Ste 13, Washington, DC 20016, USA

reviews.author: Joan Knight
reviews.text: My mother experienced sudden flooding in her lower level bathroom. We were able to shut off the main water valve. We contacted Roto-Rooter and within an hour, Oleg B, field supervisor was on  site To inspect the issue. He was able to quickly make an assessment, contact a plumber, who arrived within the hour. In the meantime, he was reassuring professional, and answered all of our questions and filing a claim with our insurance company for the remediation as it was determined, the backup was from the main water/sewer line. Both Oleg and the Plumber were very professional, courteous and knowledgeable. Within a couple of hours, the initial job was complete completed, and water was restored. Oleg also said he would work with us providing pertinent and technical information to the insurance company claim. He provided his contact information and followed up with us through out the afternoon and evening.

reviews.author: Mwende Simms
reviews.text: The plumber, Aung, came out for an emergency repair and was able to get a temporary fix completed while awaiting a needed part. He came back the following morning to complete the repair. He identified an issue with the outside pipe and quickly fixed that as well. Both times he came out he clearly communicated the issues, needed repairs, and cost and completed them swiftly. I don't often choose to go with franchise companies because their quality of work may vary and costs may be inflated, however I was extremely pleased with the responsiveness, affordability, and quality of the work that was completed. I would not hesitate from contacting the Roto Rooter again for any plumbing needs based on our experience.

reviews.author: Denise Thomson
reviews.text:
Jerry was great. He gave us excellent customer service and made sure everything was done right.

Marc and Tyrell were both awesome. They spent so much time triaging and trying to confirm where the problem stemmed from.

One thing I learned about Roto-Rooter is that they will over charge you for everything. It stinks because most of the time plumbing issues don't lend themselves to price shopping.

reviews.author: bianca washington
reviews.text: Viente was absolutely wonderful! From the moment he arrived, his patience and professionalism were evident, making the entire process seamless and stress-free. He took the time to explain every step of the plumbing repairs he was undertaking, ensuring I understood the issues and the solutions. I was thoroughly impressed with the quality of his work; he not only fixed the clog but also provided valuable advice on how to maintain the system moving forward. His attention to detail and commitment to customer satisfaction truly set him apart. Without a doubt, he is one of the best plumbers we have ever had.

reviews.author: Antwon Cooper
reviews.text: My experience with Roto‑Rooter was extremely disappointing. I expected a professional, efficient service, but instead I encountered poor communication and a lack of follow‑through. Despite multiple assurances, no work was completed, and I was left with the same unresolved issue and no clear guidance on next steps. The technician, Israel, repeatedly came up with excuses not to perform the job. He claimed my bathroom space was too small, his equipment was too large, and then quoted an outrageous price that didn’t match the situation. On top of that, he tried to convince me that the storm drain in the street was actually my plumbing line and that I needed to call DC Water to fix the issue — something that was completely inaccurate and unhelpful. What made the situation even more frustrating was the lack of accountability afterward. Follow‑up support was minimal, and I felt dismissed rather than assisted. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend Roto‑Rooter and would encourage others to explore more reliable options.

plumbers.name: Half Moon Plumbing & Electric
plumbers.address: 14705 E 116th St N, Owasso, OK 74055, USA

reviews.author: Dylan Morrow
reviews.text: Grant, Nate and Evan were a joy to work with very friendly and professional. They did the job with great care and efficiency. The new sewer line they put in looks perfect and has fixed the issues in my house perfectly. Highly recommend them to anyone needing any type of plumbing work done. Had Noah and Nic out to help fix a slab leak and install a new washing machine box. The work that was done was professional and quick. Half Moon Plumbing continues to exceed expectations and offer amazing service.  I will have them out for anything and every service I need moving forward.

reviews.author: Steve Woodley
reviews.text: My experience with Half Moon Plumbing has been exceptional. I had 2 other companies tell me that I would have to dig up my front yard to fix my problem. Luke came and suggested a much easier solution at half the cost. He was able to schedule the repair for the next day and Jake did the work. He did a great job and was very good at explaining everything and answering all of my questions.  I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: riley renae
reviews.text: David Harrellprovided Was very helpful and very informative when he came out to our home. He understood that we were selling the house and needed the repair done as soon as possible. He even called his boss and was able to get us on the schedule within 24 hours, which we truly appreciated. 10 out of 10 — would definitely recommend! Very nice, professional, and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Shawn Abernathy
reviews.text: We needed some plumbing repairs done: two toilets installed, a new tankless water heater, and an irrigation pipe repair. Evan and Ethan from Half Moon Plumbing came out and performed FIVE STAR service for our home. The quality was impeccable. They were professional, on time, and expedient with all of the work that needed to be done. Will definitely be using Half Moon in the future for any plumbing needs we have. Highly recommend - A+

reviews.author: Raelee Conrad
reviews.text:
Wonderful service from start to finish! The lady who scheduled my appointment (so sorry I can't recall her name) was so friendly and understanding and got me scheduled right away. I loved that they sent a confirmation text and a picture of the tech that would be coming so I knew I was opening the door for the right person!
Lukas was my tech for the first appt and he was friendly and professional. He assessed everything thoroughly and provided me with estimates, answered all my questions, and explained all my options with zero pressure. Once I decided, he got right on the phone and got me scheduled for a new water heater installation the next day!
Bo was my tech for the installation and he was great. He explained the process clearly, made sure I had a chance to use the water before he had to turn it off, and made sure I didn't have any questions. Once he finished he explained the new hardware, how to change the temp max and what it was currently set at, where the shut off valve was etc, which I really appreciated! He was friendly and professional with great communication!
I was very satisfied with everything and would definitely use Half Moon in the future!

plumbers.name: MAC 5 Services
plumbers.address: 51 NW Carolina St #103, West Melbourne, FL 32904, USA

reviews.author: Jose Montes
reviews.text: Doug Burr came to our house to inspect and fix an issue with the wiring in the main panel. He was very professional, knowledgeable, and resolved the problem quickly. I highly recommend his work and would definitely call him again in the future. 👍🔧

reviews.author: Yolien Mandell
reviews.text: Jonathon Frazier was extremely knowledgeable and did everything he could to rectify our A/C issue. He explained everything in terms that someone without experience could grasp and showed full transparency of the services and their benefits. Truly enjoyed this service, 10/10 recommend this tech!

reviews.author: tammy petty
reviews.text: Roger and gwin were professional and super friendly. We called and  they were out the next morning. New system in and they cleaned up their mess even vacuuming up all the extras. I would recommend these guys as the first to call. House is cool now. Amazing gentlemen.

reviews.author: Jame Andy
reviews.text: Chris the A/C guy was amazing!! Extremely friendly, knowledgeable, easy to talk to! He seemed very  honest on his evaluation of what is needed to keep my current A/C running properly and not pressuring me into a new system! I highly recommend Chris and this company for your A/C issues!!! Thank you Chris!!! 😀

reviews.author: Wizard's Enterprise
reviews.text:
Jorge Torres from Mac 5 did an outstanding job on the maintenance for our AC systems. I’m very particular about quality of work, and he honestly exceeded my expectations. He took his time, checked everything thoroughly, explained what he was doing, and didn’t give off that rushed “in and out” feeling that a lot of companies do nowadays.

You can tell he actually cares about doing the job correctly instead of just trying to get through the appointment as fast as possible. Professional, respectful, knowledgeable, and very detail oriented. Our systems are running great now.

If you’re using Mac 5, I highly recommend asking for Jorge specifically.

plumbers.name: Grogg's Home Services
plumbers.address: 5349 Dupont Rd, Parkersburg, WV 26101, USA

reviews.author: Bruce Abbott
reviews.text:
I have had the most pleasant experience with Grogg's.  Beginning With Trey and our estimate/sales experience and continuing with the installers, Danny Adams and Rylan.  Two most outstanding individuals.  Knowledgeable, efficient, professional and courteous.  They are indeed an asset to your business. Also  Alec performed technician duties professionally and timely.
Thank you for a most pleasant experience.

reviews.author: Amanda McGrew
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Grogg's Home Services today. I was dealing with a nasty drain blockage that had water backing up into my kitchen sink, but Zach Collins sorted it out perfectly. He was punctual, respectful of my home, and clearly knew his stuff. He diagnosed the problem right away and had everything flowing again in no time. It's hard to find honest, quality service these days—I'll definitely be asking for Zach the next time I need help!

reviews.author: Kathryn Ross
reviews.text: We’ve been having issues with our furnace. Called one place and they no showed/no call so we tried for about a month on our own to go through the motions. Well come this past Monday, it was COLD in the house. We called Grogg’s and within the same hour they were looking over things. Our furnace was over 20 years old and had all original parts, it was their recommendation to update our HVAC system. Unfortunately for us, we bought our house a couple years back and since moving had issues with keeping the house either warm or cold. Thanks to Grogg’s we now know that the original HVAC was don’t professionally and we needed a bit more extensive work. Grogg’s was able to help us with financing and got everything completed this week. It’s been a day or so of comfort. The house is evenly heated. I highly recommend these guys. They were professional and so helpful with any questions or concerns.

reviews.author: Dream Child
reviews.text: Giving a huge shout out to these guys. They took our call for service at 10:00 at night and was up here first thing this morning in the freezing cold ( we could see our breath in the house and our windows were iced over inside) they worked in my cold house, ran to town and back for parts and braved my slick, steep  hill of a driveway to get our furnace fixed. Super nice, too. If you ever need services, I recommend these guys a thousand percent! Thank you for saving our lives in this storm!

reviews.author: Matt Shorb
reviews.text: Grogg's did a great job. I called for an appointment on a Tuesday and they got me scheduled for the very next day. The scheduling staff and technician were all very nice, respectful, and courteous. The technician (Greg) arrived 10 minutes early, and then diagnosed and fixed the problem (a bad electrical connection) in less than 45 minutes. (arrival to departure) Grogg's charged an extra transit fee for me because I live out in a very rural area away from any cities, but the added price wasn't unreasonable. Overall I'm very satisfied with their service and would definitely recommend them to anyone.

plumbers.name: Korrect Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning, Inc.
plumbers.address: 7967 W Third St, Dayton, OH 45417, USA

reviews.author: Wanda Krebs
reviews.text: After making a call to Korrect Plumbing for a non emergent issue,  a plumber was dispatched within 2 hours to fix our faucet and he was knowledgeable, friendly, efficient and got the problem resolved promptly and at a reasonable price. We are exceedingly pleased. He even got toilet in the same lavatory to stop dripping.

reviews.author: Nick
reviews.text:
I was very pleased with results of the major repair that was accomplished in my home. Korrect Plumbing found the leak in my kitchen drain pipe that went to the main drain. I had plumbers working in my kitchen for 3 days to jack hammer the slab in my home to access the corroded cast iron pipe that is 70 years old. The men that were assigned to the work were very knowledgeable, along with being very polite and professional. They also kept the work area very clean which I greatly appreciated. Everyone I had to contact at Korrect during the project was very easy to work with and very professional. I will call Korrect Plumbing for all of my plumbing needs.
Thanks Korrect

reviews.author: pnichol080
reviews.text: Top notch service everytime I have used Korrect plumbing. They are a bigger outfit where you might assume they would be higher priced based on their size and newer equipment but its actually the opposite. They usually come in cheaper and their quality in work is superior. Ive had them come in behind other plumbers and do what others said couldnt be done and for less money. Don't waste your time or money calling anyone else.

reviews.author: Katie Kay
reviews.text: Our water heater stopped working, it was 16 years old so we weren’t too surprised by it. The Korrect install team came out not long after I called. They installed our water heater same day and took great care in removing our old one. They answered all of my questions and made the whole process easy and took the stress out of it. Would highly recommend this wonderful company!

reviews.author: Trey Dossman
reviews.text: We had our water heater go out on us on a Tuesday. I called Korrect and they had a team out within 3 hours. They were fast: they removed our old water heater and had the replacement water heater completed within 90 minutes. They were very professional and knowledgeable, upfront with pricing, and were very considerate of our space and house (using drop cloths to walk on and cleaning up after themselves). We've previously used Korrect to remove an old water softener and install a new one, which was completed with similar professionalism and upfront pricing. Very happy with the service that we've received!

plumbers.name: Carney All Seasons

reviews.author: Snorman9
reviews.text:
Since Wind River acquired Brownie's it has sucked. We used Brownie's for 12 years with zero issues. Two years ago we had issues with Wind River for an appointment to inspect and pump out. Three weeks ago I made another appointment, this time to replace a high level float and alarm that are old and dilapidated. Also, something in the septic system continues to trip the GFCI receptacle to which equipment is connected. A local electrician inspected and replaced the outlet and installed a new one and informed us that the septic equipment is tripping the GFCI.
I made the appointment a week in advance for a Friday. They no-showed, first claiming "nobody answered the door" (a lie, I was home all day), then said they called a number on the account (my wife's) despite me giving them my contact number when scheduling.
So they came the next day, a Saturday, knowing we wouldn't be home. The service tech dug up the lid to our system, supposedly checked everything and called me (the correct number this time) and told me nothing is wrong and everything is working fine. He told me he did not have the high level float and alarm on the truck and someone would return on Monday. Two days later, the GFCI tripped again. Wind River never called and never returned to replace the high level float and alarm (which I plainly asked to be replaced when I made the appointment) or further diagnose what is tripping the GFCI. They left a mess but they made sure to charge my credit card, which they insist having on file before coming to your location, for $176.
Don't walk away from these clowns, run.

reviews.author: Hailey Mehlich
reviews.text:
I reached out to this company 11 days ago to schedule an appointment and made two follow-up calls during that time, but I never received a return call to schedule service. I do want to note that their customer service representatives Tamika, Jeff, and Stephanie were all very kind, professional, and helpful when I spoke with them. I’m sharing this simply so others considering their services are aware of my experience with their follow-through on scheduling.

reviews.author: Elba Anna Arroyo-Vazquez
reviews.text:

But when calling in it was a bit difficult. Plus I was charged for 1000 gallons to be pumped and only 750 gallons were pumped and I feel I over paid and still haven't gotten a call back about my broken tile or fixing my cord to the pump... So customer service center is not very accommodating.

Update: A manager called me and explained that the customer service rep, (we'll putting it nicely) basically didn't know her job or how to explain the services, I think it may be because better training is required but what do i know... 🤔
He sent out a "plumber", again a very nice guy. He explained everything buuuuut, what kills me is they wanted to charge me $300++++ to change out a float switch that cost $45 on Amazon and needs to be threaded into the tank, plus you dont need a plumbertodo that, the first person that came shouldve been able to do it. reviews.text: The workers are excellent. Nathan who came to the house first to assess our broken furnace was excellent, fast, very personable and helpful. They shed phones and equipment, took a deep breath, and squeezed in there to assess the situation. In no time they had the water flowing again! They diagnosed the issues and repaired them both quickly, and my bathroom now smells like it’s brand new with those good, clean pipes! reviews.author: Jason D
reviews.text:
This company has gone down hill and might be rock bottom. On the last visit which was a furnace tune-up, they did the work (not sure how well) and presented my wife with thousands of dollars of recommended repairs and upgrades. The list was ridiculous and included things that only they could have caused (like crimped wiring inside the unit when it wasn’t mentioned when they came in March nor any of the other times they came and they’re the only ones to access that compartment in the last eight years). My wife called me and we declined the additional services and the technician left.

When I returned home after about a week, I found an absolute mess: the furnace room door was off its hinges, there was a furnace filter propped next to the furnace, and general disarray in the space. I went to work trying to clean things up and discovered that the problems were even worse than I expected. Not only was the door of its hinges, it had actually been broken. The technician didn’t even mention it, let alone offer to fix it. The furnace filter that was propped by the furnace was mangled and torn and plastic packaging (like from a new filter) was stuffed inside it. We figured out that the one leaning there was the new filter I had installed about 6 weeks before (and did not need to be changed) and the plastic was from the spare I keep on hand. It’s a tight squeeze to get the filter in and out and requires care not to damage it. Clearly the technician wasn’t careful and simply ripped it out of its housing. Again, no mention of this from the technician and no offer to replace what he ruined.

Upon further inspection, I found that one of the seals around the PVC pipe that delivers air to the unit was not in place. I went back and looked at the pictures from the previous service (in March) and it was properly seated, which makes me question whether the technician knew what he was doing or cared at all to do the job right. I’ve canceled my service contract with Western Heating and will never utilize their services again. I’d caution you against using them as well.
