reviews.author: Derek Wynn
reviews.text: "Buy a house", they said. "it's the American Dream!" They claimed. Until you are taking a shower and the water temps start to fall before the rinse cycle. So I needed a new heater. Lovely. I spoke to a couple of local hardware shops, and the prices they quoted me might have been ok for some people but I didn't have a briefcase of cash sitting stashed iny home, so I needed other options. A brief Google search brought me to "Done Right Plumbing", and they were local so I thought "🤷🏾‍♂️ couldn't hurt." Only a few short moments of convo with Jessica (hope I remembered the name correctly) and not only did I have a number that fit my budget, but the product (according to both Google and customer reviews) was superior to what the hardware store was selling. Sold me. When Technician Chris showed up, he was courteous, competent and quick - got my heater installed properly and the setup looks fantastic. I am back among the privileged with my warm showers and "Done Right Plumbing" saved the day! Thank you so much!

plumbers.name: Dipple Heating, Cooling, Plumbing, Electrical
plumbers.address: 2036 Frontage Rd Unit 7, Anderson, SC 29621, USA

reviews.author: Pamela Webb
reviews.text: Trent Rowland did an excellent job with the pull and clean on my furnace. He was polite and very knowledgeable. He took photos and explained every detail. I was sent an email with my details and receipt. It was a very good experience.

reviews.author: Jessi Klein
reviews.text:
Billy West was amazing. I cannot say enough good things about this experience. From the moment he arrived, he was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly thorough. He took the time to clearly explain what was going on, walked me through what needed to be done, and made sure I fully understood the solution before moving forward. There was zero pressure and just honest, straightforward expertise.

Beyond being technically unmatched, he was genuinely kind and thoughtful. He even brought my trash cans in without being asked. Such a small gesture, but it speaks volumes about his character and level of care.

I never thought I’d describe a plumbing issue as “delightful,” but here we are. This was hands-down the best experience I’ve ever had when it comes to solving a home problem. I almost wish I had more plumbing issues just so he could come back and help again.

Highly, highly would recommend.

reviews.author: clark ballantyne
reviews.text: Mathew with Dipple was very professional and knowledgeable!  He came and serviced our HvAC needs and did a fantastic job.  He explained what needed to be done and the cost, which was very reasonable.  He completed the job and then explained how to best run our system so it would run efficiently and effectively, as it was supposed to.  Which prior to them, the original company had not fully completed our system properly and left one item broken and uninstalled!

reviews.author: Diane
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Brandon. He is knowledgeable, engaging and pays attention to details. I needed a light fixture replaced, Brandon ‘s assessment and installation were quick and efficient. He went the extra mile by patching up the holes left by the old fixture. Overall, a great and easy experience. Thanks Brandon!

reviews.author: Renee Hall
reviews.text:
Woke at 3:30am to a flooded kitchen!  Called Dipple and got a LIVE VOICE at 3:30AM! She was so kind and assured me a technician / service person would be out first thing that morning.  Dropped son at school and Danny was at my home, waiting for ME, at 8:15am!

He diagnosed and repaired one issue within an hour… Diagnosed a second issue and assured me he would be back the following morning to repair.

Danny was here by 8:45am, smile on his face, and new toilet IN HAND!  Like LITERALLY!  He installed the toilet and was finished within an hour.

I will DEFINITELY recommend Dipple to my friends and neighbors and will never hesitate to call Dipple again!  Thanks Danny and team!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 300 Frank H. Ogawa Plaza STE 249, Oakland, CA 94612, USA

reviews.author: Ivan Ramos
reviews.text: Enrique the technician provided us with updates throughout the repair.   Extremely efficient in repairing what I feel was a major repair but the expediency and marksmanship of his work is an example of the company having knowledgeable and experienced professionals.  Very happy with this experience.  Although I wouldn’t want to go through it again, they handled our water repair with urgency and professionalism.

reviews.author: Mamacita Dulce
reviews.text: Sayed did an amazing job was on time !! And got straight to the job!! It took less than 5mins to fix the issue !! He was so respectful and had a great attitude and very professional!! I love the customer service he provided it’s really nice to know there is still people taking pride in their job and having a positive attitude especially in a situation like mine where I needed an emergency plumber on the weekend !! And at 8pm Sayed was great thank you !!

reviews.author: Keith Nettles
reviews.text: Saide did a great job. Our system was backed up due to the school next door. It took some time, but he was able to get it cleared out and running like it's supposed to. Highly recommend asking for him.

reviews.author: Jonah Makonnen
reviews.text: Heath did an amazing job! Our toilet was overflowing, and he responded on very short notice. He was efficient, quick, and incredibly understanding. Huge thanks to Heath—10/10 would absolutely hire again!

reviews.author: varun agarwal
reviews.text: Sayed did a very good and thorough job for our main line drain blockage. He was very communicative, and efficient and gave me different options on how I want to proceed. Will definitely have him again in case of any issues.

plumbers.name: Buckeye Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electrical
plumbers.address: 1018 Proprietors Rd, Worthington, OH 43085, USA

reviews.author: Paul Brockman
reviews.text:
I am writing because Buckeye Heating and Cooling declined to repair my air conditioner during a service call because the work required was not in the service techs purview.  Buckeye has insisted that there needs to be 3 service calls to fix my air conditioner.

My contention is they are over billing me. Also, they have not provided information about services performed plus there is no vehicle to complain.

This is what happened. My air conditioner is approximately 5 years old, and it was making a loud noise.  I called for service and on July 24 a service tech came out.  The air conditioner noise was not repaired.   When asked why he said it needed cleaning and (paraphrasing) that work was not in his purview so a cleaning service call would be needed  When asked why the unit was making a noise the technician made disparaging remarks about the quality of the unit.  This made me feel terrible about my purchase and choosing Buckeye.  I did not understand why they could not clean it but I felt compelled to just call Buckeye again and get the unit cleaned.  I have attached a picture of the condition they left the unit in.

I do not know what services were performed on that day. No record of the services performed was ever given to me.

I called Buckeye again and asked again for the air conditioner noise be repaired, the unit cleaned plus have some sort of preventive maintenance performed.  Once the air conditioner was cleaned the noise stopped.  Great!   However, that was all the new service tech was able to do.  They stated that another service call would be needed for the additional services because, like the first service call, that was not in their purview (paraphrasing).

I called to complain about my experience and the bill but their phone system does not have an option for customer service complaints.  I did, eventually talk to a person and left a message regarding the complaint.  More than a week passed & they did not call back.  I called again on 10.9.25 and left another complaint message.  I did get a return call on 10.10.25 and they left a message but with no direct phone number.  So, that left me with having to go thru the game of telephone tag with them again.

I really wanted to keep my complaint just between both parties plus I just do not have the bandwidth for a formal complaint.  However, it’s not possible to do that when they don’t offer those options.  Plus, I was just shocked by the way the first tech left my project and the comments they made.  My experience leads me to the conclusion that their communication processes are oriented for their convenience & benefits, not their clientele.

Additionally, I would argue that one service call could have done all this work.  Three service calls are not at all respectful of my time, not to mention the fact that there are 3 bills instead of one.

Therefore, I am lodging formal complaints with:

Organization		Reason
Buckeye			Refund & cancellation of 3rd service call
Costco 			Purchase was a Costco promo
BBB				For the benefit of others
Google Review		For the benefit of others
Yelp Review			For the benefit of others
AG				Unfair Consumer Business Practices & benefit of others.

I would expect an immediate refund from Buckeye and I would hope they revise their repair & customer service processes.

reviews.author: Edward Epstein
reviews.text: As a new customer of Buckeye Heating, Cooling and Plumbing, my wife and I happily recommend this company. We have utilized both their heating and plumbing services and glad we did. We could tell that this company is very customer service oriented, explains appropriate alternatives and is effective at resolving the problems. A special shout out to Scott, Kyle, Csaba, Tom, Max and Dylan for the great work you did. My wife wants to add how great these men were !

reviews.author: ana manzo
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of meeting TJ after we briefly spoke on the phone. Later that evening, he was able to arrive within an hour and took the time to help me through the crisis I was experiencing. He quickly diagnosed the issue, fixed my furnace, and got my heat working again! He was incredibly kind, professional, and helpful throughout the entire process. I truly appreciate his prompt response and excellent service.

reviews.author: Renee M
reviews.text: Joey and Matthew did an excellent job cleaning our ducts. The previous owners did a remodel and used the ducts as a garbage can. They could have cut corners but didn't. End-to-end this was a great service experience. We definitely recommend Buckeye Heating & Cooling.

reviews.author: Anne Utendorf
reviews.text:
I had several services over three days.  Jeffery and Scott replaced my water heater, and Aaron and Chris were here for several plumbing repair services.  They did great work with excellent attitudes and patience.  It was a pleasure working with them.

Josh VanFossen was here to look at an issue with my kitchen sink plumbing. Again, super to work with, thorough, and gave me his card to update him in case of issues with the work.

Whenever I call to schedule, I receive great service.

plumbers.name: Goose Creek Heating & Air (+ Plumbing)
plumbers.address: 302 Hamlet Cir, Goose Creek, SC 29445, USA

reviews.author: Cameron D
reviews.text:
Jon Teal and Sam Gilliland came out when I requested a quote, both were great speaking with and listened to what my needs were. They were quick to get here and their initial assessment didn’t take up too much of my time. They provided several quotes and I paid what I was quoted!

Braylon Mitchell and Brent Craven were extremely professional and from the looks of it, did an awesome job with the installation. They were efficient and cautious of the work space they had. I would recommend them all for any consult and installation that is needed!

reviews.author: Shannon Knight Saxon
reviews.text: During my initial search for an AC/heating repair company, I reached out to 3 different places but never heard back. Shortly after contacting y'all, I received an email for what needed to be repaired/replaced. A HVAC tech was here the next morning to give us an estimate. We decided to go with repairing the issues. Yesterday, the HVAC repairman came to our place and was super polite and very professional. As a woman who was home alone, I felt very safe around him. He was very thorough in his explanation of what the issues were when he found them. He did a lot of testing to make sure that the unit was performing as best as it could (given it's age,,lol) when he was done with the repairs. He also offered to speak to my husband about his findings as well as the steps it took to repair. The price was very reasonable, given how far out we live. They also gave us a very thorough report via email to reference if we forget about something they found. Overall, we will absolutely use them again. We would've frozen without y'all. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: craig jones
reviews.text: We had several companies give us quotes to replace the equipment in our home. We ended up going with Goose Creek as their price was way more reasonable than the others we received. Workers were very neat and efficient. Upstairs system was replaced completely including the ductwork. The first floor was equipment only. Both were up and running in only a couple of days. Would definitely recommend Goose Creek Heating and Air.

reviews.author: Adam Carr
reviews.text: We used Goose Creek Heating & Air to replace our entire HVAC system, both inside and outside units. They were phenomenal. Very professional and friendly. Reasonable price. Quick turnaround time. They explained everything thoroughly before they left. They will do a followup quality control visit in the next few days to make sure there are no leaks or other problems. And I’m happy that the first 2 preventative maintenance visits for the first year are free. Extremely satisfied with both the work and the overall experience.

reviews.author: LJ Balaban
reviews.text: Chris and Jayden were great. Came out within a couple of hours and stayed until the job was complete. First time needing a plumber in Summerville and they didn't disappoint. Highly recommend and will call them if needed for any other plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Pronto Plumbing Heating Air Drains
plumbers.address: 1111 Primrose Ave, Camp Hill, PA 17011, USA

reviews.author: sherri jumper
reviews.text:
Dear Pronto, your Pronto team showed up as their scheduled time and notified me they were heading to my address and kept me informed. Matt was amazing when he took the time to diagnosis my situation on Friday February 27, 2026. He had offered me several options and prices to accommodate me. After throughly discussing the options I had chosen the job to have all my pipes replaced with advised that this could last 25-30 years of the upgrade. When Matt, Corey and Damian showed up today on March 2, 2026, these guys were punctual and Matt discussed what was going to be done. Those gentlemen got right to the core and non-stop. The three man time worked efficiently and productively. Thank you, Matt, Corey and Damien for a great job and professional job well done!!! I am absolutely 💯 pleased with the work. Thank you Pronto for having such a great team of employees. I've had several jobs completed and I can say I have been pleased with all the Jobs performed by your staff of employees. Keep up the great work guys.

Sincerely,
Sherri Jumper

reviews.author: Donna Sweeney
reviews.text: I just had what was hands down THE BEST HVAC service call I've ever experienced from start to finish the entire process was professional and efficient scheduling was quick and easy and my technicians Chris S. And Tom S. arrived on time, they were courteous, knowledgeable and took the time to clearly explain everything to me  They did not rush through the process or the appointment. They inspected everything identified the problem and resolved it!   And they give you OPTIONS that they do not force down your throat and clearly explain the differences.  Their honesty and transparency was what stood out for me. Pricing was fair. No surprise charges, BONUS!  The repair was completed in a timely fashion. I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone needing services. They absolutely earned and deserved five stars! (And I rarely write reviews). Thank you so much for making this a stress-free process!

reviews.author: Tasha Fernandez
reviews.text:
This week I booked with Pronto for a garbage disposal replacement . Scheduling was very prompt and Patrick Goodyear was the tech sent .He went over options and ended up having the garbage disposal already on his truck. He quickly replaced it while we talked about pets, family, and holidays. It came up that I lost my dog Ruger in October and I had 2 shelves for his urn but they weren't  hung yet. I need to get a drill to do it and with the holidays, it hasn't happened yet.  Patrick said he would take a look at the shelves. When he had completed the garbage disposal install, he hung the shelves for me. This took only a few minutes for him but it meant so much to me!!
If these are the attributes of those that Pronto employees, then Pronto is a company that I will be doing business with again and recommending to others. Thank you again Patrick. Being reminded that there are still good people out there is encouraging.

reviews.author: JSDuckNC
reviews.text: Austin, Lance, and Lane demonstrated exceptional diligence from the outset to the completion of relining our aging basement sewer line. Their expertise was evident as they worked cohesively and efficiently throughout the project. Despite the inherent challenges of excavating concrete within a basement environment, they maintained a clean workspace to the best extent possible. The pipe relining process itself was highly effective, minimizing disruption by requiring exposure of only a few small areas rather than necessitating the removal of concrete across the entire floor. The result is a durable sewer pipe expected to last 50–100 years, with only a few minor concrete patches remaining. We highly recommend Pronto and their relining service to anyone in need of sewer pipe repairs.

reviews.author: MJ
reviews.text: Where do I even begin I am not typically someone who leaves reviews unless I am truly impressed with the service. I called pronto a couple times in every time I had the pleasure of Tommy , coming out . Tommy is absolutely incredible, extremely skilled knowledgeable very patient and kind. The first issue I had was something minor Tommy did a great job. And then I had another issue arise. I actually had another plumbing company come out due to having a home warranty and I just did not trust their judgment. So I called pronto again Tommy he came out took his time and fixed the issue an issue that could have only been figured out by a skilled plumber I am sure of that. Pronto should be extremely grateful to have someone like Tommy. I know there are many plumbing companies , but I'm almost certain I called the best of the best . I will forever call Pronto for any issues I have!!!!

plumbers.name: Boulden Brothers
plumbers.address: 107 Sandy Dr Building 700, Newark, DE 19713, USA

reviews.author: Dave Detrick
reviews.text: Once again, the Boulden team did a phenomenal job in my home. This was next day installation completed in less than five hours.  They removed my old furnace and replaced it with a high efficiency two stage variable speed furnace. They were neat, polite, friendly, and most importantly, they were Highly skilled and experienced professionals.  Great job!

reviews.author: Lynn M
reviews.text: I had a perfectly good unit, had maintenance service done by Joe.G at BB and the first Visit went fine, 2nd visit this past August/Sept he came and how convenient after he serviced I had a temp sensor error showing on my thermostat. After a few attempts to locate and find out I noticed our temp sensor was cut, which when Joe.G sent us a picture of our model number unit when I asked for it when he serviced (pic attached) you can clearly see the OAT sensor in the picture , when I checked the unit, the wire to it was clearly cut, perfectly too, so thank you BB & Joe for costing me extra $ on my electric bill and possibly ruining my unit had I not caught on, looking to further this matter !!! Be ware they will make a problem if u have none to make money!

reviews.author: Mike Roney
reviews.text:
Update 10/2/25 (3 star): We just discovered something that we did not know at the time the work was completed.  Part of the job was to connect a vertical drain pipe (used for a water treatment discharge line) into the drain under the laundry tub.  That drain goes through our basement concrete slab into an underground pipe that goes out to our septic tank.  As it turns out a trap was not installed to seal off septic gases.  We only know that now because we had another contractor out to install an air gap for that plumbing and they immediately pointed out that there was no trap.  We had them take care of it.  But we wanted Boulden to know that it was apparently missed.  See pictures.  First shows plumbing under laundry tub.  Second shows trap subsequently added above sink.  Perhaps it was too crowded under the sink for a trap but there was no mention of a trap in any case.

Original review (5 star): Your technician did a wonderful job connecting the plumbing for our laundry tub and installing a hose bib. Boulden's pricing seems excessively high. The (up-front) charge was $3,100 for 6 hours of work, and almost all of that must have been labor because very little was needed in materials. We may just be in a very expensive market in northern Delaware. But you can expect from Boulden Brothers high quality workmanship and professionalism.  And you can also expect immediate response and availability.

reviews.author: Cory Burtch
reviews.text: I was having some electrical issues in my new house, so I had Boulden Brothers out to investigate. Dan was incredibly helpful and friendly, happy to explain everything he was doing. He gave me several different estimates and payment options. I had him back out today to do the work and he was just as lovely. He was able to arrive early and had everything done way faster than I anticipated. I’ll definitely be using them again!

reviews.author: Esther Okeyo
reviews.text: The technician, John who came out to help us with under the sink leak did an amazing job. It took him very little time to figure out what was leaking and reassured us that he was going to take care of it. He did. He ran the water several times to make sure the work was well done. He was professional, kind and explained every detail of what he was doing. He is knowledgeable and amazing person.

plumbers.name: Power Pro Plumbing Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 18105 S Hobart Blvd, Gardena, CA 90248, USA

reviews.author: Mays Richard
reviews.text: Joaquin was just doing prompt service. I got very headache last few days because of reserve water tank getting empty. After search on Google I found this company and call immediately. I truly impressive with their quick response and take appointment after discuss. Joaquin came to my home and detect all the leak very easily. Was fix the issues in couple of hours without any extra charge. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Avila Ronald
reviews.text: I was experiencing persistent water leakage from two different faucets in my kitchen, which had become quite inconvenient. After noticing the problem, I contacted a representative from Power Pro Plumbing over the phone. The customer service process was smooth, and they promptly arranged for a certified and experienced plumber to visit my home. The plumber arrived fully equipped with all the necessary tools and materials to handle the issue. He quickly identified the source of the leaks and fixed both faucets efficiently and professionally. The entire repair process was completed in a timely manner without any unnecessary delays, and I was very satisfied with the quality of service provided.

reviews.author: Carlease Burke
reviews.text: Joaquin Segura came to my home to install a kitchen faucet I purchased from Home Depot. He did a great job. Neat, professional and knowledgeable of the product. Thank you for your service, patience and kindness.

reviews.author: Andrew Cartmell
reviews.text: Power Pro Plumbing Heating & Air provided an outstanding experience from start to finish. Emiliano came to repair a leaky kitchen faucet, unclog a bathroom drain, and inspect our water heater. He was punctual, knowledgeable, and explained everything clearly before beginning the work. Emiliano not only fixed the issues but also cleaned the drainage line and tightened loose fittings to prevent future leaks. His professionalism and attention to detail really stood out. The pricing was reasonable, and the customer service was responsive and honest. I highly recommend Power Pro Plumbing Heating & Air for reliable, quality home repair services.

reviews.author: Rolling Along
reviews.text: We love Joe! He’s very nice, professional and patient with us ladies. He gave us the best options for our project. We appreciate doing business with Power Pro all the time. Everything was very clear and concise. We didn’t have a problem understanding what needed to be done by the time he left our home. We were sure we made the right decision on everything that we were looking for and needed. Joe left no stones unturned and went above and beyond for good service. Thanks!

plumbers.name: Swan Plumbing Heating & Air Of Loveland
plumbers.address: 3838 N Garfield Ave, Loveland, CO 80538, USA

reviews.author: Mary Herrera
reviews.text: A thank you to Swan for excellent work.  What we thought would be regular maintenance ended up being the replacement of the boiler and two hot water heaters.  Andrew discovered the issue and called for his supervisor for a second opinion.  Problem was verified and we were given three options.  Given the severity of the issue, they were able to start two days later for a three day job.  Ruben and Justin were very kind and did an excellent job with the entire replacement.  We appreciated their willingness to take the time to explain the process.  House was built in 1979 with original boiler. A big thank you to Andrew, Ruben, and Justin!  Because of your hard work, we were saved from a much bigger future issue.  I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Swan!

reviews.author: Mike Markano
reviews.text: Justin Sanders was such a pleasure to work with!!  Very professional and thorough, explained all he did and advised of possible problems we might encounter.  Was not pushy about getting repairs done, but explained why it might be needed.  We have been customers of Swan for a number of years, and will continue to be.  We had another service technician Mark come out this past summer to inspect our AC, and he also needs to be commended on his excellent work and customer skills.  I highly recommend Swan, and their technicians!  These two individuals were exemplary!!  THANKS

reviews.author: Tiffani Johnson
reviews.text: I interviewed 6 hvac companies before choosing Swan. They had the most knowledgeable and professional crew from the first person who came to my house to the last. They took time to explain things in detail and answer all my questions right away. I also think I got the absolute best deal for all of the work they did.

reviews.author: Mickey Pitt
reviews.text: Replaced a 20 year old AC and heating system with a new system. Did not want contractor grade equipment. Desired a more efficient system. Swan only one to provide a quote after they came, took measurements, discussed with me my concerns and what I wanted. Provided 4 levels of options to choose from. Went through rebates which saved me $$$$. Technicians were very professional. I work in design and construction for large scale solar and battery systems for utilities, I was impressed with the skilled craftsmanship of the technicians. Provided enough people to complete change over in a single 8 hour shift. Also corrected ventilation duct and flu issues with the system. These guys were great and highly recommend them. “Slow is Smooth, Smooth is Fast” took their time and were very efficient.

reviews.author: Christopher Chawula
reviews.text: I was overcharged $400 for what Roto Rooter  offers a service for of $99. They never unclogged the sink, misrepresented the conversation that we had about the expectations of the job and then Jaden the Supervisor felt it was all right that his plumber left pipes that were leaking water in my house. They weren’t leaking prior to his arrival! Overall, the job was never completed, and my plumbing situation was worse with leftover garbage underneath the sink and a puddle of water and a leaky pipe that wasn’t leaking prior to Swan plumbing showing up.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 5052 Haines Rd N, St. Petersburg, FL 33714, USA

reviews.author: teresa scott-davis
reviews.text:
Joe was awesome! He was very professional, respectful, and kind. He did a great job. I would gladly hire him to do more work at our home.
Customer service was awesome as well. They stayed in contact to let me know if Joe come earlier.
It’s hard to find a quality technician with a great professional demeanor.

reviews.author: Rebecca Bardi
reviews.text: This is our second time using roto-rooters services and we are very happy. Joshua was fantastic. He arrived on time and ready to work. He took the time to carefully cut away at some very stubborn tile in order to access our shower cartridge. Once in he was able to swap out the cart and installed the trim nicely. We are so grateful to have a shower that has hot water again!

reviews.author: Bonnie Griffin
reviews.text: Waited for about a month before submitting review and all plumbing issues remain resolved. John and Andrew were wonderful and a pleasure to work with. They answered all our questions and were very patient with us. Treated us and our home with great respect. They were hard working and cleaned up after themselves. We actually kind of missed having them around.

reviews.author: Steve G.
reviews.text: I would give five stars to the technician, Scott. He was friendly and courteous and explained everything clearly. He also worked quickly to fix our drain clog. The reason I’m giving only 4 stars however is because the pricing from Roto- Rooter is a bit steep. They charge set rates for the job, regardless of how little time it may take which works out best for the homeowner if it’s a big job that takes a lot of time, but for a job that’s done quickly and relatively easily, you still get charged a big bill.

reviews.author: Jody Lehman-Lynn
reviews.text: Today was the first time we ever used Roto-Rooter and we are glad we did. We chose them because of their positive reputation and no trip charge policy. They send a serviceman who scopes out the issue, discusses it with you and provides a price. You either go with it or send them on their way. Our plumber, Josh, was so friendly, knowledgeable, and understanding. He took his time with us and reviewed what he did and why. He was patient and kind. We will absolutely use them again should we ever need a plumber. I highly recommend Roto-Rooter.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 87 Carando Dr, Springfield, MA 01104, USA

reviews.author: Bill McPadden
reviews.text: Never a good time for a sewer line back up. Saw an issue in our basement bathroom where the sewer line started to back up. Luckily, we caught this early. Contacted Roto-Rooter and they came within their two hour service window. Bryan, (the first on the scene) asked some good background questions and explained a  best process forward. There definitely was a clog between the house and where the sewer line connected at the street. Line was reamed, a snag detected and everything cleaned out.

reviews.author: Brian Fraser
reviews.text:
Excellent and professional interactions. Very personable and professional technician. He seemed completely confident in his expertise and experience without being dismissive or condescending in any way… he was completely capable of handling our issue.  Price was extremely high compared to the national average. It was explained as a set price no mater how long the job would take which could be beneficial for what I  would believe would be 25% of the calls.
I would be fine with the price if it was a late Sunday evening call and was able to show up within the window originally given. With a company as large as RR I would expect they have plenty of units on standby.  My guy came from a call in Newburyport which does seem like an in-efficient coverage area.
Over all very happy and appreciative of RR service and Bryan’s professionalism made the price worth it by 930 that evening.  I would have been a very sour customer if I had to wait that long and had to deal with a “typical” less professional tech.
Thank you. I would recommend with my experience ( I don’t give full stars on many things on principle alone… I am happy to give Bryan all 5!)

reviews.author: Nancy
reviews.text:
Bryan was exceptional from start to finish. He was incredibly thorough, taking the time to walk me through every step of what he was doing. His explanations were clear, informative, and never rushed. I appreciated how he laid out his recommendations in a way that made sense.

A professional… knowledgeable, respectful, and genuinely committed to doing the job right. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Bella Santos
reviews.text:
Here’s a more polished and professional version that still clearly conveys how frustrating the experience was:

Extremely disappointed with my overall experience with Roto-Rooter.

The initial service for unclogging a sewage backup in my basement was excellent. The customer service representative was helpful, and the technician, Jude, arrived within two hours. He was professional, explained everything clearly, and made me feel confident about the process.

Unfortunately, everything after that went downhill.

A supervisor contacted me and scheduled a follow-up inspection to audit the line. I took a day off work to be home for the appointment, but no one called or showed up. Assuming there had been a misunderstanding, I waited again the following day and ended up losing another day of PTO. When I called customer service for clarification, I was told I was “not in the system.” After explaining that I had receipts and documentation, the representative abruptly hung up on me.

When I finally spoke with another supervisor, someone eventually came out to run a camera through the line. I was presented with two repair options — approximately $7,500 and $14,000. However, the written quote emailed to me later was over $20,000, which was extremely concerning and inconsistent with what had been discussed in person.

I decided to get additional estimates from other companies, many of whom simply asked for the camera footage. I then learned Roto-Rooter charges approximately $700 just to release the footage. On top of that, the employee I spoke with regarding the video was incredibly rude, constantly interrupted me, and spoke to me in a condescending manner as though I could not understand basic information.

When I asked to speak with a manager, I was told they would “maybe do me a favor” by requesting a discount. At no point did I feel valued as a customer.

The lack of professionalism, poor communication, inconsistent pricing, and dismissive treatment made this an incredibly frustrating experience. I understand repairs are expensive, but customers deserve honesty, respect, and basic professionalism throughout the process.

reviews.author: Ryan Rose
reviews.text: Yet again, another great service from Roto-Rooters. Manny performed a pump replacement as it was preventing my sink from working. Not only did he complete in a timely manner, he was respectful, informative, and genuine. He was very responsive as per my requests because we have family members with dementia here, and he handled all requests perfectly. Very appreciative of manny and roto-rooters, not only because of the service done, but how fast and timely the progress went as well. 10/10 experience and I do and will continue to share their names. Thank you again Manny !!

plumbers.name: My Buddy The Plumber Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 3169 S Highland Dr, Salt Lake City, UT 84106, USA

reviews.author: David Keifert
reviews.text: After receiving several quotes from other places we decided to get one from My Buddy the Plumber, they went through our system like none of the other guys had. They had excellent recommendations about moving our vent to prevent hair build up and expanding the size of both our intakes. Our house is breathing way better than it ever has now. They recommended a quieter furnace and we’re loving it. Korey and Kasey were informative and went above and beyond with the installation and fixing things that our roofers missed, and clearing dog hair out of the intakes. They were pleasant to be around and had no troubles working around the professional cleaners that were working at the same time. Would recommend this company to friends and family. Very satisfied, thanks!

reviews.author: Talon Ozmore
reviews.text:
They came the day after the earthquake here in Magna. Daniel looked at my water heater and between the both of us came up with a game plan to get our house back into shape. Unfortunately the water heater we had installed when we first moved in was replaced incorrectly. I explained that when you guys came to fix our AC unit and replace our furnace that our water heater was out of code. Expansion tank on the hot side. No earthquake straps. Wrong piping. Missing parts. No sediment trap on the gas line. Etc.Daniel took the time to listen and showed compassion for what we had gone thru. He offered solutions and advice that was greatly appreciated in a stressful situation. He came the next morning and explained every little detail on what he was going to do. We also found out that the water pressure was not where it was supposed to be. He explained that average range is between 50-80. Our house was 112. So our pressure regulator was the problem. He was a great help and I hope the owner Brandon( Daniel couldn't stop praising him at every chance he could) will see this and Give Daniel the recognition he deserves. You guys have come to our rescue multiple times now and I will continue to call on you guys even when we move. I have told multiple people to call if they need anything.
07/13 New service. We had our water main break and they once again came to our rescue. Brian was out within the service hours and said he would make sure we got taken care of.
We don't have enough words to thank this company for how many times they have come and treated us with compassion and respect for our house issues.

reviews.author: Nathan Feller
reviews.text: Casey and Tony were the techs that replaced my Furnace and AC. After getting quotes from multiple companies My Buddy had the most bang for your buck. Air purifier was the icing on the cake. Casey and Tony were professional, cordial, clean and fast! They broke down the information so I could understand it and even swept my utilities closet. highly highly recommend them and will be requesting them in the future. Thank you guys so much! Me and my family very much appreciate it!

reviews.author: Evan Stephens
reviews.text:
Revised Review:  I was contacted by the owner and had a very good conversation regarding the work and the cost.  I am very satisfied with the resolution.  The work as I stated before was very good.

Awesome and Fast  (That was my initial response).  However after digesting the invoice, I would not recommend their service based on how much they charge.  I had a water leak coming through my ceiling.  I cut out a 3x3 section of drywall, identified the leak, placed a plastic sheet on the floor and had it ready to go.  The technician arrived and spent about 30 to 40 minutes working to repair the line.  He cut out 18" of pipe, used 2 fittings and installed 18" of Pex.  Total cost $555 (I did get a discount for writing a Google review).  I called the next morning and explained my concern and was told "That is what it costs to have a licensed professional fix your pipe."  The service itself was good as they responded quickly, the technician was very nice and the work so far appears to be good.  Simply put, Overcharged for basic plumbing service.

reviews.author: M S
reviews.text: Derek D. and Hayden came today and installed much need faucets, and repaired my toilet which was loose and running all the time. They were professional, explained what needed to be done and the cost was super reasonable!! I appreciated the professionalism, neatness, and they were on time. Thank you!! I will be using you again in the future!!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 11 N 5th St #300, Reading, PA 19601, USA

reviews.author: David McKee
reviews.text:
It started when I had a failure in my main drain pipe after a few years of it acting like it wanted to fail it failed. I went to the phones and called the local person I had been using for the repair. Their response was less than prompt I picked up the cell phone scrolled into plumbers and came up with roto-rooters number so I called. I knew the company I knew that they were committed to advertising their products.  I was connected with Stephen Hogan he was fantastic took my call seriously responded quickly and thoroughly. It was a huge job at least from my perspective and the team he sent out was effective and thorough. Stephen stayed on top of the job to make the sure things were going well. The repair crew was effective and efficient and understood I had a brand new driveway and I had to dig right along the edges of it did absolutely no damage and I was really pleased.
Thank you Stephen and the repair crew forr all your effort I'll have no problem recommending you in the future.

reviews.author: Melissa Freeman
reviews.text: Aidan is hands down the best plumber I’ve ever worked with. He’s incredibly knowledgeable, professional, and takes the time to clearly explain what’s going on and what needs to be done. I really appreciated how helpful and thorough he was throughout the entire process. It’s rare to find someone who combines expertise with such great customer service. I wouldn’t hesitate to call him again or recommend him to anyone needing reliable plumbing work.

reviews.author: Pete Becker
reviews.text:
We got a new water heater installed, but the plumber was not able to remove the old one. It was only after I posted an unfavorable rating that someone called to setup a second plumber to help. They did come back two weeks later and got the old unit removed; however, they missed their appointment window by a few hours.

Roto Rooter was good in scheduling a water heater replacement to work around my Saturday schedule, but the price was much higher than I expected. Lowes was going to do the job for $1800 including removal, but they do not work on Saturdays. Roto Rooter charged almost $3000, which I thought was excessive even for Saturday work.

reviews.author: Grant Gregor
reviews.text: Anthony was here on time and resolved our issue quickly and was very cordial and pleasant. We will definitely have him back if our need arises again. He made an unpleasant circumstance go away in a professional manner. Definitely a grade ‘A’ tech.

reviews.author: elliott nicholas

He went the extra mile and stay patient as I went to Home Depot to find a part. While I didn't use thier service for the first visit, we came up with a plan that works around my schedule. reviews.author: Kurt

Perry (plumber) was also extremely knowledgeable about the hydrolics, valves, water pressure and overall Plumbing of the project.  He was neat,  courteous and respectful of our home and time.  We are confident that Alvarez will be available for routine and emergency situations in the future.  We would not hesitate to recommend this company.

Still a satisfied customer and would recommend.

reviews.author: Livia Wolfer
reviews.text: I had Matt in today, with Jonathan shadowing him, and they did great work! reviews.text:
What started out as an issue with water acidity exposed a problem with the iron filter on my well. Allen came out to the house and assessed the problem and called on Jacob as the problem was larger than just adjusting the system.

Jacob adjusted schedule and came out. After identifying the problem he gave me pricing on removing the 25 year old iron filter and adding an equivalent and also addressed a problem with sediment. He never griped or indicated any distress with having to work late. He did a great job of removing the old filter and putting the new one in place with all the plumbing changes associated. The new filter looks like it was there from the start.

As always, Furr really has a talented team that does goodlooking quality work.

reviews.author: Akua G.

I truly appreciate his professionalism and would highly recommend him to anyone needing HVAC services!

reviews.author: Debbie Brooks

Very knowledgeable and definitely demonstrated excellent customer service.

reviews.author: Christine Kantner
reviews.text: We had a fabulous experience with Goode Plumbing when we needed to reroute the flow of our sump pump. Joey was the technician who came out to evaluate the job . He was so kind and knowledgeable that he really put me at ease about this big job. It turned out great! The work was done quickly and they left my home so clean! I was so happy with the whole process that I called for an estimate on another big project Ava requested Joey again. I will be back for another review once this next job is complete.  Thank you, Joey! And thank you, Goode Plumbing!

reviews.author: Burt Schell
reviews.text: Louden and Caleb were excellent! Friendly, knowledgeable and prompt. Kudos to Goode making it possible to remove and install a new water heater. That’s from 1st phone call to completion. 5 stars Burt

reviews.author: Rafael Matos
reviews.text:
I am satisfied by Goode Plumbing. Kevin and Joseph were punctual and efficient. Kevin was the plumber who assessed my bathroom issue. He took his time assessing the issue and providing the initial quote. He balanced his company’s policies with our situation’s needs with care and respect. He offered efficient solutions.

He and Joseph worked on the issue in my bathroom. They explained the problem and walked me through options. They were punctual and their communication was great! I recommend Goode Plumbing based on their service!

Thanks Goode!

reviews.author: Joan Oliver
reviews.text: Brian R did an outstanding job replacing the cartridge in my shower and updating all the pipes and water lines under my kitchen sink. He explained each step of the process and why it was necessary, which I really appreciated. He also made an effort to reuse parts when possible to help keep costs down (and saved me money from the original quote). We weren’t sure if the new cartridge would eliminate the noise in my wall, but it worked perfectly. He even gave me tips on how to prevent the issue from happening again. The job took most of the day, and I truly value the time, care, and expertise he put into it.

reviews.author: Lana Desman
reviews.text: We hired Goode Plumbing recently for a ejector pit clean out (which is what we thought was needed) and their plumber Frank quickly identified that our ejector pump was burning out and needed replacement, which saved us from bigger issues down the line. Frank clearly explained the situation and answered all my questions. While they’re a bit on the pricey side, the quality of their expertise and reliability make it worth it, and I’d gladly hire them again.

plumbers.name: Prime Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7617 Baltimore Annapolis Blvd, Glen Burnie, MD 21060, USA

reviews.author: Lauren Postley
reviews.text:
I reached out to Prime Plumbing several years ago to have my hot water heater moved to accommodate waterproofing installation in my basement. The man that came out was quick and very respectful and the price was reasonable.

When I had a very minor plumbing problem (moving an outdoor hose bib to accommodate deck steps), reaching out to Prime plumbing was a no-brainer. The man that came out saw the issue and jumped to a solution... extending a pipe from my basement. The pipe was brought up to an external wall (which I later found out was against MD code) and was also not properly insulated. He also removed a frost proof hose bib and replaced it with a regular hose bib. He put a ridiculous wall patch and went on and on about his side hustle to make more money (buying and renting out properties in Africa).

It only took less than two years for the pipe to fail and cause significant damage to my main and lower levels of my home. I reached out to Prime to rectify the issue. The woman that answered was incredibly rude. I came home to the water damage and was in shock as I was trying to explain the damage that I was seeing. She was very curt and insinuated the pipe bursting was my own fault. How?!? She set up for someone to come out the next day. He was equally as rude. He quoted a completely ridiculous number for the repair and reiterated that I was the cause of the water damage. My friend had a pipe burst and was quoted $300 less than what he was quoting me.

The pipe that was installed by Prime caused the water damage to my home and they continue to deny any fault. I've attached photos that show the hose bib that they moved, the patch he installed after he cut a hole in my wall and the subsequent water damage after the pipe burst. I also attached a photo showing there was insulation around the pipe, but the pipe should have never been ran to an external wall.

Please do your due diligence before reaching out to this company. Len the Plumber rectified Prime's mistakes and were much more knowledgeable and respectful.

reviews.author: Harish Khandrika
reviews.text: Rob Richter from Prime Plumbing came to install our dishwasher when Home Depot bailed on us due to finding (older style) push pull valves under our sink. Rob came and upgraded all our valves for the price of one and then installed our dishwasher. He also hauled our old dishwasher away for no extra charge! Rob stayed with us for several hours making sure the fitting was correct, checked for leaks, and even helped sus out some pressure problems in the house on his own time. He taught me about the new valves and how to problem solve pressure issues in the future. We offered him pizza and coffee not only because he was working hard but he did so on Xmas eve. Definitely will be calling prime plumbing again for all our future plumbing needs from annual county mandated checkups to future work! Thanks Rob! Merry Christmas and happy new year!

reviews.author: dwayne johnson
reviews.text: Rob provided excellent service. I needed a new water maker shut-off valve installed. Rob evaluated the situation and provided me with solutions. The work was done quickly and cleanly. Rob also provided me with knowledge about my home and gave me some ideas and suggestions. Very satisfied.

reviews.author: Benjamin Walsh
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Prime, Ernie came out originally and figured out what needed to be done. We agreed to the work and scheduling was a breeze. On install day Ernie and Casie Jones showed up were very polite, knowledgeable, quick and most importantly very nice to my old dog. They also went the extra mile to make sure I was happy with the changes. I would recommend Prime Plumbing to anyone looking for professional quality work.

reviews.author: Jamie Cole

Samuel and Dominic were awesome. They were professional, friendly, taught me a little bit about my pipes, made great recommendations, and left me feeling confident in a job well done. They also cleaned up so well that I think they left it better than when they got here!

I will definitely use these guys again - hopefully next time it’s not for such an emergency!

reviews.text: My toilet has been out of order from a small bottle that fell in while it was flushing… Kyle did an awesome job… was friendly and timely. The technician arrived on time, was highly professional, and completed the install with impressive speed and attention to detail. Everything was left clean and working perfectly. We couldn’t be happier with the level of service and the peace of mind they provided—great job by both Dylan and Jordan - highly recommend Sarkinen for anyone needing reliable home service!

We needed someone out ASAP, and Jordan and Connor delivered — arriving at our home by 10:36 a.m. They quickly diagnosed the issue and performed a reset on our Rheem Electric Hybrid water heater, getting our hot water back up and running in no time. Jordan was very knowledgeable and took the time to explain the situation, along with helpful recommendations for future replacement options.
Both technicians were professional, personable, and confident in their evaluation, which gave us trust in the company and the services they provide. They will absolutely have our business when it’s time for future repairs or replacement. We also appreciated the complimentary evaluation visit. Kudos to you Sarkinen Plumbing!

We highly recommend them for all your AC needs. Thank you, Khamani, Josh, and Vitali, for your excellent service.

reviews.author: Shannon
reviews.text: I usually don't do reviews, but I really wanted to share how great of an experience I had. The best customer service, professionalism, and kindness from a company I have seen in a long time. My furnace went out on a Sunday in February. My furnace was over 30years old. I called on a late evening and Dennis called me right back, which I didn't expect on the weekend. He sent out a repairman right away. The repair man treated me like family and was honest, I needed a new furnance because it was so old. Hearing that I needed a new furnace felt like a nightmare but Dennis was reassuring and made it easy. Dennis called me back and came out to my home to help me find the type of furnace that I needed.  He even showed me extra tips about my home. Dennis is awesome!!!! He took the time to explain and help me figure things out. He even let me borrow a heater until my new furnace was installed. Dennis brought Sean out to install the furnance and he was so cool and caring. Installation was quick and easy. He explained what he was doing and actually finished up early. I really appreciate the kindness and professionalism of everyone at W.F.Hann and Sons and will definitely use them in the future and recommend to all my friends and neighbors.

plumbers.name: MAC 5 Services
plumbers.address: 375 Gus Hipp Blvd, Rockledge, FL 32955, USA

reviews.author: Kirsty Stewart
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Robert when he came to fix my plumbing issue. He was extremely knowledgeable, professional, and took the time to explain everything clearly. Robert was also very kind, courteous, and genuinely helpful throughout the entire process. It's not often you find someone who combines technical expertise with such excellent customer service. The repair was completed efficiently, and everything is working perfectly. I highly recommend Robert to anyone needing plumbing services!

reviews.author: Valerie Maldonado
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Mac5, especially their technician, Michael. From start to finish, the service was timely, professional, and exceeded my expectations. Michael was knowledgeable, courteous, and went above and beyond to make sure everything was handled properly.

The level of customer service was outstanding, and it's clear that Mac5 truly values its customers. I was so impressed with the quality of service that I decided to sign up for their annual membership. I highly recommend Mac5 and Michael to anyone looking for reliable, professional service.

reviews.author: John Bonsignore
reviews.text: I was going to replace the toilet valve on 2 toilets inside the tank when I discovered that the shut off valve was leaking on one of the toilets and needed to be replaced. I called MAC5 and they sent my technician Brad. Brad was fantastic! Professional and polite and provided an estimate before doing any work. This put my mind at ease as I knew there would be no hidden costs. Brad completed all the work and I am extremely satisfied with the service. I will definitely be using MAC5 again! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: kelly mcbryar
reviews.text: Brian was quick to come to our unexpected leak. When he arrived he explained everything very thoroughly to us and gave us our options. He explained what would be our best option long term. We were unable to commit to that today but there was no pushing trying to make a sale etc just provided us clear explanations and service options. He repaired our leak quickly and made sure he left everything better than he found it. We are thankful for Brian’s professionalism and kindness.

reviews.author: Gillian Mayson
reviews.text: Christopher Pena is an absolutely magnificent employee. He was so knowledgeable, thorough, honest, sincere and helpful. He was able to diagnose and resolve my AC problem with so much efficiency and confidence, my stress instantly decreased!! Christopher is an extremely kind and considerate human being. I HIGHLY recommend him.

plumbers.address: 3630 State Rd S-10-1024, Johns Island, SC 29455, USA

reviews.author: Margaret Harris
reviews.text: Dom did a thorough, extensive job attempting to locate the issue with my drain line. He explained everything he was doing, presented options for the service and insured all potential areas of concern were explored. Dom was also pleasant and polite. A true professional, it was evident he was experienced and competent. Roto-Rooter was recommended to me and it was a solid recommendation. I would definitely call them again.

reviews.author: Emily Mercavich
reviews.text: Quick and friendly service from the moment my call was answered. Frank was absolutely outstanding and took the extra care and steps to figure out the extent of my problem. Something other companies have not done, which also saved me a lot of money. He was thorough, friendly, and all around a great guy! Will absolutely be using Roto Rooter for any future needs, purely because of Frank. Great work!

reviews.author: Lisa Mciver
reviews.text: Our downstairs bathroom overflowed, what a mess from a clogged pipe, but the gentlemen from Roto-Rooter did an excellent job. Didn’t leave until everything was running well. They were very professional, very nice and extremely polite. I will call them again and I will let others know how well they did.Thank you for the rescue! We appreciate it more than you know. Rico and company were great

reviews.author: Jay Michelle
reviews.text:
Mr. Malik came and cleared a deep clog for us on New Year's day 🙌🏽 We had water going all over the garage. He really saved the day. In addition to that, he helped ease my mom's mind throughout the process, continuously assuring her that he was going to get the job done.

Great Work. Great Customer Service. Highly Recommended.

Sidenote: He was here so long he left two of his tools, lol. We still have him here for him!

- Michelle

reviews.author: Vonda Fields
reviews.text: Had a really good experience with 2 Technicians however, I realized later in the evening that even though the drain was cleared that morning by the 1st technician, my bathtub still wasn’t draining. Robert came out around 9pm and did everything he could to clear the blockage. He was Awesome! He communicated everything he was doing and made sure to clean up afterwards. Very polite and respectful. Thank you Robert!!

plumbers.name: Elite Rooter Plumbers
plumbers.address: 3656 W 72nd Ave, Westminster, CO 80030, USA

reviews.author: Sasan Amini
reviews.text:
I contacted Elite Rooter for a sewer line backup in my basement. A technician arrived within the two-hour window, cleared the clog, and showed me what he claimed was a broken section of my sewer line. I paid for the service, expecting the issue to be resolved.
Less than a week later, my sewer backed up again. When I called Elite Rooter, the representative told me someone would call me back shortly since it was a repeat issue. Almost immediately after hanging up, I received a call from a man who claimed to be a manager.
Instead of taking responsibility or discussing any type of warranty or accountability for their previous work, he told me they would charge more than the first visit to come back. He was extremely unprofessional, argumentative, and repeatedly said, “Clearly you don’t understand plumbing.” When I asked about Elite Rooter standing behind their work, he continued to argue rather than help.
At that point, I had no confidence in this company. I ended up calling a different rooter company, which actually addressed the problem professionally.
I would not recommend Elite Rooter based on their poor follow-up, lack of accountability, and unprofessional management behavior.

reviews.author: Tim Mackenzie
reviews.text: Isaiah, our technician was fantastic. He was easy to talk to and explain things really well. We had a pretty good clog so he needed to take the toilet off and made a video and showed us and explained every step of the way. Super nice guy really appreciate him.

reviews.author: David Loeffler
reviews.text: Very fast and professional. Came out 2 hours after I called and after clearing my drain they sent a scope down the pipe to discover that roots from my tree had destroyed a section of the sewer line. By end of the day they had an excavation crew at work. I have a basement so they had to dig almost 12 feet deep. Day 2 they had completed the repair and day 3 it was inspected and backfilled. The price was a little on the high end, but it was all done in accordance with codes, utility locates performed, permit pulled, inspected, and properly compacted. Not to mention fast. As a construction project manager, I know this isn't the type of work that you cut any corners on and Elite didn't disappoint. The 10 year warranty lets me flush with confidence. My technician (David) was prompt, courteous, professional and communicative. Their customers are in good hands.

reviews.author: Patrick Parreco
reviews.text:
Junior and Agustin were awesome.  Very
Professional and personable.  They were able to fix our problem quickly without a mess. Thank you

reviews.author: Shawn Clemenson
reviews.text: The technician was prompt and on time. He even called me when he was 20 minutes out to let me know his arrival time. He did an excellent job and made sure to lay out floor covers for any mess. He left the place clean and the line cleaned. We will definitely use Elite in the future and I will happily refer them to any who ask.

reviews.author: Life with Renee
reviews.text:
Excellent experience with Aaron Services. My main water line burst and my front yard was flooded. Gabe came out same day and gave a quote.
Gabe walked me through the entire process. He was very helpful & responsive.
The work was efficient, professional, and completed in a timely manner. Pricing was very reasonable and less expensive than other quotes I received. Gabe and the office staff took the time to answer all of my questions and made sure I understood the process. I would definitely recommend their services.

reviews.author: Dale Grant
reviews.text:
We recently called Aaron Services and requested Gabe to install a reverse osmosis water system.  The installation and overall experience was great.  The professionalism and result of this project by Aaron Services / Gabe Jimenez exceeded our expectations.

We have used Aaron Services (Water Heater Purchase / Install and other plumbing repairs) requesting Gabe which all have been outstanding.  Calling Aaron Services and requesting Gabe has been like having a personal plumber!  We recommend Aaron Plumbing Services.

reviews.author: Kristen Giacalone
reviews.text:
I am extremely pleased with the service I received by Aaron Services with my new install of two tankless water heaters.
I had a 23 year-old water tank in my house and  I wanted to change to the tankless but did not know much about them.   Brandon was very knowledgeable and spoke with me at length of the benefits of the tankless water heaters. On the day of the install Brandon and Tai worked a very long day until the job was done. They also helped me with an unrelated drain issue. They truly went above and beyond making sure the job was done correctly and efficiently.   I highly recommend Brandon and Tai for any plumbing work and will be requesting them when my tankless heaters need servicing or if I have any other plumbing issues.  Thank you Aaron services for making this transition smooth.

reviews.author: Roger Noble
reviews.text: Had to replace a shower pressure balancing valve every couple months for 2 years. I thought maybe the valve in the wall had failed but planned that repair with a full bathroom remodel - which I kept delaying. Then my water heater, which I thought was 18 years old started releasing pressure and overflow water every couple minutes. I thought for sure I needed a new tank.  Gabe did an inspection of both items. Instead of busting out my shower to replace the valve and replacing my water heater just because I thought that was the problem, he was honest. My water heater was 6 years old (1 month out of warranty of  course) but fine. My shower valve was fine. The issue, my high rise condo towers' main PRV in my unit failed so my fixtures were being crushed under 200 lbs of pressure. In the process of that fix, we discovered my main shut off was only partially working. Aaron Plumbing could have hit me with over $5000 in charges but their honesty saved me $3500, much needed during the holidays and a year under chaotic tariff fueled inflation.

reviews.author: Jerry Lu
reviews.text: We had an underground leak at the foundation, and were able to schedule an inspection the next day. Gabe came out and really flexed his experience by quickly locating our issue. He informed us of our options and was able to repair the leak very timely and thoroughly. I’m glad I chose Aaron Plumbing and will be sure to recommend. Many thanks to the service reps and especially Gabe who was very patient and understanding with us!

reviews.author: Katherine Cseuz
reviews.text: Zeke from Steve’s Plumbing was awesome! He was super friendly and very knowledgeable. He checked my hot water heater and toilet, then around my condo for potential problem sites. He identified a leak in the making in my primary bathroom. Once everything was checked and assessed, he presented the estimate and explained in detail all the charges. I gave the go ahead and Zeke set up and changed out my old hot water heater and toilet. I had him clean the sink line. His work was neat and tidy. There was no debris left behind. I asked questions along the way and he took the time to explain his answers. I’m super happy and impressed with the speed and competency of his work. Thank you.

reviews.author: Michael Fend
reviews.text:
I owned Simply Leak Detection for many years, and whenever one of our customers needed a plumber for water line repair or plumbing work, I would often refer them to Steve’s Plumbing. In all that time, I never received a single complaint about their work—something that’s honestly rare in the service industry.
Customers frequently told me that the team at Steve’s Plumbing went above and beyond what was expected. They are knowledgeable, experienced, and clearly take pride in doing the job right the first time.
Steve Egner has built an excellent reputation for taking care of his customers. Since starting his company, he has created a culture where his technicians carry the same mindset of professionalism, quality workmanship, and customer service. That kind of leadership from the top down shows in the work they deliver.
Because of that, I confidently referred many repair jobs to Steve’s Plumbing in the past, and I will continue recommending them to customers through my new business.

reviews.author: Lacy Fischer
reviews.text: Plumber was excellent, had a sewage smell in the bathroom, he gave us an easy fix and didn't try to upsell. Reattatched our tub spout and fixed it so it works properly. Did a thorough inspection of other plumbing around the house to make sure all was in good working order. He was very knowledgeable and explained everything in detail, even things that didn't have to do with plumbing as I had lots of questions. Very reasonable price. Will definitely call them in the future if I need any repairs.

reviews.author: Sue Noh
reviews.text: I extremely recommend Charlie Tait to be your plumber. If I could give him 6 out of 5 stars I would. Much like how he looks, his work was amazing. He is a professional and has sufficient knowledge in his field of work. If you are worried about the money, don’t be. Charlie looks at his work in the perspective of the customer and gives reasonable honest prices and the work that he did was absolutely worth the money. When doing the plumbing work at my house he worked late and finished the job in just two days. It was extremely impressive as the job that needed to be done required pulling up concrete tiles in my backyard. He not only fixed the necessary parts but also the unnecessary even when not requested. If I have another plumbing job in the future, I will call Charlie Tait. Not only Charlie, but Steve’s Plumbing is an amazing company that has various payment plans. You should absolutely look at their plans and I guarantee there will be one for you! Thank you Charlie!

reviews.text:

I also would like to mention Mr. Shawn as a wonderful, kind, and always smiling person, which is priceless these days! Thank you so much!

reviews.text:
The worst experience of my life dealing with a plumber. I'll let the picture speak for themselves, but they came to unclog a drain. It cost me $700. And they destroyed a new bathroom that was being renovated. Galaxy white grout is now shit brown. Sprayed all over the walls that I have to paint. Lastly if you sign up on the Internet, there's a promise of a $55 discount. Didn't get that either.
So before you dial Roto router locally here on the space coast, buyer beware overpriced, shitty work, and the leaders obviously don't want to take care of things when they go wrong.
Need your drain unclogged keep scrolling pick a different company. Check pricing before they even drive out.

reviews.author: Lauren

reviews.author: Dale Schramm
reviews.text: Our main sewer line plugged up- tree roots and needed it high pressure rodded out quickly. The guys and the company were quick to respond, good natured, informative and professional. I highly recommend this service.

reviews.author: Sandi Menefee
reviews.text: This is the second time I have used this company. David was my go to person again, and I cannot thank him enough for clear communication, the extra mile and solid work (sewer lines to the street and all things related, and cleaning out the lines into the house). I love the project team work and they’re all friends on the job. Competitive pricing and no regrets.

reviews.author: Deborah Grassl
reviews.text: We had a garbage disposal replaced by  Gerett Lamb.  He was well groomed, on time, and had a lot of plumbing experience.  He patiently explained what was happening with the old garbage disposal that could no longer be "fixed,"  and why it had to be replaced.   He purchased a new disposal and replaced the old model in a couple of hours.  Also, he included photos of the job he did along with the detailed invoicing.  His work was fast and efficient.  I will definitely call Gerett the next time we have a plumbing problem.

reviews.author: Reach -1 - Teach -1
reviews.text: Jovani was very professional and helpful he asked, if he needed to remove his shoe's before entering. Check everything inside and out making sure I didn't have any leaks. Love the service and will use them in the future when someone else happens at my house.

reviews.author: Ben McCrory
reviews.text: David R. did an outstanding job. He quickly identified the issue and fixed it right away. His expertise and efficiency were truly a lifesaver. The service was excellent, and the pricing was very reasonable. I highly recommend Rooter Hero Plumbing.

reviews.author: Veronica Lara
reviews.text: I was very impressed with Ray and Chase. They were both polite, courteous, and respectful throughout the entire process. Ray came out to assist us with an issue in our master bathroom and took the time to explain everything clearly. He walked us through the repair process step by step, which we really appreciated. We’re very pleased with the quality of their work. Sunny Service is lucky to have such dedicated employees. In the future, we’ll definitely be requesting Ray and Chase for all our plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Ashlei Marshall
reviews.text: CHASE AND DANIEL!! Let me tell you about how awesome these guys are! I had a huge water leak underneath my tub in the master bathroom that flooded my husband's closet. Chase came out assess the damage and figure out where the leak(s) were coming from. He gave me a quote, and we made an appointment to get it fixed.  He and Daniel came out and got to work. These guys are top-notch, they knew exactly what they were doing and how to do it! They executed a plan with precision and with smiles on their faces! Chase and Daniel answered all of my questions and didn't hesitate to answer more! The work was completed quickly and efficiently and they cleaned everything up as if there were no problems at all! These guys are amazing! They even took the time to answer questions from my son who is autistic and chronically ill with kidney disease and lung disease. It meant so much to me that they genuinely care about their clients. Sunny Service, you have an amazing team... these guys deserve a bonus and a raise!

reviews.author: V Rusu
reviews.text:
I have had a very good experience with this company on HVAC side but they are horrible when it comes to plumbing.
With some credits applied to my review, I can only give them 2 stars combined. Also, it appears this company gives misleading information for promotions that they provide. I was told I am getting the best price for plumbing repairs but in reality I could find a much better deal, if I weren't putting too much trust to them. They obviously do not deserve much trust on plumbing side. They failed to take ownership of their mistakes, overcharged me and up until today they failed to fix the ceiling (pictures attached). With that said, I can't recommend this company to anyone.

reviews.author: Debra
reviews.text: The sunny service technicians are very friendly, professional, and go above and beyond they check everything thoroughly and clean the drain lines. Replace my filter check the heating or cooling whichever service it is that they are performing. They have helped me with my thermostat before when I didn’t know how to do something on it and checked my gas connections to make sure they were OK. Rinse off the outside unit I just feel very comfortable that by the time they leave everything is working the way it should which is a big relief. I will always use them for my service in the future.

reviews.author: Irma E
reviews.text: Michael Limon was punctual and after introducing himself, began servicing our hvac. Very impressed are we with him. Very professional and friendly and knowledgeable. He explained and even took pictures of how our unit is working. Our family highly recommends Sunny Services and Michael Limon.

Jason and Ted removed my old system from 1993 and installed a whole new HVAC system the same day. They were honest, professional, and very respectful of my home.
I highly recommend this company for their professionalism, communication, and outstanding service.

First picture is the old furnace
Last two pictures is the new set up

reviews.author: Chris Green
reviews.text: Konnor came out to do my initial inspection and estimate. He was very knowledgeable answered all of my questions he was able to get me a filtration system that suited my needs and within my budget. James came out next day to do my install. These guys are true professionals 100% will be calling them back for additional plumbing work. James answered every question I had and did a stellar job installing my new 3 stage water filtration system and water heater. I cannot recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Jeff Shep
reviews.text:
Very professional. Took time to explain everything so we could understand. Provided with estimate and installed a temporary fix until the parts com in.  Would recommend.
James and Juan came and completed the necessary work.  They arrived on time and completed the necessary work in a timely manner.  Very personable gentlemen. Took the time to explain everything to me and cleaned up the area.  Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Hector Gonzalez
reviews.text: Ted and Anthony did a great job! They were professional, attentive and prompt. Ted explained all the features and functions of the new HVAC unit and was patient enough to answer additional questions my wife had while on the phone.  Ted even recommended humidity settings , based on different needs and health concerns. They also reconnected my existing dehumidifier unit, which had stopped working (unbeknownst to me) and corrected the direction of some drain tubing from a previous installation by another company. This was our first experience with Duane Blanton and now we can confidently say, they are our new HVAC and plumbing top choice.

reviews.author: Mark Bloom
reviews.text: As always, prompt attention.  David rapidly diagnosed and initiated repairs while communicating with me through the entire process.  Crawling around a crawl space in single digit temperatures is never glamorous- but that didn’t stop David from delivering.  Always appreciated!
