reviews.author: Tony Casper
reviews.text:
So last Sunday in the middle of the storm Five Star Home Services came out and repaired our furnace and saved the day.  Matt the repair technician diagnosed the problem didn’t have a part to repair with him. He drove in that mess to his office and picked up the part then came back and made sure we were warm.

The service from them over the past 10 years has always been top notch.  I am replacing our furnace with them and they applied my repair cost as a credit which is an added bonus.

Today their team showed as promised and began replacing the furnace an A/C. Scott and Connor were amazing!  They were done in half the time it took my neighbors and the install look perfect. It’s sad to say I feel their high quality service isn’t the norm. I would highly recommend their team for a repair or replacement of your A/C or Furnace.

reviews.author: Jay & Daniella
reviews.text:
We were referred to Five Star Home Services through the Lowe's Project Referral Service, and honestly I could not be happier. While they were not able to come out the absolute moment we needed them (our furnace went out on a Saturday in the middle of January, when I'm sure a lot of homes needed assistance), they were very quick to communicate and reschedule for first thing in the morning on Sunday.
Naturally, we ended up needing a whole new system, but Five Star was incredible and able to update the entire system, furnace and AC, the very next morning and for a reasonable price. Noah came out and did our diagnostic, and he was super friendly and knowledgeable. I never once felt like my time was being wasted or that I was being taken for a ride.
Zane and Mike (maybe Matt, I'm sorry I don't quite remember) were both awesome! They showed up exactly when they were supposed to, there's a tracking system so I was ready for their arrival. They worked all day and everything was awesome, they wore booties and put down a drop cloth, even swept up when they were done, extremely respectful of my home.
Even their staff on the phone were incredibly great to work with!  Five Star truly deserves all 5 stars, plus. Customer service is a dying art, but they keep it alive. Thanks so much for everything!

reviews.author: Cody Harkless
reviews.text:
Very friendly, professional & knowledgeable. The whole team did a fantastic job. Joshua Rodriguez, Richard Rodgers & Cameron Woods. They installed quality products for me for a good price. Would highly recommend!
👍👍

reviews.author: Rory Nicol
reviews.text:
When our furnace went out during one of the coldest weeks of the year, I had four kids in the house and real concern about how we were going to get through the weekend. Five Star Home Services stepped in immediately. By Saturday morning — in the cold and snow — their team was at our home replacing the furnace.

What stood out most wasn’t just the speed or professionalism (which were excellent), but the way they treated my family. They were kind, calm, played with my kids, and treated our home with real care. The cleanup was spotless, and the stress we were carrying disappeared.

In a moment when it really mattered, they showed up. That’s the kind of company you want to call — and recommend.

reviews.author: Roger Doyle
reviews.text:
Hi. My name is Roger, and I won Five Stars Home Services "Scariest Furnace Contest" and had my new, totally free furnace installed last week and I couldn't be happier!

I'm a 74-year-old retiree and having my 45-year-old furnace replaced with a new energy efficient model is a blessing and all the folks at Five Stars were great. They even through in a wi-fi thermostat with a room monitor, which I really love.

After I was told I had won their contest, a Five Stars rep came over and surveyed the monster in the basement and the rest of the house and set about determining the correct sized unit, which is very important. Then they scheduled the install for the next business day. The installers texted when they were on the way and arrived on-time at 9am and promptly got to tearing out the old furnace and installing the new one, and they had it up and running by 6pm. They were very courteous and did a great job at the install and clean-up. I retired from Port Columbus where I coordinated construction projects, so I know a good job when I see one.
I've added a picture of the Honeywell T10 Pro Wi-fi thermostat and room sensor that was installed as part of the project. Having Wi-fi access is great and the room sensor acts as a portable thermostat that can be located in any room.

reviews.author: Jeff Bialeschki
reviews.text:
It is hard to be pleased with a service, when they charged us over $900 and did not do anything.  I can understand delays as we were told the technician would arrive between 4:00 and 5:00pm.  After 5pm we began receiving text messages from Latoya saying that our tech was running behind but that we were next in line.  6 text messages later, the tech arrived around 7:45pm.  After inspecting our clogged drain he said there was nothing he could do at that time but could call another service tech who had access to a camera.  That tech came around 8:45, ran the camera tube into the pipe and said they could not clear the clog, but that we needed an outdoor access pipe installed which would involve digging a 6 foot deep trench, fixing a pipe and installing an access point in the front yard.  He quoted us a price of $12,000.  I told him we needed to get a 2nd opinion.  He gave me the number of his friend "Juan" who he said could probably do the job for between $8,000 and $9,000.  He then charged us $900 for the service call.  We called a different plumbing company the following day who said that the quote of $12,000 could be considered attempted sexual assault because we almost got screwed and the new plumbing company did the exact same job (dug the trench, fixed the outside pipe and installed an access point in the front yard) for just under $6,000.  I completely understand the delay and techs get backed up with jobs, but charging $900 for a service call to tell us they couldn't fix the problem was highway robbery.

UPDATE  2.17.2026
I received a phone call from a district manager who was amazing.  He was both professional and a problem solver who is working to secure a refund of the $900 service fee.  He said that Roto-Rooter does not charge a service fee if they do not fix the problem.  He said he would work to ensure that customers were treated fairly and again, he was extremely communicative and professional.  I am extremely happy how this has been handled.

reviews.author: Susan Goedke

reviews.author: Amanda Marie Shufflebarger
reviews.text:
I am highly disappointed with the service, price, and high pressure sales pitch, and communication.

During a maintenance call for my 700sf condo, the technician quoted me over $16,000 to replace a the furnace (not even the AC). The quote was for a furnace of 80,000 BYU, much bigger than I needed, but he also said he could offer me a "ghetto unit" for $13,000. At the time, my furnace was functional (but old).

In addition, as part of this conversation, he told me that my unit was "dangerous" and that he should "red tag" it or someone could get sick. He did not red tag it or shut down the unit, but he left and called the gas company, who later showed up and confirmed there was no carbon monoxide.

When the technician emailed me the quote with this information, he only shared generic, unlabeled photos of my furnace, so while I was reviewing the quote, I asked for pictures of the carbon monoxide reading and the crack. Four days later, they responded with an image with a reading of 6ppm (which is low and NOT grounds for a red tag). In addition, the heat exchanger image showed discoloration and surface wear but no visible cracks.

In the meantime, two local licensed HVAC companies inspected my unit. One replaced it for under $5,000 that same week. Both called the Goettls' quote and diagnostic "outrageous," and neither of them found a crack. They told me it needed a new valve but was also old and would be due for replacement soon.

I am glad that I got my furnace fixed by another company, but it was unfortunate to have to deal with what felt like high pressure sales pitches and hardball approaches. When a company quotes me over $16,000 to replace a furnace (with no A/C), calling it "dangerous," and I find another company to do it two days later at a fraction of the cost, I can't help but feel they are trying to take advantage of me.

Updated to add the generic and unlabeled photos of my furnace that Goettls sent me in an email.

reviews.text: I have seen Goettl's trucks around town and just the other day I  was behind one of their vans in my community. The office called me back and I asked that they please the let the driver of number..... know that I appreciated it. reviews.author: Assad RAFFOUL
reviews.text:
3 days  ago I called Roto rooter at 9:00 PM to snake my 4 inch main drain pipe, in the basement. It was a straight 60 feet run in direct line to the street. The tech guy was prompt, he explained the possible problems that could happen and I signed quite a few documents. He told me the cost of snaking the line was $531.00 Dollars. That was an exhorbitant price that I never paid before in my life. But since it was an evening call and I needed to do the work I agreed. He brought down the tool and he snaked the line to the street in less than 15 minutes. I was expecting he will run the snake again but he was too busy trying to sell me further services. He refused to run the snake twice but he threatened me that if I did not agree to a free video inspection there is no warranty for the next 6 month on his work. He said if any thing happened  before 6 month the service is not warranted at all because there could be a problem in the line that only a video can find.
This was a totally new approach to snaking the sewer line. I have done it 25 years ago. The company at the time did it twice to make sure all waste was pushed out. Not Roto rooter. He packed his tool and left. I knew he did not clean the sewer well so I am calling my regular plumber to do another snaking of my line to assure all waste is removed.
Roto rooter is gouging its customers and will not do a decent job of cleaning the pipe i will have my line snaked in the day time for about a hundred dollars. Once Roto rooter steps in your house they want to make a big issue of snaking a sewer line, they want to do much more unneeded work to fatten their bottom line.
I will not recommend this gouging Company who refuses to give a tentative cost of snaking a sewer line on the phone. They keep it as a surprise. also any plumbing company who refuses to run a second run should be always rejected. Once the first run is done, the second is much faster and all decent companies will do it especially when they are charging the rate of a brain surgeon.
This is standard plumbing customs.

reviews.text: My rental property had really bad sewer blockage. One company I hired tried many ways to fix it with no success. Roto-Rooter came in with very professional tools and expert solution. Really appreciate your work. You will be my first choice next time. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Laura Perry
reviews.text: Scheduling service with Roto-Rooter was super easy and I was able to get someone to come assist with a backed-up bathtub within 1 hour on a Sunday morning.  The technician that came was Jason B. and he was honestly a saint, as the tub drain clog turned out to be a much bigger issue than expected involving a completely clogged up galvanized pipe.  After trying to snake the tub drain directly and that not working, he drained the water out of the tub for us and then snaked the pipe UPWARDS from the basement which resulted in a huge mess that looked like a scene out of a horror movie... so thankful that the problem is solved (for now at least -- Jason did advise that we get the galvanized pipes replaced eventually) and overall the price of the service was well worth it.  Although I initially felt it was overpriced for a simple drain cleaning, the amount of work done was absolutely worth every penny and I would absolutely ask for Jason next time I needed Roto-Rooter again in the future.

reviews.author: Amanda Reilly
reviews.text: Our kitchen sink became clogged the night before Thanksgiving. Based on my experience, I would highly recommend their services.

reviews.author: Michael Kleinfelt
reviews.text: Strada installed an A/C in our home 1 year ago. The unit flooded in my house due to the drain line switch not kicking on when the drain line backed up. When I discovered the flood as I walked into my room, I had to quickly rip up the hardwood floors. After some quick mitigation, I vacuumed the line out and cleared the clog. Even after clearing the drain line I noticed that the unit continued to leak internally. So I called Strata to come look at it. The technician adjusted the fan speed, and said the unit wasn’t running efficiently. He was nice and informative, very helpful. The technician also said that the filter grate was not the proper one, and that he would order it to have it installed. He said the filter should be in a slot that’s behind the grate. About a week later, I got a call from one of their reps. The guy, was so rude and said to replace the grate, that they improperly installed would be $315. Mind you I just paid $7k to fix the flood and $144 for their technician to come out. I told the caller that there must be some confusion, since it was literally take 30 seconds to swap out and the cost for that item couldn’t have been more that $50. The rep. said he didn’t care and it would be $315. At that point I asked to speak to some supervision, his response was that it would still be $315, for something I’m sure I will find on Amazon. I will never recommend this company after the experience and treatment I received from this rep. It wasn’t even the message it was all in how it was delivered and treated me. These photos are the result of the flood. The bowl is in the air intake box because it continued to leak. The cut in the AC box was when they built it and we discovered it once we had to cut the drywall out. Bad experience.

reviews.author: Jon Templar
reviews.text: Hired Strada to put in a new unit when my old one went out, they got it done in less than 1 day which was great, but 3 month in the motor died on this brand new unit, causing a ridiculous amount of mastic to melt off and streak down the side of the unit causing an air leak that was detected by the inspector. The motor failure also caused so much condensation around the unit that it grew mold all around the unit. The pictures taken are the end result after they have made their return trip and "corrected" the issues. Can't say I'm happy to have used them.

reviews.text: Work that was completed for the mitigation was done well and professionally. Despite being asked to be called or sent a text on an arrival time I did not receive one and instead just got a knock on the door which made planning around the schedule difficult. One of the days, I had planned for them to arrive in the morning so that they can get whatever they need done to continue my day. They ended up showing up in the afternoon due to an “urgent job” and therefore I needed to change my schedule to accommodate for it. The only communication I got about their late arrival was when I had reached out to the manager about it. When I asked about my clothes getting cleaned, the manager said he would get me in contact with someone who would be able to help with getting the clothes cleaned. It was not explained that the work would be going through Roto-Rooter and not insurance, which had Roto-Rooter charge me 20% of the bill from the people cleaning the clothes all for just getting my contact information to the company that would be cleaning the clothes which led to me getting closer to my insurance limit which led me to spending more money out of pocket. Overall did a good job with cleaning out the sewer line, mitigating the issue and fixing the problem for the sewer line just wish communication was better to understand to avoid the 20% fee for getting me in contact with the company to get my clothes cleaned. Total cost for the water clean up, mitigation, clothes being cleaned, and the 20% fee from Roto-Rooter was around $9.5k. The cost to get the drain and sewer line initially cleaned out was around $500. The cost to replace the sewer line, which required them to tear up the retainer wall, throw the bricks into a pile in my front yard cost me around $21k as well. Below photos is from before and after of the work when I was able to view it and I had already started to move some bricks down to start to rebuild the wall

reviews.author: Ryan Williams
reviews.text: Roto Rooter is great. We have unfortunately had to use them several times now for some larger projects, and each time they have impressed me more than the time before. Each tech we have had has been professional, knowledgeable and personable. At no point did I feel like I was being upsold or even really sold at all, but rather walked through the process of diagnosis of the problems and finding a solution that was best fit for me and my family’s needs. I truly feel like not only did I receive quality service and craftsmanship, but I also learned a lot about the process, and my home as a whole. Thank you Chris and Mark as you both have made me and my family feel more safe in our home. I will use them for any and all of my future needs and will recommend them to anyone I know.

reviews.author: Out Here
reviews.text: Mark did a great job installing a new water heater for our house. No mess left behind. Roto-Rooter called/advised me they were running a little behind schedule the day of install, but all went well. I wouldn't hesitate to call RR again. The peace-of-mind of a guaranteed job & a trustworthy tech is well worth the price. Thank you!

reviews.author: Emily Evans
reviews.text:
Back in July of 2024, I had a sewer blockage from roots in my main sewer line. After Roto Rooter came out and started working on my line, they suggested I replace three sections of my main sewer line.  Through their financing company they are partnered with, I maxed out what I could borrow and paid in cash the rest which would only repair two sections. They said they would do the two worst sections and leave the third. With them not doing the third section, they told me I should not have any issues for a long time. Just that first time of them coming out, I was charged a little over $15,000 and that is not including clean up or asphalt repair.
Now as of December 2025, I am having issues again. I called Roto Rooter again to see what’s going on. They suggested replacing another section. Just for them to replace one more section, is an additional $10,000.
I decided to call another company just to see what they would say. I did not want to keep having a sewer issue every 1-2 years. I had another company come out and recommend to replace the whole outside line. They informed me that it is not recommended to replace a sewer line section by section. They only charged me $8,500 to replace the whole outside line from my house to the road. That includes them replacing my asphalt.
When Roto Rooter came to my house in July of 2024, they made me feel like they needed to fix my sewer line that day. I felt pressured to just do what they said and not get quotes from other companies. Everyone that I spoke to at Roto Rooter was extremely nice. I honestly believed they had our best interest. Now I feel like they are a scam. It is not even the price that upsets me. It is the fact that they try to tell me that replacing section by section is better for me as a customer but really is just ensures that they will need to come back out again.

reviews.author: Mara Lawrence
reviews.text:
Deionne handled my emotional breakdown so well. His communication was thorough and answered EVERY question I had with grace. I really appreciate him being so patient.
I'm NOT thrilled with Rotorooters service on my property. The work previously done was supposed to alleviate the backing up of sewer, yet the sewer is still backing up and now I'm having to go through the process of service all over again. Not sure if insurance will cover it the second time around in less than a years time.

reviews.author: Debra Shahani
reviews.text:
My SIL hired this group, initially to fix a leak.  Then we found that there were other problems.  1st charge was $225, they looked and said they needed a camera. 2nd charge was $250, (they said this would come off the final bill) they brought the camera, said I needed other work. (Cedar trees were present) New cost $8,600, plus an additional $962 for the original leak (I was told that this would be $600).   They started working and then called me for an additional $1,000.  When the final bill came, they added a service charge of $314 (or about  that to my bill).  Because I am 70 years old and on a FIXED income I asked if they offered any Senior discounts.  I was told YES, 10%.  When I called to pay, I asked for my Discount and was told,  they had already given it to me.  They DIDN'T and flat out LIED.  I was expecting a discount of at least $1,000 and didn't get it. BUYER BE WARE!!!
EDIT:  I received a call this morning, the person calling wanted to know about the review.  I told him exactly what I have posted. He didn't offer the promised discount,  he said he would talk to his staff.  A few minutes later he called my SIL and asked him to talk me into "TAKING DOWN MY REVIEW " he didn't offer any other options!
As I said before,  BUYER BE WARE!!

reviews.author: Phillip Howard
reviews.text: The technician, Moe, is the only reason for this 5 star review. His customer service was more than could be expected from 90% of the construction workforce. He made sure he checked everything he needed and even double and triple checked. He was very thorough with his inspection, diagnosis, and treatment. He was quick and professional,  but also personable making the entire process very smooth and simple for me.  Before, I would have never called roto rooter, too big of a company for me, but now I will because of Moe. Hire more Moes and see how it goes.

reviews.author: Kiesha
reviews.text: I had a clog from hell going into a weekend. I went with Roto Rooter because they didn't charge more for weekend calls but I'll keep coming to them for Tony C! If it's not Tony, don't send anyone!  I called at night on Friday and he was here at 11AM Saturday! He was absolutely amazing! Very knowledgeable, thorough and a pleasure to deal with. He took out that clog in no time. He also gave me tips on how to prevent it from happening again. Thanks so much Tony! 5 ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ service.

reviews.author: Liz S
reviews.text: I gave them a 2 instead of 1 because they were super quick getting a technician out to my home, and everybody was friendly...but fast and friendly did me no good, because the plumber (Corey) "unclogged" the wrong part of the line. Instead of telling me there was no clog in the pipe I showed him, and investigating to see where the clog actually WAS, he went through the motions of cabling through the pipes, and fifteen minutes later told me he was done. He charged me $234...He said that if I had any more problems, I needed to have my septic tank pumped out...I didn't have any more problems flushing my toilets, because he put the cap to the port on wrong, and the excrement was still pouring out into my backyard... When my sister and her husband (who know much more about plumbing than me) came over a few days later, they informed me that he had not fixed the problem,and that the only reason the toilets were flushing was because the 💩💩 was still coming out into the yard... I called them back and told them that the problem was not fixed, and that the clog was further down the line. They told me that I needed to have the septic tank pumped out... My sister knew that was not the problem, so we went with Chickamauga Plumbing and Septic Systems. Their plumber instantly removed the real clog instead of an imaginary one, and only charged me $150, compared to their $234, and he didn't try to talk me into an unnecessary septic tank pumping. I called Roto Rooter back to request a refund, since I now had to pay two plumbers to get the job done. They said no, that the only thing they would have done was send the same apathetic technician back out who hadn't bothered to find where the actual problem was, but they also gaslit me and insisted that the reason the plumbing was still backed up was because of a full septic tank... Lesson learned; in the future, I will insist that the plumber comes back out, regardless of whether or not they tell me it won't do any good...By not doing so, it left them a loophole to avoid making me whole...I fully recommend the honest, more affordable plumbers at Chickamauga Plumbing and Septic... They won't take advantage of your lack of knowledge of how plumbing lines run...

reviews.author: R H
reviews.text: 2 BR 2 Bath complete slab (patio) home repipe. Extremely happy with the project results and the professionalism, communication, consideration, respect, and customer service from this company throughout the project and the first class crew that made it happen. Johnny Galivan was project estimator and manager. Nicholas Coley was journeyman licensed plumber lead with Adam and Gabe rounding out the Greer SC based crew. Jeane Robinson from Charleston offices handled the scheduling and financing. All were great and so was the work. 37 year old copper and PB piping (standard 1975 to 1995) was replaced with PEX piping complete from the meter and throughout the home including proper PRV station, shutoff valves, and access panels. I was concerned with amount of drywall patching that could be required with a job like this and the team was fantastic at keeping that to a minimum. Cold weather concerns were addressed with insulation and replacement pipe routing. Preferred Home Services labor and materials warranty also helps ease that concern. Johnny gave me fair and competitive pricing for the work and good advice as I made my decision between Preferred and a less expensive local (smaller) plumber I considered. If considering a similar large project BE SURE personnel and the job lead is licensed! Many smaller plumbing companies can perform the work under the owners license but be aware that potential future insurance coverage (such as a pipe burst) may not be covered if repipe work was not DIRECTLY performed by a licensed plumber, (depending on your insurance).  Also drywall work would have been much more extensive and costly with the small plumber option.  If you are contemplating a planned or emergency whole home repipe due to old piping age or failures, I highly reccomend you consider this company and crew!

Jim Anderson —-> GO NAVY!

reviews.author: Faith Bostic
reviews.text: We had PHS install a backflow protector and dig a new drain field in our yard in December after our sewage backed up in our house from a blocked pipe somewhere in the line.  The initial consult was fine and the techs showed up but the job was extremely rushed because the said they had to be at their next job.  They completely destroyed our entire yard.  They said they "were plumbers, not landscapers" which I get, BUT, we couldn't even open our fence because the dirt was a foot higher than it should be and our entire yard looks like a plowed field.  We can't even walk through it without twisting an ankle.  After asking them to do better, they agreed that it was a mess and they sent someone else back to try to do a better job at leveling the yard.  Their "rushed fix" didn't actually "fix" anything.  We now have a huge standing water issue and our yard is a lake that doesn't drain-all the way up to the walls of my house. We have NEVER had standing water issues and we've now gotten two quotes from other companies to try to repair the damage from PHS and it's going to cost us another 15k on top of the 10k that PHS charged us for the drain-field.  We don't have that kind of money to fix something that should not have been broken to begin with.  We're extremely frustrated with the whole experience and don't have a way to fix the issue without spending a fortune to install a massive French drain system, bring in top soil, level, and re-sod.  What a disaster!  We don't know what to do now.

reviews.author: Scott Simpson
reviews.text:
I know enough about plumbing systems to know what questions to ask about some problems I was having. Two of the three issues I identified had to do with the 3” waste pipe under the house slab. I had already used an auger to clear a serious root intrusion and as my waste main is 60 years old, I was prepared for the worst. I would have given Midway the go-ahead for some seriously expensive work if their plumber told me it was necessary.
The Midway plumber scoped the 3” main from the city connecting point to the house vent pipe and explained everything we were seeing in a way I could clearly understand. He checked the work I had already done, carefully talked me out of doing either expensive project I had enquired about, and gave me some tips for improving the remaining flushing problem that was being caused by the 1.28GPM toilet.
The third project had to do with the incoming water supply. What I thought would improve the incoming water pressure and get a jump on a potential problem was diagnosed as a case of “If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it… and it ain’t broke.” I was wrong; he was right. He could have just done the work I requested and I wouldn’t have given it a second thought. Instead, he again clearly explained the issue and convinced me not to have the requested work done.
Summary: The Midway plumber was professional, courteous, knowledgeable, and honest. I now understand how they maintain such a high customer review rating.

reviews.author: Hal Roseman
reviews.text:
After five days without electricity and temperatures hovering around 15 degrees, we finally got our power restored — and it’s entirely thanks to Hoffmann Brothers, especially their electrician, Justin.

Our electric mast had literally been pulled away from the house after tree limbs dragged down the service line. Two other well-known Nashville electrical companies came out, but wouldn’t touch anything until NES disconnected the hot line — which meant more waiting… in freezing weather.

Justin, however, didn’t stop without finding a solution. He secured emergency authorization, safely disconnected the line, rebuilt the mast and meter connection, and coordinated everything so NES could immediately reconnect our service. Within 24 hours, we finally had power back.

And the workmanship? Outstanding. He didn’t just patch things up — he rebuilt it correctly:
• replaced the entire mast system
• fixed the previous builder’s makeshift nail mounting with bolting screws
• secured and supported the conduit properly
• caulked the board holding the conduit
• cleaned the entire area
• hauled away debris and old materials

Highly recommended.

reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with Luis from Michael & Sons, and I can’t say enough good things about the service he provided. We recently purchased this home and, with two HVAC units, wanted a thorough evaluation to make sure everything was running efficiently and properly.
From the moment Luis arrived, he was professional, courteous, and extremely knowledgeable. He took his time inspecting the units and explained everything clearly and in detail. We had several questions, and he answered every one patiently, making sure we fully understood how our systems work and what to expect moving forward.

Luis was very transparent about the condition of both units, explaining what was functioning well, what to keep an eye on, and what, if anything, might need attention in the future. He never tried to upsell unnecessary services and instead focused on providing straightforward, trustworthy information. His explanations were thorough and easy to understand, which we truly appreciated.
Luis also went into detail about efficiency, maintenance, and best practices to keep both units running smoothly. Because of how confident we felt in his knowledge and integrity, we decided to sign up for Michael & Sons’ service maintenance plan. That decision was entirely based on the trust he built during this visit, not pressure or sales tactics.
Overall, Luis was thorough, professional, and genuinely cared about making sure our systems were operating at their best. We highly recommend Luis and Michael & Sons to anyone looking for honest, knowledgeable, and dependable HVAC service. This was a great experience from start to finish, and we will absolutely be using them again!

reviews.author: Chris Kensil
reviews.text: Call Michael & Son regarding a a problem with our 10-year-old primary sump pump. Daniel did some troubleshooting and found the failure the result of pump age. Pump was 10 years old and had reached its life cycle. Decided to upgrade to a Zoeller Propak system. Daniel discovered the old system was using the wrong size discharge pipe. He removed the old primary and backup pumps, installed the correct size pipe, and installed the new propak system in about an hour. He then did a functional test, went over the operation of the pumps with me and answered any questions I had. The area was nice and clean when he left. Daniel is an experienced plumber who represents this company well. This is the second time I’ve used Michael & Sons and on both occasions I was pleased with the service.

Your company was professional from the emails I received, to the text with the technician's photo and stating that he was on his way.

reviews.text: Adam Freeman originally came to do the service check. My unit was originally installed by a now out of business service. There were several issues (of which I was aware) the previous techs had...plundered. He was knowledgeable and explained what and why the various things were being done. One example of the repairs he made? The techs that installed this new unit (now 2 years old) had ran the condensation drainage through the filter housing. Essentially compromising the efficiency of the filter leaving a 4 inch gap that was sealed with foil tape. The actual filter should have been a 20 inch filter not a 16 that was "urban engineered" to fit. In short I appreciated his honesty and professionalism in doing the job quickly, efficiently and at a fair price. I could have paid more and not have had the issue appropriately addressed. I feel confident that my unit will be in service for many years to come. Thanks to Adam's exceptional service.

When he arrived, the furnace was running, and he stated he had not done anything to it.  During the visit, he did not check any voltage, components, or make any attempts to reproduce the short-cycling or the inducer motor not turning on.

After, he did take the time to have a conversation about how the installation of our unit by the builder was trash, that the only fix for my 7-year-old system was to rip it completely out, and replace a working AC and serviceable furnace with a $30,000 Trane Unit and install.

reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Legacy Plumbing. They were able to come out the same day, on very short notice, and the pricing was very fair with an awesome warranty, which gave me a lot of confidence.

Ramone, the technician, was outstanding. He took the time to explain everything clearly while working and made sure I understood what was being done and why. On top of that, he went above and beyond by fixing an electrical breaker issue, which technically wasn’t even his job.

That kind of honesty, knowledge, and extra effort is rare. I’m extremely happy with their service and would 100% recommend Legacy Plumbing to anyone looking for reliable, professional, and trustworthy work.

reviews.author: Ryan V.
reviews.text: Exceptional service by Legacy.  My outdoor faucet had a leak from the winter freeze.  The pipe was broken near the faucet.  Sean and his partner from Legacy came out and told me upfront about the pricing and potential issue.  I agreed and they replaced the faucet within 30 minutes.  Price was reasonable. It was quick and professional.  Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Plumbing Express
plumbers.address: 3050 Presidential Dr #202, Atlanta, GA 30340, USA

reviews.author: Carrie
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with Plumbing Express. They repiped my entire home and also handled all of the drywall repair and repainting afterward. When they were finished, it honestly looked like they had never been there—everything was spotless and perfectly restored.

Ed Torres, the estimator, was wonderful to work with: extremely knowledgeable, professional, and thorough in explaining the process.

Ivan Del Campo was my office contact, and he was fantastic at keeping me informed every step of the way, which I really appreciated.

The team of four plumbers who removed the old piping and completed the actual repipe did an outstanding job. They were professional, hardworking, and efficient, and it was clear they took pride in their work. They answered questions when needed and were respectful of my home throughout the entire process.

Kenny and Waldy, did a great job on the painting and drywall. They took a house that looked like swiss cheese and now you'd never know!

From start to finish, the entire team was professional, communicative, and detail-oriented. I highly recommend Plumbing Express to anyone needing major plumbing work done right. It's not fun money to spend, but if you're in need-these are the guys to call.

reviews.author: Debbie North Realtor
reviews.text: Dylan did a great job fixing our Rinnai hybrid water heater. He didn’t try to do the typical “oh it’s over 5 years old you need a new one” that so many companies do. We really appreciated that! He did need to order parts, but they came in quickly and he was very efficient.

reviews.author: Diondra Peck
reviews.text:
I would recommend Plumbing Express to anyone for repiping services.

I got initial quotes from 4 different plumbers for replacing PB pipe, and Ed was by far the most knowledgable, informative, and personable that I interacted with. Price was also hard to beat, especially considering the drywall repair was included.

The crews that came out to work were on-time and worked quickly. The drywall repair was seamless; as many others have said, it is impossible to know there were ever any holes in the walls. Throughout the entire process, Ivan stayed in contact and communicated proactively and clearly. Any issues or concerns we had were addressed promptly.

The only complaint we had was that some of the workers didn’t clean up thoroughly after themselves and left behind debris/trash. One piece left was a metal piece from a pipe that could’ve damaged our lawnmower if it hadn’t been found. In general though, the work spaces were left clean.

Overall, we’re very happy with the quality of work done and customer service experience. These guys know what they’re doing.

reviews.author: Chris Pacitti
reviews.text:
TOTAL HOME RE-PLUMB.  Our neighborhood has had so many homes experiencing water leaks (hundreds) that many of us have chosen to re-plumb before it happens.  Based on my own experience speaking with four different plumbing companies, and speaking with several of our neighbors, I decided on Plumbing Express.  They are knowledgeable, professional and very responsive to any questions along the way.  Their price was fair and it’s one price for the whole job.  You won’t have to find someone to repair and paint drywall.  They have their own people or contractors to do that so your house looks perfect when they finish.  I would highly recommend Plumbing Express to anyone needing to have their house re-plumbed.
EDIT: Ed was the initial person I spoke to. His experience, knowledge and easygoing (non-salesman like) demeanor was greatly appreciated.
Ivan was my point of contact for any questions and he was friendly and as I said, very responsive.  He also installed a Moen smart valve in our home.
Dylan plumbed the exterior of our home to the street while another crew did the interior re-plumbing.  I’m very pleased with all of them.

reviews.author: Katie Moss
reviews.text: Many thanks to Dylan for all of the work he put in yesterday to replace my hot water heater. It was an absolute pleasure to meet such a kind man who completed such a laborious task in such a short timeline, both skillfully and efficiently. Great communication all around, from the office updates on arrival timelines to expected finish time. Will absolutely recommend you in the future. Thanks again for your hard work! Happy New Year!

plumbers.name: Spot On Plumbing of Tulsa Plumbers
plumbers.address: 1911 W Reno St, Broken Arrow, OK 74012, USA

reviews.author: Nikki Cook
reviews.text: We called Spot On Plumbing because they have a 4.9 out of five reviews.  We are so glad and thankful to have chosen them!! If we could give a higher review we would.  From start to finish was a great experience.  Preston and Tato came out the same day that we called.  Both were very professional, respectful and kept us updated throughout the process. They both provided excellent customer service!!!!!  They made us feel completely comfortable with their transparency and respectful demeanor! The lady that answered the phone was great and very helpful and friendly, and their customer portal is great!!!  Great job!!! We will be highly recommending this company!!!  Thank you all so much!!!

reviews.author: wendy robertson
reviews.text:
Spot On Plumbing Company is truly excellent! We had a wonderful, top-quality experience with Hayden and Easton, who did an outstanding job installing our new tankless water heater and repiping our entire home with high-quality PEX. From start to finish, their professionalism, skill, and attention to detail were impressive.

If you’re looking for reliable plumbers in Tulsa and the surrounding towns and cities residents can trust, Spot On Plumbing absolutely delivers. Their 100% happiness guarantee really shows how confident they are in their work; if anything isn’t right, they’ll come back and make it right at no extra cost. Their goal is clearly to exceed expectations, and they succeeded with our plumbing needs. Spot On Plumbing is Veteran owned and operated, too.

Service was prompt, friendly, and genuinely thoughtful. We couldn’t be happier with the work and the service. Spot On Plumbing went above and beyond, and we highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Alisa Norris
reviews.text:
Mitchell, Easton, Aiden and Brandon were at my house today looking for a leak on the slab. It was found and all debris was cleaned up nicely.  Thanks for responding to my call so quickly.  I will retain Spot On because you now know the history of my house.  Thanks again.

Another day. New water pressure valve.  Feel safe to get it replaced and upgraded.  Thanks Mitchell.

reviews.author: Greg Hulett
reviews.text: Preston and Tato were very helpful and informative. They walked me through every estimate and every step of the process. They presented me with my current and future options when assessing the issue. Both of them were incredibly thoughtful, friendly and communicative throughout the process. Spot On worked with me to get my issue resolved the same day and for a price I was happy with.

reviews.author: Natasha Johnson
reviews.text: We are thoroughly impressed with the customer service and the attentiveness given to us. Our drains needed cleaning and we had questions about our initial appointment and we had plumbers at our house almost immediately to address our concerns. Preston and Brandon were both kind, thorough, and professional in tackling our kitchen drain which was our main concern. We appreciated that they had our backs as far as homeowners and explained thoroughly what was going on with the plumbing in our home. I would highly recommend this place and it’s really the best you could want when you are having plumbing issues and wanting assurance on how your drains are functioning / what can be done to improve them. Thank you so much Spot on Plumbing for treating us like people more than just another customer.

plumbers.name: Southport Home Services
plumbers.address: 1343 S 27th St, Caledonia, WI 53108, USA

reviews.author: Cheryl MoczynskI
reviews.text: From service to sales to installation, Southport, exceeded all of our expectations. Phil, our technician, was fantastic. Max, our salesman, was extremely knowledgeable,  and fair. I never felt pressured.  Our installers, Tyler and Jack, did a fantastic job.  They did high quality work, and were very courteous,  and professional, and answered all our questions. Their work was very clean,  organized, and detailed oriented. I will definitely be using Southport for my future home service needs. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Terri Miller
reviews.text:
First time using Southport. Very good experience. Sent someone out for quote, they were nice, knowledgeable and answered all our questions and gave us aa couple quotes with in a few minutes.
The the technician they sent out was Justan arrived on time with all notification,. He is very nice and professional. He completed job within quoted time. Justan is a wonderful asset to your team. I recommend using  Southport to anyone, very good experience.

reviews.author: Jimmy Ray Purser
reviews.text: I have been using Southport for over twenty years to keep my HVAC running smoothly. This time it was to replace my HVAC and water heater. From the pre-sales to sales to install everything went very smoothly. The installers took great care to ensure my house wasn't left messy, they provided training and inspected the entire system by putting it through its paces. I am highly impressed and greatly satisfied. I would recommend Southport with the highest enthusiasm I can muster! Great, highly skilled and friendly folks.

reviews.author: Kris Derwae
reviews.text: Phil came out on an after hours emergency furnace repair. He was there very quickly. My house was down to 37! I have a Nest thermostat and was alerted by the app. I was out of town at the time. He did quick work and got it running within 1/2 hour. Super nice guy and stayed for a bit to assure the furnace was working correctly. Southport was the only company that returned my call within minutes. I recommend Southport and Phil for quick repairs. 5 stars for service but I’m not sure if it was overpriced? They got the job done so my pipes didn’t freeze and that’s the important part.

reviews.author: Victor B
reviews.text: Called these guys based on good reviews and i regret it now. Called them after our 2 year old Rheem model XG50T06PV42U0 stopped working, no hot water. Technician came to diagnose, told me that gas valve and pilot assembly needed replacing in order for it to be back up and running. Technician replaced parts and same issue continued, he had to call another guy to come and help him and keep diagnosing. He ended up recommending a new water heater which i’m now in the process of getting warrantied. The issue is this guy didn't diagnose properly just threw parts at it. Now i’m out of $1,714 dollars and no hot water. I was basically robbed. Ad insult to injury he gave me the quote for replacing the water heater for $1,829 dollars. Now i would be in the hole for $3,543! Triple the price of what a new one would be. If i had gotten it diagnosed properly the first time i would have saved almost $2,000 including parts. Over priced for guys that didn’t fix anything. Hope this helps the next guy when they consider calling them for service.

plumbers.name: Bob Larson Plumbing
plumbers.address: 4320 128th St E, Tacoma, WA 98446, USA

reviews.author: Patrick Anderson
reviews.text: Huge thanks to Nathan and Jimmy for installing our new tankless water system. They took the time to explain what they were doing at every step of the installation and made sure we understood aftercare and maintenance before they left. Professional, patient, and thorough—excellent work and great customer service.

reviews.author: Mike Stutz
reviews.text: Nathan was our plumber and he did a great job. He was on time, polite, answered all of my questions, did a skillful job on the damaged pipes and didn't push expensive options on me that weren't necessary. I was very pleased with Bob Larson Plumbing. They were quick to schedule, gave us a fair and detailed estimate and then did what they promised. Excellent work all around.

reviews.author: Denise Lovejoy
reviews.text: I had another great experience with Bob Larson Plumbing.  Benjamin came out and showed me what was going on with my pipes under my house with thorough video.  He gave me several options and I decided on a partial repiping.  He and Gearge came out the next week and got the whole project done in one day.  I am very happy with the service and the results.  Thank you to all at Bob Larson Plumbing for the great service.

reviews.author: Debbie McVicker
reviews.text: I really appreciated that the main office sent a bio of the technician coming to my home before the appointment. It made me feel much more comfortable welcoming someone I didn’t know into the house. David explained the work clearly, was thorough, professional, and paid close attention to detail. The other technician, George was also excellent. Overall, the experience was outstanding, and I highly recommend Bob Larson Plumbing.

reviews.author: Judy Manning
reviews.text: After having plumbing catastrophe after plumbing catastrophe, I have had Bob Larson Plumbing out on probably 7 occasions in the last 3 weeks. I feel like these guys are family now! They are all top notch, caring, amazing people. They may not be the least expensive company around, but they are worth every penny and more! Nathan has been to my house the last 3 or 4 times, and he is phenomenal. He knows his stuff, works hard, and truly seems to care about going the extra mile to make sure everything is perfect when he leaves. The office staff is amazing, and my account manager, Amber, is the best. She makes sure she is there for whatever I need. Great company all the way around!

plumbers.name: DB's Plumbing and Drain®
plumbers.address: 2609 Morse Ln, Woodbridge, VA 22192, USA

reviews.author: Lisseth Palacios
reviews.text: This company took my call and assigned someone to my home promptly. I was stressed and they were friendly over the phone.  The plumber that came to my home, Michael, was amazing.  He was kind and courteous. He explained everything thoroughly and was patient with my questions.  He was very professional and his work is neat and thorough. I highly recommend Michael from DB’s Plumbing & Drain!

reviews.author: Jennifer Hargis
reviews.text: Marv J installed a pressure regulator valve which we did not have and main water shut off valve.  It was a very small, tight space and he was able to do the work without cutting into the drywall.  He also replaced an old hose bib shut off for the outside water spigot and repaired a section of bent piping in the ceiling.  He did the work at a fair price and was very diligent and friendly.  He also cleaned up the area after he completed the job.  I would not hesitate to have him work on any other plumbing issues that we may have in the future.

reviews.author: Sherry P
reviews.text: We can’t speak highly enough of DB’s and particularly Aaron F. When we had a plumbing emergency late in the day, DB’s was the only company able to get someone out that evening.  Aaron F. Came out early in the promised window, diagnosed our problem, and got us all set up. He was courteous, incredibly knowledgeable, and did a great job of communicating with us what our issue was and how to address it in the future. The next time we call a plumber, DB’s will be the first call…and we’ll ask for Aaron F.

reviews.author: Adam Kerr
reviews.text: I did not have a good experience with this company. They don’t charge for a service call but then charge a very high price to do the work, in my opinion. The technician was friendly and seemed knowledgeable. However, the price to do the work was very high to me. He was in the house for not more than an hour and fixed the pipe to my shower diverter that I improperly installed. Part of that hour included a delay b/c he needed to charge the battery for his tool, which is understandable due to the cold weather. I’m all about paying for quality work but the price seemed very high. They gave me a military discount which was nice of them but the price was still $350 for 1 hour of work (which required very few parts). I should have politely thanked them for their time and gotten a second quote from a different company. But, I was pressed for time and just had them do the work. I went with this company b/c they had an extremely high rating. I am providing this review so other customers are aware of potential challenges that they may face when requesting similar services.

reviews.author: Jessica Gutierrez
reviews.text: I experienced the worst of the worst  plumbing disaster you can imagine. I had sewage back up on multiple floors and it was a hazmat. Aaron from DB Cooper showed up and we worked as a team to rid the biohazard immediately and had the plumbing working again temporarily until they could get a crew out the very next day. Aaron wrote up the invoice and report which was extremely easy for my insurance to read and dispense insurance funds to pay for most services. Not only did Aaron resolve and repair the issue he recommended me to a phenomenal clean up crew (Semper Dry) who came immediately and resolved the aftermath. I couldn’t recommend DB Cooper more, and I have dealt with other local plumbers who were not anywhere as near as proficient as Aaron.

plumbers.name: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing of Cincinnati
plumbers.address: 756 Old State Rte 74, Cincinnati, OH 45245, USA

reviews.author: Pat Garifalos
reviews.text: Cole did an excellent job troubleshooting our garbage disposal problem and installing a new one.  He checked everything carefully and explained what he did and why.   We would definitely like to have him come for any future repairs or installs.

reviews.author: Michelle Fletcher
reviews.text: Casey and Jack came out two days in a row for a frozen ditch line pipe and sump pump issue. They worked diligently and quickly. They were respectful, explaining every step; oftentimes, repeating what they were doing so my elderly mother understood. In addition to their customer service and work ethic, they have been to our home on previous service calls and have a relationship with my mother which keeps down her anxiety. Those two fellas should be commended on superb service!

reviews.author: Brandon Roberts
reviews.text: Bill is fantastic. I will not work with another plumber unless it is Bill. I was quoted 2 guys 1200 for 6 hours. They got the job done in less than 4. Installed the new heat tape and insulation on the pipes. He even sat down with me at my original appointment to show me what I needed, where to buy it, what a good price was etc. He is amazing

reviews.author: david fewell
reviews.text: Joseph was awesome. He did a fabulous job in getting the sink working again. He worked quickly and was very friendly. I highly recommend Benjamin Franklin for any of your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: James Duncanson
reviews.text: Our tech Ethan Tolliver was exceptional from start to finish. He didn’t just treat us like a customer he treated us like family. He was very knowledgeable and thorough in explaining the repairs needed. He made the whole process enjoyable. We look forward to working with Ethan and his company in the future if anything is needed. William Owens came out and replaced the power vent on our water heater. He knew his job of the repair very well. He was genuinely concerned about our lack of hot water and replaced the part in less than 30 minutes. We are very pleased by the overall service we have received so far. We had a new tankless water heater installed after the repair and the whole process was great from start to finish. Chris and Jordan were the two install techs on the tankless eater heater. They also extended our natural gas line so we could put a gas stove in. This is honestly the best experience we’ve ever had from a company. I would highly recommend them for your next service.

plumbers.name: Baker Brothers Plumbing, Air & Electric
plumbers.address: 7315 Commercial Blvd E, Arlington, TX 76001, USA

reviews.author: Candi CooCoo
reviews.text: M. Bell's review for Jesse with Baker Brothers.  I called Baker Brothers to get a 2nd opinion and price for a supposed broken sewer line under my house caused by tree roots. The cost estimate from the first plumber that I called out had quoted a price for repair to be upwards of $10,000.  After careful and extensive examination of my ENTIRE sewer system by Jesse with Baker Bros, it was determined there was no need for ANY repairs AT ALL to be made. Jesse was very thorough and had ME watch the screen as the camera went the entire length of my sewer line. With his equipment, Jesse was able to show me exactly from INSIDE of my house where his camera was UNDER my house at any given moment. I was very impressed with his knowledge of the situation and my mind was finally put to rest. I highly recommend Jesse with Baker Brothers.  He not only saved me $10,000 I was quoted by the first plumber, but saved the construction mess and cleanup I would have had to endure. I will recommend this company to my friends and family for certain. Thank you Jesse and Baker Brothers! I appreciate you so much!

reviews.author: L M
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Bryant from Baker Bros. He replaced my kitchen faucet and three bad valves under the sink quickly and professionally. The work was neat, efficient, and done right the first time. He showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and left the area spotless. It’s such a relief to have everything working perfectly again! I highly recommend Baker Bros and Bryant for anyone needing reliable, high-quality plumbing work.

reviews.author: Sandra Williams
reviews.text: The technician relaced my ceiling fan which was not working very well. He inspected the area to assure that there were no problems.  He installed the new ceiling fan perfectly. He was very professional,  knowledgeable, and respectful. He explained the steps he made to me. His work was flawless. I was very pleased with the outcome of the service.

reviews.author: Kenny Horning
reviews.text: Definitely was not a great experience, but Baker Brothers plumbing department hooked me up and handle the problems at hand. The team was real, honest and straightforward with me, which I greatly appreciated. Now if they would only have a bundle package to offer across all there platforms or even customer rewards.

reviews.author: Mercie Gonzalez
reviews.text: I just want to say thank you to our technician, Jonathan and to the team at Baker Brothers. He came in last night and helped us get our AC going. From the initial call and to the upcoming work we’re having to set up on our unit, everyone has been super helpful and transparent. We’re so grateful to have found your team to work with and we’ll definitely be continuing service for as long as possible.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 1691 Town Center St Ste 104, Aurora, IL 60504, USA

reviews.author: nancy anderson
reviews.text:
Our old (and only) toilet had not been working right for a couple months (partial flushes, tank running, etc). It finally got completely stopped up and started overflowing and we couldn't plunge it out! Roto- Rooter to the rescue!

Our Technician, Marc, was great! He arrived within 3-4 hours of my call, diagnosed the problem quickly, and gave me possible solutions and estimates for the work before starting.

Marc augered toilet and replaced some old parts in a timely fashion. He got our old potty working better than it had before. Plus, he left the bathroom clean and tidy too -- Hooray!

It was expensive but worth it for the quick, friendly service.

reviews.author: Chuck Damore
reviews.text: We had a catastrophic failure of the cast iron sewer pipe exiting the house on a late Friday night.  None of the toilets or sinks would drain.  The salesperson from Roto Rooter came quickly after I phoned them on Saturday to assess the problem and give me a repair price.  The issue was a broken cast iron sewer line exiting the house at the foundation.  It sheared in two pieces and became clogged.  Monday morning, Roto Rooter arrived on site.  They needed to dig an 8 foot deep X 4 foot wide X 8 foot long hole under the porch to access the failed cast iron pipe.  They had to cut out concrete stoop as well.  They removed the failed pipe and replaced it with a new PVC pipe.  They pulled all permits and arranged for a city inspection.  We were able to use our water Monday afternoon.  Tuesday morning, they filled in the hole and cleaned up.  The cleanup was fantastic.  If you didn't know what happened the day before, you would have never known they were there.  It was a big job that required a large backhoe and many service techs to make the repair.  The supervisor Brandon M. did a fantastic job along with the sales associate Kyle and the rest of the crew.  The finished site was professionally cleaned.  My neighbors commented on how well the guys cleaned up.

reviews.author: Day
reviews.text:
We had a great experience with Roto-Rooter thanks to Leonard and Levi. Leonard was the plumber who completed the work, and he was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and thorough. He took the time to make sure everything was done right and left the area clean afterward.

Levi, the supervisor, was also fantastic — he clearly explained what was going on, walked us through the issue, and helped us understand the best options to resolve it. Having someone explain things in a straightforward way really made the whole situation less stressful.

Overall, excellent service, great communication, and a team that truly cares about helping their customers. I would definitely recommend them and wouldn’t hesitate to call again if needed.

reviews.author: Diana Caputo
reviews.text: I had water and sewage backup comimg from my shower. Mitchell was great. He came to my house twice. Both times in a timely manner, super friendly and respectful. He explained the whole process. He spent a lot of time getting to the root of the problem and didn't leave until he made sure everything was good. He was able to get my house running again until repairs can be done. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Brent VanLanduyt
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Roto-Rooter. Nertil came out to fix the water supply stop valves under the sink, and from start to finish the service was top-notch. The work was done efficiently, professionally, and he answered all my questions before leaving.  I would highly recommend.

plumbers.name: JD Precision Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 15487 Pin Oak Dr, Conroe, TX 77384, USA

reviews.author: L G
reviews.text: I couldn't be more impressed with the entire process. My heater died on me, I made an appointment online the next morning and then called to confirm. When I did the nice lady asked me if I wanted an earlier appointment. I did. Brice showed up on time, looked at my problem, and offered me several options. He was kind, professional and friendly. He and his assistant installed a new tankless system in about 6 hours. I was quite impressed with the detail and seamless organizing of the electrician, roofer and themselves getting and installing all the parts. I haven't gotten to really try out this new tankless system but... am very happy I called JD Precision.

reviews.author: Dan McManners
reviews.text:
Update...
I just had Ryan come out and give me a quote on replacing our shower valve. I could not have asked for a better explanation on what to do, as well the work that will be preformed. He gave me options, which I was impressed with and never would of considered without him recommending them to me. I Would highly recommend using this company for any of you residential or commercial plumbing needs.

Update Continued...
I had them do the job. Wow!!!!!
The work they did was phenomenal. He and his helper jumped on it right at the time we agreed that he would show up. Both were very courteous and polite. They actually finished the work ahead of the time he said he would. We could not be anymore pleased with work they did for us. Thank you again Ryan for your hard work and job you did. Also again would highly recommend using JD Precision for any and all your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Jennifer Arriaga
reviews.text: Austin was great and did an amazing job on our plumbing. He is very knowledgeable and straightforward. I had two leaks to my upstairs toilets and also he corrected the drain runoff from our HVAC system in the attic. I’m glad he caught that.

reviews.author: Martha Noble-Lutz
reviews.text: Andrew M. installed this beautiful bidet and I am very pleased.  He was knowledgeable, personable, professional, and kept me informed every step of the job.  With this installation and other work JD Pluming has done for me, I know they only employ top professionals.  Great job!

reviews.author: Mike Lytle
reviews.text: Steven of JD Precision came at 9pm, listened to my description of what happened (an overflow of the A/C drain pan) and suggested a modification that would allow me to clear the obstruction myself the next time this happens. I readily agreed and after he installed it he showed me how to use his modification. He also gave me a good price on all the work he did. This included using my shop vacuum to totally dry up all traces of water, putting everything away, and lugging my shop vacuum down from the attic.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 105 E St Ste 100A, Hampton, VA 23661, USA

reviews.author: Steve Thompson
reviews.text:
Called Roto-Rooter because of their strong reputation to fix a drip at my mom’s older home. The technician was polite and purchased parts during the visit that were charged to us.

After the repair, the hot water handle spun completely around with no stop and the stem was crooked. A second technician later told us the threads had been stripped, and we even had to involve the city when the main shutoff valve at the road was found loosened and flooded.

While everyone was polite, the repair created additional issues and required outside help to resolve. Very disappointed in the overall quality of the work.

reviews.author: Oscar Vogtsberger
reviews.text: The technician Wayne was very professional from his up front estimation explaining what needed to be done to get the water heater up to code, to the Quality of his workmanship. Stayed  to make sure everything works properly including that the furnace turned back on after having the gas off. I am very pleased with the service I received today, Thanks Wayne.

reviews.author: Joselyn Impastato
reviews.text: After calling so many plumbers—most trying to overprice or upsell for this minor repair project —I truly appreciated Shikean from Roto-Rooter. He didn’t try to push unnecessary services and was genuinely focused on helping with exactly what I needed. He was professional, kind, and knowledgeable, taking the time to test my water and carefully work with my older pipes to ensure a safe, proper installation. What impressed me most is that the repair I was originally told I needed wasn’t even necessary—he was able to install my washer perfectly without it. There’s a very small detail that I will be able to handle myself when ready, but it didn’t take away from the excellent service he provided. I highly recommend Shikean and Roto-Rooter to anyone looking for top-notch plumbing work!

reviews.author: Jonathan Gomez
reviews.text:
We had an issue with our water heater and called around 5 different plumbers . Our water heater is one of a kind and all the plumbers we contacted either denied the job or recommended to replace the entire unit . Later on we found out they were speaking out of inexperience/ignorance in working with our kind of unit.
Kriston from Roto Rooter came out and in 1 hr fixed our problem. He was extremely professional, efficient and knowledgeable. He saved us from having to replace the entire unit . We definitely saved his number for the future and will recommend him with any one having water heater problems

reviews.author: Pastor Fred
reviews.text: Amazing service!  Our church’s main sewer line was backed up, they were there until 12:30am Saturday night and back at it Sunday morning, Mike and Zac were the best!  Dispatch was friendly, everyone we talked to was helpful and kind.  Great company, fantastic staff.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 1001 Dawson Dr, Newark, DE 19713, USA

reviews.author: Richard Gallagher
reviews.text:
Root-Rooter

We had our sewer overflow into our finished basement. We called Roto-Rooter and a representative was at our house quickly. reviews.author: Melanie Stewart
reviews.text:
Our experience with Andrew Mares from Elkhorn Electric was five stars from start to finish!

We had a light post made of wood that was rotting out of the ground, and our options were to either ditch it or upgrade. Because we used it for holidays and loved tying a balloon to it for the kid's birthdays, we decided to redo it with a brick post.

Now something they don't tell you about building a brick light post is that it's insanely expensive and stressful, but Andrew made sure that the electricity part went as smooth as possible. To start, I unknowingly bought a post light which didn't include the mount needed for the stone cap of the post that I bought. I also got a tapered cap (slants diagonal up instead of flat) because I liked the look of it, but the masons did not let me know that it might be difficult to mount a light to a tapered cap and it was something that never crossed my mind. Andrew explained all of this to us and let us know that he would have to reschedule us so that he could get the appropriate parts to make our light work on our post.

Naturally I fretted about this all week. Was it going to have a pole sticking up? Was it going to be able to mount flush? Why hadn't the masons warned me about a tapered post? My husband assured me that Andrew did not seem concerned, so I shouldn't be, either. Sure enough when he arrived he was able to get the light put in no problem, looking amazing, and he added an electrical panel to the back for us, which we had originally requested, so that we have an additional power source for all of our Halloween/Christmas decorations we like to do (if you can't tell from the photos, ha). If that looks slightly off center in the photos it is because the masons cut it that way, versus anything Andrew did.

We also incurred NO additional cost for him to have to get a different mount for us, come back a second time, and the additional work it took for him to mount the post light versus mount light. He said "What we quote is what you pay", which is the opposite experience I had with the brick part of the post (as the final bill ran $1k over the quoted price). I also called my cousin, who is an electrician, with our original quote from Andrew to make sure it was fair and he said "I would have charged you more".

All of that to say that Andrew was so easy to work with and did such an exceptional job, it was the easiest and most pleasant part of the post being built. And the work is amazing and looks fantastic. My husband is already talking about having him come out to install outlets throughout the yard to make decorating easier, as well as discussing putting some lights in on our porch overhang. We would ABSOLUTELY recommend Elkhorn and look forward to working with them again!
