Shopping with Andres Company was incredibly easy and stress-free. They installed my boiler in just two days, and the entire experience was excellent from beginning to end. This is hands down the best company in the Bethlehem area—I wouldn’t trust my business with anyone else.

Doug was an amazing salesman: fair, honest, and straight to the point, which I truly appreciated. Everything was explained clearly, with no pressure or surprises.

If I ever need service again, Andres Company will be my first call, and I confidently recommend them to anyone in the area looking for reliable, high-quality work.

reviews.author: Owen Krisa
reviews.text: I had an exceptionally great experience with Andreas plumbing heating and air. Specifically speaking Alex Mehmeti worked relentlessly throughout the day to ensure that my baseboard heater was fixed (due to it bursting from the cold) and that my boiler was running perfectly before leaving. I would strongly recommend that anyone with plumbing heating or air problems uses this comapny, this is the second time that I had a technician from the company come to the house and both times they did absolutely amazing jobs doing everything in there power to make my home livable again so I would like to say Thank You!!! and you will absolutely have my buisness in the future with any issues I find on my home!

reviews.author: Lanesa Elon
reviews.text: Good afternoon the technician Mathew Muthard did some work on my house he was very very informative he had a nice attitude very professional. I recommend him to everyone. he explained everything so well. GOOD WORK Mathew my husband and I are happy we experienced some good work in Allentown.

plumbers.name: Home Service Doctors
plumbers.address: 10560 Main St Suite PS 100, Fairfax, VA 22030, USA

reviews.author: Barbara Baskin
reviews.text: This is the best company in the NOVA area!!! They are the most genuine individuals that I have ever met in the service industry. Today I had the pleasure of meeting the owner, the office manager, the amazing workers and the project manager (again)! I absolutely love all of them and they are so wonderful and thorough. They showed up as promised and they are such a blessing to work with! 🥰

reviews.author: Nicole Norton
reviews.text: Cameron from Home Service Doctors came out to analyze and repair my garbage disposal today. He did an excellent job of replacing the disposal and getting the water to drain correctly.  Cameron was a true professional…punctual, kind, patient and knowledgeable! We even discovered that he had been a student at my former school.  Great to see wolves excelling in a career they love!

reviews.author: Ethan hu
reviews.text:
A picture speaks thousands of words! DO NOT ever hire this place to do any work and it would be a shame for those of you who are working for this place.

The most overrated and sketchy business on earth. I called the Home Service Doctor in for a simple main valve exchange at the price of 1100$ and let alone their claim of “great service does not come cheap”. On the second day, my basement is flooded as in the picture, the water is dripping and spurting all over the place.

On a call with their Service manager, the manager uneducatedly said that “No refund. I am not trying to just brush it off. You should file a claim with your home insurance to deal with all the water damage” EXCUSE ME? This is not by accident, and you told me to file with my home insurance to deal with it?? No reimbursement and no nothing. Basically, you are telling me you are not responsible for the work that you have done to flood my whole basement and I have to pay you letting me deal with this.

Super unprofessional and unacceptable! In the middle of discussing with my lawyers for the next step and probably also file a tax fraud activity suspects to IRS.

Everyone will be blessed in the future if they choose not to come to this place.

reviews.author: Irish Robinson
reviews.text: Home Service Doctors provide outstanding customer service! Sidney Janet also delivered excellent service in response to today’s call regarding my home’s water heater problem. I am grateful he was the technician assigned to address the water heater issue. After completing the repair, he clearly explained the work he performed to ensure the water heater operated correctly. Additionally, he emailed the documents related to the service call, including photos of the water heater and its serial/model numbers. He contacted the manufacturer to document the issue and registered the water heater on my behalf. Truly, he is a Master Technician and a valuable asset to Home Service Doctors! Thank you for making my day better, Irish Robinson.

reviews.author: Prabha Mohan
reviews.text: We contacted Home Service Doctors to replace our washer hoses, as one was swollen and close to bursting. We also needed help with a recurring odor from the washing machine. They sent Sidney Janet, and we couldn't have asked for a better plumber. Sidney was incredibly professional, knowledgeable, and patient. He replaced the old rubber hoses with a durable stainless steel mesh set, recommended a simple cleaner to address the smell, and thoughtfully walked us through other potential issues without pushing unnecessary repairs. His honest and straightforward approach was refreshing. What stood out most was his willingness to answer all our questions, even those unrelated to the problem, with genuine care and patience. Getting an appointment was easy, and the prices were very reasonable! We’re so impressed that we’d gladly work with Sidney and Home Service Doctors again. Thank you.

plumbers.name: Service Specialties Inc.
plumbers.address: 14522 Lee Rd # B, Chantilly, VA 20151, USA

reviews.author: Amy Seales
reviews.text:
HVAC Service Technician, John M. from Services Specialists, Inc provided excellent service during his visit to inspect our HVAC system. He was very professional, thorough, and detail-oriented while checking everything to ensure it was operating properly. He took the time to explain how the system operates and confirmed that the system is working well and meets construction codes, which gave us great peace of mind.

His communication was outstanding, and he was very informative throughout the entire process. He also offered maintenance services, which we truly appreciated. The only reason we declined was because we are in the process of selling our home; otherwise, we would have gladly moved forward with the service.

Overall, a great experience. We highly recommend John for his professionalism, expertise, and excellent customer service! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Tod came Monday for regular maintenance. He’s awesome. He is professional, friendly and conscientious. He’s been helping me since I first moved into my house and realized I needed to replace the original heating system and both AC units. He was with Cardinal then, subsequently acquired by Service Specialties. Booking appointments and communication with Service Specialties has been great. Prices seem fair and I trust them (and Tod!) to provide me with great service.

reviews.author: Colleen O'Brien
reviews.text:
Ben installed a new toilet in my mother’s home on March 4th and did a great job! At my mother’s annual inspection earlier this year, he pointed out the age of our previous toilet and said a new toilet would be more efficient. My mother had planned to replace that toilet, and he had all the information regarding purchase and installation through SSI. My mom thought the price was great, and appreciates the information Ben provided.

This was an excellent way to accomplish this replacement with purchasing through SSI. My mom has a top floor condo, and she didn’t have to worry about getting a toilet up the stairs nor taking the old one out of her home. She will definitely call them again!

reviews.author: Becca Roy
reviews.text: Mike is amazing! I lost hot water and he was sent out to help on an emergency call. Not only did he get my tankless system working again but he had the pleasure of being here when my floor drain started to backup. He stayed and worked for hours clearing the main drain line. He explained everything along the way, and provided options for next steps. He really went above and beyond to get everything running again. He’s a true pleasure to work with. I’ve been using SSI for over a decade and you guys never disappoint.

reviews.author: Michael Mickus
reviews.text: Excellent professional service from Mike M my technician.  Great price as well. We had to reschedule to get the right parts for my water shutoff value install project after I provided make and model of the system.  I will use SSI again in the future and I highly recommend Mike M.

plumbers.name: Plumbing Care Inc
plumbers.address: 2415 San Ramon Valley Blvd UNIT 312, San Ramon, CA 94583, USA

reviews.author: Kristina Marin
reviews.text: Pablo was our technician & he found problematic areas on the hot & cold water valves under the sink as well as toilet wall valve. The valves were stiff & difficult to turn & showing rust & corrosion.   Also Pablo showed me a crack in the old original pipe connecting the pea trap that could start leaking, so he changed it to a new plastic PVC pipe.  Pablo is very conscientious, honest, knowledgeable, & communicated his professional opinion & experience whenever any problems arose or plans needed to change.  Thank you Pablo for a job well done!

reviews.author: Ridhima Singh
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with this plumber. From start to finish, he was professional, punctual, and extremely knowledgeable. He quickly diagnosed the issue, explained the problem clearly, and completed the repair efficiently and neatly.

What really stood out was his attention to detail and the pride he takes in his work. He left everything clean and made sure everything was functioning perfectly before leaving.

It’s hard to find reliable, honest service these days, and this was truly a 5-star experience. Highly recommend to anyone needing plumbing work done right the first time.

reviews.author: Arnab “Ari” Sinha
reviews.text: Alex (Alejandro) was amazing to work with. He was patient, answered all of our questions, and did a thorough, high-quality job installing our first tankless water heater. The pricing was fair, and the overall experience exceeded our expectations. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sanjay Anavekar
reviews.text:
Mitko did a wonderful job installing new Navien NPE240A2
water heater. He made sure everything works as expected and did a detailed walk-through post installation.

Martin the owner, has built a very professional team of plumbers over the years. I highly recommend them as they always deliver good quality service.

reviews.author: Alex Kalpin
reviews.text:
Hristo Ivanov from Plumbing Care INC is absolutely outstanding. From start to finish, he was professional, punctual, and incredibly knowledgeable. He took the time to explain the issue clearly, offered practical solutions, and completed the job efficiently with great attention to detail.

What really sets Hristo apart is his honesty and workmanship — no shortcuts, no upselling, just quality work done right the first time. Everything was left clean and working perfectly.

If you’re looking for a reliable, skilled plumber you can actually trust, Hristo is the one. Highly recommended!

plumbers.name: 1st Call Plumbing & AC
plumbers.address: 5511 Brewster St, San Antonio, TX 78233, USA

reviews.author: Daymond Speed (speedddy)
reviews.text: Today SAWS came to my home and said there was a leak on the city cutoff and they replaced it but found that there was also a large leak on the customer side too and after showing me, I realized that this was an true emergency issue and I needed help quick!! I looked at several Companies online and something was making me look again at 1st Call Plumbing. I never done business with them before but I still decided to try them and WOW am I glad I did!! They say first impressions are everything and my initial call with Melissa was awesome! She recognized the fact that I was stressing a little bit and said she would have someone in about 30 minutes that the technician was just leaving another job. I felt so much better after that and then Justin and Jason came out in (I swear like 20 minutes), very professional, they listened to me (without interruption!!) then assessed the issue and gave me options and never once did I ever feel pressured into anything. He showed me and explained in detail how they would tackle this and what to expect, which I appreciated! After digging some of the yard and seeing that this was originals old pipe from the 1940’s, brittle and downright corrosive, I told them it’s an investment and I ok’d the replacement. Now all complete and my wife and I are super happy with 1st Call and already have them in our contacts for our future needs!! Way to go!! A huge thank you to Melissa, Justin and Jason for making our day!! I highly recommend this family business and I will be letting friends and family know about our experience today.

reviews.author: Christina R
reviews.text: This is the second time I’ve used 1st Call Plumbing, and I continue to be very impressed with their service. They respond quickly and are able to get technicians out in a timely manner. Every technician I’ve worked with has been very knowledgeable and takes the time to thoroughly explain the problem and the solution. Their pricing is also  reasonable. They have definitely become my go-to company for any plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Nancy Carroll
reviews.text: I called with an urgent repair need today.  The office staff were very helpful and courteous and got me on the schedule for a tech to get to me within an hour.  The tech arrived promptly when they said they would be here.   After assessing my needs and giving me an estimate, they were able to jump right in and get the job done. Justin was awesome and professional.  Work was completed in the time frame they had estimated repairs to take.  Thank you for the great service!

reviews.author: Lisa Reyna (Texas Mom)
reviews.text:
I called due to a broken pipe and I wasn’t able to get the water off. They were very helpful and sent someone right away.

Greg and Fred arrived quickly and were very knowledgeable and friendly. They got things taken care of, and went above and beyond, even doing an outstanding job applying new insulation for me. I appreciate when the work looks like it was done by a professional! I love my home and appreciate when the pros take pride in their work.

They were all very helpful from start to finish. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: R Himes
reviews.text: Professional, highly skilled, friendly, considerate technicians did a GREAT job, which I greatly appreciate!! For me, 1st Call Plumbing & AC is my only call and has been for many years, and will be for years to come. Thanks to everyone for the great customer service, including office staff taking my calls & keeping me posted on who’s on the way to do the job and their arrival time. I’m confident that the workmanship’s done right! Ryan, Wade, Fred, and another I didn’t get his name all get a BIG 👍🏻‼️

plumbers.name: Flow Pros Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2770 25th St N, St. Petersburg, FL 33713, USA

reviews.author: Carina Baker
reviews.text: Elijah was professional and thorough. I am pleased with the communication, friendliness, transparency, and effectiveness that came with this job. I had my main water shutoff valve replaced (kind of a big deal) and I appreciate Flow Pros working with me despite the preexisting material. The price was fair, scheduling prompt, and warranty great. They will not disappoint!

reviews.author: Chris Nesci
reviews.text:
Flo Pro Plumbing was fantastic from start to finish. We recently had a water softener installed, and our technician, Kahlil, did an outstanding job. He was punctual, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. Kahlil took the time to explain the system, answer all our questions, and make sure everything was installed perfectly. The quality of his work and his attention to detail were clear.
We’re extremely happy with the service and highly recommend Flo Pro Plumbing—and especially Kahlil—for anyone needing plumbing work done. Great experience all around!

reviews.author: Christopher Hudson
reviews.text: Fantastic response!  Had a complicated issue with an iron pipe.  I called, got an immediate response, got a window for the next morning, and the problem was completely resolved by the middle of the afternoon.  Jeffrey was efficient, explain the quote and what the work was going to entail, and kept his time estimate! He cleaned up nicely the area.  Very pleased.

reviews.author: Kristen Tompkins
reviews.text:
Alex came out. He was kind and friendly and reassuring.

Alex is an amazing job to show up. Get the work done within integrity and commitment.

I had a New water softener installed And I can’t wait to see how amazing my curly hair looks after today.

Hands-down would hire them again for all plumbing needs. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Kevin Palcsak
reviews.text:
Bradley found the issue and provided a clear quote for the work, and Alex took the lead in fixing it. They were both friendly and knowledgeable throughout the entire process. It turned out to be a larger project with some unexpected challenges thanks to our older home, but Alex always had solutions and still managed to stay within the original estimate.
He was consistently respectful of our space and offered helpful tips as we navigate being new homeowners. It’s never enjoyable having to spend a significant amount of money just to get your home working the way it should, so I hope I don’t need to see Alex or Brad again anytime soon—but if you do need work done, I would definitely recommend them.

plumbers.name: Half Moon Plumbing & Electric | Tulsa
plumbers.address: 7633 E 63rd Pl suite 300-68, Tulsa, OK 74133, USA

reviews.author: Rachel Boyer
reviews.text: This company was fantastic from start to finish and we had absolutely no issues with any part of the process. Everyone was informative, friendly, professional, and even patient (I had a lot of questions!!) I recommend using this company if you want people in your home you can trust it doing right by you and their work. Completely happy with the work they’ve done and it looks fantastic. They took time to clean up each time and inform me of what they were doing, it was very helpful to plan the day around that. Seriously, couldn’t ask for a better company to trust. We have the technicians Steven and Nate! Each time we called the office as well, the lady was so nice and accommodating. 10/10 experience; would use again!

reviews.author: Deborah Dunlap
reviews.text:
I definitely would recommend Half Moon Plumbing. The best team I’ve ever worked with. Workers Andrew, Noah & Grant were especially helpful & very professional guiding me through the process of fixing a leak & replacing a pop up valve.
They were honest from the beginning & even adjusted price when leak detection wasn’t as bad as thought. All 3 guys were kind, polite, cleaned up & will now be my to go Plumbing team! Thank you

reviews.author: Rex Porter
reviews.text:
The Half Moon advertising by location on Highway 20, signage on Highway 169, fleet of vehicles around our area, and most importantly by word of mouth, attracted our attention long before our need for service. We knew who we would call when that time arose, plus my wife liked their colors and logo!

What began as a service call by Andrew and Matt led to James, Michael, and Steven spending an extra long, hot next day in and under our home installing a new PEX plumbing system, water heater, and kitchen faucet in our 60-year-old home.

In the days right after all this complex work, we realized there were two things we needed to address, which were sent by text:
1) The access panel behind the water tank had inadvertently not been replaced.
2) My wife changed her mind about the kitchen faucet and preferred a different style.
Sam called the next day with reassurance all would be made right, even my wife’s faucet, which was not their responsibility.

James returned to our home and made all things right, quite to our satisfaction. His cheerful countenance and attitude never wavered as he changed out the faucet, pulled and reinstalled the tank, at least that we knew! He also noticed some questionable electrical things around the tank area and offered to ask their electrician Nate to look at them even though it was late in the day.

Nate did find multiple problems with our antiquated electrical system and carefully explained them to us before he left, again when he returned the next morning, and again to our children at our request. He corrected the issues regarding the tank as well as giving us quotes on updating our system all at one time or in stages. Nate was calm and patient as he explained things over and over.

Every Half Moon man who came into our home was a gentleman. Those we had more opportunity to visit with were found to be fellow followers of Christ and lovers of His Church.

Rex Porter

reviews.author: K Mahjoubi
reviews.text:
The Half Moon team got my water shut off after my previous water heater had been observed leaking after coming home from work.

Jackson provided an informative consultation and taking the time to understand cost opportunity of not investing, so I could make an informed decision aligned with my goals.

Lastly, Jackson took the time to bypass the water heater connection, allowing me to water on tap until the installation could be performed the following day.

The installation team were professional and overall just decent guys and would recommend to a friend.

reviews.author: Curtis
reviews.text: Called Halfmoon plumbing for a situation I was having, my house was on a gas well and the gas was getting too inconsistent to keep up with the damand. The gas well is pretty much played out. I talked to the Lady in the office and she was super nice and helpful and caring, she said she would have a technician come out the same day which was very much appreciated. They sent Jeramy out to to replace some parts on the gas well and after he fixed it and diagnosed the situation there was definitely not enough pressure to continue using the well. Jeramy assessed the situation and set up what it would take to be converted to propane. Jeramy is a top notch plumber and also a very good Person. They’re not cheap, but you get what you pay for. It takes a lot to run a top quality business.I would recommend them to everyone. Thank you.Also William and his crew came out that Friday and installed a new propane line and a new water heater and did a great job. William was also very polite and professional.thanks to the whole team for making this happen in a prompt manner.

plumbers.name: Jon Wayne Service Company
plumbers.address: 8920 I 35 N Frontage Rd, New Braunfels, TX 78130, USA

reviews.author: Rick Martinez
reviews.text:
My Jon Wayne water sensor worked to perfection. I was alerted to water leak before any catastrophic damage was caused. Jon Wayne sent plumber out within 1 hour to diagnose and order replacement water heater. Thanks to the whole Saturday team!

Follow up-Post completion:
I can’t give 5 stars due to:
A) Residue left in tub after draining water heater. The team that does yearly maintenance doesn’t leave this for me to clean. B) Cover for bottom of heater not installed, netting at bottom of heater not installed , and leak sensor was placed on its side instead of correctly .

reviews.author: RAM
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Outstanding Service – Highly Recommend Jon Wayne!

I cannot say enough great things about Jon Wayne Service Company and especially Jeremy, who came out to take care of our home.

From the moment he arrived, Jeremy was the definition of prompt and professional. He showed up on time, in uniform, squared away, and ready to work. As a military family, we truly appreciate companies that operate with structure, respect, and integrity and Jeremy absolutely delivered that.

He quickly diagnosed and remedied an issue with our reverse osmosis system that had been frustrating us for some time. Instead of just offering a temporary fix, he took the time to explain the system, walk us through what was happening, and implement a long-term solution. His knowledge and confidence were immediately reassuring.

On top of that, he completed a full water heater flush with efficiency and attention to detail. He didn’t rush the job. He ensured everything was functioning properly, cleaned up thoroughly, and left the space better than he found it.

What stood out most was his professionalism and military friendly approach  respectful, clear communication, mission-focused execution, and zero upsell pressure. Just honest, high-quality service.

Jeremy represents Jon Wayne extremely well. If this is the standard they hold their team to, we’ll absolutely be customers for life.

Highly recommend requesting Jeremy specifically you won’t be disappointed. We even signed up for the Whole Home 5 star rescue membership ‼️

reviews.author: Richard Fuller
reviews.text: Was told by another plumber I may have a collapsed cast iron pipe after having my foundation raised. Troy came out to give me an estimate to replace the cast iron pipes. He took the time to diagnose the problem and was able to determine that the line was just clogged and was intact. He was able to clear the line and gave me clear next steps to take. Really appreciate him taking the time and letting me know I may not have to replace things yet, need to pressure test the system first. No high pressure sales pitch just honest feedback- thank you

reviews.author: Diana Ruiz
reviews.text: I would like to give Joseph Guajardo kudos for providing great customer service on the plumbing inspection/maintenance of my home. He was very thorough and very informative with each inspection. His detail explanation was very educational for future plumbing issues for me to consider.

reviews.author: Patrick Cullinan
reviews.text:
Chris was great. He arrived on time. He was very polite and was very clear about the problem and the anticipated solution. He was a wonderful ambassador for Jon Wayne. I will wait for the estimate but the first part was fantastic.
Patrick

plumbers.name: Kobella Plumbing Heating Cooling
plumbers.address: 11630 Chillicothe Rd Ste 120, Chesterland, OH 44026, USA

reviews.author: Gary Utterback
reviews.text: Matt H from Kobella installed an Aprilaire 720 whole house humidifier for us. He was incredibly helpful, very professional, and went above and beyond. We’ve been with Kobella for a few years now, always a good experience. For this project I opted to get multiple quotes to make sure we were getting the best value. Although others came in a few dollars lower ($50-75), Kobella definitely offered the best service and value, and quoted the newest system vs previous versions of Aprilaire. And what really won me over is they installed the system on our furnace outlet (optimal) vs the return, which is where the other two companies wanted to do it. We’re very happy.

reviews.author: Joe Barnett
reviews.text:
I could not recommend this company enough.  Jeff came over and was amazing in every aspect.  Nailed down the issue with my furnace very fast and didnt mess around with trying to add on any charges or sell anything like other companies.  Jeff did an amazing job and after telling my father about my experience, he now will be signing up for Kobella to service his house.  I also signed up for the maintenance package as Jeff was a perfect example as how company should be!

Thanks Jeff, hope to see you around for my AC check.

reviews.author: Robert Eberly
reviews.text: Christopher (and Kory) were efficient, knowledgeable, friendly, kind, and professional. All the attributes one would expect of a highly competent service provider.

reviews.author: Keli Sessler
reviews.text: Derek with Kobella Plumbing and Heating was great. Kobella sent him the same day I called about a leak in my kitchen sink. He worked quickly and efficiently and was able to replace the old pipes quickly and easily and the result was a pipe with fewer twists and turns.  He was polite and courteous and even took time to befriend my cat.  Afterwards, he cleaned up thoroughly.

reviews.author: Brandon C
reviews.text: Homer provided excellent service. He explained everything that was going on with my frozen water pipes and proved step by step details on what he was doing to resolve the issue. Unexpected expenses due to this awful winter are never a good thing but when you receive excellent customer service, it helps.

plumbers.name: Plumb Pro+
plumbers.address: 111 A Lumber Ln, Goose Creek, SC 29445, USA

reviews.author: Samantha Wadsworth
reviews.text: We had to repipe our house recently and the crew that did the work was great, I will say the finish up was sloppy. I had to request spots to be recaulked or caulked at all. And there were multiple boards not put back on the wall. With a toddler that's pretty dangerous. Overall the job got done, but could have been finished better .

reviews.author: Jason Shepherd
reviews.text:
Late on a Friday afternoon, right before prom night, I desperately needed a broken pipe repaired on my house. My own attempts at fixing it had failed miserably. I called around everywhere, but no one could get anyone out to me in time.

Luckily, I stumbled across Plumb Pro+. They worked incredibly hard to shuffle schedules around and get a technician out to my house. Jordan arrived quickly and was super friendly. He didn't mock my poor attempt at a DIY repair, and he even brought my own tools back out from under the house for me! They treated me and my family great, and I have absolutely no problem recommending them. Outstanding service!

reviews.author: Nancy Burkhead
reviews.text: Kevin was most friendly, knowledgeable and professional. He left no mess to clean up and went out of his way to make me feel better about my issue and to quiet my anxiety. He seems to enjoy his job and takes pride in his work. I definitely would recommend you guys to anyone who needs any kind of plumbing issue

reviews.author: Miguel Alvarez
reviews.text: Had a water leak at the water meter, it was late and couldn't find a technician, I called Plumb Pro+ and they sent over Kevin, who quickly assessed the problem and fixed the leak.  Will highly recommend them to my family and friends.

reviews.author: Blake Connor
reviews.text:
All I can say is Plumb Pro is awesome!!  Their employees that replaced my hot water heater on the weekend were on time, polite, and professional.  The quality of work was excellent and clean.  Charles and I’m sorry I do not remember his partners name will be requested next time I need their help. I also had Charles replace the  60 year old faucets in my master bathroom tube with a new single handle unit.  Once again an awesome experience.  Thank you guys and thank you Plumb Pro for employees like them.
Blake Connor

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Toledo
plumbers.address: 26695 Eckel Rd, Perrysburg, OH 43551, USA

reviews.author: Phillip Lach
reviews.text:
The Mr Rooter team performed hydrojetting and inspected my sanitary line. They replaced about 15-20 feet of my sanitary line, which was mostly worn away and had roots growing into the line.

They were professional and courteous and worked quickly to replace the old piping. The team was very informative of the work and offered different payment plans and options. Would highly recommend them to anyone who needs plumbing work!

reviews.author: My Future Isn't a Dream
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Mr. Rooter.

During previous visits, they only charged a standard diagnostic fee, and that fee would be applied toward the total cost if I agreed to proceed with the recommended work. That was fair and consistent.

However, this time was completely different. No actual work was performed, yet I was immediately quoted over $400 just to move a washer/dryer to access the system—something that had never been charged in prior visits.

On top of that, the previous invoice clearly stated that a water sample was already taken and would be sent to the lab. When I called to follow up, Adam was extremely rude and unprofessional. He told me that I “don’t value his time,” said he didn’t have time to talk unless I was ready to pay more, and then rushed to end the call.

This was very frustrating, as I had already paid for the initial service and was simply trying to understand what happened and what the next steps were.

Overall, the pricing felt inconsistent and the customer service was unacceptable. I would not recommend this company based on this experience.

reviews.author: Merri Flisnik
reviews.text: Mr. Rooter’s team helped me get through the unsettling experience of having to replace my sewer connection from house to sidewalk. They were quick to respond, very professional, patient and thorough in answering my questions, and mindful to keep the inevitable “relandscaping” to as much of a minimum as possible. Noah, Nate, Kyle, and Sam were some of this team’s members. Thank you all for a job well done!

reviews.author: Chris Joseph
reviews.text: Absolutely was impressed with the knowledge of the 2 gentlemen I interacted with.  Not only that but the work they did was at the highest level of quality.  I was referred to them from a family friend and it’s clear why. They will forever be my go to for any future problems I may encounter. Amazing work!!

reviews.author: John Michalski
reviews.text: Your company sent out your finest tech to service my needs of clogged drains in my two sinks.  Your tech, Brandon Farley is an outstanding employee who answered all of my questions and he showed me in detail what kind of work was needed and broke the invoice down in great detail for me. too.  Brandon is an employee that all of you in upper management should be very proud of to say the least. Very satisfied!!

plumbers.name: Upfront Plumbing Drains Heating and Air
plumbers.address: 8496 Harrison St STE 102, Sandy, UT 84047, USA

reviews.author: Keri
reviews.text: We called Upfront to install a microwave that vented to the outside.   They came first to see if what we were asking was feasible.  With a green light,  we went ahead and purchased a microwave that had convertible venting.  Then Jose and his assistant showed up the next day and installed our microwave.  They were professional and completed the job in a timely manner.  They answered questions I had about installation. They cleaned up afterwards and then showed me the work they had completed.  We felt that the price was great considering they would need to drill through stucco.  They also hauled away our old microwave.

reviews.author: Mariah Morris
reviews.text: I've worked with Mason a couple times and he's been amazing. This time, we had mold and had to completely demo our bathroom to remediate. Mason came and was very thorough when looking at everything which was really nice because he understood everything that needed to be done to help avoid any surprises that he could. He even offered 2 different options based on my budget and what needed done, and made sure I was aware of what each entailed and potential consequences and benefits for each option. I've really respected and appreciated the full disclosure and time he's taken with me each time he looks over everything and goes over options and estimates. Two other employees came and did the work to replace my main drain stack and some other piping. They even noticed that my ABS had a recall on it, which I had no idea about. They've all done great work, been very respectful, friendly, and kept me engaged throughout the whole process so nothing came as a surprise. I've had other companies try to tell me I need products that I don't really need and Upfront has never done that. The office employees are also very nice and it's super easy to schedule appointments and make payments, they'll even text you a link for you to pay. I feel like Upfront is very trustworthy and would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Bryan A
reviews.text:
I had a really good experience getting my furnace replaced by Upfront! Their estimate was fair, and they were extremely responsive, and they accommodated the replacement within 3 days.

My furnace was condemned on Friday morning. With temperatures beginning to drop next week and it being Christmas week, I scrambled to get my warranty company to take the job but their contractor was unresponsive during the weekend. Jakob coordinated with me throughout Saturday on getting the furnace replaced Monday. On Monday Justin and Austin finished the furnace replacement in less than 4 hours. Everything looks great and we don't have to worry about using space heaters to survive the cold that's coming. Thank you for doing a great job, being responsive, and working diligently to resolve a habitability issue quickly!

reviews.author: Tonia Eidson
reviews.text: Mark came out to give us a price to replace a 14 year old water heater for my in-laws after we woke up with no hot water. My husband and I come from the industry, but are from out of state and the company I would normally use was booked so I looked around for other local companies with good reviews and Upfront seemed like a great place. We were not disappointed! Mark was able to get the water heater temporarily fixed so that we would have hot water over night and then came back the following morning to replace it. He did an amazing job on the install! Everything was done to code and looks great! You can tell Mark really cares about his customers and takes pride in his work. The price was better than we expected! If you are looking for a local company that does great work at a decent price, these guys are great! Ask for Mark!

reviews.author: Austin Heywood
reviews.text: This is the best run company in utah - fair Price fantastic employees amazing management took such good care of my mom’s place and she’s 88 years old. I would use them all day and twice on Sunday. Thanks Ryan for your team.

plumbers.address: 5980 W 59th Ave, Arvada, CO 80003, USA

reviews.author: Gray Cat
reviews.text: I believe I've left a sterling review for Plumbline in the past but here's another. I called them again for a mainline snake as a precaution as I do a few times a year. Again, great service and best price. The techs represent the company well. Sam who came out this time was no exception. He's a star! If you need their services don't hesitate to give them a call.

reviews.author: Kurt Raven
reviews.text: Couldn't be more happier with Plumbline services! We had a sewer line backup and Plumbline quickly assessed and mitigated the backup. Because our line is notorious for tree-root invasion and because our line is too long (132ft from toilet snake access) for the mechanical snake, we also had them put in an outdoor sewer line access and water jet the line thereafter. With this access in the future the mechanical snake can reach the end of the line. Everything about the experience was top notch: Communications before, during, and after each step, the quality and care of the work by those involved, the explanation of the sewer-line issues, mitigation, and the reason for each mitigation step - all spot on and reassuring! Prices are comparably reasonable and the service and explanations absolutely the best!

reviews.author: Anais Bovagnet
reviews.text: Plumbline Services was fantastic to work with. They connected my refrigerator to the water line quickly and efficiently, and the whole experience was smooth from start to finish. The team was incredibly kind and professional, and I was pleasantly surprised with the total cost. It’s rare to find a company that does great work and shows that level of honesty and care. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jeff Hinkle
reviews.text: Plumbline installed my HVAC system in my 30yo home a year and a half ago. Part of the program I signed up for was a yearly inspection, free for 4 years, to make sure the system will remain in top running order (you do know how much dust goes through the system, right?). Kelsey was my technician, and she was thorough, taking pics of the inside of the system, where dust begins to accumulate, and taking pressure readings of the air flow (I put filters over the cold air returns which did decrease the airflow somewhat, but not enough to damage the system). Kelsey will come back same time next year, and I like the service Plumbline offers.

reviews.author: Rhonda Slade
reviews.text: Dominique came to our house to fix our leaking toilet. We even showed up early which is awesome. VERY professional but very easy to talk to. He was able to fix our toilet, and when he was done, he asked if we needed anything else.

plumbers.name: Ernie's Plumbing Service, Inc.
plumbers.address: 1809 W Pioneer Pkwy, Arlington, TX 76013, USA

reviews.author: Mayan Boricua • 9 years ago
reviews.text: Austin was great. He was extremely knowledgeable and explained everything well. He stopped the leak under my sink. He replaced my clogged old faucet with a new modern design. I couldn't be happier; would reccomend to anybody!

reviews.author: Baxter Mullins
reviews.text:
After 25 years living in my phone, I found in December 2025 that both showers were plugged. I called Ernie’s, our long time plumbing company, to correct the problems. Ernie’s sent Anthony to check the issues with the plumbing. What was found can be classified as a “Nightmare before Christmas”. Scenario. Both sides of the plumbing had moved where the back of the house, the plumbing was much lower than the exit to the city system. Anthony allowed me to sit with him as we moved the camera from front to back showing up and down holding waste and several breaks plus tree root blockage. Another adventure!  Ernie’s replaced 115 ft of sewer lines on both major branches. Three 4’x4’ foot tunnels had to be excavated to do the job.  New sewer pipes were hung from the foundation to assure stability. The team did a good job, cleaning up the property. Anthony and the team did a great job.

Photos show new sewer pipes compared to original and the second shows front yard after the work is completed.

reviews.author: Nora Flores
reviews.text: Anthony did a great job in replacing our gas line.everything was as he said it would be . Very communicative in details. I definitely recommend him to everyone who is needing plumbing work .

reviews.author: T V
reviews.text:
Feb. 27, 2026 EDIT

Thank you Ernie for responding very quickly to my review and graciously offering to make things right. Someone was indeed sent out the very next day after we called to schedule. The entire process was very pleasant, from our scheduler to our plumber. Our Plumber was Scott and he informed us that the first person did not do the job correctly and used the wrong pipe for our hot & cold water line leaking in our ceiling space which is an enclosed area (he used something meant for an open area such as under the sink instead). He removed the sharkbite fittings and installed a new correct pex fitting for a more permanent repair solution, and soldered it together - which the other person also did not do, and fixed up everything for us during the same visit. He was very pleasant to deal with, educated us, and checked out a few other spots for us while here. We are thoroughly satisfied and will definitely recommend and continue to use Ernie's in the future. Thank you Scott and Ernie! :)

----------------------------------------------------
During 'Snowmageddon' we had a pipe burst through our ceiling and Ernie's came to give us an estimate and repair. The estimate was free as they advertised, repair seemed well, and the technician seemed nice and timely. It was suggested that we get the pipe repaired with PVC(?) I believe, which is a more flexible material and will expand better instead of repairing the pipe with a metal pipe, which our original pipe is. Since he was the expert, we went with what he suggested. All seemed well until the next Winter when we noticed a leak in the same exact spot which required us to open up our ceiling again. We called Ernie's again to come and give us another free estimate. This time, the person that came (different person) said that he'd have to charge us $200 just to go into the attic to even look. That seemed weird so we tried to go without and tried to patch it up. That spot has given us problems every Winter since. We will be doing a full repair with metal soon but the thought and trauma of that ill-repaired pipe during Winter every year sucks. It's completely fine throughout the year but during Winter is when it starts leaking again. Not enough to notice right away but eventually a stain appears in the same spot on our ceiling and every time, I'm reminded of what our expert recommended which turned out to not be a wise choice for our house. That and the random charge to go into the attic left a sour taste in our mouths. Thoroughly disappointed.

reviews.author: Larry Whitaker
reviews.text:
" Buyer Beware!! "
We had Ernie's Plumbing do  scan of the sewage pipes because of a recurring clog.
After the video scan that gave use the estimate here attached.
It was VERY expensive (as you can see) so I asked for a copy of the video we paid for and they said "we do not supply copies of our scans."
That was an immediate red flag!
I called another plumbing company (LD Plumbing) and they said they could do a scan of the system and would provide a video with an explanation of what was found.
They cane out and did the complete scan and said there was a MINOR problem, showed us the scan and said they could fix it for $450!!
They did fix it for $450 not $3000 OR MORE!!
(2) Response to the owner's (Ernie) reply.
(A) I spoke at length to Michael the plumber who did the scan and he said they do not supply copies of the scan to customers, I called the office number and they confirmed to me that they do not supply copies of the scan to customers.
(B) Justin did NOT stand over Michael and watch the scan.
(C) Michael the plumber went into a long description of how laborious the repair would be to fix the dual clean out and even sent me a picture of what they would use to do the repair (see the picture). That is what we were quoted $3000 to replace!
(D) LD Plumbing came out and did a full scan of the entire pipe system inside the home and outside. Came back and said there is only one minor problem which was that the dual clean out had slipped off  the pipe and provided us with a picture (see the picture) and the repair would be quick and they would do it for $450!
(E) They did the complete repair (NO BANDAID) using exactly the same item that Michael showed me in the picture he sent. (See the picture of the FULL REPAIR!)
Once again I say BUYER BEWARE!

reviews.author: Katie Gresback
reviews.text: I used KMP for some pressure tests as well as fixing drain repairs under the home. My first large project with them was back and fourth with questions and processes for such a large scale job. Overall they did a great job and satisfied the repairs. They also did an Amazing job on finishing my hose bib project! They are new and a well done job. I appreciate the team! They genuinely want to keep their customers satisfied and happy and I appreciate their customer service!

reviews.author: Regina Mack
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough great things about KMP and the plumber (Nick Riley) who came to address our slab leak. From the moment he arrived, he was knowledgeable, professional, and incredibly friendly. Slab leaks can be stressful, but he immediately put us at ease with his clear communication and expertise.

He took the time to thoroughly explain what was happening, walked us through the process step by step, and kept us updated throughout the entire job so there were absolutely no surprises. That level of transparency was truly appreciated. He gave us options and didn't try to push the most expensive option. He allowed us to decide and clearly answered any questions we had to come to the best decision.

What stood out the most was how respectful he was of our home. He was extremely mindful of cleanliness, careful with his work area, and left everything in great condition when the job was completed. His professionalism and attention to detail did not go unnoticed.

If you need plumbing services—especially for something as serious as a slab leak (honestly any plumbing need)—I highly recommend KMP. Exceptional service from start to finish!

reviews.author: chris
reviews.text:
These guys are awesome!  James Bacon is the man and an excellent plumber if you need something installed or repaired.

Called them today at 10:30 and they were at my house before 1:00 pm!  That’s pretty incredible considering I didn’t arrange an appointment beforehand.

He did the work, super clean, professional, and easy to talk to with valuable informative tips along the way.

I’ll be calling them for future needs!

reviews.author: Tim Harold
reviews.text: I have used KMP a few times in the past but will never use them again. Needed my mini split charged he came out and said he couldn't do it today because of the temperature. He knew the temperature before he came out and if the scheduler told him i needed a charge, why did he come out. I told him and the scheduler that I have the refrigerant it just needed a charged. I told him it does have a small leak that I am going to fix but with the weather coming in there just wasn't time. He said he could come back out tomorrow since the temperatures were going to be better and he would call his boss and get a quote. After a few minutes he said to do the work it would take about an hour and a half to two hours. They'd have to reclaim any refrigerant in the line, which is fine. Not sure why he couldn't have just returned it to the compressor but there could be moisture etc in the line so I get it. But with this and using my refrigerant it would cost $1480. Cheaper to trash this unit and buy a new one for that price. So they got a $79 service call fee from me just to show up and say they can't do it today and gave me one of the most ridiculous quotes I have ever heard. KMP use to have fair and reasonable prices and did outstanding work. Not sure what happened but I will never refer them anymore to any of my trades families ever again.

reviews.author: Stephen Capler
reviews.text: Came out late on a Sunday night, I had a leaky water heater, he replaced the whole thing same day, was quick and was honest and direct on his quote. Did great work and my family was back taking hot showers. They did a great job. Appreciate you

reviews.author: C M
reviews.text:
HIRE THIS GUY FOR WORK - he’s gifted in the HVAC field.  Derek came in and tackled a serious issue we’ve had for about 6 years with our HVAC system. We had incorrect roof PVC pipe drainage (too long to get to the gutter) and an HVAC unit  leaning 1 1/2”  the wrong direction which caused water to back up towards the blower motor i.e towards the expensive pieces not away - then rust, corrode, and likely create something flowing thru the air that made me sick/congested from contaminated HVAC condensation.  He fixed the problem in a really creative way and didn’t give up until he had the HVAC system exactly balanced to a centered bubble. No one has even tried to tackle this before so we are super grateful that he came up with a simple solution.  Now our unit drains condensation correctly with a new, direct path to the gutter.  This now prevents mold growth.  The guy literally saved our unit from probably dying in a year to living a much longer life.

Hire him because he just removed six years of frustration that other technicians had no desire to tackle.  The pics are after showing his finished work on PVC pipes. The precious version ran to the far right along the wall then down to the gutter.

You’ll appreciate his easy-going personality, kindness, and attentiveness . When you find a good one like Derek, you’ll be a repeat customer who is confident in his work.  He didn’t just “do his job”. He cared, fixed the real problem and then sealed it so no rusty water anymore could enter the house.

Derek, a big thank you for being a hero to this family. 🇺🇸 Cecelia

I just took the longest, hottest shower of my life thanks to them 😁 We will definitely use them again and I highly recommend them to everyone.

reviews.author: Ato kad
reviews.text:
I needed a gas valve, about 3 inches of line, a line cap, a T, and a union replaced to get our heat turned back on. I explained that money was tight, but I was still quoted nearly $1,000 for about $60 worth of parts, plus almost $500 for a leak test just to verify the work.

Afterward, I called another company, and they only charge $50 for the leak test and $150 for the entire repair. There was nowhere near 10 feet of repairs needed—the plumber who actually fixed it used penetrating spray and removed the old parts easily.

*Update*
After speaking with the manager at Roto-Rooter, I was told they plan to adjust their leak-testing prices. They also assured me that the estimate I received represented the absolute worst-case scenario, and that the actual price could end up being lower.

reviews.author: Christine Falco
reviews.text:
We were having problems with our toilet bowl. It didn't seen clogged but the water wasn't filling up after each flush and the tank was almost dry.  It was a progressive thing and something we kept putting off until one day we couldn't.
We've used local plumbers before for various other work but none we would ask to come back. Plumbing work is expensive. Labor intensive, dirty, messy work. These other plumbers left huge messes and large service bills.
So we decided to go with a commercial brand we recognized and there would be a certain amount of accountability.
We did not regret our decision. Not only was Chris62 very professional but he was quick and neat and explained every option and every reason. The innards of the tank needed to be replaced. We knew it. The part was not expensive. It was the labor. He showed me where the issue was and why. Said these parts only last about 5 years.  He did snake the bowl to clear it of any debris. Checked the pipework. He saw the work done by the other plumbers and showed me what still needed to be done. But this day for this job his price was extremely reasonable when compared to the others before him. His work came with a 6 month call back , if needed and a fully written out receipt of the services he did that day. Professional, courteous, friendly and an offer to come back to address the other work we need when we are ready.
People shy away from calling a company thinking that a plumber recommended by someone else or through FB will be cheaper.
In our experience this was not the case at all. Roto Rooter was the right call for this job and we will use again the next time we need plumbing work done. Ask for Chris62. His experience and professionalism are aces in my book. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Tennis Lover
reviews.text:
On 12/23/25, Invoice #24797562 (paid $163.12), a man from your company was dispatched to repair a leak under the kitchen faucet.  He diagnosed that the elbow was leaking in 2 places and sealed the leaks.
On 1/11/26, Invoice #24831128 (paid $628.23), the same man diagnosed that the basket was leaking and replaced it with a new one.  When I questioned on 12/23/25 if the basket was leaking, he replied no.
On 1/12/26 at 7AM, there was a leak in the same areas where your man diagnosed and repaired.
The repairs for both days by your plumber came to a total charge of $791.35.
We weren't able to use the faucet, the sink, nor the dishwasher because of these leaks for two whole days (1/13/26 through 1/15/26)
Called another plumbing service that came on Wednesday, 1/15/26, to service the same leaks repaired by your company.  The plumber diagnosed that the elbow in 2 places wasn't sealed and was leaking badly.  He sealed it.  He examined the basket that was replaced and found that it wasn't tightened properly and was leaking.  The man tightened the basket and removed the excess sealant until no leakage was found.  On 1/16/26 the owner of the company that came on 1/15/26 called to check on the work and inquired if everything was done satisfactory and if I was still having issues from the work his employee performed.  I replied to the owner that his plumber fixed the leak and no problems.  The owner replied that if I still had an issue to call H-I-M directly and he wouldn't charge me for the call.
Today, Monday 2/2/26 I have no leaks!
I do not recommend your service!  I've learned my lesson.
To viewers who read this, call a real plumber!!!

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.text:
I wish my experience was a 5 star experience, but I instead my experience was a 5 star elsewhere.
NOTE: I had flowing water out to the main sewer the whole time.
The issue was a periodic gurgling sound a few seconds after flushing the toilet. Zoom came out and attempted to run a camera and a water jet down my cleanout. They were unable to do either, because there is a J trap just after the cleanout line. The tech did try to run a kitchen sink snake with a cutter on the end but lost it on what may or may not be a block. - Enter my problem with Zoom. - Later, the township comes to inspect the sewer line. Well, unknown to me. There is a second cleanout line! However, this second service line does not allow access back to the J trap. BUT it does allow access to another section of the line. Fast forward: Zoom comes back out to give me estimates for repair. I then explain that another part of the line can be accessed. The tech puts a camera down the 2nd cleanout and confirms that there is still consistent flow BUT there are roots near the end of my property line and the townships. Of course, there mostly in my property. However, the roots STILL allow water by BUT could easily could snag debris. Zoom offers a $6,000 to $10,000 repair. Which maybe still needed. I asked can we just remove the roots while I gather money. The tech says YES but your already $600 into this why pay more for root removal. Folks, I'll stop here. I completely agreed because I didn't know any better. Enter the blessing as I see it. The township randomly comes back. Sees the roots in our property and blasts them away with a powerful water jet. There reason is it's close enough to there area of responsibility. Just wow! The flow of water is even better. They even said they would return and apply herbicides if the roots returned. - Why couldn't Zoom have just offered to return and blast those same roots that they saw and that a water jet could have removed? This is what I had initially paid for.

I hate that I’m even writing this review, because I used to think very highly of this company. Over the years, I’ve invested more than $14,000 into my own HVAC system with them, and they have been the only company to install or service it since day one. As a contractor myself, I’ve also referred over $50,000 worth of business from my own clients, family, and network — all because I trusted their professionalism and workmanship.
That trust has completely changed.
I recently discovered that a plastic drain-line connection at the unit was broken and appeared to have been covered up under a coupling during installation. When I lightly touched the line, the broken piece fell away — clearly not a new issue.
When I reached out to have it addressed, I was essentially told there was no proof they caused the damage, despite the fact that they are the only ones who have ever touched the system. I sent a respectful and detailed email explaining the situation and asking them to take responsibility — either under workmanship warranty or simply as a courtesy considering our long business history.
They never responded.
This experience has shown me that while they’re happy to take your money — and benefit from your referrals — they do not stand behind their work and will ignore customers once something goes wrong. Integrity and accountability matter, and unfortunately, this company showed none.
I can no longer recommend them to anyone, and that’s truly disappointing to say.

reviews.author: Peter Grant

I called Roto-Rooter on a recent Sunday as a main sewer line backup was going to wreck our Monday morning, getting everyone out of the house for school and work. No additional fee for a Sunday, no diagnostic fee, no roll charge. Awesome!

The team was thorough and stayed until the job was done right, including cleaning up after themselves. They even ran my kitchen drain for no additional charge because they wanted me to be happy and satisfied. I already was, but that was the cherry on top. I paid the originally quoted price.

I will definitely use Rotor-Rooter again when the need arises. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Jerod Slaton
reviews.text:
Overall it was a good experience. I got them to come out to my grandmothers house to get her sewer cleared. Pricing seemed a bit high but plumbing in general is. The technician did a fine job. Worked diligently. He called the camera supervisor out, Robert. Robert did the job and when it was finished he said “I’m going to go to Gwinnett and when I’m done I’ll email you a copy of the footage I did with some commentary. It will be a few hours from now”. Well that was back in mid-December and I never received the footage. I made several contact attempts but apparently it doesn’t mean anything. The last time I called in I was given his direct cell phone number and I never heard back. I’ve pretty much gave up. I figured he never actually recorded anything and didn’t want to say that. Overall, for the service of clearing the pipes, they did good. Customer service and following up to voicemails and promises that were made, you can forget it.

I would have given Wayne, the technician that actually cleared the pipes, 5 stars. If Robert Ethel (camera supervisor)did what he said or at least within a week or so got back to me with the footage, still 5 stars. However since I still haven’t heard back going on two months now, I’ll give 3 stars.

EDIT:
Roto Rooter reached out and got me the footage. They were very nice about it and apologized about the delay. Since they were very prompt in reply I will increase my star rating from 3 star up to 4 star. Thank you.
