What’s more, he also ended up helping with a heating issue I was having as well, and he helped me make an appointment with the HVAC division of Apollo  to get it fully resolved! Isiah was patient, funny, on time, professional, down to Earth, and - best of all - he explained everything thoroughly. I highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Dave Jones - Plumbing, HVAC, Fire Protection, Electrical
plumbers.address: 2225 Kilgust Rd, Madison, WI 53713, USA

reviews.author: Megan
reviews.text: Exceptional residential electric service was provided. I was referred by my builder to DJ. Electricians came on time, worked cleaned, and successfully installed per my request the same day.  Highly recommend and will definitely use for future needs. Electric outlets added with wires tucked safely in place, dimmers added…Rodney and Mike , thank you for your excellent service!!

reviews.author: Lukas Hamblen
reviews.text:
After gathering 3 separate estimates for a new furnace, I ultimately ended up using Dave Jones to complete the job.

Pricing was reasonable and everyone I interacted with was professional. They were able to come by the very next morning. Julie in the office was very helpful and I'm not sure about the names of the install/estimate teams but they were great. Thanks!

reviews.author: Megan Gilardi
reviews.text: Dave Jones has been an absolute pleasure to work with. It doesn’t take long to get on their schedule. They’re timely, responsive, and super well-knowledgeable no matter the situation. They’ve been able to help us with everything from installing new electrical outlets in our basement, to various plumbing repairs, and general maintenance and care of our HVAC systems. Each time they’ve provided thoughtful and effective guidance and repairs. They are our go-to for any of our plumbing, electrical, and HVAC needs!

reviews.author: Jon Lewis
reviews.text: The service technician who came braved extremely snowy conditions to make sure we got our heat back on.  He was knowledgeable and was able to diagnose the issue within 5 minutes.  He had the needed parts in stock on his vehicle and had our furnace working within 20 mins.  He also made sure to check other parts of the furnace to make sure they were in good repair before leaving.  I am very impressed.

reviews.author: Nicholas George
reviews.text: Great people who do great work, I’m thankful they helped me with my plumbing and radon problems, even when our builder didn’t. They own their work and quality. Refreshing change from these days where no one ever takes accountability for things. I can’t recommend them more.

plumbers.name: HEP is on the way
plumbers.address: 2394 Blue Springs Rd SE, Cleveland, TN 37311, USA

reviews.author: Summer Irwin
reviews.text: We were completely grateful for Travis! He was so informative and helpful in every single way possible. He was one of the best plumbers I have ever dealt with! He took time to talk to us and make us understand everything. Highly suggest and recommend him!! Very very pleased!

reviews.author: Monique Michelle Freeman Marziale
reviews.text: Worked tirelessly through the day in extreme cold ensure her unit was installed and she had heat before the colder temperatures really became a problem. Her unit was completely broken. 18 years old. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Valerie Taylor
reviews.text: Amanda came to our house quickly. She was extremely personable, efficient, and informative. She knew exactly what needed to happen and helped us understand what to look for in case we have future leaks.

reviews.author: Kinkuma
reviews.text: Jacob Newman and Doug Hurst came on short notice, quickly diagnosed the issue with my heating unit during a cold snap, and had it fixed before it got dark. They were patient and thorough and had great attention to detail. Overall great work and great customer service!

reviews.author: Sage Smith
reviews.text: Impressive! I had been putting off replacing my outdoor faucets for five years and had even called a different plumber prior to this who just told me there wasn't anything he could really do. HEP had someone come the day before (Paul) who did an excellent job explaining what they would need to do to install frost resistant faucets and how much it would cost. I felt the price was reasonable and fair. They were able to schedule someone for the next morning.  Garrett and Victor showed up on time, they were extremely respectful and friendly, worked quickly, quietly and cleaned up when they were done. They had to cut through a concrete and wood wall and did it flawlessly. The website is easily laid out, and the office staff did a fantastic job scheduling and taking my payment. Everyone I talked with was very professional. I'm so thankful to have found a great company to work with.

plumbers.name: Saffer Total Home Plumbing, Heating & Electrical
plumbers.address: 4247 Harford Rd, Baltimore, MD 21214, USA

reviews.author: Abby Ricko
reviews.text: Gary & Steve came out to check on a plumbing issue at my work space, and made the experience incredibly smooth and easy!!! They were communicative, prompt, knowledgeable, and so kind! They were able to pinpoint the problem right away as our water heater, explained the whole thing to me with ease, and had an installation plan ready to go right away. I am so appreciative of how seamlessly they took care of everything which completely eliminated any stress on my end. We have used Saffer Plumbing 3+ times and its an A+++ experience every time. Thanks guys!!!!

reviews.author: Asha Hislop Des Vignes
reviews.text:
Wonderful Service! So, refreshing to get real genuine service, knowledgeable and professionalism.

The morning of the appointment Scott called to let me know he was 15 minutes away. He was punctual!

Scott left a great first impression when he placed the blue mat outside my front door as to not track dirt or the wet rain.

Scott's communication and knowledge are top tier but what Absolutely won me over when he said he's bring CJ cause his words " I believe he can learn from this job" .

CJ was respectful, courteous and kind.

I will definitely recommend Saffer Plumbing.

reviews.author: Ken Brown
reviews.text: Knows his stuff.  Prompt, courteous, efficient.  Understands our concern in maintaining the integrity of our 50's vintage home.  He & Saffer offered the solution vs. others that just wanted to "rip everything out."  We'd have him/them back again.

reviews.author: Susan Miller
reviews.text: Saffer was wonderful to work with. They kept me informed throughout the entire process and explained everything to me. The team was wonderful. Will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: liang huang
reviews.text: Don't waste your time and money with them. Bad experience, failed installation, suffered one year until I found another independent plumber who fixed their failed installation in 2 hours. Will never deal with Saffer Plumbing again. To your comment below: I didn't want to pay the bill so you failed the installation, or the other way around? A business owner with such a logic capability is not far from failure.

plumbers.name: Modern Plumbing Industries, Inc.
plumbers.address: 255 Old Sanford Oviedo Rd, Winter Springs, FL 32708, USA

reviews.author: Karla Camilo
reviews.text: They came out on a Saturday when we had no water after our main water line broke, and it was such a stressful situation. They were quick to respond, explained everything in a way that was easy to understand, and got everything fixed fast. Their professionalism and responsiveness made a huge difference. I’m really grateful for their help and would definitely recommend Modern Plumbing to anyone who needs a reliable plumber.

reviews.author: Timothy Flynn
reviews.text: This company is awesome.  They’re quick to respond and even easier to work with. Chad was awesome to deal with.  He gave me all the options I asked for and didn’t try to pressure or upsell me on anything.  He gave me lots of choices and answered all the questions I had.  10/10 service.

reviews.author: Matthew Wyman
reviews.text: Chad and Brody did a great job of installing my new gas water heater. They made sure everything was done to code and nice and clean. They were respectful and finished the job in just about 4 hours. It looks great and I'm glad to have a good water heater!

reviews.author: Joseph V
reviews.text:
We’ve now used Modern Plumbing twice, once last year for a water heater install and most recently for a full water treatment system…both experiences were absolutely top-tier.

From the very first conversation, you can tell this is a company that operates differently. The quoting process was clear, transparent, and pressure-free. Ronald and Brody didn’t just “sell” us a system, they took the time to educate us on our options, explain how everything works, and answer every follow-up question we had. We felt informed and confident every step of the way.

Scheduling was seamless, communication was prompt, and they were extremely professional and respectful of our time. The installation itself was smooth, clean, and efficient. What really stands out is the follow-up and follow-through…they genuinely care that the system is working perfectly for your family, not just that the job is completed.

Every employee we’ve dealt with has been high-quality, knowledgeable, and clearly invested in the company’s reputation and customer satisfaction. That says a lot about the culture of the entire business.

If you’re looking for a plumbing company that combines expertise, integrity, and exceptional service from start to finish, Modern Plumbing is it. We couldn’t be happier!

reviews.author: Helen T
reviews.text:
First time using Modern Plumbing in Winter Springs.  The technicians, Chad and Josh were very courteous and explained the repairs that I requested.  I am very satisfied with them and if needed I will call again and request them.
Update:  Chad and Josh came back to the house and installed the new toilets.  Their work is excellent and very neat.  While they were here, I asked them to inspect the hot water heater.  Due to the age of the unit, they were able to install a new one at the same time.  I am extremely happy with them and the service I received!

plumbers.name: Mr. Holland's Home Services
plumbers.address: 2400 S Commerce Dr, New Berlin, WI 53151, USA

reviews.author: Jessica Snow
reviews.text: Brian Gaschk, what can I say…Amazing! Thank you to Mr. Holland’s and Brian for restoring my power after a tree branch ripped the electrical mast off my house on a Friday afternoon. To have power back on a Saturday afternoon meant the world to me. Highly recommended service! A++

reviews.author: Don Dinsmore
reviews.text: George was a very knowledgeable tech. After his inspection he explained everything that he found. He had taken pictures to insure that we knew and totally understood what his results had shown. I would definitely recommend both George and Mr. Holland's Home Services. Excellent employees. Make sure that you retain these good employees.

reviews.author: Lynn Conner
reviews.text:
Do not use Hollands. Ever since they were bought by PE their service techs are unreliable , dishonest and not knowledgeable.
We had the club membership that included AC/furnace tuneups annually and a discount off any services needed. During my last two tuneups on my furnace there have been issues according to their techs. The first time the tech came for a tuneup was there for hours, then told me a part was broken and my furnace wouldn’t work but it had been working fine prior to him being there.  They told me we needed a new part that would cost about $1K… very sketchy
(Hollands fixed it no charge… )

Recently I was told by George that our furnace was deemed unsafe due to high CO PPM. And he shut off my furnace same day and told me it would be 1-3 weeks to get a new heat exchanger and they suggested due to age that we get a new furnace. I said so I would be without heat for 1-3 weeks waiting for a part? He said yes. But we could have a new system put in in days. He and Brett their sales guy were very pushy about this. I had a different hvac company out the next day for a second opinion and he told me my furnace was absolutely fine and in good working order!!
Hollands uses scare tactics and misleading information to gain sales. Please consider going elsewhere. As a homeowner I’m disgusted that in trying to have peace of mind and maintain my home I am instead lied to.

reviews.author: Hawk Tuft
reviews.text: Mr hollands has been great so far. They are a little loose with their time estimates but they have patience and will be reasonable. They won’t be the cheapest option but their techs are amazingly competent and professional and will not leave you worried about the finished work. So overall price is high, but reflects their quality of workmanship.

reviews.author: Steve Storm
reviews.text: I had contacted Mr Holland because our floor drain was backing up in the basement and I assumed that there was a blockage at some point in our city lateral.  The scheduler was very helpful and was able to get a plumber out in less than 24 hours.  I couldn't be more impressed with the technician that came out.  Josh was very friendly, professional, and transparent in everything he did.  He was able to find and clear the blockage in less than 1.5 hours.  Awesome.  The downside to the whole experience, as it often is with a bigger company, is the price.  I strongly feel that $700 dollars for this service is much too high given average rates for plumbers, as well as a trip charge.  My advice to a homeowner considering Mr Holland.  If you have a plumbing issue and need it resolved quickly and correctly, use them; however, if you have the luxury of time and the ability to shop around for a lower cost, do that.  5/5 rating for the plumber's friendliness and professionalism, 1/5 rating for the overall cost.

plumbers.name: Arlinghaus Plumbing Heating & Air Conditioning
plumbers.address: 11575 Goldcoast Dr, Cincinnati, OH 45249, USA

reviews.author: Pamela Vasquez
reviews.text: Wonderful experience from start to finish. Sam who came out and did the consultation was wonderful and very informative. He made us feel completely at ease. The crew that came and did the install was professional and quick. 6 hrs complete old system removed and entire new system installed. I would highly recommend Arlinghaus services they really are the happy house people. Thank you to everyone.

reviews.author: Andy Schoenhoft
reviews.text:
Maurice did an amazing job installing a new water heater in our home. He is extremely knowledgeable about the entire system annd very honest annd upfront with our options. He identified and corrected some piping issues that we had with our old installation. He was extremely conscientious about protecting our floors/carpeting and was very neat and efficient in his work.
We are already planning on some additional plumbing work and will request him by name.
Thanks Maurice!!!

reviews.author: Patrick Quinn
reviews.text:
I would highly recommend Arlinghaus for HVAC replacement! We took advantage of their free furnace promotion to have our AC and furnace replaced.

Lonnie did a fantastic job during the consultation, providing me with options and helping me understand what system would be best for our home. He even addressed specific concerns and requests as part of our quote.

Steve did a great job during installation as well. He and his partner worked quickly, and made sure to show me the different features available, including how to set different thermostat options, and how to change our filter. He also helped me set options to help our house feel more comfortable year-round.

Overall, the consultants and techs were helpful, friendly, and clearly took care and pride in their work. I would definitely recommend their services!

reviews.author: Sandy Bathe
reviews.text: What can I say? I’m extremely impressed! Arlinghaus is a reputable company that is professional in every aspect of Service. I haven’t seen this in years. I definitely recommend them and will have them service my heating and air again. This company is a breath of fresh air. Thank you so much. My technician Chris was very thorough and wonderful to have in my home.

reviews.author: Danielle Curry
reviews.text: Lamar was amazing! Very professional and personable. He listened to all my concerns and answered all of my questions. Very knowledgeable about the products and didn't try to upset me. He kept it very basic and easy to understand.  He managed to get my installation scheduled for the next day and did the consultation on a Sunday. 1000% would recommend!!!

plumbers.name: Patriot Pros Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electric
plumbers.address: 701 Park St, Castle Rock, CO 80109, USA

reviews.author: Matthew McKell
reviews.text:
I called Patriot Pros this afternoon to schedule an AC appointment, and the experience was outstanding. They arrived within an hour, right on time, and called ahead before arriving.

The technician was friendly, knowledgeable, and quickly diagnosed the issue as a bad capacitor, which they replaced on the spot. They also took the time to explain what happened and shared preventative maintenance tips, with no upselling.

Best of all, the total cost was only $50. Excellent service, great communication, and honest pricing. I highly recommend Patriot Pros.

reviews.author: Eerie Autumn Breeze
reviews.text:
They advertise seven-star service.
So—
I’m adding five more stars of my own: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ because they did better than just seven.
These guys are great. Seriously. They are very professional and you get what you pay for. On their way out to my house for the service call, they even offered to pick something up from the store, just in case I needed anything.
They fixed my a/c unit issue while they were out, too! Patriot Pros, you just picked up a new loyal customer!

reviews.author: mike zollinger
reviews.text: We had Patriot Pros come out to look at our older furnaces and a/c units.  Communication was top notch from the initial booking call to the appointment.  They explained everything in detail and made sure to ask if we had any questions along the way.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Tobias Tony
reviews.text:
There are few words to express the absolute professionalism, respect and service I got from both Jeremiah Gray and Rhett Parker Mudge.  Their service was far beyond what I would ever expect to receive from two technicians whom I have never met.

Everyone knows that calling up a company to get work done is daunting and you never know if you’re going to get taken advantage of or not.  Jeremiah and Rhett were completely forthcoming and honest when quoting me for a potentially large and costly job.  They took no shortcuts in diagnosing the problem with my septic tank and giving me realistic insight into what the job entailed and how much it would run.  They provided me constant updates to include pictures and findings while at my house looking at the septic tank.

I called two other companies before using Patriot Pros and did not receive the level of customer service or care that Jeremiah and Rhett provided me with.

It is absolutely necessary that we as a society stop to honor and commend the men who provide quality care and service when it is not commanded in our current world.  Furthermore,  we must deliberately defend and rigorously endorse those who provide quality craftsmanship in an age where the mundane and crooked so often are the first encounter when help is requested.

Rhett and Jeremiah walk among us as men, more than likely without ever asking for consideration or pause…. Today I honor them with this review in that many will read my words and decide to invest in more than mere words or slogans from a company… Rather that they too may receive the level of virtue and warmth that Rhett and Jeremia bestowed upon my home and my septic tank.

God speed to these two men ….

reviews.author: Linda Richmond
reviews.text: Great service from dispatch to promptly sending out two plumbers. Dispatch made sure they called before servicing and send alerts.  So helpful. The two plumbers were thoughtful and respectful and gave me options (inexpensive option or major repair) that would work. Excellent 5 star work. I’ll definitely keep using Patriot Pros!

plumbers.name: Jim's Plumbing Now
plumbers.address: 2418 Marsh Ln #106, Carrollton, TX 75006, USA

reviews.author: Christina Brown
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Jim’s Plumbing. The service number staff had excellent communication and made scheduling easy from start to finish. The technician, Malik, was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to clearly explain the problem I was having. He did a great job addressing my concerns and making sure everything was handled properly. I’m very satisfied with the service and would definitely recommend Jim’s Plumbing.

UPDATE: I called Jim’s Plumbing to do some more work for me. I needed a new water heater and some work done on my outside hose bibs. Review following: I had a great experience with Jim’s Plumbing. The contractor, Malik, was very knowledgeable about his duties and was able to problem-solve with ease. He was communicative throughout the process and very pleasant to speak with. Overall, he did an outstanding job, and I would highly recommend Jim’s Plumbing. Old pics versus new water heater.

reviews.author: Susan Donohoe
reviews.text:
Great job. James came to the job early and stayed late in order to have the job completed before the predicted ice storm. I found the price reasonable. The area was pristine when completed and he spent time explaining the vagaries of the water heater in detail. James was pleasant and professional and I will certainly call Jim’s Plumbing for any further plumbing needs for my home or my rental units.
Susan Donohoe

reviews.author: Hugo Leal
reviews.text: After foundation repair I Called Jim’s plumbing for a hydrostatic test and confirm if I had any leaks beneath the foundation , so they got me on the schedule asap and sent out an excavation crew next day .the next day I call Jim’s plumbing they sent Victor  and Steve to do an amazing job fixing all plumbing under the foundation ,very meticulous, great communication and easy to talk . 100% satisfied with his work and professionalism

reviews.author: Susan Diane Mackey
reviews.text: I highly recommend Jim’s Plumbing Now for any sewer and/or water line issues. I had a major sewer line issue and their team was incredibly professional and knowledgeable. From the initial inspection using camera technology, to tunneling under the house, to locating the issue and the final repair,  Chris, explained every step along the way. The team was on time, they worked very efficiently and were very careful to minimize  the disruption to my yard.. The price was fair and there were no last-minute unexpected fees.  If you need sewer and/or water line work done right, call Jim’s Plumbing Now. Be sure to ask for Chris, who did an outstanding job!!!    Thanks Chris!

reviews.author: Amelia and Andy also Piper and James 1,000 like's
reviews.text: Larry is amazing! He is so nice and informative. I had talked to some other companies but they were trying to make me pay an extraordinary amount of money and still didn’t know what was wrong. He came in and solved it and the cost was great and not what the other people said. I will use this company from now on! Larry is the best! He knows his stuff and works hard.

plumbers.name: Citywide Sewer-Drain & Plumbing Corp
plumbers.address: 100 Voice Rd, Carle Place, NY 11514, USA

reviews.author: Sara Chand
reviews.text: I had a last-minute plumbing emergency at my residence, and Nathan from  CityWide Plumbing⁠￼ came out to help. We were very pleased with his work. He was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain everything clearly. He made sure we understood exactly what was causing the toilet clog and leak, and kept us informed throughout the process. Nathan also made sure I received my invoice before he left. His customer service was excellent, and I truly appreciated his patience and attention to detail. I would highly recommend Nathan and CityWide Plumbing to anyone in need of plumbing services.

reviews.author: DL Nu
reviews.text:
Devaughn was outstanding.
What started as a backup and frozen line issue turned out to be more involved than expected. He stayed calm, methodical, and committed to resolving the problem properly — even working late to ensure everything was flowing as it should before leaving.
He treated my home with respect, cleaned as he worked, and maintained a professional, steady presence throughout the process.
What impressed me most was his composure and work ethic. He never rushed, never seemed overwhelmed, and clearly takes pride in doing things the right way.
CityWide is fortunate to have him.
Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Cory Salas
reviews.text: This was our first experience with Citywide and I must say they exceeded all expectations even after exploring their impeccable reviews. From first entering our home to the time he left, Gary was as polished as they come. He was extremely knowledgeable, informative,  patient,  and congenial. His precise attention to detail, and his ability to assess the problem that plagued our stack line causing our kitchen sink to back up significantly,  clearly demonstrated his extensive experience and genuine passion for his field. Fixing the problem in and of itself is enough to make any customer content but then combining that with superb customer service is remarkable. Gary took the time  to discuss any questions we had with proper care and maintenence and this is what made Gary truly stand out among any such service we used previously. We are now loyal members to this company and I can't thank Citywide enough for establishing such an honest, trustworthy and exceptional brand. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Rodney and Roberta Kapuy
reviews.text: Good service!  Quick response! Steven was very nice and worked hard to do the job. The only thing that I thought was the cost of $550.00 I had to pay to connect the piping to the garage line though the dry wall to the water line in the garage. They said the insurance didn’t cover that.  But for only doing that!  $550.00 which to me was high. It took probably less then 1/2 hour to connect that section. That was the only thing why my score was a 4 star only. Other than that it would have been a 5 star. I know everyone wants to make money but be realistic on the price.  Thank you!

reviews.author: Louise Munsch
reviews.text: Due to recent weather in Log Beach, NY we had some pipe damages.  Our regular plumber was swamped and unable to get to us for a couple of days and our heating and cooling company said it would be able to get to us on Friday which was four days away.  A friend recommended Citywide that came within a hour.  Their service was quick, excellent and price conscious.  I highly recommend using them since they have many plumbers who are efficient, pleasant and provide great work

plumbers.name: Mr. Plumber Plumbing Co.
plumbers.address: 21750 Hardy Oak Blvd Suite 9, San Antonio, TX 78258, USA

reviews.author: Joseph Vidaurri
reviews.text: We called Champion off of a referral from some friends. We were pleasantly surprised on the outstanding service we received. From setting the appointment with Carla to the technician, Barrett, who performed the installation of our new water heater. He was very friendly and professional. He explained several options that we could go with and did a good job explaining the various add ons and features of our system. We will definitely be doing business again with Champion.

reviews.author: Greg White
reviews.text: Excellent service and completed work. Jose was very knowledgeable in his trade. He completed a re-piping of drain/vents and set a new shower valve for a bathroom remodel in 1 day. Everyone involved from Champion was professional and courteous. I feel the completed work was well worth the cost and would highly recommend Champion.

reviews.author: Jan Gregory
reviews.text:
Michael assessed and recommended the perfect solution for replacing / upgrading the water softner/treatment system that I had installed in 2022. He did an amazing job with the replacement of the softner unit and installation of the brine tank in the new shed. He left the work area in impeccable condition and even removed the old system and reverse osmosis unit that was also replaced.
I would gladly welcome having Micheal supporting any plumbing need through Champion services!

reviews.author: Rudy Cavazos
reviews.text: Barret was an awesome guy. He’s down-to-earth and knows his stuff. He not only gave me recommendations and explained why, but he also outlined his game plan, the improvements I could expect, and how everything works with a water heater. He did a fantastic job. Every part he installed looks clean and professional, and he left everything spotless when he was done. I highly recommend him for any water heater installation.

reviews.author: Mary Katherine Jones
reviews.text: You never want to need a plumber. It’s not a call you look forward to making or an appointment you’re eager to have, but Champion has been a phenomenal company to work with. Austin was our specialist and he was prompt, polite, and efficient, getting a stubborn kitchen sink back in functioning order! I hope I don’t have to see him again, but if I ever do have any plumbing needs, I know that Austin (or any other Champion technicians) will help me resolve my issues!

plumbers.name: Mr. Central
plumbers.address: 1926 Richland Ave E, Aiken, SC 29801, USA

reviews.author: Andrea So
reviews.text: I had an excellent customer experience with Mr. Central. With regard to scheduling, they booked my appointment and our technician, Oscar arrived within two hours of my call for service. He did a great job diagnosing and fixing the issue with our tankless water heater. He explained everything that was causing the problem and gave me multiple options (including cost free options) for how to address it. The service fee for the visit was reasonable and transparent. I am very happy with this company and would schedule with them again.

reviews.author: Jessica Coleman
reviews.text:
Jeremy was thorough, he took his time and he answered all my questions. He went out of his way to find out answers to some questions I had that he wasn't sure of related to payment. He explained the process of what they would do and made me feel confident with choosing then to get the job done right the first time.
Jeremy and Nik did an incredible job with installing our new water heater and gas lines for fireplace. The neatly mounted the water heater and safely removed the old water heater tank. They were very clean making sure to put booties on every time they entered the home. They cleaned up the yard very well after digging for the gas lines. We are extremely pleased with the work they did and the professionalism. We will be using them again in the future!

reviews.author: Lawretta Cameron
reviews.text:
Felix did an amazing job on our HVAC system! He was professional, knowledgeable, and explained everything in a way that was easy to understand. He showed up on time, worked efficiently, and made sure everything was running perfectly before he left.

What I appreciated most was his honesty and attention to detail — no upselling, just real solutions. You can tell he takes pride in his work and truly cares about his customers.

If you’re looking for someone reliable and trustworthy for your heating and air needs, I highly recommend Felix and the Mr Central team!

Thank you so much! From the Simpkins family!

reviews.author: David MacIntyre
reviews.text: Nick and Mark came to do my yearly plumbing review and look at a leaky toilet. The toilet needed to be overhalled and after discussing three options I decided to go with a new toilet and they were able to do it while they were here. They did a fantastic job and were very careful with my house and very considerate about wearing shoe covers and were great at asking questions and giving me information. I highly recommend this company and the folks that work for Mr. Central.

reviews.author: CeeCee P.
reviews.text: Jeremy Butler was my technician. He was so professional and efficient. I appreciate him taking time to explain what was wrong and going into detail on how he fixed it. I felt very comfortable giving him space and letting him work. Thank you for the awesome experience and we will be in touch. If you’re in Aiken I highly recommend them.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 1750 Finley Rd, Lombard, IL 60148, USA

reviews.author: Joe Byelick
reviews.text: I booked an appointment online for early Sunday morning just the day before. For no extra fee, the service technician came out as scheduled. Mac tech #3824 did a great job rodding a significant kitchen sink blockage that probably built up over the years.  He had to rod it a few times for it to unblock.  Other plumbers I called for an emergency weekend repair were unavailable.  Very satisfied with the work done by Mac and would recommend to others.

reviews.author: Fiona Ian
reviews.text: We called Roto-Rooter for help with our clogged toilet in our basement and our assigned technician named Mac arrived within 15 minutes of our call. He was more than accommodating and professional in identifying the issue (sewage main line clog) and thorough inspection of our entire water line. He worked tirelessly from his arrival in the morning (10am) until the entire issue was fixed around 3:45pm. The issues and repair work were: main sewer line blockage, clear thru basement clean out, shower drain stoppage, cable and cleared thru drain. He gave us a generous discount and ensured 6 months warranty. We will definitely work with him again, and we thank him for his professionalism and commitment to getting this resolved for us. reviews.author: Joseph Lee
reviews.text:
Honestly, I’d give 10 stars.
I had been without water since yesterday, and at first, I brushed it off, thinking the nearby construction was the cause. But when the faucets were still dry this morning, worry started to creep in. After calling the water utility and hearing that the problem was on our end, I spent a long time searching for the leak—finally finding water seeping out near the meter.
I reached out to Roto-Rooter, and that’s when Riley arrived. He stepped out of the truck with a warm, genuine smile that immediately eased my stress. In the freezing cold, he knelt down and dug through the ground with his hands, determined to find the source of the problem. He went out of his way to get rust‑resistant parts so the repair would last, and he worked with such care and integrity that it honestly moved me.
He didn’t leave until everything was fully restored, checking and rechecking to make sure the water was flowing properly again. He even gave us a discount—something he didn’t have to do but did anyway. Before he left, he wished us a blessed day, and it felt sincere.
Thanks to Riley, we finally have water again. After a stressful, uncomfortable day, his kindness and professionalism turned everything around. If five stars is the limit, then he deserves double.

The technicians ended up getting really busy, so the scheduling team rescheduled me for Saturday, February 14, 2026. This all happened while I was sleeping on the couch, but to their credit, they notified me by phone call, text message, and email. I truly appreciated the communication and professionalism.

My technician, William, was absolutely professional, friendly, and knowledgeable. As a new homeowner, I was grateful that he took the time to give me helpful plumbing tips and explain things clearly. That meant a lot to me.

Overall, my experience was great. I was honestly nervous about what the cost would be, but it turned out to be very reasonable. I highly recommend Roto-Rooter and would definitely use their services again.

reviews.author: Gerald DeLoatch
reviews.text: Ryan was very professional and honest. He explained the problem and gave me options on how to resolve the issue. After he finished he told me to check his work to make sure everything was satisfactory . I will definitely use this company again.

reviews.author: Mandie Ashlock
reviews.text: Garnet came out to fix the pipes under my kitchen sink and did a great job. He showed up on time, was professional, and took the time to explain what was going on before getting started. The repair was done quickly and everything is working perfectly now. He also made sure everything was cleaned up before he left, which I really appreciated. It’s clear he knows what he’s doing and takes pride in his work. I would definitely recommend Garnet to anyone who needs plumbing work done. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Gabrielle Campbell
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with my plumbing technician. He was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and transparent from start to finish. Before anything was set or finalized, he took the time to explain everything clearly, what the issue was, what needed to be done, and what my options were. There were no surprises at all, which I really appreciated. He answered all my questions patiently and made sure I was comfortable with the plan before moving forward. The work was done efficiently and with great attention to detail.

plumbers.name: Armstrong Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 2551 Albatross Wy, Sacramento, CA 95815, USA

reviews.author: Jateen Jivan
reviews.text: Mo, Fred and team did an excellent job on a spot repair of my sewer line. They were very courteous, straightforward and honest. Thanks again fellas, you were spot on and with the concrete work they took their time on it, leaving a very clean final product. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Tanya Scott
reviews.text:
I called Armstrong Plumbing after another company failed to resolve a main line backup in my home. Carlos arrived, listened carefully, and immediately understood the layout of my older 1954 home. He used the correct cleanout (the kitchen cleanout), cleared the clog quickly, and then ran a camera inspection to confirm everything was flowing properly.
He explained that my home was originally built with only one cleanout and that there was no second cleanout under the patio, which contradicted what I had been told earlier. He also confirmed there was no pipe damage and no tree root intrusion on my property. His knowledge of older homes was obvious, and he took the time to show me the camera footage and explain what I was seeing.
Carlos was professional, honest, and extremely thorough. I finally felt like I was getting accurate information. I highly recommend Armstrong Plumbing, especially for older homes.

reviews.author: Letisha Wilson
reviews.text: I called Armstrong this morning based on a referral from another client. When I called and explained my issue they were quick to respond and assure they could assist. A tech was here within the hour. He looked at my sewer backup at the main line and advised this would be easy fix. Just needed a few mins. Of course the prior day another company came and advised I would need an expensive two way clean out. Carlos was able to get everything cleared. Confirmed toilets were flushing. Not only did this save me a bunch of money but it as handled quickly. I needed working bathrooms with my elderly mother living with me. I’d highly recommend Armstrong to others and keeping them saved for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Paul VanderKlay
reviews.text: Carlos was outstanding! 4th guy to run a camera through my sewer line first guy to spot two cleanouts that no one knew about. Dug up one of them with his partner. This was all on a visit to give us a quote. Very impressed.

reviews.author: Gisele Geiger
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Armstrong. Peter was able to troubleshoot the issue with our shower diverter and order the part from Germany. He was promptly scheduled to perform the repairs as soon as the part came in and he quickly finished the installation. We’ll definitely use Armstrong in the future to support our plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Wighton's Electric, Plumbing, Heating, and Air
plumbers.address: 183 Prado Rd, San Luis Obispo, CA 93401, USA

reviews.author: Janie Buenrostro
reviews.text: As a homeowner,  we have not had the best experiences with certain trades.  That was definitely not the case with Wighton!  From the beginning of the process, every employee we dealt with,  was incredibly professional AND respected our home as they carried out the project.  The representative who first came to assess our needs was timely, and informative.   The superintendent who came for the walk-through to confirm that the notes he had, matched what we were expecting,  also was very thorough.   The employees who carried out and performed the actual project showed up ON TIME, were so respectful of our home, they were courteous,  knowledgeable and professional.   I will not hesitate to call upon Wighton again, should the need arise.  Every employee who represented Wighton, was outstanding and so professional.   We love our ministry Split unit.  THANK-YOU!

reviews.author: B Wal
reviews.text:
I’ve relied on Wighton’s for a few home repairs in the last year.

I’ve had 2 leaks on my recirculating pipes in the last few years that were repaired by other plumbing companies …and they both failed.  Wightons came in, assessed the problem, and came up with a much stronger solution.   Everything has been working great since.

Last summer, My AC died and they came and did some troubleshooting.  I found out my compressor was dead and was going to cost thousands to fix.  I had an existing warranty on my compressor, and they went to bat for me to get a replacement from the manufacturer after the manufacturer initially said no.  They also worked with me on the price to save me money where they could.

I purchased an annual inspection package with the AC repair, and I recently had them out to do an inspection of the heating system.  Fortunately everything checked our great, and they’ll be back in a few months to look at the AC again before the summer starts.

The staff have all been fantastic to work with.   Each one has been so friendly and respectful.  Moreover, they seem to really care about the work that they do.  I will continue to use Wightons for any home repair needs that come up

reviews.author: Clifford Lively
reviews.text: Austin came and fixed our heater that stopped working last night.  We called this morning around 8 and we were lucky that he arrived around 10.  Very prompt service!  Austin is very polite and friendly.  He got it taken care of and we are so happy to have heat in our home with the part he replaced. We have been very satisfied every time we have had to call.   Thank you very much Wighton's for taking care of us.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.text:
I had a plumbing emergency this morning when I discovered water leaking from my ceiling around 6:15 AM after flushing an upstairs toilet. I called Wighton’s Plumbing before 7:00 AM, and they had someone at my house by a little after 8:00 AM.
Nate was fantastic! He quickly diagnosed the issue, walked me through everything he was doing, cleared the blockage, and verified that everything was working properly again. His professionalism and expertise truly saved the day.
I highly recommend Wighton’s Plumbing to anyone needing reliable, fast, and quality service!

reviews.author: Kathleen Miller
reviews.text: Your agent was very professional and did a wonderful job getting my water heater working again.  He said that I probably need to get a better one.  What do you recommend?  Thank you.

plumbers.name: Andersen Plumbing, Heating and AC Repair
plumbers.address: 700 Terry Ave, Aurora, IL 60506, USA

reviews.author: Anthony DiAngelo
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Joe and the Anderson team. Joe replaced our sump pump and was outstanding to work with. He took the time to educate us, clearly laid out all of our options, and explained the trade-offs so we could make an informed decision—no pressure, just solid guidance. The quality of the work was excellent.

We’ve had Anderson out to our house multiple times over the past few months for different issues, and each experience has been consistently superb. Professional, knowledgeable, and reliable service every time. We wouldn’t hesitate to call Joe or Anderson again.

reviews.author: Mariah Wright
reviews.text: Nate & Zach were great! They were on time, very polite and very knowledgeable. Immediately was able to identify the issue and provide a solution. Walked me through everything in a way I understood. Great service all around! “Im just a girl” lol and I was able to explain the issue no problem to my husband as well. 10/10!!

reviews.author: Jeanette Hoffman
reviews.text: Jon and Cesar came out to diagnose a noise I heard coming from the furnace. They arrived quickly, were polite and professional and did a thorough inspection of the entire furnace. They were able to figure out the issue and discussed with me the other things they saw that looked like they should be addressed to keep the furnace running smoothly. They offered me different options on what to repair urgently and what should be addressed but could wait a bit longer. They were not pushy at all and explained everything thoroughly while showing me pictures of what they were seeing. I continue to use Anderson because every time I’ve needed them this is the same reliable and professional service I receive.

reviews.author: Max
reviews.text:
I recently had a bathtub faucet installed by Andersen, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Evan and Michelle were professional, courteous, and clearly knew what they were doing. They took the time to make sure everything was installed properly and working perfectly before they left.

Their workmanship was clean and precise, and they made sure the area was spotless when the job was finished. It’s clear they take pride in the quality of their work. I would definitely recommend this company to anyone looking for reliable and professional plumbing services.

reviews.author: Andre Porche
reviews.text:
We had an outstanding experience working with Joe Harkins. From the moment he arrived, he demonstrated a high level of professionalism, knowledge, and attention to detail. He took the time to thoroughly assess our home and carefully identify the source of the leak, explaining each step of the process in a clear and reassuring manner.
Joe truly went above and beyond to ensure we felt confident that the issue was properly diagnosed and that our system was secure. His expertise and patience gave us peace of mind during what could have been a very stressful situation.
In addition, he provided thoughtful recommendations for trusted services that could assist with the necessary repairs. That extra level of guidance showed that he genuinely cares about his clients and the long-term well-being of their homes.
We highly recommend Joe Harkins to anyone in need of a knowledgeable, dependable, and customer-focused professional.

plumbers.name: Plumb Crazy Plumbing
plumbers.address: 308 W Britton Rd, Oklahoma City, OK 73114, USA

reviews.author: Dale C Courtney JR
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Plumb Crazy Plumbing. The technician, Tim, was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. He arrived on time, quickly diagnosed the issue, and completed the work without any unnecessary delays. Everything was explained clearly, and the quality of his work was excellent. It’s clear he takes pride in what he does. I really appreciated how smooth and stress-free the whole process was. I would absolutely recommend Plumb Crazy Plumbing and would be happy to have Tim back for any future work!

reviews.author: Ramona Campos
reviews.text: Happy with service from this company. Able to schedule estimate online and got a confirmation of appt within the hour. Day of appointment, I received a text 30 minutes prior to arrive and arrived within the requested time frame. Jesse did a great job of explaining the process, giving me the quote and told me it was good for 30 days. After speaking to my daughter, we decided to rescheduled for actual appointment. Again online and quick response from company to confirm. The same tech Jesse came out and quickly completed the job within the hour. Fair pricing, within what I was expecting for pay for the job. (Single Bibb Replacement- should cost anywhere from $300-400; paid $375 for service). Overall, very pleased with service and will call again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Dina
reviews.text: I had a pipe burst under my house when temperatures dropped below zero, and Plumb Crazy was amazing. They sent a plumber within two hours, and he was wonderful, efficient, thorough, and clearly knew what he was doing. There was no dragging out the job or padding the bill, which I truly appreciated. Great service, honest pricing, and fast response. I will 100% use them again and recommend them to anyone needing a plumber.

reviews.author: Miranda Mohi
reviews.text: We have used Plumb Crazy the last 20 years, since 2006. We have had some big and small jobs to complete and they do a great job for a fair price. They are always polite and prompt, and I feel they communicate with us well about appointments! Thank you!

reviews.author: Michael Stephanic
reviews.text:
ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC

The late January winter storm Fern wreaked havoc on plumbing in and around Oklahoma. Even while leaving our hot and cold water faucets dribble to prevent freezing, we ended up with a cracked hot water pipe underneath the house. I called Plumb Crazy Plumbing, figuring I wouldn’t get a tech out for days in this weather and with so many others dealing with broken pipes. Instead, Plumb Crazy had a technician at our house within the hour.

My tech, Kevin arrived with his assistant and they checked out the damage, gave me a quote, and had the problem fixed in less than an hour. They were extremely friendly, polite, professional and well-trained. The price was great. The service was prompt and efficient. The warranty was very reasonable and totally unexpected. And the follow-up from Plumb Crazy was above and beyond what I’ve had from other plumbers. I highly recommend Plumb Crazy Plumbing for all your plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Drain Genie Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 750 S Orange Blossom Trl #141, Orlando, FL 32805, USA

reviews.author: Philip Saintelus
reviews.text: Juan was exceptionally professional and efficient from start to finish. He quickly identified the issues with both my kitchen and bathroom sinks and explained what needed to be done in a clear, reassuring way. Throughout the entire process, he worked with care and attention to detail, making sure everything was fixed properly and functioning smoothly before he left. I also really appreciated that he took the time to thoroughly clean up after completing the repairs, leaving the space even tidier than before. Overall, his workmanship, respect for my home, and friendly attitude made the whole experience outstanding. I would definitely recommend Juan for anyone needing reliable and high-quality service.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text:
Their hearts are in the right place — Terry and Dante were kind and worked hard, and I truly appreciate their time and effort. 🙏

That said, the company’s overall workmanship felt a bit sketchy. We had our HVAC ductwork “redone,” but it turned out to be more of a patch job than a professionally finished project.  I also had to stay on top of them and point things out repeatedly — otherwise, several issues would’ve been left unfixed. 😬     The issues we noticed include:
•	Ducts not properly hung or brought up to code
•        The plenum was torn in 3 places leaking air into attic, I had to call them back to fix this.
•	Moldy vents and registers left untouched (even though the job was meant to address that)
•	Only two workers sent for a very large project, which stretched into three separate visits
•	Consistent lateness — plan to block out the whole day waiting for arrival 😕

I don’t blame the technicians; they seemed to be doing their best with what they had. The shortcomings appear to reflect how the company operates overall.

Will this add value to the home? Probably not — but at least it should keep things running for now, hopefully safely 🤞 and with better air quality for our family. 🌬️ Also hoping our $600 electric bill comes down now that the plenum holes are patched.  I will get a UV light for the air handler unit to help clean the passing air. 3 SOLID STARS ….Terry, I hope you guys win the contest. 😉

reviews.author: LaDarius Graham
reviews.text: Terry did an excellent job with the repairs around my house that were needed. Gave me an upfront price and completed the job quicker than the estimated time. Air conditioner works like new I would highly recommend him again if I need him

reviews.author: David Polk
reviews.text: Leo and Jose did an outstanding job with my AC maintenance. They were professional, efficient, and clearly knew what they were doing. Everything was handled smoothly, and they made sure the system was working perfectly before they left. Excellent service all around—I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Andrea Peña
reviews.text: Unfortunately have to leave yet another 1 star review for this company. The technicians are clearly doing only what they can with what they have but yet again my home repiping project has been stalled for over 2 months. I had to initiate and consistently check in to ensure the permits were being followed up on. I also had to be very on top of them to ensure things were up to code before the inspection, as some items were left incomplete the days leading up to it. Krystle tries to help at first but then disappears. It’s truly disheartening they don’t take into consideration that this is someone’s home and provide timely service to complete a project. To fix my wall repairs it has taken over 3 weeks with the technician only coming 1-2 hours at time. Overall just disheartened by this whole process and feel that they can’t be trusted to provide any accurate timeline.

plumbers.name: Alco Air
plumbers.address: 4412 US-259, Longview, TX 75605, USA

reviews.author: Paula Cromwell
reviews.text:
Danny from Alco came out yesterday to perform our semi annual HVAC maintenance. He did a great job! He is courteous, knowledgeable and professional. He found a few items we need to address over the next few months to prepare for this summer’s heat.

He carefully explained what repairs need to be done showed us where these problems existed. He also gave us a couple of options for moving forward. The estimates were thoroughly explained. We feel more than comfortable with his recommendations.

reviews.author: Tasha Lewis
reviews.text: Had an issue with my unit and they came right out, blessed us to be back running same day. Justin was quick and helpful to our family. Highly recommend and will use in the future

reviews.author: Millie McWilliams
reviews.text: Professional, honest, and efficient. We couldn’t be happier with their work! They took time to find answers to all of the problems we were having due to another company’s improper installation. They had everything fixed the next day. The communication was excellent from start to finish and everyone was extremely nice! We would absolutely recommend Alco to anyone needing HVAC work.

reviews.author: Claude Hammond
reviews.text: The last three times I got an ALCO estimate to do work, I got a second opinion. EVERY TIME, the second opinion I got told me the problem was much less $$$ than what ALCO recommended. I went with the second opinion (different companies) every time. TOTAL SAVINGS BY NOT GOING WITH ALCO: $14,000. It seems that ever since this company's merger or acquisition with McWilliams went through, along with a name-change,  -- and then they changed their name back to ALCO again -- they give super-expensive estimates. The final straw for me came after ALCO serviced our AC. Shortly after, all the coolant drained out of the unit. I called someone else, and the new guy showed me that a bottle cap had been used to plug up the AC unit. So I called ALCO -- and it took them 3 weeks to get back with me -- and they said I couldn't prove it was their fault.  That's it. I'm not using ALCO.

reviews.author: Noah Deering
reviews.text:
Rats had destroyed our ducts, so Alco came out and replaced them and the vents, and added a new one in an unvented bathroom. Overall, they were pretty professional and efficient, but there were a couple of annoying things:
- The workers left multiple dirty work shirts laying around on my property.
- The workers used my rented dumpster to dump everything, which was fine, but had I not had it, would they have left the debris in my yard? They had no way of hauling anything away.
- The vents installed were mostly done horribly, leaving holes, scratches, debris and messy looks afterwards.
- We had to clean up a lot ourselves because a mess was left under vents and in the yard.

I appreciate their hard work, but for $11k, I expected not to have to patch vents myself, be in charge of removing debris and having to pick up dirty clothes. Pretty unprofessional of Alco, and I would only recommend them if you tell them upfront that's not acceptable.

plumbers.name: Catons Plumbing, Drains & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 801 Geipe Rd, Catonsville, MD 21228, USA

reviews.author: Javon Cooper
reviews.text:
Ramon is hands down one of the best plumbers I’ve dealt with. He came in and fixed a problem that multiple other plumbers couldn’t figure out. No hesitation, no guessing, he got right to work and handled it.

The service was fast, efficient, and professional from start to finish. You can tell he knows exactly what he’s doing. I’m beyond satisfied with the results and will definitely be calling him again if I ever need plumbing work done.

Highly recommend Ramon if you want the job done right the first time. 💯

reviews.author: K Brooks
reviews.text:
My initial call to Catons was great.  Very friendly scheduling.  They provided me an estimated time for the plumber to arrive.

Curtis, a field supervisor, arrived a short time later to preview the issue.  He was friendly and professional.

The plumber, Jason, arrived some time after.  He was very friendly.  He assessed the issue and exhibited problem solving on the spot since the house is old and he had to figure out the best way to perform the repair. He explained what he was doing.  Jason got the job done in a very acceptable period of time and he didn't seem to mind me hanging over his shoulder.  He removed the ancient inoperable water meter which is pretty cool to look at.  I was very pleased with the service and charge.

There was some residual water on the repair the next day even after wiping, but I gave it a couple days to insure I wouldn't need to call them back.  All is very good.

Having not had to ever call a plumber, this was a great first experience.  There was a lot of anxiety on my part leading up to the repair.  The entire process is very efficient and they will let you know when the plumber is on their way.   Thanks, Catons.

reviews.author: Courtney Moore
reviews.text: Highly recommended. When another plumbing company cancelled on me last minute, Caton’s was able to send someone same day. They arrived on time after calling to confirm they were on the way. Henry and his associate were very friendly, respectful and explained things in a way I was able to understand. Will definitely be my first call in the future when another plumbing issue arises.

reviews.author: Ryan Johnson
reviews.text: On incredibly short notice, Caton was able to schedule a call and come out later in the evening. I had a bad leak in the kitchen sink. Henry came out and assessed the problem instantly and gave me all available options. He thoroughly informed me. He was incredibly respectful, professional, and knowledgeable. Really glad they were able to assist me. He came out and followed up with the perfect install. Grateful to have had him!

reviews.author: Vicki Clifton
reviews.text: Catons Plumbing was the only emergency plumbing company that was able to immediately come address our problem late at night. From the initial plumbing professional, Derrick, to the field representative Curtis, Tuesday, and the excavation crew, everyone was extremely kind, professional, and talked us through each step and explained all pricing breakdowns. They provided all images/pics/documents needed for our insurance. At the end of our experience, it was as though we were all family. I will definitely call on Catons again for all of our plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Chen Plumbing
plumbers.address: 6399 Jimmy Carter Blvd Suite 100B, Norcross, GA 30071, USA

reviews.author: Darrell Short
reviews.text: Shane from Chen Plumbing was an absolute pleasure to work with. The work was A+ class quality and completed in a timely manner. Unlike some professionals, Shane had all the necessary supplies on the Van, gave the estimate and did all the work same day! Who can give deliverables better than that!🤯 Thank you again Shane, and thank you also Chen Plumbing

reviews.author: ShadowX57
reviews.text:
Tim and Oto from Chen Plumbing did a great job handling a leaking expansion tank and a high water pressure issue at my home. They clearly explained that my pressure was way too high (around 120 PSI), which caused the expansion tank to fail.

Instead of trying to upsell a new water heater, they focused on fixing the real problem by replacing the pressure reducing valve and the expansion tank, then setting everything to a safe pressure.

The work was professional, clean, and well explained. I appreciated that they took the time to answer questions and didn’t push unnecessary repairs.

If you’re looking for honest, knowledgeable plumbers who do the job right, Tim and Oto are a solid team. I’d definitely use Chen Plumbing again.

reviews.author: Collin Rooney
reviews.text:
Dawson from Chen Plumbing came out and gave us a free estimate for replacing our electric water heater and then came back out to handle the installation. The overall experience was great- the Chen team was communicative, friendly and thorough.

Dawson was friendly, welcomed questions and the installation was quick and easy. Highly recommend Dawson and Chen Plumbing.

reviews.author: Kate E
reviews.text:
We were introduced to Chen Plumbing last year after our water meter was damaged by a delivery truck. After working with them, we were very impressed and reached out again for additional services. From scheduling to the on-site team, everyone is courteous, hardworking, honest, and kind. Their pricing is fair and clearly explained, and they take the time to walk you through each line item. They also explain the work as they go and answer questions patiently and thoroughly.

We worked with Shawn and Shane, and they were outstanding. I felt completely at ease and confident in their work. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Dorothy Sheffield
reviews.text:
He explained everything thoroughly and helped us understand exactly what was going on and how he would repair it. Polite, friendly.

Update: I wanted to make sure I mentioned our plumber by name: Braulio and his apprentice (sorry, I forgot his name). They finished quickly and spent time afterwards basically helping me understand the bigger picture of how our plumbing worked. No man-spraining, just real talk. I will NEVER use anyone else.

plumbers.name: Dor Mar Plumbing Heating and AC
plumbers.address: 228 E Main St, Newark, OH 43055, USA

reviews.author: Danielle Lusk
reviews.text:
Great service, reputable company, and very quick! Technician was in my house assessing my dishwasher within less than 24hrs

I really liked getting text reminders, having the ability to ask questions via text, and being given a description & photo of the technician before him coming to my home. This made me feel a lot more at ease.

Tech was personable, very obviously knowledgeable, communicative, and honest with his recommendations.  The only thing that would have made the service call better would be if Zach would have told me that it would only cost $5 to fix my dishwasher. I’m just not sure that’s a fair enough reason to knock off any stars!

Thank you for the service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Buckeye Bug Services
reviews.text: Fantastic experience with Dor-Mar! They just put in a brand new heat pump at my house and the entire experience was top-notch from start to finish. The crew was respectful of my home and the quality of work is excellent. If you need HVAC help, give them a call.

reviews.author: Shane Boal
reviews.text: Derrick was an excellent technician,  He was very knowledgeable, helpful and thoughtful.  I received notifications about him being on his way and he called when he pulled up to my properties.  He got right to work and explained what he was doing for our service and helped educate me on improvements and deficiencies in my current H-vac system.  The fact that our old equipment proved to be in better condition than I expected was a nice bonus to a practically perfect service visit.  I was particularly impressed with how thoughtful and considerate he was. I also liked that he didn't try to "up-sell" me on equipment or services I hadn't paid for yet, and only provided options for improvements when I specifically asked for them. You have exceptional employees and I continue to be impressed.

reviews.author: Thomas Green
reviews.text:
Terrible service… please read

Scheduled DorMar to begin work installing tube heaters oct 14th. They provided a quote that I agreed to and stated the job would take 3 days.

It is oct 27th and the job is barely halfway done. Their employees showed up oct 14th and did very little other than lay out the heater on the floor. Oct 15th they got the heater mounted and connected to gas. Oct 17th a technician stopped out for an hour to hook it up to electric.

Heater still needs duct work complete and thermostat installed. I called them Oct 20, 21st and the 22nd. Each time they stated “technicians will be out tomorrow to complete” technicians never showed up. I called again today the 27th and they said the same thing. I told them I want to speak to the job manager. And he will not answer my calls.

Dormar has been consistently behind schedule. They didn’t even have the duct work I told them they would need when they showed up to the job.
They have provided no updates or reasons for delay to me. And now the job manager will not respond to call or text.

Stay away from DorMar ! Poor job management will result in delays to construction deadlines. I’m on the verge of cancelling their agreement to have an alternative company finish the work.

After the review above, DorMar finally showed up and finished the job on the 28th. Although it is done I do not think much care went into the the finished product.

They put single wall duct right beside the loft (pictured) during operation this gets extremely hot and if someone were to un knowingly lean against it it would scald them.

reviews.author: Stephen D'Abreau
reviews.text:
Steve was very prompt and courteous. He was wealth of knowledge. No up selling or bait and switch. Plain old fashioned great service. Dor Mar just got a customer for life.
I highly recommend them.

plumbers.name: S.W.A.T. PLUMBING
plumbers.address: 2111 FM 1187, Aledo, TX 76008, USA

reviews.author: Bonnie A. Crist
reviews.text:
Andrew with SWAT plumbing is our hero!  He went above and beyond to fix our upstairs leaky toilet line. It was so awful and I was so upset! It leaked into the adjacent room and then thru the floor into the ceiling and leaked in my garage! SWAT made it a priority and sent Andrew out first thing the next day. AHS was not going to pay for it as it was not what they considered to be normal wear and tear. He convinced them somehow and was able to get it done today!  My husband and I couldn't sing his praises any higher!  He did the work quickly, made light jokes that helped to make a bad situation easier and is a great communicator. He answered all of our questions in a way we could understand.
If you have a plumbing issue or crisis, call SWAT and ask for Andrew. Whitney in the call center was great too. He was also training a new man named Ronnie who was very professional too.

reviews.author: Christine
reviews.text: They charged my credit card $2,500 without authorization illegally prior to work being done.  We specifically told them NOT to charge the credit card the day they charged my credit card and it was because work was not done yet.  Their so called plumber (that was just a sales representative) told my husband and I we pay half before work was started and half when job was done.  Then he had us sign in the sunlight on his dark phone a contract that stated we were to pay before work was done.  Which by the way is illegal.  You can’t have a verbal contract differ from a written contract, especially with 3 witnesses.  Very foolish and out right bullying.  They subcontracted most of work with people that could not speak English.  They sent the first plumber out that only paid $30 for license no classes a started working without experience is what he told me. reviews.author: Fast Boi
reviews.text: The service I received was amazing. I called and they were able to get a tech here within 2 hours. The tech helped me identify what was the issue and offered to fix it for $300. He told me how I could fix it on my own since he said it was a simple job. I took his advice and tried to fix it myself and what he recommended to do worked flawlessly. It’s nice to see that a business cares about their customers and if it is simple offers a solution. I was so impressed I will be following up shortly for a water filter and for choice plumbing to install a new sink.

reviews.author: Charlotte Bergman
reviews.text: We had some minor water intrusion in our master bathroom. We detected water flow from the main water line outside. We called Choice Plumbing Orlando and they sent someone out the next day to assess. Javier came over to give an estimate. He was polite and respectful and took his shoes off when he entered the home. He had to chisel a hole into the concrete and determined the leak was coming from an old cracked copper pipe and gave us an estimate. He applied a temporary fix to stop the leak and then he returned the next day with parts and replaced the cracked copper pipe with a PEX pipe. He had an assistant that worked with him and the biggest bonus for the project was that they could repair the concrete wall after completing pipe repair. We did not need to hire a contractor to finish the hole in the wall which was very convenient. Every time Javier came over he gave notice with a phone call of his arrival time.

reviews.author: Nancy Ellis

When I asked about this, the customer service representative claimed the drywall “crumbled into small pieces” on the spot even without checking with anyone - and which was clearly not the case as seen in the picture.

What was most frustrating wasn’t just the issue itself, but the dismissive response. A simple, respectful reply like “we’ll check with the technician and get back to you” would’ve been enough. Instead, I was told to “go read the agreement you signed.” That kind of response shows a clear lack of care for the customer experience.

Unfortunately, this interaction left the impression that this is not a customer-focused business.

reviews.author: Holly Brinkerhoff
reviews.text: We needed a water heater replacement/ installation and both Juan & Anthony did a great job from start to finish. They communicated well and were friendly & professional throughout. reviews.author: Dave Diller
reviews.text: Our patio drains were severely backed up and was made apparent due to heavy rain.  Canyon Hills was professional, easy to work with and worked above and beyond to get the job done.  They kept me informed throughout the process.  I cannot say enough good things about their service and will use them again on other plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Stephanie
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Canyon Hills Plumbing for emergencies and planned projects. We first needed their services a year and a half ago to replace a fragile pipe going to our dishwasher and hide it behind the wall (it was originally exposed in a cabinet and I have no idea why). They did such a great job and were incredibly transparent then, so when we had a significant emergency, they were our first call.

Our home is almost 30 years old and was built using CPVC which met its end a couple of weeks ago when a hot water pipe splintered then burst. We again had the best and most transparent experience. Jerry was here in about 20 minutes and he was calming, explained our options, what each would cover, the cost, and what could be considered an add-on versus a necessity. Given the age, chemical percentages in the water in Lake Elsinore, and some general observations over the past year, we decided to replace the plumbing and add filtration to help with longevity but also because chemicals are real and aside from taste differences, they also dry out my skin and trigger my psoriasis.

Jerry and the Canyon Hills team got us scheduled quickly and made sure we had cold water in the meantime (very much appreciated). They were in and out in 2 days and I'm a little amazed at the sounds and frustrations we don't have anymore. Our water pressure is better, it tastes better, and my scalp & skin are no longer crazy itchy with raw red patches when I get out of the shower. No matter how lukewarm I made the water before, I used to need lotion within minutes or it would feel so uncomfortably tight and itchy that I couldn't focus. Since we've had the new pipes and filter, I actually forgot to put any lotion on the other day. It was so nice to realize on my own hours later versus my body screaming at me. Hands down I'm so glad we knew to call them and I hope this helps others.

reviews.author: Andrea Has
reviews.text:
Thank you Canyon Hills Plumbing for coming out so quickly to fix our kitchen clog! Not being able to wash dishes was a huge inconvenience, so we were trying to get someone out as soon as possible. A neighbor recommended Canyon Hills Plumbing, saying they were highly trusted in our community, so I gave them a call. They were very understanding of our situation and were able to fit us in for same-day service at the last minute — which we truly appreciated. Even better, they actually arrived about an hour earlier than scheduled.

Oscar was really polite and professional. He explained everything clearly and made sure we understood what needed to be done. He took extra care to keep our kitchen clean, which meant a lot to me.

I would give this company 100 stars if I could! I will absolutely be recommending Canyon Hills Plumbing to friends and neighbors and will be using them for any future plumbing needs. Thank you again!
