reviews.author: DigitalChainsaw
reviews.text:
Mike is everything a plumber should be; punctual, professional, courteous, and has great technical knowledge. It has been a long time since I have seen someone love their job this much. Whatever Roto Rooter is paying him, it isn't enough.

I had water filling up my hallway the night before and I did not know the source. Mike methodically narrowed it down and found out it was a main sewer line blockage, potentially saving me thousands. He cleared the blockage and had me assist in testing the line multiple times so I had peace of mind that the repair was solid and I would have no more flooding.

I actually tried to hire a local mom and pop plumber claiming to be a "24/7 emergency plumber." Called at 6:30 pm on a Friday night and the person who answered didn't even use the business's name, just "hello?" Said he would call me back in two seconds. Got a text a half hour later saying no one could come out until the next day. I told him to disregard and called the name I have known since childhood and I am so glad I did. Big box doesn't mean small heart, at least in this case. Go with the pros at Roto Rooter (ask for Mike and thank me later) and rest assured your plumbing issues will be handled quickly and correctly.

reviews.author: Patrick Hamlin
reviews.text: Michael from Roto-Rooter came to my home and immediately assessed what the issue was. Unfortunately, since the issue is with the half pipe on my roof and Roto-Rooter no longer offers this option as part of their services. Although, Michael was great and immediately diagnosed the issue after explaining the situation to him. He provided a great background on the issue and was able to point me in the right direction to getting it fixed. I appreciate Michael for his efforts!

reviews.author: George Farrell
reviews.text: Michael was top notch! Came in with an incredible attitude and myself being a maintenance supervisor he listened to what I had to say about the situation and took in my thoughts on his decision to addressing the issue. Most people don’t want to hear your opinion on what they do for a living. Your company has a special individual in this man. Treat him accordingly. Thanks again Michael!!

reviews.author: Michael Chase
reviews.text: Today my plumbing technicians were Jack and Koli. Both the gentleman were very professional and took the time to repair my issue of replacing the hot water cartridge in one of my showers. The service was great and I now have plenty of hot water flowing through the shower again. Both gentlemen walked me through all the different steps and kept me up to date throughout the service which I truly appreciate. Jack was also helpful in talking to me about a future water heater replacement and I am definitely going to give a call when I'm ready for it. Thank you very much and I will continue to use Roto-Rooter for all my plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Wizard Plumbing and Drain
plumbers.address: 2300 Palm Ave, San Mateo, CA 94403, USA

reviews.author: Mani Hashemi
reviews.text:
Exceptional service and an exceptional team!!!
I lost hot water pressure and right away I knew something was wrong with my water heater. Since it was Sunday I had to email a few places and one of them was Wizard plumbing. Monday morning I got a few responses but Wizard plumbing was the quickest of them all and could dispatch someone urgently. Kevin arrived and identified that the water heater was leaking and needed to be replaced, after answering my many questions and making calls around to find the model I wanted. Shortly after Dino arrived and the pair not only replaced the water heater but also fabricated a custom pan to adhere to the current drain that was in place. They also replaced the leaky hot water valve as well as an automatic shut off valve. Throughout the whole time, they were curious, attentive, and thorough. They got the job done wonderfully and quickly within a few hours; this was exceptionally important as we have little kids. As they say, you get what you pay for and with Wizard plumbing, you get every Penny's worth. Don't just look for the cheapest but look for quality and Dino and Kevin are a great example of why that is the case. Thank you very much. A rockstar team for sure.

reviews.author: P. O. Benito
reviews.text: Made an appointment three days prior, they took down all of my information and asked me a bunch of questions. The morning of the appointment, I get a text message saying they do not service my area and have to cancel. Why didn’t you tell me that three days ago when I made the appointment and gave you my address? Waste of time.

reviews.author: Todd S.
reviews.text: I’ve lived in a house that was built in 1947 for 10 years. So I’ve had more than a few plumbers come through for various issues during that time. A termite inspector found a leak, so I panic-called the first result on Yelp (I don’t usually do that). Wizard Plumbing came through, assessed the situation, and gave me a number of options, each with associated costs. Not one to mess around with plumbing, I went with the most extensive & labor intensive option (and I’m glad I did; see pix). Out of all the plumbers I’ve done business with over the years, Wizard Plumbing proved to be — by far — the most honest, fair, competent, experienced and thorough. In fact, if I made a Venn diagram with all of those attributes for each of the plumbers I’ve done business with, Wizard would be the only one that made a perfect circle. They’ve definitely made a customer for life.

reviews.author: Lawrence Lam
reviews.text: Ammar from Wizard plumbing came out same day to fix me emergency. I would not have been able to open my business the next day without his help. He had to perform a major hydrojetter procedure on my plumbing. Everything works great now. I will call Wizard Plumbing again if needed.

reviews.author: Venu
reviews.text: Todd and Kyle came out today and the whole experience was fantastic. The dispatch was super responsive to start. I had a 75 gallon water heater that flooded my utility room. They sent out the two techs within hours of opening of business hours. Our situation was a bit special. Water heater two stories down and in a weird framed in closet the tank did not fit out of. They moved the washer and sink for me and left to do another job while I sawed apart the frame. That was on me for obvious reasons. I had to move electrical wiring too. The 75 gallon did not fit through the frame. Once I was complete I called and they were back in an hour. The entire new 50 gallon water heater was installed by end of business and less than 24 hours after the first discovery. It fit better. Operated better. Both techs were courteous, professional, knew exactly what they were doing as they were specific to water heaters. I will definitely call them again in any emergency. The other company called me to schedule the estimate when wizard was almost done….

plumbers.name: Harris Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electrical
plumbers.address: 204 NJ-45, Salem, NJ 08079, USA

reviews.author: Carlos Santiago
reviews.text: Yes your electrical technician, electrician. Marvin Guzman did an excellent job and has some great ideals for an upgrade to make things safer. We would prefer to have Marvin. Guzman sent back on-site to complete the future repairs. Thank you, Harris, services.

reviews.author: Christina Clark
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about Harris Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electrical. I placed a call to them Friday afternoon and they had a tech (Bruce) out that same night. Bruce was very friendly, knowledgeable and understanding of my situation. He presented my options and scheduled for another technician (Alan) to come out the following afternoon. Alan, just like Bruce, was very friendly, and very helpful. He went over my financing options and had everything scheduled for Monday. Monday came and here comes the installer, Jeff. He was on time, super efficient and had my brand new heating system up and running by 3pm. I would highly recommend them to anyone. I am beyond impressed by the entire company as a whole.

reviews.author: Lori James
reviews.text: I am a first-time customer with Harris Plumbing. I had to call them on Christmas Eve 2025 with a plumbing problem in my kitchen. The customer service representative,Jane, was detail oriented and very polite. Their yellow truck arrived exactly when they scheduled. Technician Robert Gibson was friendly, professional, and very knowledgeable. I will definitely ask for Rob if I have any further plumbing issues. Thank you Harris Plumbing staff!!

reviews.author: Carmelo Morales Jr
reviews.text: This was my third time having Harris service my house and I can't say enough good things about the company, especially Niles Hull. He was a total professional and very knowledgeable. His work was done very efficiently with great attention to detail. He was very upfront and honest with concerns and expectations as well as recommendations. It was truly a pleasurable and positive experience. I would highly recommend Harris plumbing!

reviews.author: William Elton
reviews.text: Had 2 furnaces replaced, a water heater and AC units replaced and installers were fantastic.  Were on time, very communicative but did not need to be micromanaged.  Was a lot involved in the job and appreciative of their efforts and knowledge.  Would definitely recommend…

plumbers.name: Siemer Heating, Cooling & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 400 Kennedy Ave, Schererville, IN 46375, USA

reviews.author: Laura B
reviews.text: We just had a new boiler and hot water heater system installed. The crew (Kraig, Denis, Tyler, Anthony) was fantastic. They communicated daily with us about progress and paid attention to every detail. They made sure we understood the new system and left the work area cleaner than when they started. The whole process from original quote, to end, was simple. Great communication, workmanship, and a nice company to work with!

reviews.author: Julie Streeter
reviews.text: Called after hours on a Friday night after our furnace stopped working and the answering service was able to connect me with a tech in a timely manner. The tech arrived within 20 minutes and was able to troubleshoot the issue and get the furnace back working. I would like to thank Alejandro for his patience and kindness towards my mother and taking the time to explain things thoroughly. I was very happy with the service we received and would not hesitate to call Siemer's again.

reviews.author: Norma Glass
reviews.text: Chris is both knowledgeable and courteous. He found the issues with my furnace and  explained everything in detail and gave me options.  He arrived quickly and this was an emergency since the temps are below zero.  Thank you for your work and expertise.

reviews.author: Susan Young
reviews.text: Paul was very helpful when figuring out what I really needed to make my home more comfortable.  He explained differences in systems, how things worked and gave me different options so that I could make an informed decision.  I had had 2 other estimates and was  told very different things  by both.  Everyone that worked on this 3 day job was great.  They were totally respectful of my home and family, including the dog!  Had new furnace and a/c installed, along with ductless mini splits in the upper level of my home.  It seemed like a lot of money, but considering it was upgrading the existing systems, plus adding a totally new system to handle the second floor,  I'm totally happy with the price.  So far it seems like my home is more comfortable.  Can't wait to see how the efficiency effects my utility bill!

reviews.author: Christopher Scott
reviews.text: Our sump pump went out while it was raining. Jack was able to replace the bad pump with a new one before it caused flooding in our basement!! Friendly, informative and fairly priced! Would recommend Siemer Plumbing!

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Farmers Branch
plumbers.address: 4250 Spring Valley Rd, Farmers Branch, TX 75244, USA

reviews.author: Vivian Li
reviews.text: Pascual came and did a speedy and wonderful job fixing our bathroom sink plumbing that was leaking.  He was patient to find the problem since it is a slow leak but definitely there, and was quick in fixing it in less than an hour.  He had a cheerful personality too and was considerate to take his shoes off when he came in.  Thanks Pascual!

reviews.author: Alejandro Suarez
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of being helped by Keyfer and Dillion. Outstanding experience. Keyfer was extremely thorough when explaining the possible solutions, stand out guy. Once we settled on a solution he got right to work showing me what had caused the problem. He was also training Dillion at the time who was also very nice, Keyfer did a great job of describing the steps to Dillion and verifying his understanding. I hope to not have any further plumbing issued but if I do I will call Keyfer in the future, thanks gents.

reviews.author: Brian Bacher
reviews.text: Ian came out to assess a kitchen clog we couldn't fix. Not only was he personable, but he also figured it out quickly and uncloggd our pipes. He also provided great advice on how to avoid deep clogs in the future. We used Mr. Rooter before and will definately use them.again. Highly Recommended.

reviews.author: bryan wilson
reviews.text: Had an outdoor garden hose valve break in the evening and was leaking behind the wall/siding of our house. Called Mr. Rooster and they were able to send someone out right away. Pascual was able to come out first thing in the morning and was able to make the repair, reinstall newer better equipment as well as enforce it better than it was to prevent from happening again, and most of all was able to reseal the wall back up to save me time from running to low s and rushing to get it done before the ice storm hits the DFW area. Very friendly, and helpful! Would use again!

reviews.author: Conner Atwell
reviews.text: Clint came in to fix a leak from our shower in our new home and was an absolute pleasure to work with. Kind, professional, and very knowledgeable. I would give him 6 stars if I could. Will definitely be asking for Clint again in the future, give this man a raise!

plumbers.name: Augerpros Plumbing and Drain
plumbers.address: 206 W McDermott Dr #120, Allen, TX 75013, USA

reviews.author: Paul Pierce
reviews.text: Had a leak at the street and needed some emergency service. Due to the old pipes, we discussed replacing outdoor lines causing excavation across the driveway. The team worked fast and the quality of work appears excellent. We are waiting for city inspection approval and then grounds/driveway repair can be completed . Cost was what I expected. Brendon West communicated with me throughout. He hit every timeline committed. He set me up with some temporary water service to help alleviate some inconvenience. Overall, I am really comfortable with Augerpros Plumbing and Drain. I would utilize their service again if needed.

reviews.author: Brittany Knight
reviews.text:
I was GIFTED a new water heater with installation for Christmas by the wonderful owner of this company. Thank God for that because we are a big family and our tank just wasn’t cutting it! The gentlemen who came were quick, professional, and even swept the leaves out my garage before they left. They left the place cleaner than they found it!
Really above and beyond!!
Thankful for the love of Christ demonstrated in the heart of this company and their giving, hard working, honest spirit.
Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Thomas Strawn
reviews.text: Quick and professional. They arrived the day after I called within the scheduled time frame and Justin was polite, friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. He provided a cost estimate on site and was able to make the repairs the same day. He cleaned up after himself and went the extra mile to ensure that the spigots I had replaced were covered with plastic barrier until I can have the brick repaired.

reviews.author: Daniel Reyes
reviews.text:
Kory Sullivan with Augerpros Plumbing and Drain was great to work with. He took the time to really walk me through what was going on and explained everything in a way that actually made sense, which I appreciated more than anything. You can tell he knows his stuff, but he doesn’t talk over you or rush through things.

What stood out the most was how helpful he was with the insurance side of things. He understood what I needed for the claim and made sure I had the right information. He also made it clear that if anything else came up or if I needed additional support, he’d be available. That kind of follow-through gives you a lot of confidence, especially when you’re already dealing with a stressful situation.

Overall, solid experience. Honest, knowledgeable, and easy to work with. I wouldn’t hesitate to call Kory again if I needed help.

reviews.author: Allen
reviews.text: 5 stars all day long! From the initial phone call to actually fixing the issue we knew we made the right choice. The scheduler was friendly, courteous and assured they could help. Really put us at ease since we were dealing with a gas issue vs water (remember kids, licensed plumbers like these guys work with gas and water). As far as service, Aaron and John were great! Efficient, thorough and explained the entire process as well as the solution. Fixed our lingering gas leak in no time. Acted as if our house was their own in the level of care and detail provided. We are customers for life!

plumbers.name: All American Plumbing Inc.
plumbers.address: 14260 Garden Rd unit A601, Poway, CA 92064, USA

reviews.author: Francis Ayson
reviews.text: Jo-Jo did the initial quote and gave me a lot of good information and suggestions for a whole house filtration system install and Moen flow install. He was very informative and recommended fixing replacing a few items while getting everything installed. Jo-Jo and his apprentice Joseph came on time, were professional, did very clean pipework and our family couldn't be happier with our new water softener system! I have used and will continue to use All American for all my plumbing needs. Highly recommend giving them a call too.

reviews.author: Bob, Break, and BOOM DeGuzman
reviews.text: Dalton as Lead Tech and Cody provided quality customer service, professionalism, and craftsmanship as they changed our bathtub knobs to a single lever and replaced our angle stops to our bathroom sink.  I've had multiple interactions with Dalton and Cody and I would recommend them for any plumbing job.  There's a chance I'll be working with Dalton on another project and I know he'll do a great job.  I've dealt with All American Plumbing for three water damage issues and each time they've been great people to work with.  I highly recommend All American Plumbing for any plumbing work.

reviews.author: Christine Wong
reviews.text:
We had a great experience with All American Plumbing and wanted to give a special shoutout to Jonny and Cyrus. They installed our new kitchen sink and faucet, and we couldn’t be happier with how everything turned out. They really listened to what we wanted and made sure it worked the way we envisioned.

What stood out most was how efficient and professional they were. They kept us updated throughout the entire process and explained each step along the way, which we really appreciated as homeowners. They even took the time to show us a few quick troubleshooting tips in case we run into any issues in the future.

The whole installation was smooth, timely, and the quality of their work is excellent. It’s clear they take pride in what they do. We would absolutely recommend All American Plumbing, and if you can, ask for Jonny and Cyrus!

reviews.author: Juliet San Diego
reviews.text: Once again, All American Plumbing went above and beyond our expectations. Jojo did a fantastic job in installing our new outdoor utility sink. The quality of the work done was top-notch. Very friendly people, prompt and left the work area clean. I'll be using their services again in the future and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Jim Lawler
reviews.text: Jo Jo and Stephen were great.  I called around 8:30 am and they were at the house by about 10 am.  First thing to note:  Totally polite, professional and smart.  Second they worked quickly, cleaned up well and went off to save another customer. So I had two very separate plumbing jobs which together was $500.  Based on my experience with previous companies, I'd say they were half the price.  And they did not cut corners (I've done my fair share of plumbing when I was a younger man).  Very neat jobs.  What else  can I say, other than Jo Jo has a fantastic mustache ;=). Highly recommended.

plumbers.name: Horton Plumbing, Heating, Cooling, & Remodeling
plumbers.address: 1382 S Main St, Plymouth, MI 48170, USA

reviews.author: Bhavani Shankar Tata
reviews.text:
We had a frozen water pipe break under kitchen sink due to the extremely cold temperatures last week. I called Horton Plumbing at about 8:30 pm Saturday evening and Sean Fritz showed up at about 9:00 pm.

Sean Fritz was very knowledgeable and professional and did an outstanding job fixing the broken pipe. After the job was done, everything was tested and made sure there are no more leaks and the work area was cleaned up leaving no trace. Thank you Sean.

The price was very reasonable and I would recommend Horton Plumbing for all HVAC, and plumbing related issues.

reviews.author: Leah Fisher
reviews.text: The workers for Horton plumbing are great people even the young lady on the phone. The companies great but did forget we had an appointment that day when I called they still got someone out within 30 mins. The amazing worker Conner came to fix the job. He was super friendly helpful . He went above and beyond more than he had to.

reviews.author: Andrea “Anya” Hardin Nader
reviews.text: I bought an older condo and my contractor did not hook up the laundry tub and faucets correctly.  I tried to do laundry for the first time and it leaked.  One call to Horton’s fixed that.  They sent Ron out for the repairs and he was incredible.  He was very professional and knowledgeable.  He put me at ease and fixed everything perfectly.  Since I’m a first time homeowner I had a lot of questions and he went above and beyond helping me.  I highly recommend Horton’s and especially Ron.

reviews.author: Allison Thompson
reviews.text: Steve Pouliot from Horton did a fantastic job at our home today. He efficiently replaced the expansion tank on our water heater and installed a new relief valve with great attention to detail. Steve was prompt, professional, and clearly knowledgeable — he explained everything he was doing and made sure the system was working perfectly before he left. It’s always great to have a technician who takes pride in their work and respects your home. We couldn’t be more pleased with the service and will definitely call Horton Plumbing again for future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: David Manardo
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience!
The plumber (Christian Riolo) was polite and knowledgable. He was on time and brought booties so as to keep snow off of my floors.
He quickly found the fixture we were looking for and went to Home Depot to purchase it for us.
We loved the fixture and the installation was fast and professional.
He was very conscientious and thoroughly cleaned  the work area before he left.

plumbers.name: First Quality Plumbing - Palm Bay
plumbers.address: 1449 Pennykamp St NE, Palm Bay, FL 32907, USA

reviews.author: Collin Anderson
reviews.text:
I can't recommend these guys enough.
When we had our water heater replaced, First Quality was more than fair in the price it took to get a new one, install it, and remove the old one.
They did such a great job with that, we called them to install two new toilets. Again, very fair price for the job.
Maverick was our plumber for both jobs and he is very courteous and thorough.

reviews.author: Adrian Benfield
reviews.text: Prompt service. 7:40am I discovered sitting water inside my guest bathroom vanity. After seeing a visible leak from the faucet line I called FQP at 7:48am and they had guy at my house in about 30 minutes. I agreed to have the faucet replaced and the problem was solved by 9:30am. Brandis did a great job with the install. This was my 2nd time using this company and so far it has been a pleasant/smooth operation.

reviews.author: Ryan Farace
reviews.text: Water heater replacement. Customer service was great, making an appointment was simple and pleasant. Overall the service was great, the guys were kind and looks to me that they did good work. I give 4 stars because they left a bit of a mess on the side of my house where they drained the rusty water from the old water heater. They also didn’t activate the water heater once it was connected, so I ended wasting 2 hours waiting for the water to heat when it was sitting in stand bye mode.

reviews.author: joanne lewis
reviews.text: Christian was amazing! He went above and beyond in installing our water system. We brought the system from another home and it was missing some pieces so he provided them for us. I asked a million questions and he answered them all thoroughly without skipping a beat. He was very respectful and even took off his shoes before entering our home without us even having to ask. I typically don’t give reviews but decided to do one because he was very deserving of it. I would definitely recommend using this company!

reviews.author: Jacquie Brown
reviews.text: Chris was amazing. He was fast and professional. He was informative and personable. His work was superb. I will be requesting him again for my next project. All of the ugly chrome fixtures replaced with black matte.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 5115 7th Ave, Kenosha, WI 53140, USA

reviews.author: Rebecca T
reviews.text:
Great experience!  Tech 3774 Tyriek was quick and professional, and did a really good job of explaining what was needed and the work he'd be performing.  We made the appointment on Saturday night and everything was good to go before noon on Sunday!

We'll definitely calling again next time we need plumbing services.

reviews.author: Uri Gonzalez
reviews.text: Joe was GREAT. He was able to come to out same day to help with our urgent sewage problem. Extremely knowledgeable and friendly. He identified and fixed the issue in a short amount of time and even took the time to explain the causes and how to prevent the same issue in the future. Amazing first experience with Roto-Rooter and will choose them again for any future needs, mainly just from the experience with our technician Joe. Dispatch was also extremely helpful and responsive.

reviews.author: Ashley Giblin-Brown
reviews.text: We had what we thought was a serious clog. After many attempts to declog ourselves we finally broke down and called Roto Rooter. We were told someone would be at our home by 1pm. Literally 10 minutes after calling Bruno called us and told us he was on his way. Bruno was here by 10am and he was very thorough. Every question we asked he answered in detail and never made us feel like we were bothering him. He explained every single step in detail. Max showed up with the camera to help Bruno. Just like Bruno, Max was very thorough and had no problems answering our questions. Many times I felt like my question may have been stupid but they never made me feel that way when answering me or holding a conversation with me. I would highly highly recommend Bruno specifically (and Max if a camera is needed). We were extremely lucky when Roto Rooter sent Bruno. Bruno is definitely going to be my first call the next time I ever have a plumbing issue again.

reviews.author: Delores Sanders
reviews.text: Rotor Rooter provided 5 + star services. Tyler my service man was super nice, professional and most important wore his heart on his sleeve. The knowledge shared on the steps taken and warnings on products that say flushable but was a part of the problem is a lesson learned for this family. In addition to the clean after equipment use and resources provided makes this the best customer service ever experienced. This family is team Rotor Rooter for life. Thanks Tyler BEST EVER !!!!!!

reviews.author: Susan Vera
reviews.text: Nick (5287) was awesome! Our entire system was backed up. Water filling up our toilets, showers, and drain in our laundry room. Nick came same day and was able to get things flowing again. He explained things in a way that was easy to understand and was very thorough in his work. He and his supervisor (Jonathan) were able to find the issue and suggest a solution on the spot. Both very kind and professional.

plumbers.name: Five Star Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 2200 Sandridge Dr, Moraine, OH 45439, USA

reviews.author: Timothy Mitchell
reviews.text: Five Star Plumbing lives up to their name!  Service technicians Robert and Conner were professional and honest!  I couldn't have asked for better service from anyone else.  Highly satisfied and completely pleased with the results.  Thank you again guys!  Keep up the excellent work!

reviews.author: Ellen Dempsey
reviews.text: Trey and his counterpart were friendly, on time, and efficient. They were knowledgeable on the work needing to be completed and had all the equipment and materials needed. Highly recommend this crew and would love to use them for future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Frederick Reyes
reviews.text: Rob Bunker arrived promptly. He assessed the situation and clearly explained and answered my questions. He replaced the water heater and left the area in pristine condition. I would definitely recommend his services.

reviews.author: Paul Randall
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Five Star Plumbing & Lowes performing a natural gas hot water heater installation. They provided a  time window from 1230 to 430 pm and arrived within that timeframe. Trey, the experienced technician/plumber & his worker/plumber were professional and took time to explain what needed to be done. They answered all my questions. Their quote was more detailed than others. The job was completed efficiently and I felt confident in the quality of the work. The job took 1 1/2 hrs, they were able to leave the old hot water heater at our request because it was still dropping drops of rusty water. They will pick it up in a few weeks as arranged. The AO Smith natural gas hot water heater job cost about $2000 installed. It was more reasonably priced than others. I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Kristen Schlager Lopos
reviews.text: Gregory and Kyle did an excellent and efficient job installing my disposal. They cleaned up really well too! I completely recommend them for your plumbing needs. Thank you!

plumbers.name: Five Star Home Services Dayton
plumbers.address: 2960 W Enon Rd Suite 303, Xenia, OH 45385, USA

reviews.author: Niel Petersen
reviews.text:
Five Star Home Services did an outstanding job installing our new heat pump and humidifier. The installation was extremely clean, professional, and clearly done with great attention to detail. Dakota and his colleague were excellent—courteous, knowledgeable, and very thorough throughout the entire process.

It was incredibly cold outside on install day, yet they remained professional, focused, and never rushed the work. That level of care really stood out and is something I truly appreciate.

I went through Lowe’s for this install and, to be honest, I was initially skeptical since I’ve used several HVAC companies in the past. I can confidently say I have no regrets at all. The entire process—from start to finish—was smooth, well-communicated, and exceeded my expectations.

I’m very pleased with the results and would highly recommend Five Star Home Services to anyone looking for quality HVAC work done right.

reviews.author: Michael Carlson
reviews.text: Dakota and his partner did an incredible job installing a 60K BTU gas furnace and 2.5 ton outdoor a/c unit.    They installed this as if he were putting it in his own home.   They removed a very heavy concrete pad that the old a/c sat on outside and added a new one that fit the unit (square).   They took the concrete pad and loaded it into their truck, which completely impressed me.  Both worked non-stop (7.5 Hours) and never took a break.  Both were friendly and made sure every accommodation was made during the install.   The installers requested additional parts for the hood, which were delivered but not exactly as requested.   He assured me they would correct this, but everything was running after they left.   Now, I will monitor the operation of the system in the coming weeks and months and give continuous additional feedback as necessary.

reviews.text:

Rapid response, Gary came and set up the mold remiadation, and isolated the effected area.

His team then came and replaced damaged wood, replaced damaged door, reinstalled the wall, and finished up the painting/sanding. The only thing that wasn't done, was the semi-gloss door paint.

Kyle identified the leak. Kyle fixed the leak. No more leak! LET ME TELL YOU, FIVE STARS HOME SERVICES DAYTON IS GREAT! HONESTLY, THIS TEAM IS REALLY DEDICATED AND COMMITTED TO RESOLVING ALL ISSUES. VERY THANKFUL WE HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO WORK WITH THIS TEAM. THEY ARE RESILIENT!

I truly appreciate the team of people that are dedicating time to identify what the source of the leak. They have been kind and patient. I look forward the the continued effort to resolve. I am returning back to five star because of the wonderful dedicated team: Steven, Mel, Kyle, Garret.

Update June 2025
I'm changing my review from five stars to zero stars. Unfortunately, five star home services Dayton did not complete the work we paid for in the basement bathroom.  The basement bathroom was quoted separately as the upstairs hallway bathroom leaked to the basement bathroom. I took a picture April 30th after the guy came and did the drywall. Since then, there has been a leak! Five star did the plumbing work above when they did the hallway bathroom. I told them the basement bathroom smells like mold and I sent them pictures of the mold in the basement. They denied it!
I uploaded pictures from April 30th 2025, when you can see the drywall is still drying. The most up-to-date picture is from June 2025 or you can see black mold. Five star did The upstairs bathroom remodel! They are denying that they did anything wrong!

Initial 5 star:
Jesse and Raj are awesome! They did the work in a week for our hallway bathroom. They came back on Friday to do a upstairs walk-through with me, and they remediated the minor tiny details. I appreciate the hard work that Jesse and Raj did at our house! I look forward to using this company in the future!

reviews.author: Dman 4BA
reviews.text: I received very quick same day service from Five Star to fix an issue with my heat. My technician Brandon Lowery was extremely knowledgeable and immediately identified the issue with my heating system. He went above and beyond by performing some preventative maintenance, made system adjustments, and told me about what would likely be issues in the near future so I could stay ahead of other failures. It was a great experience and definitely recommend Five Star.

reviews.author: Katie Kuss-Shivler
reviews.text: Our furnace went out at the worst possible time! But Monday, after the historic snowstorm the day before, Five Star was taking calls. Ryan the service tech came out that day and we had a new furnace Tuesday. I'm so grateful for these guys! Our tech Jesse and his helper were here at 9am Tuesday to start putting in the furnace and by that evening we were warm again. They didn't take a lunch or even use the bathroom. Just worked hard all day to get our new furnace up and running. Could not ask for better service! Thank you Five Star, we are incredibly grateful!

plumbers.name: Sunrise Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1705 S John King Blvd Suite 103, Rockwall, TX 75032, USA

reviews.author: Megan Williams
reviews.text: I Called Sunrise plumbing based off reviews. Happy I did. My outside faucet was leaking and had a tech, named Jeff, come out within two hours to fix. He was very polite and had it fixed in an hour. No problems since. I’m always terrified of calling plumbers bc they’re expensive but was very happy with what I paid with them. I will definitely be using them in the future!

reviews.author: Trisha Newman
reviews.text:
Overall, the installation was completed and I believe the plumber did a good job. However, the amount I was charged to install a toilet that was purchased before the company arrived was outrageous! I was charged $400+ to install a toilet.  Then another $200 for parts.
I am truly disappointed in Sunrise Plumbing in reference to the price I was charged. During Covid Sunrise Plumbing completed a repair and the plumber did a great job. It was because of him that I called the company again.
This time when I called the company and asked for just an estimate of what I might have to pay, I was told that I would have to wait until the plumber could fully assess what needed to be done and I had the option to decline if the price was unreasonable.
I was given the price and reluctantly agreed to the charges, not completely understanding just what exactly was being charged. After returning home that evening and seeing the part I was charged $200 for and the receipt was shocking. I could have purchased the parts myself for less than that if only I knew. Never will I ever.

reviews.author: Lilly A
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this plumber. They were responsive, knowledgeable, and made sure everything was repaired correctly. They walked me through what was wrong and gave honest recommendations without trying to upsell anything. I appreciate their professionalism and will absolutely call them again for future needs.

reviews.author: Deborah Chavez
reviews.text: I called Sunrise plumbing after realizing that our foundation repair company had referred us to a plumbing repair company that had 1.4 stars and multiple complaints from previous recent customers and after we had already paid that plumbing company $600 to do a diagnostic camera test after our post foundation repair sewer test failed.  I called Sunrise Plumbing for a second opinion and they sent out  Andrew Avalos.  I was so angry at already paying $600 for a diagnosis from a company there was no way I would use to do the repair work. Andrew’s demeanor was so calming and he was clearly very knowledgeable. He completed preliminary testing to confirm and isolate the location of the leaks for a very reasonable price and showed me everything he was doing and why.  Andrew confirmed the leaks and performed the diagnostic testing.  Then the crazy work started-jackhammering up our floor and digging down 10 feet and tunneling to the leaks-turn out there were two.  Dirt was everywhere.  But now everything is fixed and cleaned up.  We were treated very well by all the contractors and are grateful to Andrew for being so patient and meticulous and for taking such good care of us!

reviews.author: Carla Garza
reviews.text: Andrew was very helpful and professional. He came out for an estimate and gave me all the information I needed. Will be rescheduling and hoping he will be able to come back out. Thank you!

reviews.author: Betsy Lane
reviews.text: I called Atomic after months of consistent water pressure issues. Mike and Paul showed up to assist and were extremely polite, knowledgeable, clean and friendly. They took time to listen to my concerns, discuss what they planned to and provided detailed information about what they found and what their recommendations would be. I found Mike to be extremely knowledgeable and he answered all of my questions patiently and thoroughly. An hour later, after replacing a section of pipe and making future recommendations, my house water pressure is better than ever. reviews.author: Shirley Smith
reviews.text: I called Atomic to help locate the sewer lateral in our front yard so we could safely grind a tree stump (we had a sneaking suspicion it was very close to the tree stump; suspicion confirmed). reviews.author: Krista Elder
reviews.text: Sean was professional, courteous, and knowledgeable throughout my appointment. When he arrived, he immediately began assessing the situation with my 15 year old Direct Vent water heater, explained what the issue was, which replacement was needed, gave me pricing and warranty options, and that the water heater would be replaced the same day. They worked well together, were able to get everything completed, and left their work area impressively clean.  This is the third time I have used Atomic Plumbing and will continue to do so. 10/10 highly recommend.

reviews.author: jose cruz
reviews.text:
11/18/25 update:
We had a small leak under the sink. Call Atomic told them the situation and again very happy with them they did an excellent job. When I called they explain they will come out check out what is happening and we could go from there. Yes the leak was very small and I really did not know where it was coming from but when the technician came out he found the problem and yes they fixed it and did an excellent job. Today 11/23/25 and we have check under the sink and it is good to go. Again I mush say thank you to Atomic Plumbing for a great job and to the tech for a great job.

I submitted a service request for a leak under my sink on Sunday afternoon, 11/09/2025. Later that evening, I received a call to schedule the appointment. In my request, I asked for service on Tuesday since I was already off work, and the young lady on the phone confirmed that was perfectly fine—they would be working on the holiday.

At 8:00 Tuesday morning, I received a text with the service technician’s name and employee number, and he arrived shortly afterward. Mr. Michael Casey was very polite and courteous. He evaluated the issue and told me he would step out to his van to prepare a quote. We haven’t used many plumbers over the years, but I felt his quote was very reasonable for the work needed. I approved the job and asked him to replace both the hot and cold shut-off valves.

I must say, in all the years we’ve used Atomic Plumbing, they have always provided excellent service and fair pricing. I will continue to highly recommend this company to anyone in the area. I am attaching before and after photos—the “before” picture isn’t very clear, but the “after” picture is much better, as I wanted to show the excellent work Mr. Casey completed. He also took the time to explain everything he did.

Thank you for your work, Mr. Casey.

Thanks again to Johnathan, Fabian, and the whole team!

reviews.author: Julia N.
reviews.text:
For this review, I give Mr. Rooter (specifically Joe Ventimiglia and his team – Mitch and John) 5 stars for the QUALITY OF WORK that they did for us. It was excellent/outstanding.

Note: Unfortunately, at the same time I would give only 2 stars for the quality of communication and for the scheduling process for our project. The scheduling was not consistent and often left us wondering if/when they would show up. And it did not measure up to match the quality of workmanship which was excellent.

During his visit for the estimate, Joe was prompt, respectful, knowledgeable, asked questions, engaged with us and the design materials (drawings and descriptions) that we had prepared, was willing to enter the crawl space to assess the plumbing situation (a disaster left over from a previous plumber who could not finish the work) and listened to us. He let us know that he would work on getting us a written estimate as soon as possible. Within a day or so, Joe was able to send us an estimate. That was amazing in and of itself (most plumbers take 3-5 days to generate an estimate and some never follow up at all). After reviewing the estimate, we decided to go with Joe and his team (Mr. Rooter).

Within the same week, Joe and his team (Mitch and John) removed all of the faulty, partially installed mess of plumbing work that the previous plumber had “installed” for us. Joe and his team also brought all of the supplies to stage them for the next week’s work.

Before I share more of the job, let me just say that Joe and his team (Mitch and John) were professional, respectful and documented their work. Mitch was extremely personable, very respectful and conducted himself with dignity and excellence on the job. John was polite and answered questions when asked. Both Mitch and John added to the already high level of skillful excellence that Joe brought to the job.

The following week, Joe and his team worked on replacing all of the drains and supply lines under our home (in our crawl space) as well as roughing in all of the connections, drains and dry vents in our bathroom space (going from 1.5 baths to 2 baths in a complete gut with dry vents that had to be reconnected and tied into the whole system). Their work set the stage for the construction team that was doing our remodel.

Seeing Joe's (and Mitch and John) finished work has been amazing. The work is clean, precise, completed according to code, and has corrected all of the errors and sloppiness of the previous plumber’s work. Joe/Mitch/John's work is also going to allow us to prevent leaks in the future. At the start of this project, I said I wanted “pretty pipes” (meaning clean, well done, leak-proof, neat, organized, code-worthy, and otherwise excellently installed) and that is what we now have.

The only area that was not as excellent was the poor communication around scheduling. Often, we were told that Joe, or Joe and his team, would be at our house on a certain day or at a certain time and we often did not hear from anyone until late in the day/the end of the day when Joe would let us know that the schedule had shifted or that he would need to reschedule for the next day or the following day. Of course, we can understand and give grace when that happens once but when it becomes a pattern, it feels disrespectful. It happened several times and we tried to just be flexible. However, after the 3rd time, we ended up speaking to a supervisor about the situation. Thankfully, Mr. Rooter’s supervisor was helpful  and swift in resolving our concerns and the job was completed with the same skill and excellence that Joe and his team demonstrated throughout the job.

Overall, we are very glad that we worked with Joe, Mitch and John and we are grateful for their excellent skill and the high quality of their finished work. We are so thankful for the completed bathroom plumbing for our 2-bathroom remodel project.

reviews.author: Ramona M
reviews.text: We highly recommend Zimmerman Plumbing and Heating in Mechanicsburg. We use them for all our heating & cooling needs. We got a new oil furnace several years ago. They had 3-4 levels of pricing. They’re not cheap, but their workmanship and Service is top-notch - the best I’ve ever come across in all my years. We have met Earnie Zimmerman personally. His guys are professional, super nice and trustworthy. We also used them for air conditioning splits in our house a few years ago-  can’t recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Michael Garman
reviews.text: Paul did a fantastic job investigating and finding the source of a slow water leak showing up on our basement ceiling. He was able locate the leak, determine the best approach to repairing the leak with the least amount of material and time. He was able to repair the leak by replacing part of the drainpipe where the leak occurred. He was very knowledgeable, professional, and detailed oriented. This is the third time we have called upon E Zimmerman to help us with a plumbing issue and they always do great work. Will definitely use them again when needed.

reviews.author: Don Bair
reviews.text:
My wife and I moved into our new house on Main Street Saturday. Monday night some boiler sensors went out on our radiators. Long story short our whole house started to leak from basement to 3rd floor. Their emergency services were ready to take our call at 9:30 at night. Jason walked us through how to shut off the boiler and step by step to keep further damage from happening.

Fast forward to next morning less than 12 hours after the initial call took place Zimmerman’s had a technician in route to come take a look. Justin greeted us with a friendly smile and was master class in knowledge of our boiler and issues taking place. After a short time he discovered the reason for our problems. Soon enough we had a quote to fix our boiler.

Not ready to jump ship and push our emergency to another day he asked if he could fix the boiler now. Justin worked for 2-3 hours until the boiler was up and running. Testing it multiple times to ensure it was functioning properly.

Did I mention this all went down on 12/22 and 12/23 right before Christmas. I can’t thank Zimmerman’s enough for saving our holiday season and making us feel safe in our new home!

reviews.author: Tyler Dolbin
reviews.text: Zimmerman had installed both the water heater & HVAC unit in the house my wife & I recently purchased. We scheduled a regular maintenance with Zimmerman to ensure our HVAC unit was running well, as the natural gas HVAC system was new to us (previously had electric). Ed, our technician, was super helpful, educational, & informational. He went above & beyond to both service the unit, and also educate & inform us on the system. He answered any questions we had & then some. He was also able to give us a quote on a new water heater replacement upon my request. He was very friendly & honest, and the HVAC maintenance was fairly priced. I highly recommend calling them!

reviews.author: Crystal Brallier
reviews.text:
Called on an early Saturday morning asking if they provide emergency services due to water not working.  The receptionist indicated they couldn’t send out anyone because we do not have a preventive maintenance agreement with them.  Receptionist was more concerned about pointing out that we last used their services in 2018 and inquired what service provider we have used in all the past years.  I explained that fortunately, my husband is capable of doing a lot of work and we don’t rely on anyone else.  Receptionist stated she could send someone out in the next week.
Get real!  Who can wait that long for water?  I’ll never call them again!

plumbers.name: Limelight Services
plumbers.address: 4540 Venture Dr #100, Johnstown, CO 80534, USA

reviews.author: M S
reviews.text: We were very happy with our tankless water heater replacement today.  The technicians, Robert and Brennan, kept us informed along the way, left everything neat and tidy, and gave us a thorough review before they left   I highly recommend them and would you use this company again in the future!   Thanks so much for the hot water!!

reviews.author: Bambi Oshel
reviews.text:
We were very pleased with Limelight Services. Christine was helpful and great at communication for scheduling and the technician they sent out, Ben Holden, did an amazing job.
Ben was knowledgeable, personable, and patiently took his time addressing every possible concern we had, letting us know that it was nothing to be concerned about in the electrical system but he did offer solutions to eliminate the issues in the future. We plan to meet with them early next week to get that done.
I asked about under counter lighting and Ben will be installing that for us in the near future.
As we just moved to a new home we have some issues that would make the home more comfortable for us and Ben addressed those with solutions too if we are ever interested..
While he was here he installed some new plugs for my husband that were badly needed in the garage.
We highly recommend Limelight Services  and plan to call them for future projects.

reviews.author: G S
reviews.text: I'm a returning limelight customer, and they continue to provide great service. Jeremiah cleared a really tough drain in my bathroom. He explained the issue, helped me figure out the best price option, talked me through what with he did and gave me advice to improve my maintenance in the future. He was also very thorough about cleaning up, and kind to my dog. I'd be happy to work with him again.

reviews.author: Kjersten Johnson
reviews.text: Limelight was fantastic! I actually called them after poor customer service and callback from another company—and I’m so glad! They were helpful on the phone and then even got me in much earlier than scheduled (thank you, Celeste!). Brayden was then our technician and he was amazing. He was communicative and explained what was happening while solving the problem as quickly as possible. And my cat and dog loved him! Prices were fair and service was great.

reviews.author: Leslie Krug
reviews.text: I am incredibly impressed and thankful for the work that Trevor did today from Limelight Services. He was professional, friendly, on time and very knowledgeable; He also taught me some valuable tips about electricity, which I love. Five stars definitely. We have plumbing needs and will reach out to Limelight for their plumbing expertise. I am impressed that limelight treats their employees really well, is family owned, has a five star rating, and is a suite of services. Try them you’ll like them.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 5650 Blazer Pkwy, Dublin, OH 43017, USA

reviews.author: Michael Grav
reviews.text: Dave from Roto-Rooter did an outstanding job fixing leaking pipes from my washing machine line, kitchen, and bathroom. With 26 years of experience, his expertise really showed. He was extremely professional, paid great attention to detail, and took the time to explain everything he was doing. On top of that, he was very friendly and respectful of my home. The whole experience was smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend Dave if you want the job done right.

reviews.author: Bruce Millard
reviews.text:
We had Taylor from Roto-Rooter to fix a leak in the main water line coming into the house (before the whole house shut-off). He had to turn the water off at the street and then go get the parts and install them. Did this take all day? Nope -- just about 2.5 hours. He did a great job and is an honest to God nice guy!

The pics I'm adding are the before and after shots.

reviews.author: Rick Collins
reviews.text: Had an issue with toilet on a Friday, Roto-Rooter quickly respond and came on-site within a few hours time. They were very courteous and completed the repair in short order.  The cost was higher than average for repairs but probably because of the fast response.

reviews.author: Andy McMillan
reviews.text: Service itself was great. Zero complaints with the gentleman who did the work. He was courteous and thorough. However, to have to pay $817 for a simple garbage disposal replacement was pretty steep. To charge $300 on top of what I felt was already overpriced to replace a 6 inch piece of PVC pipe was an extra kick in the teeth. In all honesty I should have shopped around but once he was already at my residence I didn't want to send him away and not get the work done. Lesson learned on my part. The only reason for the low score has NOTHING to do with the quality or work.

reviews.author: Lindsey Anders
reviews.text: Dave is the best! He arrived quickly and was kind and respectful. He also didn’t try to scam me like many other companies do. He was honest and explained things in a way that didn’t make me feel dumb. He fixed the repair quickly. Would DEFINITELY recommend Dave.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 5851 Pearl Rd #205A, Parma Heights, OH 44130, USA

reviews.author: C Beeowens
reviews.text: I absolutely loved the plumber who came out and snaked our tub. I cant remember his name but, He was so kind and generous. When your going through a stressful life situation its always nice, Just to have someone to talk it out with. Not only did he fix my tub he also offered alot of great ideas and helpful tips to prevent our situation from happening again. I really appreciated our conversation, and would highly recommended using this company in the future.

reviews.author: Lisa Pizzurro
reviews.text: Doug was our technician and he was fantastic!! Very knowledgeable and did great work! He managed obstacles very well and explained them in thorough detail! He was super nice and very professional! We would definitely work with Doug again!!

reviews.author: Georgeanne Hancsak-Tag
reviews.text: Jake and Joe were polite, respectful, knowledgeable  and professional. They arrived on time, kept work area clean and communicated what needed to be done. Our job was completed without any issues. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sandra Morton
reviews.text: Trayvon #1067 from Roto Rooter was sent out to our home for a plugged tub repair.  Trayvon was super nice, friendly, and professional.  He explained everything he was going to do to fix the problem and fixed our issue just as he explained.  Trayvon worked neatly and cleaned up after himself.  I would highly recommend Roto Rooter for any of your plumbing needs.  If I need a Plumber in the future I will definitely call Roto Rooter and ask for Trayvon to be sent to my home again.  Very kind young Man, thank you Trayvon.

reviews.author: Mark Levigne
reviews.text: Reaching someone who is available is good.  Reaching someone who 'knows their stuff'?  Well that's the ticket these days.  I felt confident with Bill working on our issues from the moment we shook hands.  He kept me abreast of the progress and the estimated cost as we discovered, which one normally does, other issues that should be remedied while the issue called for is being resolved.  The quality result was high confidence that the issues we had would not return with advice on how to avoid potential ones down the road.  That's gold to me as a homeowner/ customer.  Thank you Roto Rooter and bigger thanks to Bill3811 for great service.  We always know that our home is in good hands when we call you.

plumbers.name: Western Rooter & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 136 E Santa Clara St #1, Arcadia, CA 91006, USA

reviews.author: Michael Khachadoorian
reviews.text: Art did an amazing job, front to back. I am SO grateful to him for figuring out our issue from the getgo, which wasn't easy. We hired two other companies to come try and figure out why our hot water kept going cold occasionally. They both assured us that it had to be the mixing valve or cartridge failure. I spent SO much unnecessary (wasted) time changing them out, doing some plumbing on my own.. it was all a waste.. because I didn't call Western Rooter first. The other guys kept saying our water heater checked out. All these tests, no problem. Finally we called Western Rooter as a last resort because my friend highly recommended them, and Thank God we did! Because they finally solved it! They said it's the water heater, and I was like, "are you sure?? The other guys tested it and both said it's fine!" apparently not all tests are equal or the other guys were just not as smart as Art at Western Rooter. I was astonished.. but this is the difference between true, I mean TRUE professionals, and somehow these hacks that get by somehow. Thank you for being available to me! You truly saved the day and allowed us to have nice hot showers again without worrying about them going cold. Highly recommend! PS, CJ was our billing guy, and was great to work with as well!

reviews.author: Gallagher Goodland
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Outstanding Service – Ask for James!

Western Rooter is an absolutely phenomenal plumbing company. They came out to fix a clogged sink, and the entire experience exceeded my expectations from start to finish.

James was the technician who handled the job, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for better service. He wasn’t just highly professional and clearly an expert in his field—he was also personable, respectful, and incredibly easy to work with. He took the time to explain what was going on, worked efficiently, and made sure everything was fully resolved before leaving.

Because of this experience, Western Rooter will be the only plumbing company I call going forward. And when I do, I’ll be requesting James specifically. It’s rare to find both a company and a technician operating at this level of quality and care.

I couldn’t speak more highly of Western Rooter or James. Truly exceptional service across the board. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Christine Byers
reviews.text: Plumber could not have been nicer and was very thorough in addressing the problem. Fee was reasonable given the time spent to fix the problem. Office staff were proactive and organized when I called to schedule service. Communication was adequate in terms of keeping me apprised of the timing of the service call.

reviews.author: Fred Mesbah
reviews.text: We have been using Western Rooter & Plumbing for our condominium complex. We had a kitchen drain clog this morning so I called Western. Joan at the office was very courteous and helpful. Albert came out a couple of hours later. He couldn't be more professional and courteous. He fixed the drain in no time and was very clean and organized. He is excellent! I highly recommend Western and Albert.

reviews.author: Derrick Lee
reviews.text:
Highly recommended plumbing company! I reached out to Western Rooter through Yelp and was impressed by their efficient communication. Jose and Shella were extremely responsive with scheduling, and I appreciated that they do not charge for an initial inspection, which is a huge plus. Other plumbing companies charge for the initial inspection.

Another standout is that they service apartments and condos, which can be surprisingly difficult to find in a plumbing company.

Shoutout to Kevin, who helped diagnose and fix my leaky toilet. He called ahead with his ETA, arrived on time, and quickly assessed the issue. Best of all, he didn’t try to upsell anything. While other plumbers told me I needed to replace the entire toilet, Kevin fixed the problem by replacing a gasket. They do honest work.

The entire team was professional and easy to work with. I would absolutely use Western Rooter again and highly recommend them to anyone in need of reliable plumbing services.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Drain Service
plumbers.address: 136 Tanner Rd, Greenville, SC 29607, USA

reviews.author: William Howard
reviews.text:
Travis Reid did an outstanding job!  The Frankenstein valve for the dishwasher the builder install started leaking and was lightly flooding the cabinet and floor.  Travis replaced it with a quality quarter turn valve and put in a new supply line to the dishwasher. Turned the water back on and it works perfectly.

We’ve used Rotor Rooter at our past house and had excellent experiences. The great experience today was no exception!

reviews.author: Jimmy Martin
reviews.text: Travis was very professional plumber and did a great job. My wife & I did not want to be without water a second night. Travis had to rebuild our tub faucet and build an access box. Highly recommend Travis and Rotor Rooter!!

reviews.author: Liz F.
reviews.text: Roto Rooter has always been able to clear out pipe clogs when they happen in my older house. Their prices are fair and they perform quality work. The dispatchers and technicians are always friendly and knowledgeable. I also had a leaky toilet fixed quickly as well. They don’t try to add in unnecessary work either. John was very helpful today and now we can use our plumbing again.

reviews.author: Michelle McLeod
reviews.text:
Miles and Jose were fantastic. They were punctual, respectful, and took time to explain the issues with our disposal and water pressure that were contributing to a leak.
They answered any questions, and made sure I understood and felt comfortable with the work and quoted costs.
They worked efficiently, and cleaned up after. They were also friendly!
Would definitely recommend their service.

reviews.author: Paragermania
reviews.text:
We called Roto-Rooter for an inspection on our gas water heater after noticing a leakage.
The person on the phone, (customer service) was excellent with a very fast response. Shortly after the technicians Ellis Wheeler and Tylor Fobian arrived. We felt in the best hands possible, due to not only very knowledgeable in the field but also very caring individuals. The whole team was working non stop until the project was completed. And let me tell you the finish product was flawless.
When we are talking about good, better, best. This company is truly THE BEST. 100% recommended. Very grateful and happy customer!

plumbers.name: Fry Heating, Cooling & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 152 Hamilton St, Toledo, OH 43604, USA

reviews.author: tracie durfey
reviews.text: Justin and Jaydin installed our new furnace today. They were very professional, polite, and knowledgeable. They did a great job. Very pleased.

reviews.author: Lisa Labbruzzo
reviews.text: Emergency holding tank blowout this a.m.  first off the person who answered the phone was amazing! She was able to get a person.. aka.. Josh Cash sent to my house in record time! I was freaking out as I didn't know how to shut off the water..Josh called me and talked me through it..amazing! He was very thorough and friendly and knowledgeable! This could have been a horrible day but was made better because of Fry! Will definately recommend..thanks again Josh! You're the best!

reviews.author: Rick Gozdowski
reviews.text:
Gabe was GREAT!! He came by my house and
before he started, he advised me on some options for a replacement water heater, to save me some money; I really appreciated that.  Gabe was professional, engaging, answered all my questions, and cleaned up and made it look like he hadn’t been there.

reviews.author: Chris Fullen
reviews.text: Although I had to pay $150 for the HVAC tech to come out for 10 minutes to tell me that they had to send the plumber instead which would be a minimum of another $250 due to the time of day, both guys were nice and friendly. I do feel like should get at least part of my $150 refunded to me, how is a customer supposed to know what service they need if it all goes to the furnace?

reviews.author: Larry Cain
reviews.text: fan motor was not working proiperly on condensor unit. Technician went through entire system to see what issues there may be. Determined exact probmen and repaired. Discussed curremt system and compared a new sytem. Service was thorough and reasonably priced. I would recommend Fry to any of my friends.

reviews.author: Marc Cittadino
reviews.text: The team was timely and professional.   We had our water heater go out and these guys showed up quickly and saved the day with a replacement.   They also replaced the main water shutoff valve and do excellent work.  Josue was a wonderful craftsman.

reviews.author: C C
reviews.text: Alex and his team (Shane and Dylan) at Lloyd’s Plumbing did a fabulous job with every aspect of toilet installation. I actually stopped them when they were at a neighbor’s, as I was getting ready to look for a plumber. They finished their business with my neighbor, came to take a look at the problem with my toilet and sent an estimate right away. Alex and Dylan are kind and personable. Alex came back with Shane, on time as scheduled. (The customer support is great too, when I called to update them on my own needed scheduling.) Alex is very professional and knowledgeable; he led the way for obtaining my new toilet and installing it. Alex did a fantastic job! He and Shane were in and out so quickly, without compromising a secure installation process. They left the area clean, too. I am so happy! Highly recommend Lloyd’s Plumbing!!

reviews.author: Tracy Piccirillo
reviews.text: Josue V. Did a fantastic job… He replaced my kitchen faucet and gave me a new garbage disposal and when he left, you couldn’t even tell that anybody had been there!   Very courteous and very prompt on time. Thank you.

reviews.author: Teresa Byrne
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Brandon today.  He arrived on time, was friendly and professional and explained the issue clearly before starting the work.  The job was completed efficiently….everything is working perfectly now (he replaced the water pressure regulator.) Thank you!

reviews.author: Q M
reviews.text:
Professional service, on time, good value. Needed new whole-house regulator and hot water heater expansion tank to stop pressure fluctuations. Problem fixed.

We’ll go with Lloyds next time without hesitation.

reviews.author: Carolina Nino
reviews.text: Mike Counsil Plumbing provided excellent service. From the start, all the information was clearly explained, including the issue, the process, and the solution. The technician, Hugo Perez Dominguez, was professional, knowledgeable, and very efficient. He completed the repair quickly, answered all questions thoroughly, and made sure the work area was left clean and organized. I especially appreciated that the issue was resolved the same day. Highly recommend both the company and Hugo for reliable, high-quality plumbing service.

reviews.author: Jack Griswold
reviews.text: Both Bobby Mata and Nestor Godoy were most excellent. Together they rebuilt my good old Eljer toilet back to like-new condition quickly. A bit pricey, but with a 1 year warranty, I am sitting quite happy. Very professional. Thanks. All the best, Jack

reviews.author: Kerrie Bindi
reviews.text: Our Technician Pablo walked us through everything step by step. Completed the job and made sure we were satisfied with the work. He was not only competent but friendly and cleaned everything up before leaving. A+ service and I will use Mike Cousil again after this experience!!

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.text: The team at Mike Counsil was very professional and provided reliable service. The hot water heater installation went smoothly, and Thomas took the time to make sure everything was working properly before leaving. Clean work, great communication, and excellent results.

reviews.author: Soheil Degan
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Mike Council Plumbing. Their technicians, Bobby and Nestor, were at my house within an hour of my call, quickly diagnosed the cause of a sewer line backup, and cleared it out efficiently. They were very professional, easy to work with, and did excellent work. Their pricing was also very reasonable. Highly recommend Mike Council Plumbing for prompt and reliable service.

plumbers.name: DrainGo Plumbing and Septic Services of Alabama
plumbers.address: 2793 Pelham Pkwy, Pelham, AL 35124, USA

reviews.author: Tineshia Kennedy
reviews.text: “Excellent customer service from start to finish! Amber was able to fit me into the schedule and followed up with me to let me know when the technicain was in route. Thomas arrived on time and repaired our water heater quickly and efficiently. He was professional, knowledgeable, and respectful of our home. We truly appreciate the prompt service and would highly recommend them!”

reviews.author: Serena Dovell
reviews.text: I was very pleased with the service.  Instead of it being a simple repair, I needed a whole new water heater, which was not surprising since the old heater was 20 years old. Thomas and his assistant were very friendly and knowledgeable. I highly recommend Draingo.

reviews.author: Megan Webb
reviews.text: Dawson Taylor was very kind, knowledgeable, and professional.  We woke up Christmas Eve to a plumbing blockage preventing toilets from flushing properly, sinks backing up in the kitchen, and it was basically "raining" sewage in the basement if we tried to use any kind of water.  Had to go through my warranty with AHS and the first plumbers they assigned said it would be January 2nd before anyone could come out (while the house is unlivable in this condition not being able to shower, use the bathroom,  etc.).  I called and asked for a different plumber and they connected me with DrainGo who got me scheduled for 12/26.  Dawson was able to identify the potential issue but was unable to get to the blockage d/t how my house only had a 1 way clean out.  He came up with a plan, but of course the warranty wouldn't cover what needed to be done.  He was able to come back today,  12/29, and installed the 2 way sewer clean out in my backyard and was able to reach and clear the blockage.  We had to stay in a hotel for 5 nights, but with the holiday, I don't see anyone else getting it done quicker.  I appreciate Dawson and both helpers that came (1 each time). I also appreciate the ladies who reached out each time to get me on the schedule and understanding the urgency of the situation.  The price was also very reasonable for what all he had to do.  Thank you Dawson and team.  I will definitely be recommending you all.

reviews.author: Emily L.
reviews.text:
We had an emergency at 7PM Wednesday 1/28/26 with a burst cold water pipe in our kitchen. I was at the hospital with a family member who died that night so my husband called 4 plumbers and DrainGo was the first to agree to come out. He fixed it in less than 1 hour but charged us TWO THOUSAND DOLLARS. Since when do plumbers make $2,000/hour? They 100% screwed us over because they knew we didn’t have a choice. My husband isn’t a plumber and he was panicking so they took total advantage of us. On top of that, we now have a NEW leak under our sink that was NOT there before. PURE EVIL.
2/1/26 UPDATE: Our hot water pipe in our kitchen burst today. Tell me why Roto-Rooter came out, spent 4 HOURS fixing it (AND the leak under the sink caused by DrainGo) on a SUNDAY and only charged us $650????

reviews.author: sherron hardwick
reviews.text: The technician Collier was very patient and understanding. He responded so politely and explained each process to me. The young ladies I spoke with when I was having problems logging in walked me through the process. Each person I spoke with was very helpful and patient with me.

plumbers.name: Airco Service

reviews.author: Austin Kendall
reviews.text:
Great service, Great work! I'm a VIP member to care for the new Lennox HVAC that replaced my 25+ yo Lennox and a new Navien tankless water heater.
The install last year was seamless and fast.
Drake managered the project and almost a year later still helping me fix some issues. Chris gave me the best estimate for the work I wanted and saved me thousands of dollars. I was also able to finance the new installs interest free for 60 months.
My friend Lucas works for AirCo and I'm glad he recommended them. Both Techs that have come to service the units so far have been great, the latest being Corey. He was very casual about his work, seemed very knowledgeable, efficient and ensured to give me recommendations for preventative maintenance.

reviews.author: Kim M Mullen
reviews.text:
Skyler, Chris, Adrian, and Josh are great employees.  Josh and Skyler explained everything that was going to happen; answered all of my questions, concerns, and worked non-stop.  They cleaned up and made sure we understood everything. Chris Scotto with Airco Service was also so helpful and knows exactly what is needed.  He even came by during the installation to check on things.

They show up when they say they will, there's no wasting time, and they are, ALL, extremely polite and respectful.  Thank you for a job well done.  I highly recommend Airco.

Thank you guys.  I appreciate your hard work.  God bless you, ALL.

reviews.author: jerm13 jones
reviews.text: Prefoessional, courteous and polite. From the tech to the sales rep and the install team, everyone was awesome. Install guys completed an entire HVAC system removal and install in hours, including the duct work! When they were finished, they walked me thru the whole process, showed me all of the work done and equipment installed, explained all the new features and answered any questioned. Huge shout out to the entire Airco team for getting us set up before the major winter storms!

reviews.author: Vicki Wright
reviews.text: From the on-site supervisor down to the installation techs, all were fantastic!  They came in this morning and worked diligently until the installation was competed. I am impressed with the professional attitude each worker displayed.  It was a pleasure to see dedicated employees such as the ones working for your organization. Kudos to whomever hired the techs and supervisor. All ensured I was completely satisfied with their completed work product.

reviews.author: Corey Chastain
reviews.text: Nick and Jerred were wonderful and fixed my kitchen sink quickly and with obvious skill. They diagnosed further issues and solved them on the spot, leaving us with a fully functioning system. They were professional and friendly even when my kid poured random questions at them. Would absolutely request them personally again.

reviews.author: Jack Tudor
reviews.text: It was unfortunate that my 15-year-old hot water heater decided to die. I've had Spartan plumbing, come out to my house 2 other times. This is the second time. Braden has been to my house and both this time and the last time where flawless work. Matt dropped off the water heater and assisted with the install. I now have a brand new hot water. Heater and all new brass and plumbing and even replace some of the gas lines. Both other appointments were a brand new main water, shut off and exterior faucets. I also had them replace all of the water lines going to each one of the toilets with all new handles and fixtures. Every time they come out is very professional, clean work. I would highly recommend Spartan plumbing to any and all of the people I know. Sincerely, Jack Tudor.

reviews.author: Mike Brunett
reviews.text: Tim with Spartan Plumbing did an excellent job on our water heater. He was on time, courteous, and extremely thorough. What stood out most was how clearly he explained the options and made sure the repair was done the right way, not just the quick way. If you need plumbing work done, I’d absolutely call Spartan Plumbing again and request Tim.

reviews.author: Josh Hess
reviews.text: Braden was great. I drilled through a pipe and He was able to fit us in the same day and took great care of our plumbing issue. Gave us some quotes for additional work without being pushy and even gave me a couple of resources to help with the finishing work I was doing when I caused the initial problem. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Mark Colvin
reviews.text: Cristian, Kris and Jerred did outstanding job replacing our leaking water heater. The job was done the same day in only a few hours. They were all professional and friendly. Another excellent job by Spartan Plumbing!

reviews.author: Adam Pepper
