reviews.text: High 5 did a great job at replacing my water heater. Job was completed the next day after choosing them since their quote was very affordable compared to other quotes. Jose and Michael were both extremely professional. Thanks guys! 😉❤️

reviews.author: Michelle Rosabal
reviews.text: Needed a plumber.  Hired Corey at High 5 Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electric.  Excellent service from start to finish. Scheduling was easy, he arrived when promised, and the work was done efficiently and at a high standard.  He took the time to explain the issue and how to fix it was fixed. Corey was easy to work with and he gave me alternative options too.  Honest, professional, and reliable - highly recommended.

reviews.author: Russell Saunders
reviews.text: Jaeden was the tech who showed up for our plumbing inspection and hot water heater flush. He arrived within the time range set up and I was called when he was on the way. Jaeden was personable, professional and answered all my questions. He offered suggestions on things that needed to be done without the high pressure to upsell me. He completed everything on time and cleaned up after his work area. He was extremely conscious on putting on shoe covers. Would highly recommended Jaeden and High Five for your plumbing, electrical and hvac needs.

plumbers.name: Fix-it 24/7 Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electric
plumbers.address: 8599 Prairie Trail Dr Unit A-100, Englewood, CO 80112, USA

reviews.author: E.D. Schleissmann
reviews.text:
Saved my BUTT. My dad and mom are both ancient and freezing when it’s like 68° outside. So when the furnace went down, so did any sense of calm and peace in my life. Especially from my dad.

It took about three hours, but my 11-year-old furnace. Got a new blower motor and I also got a new little pump for the humidifier.

My dad got heat finally, and quit blaming me as if it was all my fault. What a day.

Must mention Joseph. Their tech was polite, knowledgeable, and absolutely wonderful. Good guy if I need help again I hope I get him.

reviews.author: Shad Ozaki
reviews.text:
Tyler is beyond awesome! From the moment he came to my door in the morning until the job was finished that evening, he painstakingly ensured that everything went smoothly for me. He had vast knowledge about the questions I asked and easily put things into layman’s terms. He is very respectful and took great care of my home and my experience during the entire process. Tyler is the kind of gentleman I would like to meet in any circumstance. I could not have asked for a better experience. Thank you, Tyler!

Brian is amazing! I am so thankful that he installed my new HVAC system. It is obvious that Brian takes immense pride in his workmanship and is exceptionally skilled in his craft. The job is beautifully done. I could not have asked for a better experience. Thank you, Brian!

reviews.author: Mark Mareth
reviews.text: Where to begin. In July I had to have a water heater replaced in an upstairs condo. Was in a bind as it had busted and was leaking through the floor into the downstairs neighbors. Couldn’t find any one else to replace it that evening, or even come out and take it out for me. Well they quoted me $4500 for a replacement and wouldn’t budge on price. Just screw me I figured. Let it go and bit the bullet. Even though it took them 2 days to do the job and trained a new guy at my expense. When I tried to get an itemized list of everything replaced. They fought me tooth and nail for it. It was not until I not so politely. Let them know that I realized they had stuck it to me for a $2500 job by charging me $4500. Then they finally gave the list. As said, I was going to let this go and move on as the tech was pretty cool. But, they tell me they can not give me any paperwork for taxes so I can at least try to get a rebate back. Didn’t even try, just said the rebate stuff only applies to HVAC. Absolutely do not use these people. They will RIP you off and not even blink. Absolutely worst experience ever dealing with Denver Contracters right here.

reviews.author: Rose C
reviews.text: WOW! I cannot say enough good things about this company and its employees! Our furnace went out and we also knew our electrical panel was old and we needed more space so we decided to do both at the same time. They were able to come out so quick to do a consultation and they got the work done in the same week! All of the employees that we met were really incredible, they were all so knowledgeable and kind, they explained everything to us and make sure we were comfortable every step of the way. HUGE shout outs to Colton and Cory who did our electrical and Joe, Ian, Jacob B., and Elijah who worked on our furnace. Seriously, if you need work done give them a call, they actually care and will treat you and your home with respect! We spoke with other companies and they couldn’t answer our questions or were thousands more. These guys are the real deal! And the customer service is amazing!

reviews.author: D Man
reviews.text: We had an issue after a freeze, our frost-free hose bib had a hose left attached, and when it was turned on, water leaked behind the siding and showed up in the basement near the rim joist. Rock Plumbing’s technician, Cesar Alfaro, was excellent. He explained exactly what happened, walked us through the repair, and fixed it quickly. I’m also a Club Member, and it’s been one of the best programs we’ve joined…Rock Plumbing has serviced multiple things in our home fast and efficiently every time. Thanks, Rock Plumbing!

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of The Oakland-Berkeley Area
plumbers.address: 50 Hegenberger Loop, Oakland, CA 94621, USA

reviews.author: Manuel Rivas
reviews.text: Alfredo arrived promptly as scheduled.  He was polite, professional, and efficient.  He cleaned up the job site before leaving and tested the plumbing.  The work comprised of opening the wall and cutting a drain pipe to lower it to proper code and installing new plumbing below the kitchen sink.

reviews.author: Jessica Kim
reviews.text:
Had a very smooth and positive first experience with Mr Rooter, especially with our technician Alfredo!

I called to make an appointment and they had one available the next morning. I received a text 30mins before the appointment to let us know Alfredo was the assigned technician and on his way. He was punctual to the appointment, and after walking him through the issues, he explained the job that needed to be done clearly. The quote and details were pulled up upfront on the iPad, with flat rate pricing that also listed the components that would be replaced.

Alfredo himself was very courteous, knowledgeable, and very helpful. He guided us through the whole process with clear explanations of what he was doing. Besides fixing the immediate problem, he also took some steps to diagnose multiple other possible root causes of the issue. I very much appreciated that he didn't put any pressure or push with going for a larger or broader jobs. When I also shared about some auxiliary concerns, he went above and beyond to provide additional recommendations and information. I was very grateful that he was our assigned technician - thank you!

Mr Rooter came highly recommended by a neighbor - so while I didn't do much as much research on how it compares - I would go with them again in the future again given how positive this experience was.

reviews.author: Kiyomi Yim
reviews.text: Arrived home to a pool of water all over the kitchen floor.  Found we'd sprung a leak in a line under the kitchen sink past the shut off valve.  Thank heavens Alex was able to come out within hours.  He confirmed we'd shut off the water correctly, inspected under the house, explained everything he was doing, and then offered multiple levels of solutions to choose from.  I wasn't in a state of mind to make a big decision and so he offered to come back the next day.  He returned promptly the next day and did the work in a few hours.  There was never any pressure to do more than what we were comfortable with; we'll definitely be calling Mr Rooter and Alex when we're ready to do more work! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rose Huynh
reviews.text: Mr. Rooter was able to come and fix my sewer backup issue within the same morning. Alfredo was our plumbing technician and he was very professional and friendly. He took the time to explain to me how things work and was able to creatively solve some out of the box hiccups that arose during the service. Their pricing is not the cheapest but you get what you pay for. We would definitely recommend them for your plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Monica Lee
reviews.text: Our technician Alfredo was amazing. He was quick and efficient! Our toilet was clogged and he helped us identify the problem. He also went above and beyond and checked on our plumbing under in the crawl space.

plumbers.name: Chris' Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 2551 Zion Hill Loop, Weatherford, TX 76088, USA

reviews.author: sheila richards
reviews.text: This was my first time using Chris' plumbing. The appointment process was easy and the follow up was very good. The tech showed up on time was very thorough. He was able to fix the outdoor problem but was unable to fix the toilet problem. He explained the issue, and I was able to get the manufacture to replace the toilet. I thought they were very reasonable with their pricing.

reviews.author: Johnny Dwire
reviews.text:
Jeremy was the most professional plumber I have ever hired for a job… and I’m 80years old. He and his helper ( don’t remember his name) worked fast, explained what they did and why they did it and left the area as clean as it was when they arrived.
I have seen their work trucks around  town but had never hired them until my well company recommended them. C&C Water Well Co has been my savior for a long time and I trust them and tried their reccomendation and was truly impressed with Chris Plumbing!

reviews.author: Ronald Cage
reviews.text: Very quick was able to get it done two days early on December 31st just before New Years amazing effort on their part . Very professional clean and kind . Did wonderful work I as amazed.

reviews.author: John Bruce
reviews.text: Some of the best service I’ve ever had.  Fast response, completed the job quickly, and no surprises.  The final bill was $6 less than their  estimate!  Everyone I delt with, from the first phone call to the completed job, was very friendly, and went beyond the norm to be helpful and informative.  I highly recommend Chris’.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Scott
reviews.text: Jeremy was very professional and competent.  My plumbing issue was fixed promptly and at a fair price.  Chris’s Plumbing is a great company ; I have used them for years. Honest and dependable!

plumbers.name: Quality Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric
plumbers.address: 2840 N Brookfield Rd Ste 2, Brookfield, WI 53045, USA

reviews.author: Marilyn Hartmann
reviews.text: Bryan was wonderful. He was totally knowledgeable about what was happening with our furnace. He explained everything to us clearly, very professional. Bryan has a good customer service personality which is always appreciated.  I definitely would recommend him to anyone. Oh, yes, he did fix our furnace & gave us recommendations for future maintenance. :)

reviews.author: Victoria Glenn
reviews.text:
We had a great experience with Quality Heating when they came out to fix our heater. From the initial call to the completed repair, everything was handled professionally and efficiently. Skye arrived on time, clearly explained the issue, and walked us through the repair options without any pressure.

The repair was completed quickly, and he made sure everything was working properly before leaving. We really appreciated how knowledgeable, courteous, and respectful Skye was. We would absolutely recommend Quality to anyone needing HVAC service and will definitely use them again in the future.

reviews.author: Steve J
reviews.text: We hired Quality to perform some miscellaneous electrical upgrades at our home. The technician arrived promptly at the scheduled time and was personable and professional. The service and communication were excellent. We would not hesitate to work with them again!

reviews.author: Alfonso Zorro
reviews.text:
Excellent across the board.  Tech was able to address and answer all of my many questions and concerns.  But, for $200, it would be appreciated if my standard size filter(1×16×25) would have been replaced.  In the past visits this was a perk freely done as a part of the service and at a much lower service cost.
I think I will use my dirty furnace  filter to block the dangerous rays from the sun as I save the planet.

reviews.author: Timothy Hendrix
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience with Quality during an extreme cold spell when our furnace suddenly stopped working. They provided amazing emergency service, and our technician Bryan L, was super timely, thorough, and very informative. He clearly explained the issue and got everything working quickly. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Al Terry Plumbing, Heating & AC
plumbers.address: 1776 Hooksett Rd, Hooksett, NH 03106, USA

reviews.author: William Forbes
reviews.text: Nick was great, got right to the point. He explained my cooling and heating system. No pressure to buy. Family-owned company is what made the experience even better. I'm looking forward to being a new customer. Thanks Nick, you represent the company with professionalism and honesty. The install was great !! great clean happy crew. I made the right choice going with Al Terry. Here and gone in 1 1/2 days. AC and Furnace.  Thanks Branden, it was great to meet your crew. No mess, super clean up when they were done. THANK YOU !!!

reviews.author: Derek Levine
reviews.text:
Al Terry has been excellent. My 23 year old High Velocity AC Failed, they did some basic repair attempts and quickly recommended replacement due to age. I agreed. AC installation cost has essentially doubled since 2020 due to inflation and government environmental mandates so I got 3 estimates. 2 of the 3 were nearly identical so stuck with Al Terry since they were familiar with the situation. Everyone was polite, helpful and professional. Installation of my system took 2 solid days, the installers were great. Got it running just in time, going to be 93 degrees tomorrow! Appreciate the nice Veterans Discount!

2nd review of this excellent company. Had no hot water, Boiler shut down and wouldn't restart. As always, Jen very helpful was able to get technicians here the VERY NEXT DAY, early morning. Techs were right on time, polite and professional. Turned out it was my 10 year old side Venter with a seized motor preventing the boiler from running. They did a full cleaning, and replaced the fan, everything is working great! Reasonable price and appreciate the military discount. 5 stars!!

reviews.author: Ann
reviews.text: As usual the service by Al Terry's team was professional, courteous and expertly done. They installed a new heating register for us and the difference it has made already is amazing. Special recommendation and thanks to the pair of technicians we had --Alex and Jayden. They were very friendly and helpful,  answering all our questions, even those not related to the installation. A great NH company!

reviews.author: Brianna Frost
reviews.text:
I was able to book an appointment online quickly and easily within a few days of needing some non-emergency work. The staff were extremely accommodating, understanding, and very knowledgeable.

They were prompt in providing updates and letting me know when they were on their way. While in my home, they went above and beyond to make sure everything was working properly. They were respectful, thoughtful, and easy to have around, even while I continued my workday.

Before starting the project, they walked me through the entire process and made sure I understood what was going to happen. At the end, they reviewed the completed work with me and carefully explained the receipt. Warren and Drake were an absolute delight to have in my home. They were kind and respectful not only to me and my home but to one another during the entire job.

I would highly recommend them to anyone in need of plumbing services.

reviews.author: Thomas Trombly
reviews.text: We were extremely pleased with everything and everybody within the Al Terry organization. Cameron and Eddy did a great job installing our mini split. We will continue to use AT for any future projects. Thank you for your quality workmanship.

plumbers.name: Brothers Plumbing, Air & Electric
plumbers.address: 98A Shelter Ct, Greer, SC 29650, USA

reviews.author: Diana Moore
reviews.text: Great service, we had an exterior gas line leak. The technician showed up on time and was very friendly and knowledgeable. He had the job done in no time and it did an amazing. Will definitely use them again for future repair needs.

reviews.author: Steve Peterson
reviews.text: Called about installing some dimmer switches for some recessed lighting. I was expecting to have to schedule someone 3 weeks out. I worked with Sarah on scheduling and had a technician show up the next day! Nick arrived on time, answered all our questions and finished the install within minutes. Very professional, very accommodating with schedules and very responsive. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Haley Ouzts
reviews.text: Grant was seriously awesome. So helpful and went above and beyond to help us in our time of need. Carolynn offered fantastic customer service and guidance as well. We will only be using Brothers Plumbing from now on. AND, my Nana gave them a glowing review/referral as well, she is hard to please so that is saying something!!

reviews.author: Blake Randolph
reviews.text:
Called Brothers to fix an outdated pipe that had collapsed behind our washing machine. Justin, Nate, and Max were professional, punctual, and gave us a great price compared with other competitors in the area. Sarah was also great. She kept me in the loop throughout the process and worked around my schedule to help us get the issue fixed as quickly as possible.

This is the second time I’ve called them, and both times they delivered the same level of expertise and white-glove service you hope for when you need repairs. I’d recommend them to anyone who doesn’t want to be price-gouged or pressured into fixing things that don’t actually need fixing. Easy 5 stars. highly recommend!

reviews.author: Chris Hawkins
reviews.text: Guys did major upgrade including Ac and all ductwork, furnace and plumbing repair they discovered. I wasn’t looking for the cheapest company, I wanted the best installation and these guys are pros. Had a crew here for four days and they were excellent people, I couldn’t imagine better HVAC guys, I would highly recommend

plumbers.name: Service Hero Plumbing & Air
plumbers.address: 24800 Industrial Blvd, Hayward, CA 94545, USA

reviews.author: Jordan Defiesta
reviews.text: Darrion was excellent to work with. He was fast, respectful, and very transparent about the work that needed to be done. He clearly explained the options, pricing, and next steps, which immediately put me at ease. His business and sales acumen made the entire process smooth and pressure-free, and it was genuinely easy to do business with him. I’d absolutely recommend Darrion to anyone looking for a reliable, trustworthy plumber.

reviews.author: J T
reviews.text: Logan was great to work with on our drain issue. He was very courteous and had reached out to let me know what time he'd be there. He was done within 30 minutes of arriving and took care of the backed up drain. He was very conscientious of making sure water did not get all over the place and that was appreciated!

reviews.author: Mike Robinson
reviews.text: Fantastic experience.  Kent was quick to arrive, quick to assess and diagnose, and quick to resolve the issue.  He was polite, personable, and made me feel completely at ease during the whole process - one that was causing me some concern as it was a potential flooding of my garage.  Great work - and would love to work with him again... anytime.

reviews.author: David Paul
reviews.text: I called Rooter Hero on Saturday evening and a technician came over in a hour. Bryan was very professional and handled the plumbing issue in about 30 minutes. This is my 2nd time using rooter hero and would recommend their service.

reviews.author: Manoj varughese
reviews.text: "I had a great experience with Rooter Hero Plumbing when they came out to fix my kitchen sink. The technician, Diego Ruiz, was amazing—he took the time to explain every step of the process so I knew exactly what was being done. The work was finished exactly when promised, and the price was very fair compared to other quotes I received. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for honest, high-quality plumbing work. Thank you, Diego!"

plumbers.name: Grogg's Home Services
plumbers.address: 1492 E Pike St, Clarksburg, WV 26301, USA

reviews.author: Matthew Walker
reviews.text: I know timing played a roll in it but we went from a quote to installed in less than 24 hours. Don came to our house yesterday and went over absolutely everything with us in detail. He had a lot of different packages in a wide range of prices. He never once tried to upsell us into products we told him we had no interest in. He even custom catered a plan for us that was what we were looking for in terms of a package. We asked a lot of questions and he answered them all in terms we could understand. The technicians showed up on time and the installation looks great. They wore boot covers the entire time even in my basement where it’s not necessary. There is zero mess left behind. During the install Don even stopped by to check in and see how things were going. I am beyond impressed with the service. From the beginning I got messages with pictures of who would be coming to my house and when. They all called ahead, showed up on time, and were all polite and professional. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: T Yurkovich
reviews.text: We have been customers for several years. They are very responsive. They show up when they say they will. Their technicians are always courteous, professional, and thorough. They explain everything clearly, and typically offer multiple solutions for repair or replacement. Their services and pricing are presented clearly, and there are never any "surprise" charges or fees. I never hesitate to recommend them to friends and family.

reviews.author: James Sook
reviews.text:
They were so kind and knowledgeable. Explained what was wrong with my furnace (and air conditioner). My equipment was set up on 2004 and it was on life support. With these single digit temperatures outside, they did not mess around. They came one day, then had everything replaced and stuff the next.

I have a brand new setup that's energy efficient and safe. They replaced both my furnace and air conditioner.

reviews.author: smano1@smano.com Mano
reviews.text:
I've worked with Rick and Dakota on several projects.  They are skilled plumbers and great at finding solutions to complex problems.
I would highly recommend them for your next plumbing project.

reviews.author: Lauya Spatafore
reviews.text: I was very happy that someone was able to check my nonworking furnace on the day I called. The technician that came was Clyde Scranage and his assistant. I appreciated the knowledge, professionalism, and kindness offered to me. I have not used Grogg’s before but it definitely will not be the last time. The problem was identified and options presented to me without pressure.

plumbers.name: Valley Plumbing Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 1490 N 300 E, Lehi, UT 84043, USA

reviews.author: James Torrens
reviews.text: Jaxsen did a great job. He came on short notice today, gave me a good, reasonable price, I hired him to do the job right then. And his work was very well done. Thank you.  I’m back in business.

reviews.author: Juli Odekirk
reviews.text: So far I haven't had any work done with Valley Plumbing but they have been EXTREMELY thoughtful and accommodating with my schedule even after I had to cancel with them!!! They have been MORE THAN understanding!! I'll let you know after they do the work. LOL but I'm sure they will do a great job.

reviews.author: Benji Xochimitl
reviews.text: The service was prompt, professional, affordable, and effective. The technician, Trey, was easily one of the most amiable, knowledgeable, transparent, and respectful individuals I’ve had the pleasure of working with. I would easily recommend both him and his company at large for plumbing services.

reviews.author: Christine Segura
reviews.text: Jaydon did an excellent job! He made me feel very comfortable, answered all my questions and was quick and efficient. He didn’t push anything on me, which I really appreciated.

reviews.author: WasatchValley RealEstate
reviews.text: They were prompt and efficient. Had another company scheduled to come between 9am-1pm. Received a text from that company at 12:14 PM that they would not be coming today and will be coming the following day. Immediately canceled that and called Valley plumbing, they made it up to my property within one hour. Very pleased and will refer them again and again in my real estate business!

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Abilene
plumbers.address: 2929 S 1st St, Abilene, TX 79605, USA

reviews.author: Bruce Amdal
reviews.text: Grady and Juan did an excellent job!  They were very good about keeping me informed about what was happening.  I would definitely recommend them for your plumbing needs.  Becca in the office was friendly and very helpful as well.

reviews.author: Jen
reviews.text: Grady did a fantastic job today. He arrived very early, which was great. It only took him about 30 minutes to install the new garbage disposal. No more leaks. I appreciate the service.

reviews.author: Maria Rodriguez
reviews.text: I had a very good experience with this company. They were very nice, professional, and didn't take long at all. Price was pretty good too. I've called them before for previous issues and had a good experience with them in then too. Pretty sure mr. rooter is going to be my plumbing go to when I need something fixed.

reviews.author: Gerald V
reviews.text: Anthony did a wonderful job, working on my place. Very knowledgeable and helpful. Older heater was out of code, it was very much needed.

reviews.author: Karen LaBrenz
reviews.text: Grady was excellent at describing the problem and using ingenuity, and problem solving to fix my issues.  He was very kind with my dogs that were too friendly jumping on him.  I will ask for this repair technician by name when using Mr Rooter.  Also the young lady that makes the appointments handled my needs with kindness and respect.  Thank you Mr Rooter for making my experience using my   Warranty Service pain free.

plumbers.name: Ark Plumbing Service
plumbers.address: 1232 Commons Ct, Clermont, FL 34711, USA

reviews.author: chrissy Peterson
reviews.text: We were extremely pleased with our service person Omesh. He was polite, hard working and preformed excellent quality work. I would want him to date my daughter if she didn’t already have a nice boyfriend. lol. Their project manager Tom was  also extremely knowledgeable and helpful.  We use ARK for all our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Vladimir Kurlikin
reviews.text:
Had a really bad experience with this company. We are looking to get our hot water heater upgraded and were interested in hearing our options, spacifically related to an electric tankless heater. The technician arrived on time, but had absolutely no helpful info to give us. He refused to even discuss the electric tankless option, and instead recommended a gas heater option...even though our home doesnt have gas. He also mentioned just getting a bigger tank, which i followed up asking the pricing for that but he couldnt answer. He needed us to pick a size. So we did and he still didnt have any pricing to show us.

We waited over 45 minutes while he called several people to get quotes for things i feel he should have had going into the appointment.  He answered almost none of our questions, (even basic ones like the difference between a tank and hybrid heater), something he should have just come prepared with. If you are coming to give someone a quote, wouldnt you have most of the pricing/spec information ready?

Ive never had a technician be so unprepared for even basic questions. We finally got sick of waiting and politely canceled the appointment. I called a local competitor who was able to immediately give us pricing for all the options as well as recommendations for whats best for our home. Theyll be coming out to do a formal quote next week and will just go with them.

reviews.author: Jennifer McMurtray
reviews.text: Michael Moore spent today installing my new heat pump water heater and answering all my plumbing questions, and I am thrilled.  It was a very professional job on a complicated piece of equipment, and now I qualify for tax credits and a rebate. He also  had a quick look at why my garage sink drained slowly and why 1 of my toilets is making noises.  Michael is very knowledgeable and friendly, and he went above and beyond on this job. Very patient with helping me connect the phone app to this "smart" water heater. Also, Ark was the lowest bid I received for this job.  Thank you, Michael!

reviews.author: Julia H
reviews.text: Michael was fantastic! We had a shower where suddenly the water wouldn’t turn off, so we tried replacing the broken shower cartridge ourselves, no luck. Twice. Michael came out and installed a new shower cartridge.. instant success! What a relief, I’m definitely happy with this service.

reviews.author: Roderick Pasteur
reviews.text: Michael was awesome! Most service people when they come to your home you can tell they’re in a hurry and they’re trying to hurry up and get out and they’re not friendly and they just wanna be left alone, but Michael took the time to explain everything that was going on with my tankless water heater gave many suggestions. He gave me an honest assessment, he was friendly and took the time to explain everything in detail.

plumbers.name: Rapid Response Plumbing
plumbers.address: 100 Paper Mill Rd Suite 4-D, Lawrenceville, GA 30046, USA

reviews.author: Pete Barkelew
reviews.text: I believe I got an honest and sincere effort from Jason Johnson, with Rapid Response Plumbing, to take care of my home’s sewer problems. He was a very forthright in describing what needed to be done. Jason and his assistants delivered exceptional service in the construction of our new sewer drain system at a very reasonable price. I would highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Nicole Jacobs
reviews.text: Needed a plumber ASAP & Jason was ON IT!!! Came out, & spotted the issues without me saying much. He’s was very knowledgeable & professional. Jason had to replace a faucet in one bathroom & a toilet in the other. He did the work in NO time👍🏽& everything was back to normal. Jason is Very friendly & has great customer service!!! If I’m not mistaken I think the supervisor even came out to check on him to make sure Jason was good👍🏽 That’s TEAM WORK!!! I would definitely recommend this company to anyone who needs a plumber!👍🏽👍🏽TWO THUMBS UP!!!

reviews.author: Charity Sasser
reviews.text: Called when my water heater busted and they sent one of the guys out to my house the same day. Luke did an excellent job replacing the old water heater with a new one I bought. He was kind, courteous, and all around cool guy, knows what he’s doing, and gets the job done. He was awesome, highly recommend him and the company!

reviews.author: Mireille Adinsi
reviews.text: Stevie came out to look at the leak on the recirculation pump. It turns out we have bad recirculation pump so he replaced it with a high quality one. He  did a wonderful job.  I will always recommend him for everyone.

reviews.author: Chase Bradley
reviews.text:
I typically do my home projects/repairs myself and hold a high standard when hiring professionals to work on projects at my house.

In this particular instance the job was too big of a task and knew I needed a licensed plumber.

After getting multiple quotes and talking to a dozen or so plumbers about all of my different options, Luke provided the best solution to running the gas line at an incredible price.

Within days of picking Rapid Response for the job, they worked around my hectic schedule and picked a day at my convinience.  Luke and Daniel arrived early to go over the plan once more and prep for the complex project at hand.  Both Luke and Daniel are very knowledgeable.  They worked throughout the day, were polite, courteous and kept a very clean job site.  They were able to handle this task within a single day and went above and beyond all my expectations.

plumbers.name: GPS Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3064 Kentshire Ln, Frisco, TX 75034, USA

reviews.author: Steph C
reviews.text:
We highly recommend Fischer Clements and Nick from GPS Plumbing! They are both professional, friendly, HELPFUL, amazing and patient! The first photo shows our attempt to weld our shower plumbing renovation. We wanted to try our PEX but had problems welding the copper so we contacted GPS Plumbing.
Day 1: they squeezed us in to review our plumbing and discussed with us the scope and estimated time for completion. Since it would take longer than the time allotted, they scheduled to come back the next day for the first morning appointment.
Day 2: Fischer and Nick arrived smiling and provided positive feedback that the plumbing will be resolved that day. They did NOT disappoint. Watching Fischer work is like watching an sculpture at work while listening to his cool music playlist!! He thinks outside the box and understood my husband’s goal for the shower. Since I love to learn new techniques, it was amazing watching how fast and accurate Fischer welds the copper with such accuracy and finesse with Nick by his side providing the tools he needs (similar to a doctor and nurse interaction). Fischer took the time to explain the process to me which was so fun! I hope he started his YouTube channel because I plan to subscribe to his channel to learn from him. They completed our plumbing in less than 4 hours and let me tell you, the time went by fast watching and learning as well as listening to awesome and fun music! We highly recommend Fischer and Nick to help fix and solve your plumbing issues! They are both professional, friendly patient and fun!! The second photo is Fischer’s completed work. He completed the PEX in a minute. Amazing!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Jessica Murawski
reviews.text: I originally called GPS Plumbing after getting a quote from another company that felt pretty high, and I’m so glad I did. From the start, the customer service was excellent—the woman who answered the phone was incredibly friendly and got me scheduled quickly. The technicians who came out were knowledgeable, professional, and easy to talk to. They completed the work efficiently and did a great job. I really appreciated how clearly they explained everything, which gave me confidence and peace of mind. Overall, great experience from beginning to end, and I will definitely be calling GPS Plumbing again in the future.

reviews.author: Jami Sowerwine
reviews.text: GPS will be the only plumber I will ever call again.  They are the best in every catagory!!  I needed to replace a couple of tub spouts. They helped me get the parts for free from the manufacture, because of the weather the parts were slow to get here, I had to reschedule 3 times. They were wonderful every time I called. The guys came within an hour of the parts arriving.  The price was great.  Not the first time I used them and again won’t be the last.  I highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: Keep the FAITH
reviews.text:
Admittedly, this is my first time using GPS plumbing and I am very happy with them. We wanted to replace our hot water heater before it started spilling out in the garage. I called and they were here in just a couple days. They were very, very professional and nice people. When  they got here today they went right to work. It looks great. There’s a nice sturdy pan under the hot water tank now and it drains correctly, out of the garage. both of the men that were here were both very friendly, kind, and professional. They even discovered a sprinkler leak, which I appreciated.
Thank you GPS  we are very pleased

reviews.author: Kitkat Dallas
reviews.text: Brandon at GPS Plumbing is an absolute rockstar! He works incredibly hard from start to finish, tackling the job with skill, focus, and zero shortcuts. You can tell he genuinely cares about doing quality work and taking care of your home. Super professional, friendly, and efficient — highly recommend him and the whole GPS team! Steve the owner has done great on building this company from the floor up! Keep the good work up everyone;)

plumbers.name: Expert Services - Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electrical

reviews.author: Gilmar Gatto Filho
reviews.text:
My experience was great from the beginning. In the discovery part, they took the time to review, test, and plan the best option for my situation. I feel like they were on my side, looking for the best that fits my expectations and giving a professional opinion.

The execution of the plan was excellent. In my case, a few things on my front lawn needed to be disturbed, but they did their best to preserve most of it without compromising the service that needed to be done.

Highly recommend, take the time to talk with them and ask all the questions that are needed to make the best decision

reviews.author: Alyxandra Tenario
reviews.text: Chandler was great at servicing our tankless water heater and explaining the very likely consequences of not having a water softener installed alongside the tankless heater. He was quickly able to address all other plumbing concerns, as well as installing the water softener, all of which was unexpected on the initial call. Additionally , he helped to coordinate another specialist to come inspect our drainage system for potential repairs. All in all, I greatly appreciated his thorough response, informative/educational conversation and friendly banter while he worked.

reviews.author: Scott Taylor
reviews.text: Woke up to a leaky water heater, they came the next day, less than 12 hours later. Hunter was AWESOME! He gave us tons of options, shared the pros and cons of each, and wasn't pushy at all on which option we should choose. He took care of everything, was clean, polite, and professional! Would absolutely recommend and will 100% be our first call if we need help again in the future!

reviews.author: Debra Shannon
reviews.text:
The technicians Cort and Hunter did an Awesome job working hard all day. All of your technicians went the extra mile to help with financing and removing and installing the heater. They removed the hot water heater and put it back after the utility room was cleaned. Your company should be proud to have all of them working for you. I will call on your company for future needs and recommend them to friends and co-workers.
Thank you for a job well done.

reviews.author: Tracy George
reviews.text: David from Expert Services found the leak in our utility room and carefully checked our water system, explaining how everything worked and restarting our water softener and filter to make sure everything worked properly. He swapped out our kitchen faucet for a Moen faucet that has been a dream. The garbage disposal he installed has been powerful, but whisper quiet. David did excellent quality work quickly, sourced hard to find parts, and stayed late to finish. Outstanding plumber and just a nice caring person.

plumbers.name: Scott Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 7734 Madison Blvd STE 119, Huntsville, AL 35806, USA

reviews.author: J Axtell
reviews.text: We were referred to Scott Plumbing by our neighbors and we are so thankful!! We had our 2 kitchen sinks and dishwasher backing up and they sent Brandon the day I called them to fix it!! Brandon was awesome. He knew the exact problem and took care of it quickly and efficiently. He was very thorough/documented the whole repair with photos. From start to finish, thank you Scott’s Plumbing and Brandon for your prompt and excellent service!!

reviews.author: Olda Phillips
reviews.text: Scott Plumbing personnel was very responsive.  We had a busted pipe in our yard.  Bobby and his colleague identified the issue and corrected the problem. They explained everything they would do to identify the issue and also advised of the proposed costs.  The team was friendly, informed and very professional.  The cost was very reasonable. We highly recommend. Will use Scott Plumbing again

reviews.author: Laura Jevitt
reviews.text: I was able to get an appointment right away. Keith and Logan showed up right on time, both very friendly and got right to work. Very knowledgeable and explained/showed me what the problem was and how they fixed it. I thought the price was very reasonable for both jobs, too. Highly, highly recommend and I will definitely use Scott Plumbing in the future!

reviews.author: Scott Lahoda
reviews.text: Called Scott at 11am, had a tech to me by 2, and new hot water heater installed by 5. Absolutely incredible and for a fair price. Best thing was the tech. Smart and a great guy. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Carolyn Figueroa
reviews.text: Brandon came out to my house promptly and was professional and knowledgeable. We made a plan to fix my hose and will be out next week to repair it due to my needing to wait for payday. He was willing to repair it right then, however if I hadn’t needed to wait. The price seemed reasonable-it’s not an easy fix.

plumbers.name: AAA AUGER Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 2437 E Union Bower Rd, Irving, TX 75061, USA

reviews.author: Terri Borrego
reviews.text:
i called AAA Auger, and explained to the gentleman in the office that I had 2 other plumbers come and I could give pictures and a smoke test video. He said they would take the information I had and do a visual and give me a free inspection and give me an estimate. The guy came out, told me it would be $437 for his visual, he would dig around under the house a little and look everything over really good. I was already in my feeling with my sewer pipes issues , so not really thinking it through, I allowed the inspection. In hind sights I should have sent him back, because I was mislead.
I’m glad I didn’t use them, What else would they have mislead me on.,….
AAA Augers guy pretty much found the same issue the other plumbers found. But AAA Auger quoted me an extremely higher price!!
I decide to call one more company, with years of experience, who actually honored their free estimate. They were in the same price range as the first 2 Companies.
I did Not trust AAA Auger, so I did not use them…

reviews.author: Mike C
reviews.text: AAA Auger has been our go-to plumbing company for many years and we are still high on their responsiveness and quality service. They are fair and knowledgeable and do the work right. It takes several good experiences to gain this level of trust. We're lucky to have them available. Today's service by Tim McGrady was fantastic, easing our concerns about an outside spigot and cutoff valve that had broken. With the impending winter weather and hard freeze, we were very concerned but AAA Auger and Tim put us at ease. It took a morning online request, a call just a few minutes later and Tim was on his way. By early afternoon, it was all done. Thanks Tim and AAA Auger!

reviews.author: Jared Perry
reviews.text:
AAA Auger has been awesome to work with. We bought a home that had been flipped before the previous owner, and there have been issues galore. Having used other plumbers in the area, they often didn't catch the issues or weren't able to make a full repair.

AAA Auger has been out to our house probably 5 or 6 times now, and each time they've done excellent work in a timely manner for a good price. They show loyalty to their customers, and when our pipe broke the first day during this past freeze, they did everything they could to get someone out to us as soon as possible.

reviews.author: Kris Cook
reviews.text: Wow! AAA Auger is so professional. They sent Ramiro who was very thorough and informative. Our issue was a toilet not flushing. Additionally , the toilet was rocking and needed to be seated. He solved both problems quickly and efficiently. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Marisa Trevino
reviews.text: Highly recommend AAA Auger for plumbing needs - these guys are awesome! I used them today for toilet change out and TIM did an outstanding job - professional, efficient and thorough. He left restroom looking good as new and even took time to review and discuss some additional plumbing concerns I had.  The work was completed with care and integrity, and Tim honored his original quote, so there were no surprises or hidden fees. I had compared prices beforehand, and another company quoted significantly more. I’m very glad I chose Tim/AAA Auger.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 241 McLaws Cir Ste 101, Williamsburg, VA 23185, USA

reviews.author: Heavenly Angel
reviews.text:
Outstanding service – ask for Zak Jaber and Quentin!

I cannot say enough good things about licensed plumbers Zak Jaber and Quentin from Roto-Rooter. They were truly an answered prayer.

From the moment they arrived, they were professional, respectful, knowledgeable, and courteous. They arrived on time, treated my property with care and quickly assess the issue. When an additional shower part was needed. They promptly went to pick it up and returned and no time at all.

What impressed me the most was their efficiency and expertise even with obtaining the necessary part they completed the entire job in less than two hours. The workmanship was exceptional, and it was clear. They take great pride and what they do!

Zak and Quentin are a tremendous team-Smart, hard-working, professional, and genuinely pleasant to work with. They made what could’ve been a stressful situation feel easy and manageable.

Roto-Router is fortunate to have these two represent the company. I will absolutely recommend them to my family and friends and if you need plumbing work done make sure you ask for Zak Jaber and Quentin. You simply can’t go wrong with this duo.

They really helped me out. Thank you both for your outstanding service. I truly wish you continued success and all the best!

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Five Stars All the Way!

Respectfully, Ms. Nicole Flora

reviews.author: Sheri Wall
reviews.text: I called in around 6pm for a non-emergency service, just to get something scheduled the same week. The girl who answered the phone was amazing, very upbeat and professional. Then, within THIRTY minutes a tech showed up. Terry was absolutely incredible. Very through, kind, and efficient. He recommended a small repair. I really felt like he wasn’t trying to take advantage of us or just hit us with a big repair bill. I really felt good about the entire experience, and I will use this company again.

reviews.author: Scott
reviews.text:
OUTSTANDING!!!  Roto-Rooter truly came through for us after hours. Our technician, Kriston D., stayed until 1:00 AM to clear a clog in our sewer main. He handled the cleanout efficiently, made sure all of our questions were answered, and treated our home with care—cleaning up thoroughly once the work was complete. Kriston epitomized true professionalism and showed genuine empathy for our situation by ensuring we were satisfied with the work performed.  He exemplifies and sets the standard for the kind of employee I would hire any day to work for me!!!!

The next day, Tyrell H. came out and performed a camera inspection to confirm the line was clear. He also took the time to help us understand what was going on and explained the next steps thoroughly, which I really appreciated. Excellent service from start to finish—highly recommend!

reviews.author: Victoria Addison
reviews.text: Had another local plumbing company come out to try to unclog my kitchen sink drain.  After an hour, the plumber told me that I would have to have my granite countertops removed and my base cabinet pulled out so they could cut a hole in the wall to see where the plumbing goes. I decided to get a second opinion and called Roto-Rooter. Hunter was amazing within an hour he had the clog completely cleared.  It’s now been two weeks and I still have not had any issues. Thank you Roto-Rooter/Hunter for saving me thousands and thousands of dollars and a lot of stress!!

reviews.author: Daniel Blok
reviews.text:
Just wanted to share my experience, maybe this will help others.  I woke up in the middle of the night, to a leak, in which I couldn't figure out where it was coming from, so I called my usual plumbing company, Roto-Rooter, in which the very next morning, a gentleman by the name of Derek D, came out to look at my issue.  Within minutes, I knew it was a great visit, just based on his professionalism, and being a down-to-earth gentleman, that wasn't trying to bang me in the head with a bunch of nonsense!!!
Within minutes, he was able to detect my issue, even went out of his way to find the part, and within an hour and a half, my issue was resolved!!!
Thank you Derek and Roto-Rooter for such a wonderful job, without charging me an arm and a leg!!!
Very reasonably priced, very speedy service, and overall a pleasurable experience!!!
Thank you again Roto-Rooter, and a very special thank you to Derek and being such a knowledgeable and professional employee!!!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 333 W 2230 N Ste 320, Provo, UT 84604, USA

reviews.author: Daniel Walker
reviews.text: Matthew was great.  I was under the impression I’d have to replace my disposal. He was very professional and did a great jo.  Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Eric Smith
reviews.text: We had a leak in our water main and noticed wet carpet. The service team came out, identified the problem and resolved it quickly. They were professional and the customer service was incredible!  Matthew worked well past the end of his normal shift to make sure we were taken care of. I would recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Mason Mathis
reviews.text: I called several plumbing companies, and Quick Quality Plumbing was the only one able to get someone out immediately. Jaren arrived promptly and was fantastic from start to finish. His communication was on point—he walked me through the entire process and kept me updated every step of the way. The quality of his work was exceptional, and he made everything easy to understand. I would highly recommend Quick Quality Plumbing to anyone looking for a reliable plumber and will definitely be using them again in the future.

reviews.author: Sierra Wilcox
reviews.text: Our service from Roto Rooter was absolutely amazing! Our toilet broke after hours, and they were quick to respond and temporarily fix our issue, and then come back a week later to install a new toilet. Our plumber, Matthew, was absolutely wonderful and did an amazing, clean job!

reviews.author: JaNae Pyle
reviews.text: We were very thankful that Roto Rooter came to help us with our water pipe leak. Both Matt and Roy took great care of us and stayed until the issue was fixed. Again, very much appreciated!! 💕

plumbers.name: Golden Rule Plumbing & Contracting, LLC
plumbers.address: 1331 Pottstown Pike, West Chester, PA 19380, USA

reviews.author: Dawne Clark
reviews.text: Cannot say enough nice things.  Brett and his helpers were amazing and did a fantastic job.  Cleaned up impeccably every afternoon. Used many drop cloths to protect the flooring from entry to bathroom.  He is conscientious and professional and always on time.  His work is perfection and he is very concerned that the homeowner is happy.

reviews.author: Brian Levy-Polis
reviews.text: Everyone at the company was fast to respond and excellent at fitting me in with my tight schedule.  The quoted price for a tankless upgrade was the best of 3 I received by a good margin, was the only one that stated it was the maximum price for work, and the company was the only one that respected my research and did not try to either upsell me or convince me to get something else.  The plumbers were polite, fast, did a good job, and cleaned up after themselves.  They found a better way to complete the work that I hadn't considered and ended up charging me less in the end as well.

reviews.author: Fred Sheehan
reviews.text:
It was an enjoyable experience working with Golden Rule Plumbing through our remodeling project. They were the first contractor to disconnect the plumbing and sinks before demo could begin.

After the new flooring was put in,
Golden Rule Plumbing came back to reconnect the plumbing and sinks and hook up the new toilets, faucets and valves.

They arrived on schedule with all the materials needed for the job and began work right away. Kyle was great in coordinating everything and Brett the Senior Master Plumber did an outstanding job with making sure and double checking everything was right.

Thank you Golden Rule Plumbing & Contracting LLC

reviews.author: Hans Huang
reviews.text: Had a bit of an issue with changing the appointment time because of unexpected emergency calls, since I was under some time constraints and couldn't reschedule to another day. Golden Rule was flexible and communicative, so despite the delays I would absolutely call again. Ed and Tanner were extremely professional and pleasant to work with. They diagnosed and fixed the small leak that we had dripping down to the basement within the hour for a very reasonable price. I really appreciated the honestly, with no unexpected fees, upsells, or service contracts.

reviews.author: Alan G. Morse, PhD
reviews.text: Matt & Tanner were efficient, effective and totally professional.  Work was excellent!  Only reason I didn't go with a 5-star review is because I had requested a ETA so I could be sure to be on site and arrange for my dog not to interfere.  Unfortunately, the message I received only said that they "were in route" and they only called when they had already arrived.  No big deal, but that extra step is very appreciated!

plumbers.name: Dr. Drip Plumbing and Heating
plumbers.address: 123 Woodland Ave, Westwood, NJ 07675, USA

reviews.author: Paul Bandolon
reviews.text: For Dr Drip Bathroom remodeling decision - Nick and his crew (Izzy) did an excellent work. They work fast and quality is exceptional. I had some last minute request they gladly accommodated. Everything was flawless. Highly recommended. Thank you for your hard work. - Satisfied customer

reviews.author: Elgha Dilworth
reviews.text: As the owner of 130 year old home, it’s difficult to find a good plumber who’s able to old plumbing & antique fixtures.   I received a prompt call back from Dr Drip & great service from Evan & Tim.   They were able to replace an old cast iron overflow & waste pipe without damaging my antique cast iron tub & also handled a few other repairs.   I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Meaghan Wright
reviews.text:
Water damage can be overwhelming, but Dr. Drip made the experience far easier than expected. Communication was seamless, and they were able to quickly get to the root of the problem. One technician in particular was extremely accommodating and knowledgeable, with years of experience that truly showed.

We had a leak in our shower basin caused by poor installation by the builder, and Izzy clearly explained exactly what had been done incorrectly. He removed the tiles with minimal disruption and worked around our schedule to get everything resolved. I can’t recommend his expertise enough. On top of it all, his witty sense of humor made a stressful situation more pleasant—and any Steelers fan is always a win in our book

Before and after photos below-

reviews.author: Aaron Lee
reviews.text: Nich did an amazing job with the boilers in our basements all in one day. He sourced the materials  and his team of experts went at it. The stairways were tight be his team made sure not to damage any parts of it. Overall amazing work. The pipes are setup in a clean and presentable way as well. There has been no issues since it was done in Aug, 3 months ago. Would highly recommend Nich and his team.

reviews.author: USA Security Services, Inc.
reviews.text: Our water heater needed to be replaced immediately and my current plumber decided to price gouge due to the urgency of the matter.  I called Dr. Drip the same day, Nick, the owner, came to the house within 1 hour, assessed the situation and provided a substantially better price.. Best part...Nick sent Mike over with the new tank and it was completed that day.   They were professional, courteous, and left the work area clean and neat.  Its just how good business is done...Highly recommend.

plumbers.name: All Clear Plumbing & Drains
plumbers.address: 19 NJ-10 East, Succasunna, NJ 07876, USA

reviews.author: PaulieWalnuts
reviews.text:
We recently had a boiler installed by All Clear Plumbing and Drains, and the entire experience was excellent from start to finish. Their team was extremely professional, very knowledgeable, and provided outstanding customer service.

They were very informative when helping us make decisions and took the time to answer all of our questions. It was clear they really knew what they were doing and wanted us to feel comfortable with the installation and the system we chose. This was an oil to gas conversion so it added more complexity.

The installation itself went smoothly, and they cleaned up everything very neatly when the job was done, which we really appreciated. From the quality of the work to their professionalism and communication, the service was exceptional.

I would absolutely recommend All Clear Plumbing and Drains to anyone in New Jersey looking for reliable, knowledgeable plumbing professionals. Al, Fernando, and team were great!

reviews.author: don fulloon
reviews.text: Gregory did an excellent job replacing our kitchen faucet and valves. He arrived right on time, was very polite, and worked efficiently. The installation was done quickly and neatly, and everything works perfectly. I really appreciated his professionalism and attention to detail. I would definitely recommend Gregory for any plumbing work.

reviews.author: Evy Grabinski
reviews.text:
Finally found great plumbers who respond to phone calls immediately. Al came to my house to provide a free quote for a new hot water tank install & miscellaneous plumbing task. Within 72hrs I had a new hot water tank & all my plumbing needs were fixed, wow! Great service for reasonable prices. I can see why All Clear receives 5 stars ***** from customers! I’m a  customer forever! Thank you!!

Richie arrived to fix the kitchen sink hose, rebuilt the toilet & fixed the spare bathroom sink. Very professional, friendly & efficient. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Nicole Phin
reviews.text: I needed a pressure reducing valve replaced and all clear plumbing was professional and got the job done quickly. I was able to get a free quote then schedule 2 days later for the work to be done. Their office’s communication was great. They called in advance to let me know when they’re on the way and even texted me a link for tracking so I knew exactly when he would be arriving. They were timely, even early on both occasions and didn’t keep me waiting all day. Greg was so friendly and explained everything thoroughly! I’ll definitely be calling them again in the future

reviews.author: Dave LoSapio
reviews.text:
Had All Clear come out to make several repairs, advise on pipes susceptible to freezing, and discuss adding a smart valve to the water main. Great communication from
the office ahead of the appointment, friendly, and always a live person to talk with.

Greg, our technician, was fantastic! We looked everything over, discussed options, and pros/cons of the smart valve. Greg was very knowledgeable and provided great info on the valve that helped with decision-making. He was efficient and got the work done quickly and neatly. Great experience all around.

reviews.author: Benito Gomez
reviews.text:
Hosea was the plumber that replaced my water heater. He was really professional, transparent and honest about the work that needed to be done.
He was really generous with the pricing of the service that he performed and communicated everything with me clearly. Hosea definitely went above and beyond with his service in a timely manner.
Excellent service that far surpassed my expectations Roto Rooter plumbing will be my go-to shop now going forward for all my plumbing needs.Thank you for your expertise and service Hosea and Roto Rooter🔧 😁

reviews.author: Gene McCloskey
reviews.text: They were very quick to respond and assess the situation.  When a part needed to be special ordered Eric was very communicative and explained why and what costs would be involved.  The work was done quickly and done well.  I will definitely insist on having Eric do future work on my house.

reviews.author: Tam Nonea
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter was able to assist in a timely manner with an unfortunate plumbing issue I had as a new homeowner. The folks that helped resolve the issue(s) are very informative and weren’t pressuring to make a quick decision/sale. I was always informed of what was happening prior to and no actions were done without my agreeance. Special shout out to Raven, she did her thang replacing a cracked drainage pipe that was nearly 7ft long!!

reviews.author: Tim Furbee
reviews.text: Thank you to Roto-Rooter and their plumber Raven. They were fast, polite and got completed the replacement of our main water shutoff did valve in a total of 4 hours. That include the initial call, dispatching a tech and completing the job. 5/5 will recommend in the future. Raven was also a 5/5 I will for sure request her again.

reviews.author: Cecile Djoumessi
reviews.text:
I would like to sincerely thank Kyle Wesley, Williams and Hannah from Roto-Rooter Restoration Services for their outstanding support during my water damage restoration process.
From the very beginning, they were professional, responsive, and extremely helpful. They promptly removed the wet drywall, handled the necessary water mitigation work, and carefully moved items during the pack-out process to prevent further damage.
What truly stood out was their guidance beyond the basic restoration work. They:

Helped coordinate a professional company for the specialty pack-out of valuable items

Assisted me through the insurance claim process with clarity and patience

Provided advice on how to find qualified contractors for flooring, drywall installation, and other repairs

Answered my questions thoroughly and kept me informed throughout the process

Dealing with water damage can be overwhelming, but Kyle and Hannah made the experience much more manageable. Their professionalism, communication, and genuine concern for doing the job correctly gave me confidence during a very stressful situation.

I highly recommend Roto-Rooter Restoration Services, and especially Kyle, Williams and Hannah, to anyone in need of water restoration services.

plumbers.name: Rooter Hero Plumbing & Air of Los Angeles
plumbers.address: 14401 S Western Ave, Gardena, CA 90249, USA

reviews.author: Arik Warren
reviews.text:
My toilet stopped filling up in the tank last night and after a quick google search I landed on Rooter Hero. I think most of us are a little apprehensive about calling a plumber, since we are inexperienced and worry about extreme prices and services. I felt like I was taking a gamble.

Nelson arrived about 1 hour after calling in. Within 15 minutes he gave me a precise estimate of the cost. He had to go back to get a part and he was back within 45 min. He went above and beyond, helping me with something I wasn’t charged for. Friendly, professional, and extremely informative. I’m very grateful for the quick, no stress experience I had and I’d recommend this company to anyone in my building. Thanks, Nelson.

reviews.author: Janice Holloway
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Rooter Hero Plumbing & Air of Los Angeles. The technicians were friendly, professional, and arrived on time. They quickly identified the issue and explained everything in a clear and honest way before starting the work. The job was completed efficiently, and the quality of service exceeded my expectations. Pricing was fair, and there were no surprises. I highly recommend Rooter Hero to anyone looking for trustworthy plumbing and air services in Los Angeles!

reviews.author: Joseph Ben Dov
reviews.text: Yony and Omar came out and quickly diagnosed the issue. Omar was able to get my pilot relit and gave me great advice on getting the part replaced through the warranty. They arrived very fast and were professional and friendly. 10/10 would recommend again.

reviews.author: StrandlifeHB
reviews.text: If you have money to blow, this is your company!  First guy George that came out was very nice and knowledgeable.  Unfortunately the next guy who came out Fernando was straight out of Used Car salesman 101 training.  He charged me $350 for 2min of his time to tell me nothing could be done without a $20,000 re-pipe.  While this was definitely one solution, they refused to offer any other temporary solutions, and said $350 for a 2min estimate was justified.  I had another company come out and snake the line from the clean-out for $200 and everything works great.  It’s a bummer I called these guys first however.

reviews.author: James Choi
reviews.text: I have met so many passionate people in a long time. The service of this company is amazing, but the people are even more amazing. Mr Yony Vasquez was friendly and passionate at every moment. I am truly grateful. It was a pleasure to share the little food I had. I am truly grateful.

reviews.author: Pamela Dimig
reviews.text: The young man that came here today was very courteous polite respectful. Gave us our options which was very good. He unclogged our kitchen drain that was running very slowly. But he did tell us we could go a little longer if we wanted to but we have a big party coming up so we opted just to do it. But I thought the price was kind of hard high I know he doesn't set the price but I thought it was kind of expensive. But you guys are always trustworthy and stand by your work. reviews.author: Elijah Poulos
reviews.text:
James from Mr. Rooter was excellent! He came out, accurately diagnosed our septic system's issues, and fixed everything the same day (the day after Christmas too). So happy with everything we even signed up for their advantage plan the same day for regular service. Great job!

Update: So, maybe not so great after all. So, the 1st time James came out, the problem was that power had accidentally been cut to the septic system, and it became clogged. Turns out, my ststem has an aerator/agitator and a pump which all require electricity.  Ok fine. James pumped the effluent tank (into my yard) and unclogged the pump/system, and it worked for about 2 days. I still think James was good, not a reflection on him, he did his best. But, turns out I have an "aerobic alternative" septic system (fyi I'm new to septic, as in just bought the house and it's my first) and even though Mr. Rooter installed the thing new in 2017 (at a price tag of nearly $60K as the install receipt was included in the home purchase) they really don't currently have anyone with experience working on these systems. Over the next couple weeks they had to send out several more techs, and even a "supervisor" to troubleshoot my system. I honestly got the feeling they'd never really worked on an alternative system much, and one of the techs flat out told me he "hated" these alternative systems and had no idea what he was doing! He said "I'm just going to try and figure it out because I'm the only tech available today" but of course he couldn't. But that didn't stop them from charging me!! Turns out after all the drama, and over $4 thousand dollars!!!!!, my pump/emitters were just gummed up- again (see below) and then the leach field just became saturated because I didn't know anything about these, and I exceeded the gallon/day flow capacity 2 days in a row (which i had to look up myself). Mr. Rooter nickle and dime'd me at every turn, even when they were just "trying to figure it out". What a waste of time and money. At one point they told me they'd have to dig up the whole thing and replace the lines/emitters bc they "might be clogged". They didn't even have the install schematics, despite them installing it just 7.5 years ago, because they "upgraded their computers" a few years ago. I found the schematics from the inspection report and gave to them myself! On the last day I asked what I needed to do to keep everything running smoothly going forward, and wasn't provided any real guidance. For example, I asked why the original install had a notation about "Chlorine tablets" and the supervisor actually said "yeah, sometimes people have to do that" seriously!?! I ended up having to research all this myself!! I found a label on a cylinder near the system and called the number on it, in Clearwater TX, and turns out it's an automatic Chlorine tablet feeder!! And the manufacturer told me it's "absolutely necessary" for my alternate system to function properly! No mention of this whatsoever from Mr. Rooter! In fact, that company told me Mr. Rooter wasn't even certified to work on alternate septic systems anymore!!! Would have been nice to know! To top it off, it takes a special Chlorine tablet I ended up having to order online (not the pool Chlorine tablets Lowe's tried to sell me) which took 3 weeks to arrive.  Needless to say, since becoming a self-educated "expert" now on alternate systems, and putting in those special Chlorine tablets (and not overloading my system anymore) it's been working perfectly now. Just a terrible overall experience, and I feel like I was taken advantage of and mislead by Mr. Rooter, which was very costly in both my time and money. Maybe they do a good job on "normal" septic systems, but definitely don't use them for "aerobic alternate" septic systems, at least not until they get someone who's actually certified in working on them!! I hope this helps someone else avoid my mistakes. And, if anyone knows who I can/should call to service my aerobic alternative septic system in the future, please comment on this review!!!
