reviews.text: I had a late evening leak and was so happy to find this company available and ready to help. The rep they sent out was on time, and very friendly and professional. I immediately felt I could trust what I was being shown and talking over available options. They kept time promises for arrival the next morning and also for completion of the job. Luckily he showed me how to switch off the initial problem until it could be repaired. Finally they did a great job of letting me know what’s was going on and went above what I expected. I’m happy with the work, communication and clean up after. Great job. Tyvm

reviews.author: Victor Tonelli
reviews.text: Joseph, thank you for excellent professional service & explaining everything in detail as well as pricing, You left it better than you found it. Thanks again for the drain cleaning and garbage disposal service.  Smooth, easy, painless. Will use again & highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sarah Russell
reviews.text: Oscar was above and beyond AMAZING. So knowledgeable, down to earth, and extremely helpful. Spoke to our landlord to make everything clear on what the issue was and fixed everything with a great attitude. Our hero! Would absolutely recommend! Consider yourself lucky if Oscar comes to help you!

reviews.author: Mona Sweeney
reviews.text: Great service! Had a toilet backed up and they were able to send someone out within an hour of my request. I must add that my request was after 8pm and I wasn’t charged an additional fee for after hours. Eduardo was extremely helpful, fast and friendly. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Melanie Hoffman
reviews.text: I’ve been using Roto rooter for years and they are absolutely the best in the business. I had a problem with my TOTO brand toilet and they were the only ones to even say with confidence they knew how to handle this brand. Over the years I’ve always had great plumbers who were courteous, professional, did top tier work and explained everything to me in a way that made me feel confident I understood the problem and what was the best solution. Recently I had Joseph out for a job and he was equally professional, helpful and knowledgeable!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 266 E Main St Ste 6, Norristown, PA 19401, USA

reviews.author: Brittany Greebel
reviews.text: Sam and John were great. Very nice men to work with and they were very knowledgeable and direct. The type of work I got done couldn’t come with a 6 month guarantee but they gave me their business card and told me to reach out any time to them directly. Since they’ve come to do the work, there hasn’t been a problem with our drain and it’s running smoothly! Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Nancy Macmahon
reviews.text: We called for emergency service and they were at our home within 2 hours.. they had a camera team in within 24 hours and repair team too that following Monday. I am confident the work with our insurance company will  go smooth  due to the fast turn around of paperwork! All the guys were great, professional and so competent and knowledgeable! Cant say enough about each team! Great job and walked us through the trying time we had with a cracked outside line.They are the best.. would highly recommend!!

reviews.author: J. Harvey
reviews.text:
Fast and prompt service. The sent a tech out within 2 hours of my call. Tyler was a fairly new technician who was very pleasant in his demeanor. He treated our family and dog very well during this visit. Tyler was very knowledgeable about what we could expect during the drain cleanout and possible maintenance we could need in the future. Care was taken not to make a mess while doing the cleanout and he cleaned up the area after he was finished. All this happen 2 days before Christmas. Surely no one wants to have plumbing issues before any holiday along with an expensive repair BUT this interaction was as painless as it could have been thanks to Roto-Rooter and Tyler.
Happy Holidays

reviews.author: Don Wilson
reviews.text:
The service was way overpriced.  The problem was mid diagnosed and I paid for snaking through my toilet instead of going through the outdoor access point which they didn’t look for.  The camera was not able to be used so that service wasn’t available although promised as part of the service.  The diagnosis, which would have had me paying over $10k more would have had me excavating an area that wasn’t even close to where the problem was.  I would have been out over $11,000 and left with a torn apart driveway and a problem that was unsolved.  I am so angry, I feel as though my money was stolen in addition to an unresolved problem.  I will never ever recommend your company.  In fairness, the people were nice but I feel as though they had no idea what they were doing.  I feel as though they basically were grateful and had manners as my money was sucked out of my wallet and I was left with no clear picture of the problem or solution.  I had to pay another company to come out to snake and camera the problem correctly.  I feel taken advantage of and completely dissatisfied and disappointed.  The sad thing is that I’m sure nothing will be done to rectify my experience.  Sad

UPDATE: after I took the time to better communicate my frustrations, the team at Roto Rooter made sure I was heard and offered a fair compromise.  I felt that once they better understood my concerns, their goal was to maintain a long term relationship as opposed to putting a few bucks in their pocket.  Thank you for remembering that business is more about people than profit!!

reviews.author: Mario Marino
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter came out after a pipe burst in our basement on a Saturday night. They were able to come early the next morning and got everything fixed the same day. Tyler was very professional and courteous. I really appreciated their help on short notice.

plumbers.name: Lee Company
plumbers.address: 3530 N Mt Juliet Rd, Mt. Juliet, TN 37122, USA

reviews.author: Alvin Richardson
reviews.text:
I want everyone to know that Lee Company is 5 🌟!!!  In fact, 10 🌟!!!!

Lee Company was scheduled to come to my residence to install a 50 gallon electric water heater.

The tank was scheduled to be delivered between 8am and 12pm on Friday Jan. 23rd.

The Lee Company technician waited 2 hours for the tank to be delivered.   The technician was so kind and was willing to wait longer.  But, I knew he had other stops to make.  So I told him he didn't have to wait any longer.  I thanked him for his willingness to get our tank installed.

Unfortunately, the tank wasn't delivered until well after 4:30pm.

Lee Company will forever have my business and my gratitude for their support and OUTSTANDING customers service!!!

I scheduled Lee Company to come out on Monday Jan 27th to finish the installation.

reviews.author: Mark & Josie
reviews.text:
We needed our repair to our existing tankless water heater. Our technician was great. Corrected the issue, installing new parts that were still under warranty. He also found a few other issues and allowed us to only select the ones we wanted to address at this time
We have always been successful with all of Lee's service a d would highly recommend them. They are honest and do great work.

reviews.author: Lindsey Shanks
reviews.text: Jerry from Lee Company cleaned our dryer duct and did an excellent job. He took his time, was very thorough, and treated our home with care. Scheduling was incredibly easy, even the week before New Year’s. We really enjoy working with the team at Lee Company and always feel confident our home is in good hands whenever we have work done. Jerry was awesome and highly recommended.

reviews.author: Marjorie Witkop
reviews.text: The vanity lights in the bathroom flickered. I was concerned about a possible wiring problem. The technician determined that the LED bulbs were the problem. I switched  to new bulbs and no more flickering! He also checked every other outlet. No problems with any - except the outside Radon connection. He installed a new box. The old cover was broken and a wire inside the box was exposed!) I appreciated that he checked every other outlet while he was here.

reviews.author: Sean Smith
reviews.text: They came out to service two very old HVAC units. I knew I would need to replace them soon. Instead of servicing the old units, they gave me a reasonable price on two new units. They installed them the next day, on time. The crew was very polite and cleaned up after they were done. Great job.

plumbers.name: YES! Air Conditioning, Heating, Plumbing and Electric
plumbers.address: 765 S 100 E, Provo, UT 84606, USA

reviews.author: Craig Moore
reviews.text: Our 24 K generator had not been operating properly for at least a year. It wasn’t installed by Yes and the company that I purchased it from was no longer in business. I discovered that Yes is a licensed distributor for Generac generators. We have been a loyal customer of there’s for years for our HVAC. I would never recommend any other company. Our tech Tony was on time, very professional, and very personable. Throughout the service he kept me appraised of every thing he found that needed attention. The service was excellent. The generator runs like new and I’m excited that Yes will be here every year for its annual service.

reviews.author: Dave Henderson
reviews.text:
Great experience with YES! so far. Our furnace went out, they came the next morning (Saturday) and it’s now working great.

I also really appreciated the time that Sawyer spent explaining things to us. Very informative and helpful in helping us make a good decision about what we may need in the future. He was great!

We will use them again.

reviews.author: Frank Tello
reviews.text: Sterling came out to do a tune-up on our HVAC system and did an excellent job. He was friendly, had a great attitude, and took the time to keep me informed throughout the entire process. He explained what he was checking, answered questions clearly, and was professional from start to finish. I’d gladly have him back and would recommend him to anyone needing HVAC service.

reviews.author: Tom Williams
reviews.text: I’m installing a new oven and found that the electrical needs for the new oven exceed what I had available. I called Yes! And had an electrician at my house within the hour. Kayden Dooley, who has done electrical work at my house before, arrived and knew both my needs and the house. He got right to work and he was joined by George Webb. Together, they ran a new electrical line, upgraded my circuits and made quick work of it so there is no delay in my moving quickly ahead with my project. I felt great seeing Kayden again.  It’s like having my own personal electrician on call.

reviews.author: Shauna Mayer
reviews.text: Sterling was professional, kind and informative. He worked fast and was very helpful. He made clear the issues with my furnace and gave me great options. I definitely recommend Yes.

plumbers.name: Dial One Johnson Plumbing, Cooling & Heating
plumbers.address: 158 Hood St, Cedar Hill, TX 75104, USA

reviews.author: Morgan F Bilbo
reviews.text:
Came out. Inspected furnace. Did nothing. Gave 2 estimates. One for repair, one for new thermostat. Both way, way overpriced. Charged $89 for coming out.
Today, got someone else. Fixed furnace, charged total of $75. Said I don't need a new thermostat, don't need any parts for repair.
So apparently you are just sharks. Charging too much and trying to snow me!
You are not the only ones to try to do this. I hope you enjoy the $89. Because that's the last you'll hear from me.

reviews.author: Melinda Alcorn
reviews.text: Friendly and personable. Did the work right away. fixed our leaking pipe under our house in a jiffy!

reviews.author: Texaspete
reviews.text: We had several plumbing issues in our kitchen. Michael was great, was very efficient, knew exactly what we needed and performed flawlessly. Afterwards he answered all our questions and even gave us some helpful tips. We had work done by other companies but Dial One is now our favorite for any future jobs. Signing up for service plan, we also got discount on this job so at the end we paid fair price for the job. Thank you Michael for job well done. Katie C, Duncanville

reviews.author: Jeremy Reddinger
reviews.text: Great business and an amazing technician. Polite , knowledgeable, efficient, professional, and great communication are all traits that describe Emmett who serviced or central air unit. I would highly recommend getting any work needed based off of this one interaction with Emmett and this company.

reviews.author: Bionca Arradondo
reviews.text: Jose was amazing.   He explained things concisely and it was easy to understand what my options were. He was considerate of my time and patient.

plumbers.name: Shamrock Plumbing and Drain Cleaning Inc.
plumbers.address: 4032 Old Winter Garden Rd, Orlando, FL 32811, USA

reviews.author: Mayda Voigt
reviews.text: My A/C guys recommended Shamrock Plumbing for fixing a leaking water heater.  Technician Carlos was incredibly professional, knowledgeable and arrived right on time. The installation of the new water heater process was fast, efficient and very neatly done. In addition to that I decided to replace the old water softener which was not working properly. Carlos explained the latest technology about it so I don’t hesitate to invest in it, because once you try whole house water softeners, you cannot be happy living without it. No more hard water, besides the pipes, tubs, toilets, sinks, trust me your skin and hair will appreciate it. Awesome company, costumer service and Technician. I’ll use them again!!

reviews.author: Beatrice Soto
reviews.text: I just had a whole home re-pipe done and I have to say the process was efficient clean quick and I no longer have to worry about plumbing issues in the near future for a while. They were the most cost-effective company and for what I received I have to say it was an excellent value! I will definitely be using Shamrock plumbing again for any plumbing needs I have! Additionally, the warranty offered it can’t be beat. Thank you Shamrock!

reviews.author: Rina Kundu
reviews.text: 5 star experience from start to finish.  We had a total re-pipe of our house, the 5 man team who undertook the work were incredible, fast, efficient and respectful.  The office and drywall/plastering teams were equally as amazing.  Overall cost also very reasonable versus a competitor.  Don't bother getting other estimates, these guys are by far the best, go straight to Shamrock!

reviews.author: Cindy White
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Shamrock Plumbing! I’ve been using their services since 2022 at my homes. Shamrock has the best team of experts out in the field and in their office. Their office staff is pleasant and knowledgeable.
Shawn H. performed exceptional expertise and professionalism while performing our repairs.

reviews.author: Christopher Barnes
reviews.text: I’ve spent over $20,000 with this company in the last few years. I I recommended them and gave them all my business. I asked them to come do an estimate for me in November. They came out and spent about an hour and a half at my house taking down the details.. It’s now February and I’ve never heard back from them. I’ve called the office five times every time they tell me the manager is gonna call me back with my estimate. I’ve still never got a call back. The first time I called him the excuse for not calling me back was they don’t know the price of pipe, so my estimates been delayed. One of the biggest plumbing companies in Orlando doesn’t know the price of 100 feet of pipe so they can’t give me an estimate while I wait for 2 1/2 months. I expressed to the secretary that found that hard to believe. If you don’t want the job, just say you don’t want the job. Don’t tell me you’re gonna call me back five times and then never call me back.  That’s no  way to treat a loyal customer that  brings you repeat business and refers you to others.

plumbers.name: Rooterguy llc
plumbers.address: 4890 Ironton St Unit J, Denver, CO 80239, USA

reviews.author: Rob Martinez
reviews.text: Called to make an appointment for estimate on installing a kitchen faucet we bought.  We got an appointment 08:00AM the next day and was the best price we had received from calling others for quotes for this the job.  Jacob Smith did a great job explaining what he was going to do and in about an hour had removed the old faucet, checked for wear and tear and installed new faucet equipment for the price he quoted.  Jacob was professional and friendly and really established our trust in Rooter Guy.  They now are the first call we make for any plumbing needs we come up with.  Very pleased!

reviews.author: Patrick O.
reviews.text: Eric did an excellent job repairing our hose bib. He was punctual, professional, and clearly knowledgeable about the work he was doing. He arrived right on time, explained the issue, and completed the repair efficiently. We really appreciated his attention to detail and the care he took to make sure everything was working properly before leaving. Highly recommend Eric for anyone needing reliable and quality plumbing work!

reviews.author: Carolee Dean
reviews.text: Chauncy got us started with a quick estimate that was much lower than the other two bids. Then Gordon, Cody, and Valentines took out our rotted kitchen sewer pipes and replaced them. They were in and out in a day that included jack hammering up the foundation and pouring new concrete. They were even able to save some of the tile. No more sewer back ups at Thanksgiving. Thanks guys.

reviews.author: Ken Bottle
reviews.text: Gordon, Valentine, and Tanner did an incredible job replacing a kitchen sewer line in my basement. They were great to work with! They were very professional, showed me exactly what the issues were, and what to expect, before starting the job.  The work was completed in a timely manner and  at a very reasonable cost. I wouldn’t hesitate to use RooterGuy again. I highly recommend these guys!

reviews.author: Marisa Macias
reviews.text: We closed on a house on a Friday and by Sunday, we were already having plumbing issues.  We had no idea what was going on since we had experienced inspectors and plumbers (from other companies) come out before closing.  Eric and Chauncy came bright and early Monday morning.  They were super friendly and knowledgeable.  As soon as we showed them a video of the sewer scope from the week prior, they immediately said the cast iron pipe was rotting and we'd have to replace it.  They cleared the pipe to the best of their ability and performed another sewer scope to confirm their suspicions.  Our realtor couldn't believe that all of her experienced and trusted contractors could've missed it and we got a second and third opinion, and all of them agreed on the issue.  Rooter Guy gave us the best quote, so we hired them to replace the pipe.  On Friday, Rooter Guy sent Valentin, Chauncy, Gordon, Cody, and Tanner to replace the pipe.  They were quick and did a good job of removing the necessary LVP flooring without ruining any pieces.  It's been a week and we have had no problems since.  We highly recommend Rooter Guy!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter
plumbers.address: 3717 Huckleberry Rd, Allentown, PA 18104, USA

reviews.author: Michael Palmer
reviews.text: Our experience with Roto-Rooter was exceptional.  The service technician, Kevin, went above and beyond. We called, everything was professional, on time, quality work, and a reasonable price.  Recommend this company.

reviews.author: Tawnie R.
reviews.text: I manage a mid rise senior building and Vince has been out here a handful of times now and my residents love him. He's polite, explains what's happening and he's very knowledgeable. So very grateful for you guys.

reviews.author: Shana Kay
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Roto-Rooter. The service was professional, timely, and exceeded my expectations from start to finish. The team was knowledgeable, courteous, and took the time to explain everything clearly, which I really appreciated. It’s not easy to find a business that delivers this level of quality and reliability. I’m very satisfied with the service I received and would absolutely recommend them to other businesses looking for dependable and efficient service.

reviews.author: Javier Aviles
reviews.text: Carlos my technician came pretty much an hour after I called which is super fast. He was professional, informative , and friendly. The issue with my sewage was solved rather quickly. So yes I am extremely happy with my results and will definitely recommend this company to my friends and family for sure.

reviews.author: Megan Konrath
reviews.text: Our techs were absolutely amazing. They came in, made sure the job was done RIGHT, and cleaned up the entire area and looked like no one was ever even there. I had been trying to get this garbage disposal and dishwasher installed properly since November with different companies, and finally decided to call Roto-Rooter and that was the best decision we could’ve made. Everything works perfectly and I have ease of mind knowing the plumbing is in good condition.

plumbers.name: Atherton Plumbing - Dayton Drain Cleaning
plumbers.address: 705 Albany St, Dayton, OH 45417, USA

reviews.author: Mad MO
reviews.text: Sunday morning text from our tenants that shower, sink and toilet were backing up.  Called Atherton, they explained the emergency pricing, tech called me 5 minutes later and asked some questions and walked me through the process and pricing. 5 minutes later i had a text with a picture of my technician,  Nick, and that he was on his way.  30 minutes later i met himat the property, everything fixed in less than an hour, keeping me in the loop at every step. He did a great job of fixing the issue and cleaning up after himself.  I love Atherton for their responsiveness and quality of work.

reviews.author: Lisa Keane
reviews.text: Had to have a toilet replaced. Excellent and quick service- they were at my house in a few hours to provide a detailed estimate, and the next day to install. Did not try to push me into a getting a new toilet. Instead, they walked me through and provided a bid for my 3 options so I could make an informed decision. High quality materials (I did a comparison of product at big box stores) were used. Would definitely recommend to friends and neighbors. Macen and Dillion were great!

reviews.author: Julio Mateo
reviews.text: The technician (Jason Maxwell) was professional and friendly. He explained everything well, took care of the issue, and provided additional advice for taking care of our water heater and for potential recurrent issues. The communication over text from the company was also very helpful. I appreciated the short description and photo of the technician so we had some information about him before he arrived. Overall, very pleased with the services. Price was reasonable for the services provided, similar to other plumbing services in the area.

reviews.author: David Schoeff
reviews.text: Atherton wanted $1,360 to install a warranty replacement water heater. It took me 15 minutes to get two quotes for as little as half their price. Their people who came to the house seemed good but I’d recommend checking a price before engaging them.

reviews.author: Dave Kaminski
reviews.text: Ive been working in construction for over 50 years. The plumber that cleared out my drain was very knowledgeable and showed a confidence and skill thats not common in the industry today. He was very thorough and protected the environment around the drain to insure a clean space. I would definitely use Atherton plumbing again.

plumbers.name: Smart Plumbers Inc. DBA Smart Plumbers & Rooters
plumbers.address: 2175 Ronald St, Santa Clara, CA 95050, USA

reviews.author: Art
reviews.text: I have hired Smart Plumbers over the past 10 years for a rental and my residence. My experiences have always been positive. Relative to the costs associated with plumbing, I believe Smart Plumbers has been affordable and I can depend on them for a quality job.  For this specific job, Joe and Victor removed a water treatment unit and reconnected the main line in my home. In doing so they also installed a cutoff valve in the line accessible from inside my garage.

reviews.author: Brian Fogarty
reviews.text:
The first appointment I made the workmen did not show up, or call with an update if they were still coming/not coming. The second appointment I made went smoothly. The workmen arrived within the given time frame and completed the work in less than 20 minutes.

The workmen seemed to be knowledgeable about their field of service and what the issue I was having could be. My toilet issue appears to be solved for now (turned out I had a faulty and/or plugged-up filter system). They replaced the entire part and installed the new one.

I would seek their assistance in the future and I would recommend them to anyone looking for a solid plumber.

reviews.author: mark brady
reviews.text:
Professional staff from the start sent two expert plumbers, one a manager, who performed the work quickly right before a holiday.  Fantastic service, great work.
The already low price was even discounted for the elderly owner of the property. Amazing company, they are now our plumbers hands down.

reviews.author: Mike R
reviews.text: Long time customer.  They just came out to replace a water heater they installed 15yrs ago.  I did no maintenance on this water heater at all for 15yrs and I'm surprised it lasted this long.  They recommended a Bradford & White 55gal 15yrs ago and I replaced with a 50g Bradford & White, I'm going to be better about draining it every few years and hopefully get 20yrs out of this one!  They are probably not the lowest price but definitely  not the highest price and they will not take advantage of you.  Everyone I've dealt with over the years at Smart Plumbing is super nice, courteous & friendly.  This is why I keep calling them for all my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Chris Goodfellow
reviews.text: Called them after 10:15 am. Technician was here by 11:05 am. Very thorough. Snaked sewer line in several places. Clog is gone! Great service. Have used this company for years. Highly recommend.

plumbers.name: Carew Heating & Air Conditioning
plumbers.address: 1104 S 10th St, Watertown, WI 53094, USA

reviews.author: Patricia K
reviews.text: I would highly recommend Carew, from the initial estimate with Brian to the installation crew. They were all extremely respectful, friendly and helpful. Brian took time to throughly explain all options answered all my questions (without making me feel stupid). Matt and his crew did an awesome job explaining the process and how the equipment works. They all communicated effectively and respectfully. Cleaned up like they were never even here (took old equipment, so we didn’t have to dispose).  Hands down great service, if HVAC service is ever needed again, these are my guys and this is the company I’m recommending and using again. Thanks Carew for keeping us warm this winter.

reviews.author: Bruce Aschenbrener
reviews.text: Had my first maintenance inspection done this am.  Both guys were polite and informative during their visit here.  Explained everything they did and what to expect going down the road.   + & - , which was appreciated.  Both had great customer and technical skills.  Great representatives for your company’. Thank you!    Bruce A.

reviews.author: Adam J
reviews.text:
We had a great experience working with Carew. Our very old furnace (~30 years) broke down on a Friday during one of the coldest weeks of the winter. They came out the same day to assess things, and lent us several large space heaters to keep us warm over the weekend. The furnace was too old to fix and so we had our HVAC system fully replaced by Carew.

Sales: The technician walked us through all the options and the costs and benefits. We felt he was honest about what we needed for the size and style of our home and did not try to pressure us into buying something we didn’t need. He gave a very clear explanation of the pricing and financing options.

Installation: The installation team was professional and courteous. They arrived and finished on time. It was the middle of winter with a bunch of fresh snow on the ground but they did not track a huge mess inside. We did have to tidy up the utility room a bit, vacuuming and picking up a few stray screws and pieces. Outside, when replacing the AC unit, a couple of little wood borders we have in the yard were stepped on, but those were buried under snow and not visible at the time. So remember to mention anything like that beforehand to the installer.

Service: A week after installation we had a problem with the thermostat/control unit. It was not sensing temperature correctly and did not trigger the furnace at the right times, making the house too hot or cold. We called Carew and they came out the same day. They quickly installed a new control unit, no questions asked or additional charge. The system has worked as expected since then.

reviews.author: patti gasper
reviews.text: We were very pleased with the work done on our HVAC system by Rob and Marc from Carew. It has been great to have them, they took care of our system and all is good. Paul and Patti

reviews.author: Anthony Raasch
reviews.text: I've had Carew come out a few times now to deal with finicky dampers. They are extremely fast at responding. Techs have had great attitudes and they explain as well as show you the problem. Couldn't ask for a better experience.

plumbers.name: Mr Rooter Plumbing of Lexington KY
plumbers.address: 1099 S Broadway Ste 120, Lexington, KY 40504, USA

reviews.author: Donald Secrest
reviews.text: We recently encountered an erosion problem near our driveway caused by a severe clogged drainage line that was installed when the house was built 35 years sgo. The contractor or workers who built the house placed a corrugated drainage line across the driveway before the cement driveway was poured. Eventually, the line became clogged with sediment. The only solution was to dig a new trench line to add PVC pipe to a 2nd downspout.  The Mr. Rooter (Kevin) guys did a careful and good job creating a solution to my erosion problem.

reviews.author: Leanne Zimmerman
reviews.text: I had a great experience from initial call on one day to follow up the next day. The pro who did my work, Steve Smith, explained what was probably going on and possible solutions.Luckily, the smell from the tubing from dishwasher to disposal was a simple fix.

reviews.author: Jeannie Slone
reviews.text: I live in an 125 year old home that had the old clay pipes. This was a huge undertaking to replace all of these with PVC. The professionalism of Alan, Colby and Joe was very much appreciated. They answered all of my questions. They left the area well backfilled and covered with straw. I also appreciated Trevor Smith, who first came to diagnose the problem and suggest solutions. He also answered questions thoroughly. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Nina O'Leary
reviews.text: Trever was perfect!  We had tried everything we could think of and nothing worked. Maybe because it wasn’t where we thought it was. But it’s fixed and all’s great. We greatly appreciate his help. Thank you. Plus, he’s a very nice guy.

reviews.author: Brandon Leach
reviews.text: Dylan is a great Technician! Polite and knowledgable, you should promote him fast! Great job. Reasonably priced and less than 2 hours on site. Would use them again, no questions asked.

plumbers.name: Big City Plumbing, LLC
plumbers.address: 4274 GateCrest, San Antonio, TX 78217, USA

reviews.author: Bette Delgado
reviews.text: Called Big City Plumbing after notifications from SAWS about excessive water usage.  Chris & James performed a leak detection inside my home. Nothing inside was found. Water meter was still showing "running". Overnight water was flowing front yard down driveway into street. Called; spoke w Rafaela & Alyssa regarding visible leak. James returned to provide a contract to repair. Big City Plumbing took care of the steps w the office staff notifying me of what to expect. Excavation crew was mindful of saving flagstone & where dirt was placed. Chris & James returned to install a new main waterline from meter to house. Excavation crew backfilled & repositioned flagstone. This entire process was well organized w/o any issues. The owner of company came by to check in w me. This process could not have been better!  Will definitely use Big City Plumbing if need arises

reviews.author: Alicia
reviews.text: Big City Plumbing did an excellent job fixing a leak in our yard. They responded quickly, showed up on time, and were very professional throughout the entire process. The repair was done efficiently, and everything was explained clearly. I really appreciate how reliable and responsive their team is. Highly recommend Big City Plumbing if you need fast and professional service.

reviews.author: Janette Barnard
reviews.text:
From my initial contact with Rafaela to schedule service with Gerald Johnson (and his assistant Felix) and even after the service call, I had a very good experience.

Gerald was highly recommended by my neighbors who had major work done 2 years - they were very pleased with his “diagnosis” and work completed. Rafaela’s explanation of fees was transparent - she was thorough in requesting I forward images of a situation to share with Gerald in advance of his service call. While here, I asked Gerald to look into another concern I had - he identified a problem with my water softener which is being addressed on a service visit next week. Unlike some of the other companies I’ve called in the past (Jon Wayne), there was no pressure to upsell me.

Excellent follow-up by Rafaela confirming an order for a new water softening system and quick installation three days after the initial service call by Gerald.

I really appreciate the coordination between the team at Big City Plumbing. I feel like I paid a fair price for the service given by your team. I would not hesitate using or recommending Big City Plumbing in the future.

reviews.author: Renate McWright
reviews.text: The guys were very professional and skilled and found my leak. They worked hard to do the repair since the temps were dropping towards the evening and glue does not adhere at certain cold conditions. I’m grateful the worked diligently and thoroughly to get the job done. I’m always happy with Big City’s plumbing services!

reviews.author: Patricia Gauna
reviews.text: Plumber was nice and respectful. I was quoted 230$ initially then plumber ended up charging 250 plus 2 couplings 50$ additional. I thought that was steep for 2 couplings 75$ extra unanticipated cost was not in my budget. I,was nervous because I need the certificate sent to SAWS yesterday but Rafaela reassured me it was sent yesterday since I did not have confidence the plumber was going to complete on time. The plumber called me today informing me certificate was sent to SAWS. Kudos to Rafaela for all her help!

plumbers.name: Austin Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electric
plumbers.address: W197N10225 Appleton Ave, Germantown, WI 53022, USA

reviews.author: Linda Perella
reviews.text: Rich was personable, informative and polite. Explaining everything as it was done and the reasoning behind it. Rich was very knowledgeable and took time to instruct his apprentice as he worked. Luke was eager to learn and Rich did his job, teaching Luke as he did. They were both quite respectful of our home and wore protective shoe covers.

reviews.author: Corey Sullivan
reviews.text: Fantastic experience! They did electrical diagnostic work to help cut off the electricity for demolition and help plan for the future installation of the updated electrical in the basement. They are very knowledgeable, very friendly, and the technician spent a lot of time speaking with me answering questions I had about the project and providing confidence where I was previously nervous about the setup. Overall great experience from start to finish!

reviews.author: WilliamX Culp
reviews.text:
Garrett came over to put a new well pump in. The experience was amazing. He was so good at explaining everything to us and even found another issue that the pressure tank wasn’t holding air which was replaced by previous owner and is covered under warranty. They went above and beyond and notice a few other things that need repair which is cool they look at the overall system not just the individual part.

Thank you Garrett and team Austin. Good luck on building your house.

reviews.author: kathleen phillips
reviews.text: Seth was amazing and competent. He explained everything along the way. I had my furnace maintenance completed. I trusted him immediately. He shared the different plans for maintenance. He was very professional. He answered all my questions thoroughly. He is an A+. Austin is lucky to have him.

reviews.author: Peg Raabe
reviews.text:
Pete E. was fabulous! He’s well qualified and has lots of experience to know exactly what to do. He also came prepared with parts already on his truck.
Besides all that—he’s nice! Described everything so we could understand.
We’ll be asking for him if we ever have another plumbing problem! 👍🏻

plumbers.name: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing & Drain Services of Duncanville
plumbers.address: 1019 Explorer St, Duncanville, TX 75137, USA

reviews.author: Mark Laird
reviews.text: Hunter Hinz was an incredible plumber and technician. He solved my issues fast and was considerate in explaining the problems while proposing solutions. I would definitely work with him again.

reviews.author: mindi goegg
reviews.text:
They were able to schedule my appointment the same day and gave me 2 hour window.  Which they called to make sure I was available and then also texted me and let me know my technician Athens was on his way.
Athens was there within 15 minutes.  He was very nice and professional.  He was also very honest with what had to be done.  Which I
Appreciate that.

reviews.author: Micaela Ikner
reviews.text: Johnathan was my plumber. He was very friendly, professional, and let me know about my different options. He gave the pricing information upfront. He worked quickly and efficiently, and installed my new garbage disposal with no problems. Satisfied with my service.

reviews.author: David Davis
reviews.text: Chris with Benjamin Franklin Plumbing came to our home in Midlothian to diagnose and clear a drain stoppage under our slab foundation. He was professional and courteous in addition to his technical skills. Chris diagnosed the problem quickly, provided insight to the issue, and explained how to avoid problems in the future. Lastly, the fee was very reasonable. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: ASHOK PATEL
reviews.text:
Jonathan from Ben Franklin was very professional and thoroughly explained all the steps which made very easy for deciding the type of work that I need him to carry out. He took care of the whole situation in timely fashion and left the area very clean and functional.
A.G. Patel MD

plumbers.name: Service Professionals
plumbers.address: 451 Main St, Little Falls Township, NJ 07424, USA

reviews.author: Boris Glavicic
reviews.text: Joe Negri was great. Job done in less than an hour. All good. Be prepared to pay up though. $2400 for shower monitor valve replacement, even if it was easy to access through the bedroom closet.

reviews.author: Judee Obcena
reviews.text: Rich from Service professional was a great service certified electrician. He was able to help us out with inspections for compliance. Super fast and easy and answered all our questions regarding quotes and also what we need. Super reliable and will definitely use this service again!

reviews.author: Julianne VanDien
reviews.text: We had an emergency plumbing issue and Johnny N responded immediately. He was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain the problem and the fix. The repair was done quickly and everything is working perfectly now. It’s hard to find reliable service like this—highly recommend!

reviews.author: Laura DeVoti
reviews.text: Kevin and Dez performed a plumbing inspection which included flushing the hot water heater. They were extremely professional and friendly. They were also very knowledgeable. Since this was part of a maintenance program, I paid nothing for this inspection. I was presented with a plan for service of a few items. At this time I did not go forward with the repairs because of the price. I put only 4 stars because of the price quoted to me.

reviews.author: Lara Baker
reviews.text: We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to Chris, Rich, Ronnie, and the Management team for their exceptional work in replacing our pipeline. Not only did they complete the task efficiently, but they also demonstrated remarkable professionalism and courtesy, making the experience truly enjoyable. Despite having to work within a very tight budget, they still managed to deliver exceptional results without cutting any corners. Highly recommended 👌

plumbers.name: RS Andrews
plumbers.address: 39 Persimmon St suite 602, Bluffton, SC 29910, USA

reviews.author: Kevin Vliet
reviews.text: R.S. Andrews delivered exceptional service when I scheduled a technician to come to my new home to explain whole home water filtration options. I was thrilled that Jason, the technician, was not only knowledgeable and courteous, but also able to install the system that very same day. He walked me through everything with clarity and professionalism, answered all my questions, and ensured the system was working perfectly before he left. I highly recommend R.S. Andrews for prompt, expert service and outstanding results.

reviews.author: Michael Rivet
reviews.text: I had the system checkup today by Clarence. He was great! He explained everything took his time and recapped anything he found that could potentially be a problem. I felt very confident he knew what he was doing. He did not try to sell me anything as my system is 8 years old and I had another company about a year ago tell me I should be looking to replace it soon. I highly recommend RS Andrew’s and if I do need a new system they will be who I call but in the mean time I will be doing all my maintenance and repair business with them.

reviews.author: Kelly Richardson
reviews.text:
Quick call back by scheduling and able to accommodate our schedule with ease.

Jason called ahead of arrival and showed up at the time he stated. Was extremely helpful and was able to solution with ease. Extremely personable and very helpful in explaining everything.

reviews.author: Bob Kline
reviews.text: Jeramy Bond did our semi-annual maintenance, and he did a great job.  He took the time to explain everything to me and if possible, I would like to have Jeramy provide our maintenance service in the future. Also, noting that Jeramy is a super Cleveland Browns fan I was quick to point out that he was in Steeler country once he entered our home and he was fine with that😊

reviews.author: Diane Melchionne
reviews.text: RS Andrews was so quick to come out (same day, though late at night) when I had a pipe burst under my house. Connor was exceptional - nothing phases him! He never complained, and did an amazing job. Would absolutely recommend them and Connor in particular!

plumbers.name: Plumbline Services
plumbers.address: 395 W 67th St, Loveland, CO 80538, USA

reviews.author: Shane Sanford
reviews.text: I recently purchased the whole house filtration along with the reverse osmosis system and couldn't be more pleased! The whole processes was seamless and quick. The team that installed it did a wonderful job with customizing where we wanted it placed and how the finished product looked. They explained all the processes and left us great tips on how to make it work the best.  Support has also been very friendly! Thank you!

reviews.author: Jesse
reviews.text: Purchased our whole house water filtration system with Plumline and they came out super fast, installed the whole system, their technicians walked me through everything and how it functions. The Technicians were respectful of my house, cleaned up after themselves and were a pleasure to work with. I would highly recommend Plumline , so happy with my purchase

reviews.author: Rob Bagford
reviews.text: I had a great experience. Everybody from one is very nice and direct the service guy Nando get an excellent job. He was quite efficient. He didn’t take very long at all   I read this man as a 10 out of a 10 very personable. Very nice to the point got the job done. I hope all your technicians are as good as Nando.

reviews.author: Mark Heyner
reviews.text: We called Plumbline to help us diagnose and repair a couple of significant, lingering issues from a recent, badly-flawed HVAC installation.  The work involved two separate Bryant systems.  It seems the work that Plumbline - specifically Peyton - did for us has finally resolved these issues.  Further, Peyton was respectful, knowledgeable, informative and communicative throughout the process, and cleaned up thoroughly afterwards - going above and beyond, really.  The company was very good about coordinating and communicating regarding scheduling.  We've found that none of these things can be taken for granted, up to and including successful execution of the work.  It's no secret that Plumbline tends to be more expensive than other service providers, but we value their predictability, courtesy, cleanliness and good communication as much as we value their good work.  Well done.

reviews.author: Braden Hellewell
reviews.text: Plumbline installed new wiring for a Level 2 EV charger, and provided the charger and installation as well. It went very smoothly! The initial consultation appointment was scheduled for a Saturday, a quote was given while they were here and the work was done by Tuesday afternoon. Overall, very pleasant experience and the charger is working like a charm!

plumbers.name: Cocalico Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 27 N 4th St, Denver, PA 17517, USA

reviews.author: Donald Axon
reviews.text: Mark went the extra mile and  resolved issues I was not immediately aware of.  He also made suggestions to help reduce the risk of the issue in the future.  On top of that, CPH was able to get a technician to the house well in advance of the expected schedule.  Thank you very much for the timely and professional service.

reviews.author: David Phillips
reviews.text: Chris and Christian from Cocalico Plumbing & Heating (CPH) performed superb HVAC service. They were professional, knowledgeable, and courteous. They covered the entryway with drop cloths to protect the floor, wore boot covers in the house, and covered items in the work space to protect them from any debris. They worked quickly to address the issues and knew exactly how to perform the necessary service. I am planning to use CPH for air conditioning and heating system preventive maintenance in the spring and fall. I would highly recommend CPH to anyone looking for expert service and quality work.

reviews.author: Kelley V
reviews.text: We had new lines, a pump and laundry sink installed for our basement washer set up. From the quote to completion, everything was professional, super friendly staff and great communication! Doug along with his teammate were very knowledgeable and explained everything. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience! Would highly recommend CPH!!

reviews.author: Gale Gordon
reviews.text:
Our tech Mark and helper Brian were punctual. They did toilet repairs on two toilets in a timely fashion. Everything was neat and clean when they left. Very pleased with their work and Thoroughness. I have more work to be done and I will be calling Cacalico Plumbing and heating again.
B. Pogue

reviews.author: Craig Schafer
reviews.text: Called in for an toilet repair. They were fast to respond to the call and came out to solve the issue before the end of the day. I use Cocalico both personally and professionally. Their promptness and professionalism is exceptional. Always happy with the product and the work!

plumbers.name: Rooter-Man Plumbing Austin TX
plumbers.address: 15503 Patrica St, Austin, TX 78728, USA

reviews.author: William Stewart
reviews.text: All I can say is it feels really good to know a good plumber. We had replaced the grease seal on our toilet at work and a couple of months later the odor came back and the guys came and saw the degree seal we had and failed and so they put in a better one. Contacting ruderman was easy having the guys come as scheduled was easy. I will use them in the future.

reviews.author: Nam Hoang
reviews.text: Eddie is a good man. I appreciate when people take time to take off/cover their shoes when entering my home. He examined the situation, he took steps to find the problem in the least intrusive way. When he determined the leak was coming from the water lines against the side wall, he tried his best to minimize the damage of just ripping apart the wall (which I greatly appreciate).  Found the source of the leak, fixed it and cleaned up. A+++ Thank you Eddie

reviews.author: Vladimir L
reviews.text: Jay and Matthew provided great service at a good price. Came out on short notice and got my drain unclogged. Would highly recommend for plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Melissa L
reviews.text:
Eddie with Rooterman Plumbing went above and beyond today! He came out the very same day I placed the call and provided outstanding service. Not only did he replace all of the piping under my kitchen sink, install a brand-new garbage disposal, and add a new basket strainer, but he also replaced the wall switch for the disposal that went out — at no extra charge! Eddie worked efficiently, explained everything clearly, and left the area clean and dry. I’m very impressed with his excellent work and Rooterman’s customer service. Everything was handled in one visit, and I now have total peace of mind knowing the job was done right. He even offered to check on any other plumbing needs while he was here, which I really appreciated.
Highly recommend Rooterman Plumbing!

reviews.author: Charlie Jones
reviews.text: Eddie has been performing plumbing related services at my residence for years and I cannot say enough good things about him and the entire team at Rooterman. I consider them extended family and would recommend them to everyone. ~ Charlie

plumbers.name: Wilbur's Air Conditioning, Heating & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2551 Balco Rd, Birmingham, AL 35210, USA

reviews.author: Jason Mandeville
reviews.text: Jonathan and his help was very respectful and knowledgeable. Did a great job doing the work and was very thorough. I would definitely have him back out to do work in the future. Wilbur has earned a customer for life. They also did great helping us finance the grinder pump and work. The office workers did a great job scheduling and staying in contact with us. It went as great as a emergency high cost repair could go. Thanks!

reviews.author: Cait Kelley
reviews.text: Would highly recommend Wilbur's, they were easy to reach on the phone and very prompt at scheduling a time to come look at my plumbing project. Brady did a great job explaining what they would replace and how everything works. I appreciate that Susie was very communicative about who to expect and when. Jason completed the work very well, he was very knowledgeable and friendly, and even took the time to give quotes on a few other future projects I have. Overall, made the process easy, very pleased with the results, and will be using them again.

reviews.author: Marc Davis
reviews.text: Wilbur's has been our go-to for all of our A/C-Heating needs for our home and have never let us down. Our unit failed over the weekend, and they came out on a Saturday to assess the situation. Our Tech Edgar Salgado was super nice and explained everything that was required to replace our unit. They provided us with a portable A/C unit until they replaced our defunct unit on Monday, which they did quickly and professionally. They went above and beyond to make sure my family was comfortable during all of this, which was greatly appreciated. I recommend them for all of your A/C-Heating needs. Thanks, guys. we really appreciate your professionalism and great work!

reviews.author: Megan Zeski
reviews.text:
We had a rather significant HVAC emergency arise after hours and Justin Humphries was on site to evaluate it within an hour of my service call.  He took the time to perform a thorough inspection and provided us with a very detailed, easy-to-understand explanation of the problems.  There were multiple issues, and he saw to it that everything was repaired to our satisfaction that evening.  He was professional, knowledgeable, and kind.  Justin responded to a very stressful situation, and left us feeling confident in the resolution and in our relationship with Wilbur’s.
Susie, in their office, also could not have been more helpful.  She responded quickly to our initial call for service, maintained contact while Justing was being dispatched, and even followed up the next day to make sure that we were satisfied with the service.  Again, a stressful situation was made better by her professionalism and friendliness.

Both Justin and Susie affirmed our confidence in Wilbur’s service, and I highly recommend Wilbur’s for all HVAC needs.

reviews.author: Janice Johnson
reviews.text: I contacted Wilbur AC, Heating & Plumbing after reading outstanding reviews. They did not disappoint. From first contact with scheduling to the actual repairs, everyone was friendly, courteous and professional. The plumbers, Andrew and Josh were very nice. They arrived on time, found and repaired the leak in no time. Additionally, I wanted a whole house replumb quote, which I got, and they will be returning to change out the plumbing. I want to give a special thanks to Andrew, who is an extremely knowledgeable plumber. I was not comfortable about taking out walls for this whole house replumb until Andrew explained the replumb process for my house. It made me feel much better that they would not have to knock out a bunch of sheet rocks walls to replace the existing pipes, but rather reroute the plumbing.  Thanks so much for making me feel better about the process.

plumbers.name: Blue Valley Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 1740 Skyway Dr UNIT H, Longmont, CO 80504, USA

reviews.author: Isley Gao
reviews.text:
Absolutely fantastic experience with Blue Valley Heating and Cooling! Danny, the project manager, was amazing to work with—he took the time to clearly explain pricing, materials, and scheduling, and really helped me choose the right heat pump for my budget. I never felt rushed or pressured, which I truly appreciated.

The installation crew showed up on time, were professional, friendly, and communicated well throughout the entire process. They did a great job cleaning up afterward and were a pleasure to have in my home. They also took the time to answer any questions I had before leaving.

From start to finish, everything went smoothly and exceeded my expectations. I would highly recommend Blue Valley to anyone looking for HVAC or plumbing services. I also really appreciated how every time I called them, a real human picked up the phone and was able to assist me (no automated phone menus, no phone tag, no “let me transfer you” that went to voicemail). Thank you again to Danny, Alex, Angel, Zach, Olga, and everyone at Blue Valley.

reviews.author: Dr. Miles Nichols
reviews.text: Casey was great! I had hodgepodged a temporary solution under my sink and he was able to quickly get it sorted. He was also very helpful in providing several suggestions on future considerations and preventive strategies for reducing chances of plumbing issues going forward.

reviews.author: Kelly O'Neill
reviews.text:
Our HVAC system went out a couple months ago and we were desperate for a new affordable but high quality system. We contacted Blue Valley who came out immediately to diagnose the problem. They were patient while we acquired funding and applied for rebates. And once we had the funding, they scheduled us within a few days for install. Nathan was one of the workers on our install and was great! He and his team arrived on time and kept us updated throughout the process.

During the install, they noticed our water heater, which had been installed by Cooper Heating and Cooling in August 2025, was leaking. Since the installation was only about seven months old, this was surprising. We contacted Cooper to have someone come out and fix the issue, but they were unable to send a technician until the following Monday.

Blue Valley stepped in and immediately sent their plumbers over. Paul and Steven arrived promptly, diagnosed the problem, and replaced the section of pipe that was leaking within a couple hours so the HVAC workers could finish up their part. I wish we had used Blue Valley to initially install our water heater.

Every technician, project consultant, and installer we have worked with for the HVAC system has exceeded expectations. The company truly hires outstanding people and we will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Clayton Dennis
reviews.text:
Our heat abruptly stopped working this morning so I called Blue Valley, who came highly recommended. They were able to set up a same day appointment with Chris. He came by on time, inspected the furnace, and was able to get the heat back on. He was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and friendly. I would highly recommend giving Blue Valley a call for any heating or cooling needs!

Editing my review to include Danny as well! The day after I met with Chris, Danny promptly called me and walked me through the next steps. He was extremely helpful guiding me through options on the way forward. He provided honest feedback and quickly sent over several proposals. Furthermore, he guided me through the incentives and rebates offered by the state to get me the best deal possible on my new HVAC system. I couldn't be more pleased with their service thus far! Wonderful company and even better people.

reviews.author: John Skance
reviews.text:
Excellent quality and craftsmanship by Gerardo, Kasey and Alex in installing a new combi-boiler and whole house humidifier.  They showed-up when they said they would, finished on time, and were neat, clean and respectful.

Attaching photos of the old and new boiler system. Remarkable difference!  Would highly recommend Blue Valley.

plumbers.name: Pro-Tech Air Conditioning & Plumbing Service
plumbers.address: 3599 W Lake Mary Blvd Suite B, Lake Mary, FL 32746, USA

reviews.author: Nomar Conde
reviews.text:
I had this company install a central TRANE XV variable-speed unit in 2018. From the first year, I was paying for their “membership,” which turned out to be a scam — not beneficial to customers as they advertise. Filters were never included, and their maintenance visits were basically a quick five-minute drain vacuum before leaving.

Over the years, I paid for several small repairs that were clearly overpriced, but I kept using them since they were the original installers. Now they’ve quoted me $4,000 just for labor to replace the coils — and didn’t even provide an itemized estimate, just one total price. That’s extremely excessive and not transparent. I can’t recommend this company based on my experience.

reviews.author: James Bridenthal
reviews.text:
Used this company for years but will not any more. Needed some plumbing work done after a pressure flow part busted outside my home and had no water inside. I was way overcharged since I looked up the part price after the fact and it only took him 30 minutes to change it out. I asked for an itemized receipt and only got a one line item receipt for the full charge .

Never using again. I also had them come out at the same time to look at my HVAC that they installed 5 years ago only to be told it was a 3k charge to fix a part on warranty. After being over charged for the plumbing work I cannot trust they are pricing me fair.

reviews.author: Sasha Wang Martin
reviews.text: Used this company for years— apparently it was bought out. Pricing is beyond not competitive now- whoever the new owners are have zero clue what the going rate is in the area. I had one of your plumbers come out 2 days ago for a clogged toilet. Claimed he needed to pull the toilet- quoted me at $1200, and at my refusal he said the best he could do was $900. I laughed in his face bc I could have a whole new toilet installed- labor and materials- for that price. I brought a competitor out this morning- still a big company— and the plumber didn’t need to pull the toilet at all. It was fixed for $225.  And he said even if he did need to pull the toilet it would have been half. I don’t know what happened to this company but nobody is falling for this new scam you guys are pulling. Stop telling customers they need services they don’t, and fix your prices.

reviews.author: Sherry Reynolds
reviews.text: we had to have some old plumbing pipes replaced. Pro Tech employee, Joseph Hammett, was there very promptly. He is very knowledgeable, courteous, and personable.  Did the work all in one day. The job was expertly done, and we plan on using him in the future.

reviews.author: Roy Holt
reviews.text:
Absolute nightmare to deal with. Poor communication, didn't pull permits, installed broken hardware. Go with literally anyone else. One star is too generous.

They installed a new variable Daikin AC system, UV cleaning system, breaker panel, and home surge protector. The new AC unit died within a day and I had to call technicians out to fix the brand new system. After the new breaker box was installed part of the house would randomly lose power. Another tech came out to see what was going on and said an old broken breaker had been put in. He asked who did the initial work and wasn't surprised to hear it was done poorly. The new panel install was finished with "I hope the inspector doesn't look to close, this might not pass."

After a month of trying to get an inspection scheduled with weekly calls and constant assurances it would be "done immediately" and "someone will call you soon" I asked the permits office if I can schedule it myself (especially after the issues with the breaker panel I was worried about the wiring) and they said no permit existed for the work that was completed.

Finally after another few weeks of waiting the inspection was completed and somehow passed. Now I am sitting at 68% indoor humidity, mold growth in my home (I never had this problem before), and the only response from the company is "someone will get back to you soon" unsurprisingly to me no one is getting back to me.

I waited to see if they could salvage the situation and make things right, but nothing happened aside from replies of "someone will get back to you." What's the point of a labor warranty if nothing is done? Now I'm probably going to have to call another AC company to figure out whats wrong with my system.

plumbers.name: Robinson's Plumbing Service
plumbers.address: 247 Wylderose Ct, Midlothian, VA 23113, USA

reviews.author: Nazar Jonathan
reviews.text: Justin, was polite and he worked his butt off replacing my old leaking brass drainage for the 2nd floor bathrooms. I would highly recommend Robinson plumbing.  Service crews were awesome, office staff were excellent. They didn't price gouge.  I feel I got a good price for excellent service.

reviews.author: Susan Drumwright
reviews.text: We had a big leak under the kitchen sink.  Called on Tuesday. And plumber Tim came on Wednesday.  He fixed the leak in 30 min.  He was quiet, polite and on his way.

reviews.author: Nicholas Fessick
reviews.text: Had a pretty major problem with some aged main pipes in my Richmond rental on Grace street. Justin and his crew, came up with a good plan and executed it in one day. Rerouting lines and replace the old pipe and minimizing any disruption in the crawl space. Great job!

reviews.author: Dee Norman
reviews.text: I have a well and horses and when the water goes out it’s such a catastrophe. Robinsons came on a Saturday in the middle of the polar vortex and I had water that day. I’ve used them for projects both very big (and unpleasant) and very small, and I appreciate their prompt professionalism more than a review can convey. Thank you to Steve, Derrick, and the entire team!

reviews.author: Cherrie Richard
reviews.text: Robinson plumbing was excellent. These guys went above and beyond to not open my floor due to my crawl space being very narrow and super complex. They worked together to find a way to get my water back on.! Professional, courtesy would recommend 1000%!

plumbers.name: Admiral Plumbing Heating and Cooling
plumbers.address: 475 E 1000 S #202, Pleasant Grove, UT 84062, USA

reviews.author: Braxton Miller
reviews.text: I had a life changing disaster happen on my property but John was supper awesome and was very personal with me and made it easier for me to swallow they pill. He made sure my property was taken care of and helped me save money wherever we could. He ended up saving me 6,000 over all on the job they did for me. They also did great work and were very fast. Thanks

reviews.author: victor ramirez
reviews.text: Justin Fillmore was a great and informative technician. Admiral was able to get Justin here within a couple hours to help with a fountain we have in the backyard that was broken leaking out water. Justin helped shut off the water and provide useful information on the water system in our home. We appreciate all of the information that Justin provided and the quickness of him getting here/the service.

reviews.author: A.J. Rounds
reviews.text: We love using Admireal at Keyrenter Provo.  They've been a great partner for years.  Thanks for helping out with our HVAC needs.  Prompt, professional, and Economical.   You guys are awesome!

reviews.author: Blake and Laurissa Jones Bills
reviews.text:
We just had Nick come out and fix a water heater that was under warranty. The pilot light went out and it was having issues. He figured it out fast and got it up and running smoothly in no time and the warranty covered it all.
He was so nice and professional and explained their annual service plans. Knowledgeable, professional, and kind. Thank you for getting our hot water back Nick!

reviews.author: Jeffrey J
reviews.text:
Competitive price, good HVAC work. I trust they aren’t trying to over charge.

Gavin installed my new heat pump and furnace. He’s also the guy who comes to service it. This “installer is also servicer” method lets installers see any issues so they can improve their craft. Haven’t had any issues.

plumbers.name: Sharp Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 329 W Main St Unit #2, Northborough, MA 01532, USA

reviews.author: AQ
reviews.text:
HIGHLY RECOMMEND Sharp Plumbing. Breno, Gabriel, Gui, Nick, and Eric were fantastic. This is what they do. Plumbing. So they know it and have mastered it. They are as professional as they come. From my first call, I was so overly impressed with not only getting a live person, but having him get someone out to me same day when I had no hot water. They call you and text when you they are about to come your way. You get a text with a pic and name of who's coming so you feel safe. And then once they do the diagnosis, they have you do a quick conference call with their service managers so they can thoroughly explain what the issues are and offer multiple options for remedies. I have never had a company do this. I was very pleased. It turns out Navien tankless water heater was toast. Would have cost 1/2 the cost of a new one to fix and there's no guarantee other parts of it wouldn't fail going forward. So they walked me through my options and suggested a Rinnai tankless water heater. Superior brand. Very few issues. Easier to maintain. And they professionally install them and offer years of service and maintenance with the purchase.

I haven't been this impressed with a "home repair" place before. These guys are just top notch and set the bar for what I'd love to see from any company that has to come into my home to work on something small or major.

Highly recommend them, their professionalism, their communication, their work, and their unmatched commitment to the customer.

reviews.author: m t
reviews.text: Leo arrived on time, explained in detail what he was here to do and executed his job very professionally.  He was available to answer questions and very polite.  Will use Sharp again.

reviews.author: Shelz M
reviews.text:
Let me just start by saying God knew exactly what He was doing by sending Sharp Plumbing and Remodeling technician. I called and needed urgent service due to a water heater leak & water went through the walls and carpet. Gui was finishing up work in Worcester and in less than an hour he was at our house.

Gui was very professional, very knowledgable and very patient and walked us through all the steps of what the process pertains. He gave an advice on starting a claim and reaching out to a restoration company to avoid risks that come with water damage.

He later got the service manager (Nick) on the phone who was very patient as well, understanding and a man full of compassion. Truly, God uses people as a blessing in our lives and Nick, Gui and Breno were definitely a blessing to our family.

Breno and Gui did an amazing job, amazing guys and Sharp Plumbing and Remodeling were very well represented. It was a lot of work but they were very efficient and their prices are reasonable.

This company paid forward in a way that our family and I were deeply grateful. May God bless the work of your hands and thanks for saving us more damage by showing up promptly and doing an amazing job.

reviews.author: Mary Hagspiel
reviews.text: Leo came out and completed a rebuild on my toilet and also replaced the stems on my bathroom sink. He did an excellent job and left the area neat and tidy. He was very personable and I was very comfortable with him performing the work.

reviews.author: Roberta Gaucher
reviews.text: Just want to give a huge shout out to Dennis M from Sharp Plumbing and Heating Company! He came out to fix my super clogged kitchen sink. He was awesome! He walked me through everything he was doing and explained the issue. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Young Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 622 McGee Rd, Anderson, SC 29625, USA

reviews.author: Debbie
reviews.text:
Oh, what a lovely morning with two brilliant young men from Young Plumbing Services!  It’s an old house that was built on love and other ideals; now it’s time to set things aright.  All those little annoying issues that would not go away, regardless of how much work had been done, will now be removed entirely and this house will flow naturally, normally and in peace, with peace of mind.

A call was made to the office on late Monday; an appointment was set for Wednesday.  If a slot became available sooner late Tuesday afternoon, I would be slid into the schedule.  Sidney was ever so patient and kind with me, keeping me informed every step of the way.

But an early morning phone call today, Tuesday, from Sidney at the office got the ball rolling quickly.  The two gentleman made a courteous phone call to let me know that they were on the way.

Alberto and Mekhi arrived calmly and professionally.  They patiently listened to me with all the details and concerns I had to share about the plumbing issues in this old house, but the current toilet issue was my immediate concern.

Alberto and Mekhi kept me informed every step of the way of their findings and suggestions.  Both were personable and professional.  Both treated me with the utmost respect.  They earned my respect, in many ways.

Tomorrow begins the work that should have been done initially, many, many years ago.  The galvanized and cast iron bits and pieces, the dysfunctional bits and bobs, the on and off issues will be a thing of the past.  All things will become new and this house will be a safe haven for another lifetime and then some.

And Alberto and Mekhi ... I will remember them as my special friends for a very long time.  I reckon they may know more about me now than most folks do.

Young Plumbing Services: Just give them a call.  You will be well cared for.

But wait, there’s more!

Matt, Jeremy and Kole teamed up on day one and began the process of digging out, digging through major root balls and chipping away at understanding a mountain of ancient connections.

Richard and Jeremy took over on day two, in the pouring rain!  Jeremy doesn’t like to get wet from the rain, but not once did he hesitate to work in the muck, mud, mire and ... other brown stuff.

On day three, Richard and Jeremy were joined by Caila, Jacob and James. Richard, by the way, arrived driving his big white steed with that Bobcat in tow.  He is a master at what he does as it happens.  I watched it all with my own two eyes.  And if I were being totally transparent, I would tell you that he solved issues that I’ve been begging and praying for the past 13 years that someone would come along and offer lasting relief.  He did what no one has been willing or capable of doing.  John Wayne would have serious competition with this one.  Rooster Cogburn, indeed. Jeremy went above and beyond to match the black caulk with the black toilet seat.

It was a long day, that day, for all involved.  The Young team worked past 8 PM on a Friday, no less.  Laughter and respect were always shared, keeping everyone moving along and honoring me the entire time.  A few nicks and scrapes here and there, minor punctures in foreheads happened, but after serving them milk and cookies, they went right back at it until all was completed.  They clean up after themselves too.

My home is better than it ever has been because of Young Plumbing Services.

I am well loved and loved well in the hands of Young Plumbing Services.  Wouldn’t you agree?

reviews.author: JB Pruitt, III
reviews.text:
Josef arrived on time today to assess my needs of removing the old water heater & discussed my options for replacement to my satisfaction  - Matt arrived shortly after with a new water heater & all necessary parts for any upgrades to water lines , connections, gas line, etc.  He answered all my questions and was knowledgeable regarding installation.
A professional job was done in a timely manner & appreciated!  Thanks Young Plumbing for having well trained friendly employees.

reviews.author: Kathleen Wiley
reviews.text: Dishonest assessment of repair needed, overpriced quote of $5400, never received a copy of what I signed on an iPad, fear tactics used, high pressure to commit, was told I needed to replace water and sewer line, they were new PVC and replaced less than 3 years before when I bought my house-confirmed by another plumber, I paid a $2000 deposit on 4/18. Called several times to confirm what I was receiving because the quoted price was to replace both lines and I never received the quote, was sent to an AI bot, received a text back on 4/20 promising a full refund of my deposit. On that same day I called another plumber, he came out and fixed the cracked pipe at the meter box, exactly where the city water department employee said the crack was. Young plumbing said the pipe was not cracked there, that the leak was farther up the line and I need to replace the entire line. I will post the video of the leak on my facebook page and on all local group pages since I cannot attach it here. As of 5/29 I still have not received a refund. Young Plumbing cashed and kept my entire $2000 check, promised a refund, promised a replacement refund check, and now are not responding to my requests for my refund. I have filed a formal complaint with the South Carolina department of consumer affairs. An honest plumber came out on 4/20 and repaired the cracked pipe that was exactly where young plumbers said it wasn’t. It took a couple hours, and I paid $225 total for the repair. A tree root had put pressure on the pipe and caused it to crack. The honest plumber saved me $5175.

reviews.author: Matt Cox
reviews.text: I've been experiencing issue with water backing up and seeping out around a toilet and flooding my ceiling in my garage.  Charlie and his teammate were very thorough in evaluating the issue and offering possible fixes.  In short, it was a construction issue from the builder.  I really appreciate how well Young plumbing services addressed the issue and explained it.  I can recommend them and will use them for future issues should they arise.

reviews.author: julie page
reviews.text:
We had a great experience with young plumbing! Jeremy came out to help with our septic issue and he was fantastic. He was on time, very knowledgeable, and took the time to explain what was going on without making us feel rushed.
He was honest, professional, and easy to talk to. You can tell he really knows what he’s doing and genuinely cares about helping his customers. If you need plumbing or septic work done, I definitely recommend young plumbing and especially Jeremy. Thank you again!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 333 Sandy Springs Cir #224, Sandy Springs, GA 30328, USA

reviews.author: Nadine Ford
reviews.text: We called Roto-Rooter because our toilet was flushing very slow. We had Khup come and do our service of removing the toilet and finding a toy my toddler and flushed down. He did an excellent job of getting the toy unstuck without damaging the toilet. Thanks to him it saved us from having to also buy a whole new one!!

reviews.author: Batgirl 1118
reviews.text:
John was hands down the best contractor I’ve worked with. He showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and fixed the issue the right way — not the quick way. No upselling, no pressure, just honest advice and solid work.
You can tell he takes pride in what he does. The job was clean, efficient, and done to a higher standard than I expected. If you want someone who actually knows their stuff and stands behind their work, he’s your guy.
Wouldn’t call anyone else.

reviews.author: Kia Morning Flower
reviews.text: I can’t believe that a plumber/technician came to me and my family’s rescue on Christmas Eve! He was so positive and respectful. He did an excellent job and even explained what the problem was with my clogged drain. It wasn’t just the garage disposal but an air admittance vent!

reviews.author: David Fites
reviews.text:
Angel did a
tremendous job. He went above and beyond the call for us . He was very pleasant and a joy to work with.
Very professional.

reviews.author: Alaina Nance
reviews.text: Was lucky to have my workplace serviced by Angel. He had such a great personality and made the time he was servicing feel like it went by fast. Also was consistent in updating me and my team on updates regarding our plumbing issues. 10/10 service, will definitely be requesting Angel if any other issues may arise regarding plumbing
