reviews.author: Amy Andresh
reviews.text: They came promptly on a Sunday, and had my issue fixed, professionally and neatly. Majic and Jack were very personable and knowledgeable. I wouldn't hesitate to use them again and highly recommend The Plumbing Source.

reviews.author: Larry Sarjeant
reviews.text: I have had The Plumbing Source work on numerous issues in both my home and business.  They are very professional have been prompt in responding to emergencies.  When there have been less expensive options to solve an issue, they have given me all the pros and cons to each issue.  I highly recommend their services for your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Kathleen Sloe
reviews.text: Mack and Casey were very professional, prompt and attentive to our needs.  Mack explained issues and possible solutions before starting any work.  Once they started working, they worked diligently and finished in a timely manner.  We are happy we chose Plumbing Source for our well storage tank (& parts) replacement.  We would recommend them.

reviews.author: Ed Allen
reviews.text:
Tyler and his apprentice arrived on schedule and were professional in both appearance and demeanor. They efficiently addressed two issues, provided excellent customer service, and repaired the problems thoroughly. They also cleaned up the work area before leaving, which we greatly appreciated.

From the initial call to schedule service through paying Plumbing Source’s reasonable fee, the entire experience was smooth and positive.

We will call on them for future plumbing matters.

reviews.author: Chris S
reviews.text:
Needed a faucet repaired and water heater replaced.
Was very happy with the response time for repairs; Was also very happy with the explanation for what was wrong and why I needed a replacement versus a repair. Plumbers were very professional, work  was done quickly.  Everything cleaned up very well!
Felt the price was reasonable as well.

reviews.author: Tony Jones
reviews.text:
Sad..  they seemed so great.  This is there finished work. Behind my washer,  wood is still rotten,I paid them to replace it all. They left it exposed to my sub basement. Mice and bugs. (Replace all plumbing) Behind my fridge, they left it wide and open.  Being hidden, I guess they didn’t want to finish it, they didn’t remove the old floor, put new boards over it, makes me question what they fixed.   Because of that it doesn’t blend with old floor.   They left it that way.  They didn’t want to cut small boards to give it a finished look.

In there defense,  I wasn’t there. (Out of town) so I couldn’t watch them. But that’s how trust works. Now they won’t call me back. It’s been over a week.

Utterly disappointing.

reviews.author: Kellie Armetta
reviews.text: We were in a pickle with our toilet over flowing 3 times, called Pipe Wrench at 4:00 pm thinking they would come the next day and if not we would have had to relocate.  The customer service was amazing and we got the call back from Daniel Rakowski he would come today after he finished the job he was currently on. So  around 5 pm or so he showed up and worked continuously for hours @ around 7:45 pm he had the drain cleaned out and we now were back in service!! Thanks so much to Daniel for his service and professionalism.  I hate he’s getting a late dinner but couldn’t be more thankful for the fast service and dedication to resolve our issue.

reviews.author: Joe Swicegood
reviews.text: The technician was very prepared, very knowledgeable. He let me know ahead of time of what to expect. He also kept me informed of what he was doing and what he found of the problem. I was impressed with how efficient he was in completing the project. Thank you very much for sending me this technician.

reviews.author: Jenny Stooksbury
reviews.text: Daniel was amazing.  With today’s temperatures, I felt bad having an appointment, but he was very professional and thorough in his inspection, ensuring to get into the crawlspace and double check every inch of the system.  Thankfully, I do not have the leak I thought I did, but Daniel ensured to let me know of a few concerning areas of subfloor, which I greatly appreciate.  Pipe Wrench was my second opinion for this concern, and next time they’ll be my first.  Thank you again!

reviews.author: Andrew Bryant
reviews.text: Daniel did a great job fixing our problem with our washing machine drain. He was able to figure out the issue immediately, and fixed it quickly and thoroughly. Highly recommend the team at Pipe Wrench!

plumbers.name: JT Services

reviews.author: Tiffany Ridenour
reviews.text: We noticed our septic tank backing up. We called JT services and they sent Keeton out to pump it for us. He was very professional and answered all our questions. He gladly explained how our septic system worked. Highly recommend Keeton at JT services.

reviews.author: Andy Romsa
reviews.text: The folks from JT Services were the best. They dealt with rock, soil and terrain issues. They worked out solutions to each problem and accomplished the job in an exemplary and professional manner. The finished project is great and they went above and beyond to get us back to a fully functional treatment system. Thanks so much, y’all are the best, from the staff at headquarters to the installers in the field.

reviews.author: Eldon Riley
reviews.text:
Had an emergency backup and they were there within hours.  Jake went above and beyond to clear the blockage which turned out to be caused by a previous plumber's broken snake in the line.  Jake used critical thinking and ingenuity in devising a method to retrieve it.
Also a shoutout to Quincy who came and pumped the septic tank during all of this.
Office people were very pleasant to talk to and everyone was professional and friendly.  Thanks for saving the day!!!

reviews.author: Aaron Peters
reviews.text: We are highly impressed with JT services. From the moment we called and spoke to customer services and had an appointment made everything went smoothly. Keaton came to our house. Was extremely thorough and knowledgeable. He gave us multiple options that we can do he helped us out tremendously. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Chad Costes
reviews.text: Great company with wonderful staff. Everyone is friendly, professional and knowledgeable. Was very thorough throughout the entire process and explained everything that was going on. Definitely recommended!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup

reviews.author: Darrel Valsaint
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Roto-Rooter today. William Fletcher came out to take a look at a plumbing issue I was having, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the service. He arrived right on time, was professional, honest, and quickly diagnosed the problem.
What I appreciated most was his transparency and integrity—he took the time to explain everything clearly without trying to upsell unnecessary work. The service was fast, efficient, and done with real professionalism.
If you’re looking for a reliable plumbing company that shows up when they say they will and treats customers with respect, I definitely recommend Roto-Rooter. Thanks again to William for the excellent service!

reviews.author: Sherry Jaclin
reviews.text: Fast to respond, professional, and honest. They diagnosed the problem quickly. They were able to fix the issue right way, and charged a fair price. Great communication throughout the process. I would definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Bryan T
reviews.text:
Fletcher Williams was awesome, came out and did the camera inspection for us and provided a very detailed analysis of our pipes and the existing problems. He is definitely the reason for the rating.
Sergio Guadalupe on the other hand was just ok. He failed to notice a very obvious clean out and claimed he thought it was an electrical access point (which I think makes no sense, and why wouldn’t you check anyways?) this makes you wonder if he missed it on purpose to include a toilet removal on the quote which adds $250 to the price tag. He was nice otherwise though. Fletcher immediately noticed this clean out despite it being darker out when he arrived.

reviews.author: Steven Cardenas
reviews.text: Great experience with RR.  Tech and field support were a great help to clear my home drain issue.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Darlene Mosley
reviews.text: Eddy did an amazing job. From the first interaction until the time he left, extremely professional, very detailed and knowledgeable about what was going on with both my dishwasher and disposal and drains. He cleared, cleaned and treated them, left preventive cleaning supplies so this doesn’t happen again, and installed the correct disposal my home needed. And the best part, he cleaned up after. Not many other companies I’ve worked with in the last year of owning my home have done that. Thank you again. 😁

plumbers.name: Halpin Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 5177 Fishwick Dr, Cincinnati, OH 45216, USA

reviews.author: Rebecca Keating
reviews.text: Christian did an exceptional job with his partner today. They were both very professional. Christian knew exactly what to do, he did it with perfection, and he pulled me in on every decision which needed to he made. This is always important so there aren't any surprises at the end! The vanity with new plumbing looks great! He had to make a hole in the drywall to remove the old faucet which came straight out of the wall, but we can fix that with no problem.

reviews.author: Nyonu Lewis
reviews.text:
I recently had some extensive plumbing work done and I’m so glad I chose Halpin Plumbing. Charlie and Caleb were absolutely great to work with. They showed up on time, were professional, and were very thorough in their work.

What I appreciated most was how clearly they explained everything they were doing and took the time to answer my questions. They were also upfront with their pricing, so no surprises at the end, which I appreciated.

If you’re looking for a reliable plumbing company, I highly recommend Halpin Plumbing. Be sure to ask for Charlie and Caleb!

reviews.author: Brett Bick
reviews.text: Halpin is our go-to for any plumbing needs. Very competitive pricing, great work, and an awesome personnel team.  Shout out to Alecia and Christian for helping us immensely during inspection period while selling our home, as well!  We've had nothing but consistently positive experiences with Halpin... Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Douglas Jose
reviews.text: Luke and Joe came back less than a week after installing a water heater that was now leaking. They quickly figured out that the water pressure was way too high, and were able to quickly replace the pressure regulator to fix the problem, very affordably. They were able to come on two hours notice, since they got a cancellation that day.

reviews.author: Alex Long
reviews.text: Christian and Mason did an excellent job fixing my hot water heater.  They were on time to the appointment, professional, explained the issues well, and they had the necessary spare part in their van and were able to fix the issue within 30 min.  Most importantly, Halpin Plumbing is honest with their quotes.  Specifically, they charged $200 for a job that Apollo Home wanted $1,700 for (predatory pricing).  I will always be recommending Halpin to friends & neighbors.  Thank you!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 4752 Alpine Rd, Columbia, SC 29223, USA

reviews.author: Jade Watford
reviews.text:
I had a minor leak (less than 5 sq inches of damaged drywall) and called rotorooters because they had come to fix the same leak 2 years prior. The plumber was very nice. However, when he entered my ceiling space to repair the leak he did something and then water began to pour into my ceiling below! He ran outside to shut my water off and informed me that the water shutoff was broken—weird because I had just shut my own water off a few weeks prior. I believed the paid professional and ran back inside to start putting towels on the floor. Water ran through my home for nearly an hour and completely flooded it. I later learned that the water shutoff was NOT broken- the plumber just did not know how to shut it off. I thought that was basic knowledge and was very shocked that the professional I paid $600 misinforms me and caused over $40,000 in damages.
The water mitigation crew was extremely nice and hardworking. They mostly did a good job and were very professional. Andrew and Nate were especially great to work with.
Even though I had a great experience with the two of them, I would not recommend Rotorooters. The plumber caused extreme damage to my home and the owner refused to take any responsibility, leaving me to cover $15,000 of damages out of pocket. He was a nice guy— but unfortunately lacks the integrity to pay for his employee’s mistakes.

reviews.author: Roberto Abreu
reviews.text:
STAY AWAY!!! This people won’t warranty their work and if they have to come back they will charge again and won’t perform the work. Charged me $800 for a toilet removal when the toilet wasn’t even touched and they don’t even have picture of that being done. See the picture of the toilet untouched.  Store manager name Jerry questioned my statement that the technician was 15 min inside the house and 1 hour  outside playing with his phone. DIDNT DO ANYTHING!!! This is so wrong!!!
After your answer I wanted to edit my review…
The management company have nothing to do with this I am the tenant who is paying the OUTRAGEOUS BILL that doesn’t reflect the actual work performed. I called nicely to try to resolve this issue in the best possible way and your manager answer was not right. He questioned my statement that the technician did not performed the work that I was charged for. BTW I asked for a picture of the toilet being removed and you guys don’t have it!! THAT IS A LIE!!! AGAIN STAY AWAY FROM THIS PEOPLE !!!!

reviews.author: Marcal McLaurin
reviews.text: Technician (Tim) was extremely thorough in diagnosing our water leak and providing an adequate solution. It was very interesting watching the entire process from start to finish. His knowledge was on full display during the removal and installation of the water lines. Most importantly, we enjoyed the engaging conversations over the course of his work. Definitely pleased with the overall outcome and we wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone needing help resulting from a broken water line.

reviews.author: Ray Rosario
reviews.text:
Scott and Charles are professional and friendly. Their technical knowledge and work ethic is above and beyond my expectations. Price is fair. Would absolutely suggest them for any plumbing needs. Great job. God bless.
Sgt Ro

reviews.author: Dalee Sullivan
reviews.text:
Edit:
I wanted to edit my review to add that the company called my husband after leaving this review (he couldn’t answer as we were at the pediatrician). They left a voicemail saying they would like to discuss the feedback I left so he promptly called back and the person he spoke to said they had non record of calling him regarding my review despite them having left a voicemail. Never called back again either! So weird and gets a D- for customer service.
Worst experience ever. We had what ended up being a leak coming from our fridge line that was spurting up the wall inside the cabinet. When the plumber got here he did not want to listen to my husband about what was going on and kept being adamant that it was a roof leak (because he had noticed we were also dealing with that at the same time). My husband insisted the water only leaked out when it was turned on, but despite that the plumber still insisted it was the roof. He charged us over $400 for that. My husband asked if that was the best price and he replied “I only charged you for the first hour” (he had been in our home about 15 minutes at this point.) I should also add that $200ish of that was the weekend call out fee, which we did agree to, and I’m not complaining about that. My husband proceeded to pay the plumber and pointed out one last time that the leak was only active while the water was turned on. This finally got the plumbers attention and he (with my husbands help) identified that it was the fridge line. He offered no fix other than shutting off the water to the fridge and told us we’d have to call him back on a weekday for a fix. We obviously did not do that and fixed it ourselves. It was extremely disappointing to be met with poor attitude and laziness especially considering we were one day home from the hospital with our newborn son. This experience did not help our issue and cost us $400 that we really didn’t have to spend with a new baby.

plumbers.name: Locklear Plumbing
plumbers.address: 409 S Wall St, Calhoun, GA 30701, USA

reviews.author: Lex Newsome
reviews.text: The team showed up in a timely manner. They were very efficient. In 2 hrs or less, we were good to go with a new water heater. They did what they said they would do and got us out of a predicament. As far as pricing I am not exactly sure what others may charge for the same service. But convenience and efficiency is worth something. And they were certainly great in those areas. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Siri
reviews.text: Absolutely a company I trust and will (and have) recommend to anyone who prioritizes trust, safety, and transparency. You know from a photo who's coming. They're professional punctual, and in my budget and they will need in yours too. Give them a go and you too will know. The professionalism and standards they hold to are getting more scarce but it's good to know some still stand tall. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Janet Wilson
reviews.text: During the coldest winter ever one of my pipes cracked. I didn’t know what to expect the girl at the office was so helpful and gave me an appointment the next day. The technician was there right on time he was so courteous and helpful. I was pleasantly surprised at his honesty and knowledge. I thought that this kind of service was gone but from the beginning it was a pleasure to do business with Locklear Plumbing

reviews.author: Catherine Stevens
reviews.text: Locklear Plumbing replaced my natural gas water heater with a Bradford White model at a reasonable price. Alden and crew did an excellent job with the installation. It passed inspection on the first pass. It was a pleasure to do business with everyone I encountered at Locklear. All were polite, pleasant, and professional. I will definitely contact them again for my future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Matthew Bello
reviews.text: Locklear has been one of the best plumbing companies that I have ever worked with in my life. The gentleman who visited our home, Cobey was unbelievably helpful and kind. He explained every step of the process that he took and after everything, I felt nothing but satisfaction in regard to the job that he did. Would highly recommend Locklear plumbing and if you decide to give them a call, ask for Cobey.

plumbers.name: American Rooter Services
plumbers.address: 2629 Sandy Plains Rd #201, Marietta, GA 30066, USA

reviews.author: Ans
reviews.text: My expansion water tank went bad so I went online to Thumbtack and hired American (Georgia) Rooter Services to get it replaced. The contractor (Jay) did amazing work on the replacement tank and pex piping. He encountered a rough time accessing my main water shut off valve due to the city but handled it like the pro he is and conquered the job. Im very happy with the outcome and the customer service. Im very sure the water pressure in the house and bill will reflect that happiness as well! Thank you for your professionalism and expertise.

reviews.author: LaDonna Jones
reviews.text: George from American Rooter was very professional and knowledgeable. He took the time to clearly explain the entire water heater installation process and answered all of my questions. I truly appreciated his patience and expertise. Excellent customer service!

reviews.author: Ashanti Hughes
reviews.text: There was a new leak from my water heater. I was out of warranty and nervous. I contacted Thumbtack and was connected to George of American Rooter Services. He was amazing! He explain the issues and what needed to be done. The level of eduction and the ability to easily explain an issue I had no knowledge of made the experience more pleasurable than the worry I originally felt. Thank you George! I appreciate you!

reviews.author: Anne Ashworth
reviews.text: I contacted American Rooter Service for my failed sump pump and was scheduled the next morning (at my convenience) for a 10am -12pm window.  Angel and Chris arrived promptly at 10, diagnosed and clearly explained the issue, and had it repaired for a fair price in a timely manner. They were courteous and professional and wonderful to work with and were finished long before the 12pm window closed.  Happy to have reliable plumbers in my address book to refer to friends!

reviews.author: Aron P.
reviews.text: Showed up on time and did the job for my in wall pinhole leak which already have am insurance claim. Assured me that I will get reimbursed the total I paid this company by the insurance with the way they make their invoices. The person who said also said they will refund me the difference if I don't get the money from the insurance company.  Took me more than a week just to get a legible invoice from this company that can be accepted by the insurance. Guess what? Insurance company only reimbursed me for 63% of the total invoice. I contacted the same person who came and said about reimbursement to ask the refund. He will not honor what he said. They can do the job but beware of what they say to hook you to do the job. I told him to keep the money and live with the dishonesty. Why is it so difficult to find an honest company these days?

reviews.text:
I selected All Aloha Plumbing because their response time to my request was faster than the competition.

I am pleased with the work because of the quality and professionalism displayed by the service technician, Ray and the follow up communication from the staff.

I would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Cindy Ikehara
reviews.text:

I was also amazed at the forward technology this company uses. They showed me videos of the underground pipes during their
progress.
Be sure to join their club, even though there’s a yearly fee … they will come out and do a yearly inspection of your pipes, give you priority appointments and you receive a discount as well.
As you can see, Joseph explained everything to me clearly and precisely.
As you can see, Joseph explained everything to me clearly and precisely.
It was an expensive job, but I am confident that I made the right choice with All Aloha Plumbing.

He replaced two old shut-off valves and connected our washer at a reasonable price. We will definitely use All Aloha Plumbing for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Rie Luangkhoth

I am so appreciative of how professional this company treats their customers.  Follow up was awesome too to ensure we were ok.  Mahalo nui!!!! Raven H., Thank you for your support & service.  May you continue making a difference.

Earl, our technician, was efficient and quickly completed the work to our satisfaction. Hopefully we don’t have another emergency 😅 but if we do, we know who to call!

reviews.author: Richard Beall

reviews.text: We had Michael Kress come today to inspect our pipes following multiple/reoccurring issues. He was personable, professional, and a joy to work with! We are so grateful for his patience & dedication to helping our family!

reviews.author: Peter Saims
reviews.text: P trap and pipes all of a sudden fell apart, like late afternoon. My son called Young Plumbing and they said they will be out the next day at 7:30. I received a call to let me know they were in their way. James and Tanner were very, very friendly, informative and with a caring attitude. The cost was way less than I expected. Made me feel like family. Thank you Young Plumbing for having wonderful employees. Merry Christmas

reviews.author: Aimen Khan
reviews.text:
We had an issue with our water heater, and Seba and Sean did an excellent job handling the repair. They were professional, knowledgeable, and very patient in explaining what the problem was and how they planned to fix it. They arrived on time, worked efficiently, and made sure everything was functioning properly before leaving.

What really stood out was their honesty and attention to detail—they didn’t try to upsell unnecessary work and focused on the best solution for our situation. The repair was done neatly, safely, and with great care for our home.

If you’re looking for reliable, skilled, and trustworthy professionals for water heater repairs, I highly recommend Seba and Sean. Great experience from start to finish.
Aimen khan

reviews.author: Jason Powers
reviews.text: Needed new hot and cold boiler drains to install new washing machine cuz old ones wouldn't shut off. Tyler did a great job, I would definitely recommend Young Plumbing and Tyler to anyone.  Thank you for great professional service.

reviews.author: Cameron Mable
reviews.text: I've used Young in the past. They came out , were on time and got the job done quickly. James and Tanner were nice and cleaned up after themselves. I think I paid more than I could have if I went with someone else, but I trust them, they have always done good work for me

reviews.author: Tarsha Bryant
reviews.text: Great service! Tom & Joe  took care of  me and my plumbing problem. They are some of the nice guys you ever want to meet. They put my mind at ease and did a fantastic job. I highly recommend Young Plumbing and Tom & Joe. I will be letting all my friends and family know they are the best choice.

reviews.author: Lauren Christie

He was super friendly and explained his process with us, even cutting out some old piping from a  water softener used by the prior owners no longer in use to prevent any future issues.

This was our first time working with a plumbing company as new homeowners and All Pro & Eric have made lifelong fans today!

reviews.author: Santiago Del Hoyo
reviews.text: Don Smith at All Pro Plumbing did a fantastic job. He was on time, addresed our concern right away. Provided honest advice on how to repair. Although new to this company his experience, honesty and professionalism is a blessing to customers and his employer.

reviews.author: Anastasia Constantine

All Pro is an excellent plumbing company and wanted to share my experience. From the first phone call to the completion of the job, the service was professional, prompt, and extremely knowledgeable.

The work was completed efficiently, and everything was left clean and in perfect working order. I would highly recommend All Pro services to anyone in need of a trustworthy and experienced plumber. I will definitely call them again for any future plumbing needs

reviews.author: Brian Ogburn
reviews.text: I’ve had a great experience working with All Pro Plumbing. Their team is professional, responsive, and consistently delivers high-quality work. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for a dependable plumbing company.

reviews.author: S G
reviews.text:
All Pro Plumbing is simply the best! We had a major sewer line issue and they responded incredibly fast. The technician, Rudy Soto, arrived quickly and resolved the entire problem in less than an hour.

The pricing was very affordable, especially for an emergency situation, and Rudy took the time to clearly explain the entire procedure step by step. He was professional, knowledgeable, and very respectful.

Highly recommended! If you need reliable and fast plumbing service, All Pro Plumbing is the company to call.

Will definitely be using them for future needs.

reviews.author: Sandra Cubriel
reviews.text: We recently needed our whole house plumbing redone due to multiple foundation leaks. We appreciate all of the assistance and work. Eric did an amazing job! We highly recommend Tietze plumbing to anyone for their plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Carolyn Patton
reviews.text: Our technician Eric Guerrero from Tietze Plumbing, Heating and Air was amazing!  He was friendly and resolved our plumbing issue very quickly.  He then went an extra step and checked the water pressure and discovered it was high and adjusted it. He was very thorough and professional!!  Thank you!

reviews.author: Dianne Garibay
reviews.text: Josh thoroughly explained the work to me before he got started and let me know the cost up front.  Very fair price, and the work was performed expertly and efficiently. reviews.author: Esther O
reviews.text: Jonathan was super helpful with my plumbing issue and made sure there were no leaks after the job was done. He was very kind and worked quickly and professionally. I would recommend him to anyone who needs an understanding plumber.

reviews.author: Mary Hawkins
reviews.text: Bruno & Steve were very helpful not only at talking me through what caused our main line slowness/backup, but also daily preventative measures. We were also able to talk through bigger picture needs down the line. Our home is an investment, and they were easy to talk to about protecting it. Never felt like I was getting upsold.

reviews.author: Epic Battle Reenactments
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter was swift to respond to my request. The technician they sent, Azzi, arrived promptly on site and demonstrated his skill and expertise at handling the fixes and installation required. He was dedicated to completing the task on my behalf and overall was a pleasant interaction. I am very satsified with his work and the experience given!

reviews.author: Eric Ohlrich
reviews.text:
Our house has had issues with roots clogging drainage pipes for years so we have had a few different companies come and resolve the issue, Roto-Rooter was very thorough, Israel and Mike were very professional, kind, and patient. They explained everything they were doing and why, even giving us information about our pipes and issues that could arise later on. Israel and Mike didn’t just stop once the clog was cleared, they went through the pipes multiple times in order to guarantee the pipes were completely clear and told us the further steps to take.

The price was a bit steep, it was around 720$ for them to do this service which hurt, but unfortunately it wasn’t too surprising.

Overall, overpriced, but they were very knowledgeable and took the job seriously and worked through it thoroughly. Will be using Roto-Rooter again, after our wallet recovers 😅

reviews.author: Sagar Mehta
reviews.text: This is from Saturday morning. Bruno, Steven & Kyle came to check in the drainage issue. After going to the root cleaning in the pipeline process they were able to pull the roots and waste. The pipeline has got some real issue that merges into the city sewer. All them tried really hard and put in 5+ hours of work. They are helpful and I recommend them for your services

plumbers.name: Roto Rooter Plumbing & Drain Service

reviews.author: Kelly Sradeja
reviews.text: Amaze amaze amaze. We tried a different plumber who told us that we had to get a clean out installed and they couldn’t unclog until that was done. On Friday. On a holiday weekend. We called roto rooter for a second opinion and they came out. Unclogged it enough to get through the night and finished up the job Saturday morning. For an extremely reasonable price. We are so grateful. Thank you. 10/10 will always call first.

reviews.author: Jessica Shear
reviews.text: I'll start by saying, I have one bathroom. What happens to my toilet, and for how long, matters. I called Roto Rooter and easily scheduled an appointment to come look at what I correctly assumed was a wax seal that needed to be replaced, and then a potentially bigger, more costly problem with the main waste stack downstairs (or whatever it's called). I had no problem scheduling - and they understood I work from home and needed the time range to accommodate that. They met my booking needs and before I knew it, Tommy (Thomas) rang my door bell and became my new hero. In all seriousness, he understood the limitations I was working with (schedule, $$, and one bathroom), and he worked diligently to solve what was an unexpected added issue of there being NO SUBFLOOR in my bathroom. I've been in the house a few yrs, and I had no idea. He explained what he was doing, every step of the way, and he called me in to see what he was talking about when necessary. He provided me his honest opinions, and his expert advice, and he gave me options - which was the most appreciated part of the visit. He even went out of his way to create a solution to the "no sub floor" predicament, bc I couldn't afford to call someone in to rip up the linoleum and redo the  bathroom floor on top of what would be the needed toilet fix as well. Bottom line, he fixed the toilet to my satisfaction - and hopefully it will stay sealed until I'm able to remodel the bathroom entirely - but he was honest enough to let me know that might not be the case (bc of how the seal was resting w/out a subfloor) - and we determined together that the other issue w/the main stack in the basement wasn't one that needed addressing at the present time. (Unfortunately, I still hear the pipe moving, so I could be calling Tommy back sooner than I'd hoped). While it wasn't cheap, I know it also could have been much more expensive, and with a less than satisfactory repair. Tommy was incredibly skilled, very kind, and I have no problem at all recommending Roto Rooter and Tommy.

reviews.author: Mary Gorrell
reviews.text: Great tech! I was impressed with his professional manner. He explained everything and was very intelligent and respectful.  However someone from the office called to tell me they overcharged me by $340 I believe and they said they would send it to me by mail but I have not received it it's been a week or over a week maybe. I assume that's because he did not do the pipe from the house to the street and I did wonder about that because I know what it sounds like. So please send me a check thanks!

reviews.author: Chivonn Floyd
reviews.text: The call to have a tech come out was a breeze. They came out the next day because it was not an emergency for me. They were to the house by 11 am and gone by 11:45. My tech was DeDe, a very nice young man who was straight up and took the time to explain what my issue was and what he was going to do to fix it. He did the work, let me know he was done and all with a smile. I appreciate that I've never been disappointed with this company.

reviews.author: Kristy Kowalski

reviews.text:
*** RESOLVED! ***
I would definitely recommend this company again! Laura was professional, kind, respectful and understanding to my experience. She worked with me to correct these issues and insure no one would be treated this way again. This is exactly why I chose a family owned business in the first place. Things happen…correcting it is key! Thank you so much Trailblazer plumbing!

GROSSLY OVERCHARGED 4 ACTUAL WORK DONE!
I called Trailblazer Plumbing 8/25:
2 separate faucets dripping, a toilet wax ring replacement, water drip in ceiling, and a mystery water stain in different ceiling.
Upon arrival 8/27/25, he was very annoyed and rude when asked about shoe covers worn from street up to my door. He went back to truck ranting loudly (all on camera) to replace shoe covers and return to my door all irritated. I asked what the problem was. He asked me if “I’d gotten up on the wrong side of the bed that morning?” I said no, did he? He ultimately backtracked, asked if we could start over. He worked on 2 toilets, a dripping pipe in ceiling where I’d previously cut a hole to locate leak. He advised I first contact Moen about getting ALL NEW warranty replacement parts for 3 faucets, and a shower Thermostatic Mixing Valve (because I stated we had never been able to get a cold shower. He said without question it needed replacement).
I worked with Moen securing all parts needed to complete estimated work for just under $2000.
9/3/25 he returned to swap out the Shower Thermostatic Mixing Valve. He spent HOURS trying to replace the 3pc kitchen faucet. He ended up putting all old kitchen faucet parts back on the now severely dripping spout and left. (I had to shut water off every day below sink when not in use, because now parts were stripped). I contacted Moen several more times to collect extra needed parts for this job. I’ve now paid him just under $2300 for this work.
9/18/25 he returned. Removed all parts to 1st (dripping) bathroom vanity faucet, and did not even replace that faucet. Removed 2nd matching bathroom vanity faucet (which never dripped), and replaced it but not the sink drain, and also scratched the interior of this sink in 2 areas. He left after several hours.
9/30/25 he was scheduled to complete the unfinished work, appt cxld due to delays at his previous job that day.
10/20/25 he returned to FINALLY replace the 3pc dripping kitchen faucet, install the missing 3pc vanity faucet onto 1st bathroom vanity, and replace the sink drain on 2nd bathroom vanity (with the scratched sink). I then told him the shower is still unable to get cold water. He said,  “well those thermostatic mixing valves are not designed to get a cold shower, only warm/hot shower temps”…? Then wth did I need to order a totally new part when the previous one was working perfectly as it should? I pointed out scratches in the sink, he said I “should go buy a pumice stone on Amazon to treat scratches myself…???”  As he turned toward me to respond, I could strongly smell alcohol on his breath. He was very jittery and nervous all day. Since install 1st vanity sink still can’t hold water. This final appt alone took over 7+ hours?
10/20/25 he wasted SO MUCH time, we pulled security camera footage to view excessive trips to his truck.
10/20/25 Arrived: 11:05am
Exit: 12:12pm    Enter: 12:49pm

Manager wasn’t available, left message.
10/30/25, a voicemail left from Laura said they checked with him and charges seemed accurate.

Extremely knowledgeable- very professional operating backhoe- minimizing damage to my tree & patio-this is my second time using them and I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Nicholas Surman
reviews.text:

Later, when Chris and Michael came in, they were nice and finished their work promptly. Chris explained my new system in a simple and easy way.

reviews.text: Outstanding job. New line and valve replaced. Technician Dan M came out few days after original fix to check installation out. Good thing. Found leak from main line out of house which first technician didn’t see because homeowner..me..had jury rigged an earlier cracked pipe. Was wrapped in pipe tape….leak not visible. I will recommend Trailblazer to any and all with plumbing needs.

I needed to have my 2 water heaters replaced. He was able to complete same day.

My technician was Dan R. He did an excellent job, was knowledgeable and respectful. Worked hard to complete his work. We had snow on the ground that day, part of his clean up was also cleaning my hardwood floors.

I wouid use Trailblazers again and would request Dan R

reviews.author: Missy Pu
reviews.text:
On 4 Dec, my home warranty insurance notified Black Plumbing about a leaky faucet.  Black Plumbing called the same day and made appointment for 5 Dec.  Josh (the attending tech) called to inform me he would be later.  That was GREATLY appreciated, respectful and just good customer service.  Josh came over diagnosed the problem (which had to be rectified the following business day).  Mind you, this faucet was not for daily use so the Monday appt was ok.  Josh discussed the issue and gave me options.  He left but the faucet was leaking , I called Josh and he had to come back to make pipe adjustments.  The leaking was ceased.

The faucet was pretty much identical to the original one.
I am very satisfied with the service I received from Josh.
He was very professional, courteous and showed no signs of disgust because he had to return.
Thanks Josh

reviews.author: courtney dodd
reviews.text: Black Plumbing Heat & Air has been excellent to work with! Thanks to Chad L., we got our master shower fixed! It was a new construction mistake and our worst nightmare.
