do an excellent job, and they do it with care and concern for the customer. Each one is very respectful and they try to please also!!
We just had Chris from the South Daytona Benjamin Franklin Plumbing Co. and he just cleaned out our drains in all areas, and he did an amazing job!!  It's great to know that there are caring and hard working plumbers who go the extra mile and he sure did for us today!! Thank you again Chris!!

reviews.author: Shelly Craig
reviews.text:
I had a leak from my outdoor 1/4 ball valve faucet. I went onto Angie’s List and Ben Franklin Plumbing was the very first to text and call. Marshall was able to come in about 2 hours. I also live in a townhouse and I didn’t know where my water shut off was. Marshall walked the property and found the shut off. It’s good to know where it is now.
I had my faucet replaced and the city water was also tested. It came back very high in chlorine as well as very hard water!
I would recommend Marshall at Ben Franklin. They do good work and it’s an easy name to remember!

reviews.author: Sandra Patricia Smyth
reviews.text:
Kevin Bradley and Myles Goatley came to my parents’ home, and the entire experience, from the initial diagnosis to the final repair, was excellent. During the first visit, they took the time to thoroughly assess the issue, explain what was happening, and outline the steps needed to fix it.
They returned for a second visit to complete the job, and the quality of their work was just as impressive. They were efficient, respectful of the home, and made sure everything was functioning perfectly before they left. Their attention to detail and commitment to doing the job right really stood out.
We’re grateful for their reliable service and would gladly call on them again. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Charlotte Jones
reviews.text: Marshall is outstanding! He found answers to my concerns! He even got his hands dirty checking in the ground for my water meter! I will call for further help as needed! Outstanding!! He emailed recommendations for my son to review. No repairs as yet. I have toilet issues and outrageous water bill charges. He also gave advice regarding a water filtration system I have.

plumbers.name: ARS/Rescue Rooter
plumbers.address: 412 Farabee Dr S, Lafayette, IN 47905, USA

reviews.author: Anthony Matz
reviews.text:
Two men arrived on time @9:00am and started  work on the installation. It was complicated, since they had to remove the water softener and brine tank to get to the target install location. The old leaking tank water heater was successfully extracted. Then they cleaned the floor in the area since it was severely stained from the old water heater (something they didn't have to do, and they did a superb job in cleanup). They re-did the pluming for the placement of the new TANKLESS water heater which was done very well. Installed the new water heater, and explained all the technical details in layman's terms. Re-installed the other items (water softener and brine tank ). Cleaned up the entire area from the front door to the utility room. They were all business.

FYI: I WILL call them again for any pluming issues. They were very professional. A 100% excellent job. They stayed until 4:00pm -ish. THEY DID THE ENTIRE JOB TO COMPLETION WITH NO ADDITIONAL COST, JUST LIKE THE ORIGINAL QUOTED AMOUNT.

reviews.author: Tom Coyle
reviews.text: Called for a sewer line drain cleaning was told they could be out next day so I made appointment for 2 to 6 window and let them know that it would have to be closer to 5 because of my job. The guy was very understanding and put in the notes. I called next day because I had a missed call and was told they could come now but couldn't wait till 5 and this was at 1pm, which is outside of the original window I was originally given. So we made another appointment for the next day same time and ARS acted like the same thing was going to happen and when I got home from work there was water damage in our recently renovated basement so called Blue Fox out and they got it cleaned that day . When I called ARS to cancel appointment they actually had the nerve to try to upsell me with tune ups and warranties. They can't even keep an appointment how can they get a warranty claim right. Very bad customer service and communication skills across the board. Only reason I'm giving one star is because I have to for this to post.

reviews.author: Wallace Smlth
reviews.text:
On May 7, 2024, ARS came to my property on time started work on my sewer line to install a clean out check valve. They dug about 8feet deep. They took about a half day between the rain and sunshine to complete the installation
The crew was friendly and knowledgeable when I asked questions.
Afterwards it rained heavily all night. The valve worked and there was now sewer backup in my basement
Thank you ARS for a job well done!!

reviews.author: Howard Freeman
reviews.text: Advertised $83 clean out. Tech shows and he says $381! I had to disconnect water line from toilet as tech attempted to remove retaining nut holding flushing apparatus! Then I, not the tech, removed the toilet. Extremely messy and incomplete hardware installation. It took a full 2.5 hours to run a 50' snake! I certainly do hope to hear from a proper mgnt representative as the dispatcher, McKayla (sp?), called to cite company policy. McKayla should absolutely NOT have customer contact! I have included photos. The toilet was purchased and installed 24 hrs earlier. The tools were mine as the tech didn't have an 11 mm wrench or needle nose pliers. The level of overall disappointment is immeasurable, atm.

reviews.author: Drew Keedy
reviews.text:
Nate Davis - give this guy a raise. Holy crap - no pun intended.

Our basement floor drain was back-flooding. We called around, got wildly different estimates from different companies, landed on ARS as the one we wanted to have come out.

Nate drove from Avon to Lafayette, which is over an hour, on a Saturday mind you, and had the absolute best top tier attitude and personality possible.

He was light-hearted, professional, and skilled in his craft.

Nate was able to use his tool, whatever the hell the thing is called that is 75 foot of pure magic, and pulverized the blockage in our drain pipe and got us flowing again.

Without Nate we would be in deep shit right now.  That pun WAS intended.

Nate is an 11 out of 10.

ARS management - give this guy a raise. Don't let a good employee go unrewarded. This guy is one of your front runners in attitude and skill, keep him around, and to do that, you need to reward him for his efforts and his professionalism, he made your company look like a godsend on a shitty day. ( I promise that is the last pun )

plumbers.name: Powell's Plumbing & Air
plumbers.address: 1111 Boissevain Ave, Norfolk, VA 23507, USA

reviews.author: Robin Taylor
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Powells (formally Norfolk, plumbing). I had a clogged kitchen sink that was slow draining for a month. I tried every product on the market & tried to snake it (all Unsuccessfully). After washing dishes in the bathtub for a few weeks, (too busy & hoping it would magically just get better (haha), the final straw was when my washer overflowed from the drain tube going into wall, All over my laundry floor.
I needed someone to rescue me. I called Powells per many great recommendations by a client, NextDoor & google and made an appointment. They came out the very next day. The guys (Wes & Jason) got everything fixed in a few hours. They were knowledgeable & professional. I felt like the price was fair, and I did not feel taken advantage of. I would definitely use them again in the future.

It was about $800 for snake of main line and washer and sink lines as well as installing a new/additional 2 way cleanout under the house. Original quote was $400 but once they got into it , it required much more work and more hours.
Thanks Wes & Jason. I have peace of mind now!! Worth every penny! And that kind of work is Gross!! Lol
Well deserved $

reviews.author: Joselyn Impastato
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience with Powell’s Plumbing! Plumbers Miles and Jason came to my home to fix a clogged bathtub drain, kitchen sink, and secure the hose of my washer—all in under an hour! I was so impressed by how quickly and efficiently they worked. Not only did they get everything working perfectly, but they also took the time to explain what they were doing and answered all my questions. Their service was top-notch, and the pricing was incredibly affordable. I can't recommend them enough for any plumbing needs! Excellent service, great value, and such a professional team. Thank you, Powell's Plumbing!

reviews.author: ed forlines
reviews.text: I had problems with my boiler. Numerous contractors couldn't diagnose the problem. I called Powell's. They sent an experienced technician out. He correctly diagnosed the malfunction. Repair parts ordered and installed along with the needed general maintenance. Their price was very reasonable. I won't hesitate to call them again or refer them to my friends. Thanks so much for a job well done!

reviews.author: Yviehb
reviews.text: Once again, Powell's Plumbing and Air really saved the day for me. My husband, who had always taken care of our heating system, died last February, and I was concerned about some thumping noises coming from the boiler and the fact that the 1st floor wasn't warming up like the 2nd. Josh came out, did a thorough diagnostic, explained to me what was going on, and forwarded a (very reasonable) estimate for taking care of the issues. He was wonderful, friendly, courteous, professional, which is what I always fine the Powell techs to be. Very satisfied with this company and their representatives.

reviews.author: Alysia Miller
reviews.text:
Absolute lifesaver! Came home from vacation to half of our home flooded with waste water. I was terrified it was a septic issue and couldn't be quickly resolved, I also had an inkling that a lot of the plumbing, electrical, additions, etc weren't exactly to code and thus could not be fixed.

We were told they couldnt arrive for 3 days, but ended up coming a day sooner. They resolved it within a few hours! And when the backup reached the addition and flooded our laundry room, they were able to come the next day to inspect and had the supplies and repair done the day after!

And the technician/plumber was an absolute peach! His name is Weston and I felt completely safe having him in my home. No bad vibes whatsoever and he was so easy to talk to. I cant speak to the price, as our landlord paid for it, but really any price was worth the service in my opinion. Really helped us in a pinch.

plumbers.name: Progressive Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3870 Peachtree Industrial Blvd, Duluth, GA 30096, USA

reviews.author: Donald White
reviews.text:
Michael did an absolutely amazing job fixing the shower head drip in our master bathroom! From the moment he arrived, he was professional, punctual, and extremely knowledgeable. He quickly diagnosed the issue, explained what was causing the drip, and fixed it efficiently without any hassle.

Not only did he solve the problem, but he also made sure everything was cleaned up perfectly before he left. The shower is working flawlessly now , no more annoying drip!

If you’re looking for someone reliable, skilled, and trustworthy, Michael is your guy. Highly recommend his services and will definitely be calling him again for any future needs!

reviews.author: M D
reviews.text:
We woke up this morning to our master shower upstairs leaking into the office downstairs again! We had the issue repaired a few months ago by another company, but unfortunately the problem came back. Since we didn’t want to use them again, we called Progressive Plumbing.
They told us the plumber wouldn’t arrive until 12pm at the earliest, but by 11:30am the job was already finished and he was on his way out the door!
Daniel did an incredible job!! He was professional, kind, and explained everything clearly. Best of all, he fixed the issue in a way that should prevent it from happening again by replacing the previous PVC repair with copper piping.
We couldn’t be more thankful for the fast response and excellent work. Thank you, Daniel, for your kindness and outstanding service! We will definitely be using Progressive Plumbing again and recommending you to everyone we know.

reviews.author: Kelly
reviews.text: It was a last minute decision since Atlanta is supposed to get a major ice storm within the next 3 days. My husband called Progressive Plumbing to have gas install to hook up our new generator just in case electricity goes out expect the worst. They met with my husband I am guessing the owner and the owners son came out gave an estimate they left to purchase the needed part came back and had it installed it only took them between 30 to 45 minutes. The price was reasonable since it was a last minute decision. Professional company from the return phone call to coming out as promised to speaking with the owner and getting the job done quickly in less than a day. So far I am plessed with there work. I will use them again in the future and definitely will refer to friends and family.

reviews.author: Barrett Madrigal
reviews.text: I've had Michael H. do several largish jobs at the house and I am very pleased with his technical skills, work ethic, and professionalism. Always explains his diagnosis, the options and related costs. Responses quickly and answers question competently. He also will point out other related potential issues or concerns without any pressure. Not the cheapest, nor the most expensive...but reliable, efficient and trustworthy. I high recommend Michael H. at Progressive Plumbing.

reviews.author: Greg Gross
reviews.text:
Awesome job. They had a cancellation and came a day early. Replaced my kitchen sink faucet quickly without issue.
Cleaned up as if nothing happened.
We will use them again.

I wanted to add that Michael was awesome. Pleasant and professional. Very easy to work with and did an amazing job.

plumbers.name: Towne Plumber
plumbers.address: 507 Cypress Pointe, Woodstock, GA 30189, USA

reviews.author: Marcus C
reviews.text:
Had a toilet flange break and needed to be replaced. Was able to get out to see us within 24 hours. Tate and another gentleman (can’t recall his name) performed the work. Zero complaints. Quality, efficient work at a very reasonable price.

Got some quotes for some projects down the road, will definitely be using Towne Plumber again.

reviews.author: Frank Pasquerello
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Towne Plumber.  We needed a lot of plumbing work for our renovation, and Brett did a great job getting everything done in a professional way.  He also kept me informed of apparent code issues so they could be addressed.

reviews.author: Greg Faber
reviews.text: I called with a leaking pipe in the kitchen. Towne Plumber diverted Matt after he finished another job nearby to solve our issue ( we had turned the water off). Matt addressed the problem immediately and quickly had us “up and running” with the leak fixed, up to date valves and the area where he was working cleaner and neater than before he started. Matt’s work was excellent, the price was very reasonable and the issues were resolved more quickly than we hoped for!  Towne Plumber is #1 in our book, and we recommend them highly!

reviews.author: Ivie Collins
reviews.text: I called and Towne Plumber took care of me same day. Tate was the one who came out and he was extremely knowledgeable on what I needed, and got everything taken care of right way. He was extremely nice and very professional. I absolutely recommend this company!

reviews.author: Erika Ellison
reviews.text: Brett was great! He was professional, friendly, and took the time to explain everything clearly. The service was efficient, and he was able to provide a quote for our repairs in a timely manner. Brett also made sure everything was cleaned up before he left and that is very much appreciated. Towne Plumber is a reliable company you can trust, and I would absolutely recommend them to anyone needing quality plumbing service.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 3620 W 80th Ln Ste 3606, Merrillville, IN 46410, USA

reviews.author: Elisha Bean
reviews.text: Tyler and Brandon were amazing. The company had availability to send some one out almost immediately. Tyler assessed the situation and knew that my problem was going to require more than he was able to correct at the moment but he gave me options and ensured that I understood what next steps would be. Brandon came out the next morning and was able to resolve my problem within a couple of hours. Both were very professional, informative and knowledgeable. The work was completed expeditiously and within the budget that I expected. I will definitely refer Roto-Rooter Plumbing and Water Cleanup to my family and friends.

reviews.author: SPICY
reviews.text:
Nothing cheap this day if it is good.
I reached out at the beginning of the year. Company send out Technician (Josh). He did clean out the main sewer and seemed to work. I paid quite a lot of money for this. Water back in again in about two weeks after first attempt. Technician Josh came back, and he did clean out the main sewer and seemed to work again.  Water back in again in about one week after the second attempt. The third time, Josh came back with the supervisor (Jonathan) because it required a camera to see what exactly happened in the pipe. All these three attempts and camera service in the six months warranty and NO charge. Nothing works at this time because of the main pipe to the city full of tree roots and water. We can't see anything.  We have to do hydro jet cleaning, which is very expensive. Hydro jet tech ( Edgar) came to the next day and completely cleaned out and camera to check the entire main sewer in about two hours. The hydro jet really works. It's cut and clean out entire of main sewer. I saw all the videos.
He is actually located where the cracks are. Finally, the problem was solved and I'm very happy with the service.  All three technicians are very professional and very polite and helpful. Every time I call the main company back, they pick up the phone, no waiting time, and try to solve the problem right away.

reviews.author: Jade Guth
reviews.text: The first person who was supposed to come out didn’t show up and at 2+ hours past my window I called to figure out what was going on. The guy said he would be here in 30 minutes and 30 minutes later another guy showed up. That guy did fantastic. I appreciate him being up front how the cost and being efficient.

reviews.author: Michael Keeton
reviews.text: The crew arrived an hour after I called, they clean my sewer drain and showed me the blockage and what caused it. Also gave me a reasonable estimate. Thank you Roto Rooter for your service

reviews.author: justin
reviews.text: brandon did a excellent job and replaced some old water pipes for my washer-machine connection…brandon had great communication and prompt responses and was able to get everything replaced in 24hrs…. highly recommend!!!

plumbers.name: Mayes & Sons Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 11900 Mills Rd, Garrettsville, OH 44231, USA

reviews.author: Jamie Emery
reviews.text: I hope I have the correct location, my hot water heater was on the complete fritz. I called Rheem they connected me to Mayes and I have never been more grateful so the wonderful technician named Jacob. His communication with me was top notch, he arrived sooner than expected (no complaints there), was neat and didn’t get a drop of snow in my home. He diagnosed the problem made the necessary calls to Rheem, made this entire ordeal so much easier than I anticipated! Jacob even shoveled the snow off my sidewalk to my surprise! Please pass on my appreciation for Jacob a Top Notch Tech that has impeccable  service, from beginning to end. Thank you.

reviews.author: Adrianne
reviews.text: Staff was amazing and very respectful of our home. They worked unbelievably fast and cleaned up after themselves. I would highly recommend. I know I won't be calling anyone else if Im ever in need again. You just got a life long customer! And I'll recommend to anyone I know that needs plumbing help.

reviews.author: W Richard
reviews.text: I want to thank Mayes and Sons Plumbing for the excellent handling of our plumbing issue and in particular Ryan in dispatch and Preston the technician.  Briefly we have a home warranty with a company that caused our situation to turn into a nightmare for my wife and I.  Being out of hot water in our home for three days, the home warranty decided they could get a tank cheaper and didn't want to let the technician from Mayes install the tank he had come to our home with. This being Friday and the thought of going through a weekend two more days without hot water jubilation turned into panic.  Ryan was able  to figure out a way to get the new tank in as I dealt with the warranty company, and Preston the technician was respectful, professional, and certainly knew his craft as he had us back in hot water quickly.  I can only say home warranty companies can be good and bad, but this company is A+++++ and I will recommend them to family and friends with confidence.  Thank you again, Ryan and Preston.  God Bless

reviews.author: Jill Elmore
reviews.text: Matt is very knowledgeable and shares a lot of information for you to be aware of how to manage and prevent potential problems, and very good at fixing the problems he was needed for! He even restarted my daughter's laundry in the washing machine that stopped when he turned off the main water when he turned it back on! I absolutely recommend this company.

reviews.author: Sandra Sluder
reviews.text: Justin was fantastic He explained and showed me what the issue was (main sewer line blockage) and showed me after he cleared the blockage that it was clear and water was freely flowing. He was super friendly.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 525 Waverly Ave, Mamaroneck, NY 10543, USA

reviews.author: Fredelinda A
reviews.text: I had to contact this company for the first time due to a clog affecting the unit downstairs right before the announced blizzard. They were able to schedule an appointment immediately and sent the right technician, Carlos. Carlos is knowledgeable, professional, and genuinely concerned with resolving the issue and ensuring customer satisfaction. He built trust by explaining what was happening and providing guidance on how to prevent future issues within the customer’s control. The prices are on the higher end, but the reliability and speed of service made it well worth it.

reviews.author: Sue
reviews.text: I had my hot water heater replaced this morning by Ernesto and his partner.  The arrived early and got the job done well. They were polite, clean and kept me updated throughout the job.  It was a pleasure to have such a nice team working together to get the job done.  Thank you!

reviews.author: PJ Heyer
reviews.text: Carlos showed up quickly on a Sunday, was highly professional and interacted very nicely with my loud kids and excited dog. He explained to me the diagnosis process and the cost to me based on different potential outcomes. Then he quickly identified the issue, came back to me for approval to proceed and fixed the clogged pipe quickly. He stayed to show me that everything was flowing properly with no issues. He cleaned up after himself. Carlos was a pleasure to work with from start to finish. Absolutely will call these people again!

reviews.author: Kevin Wong
reviews.text:
Arthur arrived on time and showed great care in his work. He carefully checked the issue, explained everything in a clear way, and unclogged the drain quickly. He then made sure there were no other problems or backup, which made me feel confident that the job was done right.

He was patient with all of my questions and never made me feel rushed. His knowledge and professionalism really stood out. I truly appreciate how thorough and thoughtful he was throughout the entire process.

I highly recommend Arthur to anyone who needs plumbing work done. He went above and beyond, and I’m very grateful for his help.

reviews.author: Sandra Kitt
reviews.text: Repair man Carlos Acosta came to look at and assess the problems l thought l was having with my tub/shower faucet. Carlos was very knowledgeable and excellent at explaining my issue to me. As it turned out, and he honestly explained, one matter l could take care of myself in about ten minutes, which l did! The other matter we agreed was not an emergency and l could and should take my time in deciding when, again, the minor replacement could take place. I really appreciated Carlos’ professional review.  Thank you, Carlos!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 630 Forest St, Marlborough, MA 01752, USA

reviews.author: Tom Hirsh
reviews.text: Root rooters  response time and 24 hr service are great.  Pricing and results not as good. Technician came at night on weekend for no extra charge but couldn’t figure out what the problem was, suggested a $289 auger that took 10 minutes might work then when it didn’t I called for a guarantee return service. Second tech looked at it and said he wouldn’t auger again and I’d have to get a plumber, and all service would be additional cost as only auger was covered. I sent him on his way and went to Home Depot bought some tools and cleared the drain myself in 5 minutes.

reviews.author: Lauren McCarthy
reviews.text:
I’ve had three experiences with Roto Rooter. One - we had an emergency blockage situation and John was super helpful and resolved the issue quickly. $650

Two - we got our tankless water heater flushed by Carlo. He was super great - went above and beyond for us. $600

Three - after the emergency blockage, we had a follow up complimentary camera guy come out to check the pipe. He told us that we had an additional blockage and would need to get our pipes descaled and quoted us $3,800. We asked to see the photos of what he saw and he said he couldn’t provide them. We called Rooterman in Framingham, they came out and not only SHOWED US what he was seeing on his camera as he was doing it, but provided us with our own copy of the footage. He confirmed 1. There wasn’t any blockage (it was some toilet paper that he flushed through with water..) and that 2. Descaling would have actually caused damage to the types of pipes we had.

It really depends on who you get for Roto, but because of the inconsistency and such high rates, would suggest going elsewhere.

reviews.author: Linda Yip
reviews.text: Jeremiah was awesome.  He solved our issues.  He was very professional and friendly.  I highly recommend Roto=Rooter.

reviews.author: elizabeth ballas
reviews.text: I am beyond thankful for the quick professional response from Roto Rooter.  Everyone I worked with was respectful, professional  and caring. They worked as a team to locate and fix the issue then to clean up the mess. People worked into the evening to ensure my house was safe for my family to be in. I highly recommend Roto Rooter.

reviews.author: Midas of Westborough
reviews.text: Not sure if this is the correct location. We experienced issues with out restroom, called Rotor Rooter. Manny came later that day and fixed the issue in about one hour. he cleaned up well and was friendly. EXCELLENT EXPERIENCE.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Drain Service
plumbers.address: 4207 Mike Padgett Hwy Unit A, Augusta, GA 30906, USA

reviews.author: Ryan Burgess
reviews.text:
I want to say how awesome working with Roto-Rooter was. Has a pretty big problem that then turned into a major problem when the 1 collapse in my kitchen drain line became 4....

But the techs they sent to my house, Anthony and Brandon and the other 2s who's names i don't remember were awesome! They answered every silly question I had when I didn't understand what a part was, or the direction we needed to go cause it just seemed like everything wrong in a concrete slab drain pipe went wrong at once.

But working from home and starting a new job I was worried about noise level among other things, but man aside from the tile hammer the first day, could barely hear them! And that isnt a fault in the tile hammer, work was kind enough to give me off that day since we knew it would be loud!

But they really came in clutch and helped me with a massive problem I was having and prevented me from spending a bunch of money just to have the same problem again!

100% the entire team I worked with was fantastic! Can't recommend enough!

PS: before someone says they didn't restore my concrete out front I requested they not as I plan to remove that walk way, makes it easier if its precut!

reviews.author: Tony Graham
reviews.text: Mike Vance from Roto-Rooter did a great job repairing leaking sink. Great response time and quality service. Mike also cleaned up the area after the repair. Thank you!

reviews.author: Janet Broeckel
reviews.text:
Today is Valentine’s Day and I felt bad for calling somebody out for a backed up toilet and shower on this special day. But I called Roto-Rooter and Cullen Sutherland came to my rescue. After assessing the problem, he went straight to work…And what seemed like minutes … he had everything taken care of!
I would definitely recommend Roto-Rooter in Augusta , Georgia who also services my area in Aiken, South Carolina. It started this morning at 8 AM when I talked to Miss Alexis… Who was such a delight on the phone. She actually heard what I was saying and said I will send somebody out there today! (In a very cheerful voice I might add) How wonderful it is that you can call somebody and actually get a real live person on the phone. My whole experience was wonderful! When you are a senior citizen, those little things are the things that mean the most.
Thank you so much for taking such good care of me!
Jan B
Aiken, SC

reviews.author: Brian Ozden
reviews.text: Ruan was amazing!  Went above and beyond to get us back.  Without question,  he made our family a priority and did a great job.  Work quality was also amazing.  Ruan identified (he had to dig really deep and move shrubs to find the issue) and fixed the leak quickly and effectively.  100% satisfied!

reviews.author: Yoda 10
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I couldn’t be more impressed with Roto-Rooter and the amazing job they did on my kitchen replacement and garbage disposal installation. The technician was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to make sure everything was done correctly and cleanly.

The pricing was very reasonable, and I truly appreciated the military discount, which shows they value their customers. The work quality exceeded my expectations, and everything is functioning perfectly.

I will absolutely use Roto-Rooter again in the future and highly recommend them to anyone needing reliable, high-quality plumbing work. Thank you for a great experience!

plumbers.name: AZ Super Plumber - The Plumbing Store
plumbers.address: 501 6th St, Prescott, AZ 86301, USA

reviews.author: Raul Sebastian (Raul S Fisher)
reviews.text: AZ Plumbing did an excellent job installing our new septic tank system. We were very pleased with both the results and the entire process. Their service was highly professional, and we gladly recommend them!

reviews.author: James Huddy
reviews.text: They were prompt at responding to my septic tank problem and sent someone out within a couple hours. Anthony was great and very informative. He got us all squared away in short time and was literally finishing up when my guests arrived from out of town. Everything worked out perfectly. Thank you!

reviews.author: Pat Kelleher
reviews.text: I used another Septic company for 11 years. They got too big. AZ Super is just what their name says. SUPER. Service was great. Real pros. Would recommend to everyone. Thank you AZ Super…

reviews.author: Erica Hellman
reviews.text: We had a septic emergency and Az super plumber was awesome to work with! They got back to me right away, scheduled me for the following day. and were able to come out earlier than scheduled to help me out. The tech walked me through possible issues, actual issues, and future maintenance. This was a great experience and we now have our go to company for plumbing and septic needs.

reviews.author: Jennifer Stainrook
reviews.text: I needed a full sewer pipe replacement from the house to the street. Anthony and his crew were amazing and educated me on everything that was going on.  I felt 100% comfortable even though it was a big job they were undertaking.  When digging they navigated around the posts of my car port with zero damage and also managed to avoid my rose bush! Thank you, it’s nice to have work done by people who enjoy doing the job.

plumbers.name: Brian B. Quick Plumbing
plumbers.address: 218 Main St Suite 4, Reisterstown, MD 21136, USA

reviews.author: Joe Greathead
reviews.text: Dion from Brian B. Quick is easily one of the best folks I've ever had the pleasure of working with when it comes to home repair and I've worked with a lot of folks over the years. Dion quickly diagnosed a high water pressure situation in our 1960s era home after coming out for a smaller, related issue. Dion did a hell of a lot of work to get our water setup updated and stayed late to ensure it was finished right. I honestly wasn't expecting the fix to resolve so many other issues with the bath, toilets, and faucets that we had been living with. Dion was also patient, genial, walked me through the changes both before and after, and was all around a solid and professional individual. I would be happy to have Dion back out for the next thing we need fixed. Thank you, Dion! You fixed our issues, improved our quality of life, and helped me learn more about how all this plumbing stuff should work.

reviews.author: Sandra Lubbes
reviews.text: My technician was Jordan.  He was respectful and competent.  Jordan explained the worked to be done and asked me if I had questions.  He stayed focused on the work until it was all done.  He took no breaks.  He had 3 toilets to do, one was a complete replacement.  I had no cleanup to do when he left my house.  Jordan did a good job and was thorough.  I will recommend your company and Jordan's work to my friends and family.  Thank you.

reviews.author: John Defoe
reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience today with my water heater replacement. From start to finish Chris Gatton of Brian B Quick was professional, knowledgeable, and extremely thorough.
What impressed me most was the time he took to carefully explain the entire scope of work before getting started. He walked me through what needed to be done, why it was necessary, and what I could expect throughout the installation process. There were no surprises—just clear, detailed communication.
He also provided a comprehensive explanation of the new water heater’s warranty, including what is covered, the length of coverage, and what steps I should take to ensure the warranty remains valid. That level of transparency gave me a lot of confidence in both the product and the workmanship.
After the installation, he didn’t just pack up and leave. He took additional time to educate me on proper maintenance practices—such as periodic flushing, checking the pressure relief valve, and general care tips—to help keep the heater operating at peak efficiency and extend its lifespan. I truly appreciated the proactive guidance.
The installation itself was clean and precise, and the workspace was left spotless. It’s rare to find someone who combines technical expertise with such strong communication skills and customer care.
I highly recommend this company and Chris Gatton to anyone needing plumbing work. Professional, detailed, and dependable from beginning to end.

reviews.author: Dee
reviews.text: Since I previously had good service with "Brian B. Quick", I contacted them for assistance. Technician Chris Gatton assessed my problem with the garbage disposal and advised me that I needed to replace it.  He advised me of the details and his availability to do the job. Chris was always courteous and I was comfortable with his ability to perform the job. The installation was completed with no issues...great job Chris!

reviews.author: Ray Boarman
reviews.text: We had a great experience! The service was quick when we had an emergency leak, even when other companies couldn't make it out on the weekend. Our tech Dion was very knowledgeable and helpful. He got the job done quickly and was very professional.

reviews.author: Natalie Garrett
reviews.text:

I would request Hunter but many  from Eric's actually worked  their tails off at my house, even the owner, Eric.  If I had more plumbing needs, I would take any of them. reviews.author: Gabriel Martinez
reviews.text: The vacuum breaker on an outdoor faucet had failed during our latest freeze resulting in a busted frost proof pipe extension. This was not discovered until nearly a month after the freeze when attempting to use a garden hose. I called Plumb Shield and let them know the about the issue and informed them that it was NOT a pressing matter. They lady on the other informed me that, if i would like, they could have someone to my house within a few hours for an estimate. Terry and Damian arrived slightly before the prescribed window, allowed me to voice my concern and hypothesis, provided theirs, gave me a quote, and once I agreed promptly got to work rectifying the problem. Once all was done they then showed all that had occurred and went over some warning signs to be on the watch for so as to prevent this type of damage from occurring again. Very prompt, transparent, and professional. Thank you to Terry and Damian.

reviews.author: Andrea J
reviews.text: All I can say to service of this company and team that came out to fix my problem was AMAZING. Discovered leak in my flowerbed and made a call. Next day arrival and communication by Nathan  and team (Damian and Terry) was outstanding. He walked me step by step as to what the issue was, what next steps are, walked thru pricing and anticipated completion. Ended up having to replace my old gas heater as well. Also amazing was that Nathan and team worked around my time schedule and school pickup. Well organized and communication by office team to arrange city inspector, as well as, notice of arrival of city inspector within 2hr window was great. Absolutely outstanding group of individuals.. highly recommend for your plumbing needs

reviews.author: Bhavish Khatri
reviews.text: Terry and Damien were fantastic. They were professional, friendly, and quickly fixed our leaky garbage disposal. They solved the issue, and everything is now working perfectly. Highly recommend their service!

reviews.author: Linda Turner

reviews.author: Stephanie Edwards

I’d recommend Team Enoch to anyone who needs their services.

reviews.author: Jon Syrus
reviews.text: My water heater went out late one evening and I needed it replaced.  Team Enoch contacted right away and got me on their schedule next day.  My technician Caleb got here right when they said he would.  He was super friendly, explained thoroughly everything he would be doing, and took time to answer all my questions.  The new unit Team Enoch installed far exceeded my expectations.  After he finished, Caleb showed me the new water heater and explained all the new safety features they installed, which were all included as part of the standard installation - BONUS!.  It is such a blessing to find a company like Team Enoch that goes above and beyond the customer's expectations, and has such great people like Caleb.  Oh, and the price I paid was A-MAZE-ING!  This is the third time I have used Team Enoch, and I wouldn't consider using anyone else. Thank you Caleb and Team Enoch!

reviews.text: 7 years ago I had them replace my ac unit. They did an amazing job. Today they came out because my thermostat had quit working. Greg has been our tech and we couldn't recommend him more. Its nice to not have a salesman as a tech and is very derailed and thorough.
We will continue with Enoch.

reviews.author: Landon Schott
reviews.text:
I want to give a strong shout-out to Jason from Team Enoch. He has been to my house three times now for various service calls and seasonal maintenance, and every visit has been excellent. Jason is incredibly polite, respectful, and very thorough in his work.

During his most recent visit, he took the time to answer all of my questions and successfully troubleshot why my auxiliary heat wasn’t coming on. The issue turned out to be related to programming that hadn’t been set up at the original installation (a separate Team Enoch issue), but Jason explained everything clearly and made sure I understood what was going on.

Jason consistently elevates my experience with Team Enoch. Because of him, what would otherwise be a three-star experience has easily become a five-star one. He’s a great representative of the company, and I really appreciate his professionalism and knowledge.

reviews.author: Shan Varughese
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough about the responsiveness of Plumb Pro! We had a freak main pipe break causing us to lose all water, we called them that morning, Matt arrived 30 minutes later - we had an estimate shortly thereafter. They acquiesced to our needing an itemized bid, and were out the next day bright and early.

John and Bob were the experts who did the work for us this day. The level of professionalism, respect for our home, cognizance of our animals was unparalleled. They were so communicative. Not to mention it wasn’t exactly warm outside, they managed to restore us with water in less than a day! I’m still beside myself at how fast they worked with how cold it was. They literally wiped every inch of our floor before leaving too.

We called several places for estimates, and every other company told us that they couldn’t be out to help for several weeks. Plumb Pro’s price was better, they were incredibly quick to help, and the technicians are nicer and super skilled! Overall, if I could give this experience 100 stars I would. We absolutely love John and Bob! John has done work for us in the past through Plumb Pro and we continue to request him when we have a need!

reviews.author: Dave Klitsch
reviews.text: John and Will we awesome! They worked quickly, neatly, and got my kitchen drain problem squared away. John was showing me the completed work when I realized that I needed a clean out. They said no problem, and quickly added one. I highly recommend PlumbPro Services if the rest of their staff are as friendly and professional as John and Will. Thank you guys!

reviews.author: T C
reviews.text:
I called PlumbPro after noticing wet spots forming on my ceiling. To their credit, they scheduled a next-day visit and conducted a thorough inspection. They cut a hole in the ceiling—with the understanding that I would be responsible for patching it—in order to run diagnostics, including running water for about 30 minutes in total. They also inspected the bathroom above, which was the initial suspected source. Ultimately, they determined the issue was most likely a roof leak, which is outside their scope of work.

The visit ending up costing $300 and mainly involved cutting a hole in the ceiling, and running water for roughly 30 minutes.

After returning to the house to retrieve the access panel, their demeanor noticeably changed, and it felt like the team was in a rush. The access panel provided barely fit and had them chipping away drywall by hand to install. I then had to modify it myself after they left to make sure it was secure and wouldn’t fall. Now, to properly fix the ceiling, I’ll need to enlarge the hole further to remove the uneven sections of drywall.

This rush also left little time to discuss other potential issues they briefly mentioned. I later called the office with follow-up questions but never received a response. Additionally, my shower handle hasn’t turned as smoothly since the inspection.

Overall, I’m not satisfied with the experience. While I understand the issue was outside their scope, $300 feels steep for a 90-minute visit that ultimately left me with additional out-of-pocket repairs.

reviews.author: Angela Pack
reviews.text: I’ve had PlumbPRO assist on multiple projects. They’ve always been prompt, had amazing customer service and been super responsive. The work has always been done right the first time. I don’t think twice about calling these folks. Excellent value for the costs. Very happy to be a customer. Rod & John were the dynamic duo who saved my bacon today!

reviews.author: Rob Stanca
reviews.text: Huge thank you to Jim A. and Plum Pro for once again coming through on short notice and restoring our heat. Jim was professional, honest, and had us up and running within a few minutes! Truly an awesome company with great people, and I will 100% always recommend 👌🙏

reviews.author: Melody McGee
reviews.text:
Last night around 6 PM, a pipe burst under our kitchen sink. We called Roto-Rooter, and they assured us someone would be out as soon as possible. Ken, the water damage field supervisor, showed up quickly, assessed the issue, and thankfully confirmed that our water damage was minimal. He was very professional and upfront that it might be a few hours before a plumber could come since they were handling some big jobs.

Around 9 PM, the home office called to let us know the earliest available appointment would be first thing in the morning, and they even offered a discount for the inconvenience — which we really appreciated.

Robert arrived promptly this morning, was super knowledgeable, and explained all our options clearly. He worked efficiently, and our sink is now back to normal!

We’re giving 4 stars only because we had to wait until the next day for the repair, but overall, the experience was great. The team was professional, reliable, and took good care of us. We’d definitely recommend Roto-Rooter!

reviews.author: Logan R
reviews.text: Called for an emergency issue and crazy enough Steven can out to help. I’ve worked with him before at another location and was more than pleased with the service he provided. They were able to come out and resolve our issue quickly (1-1.5hrs) and they even sent out a camera technician to verify the issue was resolved and to give an inspection of the plumbing system all included. If you find yourself in a plumbing emergency give them a call.

reviews.author: Taylor Maxwell
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter was great! We had a bit of an emergency and they were here within an hour on a Saturday night. Mason was very knowledgeable and handled everything efficiently and professionally. They will be our choice anytime we have a plumbing issue.

reviews.author: Chris Russell
reviews.text:
Steven did an outstanding job clearing a very stubborn kitchen sewer blockage. He showed up on time, diagnosed the issue quickly, and explained everything clearly before getting to work. What really stood out was his persistence—this wasn’t an easy clog, but he stayed with it until the line was fully cleared and flowing perfectly again.

His professionalism, skill, and respect for my home were top‑notch. If you need a plumber who knows what he’s doing and takes pride in doing the job right, Steven is the one to call. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Ben Hale
reviews.text: We had sewage backing up into our basement shower and overflow drain in our HVAC room. We called Roto Rooter and they were able to send someone out within one hour of calling. Dakota even came back a couple days later to fix a small leak in our clean out access point. I would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Mile High Shade

Booking the appointment was quick and easy, and Stephan showed up exactly on time the next morning ready to help us out. He was open with his communication, letting us know there were a few options that might work and helping us choose where we wanted to start. When the first option didn’t fix the problem, he was upfront and honest with next steps. We chose to do a full main drain snake and he got it done promptly and efficiently! He explained his process and what the problem was afterwards so we knew what to look out for in the future! All in all a great experience and we highly recommend Roto-Rooter and especially Stephan for any drain and plumbing needs

reviews.text: I recently had a frozen pipe burst in my house. I called Elek plumbing and Elvis came out to my house and was extremely professional and friendly. He explained the problem that caused the pipe to break as well as explained everything he was going to do. He replaced all the pipes in the area of the outside hose bib as they were old and likely to fail as did the pipe that already burst. As well as installing a new shut off valve and frost free pressure releasing hose faucet to help prevent this from happening again. Once he was done, he did a walk through with me of all the work he completed as well as show me the piping that he took out of the wall and showed me exactly where all the faulty solder joints were. He even called me after he left to ensure that I had a space heater set up to ensure that the pipe didn’t freeze again while I waited for my wall and insulation to be repaired. He was fast, efficient and, friendly. I am super appreciative of Elvis and Elek as they helped me during this time and will definitively be using them in the future. reviews.author: Erin Goga
reviews.text:
I’ll try to keep this review short although I could easily write pages of positivity and accolades. I’m currently at a friend’s home recovering from a serious femur fracture.  My house sitter called to let me know that all drains in the house were clogging and the toilet would not flush.  I called Elek (now my “go to” plumbing company)and they promptly sent Jody to check out the issues.  She found the problems and while on FaceTime, clearly explained everything to me along with solutions.  Some relatively simple fixes and others a bit more time consuming.  Both the toilet, bathroom sink and kitchen sink have had off and on problems for at least 18 years with quick fixes by other companies that did not last.  Finally Jody solved the mystery!  Knowing my situation (needing to use a walker and cane)she suggested a comfort height toilet (which I’ve never heard of), and to replace my non-working garbage disposal which was a big reason my kitchen sink drain never fully drained.  Jody was patient with me and helped me to choose the toilet and disposal from afar.  Within days she was back to install the toilet (it arrived from a big box store cracked) so she took care of that calmly and went and got another toilet from Elek’s warehouse with the same specs the same day! All sinks and a new toilet running well!  Talk about above and beyond!!! Her kindness, knowledge, ability to think on her feet, and patience were a gift during a difficult time in my life.  Thank you Jody and the staff at Elek as well.
Erin Goga

reviews.author: Shaban El Helou
reviews.text:
Gave Monaco a call after my bathtub water started backing up and I knew I had a clog somewhere. I tried to fix it myself and ran a 25‑foot snake through the toilet, but it came back clean. At that point, I knew the issue was bigger and needed professionals.

They arrived within an hour of my call. The technician quickly located a clog outside, cleared out a bunch of tree roots, and even ran an underground camera to show me exactly what was going on. He was able to fully unclog the line and recommended replacing the outside piping in the future.

Thank you for the fast response and great service. Definitely a 10/10 recommendation.

reviews.author: Brad Kaley
reviews.text:
I’m giving 2 stars instead of 1 only because the company came out quickly both times, and the second field tech was professional and easy to work with. Unfortunately, the overall experience was frustrating.

I had a blockage in my sewer line from the house to the street that caused my yard vent to overflow. On the first visit, they snaked the drain and restored flow. However, the tech told me in person that he did not clear the line all the way to the street — only about 10 feet past the clog. He assumed the blockage was wipes based on what had overflowed, though he wasn’t able to pull anything out of the line. We have not used wipes in the three years we’ve lived here. It’s possible prior owners did, but that’s speculation. He did not document that the line wasn’t cleared to the street, but since they advertise a 30-day warranty, I didn’t push the issue.

For reference, I was charged about $800 for that initial visit, which feels high for a straightforward snaking with no camera inspection or confirmation that the line was fully cleared. They also would not provide even a ballpark price before coming out, which should have been a red flag.

About 10 days later, the line backed up again — still within the warranty window. When I called to schedule a follow-up, the person on the phone was extremely confrontational. He said that if they found wipes again, I would automatically be charged. He insisted the wipes previously found were “fresh,” despite having no proof and despite me explaining we do not use wipes. It felt like I was being accused of lying. When I referenced that their own tech told me the line wasn’t cleared to the street the first time — and that the clog may have simply been pushed downstream — I was told, “Why do customers tell us we don’t do our job properly?” The tone was unprofessional and unnecessary. I remained calm and simply explained I didn’t want to pay again for something that may not have been fully resolved the first time, especially SINCE IT WAS WITHIN WARRANTY.

Ultimately, they did return and clear the line at no charge, though they voided the remainder of the warranty. Honestly, I’m not sure if he legally could void my warranty, but I was so happy to just be done with them that I didn’t care. While I appreciated the second technician’s work, the hostile communication, lack of transparency on pricing, and accusatory tone mean I won’t be using them again. Quick response times don’t make up for terrible customer service and unclear pricing. I hope this helps others.

reviews.author: Roy Holt
reviews.text:
Absolute nightmare to deal with. Poor communication, didn't pull permits, installed broken hardware. Go with literally anyone else. One star is too generous.

They installed a new variable Daikin AC system, UV cleaning system, breaker panel, and home surge protector. The new AC unit died within a day and I had to call technicians out to fix the brand new system. After the new breaker box was installed part of the house would randomly lose power. Another tech came out to see what was going on and said an old broken breaker had been put in. He asked who did the initial work and wasn't surprised to hear it was done poorly. The new panel install (by the guy that put in a broken breaker) was finished with "I hope the inspector doesn't look to close, this might not pass."

After a month of trying to get an inspection scheduled with weekly calls and constant assurances it would be "done immediately" and "someone will call you soon" I asked the county permits office if I can schedule it myself (especially after the issues with the breaker panel I was worried about the wiring) and they said no permit existed for the work that was completed.

Finally after another few weeks of waiting the inspection was completed and somehow passed. Now I am sitting at 68% indoor humidity, and mold growth in my home (I never had this problem before).

They came out for an annual inspection unrelated to any of my problems and the sales associate deflected all of issues. He said my duct work was old and not built for a newer unit, even though pro-tech already inspected it and said it was fine before doing the installation. He said I needed new duct work (which pro-tech would happily sell me!) and it probably wasn't mentioned because I couldn't financially afford it despite paying in full with cash for the AC unit. So that just tells me they want to get the sale no matter what and will lie about duct work being in good enough condition just to upsell later. He then said if I used better filters I wouldn't have the issue (and they'd be happy to sell me them!) He then said that actually the UV light (that they installed) isn't great, but they'd be so happy to sell me a better one. So they lie about duct work being good enough, don't say that I'll probably need specialized air filters, and apparently install low-quality equipment in the form of the UV light.

When I brought up all the other issues I had the sales associate said they had some bad employees and they were firing people. That's not fixing my problems either! I don't feel better knowing someone is losing their job if a mistake is made, I just want it fixed.

I waited to see if they could salvage the situation and make things right, but nothing happened aside from replies of "someone will get back to you." What's the point of a labor warranty if nothing is done? Now I'm probably going to have to call another AC company to figure out whats wrong with my system.

But I HAVE heard back five times now from the upsell department ask if I want to go through with over an additional $12,000 worth of work.

Anyway shout out to the technicians Mitchell and Cody for being the two knowledgeable people I've dealt with that have actually attempted to fix things.

reviews.author: Charmaine Stallworth
reviews.text:

So I sat and thought about it and at 4:38pm I called back and was told sorry you don’t have an appointment and the earliest appointment available is actually two days later. What kind of service is that? If I hadn’t called in I was never even gonna be notified that I didn’t even have appointment. Spoke to Sherrica a manager and was told that their system allows them to overbook and then they call the members to re-schedule. What kind of system is that. I moved from Frank Gay but was trying to save money and after this lack of service from Pro Trch  I will be switching back. You know what they say you get what you pay for. By the way same thing happened with my annual maintenance service we purchased. Booked an appointment for Monday July 21 and then a couple days before pushed off until July 31. So unreliable. So this is a long post fyi.
I want to express my eternal gratitude to the City of Palm Bay and Drain Mechanics Plumbing & Septic .Almost 7 months ago after we moved back in with my grandma and started fixing this place up we had major septic issues. You couldnt even take a shower longer than 5 to 10 minutes if you were lucky. A plumber told me to contact the city. I didnt think it would make a difference but I did anyway.

After many long talks and paperwork etc we now are on city sewer. FOR FREE. We received a grant directly from the city. This job would have cost me almost 8 thousand dollars.The septic tanks have been destroyed and we are just waiting a few weeks for sod.

Drain mechanics even re-graded a section of our yard that was a problem with the extra dirt they had from the job completely free of charge.
They were very respectful and treated the property as if it were their own including adding dirt around a problem section of fence without me asking.

Every single person we dealt with at drain mechanics and the city of palm bay went above and beyond for my grandma and us.

Long story short.

I know people get mad at the city all the time or talk about wanting help and needing help all the time. This was just our experience and it was life changing.

So, it never hurts to ask for help.  The wait might be long but ya never know what might happen unless you try.

TRUST DRAIN MECHANICS WITH ANY PLUMBING NEEDS.
