Didn't want to go under house to move pipe so he was going to order a smaller base that didn't go with our unit. The pvc pipe going through the floor has a T pipe with top open and not an elbow.

reviews.author: Michael Guerrieri
reviews.text: My furnace  was not operating properly so I called them to come out and repair it since they have done lathe maintenance on my commercial unit.  They were as always very courteous. Communicative and fairly priced.  I never understood what their guarantee is when they come out to do seasonal service and something still malfunctions later in the season.  But I paid like 160 bucks to get it repaired an I'm content to say the least.

reviews.author: TrickArtist1
reviews.text: Arturo my plumber was professional and answered my questions and completed the job within the estimated timeframe he provided.  While I thought I paid a little more than I wanted, the end product, attention to detail, courteousness and professionalism were outstanding.  I would definitely recommend their services.

reviews.author: Larry Lezon
reviews.text: Technician arrived on time (called ahead with ETA), was polite, used shoe covers and cleaned/vacuumed the work area.  He also helped schedule additional service needed for my furnace.  We've used this business for years and will continue to do so in the future.  They installed a new furnace a couple years back and it's still working well.

plumbers.name: Murray Electric & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1801 W Detroit St, Broken Arrow, OK 74012, USA

reviews.author: Ryan Bingham
reviews.text: Had a slab leak under the foundation. Called Murray plumbing due to a friend of ours recommending them. Brandon and team were successful in finding the leak and very transparent on the price as well as the next steps needed for repair. Not pushy at all which I'm a fan of. Repair job was approx. 4 hrs, but part of that was because it was during lunch. Thanks Brandon!

reviews.author: Catherine Autrey
reviews.text: Dillon was really great to work with. I am so pleased with his work! Had an issue with my kitchen lighting after a DIY job where only one of the new lights was coming on. He arrived quickly, was very pleasant to talk with, and quite efficient. Replaced all the connectors in 30 minutes. My kitchen now has light again! Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Becky Duncan
reviews.text: If I could, I would give them 10 stars. Jason Smith was our electrician and he is AWESOME!  We had a lot of electrical issues on this home we just bought and Jason worked through them all and even pleasantly handled all the fixing we needed on more issues we were finding even while he was here. I recommend Jason and Murray Electric very highly for your electric needs. You will not be dissatisfied!!

reviews.author: David LeDoux
reviews.text: Jerry was very professional, courteous and did a superb job at replacing our meter canister in order to restore our power before the big snowstorm is expected to hit this weekend.  Though this is my first time using Murray Electric, I would not hesitate to use them again and highly recommend them to anyone. They were the only company able to get to my emergency repair on the same day.

reviews.author: Tammy Kraus
reviews.text:
On February 6th, we had our septic tank professionally pumped at a cost of $457.60. Just days later, our plumbing became clogged between the two bathrooms inside our home. On February 11th, we contacted Murray Plumbing and Electric to snake the line and resolve the issue.

On February 12th, my husband took time off work to meet the technician, Zac. After explaining the problem, Zac snaked approximately 10 feet into the line, removed some grease, verified that the toilets were flushing, and left. The entire service took about 10 minutes. We were charged the $89 service call fee plus $195 per hour, totaling $284.

Almost immediately after the visit, the clog returned, leaving one of our bathrooms completely unusable. Paying $284 for a service that lasted only minutes and did not resolve the issue is extremely disappointing.

I contacted the company and spoke with Jenny through their call center. I expressed my dissatisfaction and explained that the technician appeared to do the bare minimum rather than fully clearing the line. Jenny assured me another plumber would return and that we would not be charged to make it right.

On February 18th, Ozzie and his trainee arrived. Ozzie was professional; however, we were informed that while the $89 trip fee would be waived, we would still be charged $195. At this point, we had already spent over $740 addressing this problem and still did not have a functioning bathroom.

Ozzie himself stated that the previous technician likely only loosened enough grease to temporarily relieve the blockage, which explains why the clog returned so quickly. We were then referred to Missy, the manager, who shifted the blame to the company that pumped our septic tank — despite the clog being clearly located between the two bathrooms inside our home, not in the septic tank.

We were ultimately told that because the septic tank is now supposedly full again, they cannot snake the line.

This entire experience has been frustrating and costly, with no resolution. We expected thorough service and accountability, especially after paying substantial fees. Instead, we are left with an unresolved plumbing issue and an unusable bathroom.

I cannot recommend this company based on our experience.

plumbers.name: Maitland Winter Park Plumbing
plumbers.address: 210 N Swoope Ave, Maitland, FL 32751, USA

reviews.author: David Green
reviews.text: Toby was punctual and did all the repairs and installation efficiently. We are very happy. Besides installing the new faucet, he also replaced two valves and three flexible water lines. The original copper pipe from 1982 was pitted and in need of replacement.

reviews.author: Hal Schmidt
reviews.text:
Angel took the time to answer all of our questions regarding our plumbing concerns clearly and explained maintenance that are not normally provided by a supplier.
The work was completed to an high standard, and functioning perfectly.
Angel was professional and knowledgeable. Excellent service from start to finish. I would confidently recommend him and will use Maitland Winter Park Plumbing again.

reviews.author: SB
reviews.text:
I recently had a plumbing issue that was resolved effectively by a skilled plumber who quickly identified the problem. I just want to say the plumber was great and the issue was when I made the original call to the office.However, I faced significant challenges when it came to scheduling my appointment. After my value membership ended, I felt like I was no longer a priority. I was informed by the representative on the phone that it would take a week and a half to send someone out, which seemed excessive.

I had to request that they call me if there were any cancellations. The only reason I chose not to seek another plumber was that the Maitland plumber originally installed my water heater. I believe the businesses must recognize that delays in service can lead to lost customers. When potential clients experience long wait times, it reflects poorly on the company. This situation is unacceptable and should be addressed to improve customer satisfaction.

reviews.author: Martin Lehr
reviews.text: We’ve used Maitland Winter Park Plumbing for several years at our office and were always pleased with the service. They came out today for a simple service call which took just over an hour and we got hit with a bill for $800 in labor for clearing a few sinks and fixing a toilet, no estimate provided in advance. Not sure if they changed owners but we will not be using again.

reviews.author: David McComb
reviews.text:
Toby inspected our shower and did a shower pan test - he did not detect any present dampness of subfloor from the crawl space and it appears that over the years there has been a build up of water saturating the mortar layer under the tile causing water seeping up through the grout - he suggested we go back to using the shower , since it has not been used in two weeks , and if there is wetness under the house, to call him back.
He was very pleasant, polite, and knowledgeable.  I will highly recommend him to others.

plumbers.name: 1-Tom-Plumber
plumbers.address: 1840 Airport Exchange Blvd Suite 180, Erlanger, KY 41018, USA

reviews.author: Alex Cogan
reviews.text: Cannot recommend this company, and specifically Esteban, enough! We had a nasty leak that started coming through our plaster ceiling. Esteban patiently provided hours of technical advice on how to get at the problem, and then expertly fixed the problem. He made the whole process painless, transparent, and understandable for us. We were immediately at ease when he started explaining the process to us. We were assuming this would be weeks and weeks of troubleshooting, but he had it fixed in a matter of hours, for a very reasonable price. This is the company you want to call for your serious plumbing issue!!

reviews.author: Hannah Johnson
reviews.text: Cullen was awesome! Super friendly, wore boot covers in the house, gave my daughter a pink plunger and was done quickly. He was able to come out same day too.Sink is running great again!

reviews.author: Spencer A. Stiegler
reviews.text: Esteban quickly replaced our toilet today following a water leak.  He is very friendly and professional; great example of what all small businesses should strive for with customer service.  I highly recommend the 1 Tom Plumber team!

reviews.author: Logan Haines
reviews.text:
Esteban is an absolute lifesaver! I was terrified at what the leak in my ceiling was going to entail. He helped me every step of the way in finding the problem, and quickly
repairing it. For a very reasonable price, I might add. Felt so good to be in good hands. Highly, highly recommended! Call this company, they are the ones you want.

reviews.author: Robert Rankin
reviews.text: Esteban did a phenomenal job! I want him to handle ALL of my plumbing needs! He was very personable, professional, and performed excellent work! Couldn’t recommend it more!

plumbers.name: Johnny Doan Plumbing
plumbers.address: 301 US-92, Seffner, FL 33584, USA

reviews.author: LA
reviews.text: Lance did a a fantastic job installing my new dishwasher. The installer from the big box store wouldn’t install it and said if he did, it would stick out 5 to 7 inches into my kitchen. Lance was able to reroute the drain line and install with no problem. This is third time I have used Johnny Doan Plumbing, and each time I have been impressed with their timelines, professionalism, communication, and pricing. They recently re-plumbed my entire home. It took Jake and team less than 6 hours and everything turned out great. The city inspector was extremely happy with their work. There estimate also included patching the drywall, which Conner did an awesome job. I couldn’t be happier with the services provided by them.

reviews.author: Amber LaHue
reviews.text: We have used Johnny Doan several times over the past year for plumbing issues we've had at two separate properties. We've had very good service on each occasion. Their communication over the phone and via email is professional, yet friendly and helpful. They always let you know ahead of time who your plumber will be so you know who to expect. Most recently, Jesse was our plumber. He showed up on time, was able to diagnose the issue, and then repair it in a reasonable amount of time. Based on our experiences with them, I would recommend Johnny Doan Plumbing.

reviews.author: Nicolle Meeke
reviews.text:
We had an incredible experience with Lance from Johnny Doan Plumbing during what was easily the coldest weekend in Tampa. After dealing with a stressful, weekend‑long main valve leak, Lance truly saved the day. Even though we were exhausted and frantic, Lance’s professionalism and calm, understanding demeanor immediately put us at ease.
He clearly explained the repairs needed, broke down the costs with complete transparency, and worked through the cold without hesitation to make sure the fix would last for decades. He showed up quickly on
Monday—and his service was not only reliable but also affordable.
Thanks to Lance, we now have peace of mind and a new go‑to plumber. Absolutely 5 stars!

reviews.author: 2015 Stronger
reviews.text:
Another good repair today by Sam, he was able to take care of a leak in the main line and now I don't have to worry about it.

Jordan, Jesse, Jake and Emily are all awesome and they take care of issues fast. Just got another irrigation meter connected today. Can't wait to use it.

I have so many great experiences, everyone is great at what they do! Water meter connection, water softener, clogging, etc. They do it all

Very professional and highly recommended! Jake was great and professional, this is the best experience I've ever had!

Awesome service again!

reviews.author: Deborah Bunton
reviews.text:
Johnny Doan Plumbing had Jesse Brown to come to our house this morning for a service call. Mr.Brown was very professional and took care of our issue in a timely manner. I highly recommend Johnny Doan Plumbing for all of your plumbing needs.

We also had the company do a repipe several months ago and their service was excellent!!

plumbers.name: The Otter Guys Heating, Air Conditioning, Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1224 Monticello Rd, Charlottesville, VA 22902, USA

reviews.author: JoAnne Goodnight
reviews.text: I highly recommend Otter Guys for any plumbing needs. Patrick Steytler was fantastic! He was incredibly thorough in troubleshooting a finicky leak in our bathroom sink and performed a yeoman’s job in the repair, which required cutting into the drywall to install necessary stud support for the sink. Beyond his technical skill, Patrick was professional, respectful, and left the workspace spotless. I feel very fortunate to have found such high-quality service. I cannot recommend him highly enough!

reviews.author: Lori Myers
reviews.text: Malec was so professional, thorough, and efficient that we would call again and recommend Otter Guys to anyone who has a plumbing issue that needs immediate attention. He worked hard and trekked up and down stairs repeatedly in this heat without complaint, and continually put on and removed shoe covers throughout the hours he was working here.  I called this morning and spoke to a very pleasant and helpful woman named Jade, and she scheduled us for same day service. This entire experience was nothing but positive. Thanks, Otter Guys! Well done!

reviews.author: Scott Cobert
reviews.text: Our HVAC system went out on the coldest day of the year following a snowstorm. The customer service associate at The Otter Guys was very friendly and helpful. Due to the weather, the best projection was two days. She kept in contact with me and was able to schedule Andrew to assess our system.  Andrew was very professional  and walked me through the issue. Due to the extent of the repair, we decided to purchase a new system. Andrew presented multiple options and worked with us to stay our price range. Great first impression!

reviews.author: Sara Mills
reviews.text: Called the otter guys to get an estimate on duct cleaning. While scheduling, also set up a maintenance schedule for our business for the future. The free estimate for the duct cleaning was scheduled for the next day. Kenny and Caleb were AWESOME! While they were at the office, I expressed a smell that was coming from one of our closets. Not only did they find it was coming from insulation behind our HVAC unit, they removed it! They were only supposed to be here for the estimate. Pricing for the maintenance schedule is very reasonable! We will be using Otter Guys for any of our plumbing and HVAC needs! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jayson Knight
reviews.text: Michael is always a pleasure to see and talk to. He always explains in detail everything he is doing and is very informative. A people person and pet person as well, it truly is a blessing to know such a cordial person and he is a wonderful asset to your company! Thank you guys you rock!

plumbers.name: THE Water Heater Company
plumbers.address: 808 Calle Plano, Camarillo, CA 93012, USA

reviews.author: Alberto Martinez
reviews.text:
I recently had a new water heater installed and wanted to highlight the excellent work done by Ricky.

From start to finish, the experience was very professional. Ricky demonstrated a high level of skill and attention to detail throughout the installation. It was clear he knew exactly what he was doing, and he took the time to ensure everything was installed properly and up to code.

What stood out most was his attitude—respectful, focused, and committed to doing the job right. It’s not common to see both strong technical ability and a great customer-oriented approach in the same person, but Ricky delivered on both.

Overall, a clean, professional installation and a very positive experience. I would confidently recommend his work.

reviews.author: Bob Kniest
reviews.text:
Came home from a terrific cruise only to find a large puddle in the garage and a leaking water heater. Did some research and called The WaterHeater Company and luckily they were able to send someone the next morning.
Thomas B. arrived and brought with him a very upbeat, professional attitude. Thomas inspected the leaking water heater and quickly provided my options for a replacement. We agreed on the price and he went right to work. In a matter of a few hours I had my new 75 gallon Bradford White water heater installed and ready to go.
Thomas did a professional job, explained the operation of the new water heater to me, checked for air in the lines and left the area cleaned up. Very happy with his attitude and work!

reviews.author: Bruce Hirsch
reviews.text: This my my second time using The Water Heater Company, and I continue to be very pleased with their service.  On this occasion, Justin installed a recirculation pump to speed up hot water getting to some location in our house.  He arrived promptly and started by asking questions to make sure the pump was what I needed.  I really appreciated his clear explanation of what he was thinking at each step of the process.  Justin answered my questions in an equally clear manner, gave me choices, and made understandable recommendations.  When he needed an additional part, he spent the time to shop for it at no extra charge.  When he discovered that he needed an electrical outlet with 3 prongs rather than the 2-prong outlet available, he did have to charge for that but negotiated with his boss for a discounted price.  With these additional snags, Justin was clearly spending more time here than he expected for his last job of the day, but he continued to be thorough and diligent and expressed no frustration.  As with the last job done for me by this company,  I was impressed with their professionalism, attention to detail, and concern for safety.  Justin exceeded my expectations in every way.

reviews.author: tiffany doane
reviews.text: If you need a good plumber for your water heater, don’t wait and call them!! I called them, the very next day Sean came out and diagnosed the problems. I waited a week, Marc then came out and completely rebuilt my entire unit! Both men were simply amazing, knowledgeable, and put my worries to ease. I’m extremely grateful that I found a company with employees that I trust!!!

reviews.author: glenntmuller
reviews.text: Mark H. Was my Service Technician. He was very thorough about what services he was doing, after doing his initial inspection made recommendations without pressure and was very informative about what was discovered and how to fix the issue. He let me know how long the inspection and repairs would take and true to what he stated. He was very knowledgeable and I appreciated his promptness in getting the preventative maintenance on my unit completed and also having the filters on hand to replace. He represents The Water Heater Company well!! Don’t lose this technician!!! With great appreciation Glenn Muller

plumbers.name: 1-Tom-Plumber
plumbers.address: 36300 Lakeland Blvd unit 7, Eastlake, OH 44095, USA

reviews.author: DeWayne Jackson
reviews.text: I have three small children, one of which decided to play hide and seek with her toys and our family toilet yesterday. No matter what I did I couldn’t get the clog out. Heard great things about 1-Tom-Plumbing so I had them a call. Kevin was great to talk to and deal with and he sent out Daryl Looney to take care of me. What we thought was going to be a quick fix turned into a 3 hour adventure but Daryl didn’t stop until we finished the job. He was great.

reviews.author: Cassandra Kowalski
reviews.text: Jay was a huge help for me! I had a bad water backup in my basement (due to overgrown roots in my main lines clay pipes), and the timing was terrible with it being the holiday week - thankfully, I was able to get an appointment quickly scheduled that worked well for my availability. Jay was knowledgeable and respectful, communicated well, and worked hard (as the clear out of the external pipes required more time to jet through than planned). The price was great and fit within my budget, and the issue has been solved completely! I’m so thankful for Jay and this company, and can’t wait to take a bath soon (without worry)!!

reviews.author: Nathan Lynn
reviews.text: Jay with 1-tom completed a job working on my kitchen sink and did remarkable and professional work. He showed up on time, I received fantastic communication throughout the whole booking and invoicing process. Now my family can sleep well at night knowing our kitchen drain line won't ever flood our home again. Thank you Jay, and thank you 1-tom-plumber!!

reviews.author: Zenobia Magic
reviews.text: This is my go to plumber Kevin Zilke and his crew. Jay Hagar came and quickly found the burst pipe and went to work repairing it and gave me some tips on why the pipes burst and ways to try to prevent it. He took the time to check the whole line and afterwards he checked the water pressure in all of my bathrooms and shower after he restored my water. Great company, great workers and excellent price even in an emergency!!!! Posting before and after repair!!! First photo is before, second is after

reviews.author: Tom Yuras
reviews.text:
The night before moving into our new home, both of our toilets suddenly started leaking sewage water into the basement. Jay came out in the middle of the night and immediately put us at ease. He quickly identified the issues, explained everything clearly, and got to work right away.

He was able to fully repair one of the toilets that night, and he scheduled the second repair for later that week. His professionalism, calm demeanor, and willingness to show up during an emergency made an incredibly stressful situation so much more manageable.

We’re extremely grateful for his quick response and quality work. Highly recommend this company, especially if you need someone reliable during an emergency.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of the Shenandoah Valley
plumbers.address: 702 N Commerce Ave, Front Royal, VA 22630, USA

reviews.author: Tina Bramble
reviews.text:
06/04/26 - Huge shoutout to Lindsey and Andy for making what could have been a stressful plumbing visit an absolute breeze!

Lindsey was fantastic from the very first phone call—friendly, professional, and incredibly helpful in getting our appointment scheduled quickly and smoothly.

Then Andy showed up and worked his magic! He replaced our gas lines that weren't up to code, flushed our tankless water heater, and serviced our water softener—all while taking the time to explain everything and making sure the job was done right. It's not every day you get excited about gas lines and water heaters, but Andy's expertise and professionalism made us feel completely confident we were in great hands.

If home maintenance had superheroes, Lindsey would be running mission control and Andy would be out saving the day. Thanks for the outstanding service—we'll definitely be calling again for any future plumbing needs!

09/20/25 - We had a tankless water heater installed when we bought our home three years ago. While it was great having endless hot water, it felt like we needed to pack a snack and wait two minutes for it to finally make its way to the master shower. Enter Mr. Rooter Plumbing to the rescue!

From the first call, Lindsey was a joy—pleasant, helpful, and somehow able to work around our crazy schedule. Mike K showed up right on time (already impressive), parked on the street, and looked sharp in a clean uniform that fit—not a plumber’s crack in sight. He even wore booties inside, which my floors appreciated.

Mike got straight to work installing a recirculating pump for our tankless water heater, and just like that, no more “waiting game” in the shower. I was secretly hoping he’d take longer so I could avoid going back to work, but he was just too efficient!

Thanks to Lindsey and Mike, we now have hot water instantly at the far end of the house. Highly recommend Mr. Rooter Plumbing, especially if you like professionalism with a touch of personality!

reviews.author: Paul Thompson
reviews.text: Excellent service!  Dominique was a true professional and completed the work quickly, efficiently and was a pleasure to have in our home.   This was the first time using Mr. Rooter and we will definitely use them again.   Thanks for a job well done!

reviews.author: Amie A.
reviews.text: Andy Jacoby was kind, professional and patient with all my questions.  He even came back to bring me a space heater and ensure my family and I were ok when our heat was out in the coldest weeks of February.  I truly appreciate you,  Andy!

reviews.author: Robert Doranski
reviews.text:
Mike K was an amazing help with our water heater troubles. He walked me through how to fix this in the future, described in detail what was wrong and what to look out for, and completely made us feel stress free during the whole interaction. So thankful we were able to have him come out so quickly.

Also big shout out to Lindsey who took my call. She was very attentive and friendly, and made the whole process feel very easy. She got us the help we needed as quickly as she could, which made us feel very confident in this whole process.

Thank you guys !

reviews.author: Jim Lacek
reviews.text: Exceptional service from Mr Rooter Plumbing.  Had an issue with the main septic line being blocked up late one night.  I was able to make an appointment with Mr Rooter on line for the next day.  The office called first thing next morning and told us when to expect the Technician, Alex who called prior to coming and kept us updated with his arrival.  He took care of our issue immediately and gave us a lot of good information on caring for our system.  He was having issues with his septic camera, but was able to look with a smaller camera to make sure the clog was gone.  Came back the following week on my day off with the septic camera to see if there was any additional issues, sending me a video of what he found.  Excellent service and would recommend them.

plumbers.name: Master Services Inc.
plumbers.address: N3481 Co Trunk H, Lake Geneva, WI 53147, USA

reviews.author: Nicholle
reviews.text: Master Services provided exceptional customer service while inspecting and servicing my furnaces.  Carlos carefully inspected the units and thoughtfully explained the report, providing photos and descriptions of both functional equipment and the parts that needed attention.  Kaden came the following day and his team cleaned all the ductwork with minimum disruption in the house.  I am so thrilled to have a clean, efficient HVAC system.  Thank you, Master Services teams!!  Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Marilyn Woolley
reviews.text: Carlos did an excellent job of cleaning and evaluating  our furnace system. He recommended first change batteries on thermostat, did pan treatment and flame sensor. Advised UV light needed replace,  quoted price and will do that when check air conditioner in late spring. Friendly and Professional. Great Job

reviews.author: Christopher Correa
reviews.text:
I have been using Master Services for several years now, and I have consistently been very satisfied with their work. I own two homes, both of which have needed furnace replacements, and each experience has reinforced my confidence in their quality, professionalism, and timeliness.
They offer financing options and a veteran’s discount, which I truly appreciate.
Richard was the technician who came out at night to inspect my furnace. He clearly explained that it was no longer safe or repairable due to unfixable circumstances. He took the time to walk me through all of my options, explained the different replacement systems, and even discussed the possibility of repairs where applicable. He answered every question thoroughly and honestly.
The next morning, Jake arrived right away to install the new furnace and remove the old one. He was professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. He answered my questions, completed the installation quickly, and had our heat restored in less than 24 hours.
Overall, I have been extremely satisfied with the AC and furnace services Master Services has provided over the past few years. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, honest, and high-quality HVAC work.

reviews.author: Kerry Sandberg
reviews.text: All three of our technicians were amazing! Morgan communicated effectively with us previous to, and up to his arrival. After discussion of all pertinent details, he called for same day service which was perfect for our situation. Upon arrival a hour later, Mitchell and Riley explained well what they were here for and the exact procedures they would follow, and why. They told us what they found and allowed us to watch the procedure at will throughout the day; and answered all of our questions along the way. They also extended other options kindly, as well as future considerations. Our techs even had to leave and come back twice, working late into the day, to finish well. AWESOME job! Worth every penny!

reviews.author: Dennis Docherty
reviews.text: Had a great experience.  They cleared my main drain, ran a scope down to check it, and felt they could do better and ran a larger blade down again. The extra effort paid off and the scope showed a nice clean drain.  Great work and highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Choice Comfort Services
plumbers.address: 150 N Dixie Dr, Vandalia, OH 45377, USA

reviews.author: Evan English
reviews.text: I chose this business after my previous one ghosted me. I looked at the 4.9 rating and 1k+ reviews in disbelief until I called them. A human answered on the second ring and she was super friendly, helpful and made me want to do business with them. She could have scheduled me for that afternoon but I waived off until the next business day. I got a text when my tech was on the way. He showed up within a few minutes of the scheduled arrival. He was ALSO friendly and helpful. He diagnosed the problem and explained exactly what it was and how much it would cost ahead of time. He scheduled to come back do the repair the next day. He came back AGAIN ON TIME and efficiently repaired the system, tested it thoroughly and explained everything he had done. We paid the bill conveniently on the spot and signed up for the yearly service. Happy to have this quality business just 2 miles down the road and highly recommend to anyone needing HVAC service or repair. I only dealt with 2 people but I was impressed with both of them and their customer service.

reviews.author: Kelsey Rofe
reviews.text: Great prices and service, honest and reliable. Called before the snowstorm. Matt helped to get our furnace working. Told us what part needed ordered and he was back two days later to fix it (even with the weather still not great). He was in and out quickly and efficiently. Highly recommend Matt!

reviews.author: Andrew Sink
reviews.text: I want to thank Comfort Choice for coming out to fix our MrCool. When no one else would come look at it or have anything good to say about it. When we have had it for almost 6 years with no problems. The service tech got ahold of Mrcool and they sent a new unit out free of cost we only paid for shipping. I don' think you will find another company with that kind of warranty. Thank you again and we be recommending Choice Comfort for any Hvac repairs.

reviews.author: K B
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about Comfort Choice. If I could give more than five stars, I would do it without question. It’s worth having a A contract for inspection and maintenance without a doubt. Above all this, I can’t say enough about the Professionalism and kindness of all the staff members. Specifically, Jill (office Admin), Mike (sales) Josh ( tech) and all the other staff that have serviced us throughout the years. They have all gone above and beyond with service and the one on one personal contact that they offer with each customer is rare with other companies any more. Pricing is reasonable & I feel I am receiving an honest quote.

reviews.author: Ashley Kessler-Palmer
reviews.text: This team came out to give us an estimate, options with a clear idea of the cost for each, and availability in the following two weeks to come back and do the work. When Shaun came to install our new boiler pump, he told me he’d done work on the boiler earlier this year, and installed a part on it a few years ago. He was familiar with what needed to be done, and put in the time to make sure everything was working as it should be before he left. Best part is the estimate we were given was the exact price we paid. It gives us confidence that this company is locally owned, and should we need additional work in the future, I appreciate knowing that because they have done work on our system in the past,  they know how to fix it. Money well spent.

plumbers.name: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing of Prescott
plumbers.address: 6741 Corsair Ave, Prescott, AZ 86301, USA

reviews.author: The Pupp
reviews.text: Aaron was friendly and did most of the work in a short period of time.  He forgot to return to finish the job so I had to call four times. He came out and apologized as he forgot to finish the small job.  No biggie to me. What I was upset was the cost of $2K. It was excessive for the job.  I had surgery on right hand so I couldn’t do it. Aaron dug a few feet down reattach the flipper and install a new tube. Being retired with limited income the price was too high for the job. the only new parts was the 40 gage tube and cap which was about $25. The flipper was not replaced but reattached. I feel you folks could do better by not charging a high price for the type of job. The $538 to come out would have been the price to pay. The back up problem was the back flow flipper came off and cause the stop of the flow. Once it was moved the water flowed away. Other suggestions came with a price tag of $4K the back flow value was already installed. Like I said the cost was way too much.  Aaron was good doing his job.  I’m just angry at the price.

reviews.author: Paula McCoy
reviews.text:
Aaron arrived on time, he is very courteous and respectful of my home.
He worked quickly and efficiently.
He went the extra mile to assure I was taken care of.
I plan to have another ADA toilet installed after the first of the year.

I will ask that Aaron is my service technician.

reviews.author: Sydney Harrington
reviews.text:
Tom came back to check on previous employees failure to clean out tree roots. Previous employee used an electric snake, like the one we own, it got out of hand and he broke sewer line and water line, all he did was punch a hole thru toilet paper which it allowed to flush thru 2 guests in my Airbnb. When Tom came  you could tell he did not want to deal with the situation as telling my husband and I if he used his tool it would break our pipes. He never took a camera to look at the issue,  as we explained my husband and I had separated the pipes and had taken our camera to look into the issue, we had previously taken off the toilet( we are in our 70’s and my husband had a stroke wheelchair bound) Tom told us to get someone who does hydro jetting( which can breaks pipes too
Tom went back to office stated I wouldn’t let him cut pipes or take off the toilet never said such a thing. I am currently waiting for supervisor to call as I want a full refund($754).

reviews.author: Louis Ingutti
reviews.text:
The Plumber/Technician, Andrew Korland,  was friendly and professional. He listened well and added his thoughts & experience to what our plumbing situation was. He also was creative in his approach on what direction we should go in order to save money and be more efficient therefore satisfied with the job overall. Bottomline, a good ambassador for your Company!
The 2nd visit to do the install when OK but we had a few unexpected glitches that took place. It wasn’t a good experience but Andrew tried to his best to make amends to make it right. A few things could have been improved but sometimes unforeseen issues do come up. Andrew will make a follow-up visit on 3/2 to check everything out to make sure it’s to our satisfaction. Thank you!

reviews.author: Chris Mattson
reviews.text: Had an emergency. My septic tank drain from the house was clogged. Tom was great. Very professional and thorough. He diagnosed the problem quickly. Unfortunately it was more involved than just a simple unclogging and he explained the next steps to take for me to get the ball rolling on fixing it. I was impressed with Tom and the Benjamin Franklin company and will recommend you guys in the future

reviews.text: I have been doing business with this company both for my personal needs but also for my rental home company.  I have likely spent over 100k with them over the past 10 years on many many many projects and repairs.  The staff is the best and feel like family at this point.  I have had a number of Insurance related issues and they have worked with me to manage payments while I waited for Insurance Checks.  I highly recommend them for all of your Plumbing and HVAC Issues. Adam Bernd in the New Albany office is amazing as well as Zack and Brantly who does a lot of my work.  I wish I could give them 10 Stars... I marked the price as reasonable because you get what you pay for.  I have used cheaper companies but the work was not even close to what they have done for me... Keep up the amazing work.

reviews.author: Kaylynn
reviews.text: Had some hvac and plumbing work done through them and I'll recommend them all day. Really nice work and they cleaned up everything. Zac really goes above and beyond! He shoveled snow off my walkway during the quote and im pretty sure he changed a lightbulb in my basement while he did the plumbing work. Super awesome

reviews.author: christine moody
reviews.text:
Too expensive. We paid $1220 for a kitchen facet replacement ( Note: We supplied facet and supplies except for one waterline ) and a repair / replacement of stem in shower on off handle ( Inwhich they did supply new shower stem.... shouldn't  have been costly)
....Understand $89 service call. We PAID this too... x's 2 related to our initial facet not fitting correctly. Which was our fault but in all these 2 smaller jobs shouldn't have cost at max 1/2 of the $1309 total
This seemed a very high cost....so I did some research. With my basic research online local pricing especially of labor. I also phoned other plumbing LLC in area and the cost is outrageous in comparison.
Got job done sufficiently but nothing over top.

reviews.text: A large HVAC install team and 3 trucks arrived on time in 15° temps and quickly came up with a plan to move the outside condenser around a corner and route new lines and power to shorten the runs.  The installers were professional and knowledgeable, I am happy with the 1 day install.  Although, the fancy new thermostat requires another visit, so we're on AUX heat for 2 days$$

reviews.author: Jerry Taylor
reviews.text: They came out to give me a second  opinion on a furnace problem at no cost. Told me what was actually wrong which didn't really matter because the system needed to be replaced anyway. Gave me a good price on a replacement unit and can install it same day. I'm a happy camper

reviews.author: Shawn Nickelson
reviews.text: I initially called about fixing a toilet that kept running. The one piece toilet I had wasn't a quick fix nor is it something I could attempt to change the parts on. Zac (the plumber) showed up and had an answer for every question. He had a solution for every problem I had. He warned me before touching anything what could happen once we started touching things. Exactly what he said could happen, happened. Went to shut off the valve for the toilet, didn't work. Went to pull the toilet, the flange was completely disintegrated. Zac worked promptly and by himself. He installed a new toilet, a valve, and a new cast iron flange. I'm really happy with the entire situation and who Goodman sent out to to the job. I will be asking for zac specifically in the future as I know what I'm getting from him. 10/10, 5 stars, will call again and recommend. I do not ever leave reviews and literally went out of my way to leave this one because I think it's important for people to know they will be taken care of if Goodman sends out zac the plumber to their home.

reviews.author: Jennifer Rice
reviews.text: I needed a major job done and they came in significantly lower on their quote than another company.  The job was well staffed and arrived before 8am.  They had 2 teams working simultaneously in the basement and outside to replace my entire sewer line.  They restored my water the same day and cleaned up well.  They came back the next day and cemented the entire length of my basement.  They didn’t have to, but were super kind in hooking my utility sink and washer back up and made sure it worked.  They were pleasant and worked well with each other and it felt like they wanted to be there which makes the whole experience a lot easier.  Additional plus is they accept credit card payments.

reviews.author: J Ames
reviews.text: Goodman is my go to plumber. They ran new water and sewer to my subdivided carriage house 3 years ago. A big job that was done well. Today they at no charge repaired a bad washer in the meter pit(which really was the responsibility of the water company but would have been garden to get them out timely). I appreciate them. With it getting cold now the water running down the driveway would have caused a safety hazard if I waited for the water dept. I am a realtor and often refer them to clients who have plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Kyler Storms
reviews.text: I had some work done to my stack pipe today. Zac and his helper Brandon were able to get the job done quickly and efficient. We were really happy with how they communicated from start to finish and took pride in their work. Overall, I was happy with the price and the work. Had multiple estimates and goodman was smack dab in the middle as far as pricing. We will be calling them back to do some work to our shower too! Thanks Zac, Brandon, and Goodman!

Fair price, lightning fast service, and a knowledgeable friendly expert.

THANK YOU.

reviews.author: Ray's G Mail
reviews.text: I was simply going to replace a toilet that wasn't emptying very well. I discovered the cause was a tree root. It looked like an Alien. I called my plumber, he said better call Roto Rooter. Glen and Drew came right out the next morning to remove the root, a couple feet long and the full diameter of the pipe, checked my system by video camera and found the entry point of the root and a bad section of pipe all the way out under my garage. They fixed both and added a 2 way cleanout, the builder hadn't done that back in 2000. Glen did a wonderful job carefully removing tile without breaking any, did the repair like a brain surgeon, put the tile back as it was and installed the toilet. Brilliant work. They cut a section of garage floor, replaced the bellied section of pipe and added the 2 way cleanout. All good now. Thank you. Oh..Kathy in the office, great communication skills..,nothing happens without that.

i absolutely loved their service and will definitely be using them again. They are truly amazing, and I cant recommend them highly enough.

reviews.author: robert sarzo jr
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough great things about Flood Brother’s Plumbing. Before finding them, I had called three other companies—each one either quoted outrageously high prices or told me they were too booked to help, especially on a Sunday night. Meanwhile, I had a broken pipe and no idea what to do.

Then I came across an ad for Flood Brother’s offering true 24-hour service. After my wife called, Giovanni—the owner himself—was at our door within 45 minutes, fully prepared to tackle a job that every other company had brushed off. Not only did he fix the immediate issue on the spot, but he returned the very next day with his team to complete the full repair.

Their workmanship was exceptional, their professionalism unmatched, and to my surprise, the final cost came in about 20% lower than the other quotes I received. They even cleaned up so thoroughly that our kitchen and bathroom were left in better condition than before the incident.

Giovanni and his team exceeded every expectation. If I could give them 10 stars, I genuinely would. Flood Brother’s Plumbing has earned a customer for life.

reviews.author: Dulce Navarro
reviews.text: Exceptional service every time. This plumbing company consistently goes above and beyond in every aspect of their work. They are extremely professional, reliable, and detail-oriented, and they always take the time to explain everything clearly. The quality of their work is outstanding, and they leave everything clean and perfectly done. It’s rare to find a team that is this dependable and committed to excellence. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jill Shields
reviews.text:
I am writing to provide feedback regarding a recent service visit from Giovanni to address a leaking shower at my home. I appreciated Giovanni's professionalism and his help in identifying the solution. We had already planned to replace the original shower hardware, and he kindly waived the $150 service fee, understanding that this would likely lead to a larger job for your company.

I requested two quotes: one for the entire job, including parts, and another for labor only. I was disappointed to find the first quote was for $4,995.00 and the second was for $2,995.00. The $2,000 difference for hardware was particularly concerning, as I could purchase the exact same parts online for approximately $1,000.

Regarding the labor-only quote of $2,995.00 for one plumber and an assistant for an estimated four hours of work, I found this to be excessive. An average plumber rate is $150 per hour, it was obvious that the quote was disproportionate. When I inquired, I was informed that your company charges a full eight hours of labor for a plumber, regardless of the actual time spent on the job.

While I understand your company has a strong reputation, I do not believe it is ethical to charge for eight hours of labor when only four are required. Due to these pricing concerns, I ultimately declined your offer and explained my reasoning.

reviews.author: Sarah Popek
reviews.text: Needed an emergency plumber - the intake was extremely simple and the receptionist was kind and made me feel at ease. The plumber was dispatched within an hour and was able to fix my shower quickly and easily. Very professional, very painless! I was so grateful for how easy this was when I was so stressed. Would absolutely call Valdel again!

reviews.author: Hannah Le
reviews.text:
Outstanding Service and Communication – Highly Recommend!

From start to finish, my experience with Valdel for a sewer pipe replacement using the pipe burst method was absolutely excellent. Communication was prompt, professional, and consistent every step of the way. The reception team was always courteous and quick to respond, making scheduling and coordination effortless.

A HUGE thank you to Stephen Bready, the drain specialist, who truly went above and beyond. Stephen took the time to thoroughly explain every step of the process — from the initial inspection to the materials and technology used in the pipe bursting procedure. His depth of knowledge and willingness to share it gave me great confidence in the work being done for me and my parents.

Stephen’s attention to detail, transparency, and proactive communication made what could have been a stressful repair feel smooth and straightforward. The entire process was handled efficiently and the on-site work was done within 2 days.
A reliable contractor with good communication & without price-gauging charges can be so hard to come by. They've gained a long-term customer now for all of my properties moving forward.

I can’t recommend this team enough for their professionalism, expertise, and top-tier customer service. I really appreciated how well everything was communicated from the start. Highly recommend this company and especially Stephen for anyone needing sewer line repair/replacement!

reviews.author: Mark Butler
reviews.text: Steve and the entire staff from Valdel were awesome. No strong arm sales pitch. Told me both what we needed and what we didn't need. Install of water treatment system took about 4 hours and took us through the entire process for its upkeep.

reviews.author: Katelyn Mathe
reviews.text:
We’ve used Valdel Plumbing for several of our properties and they have been nothing short of excellent every single time. Their communication is top-notch—they always text when they’re on the way, which is huge when coordinating schedules. They’re incredibly respectful of the home, wear booties inside, and leave absolutely no trace that they were even there once the job is done.
They’re knowledgeable, professional, and efficient, which is exactly what you want when dealing with plumbing issues. I’ve referred Valdel Plumbing to many of my clients and will continue to do so with complete confidence. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Barbara Seebaran
reviews.text: He replaced a water line valve and had to turn off the water to the house. He did an excellent job,  was super professional and thorough. But charging 310 dollars with a 50 dollar discount for that is outrageous. They waived the emergency service fee and it still cost that much!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Buyer beware.

reviews.author: Rudie Gomez Jr.
reviews.text: Brandon who was our tech did an outstanding job. His knowledge in troubleshooting and solving the issue was impressive. I encouraged for him to take his time and gave him space to focus on the work at hand. He managed to get clear the issue and get the airflow back up and running again. Much appreciated.

reviews.author: Tim Willits
reviews.text:
I’ve been a Milestone Advantage member for years, and this experience was disappointing enough that I’ve decided to cancel.

I recently had an air conditioner coil replaced that was still under warranty, originally installed by Milestone. I was quoted two labor-only prices depending on the type of replacement: $2,363 or $3,385. The final cost was $3,385.

The work was completed by one technician in approximately five hours.

While I understand companies use flat-rate pricing, this still felt extremely high for the scope and duration of the work.

When I confronted the technician about paying $672 a hour for the work, he responded, “It is, but for the experience, for the amount of work that has to be done. I mean, it’s reasonable.”

I accepted the price and paid.

What pushed this from concern to frustration was the follow-up.

When I called to cancel my membership, I was offered a call from a manager.

The manager called me and basically told me that I knew the amount I was going to pay, and I could have easily gone with another company. He said I could have technically called another company, and they could have done the work and replaced the coil. The call was so condescending and argumentative that it was beyond frustrating. Instead of making a small gesture, like offering me future credit on a service or even making a price adjustment, he just talked down to me (I did not ask for anything special). No one wants to be lectured when they are upset.

The manager also mentioned that this work has a warranty, but I have no paperwork for it -it's kind of difficult to go to another company without warranty paperwork...

And since I’m writing this review, I can mention that I had to physically help the tech raise the unit into the attic, and he smashed my fingers against the rim of the attic opening. He also bent the middle support rod on the unit when he tried to lift it by himself. I had to tell him to stop lifting the unit like that.

Overall, this experience fell short both in pricing transparency and customer service. I was prepared to quietly move on, but the way this was handled made it worth sharing.

There are so many other companies in the area willing to do good work. I’m not using Milestone again.

reviews.author: Georgia Garrison
reviews.text: Outstanding service and quality! I can’t say enough good things about Tre and Milestone! My ac stopped working on Saturday at 4pm and after a call at 5, Tre was here after hours within the hour. He explained my ac issue and worked very hard to get my AC back going. He was very kind not only to me but my also to my daughter and 2 dogs. I have been using Milestone for many years and the level of service can’t be beat!

reviews.author: MtnGirl
reviews.text:
The hot water heater in our home has a dual purpose. It heats our domestic water and also heats the water for our in-floor radiant heat system. In the fall, it had begun to leak. After doing research, we decided to replace it with an efficient and money saving, tankless hot water system, and contacted Rex’s Plumbing & Heating, upon the recommendation of a customer.
Kevin came to our home, a very knowledgeable and experienced technician,  who assessed our system and recommended a Navien Tankless Water Heater that would serve the purpose well for both our domestic water and our heating system. He then scheduled an installation time that was convenient for us.
He and Shane removed the old hot water tank and completed the installatioin one day, (a very cold day), but he did come back one morning to fine tune everything. We couldn’t be happier with their expedient service and  their professional work. And our radiant system works better than it ever has in the 23 years we have lived here. We can’t recommend Rex’s enough—give them a call for any of your heating and plumbing needs.
Our experience with Rex’s was their attention to detail, expediency, and their expert work, are rare in today’s service world. And the cost estimate was less than what we found from other companies.

reviews.author: Ray French
reviews.text: Rex’s Plumbing did a fantastic job. We were a little bit of a nightmare customer and they provided exceptional service. I could not recommend them more. Kevin our service agent was fantastic, he was conscious of our budget and did not over sell us. He was able to repair our old water heaters and extend the life. Thanks a lot.

reviews.author: Natalie R
reviews.text:
I recently had an issue that required a service call, and I cannot recommend Rex’s Plumbing enough—specifically Terra.

From the moment she arrived, the experience was top-tier. As a woman, it was such a breath of fresh air and a huge relief to see a female plumber walk through the door. It created an immediate sense of safety and comfort that you don’t always get with home service calls.

Terra was incredibly professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. She took the time to explain the issue clearly without being condescending, and her workmanship was flawless. She left the workspace spotless and made sure everything was functioning perfectly before she left.

If you’re looking for a plumbing service that is skilled, respectful, and inclusive, ask for Terra at Rex’s. It’s so empowering to see women excelling in the trades, and she is a fantastic representative for the company!

reviews.author: Jer/ Eberhard
reviews.text: Plumber Kevin was a wonder!  He was able to find the perfect matching commode, round bowl and at the correct height that we wanted.  He was very courteous in answering my wife's and my questions. They truly tried to rip me off and then laugh in my face about it. I called to ask for a quote to unclog a slow draining bathroom tub, and they insisted they could not do a quote over the phone, it must be done in person. We said okay and waited 2 hours for them to arrive. The employee showed up and immediately quoted us OVER $550. When I said I absolutely could not afford that, he laughed and said I would not find anyone willing to do it do for $200 or less.

I’m so glad I did not listen to that snarky employee because the very next call I made quoted me $150 to get the drain unclogged on Monday, or $200 if I need it rushed this weekend. Don’t waste your time waiting for Roto Rooter to come for you a quote, they just want to put you under pressure so you agree to their absurd rates once they arrive.

EDIT: I was contacted by the hiring and training manager, David. He was very kind and apologetic regarding the treatment we received. Unfortunately, Roto Rooter’s policy of refusing to provide quote ranges over the phone still stands, therefore so does my review. People nowadays deserve a heads up before being blindsided by a hefty quote from a stranger in their home.

reviews.author: Douglas O
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Reliable Heating — Blake Made All the Difference
I recently replaced my tankless water heater and explored multiple options and companies before choosing Reliable. Blake's visit sealed the deal — and his expertise likely saved me from a costly mistake.

Blake arrived within two days with a comprehensive quote. He walked me through three solid options: an eighty gallon hybrid, a non-hybrid model, and a smaller hybrid. His recommendation was straightforward and backed by real measurement — the eighty gallon hybrid would fit, and the price difference was justified. He knew his product line inside and out, and he spoke with absolute confidence about everything. He never once said "let me check with the manufacturer" or "I need to verify that" — he simply knew these systems like the back of his hand.

What really stood out: another company (TE Certified) had suggested I'd need to tear down walls to install the unit. Blake immediately recognized that was wrong — this is a zero clearance model. That kind of knowledge protected my home and my wallet.

The pricing was competitive, and Reliable was willing to match other quotes. Once I committed, the water heater arrived and was installed within forty-eight hours. The installation itself was seamless — immense preparation, care for my home, and professionalism throughout. Corey, the electrician, was exceptional as well, rewiring the old connections with the same attention to detail.

The bonus: the unit runs cool enough that it's also keeping my garage significantly cooler. Blake did warn me about that — another example of his proactive, thorough approach.

This was a significant investment, but it's already paying dividends. I also discovered that my previous water heater was causing issues with my electrical panel. Upgrading averted what could have been a real crisis down the road.

Blake is courteous, punctual, knowledgeable, and genuinely invested in getting it right. I cannot recommend him and Reliable highly enough.

reviews.author: Lucian Smith
reviews.text:
Really perplexing how they have such a good rating. I had a leak at 3am, scheduled the plumber to arrive promptly at 8. When I asked about pricing, the person on the line said they have no information on pricing— suspicious. They assured me that the $75 site visit fee to assess the plumbing will be deducted from the price. I was expecting maybe $150 to replace a water intake pipe to the dishwasher.

The repairman arrived at 11am….. I told him my frustration about the fact that I had to book the services without any knowledge of their pricing. And I expressed my frustration that I scheduled this plumber visit at 6am and it was then 11am by the time he arrived. He even agreed that this policy was not fair and a bit predatory.

I paid $500 for this plumber to replace a water intake pipe. He even took his lunch while repairing this. No sense of urgency, and no true service when you book with this company.

reviews.author: Sean York
reviews.text:
I have nothing but good things to say about MAS plumbing. My initial call was after work, for a slow drain on my kitchen sink, I had a little bit of a slow drain throughout the week, and I thought I had time before things totally clogged up, so I scheduled my visit for the weekend (WEEKEND AVAILABILITY IS SUCH A HARD THING TO FIND). I was told that MAS could have someone come out and perform an inspection and I signed up. I tried to see if I could fix the issue myself using a hand crank drain snake, and I wasn't getting anywhere. Low and behold, later that night my sink and dishwasher totally backed up, and I knew I needed help ASAP.

I called MAS the same day at 9 p.m. and got a hold of their afterhours answering service, who let me know they would forward my call to the office to be addressed the next day. To my surprise, Carl called me back the same night! He offered to come out at 9 p.m. but let me know that since it wasn't really an emergency, he'd recommend that I just wait until the next day. He let me know that they could definitely get me in for the next day, and that he would probably be the one to come out and assist.

Without Carl I wouldn't have been able to sleep, just getting a call back from Carl letting me know that MAS plumbing could be out the next day helped me rest easy.

Carl came out the next day, and KILLED IT. Super kind, professional, skilled and also charismatic. He got the pro-sized snake out and got the job done in less than a couple hours. I could tell he really cared about the client experience, and he was super focused on getting the job done. Carl also went above and beyond and took a look at my drain line set-up so that I could ensure that it was pitched correctly.

I can't recommend MAS enough. The customer service was excellent from start to slightly panicked late-night moment, all the way to when Carl came and won me over as a client for likely the rest of my time in this house.

I'm so happy I found this Company, and Carl made me a client of MAS for life!

Thanks again, Carl and MAS!
