Thank you Bennie for recommending the water heater installation, it’s the best Christmas gift we could ever ask for.

reviews.author: Shawna Lathan
reviews.text: Our Technician David was Amazing! He showed up on time. He was friendly. The Saints should know about this company, he treated us with respect, grace, and kindness. We’re definitely using this company again. Would recommend to Churches, Business Owners, Homeowners, any other property that needs a plumber or sewer work done. 5 stars ⭐️

reviews.author: Freestyle Kustomz LLC
reviews.text: After hour standby call. Bennie Wilson was great. He let us know he was on the way, He was very knowledgeable, polite, explained the problem that is causing the constant reoccurring issue and how we can get it stopped. Gave us a quote for the possible repair work. This is the second time using BF. We have been very please with their professional work, time frame of work, help out in emergencies. We will continue to call them for any of our plumbing needs. Thank you Bennie and the BF company. Yall are great.

reviews.author: Brett Davis
reviews.text: Haven't had work done yet, just an estimate by Mr. Jay Chinn. He was very kind, knowledgeable, and professional. He also took the time to actually understand and see what the issue was and how to resolve it. He represents the company very well. I also appreciate that this company doesn't charge to come out and to give a quote like most other companies. For families like us it helps a lot!

reviews.author: Elisabeth Emhof
reviews.text: Joel did an amazing and very professional job! He provided a very thorough and clear estimate and explained exactly what needed to be done. He was able to get me scheduled in a timely manner and even offered me a less expensive option. I would highly recommend his services!

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Greater Charleston
plumbers.address: 3330 Marathon Ct Ste b, North Charleston, SC 29418, USA

reviews.author: Cristin Uricchio
reviews.text: We had an urgent water issue and, after calling several companies, this was the only one willing to come out the same day. Finley arrived quickly, was professional and calm, and handled the repair efficiently. He even showed me how to shut the water off at the street, which I really appreciated. He clearly explained the issue before and after doing the work - and even cleaned up the area with a shop vac before leaving. In a stressful situation, they showed up when it mattered. I'm very grateful and would absolutely recommend this company.

reviews.author: Patti Travasos Winders
reviews.text:
We just did a new build and needed some help. Finley was awesome, educational and helped us understand what should and really should not go down a garbage disposal.

I hope we do not need help again anytime soon, but if we do, we’ll call and request Finely. Thanks for helping!

reviews.author: Lyn Swan
reviews.text: Prompt, polite and professional.  Was expecting to have to replace my garbage disposal and was given an “guesstimate range “ over the phone.  Plumber called before he arrived and went over what he expected.    He called me back and said it was repairable at about a third of the price.   This my rental and my tenant were happy with the response and his work.   He could have replaced the unit and would never have known it was repairable.     Good people and businesses in the world.

reviews.author: beverly hiott
reviews.text: During latest winter storm, I called about possible frozen pipes at our rental property. Parker, technician, gave us great information over the phone. He continued to communicate by text and calls with both me and tenant, despite being tied up with other jobs that day. Luckily, we didn’t need their services. But, if we do, we will definitely call on Mr. Rooter. Hard to find this level of customer service these days.

reviews.author: Lance Malone
reviews.text: Emergency service with main line clogged. Zack was there promptly. Found him very professional. Resolved the clog and explained thoroughly what was occuring. So we are equipped with important information on where the clog occurred, how it may return and what we should do to resolve permanently. Feel like Zack represented the company quite well.

plumbers.name: Amped Plumbing Heating Air Conditioning and Security
plumbers.address: 4205 N MacArthur Blvd, Warr Acres, OK 73122, USA

reviews.author: Deborah
reviews.text: They are very professional.  Their work is exemplary and they have great customer service with constant communication during the process.  They pay close attention to every detail to ensure the work is exceptional!  We had new water lines installed, broken pipe repaired, and new drain line to sewer line. It was completed in a timely manner and again exceptional work!  On a personal note, i have 2 adult children with challenges that live at home with me.  My son wants to be very involved and has many questions.  Ashton Norton, Joshua Smith and every other employee, including the owner, Joe Norton that came to work at our home was very accommodating, answering questions, staying engaged and made him feel very important in the process.  I’m very grateful!!  Highly recommend Amped!!

reviews.author: Alex Hofbauer
reviews.text: I had Korey come over to give a quote on 3 cameras and a video doorbell.  The price was in line with what I was expecting and less expensive than the other two quotes I received.  Overall, the installation was relatively easy, except for one camera that Korey was determined to hardwire to avoid using a WiFi camera.  He got the job done and the install was clean with the more reliable wired camera. I appreciated his hard work and would recommend Amped to others looking for security systems.

reviews.author: Ashley Burns
reviews.text:
Thank you to Amped pluming for all of their help. Thank you to Zeke for coming out and giving us an accurate estimate that Amped stuck to. Thank you to Dakota Elmore and Dakota Boyd for coming and doing the work. They worked very clean and did minimal damage to our walls to get in and repair the leak. They also were very polite and explained everything that was going on as they did the fix.
When Zeke gave us our quote he also gave us a quote for getting our whole house plumbing done and once we get to a point that we can do that. We will definitely be going with them for that process.

reviews.author: Alan Wattenbarger
reviews.text: The crew at AMPED replaced my old cast iron sewer lines with PVC. They replaced the main sewer line under the slab and did a kitchen and laundry drain reroute. They did an amazing job!  They were very careful and methodical through the whole process!  It was a lengthy repair and pretty invasive to say the least but there is no way around that.  If you have cast iron sewer pipes, do not take shortcuts that other companies offer.  DO NOT do CIP pipe lining!  Just do old fashioned replacement.  You will sleep better at night knowing you have brand new sewer pipes and not a bandaid.  AMPED did a very pfofessional job and I am very happy with the work they did.  They are honest and dependable.  They keep you in the loop the entire way and the financing options they offer make the repair less scary.  Take a bow AMPED, you guys are awesome!

reviews.author: Joe Meyer
reviews.text:
Totally recommend this company! They had a technician at my house within 30 minutes after my initial call. Technician Byron is the best! He is so respectful and knowledgeable.  Byron diagnosed the problems quickly and fixed it right the first time. Not only did he fix our problems, but he also took the time to walk me through preventative measures for the future.

The service was professional, courteous, and transparent regarding pricing. If you want great work done right, call this company!

plumbers.name: Al's Water Heater Sales & Services
plumbers.address: 4540 Ann Arbor-Saline Rd, Ann Arbor, MI 48103, USA

reviews.author: Andrea Strieter
reviews.text: I had a leaking water heater.  Richard came out and gave a free estimate.  I got 4 estimates.  Al's was competitive with the others.  John and Drew came right on time, were friendly, informative, and done within 1 1/2-2 hrs. with the installation, clean-up, and removal of the old one.  I couldn't ask for more!  I highly recommend Al's Water Heater.

reviews.author: Brian Chodoroff
reviews.text: Service call from scheduling to completion was top notch! My initial call was promptly handled and the service call scheduled to occur within a day! The technician arrived on time and the work of replacing a leaking pressure relief valve pressure relief valve (T&P valve) was performed professionally and for a fair price. There was no upselling of unnecessary services. I had Al's install the present water heaters about 10 years ago and will call them when the present water heaters eventually need replacement.

reviews.author: Russell O'Brien
reviews.text: Al's was great!  Realized we had a small leak in our 20 year old water heater so we called Al's.  They were very helpful and explained our options for replacement.  The new water heater was installed 2 days later and we couldn't be happier.  Great price and they took care of all the permits/inspections.

reviews.author: Catherine Huebner
reviews.text: Exceptional customer service! We stopped by on a Saturday with a question regarding our recently installed water heater and they went above and beyond to help us out. Dropped everything and came out to our home to take a look and fixed the issue on the spot. We would highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Yvette Colón
reviews.text: Al's Water Heater Services deserves every 5-star review they've gotten! My old water heater failed late on a Thursday night, I chatted on the website on Friday morning, spoke with a rep on Friday afternoon, and had new water heater installed and working perfectly on late Saturday morning. Everyone was friendly and informative. I'm really happy I chose them.

plumbers.name: Spencer Home Services
plumbers.address: 67 Foster St, Peabody, MA 01960, USA

reviews.author: W C
reviews.text:
I couldn’t be more grateful for the team from Spencer who came out after Monday’s blizzard to complete our CIPP sewer line repair. Oscar, Cesar, Chuck, and Bryan (who plowed out the driveway) were outstanding from start to finish!
They addressed a sewer line with multiple root intrusions that had been causing blockages, as well as a cavity in the old cast iron pipe that was allowing runoff to leak back through the foundation and into the house. The team thoroughly prepped the line by clearing the roots and descaling the pipe. Once done, they shot the new pipe in and cured it so that we have a single continuous sewer line pipe to the city main. They also removed the aging cast iron wye connection and replaced it with a new PVC fitting.
Throughout the entire process, they were incredibly kind, patient, and professional. I asked a lot of questions, and they were happy to walk me through everything - from the materials being used, to how measurements are taken, how the resin is applied, and how the curing process works. I truly appreciated the education and transparency. I now have a much better understanding of my home’s sewer system and the work that was done.
They were also very respectful of our home, keeping the work areas clean and carefully protecting our light-colored carpet with drop cloths. After the work was done, they cleaned up everything and it was almost like they weren't here at all. They treated our home like it was their own.

Also, thank you as well to Rich, who came out on Saturday to assess the situation and scope the line, and to Angel and the front office staff who answered my questions over the weekend on timing for the job and if a plow would be possible. Every person I spoke with was friendly, responsive, and understanding.
An exceptional team and an excellent experience all around - highly recommend!

reviews.author: Karl Kahandaliyanage
reviews.text: Spencer installed a 40 ft pipe liner on my home sewer pipe. Great experience end-to-end. Will and Rich did a detailed video inspection and walked my through the process. Cesar and Oscar,  the installation specialists did the work. The team was professional and took the time to explain each stage of their work plan. Pricing was competitive. I had a third party plumber review the pricing for reasonableness. The Spencer team followed up post job completion to make sure I was happy with the work and the team, which, I appreciated.

reviews.author: Sarah Wessel Whitaker
reviews.text: We had our old cast iron/ceramic sewer pipe lined, and are very happy with the result! Oscar and Cesar were knowledgeable and friendly and were happy to show us what was going on as they were working on things. The quoting and scheduling process were straightforward too and everyone at Spencer home services was very responsive.

reviews.author: Susan Noonan
reviews.text:
Carlo the technician installed a tankless water heater for us. He did a great job!
He informed us of our options first, giving us time to decide which one we wanted to go with. He was very neat, efficient and kept us informed as to what he was doing during the process. We are pleased with Spencer Home Services and would highly recommend them to a friend.

reviews.author: Jennifer Hardin
reviews.text: Brian and the crew at Spencer Home Services were absolutely wonderful. They far exceeded my expectations. Their price was reasonable, and they did excellent work. Each crew member was professional and respectful of my property. They were amazing to work with. I would HIGHLY recommend them.

plumbers.name: Lex's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7577 Lake Trail, Frisco, TX 75036, USA

reviews.author: Annita
reviews.text: I was extremely disappointed after reading such great reviews on this company.  ‘Our goal is to provide top quality service at affordable prices’ - not the case this time.  I had them come out to fix a loose shower handle.  Although hesitant to have a plumber out, we just have not had the time to attempt to repair this ourselves.  I called and scheduled after being told it would $85 trip fee plus the cost of the repair.  Never imagined they would quote me $300 to diagnose plus the trip fee.  For a loose handle! Beware as they do not disclose this at the time of scheduling and I even asked! Instead of gaining a customer, I was left with such a negative impression.

reviews.author: Stacey Anderson
reviews.text: Sean came out and ran a diagnostic test for us to find a leak in the ceiling. We had previous plumbers here that were unable to diagnose the leak. Sean found where it was coming from and repaired it and informed me every step of the way what he was doing and the price of everything. He was absolutely wonderful to work with! I highly recommend Sean and Lex's plumbing!

reviews.author: Nick Powell
reviews.text:
Mike Young was great to work with. He was friendly, knowledgeable and very professional. He was able to determine the cause of the issue 10 minutes after arrival and was wrapped up within the hour.

Mike’s attentiveness and his willingness to go above and beyond (he even wiped down and reset the entire master bathroom) has earned him a client for life. Thanks again Mike!

reviews.author: Russell Carlisle
reviews.text: Very satisfied with the service! Mike came out promptly, was professional, explained everything that was needed, and did a great job at a very fair rate. We'll be calling them again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Allison Prochnow
reviews.text:
I would absolutely not recommend hiring this company, especially for work in older homes. A tub waste and overflow repair in our 1950s house resulted in significant damage and ultimately forced a full tub and tile replacement.

No structural issues were identified prior to work beginning and the only risk disclosed in advance was potential cosmetic chipping, which I understood. I had another estimate prior to Lex's Plumbing who also did not identify any issues. During removal of the tub shoe using a power tool, the tub was damaged and later attributed to pre-existing corrosion.

Afterward, I consulted multiple master plumbers and repair professionals (due to the extensive work necessary to repair), all of whom stated that this type of damage is far more consistent with forceful removal than with a hidden defect alone. The outcome was weeks of disruption and many thousands of dollars in required repairs, with original 1950s materials lost because they could not be matched.

I requested a refund for the unsuccessful repair and a sewer camera inspection I could not move forward on due to a loss of trust. No refund was offered. While communication was professional, I certainly do not trust their professional judgment and would not use them again. This experience showed a serious lack of judgment and accountability, and I would strongly caution anyone considering hiring them.

plumbers.name: Roger’s Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7696 183A Toll Rd #4B, Leander, TX 78641, USA

reviews.author: Rick RRTEXAS
reviews.text:
We had a water leak somewhere as our bill kept getting higher till it  tripled and we called Roger's plumbing.  They were very thorough in finding it I n slab. NOT what we wanted for a quick fix, but the quoted a fair price to repair and backed it up with a good warranty.
They had to replumb the whole house so floors didn't have to be jackhammered and flooring ripped up and replaced. Very good job by Eddie and apprentice Sean. They covered holes needed to access plumbing nightly.
So far we are happy, no leaks and inspection passed.

reviews.author: Michael Landry
reviews.text:
My daughter recently purchased a house with a possible slab leak that was noticed during the inspection. We called Roger's Plumbing and Marc came out to assess and give us a possible budget to work from. We negotiated the price and after purchased, contacted Marc for repair. He and his helper came out and found the leak was in the slab within 2 hours. A reroute plan for the waterline was initiated and all work completed that afternoon. They were very thorough in their work and kept the job site orderly while working. When they left you could barely tell they had dug 22 ft of new line for the reroute of the line.
I would highly recommend Roger's Plumbing for any future Plumbing repairs you may have.

reviews.author: Lou Sigety
reviews.text: Third time using Roger's Plumbing and all experiences were very good although a bit pricey. However sometimes more work is required than one would think and that seemingly pricey quote covers the unexpected.  This last time Orlando did a fantastic job installing a seemingly simple RO system and ran into some unexpected issues. He spent the time to get the correct parts and did a great job with the install. He was prompt and very professional - highly recommended.

reviews.author: Marcia Rhodes-Tyler
reviews.text: Orlando was amazing from the moment he arrived until the moment he left. He was kind, patient, and incredibly informative the entire time. It’s rare to experience this level of service these days. Thank you for genuinely caring and for taking the time to walk us through the whole process. We highly recommend using Roger’s Plumbing!

reviews.author: Sherry Todd
reviews.text: Jaskson was great!  He was polite and respectful.  He told me what he was doing each step of the way, asked my opinion and gave me options.  He left my bathroom really clean, much better than he found it.  He even brought in packages that were sitting on my front porch.  She went above and beyond.  I will definitely call Roger’s Plumbing next time, like I have for many years.

plumbers.name: DNA Plumbing Heating and Air
plumbers.address: 542 Haggard St #512, Plano, TX 75074, USA

reviews.author: Ron Sutter
reviews.text:
D-N-A plumbing was a great experience, they showed up on time. Miguel was very polite, and understood the issue, explained it to me in detail. They made the repairs quickly and the cost was reasonable. It was nice to find a company these days that that actually have great customer service, with a smile. Thank you for your assistance to resolve our issue.
PS: They each left with a homemade cookie that my wife gave them. 🤗😄

reviews.author: Cheryl Teakell
reviews.text: I called DNA this morning to see if they could fix our outdoor faucet that was dripping. The phone was answered right away. I was given a time for 4-6 pm today, but was told if they had a cancellation they would call and come earlier. I received a call around 12:30 stating they had a cancellation and could they come now. Miguel was here within 20 minutes. He gave me a quote upfront. He was very knowledgeable, professional, and did excellent work. I now have a new faucet and happy it was fixed before the weather gets bad. I will definitely call DNA again for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Thom Pettigrew
reviews.text: Called them on a Saturday evening for work. The offered to come out that evening but I was fine waiting until Monday. They showed up exactly on time, were very courteous, and did a great job… very quickly.  Zane and his assistant were very professional and friendly.  I would highly recommend this business and definitely will be using them for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Gloria Smith
reviews.text: DNA professionals repaired our septic system quickly and efficiently.  This isn't the first time we have used them.  Their honesty and quality work the last time they were out made us loyal customers and they will be the only ones we call with plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Aaron Covert
reviews.text:
Had a leaky wall in the kitchen where I called DNA Plumbing; they were able to get me on the schedule quickly. Notifications and communication were letting me know when the team would get to my house. Check the pipe pressure, opened up walls to make sure  there was no pooling of water and found that the dishwasher had a hole return hose.
Had the team make sure the kitchen was up to code and replaced the disposal system to make sure everything was properly warrantied.

Overall long day but atleast the house is dry now.

plumbers.address: 2541 Marietta Ave, Lancaster, PA 17601, USA

reviews.author: Matt Leader
reviews.text: Had a new Rheem heat pump and air handler system installed, to replace our old unit today.  The whole process was very straight forward and customer friendly.  Starting with Scott, getting the quotes and choosing the proper equipment was easy to understand.  He laid out a few options and was very helpful when we had questions.  The install team of Quinn and Carson were great.  They showed up on time, were quick, efficient, and cleaned up the work area.  The outdoor unit placement was also a very nice touch and an upgrade from what we had previously.  The install team helped us learn the thermostat and system maintenance, before leaving.  We are happy with the results and glad we chose Ranck for this install.

reviews.author: Lm Ss
reviews.text:
I just wanted you to know that we were exceptionally pleased with Nick's diagnosis and Ben's installation.  Ben was very interactive letting us know what to expect every step of the way during the installation process.  He did a superb job.
High regard for you and your staff!

reviews.author: Steve U
reviews.text: I was a previous customer with Ranck , however, it has been several years. It’s great to get back with them. All communication has been positive. Ben is  very knowledgeable and nice to work with. He takes time to explain the situation and the work he recommends.

reviews.author: David Nowicki
reviews.text: Eric was great!  They performed a thorough diagnosis and completed the water heater installation the same day.  The work was top notch, and they cleaned up everything before they left.  Fair pricing, quality work and respectful professional service.  Highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Stephanie Kramer
reviews.text:
Ranck has been my plumbing and HVAC company for years, after being recommended to me by the prior homeowners of my house.  Consistently the technicians are skilled, exceedingly polite, timely, and trustworthy.   I always feel certain that their work is done well and feel comfortable having them in my home.

In addition, when I have had an urgent service need, customer service has gone out of their way to accomodate my request.   I have a handful of great service providers I know and trust with my home and Ranck is at the top of that list.

plumbers.name: Wally Blanton Plumbing and Sewer
plumbers.address: 1048 Christine Ln, Antioch, IL 60002, USA

reviews.author: thomas terranella
reviews.text:
Just had Steve and Anthony unclog our kitchen sink drain. They were courteous, professional, and communicated well throughout. I was able to use a coupon found online which greatly reduced the cost compared to previous services from other plumbing companies.
Highly recommend👍.

reviews.author: Inga Bentley
reviews.text: Was very responsive to some sewer back up in our home and helped get the issue resolved in one day. The plumber and technician we worked with on the first day were hard to communicate with. They told me on price and my husband another price $200 more. They also left a HUGE mess in our basement including buckets of ours that were filled with sewer and not rinsed, they didn’t tell us they left them outside so our kids found them. The main office was also screening the calls from my number when I called to ask about updates. Pictures are of the mess they left in our basement. They also had stuff all over their shoes that they tracked through our carpet, on our banister and front door.

reviews.author: Ian Wang
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Derrick and Andrew from Wally Blanton. From start to finish, they were professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly courteous. They arrived on time, clearly explained the plumbing issue, and walked me through the solution before getting started.

Their work was efficient, clean, and done right the first time. You can tell they take pride in their craftsmanship and genuinely care about customer satisfaction. They answered all my questions and made sure everything was working perfectly before they left.

If you’re looking for reliable, honest, and skilled plumbers, I highly recommend Derrick and Andrew at Wally Blanton. Five-star service all the way!

reviews.author: Karissa Brown
reviews.text: John & Mike responded quickly, professionally, and were able to diagnose & do repairs to our pipe. They have many years of experience working in this industry, are knowledgeable on all full service household repairs, and can answer any questions that you might have. They both explained everything thoroughly and made sure that we understood what was done, how it was done, and how to proceed moving forward. I highly recommend that you trust this family-owned company with your plumbing and sewer needs. They truly care about their clients, whether you are a first time client (like us) or a veteran client.

reviews.author: Krista Silecchia
reviews.text: Our sump pump went out last night and the company was quick to schedule to come out the next day.  Mike and John arrived at the earlier part of the appointment window, which was extremely helpful.  They were friendly and efficient, and explained everything.  I highly recommend Wally Blanton Plumbing.

plumbers.name: FreeFlow Environmental
plumbers.address: 4411 Evans Ave, Valparaiso, IN 46383, USA

reviews.author: Wendy Triplett
reviews.text: I was having issues with my septic backing up. I just had a new septic tank installed 4 years ago so I knew it wasn’t to my tank.   I had two great techs that came out to help with a tank  pump and diagnostic.  Dustin Peksenak & Willam Santos   Both explained how my tank and my field worked.    Ended up my field was not taking any water and needed restoration.      They explained why that happens and how they can fix that.       They were very knowledgeable.       Thank you for restoring my field !!!      FYI.       They cleaned up everything.    Barely noticed they were there !!!

reviews.author: David Nykiel
reviews.text:
Luis was our project manager. He found out the issue with my septic tank and fixed it in one day. Luis and his helper were beyond helpful, answered all of my questions, and went above and beyond.
Freeflow exceeded my expectations in every way. From the time I called, my first call, setting an appointment, and getting Luis at my residence. This company did exactly what they said they would.

If you are having issues with your septic they would be the first company I would call!

reviews.author: Ed J
reviews.text: William was very pleasant and knowledgeable, he answered all my questions and explained suggestions to keep my septic working better. He was very pleasant as well. Doing an appointment on line was very easy and they came out in a timely manner. I got called the day of my appointment and everything was explained to me and I could set up my billing which I definitely like. I also liked that they sent me a reminder of the last time they serviced my tank. I definitely would recommend this company if you need your tank pumped.

reviews.author: Maryann
reviews.text:
I wanted to share the awesome service I received!! I filled out an Estimate online on Saturday due to having a leak in my septic field.  I received a call from the office on Monday and by Monday late morning Dave P was here to give me a quote.  He was very knowledgeable and explained everything! Tuesday morning he had a crew out to further diagnose the problem.
Luis aka Rico and William shared with me what the issue was and a price to fix it.  They were great as well.  Him and his partner had the job done quickly and to my satisfaction.

Last but certainly not least Holly from the office kept in touch with me and helped me through this entire process!

Would definitely recommend FreeFlow Environmental!!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Antonio Perez
reviews.text:
Make sure you sign a contract!!! they quoted $4800 to redo a small section of my cleanout which when they dug it up they ended up finding a old septic tank they had to crush which they said it would be another $1200 and they HAD to do it.

Long story short same issues a yr later water kept backing into the house and there was sitting water in the cleanout.(I’ve called them multiple times to have them check out when it would backup but the soonest they would comeback out is a week later) Had to have another company come out and they redid from back of house to main sewer line for $5900 and no more sitting water or backup in the house

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 3545 Ellicott Mills Dr Ste 102, Ellicott City, MD 21043, USA

reviews.author: Marilyn Schiff
reviews.text:
We got absolutely superb service from Roto-Rooter. We had a sewer backup in our basement and also a clogged toilet.  Jarrett Mc million inspected for water damage from our sewer backup And happily it was on a concrete floor so there was none. We were very happy to have him check though and he did a very professional job. We highly recommend him.
To fix the actual damage a plumber named Jose came and he also did a superb completely professional job. We are very happy with our router router service. Thank you.

reviews.author: tonya perkins
reviews.text: I scheduled online to get an appointment & was able to get someone to come this evening. Kasan was awesome! He was professional and friendly when he arrived & asked what issues I was having.  He put on his shoe protectors & treated my home as his own. He did a thorough assessment of my sink, toilet & tub.  He checked my sink & toilet on the 1st floor to make sure all was good there. He had to go & purchase a couple items needed. He successfully unclogged my shower, tub & was nice enough to caulk around the toilet. He gave me some helpful tips to use going forward.  Yes, I would recommend him to others & request him again to assist in my home!

reviews.author: Quilla
reviews.text: Plumber was nice but $450 to use an auger a couple times to unclog a toilet is excessive. He also almost refused to take a $50 coupon from the roto rooter site. He basically implied he’d take it not because it was valid and didn’t expire until April but because he was doing us a favor. Definitely going to look for other plumbers in the area moving forward.

reviews.author: Simone S.
reviews.text: We called Rotorooter to fix a plumbing leak and flood in my basement. When  Mr. Jose (#3710), arrived, he was professional and courteous. He explained everything thoroughly and made us feel at ease. He promptly fixed the problem, and was a relief to work with in a stressful situation during a holiday weekend! I highly recommend Rotorooter!

reviews.author: Linda Jackson
reviews.text: My issue was a stale kinda wet smell to me in 1 of my bathrooms.  The technician knew how to address the issue immediately, although I didn’t pay for a trip fee I had to purchase their product called Pipe Shield @ $100.00 dollars which flushed the bathroom drain.  The product got rid of that stale smell in a matter of minutes opposed to 5 months of that stale smell. The technician told me it’s a treatment that had to be done every day until the bottle was empty, it’s a pretty good size maybe a gallon.  Of course he started the treatment by showing me exactly what to do. At this point I am satisfied, thank you Roto Rooter your service was punctual and productive.

plumbers.name: Black Diamond Experts, Electric, Plumbing, HVAC
plumbers.address: 1525 W 400 S, Orem, UT 84058, USA

reviews.author: Bob McCann
reviews.text:
Great experience all around. The initial technician they sent out was outstanding. Your the best, Jose!

He not only diagnosed our immediate issue, he also advised us about the condition/potential issues with all of the components (it's an old furnace).

He took the time to lay out several repair options, from just fixing our immediate problem through several different price options to repair/replace some or all of the other issues.

We ultimately decided to have Black Diamond install a whole new furnace due to age/overall condition, but the detailed breakdown of *all* of the options and their (very reasonable) prices was very much appreciated in helping us make the best decision for our home.

reviews.author: Melanie Christensen
reviews.text:
Bryan and Zack came over first and evaluated our problem with many plugs in the attic area that needed a safer solution. They returned two days later with extra safety plug in areas with GFI.  They also gave it their own master switch in the box.
Thx guy!! Y’all are awesome!
Melanie C

reviews.author: William Martin
reviews.text:
We have had a great experience from Kris who came out to clean out backed up line then Alan who came back with Kris to run ecamera and show us the problem and quote what it would take cost and time wise to our Lead installer with Matt and Riley as his helpers. Mike keep us informed and their scheduler keep us informed and we got the job done in 3 days. Just waiting for asphalt to be patched and we will be done. Great job Black Diamond, we used them on an electrical project before and everything went just as smooth
Thanks Bill Martin

reviews.author: Michael Johnson
reviews.text: Todd and Joe repaired a shorted neutral and added a 220v circuit in our garage. They were thorough, careful, and kept me in the loop throughout the work. Joe did the diagnostic work on the fist visit, and Todd and Joe wrapped everything up in an afternoon just a few days after my first call.

reviews.author: Carissa Dib
reviews.text: This company has the best employees!  Brad was on time, professional, kind, answered my questions, explained everything well, and gave price quotes for possible changes.  The membership is well worth it.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rogers Neighborhood Plumbing
plumbers.address: 4061 Oceanside Blvd Suite E, Oceanside, CA 92057, USA

reviews.author: Justin Garza
reviews.text: This was hands down the best plumbing experience I have had. I was reluctant to call and hire someone to do it. After I read online all the reviews I made the choice to call. From the young lady I spoke to on the phone to set up the appointment was really friendly. I got Tiffany today. Tiffany was amazing. She was 2 hours early, she was very friendly and professional. She told me everything she was doing and keeping me informed on the status. She did a wonderful job from what I thought would be maybe 30 minutes to taking a few hours. She was amazing and could not have asked for a more pleasant experience and person. She worked her butt off.  Even though I had to pay I absolutely will call again for any service. I will recommend highly to anyone who needs any type of plumbing service. Thank you.

reviews.author: Michelle Pryor
reviews.text: I own a small business in North County. Mr Rogers plumbing came and gave my facility a second opinion on a water issue that we had been having. Their knowledge was CORRECT, their work was quick and well done, their technician was skilled and communicative. They saved me tons of money on a correct diagnosis and were wonderful to work with. Cannot recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Ryan Palmes
reviews.text: Mr. Roger's Neighborhood Plumbing is amazing! As a property management company, We need vendors we can rely on. They respond quickly, complete work orders efficiently, and their plumbers are professional and friendly. Tenants always have great things to say. Excited to keep working with this fantastic team!

reviews.author: Katy Bartlett
reviews.text:
Mister Roger's' Neighborhood plumbing was awesome. They were very friendly. They took care of all my needs. I asked questions, they answered them thoroughly. And I really appreciated their service. I am elderly, and I appreciated the way they helped me through all of this period I recommend this to all my friends that are my age or even older.
Thank you so much for a bad experience that turned into a great experience.

Kathy

reviews.author: Christian H
reviews.text: Beyond thrilled with the work that Tiffany did with installing new spigots and a water pressure regulator. She was on time and provided a very fair price. Very very happy with the work completed and will be using Mr. Rodger's if we have any further plumbing needs!

plumbers.name: Tioga Plumbing & Electric
plumbers.address: 136 S Norwood Dr, Hurst, TX 76053, USA

reviews.author: R R
reviews.text:
Tioga plumber Eric Ingle consistently delivers customer-oriented, highly professional service. His workmanship is beyond reproach, and just as importantly, he is approachable, courteous, and easy to work with throughout the process. Eric takes the time to explain things clearly and treats customers with genuine respect. Total kudos to Eric!
The following review reflects my experience with a major project Tioga completed not long ago: I recently had the pleasure of working with a fantastic plumbing team from Tioga Contractors, and I couldn't be more impressed with their service. From the start, the crew members were polite and responsive, always taking the time to address any questions I had along the way. They demonstrated a great deal of thoroughness in their work, ensuring everything was completed to the highest standard.
What stood out to me the most was how committed they were to my satisfaction. At every step, they made sure I was happy with their progress, which I really appreciated. Supervisor Javier was particularly attentive, stopping by to personally answer any questions and offer clarification when needed. His leadership was evident in the professionalism and confidence displayed by the entire team.
Overall, the crew exuded a sense of expertise and professionalism that gave me complete confidence in the work being done. It’s clear they take pride in their craft, and I would highly recommend Tioga's services to anyone in need of plumbing work.

reviews.author: LonnieL
reviews.text: Very responsive and checked out our leaking water heater the day we called.  Knowledgeable & gave us some alternatives.  We elected to go with a new unit given age of our existing hot water heater & they had the new one installed the next day.  Kept us informed at each step of the process.

reviews.author: Samille Stovall
reviews.text: Tioga has been servicing my home now for almost 5 years. I can rest easy knowing it's in such capable hands. They come yearly to inspect both electric and plumbing. I appreciate knowing my house is up to date. All of the technicians do such high quality service and are so polite. Thank you, Tioga! Eric came out to install new disposal todzy and found a problem under sink. He got in touch with restoration company and they are on their way to look at damage. I am so thankful for the thoroughness of Eric. It gives me peace of mind.

reviews.author: Dave Fassett
reviews.text: Another flawless experience with the best plumbing and electrical company in Texas. Sam, the electrician that did the work on our home, is a hard working go getter. He is very knowledgeable, friendly, and loves what he does. He showed up proptly and did not hesitate to get after it. He explained everything he was doing and answered every question we had. This interaction and service just solidifies why I will use no one else but Tioga for my plumbing and electrical needs. As I have said in my past reviews everyone over at Tioga is top tier, from the front desk all the way to the technicians. Family owner and operated and they treat you like family. DO NOT hesitate to call them, you will not regret it.

reviews.author: Jan Hall
reviews.text:
My hot water heater was giving up and leaking called for service and they were able to squeeze me in early!  Eric was AMAZING. He was kind, knowledgeable, and trustworthy.
He even educated me as he was fixing my hot water tank issue - excellent customer service and care!
Eric was great! Can’t say enough about this company!!!

plumbers.name: Vern's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 6178 Energy Rd, Bealeton, VA 22712, USA

reviews.author: Amanda Baity
reviews.text: We had a plumbing emergency and a different company came out and ended up breaking our pipes. Since we were already going to be replacing some things, we decided to install a garbage disposal and Christian and Brandon took great care of us. They were very professional and personable. I highly recommend Vern's plumbing and we will be using them in the future should we need their services.

reviews.author: Brittany Heishman
reviews.text: Ryan and his colleague did a great job. They initially came out to test our water and recommended the Neutralizer filtration system. When they came back for the installation they were on time, accommodating, professional, and thorough.  The work they did looks great and we are hopeful this will protect the longevity of our copper pipes.

reviews.author: Brandon Bailey
reviews.text: Christian came out and tested our water to confirm which system would work best for treating our well water. Once tested he recommended a few different options and explain them all well. Once we made our choices and the parts arrived he returned and installed everything needed as well as explaining everything as he installed it. He done clean and neat work and was very thorough with making sure we knew what we needed to before he left. Highly recommend Christian and Vern’s Plumbing. The office personnel were also helpful and polite when working with them.

reviews.author: Nichole Ahlstrom
reviews.text: Fantastic service. I called to have a main pipe unclogged. They were able to come the same day. Ryan was very professional, explained what was going on, and very polite. I’m very grateful for Vern’s Plumbing. Excellent work.

reviews.author: Maria Ankrum
reviews.text: After installing a water softening system and a new water heater, our tech Ryan was absolutely amazing. Very knowledgeable and did such a professional job along with his assistant. We couldn't be happier with the flawless service and attention to detail. All of our questions were answered patiently and in a way that made us feel comfortable about our new system. Such a professional business. Flawless performance from start to finish. I highly recommend them!

plumbers.name: Priority Plumbing and Heating - Littleton
plumbers.address: 2270 W Chenango Ave #400, Littleton, CO 80120, USA

reviews.author: Michael Lietz
reviews.text: Levi and Eric were knights in shinning armor. They were both respectful and very knowledgeable. They took the time to show us the issue,  discuss options and kept everything in the truth. We will need the work fixed and will recommend them specifically.

reviews.author: Susie Johnson
reviews.text:
When I called Priority Plumbing, I spoke with a lady by the name of Candice. She was wonderful, so kind, asked many quesions surrounding my issue to help direct what the next steps ought to be. Jahziel came out to our home and he was fabulous!
We had a sewer issue and because he thought outside of the box Jahziel was able to determine the problem. No other plumbing comany could figure it out. I was so thankful.
He came with a smile on his face, very polite and took the time to explain what had happened. His service was top knotch!
I really appreciated both Candice and Jahziel. Excellent customer service!
Thank you so much
Susie

reviews.author: Wayne Davis
reviews.text: 5 Stars, what can I say? Clyde showed within an hour, had everything he needed to make the repair on the broken water pipe, and was done in less than 2 hours. Happy with the work and Clyde’s professionalism! Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Andy Vaughn
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of working with Joseph Quintana on a job with a mutual client. He was very easy to work with, highly communicative, and a consummate professional! Thank you for setting the standard, Priority Home Services!!

reviews.author: Brianna Clouse
reviews.text:
**Edit to company response 5/30/24 I am partial homeowner, I took ownership in 2021 through the existing mortgage, so please add more detail.
My mother also the owner and policy holder - whom you guys have avoided and who is at a communication disadvantage due to english being her second language, I have had to step in.
We, the client of HomeServe a Home Warranty company - would never had to pay for your services. Exactly why we pay for home warranty and have full coverage for our mainline.

The issues I have as a homeowner and an unfortunate customer of Priority and Plumbing due to them being contracted by HomeServe:
- Said they would fix our sprinkler lines and electrical in Nov 2023 they destroyed.
- Got avoided by this company for 6 months UNTIL it was discovered they didn't replace 4ft of the original pipe that had SEVERE root intrusion (the entire reason we got our mainline replaced.)
- 05/01/2024 Sean Farris said they would fix the sprinklers and make this right and has continued to avoid us.

This company absolutely did not go above and beyond. Priority Plumbing and Heating HAD to come back to fix a problem they were legally contracted to fix in Nov 2023 and did NOT complete.

Above and beyond for what, adding some soil?
The stress and financial burden this has caused has been significant.

Original post 5/29/24 **Another bad Sean Farris (VP/ Owner) review on a mainline replacement (Estimated $18,000+ Insurance job.) On November 9, 2023 Priority Plumbing and Heating Littleton was hired to replace and install a new mainline on our property by my home warranty company (HomeServe.) They acted in several negligent ways, did not complete the job they were paid to perform, destroyed my front yard, sprinkler lines and electrical.
When we raised the concerns to Sean - Sean Farris, told us to kick rocks and that our concerns were not his issue. We were persistent and knew this job was not done correctly. He continues to give us the run around for 6 months, he was conveniently always in a "meeting." After paying a 3rd party to scope out and make note of all the things Priority Plumbing and Heating did wrong, they told me it would be $18k+ to fix their mistakes. I had a demand letter written up to get them to pay attention to the issues that I had complained about for 6 months.
Things they did wrong:
- Did not backfill our soil causing a sinking trench.
- Cut all of our sprinkler lines/ electrical and buried them.
- Failed to replace our mainline in its entirely, left with severe root intrusion.
-  Failed to clean up -  left old clay pipe strung along our front yard.
- Clean out caps were below ground level, improperly glued and secured.

Fast forward May 2024 - Priority Plumbing and heating said they would replace the rest of the line that they failed to replace the first time, clean up the trash they left, back fill our soil that was sinking into a trench, and get someone to fix our sprinkler lines/ electrical.
Once Sean and his crew came to fix their original issues - his crew member showed us that our mainline was leaking sewage into our front yard for six months from. Sean never mentioned anything to us other than everything looks great.

Now its a month later - Sean Farris wont return my phone calls about getting our sprinkler lines/ electrical fixed, he continues to be in "meetings"

Seans' motto is - we were paid to replace the line and thats it. If we break it, its not our issue.

Spent over $4,000 to get my sprinkler lines and electrical fixed + had to pay to get my line scoped by a third party. Spent 6 months trying to get them to fix their mistakes. Avoid at all costs this has been a horrible situation and horrible company to deal with.

I believe the only reason they came back was because HomeServe was made aware Priority Plumbing and Heating did not perform the job in its entirety that they were paid to do. IF not for that, I would still have sewage leaking into my yard, a sinking trench etc.
AVOID at all costs and do your research.

plumbers.name: Blue Fox HVAC, Plumbing, Sewer, & Drain
plumbers.address: 1511 W 350 N, West Lafayette, IN 47906, USA

reviews.author: Matthew Day
reviews.text:
My furnace stopped working and i had 3 techs from 3 different companies come diagnose it.   The Blue Fox tech was the most knowledgeable and even got it running again, but a cracked manifold made it unsafe to operate.
They quickly got me quotes for 4 levels of furnaces and installed it the next day. They even matched the labor warranty of a competitor.
Not happy to have to spend the money on a new furnace, but Blue Fox did a great job from the tech, to the office, to the installer.

reviews.author: Michelle Browning
reviews.text:
I want to give a huge shout out to BlueFox, and their employees I wish I could name them all,  Ryan Mullin came out last December/January to work on our furnace, come to find out it was a whole different problem with our LP. He was courteous AND very knowledgeable. With our first experience it was a no-brainer for us to continue with bluefox,  with our AC unit to being replaced, Cody Crawford, was easy to work, he made sure that we knew all the options and there was no sales pressure! The installation process seamless, a great company to work with!!
Thank you,
Browning's

reviews.author: Anthony Howard
reviews.text: I had no AC. My house was 92°. I called blue fox and originally had the appointment set for later in the week and I told them that my house was 92° and they made sure to get me somebody out there as fast as they could.  Let me tell you that Brent D is one of the coolest, nicest and most professional techs I have seen in a long time. If ever.  Super honest.  Fixed my AC fast with no BS sales or anything.   AWESOME COMPANY!  Forever a fan.

reviews.author: Lisa T.
reviews.text: I just had a new HVAC system installed. The entire crew was professional, courteous, friendly and hard working. I highly recommend this company. Brent, Cody, Craig, Brayden and everyone I dealt with were great. The scheduling office was easy to deal with. All around a good experience when you're hit with a major home repair that's not fun. Last year Diego came out to repair the system and his fine work bought me one more year with my old failing system. No pressure sales, exceptional customer service.  Good job!

reviews.author: Bhavin Shah
reviews.text: Bluefox did a new HVAC unit replacement. Arlee and Dave and team did an excellent job with the installation. They made sure all of my concerns on how we wanted it were addressed and also walked me through the details. They even fixed the issues we were have because of the old installation that came with the original construction of the house. They worked through the coldest days and snowstorm to get our heating back up. Broc our sale rep was excellent he made sure communication was prompt and even responded over the weekend.  It’s only been a few days so I can’t comment on how durable things will be, but as of now we are extremely satisfied customers. And certainly feel confident in recommending this team to anyone.

plumbers.name: Gold Star Plumbing & Drain
plumbers.address: 8737 Florentine Rd, Prescott Valley, AZ 86314, USA

reviews.author: Aadam Lamb
reviews.text: Clay Komos did an amazing job at diagnosing and repairing our circulator pump for our home water system. Once we received the parts needed for the repair, Clay was able to able to schedule the installation within two business days. He was knowledgeable and explained what the issues were with our old circulator pump. He was also very friendly with me and my kiddos! Would highly recommend Gold Star Plumbing!

reviews.author: J Ferris
reviews.text:
Great experience all the way around. The guys that came out were fantastic; professional, friendly and knowledgeable. The job entailed cutting into our foundation slab and repairing a leaking waterline. Price was reasonable and they started the very next day. Very pleased and will use this company for any future plumbing needs I can’t handle myself.
Great job Gold Star Plumbing!

reviews.author: Angie D in AZ
reviews.text:
Outstanding Service from Start to Finish!

This was my first time needing to call a plumber in many, many years, and I was pretty panicked after my pest control company found standing water in my crawl space. I contacted Gold Star, and they were able to come out the very next day (yesterday).

Michael and Andrew arrived and were absolutely incredible—thorough, polite, informative, and truly ROCK STARS. They walked me through everything, explained what they were seeing, and shared tips I know I’ll appreciate if anything ever comes up again.

They completed a full inspection, offered clear recommendations, and thankfully confirmed that the issue was minor and completely fixable. They genuinely put my mind at ease, and I slept peacefully last night because of them.

I’ve already told my family about Gold Star and will gladly recommend them to anyone who needs plumbing help. Their number is now saved in my phone, and they will be my first call if I ever need service again.

THANK YOU SO MUCH, Gold Star! 🌟

reviews.author: Fred Kennedy
reviews.text:
After an experience with a local plumber who couldn’t resolve an emergency that stopped us from using water or sewer in our apartment complex, inconveniencing, both, us and our tenants…we went without water and sewer from seven o’clock that morning until the following day!!! We called Gold Star the evening of the first day and immediately spoke with Ann who understood our issues completely! She scheduled us for an assessment the following morning, with actual repairs scheduled for that afternoon. On the morning of the assessment, Clay, the technician, called me before eight o’clock an said he would see me shortly, he was expedient and reflected a high level of professionalism, warmth (especially on an extremely cold an wet day), and understanding!!! From the moment he introduced himself, explained the process, provided an estimate for the possible repair, and product knowledge, we were amazingly impressed! Upon his initial inspection, Clay, also, answered all of our questions intelligently, helping us understand a variety of issues we had been dealing with. At that point, we decided to do a more thorough investigation and repair, which he said he could start immediately!!! We were ecstatic!!! Upon approval of the new estimate, he began an extremely detailed assessment using a camera and an iPad to reflect the condition of our downline, the exact location of the blockage, and the condition of our sewer-line. We were impressed by Clay’s explanation of what needed to be done, both, short-term and long term! After the explanation, he began hydro-jetting our downline, our upline, and all seven roof vents on our property, including our waste-line on our kitchen sink!!! He cleared all invasive roots, cleaned and flushed all lines, removed all blockages and then videoed the mainline. He went on to show us how thorough his expertise and equipment had left our system in pristine condition!!! He then inspected the property, put away his tools, secured all of his equipment, cleaned up all work areas completely, and walked the area with us explaining the work that had been completed. He discussed future issues needing attention, and the level and quality of repair that could be done!!! Again, we were impressed and extremely comfortable with the absolute quality and outcome Clay exhibited throughout the day until the job was done!!!
We anyone could leap tall buildings, walk on water, and be faster than a speeding bullet, both, Clay and Gold Star would fit the description!!!
Thank you Clay and thank you Gold Star!!!
Humbly,
Fred & Joann

reviews.author: Suzy Kitchukova
reviews.text: I cannot even begin to explain how much Clay went above and beyond. He was so professional and easy to work with. It truly is refreshing communicating with such a stand-up guy. He had all of our issues resolved quickly. I absolutely recommend Gold Star Plumbing!!!

plumbers.name: Henry Plumbing Company
plumbers.address: 1209 E 59th St, Savannah, GA 31404, USA

reviews.author: Travel with the Pulkas
reviews.text: Good transaction. After setting up the appt, an automated system advised me of appt times and when the tech was on the way. The phone rep was very polite. They were professional, courteous, and kept to their timelines. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Brian Waligora
reviews.text:
Henry Plumbing was an absolute joy to work with.

We were caught off guard with the need for two hot water tank replacements, and the job was handled quickly, professionally and very aggressively priced.

Tonya in the office was super professional and speedy. Communication was top notch including call, text and email notifications. I never had a question about expectations.

The estimate team was able to come out same day and explained all necessary repairs.

The install team was thorough and professional and exceeded all my expectations.

I highly recommend Henry Plumbing to anyone in the greater Savannah area!

reviews.author: Ellie Havlin
reviews.text:
We cannot say enough good things about Henry Plumbing! They came through for us on extremely short notice (less than 24 hours in advance) and handled everything quickly, professionally, and with such great service.

Huge shoutout to Tonya, she was amazing to work with! So responsive, helpful, and truly made things happen when we were in a time crunch. In our line of work, timing is everything, and they absolutely saved the day.

It’s rare to find a company that delivers both speed and quality, but Henry Plumbing did just that. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, top-notch plumbing service in the Savannah area!

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.text: Did a fantastic job. Had a sulphuric smell anytime I ran the hot water and a partial clog in the upstairs tub. The technician came cycled the water in the hot water heater and unclogged the drain. Everything is working as it should. Thank you Henry plumbing for great service at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Ann Harrington
reviews.text: I was staying at my daughter’s,  and her garbage disposal wasn’t working. Henry’s was able to get someone there by the next day. The two gentleman that arrived to work on the disposal were very polite and professional. They quickly found the problem, fixed it and then showed me how to fix the problem myself it ever happened again. I would  definitely recommend them!

plumbers.name: Leak Geeks Plumbing
plumbers.address: 4708 Keller Hicks Rd, Fort Worth, TX 76244, USA

reviews.author: Jaime Mincher
reviews.text: We’ve used Leak Geeks for over 6 years and have had nothing but the best service. Always on time, always cleans up after their work and listens to all concerns and answers all our questions. We have been very happy with Leak Geeks.

reviews.author: Bryan Blackwell
reviews.text: Leak Geeks did a fantastic job installing our 2 gas water heaters.  They matched the bid from another company and still installed the Bradford White industrial heaters.  They installed them in the same footprint and met code with no additional charges.  They went above and beyond to meet all of our requests.  This is the second major plumbing installation that Leak Geeks have done for us and both were excellent work.  I highly recommend Leak Geeks.

reviews.author: Al M
reviews.text: We have used Leak Geeks as our go-to plumber for well over a decade. They are always prompt, friendly and professional, and stand behind the work they do.  They have generally been a good value for the high quality of work, tho this most recent call I was astonished at the price I was charged.  The exact part is readily available and inexpensive elsewhere, so I am not quite sure why the significant upcharge for what turned out to be a quick (and easy) install on the water line. I’ll take the blame for not requesting the estimate first before the repair was made, but will in the future.  As always, no issues with the actual work and no leaks.

reviews.author: barb55
reviews.text:
We had a leak from a past repair that was performed by the leak geeks a few years back. I called their office and explained the problem and they had a tech at my home in 20 min.
A very professional young man named Brad.
He diagnosed the problem quickly and said yes the leak was caused by faulty material and he would talk to their office boss about a warranty repair. It was approved and the repair was quickly performed by Brad.
I am very very happy with this company for standing behind their product.
I will definitely use them again for any of my plumbing needs I have a hot water heater that is pretty old but is still heating. But they will get my business when the time comes.

reviews.author: Susan Solis
reviews.text: I like the whole process. I like being able to book online. My technician Erick listen to me and gave me valuable information. He was a very professional and nice person. This was my second Leak Geek experience and I’ll definitely use them again.

plumbers.name: Daigle Plumbing, Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 11 Windham Rd, Derry, NH 03038, USA

reviews.author: brittany stuart
reviews.text: I can’t express how great working with Daigle company has been. They came out fast and gave me a very reasonable quote for the work that I needed done. And Justin has been truly a life saver and reassured me, he would be the one doing the job to see it through! I couldn’t be happier to have this company come do the job!

reviews.author: Linnea Stanley
reviews.text: This is the best decision I’ve ever made. I purchased my forever home and was at a loss as to who to contact about a new air-conditioning unit as well as a new water heater. I was referred to Daigle plumbing, heating and cooling. I met with Jeremy and we discussed everything I needed. He was able to give me my quote right then and there and I signed off on it. Jason came over with the team and my air-conditioning unit was put in and they were gone in a matter of a couple of hours and my new water heater is in and everything is running smoothly. Everyone was so nice and so polite, and I really got more than my money’s worth! You would be crazy to use anyone else! Exceptional company, and exceptional employees. Thank you so much Jason and Jeremy and the entire team Including Juanita!

reviews.author: Kim Cataldo
reviews.text: I wish I could give Diagle Plumbing & Heating Derry10 stars!! Team-Bobby, Greg & Jeremy. What an asset to the company! Had my furnace replaced and couldn't be happier with the level of work and knowledge of these guys. They explained everything to me in terms that I could actually understand.  Super friendly, arrived on schedule (actually earlier) and cleaned up like they were never even there. You just gained a very satisfied customer. I would 100% recommend them to anyone looking for heating & plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Jean C.
reviews.text:
I called Daigle Plumbing and Heating on 1/22/26 requesting service for my furnace. The woman who answered the phone was friendly, polite & responsive. Fortunately for me, she was able to have someone come out on 1/23/26 between 8am-10am.
The 2 techs arrived on time, serviced my furnace & made an adjustment to one of the parts that was creating a banging noise. They were very neat & respectful of my property. They explained the details of the service they performed & provided a receipt detailing everything they did.
I was so impressed with the service from all the staff from start to finish & would highly recommend Daigle Plumbing and Heating for any of the many services they offer!
Thank you again to the Daigle Plumbing and Heating Team!

reviews.author: Margo Denison
reviews.text: Jason from Daigle Plumbing & Heating did a great job for us.  He was courteous, on time, had great pricing & a good sense of humor.  He installed a new faucet among other things.  I won’t hesitate to call on them again!

plumbers.name: The Clean Plumbers - Tampa
plumbers.address: 14545 N Florida Ave, Tampa, FL 33613, USA

reviews.author: goose goose
reviews.text: What a great experience with the clean plumbers.  Eric Young probably won't answer my phone calls anymore because of how much I called him and asked him for pictures and camera footage. The buyers realtor were obsessively annoying and needy. Needless to say, luis and Steve did a hydro jet job on the house and I was able to close without a problem, to make a very long story short. Thank you fellas for working your tails off ahead of time so that I could close on-time. I really appreciate your professionalism, and dedication throughout the entire process. I couldn’t have asked for a better team, and I highly recommend The Clean Plumbers to anyone who wants the job done right the first time

reviews.author: susan massey
reviews.text:
I had my gas hot water heater replaced today. Mike Mihal and Reagan Blake were on site at 10 am and left at 12 noon. The installation included new water supply connectors, gas reflex lines pressure relief valve and expansion tank as required by code. The existing setup was a difficult one but these two with their team efforts were able to accomplish the task.

The team were certified professional plumbers and their job was exceptional. Now I know that some think that it is a little pricey but I do not mind the price for a certified, well trained professional team of plumbing associates as well as the customer services that I received along the way. This was impressive. So today I signed up for The Clean Club Membership for priority scheduling for any other plumbing services I will have in the future.

reviews.author: Stella ventucci
reviews.text:

For what appeared as an anxious project dealing with sewer plumbing blockage, Erick's calm and polite manner overshadowed any anxiousness I had. He explained everything in detail and showed tremendous patience, as we waited for another technician to arrive. When it came time for my options ,He was eager to speak jointly with my son via telephone, so I would have another input for my final decision. I am so satisfied with Erick and Clean Plumbers that my best interest came first, and I would not hesitate to recommend them as a trustworthy and honest dealership.

reviews.author: charlotte young
reviews.text: Adam was delightful and efficient. I called him “Magic Fingers,” because he solved several issues by simply adjusting the valves or whatever. He also solved the more major issues that needed addressing. I would highly recommend him, and thus, Clean Plumbers, for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Ray L

reviews.author: Macy W
reviews.text: Wow this company is amazing. My husband worked with a guy named Sean who was very knowledgeable and helpful. The two guys the sent were so lovely, Josh and Spencer were absolutely kind, respectful, knowledgeable, provided details and happily answered questions. They were thorough and clean. But honestly that’s what you pay for and these things aren’t cheap. I’m glad we went with this company and will be returning.

reviews.author: aaron weeks
reviews.text: John was on time, thorough in his work, and did a great job. I have pvcp piping and hate any job where I have to mess with it. I would highly recommend them and will use them again with confidence. Thanks, John! Nice work.

reviews.text: Brody was rad!  He and his partner were super personable and professional. They came the same day I called. Updated my old broken pipes and new nozzles. Very clean, and they even added nail plates, so the contractors won’t accidentally puncture the new pipes. I’m super happy with the service. Thank you Alchemy!!!

reviews.author: Ivan Redding
reviews.text: Josh was really great and friendly and so was his apprentice. They both had an attitude of wanting to be there and execute the job well. reviews.author: paul modesitt
reviews.text:
The two technicians were Brody Diaz De Leon and the other gentleman, whose name I did not catch. The repair involved replacing a 4-inch building drain that had already been agreed upon. They cut out and removed the 4-inch-long ABS 90. Once removed, they installed a new glue coupling a new 4-inch long-term ABS 90.

The technicians from Alchemy are always polite and always efficient. In the last few months, we had a leaking pipe in the ceiling that was fixed, and then the main waterline in the crawlspace of our house was also fixed. When they came to do that second repair, they pointed out that the 4-inch building drain needed to be repaired. So that’s what they repaired today.

I hope I don’t see them for a while, not because of their work. Their work is fantastic, but because I hope we don’t have any more leaks in the near future in our home, the next time I do need some plumbing work done, I always know who to call, and that’s Alchemy Plumbing. I included a few photos for reference. Highly recommend them for any plumbing work; they are reliable, honest, and thorough every time.

They got the job done quick and fit us in with their busy schedule. I appreciate it and definitely will be using them again in the future.

reviews.author: diane choi
reviews.text: I’m a property manager, and Allen’s Plumbing is my go to plumbing company. They are consistently responsive, quick, and friendly. When I call in a repair early in the morning, they are often able to send someone out the same day. I’ve worked with many plumbing companies, and Allen’s pricing is hard to beat. Most recently, Davin assisted with a plumbing repair and was extremely professional. He clearly explained the issue, walked me through my options, and answered all of my questions with patience and care. Thank you Allen’s plumbing for making my job easier by being amazing!

reviews.author: Russell Nakamura
reviews.text: Technician - Karl R. - did an outstanding job. Arrived on time, was extremely competent and professional. Karl explained his plan and kept me informed of the progress. He was very thorough and I was very satisfied. He was very good and would love to have him on any of my jobs again.

reviews.author: Colin Higa
reviews.text: Great work by plumber Bennett.  Bennett arrived on time and did a great job in a timely manner. I learned a few things watching him work and he gave me some advice to keep my drain clean and clear on a daily basis.  Highly recommend using Allen’s Plumbing.

reviews.author: Wayne Ajimine (Waji)
reviews.text:
We noticed indications of clogged drain pipe on Monday night, 11/24.  Called Allens Plumbing on Tue. morning and they managed to get tech to me in late afternoon.  He confirmed a drain issue and removed the master toilet to run a snake from there.  He managed to get the flow going and also checked the pipe with a camera.  Show me a section in the pipe water was still present, which indicated that section was not straight and had dip.  This would be an expensive repair if we decided to get it done.  In the meantime we will occasionally run some extra water through the drain to try and keep that section clear of debris (like toilet paper).  We could have run the snake from a shower stall drain but I wanted the wax ring seal on the toilet replaced anyway.

Our tech, Jesse, was very courteous.  He did the work very efficiently and explained everything clearly and completely.  He kept everything nice and clean.  You could not tell any such work had occurred in the bathroom.   I was very satisfied with the service and it was well worth the money spent.  I will use Allens Plumbing again if the need arises and recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work done.

reviews.author: Won Chung
reviews.text:
I’m really glad I listened to Chris and Larry’s recommendations. They were extremely professional, knowledgeable, and went above and beyond during the service. They checked all the major systems — water pressure, the pressure-reducing valve, both expansion tanks, and more — and took the time to explain how everything works and how to properly maintain the water heater.

The anode rods were definitely at the end of their life and truly needed replacement. I wouldn’t have known to take care of that if it weren’t for Chris and Larry’s advice. They recommended upgrading to power anode rods, which is a much better option than the standard ones, and I really appreciate their honesty and expertise.

They also replaced both expansion tanks. Even though the second one wasn’t completely full, they proactively swapped it out for peace of mind, which I really valued.

Overall, I now feel confident that I won’t have to worry about my water heaters for a long time, aside from routine annual maintenance. Huge peace of mind thanks to Chris and Larry.

reviews.author: Bill Wetherbee
reviews.text:
​I still recommend CR plumbing!  Their technicians do an excellent job; they are always honest with me and the price is fair.  I was especially impressed this time with Caleb and Andrew because they ran into several issues with the original plumbing install (details below), they did things the right way and it did not increase the price.

I called CR Plumbing this time because we had a problem with the water pressure in the house​.  The first thing they did was to measure the pressure with no water running and again with several fixtures turned on and we​ definitely had a pressure valve problem.  They also looked at the water heaters (since they are affected by the pressure) and found that we needed a new expansion tank.  The old one was full of water and had been making noises when we ran hot water.   Caleb and Andrew gave me a price; I agreed and they got started.

One of the issues they had to deal with was a bad ​(acute) angle of the pipe in the ground.  Rather than forcing another bad angle, They built a clever connection (see picture).  When replacing the water heater expansion tank they used a bigger one that was up to code and anchored to ​a stud in the wall.  The old one was just attached loosely.

Caleb and Andrew stayed and did the job right even though it got a bit late and dark. The price did not change from the original estimate and the maintenance plan saved us money.​  As long as CR keeps doing a good job like this, we will be calling and recommending them.

Electrical Service
I had a problem with an outlet and GFI.  I tried replacing them but kept having an issue.  I had good results with CR's plumbing and A/C services, so I tried their electrical service.  Timing was very fortunate since the technicians just finished another job and were heading back. Andrew and Olaf are trained techs that CR just acquired from a company that recently shut down.  They determined that not only was one of the CFIs bad, but I had two CFIs on the same circuit.  I'm guessing that a lot of CR's work is from builders who don't do things the right way.  The net is that they did a great job, tested everything, made sure all the plugs and plates matched and kept me posted along the way.  I hate when I have to call CR, but I know they will get things fixed right.

Heating System
I had CR come out to test the heating system.  It felt like the temp was not warm enough coming out of the upstairs unit.  I wanted to get ahead of this if it was a problem.  Ian measured the temp coming out and checked for leaks.  Turns out that there was not a heating problem, but the air was blowing directly on my visiting daughter and will just get a different vent to change the air direction.  CR called this routine maintenance and it was no charge.  I will definitely be using them again for any HVAC, plumbing or electrical work.

reviews.author: Chloe Saltarelli
reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience with this plumbing team.  Chris & Jeff were prompt, professional, and extremely knowledgeable. They took the time to explain the issue and the solution, and the work was completed efficiently and with great attention to detail. It’s hard to find service providers you can truly trust, and these guys exceeded our expectations. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: We had Robert come out to change a valve and install a trim kit. He was super nice and professional. We are super happy with the results and would always come back to Robert at Pippin Brothers if we needed anything else.

reviews.text: Mr Codoponey was the an individual sent out to trouble shoot the problem of no hot water after the initial installation. The problem he encountered with the hot water was above his level of experience. He said the company would have to send someone else out. Mr Robert came out about 6:00 pm and diagnosed the problem with minutes. He said it was a burner unit problem. He asked me did I wanted it fixed that night or wait until Monday, I said I would like to have hot water over the weekend. So he said it will be done. He told me he would have to go back to the company and get another burner unit and that would take about an hour. So he left and returned within an hour with the unit.
