He said he had been doing this for 37 years and his experience showed. Mr Robert is a real asset to the Pippin Brothers company. He's a fine man. I thank him for his service. Willie Cummings

reviews.author: Leslie Greiner
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying that we all know how difficult it is to find a genuine person nowadays in any trade. Especially a person that's not money driven or just trying to make a sale.

Robert came out to my home for an estimate to install a tankless water heater and filtration system this morning.  He arrived right on time and was extremely polite and no chip on the shoulder, ( that in itself was refreshing). I explained what my husband and I were wanting to do and I got different quotes based around what would be best for our needs/wants. He payed attention to what I was saying and even gave different ideas to help make our project more obtainable.

I had also shown Robert our conundrum under our kitchen sink ( which is a different project at a different time,) and put me on contact with someone to help with that project as well. It's very hard to find people nowadays to just be genuine or offer friendly advice ( without being charged) and Robert was the guy that did just that. Robert was personable and polite. Definitely an asset to any company.

I understand a lot of people may not want someone to come to a job that takes there time and hears what they want done and gives advice on making that come true, however they're people like myself that would like to be heard about what they would like to see done and not feel like they just gave there money to a company that could care less about there family or home.

I have not had the work done just yet but definitely had a great start.

Gratefully, potential client,
Leslie Franklin

I'm giving 5 stars for service

Hopefully it with be 5 stars on install and performance.

reviews.author: Michelle LaPointe
reviews.text: We had an outstanding experience with Precision plumbing from start to finish. reviews.author: monica johnson

reviews.text: Worked with Mike, extremely personable, knowledgeable and thorough. Helped me through a kitchen sink clog and snaking of the drain. Wouldn’t leave until he knew the problem was handled and I was satisfied with the work. He was a great from start to finish and an asset to your team.

reviews.author: Kevyn Rakowski
reviews.text:
Roto-Rooter came within 2 hours of when I called.  Having a backed up kitchen sink 2 days before Christmas is not fun.  The technician was great!  He gave me an estimate and when I gagged, he gave me a discount that was better than their on-line coupon.  He also made sure to tell me the work came with a 6 month guarantee.  My regular plumber's is only 2 months.
He quickly started to work and removed the clog from the main pipe.  He also told me the configuration of the current pipes was not ideal, which I knew.  But unlike my regular plumber who quoted me an estimate to fix the configuration, this technician told me how to fix it myself.  Great guy! He saved me money and my Christmas baking! I would definitely recommend Roto-Rooter!

reviews.author: Carla M
reviews.text:
Sean 4581 came to my home to clear a blocked sewer line. It was the second blockage I’d had in five months causing flooding in my basement and thousands id dollars worth of damage. Sean came to my house having already read the notes from the previous service calls. I found that noteworthy because he came with knowledge of the history and also with a clear sense that we had not yet identified the root cause of the problem. I was impressed by that.

He cleared the line and then used a camera to investigate further. Ultimately, he diagnosed the problem and spent a good amount of time explaining the problem, the cause, and a proposed solution. He also clearly explained why the estimated cost to fix it was as high as it was. He understood I needed to get other estimates and was respectful in his communications with me as he waited for me to let him know whether I had chosen Roto Rooter to perform the work. Although I chose not to use Roto Rooter for the repair, I trust this technician’s skill and his ability to properly diagnose and solve problems. Had Roto Rooter’s pricing been more competitive, I would have used them because I had so much confidence in the way Sean triaged, explained the problem, and managed the issue.

I appreciated that the company waived the fee for clearing the pipes when Sean visited since the problem reoccurred in such a short period of time.

Sean 4581 is a consummate professional and an excellent representative of Roto Rooter. He is someone I would not hesitate to hire or to have in my home addressing complex plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Anne Ingoldsby
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Brandon. He came out quickly, was punctual and courteous, and took the time to listen before getting started. He replaced an old pipe that wasn’t up to standard with a much higher-quality solution and completed the job efficiently. The pricing was fair, and the workmanship was top-notch. It’s hard to find reliable professionals like this — highly recommend!

reviews.author: Carlos Gonzalez
reviews.text: Outstanding new water heater purchase, removal and installation, all in one afternoon. Tom Kessinger is one heck of a professional. Tom did not over promise or under deliver. He delivered on all aspects as promised. Very happy with my decision to go with Benjamin Franklin Plumbing Co. Will be looking to have all of my plumbing needs with Ben Franklin Plumbing.

reviews.author: Lisa Wildenhaus
reviews.text: Never a convenient time when water pipe breakages happen!  Monday evening on a holiday. I called Benjamin Franklin at 9:20 pm with an emergency call. Tom K. was the service tech assigned. He contacted me within 30 minutes of my call to let me know he was enroute. He showed up well presented, clean cut and in uniform. Very well mannered, professional, and knowledgeable. After I explained what happened and the action I had taken, he explained my options. He was thorough and made sure I understood everything. We decided on the least costly option knowing that after he opened a small hole in the drywall would determine whether I would have a larger problem or not. Fortunately for me it was not the worse case scenario and it was something Tom could fix. He was finished within a couple hours and I had water again.  I cannot express enough, my gratitude for Tom K. and Benjamin Franklin.  I will not hesitate to contact them for any future plumbing repairs and/or new installations.

reviews.author: Keith Gruendl
reviews.text: Tom was very helpful and professional as well as his employee he was training. Both provided us some other plumbing options and were pretty thorough. We decided to go with them in the initial visit, which we did not do with a couple other firms giving us bids. They made a very reasonable adjustment to their bid staying competitive and their knowledge and professionalism made the decision easy for us. They also came prepared to immediately do the replacement of our water heater. Very happy. Thank you

reviews.author: Jim Shepherd
reviews.text: The guys did a great job installing my water softener and filter system, and did it same day!  Not the cheapest I was quoted (or the most expensive), but they provided additional value by flushing and cleaning my tankless water heater (which I hadn’t even considered).  Now I have pure water throughout!

reviews.author: Shontay Lovett
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Seth from Michael & Son Services. From start to finish, he was professional, knowledgeable, and extremely thorough. He took the time to explain exactly what needed to be done and why, and he provided before-and-after photos so I could clearly see the work that was completed.

What I appreciated most was his transparency and patience. He answered all of my questions without hesitation and made sure I felt comfortable with the process. You can tell he takes pride in doing the job correctly — not just quickly.

If you’re looking for someone who values quality workmanship and clear communication, I highly recommend Seth. He definitely earned this 5-star review!

reviews.author: Johnson Family
reviews.text: Extremely professional, knowledgeable and courteous. He wired and installed our double oven, as well installed a box for our range oven. The best electrician we have ever hired. He went above and beyond and made sure things were done right. I would definitely recommend Orian.

reviews.author: Jessica Bishop
reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience with Standrick! He was professional, punctual, and extremely knowledgeable. He even fit us in last minute, which we truly appreciated. He took the time to explain the issue in a way that was easy to understand and made sure everything was completed safely and efficiently. The work was neat, fairly priced, and done right the first time. It’s such a relief to find someone reliable — we’ll definitely be calling them again for any future electrical needs. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Stepan Stepanyan
reviews.text: We recently replaced our 50-gallon water heater tank because the old one was leaking. Before making a decision, I had estimates from a couple of other companies as well. Jason Bernasconi from Michael & Son was by far the most knowledgeable and very pleasant to work with. He explained everything clearly, proposed a few options, and offered a 12-year warranty. That gave us confidence to move forward with him. The work was completed the very next day and took only a few hours. Everything was done to our full satisfaction. I marked “Reasonable Price,” although I think if you shop around, you may find quotes that are 20–25% lower. That said, the warranty and overall peace of mind made it worth it for us.

reviews.author: Grace Lawrence
reviews.text: Orion Jacobs did an outstanding job servicing my generator. Orion arrived at the scheduled time. What I really appreciated was the fact that he called to let me know he was in route. Orion also shared some valuable information about specials on having my heating and air conditioning serviced as well with the warm weather approaching, that will be next on my list. Michael and Son prices are very reasonable. Thanks Jacob.

reviews.text: No words for the professional workers, Jeff & Aquices...They went above and beyond to do the very best installation.  They are so polite and knowledgeable.   Cleaned everything after work was completed.  Ran was the genius that figured out exactly what I needed with an affordable price.  No pressure and answered all questions.....I would give them 10 stars if permitted.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Porter
reviews.text: We needed to replace our 30+ year old heat pump that died in the middle of the night. Technician Ran came out on a Sunday and advised us to replace our unit. He scheduled us for the next day and kindly repaired our old unit to keep us cool until the new one was installed. Technicians Jason and Kirill installed the new unit the next day. They took their time explaining the installation process. I appreciated how polite and kind they treated us. They made all sorts of unexpected improvements to bring our new heat pump up to code. Overall we were very happy with the workmanship provided.

reviews.author: Lina Lome
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Anna's Air -Heat and Plumbing , especially with Chris. His customer service went above and beyond my expectations. He was very thorough, knowledgeable, and professional throughout the inspection of my AC unit. Chris took the time to answer all of my questions and explained everything clearly. I truly appreciated his honesty, patience, and attention to detail. I highly recommend this company and especially Chris for anyone needing AC service.

I will absolutely be using Grant and Anna’s Air, Heat and Plumbing on future projects, especially throughout Brevard County. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Deborah A Adelman
reviews.text: I am so appreciative of Sean and 24-7 Rooter and Plumbing. At 7:30 on a Saturday night our toilets and shower were backing up. Sean arrived just over an hour later, explained the options and cleared the line before it got messy.  He is knowledgeable, helpful and left our home clean.

reviews.author: Andi Trindle Mersch
reviews.text: Very prompt service. Ernesto was thorough, efficient,  and he provided tips for future prevention. He was also very conscientious in cleaning up and ensuring I felt the work was complete.

reviews.author: Sarah Bauder
reviews.text:
We had a geothermal system installed when we built our home, knowing that it was an energy efficient system that we wanted to last for a number of years. We invested in a “top-of-the-line” model, and 8 years in had a small leak in the water tank affiliated with the system.  When I reached out to our installer twice, he never returned our calls or texts, so we had to do some hunting to find a company willing and knowledgeable to come look at it. We had a company “service” it once that SAID they could fix it, but they left saying they couldn’t figure it out, but that they would research and get back to us. After not hearing from them for a few weeks, I called back and was told they would be calling me soon - no one ever returned my call.

My husband and I desperately began looking again for an HVAC company that serviced geo systems, and THANKFULLY we came across Wind Bender, who not only sent someone out in a reasonable time frame, but also openly communicated with us about everything. When Matt came out, he serviced the unit, tried a few things to repair the system, but when that didn’t work, he let us know! Just a week or two later, we heard from them that they were going to try another part, and if that didn’t work, they would contact the manufacturer to replace the unit. The part didn’t work as we hoped, so they proceeded to order the replacement tank, which was under warranty), and today they replaced it.

Not only were the technicians polite, respectful of our home, and knowledgeable, but Matt pointed out to me today before he left that our system wasn’t being used optimally.  He proceeded to show me how to make a simple change on our thermostat to make the system run and ensure maximum energy efficiency.  You can’t ask for better service than that!  Wind Bender will be our service provider from now on.

reviews.author: Charlie Ogle
reviews.text: I recently had a tankless hot water heater installed and couldn't be happier. Wind Bender was professional and knowledgeable. They took the time to explain my options, walked me through the benefits of going tankless, and made sure I felt confident about the upgrade.

reviews.author: Tonie Reed

I pray that AHS will add this company to my preference list.   Thank you wind Bender for restoring my faith with having an awesome experience  during a difficult time when having plumbing issues. You Rock!!

Sincerely

Toni R.

reviews.author: Taylor Burkette

They took the time to not only explain what exactly was going on, but to make sure there wasn’t anything else I needed. It was so nice to have someone fix our issue, explain it, and take the time to show it was important to them as well. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Leona Scobee
reviews.text: This was my first experience with Benjamin Franklin Plumbing.  John Axford replaced my bathtub faucet system.  Didn't take him long either.  With original 1947 fixtures, he did an awesome job in getting rid of the leaky pipes.  He cleaned up the work area after finishing; was like he hadn't been there.  Would definitely recommend him to others needing help with their plumbing.

reviews.author: Naomi R
reviews.text: Austin was fairly quick to come out and asses the problem. I had a water pipe leaking under ground. Instead of charging me a lot of money for what felt like a hopeless attempt to get into the leak we stopped for the night. He came bacl the next day and got the leak fixed. I am very satisfied the work done will ensure the area will not be a problem again for many years.

reviews.author: Nancy Charlton
reviews.text: Had water leak, but didn’t know where it was at. I looked and a friend looked underneath the house and out in the yard and we could not find anything. Chad from Benjamin Franklin came out and he looked. We couldn’t find anything, but we finally decided it had to be in the area where the septic tank was. Chad dug down around the area and actually found where the water was running loose underneath around the septic tank. The electrical pipe was forcing pressure down on the water pipe. He fixed the pipe to go up and over the electrical pipe so I wouldn’t have that problem again. The septic had probably settled some because of that problem. Thanks to Chad for doing all the digging and getting the problem fixed. He was very courteous, prompt, and a very good worker.

reviews.author: Laduanda Hill
reviews.text: The plumber was very kind. He walked into my house that was smelling of backed up sewage. He remained professional and got the job done in a timely manner. I really appreciate how efficient and helpful he was from start to finish. Thank you Benjamin Franklin Plumbing for being prompt taking care of my needs from start to finish.

reviews.author: Regina Winkles
reviews.text: Had a water heater leak in my garage from the ice storm and they came out and got me a new water heater, installed it, all in the same day so I didn't go without hot water. And even called the restoration service to get them out right away to help dry out any damage. Definitely 5 star service.

reviews.author: Jake Lilevjen

reviews.author: David Watson
reviews.text: Trevor and Gabriel were very quick in answering our request on having our toilets. After Trevor patiently  answered all our questions, we agreed and Heather called us later to make our appointment. Trevor and Adam came out on time and were very professional in their demeanors and finished the installations very effectively. There was no mess left and they carted off the old toilets.  We are very happy with the work they performed. And we especially like the soft close lids and seats. We would highly recommend Southside Plumbing.

reviews.author: Michelle Teti
reviews.text: The Southside team was great. We discovered a leak under our kitchen sink leading to the dishwasher and Southside was able to fit us in same day. Trevor was great. reviews.author: Walt Jaakkola

We felt like we were in very good hands and would definitely use Chris and Southside Plumbing for future repairs and projects.

reviews.author: Tricia Stefaniak
reviews.text: Southside plumbing has over the years proven to be the most reliable, professional experts who treated us with incredible care. Trevor, Adam, and Gabriel were absolutely fantastic. From beginning to end this experience was seamless and felt like family!! Thank you

reviews.author: Natalie Huschka
reviews.text: We required original pipes to be replaced in our home from the kitchen sink to a drain located under the basement floor (concrete).  Avid was quick to respond and offer us options. They honored the quote that was 2-3 months old by that point and coordinated repairs quickly.  Finished everything in less than two days and left the area cleaner than before they arrived.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sami Cowan
reviews.text:
Eric was so professional, was able to find some hidden problems, and everything was at a price that didn't break the bank. Everyone at Avid has been very kind and detailed when conducting their work and showing me exactly what they were fixing and provided clear, next steps for me.
I'll be using them again for future services and I'll be recommending them to friends and other businesses I know!

reviews.author: Jeanette Comstock
reviews.text: Excellent work all around. From calling and speaking with Brian who was patient, helpful, and knowledgeable to Andrew our plumber and his assistant installing our water heater. Will definitely be using Avid again and highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tracy Palmer
reviews.text:
Avid Plumbing deserves every bit of this 5-star review. I’m a salon owner, and our water heater completely failed in the middle of a busy workday with over 10 stylists fully booked — it was incredibly stressful. Avid was able to arrive the same day, quickly diagnose the problem, and clearly walk me through all of my options. The owner took extra time — even after hours — to explain how everything worked and answer every question I had without rushing me.

They understood the urgency of our situation and had the needed parts ready and installed first thing the next morning. Colton, who handled most of the service, was professional, courteous, and easy to talk to. He explained things in a way that wasn’t intimidating, especially since I don’t have much plumbing knowledge.

In less than 24 hours, we went from having no hot water to being fully operational again. Their responsiveness, communication, and professionalism were outstanding. I highly recommend Avid Plumbing.

reviews.author: Mark Estes
reviews.text: We had some pipes freeze up in her house with an urgency to be fixed so I searched Google and found Mr. Rooter. I called them up and they had somebody out within the next day which I was really surprised. Craig showed up right on time and was very professional and upfront about the cost and things that it would need going forward he went above and beyond explaining everything to me that was needed to get the water going again he had to crawl into a very small crawlspace underneath the house Which most plumbers would not even do considering the technicality in it he went under there and videotaped everything for me to show me the problems that were going on and then gave me a fair price to have everything done correctly. He spent probably over two days there working on this to get it done correctly. He went above and beyond and stayed late to get the job done and subzero temperatures. He was more concerned about me and my kids that himself. He finally got everything unfroze and new pipe was added. The price was exactly where I needed to be at when I thought it was going to be thousands. I can’t say enough about Craig in the job that he did. He is very thorough professional, and on point with his company. Communication was excellent as well with Missy. You can’t go wrong with this company. You will not be disappointed, thank you so much. This house is over 200 years old so he had really troubleshoot to fix it!

reviews.author: S Lange
reviews.text: Marco did an excellent job clearing our kitchen sink drain and redoing the undersink piping.  Very quick work, cleaned up completely before he left.  Drain works so much better!  Highly recommend Marco to take care of your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Éadaoin Ilten
reviews.text: The team at Mr. Rooter were friendly and professional. Very clear about what might be possible and potential outcomes. They even came in a snowstorm to check out our issues! Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Kellie Bauman
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience with Mr. Rooter! We had a gas leak coming from our water heater and they were able to get to us right away, fix the leak and then come out the next day to replace the water heater. Our tech, Ryan, was very personable, friendly and professional!

reviews.author: Cindy Smith

reviews.author: Katie Kearney

reviews.author: Amber Ivey

It’s clear they take pride in their work, and I appreciated the honesty and fair pricing. I wouldn’t hesitate to use Brooks Plumbing again and highly recommend them to anyone needing reliable plumbing services.

reviews.author: Tyler Campbell
reviews.text: Brooks is amazing. Prompt, courteous, fair, and always goes above and beyond to make sure their customers are satisfied. I use them for all my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Dana Rudisill
reviews.text: My garbage disposal had gone bad.  I called James Plumbing.  I got the answering machine at first, but the lady in the office (Linda) called me back in a very timely manner. He came straight in and got to work. Within 20 minutes, he had me a new disposal installed and he was a very pleasant young man.  He even showed me how to unlock the blade if it ever jammed up on me.  I highly recommend James Plumbing for all your plumbing needs!  Thank you Linda and Johnathan for taking care of me in a very timely fashion!

reviews.author: Terry Carrier
reviews.text: Wonderful service. I called at 10:00 am this morning for a clogged drain and they had someone here by 1:15. The plumber fixed everything in 20 minutes. He was very pleasant and knowledgeable. Very impressive company.

reviews.author: Jen “JT”
reviews.text: We needed a plumber to fix an issue for us and we needed them right away. James plumbing was out the next morning. Had the problem addressed and fixed in an hour tops! Super nice guys and great work! Will definitely continue to use them at our business!

reviews.author: Michelle Lee
reviews.text: Suzette was fantastic in the office in helping me to get her all the necessary information  give me all the options for my hot water tank that burst last week! Definitely went the extra distance to find and dig up my city water valve that no one else has been able to find! Outstanding! And very thankful for their speedy and professional service I will always call James Plumbing for all of my plumbing needs!!!

reviews.author: Tony Mostek
reviews.text: We would highly recommend James Plumbing. After a recent snowstorm, they were able to come out the next day. All the other plumbers couldn't come out for a few days. plumbers.name: Cowboy Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 1269 Summerwood Dr #401, New Braunfels, TX 78130, USA

reviews.author: Margaret López
reviews.text:
We had a small problem with a pipe that became disconnected under our sink. With Thanksgiving in a few days, the LAST thing we needed was a non-working sink!

I called our local plumbers but they weren't able to see us until after the holiday.

I contacted Cowboy Plumbing, and they were able to get someone out within an hour and a half! (I realize that may be a bit unusual, but I'm grateful anyway.)

Gary Gilbert showed up and VERY professionally handled our problem! He was courteous and friendly and answered all my questions.

The cost was reasonable and I appreciate the professionalism!

I highly recommend Cowboy Plumbing for any plumbing needs!

Thanks, Cowboy Plumbing!

reviews.author: C V
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience with this plumbing company. Christian handled the removal of our old stove and installation of the new one seamlessly. He was punctual, knowledgeable, and made sure everything was properly connected and working perfectly before leaving. His positive attitude and professionalism really stood out. Excellent service from beginning to end.Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Alyssa Calderon
reviews.text: Gary arrived for what I thought would be a simple unclogging. The issue turned out to be a bigger issue. Gary and his service manager gave me all the details. Showed me the images of the camera snake job and clearly outlined the issue underneath the home. Although it wasn’t what I wanted to hear, we were presented with all the facts, worst and best case scenario. They both fit us to a place where the plumbing is fine, however there are repairs to consider. We were also given recommendations to maintain plumbing functionality in our home and best practices.

reviews.author: wendy m
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience with Cowboy Plumbing.  I had a leak in one of the pipe's outside of my house.  I called Cowboy based on a recommendation from my neighbor and I am glad I did.  They quoted me an arrival time between 8am and 11am and were there before 9am.  Chandler and Junior were super nice and assessed the leak and what it would take to repair very quickly.  Chandler explained the pricing and warranty very thoroughly so there was no question about what I was receiving for their time and labor.  They replaced the piece of pipe with the crack and added insulation where it was lacking.  They re-routed the pipe so it was no longer hanging awkwardly and exposed.  They left the area way better than it was pre-leak.  Overall I was very happy with the service I received and would definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Eric Leach
reviews.text: Great service.  Highly knowledgeable, transparent, and friendly.  I had an issue and they showed up in 15 minutes.  They kept me up to date as things needed to change without pressure either way.  I'd highly recommend them if you have an emergency.

plumbers.name: Meetze Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2060 Hwy Church Rd, Elgin, SC 29045, USA

reviews.author: Kristin Renfro
reviews.text:
We are new to the area and had only been in our home for two weeks when we discovered a leak from an upstairs bathroom that was coming through the ceiling downstairs.

We called Meetze Plumbing on a Sunday, and they had a technician at our home that same afternoon. Neither the technician nor my husband were able to pinpoint the source of the leak during that visit, but the technician took the time to explain what to watch for and gave us several suggestions to help narrow it down. The service charge was very reasonable at $50.

The next day, we identified the source of the leak and called Meetze again. They scheduled us right away and had a technician at our home first thing Tuesday morning. The leak was repaired quickly, and they did not charge us for the return visit.

We were also impressed with their communication. They send an email when the technician is on the way, including the technician's name and photo, and the technician calls ahead with an estimated arrival time. Everyone we interacted with was polite, professional, and helpful. The technicians wore protective boot covers in our home and treated our property with respect.

Excellent customer service from start to finish. We will definitely use Meetze Plumbing again and would highly recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Fredrick Edge
reviews.text: Julian did a great job fixing my shower that had been dripping. He showed up early, communicated well throughout the whole process, and had great customer service. He also used shoe covers like we asked, checked things thoroughly, and didn’t try to overcharge or add on anything unnecessary. Overall, he was professional, respectful, and got the job done right. Definitely appreciate the good work.

reviews.author: Amy Graves
reviews.text: We have used Meetze Plumbing several times for various issues in our home. We have been pleased with our service each time. Jack was very professional and worked diligently to troubleshoot and narrow down the issue we were having with our water heater. He was upfront about the cost for his expertise. An electrician was able to fix a wiring issue, and our water heater started working immediately as Jack said it would. We appreciate the quick service call from Meetze. Jack is an honest and professional service provider.

reviews.author: Shirley Cush
reviews.text: Great service anytime I have a plumming issue. Service man I always prefer is Eli.  Professional and and always advise on things going on and things could happen as I’m sure all of the workers do the same. I’m old school, have a service man just used to his coming. I highly recommend Meetze Plumming for all issues and any needed repairs. They do give military discounts as I am a Veteran. Another great thing about the company.

reviews.author: Jill Davis
reviews.text: Had wonderful Meetze experience! Julian was our technician and he was extremely patient, thorough and effective in assessing all our questions and desired changes as well as completing a variety of projects in a single session. Thank you Julian!!

plumbers.address: 8872 Meade St, Westminster, CO 80031, USA

reviews.author: Kyra Silbernagel
reviews.text: We used Big Apple Plumbing to do our sewer line replacement and we were very happy with the work that was done. Jason was very quick to respond to our initial request for a 2nd opinion and sewer scope. He talked us through all of our options and patiently answered all of our questions. The actual work to replace the sewer line was completed extremely quickly and with super minimal impact to our yard, which we really appreciated!

reviews.author: Kelly McDowell
reviews.text: Sewer Line Replacement: Jason and his team were professional, excellent with communications keeping me in the loop every step of the process. This was a huge job replacing the entire sewer line from inside the house to the main line at the city sewer. I was so impressed by their professionalism, their work, the knowledge, taking the time to help me understand the job, communicating when they would be here, the status of the project and their clean-up. I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND them for any of your needs from the really large, extensive projects like mine, to any smaller projects. What a great company and crew! Thank you guys so much. I am very happy with your work and will recommend you anytime someone is looking!

reviews.author: Alexis McKinley
reviews.text: Jason and his team are amazing! We had a leak for who knows how long because we are very rarely in the basement and I called about 20 minutes before closing on a Sunday. Monday morning Jason came and assessed the situation which was drastic enough to be a 2 day job and from start to finish Jason was super professional and made sure to educate us the whole way through. The team made sure to lay down protective things for our floor and they were very efficient. I am very pleased with the outcome and am showing before, during and after photos. I would recommend this company anytime you need anything plumbing. Jason knows what he is talking about and exactly how to fix it right the first time. He made sure our clean out was placed in a proper place for future problems if plumbing is ever needed again. I am very thankful I called Big Apple Plumbing LLC!

reviews.author: Kevin Frame
reviews.text: Jason and Disraeli are amazing master plumbers. With the two of them working together, the new plumbing additions and replacement of old pipes went very quickly. They were able to meet every request I had and kept me informed throughout the entire job. They added a new washer box in the garage, new plumbing for a basement remodel including a new full kitchen, full bathroom, and washer/dryer. They also installed the new tub/shower, and frost free hose faucets leading outside. I will be using Big Apple Plumbing for all my future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Robert Sipe
reviews.text: I would like to express my gratitude to Big Apple Plumbing for sending Disraeli to resolve our clogged drain issue. Disraeli was extremely patient and clearly explained the entire repair process. We were very impressed with his professionalism and attention to detail. I highly recommend Big Apple Plumbing for any plumbing related needs.

plumbers.name: Reliable Heating & Air, Plumbing and Electrical - Athens
plumbers.address: 112 Park Ave #3, Athens, GA 30601, USA

reviews.author: Deandra Harris
reviews.text:
“Reliable” does not define the service we have received! While the customer service representatives are courteous and the technicians appear knowledgeable and receptive to our concerns-we have had 2 water leaks within 6 months, through our air conditioning/heater vent in the laundry room with no resolution. The last appointment occurred on February 5th and we were told the supervisor would follow up as the technician couldn’t find the problem. We have yet to receive a follow up correspondence from the supervisor, Dominick! In addition, we have been dissatisfied with previous maintenance appointments that have resulted in cancellation or no call/no show after taking time off of work. No one called to apologize or reschedule these appointments. Following this, we have requested Saturday appointments, when needed, that have been accommodated.

Secondly, we have received minimum documentation following scheduled  appointments, so much so, that I asked one technician if we could take a picture of the notes in his iPad. While some visits have resulted in a verbal explanation, typically at our request, proper documentation to the customer seems standard in customer service professions, especially when the call is for concern of the homeowner.

We expected more from Reliable! After the presentation from the sales person, we were sold on this company, and entered an agreement that required consistent maintenance and regular payments. While we have lived up to the agreement, Reliable has not! At this point, we are concerned about the leak that has damaged our ceiling in the laundry room without a follow up inspection for possible ceiling repair and/or a resolution for the leak, and a system that has not been properly maintained due to missed appointments.

Do we deserve the commitment that was promised to us? We surely think so!

reviews.author: Cory Cantrell
reviews.text: Everyone I worked with at Reliable was friendly and knowledgeable. The techs showed up on time, and always called to let me know when to expect them which was a plus. They did great work, and were very efficient. They also consistently asked me if I had questions or concerns. I’ll definitely call them up next I have a need for their services.

reviews.author: Matt Strum
reviews.text:

I would highly recommend Total Comfort for HVAC services.

I’d also like to thank Rob, Tim, Dawn, and the entire team for their coordination and efforts in making this project smooth and seamless.

reviews.author: Frank Rizzo
reviews.text: Leaking sink drain. Total Comfort is our plumber. Harry was dispatched and after listening to what I had done to identify the problem, was able to determine we had two leaks in our kitchen/bathroom drain line. He had to open the ceiling on our lower level and determined that a 70 year old cast iron pipe was the culprit. We required a re-pipe in a tight area and he was able to complete that successfully. Because of his thoroughness, this very bad problem has been solved. Had he not investigated the entire problem and looked at all of the piping, we certainly would have had to have them back here. I appreciated his professionalism and thoroughness to do the job right. But that is why Total Comfort is our plumber. I’ve added photos of the completed corroded piping. Pretty scary if you ask me.

reviews.author: John Al-Samarrie
reviews.text:
OK, this is overdue.  Last month I noticed water on the garage cement floor and thought it was just moisture.  After careful review I noticed that the water heater was leaking.  I called four different plumbers to get estimates with Drain Doctor being the first one I called.  A little history of my previous water heater is in order.  in 2019 I was overseas, and the heater broke and leaked all over the garage damaging some important personal items.  My girlfriend at the time called a plumber who installed a new heater and what a mess it was.  That plumber used galvanized steel for the inlet and outlet of the heater lines.  Routed the pressure relief pipe into the water heater pan rather than outside of the pan and installed my recirculating pump facing the side wall where I could not gain access.  Additionally, the gas line reservoir was installed by the water heater rather than near the gas line valve coming out of the wall.  There were no 2x4 boards in the back of the heater for earth quake bracing and the water lines were not earth grounded, all of which are city compliance requirement.  To say the least it was a cluster F.  When Bobby from Drain doctor showed up, he immediately pointed out the nonconformance of the water heater and gave me a bottom-line price from his standard pricing book which no other plumbers could beat.  Some quotes were almost double and after negotiating with those plumbers they got close to Bobby's price which didn't sit well with me.  So, I decided to go with Bobby and that proved to be fortuitist based on his efficient and compliant work.  Bobby is a plethora of plumbing information or more like a Wikipedia of plumbing.  He does have a laid back and straight forward attitude but don't let that fool you.  He's the top gun in his industry.  Anyway, I've read some of the negative reviews and in each case, there has been a unique set circumstance that all of us experienced in our daily life but over 99%+ of Drain Doctor reviews are very positive.  I can't tell you how happy we are with his work and in fact our outside main water line inlet valve was broken, unbeknown to us and we had him come back the next day to fix that as well.  I didn't bother getting other quotes because I knew Bobby would give us a competitive price but more importantly do the job right.
Anyway, you can't go wrong with Drain Doctor and ask for Bobby.  Bobby is your man.
Lastley, I don’t usually write reviews, but I was so impressed with the work I was compelled to write about our experience.
Thank you,
John A.

reviews.author: Janelle Leppink
reviews.text:
TLDR; Call these guys, they’ll take good care of you and your home 🙏 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟

We had a pretty stressful situation this morning when a toilet supply line randomly burst and sprayed water everywhere in our third floor bathroom. Before we knew it, water leaked down three floors through the walls, the ceiling, everywhere. Total nightmare.

We called Monkey Wrench Plumbing and they were able to get someone out the same day, which saved us. Kyle was our technician and he was great. Super down-to-earth, easy to talk to, and clearly knew what he was doing. He explained that the old builder-grade plastic supply line had failed (which apparently happens more than you’d think) and walked us through what he was going to replace it with.

He swapped out the cheap plastic line and valve for a braided metal one that’s much more durable and built to last. It feels good knowing we won’t have to worry about that happening again.

What really stood out was that they also helped get a restoration company out that same day to start dealing with the water damage. When you’re standing in a house with water coming through ceilings, that kind of quick coordination means everything.

Overall, just a really solid local company that shows up when you need them. Hopefully we don’t have another plumbing emergency anytime soon, but if we do, we’re calling them again without hesitation. Highly recommend.

Got everything back up and running the same day! Above all that, he believes in great customer service and I highly recommend him for any plumbing work in our area!

reviews.author: Karima Harris
reviews.text: Kirk came in. Got straight to work and did the work right and efficiently. He was reasonable with his pricing as well. I'd highly recommend Do it right plumbing 610 for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Daniel Thelemaque
reviews.text: Me and my family are relieved! Under the recommendation of Mr. Kirk Caldwell, the CEO of Do It Right Drains and Plumbing, I was able to get a 5 foot clog removed from my water line from a recommended company in Northeast Philadelphia. The service was swift and was priced very reasonably. I regret contacting my home warranty about this and should have contacted the one who was able to do it right the first time. Thank you Mr. Kirk!!!

reviews.author: Zhefeng Liu
reviews.text: Kirk is a true professional who loves his job and values his customers. I called late one night because I suspected that my main water line was frozen from this past weekend and he was extremely kind and immediately let me know that he will try to make it to me ASAP. I knew this is an usually cold season and understood that he had a lot going on, but he made sure to keep in contact with me every step of the way and it made me feel that he really cared and was trying to get to me. Luckily, my line thawed and I no longer needed his services, but he went above and beyond and called me to make sure I was doing ok. As a first time homeowner, it's really difficult to navigate home repairs, and Kirk made it feel friendly and easy, and I will definitely be reaching out for any future repairs!

reviews.author: Jen Lipshultz
reviews.text: Kirk did a large job repairing some shut off valves and copper pipe corrosion. He was prompt, upfront, and communicated along the way. He gave a low/high estimate as there was some uncertainty with the shutoff next to the meter working, and he clearly outlined the costs and work to be done for the prices before I agreed to the work. I appreciated the professionalism and great work! Can't recommend enough.

plumbers.name: Guaranteed Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 900 Cottman Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19111, USA

reviews.author: Rachel Snyder

They were helpful, ethical, and fairly priced. As a first time homeowner it is intimidating to have repairs done and not have fear you are being taken advantage of. Everything they quoted was fair and repairs were completed quickly. Very thankful I gave this place a call!

reviews.author: Chuck
reviews.text: Guaranteed Plumbing always does great work. Everyone I spoke with was friendly and extremely knowledgeable. I used them years ago to have all plumbing put in a brand new bathroom, and called them immediately when a frozen pipe burst. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Brandon Cubina

plumbers.name: Curtis Total Service
plumbers.address: 1415 E Pennsylvania St, Allentown, PA 18109, USA

reviews.author: Nathan Linder
reviews.text:
I trusted this company to install a new HVAC system a little over a year ago. I've gotten quite an education on systems since their install.

Essentially, they installed a VERY expensive communicating air handler to work with a base-level NON-communicating Heat Pump. ALL I knew at the time of install was that I was getting a new system. I had no idea how poor their choice of product was for my home until it was too late. I felt I had no choice but to act quickly because I was told my old oil furnace system was "red tagged" or unsafe to use. Truthfully, they offered 3 options: repair the current system, replace the current system, or go with a "highly-efficient, ultra modern" heat pump. They really pushed this system saying it was a certain seer level and that I would qualify for ALL sorts of rebates and incentives from the government - none of which happened.

Here are some more bullet points to help you make your decision on whether or not to use this company:

- left trash from the install in my yard
- had to come back the very next day after install because they installed the wrong type of thermostat
- had to come back a month after install to install a mysterious "box" under the air handler. I have no record of this work being done because they refuse to let me see the paperwork / invoice for it. This was Feb. 19th of 2025
- system formed a LITERAL block of ice in it after only a few days of using it to cool my home in the summer. Tech tried to chalk it up to some nonsense about difficulty shipping parts during covid (it was 2025 ... ) - ? They actually had to turn the system OFF in the middle of summer to let it melt while I slept in my attic that has separate AC. They added a small amount of coolant to the unit to "fix" the problem. See the photo.
- thermostat is off / wrong and always has been - they blame my old house, etc. - shouldn't these factors have been taken into consideration prior to the install? When I asked specific questions about the thermostat, the tech responded, "Well, we'd have to consult an expert for that". Aren't YOU supposed to be the expert!?!?
- NOTHING in my set up qualifies for any tax rebates or cash incentives from PPL.

After giving up and consulting a reputable company, we found:

- Heat pump had a leak and was pretty much running on VERY little coolant. This discovery was a stark contrast to the "all is good" seasonal maintenance updates that Curtis performed
- This was the result of a broken part that needed to be replaced. I also had to pay to have the unit flushed and restocked with coolant.
- New company was taking pics because they were in total and complete disbelief of how unprofessional and shoddy the installation was.

Final notes: Curtis Total Service is currently dealing with an ongoing lawsuit for taking advantage of customers not fluent in HVAC tech or that are elderly. My last conversation with their General Manager ended with him calling me "Stupid" because:, "You could have gone with ANY other company but us, did research, etc., but you chose us. You're stupid"

This company is an absolute fraud. If this review costs them even a dime, I'll be happy.

reviews.author: pradell pompilus
reviews.text: To be honest we have had not the best experience with Curtis in the pass with the system that we had installed... mainly the system then any one person at Curtis... But we stuck it out with them and did the rest of the work needed to get our system working correctly... were still getting accustomed to it... But as of today... we needed a professional and my wife didnt want to call Curtis... but I said I dont want to deal with someone who doesn't know what was done recently and who just installed our system... like taking a caddy to Lexus dealership... yes they work on cars... but they specialize in that brand... long story short... Curtis Sent John who not only was patient but very kind and very helpful... not only did he retrace the entire system in our house to find this small issue caused by a temporary install that another plumber didnt see but... but was kind to wait till our other plumber was able to capp off and fix his problem to fix ours... Thank you for sending John. Much Success to him.

reviews.author: Irene Platania
reviews.text: They were informative, honest, and completed the job to my satisfaction. Jason made me feel at ease, Brian did a great job of communicating and the workers took the time to do the job right. A great experience during a stressful time.

reviews.author: Lauren Hall
reviews.text: Jacob (master plumber) is exceptional. He is very knowledgeable about plumbing, especially older systems. He walks you through the entire process and checks all aspects of the system to ensure success after install. Jacob and Brian were incredibly communicative and responded to our call in a timely manner. They schedule the job quickly and helped us manage the problem until the proper parts came in. We felt taken care of throughout the entire experience. Do not hesitate, call Jacob and the team to assist you with your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Amber Rubin
reviews.text: AMAZING! So normally big name companies freak me out because you think you’re going to get a cookie cutter service but I was completely wrong. Thank you Roto-Rooter for a quick and efficient job and thank you Joe for helping make our lives so much easier in a crappy (literally) situation!

The technician, Jack E. was sincere and reliable, making the whole process stress free. I will definitely call them again for any water heater or major plumbing needs. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: TNT Home Services - Longmont
plumbers.address: 525 3rd Ave, Longmont, CO 80504, USA

reviews.author: Bill Parker
reviews.text: After 2 weeks, I have still not received a call back from Dan, Tyler or Angela at TNT.  In fact, I have not even received an invoice for work performed (or not performed).  Sadly, I had to dispute their charges through my credit card.  I would like to offer a better rating but this is the first time that I to give a "0".  Because of its excellent past ratings I decided to give TNT a try for a frozen pipe.  Boy am I sorry I did.  TNT confirmed my appointment between 8 - 10 AM.  I received a message that my technician was on his way at 8:25 AM.  I had to call the TNT dispatcher back twice to get why their technician was so late after being on his way at 8:25 AM.  Their TNT technician finally arrived at AFTER 10 AM.  Next, I showed the technician exactly where the pipe was leaking in the basement.  Since there was drywall, he said it would cost $530 just to cut into the drywall and nothing more.  I took out my portable saw out and cut around the leak for the TNT technician in four minutes.  The small split in my 1/2 inch copper pipe was immediately evident.  He gave me a price of $990 just to replace a 3 inch piece of copper with additional charges for any additional work at all.  After being late, not being updated on his lateness and outrageous pricing; I told the TNT technician to forget the work and charge me the $79 Water Line Repair Diagnostic advertised on their website that was agreed to at the time of my booking.  He refused to leave my house until I paid his $210 diagnostic charge.  TNT is a total rip off, and I fully expect their management to take care of its customers they advertise on their website ... "Behind all of the work we do is an unmatched level of honesty and integrity."

reviews.author: doug deam
reviews.text: From the beginning to the end the experience with TNT was excellent. Craig did an excellent job estimating the job, providing a very competitive quote, and answering all my questions. The installers Adam and Carlos also did an outstanding job in the installation process. They went the extra mile to make sure everything was installed and functioning perfectly. They were very gracious in answering my questions and teaching me the best maintenance practices. They were on time, courteous, and pleasant to work with. I highly recommend this company and give them 5 stars.   Doug

reviews.author: Amanda Oakland
reviews.text:
Our water heater has a slow leak, so we called TNT to come take a look at it. After a quick glance, the technician told me the water heater needed replaced. He went over pricing with me, and I asked him to send everything to me in an e-mail so I could look it over. He was very pushy about me committing to a new water heater right then and there, with several comments about how this "deal" and that "deal" were only available RIGHT NOW and if I waited until later the deal wouldn't be available and it would be more expensive. I asked him to still just e-mail me over all the info because I was not able to commit at that very moment (after all, this was a ~$4,000 purchase. I needed some time to think and discuss with my partner). Once he realized I would not be buying anything from him that day, his attitude soured pretty quick. I understand that these people want to sell their products and are just trying to make a living, so I don't fault him for trying to sell me a new water heater. However, once I made it clear that I needed some time to think, he should have respected that. His attitude and pushiness definitely lost my business.

I will also add that we had a different company come look at it a few days later, and that technician actually spent time inspecting the water heater, took off a panel to get a closer look, handed me a flashlight to let me look myself, explained how everything worked, etc. All TNT did was take a quick glance before declaring that it needed replaced.
And the other company happily offered a quote and told me to get back to him once I decided if I wanted to move forward. Not pushy at all.

What I DID like about TNT is that before the technician arrived,  they sent a text message with a photo of the technician. As a women who was home alone and letting a stranger into her house, I really appreciated this.

reviews.author: Steve Gardea
reviews.text:
Brent Burger was the sole reason why I did business with TNT Plumbing.
Initially, his colleague wanted to way overcharge me for a job, and the invoice they gave me was super vague and not transparent. And eventually TNT knocked several hundred dollars off to try and entice me to sign. The guy almost had me sign for the work without telling me what the signature was for first too. It felt like high pressure sales and like the price was negotiable somehow.
I had someone else do the work because of this, but only called TNT back because Brent was super friendly when he came with the other guy and I needed finishing touches done.
I'm so glad they sent Brent and not the other guy this last time. Brent is extremely friendly, very knowledgeable, not at all pushy, and the ultimate reason why I did business with TNT at all.
If this company knows what's good for them, they'll keep Brent. I'd say they also maybe need to improve on being more transparent with their invoicing and pricing, hourly, etc... But it's good to know if you research a fair price for the work you want done they're willing to negotiate. Also offered a military discount.
Thank you Brent!

I highly recommend Ken Neyer Plumbing.

He cleaned up afterward and it looked and worked great.  Thank you very much!

12/26/2025 -- We really appreciate how quickly you were able to respond.  Same day service and having a replacement water heater on board was fantastic for us.  Nathan did a great job and had great attention to detail and even cleaned up the site during and after the tank replacecent. He went over everything he was going to do at the start of the job and made sure we understood what was happening.  Hats off to Nathan (and Ken Neyer plumbing). Thank you for a job well done!

reviews.author: Ava Bettencourt
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Ken Neyer Plumbing! The woman I spoke with on the phone when I scheduled my appointment was kind and helpful, and I was able to get an appointment quickly. The technicians that provided our service (August and Noah) were friendly and professional. They explained what needed to be fixed and were transparent about the cost. I would recommend Ken Neyer Plumbing to anyone looking for a reliable plumbing service!

plumbers.name: United HVAC, Plumbing & Electrical
plumbers.address: 10531 Pineville Ave, Cupertino, CA 95014, USA

reviews.author: Chaozhong Lian
reviews.text:
I highly recommend United HVAC, Plumbing & Electrical! From start to finish, the entire process was incredibly smooth. They handled all the permits and inspections throughout the project, which gave us complete peace of mind. Every single technician we interacted with was friendly, approachable, and truly easy to work with.

I specifically want to give a massive shoutout to Max (Aiusha) and Rinat for their wonderful work.

Max is super professional and highly skilled. He installed my water heater and water softener with absolute "military precision." I'm the kind of guy who has a lot of weird, specific ideas about how pipes should be routed and extra gadgets I want installed to monitor the system, and Max handled all my requests with total ease. I am also super paranoid about plumbers plowing through studs or structural beams in my 1961 house, but Max was extremely careful and treated my home's structure with the utmost respect.

Rinat is also a fantastic plumber. He installed a PRV, a Moen Flo auto-shutoff valve, an RO system, and even replaced some of the old sewage pipes in my house. He really listened to all of my requests and finished the job quickly and professionally. I highly recommend him!

Because of their wonderful service, I’ve officially signed up for their company's membership. I am currently working with them to redo my HVAC ductwork, and I will definitely leave another review for that project once it's done. I'm sure they will do a wonderful job there, too!

reviews.author: Chaozhong Lian
reviews.text:
I wholeheartedly recommend United HVAC, Plumbing & Electrical. I recently hired them to replace the original 1961 HVAC ductwork in my house, and they did a wonderful, extremely professional job. I am beyond satisfied with the results.

You don't just have to take my word for it--I actually took pictures of their completed work, uploaded them to Google Gemini, and asked the AI to evaluate the installation. Even the AI praised their work, calling it a "top-tier, textbook installation"! (See the screenshots below).

During the bidding process, I compared United with another company. United's quote was slightly higher, but choosing them was absolutely the best decision. Their program manager, Tim, was incredibly easy to work with. He quickly identified asbestos tape on my 1961 ducts and insisted we use a C-22 licensed abatement company to remove it safely and provide all the legal documentation for future reference. The other company offered a cheaper route by doing the removal themselves, but for something as dangerous as asbestos, doing it by the book is well worth the minor price difference.

I also want to give a massive shoutout to Bair (Bayar) for his exceptional craftsmanship. He is easy-going, friendly, and really listened to all of my concerns. He provided great recommendations on how the new ductwork should be organized, and actually used a machine to fine-tune and balance the air pressure throughout the house. To top it all off, he even carefully reorganized the insulation in my attic after the work was done! It's this kind of attention to detail that makes them stand out.

The pictures speak for themselves. If you want true professionals who care about safety, honesty, and quality craftsmanship, go with United HVAC.

reviews.author: Henry C
reviews.text: Needed to have two circuits added for a couple ovens as well as one outlet moved.  Marc moved the outlet and updated old wiring for free in addition to installing the two circuits.  It was a big job and Marc made sure to get the job done before he left.  I’m very satisfied with the work that was done and really appreciate the extra effort that Marc put in.  While the quote was a little bit more than the other quotes I got, the estimate was clear, complete, and fair.  All in all, I am a satisfied customer and would definitely use United HVAC again.

reviews.author: W-J Wang
reviews.text:
My ADU bathroom plumbing is quite old, and I recently noticed very low water flow from the faucet. After cleaning the aerator, the water flow returned to normal, but the P-trap started leaking. Because the drain outlet was heavily rusted, Melvin assessed that a plastic P-trap would not work and that the old-style metal piping had to be used instead.

He made multiple trips to the store to find the correct metal P-trap, and later also discovered that there was a blockage inside the drain line, which he handled at the same time. Melvin was professional, patient, and thorough throughout the entire process. I really appreciate his persistence and would highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Ginger Perng
reviews.text: We had to replace the wax ring on our toilet.  Scheduling was easy; pricing was fair (much cheaper than the other quote we got!)  Our technician, Melvin, was polite and expedient.  This is our second time using United and highly recommend for gas and plumbing services.

plumbers.name: Z PLUMBERZ
plumbers.address: 9 S Park St, Ypsilanti, MI 48198, USA

reviews.author: Yu “Keanu” Zhang
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Z Plumberz. Brian and Kai came out to replace my old cast-iron vent pipe that goes through the roof from the attic. The job was especially difficult because my roof space is very low, and they actually had to crawl a long distance inside the attic to reach the pipe location.

Despite how challenging the work was, they stayed patient, professional, and careful throughout the entire process. You could clearly see they took pride in doing the job correctly instead of rushing it. I really appreciated their effort and workmanship.

I’m very happy I chose Z Plumberz and would absolutely use them again. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sharon Balduf
reviews.text: I had a leak coming from my ancient kitchen faucet. I called ZPlumberz in late afternoon and Angel was here at 9:00am the next day, quickly diagnosed the problem and replaced(and went to purchase) the entire faucet component and three stop valves. I instantly felt at ease with her. She knew her stuff, was meticulously neat and careful and respectful of property. I was back in business by noon!  I had complete faith in her knowledge and expertise. I will be requesting Angel if I have ANY further plumbing issues. She was awesome.

reviews.author: Mark Nock
reviews.text: I have some big issues with this job.  First, when I questioned their price, which I thought seemed high, I was told they expected the job to take "about 1 week or less".  That might justify the number they gave me.  But, it only took 2 days.  For most of my time as a manufacturing engineer at one of the "Big Three", part of my duties included specifying construction jobs and working with contractors.  I figured the job should have been around 62% of what they charged.  Shame on me for not getting a couple more bids.  They took absolutely NO precautions to protect my lawn, driveway, or front sidewalk.  Other contractors typically put down plywood and tarps.  After they filled in the dig area, I was left with sand all over the adjacent areas of the lawn, varying in depth up to about 2" - thick enough to kill the grass.  A small area of my driveway concrete was broken loose, and the front sidewalk is cracked, with part of the slab pushed down enough to leave a small trip hazard.  When I questioned them about making it right, they said that the estimate specified there would be no landscaping or concrete repair.  From this, my assumption was damage in the dig area was part of the job, to be expected.  That is true.  What I didn't expect was that their interpretation exempts them from taking due care during the job, and cleaning up afterwards.

reviews.author: Joe Spieles
reviews.text: Very happy with Z Plumberz with how quickly they were able to come out, the quality of the work, and how kind everyone, especially Angel, was during the process. She walked us through our options and costs, was happy to explain what would be done and why for any of the variations and took the time to walk through the process needed for long term care of the repair.

reviews.author: Becky Casanova
reviews.text: A huge thank you to Z PLUMBERZ of Ann Arbor and Toledo for being a beacon of hope! After waiting a whole week for a company to fit me in due to frozen pipes, I thought all hope was lost, but then I called Z PLUMBERZ and Stephanie sprang into action, securing an appointment for the very next day! Remarkably, just two hours later, she called back with the incredible news that a plumber would arrive the same day! Within an impressive 30 minutes of Chad's arrival, the water was flowing freely again! Exceptional customer service and satisfaction that truly exceeded expectations!!

plumbers.name: Garvin's Plumbing and Sewer
plumbers.address: 2900 S Shoshone St, Englewood, CO 80110, USA

reviews.author: Amy c
reviews.text: 5/5 stars! Grayson came out to fix a water issue after some construction happened on the floor above my unit, and he did an excellent job. He explained everything in a way that was easy to understand and even made the process fun to learn about. He also helped install a new garbage disposal and shared some helpful tips about appliance lifespans. Super professional, knowledgeable, and friendly. Highly recommend for any plumbing needs! 10/10 highly recommend

reviews.author: K Mason
reviews.text: From ease of scheduling to the completion of the project, this was a very positive experience and stress-free! James was extremely professional -- explained my options clearly, was efficient in replacing my water heater in a very timely manner, took extra care in clean-up and was conscious of protecting my home during the installation process. His two team members were awesome in helping with the removal of the old water heater (as it couldn't be drained), and they too were extremely professional and genuinely interested in helping and doing a great job! Thank you Garvin's -- you're now my "go to" for all of my plumbing needs. Give this team 10 stars!!

reviews.author: Jessica Ohly
reviews.text: Garvin's was exactly the help I needed. They had Saturday hours, and Grayson D took the time to explain what he was doing. He helped me learn how I can take care of my system moving forward, and my clog was cleared. I will definitely use Garvin's Plumbing and Sewer in the future.

reviews.author: A. H.
reviews.text: The technician from Garvin's arrived 12/03/25 on time and got our plumbing cleaned out and draining perfectly again! He was very friendly and knowledgeable; unfortunately, my husband didn't get a card and I'm unsure of the technician's name. After having interactions with a few other plumbing companies over the years that were fine but not great, I truly wish we'd found Garvin's sooner, but we will stick with them from here forward! As a side note: their prices for what we needed were incredibly fair and reasonable.

reviews.author: D Howie
reviews.text: I have been a very satisfied customer of Garvin's for 18 years! My most recent visit from your technician, Scott Richardson, was a particularly great experience. He was very thorough and accomplished everything on my list in one day. Scott is conscientious, polite, and knowledgeable about everything plumbing-related for my 1955 house. I will continue to use Garvin's and will happily recommend them to my friends and neighbors!

plumbers.name: All Seasons Plumbing
plumbers.address: 9665 S Compass Dr, Rossford, OH 43460, USA

reviews.author: Karen Kin
reviews.text: Zack was amazing!  He answered all our questions and did a great job in replacing  our bathroom and kitchen faucets and cleaned up very nicely. Thanks Zack for your expertise and it was a pleasure meeting you!

reviews.author: Kim Garrett
reviews.text: Service was outstanding. Fast, friendly and efficient. Pricing seemed high but when you know zip about plumbing, what can you do? I had two baskets on a double sided sink replaced with accompanying washers and sealant. About 400 bucks and a little change. Once again, same day response and service and super friendly guys! They worked for about half an hour I'd say. No shade to them whatsoever, I just thought it was pricey. Also, this included a two year warranty so hopefully you get what you pay for!

reviews.author: LuCynthia Jones
reviews.text: Levi and his crew at All Seasons did an excellent job.  They replaced the polybutelene water lines in my home with pex and they replaced my water heater.  They were on time, professional, let me know what they were doing along the way and sought my permission for a few changes and left my home clean.  The price was reasonable and the service was fantastic.  I would highly recommend All Seasons.

reviews.author: Steven Tester
reviews.text: I’d been having problems with my tankless water heater for almost 5 years. Never got satisfaction from the builder of my home to resolve. Levi with All Seasons looked at the system, diagnosed the problem within 10 minutes and my problems are solved! He and his assistant were prompt, very courteous and pleasant to work with. I’ve used All Seasons for my heating and air conditioning servicing with the same great results. Couldn’t be happier.

reviews.author: Bill Dobbins
reviews.text: Levi was great to work with. Professional and courteous the entire time he was here. Took care of the issue made sure everything was back to the way it was before the problem occurred. Great job!
