reviews.author: Lakshan Genagtharan
reviews.text: TJ from Peach Plumbing did a fantastic job flushing my hot water system. He went above and beyond, checking everything and even installing a water filtration system. Super professional and knowledgeable. Five stars all the way—definitely call TJ for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Nia Edwards
reviews.text: I could not be happier with tj's service.His knowledge, he is one of the few service providers.I have worked with in the last year.That shows a great amount of integrity and honesty. I appreciate how knowledgeable he was and the quality of the work that was done. Because of him, this company has a new customer and I will definitely be referring him. Happy new year.The barbecue sauce is at the bottom.Yeah I got twoWynn

reviews.author: Jennie Soria
reviews.text: They were fantastic. All my plumbing chores handled (move exterior faucets, fix exterior water line, replace PVC and compression tank, reroute my dryer vent). They started same day and finished next day.  A beast of redirecting my dryer vent through ceiling was done. So happy with the results. Very nice gentleman plumbers. Very reasonable price.

reviews.author: Jennifer Sovik
reviews.text: Great experience! We needed a new water heater and they were able to fit us in for a quote that day. The price was in line with what we were hoping and they had availability to do it that day. Carlos took great care of us and did an awesome job putting it in. Thanks again guys!

reviews.author: Jessica Willms
reviews.text: I’m so glad that Palette Plumbing and Peach Plumbing merged - Jordan was so awesome! Such painless process and everything was very straightforward. He explained everything clearly and got us a few extra discounts on top of what was already projected. Even ended up getting the main tankless water heater service I initially requested done for free because we took care of some other plumbing issues simultaneously. Will absolutely call Peach every time.

plumbers.name: Scenic City Plumbing
plumbers.address: 6148 Dayton Blvd, Hixson, TN 37343, USA

reviews.author: Ray hickman
reviews.text: Scenic City responded to my call very fast and in about 2 hours they had removed old hot water heater and installed a new one. Shawn, their technician, was very professional and the install looks way better than what I had before. Thank you so much!  I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: siobhan cummins
reviews.text: Scenic City came to my rescue. We realized last night we had no hot water. I called at 8:30am this morning and they had a new one installed by 11:45am. They were communicative, efficient and clean. I would highly recommend Scenic City Plumbing for all your plumbing needs; especially hot water heater emergencies.

reviews.author: Caleb Ballard
reviews.text: Mr Diaz and Mr Justin “Hoss” did a fantastic job replacing my water heater! They were professional and took the time to walk me through what was needed. Their customer service was above and beyond in a really stressful moment of life! The company did amazing getting them out as soon as possible! Thanks so much!!!

reviews.author: Lisa Stanley
reviews.text: David arrived on time and he put covers over his shoes. He was very professional and polite explaining everything to me about the process of identifying the problem. Not only did he fix the seal on my toilet and cleaned up perfectly, he also fixed my shower so that the hot would come out on the hot side and cold on the cold side. Scenic City sent David over in less than 2 hours from my call! Price was very reasonable and I’m very pleased with the service!

reviews.author: Erin Riley
reviews.text:
I woke up this morning with frozen pipes. When I called Scenic City Plumbing they were already fully booked for the day and couldn’t send someone out. I thanked them and told them I would see if I could find another plumber who was available. I didn’t have any luck, but a few hours later Scenic gave me a call back and told me they had someone in my area available who finished on a call early. I really appreciate them following up with me, and I couldn’t be happier with the service I received.

David was kind, polite, thorough, and very professional . He and I walked through the house and very pragmatically looked for any issues or concerns before he began the process of turning my water back on. He kept me informed every step of the way as to what he was doing and why. He emphasized the importance of slowly easing the water back on to prevent catastrophe, and I’m very happy to say we were able to get water running again without damage to my pipes.

I’m already planning to reach out to Scenic for pricing on some additional work I need done. I can’t recommend them enough.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 3525 Quakerbridge Rd Ste 6500, Hamilton Township, NJ 08619, USA

reviews.author: Shoeless K
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter was awesome... extremely responsive during our time of need with my mother's 70 year old home and plumbing.   Liam was our technician and he was absolutely amazing.... textbook class service, from start to finish. Super friendly, knowledgeable, helpful, and resolved our issue expertly.  Aside from his personality, his willingness to respect my mother's clean carpets was very much noted and appreciated! Not sure what else he could have possibly done any better. Great job Liam, and thanks!

reviews.author: Yoselyne Napuri
reviews.text: I contacted Roto Rooter for a sump rump installation. Liam came out quickly to install my new sump pump and the service was excellent! He was very informative, explained everything clearly, and made sure the job was done right and in a timely manner. What I really appreciated was that he was able to complete the installation the same day. He was professional, kind, and efficient throughout the entire process. Highly recommend! Thanks Liam!

reviews.author: Janine Prisco
reviews.text: I always have a great experience with Roto-Rooter!!! We were having an emergency plumbing issue and they showed up within the hour!! Liam was excellent!! He was nice and knowledgeable and always checked in to let me know what he was doing and inform me of any price changing before moving forward. He took his time and made sure everything was done correct and to my satisfaction. He offered me additional services to assist with my issue, but didn’t push or pressure me to do them. He was great!!!!! I would highly recommend Liam and Roto-Rooter!!

reviews.author: Aryanna Jean-Louis
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this plumbing company from start to finish. They were professional, punctual, and very knowledgeable. The technician explained the issue clearly, gave me honest pricing upfront, and completed the work efficiently. Everything was left clean and working perfectly. It’s hard to find reliable service like this these days, and I really appreciated their attention to detail and customer care. I would definitely recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work and will be using them again in the future!

reviews.author: Erin Howard
reviews.text: We had an emergency at the studio I manage and unfortunately having a restroom out of order for our members can be a struggle. Liam came the same day we contacted within a few hours and fixed the issue promptly. Very kind, energetic and efficient! Thank you!🙏🏼

plumbers.name: TYCO Plumbing
plumbers.address: 6343 W 120th Ave Suite 221, Broomfield, CO 80020, USA

reviews.author: Judith Ellis
reviews.text: Tyco was great.  We got a new hot water heater from them and they were superb from estimate to installation.  We would certainly use them again, and recommend them to everyone.  Thanks for a great job.

reviews.author: adam blakey
reviews.text: Tyco was very professional and prompt  at replacing our hot water heater. Tyler and Robert were the men who did the work. I would highly recommend Tyco Plumbing for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Nathan Henault
reviews.text: We've had Tyco do a bunch of re-plumbing, sink rough-in/finish, and toilet installs during a renovation and water heater and under foundation work while finishing a basement. They are always right in the middle of the quotes we receive and we have not had any issues with any of their work in the 4 years since they first helped us out. I always call them first when I need plumbing work done.

reviews.author: Nicholas Kelland
reviews.text: I’ve used Tyco several times for plumbing needs (small, big and huge) and they’re always extremely professional, thorough and high-quality of work.

reviews.author: Trey
reviews.text: Ryan with TYCO Plumbing had great communication and did a professional job. He left the site very clean after completing the work as well.  I would recommend their services!

plumbers.name: Save Home Heat Company
plumbers.address: 5741 Arapahoe Ave #4, Boulder, CO 80303, USA

reviews.author: Peter Mohseni
reviews.text:
I had Gabe come out to give me an estimate for our boiler repair. I was very impressed. I dealt with three other heating and plumbing companies and Safe Home Heat was by far the easiest to deal with and the most responsive. Gabe was prompt, communicated knowledgeably and quickly. He is very professional and answered all my questions.
If you need a reliable and honest heating and plumbing company,  Safe Home Heat Company is it!

reviews.author: Bill Jacobs
reviews.text:
The interaction with Chip during the estimating phase was very positive.  He explained the work to the level of detail that I needed.
The boiler installation was done by Garrett and he did an excellent / professional job.  All of the piping was perfect.  Communication with the front office was also very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Robert G
reviews.text:
Save Home was great.  Yep, working with a local company filled with good people was actually a pleasant experience.

Chris, the owner and estimator who initially came to my home, asked pertinent questions, made appropriate recommendations and clearly addressed all my concerns.

Jack and Colton, who completed the install, showed up on time, laid down drop cloths, and got to work.  The two were a good team and I could hear them actually hustling up and down the stairs on their numerous trips to and from the basement mechanical room - I think they actually liked their jobs!

And, the administrative assistance from the office was simple, friendly and efficient as they aptly explained billing procedures, submitted rebate requests and scheduled the city's inspection.

Good group!

reviews.author: Debora Murray
reviews.text: Bryan was great!  He got the issue fixed quickly and educated me on regular maintenance I can do to keep the system running efficiently.  He also advised me of the maintenance program at Save Home Heat which I will be signing up for.  Great experience.  I would recommend Save Home Heat to everyone.  I’ve been a customer for a long time with them and the professionalism and knowledge of their technicians has always been top notch.  Thank you Bryan!!

reviews.author: Austin Emser
reviews.text: I feel very fortunate to have found SHH. Everyone we dealt with was top notch, but in particular I'd like to call out Garrett and Brett. Navigating a home under contract, the general inspector said everything was great, but I reached out to SHH for a second opinion. They were able to find over 15K of issues that saved me from inheriting a disaster. Garrett and Brett were super transparent, friendly, and professional through and through. Thankful to have pros we can trust in the future!

plumbers.name: Mercy Plumbing
plumbers.address: 5560 S Peek Rd, Katy, TX 77450, USA

reviews.author: Neel Gupte
reviews.text: John is very knowledgeable. More important, he is honest and a straight shooter. He will tell you straight if something is not right and help you understand why. I like it. We had to reroute a gas line to the outdoor kitchen. I had another contractor come in to give me an estimate. But what John proposed was brilliant. Julian and his coworker did most of the work. It was thorough. Their price was reasonable and affordable. It took them over a day to finish the entire work. I will use them in the future. I strongly recommend them.

reviews.author: B Mon
reviews.text:
I called to request a quote for a water heater installation and was told that someone would need to come out to assess the current setup in order to provide an accurate estimate, which I completely understand. However, during the call, the representative stated that he was “losing $100” just by being on the phone with me. That comment was off-putting and unprofessional, and it immediately changed my impression of the company.
As a customer, I’m calling in hopes of receiving helpful guidance and good service—not to be made to feel like a burden. Rather than continuing the conversation, I let him know I would not be moving forward with their services and ended the call. Seems like they have enough business by his attitude.

reviews.author: PJ
reviews.text:
Last night i had a gas leakage in my dryer gas valve. It seems when LG technician was installing the new dryer they cracked the valve.
Anyhow i contacted Mercy Plumbing late night, they responded immediately.
Nathaniel showed up 10min prior and started to work on it. He checked the whole house if they were any leakage and he mentioned that it will take around 60~90min but actually finished in 45min. He is also very knowledgeable in his work, super nice and explained the current situation.

Very trustworthy company. Thank you Nathaniel.

reviews.author: Yiming Zhu
reviews.text: I spoke to John over the phone. He was able to give me a great deal for repairing a leaky exterior main water pipe and valve. Nathaniel came out for the same-day repair. He's very professional and courteous.

reviews.author: Austin Flynn
reviews.text:
I called to have a toilet pulled for a construction project. I got a lecture on how they see this type of project all the time and it is always trouble. They should come out and check etc etc. Felt like a pat on the head, patronizing, let's look out for the little woman who doesn't know anything, type of conversation.
I did schedule an appointment because I needed the toilet removed. The first plumber that I called, called me back and we were able to set a time without a lecture and I was treated as an actually intelligent human being.
I called Mercy Plumbing back immediately to cancel the appointment so they would not be losing time on me. When I called, I was told that they were losing money because I did a google search to find a plumber and happened to choose them. Apparently I cost them $100 for calling them for a job. Well they do not ever have to worry about that again. Mercy Plumbing is on a do not call list for our household.
My fault that I actually sat thru this critique of my life choices.

plumbers.name: Howze Plumbing
plumbers.address: 12053 Katy Rd Ste. 109, Keller, TX 76244, USA

reviews.author: Charley Casillas
reviews.text:
Chesney and Nick, the installation crew, were knowledgeable, efficient and thorough with our repair. They provided detailed explanations for every step and process in their work. They both had a postive attitude and were pleasant to talk to.
Daniel was our first point of contact. He arrived at 4pm and stayed late to diagnose our issue, and also fix problems we were unaware of. He was also extremely knowledgeable and pleasant.
We are very satisfied with our experience and service provided. We would definitely recommend Howze for any plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Ken Gettinger
reviews.text: Very professional and quick to respond. Communication was excellent. The process of getting gas service after the service had been off for a year required having a professional test the system with permits and then have the county come inspect it before I could get the gas company to start service. Something i wasn't used to being in Florida. Chance, the technician, took care of that, he replaced a couple of old 1970's valves and tested the system and it was all good. He did the work quickly and kept me informed with the county inspection and what I needed to do once it passed. Being out of state, he sent me many photos of his work.  The system passed and my service was easy to get started. I recommend them highly.

reviews.author: John Rebman
reviews.text:
Howze Plumbing fixed a shower pan leak and some plumbing issues with my tub. The tub was originally not installed properly and they fixed everything and got it working properly.
Patrick and Nick were always on time and respectful while here.
Also Chesney in the office was always helpful and pleasant to speak to. Overall I am very pleased with their work and if I need any plumbing work in the future, I will call Howze plumbing!

reviews.author: Colleen Kelly
reviews.text:
Daniel Green was incredibly professional and articulate. He explained the job and told me the steps he would take to repair my plumbing issue. He gave two quotes the second one was higher in the event more extensive work needed to happen. He repaired it thankfully not needing interior work.
I trusted Daniel and his integrity. This  was such a remarked difference from a competitive plumbing company that  I met with the day before. I highly recommend Daniel Green and his company Howze Plumbing.

reviews.author: Garret Hill
reviews.text: I called Howze Plumbing because I needed an outside faucet repaired and they were able to send a plumber the next morning. Chesney arrive first thing in the morning and was an absolute professional. He was friendly, knowledgeable and worked efficiently diagnosing the problem. The pricing was black and white and between he and Nick, a repair plan was put in place and executed quickly. If you need plumbing services in DFW and want professional and personable people, Chesney with Howze Plumbing is the way to go.

plumbers.name: Herdman Plumbing Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 5454 NW Caitlin St, Silverdale, WA 98383, USA

reviews.author: Angelica Serna
reviews.text:
Had a fantastic experience with Christopher and Ken with the diagnosis, removal and replacement of my electric water heater. My problem was an outdated, rusted-through 80gal water heater that had leaked through, shorting the power switch off, and was continuing to leak into my garage. The solution was the complete replacement of the water heater (with a 50gal + expansion tank), the cold water shut-off valve, and metal stand to bring everything up to code.
Both guys were friendly, professional, and extremely patient with explaining the process before and after the job was completed. reviews.author: Phong Nguyen
reviews.text:
Late in the day I spotted water leaking from under one of my toilets, not knowing yet that my store’s sewer line had backed up as well. It was the weekend, so I expected higher rates and started calling around. It was about 5 p.m. on Saturday when I tried PriceBusters, and to my surprise someone actually picked up. It was the owner, Zach.

He gave me a fair quote on what I thought would be a simple job, pulling the toilet, checking the line with a camera, and installing a new wax ring. I told him I’d call around. After hanging up, I reached out to three other plumbing companies. Not one company answered their phone. That alone told me a lot.

Zach said he could come out the next morning, so I called him back and asked if he’d meet me before we opened on Sunday to try to get the blockage cleared. He agreed without hesitation.

Sunday morning, Zach showed up on time and spent several hours trying everything he could. He didn’t rush. He looked at the issue from different angles even from the rooftop and he really made an effort to find a cheaper fix before landing on what ended up being the big solution, which was digging out the pipe and installing a clean-out so they could jet the blockage from outside the building. I appreciated that he didn’t jump straight to the expensive route.

The next morning his Calvin and Logan arrived early and had already dug a five-foot hole beside the building by the time I got there. Logan was fantastic. He had a great attitude, stayed polite, and worked hard without a single complaint. They were out there the entire day, digging and working in the rain well into the night. Watching them made me appreciate how tough this job really is. It’s messy, humbling, and honestly the kind of job most people want nothing to do with, but they handled it with pride.

They did such a solid job that I’ve already asked them to come back every six months to jet my French drains. If you’re looking for a plumbing company that actually answers the phone, shows up, and works as if your problem is their problem, call PriceBusters. Zach and his team earned every one of these five stars.

reviews.author: Marc Favro
reviews.text:
I’m posting separately to add additional context to a recent review about this company’s visit to our home.

We had no water from our kitchen sink, but every other faucet in the house (4 bathrooms and our laundry sink) had normal hot and cold water. This was inconvenient, but it was not a whole-house emergency.

The plumber quoted $425 for the first hour and $375 for each hour after, plus a $125 service fee. When asked how long the work would take or what the plan was, no clear timeframe or scope was provided. We were essentially expected to agree to open-ended hourly charges at a very high rate.

We chose not to move forward. The next day, as temperatures rose, the pipe unfroze on its own with no leaks, no damage, and no repairs needed.

Given that outcome, it’s disappointing the situation was framed with urgency and worst-case language rather than a more measured explanation of possible next steps. Customers deserve transparent pricing and a realistic assessment before being asked to commit to significant, undefined costs.

Sharing this so others have the full picture.

If you need a plumber who is reliable, knowledgeable, and willing to tackle the gross stuff without complaint, Vernon is your guy. Five stars all the way! And best of all I can use my kitchen sink again.

reviews.author: Anthony Proenza
reviews.text: What a good experience it was from first phone call through Home Depot to the final installation. Patrick Watt, the plumber who did the installation of a new water heater was detailed, clean work area, cautious, and professional all the way. I believe it was the best plumbing experience I’ve had. Same day service through Home Depot with delivery and removal and disposal of old water heater all went as planned. Great job! I recommend them 100% and will get my repeat business for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Robert Cambo
reviews.text: Douglas Orr Plumbing did a great job on our master bath in Coral Gables. Chucky Angel and Carlos were very careful professionals that paid attention to detail and did things the right way. It’s an employee owned company and it shows.

reviews.author: Luis Ojeda
reviews.text: Great experience with Douglas Orr Plumbing. Pricing was fair, and Juan and James were excellent. They arrived on time, quickly diagnosed the issue with my water heater, explained everything clearly, and completed the repair efficiently. They replaced the necessary components, flushed the tank, and made sure everything was working properly before leaving. Professional, knowledgeable, and courteous throughout the entire process. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sergio murrieta
reviews.text:
I hired Douglas Orr Plumbing to come check out my bosses’s new Toto Neo Rest that was installed a little over a year ago, there was a infrequent leakage problem that no other plumber in town could resolve.

I was referred to the company by Toto themselves, I was told they are the only experts on Toto installations in dade county.

Orr plumbing send Angel and Matt to come resolve the problem that I was having that no other plumber could resolve. After a short visit Angel the master plumber quickly recognized the issue that we were having and put together a solid plan of what needed to be done to not only temporality fix the problem but also ensure that the Toto is properly installed.

I am writing this review because it is hard to find an expert, professional and friendly plumbing company to provide the type of service that I received. If anyone ever needs help from a plumbing expert, Douglas Orr is the place to call.

plumbers.name: Edwin Stipe, Inc
plumbers.address: 1642 Union Blvd Suite Z, Allentown, PA 18109, USA

reviews.author: Pam Richetta
reviews.text: What a terrific experience, thanks to Edwin Stipe and the terrific professionalism provided by Brian.  He was extremely thorough as he checked all of our plumbing throughout our home AND outside.  Our home is 108 years old so you might imagine that checking our plumbing can take extra time’.  But the quality of work, the level of experience and the tremendous quality of work provided is just one of the many, many reasons we have ALWAYS reached to Edwin Stipe when we have plumbing issues.  They have been providing us with quality workmanship for our problems since 1999.  In a word … Excellent!

reviews.author: Linda Smith
reviews.text: Shelby was so knowledgeable and courteous.  She found the problem right away and she repaired our oil furnace with ease! She found what numerous techs were unable to do! Not only did she solve the problem but treated us professionally and respectfully. She is a five star technician and we were very impressed with her skills in troubleshooting and technical expertise.  Thank you so much for going extra steps to help us on a very cold day in January 2026! Our furnace is functioning so well now! We will recommend her in the future to our friends and family. Thank you, Shelby for a flawless repair.  Linda and Lee Palmer Township PA

reviews.author: Cortney Selander
reviews.text: I’ve been a customer of Edwin Stipe for 11 years, on a service plan. All of the techs I have had come to me home over the years have been great. Most recently Roly Calero was at my home several time over the last two weeks helping me troubleshoot an issue with my furnace. He was a wonderful help and gave me great advice that ultimately helped get to the bottom of the issue. I can’t recommend Roly enough!

reviews.author: Kevin DeMouth
reviews.text: I would give the tech Shelby a five star rating. She was very professional very friendly explained what she was doing every step of the way just very professional. However, I would rate the company at two. I spent two days waiting the entire day for them to come, and there was a no-show. Two entire days I waited. Not good work policy not good business management. The AI equipment they have answering is not working properly.

reviews.author: Ashley Gerstenberg
reviews.text: I was so impressed with Shelby! She was very thorough and took her time to explain things to me. Other technicians have complained about the tight spot that they need to crawl through to get to our unit but Shelby said it was no big deal and its just part of the job. I will most likely be requesting for Shelby to be the tech to come to our home from now on! We highly recommend her!

plumbers.name: Drain Time Plumbing
plumbers.address: 9880 Waterman Rd STE 140, Elk Grove, CA 95624, USA

reviews.author: Therese Dominguez
reviews.text:
First of all, I really appreciate that Leo and Nick arrived right on time. From the moment they walked into our home, they were friendly, polite, and courteous. Leo took the time to answer all of my questions and clearly explained what they were going to do, which gave me a lot of confidence in the process.
Our toilet drain had roots growing alongside it and even starting to come through the flange. Leo and Nick jackhammered the tile, addressed the root issue thoroughly, and completed the repair much faster than I expected. The work looked excellent—solid, professional, and done with care. Even better, they left the area spotless, which I truly appreciated.
Thank you so much, Leo and Nick! I couldn’t be happier with the service—absolutely 110% satisfied

Part 2 of my review:
After Leo and Nick completed their work and my husband re-tiled the area, Zach came out to install our toilet. He arrived right on time and was an absolute pleasure to work with—friendly, courteous, and easy to talk to. He took great care with the installation, and the toilet works perfectly. Thank you, Zach!

Overall, Drain Time Plumbing has provided excellent customer service from start to finish. Mark and his team are not only professional but genuinely friendly and easy to communicate with. Out of the four plumbers I contacted on Yelp, they were the very first to respond, and they had James out the next day to inspect the issue and give me a quote. Their price came in $400 lower than a competitor’s, and they were flexible in scheduling the installation to fit my availability.
I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Drain Time Plumbing has earned my trust, and I’ll definitely be calling them for all of our future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Michael M
reviews.text: These guys are the best. We had an emergency and our house started to back fill with sewage. We called and they came out in 15 min. They were transparent throughout the entire process while clearing the lines. They showed me the camera view of what was going on with the line and provided recommendations. We are happy they came when they did or else our house could’ve been way worse.

reviews.author: around2itnow
reviews.text: Great experience.  They came out on a Sunday to give us an estimate.  We called at the last minute and were surprised they were there quickly. They offered a free camera inspection which was very impressive to me.  Other companies will charge a lot for that service and only include it, if you hire and in some cases, not even then. Chayden listened to us and was very understanding of our current budget limitations.  That's really important to us right now.  It was a lot like talking to a membef of the family.  We didn't feel pressured at all.  I really felt that we could trust him.  He seems very honest.  We didn't hire them at this time.  We definitely keep them on our list for future needs.

reviews.author: Lin Pevny
reviews.text:
10 stars! Mark and his team rescued us from our plumbing issues. This is our second time utilizing DrainTime plumbing for two separate issues at two different locations. And they did an excellent job fixing the plumbing issues.

Mark was quick to respond to our ordeal, gave solutions and his crew was out to get things removed, replaced and running/fixed. Communication, customer service and the work done was on point.

We had an issue with the clean out, toilet backup. The building was built in the 80s. cast iron gets old and needed replacement. It was replaced with a two way clean out. They got the permit, did a clean job cutting the concrete, keeping the work area clear and secure (no trip hazard) and finishing up the work within the time frame. The job came with a 10 year warranty.

If you’re looking for an honest, plumber who follows code and does the job well, I highly recommend Drain Time Plumbing. They listen to your needs, explains what’s going on and what can be done and why and the price is right.

Thank you Drain Time Plumbing!

reviews.author: Denis Ageev
reviews.text:
I had an issue, and as soon as I posted on Yelp, they reached out to me immediately and got Zach to setup estimate just a few hours later. Everything was done swiftly and were very flexible

Zach was extremely friendly and helpful. I was very curious about every single detail, and he happily explained to me what is what and how it works. Zach took time of his day to make sure that we understood everything crystal clear and he was mindful of keeping interior clean and tidy. From now on these guys will be my go to for any plumbing issue!

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Hendersonville
plumbers.address: 339 B Rockland Rd, Hendersonville, TN 37075, USA

reviews.author: A H
reviews.text:
Mr. Rooter provided excellent service installing the new 50-gallon electric water heater. Jay the technician, did an outstanding job from start to finish. As he arrived on time, explained the process clearly, and handled the installation with real professionalism with attention to detail.

Jay removed the old unit after installing the new unit. He kept the workspace cleaned the entire time while on the premises. I highly recommend Jay from Mr. Rooter for anyone needs a professional for their high-quality water heater installation.

reviews.author: Bed, Bark, & Beyond
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about Mr. Handyman and Mr. Rooter Plumbing.
Jason Heavin came out to fix a pipe at my business and was an absolute legend. Not only did he handle the original problem quickly and professionally, he also helped me knock out another task while he was there! No attitude, no upselling nonsense, just “let’s get it done” energy.
AND let’s talk about the price because whew… I paid under $600 for everything. Meanwhile, another company had the audacity.... the confidence.... to quote me $2,500 for the same job. Like sir… be serious.
Jason was friendly, efficient, honest, and clearly not in the business of robbing people blind. If you want someone who shows up, fixes the problem, and doesn’t make your wallet cry, this is who you call.
10/10 would trust him with my pipes again.

reviews.author: Holly B
reviews.text: Called Mr Handyman & they sent Jay, who is the nicest, most knowledgeable & professional plumber I’ve encountered. He answered my questions and helped clarify my issue in a timely manner with a smile! 10 out of 10!

reviews.author: Liodfa dafada
reviews.text:
Really pleased with work Jay M. did, our heater went out this morning and Mr. Rooter was able to send someone out by the evening to get us situated.

Thanks to Jay and the team.

reviews.author: Regina Arrington
reviews.text: Bryan and Jay installed all new plumbing throughout my home in 1 day.  They did a great job. I would recommend Mr. Rooter to anyone who needs any plumbing done.

plumbers.name: Mountain Valley Plumbing and Heating
plumbers.address: 210 Collyer St, Longmont, CO 80501, USA

reviews.author: Gloria Owusu
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Mountain Valley Plumbing and Heating from start to finish. When my furnace stopped working properly, I called them and they were able to send a technician out that very afternoon. DJ was the technician, and he was extremely professional and took the time to thoroughly explain what was going on with my system.

Given the age of my furnace and water heater, DJ recommended that I consider replacement and suggested speaking with one of their sales representatives. Zach came out the same day, completed a full evaluation, and provided me with an estimate. While I was initially hesitant about the price, Zach and JD were very considerate and worked with me to provide a fair estimate, which I truly appreciated.

Zach was professional, knowledgeable, and patient, taking the time to explain all of my options and answer my questions. The following week, I had my new furnace and tankless water heater installed. Fernando and Franco were amazing—they did an exceptional job with the installation, were efficient, and clearly took pride in their work. I am extremely satisfied with the quality of the installation.

Overall, I highly recommend Mountain Valley Plumbing and Heating. Their team was responsive, professional, and easy to work with every step of the way. I will absolutely continue working with them in the future. Thank you to the entire team!

reviews.author: Kari Owens
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Mountain Valley Plumbing and Heating! I had a toilet start to leak over the weekend and today (Monday) they were out here fixing the leak and installing a new toilet in a separate bathroom. The technician remembered me from past projects, took care to make sure I was fully informed of my options and was incredibly thorough.

About six months ago, Mountain Valley Plumbing and Heating came out for a furnace tune up and at the time found out that the company that installed my high efficiency furnace never installed the condensate drain line, a huge mistake that was not only very costly but also dangerous. I called the furnace installation company, Steele Bros Heating to fix the issue and they refused to fix it without charging me an absorbent price. At the time, Mountain Valley Plumbing and Heating offered to come fix the mistake for free.

I will never use another plumbing or heating company other than Mountain Valley Plumbing and Heating. Not only are they incredibly professional but they care about doing exceptional quality work. I highly, highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Patrick
reviews.text: DJ came out to help diagnose issues with my furnace, humidifier, and heat pump system, and he was fantastic to work with. He was friendly, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain everything clearly. Very easy to talk to and genuinely helpful. I would definitely recommend him to others.

reviews.author: Erica Davis
reviews.text:
I had a mess under my sink.  My last plumber did not do the repair that I paid for:-/
A few months later, I noticed water, which almost ruined my cabinet, under my kitchen sink. Fernando,  my service man, explained his process and began his work.  An hour later - done. He was  very professional and I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Trudie Gilliam
reviews.text:
Fernando, Franco, and Gabe did excellent work! I am very pleased with their expertise  and professionalism.. Zach, the project manager was very helpful in coordinating the install and answered all my questions. I will highly recommend Mountain Valley to my neighbors and friends!!! Thank you!
Trudie Gilliam

plumbers.name: Daniels Plumbing
plumbers.address: 225 Foster St, Tomball, TX 77375, USA

reviews.author: Keith Saathoff
reviews.text: I have used Daniel's Plumbing for many years. I appreciate that it is a locally owned small business not a corporate giant with upsells. The owner is an upstanding and honest man. My service tech, Jonathan B, was also 5 stars. He was professional, personable, and knowledgeable. Service was scheduled for same day even though it was not an emergency!

reviews.author: Mary Sweeney
reviews.text: Arrived at appointed time. They replaced our old tankless water heater in estimated timeframe. Cleaned up when finished, made sure all my questions were answered and I was satisfied with work. I would definitely use them again for my plumbing projects.

reviews.author: Stuart Locker
reviews.text: Austin and Boon did an excellent job at my house. Fixed a leak from the pipes of the tankless hot water heater and corrected a bad plumbing job, fixed a toilet, and improved the setup for an outdoor water line. Will definitely use this company again.

reviews.author: Dean N
reviews.text: Jonathan was the service rep that came out to do the repair.   This employee was very helpful and extremely knowledgeable about what he was doing.   He also gave me some helpful preventative information about other potential issues that could arise, and how to fix it.   Very competent plumber.

reviews.author: Ron Harper
reviews.text:
Called for an estimate to replace a 17 wear old water heater and water lines to the heater. They sent a plumber (Austin) within 3 hours. After estimating what i needed Austin showed me what was avaliable and a cost of the repairs and replacement of the water heater. He called his office and had the items that I needed delivered . He took extra time to put down a drop cloth from the entry door to the attic stairs.  A short time later , quicker than I expected, he showed me the instalation and explained the system and operation. This was a very personal neat and clean job. Thank you Austin for a great job.
Ron

plumbers.name: Pace Plumbing Inc.
plumbers.address: 4274 Bell Ln, Milton, FL 32571, USA

reviews.author: Mel Apin
reviews.text: Hunter from Pace Plumbing in Milton, FL replaced my sewer ejection pump, and I couldn't be happier with his work. He originally came out just to replaced the ejector pump, but he quickly discovered that the float alarm switch was also bad and replaced it without hesitation. Hunter was extremely professional, knowledgeable and clearly knew exactly what he was doing. He tested the pump, float and alarm three separate times to make sure everything was working. He even gave me some helpful maintenance advice. I'm very satisfied and truly appreciate of his excellent work!  HIGHLY..... HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!!  Ask for Hunter if calling Pace Plumbing to do some plumbing work.

reviews.author: Cyndee Merritt
reviews.text:
I have 2 reviews on Pace Plumbing.  I was going out of town the end of January.  The day before I left, my subdivision fb page told of different  people having  their alarms going off from their grinders. (Not sure what they are called). Mine was fine so I didn't worry about it. The morning I was to leave, I heard my alarm going off at 3:45 that morning.   Now what??? Im leaving at 5:00 and  I had no clue what to do. My son n law called ecua. I was told to unplug it, and someone would come out.. I left the gate unlocked and I left. I was a nervous wreck.  While I was in disney, I got a call from Pace Plumbing.  Kyle called me and said he would take care of it. He kept me informed  and eased my mind. It was all fixed when I got home.  Thank you Kyle so much.
2nd review--- today my shower was leaking, so I called Pace Plumbing again.  I got a call from Nathan saying he was coming out today to fix it. He did!!!!!  He cleaned up his mess perfectly.  Very respectful and friendly. I will use Pace  Plumbing  from now on. Thank you Nathan.

reviews.author: Lisa G.
reviews.text: Adam and his team came through again quickly!. Juan corrected issues with toilet and pipe leaks under sink and shower head .  This will help sell my house in a timely manner which I greatly appreciate!! I always trusted Pace with all my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: April Gricks
reviews.text: We cannot thank Nathan enough for his service, and the work he did. He responded promptly and issue resolved. Thanks again Nathan. We definitely recommend Pace Plumbing. They are professional, reasonably priced, and honest. No upsale pressure.

reviews.author: Matt_Myers_Sr
reviews.text: I contacted Pace Plumbing when my Natural gas water heater stopped working. Technician Jesse contacted me to find out a few detail details on what was happening. I sent a few pictures and he told me a technician would be responding shortly. Technician Erin arrived and quickly found out the issue and had the water heater running within a few minutes. He even gave me a few pointers to keep the issue from happening again. Fast and efficient! They didn’t charge me for the response or time spent. Fantastic company who does quality work. I will be recommending them to my friends and family. Thank you, Pace Plumbing for all you do.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 510 Lawrence Expy Ste 206, Sunnyvale, CA 94085, USA

reviews.author: Charlene Flynn
reviews.text: Very quick response.  Ivan was professional, personable and got right to the problem and explained everything as he went along.   I appreciated that they sent Patrick and Christopher to explain other options and offer to follow up anytime.  They did not give a strong up sell which I really appreciated.  I was also given a discount for being a past customer.  Roto Rooter put their best foot forward today.

reviews.author: Shankar Iyer
reviews.text:
I called them for a simple clogged toilet. The tech was great, came and used a drain auger ($40 on Amazon) to fix it in 10 mins. Problem is that they charged me $400!!   That's price gouging.  While I admit they gave me an invoice before starting, they could have told me when I scheduled the appointment. Clearly they charge these rates for simple toilet clogs so why not be pricing transparent. Hard to wait for 3 hours for them and then send them back because I needed this fixed.

Per the response to the review, I called Pat Swanson who kindly replied to me that he was escalating and a corporate person would call. That person left a message simply stating that their standard prices for toilet repair started at $400 but they couldn't be transparent because it could be higher. Not a useful response at all. Simply put, this shows lack of price transparency and pricing that is outrageous and unfair.  Be forewarned when calling this company.

reviews.author: Randall Woo
reviews.text: Theo was a fantastic technician. He was thorough in finding the problem and explained everything every step of the way. He treated the customer with respect and was clearly knowledgeable of tankless water heaters. I would definitely use Roto Rooter again for my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Tia
reviews.text: Miguel and Brian were awesome! We had a pipe leaking under our old mobile home and Miguel was very transparent and honest about everything along the way. They fixed up a number of things and answered all my questions along the way. Double checked things I asked them to look at as well. They found multiple issues in our old pipes and made sure to take the time to double check their work along the way and nothing ever felt rushed. You could tell Miguel really knows what he’s doing and cares about his work. We really appreciate his honest and hard work. Great knowledgeable plumber and we would request him again in the future if we have to call one out. Thank you Miguel for all you did for us we seriously appreciate it!! Literally ABOVE AND BEYOND 10/10!

reviews.author: matthew torres
reviews.text: We had a clog in our drain and we called them out. Ruben came out and was super friendly and knowledgeable. He knew exactly what the issue could be and started right away on snaking the drain. Once he was all done he informed me that the line is now clear and that one of his other techs was going to come out with a scope to check the line. They both were amazing and really helped me out!

plumbers.name: Colonial Plumbing & Heating Co., Inc.
plumbers.address: 114 Charlotte Ave, Colonial Heights, VA 23834, USA

reviews.author: Steven Bishop
reviews.text: Thank you Jordan, Ty, Landon and Will! Our downstairs bathroom and kitchen were overflowing from a clogged drain leading out of the house. They showed up to help promptly and worked hard on the issue for several hours last night, explaining everything as they went along. They weren't able to solve the issue immediately but came back with another team this morning and everything was fixed in 30 minutes. Super professional, kind, and very fair pricing. We have our water and house back, thank you guys!

reviews.author: Laurie Perez
reviews.text: All I can say is thanks to Noah and Will at Colonial Plumbing because they saved Christmas breakfast for our whole entire family. We came home the evening of the 23rd to find our sink backing up when we ran the garbage disposal or dishwasher. We called Colonial Plumbing and they came out bright and early on Christmas Eve and were able to troubleshoot and repair the issue. They were knowledgeable, professional, and very polite. Will definitely call them again. Thank you Noah and Will.

reviews.author: Glenn Hughes
reviews.text: Landon and Tony came out to fix a stoped up tub and sink.  They fixed the problems in a short amount of time.  They were very knowledgeble, professional, courteous and provided excellent customer service.  I had CPH come out another time they fixed the problem, and they noticed the cap on the tap out was broken letting sentiment in the line, so the technician went to Home Depot and bought the top, brought it back and replace the brokent cap.  When we asked him how much we owed him he said nothing.  This is the kind of service you can expect from Colonial Plumbing and heating.

reviews.author: Sharleen Lanier
reviews.text: My technician's name are John and McKenzie. Both were professional, very knowledgeable and neat. They diagnosed the problem, explained what was needed. They Fixed my heating issue with delay. What a awesome team. God Bless them both. I can't thank them both enough. Simply Beautiful.  I'm am so happy to now have heat for the Holidays. 😊

reviews.author: Tommy Nevetral
reviews.text: Colonial Plumbing & Heating was contracted to connect a newly installed vented gas fireplace. A previous gas approved plumber had been onsite and could not complete the job and did not show for two other appointments. Colonial Plumbing sent gas technician Carter Brink to evaluate & repair a close quarter connection and placement of an isolation valve and make the connection back to the gas piping. My wife and I were very pleased to see Carter arrive on time and exhibiting a cordial greeting first thing. Carter spent several hours making the repairs with a jovial and knowledgeable attitude. Carter exceeded my expectations as he was very systematic in his reasoning and exhibited excellent critical thinking skills to resolve the close quarter issue.  Carter further exhibited "great customer service" by working through the gas fireplace dealer on the phone with a solution for pairing the remote control to the fireplace. I would not hesitate to have Carter Brink of Colonial Plumbing & Heating to resolve any future plumbing/heating/HVAC issues that may transpire. Thank you, Carter Brink of Colonial Plumbing & Heating!

plumbers.name: 1st Home & Commercial Services
plumbers.address: 630 Ralph Ablanedo Dr Bldg 1, Austin, TX 78748, USA

reviews.author: Joshua Broom
reviews.text:
Excellent experience with First Home and Commercial Services. Dominic was exceptional and arrived on-site within an hour of our call, which made a big difference for our operations.
He quickly assessed and repaired a complex commercial system with six electric water heaters, several of which were not functioning properly, and stabilized the entire setup. Beyond the immediate repairs, Dominic developed a clear preventive maintenance plan—including system flushing, filter replacement, and follow-up work—to ensure long-term reliability.
He’s already coordinating with supply houses, sourcing parts, and preparing a bid for a critical filtration system upgrade. Professional, proactive, and thoughtful in his approach. I highly recommend First Home and Commercial Services, and especially Dominic, for commercial and {Services, and especially Dominic, for commercial facilities support.
Huge 5 Stars!!
Thanks Dominic !!

reviews.author: Mary Ann Spracher
reviews.text: Dominic went above and beyond today. He came over to check out our tankless water heater and also took a look at one of bathroom sink filters.  He changed the screen out for me because he happened to have one in his truck.  Great family owned business.  We plan to use them to install our new tankless water heater.

reviews.author: Britnie Ortega
reviews.text: Ollin was great. Very respectful and honest and got that job done immediately and did a great job. I had 10 other companies come and nobody was able to do it but ollin. 130% recommend for any future work!

reviews.author: AwesomeTexaz
reviews.text: Ryan was an absolute lifesaver when our AC unit conked out! He arrived right on time, which we really appreciated, and his friendly demeanor made the whole process stress-free. Not only did he diagnose and fix the issue quickly and efficiently, but the price was fair and exactly as quoted—no surprises. We’re so grateful for his help in getting our home cool and comfortable!

reviews.author: Danielle Day
reviews.text: Olen and Anthony did an amazing job this morning fixing a break in our main water line to our house. Both were very professional and did their jobs quickly but well to get our house back to where we had water. I cannot recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Nick Kelley
reviews.text: Andrew was amazing he came by and was here identifyed the problem quickly and efficiently. Was very thorough and spent extra time to ensure everything was working properly. Then Nick came out to double check everything and the whole process was seamless. Cool people and good service would do it again.

reviews.author: Rhonda Melendez
reviews.text: I was very impressed with the professionalism of Andrew and Ricardo during my appointment.  Andrew came in and explained everything he would be doing. He got the job done with great efficiency. Also, Ricardo was very explanatory as well . He showed the video and explained what I was looking at. Both men were very courteous and knowledgeable. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Tonya Gaines
reviews.text: We would like to take a moment to convey our gratitude for the service call at our home today. Andrew arrived first, & was very kind, respectful, knowledgeable, & thorough, in explaining what he was going to do, as well as possible scenarios that could involve further service immediately, or down the road. He informed us that his manager, Nick, was on his way, to do the scope on the sewer line, allowing my hubby to view what he was seeing along the way. I didn’t chat with Nick, but my husband really liked dealing with him as well!:)) Both young men were great to do business with!:))    Sincerely, Tonya Zogg-Gaines

reviews.author: ritz panaligan
reviews.text: Technicians Andrew and Justin were very professional making the whole process stress free. I was given a clear understanding of the issue and options to adress them.  Thank you for providing great service!

reviews.author: Jade Keys
reviews.text: This was amazing!!! He was so helpful and absolutely save the day right before the storm! He not only cleaned the pipes but gave me a great update on my house!! I will definitely be calling him again!

reviews.author: Denise Messerli
reviews.text: After discovering a leak under a toilet Kalos was able to have Ted come out and replace the wax ring within a few hours. Ted was very courteous and knowledgeable about his task. I was very impressed how throughly he cleaned up when he was done. Kalos appears to hire only respectful technicians. We will definitely continue to call them whenever we have need for plumbing or AC expertise.

reviews.author: Laura Mirra
reviews.text: I was in a jam today with some new appliances I ordered.  I couldnt have them installed because our hookups were too outdated.  So, I called Kalos and Ted was able to come out just 2 hours later and replace both the refrigerator and dishwasher hookups.  Ted was knowledgeable, kind, and quick.  I'm so thankful for the excellent service I received today and will use their service again for sure!

reviews.author: Alex Aya
reviews.text: I never give 5 star reviews so this is a first. Completely professional from beginning to end.  No hard sell on unnecessary items, no hard push to replace a 6 year old unit for $20K because an evaporator coil is leaking. They gave me a quote and fixed the coil the next day without charging me an exorbitant amount for the parts and the work. Techs were also very knowledgeable, easy to deal with and able to answer all questions I had for them.

reviews.author: Justin J
reviews.text:
We moved into our new house less than a year ago and we started having drainage issues very late last night. Needless to say we were both panicking and under a lot of stress as sewage was backing up. We had initially called another company to come out and fix the drain, but we were never given an ETA or rough estimate on when we would get a call. After several minutes, we ended up calling Roto-Rooter and I'm glad we did. Sharon in dispatch was very helpful in telling me a rough ETA and how there dispatch process works. I received a text less than 5 minutes from the call. And received a window when the plumber would be here and the window was spot on.

Nick was the plumber who showed up. He was very friendly and could tell that I was stressed and upset. He made me laugh and made be feel much better. He was very professional in explaining what he was doing every step of the way which I really appreciated. He ended up having to snake into the drainage cap (ours unfortunately is in a very narrow area beside our water heaters). He had some trouble getting whatever was clogging the drain clear and we both began to suspect it may be an issue with the sewage tank and not the drain. Nick ended using his camera to scope down into the pipe and explained to be what water looks like in the pipe versus the sewage tank. Once he  couldn't advance the camera any further he looked at the water on the camera and knew that we had not made it to the tank yet, but the blockage was very close to it. He went down with the snake and went a little further the second time and our standing water started draining and I felt so relieved. We had a lot of towels to mop up what we could and Nick offered to help clean up, but he had been at our house until after 1AM (his shift ends at midnight). Nick said he wanted to get me fixed tonight and he never gave up.

If you're having any plumbing issues I would 100% recommend Roto-Rooter! And if you're lucky enough to have, Nick come out you will be well taken care of!

reviews.author: gary webb
reviews.text:
I am submitting this as a formal complaint regarding a recent service call and subsequent billing.
I contacted Best Plumbing to come out and replace a faucet cartridge. I already knew what the issue was. A technician came to the property and spent approximately 45 minutes attempting to locate the replacement cartridge on his phone. He was unable to find it and stated that his office would contact me within a couple of days.
I later discovered that the faucet is a lifetime warranty product, and the cartridge replacement is provided at no cost by the manufacturer. Chown Hardware was able to order the correct cartridge for me within one week without issue.
Before receiving any meaningful follow-up regarding the service visit, I was sent an invoice for nearly $500. After the invoice was issued, I received a call stating the cartridge would cost $140. I explained that the part is covered under a lifetime warranty and is provided free of charge.
Despite no repair being completed and no part being installed, I was billed almost $500 for what amounted to a 45-minute diagnostic visit. At no point prior to the appointment was I informed of the service call rate, nor did I sign any agreement authorizing a charge of that amount. Had I been told the visit would cost nearly $500, I would not have scheduled the appointment.
When I attempted to dispute the invoice, communication occurred through a collections representative, whose tone was unprofessional and included threats of financial consequences if the invoice was not paid.
This experience reflects a serious lack of transparency and professionalism. I am sharing this so others are aware of these business practices
There are consumer protections in Washington that apply here too. The Attorney General’s Office enforces the Washington State Consumer Protection Act, which prohibits unfair or deceptive business practices, including failing to disclose costs and then charging consumers without their informed consent.
RCW 19.86.020 – Unfair or deceptive acts or practices unlawful
“Unfair methods of competition and unfair or deceptive acts or practices in the conduct of any trade or commerce are hereby declared unlawful.”
It's so amazing. All they had to do was call me back to discuss the bill not just send a random bill out of nowhere. I never signed a contract. I never agreed to that but had they called me and discussed it. Then we probably would have came to terms instead of trying to strong arm you Washington state has great laws the AGO DOL FTC and BBB.

reviews.author: John Colburn
reviews.text:
We recently hired Best Plumbing to diagnose and repair a serious issue with our main sewer line, and the entire experience was outstanding from start to finish.
It began with a gurgling first‑floor toilet. Best Plumbing responded within 24 hours, removed the toilet, protected our wood floors, and both snaked and scoped the line. They reinstalled the toilet, cleaned the area thoroughly, and left the powder room spotless.
The inspection revealed that our main sewer line was clogged with roots. The repair required hand‑digging an 8‑foot‑deep hole. The crew treated our property with real care—laying down tarps, preserving the sod, and working diligently and respectfully throughout the process. They installed a liner to fix the issue, then returned to refill the hole by hand, replace the sod, and rake the yard. Aside from a few faint seams where the sod was lifted, you would never know they were here.
Mitch, the project manager, communicated clearly and consistently over the two‑week project. The pricing was reasonable, the workmanship was excellent, and the professionalism was evident at every step.
High trust, high competence, great communication. I strongly recommend Best Plumbing to anyone needing sewer or plumbing work.

reviews.text: With my 2 water heaters beginning to show their ages, I started looking into a tankless system. I called Big Brothers and got what I thought was a pretty good estimate for the install. The clean up was done perfectly. Since then, I have had 2 toilets replaced and got the same professional service as before. Seems that Big Brothers takes pride in their work and treats you very fair which is something that I find lacking in a lot of business. Will be calling them for furture home services that might arise.

plumbers.address: 553 Woodruff Rd, Greenville, SC 29607, USA

reviews.author: Lynn Vining
reviews.text: Oh my goodness, how thankful I am for JB Plumbing! My 22-yr old hot water heater went out on a Sunday evening (not a surprise; had already gotten a quote from another company a few months earlier & was saving up money for this purchase). However, after putting in a call to the "other company" TWICE, and not hearing back from them, I searched for a reputable plumber in my area and found JB Plumbing. Not only did the owner, Jean, call me back personally after I had spoken with his office, but he came out the same day to give me an estimate. While he was here, I inquired about the pipe/valve next to the water heater, wandering if that should also be replaced. His answer was "NO". He said I did not need to waste $400 fixing something until it actually needed to be fixed. What a delight to find a company that values PEOPLE more than money. Jean was so kind, completely trustworthy, and clearly values quality craftsmanship—thank you, Jean! And his quote was far better than the one from the "other company", forget the fact that they still haven't called me back. When he scheduled my installation, he expressed that he wanted me to get to know the rest of his team, so he set up my installation with Kerry. It was equally nice to see how much Jean values the people that work with him, too! Kerry was scheduled to arrive between 10 and 12. Kerry contacted me when he was on his way, and arrived only moments after 10AM, how cool is that? Kerry was so personable & professional that I readily knew I was dealing with a top-notch master plumber for sure! He took such care to make sure that everything was done precisely and TOP-NOTCH! Both of my sons saw the installation after he left, and both commented on his TOP-NOTCH work! Kerry even did things that were not part of the original estimate, like drill a hole through the wall to the outside, so that a proper drainpipe could be installed (he did beautiful work on that too). It is so comforting knowing that in the future, I don't even have to think twice about who I will call for all of my plumbing problems—the wonderful team of this family-owned business—JB PLUMBING! I HAVE FOUND MY PLUMBING FAMILY!

reviews.author: Katie Pizzo
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend JB Plumbing enough! I recently moved to a new house and discovered I had several problems and leaks that needed to be fixed. Chris and Kerry have been absolutely wonderful throughout the entire process. Their team is incredibly professional, and they get to you quickly – they've helped me resolve many issues that could have been major headaches.

What really impressed me was their responsiveness, especially when I had a gas leak on the weekend. I was panicking, but they came out immediately and handled everything with such care and professionalism. They were reassuring, took the time to explain what was happening, answered all my questions, and made sure everything was safe before they left.

Chris and Kerry truly go above and beyond. They're not just skilled plumbers – they're genuinely helpful people who care about their customers. Their dedication, even during what should have been their time off, really shows their commitment to excellent service.

If you need a reliable, skilled, and caring plumber, look no further. JB Plumbing has earned a customer for life, and I'm so grateful for all their help!

reviews.author: Angela
reviews.text: It was an awful experience. Had them inspect a water tank leak. He knew what was wrong, but pretended he did not and started to criticize everything you could think of. He talked for about 30 minutes about how everything had been done wrong and was just really letting me know how stupid I was for hiring the guy who had installed my water tank. Started to talk about how I might need to get a new water tank and a new furnace when it was only 5 years old, and redo everything like re-plumb and replace everything. Went on and on about this needing to be fixed and that needing to be fixed, and pretended he couldn't tell how many gallons of water the tank held. He spent a few hours wasting my time away from work, just to empty out the entire water tank and fix absolutely nothing. I ended up having to miss work that day altogether. He told me he can now fix it after the tank is empty, but it will cost a lot of money. Made the entire situation sound much worse than it was, when it was a simple fix, while trying to charge me more than it was, which he had already done for just showing up and emptying my water tank, fixing nothing. I let him go and said I needed to think about the quote since it was very high. Additionally, the quote kept changing throughout his criticism of the water tank, the plumbing, and various other aspects. He started to say things to scare me about the kind of damage, and he might not be able to come back later if I changed my mind about having him fix the leak. About how I will not have hot water to shower if I don't make a decision now. Almost a threat to get a little lady homeowner to spend so much money on a fix that was not what he said. I think he purposely emptied the water tank to get ready to "replace" the tank that did not need to be replaced. I discovered all of that when I found someone else to come look, and it took 10 minutes and was free. The reviews about Roto-Rooter were true, in that they overcharge and upsell more than necessary, except that the reviews also missed how they create issues that do not exist. Stay away from this one. Incredibly dishonest business. Forced to give one star, but wish it could be a negative 5 stars.

reviews.author: Taylor Andrews
reviews.text:
UPDATE: Approximately 30 minutes after Shawn and Darian left, we were without hot water, yet again. I called them back out the next day, and I was informed it was a cartridge in the single-handle shower upstairs causing our entire house to be without hot water. I informed the technician I would not accept that answer, and we called another company out two days later. Upon telling the new company what was happening, he immediately diagnosed it as the recirculating pump, which we had mentioned both times 1 Tom had been out.

After running diagnostic testing, it was confirmed to be the recirculating pump. Fast forward to the next day, and we had discovered a significant gas leak at our water heater. There were missing and loose screws, allowing gas to flow freely into our garage instead of properly venting out into the exhaust. I’d like to think that 1 Tom would have noticed this since they “watched the flame rod for 30 minutes,” but nothing was ever mentioned about it (the second company did not have to “open” our water heater for the recirculation pump diagnostic). Our family’s health was severely jeopardized by this oversight. I highly recommend spending your money elsewhere.

Shawn and Darian were quick and efficient with their service! Having no hot water isn’t any fun, but they fixed the problem quickly, and they made sure to thoroughly explain the problem they found. 10/10 recommend these guys!!

reviews.text: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup in Atlanta demonstrated true craftsmanship and precision during their recent visit. They carefully installed a battery backup sump pump in our basement and walked us through each feature, ensuring we felt secure in its operation. Their thoughtful approach to flood prevention showcased both technical knowledge and genuine care for the integrity of our home. It’s rare to find a crew that balances skill with professionalism so consistently. Our foundation feels protected, and our confidence in their work is absolute.

reviews.author: Greg Gerry
reviews.text: I’d give 6 stars for the team at Roto-Rooter if I could.  I called at 10 am and Garret listened to our issue and promptly had a technician scheduled to come to the house by noon.  Our tech Axel arrived on time and was understanding, professional, and friendly.  He diagnosed and fixed our water problem in no time.  Extremely pleased and satisfied from top to bottom.  Do yourself a favor and give them a call.  Thanks again!

reviews.author: Mallory Neal House
reviews.text: Axel was great!! Was on site within an hour of me calling - identified the issue and had everything replaced and working properly the next day. I’ve used roto rooter a few times and have always had a great experience with each tech. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: John R
reviews.text:
Monday and Tuesday I had guys out to encapsulate my crawl space.In that process one of the workers cracked one of my pipes under my house in which they said they would handle getting repairs. Rota-Rooter is the company they finally were able to get to come out. I was told they would be here at 6:30pm, but the plumber didnt show up until 8:45pm.
The plumber asked me if I had the water turned off not realizing he was talking about at the meter. As far as I knew the pipe that got cracked wasnt leaking no one told me anything as far as that. I told him it is. He noticeable got mad when he discovered the water wasnt turned off and spent the next 10 minutes scolding me.
After he got done scolding me I took him to the water meter. He then proceeded to ask me if I had a T handle to turn the water off. Since when did I become to the plumber having to supply equipment?Isnt that something all should have in the business? I told him no and then the curse words starting flying out his mouth in the middle of the night.
He told me to call my neighbor and ask them if they have one. I know darn well she doesnt plus she had already gone to bed. Here we sat at the meter with him trying to turn the water off with a wrench. He finally got it turned off.
I went back in at this point because it’s not my job to do his job. I remained respectful through this time of interaction, but I can tell you for any plumbing needs that arise in the future on my dime I will not ever call Roto Rooter. If I ever have a company do anything under my house and they mess something up I will tell them to never call Roto Rooter.
I know they have been around for decades but rudeness wont get customers

Check out the before and after pictures!  Hint: the before pictures are the ones where there's more corrosion than metal.

===Original Review===
I bought a new condo and had them do a plumbing inspection before I moved in.

Bad news:  The former owners did nothing to maintain it, the plumbing is a disaster, and the home inspector missed it.

Good news:  Rob checked everything thoroughly, gave me a detailed explanation of what was wrong, prioritized the most important fixes, gave me quotes on each phase that would need to be done, and discussed financing since he knew I just gave all my money to the bank.

It was frightening and disheartening to hear about all the problems, but by the time he left, I felt so much better because I have a plan and a way to afford it.  I can't thank you enough and look forward to updating this review with the after pictures!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Ball
reviews.text: I was referred to Bishop Plumbing by Carrozza Plumbing and I'm so thankful for their professionalism and great work ethic.  Joe and Lionel were amazing, I had tree roots and the previous company did not do the job well.  Bishop does things RIGHT, they did a fantastic job and Joe kept me informed during the entire painful process.  Thank you guys!!  We appreciate your hard work.

reviews.author: Kate Cummings
reviews.text:
I cannot figure out how anyone is giving them anything other than 1 star.  Interesting, they have only a 1.5 rating on yelp????
Anyway, the place is a total scam. Charged us thousands of dollars and claimed they found the break. Turns out the x he was referring to was actually from a tree trimming job done the week earlier. He came to the door 3 times. Each time looking for more money to do further investigation. In the end they never found the cause. We than had a local independent guy come out. He found the break and didn't even charge us for the camera use. Bishop only offered us $100 compensation. However, if we took the $100 we had to sign a waiver stating we would not publish bad reviews. Well that says it all. We refused the $100 just so we would be able to warn others in our neighborhood of the sketchy services. We care more about being a good neighbor than getting $100. STAY AWAY!!!

plumbers.name: The Trenchless Co.
plumbers.address: 6201 Elvas Ave, Sacramento, CA 95819, USA

reviews.author: Andrea Willey
reviews.text: I would give The Trenchless Co. 10 stars if I could! From the first call with Lucy for scheduling to the crew completing the job, the entire experience was outstanding. This was a challenging slab leak that had stumped multiple other plumbers and detection companies, but this team stepped in with confidence and determination. They solved the issue and professionally executed the repair. The workmanship was excellent, communication was great throughout. I’m so grateful for this crew. Thank you to everyone at The Trenchless Co. on Elvas Ave—you’re the best!

reviews.author: Meg S
reviews.text: Excellent customer service! If you get Lucy when you call you're guaranteed top notch service. She knows her stuff and outstanding phone skills! I had them add a clean out to my home. Matt came out I actually need new sewer pipes as mine are cast iron.. but Matt was very personable and I explained that I didn't have the money now for new pipes, so he suggested that I add a clean out in my driveway since the house never had one, and that way they would have easy access if a clog was to occur. The price very very affordable. I just bought the home and I wasn't aware of how old the sewer pipes were... The team they sent out (Apolonio/Freilyn) were also fabulous, friendly, and answered all my paranoid questions. They took care of the first part of the dig and remove around a 3x3ish square, and cut the pipe and put in the new pipe for the clean out, and filled the hole with dirt. There was rain in the forecast, so a different team (Rick/Shawn) came back and filled the hole with the concrete and they also answered all my new home owner questions. Both teams were very knowledgeable and personable. From a new homeowner who had called several companies regarding my sewer pipes this was the most super stupendous all around best company I have encountered. I have also worked over 30 years in customer service, and I know most people are quick on the negative, so I wanted to give a really good positive about my whole experience. I will be using them to re-pipe my sewer once I can save up for it. I hope this group of people get the acknowledgement they deserve!

reviews.author: Francine Scott
reviews.text: There was a lack in communication. The Documentation signing   I had to reach out to the company with a phone call to expedite signing papers and pay them to get my project completed. 2,500.00 dollars to dig a hole find the small leak and cut pipe to replace coupling. The plumber who installed the coupling was conscientious and completed the project in a timely manner matter.

reviews.author: david worley
reviews.text:
While buying our new home, our agent arranged for The Trenchless Co. to inspect the sewer line and clear a blockage that had been found by a previous company. We were told that for just over $1,000 they would jet the line, clear the blockage, and fully clean out the system. This was a challenging job, as two other companies had been unable to even locate the sewer clean-out. The technician from The Trenchless Co. did find it and performed the work professionally—he was knowledgeable, helpful, and respectful throughout the visit.

However, after receiving the inspection results and jetting report, we were advised to pay an additional $500 for “more jetting” to clean the remainder of the line. This recommendation came after being told the original $1,000 service would clear and clean the line completely. Being asked for another $500 to finish work we believed was already included felt unreasonable and came across as an unnecessary upsell. The clean-out had already been located and the additional work would have required minimal extra effort, making the added charge seem more like a money grab than a genuine recommendation.

Update:

Max, the owner of The Trenchless Co., reached out personally and went above and beyond to make things right. He is sending a technician back out to complete the remaining work at no additional cost. Max was extremely professional and transparent, explaining that the crew had gone beyond the original scope of the call but agreeing that the job should have been fully completed—or at the very least, I should have been informed and given options before the technician left.

His willingness to take responsibility and ensure the job is done correctly truly stands out. Because of Max’s efforts, I’m now a loyal customer and a big supporter of The Trenchless Co. They’ve shown that they genuinely care about their customers and their community, and I sincerely appreciate the way they handled this situation.

reviews.author: Michael Salac
reviews.text: After posting a negative 2 star review for Trenchless Co. for assuming the work was overpriced. Didn't realize the scope of the work that needed be done. Max Greenburg (owner) reached out to me and explained what the job I paid for entailed. Lot more  than I realized and why I was charged the amount for the work. After speaking with Max several times today , he came across as an honest owner who truly cares about his customers. Will recommend this company to anyone who needs work done in what they specialize in. 5 stars....
