reviews.author: Javier Arroyo
reviews.text:
The service I have received from this company and its technicians has been very good. Justin is very professional, shows on time, and is effective in troubleshooting and finding root cause for issues. I definitely recommend working with Rapid Response for any HVAC related needs.
Thank you.
Mr. Arroyo Mooreland II Subdivision/ Brentwood.

reviews.author: Kenny Taylor
reviews.text:
I called Rapid Responce Heating and Cooling for an issue with my home heating system. Not only were they super fast with scheduling an appointment, their technician Chad Cox did an amazing job with troubleshooting my unit to figure out my issue. He was very professional, courteous and super friendly. I will without a doubt call them again if I have services needed.

Thanks a bunch Chad

reviews.author: Jessica Sellers
reviews.text: Truly so thankful for Rapid Response for their extraordinary service and skills as we renovate an old house! Tyler in particular has gone above and beyond, and anytime in the future a plumbing need arises, we will always ask for him! Particularly during Winter Storm Fern, we had a true crisis involving a burst pipe, and Tyler arrived quickly and was very knowledgeable and helpful with getting us everything we needed. Thank you all again for being so helpful and responsive.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Crossville
plumbers.address: 4624 Genesis Rd, Crossville, TN 38571, USA

reviews.author: Linda Simmons
reviews.text:
Mr Rooter is a company that goes over and above to provide the best service possible!!
Not once, but twice they have repaired a broken waterline at our building and have been a real pleasure to work with. Finally a company that really cares about their customers and providing top quality service!  You can’t go wrong with Mr Rooter! Good old-fashioned customer service is hard to find, we found it here with Mr Rooter.  They are also very knowledgeable and very professional. The owner is top notch, he even showed up on the job to help out and support his team, how often do you see that.  We are customers for life, 100%.

reviews.author: montana van der werf
reviews.text: Luke was wonderful to work with—very kind and professional—and the office was responsive. I called and they had Luke out within the hour, which I did appreciate. However, the pricing was disappointing. $400 for one PVC ball valve and a small piece of insulation for winterizing—materials that cost under $50 and required roughly 15 minutes of labor. It felt like pricing that takes advantage of people when they’re in a bind, which definitely left a bad taste in my mouth and makes it hard to recommend mr. rooter or use them again in the future. While the response time was fast and the work was done, the markup was excessive!!

reviews.author: Marty Riddle
reviews.text: I called a central service and told them that I needed an Rheem electric tankless repair done. Unfortunately, the service sent us a gas water heater repair man from Mr. Rooter. He did try to fix the problem, he did what he could. We still have the error code on the unit, but learned how to by pass it. We feel the cost for the service was quite high. The technician was professional, friendly, and did try to address the issue.

reviews.author: Sasra Deesha
reviews.text: Amazing experience with the Mr. Rooter team; the task was completed within a few hours, including the inspection. Trustworthy, safe, and highly recommended.

reviews.author: Raeanne Hance
reviews.text: Responded immediately very knowledgeable very kind. Got us up  and running in one day. Pricing may be a tad high, but worth the efficient work.   The technician Luke was amazing

plumbers.name: 5 Star Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1136 Kensington Ln, Lincoln, CA 95648, USA

reviews.author: Lauren Butterfield
reviews.text: Technician Benjamin was great & came within the hour to fix an emergency compensated supply line to my toilet. He was communicative, kind, & worked to expectations. The price was high, totaling over $350 for the replacement & 50 minutes of labor. It had to be fixed so there was really no opportunity to look elsewhere but I was confident because of the reviews. Overall I’d consider 5 Star again.

reviews.author: S L
reviews.text: I had a great experience with 5 Star Plumbing. Their customer service was excellent from start to finish—very responsive, professional, and easy to work with. The quote they provided was fair and competitive, with no pressure or hidden surprises. What I appreciated most was how open and honest they were in explaining the work and the pricing. They took the time to answer my questions and made sure I understood my options before moving forward. It’s refreshing to work with a company that values transparency and customer trust. I would definitely recommend 5 Star Plumbing and wouldn’t hesitate to use them again.

reviews.author: David Stonehouse
reviews.text: Amir was able to move a late afternoon appointment to an earlier, more convenient time. He was prompt and did a good job explaining the issues with my drains. The fix was done pretty quickly and the pricing was fair. I had confidence in Amir’s work.

reviews.author: albert nahman
reviews.text:
We had a drain cleaning job in our Sacramento home and was very pleased with the interaction I had with the technician, Tolly.  He was very straightforward and explained everything to me on the phone as I was not able to be on site.  He was able to come earlier than expected and let me know well in advance.
He was an excellent communicator and the price was reasonable. I would definitely call them again for our rental home in Sacramento.

reviews.author: Brittany Shepherd
reviews.text:
5 star plumbing offered high-quality service and customer service which directly aligns with their company name. Everything about this company was five stars. I contacted 5 star plumbing as a second opinion.  There was flooding in both bathrooms and I was told (by a different company) I needed to reroute the entire plumbing system. The 5 star plumbing technician Eze arrived promptly, assessed the issues, and unclogged the drain! They were efficient, maintained an open line of communication, and provided an estimated price range prior to starting the job!
Once the job was done, the problem was explained and job site left clean!

Hands down- the best plumbing experience yet! Will definitely use them again and would recommend to those in need of service!

plumbers.name: Advanced Plumbing & Drain
plumbers.address: 3450 Sacramento St #204, San Francisco, CA 94118, USA

reviews.author: Luma Muhtadie
reviews.text: I love this company! They are responsive, professional, and fairly priced. I’ve enjoyed working with Aaron on multiple projects—he is friendly, reliable, and takes the time to explain what he’s doing. After trying three different plumbing companies in SF that were more focused on selling me things than fixing problems, this was such a refreshing change! I finally have a go-to plumber I can trust!

reviews.author: Robin Adler
reviews.text: Aaron gets an A for amazing. Awesome. Amiable. We will use Advanced if we ever have a plumbing need, and you should, too. Responsive on the phone. Quick appointment slot. Communicative when he was arriving. Love that I found this company!

reviews.author: Cynthia Christopher
reviews.text:
On Xmas day, the hot water faucet handle on my kitchen sink fell off and created a geyser.
I called several plumbing companies who gave high consultation fees. Most weren’t available until the next day.
Fortunately, I found Advanced Plumbing and Drain. Tim answered the phone and scheduled me for the next day between 7-8.
Alex kept me updated as to his arrival time.
I opened the door to a very friendly happy plumber who put us at ease. He was professional and knowledgeable. Alex did a quick fix at a fair price so that we could celebrate Christmas that day.

reviews.author: Mayo Molnar
reviews.text:
I had a very stressful plumbing emergency and I googled plumbers near me and asked for a plumber 'right now', these guys were the third ones on my list (previous two couldn't dispatch someone at that time) and Jill at the dispatch said she migh have someone in the area and sure enough Alex Fernandez was in the area and arrived on site within 5 minutes which was amazing!
He was very helpful and knowledgeable and dealt with the issue in a professional manner and didn't take him too long! I was very happy to have the whole issue resolved in one hour as it concerned the whole building with multiple units. Thank you!!!
I have saved their number now so I know who to call next time i need a good and reliable plumber!
Very much recommend this business!

reviews.author: Danielle ML
reviews.text:
We had an issue late Sunday afternoon with our kitchen sink. We called their service, and they arrived promptly early Monday morning. The technician was knowledgeable, courteous, and thorough. He explained the problem and showed us how to prevent future issues: avoid putting too much food in the garbage disposal, and run hot water with detergent once a week to help prevent clogs.
I highly recommend this company!

plumbers.name: Lee Company
plumbers.address: 142 Bear Creek Pike, Columbia, TN 38401, USA

reviews.author: Raegan
reviews.text: Lee Company installed 5 scones for me and while the technician was very polite and professional, he did a pretty terrible job.  He ruined all the drywall around the sconces and they are not level with each other.  They also charged $800 for the sub-par work.  When I complained, they did say they would come back out to fix the drywall but it would be 3 weeks before they could do so which is unacceptable.

reviews.author: Derron Schronce
reviews.text: The service I received from Lee Company was excellent, professional, and personable. They are superior in their communication from scheduling to arrival. I was so impressed that I didn’t hesitate to contact them again for another service project coming up. I sincerely recommend them.

reviews.author: Nick P
reviews.text: Had my dryer vent cleared out as it was causing a fire hazard. Son, my technician, was very helpful and polite. He actually replaced part of my dryer vent as it was torn from the initial installation of my dryer. Always love using Lee as their service and quality of work is top notch

reviews.author: James Hiatt
reviews.text: Had my refrigerator repaired by Scott. He explained the problem and what needed to be done. He ordered the replacement part and came back in a few days as scheduled and replaced it. Very professional and friendly service.

reviews.author: Julie Coveney
reviews.text: Had two services on same day: plumbing and electrical. The two men arrived on time and fixed the concerns we had with efficiency. They also explained a comprehensive annual service that covered many things. Reasonably priced. Very effective workers and able to take care of items needing repair. Thank you Lee Company.

plumbers.name: AllTech Plumbing, Heat, and Air - Southwest Oklahoma
plumbers.address: 1902 SW Washington Ave, Lawton, OK 73501, USA

reviews.author: Jacki Harris
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Alltech Heating and Air. I called the day before snowmageddon was set to hit majority of the U.S. with below freezing temps, high precipitation chances and my heater was working only at times. From start to finish, alltech reached out to me within the hour of making a request and gave me a slotted time for service. They provided me with updates and even came out earlier than expected. The tech, Josh was PHENOMENAL. He was very professional, arrived on time, and took the time to clearly explain everything that was being done. After identifying the problem and troubleshooting for the solution, he rechecked his work and ensured everything was operational. The service was excellent from start to finish, and I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: David Ray
reviews.text: We experienced trouble with a propane wall heater and asked Altech Lawton OK for a repairman who came the very next day (name of Daniel). He was very professional and knew exactly what to do, finishing the job without complications. Altech has always been there for our repairs and we have always been very happy with the results.

reviews.author: David Stanley
reviews.text: Tyler , with AllTech is the best plumber I’ve ever used! He was fast, courteous, knowledgeable, and had attention to detail.  Good service is hard to find these days but Tyler has been a pleasure to have at my house detecting and fixing my plumbing issues. I will not think twice about using AllTech and Tyler in particular for any plumbing issues in the future!!

reviews.author: Tanner Sayler
reviews.text: David and Josh came when our heat was out and reading Lo during the ice storm. After one simple fix they were able to get us going and now we are getting warm. They were so professional and knowledgeable. Thank you!

reviews.author: Michael Vurno
reviews.text:
Edit: they scheduled another appointment for Wednesday to do the camera again...

I called Pippen Brothers this afternoon, the same $99 service fee, they came out within a couple of hours and quickly cleared my line and ran a camera.
If you want quality service and good customer service, do what I did, go elsewhere. My experiences with Pippen Brothers have been great. A complete night and day from these con artists
My family of 4 (3 females) have not had working toilets in over a week because our home warranty company contracts with AllTech. In the past they have added charges and tried to get me to buy a whole heating and air system because mine wouldn't last the weekend (over $10k) my system is still working strong 6 months later. This current situation, it took them a few days to come out to my non working restrooms. The person they senta few days later on Monday didn't have the proper tools to properly snake the line. They made me wait til late Wednesday afternoon (still with no toilets or showers).  He also didn't have the proper tools to fix the problem. I then had to wait til Friday and they showed up at 730 at night. 2 hours past their window. They only called me when the warranty company called them. I called twice without a return call. Every dealing with them has been a horrible experience. We are probably going to change warranty companies just to avoid dealing with them again.

Go anywhere else.

plumbers.name: R & A Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3998 Rippey Lake Rd, Mt Pleasant, TN 38474, USA

reviews.author: Mark Burstein
reviews.text: This is great company to work with that I would highly recommend!!!  They communicate with you throughout the whole process and deliver exactly what they say they will.  Extremely friendly and always take the time to answer any questions you may have.  Jeff & Misty and their team are great!!!

reviews.author: Acacia Melody
reviews.text: If looking for an honest family company who will be thorough about the work and communicate clearly the entire process, we could not recommend R&A Plumbing enough. They saved us THOUSANDS of dollars. This is a company that cares about people and doing excellent work. Thank you Misty and Jeff!

reviews.author: Tammy Carroll
reviews.text:
They were great. I would highly recommend them and I would use them again. They did exactly what they said, they would do.

For the initial bid. My thoughts were they were nice and very knowledgeable. They showed up when they said they would and discussed what could and could not be done.

I let them replace all the water and sewer pipes under the house and they did a great job. They were very thoughtful of the renter living in the home. They did exactly what we discussed in our initial bid discussion. We are very happy with the job they did. I will definitely use them again if we have any plumbing problems.

reviews.author: Paul McWilliams
reviews.text: Our 40 gallon 3 year old hot water heater failed and we had water all over our garage. I called R & A Plumbing and with 2 hours the guys arrived, removed the water heater and found the problem. We discussed options replacement tank or tankless water heaters. Both pros and cons were talked about and after discussion we decided to go with a tankless unit. They went right to work on the installation, heavy downpours didn’t slow their progress at all. Within a few short hours we were up and running with hot water. Great job by R & A Plumbing, we highly recommend them for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Hayley Wilson
reviews.text: I've now used R & A Plumbing for multiple jobs, and I'm thoroughly impressed with their service, staff, pricing and knowledge. I trust their family-owned business and never feel like I'm being pressured with any kind of sales tactics that some of the larger-owned corporations use. We will continue to use R & A Plumbing and recommending them to family and friends.

plumbers.name: True Plumbers & AC
plumbers.address: 4000 N Frontage Rd, Plant City, FL 33565, USA

reviews.author: John
reviews.text: True Plumbers & AC recently installed a new AC unit at my house. The old AC was 21 years old and was the install was definitely needed. TJ and John “Book” came out to install and did a fantastic job. They were both professional and friendly and I never doubted their expertise. Brian was also there to oversee the project and was first class with his friendliness and was great at keeping us up to date with the progress. Would 100% recommend this company!

reviews.author: Mary Lewis
reviews.text: I called around 7pm on a Sunday night because our backyard spiket broke.  We have well water so we had to shut off water to our entire house.  Initially, there was some communication issues but Kayle contacted me and addressed my concerns.  The service technician was very professional and fixed the problem quickly.  I would definitely use True plummers in Plant City again

reviews.author: Dannyl Risk
reviews.text:
Will be our go-to plumbers from this day forward!

We had a death in the family yesterday. Within an hour of that happening, mom's water heater began flooding the Florida room.

Three calls to our home warranty left us even more distraught. I found True Plumbers online. From my first contact with Erica, to Chris and Paul coming out they treated is with kindness, respect, and grace.

Chris and Paul found the issue quickly and were able to fix it easily.

What could have been a total disaster for our family ended up making our day just a bit brighter for their kindness dedication and service.

reviews.author: Dee
reviews.text:
Based on an exceptionally positive experience with True Builders on my kitchen rebuild three years ago, I didn’t hesitate to contact True Plumbers when I needed a new water heater. Although we had a bit of a bumpy start (which, I admit, was primarily my doing), Chris persevered to find a solution that would ensure my complete satisfaction. I really appreciated his patience and efforts. Randall and Charles installed the tank with expertise and tenacity in a timely manner. When installation was concluded, Randall was resolute in not leaving the property until the water had reached the maximum temperature and he was assured  that I was happy with it. I was very impressed and appreciative of that. All three of these men were friendly, respectful (of both me and my property), and considerate. In addition, they all seemed to share the common goal of leaving the customer happy - and they did that. I would be remiss if I didn’t mention Erica who went above and beyond in overseeing the whole process, and in her constant reassurances. She is a gem and an excellent representative of the company.

Thank you, True… you hire good people!

reviews.author: Devon Coleman
reviews.text: Awesome experience with Mr.Alex Cheek today. Woke up to no water gave you guys a call and the lady on the phone(sorry I didn't catch her name) was very helpful and quick to get things moving for me. Mr. Alex got here in just a couple hours and had my place back up and running again in about 45 minutes. Also pretty good pricing. Was worried I'd have to cash in the savings but it ended up being a fraction of what I thought it would be. If I ever need a plumber again you guys will have my business without a doubt. Thank you so much for your help!!!

plumbers.name: RightNOW Plumbing
plumbers.address: 11047 Pierson Dr G, Fredericksburg, VA 22408, USA

reviews.author: David Michel
reviews.text: Your scheduler, estimator and installation crew all did a great job - competent, professional, quick, and tidy leaving a completed job and a clean workplace.  You provided a quality product I requested at a competitive price.  You asked and answered questions and provided detailed explanations.  Excellent work TEAM !

reviews.author: H
reviews.text:
excellent and fast service!  competitive pricing.

the team showed up when they said they would and was happy to answer all my questions and make the work happen on a timeline that worked for me.  i had four other contractors come by to look at the job and quote the work.  so i was feeling well educated about what was going on.

in sum, good value, willingness to explain,  thoughtful answers to questions, and the ability to do a quick turn from "yes" to execution - that closed the deal.  thanks :)

reviews.author: Henry Kim
reviews.text: Exceptional customer service. I left a message regarding my water heater at 7:30 pm and at 7:35 pm, Katie called me back and got me scheduled the next morning. Andy, the tech was great. I highly recommend RightNOW Plumbing!

reviews.author: Bill Carroll
reviews.text:
Ive known about RightNow Plumbing for a few years but never had to utilize their expertise until today. Nick was absolutely a gentleman and professional as he showed up to my emergency literally under 15 minutes. I was sooo impressed and thankful. He assessed the problem immediately and once we were able to shut off the main valve, he had it fixed and repaired within 6 minutes. He acted like it was a walk in the park but to me it was like Superman with a RightNow Plumbing cape on came to us to rescue my home from damage.

I highly recommend Nick and his crew for doing what they do best with an extra added flair and overdose of personalism, and professionalism.

reviews.author: Edgar Cubas
reviews.text:
Very pleased with the services. The technicians are polite and fully knowledgeable to answer questions.
I compared prices with about 10 other contractors, and this company was the only one that worked with me in the options without wasting my time with tedious appointments during this hectic holiday season. I am glad they accommodated the installation on Christmas Eve. Thank you for that, too.
I recommend this company.

plumbers.name: Kwik Serv Plumbing, Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 1047 E High St, Mundelein, IL 60060, USA

reviews.author: Char Oslund
reviews.text:
I used this company on recommendation of my home owners ins. However, I am very pleased on so many levels... with the quick schedualing, the service was beyond  professional as well as accurate!  The service man was so sweet and courteous, on time. My toilet wasn't really even broken, he showed me how to fix it if it happens again. Over all... a really great experience!  And to think if I wasn't for my ins company, I may not have known to call them.  I am 65 and have had my fair share of service calls. Firstly, you worry as you don't want to get "taken", and then there is the lateness along with the attitude and rudeness... none of that!  I am telling you... so refreshing! I will us them even when its not a insurance issue. I feel  confident that I will have no issues.
Gina at the office is also great.

reviews.author: Hope Engels
reviews.text: Kwik Serv Plumbing is an amazing company. First, I would like thank Gina who works in the office. She was amazing. Very courteous and sweet. She assisted me with scheduling the installation and answered all of my questions. Gina also assisted me with scheduling the Village of Buffalo Grove for the final inspection. Alex A and Adrien were the technicians who installed the new hot water heater and they were amazing. They were courteous and professional. They were prompt and cleaned up completely after the installation was completed. They also gave me an explanation on what they did and how the new hot water heater works. I highly recommend this company. You will not be sorry.

reviews.author: Ben Stylez
reviews.text: Andy is hands-down the best HVAC technician I’ve worked with. He showed up on time, knew exactly what he was doing, and broke everything down in a way that actually made sense. No rushing, no guesswork—just pure professionalism and skill. He treated my home like it was his own and made sure everything was 100% before leaving. If Andy is on the job, you’re in great hands. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him to anyone.

reviews.author: Tammie Clarke
reviews.text:
Josh P. was absolutely outstanding! He was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly polite throughout the entire service. His customer service skills were top-notch—he brought back that old-school feeling of being truly valued as a customer. It’s rare to find someone who takes such pride in their work and treats clients with genuine respect. If I ever need plumbing help again, Josh will be my first request. Highly recommended!

Thanks,
Tammie

reviews.author: Nyronia Clark
reviews.text: Ulises was great! He explained the issues and why replacement parts were needed.  He took his time and properly installed faucets & pop up extension. He made sure to thoroughly test after installation.  He also found the source of the leak.  He was great with communicating as well as the work performed.  The job was just completed yesterday, so hopefully there will be no future issues related to this job.  I’d so I will leave another review.  However with the service he provided I belief that will be unlikely.  I will be sure to request Kwik Serv and Ulises for my plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Lee’s Plumbing Repairs
plumbers.address: 4697 Jakes Colony Rd, Seguin, TX 78155, USA

reviews.author: Amanda Flory (Conn)
reviews.text:
I got an LeftOn sink that I wanted installed. This process required a different company to come out and remove the old sink, then cut the countertop to the proper size.

Once these guys came out to the house to install it, we realized that there were several parts of the drain that needed to be replaced because it was not compatible with my current setup.

Not only did they do a good job at setting up a new drainage system that was compatible with the sink and my home, but they did it in a timely manner, explained the entire process as they did the install. Before leaving, they made sure to test everything, explained the aftercare of a newly installed sink, and cleaned up their workspace.

reviews.author: K. P. J.
reviews.text: We appreciate the work done by Caleb and Chase!  The recommendations, water heater and softener they installed and the instructions for maintenance were excellent!   Highly professional and the costs were extremely reasonable.  We highly recommend anyone in the New Braunfels/Seguin area to get a quote and go with Lee’s Plumbing Repair!

reviews.author: Larry Buchanan
reviews.text: 10/10 would recommend. Called around town to about 10 businesses trying to get someone out today, only Lee's could make it. Not only did they come out last minute, but they quickly diagnosed the problem AND installed a new water heater same day!

reviews.author: Leah Carrillo
reviews.text: Caleb and assistant did a great job explaining their recommendations and how the repair would take place for tub faucets and adjoining pipe connections. We are very pleased with the results and have piece of mind with their in house warranty. Booking was easy, however improvements could be made making more precise time frames. For both plumbing sessions, the plumbers arrived outside of my quoted appointment time frames, so I had to reschedule other appointments to accommodate their late arrival. Overall, would book again for future projects.

reviews.author: Ed Smitley
reviews.text: After having my foundation leveling completed I had the sewer pressure test completed by another company and it failed. Had Lee's Plumbing give me a second opinion and ended up using Lee's Plumbing. The work was completed on schedule which allowed me to go on my vacation as scheduled. Highly recommend Reno's team for all plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Jones & Sons Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1201 Cedar St C, Safety Harbor, FL 34695, USA

reviews.author: Laura Zuppo
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of working with Michelle and Will from Jones & Sons. I called the company because I wanted a second estimate. My parents referred me to them because they were happy with their work and service, as well. Michelle got me an appointment within 24 hours (Thankfully, since I had two bad leaks). She was very polite  and courteous. Will arrived at 9 am (8-10 window). He diagnosed my issues very quickly and proposed two solutions. While the Jones & Sons estimate was higher than the estimate from a larger company by several hundred dollars (the only negative),  I felt confident in Will and how he wanted to approach the issues. I chose Jones over a major market competitor who came in with a better price because of the technician-- quality service and trust always wins! He did a quality job and I would ask for him again if, and when, I need a plumber.

reviews.author: M.A.S HANDYMAN SERVICE
reviews.text: Mr. Uncle James is just a great guy. Very knowledgeable, very honest and straightforward about what's going on. And one of the best parts even though you know you're going to pay a Big Bill somehow he always makes it feel like it's nothing. And Jones and Sons Plumbing as a whole is just amazing they've helped out quite a bit. Ever need any kind of Plumbing from something small to something large they will help out.

reviews.author: Marvin Cluff
reviews.text: I called Jones & Son’s Plumbing early this morning because my sink was clogged. They came and left before noon and we are clog free. Justin was so friendly and knowledgeable and didn’t lie when he said clogs were his specialty. Price was great and I know the clog will never come back. Thanks Jennifer Jimenez for sending Justin out so quick. You were so nice and communicated with me by text all along the way.

reviews.author: Brian Herron
reviews.text: Will was amazing.  He treated our home with respect and transparent about some of the hidden issues while hooking up new plumbing during our remodel.  They were very fair with pricing and worked until the issues were resolved.

reviews.author: Michael Augustine
reviews.text: Jones & Sons always does a great job. I called them yesterday to snake a drain and "Uncle James" arrived at 8am today. Uncle James was fast, clean, and professional.  He explained everything and the situation was quickly resolved.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Austin
plumbers.address: 12201 Roxie Dr, Austin, TX 78729, USA

reviews.author: Roy Shalem
reviews.text:
We’ve had a great experience working with this vendor across our properties. Communication is clear, response times are fast, and the quality of work is consistently solid. They show up when they say they will, handle issues professionally, and take pride in what they do.
As the Maintenance Manager at Smart Egg Properties, having reliable vendors makes a huge difference, and this vendor has proven they can be trusted. I would absolutely recommend them to any property management company or home owner looking for dependable service.
— Roy
Maintenance Manager
Smart Egg Properties

reviews.author: Kitty Myth
reviews.text: Zachery was professional, courteous as they come and patient. My sink had a ridiculously stubborn leak. Zach identified instantly the issue just by looking at it! We’re so impressed and grateful to have met his kind gentleman. Thank you very much for your time, we appreciate y’all.

reviews.author: jeff pray
reviews.text: Juan and Jeremiah were incredible.  We discovered a water leak on the side of our house after 6:00 pm.  We contacted Mr Rooter at a time we considered “after hours.”  They came out promptly, diagnosed the issue, and make the repair.  They were both extremely courteous and friendly despite the late hour.  It was 9:45 pm by the time the repair was completed.  My wife and I are happy to have found Mr. Rooter in an emergency situation and super grateful for their awesome techs Juan and Jeremiah.  Thanks so much guys.

reviews.author: Lisa Moss
reviews.text: Mr Rooter Plumbing was a quick response (called night before arrived next day). Luis and his partner were very friendly and asked the questions they need to know. Toilet flush was repaired quickly this time. I don't know how reasonable the price was because I'm just a temporary tenant. The landlord seems to keep this company on hand as one of their plumbing service options.

reviews.author: Chase Rupe
reviews.text: Had a leak in the washer hookup line at a rental house. Mr. Rooter was out the next day and did the repair quickly and for a fair price. Very responsive, professional, and communicative.

plumbers.name: Action Jackson Drain Cleaning and Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7306 210th St SW, Edmonds, WA 98026, USA

reviews.author: McKenna Kostrencich
reviews.text: My neighbor and I experienced a shared drain clog that caused backups in both of our units. I called Action Jackson, and they arrived within an hour. The team was professional, communicative, and efficient throughout the entire process. They provided a clear, flat‑rate quote upfront, which was more affordable than other services I contacted and/or have used in the past in the area. I would highly recommend Action Jackson to anyone in the greater Seattle area looking for fast, reliable plumbing service!

reviews.author: isaac gaspar
reviews.text: Tyler, Robert and Andrew helped get us back to being able to use our plumbing. Quick service and knowledgeable in the fine art of sewer jetting. They identified problems and offered option besides just the jetting of how I can fix it for good! Thanks for the awesome work!

reviews.author: Alicia Land
reviews.text: Today I called Action Jackson for a clogged sewer at my elderly parents house. I had one other company out there before Action and we found we needed a jetter & camera! I called Action which was referred to me by the other company. I was quoted a price for the job. Tyler and Jake were dispatched to the job! They both knew what they needed for the job to be complete. They brought their Jetter and was in contact with me the whole time from arriving on the job site, to during the job and after. Communication was top notch! Their skill on how to complete the job was fast & efficient. they both were knowledgeable and knew what they were talking about!  I would definitely call Action Jackson again the in the future! I even talked to the owner at the beginning of the job and he was honest & straightforward with me and made sure my family was taken care of! If I could give them more than 5* I definitely would! Cheers!!

reviews.author: Cole Smith
reviews.text: Action Jackson was extremely timely and very reasonably priced. They were onsite in about in hour from when I called them and got the job done quickly. I highly recommend them and will for sure be using them next time.

reviews.author: _ jkendle@uw.edu
reviews.text:
Action Jackson came through again with professionalism, thoroughness, timely and friendly service.  From the lady that answered my initial call for help with warm and helpful scheduling, having Action Jackson representative Bobby show up in less than 35 minutes, and getting everything cleaned out and leaving the area like he and his assistant found it.  To say I'm a happy customer and have NO hesitation recommending this wonderful family-owned business is a true understatement!

Big thanks to Bobby and the rest of the Action Jackson team!!!

plumbers.name: Casco Plumbing And Well Pump Service
plumbers.address: 43 W Jubal Early Dr, Winchester, VA 22601, USA

reviews.author: Craig Lewis
reviews.text: This is the second job I've had Casco Plumbing do at my home. Jimmy has been here to perform both jobs and I've been more then 100% satisfied with his work. He listens to you when you define the problem and then he looks it over and comes up with a plan to correct the problem. Most recently he unclogged the drain and he redid the plumbing under my kitchen sink. I have some additional work that needs to be performed in the next couple of months and I'll be calling Casco Plumbing and asking for Jimmy.

reviews.author: Sharon Bartshe
reviews.text: Kudo’s to Casco Plumbing for sending out a plumber the same day I called them…and not just any plumber.  I think they sent out their best.  Shawn was thorough, neat and very experienced operating the sewer line video camera and interpreting what he saw. He also stayed with us while we waited for the community Warranty Manager to arrive to view the video and the area in question.  I couldn’t be more pleased.  I also found the charges to be fair.  Sky, the receptionist, kept us informed of the approximate time the plumber would arrive.  Such a pleasant voice on the other end of the phone!  Thank you, Casco.

reviews.author: Paul Price
reviews.text: Very good experience. Corey was able ro come out within hours of my call. Handled all issues presented to him in a professional & efficient manner.

reviews.author: patricia young
reviews.text:
Four stars ✨ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ all around!

I had an excellent experience with Jacob from Casio Plumbing & Well Pump Services from start to finish. He was punctual, knowledgeable, and clearly explained the issue and the solution before starting the work. The repair was completed efficiently and to a very high standard, and everything was left clean and tidy afterward. Pricing was fair and transparent, with no surprises. I would confidently recommend this plumber to anyone needing reliable, professional service.

reviews.author: Ali Hayder
reviews.text: Dylan came out and helped us install the new vanity he was very helpful understanding and explained the process very well. Also was very timely available and help finish the job in a timely manner.

plumbers.name: Pro-Rooter Plumbing & Drain Services
plumbers.address: 9501 Timberwind Ln, Yukon, OK 73099, USA

reviews.author: Lord Khang
reviews.text: Shelby and Trent came out and solved a challenge with my septic system that other veteran companies could not without wanting to charge ten or more thousand dollars.  Total professionals whose thoroughness is unmatched in the industry.  The results were exceptional. Their recommendation sound.  I spent far, far less to obtain the best possible result.  Thank you, so very much.  And that Angus guy on the phone, truly a pleasure to deal with sir, I salute all of you.

reviews.author: Kedrin Coleman
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about Shelby. I’m very happy with the service he provided. He was timely, professional, & quick to diagnose/fix the issue I was having. I would highly recommend him and Pro-Rooter Plumbing and Drain Services to anyone in need of plumbing services.

reviews.author: Jason Thaxton
reviews.text: Angus and his team were the best plumbers I have dealt with. Quick, transparent, quote. Arrived right on time to replace our water heater. Communicated with me regarding every step of the way. The work was completed much faster than I could have imagined. The work was impeccable, and our garage was cleaner when they left than when they started. No doubt they will be my first and only call going forward. Can't recommend them strongly enough. It's great when you find a trustworthy and talented company.

reviews.author: Austin Johnston
reviews.text: Trent and Shelby came out to my house this afternoon. They explained to me through step by step of what our situation was looking like in a very professional manner. I would definitely recommend to anyone and definitely going to contact them for any future repairs I have going forward.

reviews.author: Julia Towe
reviews.text: Shelby was so kind and very helpful. He as Professional, quick , high quality work. Will definitely be using him again. Thank you Shelby!

plumbers.name: Allstar Service & Repair
plumbers.address: 762 S 300 W, Payson, UT 84651, USA

reviews.author: Emily Ellsworth
reviews.text: Tyler came to give me a second opinion on my furnace wheel needing cleaning. He recommended I could wait a year or 2 on it (not terribly dirty) but said the coil needed cleaning more than the wheel. He showed me the actual wheel after taking it out and where the coil is. Also photos of both. I chose to get the coil cleaned today and he took Before & After photos of it. He was very thorough and very professional. I will switch to his company from here on.

reviews.author: susan terry
reviews.text:
Justin, from Allstar Plumbing, was aMAZing! he came out to assess my gas pipe leak and gave me a reasonable, fair estimate. as an older woman, I really appreciated that he explained the issues clearly in layman’s terms—never patronizing. he answered all my questions with patience and respect. when he returned to do the work, that same treatment continued. he was quick, kind, and professional throughout. I will definitely use Allstar in the future.

THANKS Justin!

reviews.author: brad rowe
reviews.text: Matt from Canada works for this place. He is a stud. He came in was very clear with pricing and what needed to be done. When it came time to put in the work. That dude was fast! He knows what he's doing and will take care of you. Thanks Matt!

reviews.author: Taylor Hooker
reviews.text: Could not be happier with the work we have always received from AllStar Plumbing. We’ve had huge repairs to small repairs and we’ve always had excellent service, especially from Travis and his team. Val has helped us multiple times and always went above and beyond to help make sure we knew what was going on. We’ve never felt pressured to do anything but we’re always given the honest opinions and suggestions that helped us make the right decisions for us.

reviews.author: Sharee Jensen
reviews.text: Matt came to our house to give us a quote on re plumbing our polybutylene lines and fixing  existing problems to make our plumbing to code. He was very cordial and explained everything to our understanding.  We appreciated his professional opinion.

plumbers.name: Excel Plumbing
plumbers.address: 661 Glenn Ave, Wheeling, IL 60090, USA

reviews.author: Bjoern Elsasser
reviews.text: Excel team provided great service for assessing my sewer line, rodding it and showing me the extent of root invasion into my sewer line. They also mapped out where the sewer line runs. Ivan recommended having the clay pipe hydro jetted to remove the roots and then seal the line with epoxy as no shift in the 4 foot clay pipe connections have shifted more than a quarter inch. One inch requires excavation/installing new sewer line.

reviews.author: Andy Thomas
reviews.text: I called Excel first thing in the morning after discovering a hot water tank leak. Kelly quickly provided me a quote that was reasonably priced and promptly answered all my questions. After accepting the quote they scheduled same day service and kept me in the loop as to next steps. The installation team, led by Yaryk, arrived shortly afterwards and did an awesome job removing the old water heater & installing the new one. They were clean, efficient, and professional.

reviews.author: Lenora Brown-Rodriguez
reviews.text: Excel Plumbing provided stellar and expedient service right when I needed it.  Had a frozen pipe issue during the arctic cold blast on Sunday, January 25, 2026.  The Plumber arrived at my house in under an hour and executed quality servicing as my pipes were unthawed in less than 8 minutes!  I recommend this company for sure!  I hope I never have to endure an issue like that again, but if I do, I will gladly call EXCEL PLUMBING again!

reviews.author: Shannon
reviews.text:
The name says it all….call them if you want a company that provides exceptional service with exceptional people!

I was in a pickle, it’s Sunday (10/19) at 245pm and another company just ditched me!  I only have 1 bathroom and it was out of service since (10/18) at 730pm!

I called this company and within minutes they confirm they can do an emergency service for me and me here today (10/19). Scheduling was easy, and honest and upfront about the time.  Luckily I had someone out to me in 1.5 hours!  Talk about emergency response time!

After setting up my appointment I get a text with my plumbers picture and name (Mike L). Mike arrived promptly, at the time that was agreed upon by the person who scheduled the appointment on the phone.

Prices were given to me up front by Mike and in the end that was exactly what I was charged.  (I love no surprises when it comes to money!) Mike was knowledgeable, very polite, conscious of my home.  He communicated well throughout the process.  Truly a pleasure to work with!

10/10 will be using this company for all future projects or issues!

Thank you for helping out a gal in an emergency, being so prompt, keeping your word, and completing my job to full satisfaction!!!

reviews.author: Lindsey Rose
reviews.text: We had a backup in our basement that lead to us having to basically get all new plumbing. Excel was quick to set up appointments, communicative, and we had 4 different gentleman service our home through the process and all were knowledgeable and friendly. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Heart of Ohio HVAC, Plumbing and Electric
plumbers.address: 1988 Pearl Rd, Brunswick, OH 44212, USA

reviews.author: Cassaundra Sucku
reviews.text: Moved into a new home. We wanted to have our furnace serviced and ensure it was being maintained properly. The tech that came out was very nice and helpful. Stated we needed some work done on our boiler estimating around $1500. Told him I would like to speak to my husband first. I called later that day to ask a question and the person at the Brunswick office said they will call me back. Never did. Called a couple days later to set up service for everything our tech described. They took my info and I never got a call back. A week later,  I went with another company and they were able to send somebody out the same day and fix our problem the same day for way cheaper. The money is not the problem, but the lack of customer service in calling me back is what irritates me. You guys lost out on my business that day, but also my business for the future.

reviews.author: Dawn Walker
reviews.text: We needed a gas line replaced for a fireplace and Dan was amazing!! So helpful and professional and the price was great. He made it a great experience from getting the quote to finishing the job. I highly recommend him for any of your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Sara Jung
reviews.text: This company truly has a heart. When my furnace stopped working as temperatures dropped below 20°, they responded quickly and were incredibly professional and friendly. Scott was our technician, and he was knowledgeable, efficient, and stayed to make sure everything was working properly after he had fixed the issue. I highly recommend this company and will definitely use them again for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical needs!!!! Thank you for your great service!!

reviews.author: Ryan Peecook
reviews.text: Had a furnace and AC unit installed in 2024. I had an Aprilaire 700 humidifier on the old furnace working. Once they left in June, winter came and the Humidifier didn't work. Called them out to look at it and do one of the included inspections, I was told its wired wrong and need schematics. Days turned to weeks, weeks to months and months to a year. I called Aprilaire and had a call last 7 minutes, got the schematics, wired it myself and now its working fine. For the service I received I was overcharged by atleast $1000. $8900 was the cost of my install and my working equipment was no longer working upon install. The rest of the system i am more than happy with but once they collected my money I went from a priority to the back burner. Aprilaire customer support saved me from buying a $500 humidifier when a professional company couldn't obtain schematics to fix my humidifier.

reviews.author: Andrew Ripple
reviews.text: Heart of Ohio was quick to respond and had a plumber sent to my place first thing the morning after contacting them. Brandon came out and did a great job fixing the issues I had, while being friendly, knowledgeable, and polite. I highly recommend Heart of Ohio for any need you might have.

plumbers.name: Pro Plumbing Plus Electric
plumbers.address: 302 S Spring St, Manchester, TN 37355, USA

reviews.author: Carrie Fierro
reviews.text: We tried to save some money and DIY the plumbing ourselves. After the second clog, we gave these guys a call and glad we did. They came out addressed/corrected the issue and ran new main sewer lines. Anthony, Matthew and Curtis were great! Answered my questions, explained the worked completed and left a clean workspace after. From the time you call and speak with sweet Brittany to the final walk-through with Anthony and Curtis you know you are in good hands.

reviews.author: Samra Thut
reviews.text:
Great experience so far! They thoroughly tested for a leak, clearly explained everything, and confirmed the issue. Very honest, professional, and helpful. Glad I chose them!

Update: Anthony & Andrew came out to perform leak detection and had to cut through the drywall, but they did minimal damage and were able to neatly cover it afterward, which I found really impressive. They quickly located the leak and  improvised on the spot to avoid having to jackhammer through my slab.

They truly went the extra mile to find the most cost-effective solution possible, and I really appreciated their effort and honesty throughout the process. I can’t recommend them enough and will definitely be using them exclusively going forward.

reviews.author: Susan Mundell
reviews.text: Chris and Todd were wonderful.  They told me exactly what was wrong (Old cast iron pipes) and cleared the clog as well as I willing me how much it will be to replace the old pipes.  They were very polite and helpful.  I will definitely be contacting Pro Plumbing Plus to get pipes replaced when I can get the money together.  But at least they cleared the blockage in the pipes so I am no longer getting a backwash into my tub and shower.

reviews.author: Doug B
reviews.text: Anthony and Matrhew were professional and courteous and  set my new propane tankless water heater up in one day.  It works great!  The guys even cleaned up the work area after they were done.  Brittany did a great job getting the job scheduled quick and calling to let me know when they were about 45 minutes out for the install.  Price was great too for high quality work and product. Great company that I will definitely be recommending to my friends and family!

reviews.author: Madeline Ritter
reviews.text: I would look somewhere else. This company is not worth the money they estimate. Paid close to 700 dollars for a sink to be reattach the countertop. First guy came he was on time and very polite told me the estimate 693.00 and that they are the cheapest around for a job like this. After "fixing" the sink told us not to use it for 24hrs we didnt. Having to do take out for the night. Couple days later it wasnt attached anymore. Called and told them with what happen same tech came out and "fixed" it again told us to not use it for 24hrs. We didnt use it for 48 hours so take out for 2 nights not cheap first all for a family of 6. After using it for a week the sink detached from the countertop again. Call and explain my frustration on this matter. They sent out a different person. When he came we told him what has happen. Seemed like he didnt believe us or something. He was kinda rude on the matter. Again we cant use our sink for 3 days this was over the weekend. Which was a big inconvenience but at this ponit we just want the sink fixed. After fixing the sink he tell my sister we can not use to the sink until the seal is dry and if it gets wet and they are called out again for it we will be charged. He was not clear on the 5 year warranty they offer. Is the warranty void because they can not fix the problem the first time. My sister sent pictures of the finished work it looks like there is still a gap from the sink to the countertop. I would not recommend this company to anyone.

plumbers.name: The Fair Plumber LLC
plumbers.address: 846 N York St, Elmhurst, IL 60126, USA

reviews.author: JH
reviews.text: I had to get the line routed out between the house and the street, once that was fixed he had to repair the wax ring.   Jose was my plumber,  he was awesome!  Polite and knowledgeable.   A great smile too!  I will definitely use him again. Thank you Jose!! 😊

reviews.author: Peggy Woloszyk
reviews.text:
Our house is 100 years old. Water was backing up into our basement shower. We called 3 companies and only Fair Plumbing sent someone out that same day.

Manny used the camera and found that some clay pipes had shifted and rodding out the pipes did not clear the build up.

The next day, Manny, Anthony and Gabriel arrived. A section of the basement concrete floor needed to be jackhammered to expose the pipe. Once exposed, they also found a hole in the sewer pipe and in the drain pipe.
The clay pipes were replaced with a 10 foot PVC pipe, a new drain and two clean out traps were also installed.
Anthony and Gabriel did a great job laying the new concrete and Manny made sure to keep us informed throughout the entire project.
The team came on time, plastic was hung around the work area, they mopped the floor and did a great job cleaning up. They told us what they needed to do and they got it done. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Ron & Yasha Talaga
reviews.text: Our toliet had been sprouting water from the tank, as well as leaking from around the bottom. Thomas and Rolando from The Fair Plumbers came out, and replaced the wax seal which was pretty much nonexistent, replaced the supply line and reconnected the valve. They were quick, thorough, and informative. The office also did a good job communicating when the plumbers were scheduled and on their way. Overall a great experience!

reviews.author: Orlando Santiago Jr
reviews.text:
Jose and Eric were INCREDIBLE!
Honest, upfront and super helpful with every option they had. They truly saved the day!  The laundry sink broke in the back and when I was unable to reach or see what the issue was i shut the main water valve off and began calling. No one was available, or they were too far away to be bothered until I reached out to The Fair Plumber. They came within an hour and handled it. Will use them again and highly recommend their services

reviews.author: Cruse Family
reviews.text: I called due to a malfunction with our pump. We had warranty with them. I called and they came out to replace it the same day at no charge. Jesus was super helpful at explaining what happened and over all we are very satisfied with the work.

plumbers.name: Brandenburg Plumbing, Heating, & Air
plumbers.address: 320 N Ridge Rd Ste 2B, Marble Falls, TX 78654, USA

reviews.author: Chris Cabiya
reviews.text:
Brandenburg Plumbing provided excellent service diagnosing and repairing a water leak for one of my trusted seller clients. The issue was identified quickly, clearly explained, and resolved properly by replacing the leaking valve. Efficient, professional, and done right the first time.

Lucas, the owner and master plumber, sets a high standard. His expertise, professionalism, and leadership are evident throughout the process. He takes a methodical, no-nonsense approach and prioritizes quality workmanship.

The entire team was professional and respectful, and communication was smooth from start to finish. An honorable mention to Nick McBride, an outstanding journeyman plumber whose skill, attention to detail, and professionalism stood out.

For context, I am Chris Cabiya, Founder and Principal Realtor® at Cabiya Realty Group and a local real estate investor serving the Highland Lakes area, including Marble Falls, Horseshoe Bay, and Granite Shoals. I hold service providers to very high standards on behalf of my clients. Brandenburg Plumbing met those standards without hesitation.

Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Janet Bray
reviews.text: Brandenburg plumbing and all of its employees are excellent!! I have worked with them for nearly 30 years and they have come to my rescue time and time again. They are all very knowledgeable, helpful and courteous. This time it was Gabriel and Colton fixing my old plumbing issues. Gabriel goes above and beyond; and is very thorough. Thanks again guys!!

reviews.author: T E
reviews.text: It was easy to make an appointment and they addressed my leak the same day. Nick was amazing! A leak in a wall is never good news but he did everything he could to minimize the wall cut, worked quickly and was able to solve the problem without extensive repairs. This was a great experience and I’m so happy I was able to work with Nick. He was polite, friendly, explained everything along the way. He left the area super clean as well.

reviews.author: joan redbird
reviews.text: Great experience. Colt worked hard and got the job done. He was polite, friendly, and professional. Mr Brandenburg stopped by checked the job. He was also friendly and professional. Pleased with service. Would recommend! Thanks

reviews.author: Rami Segal
reviews.text: Highly professional service all around. House water filter canister cracked with the last freeze. We called after hours on Friday and Brandon came next day to evaluate. He made great recommendation for improvement of the system and provided an estimate. Work was done and Brandon sent pictures of the complete job. Great company, Great service , Highly recommended. I will use again when needed.

plumbers.name: Berkeys Plumbing, A/C & Electrical
plumbers.address: 4645 Avon Ln Ste 260, Frisco, TX 75033, USA

reviews.author: Sam Khavari
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough good things about Berkey’s, KP, and their team of salaried (NOT commissioned) HVAC techs! They give you sound advice, suggestions and recommendations regarding any HVAC issues you may be facing - without the pressure of having to make an on-the-spot decision that you don’t feel comfortable making. They are super thorough in their assessments and you feel good knowing that you can trust their advice.

My heater would blow cold air - I’ve had 3 different HVAC companies through my home warranty take a look and none of them could provide a fix. Turns out the Nest thermostat needed to be replaced with a Honeywell T6, and as soon as we made the change, everything magically worked!

Best part, they didn’t charge me a stupid service call fee that would not go towards the cost of repairs!

Instead, I signed up for their VIP Membership for like $20/mo and have them on speed dial in case I have any HVAC, electrical or plumbing issues - I get next day (not next week, we’re too busy, and gonna charge you a service call fee) service. I feel you get the backing of a big company, not a fly by night, solo tech working from his truck, or moonlighter - these guys are trustworthy and am happy to partner with Berkey’s!

reviews.author: Mohammad Ganjizadeh
reviews.text:
Mathew came to service my heaters and AC for last two times. I went to my attack yesterday and saw something which blow my mind away! I had a roof change last year and saw AC pan full of nails, pieces of roof shingles and woods. I broom them and cleaned it. How during two visits it was not cleaned or reminding me to clean? But, Mathew wanted me to buy drainage liquids to clean the pipe from him. Never send him back again! Thank you!

Picture is after I cleaned one full pan out of the pan.

reviews.author: Bill Hutchings
reviews.text: I can always rely on Berkey's to show up when they say they will and fix whatever plumbing issue might arise.  I have used them 5 times in the last 10 years and they never disappoint.  The problem is resolved, the right way, no corners cut, no shortcuts. This time they located and repaired a slab leak and were able to reroute the damaged pipe without having to tunnel under the house or cut up the foundation.  If you want it done right Berkey's is a great choice.

reviews.author: Lisa Steele
reviews.text:
We recently had Berkeys out for a water heater repair, and I wanted to share what a great experience we had. Our technician, Alejandro Sanchez, was on time, friendly, and very knowledgeable. He took the time to explain everything and made sure the repair was done correctly.

The office staff was also wonderful to work with—very friendly, great communication, and they sent a follow-up text with the appointment information and details about the technician who would be arriving, which I really appreciated.

Our water heater was still under warranty, and Berkeys handled everything exactly as they should have, and the repair ended up costing us $0. It was a very smooth and easy process.

We use Berkeys for Plumbing, Electrical, and HVAC, and they truly are a one-stop shop. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: BJ Centers
reviews.text:
Whe
When you get a technician that represents the company he/she works for at the highest level, It's great to be able to share that with others.  Berkeys technician Steven Johnson was knowledgeable, experienced, informative, and answered all my questions with very helpful information about how my system works and how to keep it working efficiently for how hot/cool I like my house. I have a dual damper system that make maintaining a comfortable temperature, in any room, difficult.
I highly recommend this company, and when needed ask for Steven to be your technician of choice.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Central Oregon
plumbers.address: 62890 Peerless Ct #6, Bend, OR 97701, USA

reviews.author: Marilyn Schwartz
reviews.text: Mr Rooter's response to my requests are handled within a day. Their plumbers are well trained, efficient & clearly explain procedures for products. My recent request was not urgent, & I was surprised how quickly my water heater & circulating pump were installed!

reviews.author: Starr Hume
reviews.text: I scheduled Mr Rooter of Central Oregon for a garbage disposal replacement. I had an appt. But no estimate. I cleaned everything from below my sink. The service rep came in, looked at my needs and went to get his equipment. On the way to the kitchen he causally stated oh this will be $550.00. I stated that seemed expensive. He goes "do you want this done or what. I'm just the service provider" no other discussion. He went to his truck brought in a disposal he had in his truck. It took him less than 45 minutes. That's the break down. A provided disposal which I'm sure they bought in bulk for $50 or less. That's $500.00 per hour! I paid as it was all done. I contacted the owner and explained I was on a fixed income and felt the cost was ridiculous! He said OK. No other response. The new disposal makes noises I've never heard and does not sound like it will last very long. I deeply regret using Mr Rooter. They were recommend on Next Door. Way too expensive.

reviews.author: Faith Thaler
reviews.text: The receptionist was so nice, helpful, and knowledgeable. Someone staying at our rental flushed the toilet paper holder down the toilet and we needed it fixed the same day before our next guest arrived.  They were able to come out 2 hrs after I called and Jason the man who did the fix was also amazing. He even offered to go to Ace to grab a replacement toilet paper holder so that my next guests had one. Cannot say enough nice things about them. They will be my go to plumber for any future issues!

reviews.author: Patrick Welch
reviews.text:
Jason  was on time  and awesome. He took  care of my problems  and offered  some advice on how to remedy  my recurring  toilet problem and helped me map a plan for the future. I highly recommend Mr Rooter to anyone.
Patrick

reviews.author: steve mccann
reviews.text: The technician that came out was professional and courteous. The owner of the company responded personally to my questions amd requests. I was very impressed with the integrity of the company.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter
plumbers.address: 66 International Ln, Staunton, VA 24401, USA

reviews.author: Samantha S.
reviews.text: Great customer service received from all the Roto-Rooter staff we interacted with. Chris came on Christmas Eve (same day service!) and was able to get our clog cleared. He was very nice and knowledgeable. He had to pull one of our toilets to snake and basically couldn't even tell he had once he was done! Jim came following wk to pump our septic tank and then 2 guys came after to install our riser (so never have to dig to access septic tank lid again). David came next day to camera our line to ensure didnt have any root issues. He was very helpful and knowledgeable and did great job cleaning up the 2 areas he worked in. (When they use camera - they record it and email files later). Ashley in the office was very nice and professional in my various calls with her re scheduling and to tell me they were on their way to house. I loved they didnt charge fee to use credit card for payment (also take cash and check). Plumber / technician at house calls office to get total and they run the credit card. On Christmas Eve I had put in request to schedule via the main Roto Rooter website and got auto email afterwards acknowledging then a call soon after. When I put in request for pumping of septic tank following wk on Staunton specific website it said it went thru but they never received it and I didnt get email. So make sure get acknowledging email if use online option.

reviews.author: Kacy Spooner
reviews.text: The technician (Seaton) who came out to pump my septic tank that had not been uncovered or pumped in the 60 years since it had been placed in the ground was excellent. He was able to figure out right away where the tank was, so I avoided the fee of having to have it found with equipment, and he worked quickly and efficiently to pump the tank. The technicians who came today were also efficient and quick as they installed a riser on the tank. Service was all around fast, friendly, and effective. Would highly recommend to anyone for septic service.

reviews.author: Jennifer Smith
reviews.text: David K. & Tony R. Were my service techs for my septic tank. I have never had to deal with one before and didn’t even know where to locate the opening. The opening was located very quickly without the use of a more expensive camera solution, and then was serviced quickly and efficiently. Both gentlemen were extremely nice and courteous! If I ever had the need for service again I would definitely be calling them again!

reviews.author: Rebekah Carter - Custom Gardening Services
reviews.text: We've hired this company to clean our septic tank regularly over the past 18 years, and they are always friendly, quick, professional & affordable - sometimes even arriving the same day we've called for service. I appreciate the convenience of being able to do business with a reliable company that delivers the same great results every time. Thank you for your service!

reviews.author: Daniel Drumheller
reviews.text: Two men showed up in a nice truck with all the tools they needed for a septic pump job. They did a nice job and preserved the grass the best they could. They were very friendly and had good stories to tell while they worked quickly and stayed very focused. They also seemed to get along with each other very well and that was fun to see. Overall a good experience and I will call them again as I always have. Fast service and good office communication too.

plumbers.name: ACE Home Services (formerly AZ Best Plumbing)
plumbers.address: 50 Stutz Bearcat Dr Ste 3, Sedona, AZ 86336, USA

reviews.author: Dianne Echazabal
reviews.text: These guys are the very best. I needed  to put a freeze free spigot in the paddocks behind my small barn.They came out together and had the difficult job completed in about 1.5  hours. They made the suggestion to put a "shut off " valve in the box should there be any problem with this spigot. Also suggested we diconnect all the hoses from their bibs during the winter. Friendly  knowlegable with good advice. Many thanks. You did a terrific job.

reviews.author: John Goodman
reviews.text:
Recently had two complete HVAC systems replaced at our home in Verde Santa Fe. First I appreciated the non pressure of the sales and management staff to make a decision and their patience with all our questions as well as concerns.
The three man crew that came to do the job were very polite, knowledgeable and efficient.
The total job was completed in two days, one system per day. Everything working perfectly.
They cleaned up nicely too.
I highly recommend ACE Home Services. (8/6/24)

Adding to my review, ACE was the only company I spoke with that would install and warranty their work for a Mini-Split AC unit I purchased independently.
Joshua Hogan, did an excellent job with the installation of the 24k BTU unit I purchased online.  Joshua was one of the 3 installers on the main house installation.  They all did excellent work and took any time needed to answer and questions, concerns or requests we had during the installations.

Before the main house was done we were having a problem with small particles and what looked like pink insulation coming down from one of duct lines.  After a duct cleaning the problem still continued, but slightly less.  Technician Marshall crawled around in the very hot attic inspecting the duct run looking for an obvious hole. No luck.  ACE offered to replace the whole duct run at a very reasonable cost and so they did. Upon inspection of the removed 50' of duct it was determined that the particles were actually particles of rust material flaking off the old A-coil.
Problem solved!  Thanks for pursuing the problem.

I would not hesitate to call or recommend ACE and use any of the service staff. Our job was big and it was a pleasant, unstressful experience.
We are very please.  (8/22/24)

reviews.author: Robert Ganem
reviews.text: I have used ACE Home Services a couple of times for my vacation rentals, but was very disappointed by my last experience.  They scheduled a plumber to come out on Saturday to unclog a toilet.  I informed my guest, but no one ever showed up, nor did anyone call to say they would not be showing up.  I called the next day and was again given an appointment window.  Again, no one showed up and no one even called!  I can understand that certain calls can take longer and needing to reschedule, but not even calling to let me know is really inexcusable.  The fact that it happened twice, unfortunately, lets me know that it's just how they operate. After the service, I received a standard survey request and had a chance to speak to a representative for the company. She was cordial, but I did not get the sense that any steps would be taken to avoid this type of poor service in the future.  Very sad.

reviews.author: Bridget
reviews.text: I had a new furnace and thermostat installed and the ducts cleaned out in a 1000 sq ft Flagstaff home. The entire process from start to finish was excellent. Sol did a great job with the quote and decisions on what to install. Lisa and Tom did fantastic assisting me to coordinate services and payment through my escrow company, Joe and Bradley did an amazing job with the installation and such cleaning (and the ducts were super gross from the previous long term tenants). I feel so fortunate to have had a great team making my new-to-me home safe and warm. Thank you ACE!

reviews.author: Helen Baker
reviews.text: Not reliable for non-emergency services. I waited in day after day, each time being rescheduled to the following day at the end of the service window. Finally got rescheduled to a weekend service window and the plumber called to say he “wasn’t driving that far unless it’s an active emergency”. So why schedule me? Wasted 3 days of my time and then ghosted. This isn’t AZ Best any more - do not recommend.

plumbers.name: Restore Plumbing and Drain
plumbers.address: 1401 Timber Dr, Elgin, IL 60123, USA

reviews.author: Barbara Diepenbrock
reviews.text: Quick in and out.  Half as much as a plumbing company I've been using for years with the same product and quality.  Friendly and fast.  I believe in paying fair wages and paying what for what you get but the other guys were ridiculous for what the job is.  If I wasn't old and fat now....I could do it myself but it would take me a whole day lol!  Thank you Restore Plumbing for being accessible and affordable without losing the fantastic service and quality.

reviews.author: Mike Dudek
reviews.text:
Absolute incredible experience from start to finish with the Restore team. From my very first phone call, everything was handled professionally, clearly, and with real care. The consultation with Dave was thorough and straightforward. He took the time to explain the system, answer questions, and make sure I was comfortable with every step before moving forward.

The installation work completed by John and CJ was equally impressive. They were punctual, respectful of my home, and clearly took pride in their work. The install was clean, efficient, and well explained, and they made sure everything was working properly before they left. It is obvious this team knows what they are doing and genuinely cares about delivering a great experience, not just finishing a job.

It is rare to work with a company where every touchpoint feels this well run and thoughtful. I would give this group 1000 stars if I could. Restore has absolutely earned my long term business, and I will confidently refer them to anyone I know who needs reverse osmosis or plumbing solutions. I truly appreciated the experience and could not recommend them more highly.

reviews.author: Ula Borodzinska
reviews.text: We had Kohler Veil "smart" toilet repair (still under warranty luckily).   Jonathan was on time, super polite and professional. He quickly determined issue and fixed it perfectly. Thank you Jonathan! If needed in a future I will be calling them and requesting Jonathan's services.

reviews.author: Pat Pornsakwiwat
reviews.text: The shower had no hot water. We called Restore plumbing and drain. The woman who answered the phone was very nice. John came the next day to inspect and explain the possibilities in detail. He was extremely patient and tried to fix the problem. Finally, we had hot water running. Very happy with the service we received from John.👍👍

reviews.author: Larry Wetzel
reviews.text: This is the second big job I have had in my house plumbing-wise.  Restore has done an outstanding job from start to finish. My technician, Virginio, was absolutely fantastic on explaining everything and performing the work.  Thanks again.  Will talk to you in the future.

plumbers.name: 1st American Plumbing, Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 4843 Emma Mine Dr, Herriman, UT 84096, USA

reviews.author: B A
reviews.text: I was very impressed with 1st American Plumbing.  Baeler was sent to my house for a drain cleaning and drain pipe repair.  They were able to come out that same day.  Baeler was very polite, great to work with, and he did an amazing job.  I was quoted a reasonable price up front and that was the price at the end.  Baeler managed to protect the area he had to work in and left it cleaner that it was before he arrived.

reviews.author: Chad Neilsen
reviews.text:
Be Careful with These Guys — Seriously!

I called for a quote to fix a small gas leak on my backyard fire pit. They sent a quote and said to sign it if I wanted the work done. I never signed it because I was still getting another quote.

Less than 24 hours later, they showed up unannounced while I wasn’t there and started doing the work without permission. When I called to sort it out, they came back—and left my yard wrecked, even leaving an uncapped gas line. That’s not just sloppy, it’s dangerous.

Super unprofessional, zero accountability, and honestly scary that they think this is acceptable. ⚠️ Watch out before hiring them!

reviews.author: Alexandra Shoemaker
reviews.text:
1st American plumbing is the best experience I’ve ever had with any vendor in Utah, and I will recommend them to everyone.
My pilot light went out on my water heater and I couldn’t get it back on.  After watching many “how to” YouTube videos I realized this was a job for a professional.  I called 1st American really early and Matt answered the phone (first good sign that an actual PERSON answered and not an automated answering machine!)  Matt talked with me about what I had already tried and scheduled a technician who arrived at my house at 9:00am on the dot.

I think it’s a very cool feature that they send you a text message with a photo of your repair person and a biography of their experience right when they arrive.

My technician Jon was so kind, polite and incredibly knowledgeable.  He had parts sent over for the repair, and had everything wrapped up promptly.  Pricing was fair and reasonable, and I am SO glad to have found a reliable local company. Their number is saved in my phone and they’re my new go-to for anything plumbing or hvac.

reviews.author: Colin
reviews.text: I recently had Jon from 1st American Plumbing, Heating & Air complete the install of my new water heater. Jon arrived on time and was extremely professional, respectful and highly skilled -  even going over and beyond to assist. I would highly recommend this company and especially Jon if you require a high-quality, reliable service.

reviews.author: Chris Shane
reviews.text: John was very punctual and communicative. He was friendly and good with my dog. John was educational and explained how things work. John went the extra mile. I had never used First American previously but they came recommended by a friend. I was impressed. They let me know all chargers and possible charges up front. Highly recommend.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Fort Worth
plumbers.address: 1200 Pennsylvania Ave, Fort Worth, TX 76104, USA

reviews.author: Kevin Young
reviews.text:
Clint came to my house and examed my problems like a plumbing physician. He gave me options of treatment and then educated me to prevent my issue from continuing.
Clint has an old school style, (friendly and professional), that gets the job done. He is trust worthy and the only Plumbing Doctor I want to cure my plumbing needs.
If your looking for a trustworthy and capable person, I highly recommend Clint!

reviews.author: Charles Rowe
reviews.text:
I am absolutely thrilled to share my experience with MR Rooter (Fort Worth) and the outstanding service provided by the technician (Tun) this past Sunday. From the moment he arrived, it was clear that Tun was not just skilled but also deeply committed to delivering exceptional customer service.

He took the time to thoroughly assess the issue, explaining each step of the process in a way that made me feel completely informed and confident in the work being done. What truly set him apart, however, was his attention to detail and the care he took to ensure everything was not just fixed, but working better than it ever had before.
