Christopher Laurel

reviews.author: Judy Voss
reviews.text: Anthony's Plumbing is excellent in my book.  I will continue to use them for all of our plumbing needs.  On this occasion, we had a water heater issue.  Vincent came out early the next morning and replaced our water heater.  Prior to replacing, he discussed the matter in full detail, including cost.  It was a pleasure doing business with Vincent and Anthony's Plumbing.

plumbers.name: Mullin Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2936 N Shields Blvd, Moore, OK 73160, USA

reviews.author: Delf Meek
reviews.text:
I used Mullin Plumbing a couple of years ago to repair a slab leak. Since I had good results with that repair I didn't hesitate to call them again when I had a leak in the wall of my shower.

They did come out in a timely manner. It was determined there was a leaking shower valve, which needed to be replaced, which included installing a new one, so we needed to replace the faucet. I supplied the faucet (A standard Delta Classic Shower Faucet from Home Depot).

The installation job of the faucet was the worst I've seen and looked like a 6 year old cobbled it together.  He removed the horizontal 2x4 wood brace for the shower valve mounting bracket and ended up using toggle bolt anchors for the front face plate and drove a screw from the backside of the bracket to hold the shower valve in place. After further investigation, this is because he managed to break one of the faceplate mounting holes off of the mounting bracket (How?!?!).  The broken piece was laying on the floor inside the wall.

I should have done a better job of inspecting this work before paying them and sending them out the door, but I'm not a plumber or a carpenter for that matter and put a lot of trust in this company to perform a repair correctly.  It wasn't until I started the drywall repair I discovered this dumpster fire of a repair.

I could call them back to repair this, but I don't want them back in my house. Ever. I ordered a new bracket from Delta ($15) as well as new faceplate screws.  I trimmed off about of 1/4 of inch of tile on the bottom.  Screwed the 2x4 wood brace back into place and mounted the shower valve bracket into place.  I'm not a carpenter.  This job took me 30 minutes to do.

The 1 star I'm giving this review is more than I want to give it.  I've made sure to tell everyone I know to not use these jokers.  While it was probably just the individual plumber that should be fired, this 100% gave this company a bad name.  Take a little bit more pride in your work.

reviews.author: Dustin Clark
reviews.text: MY REVIEW HAS NOTHING TO DO THEIR SERVICE RATHER AN EXPERIENCE WITH THEIR DRIVER ON THE ROAD. A MULLINS TRUCK CUT ME OFF ON THE INTERSTATE PULLING A TRAILER WITH NO WORKING LIGHTS AND SLINGING ROCKS OFF THE BACK ONE WHICH BROKE MY NEW WINDSHIELD. WHEN TRYING DRIVERS ATTENTION HE ROLLED THE WINDOW DOWN AND FLIPPED ME OFF, I WAQS GOING TO LET IT ALL GO BUT NO ONE WANTS TO ANSWER THE PHONE WHEN YOU CALL.

reviews.author: Jeff Middaugh
reviews.text:
Right before Christmas I was at my mom’s getting ready for our Christmas party.

We noticed water on the living room floor.

I checked the garage and water was flooding everywhere.

I looked and Mullin plumbing was on the install records so I called them as I got the water shut off. The living room and garage were already flooded.

One of their pex crimps failed and the hot water was shooting out full blast into the wall.

When I called I explained everything and asked about warranty since installed 3 years prior. They said they’d assess once they show up and no apology.

The repair person was the same as the installer my mom remembered and they didn’t take accountability or apologize.

My mom is 85 and I asked about warranty or discount for poor workmanship and was told no. Not even $1.

The repair cost over $250 for a simple crimp on what they failed to do correctly.

We won’t use Mullin Plumbing again.

reviews.author: Taylor Miller
reviews.text: We had Eddie out to fix our water heater. He was great. Communicated with us every step of the way and couldn’t have been more nice. He got it fixed and running great! We are very grateful that he was able to help us out in a pinch. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Brad Stevens
reviews.text: Scheduled an appointment last week for a Monday service. The company texted me at 10 that their technician was on the way, I took off work to meet the technician. They called at 12:45 and canceled my appointment. I would recommend to never use this company. A zero star review is even too much for Mullin Plumbing.

plumbers.name: Drain Go Plumbing
plumbers.address: 211 Central Cir SW, Decatur, AL 35603, USA

reviews.author: Joy Webb
reviews.text: I had a service call for 12-4 and they called me at 2:15, I was at work and had paid someone to be at my house, they did not come and rescheduled for another 4 days. I had already waited 5 days to get the 1st appointment. They were used through American Home Sheild my warranty company, but I would not recommend them at all. They do not care about the problem that's going on at your house and their customer service is a joke. I rescheduled with Roto Rooter and got outstanding service.

reviews.author: D. L. Spence
reviews.text: Terry and James recently assisted us with a clogged drain, and their service was both prompt and highly professional. They quickly identified and resolved the issue, leaving everything in excellent working order. Each time we’ve needed support from Draingo for plumbing concerns, the experience has been consistently positive. Their team is reliable, efficient, and dedicated to delivering quality service. We truly appreciate their expertise and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Draingo to anyone in need of trustworthy plumbing solutions.

reviews.author: Stephen Ross
reviews.text:
Draingo of Alabama replaced our water heater, we had some issues with our home warranty who by the way will not send out a list of of parts they cover, they will tell you what parts are covered over the phone from a call center in India which isnt good enough. This is for anyone dealing with warranties, nothing to do with Drain go. We finally did get them to send us a list of what parts were not covered (weird) but they sent it under a letterhead and logo of some completely different company name so we never opened it and didn't find it until later as it looked like Junk Mail.

However Drain Go was very nice on the phone, and also the person they sent out Elbert was fantastic, and super fast. I would use them again.

reviews.author: Latasha
reviews.text:
Over priced and under performed.

Came out to look for a leak. Advised me to turn off the water until they could get there 6 days later. Of course I had to clean up the water.  They get here, 2 young boys, look at the toilet for 15 minutes and say nothing is wrong with it.  Charged me $170... standard work day during regular work hours...

reviews.author: Debi Ungerbuehler
reviews.text:
I really was pleased with the 2 gentlemen that came to our house this morning. I am terrible with names, look on my receipt, I'm sure  you can find out their names. They both meet and played with our dogs. Which was extremely nice. Then they were happy to leave them alone and to go play in the yard. Our hot water heater had went out. They changed out the thermostat and both heating elements. They were both very respectful and a joy to have fixing our problem. Thank you so much. The world needs more people like them.
Merry Christmas and Happy New Year,
Debi and Vanessa

plumbers.name: Salt City Plumbing, Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 47 S Orange St A8, Salt Lake City, UT 84116, USA

reviews.author: Fuong Banh
reviews.text: If you are looking for a company that is affordable, great service, and can take care of things fast, Salt City Plumbing is it!  I have tried a few plumbing companies and most of them tries to upsell you on things you don't need and prices that cost an arm and a leg.  Tre at Salt City Plumbing was awesome!  He arrives promptly and gave us a solution that cost a lot less than the other companies and got things done for us the same day.  We would recommend this company and Tre to anyone.

reviews.author: Trish
reviews.text:
This is from a service done on Monday, Jan 5, 2026:

Today was my first time working with Salt City Plumbing. Got an appt set up for tomorrow to come do a FREE estimate to repair gas pipe leaks. They called me back shortly saying they had a cancellation, a technician would be out between 3 and 5!! 🥳 Tommy showed up early at 2:15 🤩! Tommy looked over the issue with me gave me 3 very reasonable quotes and got right to work. He fixed the pipes quickly and ended up not needing to replace a gas valve that another company was ready to charge me for.

It’s so nice to want to cry tears of joy rather than tears of frustration. We got astronomically ripped off by another company this weekend for a similar repair needed on our other boiler…which we were charged LITERALLY 4X the price of what Salt City Plumbing charged (and did a better job).

Got our heat and hot water restored to our second building after it being off since Friday night. Crying tears of joy 😭🥰

Thank you so much Tommy and Salt City Plumbing!!

I also took a good look at their newest reviews before Tommy arrived…. you have to scroll a LONG WAY to even find a 4 star review.

THIS BUSINESS IS AMAZING!! 🙌
Happy employees and happy customers!!!

Also, shoutout to Shae for coming over to look over our boilers and give us estimates for future work! Very knowledgeable and professional!

reviews.author: Lori Campbell
reviews.text:
These guys deserve all five stars.  They are down to earth, no bullshit, efficient, and affordable.   This is old school attention to detail and customer service that you don't see anymore.

I have an old house with it's fair amount of plumbing drama and these guys, Josh especially, have sorted it out without selling me on a bunch of upgrades and extras I don't need, which means I call them when new issues arise because I trust them.  My house was built in the 40's, something new always comes up.

The owner has been out for projects and is just as professional and straight forward as his employees.

As a homeowner who isn't handy having a company I can trust to get here, get the work done, not try to fleece me, and stand by their product/service is priceless.

You can shop around and get all the bids you want, you're not going to beat these guys on getting the job done.  They get my business every time and they have earned

reviews.author: Maude Vôs
reviews.text: Tommy repaired our heating last week and did an amazing job! He was on time and had great communication! 10 out 10 will use this company again & request Tommy!

reviews.author: Jeremy Koff
reviews.text: First time using this company and the experience was exceptional. They were extremely responsive, and within an hour of my call one of their technicians, Shae, was on site investigating a leaky shower. He quickly determined it was a minor issue that didn’t require plumbing services and proactively made a quick repair by sealing a small gap in the shower plate where water had been seeping in. Shae was professional, courteous, and honest. I would absolutely recommend this company without hesitation, especially Shae.

plumbers.name: Brandon's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 17450 S Sooner Rd, Norman, OK 73071, USA

reviews.author: Ron Howell
reviews.text: David, my technician today was the best I could hope for.  I will request him by name going forward.  I get anxious having plumbers, HVAC, electricians, etc coming into my home.  Always looking for one of those types that you just trust what he tells you and David is that guy!  As for Brandon’s, I actually called them because the first business i called didnt seem to have it all together.  Brandons booked my appointment with no issues and all communication subsequent to the appointment and arrival time was spot on.  Price was very reasonable.  Brandon’s (and David) are my go to going forward.  Thanks Brandon!

reviews.author: Lindsay Calhoun
reviews.text: I cannot thank Brandon's plumbing enough for fixing our broken pipe - they worked us into their schedule and quickly resolved the issue. They were very professional, great with communication. Brandon himself showed up. Thank you, I will always recommend you to anyone looking for a plumber!

reviews.author: Fred Dowell
reviews.text: The plumber, Ryan, showed up on time and was professional and efficient.  Fixed my leak quickly, and explained exactly what options I had in completing the task.  I am a commercial real estate broker in Norman, and have managed several apartment complexes and commercial office buildings and retail space during the last 25 years - so I have used several local plumbing firms over the years.  This work was done at my home.  Brandon Plumbing is very versatile, and performs the full spectrum of plumbing services needed for commercial & residential work to include drain camera inspection.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Crystal Rogers
reviews.text: David nichols was our journeyman plumber and his helper was Jax. Phenomenal service! They were truly hero’s! They got my water back up and running quickly! And they cleaned up afterwards. I was so excited I forgot to get a receipt. Truly great service. We will call them again in the future and refer them out!!

reviews.author: Alexus Wilson
reviews.text: We have had super bad plumbing back up in our house the last year and a half it finally got to where our sinks in the kitchen weren’t draining at all and we had zero water pressure in our bathroom. John Steve, saved the day with the miraculous handyman skills and plumbing education. Not only did we get our sink fixed today, but they also left us with a bundle full of knowledge. Not that we wouldn’t love to see them again, but that way we didn’t have to see them again under these circumstances. John and Steve remained completely professional the entire time walking us through every step as they were doing it and even went back over a few things a couple of times. They did not rush, but did get things done in a timely manner and we couldn’t be more happy with the results. I highly recommend Brandon’s plumbing BUT especially these two dudes. WHAT A TEAM! Thank you again John and Steve for helping us out! Happy Holidays! -The McCrazies ❤️

plumbers.name: M.E. Plumbing, LLC
plumbers.address: 925 S Austin St, Seguin, TX 78155, USA

reviews.author: demarcus jackson
reviews.text: People were very nice. Called Thursday afternoon and they came out Friday morning on time as promised. They charged me about double price but i didn't have time to schedule someone else to come out there for a quote. I needed hot water for the family. They charged 3175 for 50 gal electric water heater installed. (This price is with a discount). Service was great,  they did great job installing, very quick on install, clean finish, good product.  Could have save probably 1500 - 2000 going elsewhere, but also could have been another day or two without hot water. With it being freezing temps during this time, a baby, and young ones. Cold shower/bath was not a reasonable option.

reviews.author: Len Moore
reviews.text:
Photos are from BEFORE. I think I have met every single employee with ME at this point, and everyone is friendly, professional, personable, and knowledgeable. I had lots of work done this past year, including a total sewer line replacement in a 90+ yr old home. Mike, Martin, Matthew, Jacob2 and Andrew all looked at my options, came up with a plan, and were able to save my driveway from excavation by dropping my line into my basement, then drilled thru 8 inch concrete wall into my crawl space, connect to 2nd bathroom , and then out the front to the street. They carefully dug by hand around my 200 year old live oak trees and did not damage any roots.

Matthew and Jacob 1 installed back connecting sewer line last summer. Matthew also replaced a rotted out toilet flange. Andrew fixed a blockage in back half of house. Then Jacob2  And Jacob3 finally installed my main sewer line this week, with Martin and Mike stopping by to assist, keep me updated on progress, etc.

A lot could have gone wrong bc of basement logistics, age of home, etc. And even with concrete drilling taking 10x the time it normally takes bc of its old age, Jacob2 was calm and reassuring to me when I started to panic. Everyone, from Kelly in the office to owner Mike, answered my questions and concerns throughout this massive project. Cannot recommend them enough. I even got a bundled discount for everything done.

If you want your plumbing done right, done professionally,  and have an entire TEAM working together to make it the best possible experience: ME Plumbing is the place to go, every single time. Photos below are from BEFORE. You can see the original cast iron pipes they had to remove. Now its all brand new PVC!!

reviews.author: Heath Bentley
reviews.text: ME Plumbing came out for a leak detection and repair. The crew they sent out seemed inexperienced and it took almost a full day to locate and fix a cracked pipe and replace a clean out cap under the kitchen sink. A senior plumber arrived to help around mid-day, so they had three guys working on a simple issue at one point. The end product was quality work, but my biggest issue is with the price. The cost was exorbitant and it seemed like I was paying for their employee development.

reviews.author: Cristina Rivera
reviews.text:
Who you gonna trust when you've got a leak in your home? ME Plumbing, of course! We've exclusively used them for every plumbing issue we've had for the last several years, from way back when Mike Edwards himself came out in the field, back when he was growing his business. Our experience has been that regardless of who gets dispatched/sent to your home or business, the level of care you get is exactly the same as if Mike was taking care of it himself. Top notch customer care and the highest quality service, with honest prices and integrity.

2 days ago we had what appeared to be an emergency leak situation at the house, and Martin miraculously was able to fit us in that same day. They are so good, in such demand, and they take such great care of each of their customers, it didn't surprise me that they were solidly booked every day all day and initially weren't going to be able to fit us in for another 6 days. I was sort of panicking though.. the wet spot on the carpet had grown from 3 feet to about 1/3 of the room overnight, so Martin offered to fit us in after their regular business hours!! It was 💯 worth it to pay the extra fee for our peace of mind. I'm so SO grateful he did that.

He sent us 2 incredibly professional, thorough and efficient, wonderfully kind young men -- Daniel and Derek who took extremely good care of us. Daniel especially went above and beyond for us, and I am just so grateful for his kindness, thoughtfulness and generosity.

We were very fortunate that our problem turned out to be relatively minor, but there's no way we could have known that without them running their diagnostic tests etc to determine the source of the issue.

Thanks again, ME Plumbing Team!! My family and I so appreciate you!

reviews.author: Alex Guzman
reviews.text: I own a duplex and had a water softener installed in both units. It took pretty much all day, but the work was done professionally. I am very pleased with the results.

plumbers.name: Practical Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1002 E Elms Rd Ste 103, Killeen, TX 76542, USA

reviews.author: Nicole J. Ryan
reviews.text: The office personnel and the plumbers were so professional and so very patient. Karen G. Paul Simmons and Christopher Daniel, I appreciate you all very much. I had both my upstairs and downstairs sinks leaking and they did awesome. They even texted pictures of the plumbers first prior to their arrival 🤗 Great job team!

reviews.author: Maison Esplana
reviews.text: We worked with Mr Christopher today for some plumbing issues and he was fantastic ! He was respectful of our busy house hold, listened to our concerns & walked us through exactly what the issues were. He was also thorough and quick with his work & neatly organized. Overall our issues are fixed & we are very happy with the work that was done. Thank you !

reviews.author: Jason Zelenak
reviews.text: The crew was spot on. They kept me informed of when they would arrive. I ensured the path was clear and clean. I explained the situation. They got right to work. They advised me that my water inlet valve was stuck, so I made the choice of having it replaced. The crew was professional the whole way, even helped me on connecting my water heater to the WIFI via the app. Definitely recommend 👌

reviews.author: Christopher Vasquez
reviews.text: Junior Was  prompt and extremely professional. He quickly removed the damaged section of PVC and installed the new water shut off valve and supply line that i had purchased earlier.  I Highly recommend Practical plumbing for a same day repair

reviews.author: Be Jammin
reviews.text:
Practical plumbing is the practical choice. Easy quick fix on my leaky faucet. They did this job for half the cost that roto rooter quoted. Great work, great price.
Thank you

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing, Drain, and Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 176 S Schuyler Ave, Bradley, IL 60915, USA

reviews.author: jenny M
reviews.text:
I was almost satisfied with the service, but there were significant issues that need attention. The technician did not check whether I couldn’t shut my bathroom door. I was instructed to call should there be installation issues it will be covered but if its a toilet issues then it wont as i self bought it. This plumber without listening to the issues wanted to charge extra rather than assess the situation first.
A professional should exercise good judgment, and unfortunately, that did not happen here. Initially, I was informed there would be an assessment to evaluate the work needed, including reviewing the new toilet. The first technician looked at it but did not express any concerns. A second plumber came to complete the job.. I understand that sometimes things can go wrong, but both staff explicitly told me to call. Instead of evaluating the situation, the plumber immediately tried to quote me extra. He even commented, “you bought a bigger toilet,” without verifying the measurements himself. The new toilet by the way is the same brand,size and make from Lowes. I feel that a true professional should recognize potential issues with toilet size during installation rather than simply trying to complete the job. Assessing the situation first, and then quoting if necessary, would have been the correct approach. I would have been willing to pay for any additional work if it had been justified. I uploaded 3 pictures. The first one indicate that I cannot shut the door after his job, the second picture indicates how it was before as you can see its all the way to the margin. And the third picture is how he tackle it. And that is why I can’ close the door. He left a big gap. Tell me why do I need to pay? It was your mistake! Because of this I am very very frustrated.
I am sharing this feedback to help other customers make informed decisions. I value good service and hope this company can improve its professionalism and approach to customer care.

reviews.author: Scott Walters
reviews.text: Our technician Matthew was great.  He identified the problem quickly and got our drain working pretty quick.  He was also personable and kind, while working at a late hour.  Would recommend 10 out of 10.

reviews.author: Charles Cox
reviews.text: I was able to get same day service for our clogged kitchen drain. Communication was great and I knew when to expect the technician. Jonathan was professional and despite a simple job ending up being more involved, the pricing was still fair and I’m happy with the results. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Jennifer Patchett
reviews.text: Roto rooter service was honest straightforward kind and professional. Both Jonathan and Matthew were wonderful at what they did and informing me of what my service and costs would encompass. They were there exactly when they said they would be and completed the job promptly and professionally. I am very happy with them and will use them again.

reviews.author: Shay Rielle
reviews.text: The tech, Mike, showed up quickly and was very polite. He assessed everything walked me through every step of the repair process he planned on doing. There was another issue that popped up that he didn’t feel confident in fixing on the spot so he called another tech that specializes in that particular repair. Overall, service was great.

plumbers.name: MPT Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 1520 Industrial Dr, Lake in the Hills, IL 60156, USA

reviews.author: Bob Lescaleet
reviews.text:
I was impressed with the plumber Mike.  He was very knowledgeable and efficient.  Mike was on-time and finished his work without a problem.  He answered all of my questions and gave me good advise about my upcoming project with a new sink install.
All in all it was a very good experience and I would not hesitate to recommend MPT Plumbing.

reviews.author: Dave Dorocke
reviews.text: Called MPT Plumbing (Mike) to address a minor leak after a water meter replacement late last week. Since the issue occurred due the meter replacement, he not only called the city to ask about having this fixed, they directed him to the company that replaced the meter. He called, they listened to his explanation of what happened and promptly scheduled to come out the day to fix this issue. Mike is a true honest business owner that genuinely cares about his customers and goes well beyond the norm in regards to typical customer service. I am incredibly grateful to have met this good man today. Thank you for your service and insight today.

reviews.author: Gina K
reviews.text: Mike saved me from a major disaster with a sink install. He came in and took over the situation and I’m grateful for his professionalism and direction. He even set me up with other contractors to help with other needed services. Great guy. Highly recommended MPT!

reviews.author: Carol Schacherer
reviews.text:
Mike and his partner were amazing!
Very professional, very kind.
I had a big difficult job that they had to do and now it’s fixed!
I would recommend this company to everyone.

reviews.author: Brian Seng
reviews.text: The gentlemen who did the job were perfectly reasonable and professional. Clean job and did exactly as needed for a little less than I expected to come in at. MPT came recommended by 2 acquaintances, will be happy to continue that recommendation.

plumbers.name: Merry Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1465 San Marino Ave, San Marino, CA 91108, USA

reviews.author: Thorn Koe
reviews.text:
Merry San Marino Plumbing does most of the work in our aging condo complex. Their office staff is super helpful and responsive.  The plumbers themselves are truly professional and do an excellent job.  They're not inexpensive but you get what you pay for.  Very happy to work with these folks over the
years.

reviews.author: Scott Lamensdorf
reviews.text: Hector did a great job repairing our bathroom  faucet. He came quickly as we had a slight leak and it was a tricky repair.  He also cleaned up when we was finished which was appreciated.

reviews.author: Ginny Onysko
reviews.text: Hector has come to many Plumbing crises at my home. He is always prompt, clear, and knowledgeable. He’s competent, acts quickly and gets the job done. Hector is a great role model, and you should be proud to have him representing Merry plumbing.

reviews.author: Drew Lage
reviews.text: Todd Hernandez and everyone at Merry Plumbing is always prompt, thorough and courteous. Feels like an old fashioned business that strives to serve it's community.

reviews.author: Ryan Jupiter
reviews.text:
Merry Plumbing were quick and efficient. I needed a toilet replacement and they came out within one day. Todd was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and installed our toilet in less than an hour!

I had previously used Merry Plumping to fix a leaking tub. Both times their services were top notch. Highly recommend for all your plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup of New Braunfels
plumbers.address: 1111 N Walnut Ave Ste 202, New Braunfels, TX 78130, USA

reviews.author: Meagan Ortiz
reviews.text: Jason was very nice and explained the problem thoroughly. I've had 4 other plumbers come in the last week and they never took the time to explain anything and clearly didn't get to the root of the problem. I'm very glad to have call Roto-Rooter and was very pleased to meet Jason.

reviews.author: Bryce Basso
reviews.text: Jason was great to work with. He walked me through every step he was going to take to find and fix the issue, which I really appreciated. He didn’t try to upsell me on anything I didn’t need and did exactly what he said he would do. He explained the best course of action and got my input before moving forward. Overall, a very professional and straightforward experience.

reviews.author: PAULA LONGORIA
reviews.text: Darrell did a great job at replacing a leaking toilet hose. He was fast and efficient. I would highly recommend him to others needing plumbing repairs!

reviews.author: elizabeth mcneill
reviews.text: Eddie came out to fix a water leak. The water company called to inform us about unusual usage, and sure enough we found a swamp in the yard by the house. He was very thorough, explained everything clearly, answered ALL of my questions, and educated me to be a better home owner. He quickly found the leak and repaired it. And cleaned up after himself. He was so friendly yet professional, I highly recommend Eddie with RotoRooter.

reviews.author: Roland Munoz
reviews.text: Mr. Jason was very prompt. Customer service told me a tech would show up within the hour and he did. Jason was very respectful, friendly and knowledgeable.  He gave me my quote and immediately started working as soon as I agreed to the quote. His work was very clean and very quick, he had my household back to normal in a very quick timing. I have never hired a professional plumber before,  but he made my first experience very enjoyable.  He definitely requires some recognition of appreciation.

plumbers.name: DNI
plumbers.address: 14196 Co Rd 7, Mead, CO 80542, USA

reviews.author: Mark McLean
reviews.text: DNI always takes good care of us. This time, they came out for a humidifier repair, realized that it was going to take some plumbing, as well (shutoff valve was frozen and needed to be replaced). JD was out later the same day to handle the plumbing part of the job so that Mark can come back to finish the humidifier. It's really nice to be able to rely on one company for both HVAC and plumbing. They are fair, reliable, and professional. Can't ask for much more.

reviews.author: Crystal Tanaka
reviews.text: I run a business that relies on refrigeration. DNI got a technician out before anyone else could. Repairs were extensive and there was a lot of back and forth. Ultimately, after a great deal of trouble-shooting, the problem was resolved. Throughout the process, Jasmine, in the office, was helpful, understanding, and helped me get a reduction on the final bill due to the inconvenience.

reviews.author: Matt Matheney
reviews.text:
This company is fantastic. Easy to do business with, they really have great customer service and support throughout the whole job from start to finish. You deal with one person(Billy is the best) through out the process. They are upfront about everything and Zach Rameriz and Will were just great, respectful and very knowledgeable about what they were doing. New A/C unit outside our home and no hassle or issues. Would SO HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS COMPANY TO EVERYONE.
THANK YOU.

reviews.author: jim lapre
reviews.text:
Zach from DNI Heating & Cooling did an outstanding job troubleshooting a refrigerant issue on my Bryant dual-fuel system. He didn’t just top off the charge — he methodically checked for leaks using nitrogen pressurization, electronic detection, and a vacuum hold test. He replaced the Schrader valves, added fluorescent dye and sealant, and explained every step clearly and professionally.

I appreciated his patience, technical depth, and commitment to getting it right. It’s rare to see that level of care and diagnostic rigor. If you want your system serviced by someone who treats it like his own, ask for Zach.

reviews.author: Hannah Staehling
reviews.text: My recent experience with DNI was disappointing. I own a condominium out of state and required prompt repairs to the AC unit, as it was no longer producing cool air. Because I have a tenant in the unit, timely resolution was essential. What appeared to be a minor repair ultimately extended into 3 days of work, resulting in three separate invoices totaling approximately $5,000- without prior calls or explanations. Communication throughout this process was severely lacking. In situations where a job requires additional hours of labor, or when scope changes, I expect the technician to contact me to explain the circumstances. Despite two months of requesting a conversation with a technician to understand what was done, I only recently received a call. During this time, the Accounts Receivable department repeatedly contacted me about payment, while I still had no clarity on the repairs performed. This experience has left me concerned that my absence from the property may have led to unnecessary work hours and inflated costs. Greater transparency and proactive communication are essential when working with any customer.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Anderson, SC
plumbers.address: 130 Powell Rd, Anderson, SC 29625, USA

reviews.author: Ellen Todia
reviews.text: Quick and efficient service! Contacted them on a Friday, they came out the following Tuesday and sent me confirming text messages. Our technician was professional, friendly and not only did he empty our septic tank, he also fixed a blockage in our plumbing. We are very pleased and highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Chad Caldwell
reviews.text: I've never used Mr. Rooter for my plumbing needs before, but they will be the first I call next time.  On Black Friday I had someone here within a few hours of calling about a leak to my water heater; he diagnosed the problem and quickly got the parts to fix it.  He explained the repair and even got additional parts if I needed to fix the other tube down the road.  I was very pleased with the speed of response, repair, and the price (especially considering it was a "holiday" for several other plumbers who would not come out at all).  Mr. Rooter is now my "plumber on call" when I need them!

reviews.author: Jill Robinson Beaver
reviews.text: I had a new set of tenants move in and they contacted me Friday night saying the hot water heater was not working. I called Mr. Rooter at 8 am the next morning (Saturday) and it was fixed by 11:30 am the same day. Our technician was Justin and he was very nice, informative and made our experience top tier. If you ever need a quick fix, I can’t recommend them more!

reviews.author: Chad McKenzie
reviews.text:
I decided to try Mr. Rotor after being recommended by a close friend who has done work for them. I normally use another company and usually pay under $400 to have my septic pumped. A friend of mine paid $380 with another company just days before my service.

Before they arrived, I personally dug up the tank and removed the lid to confirm it needed to be pumped. When they showed up, everything was already exposed. No digging, no lid removal.

The technician quoted my wife $500 because the tank was “really full,” which didn’t make much sense since people only call to have septic tanks pumped when they’re full. We agreed to the price to get it done.

We were later billed $888.21. When I called the office to speak with a manager, I was not allowed to. Instead, they said the technician would call me back. The explanation we received afterward was that the extra charges were for running a camera and for excess sludge. The invoice shows an $83 sludge charge billed twice and roughly $388 for a camera. If a camera was run, it would have gone only a few feet. The septic is less than six feet from the house, and the break was right at the entrance, which I had already pointed out.

The work itself seemed okay, but the pricing, billing, and lack of management involvement left us feeling overcharged and let down. Offering a small discount only if we agreed to nearly $2,000 in additional repairs didn’t help.

Buyer beware. I will not be using or recommending this company again.

reviews.author: Susan Feigin
reviews.text: Scheduled quickly, came in time, for the job done, reasonable charge, explained clearly. Nick was so nice and I was glad to meet him!  I could not be more pleased with your service!  Highly recommend calling Mr.Tooter! ( bad spell check but appropriate!  Mr. Rooter of course)

reviews.author: Jeff Blackburn
reviews.text:
Love the attention to detail and the trouble shooting skills Chip and Adam gave us. We were dealing with low water pressure with a 24 year old pressure tank. These guys were amazing, had it knocked out in a morning and took on a couple of issues we had with an outside hose bib.

Truly Professional!
Thanks guys,
Jeff

Jay and his group came out to replace my furnace and air conditioner and were efficient and so nice to work with.
The work was done about 2 years ago and everything has held up nicely through the cold winters and hot summers!
I've had them come out for maintenance too during that time and the guy is nice everytime!

reviews.author: Amanda Lauer
reviews.text: I have used H. Jacks several times and they are always super friendly and helpful. Had to call on a weekend for an emergency plumbing situation. Ken came out within 30 minutes of my call and snaked my main drain line. He was very kind and knowledgeable. I know when I need them they will be there!

reviews.author: Dana Kroffke
reviews.text: Ron and Ben came out to look at and diagnose an issue I was having with my septic/sewer lines. They arrived quickly, diagnosed the issues, explained everything thoroughly to me and quickly got me on the schedule for a repair. They were incredibly nice; I highly recommend them!

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Southeast WI

reviews.author: Pippin Michelli
reviews.text: Been using Mr Rooter for 25 years, always really pleased and satisfied. Didn't realize they had recently changed hands and this has significantly affected prices. The only thing they need to do is alert customers to the likely cost now, instead of assuming they know. Always good service. Great technicians.

reviews.author: Kenneth Acker
reviews.text: We had our main sewer plugged. We called "Mr Rooter" and they sent the tech Jakob. Jakob was very polite and professional.  He ran his camera down the main sewer and found roots was plugging the sewer. He ran his snake in and out quite a few times. The drain started draining but when his ran his camera again he still seen roots so he did it until drain was completely clean. Works great now and they guarantee their work. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Robert D
reviews.text: I called yesterday and within 45min someone was out by my property. They used automated messages to keep communication clear. and an actual person called me a few times too. so not just bots.  The technician John P Diagnosed the issue that a previous plumber couldn't! and also fixed it with ease. John kept me in the loop and was thorough with his explanation and charges also explained things super easy and didn't try to add unnecessary charges or fees.  Definitely would use rooter plumbing again. Great experience.

reviews.author: Lee Gill
reviews.text: John of Mr.Rooter did an excellent job explaining every detail of our drain cleaning process. He also provided quotes for a future permanent solution. John was positive, prompt, and professional. (Kudos to Josh who helped with the drain cleaning.) We would highly recommend Mr. Rooter for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Taylor Neu
reviews.text: Outstanding service from start to finish. The team at Mr. Rooter Plumbing did an excellent job replacing our hot water heater. They were professional, punctual, and clearly explained the process and options before starting the work. The installation was clean, efficient, and completed exactly as promised.

plumbers.name: Blue Mountain Plumbing, Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 46 Tinkling Spring Rd, Fishersville, VA 22939, USA

reviews.author: John Frank
reviews.text: Their extensive knowledge and experience is impressive and their patience to answer questions and explain multiple options has me leaning strongly towards choosing this company to do the job. So far I’ve only got an estimate but I believe I’ll be calling them soon to get the ball rolling and get the work done. A good friend from out of state that works in plumbing says it’s a good price for the job and they’ll be replacing my tankless water heater with one that can provide about twice as much hot water per minute as my current one.

reviews.author: Mindi Reedy
reviews.text: Josh and Jonathan installed our new water heater today. They came out to service our old one and the internal components were rusted, not to mention it was 11 years old. We decided on replacement and the techs ran and got the new water heater today and installed a new shut off valve as well. We had our routine HVAC maintenance today too. We were glad they could do both jobs at once, and replaced our Water heater same day! Pricing was great. Technicians were super friendly and knowledgeable!

reviews.author: Kenny Ayscue
reviews.text: We had an issue with a toilet running...and the shut-off valve broke.   Blue Mountain got a tech scheduled quickly for us.  Scott, the tech, arrived on time and took care of the issue quickly.   We use Blue Mountain for our HVAC and plumbing issues and have never been disappointed in their service!

reviews.author: Ken Campbell
reviews.text:
Jared , Scott , and David did an excellent job taking out the old hot water tank and installing a new one.
I am very pleased with their professional performance   It was a blast talking to those guys too.

reviews.author: Phyllis Feighner
reviews.text: Wonderful Tech he really checked out our heating unit very well. I was told what for tech to come out it would be 129.00 dollars but after he checked our unit it was 279.00 dollars. He did a maintenance check. The price was rather concerning to me But he found everything to be ok. Also can you email me a receipt, we didn't get one. Everything else we were satisfied with.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Richmond, VA
plumbers.address: 1210 Sycamore Square Dr, Midlothian, VA 23113, USA

reviews.author: Chang Yang
reviews.text: I really appreciated Mr. Ahmad’s hard work to fix our water pipe line and the faucet. I bought this town house 6 months ago, but never noticed the from yard faucet didn’t work until last week, I thought it was easy fix, Mr Ahmad found the pipe line and replaced the control valve but it still didn’t work, then the neighbors said most of the housing here have issues with their water faucet outside, some neighbors showed us how theirs were fixed and they said it took them two days to fix it, another neighbor said the former owner couldn’t figure out how to fix it so they never fixed it. I thought Mr Ahmad was going to quit but he didn’t, today he came back early and continued fixing it and found a few bad pipe line areas and replaced them, now it’s working perfectly!! I appreciate Mr Ahmad’s hard work, his expertise experience and knowledge, he said everything was possible through the Christ!! That inspired me!!

reviews.author: William Gibson
reviews.text: Paul is incredible to work with. I drafted a basement renovation plan and proposed changes to the plumbing (relocating water heater, washer, dryer and other plumbing elements). Paul has completed the work with good craftsmanship and at a fair price. I will continue to use Mr. Rooter's services in the future.

reviews.author: Chris Reyes
reviews.text: Mitchell did a great job fixing/repairing our shower faucet & cartridge, tank and valve. The first plumber who came (they said they're "near") suggested opening a hole behind the shower valve to replace it. It was a waste of time & money. I should have called Mr. Rooter and not that other "near" plumbing company . They gave us a nice price package for 3 different services. No opening of walls behind the shower valve.   Good job, Mr. Rooter!  Thank you, Mitchell!

reviews.author: Jacquelyn Cheney
reviews.text: Brandon from Mr. Rooter was incredible to work with. We were dealing with several issues at one of our listings, and not all of them were even plumbing related, but he stepped in and helped with multiple things without hesitation. His attitude and willingness to go the extra mile made a stressful situation so much easier. Really grateful for his help and would absolutely recommend him!

reviews.author: Cassie
reviews.text:
New Review: Absolutely fabulous work on our bathroom remodel. They worked with us on scheduling and explained everything - even how to do a few small fixes ourselves.

Old Review: The work was good (though it took them about three times longer than they estimated) and they mostly cleaned up after themselves. Not the most organized business and it's been a nightmare to close out the job payment and get a receipt.

plumbers.address: 19 Hillcrest Ave, Fox Lake, IL 60020, USA

reviews.author: Joe Rodriguez
reviews.text: I’m a caregiver for my mom. Had a sewer line collapse and needed to get it fixed to make sure she had what she needed. Dave and his crew were great to work with. Very professional and efficient and kind. Easy to work with. They showed up when they said they would, kept me informed and when I thought there was another issue they were quick to address it. Enjoyed working with them. 👏

reviews.author: Ruth Wojak
reviews.text:
The owner Dave came out and assessed the situation. He realized that the plumber the day before didn't do their due diligence. He called them immediately and had them out again within 20 minutes to finish what they should have finished the day before.
The job that Dave was hired to do, he explained that it needed to be done, but was probably not an emergency.  He actually called me three times after he left, to make sure that I was doing good with my present situation (which was a rusted through kitchen stack, which was now full of mud).
The guys who came and did the work were fantastic. Arrived on time. I received a text with their location, so I knew when exactly they would arrive, should they be delayed. They were courteous, quick, clean, friendly.... Can't say enough good about them.
When they left, I went down to clean the path to the work zone. They literally left the area cleaner than when they arrived. I assumed they would make a mess, so I didn't vacuum up the dust that is frequently in a basement. I also didn't clean up the mess from the basement being flooded. All was cleaned up. True, they jack hammered part of the floor out, but they also cleaned more than just the area they jackhammered.
Top notch company. I would hire them again in an instant.

reviews.author: Lindsey Idle
reviews.text:
Dave is awesome… such a good guy. I own a home bakery, so my pipes are definitely used more often than others.

I had a pretty major blockage this morning and not only did Dave come out on time but he brought all the necessary equipment as well as some preventative care for me to hold onto. He gave me great advice on how to avoid blockages in the future and made sure I knew how to use the drain treatment product to get the best results.

Honest plumbers can be hard to come by but these guys are absolutely fantastic

reviews.author: Justin Richtmyre
reviews.text:

All expenses were discussed upfront so that there were no unexpected financial surprises. They communicated their arrival times via text. They dug up our broken pipe, installed new pipe, installed a sump pump which we did not have before, and poured concrete. Great job.

reviews.author: Ricardo Cedillo
reviews.text: Superb performance by all of the crew at Ex-Stink Plumbing & Sewer! I give there professionalism and attention to detail an A+. Excellent job gentlemen! I will highly recommend and pass the word on. Thanks again!

Thank you Red Beard Plumbing for exceptional service!!!!

reviews.author: James Guzak
reviews.text:
Redbeard has been my go to plumbing company for three years. They are responsive, do top quality work, and their staff technicians are knowledgeable and personable.

reviews.author: The Goods
reviews.text: Quick, responsive, and fair. I have used them multiple times around the house and have been really happy with their service. reviews.author: Andrew Merrill
reviews.text: They did a great job replacing all the parts in our toilet. They spent extra time answering all our questions about other plumbing needs we will have to tackle in the future. reviews.author: Amy Key

reviews.author: Arvinder & Karla Singh
reviews.text:
Tankless water heater fiasco -After struggling with a tankless water heater issue in our new build and working with more than five plumbers who couldn’t provide clarity or solutions, Roadrunner Plumbing & Air stepped in and completely turned things around.
From the start, their team delivered personal service and showed a true commitment to getting the job done right. They didn’t cut corners, ensured everything was up to code, and took the time to make sure we were aligned every step of the way. What stood out most was their transparency and guidance—not only did they fix the problem, but they also helped us understand how to work effectively with plumbers moving forward.
It’s rare to find a company that empowers its employees to deliver quality work with autonomy, and Roadrunner Plumbing & Air clearly backs their team and their results. We left not only with hot water but also with valuable lessons: document the work, ask questions, and partner with professionals who are fair and transparent.
Thank you, Roadrunner Plumbing & Air, for restoring our confidence and setting the bar high for service and integrity.

reviews.author: Chris Morgan
reviews.text: I just had my water main line replaced today, and I just wanted to leave an honest review and express my gratitude towards the job that was completed and the employees that did the work. Angel and Chance showed up on time and got right to work. They kept me informed each step of the process and showed me exactly what the issue was and how it would be fixed. They were punctual, professional, and personable. I was given different options as far as repairs go and was informed what each option entailed. Thank you for sending out solid employees to get the job done in a timely and professional manner.

reviews.author: Leslie Cupit
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience with this company. They responded quickly and were very efficient. When the tech had to come back out they worked quickly and came out when it was convenient for me. Mike was very kind along with his assistant that came along with him. Overall I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Luke Pardo
reviews.text: Scheduled an appointment and they came out same day to repair a leaking water/ice valve behind my fridge. Angel, the repairmen, and the customer service office was extremely helpful and communicative. I wasn't home and they were able to access the property and fix the issue. Awesome service and will be using them again.

reviews.author: Bill Thomson
reviews.text:
Mike Genson and crew were polite, professional, and thorough in maintaining our plumbing.
We have been long time clients of Roadrunner Plumbing, always excellent and expert services rendered with each visit.
We recommend their services to all!

plumbers.name: Aspen Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 3350 S Aspen Ave, Broken Arrow, OK 74012, USA

reviews.author: jason brown
reviews.text:
Not terribly impressed.  Since there was a dishwasher removal involved we had to pay labor for a second person to come out. The second person didn’t show up until after the dishwasher removal was performed by the first guy. Not only that but not long after they came out our dishwasher backed up because it couldn’t drain because of a kinked drain hose.  Unfortunately the dishwasher was 20 plus years old and I could no longer source the integrated drain hose so we ended up buying a new dishwasher.

Second I paid for an hour of digging in the yard to find a leak that was causing a wet spot near the meter.

Before they came out I had previously dug down to the water supply line next to the meter and found the leak wasn’t coming from there but further behind where I had dug.

When they came out they didn’t ask where to dig. They just widened the hole I previously dug a bit which couldn’t have taken an hour. I know this because I could see the worker’s feet on the other side of his truck parked in the street for the lion’s share of the time instead of being in the yard digging to locate the source of the leak.

Seems like they were more interested in selling a couple of hours of their leak detection at $450 for two hours or $4500 to bore new pipe to the house.

Instead after they left I dug in the wet spot in the yard where I’d wanted them to dig in the first place and found the compromised compression fitting and replaced it myself to the tune of $12 from Lowe’s.

reviews.author: Jackie Bishop
reviews.text:
I’m very pleased with my first encounter with Aspen Plumbing.  Your representative, Brian Freeman, was courteous and knowledgeable.

I truly appreciate your service and quality.  In the future, I feel confident about choosing your company to do the best job.

Jackie Bishop

reviews.author: Matthew Winslett
reviews.text: The expansion tank on our water heater gave out on Sunday morning. After getting in touch with Aspen Plumbing, they helpfully explained how to turn off water to the water heater so we still had some running water. Then, they came out Monday at noon and had the work all done within two hours. Quick, knowledgeable, and efficient. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: phoenix46a
reviews.text: I was impressed with their back office. They handled my call, courteous, followed up promptly on a part I had on order. My issue took 2 visits. Each plumber was fast, friendly and competent. Very reasonable on price. From now on I’m calling Aspen Plumbing. 👍

reviews.author: Kellie Long
reviews.text:
Update: Aspen is wonderful!! Brian and his colleague were here when they said they would be, got the job done way faster than I expected!  It looks great, is working great and I will be calling Aspen for any plumbing need I ever have!!

Great service, very knowledgeable, and fair quote!  So far I’m impressed!!

plumbers.name: Harts Plumbers, Electricians, & HVAC Technicians
plumbers.address: 1202 Black Lake Blvd SW Ste A5, Olympia, WA 98502, USA

reviews.author: Angie Huston-Calvin
reviews.text: Corey was amazing and very thorough in getting to the problem and fixing it!! I had a tricky main line issue, and he was very patient and determined to get it unplugged which he did!! Aside from being knowledgeable to do the job, he was very polite, courteous in taking care with keeping my house clean, and professional. I would highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Trudy Fairhurst
reviews.text: I have used this company in the past and they have always been good but we were lucky today to have Spencer as our electrician. Very professional and competent and an exceptionally nice guy. Can’t thank him enough for his willingness to solve our issue in our old house with a mislabeled panel. Cost was also very reasonable! Thanks again Spencer you’re awesome.

reviews.text: Anthony was very friendly, explained things, and was helpful and professional. If you have dogs like I do, he will be thrilled. He listened to my concerns and worked within my schedule. He provided needed info and answered questions. Nice experience even if more expensive than expected.

reviews.author: Reno Garcia

He explained everything clearly, ensured my system was up and running, and checked both my sump pump and basin. Through his thorough inspection, he discovered that my sump pump required attention. Hart is fortunate to have such a knowledgeable and dedicated representative. Much appreciated and will be calling for their services again. Thank you.

reviews.author: Bryant Mercil
reviews.text:
Mike was outstanding in his approach to inspecting the existing plumbing system in my home. He carefully examined all aspects and ensured nothing was overlooked during the inspection process.
Throughout the inspection, Mike took the time to answer all my questions. His responses were clear and informative, which helped me better understand the condition of my plumbing system.
His estimates were detailed and included all necessary options that I needed to consider for my plumbing needs. This thoroughness made it easier for me to make informed decisions.

reviews.author: JOSE CRUZ
reviews.text: Travis came out this morning to do a check up on our AC/Heat system. He is very courteous, polite and professional. He was very thorough and clear in his explanations of what he recommends for our system. Travis has a great personality and it was a pleasure having him to come out and do the inspection on our system. Dial One Johnson always sends the best people out. Thank you for your awesome customer service and great workers! These guys truly are the best, cant recommend them enough. If you need AC, AC service of any kind, Johnson Dial One are the very best in the field! You can’t go wrong with them. Thank you again for sending Travis to us; he is truly a credit to his profession and represents his company magnificently!

reviews.author: Ben Hart
reviews.text: Jose called and let me know that he was available earlier than scheduled, which was excellent. Arrived, diagnosed and fixed my furnace problem within 10 minutes. Very pleasant and easy to work with. Top service.

reviews.author: Marianne R
reviews.text: Dial One was quick to book an appointment. Their friendly admin staff was very helpful. The call-out fee is mandatory, and they only come to assess, so the work wasn't done the same day.  But once the plumbers were there 2 days later, they did all they could to figure out and fix the problems.  A big shout-out to James & Will, who were excellent in their communication and work-ethic.  I will certainly call on these folks again.

reviews.author: CJ Johnson
reviews.text: Mold light install in vent system went well. Fast and clean! Other problem areas were identified and an intervention was to avoid future problems, of which was much appreciated. Very informative about what was done. Overall pleased with the service

reviews.author: Deidra Collins
reviews.text: The technician (James) was professional and efficient . I appreciate him remembering having serviced my home before. That goes a long way with me. The problem was  diagnosed and completed. I will continue to call Dial One for my plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Plumb Doctor
plumbers.address: 747 Chance Rd, Marietta, GA 30066, USA

reviews.author: Charlie Perez
reviews.text: We had a leak in the main line from the water meter to our house.  These guys were referred to me by one of my neighbors so I felt good about calling them.  They came out the same day to assess the problem and returned the next day to fix it. It was  pretty big project that took the better part of the day. Brandon (the owner) came out I person to help out.  They did a great job at a fair price.  Not cheap but fair. Cheap does not usually equal good.  I’ll definitely reach out to them again next time I need plumbing work.

reviews.author: Sean McIntyre
reviews.text:
Plumb doctor was recommended to me many years ago.  I have contacted them on 4 different issues and they sent someone out immediately each time and once was a Sunday afternoon after I spoke with Brandon the owner directly.  Each time they were able to fix the problem and only charged me a service call.  Today I had a severe leak and because of their previous
honesty and excellent customer service (including the administrative staff that assisted me on the phone and the on site plumbers) I contacted them again. They were able to send Fletcher over, who has helped me before, and it took more extensive work to fix but he did a fantastic job once again.  I highly recommend Plumb Doctor!

reviews.author: Aaron Reali
reviews.text: Plumb Doctor is a top-notch company with an outstanding team. While I haven’t personally used their plumbing services, I’ve worked with their company professionally and have always been impressed. Brandon, the owner, is incredibly honest, hands-on, and easy to work with, and that leadership clearly shows throughout the business. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Plumb Doctor to anyone looking for a trustworthy plumbing company.

reviews.author: Juanita Love
reviews.text: I had called another plumber before calling Plumb Doctor and I had some doubts about the repair he said I would need. I decided to call Plumb Doctor and I'm glad I did! Plumb Doctor provided excellent service from start to finish! Their pricing was very reasonable, and what impressed me most was the way they explained every step of the process before beginning any work. I felt informed, respected, and confident in the service I was receiving. The work was done efficiently, professionally, and with great care. I highly recommend Plumb Doctor and will definitely call them again in the future. Fletcher and Del were the absolute best!

reviews.author: Pablo Peñasco
reviews.text: My water service line in the front yard broke. Plumb Doctor had provided excellent service at my house before so I called them. They went out of their way to help me today! 8am phone call and Brandon answered immediately. Cody was here by 11am. We agreed the old PVC line was old and brittle since this is the 3rd break in 4 years(plus we discovered another repair later when digging). They gave me a fair price and were back by 2PM with utilities getting marked before they started trenching. I am grateful to them to have plentiful clean water flowing again! I also told Cody about my pressure regulator had failed twice in the last 4 years and he immediately knew to check the expansion tank. It had failed. Cody replaced that for me while he was here. Thanks also to Tim for his expertise and hard work. Both times I have used Plumb Doctor they have provided a quick response and quality work the same day I called in. Thank you gentlemen.

plumbers.name: Total Plumbing Solutions
plumbers.address: 15901 N Florida Ave, Lutz, FL 33549, USA

reviews.author: Tim Curry
reviews.text: We have an older home built in the 70's and needed a full re-pipe.  After gathering some quotes, we decided to go with Total Plumbing Solutions.  They did an excellent job.  I was a big job and took 2 days to complete start to finish.  I was impressed. These men worked hard.  Charlie oversaw the crew and he went above and beyond to make sure everything was done correctly and he gladly answered any questions in detail we had along the way.  He was very courteous and conscientious.  All cleanup was done properly when the job was complete.  I was extremely happy with the outcome.  Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Joe McGeehan
reviews.text: My wife was about to shower this morning, but no water despite the fact we had water everywhere else in the house. Called Total Plumbing Solutions  because they were recommended by our plumber for the last thirty years. The job today was performed to our complete satisfaction and the price was more than fair. Highly recommend them and will use them in the future.

reviews.author: Jim Harbaugh
reviews.text: Joe, with Total Plumbing Solutions was at a neighbors house and I asked if he could look at a plumbing issue under my  bathroom sink. After he finished the job he was working on, he came to my house, provided a reasonable estimate and did the work in a timely manner. Very courteous, helpful and did a great job. I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Sharon Markee
reviews.text: My husband and I were very pleased with the service provided by Total Plumbing Solutions. They arrived when they said they would, and performed the work at a reasonable price, installing 2 filters on our water softener. They didn't charge us just to bring the truck out either, as others do if you don't use their service. They had to come twice, as we were missing a part to the water softener the first time they came. They were courteous and got right to work. We will definitely use this company again and will refer them to our friends and neighbors. Thank you, Michael, at Total Plumbing Solutions!

reviews.author: Debbie
reviews.text: Joe and Doug are a great team.  They have done a lot of jobs for us including repairing a major water leak under the slab.  They are polite, clean and very respectful.  Their work is A+.

plumbers.name: Atlantic Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning, Inc.
plumbers.address: 609 Copeland Dr, Hampton, VA 23661, USA

reviews.author: James Rowe
reviews.text: Joe was on time and vvery courteous show him what I needed fixed. Quickly he told me what was needed to fix it and price. Soon the job was done and I was satisfied. Will call on Atlantic if ever have any plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Mike Martinez
reviews.text: Both Josh and Michael were extremely professional and friendly.  They completed the job and cleaned up making the project spotless. Very impressed with the quality of their workmanship.

reviews.author: Troy BruvahTee-roy Forbes
reviews.text: Furnace went out. I thought I fixed it. I missed a step or two. They were able to come out quickly. Not only was the small problem I caused fixed, but the tech also performed a comprehensive inspection to look for other potential problems. He also offered advice for future situations. Very professional and personable service, Atlantic is my goto for HVAC!

reviews.author: Chandra Clarke
reviews.text: My experience with Atlantic was top tier. I received a same day appt and specialist Mark was knowledgeable and took his time diagnosing issue with furnace. He had heat back running after 3weeks in cold and gave professional suggestions on parts to extend life of unit. Atlantic was a referral by friend who also had a pleasant experience. reviews.author: Kevin Thomson
reviews.text:
GS Plumbing provided outstanding service from start to finish. My technician, Trevor, arrived on time and was professional, courteous, and attentive as I explained the drainage issue I was experiencing. After verifying the problem, he first attempted to clear the line with a snake. When it became apparent that the blockage was likely farther down the line or more severe than initially expected, Trevor didn’t hesitate to take the next step.

He went into the crawl space beneath the house, carefully traced the line, and isolated the approximate location of the problem. Throughout the entire process he worked diligently, explained what he was doing, and made sure I understood the situation and repair options. His communication and professionalism gave me a lot of confidence that the job was being handled correctly.

As a disabled veteran who is unable to access the crawl space to perform these types of repairs myself, I was especially grateful for Trevor’s thoroughness and respect. GS Plumbing also extended a veterans discount, which I truly appreciated.

Based on this experience, I will not hesitate to call GS Plumbing again for any future plumbing needs. Excellent service, knowledgeable technician, and great customer care.

Thanks again Trevor 👍

reviews.author: Nathan Scott
reviews.text:
Avoid at all costs….

We were looking for someone to flush our tankless water heater, address our water pressure drop, and install two shower heads.

We initially scheduled our appointment for 10AM-12PM, but we were later notified that someone would arrive a little after 12 PM. Fast-forward to 4:30 PM, and the sales associate/plumber arrived.

After listening to our concerns, he stated he would put together a quote for us. The quote itself took about an hour to provide.

At this point, I was prepared for the used car salesman tactics. Sure enough, the first quote was  $9,000 for primarily a water conditioner/softener and a few other items that had absolutely nothing to do with our request.

The price pyramid scam included five other options, all the way down to a roughly $2k quote that actually covered what we requested.

This was my only day off to meet with someone, and even though it was on the high side of things, the technician was kind, and I didn't mind providing him with our business. I don't hold him accountable for the pitch this company makes them go through.

The work was scheduled for the following day, and I had to be at work, but the technician did come and attempt to provide the services we paid for.

However, it was done so poorly that we now have to hire another company to straighten out and fix the mistakes. As you see in the photo below, the connection points on a high-pressure line are not aligned, the PRV has zero support to the point where it is bending the line below, and the water shut-off handle is barely accessible now.

And to top it off, we still have low water pressure in our kitchen, a hole in our wall that was much larger than necessary, and a mess of insulation/drywall dust to clean up in our garage from the cutout.

I would highly recommend that anyone looking for plumbing services look elsewhere.

reviews.author: sharon smith
reviews.text: Bernard was friendly and efficient in checking out my heating unit. I asked lots of questions and he was polite and patient in answering all of my questions. I am very impressed with your customer service and how I was kept in the loop in every way about the status of my appointment. Great customer service goes a long way to convincing me to sign up for the years service plan. I have confidence that I will be taken care with my HVAC needs.

reviews.author: Chuck G.
reviews.text: Builder used cheap push/pull shutoff valves on my toilet input water lines and one wasn’t working right. I wanted them both replaced with good quarter turns and choose Strittmatter based on great reviews and them being local. Cody came out and did fantastic work. He was professional, knowledgeable, efficient, personable and gave me a fair price. He also answered a few of my random plumbing questions and offered other good tips. The only downside of my overall experience, and a bad first-contact with a new-to-me company, was dealing with “Katie” the AI receptionist who was a little creepy and inefficient to work with.

reviews.author: Kelly Irwin
reviews.text: The Frymire team did quite a bit of pluming work in my home. Their works was quality and the service was professional. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nancy Stroud
reviews.text:
The experience with Frymire-Strittmatter was HORRIBLE.  Dave came, gave a bid of $1850 to install a hot water heater PAN.  Insisted it was same price for installing a hot water heater, and that it took two men.  I am desperate to have it installed as I am selling my home and this is an item on required repairs for sell of home.   He then gave me a discount of $200 since I was a repeat customer.  So the bill, including tax was to be $1622.  I paid a $250 deposit and scheduled an 8:00 AM appointment.   On the day of the appointment I received NO phone call ….Dave did not show up until 11:30…..I was on my way out the door for a scheduled medical procedure…..which he and I had discussed when scheduling and he assured me that the job would be completed well in advance of my required departure to the medical procedure with having scheduled an 8:00 AM appointment. Additionally when he arrived for the appointment he was by himself.  Now since the price was so HIGH because it was a 2 person job I was a little curious since I was paying the hourly rate of 2 plumbers     When I expressed concern about why he was 3.5 hours late he stated he was not responsible for scheduling.   Yet, when I booked the appointment he was on the phone with the scheduler and confirmed the 8:00 AM appointment.   After a very heated discussion about tardiness….paying for 2 people when only one was here I told him to get off my property.   Additionally all morning I had tried calling to inquire about no one showing up and all I could get on the phone was their AI Bot fielding phone calls.  Later in the afternoon I called, finally got a woman on the phone, told her my story and how furious I was and demanded that I wanted my $250 deposit back….my concern about being overcharged.    This woman promised a call back.  You guessed it…..Not one damn call back.   I can’t begin to express my dissatisfaction with Dave….Frymire-Strittmatter- and the entire experience. Clearly they have no conscience about over charging.  As far as I am concerned this company STOLE $250 from me, completely misrepresented their ability and what it took to get the job done.  And let me add, I was furnishing the pan not Frymire-Strittmatter.
I would NEVER NEVER recommend this company or anyone associated with it ever to anyone.    And, oh yes….i got the job done for $225 from their competitor.

We would highly recommend Monae for any plumbing work needed! Thank you Monae for your hard work, time, and effort! You are very much appreciated!

reviews.author: Joshua Cucci
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about my experience with Roto-Rooter, specifically with Howard. We were dealing with a major issue with our main sewer line, which is a stressful situation for any homeowner.

From the moment Howard arrived, he was incredibly professional and thorough. He didn't just guess at the problem; he took the time to properly diagnose exactly what was blocking the line. What I appreciated most was how he explained every step of the process to me. He walked me through the camera inspection, showed me exactly where the issue was on the monitor, and explained why it was happening, not just what needed to be done to fix it.

He was meticulous during the repair, ensuring that everything was cleared out completely rather than doing a "quick fix." He even double-checked everything before leaving to ensure the flow was perfect. It’s rare to find a tradesperson who is both technically skilled and a great communicator.

reviews.text: After an almost 12-hr work day, I arrived home to an intermittent gurgling sound coming from my bathroom. Brian took my call at roughly 7:35 pm and immediately scheduled a technician that would arrive within a 2-hour window. My technician, Howard, arrived within an hour of my call, ready to help. He tested the functions of the commode, flushing several times and checking the components of the tank, but was not able to replicate the problem. He was patient as I asked questions, and offered the possibility of replacing all of the elements in the tank and gave me an estimate. Additionally, he waited several minutes to see if the problem presented itself again, but it did not. Although no work was necessary, the customer service was top tier. Roto-Rooter provided excellent and dependable customer service - from scheduling to arrival. The best part of this experience is that Howard was genuinely kind and professional, and suggested a potential solution if it occurred again. If I have plumbing problems again, I will definitely contact Roto-Rooter.

He ignored my requests & replaced with bulky but practical chrome handles & replaced copper pipes with "brass". Which is okay for practical reasons, however when i went to clean/drain the tub it did not happen. Mind you i had "gerry-rigged" the overflow when i bought this house but it did drain. $1474 dollars later I called the office for the tech to come back out b/c tub would not drain at all we got into a heated discussion about the overflow plate & linkage whereas this tech Sean advised me he could make "right" for $800 bucks OR i could buy a dollar store drain plug/stopper.
