reviews.author: Jeff Alderson
reviews.text:
UPDATED twice.

Too long, don’t read. Find someone else. Poor communication, wouldn’t stand by their work.

I'll give an honest review here, there have been some issues outside of their control, and some issues on their side.  But most of the major fault is theirs.

After posting my initial review I got a prompt call and an explanation of what went wrong.

Then I came home and found the whole setup spraying water and cycling on and off excessively. They said resubmit to the warranty company, but the warranty company said they are no longer working with this company.

We have a home warranty and had a sewer grinder pump fail  It's an older home which has complicated things.  We were without use of our home.  Initial call to them was on 2/3.  They couldn't come for 3 days, until 2/6.  Their reason was that was their contract with the home warranty company.

On 2/6 they worked on it for a few hours and spent quite a bit of time on the phone with the warranty company.  That's not their fault.  By the time the repair was authorized they couldn't drive to get the part because the place was closing.  They wouldn't come back until 2/11, even though the part was in stock and they could have picked it up the next morning.  The repair guy did patch it enough so I could run it manually as needed and showed me how to do that.

On 2/11 he returned with the part.  He comes while we're at work, leaves after a few hours.  Never hear anything.  I look at the side of the house and it's cleaned up, put back together.  I notice the switch is flipped to OFF, I assume it's done and he made a mistake, so I flip it to AUTO and forget about it.  Then I start getting emails from warranty company about the service not being complete.  On Sunday 2/15 I call to find out what's going on.  I'm told they don't know anything but will ask the technician tomorrow and call me back.  No call on Monday 2/16, so I call back on Tuesday 2/17, said technician will call me.  Someone from there calls twice on Tuesday but doesn't leave a message, I couldn't answer.  I call again on Wednesday, same thing, technician will call me.  Finally Thursday AM (2/19) I'm told the pump can still be run in manual mode, but a part is needed and they don't know when it will come in.

We wait until the next week and start calling again on Monday to find out when the part will be in.  Told we'd get a call back, don't get called back. Call again Tuesday, first time told someone will call right back, they don't, so call again at 5 and told the part just came in and they will fix it on Thursday (2/26).

Technician comes on time, calls me after and says he's done.  But the only part he could get requires a neutral wire in my electrical box so now I need an electrician to come rewire it.  Oh and by the way, it won't run in manual mode anymore.  So now we can't use the house again until I can get that fixed.

That evening I receive a bill for $950 from them.  I'm writing this review after receiving this bill after hours so I can't even call and find out why they are billing me when the home warranty company told me everything was covered.  I call the home warranty company and they said they contractor hasn't submitted the report to them yet so they have no idea either.

UPDATE.  After submitting the review I get a call from someone who is genuinely trying to figure out what happened.  He explains some challenges they had and agrees there's some things to fix.  He acknowledges the bill was sent in error and their communication wasn't up to his standards.

Update #2. See the attached video. Water spraying everywhere. They wouldn’t just come out to fix it. Said to call home warranty company. Home warranty company said they don’t work with them anymore. I’m actually glad to be done with them.

Wouldn’t call me for days on end, never tell me what's going on or if I can even use my house.  It took from 2/3 until 2/26 to do the repair, 6 days of that was waiting on a part.  I called them 9 times and my wife called 4 times.  After all that the repair was terrible quality.

reviews.author: NichtGuteFürSie Nimmer
reviews.text: Marlon and team came initially for a snake cam inspection due to sewer stoppage under the crawlspace and found major cast iron pipe under the house was severely corroded and leaking in the crawlspace. A whole section of cast iron pipe was taken out and replaced with modern ABS piping. However down the line there was clay pipe that was also flooded. This damn house was build in 1955 and perhaps older sewer pipes with pre-existing foundation on an older home prior. After a sewer clean-out built for further cleaning and inspection, multiple spots along the clay pipe had root intrusion causing sewer accumulation and stoppage. Since spot repairs will not solve a near-century old problem as earth movement and tree roots will further compromise the clay pipe, a trench-less repiping was deployed from under the house to the sewer main to get rid of any cast iron and clay pipe, as it's been at least 70 years since the sewer pipe had any service or upgrade. An 20-ft epoxy prepared line pulled with pressured air pump was done from the new clean-out outside to the section under the patio and house. Then a trench-less pipe bursting shoved a 50ft+ ABS pipe all the way to the sewer main. The team worked diligently everyday during the stormy days to get the job done, except one day during the epoxy curing followed by a mother of all storm when weather god had a bad Valentine's date. Empathy was practiced to make sure we had least inconvenience. Thanks to Marlon for his friendliness that came a long way. And George who took the time to explain the finer detail to make sure things were well taken cared of. I came to experience how the backyard soil became soft enough to dig holes on a few occasions but short of any Shawshank redemption escape experience along the sewer trench. Works Plumbing took care of the rest from the initial phone answering, organized communication, hard-work team effort, to reseating the toilet and caulking that was better than it was first installed. Great job to all. Well, it ain't cheap, but a clean sewer will save sanity for ages to come. Cast iron and clay pipe suck, don't let them ruin your shower, kitchen, and bathroom experience. Let Works Plumbing take care of them for you along the coastside from SF to Half Moon Bay.

Over the last few months, my home has required major foundation and plumbing work, and the entire experience has been overwhelmingly stressful. Thankfully, our incredible Realtor, Jay Marks, put us in touch with CR Plumbing, and they were an absolute godsend throughout it all.

With plumbing, it often feels like a “we fixed this, but now we found something else” situation, and CR Plumbing stayed with us every step of the way. Chris was educational, kind, and deeply empathetic. The team was completely transparent about both the process and pricing, and they even went out of their way to be flexible when payment became a challenge for us. Communication was always clear and timely—Autumn was especially wonderful to speak with whenever we had questions or concerns.

Every person from CR Plumbing who stepped onto our property was professional, friendly, and genuinely kind (and occasionally a little goofy, in the best way): Chris, Larry, Olaf, Christian, and Jaden. Even Clayton, the owner, came by personally to check on the work. That level of care speaks volumes.

The reality of repairs like these is that they are expensive. CR Plumbing repaired a break in our laundry room, our washer box, our cleanouts, and eventually about 85% of our underground plumbing. It was a significant cost—but the quality of work, expertise, and peace of mind they provided made every cent worth it. They will be my first call for any future plumbing, electrical, or HVAC needs.

Thank you, Chris, Larry, Autumn, Olaf, Christian, Jaden, and Clayton. If I missed anyone, I truly appreciate you as well. I’m incredibly grateful for your service.

reviews.author: Martin Vercic
reviews.text:
Have used CR Plumbing twice and both times the jobs, the price of the repair, and the customer service from the Plumbers were excellent.
Both The Plumbers today--Jarrod & Larry--were very friendly, explained the necessary repair, and promptly finished the job.   I will use CR Plumbing for any future plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Tammy Carlson
reviews.text:
I’ve been using CR for many years. Customer service is always great and the people they send out are phenomenal. Not only great at what they do, always very nice and personable.
Chris and Larry were here all day today doing my hot water heaters. They were great. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Andrea Mills
reviews.text: Our upstairs shower was leaking into our garage when in use. Kaleb and his partner were quick to find the issue with the spout. Kaleb even let me know the replacement spout should be covered under Moen’s warranty (already called and have a new one on the way at no charge). Quick diagnosis of the problem and easy replacement with a temp spout until the new one arrives. Highly recommend Kaleb and CR Plumbing.

reviews.author: Sandra Paglia
reviews.text:
What a relief!! We have finally found a plumbing company that is reliable AND honest.
While one visit might not seem enough to come to this conclusion, in my in experience it is.
Willie and Victor showed up when they said they would, assessed the situation and, expertly and efficiently, dealt with it.
They quoted the very fair pricing and didn't try to indicate a need for any other add ons.
It so happened that the morning of their afternoon appointment we had gotten a call from the city water department regarding a possible leak in our pipes indicated by water running in the street gutter that emanated from our property.
I asked Willie if that was something that he could look at and, without hesitation, he kindly checked the indicators and deemed that there was no leak. A French drain system that needed to be cleaned was the likely cause of the water runoff.
I asked if that was something CR Plumbing handled and he said it was.
I will make the appointment for that service next week and will rest assured that the same professionalism will be demonstrated.
10 years of intermittent plumbing needs have usually left me disappointed and frustrated with no one plumbing service ever being asked back.
I am SO PLEASED that CR Plumbing has broken this 'curse'.
I feel very confident recommending CR Plumbing and their variety of services.

plumbers.name: Pither Plumbing
plumbers.address: 310 W Methvin St, Longview, TX 75601, USA

reviews.author: Jaysen Dry
reviews.text: Ask for Nick! He's a well mannered young fella and willing to do any job that's big or small! He's going to make sure you're happy with everything before he leaves and that includes any mess that was made during your project. Btw, my gas stove is going strong and so much more efficient than my electric setup I had previously!

reviews.author: Charlotte Stewart
reviews.text:
The plumbers were prompt, professional, and trustworthy.
I had a long list of plumbing problems. I called Pither Plumbing. Even though I told them it was NOT an emergency, I received an appointment for the next morning.
They called that morning, and came over promptly.
I put our dogs in the backyard.
They fixed and reset a toilet. They fixed an under sink leak, and installed our garbage disposer. They fixed a couple of problems (with our permission) that were not on the list.
They looked at, and we discussed, some slow facet leaks. They would have made more money by fixing the slow facet leaks that day. They however, recommended the best type of facets to get for a long term solution.
I highly recommend Edgar and Pither Plumbing.

reviews.author: Collin Thompson
reviews.text: Ron with Pither was extremely helpful! I had a small water leak in my toilet which the city actually notified me that I was having higher than normal water usage. They came out the same day and got it fixed and quickly! Very reasonable on price too! Highly recommend for your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Doug Heard
reviews.text: Tankless hot water heater.  Over the last year and half I have called the original plumber, and several others to fix my tankless system as it had stopped working properly - it would only make hot water when multi outlets were activated.  None could seem to fix the problem and the 3 other guys gave it an honest effort.  I called the 4th plumber and he told me to call Pither, as they were great when it comes to tankless systems  The guys who came out took about hour and BOOM the problem was discovered.  A second visit to replace a part and hot water easy .    I am not saying these guys walk on water but I bet they can make sure your plumbing doesn't require you to try.  Call them and  when you do mention this review and get  a .0001 % discount!!!

reviews.author: Juan Vazquez
reviews.text: Very unprofessional. Their website says they serve Mount Pleasant, but after making me wait all day with no updates, they suddenly tried to charge $450 just to show up because they’re based in Longview. That’s not honest or transparent. I didn’t move forward with them and suggest others double‑check pricing before scheduling

plumbers.name: Flatirons Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1111 Spruce St #404B, Boulder, CO 80302, USA

reviews.author: Jeanne Tobin
reviews.text: I was extremely pleased with Flatiron Plumbing. They were able to come out the same day that I called and Anthony the technician was very pleasant, knowledgeable and helpful. We have used them several times now and have always been very pleased.

reviews.author: John M
reviews.text:
The technician, Anthony, was great, professional, efficient, and did solid work after he had to go get parts.

The price was quoted upfront and I agreed, not knowing the job would take under 30 minutes or be as simple as capping two water lines and one gas line with easy access. The $575 final bill later felt well above market.

When I contacted the office, I did not ask for a specific price reduction. I intentionally left any adjustment to their judgment, in good faith, believing they would assess what was reasonable. Instead, I was told that because I accepted the quote, I needed to state what the job was “worth.” When I declined to name a number and asked them to determine a fair adjustment, the office manager became rude and refused any consideration.

That response reflects poor customer service. A small goodwill adjustment would have kept me a satisfied, repeat customer. Unfortunately, the office response overshadowed an otherwise positive experience with the technician.

reviews.author: Greg Boehme
reviews.text: I contacted Arvada Flatirons Plumbing for resolution on a water issue late in the afternoon.  They scheduled us for the first appointment the following day.   I received notification my  tech would  Anthony who arrived timely.  We discussed my issue with a leaking stack pipe as evidence by water in the basement.   Anthony said he would do an inspection to determine source of the leak. He quickly determined the source.  We were given several options for correcting the water leak on the cracked fitting.  Once we  selected the fix,  he quickly got to work.  It's was within the walls from the upper bathrooms.  During his work , a second tech , Paul show up to assist as the plumbing ran thru 3 Floors.   They completed the work on a timely fashion and  flush tested the new plumbing.  They thoroughly cleaned up the area when finished.   I highly recommend Flatirons plumbing Arvada for any work.  They are professional, courteous and prompt.   My neighbors had previously use them and were please with them as well.

reviews.author: Rob Watt
reviews.text: From my very first contact with Flatirons, I was impressed with their quick response to my plumbing issue, getting me on the schedule quickly, and then repairing my leak in a timely fashion. Steven was very professional and got the job done when he said he would. The only issue I had, I felt they over charged me for the work performed. But their work performed, was 5 star.

reviews.author: Ken M
reviews.text: A visit yesterday from Flatirons Plumbing was a pleasure.  Caesar arrived on time and immediately knew what our problem was.  After checking his truck for the part that he needed (he had one), the repair was quick and our leaking drain was fixed - I had tried to repair it but knew I did not have the right part and was hesitant to attempt buying, let alone installing, what was needed.  Caesar was a delight to work with, personable, knowledgeable, very focused on helping us resolve our problem, and should we have other plumbing problems in the future we shall always call Flatirons Plumbing. . . and ask for Caesar!

plumbers.name: 24 Hr. Emergency Plumbing & Hot Water Heater
plumbers.address: 805 Maple St, Brooklyn, NY 11203, USA

reviews.author: Taquanna Woods
reviews.text: Candace did a great job installing the water heater and changing the pipes. Very clear and thorough explaining issues and for a great price!! Thank you!

reviews.author: Alexandra Wesser
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend these services enough. We run a small business and we were in desperate need of a plumber at 2:30 in the morning. Candace answered our call and was incredibly professional and reassuring and she sent Roberto to the rescue quickly. Roberto was wonderful-- he did not stop until he figured out the problem (and that was no easy feat). He was kind, patient, and thorough; he truly was everything you could wish for in your lowest moment.

We're grateful for 24 Hour Emergency Plumbing and we'll be calling them first the next time we have any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Addie Wilk
reviews.text: I'm so glad 24 Hr. Emergency Plumbing were able to get the help I  needed! True 24/7 service really shines when you need it most - like when your water heater stops working late at night. It's great to hear the technician was quick, clean, and professional.

reviews.author: Bklynn528
reviews.text: I had a last minute job that needed immediate attention, and when I called, Candice took the time to share her expert advice regarding my water heater.  She recommended an upgrade, something I already knew was necessary but had been putting off.  Not only did Candice and her team complete the job that same weekend, they also ensured all plumbing and piping were up to NYC code.  I’ll definitely continue working with this team on future projects.

reviews.author: Justin Knowlton
reviews.text: The service provided was professional, friendly, prompt, knowledgeable, thorough, respectful, and overall exceptional. I highly recommend 24 Hr. Emergency Plumbing and Robert to anyone requiring quality work for household utilities. The technician's assessment of my boiler and hot water heater by Robert was truly remarkable.

reviews.author: Lesvia Millican
reviews.text: Alexandro was very professional. I got the sense that he knew exactly what he was doing so that put me at ease right away.  Both of the technicians were really nice and very polite. They installed my wall heater in a really short time and took the time to explain how to operate the heater. I would highly recommend their services.

reviews.author: Vincent Alderete
reviews.text: Jerry and Jeremiah were 10 stars the best I have ever seen in my life. Mastery in performance, customer care and know what's best. I have never experienced the type of care and advising the best possible outcomes. Me and my family were suffering with out a functioning water heater taking a cold shower was a nightmare. Amanda dispatch sent the guys out they knew exactly what to do and diagnosed the issue quickly with precision. After explaining our budget the family like business at Earl's donated a water heater to us. I'm still pinching myself. Thank you King Jesus for Earl's Plumbing & Air. I pray everyone gets the service, love and good Christian business relations I have received. My heart goes out to the company. Bless you and your generations to come. If reading this you are truly in for one in a lifetime experience.

reviews.author: Lindsey Brown Synatschk
reviews.text: Earl's was so professional in their communication from start to finish. I usually spoke with Stephanie on the phone, and she was so kind and helpful. Our plumber was Zach N. and he was fantastic as well. Although we were outside of their normal service range, the supervisors at Earl's approved us during a terrible winter storm, and we are most appreciative. I especially appreciate that they texted a technician photo, bio, and ETA along with tracking. Would definitely use Earl's again and have already recommended them to others. Thank you!

reviews.author: Paul J Brooks
reviews.text: Earl‘s always does an amazing job! Fast, friendly, professional, and expert install installation and maintenance maintenance! We have our home warranty with them, and they have been really great to work with. They saved us a ton on our water heater expenses. I would definitely recommend buying a home warranty for girls and getting the premium package. It’s been a lifesaver.

reviews.author: Alyssa Mattheus
reviews.text: Tyler Anderson has come to fix our plumbing on a couple different occasions. He has been phenomenal each time. Tyler is kind, knowledgeable and professional. That is SO appreciative and excellent to observe something like that. Thanks Tyler for being an amazing plumber, but providing great customer service too!

reviews.author: Lupi Basil Merlo
reviews.text: Respond time was great! Our plumber Guillermo spent time explaining everything to us and gave us options regarding choosing the new faucet and repaired the water leak. He worked quickly and efficiently.  Very pleased with the job! Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: allie grant
reviews.text: lyndon is AMAZING!!! a total life saver!! so thoughtful and kind, diligent and conscientious- taking lots of photos and going to great lengths to make sure my landlord and i were both fully aware of every single step of the process. he takes great care in his work and is extremely skilled and a true professional in every way!! cannot recommend his services enough!!!

reviews.author: Claudia C
reviews.text:
I called Roto -rooter for a second opinion today, I used another provider yesterday who told me there wasn’t a clog, they said the issue was because of narrowing of the copper pipe. The technician from the other company used a camera and spent a long time snaking it twice, and was not able to clear the clog in the line.
Today, Johnston my Rotor-rooter service technician arrived quickly, he was very professional and explained to me the issue and what my options were and approximately how much each option would cost.
When we agreed on an option and price, he was able to clear the clog within 2-3 minutes!!! I couldn’t believe it when I saw the drain emptying!!!! He was so quick and efficient, I was so impressed, I was speechless!!
If I have any future plumbing issues I’m definitely going to call Roto-Rooter and ask for Johnston!!! I also provided his info to my landlord to put on his list, for possible future service!!!
I am VERY grateful to Johnston for resolving our plumbing issues today!!

reviews.author: N T.
reviews.text: Outstanding service! After getting a quote of over $6,000 for a drainage sewage backup issue. Linden and his team from Roto-Rooter came to the rescue! With the total transparency the  team snaked clearing out the drain of baby wipes and towels for under $500. The team supervisor camera-ed the drain providing detailed information while I was watching the camera go through the pipe s Water flowing freely once again. The entire team is professional, extremely knowledgeable, providing assessments with clear and concise information. Extremely grateful thanks so much for

Professional crew reasonable price, Guillermo was the supervisor at the job
They run camera, water, jet, snake, and again camera to make sure The sewer  line is clean.

reviews.author: Ken Chen
reviews.text: Speake’s plumbing did good job on repairing my leaked gas line. Crew arrived within 2 hours after initial request, on New Year’s Eve. Replaced leaking gas pipe and completed job with 2 hours.

reviews.author: Meia Jefferson
reviews.text: Mr.David was amazing. His customer service was superb. He was attentive kind and knowledgeable. He was patient and his work was efficient. He fixed our work in a timely manner and with no issues. 10/10 would definitely recommend to everybody!

reviews.author: Henry and Stephanie Herber
reviews.text:
Speake’s has been consistently great to work with.
A knowledgeable person answers the phone, and took some time to give me advice even knowing I mostly DIY.
I wanted some help hooking up a gas line and have them review my water heater install for safety. They came out promptly. Daniel was excellent to work with and very efficient with his time.
They did not try to upsell me on useless items and charged a reasonable rate. Very happy with my experience.

reviews.author: Mary Jo Nelson
reviews.text: We have had two instances in the past three months that have required immediate attention. Speakes was able to come out very quickly, and it was greatly appreciated. They have always been very dependable, honest and thorough. We are likely to have found a plumbing service that does good work with integrity.

plumbers.name: High Speed Rooter & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3831 Arden Dr, El Monte, CA 91731, USA

reviews.author: Trudy Guzman
reviews.text:
The house is at least 70 years old and most of the pipes are the original galvanized. We discovered an extremely bad water loss and we put in a call. They found the main issue and then showed us pictures of many more. As you can tell from the pictures, a nearly full plumbing replacement job took place. These guys were incredibly thorough and knowledgeable, being very forthright with sharing that knowledge. They made sure to keep us informed the entire job. They explained any and all questions we had.
Long story short, they worked long hours for a week to get this job done. Jovanny, and the entire crew were excellent! Especially with all the under the house work that had to be done. They had to crawl around for hours under the house like classic tunnel rats. I would definitely recommend their service to anyone needing any kind of plumbing work.

reviews.author: Kelley James
reviews.text:
Chris and the team were incredible with their work and repair. We had contacted a different company who came out first to do an evaluation and they were here for just 15 minutes.

When Chris arrived he spent nearly two hours evaluating the problem (even going under the houses crawl space) and identified the issue causing just our shower head to lose all pressure/output.

Would recommend Chris and High Speed Rooter & Plumbing, and I will definitely contact them again!

reviews.author: Ken Vail
reviews.text: They did a great Job pumping our septic tank. They arrived within an hour of talking with Frank on the phone. The job was completed within 30 minutes of the truck arriving. The final price was very reasonable and was slightly lower than what he had estimated on the phone. Frank followed up with a no cost evaluation of the tank. No high pressure sales just explaned the conditioni of the tank and some optionial modifications if they become necessary in the future. All in all very happy with the service, honesty, and professionalism.

reviews.author: Claudia C
reviews.text:
I had initially contacted Robert about a pipe burst for my sewer line, and after getting quotes from over a dozen different rooter companies, I have decided that Robert seemed the most helpful, easygoing, and willing to answer my various questions about the process. At the time, I wasn’t ready to proceed, so I kept in contact with Robert for 3 months, during this time, I’ve also called him about other questions I had, even questions my friends had, and he was always patient and willing to advise me on my concerns. This reaffirmed me that this company is the right choice.

Ultimately I was ready to proceed with the project and Frank became my main contact, he was professional, willing to work with my schedule, and took plenty of pictures during the process to reassure me.

I would overall recommend this company, as I felt that they will be people I can continue to reach out to if I had any future questions!

reviews.author: Carol Xu
reviews.text:
High Speed Rooter has been servicing our church for the past few years, and they have always provided excellent service. They are very professional, their pricing is fair, and they truly care about their customers.

In my opinion, true success in any business is not only about being skilled and professional, but also about having a genuine heart to serve people. High Speed Rooter definitely demonstrates that.

We really appreciate their help and highly recommend them.

Very Enjoyable Experience…

Thank You…

perfect. No wonder they are trusted.

He is also a very pleasant man and helpful with suggestions for what we needed to do. I was happy Pat did this for us.

reviews.author: Schyler Chappell
reviews.text: I had Austin out to clear a backup in my sewer line. He not only unclogged my outlet, he educated me on what potentially may become an issue down the line, how to avoid problems and what long term solutions may be, if it becomes an extensive problem. Austin was pleasant to speak with, clean cut, and professional. I highly recommend this company and certify that they are trustworthy and provide quality service. The office lady - I think Lucy was her name - was also an excellent communicator.

reviews.author: Theresa E Carpinelli
reviews.text: It took them awhile to finally get out to my house for the installation, but once they got here, they couldn’t have been nicer and more professional.  Did a great job with the installation, and were very considerate.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: EA C
reviews.text: Austin was prompt and very helpful and informative!  The cost is very high only down side for me definitely seemed like a nice company to work with.  I will definitely give their info to a neighbor or friend.

reviews.author: Jennifer Pavlak
reviews.text: Rooter Man has been the best plumbing experience I’ve ever had. I was recommended them by Americon Restoration after a pipe started leaking through my kitchen ceiling. Heather from Rooter Man text me SAME DAY that Americon was here trying to set me up with an immediate appointment with a plumber. She got me booked for the very next day! My plumber, Evan, showed up promptly right as the two hour window began, and was so personable and kind. He assessed my issue and determined he needed to make a run to the hardware store first so he could do the job same day. He ended up replacing about 16 inches of my corroded supply line. He worked so diligently, and explained to me what he did to correct the issue. He spoke to me (a single mom) respectfully and concisely. His cleanup was if he was never here. What a wonderful and smooth process this was for me- I took their card to recommend them- and use them again!

reviews.author: Mary Morgan
reviews.text: Patrick was prompt and so nice. Very helpful, even when i couldn't get home to talk to him myself. My daughter called me & had him on speaker to explain what the problem was, how he fixed it & assured that we should be good for a long time now, also explained what would be done if they have to be called out again. Highly recommend & definitely will call if any other problems arise

plumbers.name: Mackin & Sons Plumbing
plumbers.address: 911 Broad Suite 201, Wadsworth, OH 44281, USA

reviews.author: Polly LaHue
reviews.text: Josh did a great job installing a much-needed garbage disposal. He was prompt, pleasant and professional! Tidy, too! What more could you ask for in a plumber?! I'll be using Mackin for all my plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Karen Elizabeth
reviews.text: Mackin & Sons provided excellent service when my water heater failed. My phone call was answered immediately--no automated voice system, no need to leave a message. They got me on the schedule the first day I was available, removed the water heater and gave me a written estimate that included options to repair or replace. I chose replacement, for which they helped me secure financing. There were issues with my subfloor and surrounding area that needed to be addressed before the new water heater was installed. Mike worked with my insurance company and recommended a company to do the remediation work. Mindy in the office was always pleasant and helpful, as was everyone else I spoke with. Once the floor repairs were done, they were available right away for the installation. Josh and Ethan did a fantastic job fitting a 40-gallon water heater and drain pan into a small opening that previously held only a 30-gallon. They even managed to fit a thermal expansion tank into the limited space. They explained what they were doing without my even asking, and the questions I did have were answered patiently and knowledgeably.  Turning the water back on caused my ancient faucet to give way, and Josh was able to repair it on the spot. The whole company was professional from start to finish, and it showed in the end result. I would recommend them anytime.

reviews.author: Rachel Latin
reviews.text: Hot water tank started leaking at 8 pm last night and called Mackin & Sons late to schedule an inspection. By 10:30 am today, we had a new tank professionally installed. Josh and Ethan were friendly and answered all our questions. Couldn't be happier with the quick response time and the great service. Thank you Mackin & Sons!!

reviews.author: Josh Brockman
reviews.text:
Mackin and Sons Plumbing was fantastic to work with. Kristian was great to work with and goes out of his way to help. They rushed to get our water running so we could move in on time, which meant a lot to us. Not only that, but they took the time to walk us through several water treatment options that fit both our needs and our budget.

When we later ran into a plumbing issue that they hadn’t previously worked on, he didn’t hesitate to help and took the time to talk us through how to fix it without even having to coming out. The problem was resolved immediately.

They are extremely professional, friendly, and very knowledgeable. We will absolutely be using Mackin and Sons again in the future and highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable plumbing solutions.

reviews.author: Penny Mcbride

He has even went through insurance. Thank you for all your company has supported us through. Make a big difference knowing you have our backs.

Thank you so much again!

Five star service!!

reviews.author: Kayla Wynn

They called ahead and even arrived sooner than expected. The team efficiently diagnosed the problem, located the source of the blockage, and cleared it out promptly. They worked cleanly, were impressively quick, and their pricing was very fair. Everyone we interacted with was friendly and professional.

reviews.author: Cecilia Tang

They were prompt, communicative about pricing, efficient and courteous, left the work site in immaculate condition, and went above and beyond my expectations for this work. I am appreciative of the job they did and would absolutely recommend their work. Photos: a very gross before and then the after!

reviews.author: Walter Scott

reviews.author: Georgia Powell
reviews.text:
Edit 2: Changed rating to 4 stars.  Heilder corrected all the issues from their initial water line installation.  The work this time around was done correctly and there are no issues.  It is unfortunate that they had to come out a second time to complete the job.  The last four pictures of this post show the completed work.
Edit 1: Company owner called me this morning to come up with a resolution.  It was a very good conversation.

I choose Heidler based off other customers who said they had an excellent experience.  I had the complete opposite experience. I called customer service within 10 minutes of the job being completed to explain my disappointment with the work.  I was told that I would receive a call back, but no one has called.
The project was to install a water line to the fridge.
Pic one shows how the plumber installed the line making the cabinet space unusable.  The 2nd, 7th and 8th pic shows the copper water line against the main electrical line.  The copper is being pushed in the wood due to tension from electrical line.  Does this even meet code and is this safe??   Pics 3 and 4 show behind the fridge.  The way the line was placed, it is unclear how to even fix the dry wall as the copper pulls when the fridge is pulled out.  Finally, somehow they damage and dented a lid that was on the counter and never said anything (pic 6, 7).  This looks like an amateur completed this, not a professional company.  It cost almost 800 dollars for this work.

reviews.author: Phyllis Scalettar
reviews.text: Heidler takes careof the plumbing and fireplace maintenance at our home. Their service and their staff are 150%…professional, , prompt and pleasant. They always have provided me with the highest quality and the greatest reliability. I actually use them as my standard when evaluating other vendors for other types of services. They have to meet my Heidler criteria to work for me. I recommend Heidler with no reservation and my highest endorsement.

reviews.author: Maria Fiaschetti
reviews.text: Phillip was excellent and explained everything thoroughly. We had an issue with our toilet that had a root cause more involved than a simple repair, but at each step of investigating the issue, Phillip explained what was going on and what would happen next. He showed me where things were broken, why they broke, and what that meant. He was very courteous and polite. Our toilet ended up needing a new flange in the concrete floor, but now it is sturdy and sealed and we feel really good about getting this service from Heidler.

reviews.author: Kyle MacQuilliam
reviews.text:
After weeks of a stubborn kitchen sink that refused to drain, even after I’d snaked it 25 feet myself, I finally called in the pros — and Heidler proved exactly why they have the reputation they do. Dave showed up on time, diagnosed the issue quickly, and fixed what I couldn’t in no time.

What really stood out was his honesty: even though the original quote was for a hydrojet service, he said confidently that a proper snaking would solve the problem — and it did, for about half the cost. The water now flows perfectly with no backing up, and he even installed a cleanout access for easier maintenance in the future.

It’s refreshing to find a company that values doing the right job over the most expensive one. Thank you, Dave and the team at Heidler — five stars and genuine appreciation.

reviews.author: Jorge Leeao
reviews.text: The winter of 2025-2026 was pretty brutal, with temps in single digits on some days.  I had shut off our first floor baseboard heating due to a leak somewhere in the water pipe system.  However the old Levitt house we live in have the pipes embedded into the concrete slab (no basement) so finding the leak was especially challenging.  Our HVAC system plus the Dyson Heating unit DID NOT provide enough heat during the cold nights.  In March we finally called several plumbing contractors to see how the leak can be detected and repaired.  Only Chivalry offered using thermal imaging gun to try to narrow where the leak might be.  Eric and Rich came out to perform the scan and identified two possible leak locations.  The first potential leak site was in the kitchen.  They were able to limit removing just a single 18×18-inch tile to access the pipe, but this location showed no leak. The second location, near the back door, required cutting through laminate flooring, and that is where they found the leaking pipe. Replacing the leaking pipe section was fairly standard.  But the hardest part was finding the leak.  We are grateful for Eric and Rich's detective work and the repair done to restore our baseboard heating.  Now we can look forward to a warm winter next year.  PS. Its up to the homeowner to repair the surface AFTER the digging, which I was able to do myself. Luckily, I kept some tiles and floorboards.

reviews.author: Donald Bellino
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Best Cooker
reviews.text:
We used Chivalry (previously known as Aquaman) for many years. They used to be good, but not anymore. When we called them we were told we needed to get the faucet ourselves and that they would come to replace it. Fine, we went to Home Depot and picked up a Glacier Bay faucet and yesterday, 2 Chivalry guys came to replace the faucet for us. They charged more than five hundred dollars for this. Today, we found out there is a small leak at the valve in between Glacier Bay’s tubing and our sink pipe. We called Chivalry and they sent someone else who is not one of the original guys that replaced the faucet. He looked at the leak and said the leak was caused by a factory defect and Glacier Bay products always have this kind of problem. Then he said he only uses Moen products and that he has some of their faucets in his truck. If we wanted to, he could replace it again, only this time it would cost us more than nine hundred dollars, including the parts.
Meanwhile, I told him the 2 guys yesterday took our Glacier Bay box with them, so we’re unable to return it to Home Depot should we need to. He called them and told them not to throw out the box. When I asked “So when are your guys going to return the original box to us?” He said when we called them to replace it again they would bring it back on that day. So the understatement is that if we don’t call them for the next faucet replacement, we would not get our Glacier Bay box back to return to Home Depot. We said we’d think about it.
After he left, at first we planned on going to Home Depot to pick up a Moen’s faucet, but somehow, something he said really bothered me. So I just asked my husband to tighten the valve and after that there were no more leaks. So, the original 2 guys didn’t even tighten the valve enough so that it wouldn’t leak and the 2nd guy didn’t even think to tighten the valve at all? And no one verified that it didn’t leak after the job was done? We will never hire them again. Why is it so hard to find an honest and reliable plumber?

We would like to specifically highlight Walter for his efficiency and helpful demeanor. We highly recommend their services and look forward to our next project together.

reviews.author: KC CLINE
reviews.text: I called because our toilet was acting up and when Walter got here it seemed ok. Walter cleaned it out with his auger just to be sure. He was a perfect gentleman and professional. As it turned out there was no charge because they were out in December during the power outage. Thank you very much!!

reviews.author: Nick Kuhn
reviews.text: I can’t express how much of a positive experience it was to work with Homeservice Plumbers (Colorado) on our water heater replacement. The water heater we replaced was over 20 years old and we decided it was time to replace it, even though it hadn’t crapped out on us yet, but for the right price. We had a flexible budget but we knew we wanted to stick to it and not feel like we were overpaying for something we knew at the time was just precautionary. Justin came to our house and presented us with clear options but he went above and beyond talking with his supervisor, Ben, on not just bringing the cost down but bringing it down to meet our budget; and we got to be on the schedule the following day! We know as a business they didn’t have to negotiate at all so the fact they did blew us away. Huge thank you to Justin and Ben for that! The following day, Marcus G. arrived to do the work and he was done in about 4 hours (which even included a pause so he could run to the shop and back); it was a pleasant surprise to see how quickly he was able to get everything done including that pause and in the end everything looked great! Everyone involved was friendly and professional and we couldn’t appreciate you guys more for this entire experience from beginning to end. You guys have a customer for life for our future plumbing needs. Thank you so so much!

plumbers.name: The Hot Water Heater Pros
plumbers.address: 1604 W Main St, Franklin, TN 37064, USA

reviews.author: Bonnie Walker
reviews.text: Our hot water heater blew up after 5P on a Friday. We called The Hot Water Heater Pros since they had installed it 3 yrs ago, & it remained under warranty. They found our records, came by to confirm that repair was not possible, & scheduled the replacement installation for Monday. Cole, the technician arrived early for the appointment, efficiently installed the new tank with care & precision. We had to pay $600 for labor, which I disagree with but paid; you'd have to pay more to start fresh with a new vendor.    But out of warranty, I'll hire the company that truly honors the warranty and does not charge labor under warranty.  They do exist, so ask about this when replacing a heater that's not under warranty. Again, the technician was AWESOME!

reviews.author: Chris Lindsey
reviews.text: These guys are AMAZING! We lost our tankless water heater in the ice storm. They came out at 7 PM and put a new one in for us. They did an amazing job, gave us a great price, and got us going quick. Both of their installers were top-notch PROs and super nice guys. They care about their work and their customers and it shows. I literally could not recommend this company more.

reviews.author: Lisa Postell
reviews.text: I hired The Hot Water Pros to flush my tankless water heater. Communication was great. Great pricing. I don’t know if it is the placebo effect, but I feel like my water heater is working more efficiently now. I highly recommend. Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Kate Eller

reviews.author: Justin Farr
reviews.text: I would highly recommend The Hot Water Heater Pros! We called them when we needed to replace our external tankless unit after the freeze. The entire team was easy to get a hold of during a stressful time. Cole was great and really helpful in explaining everything to me.

reviews.text: I can't say thank you enough to these amazing people! Aaron was able to get me a quote on a new HVAC system and get the ball rolling ASAP. They were so nice, very thorough and didn't rush the install process just to get to the next job. Highly recommend this wonderful company.

reviews.author: Gary Lott
reviews.text:
Called Bailey Brothers Plumbing on a Friday around 2:30 PM—the day before we were about to get full-blown Snowpocalypse. We had a leak somewhere in our hot water closet and had already struck out with several other plumbing companies. One of them actually referred us to Bailey Brothers… and that alone says something.
Bailey Brothers said, “No problem,” and sent Larry Floyd to the rescue.
Larry was fantastic. Super professional, easy to work with, and honestly brought some serious Sherlock-level deduction skills to the job. This was not an easy issue to find, but he didn’t rush, didn’t make excuses, and didn’t quit because it was cold or getting late. He stayed with it until he figured it out—and fixed it—just in time before the great cold front of 2026 hit.
Huge thanks to Larry and the entire Bailey Brothers team for saying yes when others said no. That kind of service is rare, and it matters. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Taylor Moore
reviews.text: Highly recommend Bailey Brothers! Stephen came out within hours of calling. He was incredibly professional, transparent, and personable. Stephen took the time to explain the processes and actually listened to any of my concerns. The greatest part? The cost was very affordable! I have found my new plumbing company! Thank you, Stephen!

reviews.author: James McMurphy
reviews.text:
I called Bailey Brothers and they showed up within the hour! Very prompt.
Unfortunately it was all downhill from there:
I was quoted $2,800 to fix a broken fitting on the bottom of a well pressure tank. They said the whole tank needed replaced along with other fittings and their labor. I questioned why the broken fitting couldn’t simply come out of the tank so that the entire tank didn’t need replaced. I insisted they try to remove the fitting and when they did, it came right out. So right there saved over $1,000 just because they were going to be lazy and not try to remove the broken fitting. When I tried to question, very nicely, why I was being charged so much for labor and a part ($1,200- $1,400) to resolve this issue, Larry got hostile and hung up on me after saying if I didn’t like the price I could call someone else. He left me and my customer high and dry with no water all night just because I was questioning some things and trying to figure out why labor was so high. He ignored calls and texts, which I could see he did in fact read. Unbelievably rude and unprofessional. Not to mention lazy. Do NOT waste your time calling them.

We were expecting a very expensive repair based on prior quotes from other companies, but Doug and Daniel walked us through several reasonable options and explained everything clearly. We decided on a 5-foot spot repair that fit within our budget, and thankfully that solved the problem. Our water was restored and running perfectly again. reviews.author: Joe DeSilva
reviews.text:
This is a WORLD CLASS company. I have never worked with a company or people that display such care and consideration for their customers like AAA Advanced Plumbing & Drain Cleaning.
The main sewer line in my brand new home was backing up just 2.5 months after moving in. After getting canceled on twice by Roto-Rooter, I finally reached out to Advanced Drain. That first night, Novey and Tyler showed up — extremely professional, on time, and 100% focused on listening to me. Their goal was to fix the issue, and they were willing to spend whatever time was needed. Unfortunately, the problem was much bigger than expected, and after 4 hours they needed to return with a larger machine.

The next day, Jim, a 33-year veteran, showed up. On time, professional, and the hardest working person I have ever met. When I was ready to give up, he looked at me and said, "patience and persistence." Sure enough, after 5 hours in freezing cold and snow, Jim got through the blockage. But he didn't stop there — he insisted on coming back the next day to run a camera through the line to identify the root cause. Jim's care, knowledge, and refusal to quit until we had answers is candidly not something you see much of anymore.

All of this outstanding front-line service was wrapped together by an unparalleled customer service experience, led by Jamie. She was my first call, and what a warm, professional and genuinely caring person she is. She became a friend — calling me regularly with updates on timing, next steps, and everything in between.

If I were to rank every Google review I've ever written, Advanced Drain would sit firmly at #1. I can't say enough good things about them.

Thank you to Jamie, Jim, Novey, and Tyler — you are all exceptional.

reviews.author: Kristin Duaime
reviews.text: I want to thanks Sal, Chris specially Sam from Plumming Pros. Monday morning we found sewage backed up in our basement. Unfortunately right after a major snow storm had blanketed NJ with 2 feet of snow. I thought there was no way someone would come out right away. So I got on my phone and googled searched for plumbers near me. I came across Plumbing pros and gave them a call. They answered right away and thankfully had a tech on call. Within a few mins I had a text from the tech. In the message was a picture of the tech and text letting me know he was on his way. Within the hour he was knocking at our door step. Well mannered, polite and friendly. Sam to got to work right away. First putting on booties to keep our floor clean. I showed him to the basement and he got set up. Laying out tarps and garbage bags to keep things neat and orderly. As he moved the camera down the pipe looking for the problem he took pictures along the way. He kept me informed the whole way and even let me look over his shoulder as he worked. When he knew what the problem was he called his owner and confirmed what he saw… broken pipe and tree roots blocking the pipe. He worked up an estimate and had financing available. Knowing the urgency, they got me scheduled right away. By Wednesday morning they started digging. I was impressed with the safety measures taken around and in the hole. Safety fencing around the hole site and metal boxes to hold the walls up. Thursday the new pipe was in and even got it inspected the same day. We were back up and running by Thursday night. I was impressed with how everything was handled start to finish. I know who I’ll be calling and recommending to everyone for their plumbing problems.  Thank you again!

reviews.author: Greco G
reviews.text:
Please read this! Great information.

Overall pre-experience:
I have called many plumbers as I am new to the area as far as utilizing contractors. I came from a town where I knew everyone, but once I moved to Sacramento, I knew not a soul as far as contractors are concerned. The plumbers that I have called while in Sacramento either never called me back or answered, but with interaction they just said "hmmm, not sure" "We can send someone out" type of answers, but still never heard back. Very very frustrating to say the least.

NOW my main review of the great company:

When I called the main office and nice young lady answered(Kathryn)and was very very helpful. She took care of me hand and foot and asked me to send pictures of the area where I needed help and they would supply me with at least a quote. Once Armoured received the picture I was presented with a clear quote. Once I said "Let's get it done", they jumped on it and the next day, boom, a nice gentleman named Philip was on-site. Yes, a young gentleman but very skilled and quick!

The issue with my plumbing:
I had a problem with my main shut off valve. When totally turning it off, it still let water through. I was seriously debating if I should call a plumber. I reached out via internet to Reddit and for Citrus Heights they said "Armoured Plumbing!". This was my last ditch effort to find a good plumber and I am glad I did.

Experience:
The young man Phlip was quick, skilled. He was on-site and ready to work. He quickly gathered all tools and was ready to tackle the fix. I never saw him walking around, lazy foot type of behaviour, like some other contractors I have seen.

Pricing:
I have had several folks price this out by phone after receiving pictures, but some prices were overkill as one quote was up in the 4k amount, which was entirely too cost absorbatant. Hence why I am glad to finally find a plumber now that I can trust. Final cost was very reasonable to me.

Overall review:
Owner: Barry, very responsive and detailed. He first called me and was very knowledgeable and explained everything.
Front office staff: Great to work with and very very informative, patient, kind and just overall a good experience.
Technician: Philip: Great young man, super informative and talked to me while on site explaining things that I would question with no hesitation and was very confident in his abilities.

In reading other reviews: I found some folks(low percentage) unhappy, but in reading some of these posts, they seemed uninformed, not the property owner and just overall complaining about things that they did not communicate to Armoured.

Remember all, communication is the key here! Armoured does communicate as I experienced this first hand.

Just a note: This is a valid review. I have no affiliation and have never contacted this company before.

Feel confident utilizing Armoured. They were great to me and they will be great to you.

Thank you Philip, Barry and Kathryn for their amazing support. Great folks to work with!

**Please press the like thumbs up if you experienced the same!

I hope you appreciated this review!

reviews.author: Heather Gerhart
reviews.text: Oh the joys of a backed up toilet! I have this particular toilet that loves to get backed up, and i can usually clear out the toilet with a plunger and go on with my day. So now to lowes i go to buy an auger and I cant get this thing to go in the toilet line longer than a foot no matter what I try.. So finally i just give up and make the appointment with the plumber. He then clears out the toilet with his auger in no time and im just amazed at how easy it was for him! Even he struggled with it and that made me feel better than it wasn't just me! reviews.author: Chang Gong
reviews.text:
Update to my original review:

I had an initial repair performed on January 17, and at the time the furnace appeared to be functioning properly.

The furnace began operating inconsistently again in early February. I called the company on February 12 to schedule a follow-up appointment.

On the evening of February 15 — the night before the scheduled visit — the furnace was still running, although it was taking a long time to start producing heat.

A different technician arrived around 10:00 AM on February 16. After approximately two hours of work, around 12:00 PM, he informed me that the furnace had been tampered with and claimed that the manual gas valve had been shut off. He refused to continue service and implied that someone else had worked on the system without their knowledge.

He then left without completing the repair and did not collect any payment for the visit.

The accusation is concerning and does not align with the timeline. The furnace was producing heat the night before, and we did not have anyone else work on the unit.

I requested time-stamped photo documentation showing when the technician began work and when the alleged issue was discovered. The company refused to provide this documentation, stating it was “for internal purposes only.”

I am disappointed by this experience.

(Original: Eydin did an excellent job repairing our furnace. He is very knowledgeable about heating systems and was extremely accommodating, even working outside of regular hours to make sure we had heat as quickly as possible during the cold weather. Highly professional and reliable—would definitely recommend.)

He showed me water around the bottom of the heater in the pan on which the heater was sitting.  The water was not there the night before.  I removed the water.  There was no rust at the bottom of the heater.  There is no water there after two days.  He had a couple of minutes alone with the water heater so my conclusion is that he put  the water there to force replacing a functioning water heater and a couple of valves  a cost of over $3000.   When I priced what he was offering compared to what I could independently, I could do all of what he offered at around $1000. I didn't want to waste money to replace a fully functioning water heater.  I had one before that lasted more than 20 years.  Rheem water heaters interior is glass coated for a long life if they are maintained properly.
Be careful if you ever need anyone doing work in your house, make sure to ask around and get some decent people.  There are a lot of thieves skinning a lot of innocent people and there almost no regulation and no control.  We live in a strange time.

reviews.text: My 84 year old aunt had a blockage in her sewer line this past Sunday so we called Stemmle and they said that they could get to us in about an hour. They arrived at little after 6pm and assessed the situation. They told us that there would be a dispatch fee of $189, which we understood and then they searched for and located the blockage by way of a clean out located in the garage (floor) and cleared the blockage with a "snake"after pushing the snake in roughly 12' (the blockage was soft and was flushed away by flushing toilets (2 downstairs, 1 upstairs). They were through in less than an hour and left just before 7pm. They charged the dispatch fee of $189 plus a fixed fee for snaking the 12' of sewer line of $592 for a total of $781. The two plumbers that were dispatched were polite and knowledgeable but the fee that Stemmle charged, $781, seems excessive for less than an hours work.

reviews.author: Adel
reviews.text: Great experience with Kyle J and the Stemmle plumbing team. I unfortunately had the experience of a pipe freeze and burst underneath the house on a Sunday in my rental property. reviews.author: Nathan Delong
reviews.text:
When I first used Nexgen I had them install a brand new system in my home I was doing a remodel too from the ground up. A rep. named Jeff Larson was as professional as could be and designed an awesome system. He deserves 5 stars. Too bad the first foul was with the installers. They forgot to hook up one of the handlers and had to put a hole in my new drywall. Even worse they left a live line in there. The lead installer told me it was fine and didn’t need attention. They just had to cut a hole in the new drywall and now put a junction box, that I told him he had to put in,  because you can’t have wire nuts in the wall. Even though he swore up and down it’s fine. Yeah right. B.S. Then my electrician came by who was working on the house and used his meter on it. Picture 1. 230 volts. Yeah it’s fine. Now I pay them monthly to have them come service my AC and tankless water heater. It’s gets the work done for free but costs 180 a year. It’s about a fair deal as long as you use it. The problem I have with it is it just feels like an opportunity for them to try and sell overpriced services. Like their proprietary cool cleaning for 500 bucks. I know people fall for this scam. Ask any AC guy. All you really need to do is spray them with water. If you do this coil cleaning twice a year for 2 years you’ve already bought a new condenser.
Nexgens over head is so astronomical they now charge the SH out of people to do any work. This is another laughable one. They wanted to charge me 12,000 dollars to install a tiny mini split. Instead I bought the unit for 1200 and did most the install my self and found some one to charge the lines that charged me 100 dollars. And this guy is a pro that I still use today for projects. I think I am going to just give him the 180 bucks to do the service work for now on since Nexgen likes to pester me for a review for coming over, taking at least 30 photos of my AC, replacing just one of the 8 filters in my house, then trying to upsell me on some service for 500 bucks that is not needed. Well there is your review. Would you like another. Please send me another email. I’m sure I can think of more.

reviews.author: Kenneth Kaberlein
reviews.text: Juan Jimenez from Nexgen did fantastic work. He was very knowledgeable and professional the entire time working on my unit. plumbers.name: Reliant Plumbing - San Antonio
plumbers.address: 1119 Fresno St, San Antonio, TX 78201, USA

reviews.author: Rachael Lorenzetti
reviews.text:
I have had a horrible experience with Reliant Plumbing. Charged $800 for a PVC pipe replacement to a Ptrap, only for the work to start leaking. I had calls back and forth with the company, was transferred to three different staff members over the course of three weeks. We were overcharged for what was replaced, and for the quality of the work that was done. If you want the whole story read on.

Our Ptrap came apart under our kitchen sink, due to the previous owners trying to do a DIY pipe job in our 1974 home. Called Reliant based on their reviews, someone came over, talked with my husband, but wasn't the actual plumber, then the actual plumber came over said everything needed to be re-piped, and it was going to be $800! Since this was a reoccurring problem for us, and having the kitchen flood five times, my husband in frustration agreed.
Then after the work is done the plumber proceeds to tell my husband that this is only a temporary fix, and what we really should do is drill into the wall to lower the angle of the pipe...after we had already handed over the credit card. I called to complain, talked with Steven, and he said the plumber must have been mistaken?--After researching the plumber was telling the truth, but the company took our money before we could consider our options. I could not understand how the work that was done was worth $800. Other than replacing the accordion pipe that was originally there, everything looked exactly the same. This job should have cost no more than $500 (on the very high end). And the story continues, I called back after inspecting the work to verify why the bill was so high, since the invoice did not go into detail besides saying it was a re-pipe. I was told I would get a call from management, no reply for a full week. Then a leak starts in one of the pipes they replaced. Called back again, airing my grievances to reception, since I didn't get a call that was promised, and now the $800 work I paid for was leaking. I now get a call from Andrei, told him the whole story, and we agreed that a plumber would be sent to inspect the job between 8am-9am on Wednesday morning, "You will be our first appointment of the day" he said. Come 8:50am Wednesday morning, no one has shown up, nor called or texted. I call Andrei asking if someone is still coming, he says he'll call back...he doesn't, I get a call from reception instead asking if I would still like a technician to come (well ya, I wanted one to come between 8 and 9am as promised, cause I need to go to work). I air my grievances again, and finally just asked for a refund, because I am so displeased with the work and service.
Reception says I will get a call from management again. Now a different person calls me, and I air my grievances yet again--how did the work add up to $800, why is it now leaking, why didn't anyone show up? He then proceeds to tell me that the screws just maybe need to be tighten, but also he cannot consider a refund because how does he know that I just didn't "loosen it myself in order to call and ask for a refund"?! That accusation alone is a reason why not to hire them. I told him I still couldn't comprehend the $800 fee, and he said that was a standard price...it is not. At that point I was so frustrated and offended. I said it was my right to ask for a refund, and if it was denied, fine, but I wish to no longer to do business with them (even with their warranty, I feel I had been given such a runaround I refused any further help from them). I'm sure they can care less about any of my complaints cause they got our $800, which was a blow to our budget. Now we are bearing the cost of that bill, without having the problem fully fixed.

reviews.author: Diana Galvan
reviews.text: Austin & Gabriel did an amazing job with our repairs. They were patient, hardworking, and communicated with us thoroughly during the process.
