Anytime we had a question or needed something checked, they were quick to respond and come back. That kind of service really gives you peace of mind.

We highly recommend Bommer Plumbing!

Patti and Joe from Stratford

reviews.author: C Truong
reviews.text: All of the family members in my family genuinely recommend Bommer Plumbing & Drain Cleaning Company to everyone because Bommer Plumbing & Drain Cleaning Company is beyond excellent and outstanding. Everyone in the company was awesomely kind, professional, experienced, and knowledgeable. All the team members worked together to organize the whole process promptly, efficiently, and professionally with their experiences and expertise. Their customer service is beyond excellent. Katie, Alexa, and Christina are absolutely outstanding with their kindness, warmth, helpfulness, and professionalism. Trebor was outstanding with his fantastic skills, knowledge, experience, and expertise. Keith is outstandingly excellent with his talent in this profession. Generally, Bommer Plumbing & Drain Cleaning Company is absolutely the best. Our very profound thanks to Katie, Christina, and Alexa, our wholehearted gratitude to Trebor, our heartfelt gratefulness to the amazing crew, our sincere appreciation to Keith, and our deep appreciation to the entire excellent team of Bommer Plumbing & Drain Cleaning Company today and always in the future. Again, all of the family members in my family sincerely recommend Bommer Plumbing & Drain Cleaning Company to everyone.

reviews.author: Aspen
reviews.text: I can’t rave enough about my experience with Bommer! I believe it was Christina, who took my initial call. She was so kind and understanding. We talked through my needs and she was able to get me on the schedule. When Keith came out he was informative and pleasant. He diagnosed the issue, thoroughly explained what needed to be done and got to work. I had paperwork that I needed to have  completed and the office went above and beyond to have it back to me same day. It is evident that Bommer puts their customers first. I would recommend them 10/10. Thank you guys for helping to ease some of the stress I was having. I am immensely grateful for your excellent customer service and outstanding work.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Miller-McGrail
reviews.text: Trebor was an excellent plumber who came out and took a look at our problem. He was kind, and able to explain our options. While we did not ultimately go with Bommer to fix our problem, as the prices were substantially higher than other estimates we got, I wanted to make sure I gave Trebor credit for his excellent service.

reviews.author: Maryann Flemming
reviews.text: I called Bommer plumbing because I have used them in the past with great satisfaction. They came within an hour and had everything working again quickly. They are a great family run company and I highly recommend them

plumbers.name: Glasmeier Plumbing & Air
plumbers.address: 770 Franklin Ave, Heath, OH 43056, USA

reviews.author: Tiffany Yeager
reviews.text:
We recently had our entire basement plumbing redone (everything except the main drain), and I cannot say enough good things about Glasmeier Plumbing.

The scope of work was extensive, and they handled everything thoroughly and professionally. From the very first phone call, everyone was kind and responsive. Mary, the receptionist, made the entire process easy to understand and ensured we were scheduled for the very next day. That level of communication and efficiency meant a lot, especially given how much work needed to be done.

Gabe and Dominique handled the job, and they were outstanding. They were professional, honest, and took the time to answer all of my questions. They clearly explained the process, were transparent throughout, and did an amazing job. The quality of their work truly speaks for itself.

If this is how Glasmeier continues to operate, I will be a customer for as long as they’re in business. I would recommend them to my friends and family in a heartbeat. I’m incredibly grateful for this company — they treated me more than fairly, and I am very impressed.

Thank you, Glasmeier Plumbing!

reviews.author: Chris Latella
reviews.text: Absolutely horrible!! Nancy was fantastic but other than that, I got hustled. Plumber came out with another gentleman, very professional, they showed me a video of how the line outside my house was "misaligned", "holding water" and "old clay pipes" and didn't clear anything. Charged me $749. to tell me that in need to replace from house to main. After a second opinion I contact Glasmeier and spoke to the owner and he offered to send crew back out. I got the same fellas and I see the same videos of nonsense and kept to all needs replaced. The plumber SHOOK MY HAND and told me he would return to flag the line yard, tell me where all roots came in and the depth on Monday. Never showed up, a man doesn't shake and break his word. Thank God they didn't,  I called a real plumber and he cleaned out EVERY ROOT and didn't rip up my yard or replace anything, that weird huh??? Good to go!!! Now they did say that this will probably need to happen every year or two but the honesty means a lot!! I will be telling evry one of my buddies at the VA about this situation. The eagles club, moose lodge, elks lodge and the American legion friends about how I paid $749. and still had a back up, pay someone else about the same and I see the results. Take your business elsewhere.

reviews.author: Karen Boyd
reviews.text: My experience was great! First, to have a service call the day I called and to have the issue addressed and repaired properly the next day was exceptional. Also to have what was done explained to me was very educating. I like to know that kind of stuff. I’m thankful and grateful with both gentlemen that did the work. Thank you! I will definitely have your company’s information is my contacts for any future services.

reviews.author: Patricia Lorek
reviews.text: David and Ryan were incredible at re-imagining our bathroom design.  We had a very large shower enclosure but no tub in our new home.  We spoke to several bathroom contractors who had great difficulty with this problem.  David and Ryan worked patiently through a series of ideas until they could successfully install a beautiful large soaking tub in the shower enclosure preserving the entire original shower tiling and glasswork.  They also installed a very powerful, stable standing faucet ultimately making this tub even better than our drop in alcove tub in Colorado.  As a bonus they are fun to work with and nice people!  We absolutely recommend Glasmeier if you are looking for talent and highly skilled people for your job.

reviews.author: Jackie G
reviews.text: Glasmeier has been very responsive and helpful, especially Ryan! He took his time to fully address our issue at hand and cover some more very helpful information otherwise. Dusty was also super helpful in resolving the issue we had with our kitchen drain. We will be happy to call them again when needed. Most certainly recommend Glasmeier!

plumbers.name: 1st American Plumbing. Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 10961 S River Front Pkwy, South Jordan, UT 84095, USA

reviews.author: Adam From Salt Lake
reviews.text: Needed a gas valve replaced and a tub spout installed. Jon came next day, got them both done in about 30 minutes and they work perfectly. Highly recommend 1st American!

reviews.author: Vicki Haymond
reviews.text: Jon S came to the service appointment promptly.   He thoroughly analyzed the problem and solution.  He was courteous and covered his feet (it was a rainy day) each time he went in and out the door. I would recommend this company and this service tech professional.

reviews.author: Ellie Peterson Arnold
reviews.text: We needed a gas line capped to replace our gas range with an electric model. I paid a little more than I expected, and there was some miscommunication with the dispatcher, who basically told our technician Tyrell the opposite of what we wanted, so he was surprised when he arrived about what he would be working on. But Tyrell was great—very professional, clear, and did the job quickly and well. We appreciate the good service and wouldn’t hesitate to work with this company again!

reviews.author: Annor Benson
reviews.text: Matt came on an emergency Sunday call to replace a hot water heater several years ago and was awesome—prompt, fair and professional. I had another need on a Saturday after Christmas and Jon was here quickly and was professional and fair. I absolutely recommend them and plan on contacting them soon for non-emergency work. I appreciate a local company where the money stays local.

reviews.author: Mark Anders
reviews.text: I've used these guys for the last 3 years and I can't say enough good things about them.  Tyrell is extremely professional and good at his job and today I met Blake who is just as competent and thorough!  I believe that they are fair and honest and I've come to trust them for my sewer line issues.  I have no experience with any of their other services, but I don't know why they'd be any different.   Thank you, guys.

plumbers.name: Gainesville Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1636 Fulenwider Rd Unit D, Gainesville, GA 30507, USA

reviews.author: Kyle & Jeana
reviews.text: I called for an estimate on a water heater replacement and was given a price quickly. Dylan came out the next morning and replaced the water heater and cleaned up some sloppy piping. He was very knowledgable and had the work done in a very timely matter. Thank you and I will not hesitate to call if needed again.

reviews.author: Christina Ernst
reviews.text: As a fellow business owner, I really value working with people who are honest, reliable, and genuinely care about their customers. Gainesville Plumbing came out on very short notice to install a well pump, and they handled everything efficiently and professionally from start to finish. Their pricing was great, communication was easy, and they took the time to walk me through the issue so I truly understood what was going on. It’s such a relief to work with a company that combines skill, integrity, and a personal touch — I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone in our North Georgia community. I am in White County and was really happy with their services.

reviews.author: Mike Boritz
reviews.text: Lane and his crew are great to work with. Very professional and courteous. Dylan has been working to help repair our navien water heater and has resolved the issue. Would highly recommend Gainesville plumbing to anyone for their plumbing needs

reviews.author: Stacie Crowder
reviews.text:
(Separate dates/times of services.)

We very recently had Gainesville Plumbing complete some MAJOR repairs regarding our septic, etc. The company as a whole, its staff and services were EASY TO MANAGE/COMMUNICATE WITH, had KIND and CARING PEOPLE, and PROVIDED FANTASTIC SERVICE! Wha my husband and I also greatly appreciated was how the company did all they could (and were successful) to keep our family from loosing the “orchard” parts of our yard. I WOULD HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS COMPANY!
—————————————
We had prior work/service of theirs before (see above) and we were greatly satisfied. We just had more work/inspection done and excellence overall yet again! The techs, all staff, pricing, and their services are highly recommended!

reviews.author: Joe Martinez
reviews.text:
I am beyond grateful for Lane and his team. We had a septic issue and needed a completely new field line. After two outrageous quotes and feeling taken advantage of by a couple of name brand companies, I was referred to Lane. So glad I held out for his workmanship, honesty and attention to detail.
Why I had to do this: I had a driveway installed a couple years ago and the concrete fellas accidentally dug into my field line. Two years later it compromised the entire system. Lane regraded my front yard after installing the new line and pump and also put down Bermuda seed to give me my grass back in the spring. His efforts were very professional and he didn’t cut any corners, also taking care of the two inspections from the county which included a soil test where the old line was.
I didn’t have to be on site for anything and felt very comfortable with letting him do his thing.
I appreciate y’all for your hard work and attention to detail.

plumbers.name: Green Tech Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 165 Middlesex Ave #1057, Somerville, MA 02145, USA

reviews.author: Jillian Mucci
reviews.text: I contacted Green Tech about getting my tankless water heater serviced, and I received a call back within minutes. Dave came out the very next day. He was prompt, friendly, efficient and super respectful of my space (he wore shoe covers inside and cleaned the area he was working in thoroughly). Super happy with this service. Will definitely use again! Thanks so much, Dave!

reviews.author: Tara Mehan
reviews.text: We had a leak under our kitchen sink that turned out to be several leaks. Dave came out quickly on a Saturday and fixed it in under 30 minutes without having to replace any parts. He was professional and efficient. Would recommend to anyone local who’s in a pinch! Thanks for the help Dave!!

reviews.author: Owen Raccagni
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with green tech. I submitted the request for service form on their website and got a call less than 30 minutes later. They were able to come the next morning. Hector was very professional, explained everything clearly, and fixed my shower issues quickly and competently.

reviews.author: Rachael Demers
reviews.text: We had an emergent gas leak behind our wall that needed immediate attention. We were able to get a tech to our residence the very next morning. David was extremely professional and knowledgeable. He was able to repair our gas pipe and went so far as to try and salvage our tile wall that had to be taken down to gain access to the pipes. David was great to work with and we would definitely re-use this company in the future. We really appreciated his expertise!

reviews.author: Janette S John C
reviews.text: Highly communicative, efficient, and professional! We were able to schedule time with Green Tech to help us dis/reconnect our oven after we had to unexpectedly replace it, and Green Tech was very accomodating. They sent out their Tech, David to help us disconnect the old oven this morning and he was great! Super nice and efficient, and answered my questions fully. Too, he put in the grates for the new oven for us as an extra kind gesture. Definitely recommend working with this company if you're looking for assistance locally who also will do good work.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Killeen, TX
plumbers.address: 2201 S W S Young Dr Suite 115A, Killeen, TX 76543, USA

reviews.author: Manuel Matos
reviews.text:
We recently had our main water line into our home burst, and it was a stressful situation to say the least. Kelvin, Braeden, and their crew were absolutely outstanding from start to finish. They quickly got the yard dug up, located the issue, and not only repaired it but rerouted the plumbing to help prevent future problems.

Throughout the entire process, they were courteous, professional, and completely transparent. They took the time to clearly explain what had happened, what needed to be done, and why — which made it easy and comfortable for me to move forward with the work. There were no surprises, just honest, quality service.

It’s not often you find contractors who combine skill, integrity, and great customer service, but Kelvin and Braeden truly do. I would highly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work. Outstanding experience all around.

reviews.author: Nelson Mercado
reviews.text: Kelvin came out for a potential clog in my sewer line. Ended up clearing itself most likely but he was super professional and courteous the whole time. Highly recommend calling roto rooter if you ever need some quick service. Appreciate you kelvin!

reviews.author: Lily Fraser
reviews.text: Very prompt arrival. Very polite and introduced himself very professionally. Mr. Jake Wilson took care of my request this morning. He was very thorough and went beyond to check all the sinks in my home. His expertise and service was very much appreciated. I would not hesitate to recommend him nor his company to anyone who needs plumbing work done in their home. Thank you very much Mr. Jake and have a blessed day.

reviews.author: Victor Anda
reviews.text: Kelvin was awesome! He was extremely polite, efficient, and knew exactly what he was doing. He quickly fixed our water pressure issue, clearly explained what he had done, and was on his way. Excellent service from start to finish—highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jimmy Iron
reviews.text: Called Mr Rooter Plumbing and they s heded a window of three hours . They were able to get someone out to our house a two hours later and before the scheduled window.  Kitchen sink was clogged shut and Chad was able to run his machine twice to unplug the line . He then took the time to check the main sewer line to see if there was any other issues . Chad was fantastic at explaining what he was doing and gave us options if our pipe needs to be replaced in the future.. Great customer service and highly recommend Chad from Mr Rooter!!

plumbers.name: England’s Plumbing and Heating
plumbers.address: 27 Commerce Blvd #2, West Grove, PA 19390, USA

reviews.author: Donald Gorman
reviews.text: Recently had a tankless water heater installed by England’s plumbing and Heating. It was a very positive experience through the entire process, from the initial conversation and quote from Charles to the installation/cleanup.  Charles also let us know about rebates from PECO and a possible federal tax credit we might have otherwise known about which will result in significant additional savings for us.  Would highly recommend England Plumbing and Heating to others.

reviews.author: Rich M
reviews.text: I've been using England's Plumbing and Heating for years and have always been pleased at the service.  They've done a number of different jobs at my house and each time, Charles has been great to work with and as has his team.  The difference between them and the large plumbing service companies couldn't be bigger.

reviews.author: Will Trout
reviews.text:
We had a toilet leaking into the sub-floor below it. I pulled the toilet off and found the flange was not in great shape and decided I wasn't sure about fixing it. England's picked up the phone on the first call and said they could have someone over within the hour (unlike the other places I tried). It turned out to be a simpler fix than I had feared and they were done very quickly. I feel like it was more expensive than it maybe should have been but they were upfront about the costs and I think they did a good job so I can't fault them for that. It was ~$500 to (I believe) put in some kind of stabilizing bracket, new wax ring, reseat the toilet and check for leaks. Work comes with a 2 year warranty. You know what they say, pick two: speed, quality, price.

In short: fast, quality work but possibly on the expensive side.

reviews.author: Barry Lewis
reviews.text: Well I contacted them to come to the house to replace a cartridge in a shower faucet that I did not have time to do. Two young men showed up. Attempted to open the ring to access the cartridge failed to do so. Told me it was going to be about $1,200 to replace the faucet $1,200 to $1,500. They charged me $125 just to come out. The moment they left I placed some penetrating oil on the ring and removed it by hand. I went to Lowe's, bought a $63 cartridge and replaced it. I called them back to tell them I removed the ring by hand and asked them how much it would be to simply put a cartridge in and they informed me that they had no interest in doing that because the faucet was older and they were concerned that if they replaced the cartridge they would have to cut through the wall and they didn't do drywall repairs and they didn't want to be responsible if something went wrong with the cartridge. So they charged me $125 to come out. We're incapable of opening the faucet ring and then did not want to provide me with the cartridge and replace it after I told him I was capable of removing the ring. I did the repair for $63 myself and I will not contact them again for any plumbing services in the future. I would recommend that if you call this service you make it the second service to come to your home. I would have someone else come out first and look at the problem or just avoid them all together. That's my personal recommendation for my own personal experience.

reviews.author: Robert Rebar
reviews.text: The solenoid valve is leaking in our Noritz tankless water heater. The services guys ordered and will replaced the valve.great work the new valve was installed. No leaks. They also replaced the adjacent gaskets This is extra work that you would want to see and increased the odds against any additional leaks occurring. Thanks guys good work.

plumbers.name: 317 Plumber
plumbers.address: 12502 Promise Creek Ln Ste 418, Fishers, IN 46038, USA

reviews.author: Sam Meko
reviews.text: Danny and Trayvon made the initial visit to determine our needs and provide a quote. Trayvon was very good about explaining everything and answering our questions along the way. We had two water heaters replaced and some cold lines rerouted to a water softener in a home we just moved into.Trayvon was incredibly personable and respectful. The work was completed timely and the space was left better than when the work began. Danny called afterwards to ensure we were satisfied with our service. Would highly recommend 317 Plumber.

reviews.author: Jill Chisholm
reviews.text: 317 Plumber exceeded my expectations. They quickly and efficiently replaced a broken pipe in our yard. Both their plumbers and office staff were exceptionally friendly, professional, and informative. I appreciated that they clearly explained my best options without any pressure. Communication throughout the process was outstanding from both the office and service teams. I highly recommend their services to anyone in need of a trustworthy and skilled plumber.

reviews.author: Nateisha Gilbert
reviews.text: 317 Plumber is great! They took care of me same day and cheaper than any other companies I received quotes from. My brand-new water heater is fabulous. I will forever call upon them. Thank you 317 Plumber

reviews.author: James Porter
reviews.text:
Working alongside 317 Plumber is always a smooth experience. Owner/operator Danny Gerold is hands-on, quick to respond, and truly committed to taking care of his customers and trade partners alike.

The PorterHouse Contracting team is always happy when we have joint projects together because we know the communication, professionalism, and quality of work will be top-notch. We truly appreciate the working relationship and would highly recommend 317 Plumber to anyone looking for dependable plumbing services.

reviews.author: Terri Szewczyk
reviews.text: 317 Plumber was contracted for our neighborhood’s efforts to move from septic to sanitary sewer, and we could not have been happier with Danny’s oversight of the project.  Danny was frequently onsite, taking the time to explain each step of the process and ensuring everything ran smoothly.  Although the original plan required dismantling our deck, Danny came up with a workaround for us to reroute our plumbing inside and save us quite a bit of headache and expense.  He and his team were incredibly professional and cordial, just overall good people.  Will certainly be using 317 Plumber again when plumbing needs arise!

plumbers.name: Wasden Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 3810 Industrial St #400, Rowlett, TX 75088, USA

reviews.author: Shug Jones
reviews.text: These guys are great!  They have done several jobs for me including plumbing a remodeled primary bath.  This time they ran a gas line to the kitchen in my new home and fixed a leak that was coming from the tub upstairs to my laundry room downstairs. They also installed my gas range.  Brendan, Matt, and all the others do excellent work and are a pleasure to work with.

reviews.author: LR Creative
reviews.text: Great group of guys that came out and did the repair. Aaron and his helper work as a great team. Matt made sure our estimate was right and that we got the service we needed. Local support local.

reviews.author: LINDA STORY
reviews.text: We have had great experiences with Wasden Plumbing every time we have called them. From the moment we called, their customer service was friendly and professional. Our most recent experience was definitely above and beyond our expectations for quick service. Matt made time in his schedule to go check out the situation that day and explain the issue to us. He sent a plumber out the next morning and the repair was completed efficiently. Prices have always been fair and transparent — no surprises. Their promptness, integrity, and honesty are truly an asset to their company. We will be using them again for any future plumbing needs and highly recommend them to anyone looking for honest, quality service.

reviews.author: Victoria Walden
reviews.text: Excellent company! Professionalism and customer service is top-notch. After being told by Atmos energy that I had a gas leak and them shutting my gas off I had called another company originally, and after that company came out I was very uncomfortable with them and the plumber they had sent out. I felt like it was just a money grab. So I called this company on a late Saturday afternoon and they still answered the phone and answered all of my questions patiently and without rushing me. My gas was already turned off, so there was nothing they could do until Monday as far as getting it fixed and back on. They showed up on time and after testing the line told me that in fact, I did not have a leak. Atmos came back out and turned the gas back on. And Wasden then drove back over and double checked everything just to ease my mind. They were honest and extremely  understanding of my concerns. Would definitely recommend them to anyone that asked for a plumber recommendation

reviews.author: Amber Johnson
reviews.text: Matt and his crew made it out to my house same day, (earlier than expected - which I appreciated) and replaced my busted pipe in 5 minutes! I thought there was going to have to be some demo involved to reach the leak, but nope! They got in there and fixed it like it was nothing, demo free!! Great service!

plumbers.name: AndPro Plumbing
plumbers.address: 505 E 2nd St, Claremore, OK 74017, USA

reviews.author: Montie Ledford
reviews.text: This company is amazing! We had a plumbing emergency during this cold weather and And-Pro was onsite within an hour.  Joshua was fast and efficient and got the job done! There are 24 horses 🐎 that are thankful they have fresh water tonight.

reviews.author: Dean Berry
reviews.text:
We had a non-emergency, but definitely inconvenient drainage backup in our kitchen in Owasso, OK.
Contacted AndPro, and they arrived the next day. Stephen Hutton contacted us when he was on his way and did a great job of communicating throughout the visit.
He was clean and thorough, making sure to verify the success of the repair and explaining to us what caused the issue.
We highly recommend AndPro Plumbing.
Thank you Andrew and Stephen!

reviews.author: Angela Hughes
reviews.text: From start to finish, I am super impressed with AndPro! I can definitely tell why they have been voted Best in Claremore for 3 years in row. I’m a new customer and called yesterday for a couple repairs. They were here today, evaluated, and completed the work very quickly. AndPro has been in constant communication, including a picture of the tech in text message when he was on his way. Our tech was super friendly and very knowledgeable. We will be returning for all our plumbing needs. THANK YOU!!!

reviews.author: Jay Lederman
reviews.text:
We had a long list of plumbing repairs that needed attention, including installing two owner-provided faucets, repairing a Delta Roman tub faucet and adding shutoff valves, replacing a toilet wax ring and tank repair kit, replacing hot-water shutoff valves under multiple sinks, and repairing several exterior spigots.

Our technician, Stephen H., was courteous, professional, and did excellent work. What I appreciated most was that he wasn’t focused on upselling—just on getting the job done correctly. He did offer a few relevant recommendations for additional repairs that made sense for this visit, but he never overinflated the urgency or pushed unnecessary work. He kept it honest and straightforward.

I would highly recommend AndPro Plumbing and Drain, and we will definitely be using them again for the next phase of work.

reviews.author: Tracey Payne
reviews.text: I called this morning because my water lines were starting to not want to drain properly. They came out within just a few hours. The sent me a text message with an approximate time, then another message when they were headed my way. The servicemen were very professional, friendly and clean. They were knowledgeable and helpful. They had my issues resolved quickly and didn’t leave a mess for me to clean up. I would use them again and recommend them to anyone looking for a plumbing company.

plumbers.name: My Plumber Plus: Heating, Cooling & Electrical
plumbers.address: 1320 Central Park Blvd Ste 200, Fredericksburg, VA 22401, USA

reviews.author: Diane Myers
reviews.text: We bought a fabulous HVAC system and have been more than pleased. Servicemen always polite and good work. We regret the maintenance plan.  Had HVAC inspection in DEc.We agreed to the suggested duct cleaning. $800 plus. While thats being done, the guy comes out with a suggested UV light for the system. Another $1500, to which we declined. then another suggestion of  special filters. Beware of the non stop attempts to upsell.

reviews.author: Kawai Cheung
reviews.text:
I called My Plumber Plus to fix a slow leak in my toilet. I was charged a $49 service fee just for the plumber to come out and provide a quote. Once here, the technician quoted me $1,100 to replace the fill valve, flush valve, flapper, and the floor shut-off valve.

This is absolutely predatory pricing. Those parts cost less than $70 total at any hardware store, and the labor is a 1-to-2-hour job. For $1,100, I could have purchased three brand-new, high-end toilets. It felt like they used the $49 fee to get their foot in the door, then tried to take advantage of the situation with a ridiculous estimate. I declined the service and would warn anyone else to avoid this company and save your $49. They are not looking to provide a fair repair; they are looking for a massive payday.

reviews.author: Tim Maher
reviews.text: Had our plumbing maintenance check on our house, Jason Flynn did a fantastic job! We needed a new electrical rod to be put in our water heater, that was a priority, and was taken care of. Other things (a water softener system) were recommended, but Jason didn’t push us, it was noted for a future visit. Very professional, competent work. Highly recommend Jason Flynn and My Plumber Plus for your plumbing needs. Not closed on weekends, available 7 days a week, we like that! Thank you Jason Flynn & My Plumber Plus!!

reviews.author: Lon Sutton
reviews.text: From the beginning these guys were amazing. Tim the sales guy and the workers Zach and Austin were amazing. Everyone answered questions and made sure the job was done correctly. They cleaned up very well and went above and beyond for me. I highly recommend using Prime. I hope I don’t need them again but will definitely use them again if I need plumbing

reviews.author: Alexandra Heflin
reviews.text: Any and everything Plumbing came out and fixed my leaking kitchen faucet and two toilets that continuously ran. Anytime I use any and everything Plumbing they handle my issue in a timely and professional manner. Highly recommend :)

plumbers.name: Amy Home Services
plumbers.address: 39 N Western Ave, Carpentersville, IL 60110, USA

reviews.author: René Zamora
reviews.text: I have been using AMY Home Services for 18 years !!  I currently have (3) products a water heater,  air conditioner and furnace.  Good products reasonably priced and great service.  The air conditioner and furnace come with 10 year warranties.  I’m signed up with a service agreement that covers annual inspections to keep these products under warranty.  The crew always offers great tips on what home owners can do to minimize service calls.  I’m a happy customer.

reviews.author: stephanie papaioannou
reviews.text: We have been clients with Amy Home Services for more than 10 years and have used them for electrical, HVAC plumbing. Don't think there is anything in our house they have not touched!!! Techs always reliable and get the job done. Would not consider ising anyone else! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Jacob Reisbich
reviews.text: Had the last thing you want during a cold wave with our boiler giving us no heat to the entire house and Justin was able to come out quickly and troubleshoot the issue. Ended up being a rather simple fix in form of a malfunctioning damper, but Justin was also able to temporarily provide heat to house while we waited for the part to arrive. When it did get here the replacement was about as quick as you could ask for and at a very reasonable price. Ended up having a circulating pump that was also on the way out and got that fixed as well. Given the age of my home and it being worked on by a good handful of contractors throughout the years Justin handled everything very professionally. My favorite part is he not only fixed our issues, but was thorough in explaining how he also detected the issues so these things can be better avoided in the future. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kevin Sanchez
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Amy Home Services and Jake installing my new water softener. He showed up on time, was extremely professional, and clearly knew exactly what he was doing. He took the time to explain the system and walked me through everything I needed to know.

The installation was done quickly and cleanly, with great attention to detail. Jake even cleaned up the workspace afterward, which I really appreciated. Since the install, everything has been working perfectly—I can already notice the improvement in my water!

Highly recommend Jake for anyone needing any plumbing services. He made the whole process stress-free and seamless. Great service all around!

reviews.author: Dave Snyder
reviews.text: This is not as easy as it may sound. Trevor and Jason removed the entire furnace system and replaced it in a day. Not only the outside condenser unit but the inside furnace and blower system. Trevor had noted that the size of the trunk was smaller than recommended and completely modified the system to enable a greater airflow. There were many changes to the system requirements based on updated HVAC code, which Trevor explained. In general, the overall reworking of the system was done smoothly and with hardly any change to our home system, except of course, the whole furnace and outdoor unit. Amy has done many upgrades to our home and my Wife and I are very pleased with the work that was done in the past as well as this particular upgrade.

plumbers.name: Ken's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2506 Poinsett Hwy, Greenville, SC 29609, USA

reviews.author: Valorie Ruck
reviews.text: Keith is a very knowledgeable and friendly plumber who installed my hot water dispenser easily. He was even a little early for my appointment!  He took time to educate me on some other plumbing issues I may need to take care of in the future. I would definitely recommend Ken’s Plumbing.

reviews.author: Mikalah Smith
reviews.text: Awesome, prompt service from Ken's Plumbing. They were able to get to us very quickly when our septic pump started giving us problems. Clearly very honest, hard working people. We had Bill come out and he was great! I will recommend them to anyone I know who has plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Lynn Smith
reviews.text: We have used Ken's Plumbing for a couple of things now, and have been well pleased.  We had sewer issues several years ago and they were very fast and helpful.  We have now called them back for a gas line to the generator before bad weather hits. They came out and estimated and were back for the work in a couple of days, well before the predicted storm. Also referred us to an electrician, Andrew Grant with Kingdom Electrical who was also awesome.  Thanks very much to Keith, Jonathon,  Gina and Betty for all the assistance.  Awesome team!

reviews.author: Al Carden
reviews.text: Let me tell you, there is still a competent plumbing company in the Greenville area that you can trust.  I have used Ken’s Plumbing many times over the years and they never disappoint.  The latest was a drain under my kitchen sink that needed some rework.  Billy showed up and fixed it perfectly quick time in a hurry.  These guys are the best!

reviews.author: Fred Smid
reviews.text:
We had a water leak from our sink drain pipes and a severe rust problem with our disposal.
We contacted Ken’s Plumbing which we had used a few years ago and they were able to send James out within 45 minutes. Over the course of about 2-3 hours he fixed the (replaced the drain piping and installed a new disposal. We then remembered we had been meaning to see about a replacement for our old kitchen faucet which was definitely on its last legs. He gave us a quote on a new one and the price and quality were fine so we had him install that as well. We feel we will be worry free from now on. James was professional, courteous and VERY helpful. First class service at a fair price. Jean who answered the phone and helped us get help immediately couldn’t have done it e a better job either.

plumbers.name: Beetles Plumbing Solutions
plumbers.address: 9841 York Alpha Dr ste a, North Royalton, OH 44133, USA

reviews.author: Erin W (Erin)
reviews.text:
We couldn’t be happier with the service we received from Beetles. I had watched some of their social media videos while researching our sewer issues and saw that they were a local, family-owned business. Larry came out for an estimate, and just a few days later we had a plumbing emergency — he and his whole team jumped in and helped us immediately, even in sub-zero windchills.

Every member of the crew was professional, friendly, and knowledgeable individually - I have found this is a big rarity with other companies whose owners giving the initial estimate often are the only ones with expertise. That was not true here. They were honestly the cleanest/most respectful contractors I have ever had - even while breaking up concrete in our small basement — a job that could have easily created a huge mess.

Throughout the entire process, what also stood out was their communication… I so appreciated the ability to TEXT with them instead of having to call to ask questions about the estimate. Kelly was so proactive and communicative - they let us know exactly when they were on their way so we could plan.

I would (and will!) recommend them to anyone with minor or large plumbing issues. Even their service fee to come out is much more reasonable than other companies. Larry and his son (also Larry), Luke, and the rest of the team were all very patient with our questions prior to beginning work. It’s rare to find a company like that these days. Thank you Beetles!

reviews.author: Premier Resources
reviews.text:
We’ve worked with Beetles Plumbing Solutions on multiple projects and have had consistently positive experiences with their team.

They show up when scheduled, communicate clearly, and complete their work professionally and without unnecessary issues. In construction, reliability and accountability matter, and Beetles Plumbing Solutions has proven to be a dependable plumbing partner on our projects.

Their work is clean, organized, and completed the right way.

Premier Resources Contracting works with many subcontractors across multiple states, and we value trade partners who take their work seriously. Beetles Plumbing Solutions has demonstrated that professionalism, and we look forward to continuing to work with them.

reviews.author: Jennifer Majkrzak
reviews.text:
This is my second interaction with Beetle’s plumbing and they have been nothing less than exceptional each time. They are so professional, honest, and caring about your situation. They came same day when I needed them. They gave me several options of what I could do with no pressure on any of them. They did the job quickly, Professionally, and cleaned up after themselves. Luke was so nice with my son. He even gave him a coloring sheet and crayons.
Such an excellent company and excellent humans. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Bob Ruggeri
reviews.text: We just met with Luke with Beetles plumbing due to our toilets flushing slowly. They gave us a handful of options to choose from and were very patient with us.  We decided to replace 3 toilets and they were able to install them all same day.  In total it was about 3-4 hours and they were gone.  The staff was very friendly and helpful and we have peace of mind knowing our toilets are good for many years to come! Will do business again!

reviews.author: Contessa Michel
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I cannot say enough good things about Beetles Plumbing Solutions. I woke up on New Year’s Day to sewage backing up in my basement and was completely panicked—not to mention overwhelmed by the smell. I called and left a voicemail, and they responded right away by text, which immediately put me at ease.

They were able to schedule a technician for early the very next morning, which was such a relief. Ricky was absolutely wonderful—professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely kind. He took the time to explain everything and made a very stressful situation feel manageable.

This company truly cares about their customers and goes above and beyond when it matters most. I am incredibly grateful for their quick response and excellent service and would highly recommend Beetles Plumbing Solutions to anyone in need of a reliable, caring plumbing company.

plumbers.name: Jim Dandy Sewer and Plumbing
plumbers.address: 6202 214th St SW, Mountlake Terrace, WA 98043, USA

reviews.author: Andrew Galbreath
reviews.text: We had a major leak due to sub-par plumbing work done by another company. Jim Dandy’s team came in and assessed, diagnosed and resolved the issue quickly and competently. Very professional, kind and communicative. Would HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

reviews.author: Rhetta Fisk
reviews.text: Thorough checking and found the problem(s) with leaking toilet and small part for dishwasher in kitchen. Replacement for three pumps et al were available. Could have done it today but I needed to coordinate one of the repairs with MIL tenant.

reviews.author: Anuj Surana
reviews.text: Came in promptly and available on Sunday when we had a water leak in our home. Plumber was extremely knowledgeable and courteous and was able to quickly figure out problem and refer us to a water damage restoration company. He himself made the calls and asked them to come take a look. Overall a wonderful experience and definitely will hire them again for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Brian Lippert
reviews.text: We had a mainline blockage that needed repairs and Jim Dandy was a life saver. Shane came out on Saturday and was knowledgeable and shared every step of the process with us. When it turned out to be more than originally quoted for reasons of our older home, they shared options and solutions. Manuel came out the next day and after making the necessary repairs we shared thatbwe had shopped there pricing and that they were competitive with other local companies. They were appreciative, professional, and respectful. Great company and great employees, Manuel and Shane were great!

reviews.author: K Walden
reviews.text:
Needing a plumber is such a dreadful feeling but the service we received was a big relief! Alexander arrived promptly and explained his course of action after I showed him the gross results of our sewer backup. His work was thorough, he was honest and transparent with costs and he got it all done quickly. I really appreciated that he cleaned the entire area and is just a super nice guy! The whole process ended up being a positive experience. Totally recommend JDS&P and Alexander.

***** Another 5 stars! Adding to my review - after the above service I asked for a water heater check and was able to get my old one replaced with a much more efficient modern water heater same day. I was very happy with Manny’s advice, detailed explanations, and his work. He gave me a great price for a quality product and exceptional work. Glad to have used Jim Dandy again!

plumbers.name: Mr. Drippy Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3411 Lorna Ln, Hoover, AL 35216, USA

reviews.author: Hunter Russell
reviews.text:
🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩

I cannot say enough great things about Mr. Drippy Plumbing off Lorna Road in Hoover, Alabama! From start to finish, the experience was absolutely top-notch.

I was scheduled for a service window between 8:30–10:00 AM this past Friday, and right at 8:00 AM I received a confirmation call from Laura, which I really appreciated. Even better, Pierce arrived promptly, just after 8:30AM and appeared extremely professional and ready to get to work.

Pierce was extremely respectful, knowledgeable, and easy to talk to. I showed him the issues I was having with a toilet and two sinks, and he carefully explained what was going on in a way that made complete sense. He stepped back out to his van to coordinate with Laura on pricing, and within minutes had clear, straightforward options with numbers for me on how we could approach the problems. The pricing was very reasonable, and they even offered bundling discounts, which made it an incredible value! (Especially for the level of professionalism and quality service they provide.)

It is rare to find a company where you genuinely feel comfortable having someone in your home, but that’s exactly how I felt with Pierce. From the moment you meet him, you know you can trust him — supervised or unsupervised — to do the job correctly and with integrity. Going forward, I will absolutely be requesting Pierce Winkler as our on-site plumber every time.

If you need plumbing inspection, repair, installation, or replacement at a fair price and want a team that truly values professionalism and customer service, I highly recommend Mr. Drippy Plumbing. Pierce and Laura were outstanding!

reviews.author: Tyler Jones
reviews.text: My family lives in a 100+ year old house. We know that repairs come with the territory. And we've dealt with countless contractors and repair shops over the years, but nothing compares to the service shown by Mr. Drippy Plumbing and, specifically, by Greg H. His attention to the details and willingness to be a problem-solver went above and beyond. I'll continue to pass along the good word for this team.

reviews.author: Austin Andrews
reviews.text:
12/2024: 10 out of 10. Jonathan came to help with another clogged drain line. In the same time it took to clear a clog last time, he was able to clear the clog, show me a video of the drain line, and replace my sump pump. He’s by far the best technician I’ve had for any kind of work at my house! If you need a plumber, Jonathan is the one to ask for.
Jessica - who quoted my work - was clear over the phone and was able to provide a very competitive rate for the work.
I’ll be sticking with Mr Drippy in the future.

1/2024: They sent Jay Jay out to fix a full clog in our bathroom drain line that and he was great! Took a bit of time, but Jay Jay got everything cleared out and was incredibly friendly and professional.

The first thing they tried didn’t work, but the second did - and I was only charged for what fixed it. I’d be happy to call Mr. Drippy or Jay Jay again in the future.

reviews.author: Miesha B
reviews.text: Called for an estimate for a whole filtration system & they were able to give me a great price, plus David & Dalton were AMAZING! 10 out of 10 service!

reviews.author: Alden Moreton
reviews.text: David did a wonderful job for us. We just bought a new house and needed to replace old, leaking cast iron. It was a full day’s work, but we are very happy with the result.

plumbers.name: Veteran Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 3560 National Dr, Norman, OK 73069, USA

reviews.author: Mikki Carrion
reviews.text: We called Veteran Plumbing to come help find a leak that we had in the front yard. David came out to confirm the leak and the next day they came out, found it and had it fixed! Super helpful, fast, nice person to deal with. Will use again any time we have a plumbing issue. Will also recommend to anyone we can!

reviews.author: Lydia Ledbetter
reviews.text:
We just had Veterans Plumbing come out to fix an outside faucet that wouldn't stop leaking. The problem was fixed quickly with a very reasonable service call cost.  The communication line with the office was exceptional !!!
We WILL use them again and recommend them to anyone needing a plumber.

reviews.author: Sergio Carrion
reviews.text: David did an amazing job. There had been 2 other plumbers come out to find the leak and David was the only one to find it. From the initial phone call to job completion was super fast. 10/10 would recommend Veteran Plumbing. Next time I need a plumber, Veteran will be my only call!! Thank you David for an outstanding experience!!

reviews.author: Ryan McIlnay
reviews.text: Tyler has been out to my property twice, 1 year apart, and has provided above and beyond service each time. Always willing to answer questions and gets the job done quick, friendly and professionally. Would give Vetran Plumbing 6 stars if I could. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Kayla Dishon
reviews.text: David was amazing! He came out and capped my gas line to my fireplace before this winter storm and fixed a toilet issues we had for a while! Fast and great service!

plumbers.name: King Rooter & Plumbing | Plumbers Denver, CO | Drain Cleaning | Sewer & Water Line | Tankless Water Heater Repair
plumbers.address: 100 Fillmore St #500, Denver, CO 80206, USA

reviews.author: Patrick Hansen
reviews.text:
I made a service call on a Sunday evening and they were able to schedule a visit the very next morning.

They were very friendly & helpful service over the phone and with discussing info about my plumbing problem and with the scheduling.

I was dealing with an internal basement sewer main clean-out issue with an older cast iron pipe.

Dan, the technician arrived at the expected time in the morning, was friendly, knowledgeable and very informative.

He listened to my issues and what I have been dealing with. He accessed the problem and provided 3 potential options with very reasonable pricing.

We discussed the options and chose the best route for my needs, and proceeded w the repair. He had to depart momentarily to retrieve some materials, but came back quickly to start the project.

Dan handled the repair within a couple hours after returning & starting. When he was done, he notified me and I went down to review the work, it was a solid clean repair which aligned to what we discussed & agreed upon. He also did a great job cleaning up the area - couldn’t even tell he was there or a repair was recently made.

I am very satisfied with Dan and this company.

Overall, they were very helpful, friendly, timely, reliable, knowledgeable, and offered reasonable pricing.

I will definitely work with them again for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Jack Sims
reviews.text:
King Rooter teamed up with Anytime Plumbing from Santa Fe, New Mexico to do a re-line project at Kendall HOA, Purgatory Ski Resort, Durango, Colorado. It was an extensive project that  required re-lining the entire plumbing system in a 5 story building. It was over $2,000,000.00 in work that had to be completed in 4 months. Considering multiple hidden conditions, King Rooter and Anytime Plumbing did an excellent job.
Jack Sims
President Kendall HOA

reviews.author: Scott Forsythe
reviews.text: Professional, prepared, no quit until it’s done right. Courteous to our needs. Would recommend.  Repaired sewer line and Installed liner.

reviews.author: Erin Wills
reviews.text: King Rooter & Plumbing was amazing. I had an issue with a backed up French drain, causing standing water and water in my basement. Al came out to inspect the issue. He gave me 3 options for solutions, talked through each one, and made me feel confident in his expertise. Before booking, I called for clarification. Whoever I spoke with reassured me, answered my questions, and was very kind. The repair process was painless. I am very pleased!

reviews.author: Samuel Montano
reviews.text: DONT GIVE THEM YOUR BUSINESS. MAKE SURE THEY SHOW YOU HARD COPIES OF THE ESTIMATE BEFORE YOU AGREE TO ANYTHING.  For my mom’s residence. Water was coming up from the floor sewer. They came and talked my mom into 1500 dolors worth of work. My mom thought she was getting the pipe fixed so it wouldn’t leak anymore. They were called to fix a leak. Turns out they were there to snake the drain and replace pipe above ground that is not leaking. Therefore leaving the leak in the ground unattended. Then after saying that she needs to pay more for a coating. When she was under the impression that the leak repair was included in the estimate. They left and never gave my mom an estimate on what it would cost to fix the leak it’s been a week. This company is BS. STAY AWAY.

plumbers.name: Affordable Plumber CO LLC
plumbers.address: 1159 Preble Ct, Castle Rock, CO 80104, USA

reviews.author: Candi Stead
reviews.text: Pat at Affordable Plumber, LLC is fantastic! We were looking for a whole‑house water filtration system because of all the chlorine in our water. Pat came out the same day I contacted him, gave us a clear quote, and had everything installed in less than a week. I had a ton of questions about softening our water without using salt or spending a fortune, and he took the time to look into options and find the perfect solution for us. His professionalism, honesty, and follow‑through are unheard of these days. We’ll absolutely call him again for any plumbing needs—we’re actually trying to think of more projects we can hire him for! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Megan Stermer
reviews.text: I highly recommend Affordable Plumber. At first, I had larger plumbing companies come in and assess my plumbing system. I felt as if their only motives were sales, meeting quotas/budgets, etc. Then I found Affordable Plumber online, read the reviews and immediately called Pat. He was so informative, quick to respond and quick to help! He just recently replaced my water heater and fixed my master bath leaky shower head. His prices were reasonable, he’s efficient, professional and will go the extra mile for you! Support local and call Pat!

reviews.author: Tim Greenfield
reviews.text: Nothing but high praise for Pat - his quality of work, attention to detail and most importantly his POV of always doing right by the customer.  Full recommendation for Affordable Plumber CO LLC.  Background: woke up to my garbage disposable leaking every time I ran water. Researching plumbers and called Pat.  He had me text a few photos of what was going on, immediately diagnosed the issue, quoted a flat rate (which included the cost of the new disposal). Told me he could fit me in same day.  Throughout the day, Pat kept me updated on his expected time of arrival. Once he arrived, immediately saw that some of the plumbing setup was poor, fixed that as part of his bid, outlined another best practice idea, quoted me the cost and let me decide if I also wanted to include the work. He completed the job with great attention to detail, explained everything to me and left the sink area cleaner than it was when he arrived.  100% recommend Pat and Affordable Plumber CO LLC.  Top quality work, top quality person…

reviews.author: Connor McKenna
reviews.text:
Pat and his team installed an RO filter under my sink and fixed some diy plumbing from the previous owners. They were easy to work with and did a great job. They didn’t try to upsell me and I feel comfortable calling Pat if I have any questions or something goes wrong. For someone who isn’t a diy guy, and doesn’t know that much about plumbing, they were a great choice and I’ll call them if I need additional plumbing work.

Additionally they were respectful and I felt comfortable with them in my house.

reviews.author: Angie Green
reviews.text: We are so happy we called Patrick from Affordable Plumber! He arrived within a day of calling and was in and out in such a short time!! His knowledge and expertise is like a breath of fresh air. Thank you Patrick, you are now our go-to plumber, we appreciate your professionalism and affordable prices!!

plumbers.name: H2O PROS Plumbing
plumbers.address: Seaboard St, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577, USA

reviews.author: Patti Ramsey
reviews.text: Excellent experience with H2O PROS Plumming! They returned my call right away and had my toilets installed within three days. The team was professional, efficient, and cleaned everything up before leaving. The installation was done quickly and correctly, and the price was very reasonable. I highly recommend them and will definitely use them again for future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Stuart Thompson
reviews.text: Spoke with Keith to set up appointment for 1:30 the next day. David showed up right at 1:30 and was able to quickly fix a leak that we had coming from our upstairs bathroom. The price was more than reasonable and David was awesome! I will be using them anytime I have a plumbing issue!

reviews.author: Joseph Livolsi
reviews.text: No hot water issue. H2O PROS plumbing responded quickly when called. Dave arrived and upon finding out the I was remodeling the guest bathroom, asked if he could check it out. He immediately noticed the cartridge was not installed when the shower valve was roughed in ( by different plumbing company). Once he installed the cartridge, problem solved. Dave proved to be quite knowledgeable, courteous and friendly. Call it a quick fix or the fact he had installed our hot water heater this past year, he did not charge me a dime. Needless to say they are responsible and professional, I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Connie Sieczkowski
reviews.text: Had my Rannai Hot Water Tank, ironizer rerouted inside the tank and insulated completely .  It was put on the outside by another company that did not know what they were doing. The serviceman David and assistant completed the job professionally and everything works perfect. They were on time, professional and explained what they needed to do to correct the situation. They do great work and H2O Pros is an excellent company to deal with.  Thank You!

reviews.author: Andrew Gardo
reviews.text: On time, professional, and solved all my issues. I asked if Keith could look at low pressure in a shower after he installed a new hot water heater which I hadn't scheduled and he fixed that to. Above and beyond great service. Highly recommend 👌

plumbers.name: Tom's Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 130 Tefft Ave, Elgin, IL 60120, USA

reviews.author: Rudy Galfi
reviews.text: Tom’s Plumbing did an absolutely amazing job relocating my water heater, adding a hot water recirculating pipe and motor, and installing a Moen Flo water protection system. The quality of workmanship was excellent—efficient, clean, and clearly skilled. Best of all, the estimate was very reasonable for the scope of work performed. Highly recommend Tom’s Plumbing for anyone looking for quality and reliability!

reviews.author: Diana
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Tom’s Plumbing. Bob kept a clean, organized workspace throughout the entire job. During the inspection, Bob was patient and took the time to thoroughly explain each concern I had, making sure I fully understood the work that needed to be done. I’m very pleased with the quality of service and the work completed at my home, and I would not hesitate to recommend him.

reviews.author: Joe Bayer
reviews.text: Bob from Tom’s plumbing helped replace galvanized pipe coming from my main that was starting rust and drip. Bob went above and beyond on the job, was quick, and was very respectful. The estimate from Tom’s plumbing was by far the best out of the 5 plumbers I asked estimates for. I will definitely contact them again in the future when I need something done.

reviews.author: Patricia Davis
reviews.text:
I have used Tom's Plumbing for three different jobs. I live in an older townhome and thigs are starting to wear out.
They are professional, dependable, qualified and each job has been done
within a good time frame, attention to detail including to my home. I am more than pleased with their work, pricing and dependability. This time they replaced the Ejector Pump and the Hot Water Heater.
I can confidentially give this great review because several years I had work done by another company and it was a terrible experience.
Tom's is the BEST!!!!

reviews.author: Joseph Bajek
reviews.text: Tom's Plumbing sent out a professional to install my toilet within a few days. Bob was very professional and did a great job. Total time was about 2 hours. Would recommend service.

plumbers.name: Mike's Plumbing And Heating Services Inc.
plumbers.address: 7110 Golden Ring Rd #111, Essex, MD 21221, USA

reviews.author: Abdallah Naanaa
reviews.text: The team at Mike's Plumbing was awesome! They were extremely responsive and called me to let me know when the plumber was coming. Once onsite, Kevin was fantastic! He was reasonable, pleasant, and went through all of my options with me while being realistic about the work that needed to be done. Kevin cleaned up after all of the work he did, finished in a reasonable amount of time, and even placed placards on different water lines to help me identify them better. This was an awesome experience and I'd use them again!

reviews.author: Michael Kagarise
reviews.text: We called Mike's Plumbing and they had Jake come out for our leaking shower faucet. Jake did a wonderful job. He was very professional. Before coming in, he laid down a mat outside my door to my house and made sure to wipe his shoes off.  Jake let me know what the price was up front and in writing before beginning work. When working, I saw he had his tools on a mat to make sure not to mark up my tile floor. Afterward, he made sure everything was cleaned up when finished and then talked to me about what he had done. Jake made sure I tested the faucet and made sure I was happy with the work before leaving. I can't praise him (and Mike's Plumbing) enough for the professionalism he had and quality of work he did. I would definitely recommend Mike's Plumbing.

reviews.author: Marcello DiFrancesco
reviews.text: Jake was fantastic. Honestly can't speak highly enough. We had an issue with our water heater, found Mike's Plumbing on a google search and Jake was at our house within an hour and a half from the call. He came in the door was incredibly respectful, played with our dog for a bit, and checked out the water heater. Turns out the water heater didn't have an issue, but rather just a simple caulk job was needed around a faucet. He could have easily sold me a pricey job I didn't need but was an honest good guy and most importantly was just a pleasant person to work with. Will absolutely be using Mike's Plumbing in the future.

reviews.author: Jamie Gayton
reviews.text: Mikes Plumbing has been great in my experience.  I’ve had them come and do 3 different jobs and they always were prompt and quick.  I’m happy w the price for the service i got.

reviews.author: Margaret Sherman
reviews.text: We were extremely happy with the prompt and outstanding service provided by Mike's Plumbing & Heating to replace our residential hot water heater. The job was completed in a timely manner and at a reasonable cost. The technician (Mike M) was very friendly & respectful and provided clear & detailed explanations. He took the time to answer all of our questions and was very neat & clean.  His workmanship was exceptional!  We will not hesitate to use Mike's Plumbing & Heating again and highly recommend them to others.

plumbers.name: Culbert Plumbing Inc.
plumbers.address: 3055 McMillan Ave Suite A, San Luis Obispo, CA 93401, USA

reviews.author: anbarasu chandran
reviews.text: John was courteous and did an excellent job replacing our water filtration system, which had developed a leak. The original system was also installed by their team, and it turned out to have a fault. Overall, the team did a great job and was very reliable. Scheduling was easy, and they were able to accommodate us quickly. Josh, the manager, was great to work with and very helpful during the original installation as well. The only drawback is that the pricing felt higher than expected; more reasonable pricing would have made the experience perfect.

reviews.author: Holly Nero
reviews.text: Great customer service!! Joshua was very professional, knowledgeable and courteous. He kept us informed as he was doing the repairs. He did a great job in a timely manner. I would definitely call them again for any plumbing needs that may arise. I highly recommend Culbert Plumbing.

reviews.author: Family Gray
reviews.text: Chris at Culbert Plumbing was skilled and hard working. He solved our difficult drain clog problem using a multitude of the best snakes and cameras and water jets. Great value. Thank you for staying late and getting the job done.

reviews.author: Sam Goldstein
reviews.text:
This company is a 5 Star operation from start to finish.  Prompt, professional, innovative, fair-priced and more.
Can't say enough about how well they treated us and what a pleasure they are to do business with.
Highly recommend this group of plumbing professionals.
Liz, who always seems to answer the phone was unbelievably helpful with planning and coordinating with other professionals on our project, and the two "hands-on technicians", Christopher and his partner were the best of the best.
Our thanks and best wishes to everyone at Culbert.

reviews.author: Terri Main
reviews.text: Had Culbert Plumbing come out and flush my system and replace a part on my tankless hot water heater. Good communication and efficient.   Would definitely use them again.

plumbers.name: Brodway Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1138 E Donegan Ave Suite B, Kissimmee, FL 34744, USA

reviews.author: Samantha Rodriguez
reviews.text: Yesterday Bernie and Josiah came to my house and to test my water heater and we came to the conclusion at the best option would be to replace it! They were both very friendly and knowledgeable and explained everything very thoroughly. Terel came to my house today he was also very friendly and informative about the new water heater and also about the new back flow pipes I had gotten installed which I appreciated! He got the job done quicker than I expected ! 10/10 recommend! 😊😄

reviews.author: Robin D
reviews.text:
Excellent job. Repeat customer. The team is prompt and efficient. We needed to replace our old hybrid hot water heater. When we sent a picture over of our old unit, they were able to identify that the builder had installed the unit facing the wrong way just from the picture.
The options and prices were discussed on the phone, and an estimate emailed quickly.
They were out the same week on a day and time that worked for us, and brought all the tools and the know-how to the project. After the installation, they showed us all the features of the new unit, explained how to maintain it, and answered any questions. We highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Joshua M.
reviews.text: Had several quotes from all over Orlando to get my aging water heater replaced.  Brodway offered the best quote.  On top of that, the plumber who performed the installation, Terel, was extremely thorough with the install.  He ensured everything thing was 100% before closing service for the day.  I would recommend Terel and Brodway for the excellent work and reasonable pricing.

reviews.author: Tom
reviews.text: Broadway did a great job from Bernie in sales to Roy in project management to Alex our installer!  Called them at 5:30 at night and they were done by 11:30 the next morning with our new water heater.

reviews.author: Edward Rheaume
reviews.text: Called Brodway plumbing as my pipes froze during coldest weather in over 16 years froze water pipes to water heater. They were able to get a tech out to me within a limited timeframe and Leo did a great job rebuilding my water heater plumbing in a quick and efficient manner. He was very professional and I will definitely call again when in need of help. Thanks again for a job well done!

plumbers.name: Monkey Wrench Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electric
plumbers.address: 4649 Beverly Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90004, USA

reviews.author: Yoon Cho
reviews.text:
$1,000 Disappeared During Their Repair Work

We hired this company after our water pipe burst. They began work on February 8 after my midnight emergency call on February 7. The job is still not finished.
During the repair period, $1,000 in cash went missing from inside my home.
I had my cash organized in $100 bundles. When I opened my bag later, the larger bills were gone, and only small bills ($1, $5, $10) were left behind. The money was clearly disturbed and disorganized.
No one else had access to the house during this time except their workers.
I am not interested in arguing. I am simply sharing my experience so others can make an informed decision. Please think carefully before allowing this company into your home.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Leggio
reviews.text: Luis was great! He was on time, friendly, efficient and knowledgeable. Would be happy to have him service our home again.

reviews.author: Andy park
reviews.text: I sure hope people aren’t getting SCAMMED by this company. Called for a tech to check out our boiler because hot water wouldn’t come out. Tech comes out, doesn’t touch or troubleshoots any system/part, and starts giving us quotes for a new boiler, which he quoted $4,000. I asked him why Home Depot boilers were $600 and he says the company’s boiler it’s a nice ‘luxury’ boiler and there were no cheaper ones from the company. For a temp fix, he quoted $1,300 for parts and labor which I rejected because I got sketched out. Paid the initial $89 and told him to get the hell out. Called a local tech and he fixed it by just turning on the pilot light. Hot water works just fine now. DONT GET SCAMMED BY THESE CORPORATIONS AND DO YOUR DUE DILIGENCE!!!!!! Honest working techs out there somewhere, not with monkey wrench.

reviews.author: Kim R
reviews.text: Plumbing: does not service condo owners in building with more than 2 levels per insurance. They seem nice, but making a note to not call in the future. I appreciated the upfront communication to not waste time & money. I think I’m running into people who take your money for an evaluation at a high cost knowing they will never be able to do the job so they ghost you & give you an extremely high price when pushed (John’s Plumbing). There were additional things with venting & lighting in the bathroom I wanted to check here since the service seems broader, but it’s not urgent. Maybe I will consider them for a non plumbing job.

reviews.author: Jordan W
reviews.text: Rick, our plumber, was informative, knowledgable, clear, professional, kind, creative, timely. He had extensive industry knowledge that he was able to communicate clearly to your average-Jane. I'm happy to say I learned a bit about plumbing! Joey, our dispatch, was patient, professional, organized, communicative, timely. Excellent service all around. We will complete projects with this company again in the future!

plumbers.name: Copper Peaks Plumbing, Drains, Heating and Air
plumbers.address: 5928 S 350 W, Murray, UT 84123, USA

reviews.author: Jeff Nolte
reviews.text:
Copper Peaks did an outstanding job installing a new heating and air conditioning system for us. The price was fair and the install was top notch. Nick and Eric went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect before they left.
Five Stars!

reviews.author: Mike Stephen
reviews.text:
Was incredibly nervous and stressed about my floor drain “issue”. Expecting to cost thousands.

Zeke was great at talking to me like a human, but not talking down to me explained what he thought was the issue and went out to his truck to grab some “magic fairy dust“ and a bucket of hot water.

Not five minutes later the drain was flowing freely!

He also told me what I should keep an eye open for and what I could do for future maintenance. All that no extra charge other than the initial callout fee.

Thank you SO MUCH for taking that stress off Zeke and Copper Peaks Plumbing!

reviews.author: Sandra Barrus
reviews.text: Gentry was personable and very knowledgeable about what needed to be done to fix our issue.  He was polite and made sure everything looked good (and clean) before he left.  He patiently answered questions and made sure we felt comfortable calling him if we saw any issues later. Will definitely call Copper Peaks Plumbing if we need any other help!

reviews.author: Amberlyn Peterson
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Copper Peaks. My outside faucet started leaking. My tech, Gentry, was absolutely fabulous. He took the time to educate me and get the problem fixed. The price seemed very fair and was less than I was expecting. I would definitely use their services again.

reviews.author: Jeremy M.
reviews.text: They sent out their technician Jeremy. He fixed the toilet float and handle for us.  He was great discussed plan and gave price before we started. Showed up on time and finished in a timely manner. Will definitely use in the future

plumbers.name: bluefrog Plumbing and Drain of Denver
plumbers.address: 7310 S Alton Way STE 6I, Centennial, CO 80112, USA

reviews.author: Ally ao
reviews.text: They responded promptly, and although there was a little miscommunication, they didn’t make excuses. They sent a plumber to my house the same day, fixed the leak and even provided before-and-after pictures. They were not only polite but also took real action. On top of that, they offer a one-year labor warranty. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Vishak
reviews.text:
I had Blue Frog Plumbing & Drain come out to fix a simple leaking hose connection at my water heater. To be clear, this is not a water heater they installed. They were only performing a minor repair. The repair itself was completed and solved the issue, and I paid the plumber.

After the plumber left, I noticed that he had placed a large, obnoxious Blue Frog Plumbing marketing sticker directly on my water heater. He did not ask for permission. He did not mention it. He did not give me the sticker and ask if I wanted it applied. He simply put it on my property without consent.

I do not want ugly marketing stickers on my equipment. It looks cheap, it looks unprofessional, and frankly the giant frog logo is an eyesore. When I tried to remove the sticker, I discovered it is a very thin, low quality sticker that tears immediately when you try to peel it off. It rips into pieces and leaves residue behind, making it even more frustrating to remove.

This is not about the cost of the service or whether the repair worked. This is about basic respect for a customer’s property. You do not put permanent advertising on someone else’s equipment without asking. Period.

Even if Blue Frog Plumbing offered the lowest pricing in the area, I will never use them again. Respect for a customer’s home and property should be a baseline expectation, not an afterthought.

reviews.author: Matt Weeden
reviews.text:
When we discovered that our ground floor toilet was leaking from the base and hey, surprise, the previous owner didn't install a flange, and oh also the copper drain pipe from 1970 doesn't meet modern standards so there's not a good way to connect one anyway—it was time to call in the pros! We got several quotes from various plumbers, and estimates ranged from $1800 on the low end to over $8000 (!!!) with one place, where they wanted to replace ALL of the old drain pipes in the basement. Which, in an ideal world where money is no object, sure; but unfortunately reality is a thing.

Thank goodness I also called BlueFrog to get their take on it. We got the whole job quoted and even completed within less than 3 hours, and now we have a proper flange with a new ABS drain connection that's married onto the existing copper pipe, for under $1000 altogether. No jackhammering of tile and subfloor involved, no cutting holes in drywall, or any unnecessary additions sold via scare tactics. Will we need to replace all the pipes someday? Probably. But, a big shout-out here to our technician Jason Bandy: he has a very down-to-earth, no-nonsense approach and demeanor, and he's adamantly against recommending or charging for things that you just don't need right now. And he took the time to clue me in on signs to watch out for that's going to tell us that, hey, NOW we actually do need to replace some of these other pipes. He's approachable and personable, and you can tell you're talking to an actual human being rather than a corporate mouthpiece.

Also the online scheduler is super easy to use, both to book your appointment and to reschedule if needed.

In summary: SO glad that I contacted BlueFrog, and I anticipate calling them again the next time we have a repair we need help with! 5 stars++

reviews.author: Drew Chilton
reviews.text: 5-star service right here! Cody was super professional and does solid work. He replaced our hose bibb quickly (in and out in an hour) and even installed an extra shutoff valve, which was a great bonus (we didn't even ask for it). He even stayed after to answer extra plumbing questions I had. The price was solid, literally half of what the big names are charging. Plus, the front desk was super responsive and even called me earlier in the day to see if I wanted to have my appointment sooner. A+ service all around, I will definitely be using them from now on!

reviews.author: Pavel Chekhov
reviews.text: We received excellent professional service from bluefrog plumbing.  From customer service to the actual work done by Brennan Pramberg.  The price was moderately higher than average I expected, however I will accept based on the quality of service

plumbers.name: Just Right Plumbing
plumbers.address: 231 E 400 S Unit 104B, Salt Lake City, UT 84111, USA

reviews.author: Tricia Bronson
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this heating service. Todd showed up with such good vibes - friendly, professional, and easy to talk to. He explained everything clearly so I understood what was going on. He also provided detailed photos of the work, which I really appreciated - it gave me confidence that everything was handled correctly. Excellent service from start to finish! I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Thomas Osimitz
reviews.text: Todd Petersen from Just Right came to our home recently to do annual service on our 3 gas furnaces. We appreciated that he called about 20 minutes before he arrived. When he showed up, he was polite and cheerful and very professional.
