reviews.author: Olga Shmigelskiy
reviews.text:
Kentucky Plumbing (KYPD) exceeded expectations from start to finish. Jake and Victor, were absolutely amazing when it came to scheduling and communication. They made the entire process smooth, organized, and stress-free, and their professionalism really stands out.

Tim K. did a fantastic job with the service - efficient, skilled, and clearly experienced. The work was completed flawlessly and everything was left clean and in great condition.

It’s rare to find a company where both ownership and team members operate at such a high level. HIGHLY recommend Kentucky Plumbing!
Truly top-tier service! THANK YOU!! 👍

reviews.author: Christian B.
reviews.text: I've used KYPD several times over the course of about a year and a half.  I will call them for any plumbing needs and wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone.  I've had a tankless water heater installed with a recirculation line.  This included upgrading and extending a natural gas line to the tankless unit and HVAC.  They also stubbed in a natural gas connection for a Generac system.  Most recently, I contacted KYPD with an overflowing condensate drain.  Ivan did an outstanding job diagnosing with a snake/camera and removing the blockage with a hyrdo-jet.  He was on-time, very courteous and professional.  He did a great job explaining the troubleshooting process and the diagnosis.  I appreciate how he really hustled every step of the way to locate, break out the clog, and then clean up in less than an hour and a half.  Overall, KYPD has excellent employees and provides excellent service.

reviews.author: Roger Rennekamp
reviews.text: KYPD installed the plumbing for a room addition onto our current home and installed an external faucet for watering the yard. I couldn't be more pleased with the service provided by Vova and Curt.  They were knowledgeable, professional and courteous.  Work was completed in a timely manner for a reasonable price.  I will definitely use KYPD again.

reviews.author: Randy “Stone” Jones
reviews.text: Maybe I was just lucky, I got Tim Kapiula for my service specialist. Polite, knowledgeable, efficient, professional, I couldn't have gotten better service. He kept me up to date on the progress and let me know when he had to run get a part that wasn't on his truck and the cost of the extra part. The repairs went fairly quick and everything worked perfectly when he was done. Would I recommend him? Would I ask for him next time? Yes, 100%, yes.

reviews.author: Robby Dundon
reviews.text: The plumber who came out, Ivan, was very professional and knowledgeable. He was able to diagnose the problem quickly and had it fixed with a couple hours of work. The price was good, much better than another estimate I got from a different company. I'll be using KYPD for any future plumbing needs I have.

plumbers.name: Drain Kings Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7517 John T White Rd, Fort Worth, TX 76120, USA

reviews.author: M Ryan Grandy
reviews.text:
If you are looking for the best plumber in Fort Worth, look no further than Desmond and the team at Drain Kings. We were facing a scary natural gas leak that wouldn't pass city inspection right before a major cold front. After a disappointing experience with another plumber, Drain Kings came in and completely outshined the competition.

They replaced our entire natural gas lines and got everything up to code so Atmos could restore our heat just in time. Huge thanks to Desmond, John, and Marcus for their professionalism and hard work. They are personable, respectful, and walk you through every step. For a fair price and top-tier quality, call Drain Kings. You won’t regret it!

reviews.author: Ryan Maxham
reviews.text: Desmond and DrainKings were the best. I should have started with him and probably would have saved myself the headache and some money. They helped me with my city citations, my water leak and fixed a year long break. I moved on to a gas project and they helped me there as well. All around great company!!

reviews.author: WonderFul Woman
reviews.text: I called Drain Kings for a leak under the kitchen sink and Desmond had availability within a couple of hours. Johnathan arrived early and assessed the problem and offered his expertise. Not only did Johnathan walk me through the process of the repair, he answered my questions and offered his professional opinion about leak detection devices. After he finished,  he doubled checked his work even showing how to use a device he recommended. I know I made the right call to Drain Kings and I wouldn't hesitate to call them again for my future needs.

reviews.author: Joy Laurice Johnson
reviews.text: Desmond and his entire team are amazing! My issue was identified and resolved immediately. Their knowledge, expertise and customer service is unmatched. At the sight of water or plumbing issue he should be the first call.

reviews.author: Tony Cube
reviews.text: Drain King is the best!!! Punctual, professional and meticulous!  I have used several plumbing companies in the past, but Drain King out performs all of them. They have my loyalty, and will use them exclusively. I have an older home that sometimes develops blockages in the pipe underneath due to its age and other issues. Drain King always does an amazing job!

plumbers.name: RHD Plumbing & Remodeling, Inc.
plumbers.address: 6474 Blanchar's Crossing, Windsor, WI 53598, USA

reviews.author: alicia hyberger
reviews.text: I had the good fortune of winning a top of the line Toto toilet by entering a giveaway drawing I saw in an advertisement during the Super Bowl 2026! RHD Plumbing generously sent me a very expensive toilet complete with a bidet to my home and installed it today! I am impressed with their generosity to gift something so incredibly nice! I had the pleasure of working with the service manager, Lori and two friendly and professional technicians, Craig and Jason. I would highly recommend hiring RHD Plumbing and Remodeling! Absolutely stellar customer service. 5 stars all the way!!!

reviews.author: Aimee Granger Ziegahn
reviews.text: RHD did a fantastic job on our primary bathroom walk in shower. We needed to redo the plumbing and fixtures from a shower tower to a standard system. Other plumbers overcomplicated the process. Craig was extremely professional and knowledgeable,  and provided a fair quote. He worked with us on scheduling around other details, and Billy provided an efficient and clean install on time. Pricing was very fair, communication was excellent. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.text: Billy did an amazing job installing our new kitchen sink and faucet remodel! He was honest and upfront about the expectations if the sink would fit or not but he made it work with some creativity and it looks awesome! The cost was lower than I expected. Wait, when does that happen!? At RHD plumbing!

reviews.author: Leonardo Rodriguez
reviews.text: Had a plumber come out to replace my water softener and the experience was great from start to finish. Billy showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and did clean, professional work. The installation was done efficiently and everything was working perfectly before he left. Pricing was fair with no surprises. I’d definitely recommend Billy and will use this company again for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Rod Beadle
reviews.text: RHD has always been fast, courteous, responsive and efficient at diagnosing and fixing all of our plumbing issues. Lori is very friendly and ensures prompt call-backs. Most recently, Billy came to figure out why our soaking tub was leaking water. I thought it would be a major repair but he was able to find the issue and fix it quickly and at minimal cost!

plumbers.name: Raymark Plumbing & Sewer
plumbers.address: 10710 Lake City Way NE, Seattle, WA 98125, USA

reviews.author: Michael Cuzzetto
reviews.text:
Raymark truly hits the mark - 100%. We recently had our main water line replaced, and the entire experience was outstanding from start to finish. From our first call, their team was professional, responsive, and easy to work with.
Ty, the lead technician, was courteous and highly professional when providing the quote. He took the time to thoroughly explain the details, presented clear options, and never pressured us in any direction.
Ernesto handled the installation and was friendly, efficient, and meticulous. He walked us through the completed work to ensure everything met our expectations and left the area so clean it looked like he had never been there.
Trustworthy is the best word we can use to describe Raymark. They have absolutely earned our confidence and will be our plumbers from here on out.

reviews.author: Todd Gates
reviews.text: My friend Robin doesn't leave reviews but asked me to post this for her, as she feels this team deserves recognition. She met Ronald first, and he was incredibly clear and patient in explaining her sewer issue. Andrew, the Utility Director, provided steady oversight and came in person to look at the site. Both have been timely, responsive, and professional throughout. Their communication has made the process much easier for her to navigate, and she is grateful to have a team this reliable involved in the work.

reviews.author: Amber Yeaw
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Raymark.  They were professional and very communicative throughout the whole process.  I had to wait a few weeks for some uncommon parts to arrive and they updated me regularly so I knew I wasn't forgotten.  They did a great job on the installation too.  A few weeks later, I noticed some water on the bathroom floor.  They sent a team out that same day to look at it.  They quickly identified that the leak was from another source but never treated me with any irritation or unkindness.  I'm thoroughly impressed and will always use Raymark!  Their customer service team is amazing too.  :)

reviews.author: Anya Buell
reviews.text:
I couldn’t be happier with the service I received. From the moment he arrived, he made me feel completely at ease and took the time to really listen and explain things clearly. He worked incredibly hard to track down the problem and didn’t stop until he figured it out—truly going above and beyond what I expected.

On top of that, he was clean, thorough, and respectful of my space. He was also friendly, personable, and genuinely funny, which made what could have been a stressful situation surprisingly pleasant. It’s rare to find someone who combines skill, work ethic, and great customer service so well. I would absolutely recommend him to anyone needing a plumber.

-Anya

reviews.author: Joe In Real Life
reviews.text: We had a sudden flood in our basement bathroom and Raymark Plumbing came through big time. Bella at reception was wonderful and got us on the schedule right away, and Tristan and Zander were at our house within about 90 minutes. They found the problem quickly, explained everything clearly, and fixed it fast. The quote was honest and the price was very reasonable. Great service from start to finish—we’ll absolutely call Raymark again.

plumbers.name: Premier Plumbing & Leak Detection, LLC
plumbers.address: 4605 NW 6th St STE F, Gainesville, FL 32609, USA

reviews.author: Nicole Vargas
reviews.text:
Where do I even start? Premier Plumbing has been such a blessing to work with. Anytime we have a plumbing need, they are not only quick to respond, but also incredibly thorough, which is greatly appreciated when working on homes that require comprehensive work. Whether the job is as small as changing out a faucet or as extensive as a full repipe, Premier never fails to impress me.

Their work is efficient, high-quality, and dependable, but what truly sets them apart is their top-tier customer service. They are always willing to help, communicate clearly, and respond quickly.

A huge shoutout to Bob Kavanaugh, who truly makes my job easier and consistently goes above and beyond for his clients. He is incredibly accommodating, genuinely cares about the quality of the work, and always ensures every concern is addressed. It’s rare to find someone so dedicated and professional!

reviews.author: Talia Pate
reviews.text:
I am revising my review to reflect the fact that several months ago, we had a very positive experience with Premiere Plumbing. That initial excellent service is why we called them again for this recent issue. However, this time, the experience was extremely frustrating and disappointing.

First Appointment: No call no show
We scheduled our first appointment, and the plumber never arrived and never called us. We had to call them late in the afternoon to find out what happened, which wasted our entire day and required us to change existing plans for the following. They ended up coming the next day.

Second Appointment:
The first visit didn't actually fix the problem, though, so we had to call back for a second try. We were given a time slot between 9 AM and 12 PM. At noon, when they were a no-show again, I called the office. I was told that we weren't even on the schedule, even though the same person I was speaking with had booked the appointment.

When I called, I kept my voice calm but understandably expressed my frustration about this second no-show and the fact that the original problem still wasn't fixed. The employee's reaction was surprising to say the least. He basically told me he'd rather I just cancel and go somewhere else because I was "being rough” and they were “too busy already.” It was completely unprofessional to tell a paying customer to leave just for expressing disappointment in a reasonable manner.

We totally understand that mistakes happen, but two major scheduling errors plus an employee who tells you to take your business elsewhere when you're understandably frustrated is just too much.

reviews.author: J P
reviews.text:
We are new in town. I called this company from a referral of a neighbor of mine for a slab leak on a fixer upper I purchased.
I had Corey and Robbie come out and had it diagnosed quickly.
I received the estimate and pondered it a day or two and then called them back to schedule the work to be done.
The gentleman who answered the phone got us all set up and kept in contact during the process.
The job itself went smoothly and for much less then I had thought!
The guys were friendly and kept our place as clean as possible during the repairs.
We will definitely use them for all our plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Nikkie Vogel
reviews.text: We had RJ today and he did a great job. he was knowledgeable, friendly and on time. He took the time to explain the issue to me and find the solution.  As always they came quickly when I called them for our leak. We use them for all our repairs on all our properties.

reviews.author: Matt Avinger
reviews.text:
Chris and Logan are awesome! (Bob is alright 😉) They saved the day at the salon by handling a lingering leak and knocking out the new plumbing for our shampoo bowl without any issues.

Chris is a total master of his craft. It is obvious he really cares about the quality of his work and that he loves what he does. Between him and Logan, they were super professional, showed up on time, and got everything hooked up perfectly.

Even though I like to joke, Bob actually got things scheduled quickly and really understood what we needed just by listening to our situation. It is a huge relief to have the new bowl ready to go.

If you are in Gainesville and need someone who actually takes pride in what they do, definitely give these guys a shout.

plumbers.name: A&W Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 1420 E Algonquin Rd Box 385, Algonquin, IL 60102, USA

reviews.author: Tyler Sullivan
reviews.text: I highly recommend A&W Plumbing! Matt did a great job from start to finish! We were in need of a water softener and installation and Matt was able to come out on very short notice to help us determine the best solution for our home. With the limited space we had available, it was determined that our best option was to install the unit in the crawl space. He helped us choose a unit - making sure that it wouldn't be too tall while also fitting within our crawl space access point. Matt's attention to detail and craftsmanship was exactly what the job called for. I am extremely pleased with the results and look forward to working with him again for any and all of my future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: J Schmidt
reviews.text:
Called Matt on Saturday, found my water heater was leaking pretty bad.  He swung bye on Sunday and confirmed the tank was compromised and that we'd need to wait until Monday to replace.

Gave me a call at 7:30 am first thing with a quote, price was amazing, well under quotes I got from other larger plumbing companies.  He showed up around 10:30am with the new water heater and  left shortly after 1pm.

Matt is a great guy, great service, and even corrected issues the previous plumber had done like over tight fittings.  Matt does an amazing job, this is my second time having him over, the previous effort was to repair my Ejector pump that failed.

A++ job, Five stars all the way.

reviews.author: Sean Patrick
reviews.text: A&W is FANTASTIC AND Matt is great reliable owner. Very friendly and professional and at a very reasonable price. Takes pride in his work as he is the owner. Always on time, and communication is fantastic. He has replaced my water heater, replaced whole house shut off valve, as well as other plumbing issues. A&W is the only plumber I call these days. Great business.

reviews.author: Marie Beusse
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Matt he was very quick to respond to my call. He arrived on time and immediately diagnosed my problem. The repair was done efficiently and at a very fair price. It is hard to find such an honest and dependable service these days. I will definitely call him again for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Brendan Gillespie
reviews.text: I needed to have some shower/tub fixtures replaced so Matt from A&W came out to work on it. The new set looks good and works good with no leaks. He also inspected some of the other plumbing features of the house and took care of a pipe on the water heater that was not positioned right. Overall I am satisfied with the work. Thank you!

plumbers.name: Pronto Plumbing
plumbers.address: 450 S Cemetery St, Norcross, GA 30071, USA

reviews.author: Lydia White
reviews.text: Pronto is an exceptional company. They are always pleasant and give you service. Joe roach is the one that has been coming to do repairs. He is very knowledgeable, pleasant, patient, and he does a 105% not just 100% I trust everything he does. This company is fantastic. I recommend them 100% now.

reviews.author: Richette Foster
reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience with Pronto Plumbing and felt compelled to leave this review. From start to finish their customer service was exceptional.

There were complications with the kitchen fixture that were completely outside of their control, yet they never stop advocating for me. They stayed in constant communication through calls and text, kept me informed every step of the way, and were genuinely apologetic throughout the process.

What truly set them apart is that they went above and beyond what was required. They made sure the issue was resolved properly – even when it meant doing more than they were obligated to do. That level of integrity, professionalism, and care is rare these days.

Pronto Plumbing did not treat me like just another service call. They treated me like a valued customer, and that matters. I am truly grateful for the effort and would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, honest, and customer focus plumbing service services.

Denise

reviews.author: Mercedes Moultrie
reviews.text: This company was referred through American Home Shield. The technician was scheduled promptly and arrived on time. He was very thorough and provide great customer service. We wanted to proceed with this company servicing our hot water heater, but they couldn't perform the work until a week later.  We decided to go with another company that could service our needs within the same week.

reviews.author: Rawanda Goode
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with this plumbing company. They responded quickly, arrived on time, and were extremely professional throughout the entire process. The technician clearly explained the issue. Everything was left clean and working perfectly.

reviews.author: Vallerie Wood
reviews.text: My garbage disposal was leaking and not working. The service team was very responsive in contacting me and setting up appointments and follow up. The service person who came out was courteous and helpful. Would highly recommend this company.

plumbers.name: Plumber Near Me
plumbers.address: 4039 W 1st St, Sanford, FL 32771, USA

reviews.author: Stephen Pierce
reviews.text: Josh did a fantastic job installing a new main water cut off, hose bib,  and new Kitchen sink drain. I highly recommend Plumber near me. I like to work with Veteran Owned companies.

reviews.author: eugene lloyd
reviews.text: Josh Glenn was quick to respond and very efficient. He was truly knowledgeable and found our plumbing issue within minutes. He tried the least expensive repair initially and it worked! We would recommend him and his company to anyone who desires a seamless experience.

reviews.author: Ernest Singleton
reviews.text: I initially chose this company because it's veteran owned (Navy vet myself). Tony C. did a perfect job installing new supply line and shut off valve to my home. He clearly explained all my options beforehand and left it up to me to decide without trying to upsell anything. Also was friendly to chat with in general. I can't recall the name of the lady that scheduled my appointment but she was friendly as well. I will use for any/all future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Sheri Patterson
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about Plumbers Near Me and Bobby the owner. He truly went above and beyond in every possible way.  When my water heater started leaking at night, Bobby came out without hesitation and helped us drain it safely,  which immediately eased a stressful situation.  The next morning,  Bobby was right back as promised to install a new hot water heater. The installation was smooth, professional,  and efficient and he took time to make sure everything was working perfectly before leaving.  On top of that, Bobby noticed an issue with my shower and fixed it without hesitation.  His responsiveness,  expertise,  and genuine care for his customers are rare to find. Friendly,  reliable,  and incredibly thorough.  I would absolutely recommend Plumbers Near Me to anyone in need of plumbing services and will be calling Bobby for any future issues. Truly outstanding service!

reviews.author: Heather Williams
reviews.text: Highly recommend! I had a water softener installed. They are great with communication and were on time. Very professional and explained everything before they left.

plumbers.name: Ed's Heating Cooling Plumbing Electric
plumbers.address: 4025 Gibson Dr, Tipp City, OH 45371, USA

reviews.author: Michael Dillon
reviews.text: Jimmy did a fantastic job on our washer and dryer hookups. The installation was very clean and neat. He put everything back the way it was and he cleaned up all the drywall and sawdust. We had two other quotes that were more expensive by $500. But what sold me was the other two companies were going to tie into the drain with a tee. Jimmy did with a wye, which is a better solution.

reviews.author: Mark Grine
reviews.text: Ed's electric is the best. Our technician Denney was out for routine maintenance on our heating system. He was knowledgeable, courteous and made sure we understood everything he had done for us. Not our first experience with Ed's. It has been that way with all their employees. Tonya in the office and all the service personnel are top notch. I have recommended them to others who have had the same experience.

reviews.author: Steve Durian
reviews.text: Had to make an emergency call for no heat at my mother's house. Arrived quickly and was able to diagnose the issue, which turned out to be a plumbing issue. Once the plumbing issue was resolved the technician came back out and got the furnace running again. Great service and definitely appreciated on a cold evening. Joe was very professional and polite. Thank you Ed's!

reviews.author: El Greco
reviews.text: Our tech, Josh was great. He took care of the tuneup and explained what his concerns were. At the end he addressed what his suggestions were and provided an estimate. No pressure. Very professional and knowledgeable. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Barbara Vaughan
reviews.text:
I called Ed’s to have my furnace cleaned and evaluated as it is over 20 years old. Charlie & Canton came out and took the furnace apart and showed me a multitude of issues, None of which surprised me, especially finding  several cracks in the heat exchanger. I decided to purchase a new furnace and AC unit from Ed’s HVAC.
I’m very happy that I got a jumpstart on this project before the cold weather gets here &  I am getting my new system installed tomorrow. Excellent service.
I have used Ed’s plumbing  in the past, and I was very happy with those services as well. Jessica and Tanya, who work in the office, are very helpful and very nice.
I highly recommend Ed’s plumbing and HVAC and I will be using their services again in the future.

UPDATES:
Since having my 22 year-old furnace evaluated and inspected, I have had Ed’s HVAC install a new furnace and AC system. Adam, Luke E., And Justin worked as a team and removed and installed my new HVAC system, which works great. The team worked well together.  Everything was cleaned up and I couldn’t be happier.
Later, I had Shane come out and give me an estimate for some electrical  work. I needed to have the main power line, which comes into the house, replaced. The job was quickly scheduled and the electricians came out a few days later. Luke C. & Jason worked together to replace the power line in just a few hours and it looks great. It is on the outside of the house so they did protect the line with conduit, which had not been done previously.
Yesterday, Charlie came back and cleaned my furnace vents. Charlie took his time cleaning the vents and showing me the before and after pictures. Great job and I am very happy with it.
I highly recommend Ed’s heating and plumbing company. I do plan to use Ed’s  again in the future for other projects.

plumbers.name: Sherrill Pumping
plumbers.address: 300 Brookstone Dr, Crossville, TN 38555, USA

reviews.author: Stav P
reviews.text:
Last night Sherrill Pumping showed me what true professionals are all about!  Earlier in the day I had my plumber, Frank who owns Integrity Plumbing diagnose a very serious problem I had run into with my septic tank system.  He explained and showed me why it was so serious.  Basically my whole septic system was clogged from 2 different entry points my bathrooms were literally useless.  I had sewage backing up into my home from 2 bathrooms.
He told me to call Josh who owns Sherrill Pumping immediately and explain the problem.  It was in the afternoon and I fully expected to have to wait a couple of days minimum to get them to come out….
Josh took my call immediately and responded that it sounded real bad and that him and his crew would be out by end of day for sure!  I was blown away and obviously extremely happy.
As the afternoon went on the weather got super nasty with pouring rain and cold.  I thought for sure they would call to cancel and reschedule… to my surprise they showed up and began their work immediately.. they were very professional, courteous, and immediately I realized very experienced as well.  They stayed there, pumping my septic tank, troubleshooting the long overdue backups I should have taken care of, and in the end, in pouring rain and darkness got my whole septic system up and running again 😎👍.  I told Josh he saved my life and he joked back he hears that all the time… I’m certain he does!!
If you have septic tank issues I would DEFINITELY make them the first and only company you call.  They care about their customers as was evident when they took my job on to their already full schedule for my emergency!
Thanks Josh and your crew for the excellent work and dedication to people like myself ..
Your customers who find themselves in a desperate situation with seemingly nowhere to go!
You came through big time 😎👍

reviews.author: Drew Wilson
reviews.text:
Great service from Josh and his team! Very knowledgeable crew who enjoyed sharing everything they could on our system and its performance. Provided soundly technical and economical recommendations for our family moving forward with our septic system; could not recommend them highly enough!

I did joke with the guys on ground that I almost did not call them seeing nothing but "5-star" reviews. It had to be a fluke I figured, however, their work and quality speak for itself! Will not hesitate to call them for any inspection or repair needs in the future.

reviews.author: sean thomas
reviews.text: My septic tank was full. I had a line that was filled with waste that would not properly leake out to the leech fields. Sherrill pumping came out and worked hard and quick in the cold weather. Light snow as well. I could not be any happier. Super fairly priced. Very nice people. I highly recommend this place to any and everyone. Thanks again. Happy household now.

reviews.author: Katy Bramkamp
reviews.text: Our system backed up on a Friday night. We made due until Monday. My husband called Monday morning and Josh went above & beyond to get us on the schedule for Monday. When 4:30 came along and the sun started setting we figured they weren’t going to be able to make it out. They arrived a little bit after 5:00. We were hoping it was just a matter of pumping us out but there was a clog. They stayed until 8:15 until they got our system unclogged. We HIGHLY recommend Sherrill.

reviews.author: Carrie Jo Roberts
reviews.text: Thank God for these men... They came out due to a sewer backup, to our new home we purchased Jan 16 2026. They talked us through what they are doing and what they did. I may be new but they are now our guys ... Great company.. y'all need work please call them. Absolutely amazing... Thank you...

plumbers.name: Coast Plumbing Solutions
plumbers.address: 198 W Hwy 246, Buellton, CA 93427, USA

reviews.author: Jayraj Laxman
reviews.text:
I recently had a Rinnai tankless water heater installed by Coast Plumbing Solutions, and the service was excellent from start to finish.

After requesting quotes from several local companies, Coast was the first to respond—not with an automated text, but with a personal phone call. The owner, Katie, was incredibly polite and took the time to answer all my questions thoroughly. She quickly scheduled a site inspection to accurately assess the job. Their technician, Wallace, arrived for the inspection and was both respectful and thorough. Shortly after, they provided a very reasonable quote that clearly outlined the scope of work.

On the day of installation, Wallace arrived promptly after calling ahead. He was professional and did an immaculate job with the installation and the removal of our old unit. Before leaving, he tested the system and ensured I understood all of its features.

For the past two months, my family and I have had consistent hot water ever since the installation. We will definitely be contacting Coast Plumbing Solutions for any future needs and highly recommend them to friends and neighbors in the area!

reviews.author: Sandy Lincoln
reviews.text: I recently used this plumbing service and couldn’t be happier.   Charlene at the front desk listened and was so very thoughtful.  Julio came to my rescue!!!  He communicated with me every step of the way. The repair was completed efficiently and everything was left clean and tidy.  I feel so lucky that I contacted them.  Highly recommend for any plumbing needs!  Thank you again, Julio!  You're the best!

reviews.author: Kristen Gowing
reviews.text: We had such a great experience with Coast Plumbing. David was our technician and he was awesome. Also very reasonably priced and it is hard to find places that don’t juice you for basic services. We were so happy with their service we plan on calling them again to come look at a few more things around the house. Thanks David!

reviews.author: P S
reviews.text: I had a few shower fixtures and valves in my home that were outdated and needed replacement with something more modern. Isaac, Julio, and David were able to quickly diagnose what would be necessary for the repair and provide a solution that integrated well with the existing architecture. Despite the rainy day, they were clean, polite, and courteous along the way. I'll be sure to use them again for my future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Jessica Simonson
reviews.text: We work with Coast Plumbing Solutions all the time at DMH Properties, and they are truly top-notch. Their team is friendly, knowledgeable, responsive, and consistently does great work. Katie, Char, Riley, Isaac, and everyone else there have been awesome to work with. Communication is excellent, scheduling is smooth, and we always know we’re in good hands. We will absolutely continue using Coast Plumbing Solutions for all of our plumbing needs. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of New Braunfels
plumbers.address: 863 I-35 Ste I, New Braunfels, TX 78130, USA

reviews.author: C G
reviews.text: So pleased with the work Mark from Mr. Rooter completed at our home today!  Mark provided a clear estimate and walked me through any potential problems that could come up (there weren’t any problems, though).  Mark was friendly, efficient, and thorough and I have confidence in the work that was completed.  Mr. Rooter has completed other work for us in the past and I will continue to call them if we have any plumbing work I need done!

reviews.author: Alison Braune

reviews.author: David Hodges
reviews.text:
We had our counters and sink installed today and thought we wouldn't have time to have a plumber come and install our garbage disposal and faucet but the installers finished by 11 AM. I started calling plumbers to see if somone could quote us today. We had a plumbing quote in the early afternoon that I thought was too much and we were luck to get in touch with Planet Plumbing who quoted us half the previous quote at 5:00 PM. They were professional and did the quote in an informative way. We agreed and they started the work immediatly and finised with by 7:00 PM which was amazing they were willijng to go above and beyond on the evening before the 4th of July. Jessie and Ben were professional and did a great job installing our faucet and garbage disposal. We are grateful for their service and could not recommend them more.

Post Number 2. December 19, 2025. We had some molding installed 5 months ago. After getting some items for Christmas decorating out of the crawl space, I noticed that some of the items were wet. I looked up at the plumbing and found that water was coming down one of the pipes that seemed to increase when the upstairs shower was on. I called late at night and Planet Plumbing set up an appointment the next day. Chase and Collin came to the house, I told them that base on where the pipe went up, I thought it might be a nail from the molding. They looked around and said that it made sense but they wouldn't know until they opened the wall. They opended a small space in the dry wall above the pipe and sure enough a nail went through the molding to a pipe that was leaking. They cut and replaced the pierced pipe expediently and for a fair price and even found some other issues that they recommended we consider fixing. Thankful we have Planet Plumbing to call on them. We have used them 3 times this year and have been impressed with the professionalism and fair price each time.

reviews.author: Barry Jennings
reviews.text: I had the best experience with Planet plumbing.  They were open, honest, hardworking and had fair pricing after a thorough inspection was carried out to see what the problems we had were.  Saul was our tech and he is a spectacle of professionalism.  He was not satisfied unless he had it done the right way. He stayed late to make sure the job was done in a timely manner to allow for the use of the home while they tore up the concrete slab to fix the main drain in the older home.  The old cast iron pipes were extremely scaled up with buildup over the past 60 or 70 years.  They came quickly to evaluate and gave a fair quote didn’t change the price on us and scheduled right away to fix the problem.  I would use them again in a heartbeat.  If I have any plumbing problems in the future, I don’t even see a reason to call anyone else.  I will even ask for Saul by name when I call.

reviews.author: Brad Magill
reviews.text:
This is a reveiw for Michael Longwell who performed plumbing services for a rental porperty owned in Boulder, CO.

Our rental unit is located in a two-story condominium with an underground parking garage. In early January 2026 a leak was discerned in the garage. Numerous plumbers came to the property but were unable to figure out where the leak was coming from. The HOA of the property then called Planet Plumbing and Michael Longwell came out to inspect the problem. Within 30 minutes Michael figured out exactly where the leak was coming from and what unit in the property the leak emanating from. The leak was coming from the tub in the unit above our unit. Michael determined to locate the leak he would need to go into the bathroom wall of our unit, so we scheduled a time for Michael to go into our wall. Within 15 minutes Michael located the cause of the leak, which was an HOA pipe, and the leak was 100% fixed within an hour. All can say is Michael was a fantastic in every aspect of the work he performed as he was courteous professional and knowledgeable.  If we have a need for another plumber in the future, we will be reaching out to Planet Plumber and specifically requesting that  Michael be put on the job.

Thanks for the great work, Michael. You were a pleasure to work with.

Brad

reviews.author: Amy Zeiger
reviews.text: Our apartment supervisor recommended Planet Plumbing and we had an excellent experience. The tech, Ryan, was knowledgeable and thorough, our new faucet and garbage disposal work great. Highly satisfied.

reviews.author: Timothy Spencer
reviews.text: Our kitchen sink backed up Christmas night (of course!) and when I called this morning I received professional help, a text when my tech was on the way, and an excellent repair when he arrived. Andy was super personable, and explained the process and the cost up front. The repair was fast and everything is working wonderfully. Thank you Andy!

reviews.author: Shane Bustle
reviews.text: Excellent experience. Andy was able to do a repair that the competition didn’t want to attempt, saving me thousands. Superior Plumbing is appropriately named. I will be calling the back, but hopefully no time soon.

reviews.author: Anurag Tomar
reviews.text:
This heater was installed by Jose at Superior Plumbing, 8 months back. Jose did a meticulous job, replacing pipe connectors, putting in new shut-off valves, securely strapping the tank to the wall studs.
However, last week unit shutdown with error code of "10 red flashes". Switching off, and restarting the pilot light resolves the issue, but as this was 2nd time in 6 weeks, Rocky from Superior Plumbing came out to inspect it. Rocky contacted the manufacturer, and by their suggestion, took the burner out and cleaned it, polished the sensor and cleaned the fire chamber, and blew some compressed air through the flute. It seems collected lint and dust can cause this issue. If it happens again, maybe the sensor needs replacing.
Anyway, no charge for this service. Rocky was professional, efficient and courteous. Took him a little over an hour to inspect, talk to manufacturer and finish the work.  Hopefully we will not need to replace the sensor.

reviews.author: vijaya venkatesh
reviews.text: The discharge tube of my water softener broke and the water was using out and spraying everywhere.  I had to shut off the main valve.   When I called Superior Kimberley immediately arranged for Andy to come and replace a new tube.  Andy did a great job and was very efficient too.  Thanks, Superior!

reviews.author: D Brookshire
reviews.text: Southtowne did a great job installing our furnace. Everyone I dealt with was kind, professional, and genuinely cared about my family’s safety. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Southtowne to anyone needing HVAC work. Thank you guys for all the help !

reviews.author: loisjoann goldberg
reviews.text:
When  I asked my neighbor for a recommendation for a local HVAC company, he immediately recommended SouthTowne Plumbing, Heating, and Cooling. He added that another family member had work done by this company and was extremely pleased.

The first time you call a new company to have maintenance performed at your house, it can be stressful not knowing what to expect.

The day of my maintenance visit the temperature was about zero. When Scott came to my door, his cheerful, friendly and professional attitude laid to rest any fears I had about switching to a new company.

Scott explained the company was still family owned, and a local business. This was very important to me.

He took his time to inspect both the inside and outside HVAC components, as well as my mini split. He explained what he was doing and took pictures to show me the condition of the unit on the inside when the panel was taken off.

I had the new filter, and he replaced it for me. I feel that Scott gave both my systems a complete thorough inspection and maintenance checkup.

After the work was completed, Scott explained their maintenance plans that I could choose from if I decided to go with their family plan.He did a thorough job explaining the, differences and what I could expect from each one. Newer HVAC systems have more complex components in them which require maintenance that older units did not need.

Based on my experience with Scott, I will be calling them for my spring maintenance visit and look forward to joining their Family Plan at that time. The Family Plan will include two annual inspections, filters, and cleaning of interior components.

reviews.author: Jonathon Ramseur

The team over at Roto-Rooter’s work at my home was phenomenal. They handled the process from start to finish with tremendous respect and clarity. I can’t thank them enough for how easy they made this process. I had a pipe burst in my bathroom that completely soaked the walls of my bedroom. It was a disaster.

Also, I want to give a special thanks to Mark, who was the primary point of contact, and made everything from dealing with insurance to repairs a breeze. The guy was extremely helpful and made this process stress-free with his experience and knowledge.

Thanks a ton! We will definitely be using, and recommending, Roto-Rooter for any projects we come across!!!

reviews.author: Tanya Duplechein
reviews.text:
I had a technician come to fix a clogged pipe from my kitchen sink and originally I was very pleased at how quickly he was able to clear it out as I had been dealing with the clog since last February but when he left I went outside to put the cover back on the access pipe in the front yard and noticed it was still completely backed up and full of water still and I told him it was clogged in both directions of the access pipe, so he had to come back out here which he got here 4 hours later then they scheduled him to get here. When he came back he worked and worked on it and couldn’t get through the clog and said it was a bunch of sludge, then he proceeded to tell me that the pipe wasn’t connected with my kitchen sink and I should not worry about it, and I told him no, I am going to worry because I paid $300 to have you unclog the pipe and I know it’s connected to the sink because every time I washed dishes I had to take the lid off the access pipe outside so it would come out there and I could wash dishes and the access pipe was never full of water like that until my kitchen sink started clogging up. So he said it was late and he would come back tomorrow morning at 9am and I said I would be there waiting for him. He just never came back the next day and didn’t inform his manager or anyone at Roto-Rooter that my pipes were not fixed and he was going to come back. I waited until almost 4pm then I called to see where he was and why he never came. They had no idea and said they would call him. Then she said he was on his way and would be here in about an hour. 30 minutes later a new guy showed up and said he was the one coming to run the camera through the pipes but he was waiting for the other guy to get here and he was still an hour away. So I said since he is an hour away I’m going to run to the gas station and grab some cigarettes, I’ll be right back. When I got back he was gone and I had only been gone 5 or 10 minutes. So I called and asked what was going on and the girl said oh he will be back, the other guy is still 45 minutes away so I said ok. Am hour later the girl calls me back and tells me nobody is coming. The other guy who was here just left when I did, which I knew he did because the first thing he said when he arrived was how he was upset about being here because he was supposed to be off at 6, which I thought was very unprofessional! Then she tells me the other guy that said he was coming back this morning and also said he was on his way an hour earlier, had just never left and all that time they were giving me updates and saying he was in traffic but on his way was just a lie because he wasn’t ever coming. So worst service I have ever experienced in my life, completely unprofessional and just a lack of care and customer service and I will never use the service again. I will say that the customer service girls I spoke to each time were very nice and very professional and I could tell they were embarrassed about the way the technicians were treating me and I don’t blame them and I would certainly return if I only dealt with them, but the service, there was no excuse for that and I am shocked they would even do anything like that. Worst experience ever, do not use them.
Ps. What I really wanted to do was speak to a supervisor and let them know what all happened and so I would know that the manager was at least aware of what both of these technicians did and how they just didn’t fix the problem and didn’t want to stay late and said they would be back in the morning when they never had intentions on coming and didn’t let them know it wasn’t fixed yet, if that’s not bad enough for another to show up mad about being here and then to just leave without even saying anything to me, and for the other guy to be on his way and find out I’m waiting for someone who still isn’t coming. I was told that they were going to inform the supervisor on everything that happened and get to the bottom of it and I truly hope they do, this is insane and completely unacceptable.
