reviews.text: Immediately responded (same day on a Saturday) to my call to clear my backed up sewer line. Sami and his team were able to quickly fix the issue. I highly recommend this company for all your plumbing work. Very happy customer.

reviews.author: Thomas Ortega
reviews.text: We had a spewing water sump pump in the middle of the night. All the big box plumbing companies who claim to have 24-7 emergency service were either booked through or not answering, one company literally had an AI voice tell me sorry they can't assist until the following day. He answered and came to our house within the hour. Very professional. Came out of his work van in an absolute downpour and replaced our sump pump for a very reasonable price considering the circumstances. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Christopher N
reviews.text: I did a cold call to Climatech plumbing (Sami)  and he was personable and interested as I communicated my project of updating my basement laundry room and the utilities, and Sami came the next day to see the project! My project---Updating the location of gas W/D, Laundry sink both needing water pipe & drain rerouting/laundry box install, adjusting of an in floor drain no longer being used by the updating, install a new Zoeller sewage pump and update its piping/venting/rerouting, remove old galvanized drain pipe and install pvc pipe to create a better multi drain configuration connection of my existant overhead sewer system, remove an old traditional aged hot water heater and install a new positioned Navien tankless H/W heater with new gas/water and thru wall exhauting piping, adjust furnace gas pipe, relocate/install gas dryer exhaust venting duct & end cap with boring tool. Lots of work which the team completed within the timeframe stated and i was very satisified with the workmanship of the project.  I added some additional work based upon Sami's pricing to install a new main water ball shut off valve and adjust my common bath/sink drain by removing the galvanized piping and reconfiguring new pvc drain lines which im glad i did as looking inside the galvanized water main pipe and the galvanized drain lines that were narrowed and filled with debris.  Sami kept me updated via text & calls of a schedule that he kept and answered my questions and concerns in a timely manner.   Sami and his co-worker did a great job, were respectful of my home and were clean and tidy.  Im a 1st time customer and would HIGHLY RECOMMEND CLIMATECH PLUMBING!!

plumbers.name: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing of Silver Spring
plumbers.address: 2600 Forest Glen Rd suite a, Silver Spring, MD 20910, USA

reviews.author: Jim Levings
reviews.text: We had a pipe leak in our laundry room and called Benjamin Franklin Plumbing, and I couldn’t be more impressed with the service. Our technician, Ira Miller, was fantastic. Punctuality: Ira arrived right on schedule. Much appreciated! He diagnosed the issue immediately and had the pipe repaired much faster than I expected. Once the job was done, he made sure the workspace was spotless. You’d never even know a repair had taken place! We will definitely be using Benjamin Franklin Plumbing for any future needs. Thanks again, Ira!

reviews.author: Devin Ward
reviews.text: Israel did an outstanding job! He was professional and explained everything clearly. He also showed up with a positive attitude. I would definitely recommend him.

reviews.author: Damon Gallaty
reviews.text: I had Benjamin Franklin Plumbing come out to replace our electric water heater with a tankless water heater. They gave me a great estimate compared with other plumbers and did a fantastic job. I plan to use them for future plumbing work.

reviews.author: Dr. Cheryl Iglesia
reviews.text: Chris gave expert service in installing a new reverse osmosis system. He went above and beyond in obtaining the correct connector for the RO system to the ice machine in the freezer. He and his apprentice Cody were also very neat in cleaning up after the installation.

reviews.author: Tricia S
reviews.text: David Laboskie did a terrific job.  Our kitchen sink stopped up on Sunday afternoon, just days before Christmas.  David was able to come that afternoon.  He unclogged the line very efficiently and cleaned up thoroughly so that there was no evidence of his work or the gunk that came out of the line.  Besides his competence, David was also a very pleasant, friendly guy.

plumbers.name: Lee's Air, Plumbing, Heating, & Roofing
plumbers.address: 2440 S Gearhart Ave #101, Fresno, CA 93725, USA

reviews.author: Isaiah Elenes
reviews.text: Lee’s Roofing did an excellent job on our full roof replacement. The quality of work was great and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. Huge thanks to Elijah, Oscar, and Beto for keeping me informed every step of the way and sending updates while my family and I were out on a family vacation. That communication really gave us peace of mind. The crew was professional, efficient, and left everything clean when the job was done. I highly recommend Lee’s Roofing.

reviews.author: Pamela Dempsey
reviews.text: We made the hard decision to say goodbye to our aged clay roof tiles and to go ahead with a conversion to a new asphalt roof. The easy part of that decision was choosing Lee's Roofing for the project. We've always had wonderful service with Lee's which has included installing a new HVAC unit and all new ductwork and insulation, as well as semi- annual maintenance through the years. We knew we could expect A+ work on our roof. True enough, our new roof looks sooo good and the entire job of removal and installation went very fast. The installation crew was hardworking, and sales rep Dylan Kent did an excellent job going over the proposed work/costs and explained the whole process beforehand. Special shoutout to project manager Juan Celis for his great communication, awesomely friendly and helpful manner, and excellent oversight of the installation. Overall, a super great experience for us and we love our new roof! Thank you, Lee's!

reviews.author: Matthew Stancombe
reviews.text:
I had a great experience working with Brandon from Lee’s Roofing. He was professional, knowledgeable, and easy to work with from start to finish. Brandon took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure I understood what was going on.

He showed up on time, was respectful, and gave an honest assessment without any pressure. It’s clear he takes pride in his work and truly cares about helping.

If you’re looking for someone trustworthy and dependable, I highly recommend Brandon. Excellent service and communication every step of the way.

reviews.author: Sally Valenzuela
reviews.text: Just wanted to say thank you to Lee's Air plumbing they came out. Did their service on one of our buildings at Central Valley auto glass. They did an amazing job  the guy was very helpful.He explain everything as he was doing job. I would totally recommend lee's for any job. Thank you again mister pancake you're an amazing person. After he was done with everything, he also cleaned up. So that was a plus we were very happy with the services, and again, thank you, Lee's Plumbing.

reviews.author: Etsumi A Matsuda
reviews.text: The salesman said that the company would reach out me to discuss the installeration on this Saturday but still no discussion in details even though I have paid for estimate that another company didn't charge. Not sure whether they come in as he said. They changed the date. Also didn't show up on time. I had to call what was going on.. However, the installer completed his job professionally, cleaned up. I'm very happy about it. I'm looking forward how this product will work when it rains. Thank you very much to call me many times for the update. I really appreciate.

plumbers.name: Bernie's Plumbing & Heating Company
plumbers.address: 1501 Lee Hill Dr, Boulder, CO 80304, USA

reviews.author: Doug K
reviews.text: Great experiences with Bernie’s thru many years. Have had them to my house for multiple issues and always felt they treated me fairly and  professionally and completed the work  quickly too! Would have them back anytime and would highly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing+.

reviews.author: Will Ford
reviews.text: Writing this for my dad who isn't great with technology. I’m a retired home builder and have been pleased with Bernie’s. They are reliable and there workman ship is excellent!

reviews.author: Mark Coffey
reviews.text: Knowledgable local plumbers with a long track record that will take the time to do a repair correctly.   They also did an excellent job installing our new on-demand boiler system.

reviews.author: Beat Steiner
reviews.text: Bernie’s has been taking care of our somewhat elaborate heating system for many years. We’ve been pleased with their knowledge and careful attention to this work.

reviews.author: Ariel
reviews.text: I would absolutely give 10 stars if I could. Despite Mitch being harassed for no reason by my older mother, he added on so many things to a standard water heater replacement at no cost, that other companies surely would have gouged a customer for.  He added 2 shut off valves to the tank, replaced the lame flex metal connectors (another company had put on) with copper lines, replaced the thermal expansion tank and triple checked and changed the whole house pressure.   I am really sorry Mitch about my mother and I am so grateful people like you and companies like Bernie's still exist.

plumbers.name: E-Z Plumbing And Drain
plumbers.address: 1912 N 200 E, Spanish Fork, UT 84660, USA

reviews.author: Xmas Lutu
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Easy Plumbing came through for me when I had a plumbing emergency after hours. Jeremy responded on short notice, showed up quickly, and took care of the problem efficiently and professionally. He explained everything clearly and made the whole situation far less stressful.

What really impressed me was how fair and affordable the cost was — especially for an after-hours emergency call.

If you need reliable, honest service when it matters most, I highly recommend Easy Plumbing and Jeremy.

reviews.author: Alex Moore
reviews.text: Dillon and Jeremy were amazing. After a late night scare of carbon monoxide diagnosed from a faulty water heater, these guys came in and literally saved our lives. They were so fast, efficient, and professional working on our old house. We will use them and recommend them from now on. I’m so glad we found a plumbing company we can trust!

reviews.author: Kaylyn Swanson
reviews.text: I really appreciated working with this company. I was able to make an appointment quickly and get my clogged drains looked at. They gave me all my options and prices upfront. Costs were reasonable and they were able to get the work done that day. They made sure my lines were clear before leaving. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Denise Fullmer
reviews.text: EZ Plumbing was amazing to work with From Jeremy, to Shay and Dillion specifically!!  They treated us fairly and like family!!!  They were very affordable and honest!  The reason I gave them a 5 Star Review is because they didn’t have a 10 Star Review!!!🏆

reviews.author: C McCloud
reviews.text: Jeremy came quickly and was very efficient. Did a very thorough job. Best drain cleaning I’ve had done. He’s a really kind person and was enjoyable to talk with. I would highly recommend him.

plumbers.name: Honest Abe Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 1374 Leisure Dr, Summerville, SC 29486, USA

reviews.author: Karen Matos
reviews.text: Our services began with a courteous phone call from Devin and Donovan the owners to get info before coming for the job. I suggested they FaceTime so they could see the plumbing. This was helpful and saved time. Ryan and Thomas came to our home to fix a valve plumbing problem. They went over and above in their professionalism. They were also very patient with all my hubby’s questions. We’ll tell anyone looking for plumbing to call this company FIRST. Hopefully we won’t have additional plumbing issues ourselves, but if needed they’ll be the ONLY call we’ll make.

reviews.author: Sarah W
reviews.text:
Great job done, I had called the night before to schedule a gas stove swap out. They booked next day mid morning. I ended up calling same morning and asking if it was possible to move the appt sooner as the old stove was being picked up. They came ASAP! No hassle at all, great communication, professional and helpful.
I paid the price to ensure the job was done safely. Will be using this company again in any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Tyler S
reviews.text: Adam was wonderful to work with.  Came in, provided me an estimate for a bathroom renovation (shower valve, sink lines, toilet lines, gas line relocation) and was honest at the end of the job by reducing the price due to a part of the job not being as extensive as he estimated.  As many who live locally know, finding a good tradesman you can depend on and trust is rare.  Will call Honest Abe again and request Adam on my next bathroom.

reviews.author: Christina O'Brien
reviews.text: I found this company on a West Ashley Facebook group for recommendations and I understand now why they received such high reviews. I called and spoke to a real person and they had me scheduled for the very next morning to fix my toilet leak. The gentleman who came was wonderful! Absolutely top notch service all around and we will be recommending them to everyone from now on.

reviews.author: Lisa Zarrillo
reviews.text:
This is the best plumbing team my husband and I have ever worked with. His wife handles all calls and messages, and she is incredibly kind, responsive, and accommodating—even during urgent situations. She manages everything with such care and professionalism.

Donovan is just as impressive. He arrives as scheduled, is honest in both his work and pricing, and consistently delivers high-quality service. He installed our hot water heater within 24 hours and most recently completed a sewer repair for us. With a tight timeline due to our home closing, he made room in his schedule and worked tirelessly all day to get the job done.

A dependable, hardworking, and professional team. We highly recommend this small business for any plumbing needs!

plumbers.name: Golden Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2430 Bowman Ave, Louisville, KY 40217, USA

reviews.author: Michael Hommrich
reviews.text: Dean Titus was super.  He and his apprentice were very knowledgeable , friendly, and efficient.  The entire team, Janet, office manager and Jacob Allen were great to work with.  Great service and reasonable pricing.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Raven Meredith
reviews.text: Golden Plumbing was very helpful after another company chose not to help repair a leak in my old weird house. Quick repones and scheduling, and very helpful and professional service from Dean! Will definitely use them again for future needs and will recommend to anyone who asks!

reviews.author: Drip Collins
reviews.text: Jacob has been great!!! He worked with me and explained everything that needed to be done. It’s been so nice to work with a company that wants to be fair in pricing and doing a great job!!!! Thank you will use again if ever needed.

reviews.author: Brittanie Steele
reviews.text:
I am absolutely going to use Golden Plumbing for our next job. The technician Jacob Allen was so sweet and extremely helpful. He and his helper not only repaired the water leak outside our home but also came in and did a quick diagnosis of another issue we are having.

We look forward to having them back to get that resolved as well.
Our water line needed to be repaired immediately. We didn't have time to wait because having our water off put the rest of our pipes in danger of freezing due to the cold weather. Golden plumbing came right out. The price they gave us was extremely competitive and affordable. They were out the same day and when they left we had water and we were extremely happy with the job they did.

reviews.author: Amanda Gellhaus
reviews.text: Had a sink/dishwasher drain backing up; called Golden and spoke to a very nice lady (Janet, I believe) who got me set up with a same day appointment. The technician (Dean) was great; he explained his assessment and provided an estimate, and he got our drain fixed up quickly. I appreciated that he left the area very clean and explained everything/answered questions. Drain is working just fine now; would highly recommend!

plumbers.name: JB Plumbing
plumbers.address: 515 W Allen Ave #13, San Dimas, CA 91773, USA

reviews.author: M
reviews.text:
We have used JB Plumbing for smaller jobs and have been very very happy with the work, they were the only company we considered calling when we found ourselves in major plumbing situation.  We, unfortunately have had other plumbing issues and used different well known plumbing companies for which the work was good.  What made a JB  Plumbing stand out was:
1.   The professionalism of everyone we have dealt with in the this organization
2.   The professionalism of the job completed
3.   The knowledge and honesty to address all of our questions
4.   The promptness of the services
5.   The quick responses after the job was completed when we had additional questions

I recommend JB Plumbing for any plumbing issue big or small.

They have installed a water heater, installed a toilet when the original installation was not done well and now this major problem we just had with a bad water leak.

Thank You everyone at J B Plumbing

reviews.author: SuperDarkilla
reviews.text: Cory and Phillip were the best plumbers I have seen in 57 years. They were on time, straight forward and got the job done. No hassle, no fooling around got in and got the job done. They are in my permanent contacts and will DEFINITELY BE GETTING A CALL !!!

reviews.author: David Contreras
reviews.text: JB has done a few jobs at our house and they’ve been great every time. Just had Johnny and Cameron out to clear a clog and they were great. Personable, honest, and communicative. Sean and Nick also upgraded our water main service and helped fix a leak a  few months back and they were just as great. It’s hard to find good tradesman but JB is now our go-to plumbing service.

reviews.author: Nicole M
reviews.text:
Looking for the nostalgic and rare experience of a knowledgeable, reliable, trustworthy and reasonably priced plumber… one who takes care like a family member would?
Job: full home repipe
Jonny M. runs a tight ship and he and his crew really know what they’re doing!
First time customer referred by a neighbor, and I was totally impressed.
They were very professional and covered everything, cleaned up every night before departure, took great care with our belongings, kept open discussion regarding options, handled communication for permits and got them quickly, and tidied up before departure. They got done ahead of schedule as well.
We’re super satisfied and would highly recommend.
We’ll see you guys back for our toilets and tankless water heater next week!

reviews.author: Todd Landers
reviews.text: I left a message on a Monday afternoon with JB Plumbing to unclog double sinks in our upstairs bathroom. Within a couple of hours, they replied and arranged to come out by noon the following day. Cameron and Will actually came out a few hours early, snaked the drain and had it flowing in about an hour. They were courteous, did a good job of explaining what they were doing, and cleaned up behind them. I would definitely recommend.

plumbers.name: Rare Breed Plumbing, Heating, and Air
plumbers.address: 8763 Sandy Pkwy, Sandy, UT 84070, USA

reviews.author: Francais Anita Parker
reviews.text:
Isaac & Collin arrived on time. When I opened the door, they were courteous and stood back a few feet before being invited in. The put on shoe cover before entering my home. They confirmed what our appointment was for (yearly water heater flush and whole home plumbing inspection), and then I showed them to the laundry room where the water heater is located.

Isaac was training Collin on the processes for this type of visit. I got the pleasure of over hearing him patiently explaining the next step, things to look out for, and encouraging Collin as they went along. They drained my water heater and then went around inspecting each shutoff valve in my home to confirm it is working. They found 2 that wouldn't shut off and they notified me about what that means. These gentlemen were very polite throughout the visit.

I'm on the Herd Membership, and visits like today reaffirm the reasons why. Trustworthy, respectful service is so important and difficult to find.

Court had worked tirelessly to build that into the culture of his team, and it shows in the work they do. Thank you, Isaac and Collin!
10/10 would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Laurie Flagler
reviews.text: Greg was amazing! I had a bathroom leak that turned into a bathroom remodel. He advised me on replacing plumbing from 1973 so we didn’t have further issues and I had him install the tub, toilet and faucets and he always did very quality work. And he was able to fit me in during the remodel schedule. Really appreciate his level of service and professionalism.

reviews.author: Christian Mogren
reviews.text: Rare Breed Plumbing did an amazing job helping me fix a sink in my parents’ house. Thor showed up right on time, diagnosed the issue quickly, and explained everything in a way that made us feel completely at ease. He was friendly, respectful, and clearly skilled at what he does. The repair was done fast and done right, and the whole experience felt honest and stress‑free. I’m really grateful for their help and would absolutely recommend Rare Breed Plumbing to anyone who needs reliable, trustworthy service.

reviews.author: Mark Allen
reviews.text: Ashton did a really quick and through job with replacing my kitchen faucet. Rare breed has been a great place for all my plumbing situations that have come up over the last 3 years. I highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Joseph John
reviews.text: Rare Breed Plumbing, Heating & AC actually purchased the plumbing company that installed our sump pump. We had concerns regarding the sump pump, and Chandler answered all of my questions assuring me that it was functioning properly. No cost for the service which is “rare” these days. Very much appreciated the quality service.

plumbers.name: ASAP Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1258 N Rose Farm Rd Unit 1, Woodstock, IL 60098, USA

reviews.author: Kevin Crown
reviews.text: The technician showed up within the time window ASAP advised. He was courteous and ready to work. He stayed until the entire job was complete and knowledgeable, he answered all of our questions. We had a tankless water heater installed, a whole house sediment filtration system installed, shut off valve replaced, and reverse osmosis drinking water system installed.

reviews.author: Gitlin Law Firm
reviews.text: We have been very happy with ASAP Plumbing for all of our needs. We’ve used them for both general repairs and plumbing issues, and they have consistently delivered excellent service. They are always prompt, professional, and pleasant to deal with. We truly appreciate their reliability and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Steven McCarty
reviews.text: Lucas was very professional and installed the water heater within a couple of hours. He went over the install details and how long it would take. When finished with the install, he explained maintenance and warranty. He cleaned up everything including disposal of the old unit. His work was very clean and demonstrated there were no gas leaks to set me at ease. I am very happy with the process and the price. I highly recommend ASAP Plumbing.

reviews.author: Nicole Leconte
reviews.text:
ASAP has been wonderful to work with! From Alex, who I initially  cumminicated with regarding my hot water heater, getting a quote, and scheduling a plumber, Olivia after hours, and finally Max who installed the water heater. They were very efficient and got everything handled in a very short turnaround time (next day).
In addition, Max is extremely knowledgeable, helpful, and professional. I am pleased with the removal and installation he performed and he patiently answered all of my questions. Overall, they ALL are very friendly and empathetic which truly helps when dealing with plumbing emergencies that always seem to happen at the worst times. I would not hesitate to use them again. I
strongly recommend their services!

reviews.author: Bethany Bellavia
reviews.text: Jon came out and gave me an estimate and explained everything to me. He was accessible and personable through the entire process. Keifer & Bryce are the plumbers that completed the work and they did phenomenal! We had a transitional hot water heater replaced with a tankless in addition to repiping and moving our water softener. They did it all and were at my house ALL day. They were professional, kind, and answered my questions. I highly recommend ASAP!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 1600 S Preston St, Louisville, KY 40217, USA

reviews.author: Jimi Hance
reviews.text: I had a valve break on my main water supply line to my house at 1 am. It flooded my kitchen, part of my living room and dining room. I called around 3 am in need of a plumber and Chris called me back by 8 am. By 1130 am he was at my door and finished up before 1230. Chris was absolutely great! He was knowledgeable and knew exactly what was done wrong with the prior work on the pipe. He was easy to chat with and was very informative on what he was doing and why. I do think the price was a little steep for a smaller job, but I understand that this was done after hours and on a Sunday. I do not hold Chris accountable for the price. I do hope that Roto Rooter is taking good care of Chris! Good knowledgeable employees are hard to come by these days. I will recommend him to anyone in the future! Chris gets 5 stars for his work but RR gets 3 stars for the steep price. This job should of been no more than $300 or $350 AT MOST.

reviews.author: John Martin
reviews.text: Dalton was conscientious and provided a quote for the work required. He cleaned our line and found and removed the cause of the blockage. He ran a camera through the drain line to insure the line would remain clear and there were no other problems. The total was exactly as quoted. Very satisfied. Great service by Roto-Rooter. This was an after hours job. Very grateful that they were able to solve our problem quickly when we needed them.

reviews.author: Suzy Mohr
reviews.text:
We recently needed the help from Roto Rooter for a backed up drain in our basement. Kyle was our technician and I want to compliment him on cleaning everything up when he was finished. I wasn’t home most of the time while he was here and was afraid when I got home, I would have lots of cleaning to do. It was nice to come home and find he had already taken care of it.
We are happy to report that our drains are working the way they should.
Thanks

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.text: Thanks Chris for being so thorough and efficient! I won't use anyone else besides Roto-Rooter from now on. From start to finish, it was an easy process and he arrived quick to resolve the issue. He explained what he was doing, and answered the questions I had. Overall, it was a quick and easy fix to a "crappy" situation.

reviews.author: Sony Steier
reviews.text: I recently used Rotor Rooter on a rental property of mine. We first tried two other plumbers who worked on this powder room toilet but they left and said it was better. However, The problem still existed and this toilet was Mount Vesuvius after those plumbers left! Somehow, they made it even worse. It was the Friday after Thanksgiving, and the only plumber who we could find was Rotor Rooter. They did not charge holiday hours and came within a few hours. It was roto Rooter who finally found the problem with our sewer line. They determined it was a pipe that tree roots had grown into, and gave us a price to fix it. I had this issue before on a different property, so I was familiar with the hefty cost. Their price was surprisingly  reasonable for this scope of work. When they got to the Area of Repair, they soon realize that the damage extended even further into the line toward the road. They at first quoted a price to fix, but I asked to talk to their supervisor James.  In discussions with him, he said, he believed Msd should be responsible for the rest of this line because it was poorly made and passed a section that typically is what Msd plumbs to.  James took the time to explain the problem more and how I could discuss this with Msd, which was a huge help. When they came out there, Roto Rooter met with Msd and helped convince them to fix the problem with the rest of the sewer pipe. I was extremely thankful at his help and diligence, which saved me over $5000 on this additional repair. I would always suggest asking lots of questions and understanding the problem, and with Rotor Rooter and James in particular, they were extremely courteous and helpful with the best communication I have had in a long time. I wish I had called Roto Rooter to come out and fix this problem before using any other plumber. Hats off to Rotor Rooter.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 133 Portage Trail Suite 102, Cuyahoga Falls, OH 44221, USA

reviews.author: Angie Best
reviews.text: My representative was Matt and he was wonderful!! He was quick and efficient and left everything clean and the way it was. He was a life saver! We had water backed up thru the whole house for a week straight. Thank you so much Matt!

reviews.author: Denis Carter
reviews.text: This company has outstanding technicians and equipment at a fair price.Our toilets were not flushing at all. The water was filling the bowl. Cory and Dante from Roto Rooter used a camera in our sewer line and discovered a blockage directly under a large pin oak in the middle of our front yard. They attempted jetting it with a super high psi jet head, but the blockage was due to large roots that had infiltrated the sewer pipe at the joints. Undaunted, they pulled that machine out and brought out a root cutter unit which did the job. They jetted it once more and it was perfect. These two technicians, Cory and Dante, were amazing. They knew exactly how to tackle a serious problem and were polite, hard working, and consummate professionals. I will use Roto-Rooter for all my plumbing needs from now on.

reviews.author: Lisa Rene' DeBenedictis
reviews.text: I called and left a message and they returned my call promptly.  I had water backing up in my basement and they sent Jesse to the rescue within an hour.  He was very responsive and respectful and explained every step of the process.  He cleaned everything up and fixed the issue with ease ( tree roots). I highly recommend this establishment.

reviews.author: Ryan Strauss
reviews.text:
I had a badly clogged kitchen sink and called this Roto-Rooter for help. Nick showed up on time, explained what was causing the blockage, and cleared it out quickly without any hassle. Super professional, reasonably priced, and made sure everything was running perfectly before leaving.
Highly recommend if you need someone reliable and skilled!

reviews.author: Valencia Walters
reviews.text: Roto Rooter provided an overall good experience. Quick scheduling appointments. The plumber James provided great customer service and quality work. I had a clogged toilet from a dislodged toy. James was knowledgeable about plumbing, provided details explaining the different options and process, and openly disclosed pricing. He work diligently and eventually was able to unclogged the toilet by removing the toilet and extracting the object. He was professional and worked efficiently. He cleaned up his work area when finished which was a plus.  I would recommend roto rooter and will definitely be using their services in the future.

plumbers.name: Miracle Man Plumbing Inc.
plumbers.address: 3501 N Dale Dr, Prescott Valley, AZ 86314, USA

reviews.author: Jessup Goldbergcook
reviews.text:
The owner, Caleb, is an outstanding guy. I had called to ask a few questions about relighting a water heater that was giving me some trouble. He patiently walked me through the steps over the phone, and I was able to get the water heater lit with no problems at all. It’s rare to find someone so willing to take the time to help.
I would highly recommend Miracle Man Plumbing to anyone in the area who wants to hire a company they can truly rely on. Their professionalism, honesty, and genuine customer care really set them apart. 5 Stars!!!

reviews.author: Rusty Brown
reviews.text: I contacted Miracle man on 2/25/26 and was immediately put on the books for a free estimate the next day. Ron came out and he was efficient and personable from the get go. He did a wonderful job and was able to fix our problem at the time of the estimate. The price was very reasonable. I would recommend Ron and Miracle Man to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Rick Ulmer
reviews.text: Caleb, Michael and Neil are a fantastic team. I would refer them to anyone and without a doubt Miracle Man Plumbing would give the task 110% effort.  Caleb was given a difficult task of finding a leak in the main sewage drain, dug down six feet in a small front yard.  His team had a “Can Do” attitude the three days they worked.  Pulled out boulders and huge roots to clear the drain.  This problem affected all water related appliances in the house.  Prior to leaving, the team ensured all appliances were cleared and the huge mess was cleaned up. I also need to give Stephanie a member of admin staff a positive shout out.  She kept us informed and ensured we were billed accurately.  Outstanding job!   If you need a miracle accomplished call Miracle Man Plumbing.

reviews.author: Michael Harrington
reviews.text:
We needed a gas plumber for our new gas stove.  We had an prior issue with the gas connection we had and needed it modified quickly due to kitchen renovations.  We called on a Saturday thinking we would leave a message, and were very surprised to have a very pleasant woman to answer the phone. She scheduled an appointment for us for the following Monday morning (Federal Holiday).

Ron arrived on time and was able to troubleshoot the problem and he gave us a reasonable estimate to repair it.  He went out, bought the necessary parts, and quickly solved our issue.  Ron was polite, professional, shows great pride in his work, and was excellent to work with.  The repair was done efficiently for a very reasonable price.  For any future plumbing needs (gas or water) we will DEFINITELY choose Miracle Man.  We highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Jake Eddy

reviews.author: Les S
reviews.text: Our technician evaluated and fixed our rooftop unit while keeping us informed throughout the process. We appreciated his knowledge and timeliness.

Without reservation they will be the first call I make for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Anna Johnson Woodford
reviews.text:
I had a utility sink in my laundry room that I wanted to move/replace with a cabinet/sink combo; Ben came out to give me an estimate and after chatting for a couple minutes, let me know he might be able to do the work right away, and possibly for lower than the initial estimate, if he had the supplies in his truck.

After checking his truck he confirmed he had all the necessary parts on hand and immediately got to work.  Within 2 hours of showing up he had upgraded the two copper pipes to PVC and moved all the plumbing lines over so it would align with the new cabinet position.

To top it off, when the water was turned back on he heard a whining sound, indicating air was trapped somewhere in a water line, and he didn’t leave until the source was found.

Ben was honest, considerate, thorough, and an all around pleasure to work with.  I highly recommend him and Blair’s Plumbing Repair.

Would highly recommend both Steven and Sosa Plumbing and will call them with any furture plumbing needs I might have.

reviews.author: Juli Butler
reviews.text: Excellent service from Jason at Sosa Plumbing. He showed up on time, was professional and courteous, and clearly knew what he was doing. He replaced a kitchen faucet and an outdoor spigot efficiently, explained the work, and didn’t waste time. Everything was done right the first time, no mess, no surprises. This is how a plumber should operate. I wouldn’t hesitate to use Jason again or recommend him to anyone needing plumbing work.

reviews.author: Demian Saffer
reviews.text: Jason was out to my house twice - for two separate issues with clogs in cast iron pipe under the slab (once on Friday and again for a different line on Monday...when it rains, it pours, I guess). On both occasions, he was efficient, communicative about what he was seeing with the camera and in explaining what he was doing, and professional. In both cases, augering the lines was not sufficient to release the clogs, and camera work and hydro-jetting was needed to clear them. I especially appreciate that there was no attempt to upsell services or use scare tactics on the customer - it actually seemed like he was "on my team" here, and wanted to sort out the issues as quickly as possible as opposed to hoping to pad the work and hours on the job. All in all, I am very happy with Sosa and Jason's work. They'll be my go-to from here on out.

reviews.author: TJ
reviews.text: Sosa services has been amazing since I moved into my new home in Feb 2023. They came out quickly, within days of my inquiry and installed my softener and filter. I called at 8:30am and spoke with the staff at Devlin.  They were very polite and easy to work with.  By noon, Preston showed up to inspect the unit and emailed me the estimate.  I made a decision late that afternoon to go with Devlin and they set me up with an appointment very quickly the following morning.

Preston showed up for the install right on time.  Very professional and knowledgeable.  In less than 2 hours, the work was complete and I had a brand new water heater.  The expenses that they originally quoted were right on.   Devlin made the process very easy.  From the staff in the office to the service team, everyone was great to work with.

This is my new go to company for anything plumbing. I'll definitely be using them again in the future.

reviews.author: Kelli Quinn
reviews.text: I had a cook top installed and I smelled a faint smell of gas and called Atmos gas company (first mistake) they came out and said my cook top lines needed tightened but stated when they cut it off at the stove my gas was still going so they turned my gas off in my entire house stating that I had a leak without having me turn off my appliances including my heat. This was 12/23 right before Christmas and took my meter which meant I had to get a leak inspection from a licensed plumber and a city inspection which is very costly. I couldn’t get anyone to come out due to the holidays and the earliest I could get someone was 12/31 which was Swat plumbing (do not recommend) and they was trying to charge an ungodly amount and what they described needed to be done for a leak inspection was not what I googled and said it would take 4 to 6 hours(not true) but I prayed about it and called Benjamin Franklin plumbing the lady said she could get somebody out TODAY!! When I tell you ATHENS CLINKSCALE IS AN ANGEL I mean it, he not only fixed my issue he calls with me and spoke with Atmos (Gas company) and explained that the technician that came out did not diagnose the gas issue properly and that I should not be charged for a permit and convinced them to turn my gas back on that night within an hour I was up an running. In today’s society you don’t find honest companies like this or customer service. This was NEW YEARS EVE! and he did try to price gouge me or get over this company is definitely a HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!! and Athen is definitely a great asset to any company!

He walked me through everything step by step, gave wonderful insight, but didn't make me feel obligated to commit to anything right away like other plumbers/technicians I've worked with. He is clearly invested into doing what's best for the homeowner, but was also realistic about expectations and understanding of the realities people face when they suddenly have an unexpected large expense. 10/10 would work with Athens again.

reviews.author: Gabrielle Alper
reviews.text: So happy to have found a quality and reliable plumber right in my neighborhood!! I had a few plumbers come by to check out an odd issue with the showers in the house we just moved into. Prior to Warrior coming to visit, other plumbers just looked at it without taking it apart, and then said it would need to be replaced in full. Which was not only costly, but time consuming. They were also SUPER affordable and Brent was upfront about the cost and process. We will definitely use Warrior again when we need plumbing work.

reviews.author: Nancy Sherman
reviews.text: We are grateful beyond words for the consistently excellent work and high level of commitment to their customers that the  talented, knowledgeable and, very importantly, totally trustworthy team at Warrior Plumbing brings to each and every job. Most recently, just days before the snow and ice storm (Fern) would cover Baltimore, I was told by another plumbing company, after two expensive part replacements and days of no heat in the house in mid December, that they were going to "red tag" our boiler (more days of ho heat in the house just before the January storm), and that they would leave a contract for us to sign for the purchase and installation of a new boiler. If we wanted to move forward, a signature and partial payment would be expected - all on a job where little inspection of the existing unit happened and no reason for the red-tagging existed. I knew that I had to, at the least, get a second and maybe third estimate on the cost of a new boiler. I called Warrior initially for just this estimate. After speaking with Brent and letting him know what had transpired with the first plumbing company, he offered to have someone come out the next morning and take a look at what might be going on. Dave and a colleague arrived at my house - did a simple, but essential inspection of the unit - correctly observed the new pricey parts the other plumber had installed in December - and, saw one part that was in good shape but had two bolts missing that would keep it standing upright. A schematic of the inside of my boiler - pulled from Dave's back pocket - and, some very smart observational skills and knowledge of my boiler - allowed Dave to have the boiler up and running again with the installation of two bolts, which he had on hand in his truck. Our heat has worked better in the past two weeks than on any day in my recent memory. And, I was able to tear up an estimate from the former plumber for $11,400. Whether Dave is a super-smart professional or an angel dropped down from heaven, I don't know. I am inclined to believe he is both. I am deeply grateful every day for the professionals and people that I have met and have had the pleasure of working with at Warrior. Their work is more than solid; and, as individuals, they, too, are more than solid - really good people - genuinely proud of what they do - proud, especially, to do an honest day's work, and very proud when they can help you resolve your problems. Some companies say that you will be safer with them; but, Warrior really cares - about their work, about you, and about keeping the good reputation for excellence and honesty they have earned from grateful customers in Baltimore. Thank you so much, Brent and Dave! I've got you on "speed dial" - lol - the rest of Baltimore should, too!

reviews.text: I called Four Seasons for service on my furnace that had stopped working the previous night. My  7 p.m. call was answered right away by a very professional woman. reviews.author: A H
reviews.text:
Update, they reached out and said they would refund the date he came out for service.
The “one-year no breakdown guarantee” seems to mean very little. I had preventative maintenance done last week and was told everything looked good. This week, my furnace stopped working.

A technician came out, checked it, replaced the filter (with my filter — the previous one was only three weeks old), reset the rollout switch, and charged me $300. There was no repair made and no explanation for why the furnace was shutting off on safety. When I questioned the $214 portion of the charge since nothing was repaired and no root cause was identified, I was told, “It wasn’t running when I got here, but it’s running now.”

I called customer service to ask what the point of the breakdown guarantee was. They agreed I should not have been charged the $85 fee and said they would credit a portion of my bill because they believe in good customer service.

A couple of hours later, my furnace would not shut off. I called again and was told they could send a senior technician and waive the $85 fee. At that point, I decided I no longer wanted to continue service.

It turns out the technician left a jumper on my furnace, which is why it was running continuously. Leaving a jumper in place can cause additional long-term issues. So in the end, I paid $300 for a reset, no diagnosis, and a mistake that might have caused further damage.

Customer service was polite, but between the unclear guarantee, charges without clear repair, and the technician error, this was not a good experience. I will not be using this company again.

reviews.text: I am a licensed principal broker in Or. I contacted A-1 Plumbing to inquire about getting a quote for repairs that were called out in a home inspection report. I received a call from the owner and I explained again what we needed. I told him we needed someone to go in to the crawlspace to provide us a quote for work that was found in our home inspection. We wanted someone to look at the drain lines as they were done incorrectly. He said he is on his way to the house. reviews.author: Cordell Walker
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience with 1-Tom-Plumber from start to finish. They answered my call right away after I discovered my old water heater was leaking, which honestly caught me off guard since it was only about 8 years old. I had a big bulky 75-gallon Richmond power-vent water heater, and by the time I noticed the issue, water was leaking throughout my basement.

To make matters worse, some of my existing plumbing lines were already corroded and beginning to leak as well. I went a full week without hot water while trying to figure out the best long term solution, which was incredibly stressful.

When 1-Tom-Plumber came out, they were professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain all of my replacement options without pressure. After talking it through, I decided to upgrade to a tankless “endless hot water” system. I’m so glad I did.

The new system works amazingly well. I never run out of hot water, and unlike traditional systems, it doesn’t require a specific hard-water softener, so I didn’t have to invest in an additional water softening system. It also doesn’t require costly yearly flushes, which was a huge plus for me.

On top of that, the system comes with a 15-year manufacturer warranty and is made right here in America, which gave me even more confidence in my decision. The workmanship was truly top-notch, the installation was clean, and everything was explained clearly along the way.

I’m extremely happy with my experience and the upgrade. If you’re dealing with water heater issues or considering going tankless, I highly recommend 1-Tom-Plumber. They made a stressful situation so much easier and delivered excellent results.

reviews.author: nodiva10
reviews.text:
We placed a service call with Mr. Rooter to address a plumbing issue in our home. On June 3, 2025, a plumber named Brandon came out to diagnose the problem. He first ran a camera through our toilet and showed me something black on the screen that he said was causing the backup. He then checked our crawl space and found a test plug on the line that had been left from when our home was built by Ryan Homes. He removed the plug and charged us $235 for that repair.

After that, without us specifically requesting it, Brandon ran a camera through our exterior sewer line. He asked my husband to look at the camera footage and pointed out what he claimed was a crack in the sewer line. My husband told him he did not see what Brandon was describing. Brandon stated that rainwater could be entering the line and causing backups and emphasized that heavy rain was expected over the weekend. He created a sense of urgency and told us we needed to fix the issue immediately. He also discussed financing options. Trusting his professional opinion, we agreed to the repair, which he quoted at over $12,000.

He scheduled the repair for the very next day. On June 4, 2025, Mr. Rooter dug up part of our driveway to reach the sewer line, which was approximately nine feet deep. Brandon claimed the pipe was broken at the elbow where it enters the ground. While they were digging, I went outside to take photos because we wanted to see the damaged pipe ourselves. The contractor told me to go back inside for safety reasons. While observing the open hole, I did not see any water or smell any sewage. We later asked for photos of the alleged broken pipe, but none clearly showed any damage. The first set of photos Brandon provided were blurry and pixelated, and the supposed break was not visible. This was the reason I wanted to view it in person.

After the work was completed, our yard was left in poor condition. We had to call them back to return and address the damage they caused to our front yard.

Based on our experience, we feel that Mr. Rooter used pressure tactics and fear based urgency to convince us to authorize an expensive repair that may not have been necessary. We believe we were charged over $12,000 for a sewer line repair that may not have been needed. We felt misled and taken advantage of.

Afterward, we researched the company and found many similar complaints from other customers mentioning inflated pricing, unnecessary repairs, and high pressure sales tactics.

Our next door neighbors also had a concerning experience with the same plumber, Brandon. They called Mr. Rooter for a small bathroom leak. The company tore out their living room ceiling and part of their kitchen but still could not locate the leak after two days. Brandon provided them with a $1,500 estimate to repair both their master and guest bathrooms, even though only the master bathroom had an issue. Frustrated, they hired another plumbing company, which quickly located the leak in the master bathroom. Mr. Rooter then billed their homeowner’s insurance $10,000 for the damage caused during their unsuccessful attempt. Their insurance company informed them that the charges appeared excessive.

After learning about our neighbors’ experience, we became even more concerned that we had also been overcharged and pressured into unnecessary work.

We strongly encourage others to be cautious and to seek second opinions before agreeing to major repairs with this company. In our experience, the pricing, sales tactics, and services provided did not feel transparent or trustworthy.

reviews.author: S Berry
reviews.text:
1★ — Lost fastener, improper reassembly, higher power bills, and poor follow-through

I contracted Philbrick Inc. Heating & Cooling for routine cleaning and maintenance on a system I purchased from them for approximately $8,000, and for which I’ve paid hundreds more over the years for service. The technician who performed the service lost a manufacturer-specific fastener and reassembled the enclosure improperly. One corner of the cover was left with about a ½-inch gap, which allowed a significant amount of cooled air to escape into my attic throughout the hottest part of the summer, increasing my electric bill.

I discovered the problem months later while replacing the filter. I called Philbrick the next day and requested they correct their mistake. It took approximately four days to get a technician on site. He confirmed a fastener was indeed missing and attempted to fabricate a substitute. Lacking the right part and skill for that task, he ended up taping the corner of the door—a stopgap that still leaked air. He said he would try to scavenge the correct fastener from an old unit back at their facility and “take care of it.”

Instead, I was told I owed roughly $100 for this visit, despite the issue originating with their prior service. After multiple calls, I spoke briefly with the owner, who said he would investigate and get back to me. He never did, the service call was in June. About two weeks later when I called for an update, the receptionist told me the charge had been waived and she'd leave a message with he owner, but no one has ever followed up about the missing fastener or the energy loss.

Today, I went into the attic myself with a flashlight, mirror, and magnet. In about 30 minutes I located the original fastener inside the unit and repaired the enclosure properly. I should not have had to do this.

Based on this experience—poor workmanship, delay in response, an inadequate temporary fix, an attempted charge for their error, and no meaningful follow-through—I cannot recommend Philbrick Inc. Heating & Cooling.

reviews.author: Clyde Miller
reviews.text:
Stellar Plumbing and Ken Saved Our Dream Home!
I had a serious plumbing emergency at my brand-new house—the dream home I was so excited about. Due to a high water table, the basement's sump pump setup, which was originally installed by a realtor that thinks he is a contractor (isn't good at either occupation), was running constantly (every 3.5 minutes!), destined to burn out and cause a major flood. I was incredibly nervous that I had bought a house that would constantly flood.

Fortunately, I know the owner of Stellar Plumbing, and they immediately sent out Ken. Ken has 16 years of experience in plumbing and even more in the trades, and his expertise was immediately apparent. He not only quickly assessed the faulty setup but also took the time to calm me down and walk me through the comprehensive solution.

This was a mini-construction project involving a deeper pit and a dual-pump solution with completely redone piping. While it was a significant investment, Ken assured me that his experience with similar projects meant this was the permanent fix I needed.

The results are astounding: our new system is robust, reliable, and the pumps now alternate, running only about every 15 minutes. I feel 100% more confident that my home is protected and has the right system in place. If you have any serious plumbing concerns, especially with water management, I can't recommend Ken and Stellar Plumbing highly enough. They are true professionals who deliver lasting peace of mind!

reviews.author: JOHN GROSS
reviews.text: I had Stellar out to give me a bid on a backup for our sump pump as well as a few other plumbing jobs.  They were very courteous, professional and knowledgable. reviews.author: Josh Stephens
reviews.text: They tried to say I had a broken sewer and wanted to dig up my yard and charge me $18500 for a full sewer line replacement. I have a warrenty for the sewer and water line I'd gotten through the village of Streamwood so I contacted them and they sent out another plumber (Center Gaurd Plumbing) to inspect the line. They cleared the blockage and revealed that Stellar didn't even map out the sewer line properly. When I brought these finding to Stellar they said that the plumber that came after didn't do a good job and that stellars efforts initially made it easier for the next guy to completely clear the line. Lol. So by that logic if their guy just stayed working at the clog he made (cause it wasn't backing up befor he meddle with it) they would have been able to clear it. I assume they gave up becuase they saw a way to make an easy $9k-18500. And I say that because the whole time this is happening Carlos was trying to sell me financing not realizing my warrenty would cover the cost of any and all repairs. Just really disappointing as the work they did was pricey but still adequate, I didn't mind paying extra if the job is done right but I do cross a line when you try to pull one over on me. Stellars guy didn't even map my sewer line out correctly if I had needed to use them they would have been poking holes in my yard like a geek squad installer trying to mount a TV on my wall. I thought this was a professional outfit but they couldn't even honor a partial refund when I called them out on them not finishing the job. At the end of the day it's just money I can make more but man I'd hate to have someone else pull a loan on something they don't need to.

reviews.author: maria darch
reviews.text:
A Truly Human and Professional Team

When a sewer emergency suddenly appears out of the blue at your home, it’s not just a technical problem — it’s a deeply stressful, unsettling moment. What you need most is quick help and a human touch. That’s exactly what we received from Rooter Experts.

Everest was incredibly efficient, dispatching a technician to our home within 30 minutes. That alone brought huge relief. But what really stood out was the professionalism and calm expertise of Bleedi, the technician. His curiosity and methodical approach made all the difference. Step by step, he ruled out possible causes until discovering that the issue had been created by PSEG’s work the previous week, which had damaged our sewer line.

He began by carefully jet-cleaning the line to clear a path for the camera inspection, ensuring that the diagnosis was precise and nothing was left to guesswork. Throughout the process, he remained composed, clear, and kind — qualities that matter enormously when you’re facing a scary home emergency.

Even after the repair visit, Everest stayed in touch, following up to guide us through the claim process with PSEG and checking in the next day to make sure everything was still okay. That kind of care is rare.

Rooter Experts combines technical excellence with genuine humanity, and in moments of crisis, that makes all the difference. We couldn’t recommend them more highly.

reviews.author: Ashlee Frye
reviews.text: I want to start by saying how appreciative I am of this company. We had issues with our septic in a 1962 house. Come to find out the septic was completely full! DeAndre and AL came out and pumped our tank! Come to find out our tank was basically caving in on itself, pipes were bad, just all around a terrible situation. DeAndre and AL were extremely helpful getting us setup for the weekend until our tank could be replaced. They were able to get the pipes unclogged and usable while we wait out the snow. I will also say I appreciate how professional but also personable they were while they were here. Next we did have some issues with financing, however Lacey in office was able to help me each step of the way. She was very communicative and kept me updated on all of our options until we were able to work it out. Tony and Michael came out today (2/6), and got started right away. The hole was dug within an hour and they went straight to work on the tank. They installed fresh pipes, got the tank installed/leveled out, and flattened the yard back out before the end of the day. They were extremely nice and made sure we knew what they were doing. My mom and I watched throughout the day and they did such an amazing job. The skills they have using the heavy machinery and knowledge on what to do was so much appreciated. Im thankful for each of the team members that worked hard on our project. I will be using WeCo from now on for all our tank/plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Keah Sosa
reviews.text:
Edit: changing my rating from 3 to 5 stars due to the response from the owner. While the below review still stands, the owner's response was very kind and honestly unexpected. Any company that can take ownership of mistakes and try to make it right deserves a second chance.

We called WeCo Rooter on Sunday to get an issue with our septic tank fixed. All of our drains and toilets were not draining/flushing and we had some back up coming from the shower. On that call we told them we don't know where the septic tank is and that we think it needs drained. We were scheduled for Monday.

On Monday they call and say that their truck has broken down and they can't come out until tomorrow, fine that happens.
Tuesday comes and we don't hear from them until late afternoon 4-4:30pm. They come out with the truck to drain the tank, but they didn't know that it needed located first. The guy to drain it tried to call to see if anyone that locates tanks was in the area, no luck. I call the office and ask them to be first in line Wednesday morning, they can't guarantee that but said they'd put a note saying "very urgent" on our ticket.
Today we do not hear from them until I call at 9am and they are still "figuring out logistics" and said they'd call back soon with when they'll be out today. We don't hear anything so 2 hours later we call back. They say they'll have someone out within an hour. Literally an hour later someone shows up. It's now been Sunday morning to Wednesday at 12:30pm to get someone out here to fix our problem. Mind you, we had no facilities during this entire time, no water, no toilets, and they were well aware.

This is no reflection on the people who actually came out and fixed our problem today, those two men were great and very nice. This is a reflection on scheduling and admin. We paid about $1,400 for subpar service with no urgency or care from their office. We will not be using their services again. If you need anything to happen fast, do not call WeCo Rooter.

reviews.author: Ryan See
reviews.text:
Updated Review:
While I wish we didn’t experience the situation described below… mistakes happen. How someone (or a company) responds to a mistake speaks volumes. ENCO quickly reached out, explained their side of the story and listened to my concerns. In the end, they addressed the situation and demonstrated character. In the future they will be my first call.

Original review:
While the plumber who visited was timely, worked efficiently, and was very polite, I cannot recommend this company due to their questionable billing practices.

After diagnosing our leak, the plumber provided us with a clear, agreed-upon quote for the repair. We accepted this price and the work was completed quickly and effectively.

However, when it came time to pay the bill, we were told, "Oh sorry, the price is $150 more." This last-minute, unquoted increase left an extremely bad taste in my mouth. A quote should be honored, and springing a substantial, unauthorized fee on a customer after the job is done is unacceptable and feels like a classic bait-and-switch.

For this reason, I would not recommend trusting this company. I will also be sharing this experience with our realtor who recommended them, as I would not want anyone else to face this kind of last-minute price gouging.

Avoid if you value transparent and trustworthy pricing.

Another gentleman from the same company came out & found the leak outside the house, approximately 24 feet away from where they tore up the concrete inside my garage. The actual leak was found & repaired in less than an hour.
I was surprised to get an invoice from All Masters Plumbing for $5445.00 for the work they did fixing their mistake!
Previously we signed a loan thinking it was going to be a major cost but loan was not needed because it was a leak outside! Now the loan company is calling & asking why I'm rejecting this document since All Masters Plumbing submitted the loan as work completed!
I would never recommend this Plumbing company to anyone because of the misdiagnosis, shoddy repair & charging a horrendous price for repairing the damage they did! My wife & I have called several times & left messages for the manager to call back, but he never does! All I want is my bill adjusted, I shouldn't have to pay for their mistake & I would like my concrete done so it looks like it did before they wrecked it!
I'm hoping this is a mistake made by office thinking that first job was completed properly!

reviews.author: Kat Pham
reviews.text:
BEST SERVICE AND QUICK !!
Very professional work making sure customer are satisfy and happy with the works. Get everything clean out nicely and help customer with question showing steps by steps explain everything clearly for sure will recommended to many more client. Our business are very satisfy!! Thomas and Mark are very kind and friendly!!

reviews.author: Sanjiv Patel
reviews.text: Douglass came out to my house for an estimate that I requested for frequent back ups and roots in my lines. He was very informative and took the time to show me videos of what the issues were. He gave me his honest professional opinion on what repairs to focus on first. He was great.

plumbers.name: Monkey Wrench Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electric
plumbers.address: 1238 7th St #C, Santa Monica, CA 90401, USA

reviews.author: Amanda Chitarra Utami Putri
reviews.text: Had a great maintenance check-up with electrician Andrew. Monkey Wrench offered me a complimentary overall check of the electrical in my house. So that alone was was a plus. Andrew came on time, he was very polite, honest, and friendly. He checked everything in great condition and offered recommendations on how to improve on the electrical conditions. He answered all our questions and is very knowledgeable. The customer service is always quick to respond too whenever I reach out to them. Would highly recommend Andrew and Monkey Wrench!

reviews.author: Pierre Denis
reviews.text:
I called Monkey Wrench for a leaky toilet and a leaky water valve. Their technician Daniel Sanchez came in this morning and he did a great job. He was very clean, polite and quiet.
The work was done to my expectations and I would definitely use Monkey Wrench again and I would definitely ask for Daniel again.

reviews.author: Jason Goldberg
reviews.text: Andrew was wonderful, helpful, thoughtful just an all-around good guy who do what he was doing. Would definitely work with him again in a heartbeat. My wife has already made a list of other electrical work.

reviews.author: Roland Sturm
reviews.text: This company seems to have taken over some previously independent and reliable plumbers (whose websites and phone numbers and good ratings still exist, but those all go to monkey wrench). First experience with monkey wrench has been as you expect from a referral service: Aggressive push to upsell on the phone ("free" inspections, maintenance plan), then the all-too-common no show during the scheduled 4-hour window - despite them sending a message in the morning that confirmed again. Most of a work day wasted waiting for nobody.  Missing my previous plumbing company.....

reviews.author: Brian McCarthy
reviews.text: Monkey Wrench set up a schedule right away to deal with our No Hot Water issue. The technician, Louis Serrano, came promptly and was extremely knowledgeable about our Noritz waterless tank system. He analyzed and fixed the problem. He was  a pleasure to work with.

plumbers.name: Approved Plumbing Co.
plumbers.address: 770 Ken Mar Industrial Pkwy, Broadview Heights, OH 44147, USA

reviews.author: Jeff Kuchta
reviews.text: Found water leak at outside faucet,  call and got great response time. Sam came out, explained option to repair, was able to do right away. Explained what he was doing and did great professional job.Will definitely use if need plumber again.

reviews.author: Lee Ann
reviews.text: I got an appointment right away. Sam and the other worker gave me various options and did the needed repair quickly. They recalled work they had done at my property some years back and that work was also excellent. Sam was especially helpful and pleasant.

reviews.author: Robert Uniack
reviews.text: Great service!  Sam Larissey solved my problems!  Very knowledgeable technician.  He explained everything that he did thoroughly.  He has great people skills - very friendly!  Highly recommend Approved Plumbing Co.

reviews.author: Naomi Feldman
reviews.text: Wonderful service. They responded quickly and were on time and professional. They worked hard for several hours in terrible weather. They managed to unblock our very blocked drain and charged us fairly. They explained the situation and what they were doing clearly. I highly recommend and will call them again if we ever need their services again.

reviews.author: Armin Green
reviews.text: Service experience with Approved Plumbing was excellent.  The Company is knowledgeable and  responsive, fixing a complex Kohler Veil smart toilet problem.  Sam Larissey, the technician is highly recommended.

plumbers.name: Allen & Sons Plumbing and Heating
plumbers.address: 834 S Perry St, Castle Rock, CO 80104, USA

reviews.author: Connor O'Brien
reviews.text:
Clayton, the owner is an awesome human being!

I just moved back to Colorado and messed up the sprinkler blowout process. I gave him a call, scheduled the service for the next day and they had me sorted with ease.

I had referred him to my father up in highlands ranch as well, he was very happy with the quality and speed as well.

Highly recommend Allen & Sons for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Brian Codding
reviews.text:
After years of dealing with multiple plumbers, recurring leaks, and a lot of patch jobs, I finally feel like we have a real, long-term solution thanks to Wayne at Allen & Sons.

Wayne took the time to actually figure out what was going on instead of just fixing the next leak. He cleaned up a decade’s worth of prior work, quick fixes, and a pretty messy setup, and put in a well thought out solution from end to end.

His focus was on reducing long-term stress on the system, improving water quality, and making sure everything is built to last. The work in the mechanical room is especially impressive. He replaced what had become a rats nest of PEX and fittings with a clean copper install that looks and functions way better.

Wayne was also very patient throughout the process. I had a lot of questions given everything we’ve been through, and he took the time to walk me through it all.

I’d definitely recommend Wayne at Allen & Sons if you’re looking for someone who knows what they’re doing and actually fixes the problem the right way.

reviews.author: Alan Sturm
reviews.text: I got 4 bids for replacing 2 water heaters. Allen & Sons was not the cheapest, but I went with them because they were the most professional, communicated well, and were honest with me from the start. They did what they said they would do, were on time (and fast), and most importantly did a great job. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Sarah Johnsen
reviews.text:
We had an issue with water pooling at the base of one of our toilets and decided it was finally time to replace both of our old toilets. From the very first call, Allen & Sons stood out. I spoke with a real person immediately, no automated system in sight.

They offered same-day service, but worked around my schedule and came out the next morning. I got a text when Jojo was on his way, and he arrived on the early end of his two-hour window, always a win.

Jojo installed both toilets efficiently and was polite, knowledgeable, and great at explaining things throughout the process. After finishing up, he caught an issue and took care of it right away without any fuss. That kind of attention to detail really stood out.

Reasonable pricing, excellent service, and a team member who clearly takes pride in his work. We will absolutely be calling Allen & Sons again!

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.text: JoJo came to help us identify the cause of the pinhole leaks we keep getting our pipes and installed a new pressure regulator to reduce the water pressure.  He was straightforward and got the fix done professionally.  I recommend Allen & Sons!

plumbers.name: Mr. Twister Plumbing & Septic
plumbers.address: 3101 Church St, Hellertown, PA 18055, USA

reviews.author: Mark Morales
reviews.text: Took the time to explain my issue and the cause as well as the solution. Mr Twister went above and beyond exceptional service. My service tech was a well mannered professional who really knew his stuff. If ever needed, no hesitation to have Mr Twister back in my home.

reviews.author: Cydni Ticktin
reviews.text: Mr Twister was able to get us in same day for an emergent issue. Our Technician Mark was absolutely amazing. He took his time to explain and educate us with all of our options and helped create a plan to fix our issue. He was personable, understanding and incredibly helpful. Could not have asked for a better experience.

reviews.author: Linda Smith
reviews.text:
Fantastic work!! This was our first time using Mr. Twister and we are very pleased with their work. After Freddy came out and gave us an estimate on 2 options with reasonable prices we decided to have our 2 (50 yr old) bathrooms redone. Bob K, Bob, Steve, Rob and Jacob K are the guys that worked on the project. They were always on time and cleaned up each day. When it was completed we were extremely happy with our new bathrooms!!  We will definitely refer Mr. Twister to our friends and family. Thank you all for a job well done!
Attached before and after pictures

reviews.author: Matt Keretz
reviews.text: Great job by Luke and the Twister company! Super friendly, talked me through my options, and was super knowledgeable about what was being done. Also, let me know of things to look out for down the road! Thank you again!

reviews.author: Royā Retreat
reviews.text: Mr. Twister has been handling various jobs at my property over the past year, and I can’t recommend them highly enough. They and their team are consistently professional, clear in their communication, and always show up on time. Their pricing is fair, and most importantly, they’re extremely trustworthy — which is rare to find. Every project has been completed with care and attention to detail. It’s a huge relief knowing I can rely on Mr. Twister. Highly recommended.

plumbers.name: Action Plumbing, Heating and Cooling
plumbers.address: 96 Obrien Dr, Crossville, TN 38555, USA

reviews.author: janet harrington
reviews.text:
Jacob and fellow technician did an excellent job cleaning our gas furnace of mold, installing the uv light and cleaning our ductwork. They arrived on time and worked throughout the afternoon, explaining the processes needed for the cleaning. Both young men were very polite, diligent and expertly executed their jobs.
We are extremely satisfied with the work being done by Action at our home.

reviews.author: Elroy Boles
reviews.text: Our service on our HVAC was performed by Jerret who was a super nice guy. He arrived on time and was very professional. He was very good with explaining what work he was going to perform. He made sure we were satisfied with everything before leaving. Thumbs up to Jerret. Thanks

reviews.author: Ray Fumi
reviews.text:
Action technician David Flynn arrive promptly as set up for a service call.  My tankless water heater was not recirculating the water efficiently.  When the hot water supply was turned on at a faucet, it took several minutes for hot water to arrive.  David working through several diagnostic test, determined my system needed an upgrade to the fresh air intake vent.  David got to work and within one hour he completed the task.
David Flynn was very professional and courteous.  Ray F.

reviews.author: Tim O'Hara
reviews.text:
Brandon Payne came out for our initial visit to asses our HVAC system and talk about Action's maintenance plan. He was a terrific ambassador for Action, loads of experience and extremely polite! Very easy connection and felt very good about beginning our relationship with him and Action. We also thought Dawn (the representative with which spoke on the phone for the appointment) was excellent and polite! Absolutely recommend!

The Installation...
After 17 years on our old HVAC system it was showing signs of need for replacement. Got (3) quotes and ultimately chose Action Heating and Cooling (Crossville, TN) for a number of reasons to include excellent communication between us and Brandon our project manager multiple times, and the quality of the brand name they recommended (Trane). Price was not the cheapest, but it was their work ethic, rapid personal response, and investment in their quality technicians that made the difference initially, as well as expectations for the future care and maintenance of our system. Zac, Jordan and Austin did not disappoint us! They were exceptionally polite, respectful, skilled and knowledgeable in their craft! The entire process of removal of the old and installation of the new could not have been more smooth and seamless. They spent a great deal of time in the end (when surely tired from a long day), explaining and setting up the new thermostat controls and making sure all systems worked as expected. Those guys gave us great confidence that we made the right choice in Action. It's been a few weeks now and we are most pleased with everything!  Highly recommend Action and this team!  5-stars!  Thanks again guys!  -Tim

reviews.author: Beth Gower
reviews.text: Brandon did an excellent job of explaining all he does for his inspection. He was prompt, personal and thorough.   We are very satisfied with our 2nd inspection for the year.  We signed up for another year at the Home Show today.

plumbers.name: H2O PRO Plumbing
plumbers.address: 4795 Bethlehem Rd Ste E, Richmond, VA 23230, USA

reviews.author: Kristen Montgomery
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying I’m big on first impressions!
The two gentlemen Kevin and Wayne from H20 pro were very kind , relatable , and very knowledgeable! They had our issue found and resolved fully within two hours, if that ! They had supplies and were ready to work as soon as we gave the okay ! Prices were fair especially for the last minute task I threw at them lol
They helped us prepare for a winter storm that was coming and we’re really there for us ! I HIGHLY recommend this small business to anyone for plumbing needs ! They’re newer to the area and really came through and impressed ! They were also very kind with my dog as well, our pup approved as well ! CHECK THEM OUT !

reviews.author: Lafaun Cain

I appreciate him and his partner (I believe his name is Josh...) taking the time to ensure that the installation was done right.  Both were very professional, and did an amazing job!!

reviews.author: Chris L.
reviews.text: H2O Pro Plumbing came out to replace my old hot water heater that went bad.  When initially reaching out to them, they responded back very quickly.  They were friendly, professional and very knowledgeable while installing a new replacement.  The guys were extremely cautious in protecting my home from damages during the repair.  I highly recommend this plumbing company and would use them again.  Without hesitation, I totally give Jason, Omar and Christian 5-Star ratings for a job well done…!!  Kudos from a happy camper…!!

reviews.text:
