reviews.text: Staff was very professional & very courteous while installing a new septic drain field for me. I would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Shawn Schroder
reviews.text: We called these guys on a Sunday afternoon because they advertise many places that they don't charge extra nights and weekends never over time fees etc. they proceeded to tell me that there's $159 fee for after hours despite the fact that they say all over the place that they don't charge extra fees for nights and weekends. I called twice and they just brushed it off and told me they didn't know why I was seeing that and in fact they said I should stay away from companies like that because they have hidden fees and won't do a good job. Then the second time I talked to Jorge I eventually beat it out of him and he basically told me that because they are an independently owned franchise that they can basically do what they want and they choose to charge a fee. Even though their corporate rules are that they don't charge overtime fees, he said he could send somebody out first thing in the morning on Monday and wave the dispatch fee I don't know if they normally charge a dispatch fee on normal business hours. So they came out were there for 45 minutes or so and easily snaked the drain got it cleared then told me that I should pay an extra $295 for the camera snake. I said yeah ok let's do it. He said the big man supervisor with emphasis to make it sound like it was a big deal. We needed the supervisor to come check it out. He assured me that the guy would be back that same day then they even called me and said between 4:00 and 5:00. I said okay so I waited all day and they called me right about 5:00 and said that they were running late they would come between 11:00 and 1:00 tomorrow, I said I will be at work I took today off for this. He asked me well how about Wednesday and how about Thursday I told him what my schedule was and he said he would check with his guys and give me a call back in a half hour never called me back. Might I add they also charged me for this service ahead of time and then just blew me off never called me or anything. I eventually told them yesterday that I wanted a refund and then all of a sudden magically they were planning on coming there that afternoon. I said no you're not I'm not there I'm 100 mi away at work. I am pissed off and just want a refund I don't tolerate disrespect and wasting my time. He agreed to give me a refund but then also told me that there is something going on in there and that I need to have it checked out and fixed. They are just trying to upsell everybody on everything that they don't need for something that's very common in almost all homes. They did give me a refund. Next time I will take care of it myself or call somebody else that isn't going to be deceitful and take advantage of people.

reviews.text: If you’ve got a gas leak, call Matrix and ask for Eddie. He was onsite fast, handled the repairs in a day, and was incredibly easy to deal with. He took the 'scare' out of the situation and charged a very fair price. I’m a very satisfied homeowner with total peace of mind!

reviews.author: Hugh Harris
reviews.text: Huge thanks to Matrix Plumbing! Brad arrived exactly when he said he would, found that our “leak” was just a loose, corroded pipe connection, and fixed it fast, saving us from a costly repair. He also replaced two toilets for us later on. Super professional, honest, and friendly.  At no time did I think I was being up sold.   Great experience all around!

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience with Matrix Plumbing! I noticed a water leak under my master bathroom sinks and called them for help. Jason arrived promptly and quickly identified the issue. He fixed it in under an hour, which was such a relief since I was worried it might be something major. I’m really happy with the service and highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Grace Bauer
reviews.text: Finding a gas leak is an immediate panic moment, but Eddie from Matrix Plumbing was a total lifesaver. He arrived fast, clearly knew his stuff, and had a way of calming my nerves instantly. He finished the entire job in just one day at a very fair price. I finally have my peace of mind back—thanks for being a pro, Eddie!

plumbers.name: Berks Plumbing & HVAC Specialist
plumbers.address: 201 E Bellevue Ave Building 1A, Reading, PA 19605, USA

reviews.author: Enrique Mentado Sosa
reviews.text: Mike, Ethan, Jose, and Bradley were a fantastic group of guys to work with. They made getting rid of a leaking water heater a breeze even though they had little to no room to work in. They also installed a brand new tankless water heater system. They were able to get the job done in a single day! 100% will be calling Berks for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Josh Keim
reviews.text: We had an exemplary experience overall, quick response time through the whole process, I felt like a valued customer through and through. After they helped with a tub remodel, they came back to help me with another issue the next day and free of charge. Jose and Ethan were professional and great with our dog as they came in and out of the home. They left no mess behind a big job.

reviews.author: Jeff Lange
reviews.text: Berks plumbing has our business for life, You can’t beat the timely response and care from them. Called at 8pm at night and Mike was there next morning EARLY, which is very rare nowadays. Assessed everything, had Blake and Jose come out within the hour and was done in under 2 hours. Calls berks plumbing they WILL take care of you. 🫡

reviews.author: Just Me
reviews.text:
Excellent service! We recently moved back to Berks and the plumber I used in the 70's has retired. After looking over the reviews, i chose Berks Plumbing and are so glad I did!! Immediate response, quick consultation and installation on the same day!
Everyone I dealt with was super friendly, polite and professional!
Blake and Travis did a wonderful job on the installation of my new kitchen faucet with no mess! Mike helped me pick out exactly what needed! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Kim Lechuga
reviews.text: Called after dinner time,  pleasantly surprised to have someone answer the phone!  Someone came the next morning and despite not getting the news I wanted,  which was a quick easy answer, they had the guys here fixing my plumbing almost right away.  Nice, non-intrusive,  clean, and professional work.  Can't ask for more than that.   Great experience minus actually needing the repair work!

plumbers.name: Home Love Plumbing
plumbers.address: 51 S Main Ave #301, Clearwater, FL 33765, USA

reviews.author: Bernadette Homan
reviews.text: Very responsive company, easy to work with.   Plumbers and office staff (Lisa) are all very helpful, respectful and courteous.   Highly recommend. 10.1.25  Julio and Cameron did an excellent job.  Replaced corroded plumbing under driveway to get me back up and running.   Dealt with issues for 2 months and apparently all is well.  Julio repaired the driveway very close to original.  He also added a cleanout on ground level so future they didn't need to climb on roof. I am happy.  If I need plumber again I will definitely ask for Julio.   He and Cameron were polite, respectful of me and my home.  I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Tran The man
reviews.text: The service we got with Adam was professional and effective. He didn't leave until the issue (clog) was resolved.  He took the Time to explain everything he was doing and gave us suggestions on how to maintain the drain lines.  Thanks again Adam!

reviews.author: Nancy R
reviews.text: The team at Home Love Plumbing did an excellent job replacing one of our water heater and flushing the other. Bri was great in scheduling the work and kept us up to date. Julio and Jared were very helpful, conscientious and professional. I would highly recommend them for any plumbing work!

reviews.author: Martin Morrison
reviews.text:
The pipe to our hose split near the wall.  Adam from Home Love Plumbing came over that same evening to prepare an estimate.  He returned the Nex day with a second plumber, Ivan.  They chipped open the wall to access the pipe, replaced the damaged section and hose shutoff.  The guys explained everything they were doing and asked if we had repair preferences.  Plus, they had a good sense of humor.  Additionally, Bree in the office was very helpful from start to finish.

I will certainly call for their help again if I need it and recommend others consider using them also.

reviews.author: Bud Haimbaugh
reviews.text: Employee showed up on time and addressed the problem and provided a reasonable quote and went to work fixing the issue! Cleaned up the area and took care of the problem and did some extra cleaning ofthe plugged up toilet! They are going to be our plumbers on file !

plumbers.name: In & Out Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1139 Browns Point Blvd NE, Tacoma, WA 98422, USA

reviews.author: Kellie Hamblin
reviews.text: Ivan and Jorge from In and Out Plumbing came over on a Saturday morning to check out an issue. I’m a first-time customer. I found them via a neighborhood page on Facebook where they were very highly rated by numerous customers. I also found them very professional, efficient, honest, thorough and reasonably priced! They even offered a do it yourself option and told me where to get a specific tool. Although the fix seemed straightforward, I appreciated them so much by that time I wanted them to have the work. They are definitely now my go to for all plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Laura Elgar
reviews.text: I was able to get a service member out to my home the same day I called. Ivan was very diligent in spending time to try to solve the problem the most simple and cost effective way. We did end up needing to replace an entire pipe, but he stayed on the job and spent the next couple hours on the job so that I could have a usable sink again. Very impressed with his diligence and service.

reviews.author: selena thompson
reviews.text: Rigo has been my plumber for over eight years. I have appreciated his honesty and workmanship. He has replaced almost all plumbing needs in my home to include a new expansion tank. New hose bibs new garbage disposal, Replaced all hot and cold water valves to bring my home up to code and during a plumbing emergency reconstructed the plumbing for a shower project.  What I appreciate the most about this family run business is their upfront pricing and clear written estimates. They’re also willing to answer any questions that you have about the work to be done as well as the pricing for their services the labor and materials. I am proud to be a part of the in and out plumbing consumer family congratulations on your new location here in northeast Tacoma!

reviews.author: Carol Landers
reviews.text:
We knew who to call immediately when we had an unexpected leak!  In & Out Plumbing did a great job for us last year.  We were blessed to have Ivan & Junior to do the job.  We have an old house, actually it was built about the same year we were born so there are always the unexpected problems and we appreciate businesses that are fair and "get the job done right".
We had a leak under our cottage and with the direction of Ivan and Junior, they suggested that we re-route the plumbing instead of jack hammering the floor. We are so thrilled with the results!  Ivan and Junior are both skilled in their trade, they were always thoughtful of the inconvenience, they took the time to explain the work, and they left the work area looking great.
We highly recommend Ivan and Junior for any plumbing problem.
We decided to also remodel the shower in the cottage at the same time, and we are so glad we did this, as there were complications from work that was done in 2007.  We are thankful that the job has been done right.  Omar did a beautiful job of the tile in the shower.  We also had a water hydrant installed next to our garden.  Our unexpected leak has turned into a "blessing".

Doc wants to add:  The best communication with In & Out for arrival and departure times.  Great Communication.  Kind Crew.
They provided perks to help two old people through the process.
After our 38 years in business, they will Always be our "Go To"!

reviews.author: Christine Elliott
reviews.text: working with a short time frame and urgent need. They were at work every day by 9 am and finished their work day by 5. Very mindful and respectful of my home and personal space. Completed the job as scheduled and we are very happy with the finished product

plumbers.name: Payless Water Heaters and Tankless Water Heaters
plumbers.address: 37370 Cedar Blvd, Newark, CA 94560, USA

reviews.author: Alpa Gandhi
reviews.text:
I had called Payless as there was some noise coming from our hot water system. They came on the same day after giving us lots of information about whom to expect and around what time. We were sent a photo id of the person coming. Donovan G arrived on time , had a thorough look and gave us advice on what our options were and based on that, we decided best option was to get the system changed. He very quickly gave us a quote and organized a time to come the next day in the morning so we could get hot water as soon as possible.
Joel and Eduardo had helped him on the two days. They arrived earlier than their time, fixed the system, explained in detail what work was carried out, what to do in case of an emergency. Also explained in detail what the cost was. They left as quietly as they arrived and left the place very clean.

reviews.author: Matt S.
reviews.text: Overall fantastic experience. Scheduling was fast and easy. They let me know exactly when Tristan would arrive and he arrived right on time. He discovered serious issues with my existing water heater and walked me through my options. The options were good and flexible to my needs. Tristan had everything he needed and installed everything same day within about 4-5 hours, which was awesome. I wasn’t bothered at all during the installation, no hiccups or flagging cumbersome issues. They cleaned everything up like they were never there. The water heaters they sell are incredibly quiet. My Navien sounded like BART leaving a station every time it started up. Good riddance! Thanks Tristan!

reviews.author: Matvey Farber
reviews.text: Great service. Water heater went out thanksgiving day, Tristan  came out first thing Friday morning. I was provided with a thorough and clear explanation of the status of my 20+year old water heater and my options on how to proceed. Tristan took extra time to answer all my questions thoroughly and did not push me on which path to go with. The work itself is immaculate and very well done. I feel good having a reliable, higher end,  and properly installed water heater.

reviews.author: Thomas De Arth
reviews.text:
Service call was fair ($59) and the technician was very nice and professional.    No complaints at all-Prompt and on time.

The 3 yrs old hot water heater needed parts (gas control valve and an attached sensor), which were under warranty but Payless wanted to charge $750 to install the replacement, which I have been told by 4 different local companies that it takes between 15 and 20 minutes.  Now I get there is a cost for knowledge but $2,250/hr ($750 /20 minutes x 3 = $2,250/hr).?  Seriously????

Whatever happened to fair and reasonable business practices?  Do we have to rip each other off like this?  I mean, I understand that there is travel time, equipment, and repair truck cost but $2,250/hr?

The repairman told me that everyone would be about the same but that in-fact was not the case. Called 4 other plumbing companies who quoted between $250 and $350 for the job.

Moral of the story, shop around and  WATCH out for these guys.  They draw you in by their rapid response.

“Payless” should be renamed as “Pay More - a LOT More!”

reviews.author: Kevin Yip
reviews.text: I was in desperate need to repair Bradford White hydraulic water heater because tenant has been without hot water and heat for several days. My plumber needs several days to get the parts. So I called Payless with the model and serial number asking if they have the parts. They replied later saying yes. However, the technician called me from the house next day saying that they don't repair hydraulic heater when I gave them the model already. A waste of one valuable day despite my due diligence. Other than that everything was good.

plumbers.name: Drainmen plumbing inc
plumbers.address: 21 N Hanover St, Pottstown, PA 19464, USA

reviews.author: marybeth krause
reviews.text: Called and John came out the next day to replace the dip tube and anode on my hot water heater. Very happy with the work done and the additional advice John gave me on replacing the heater elements (did it myself the next day with no issues), the limitations of the basement sump pump, and information on what various things cost. Will definitely call the next time I need plumbing work!

reviews.author: Lisa M
reviews.text: After a terrible experience with their virtual assistant,  I spoke to someone last night and they apologized for the issues with the VA.  They were very apologetic so I called them today after a ridiculously high quote from someone else.  They came out and diagnosed the problem and had it repaired, saved us from having to put in a new hot water heater and followed through until the end.  We appreciate that John came out even though he wasn't on weekend call.

reviews.author: Deb gill Gill
reviews.text: Discovered a leak early afternoon of January 2.  Called right away and the crew showed up before the time frame I was given.  Once again courtesy, professional and problem solved within a matter of minutes.  This was a call back and they honored it.

reviews.author: Sean Dolan
reviews.text: Called in the morning and they were able to be out by mid afternoon. John and Mike both diagnosed the blockage fairly quickly and John was able use the snake and camera to clear the blockage. They were friendly, professional and informative in their work. Hopefully I don’t have any plumbing issues for many years but when an issue arises I know who to call and I will be recommending them to any family and friends that experience plumbing issues.

reviews.author: nicole f
reviews.text: Mr. Mike Ammouri is awesome! He is a man of his word, he came and completed the repair on our sewer lateral line in one day. There was a complication with the project due to the township error. Mike resolved the issue and we are pleased with his work. Great job Mike and we appreciate your timely response. I highly recommend Drainmen Plumbing!!! He also did an awesome job putting my lawn back together.

plumbers.name: Diligent Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 1023 SE 223rd Ave, Gresham, OR 97030, USA

reviews.author: Brad Schwartz
reviews.text: I contacted Vitaliy for an estimate on water heater replacement and also to look at a water temperature problem in our master bath. He gave me a 2 hr. window and contacted me 30 min. before to let me know he was on the way. He listened to my explanation of the issues we were having and I ended up going with him based mostly on my interaction with him. The day of install he was alittle early and took some time to troubleshoot the temperature issue and gave me some possible solutions. Water Heater install went smoothly and we decided to give it a couple days to see if it made a difference. I had him out again once I received the new parts and he resolved the problem with water temperature. He is very easy to get ahold of and responds within just a few minutes and is always prompt when he comes out. I will be seeing him every year for the waterheater maintenence and will use him for any other plumbing issues I run  into.

reviews.author: Jennifer Snuggs
reviews.text: I worked with Vitaliy at Diligent Plumbing and he replaced my faulty turn off valve and had to drain, rework and moved the gas pipe for my stove. When I first called him due to my water not turning off under my sink he was here very fast! He was kind, explained everything that needed to be done and got to work. He also, was able to come out on a later date to move my gas line, so, my new gas range stove could fit in its spot and be hooked up properly. He has excellent both times I used him! I would definitely recommend him to anyone needing a plumber!!

reviews.author: jill cuyler
reviews.text: Great experience with Diligent!  They had the lowest bid of all three plumbing companies I had come out and also the most responsive and timely with getting the problem assesed and fixed within 36 hrs. Very professional and honest. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Samantha K
reviews.text:
Vitaliy and his team were excellent to work with. They helped us with several projects such as clearing drains, replacing our kitchen faucet, and upgrading the water heater. Everything was done efficiently and with great care.

Vitaliy was communicative and respectful throughout the whole process. He explained the work clearly and made sure we were comfortable and informed every step of the way. I appreciated how smoothly the whole appointment went, and how quickly the work was completed.

Highly recommend Diligent Plumbing if you want professionalism with a personal touch. I'll definitely be calling again for any future needs.

reviews.author: Aryn Fix
reviews.text:
Vitaliy is always friendly, professional, so quick to respond, and does great work. We recently had a water heater fail and called Vitaliy…he was here within an hour and we had a new water heater installed immediately.

Over the next few days the pilot light kept going out and had to be relit multiple times. Called Vitaliy and he came back and replaced the gas regulator under warranty.

Need a plumber? Call Vitaliy!

plumbers.name: First Service Plumbing & Drains LLC
plumbers.address: 211 S Persimmon St Ste 250, Tomball, TX 77375, USA

reviews.author: Brian Robin
reviews.text: First Service Plumbing did an excellent job. Ron, the owner, was quick to respond, clearly explained everything, and charged a fair price. The work was done right the first time and the quality was outstanding. Great communication and service throughout—highly recommend.

reviews.author: Vanessa Montalvo
reviews.text: Second time using this company and they really do a great job. From making an appointment, seeing on a map how close they are to arriving, the repair and cleanup - just great all around. Ronnie and Shiloh were very professional and kind. I highly recommend First Service Plumbing and Drains!

reviews.author: Maggie Meehan
reviews.text: Wow, absolutely incredible service! They arrived promptly within the time window they gave me and then completed the service on my leaking faucet in my bathtub within 30 minutes. Incredibly respectful as well! I will refer to everyone! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Brendan Barry
reviews.text: Incredible company of people that will go above and beyond for their customers. Very thankful for Ron and the attention to detail his company demonstrates. First Service Plumbing and Drains is definitely our recommendation because of quality level of work and thoroughness to make sure the job was done right.

reviews.author: Mary Forshag
reviews.text:
We had a tankless hot water heater installed by this company about two years ago, and they have serviced it annually ever since. Scheduling is always easy, and I really appreciate the text links that let you know when the technician is on the way—including a live map showing their location en route.

Every technician we’ve worked with has been professional and knowledgeable. Highly recommend Ronnie III in particular—he was extremely polite, thorough, and a true pleasure to work with. We’ve been very happy with the service and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this company.

plumbers.name: Renew Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 29 NW Franklin Ave, Bend, OR 97703, USA

reviews.author: Lifestyles Realty Group
reviews.text: ReNew has been our go-to company for years, and they consistently have done great work, are communicative, and quick to respond to our work requests. They are incredibly knowledgeable, and invoices are detailed so we rarely have questions. Their pricing is very fair, and they have an awesome team of technicians. Thanks ReNew!

reviews.author: Jennifer Dehner
reviews.text:
I was referred to Renew Plumbing by a family member who spoke very highly of them. I do not write gushing reviews often, but when I do, it’s for businesses that DESERVE PRAISE & GRATITUDE. I called in the morning and was lucky enough to get same-day service for what I thought was a broken garbage disposal — the disposal was fine, but some pipes under my sink were not installed correctly and were literally coming apart. The plumber informed me and quickly worked to replace and repair the pipes.  He also took the time and effort to tack my dishwasher hose in the proper place for function, tighten my faucet and its handle (which was loose), as well as secured my freezer door handle properly back to my fridge.
Renew Plumbing will have me and my family as customers for life. The plumber (who also happened to be the owner) is the kindest and most respectful human… He loves what he does, is extremely experienced, and does a 12/10 job, going above and beyond to make the customer happy. Thank you, Renew Plumbing!

reviews.author: W M
reviews.text: Renew Plumbing is great. They have helped us on a few occasions and this most recent was a doozy with a cracked water main. They were quick to get out to us when the problem arose and diagnosed the issue swiftly. I felt that their pricing was fair and transparent. Kaden was our point person near the end of that project and was such a nice guy. Josh also showed up within the hour when I called today about a new leak that was detected. That brought me a lot of peace of mind.

reviews.author: Ella Quinn
reviews.text: Renew came to our house immediately when we had a backed up drain. They were super knowledgeable and kind and helped to solve our issue. They also helped give us info on how to avoid this in the future. Very fair and responsive. We will always call renew for future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Carol O'Casey
reviews.text: What a relief to find an honest, knowledgeable, efficient, trustworthy and friendly plumber! Dave came out the same day and repaired my leaky shower--you can tell he knows his stuff and cares about his clients. I'm thankful for Renew Plumbing!

plumbers.name: H2Flow Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2258 Walls Rd, Greer, SC 29651, USA

reviews.author: patti Kellems
reviews.text: Phillip Waters came to our home to what we diagnosed was a water heater element gone wrong.  He quickly diagnosed our issue to be a pressure regulating valve and thermal expansion tank.  He explained the problem to my husband completely, answered his questions and went to purchase the parts.  Phillip was courteous, friendly, and used his time efficiently.In the 20 years we have lived here this was by far the most professional plumber work on our home.

reviews.author: Warren Martin
reviews.text: Phillip was absolutely great! He does a super neat job and his prices are very reasonable. He replaced faucets and repaired toilets in both my bathrooms, and installed new faucets in my kitchen sink. This is the kind of work you wish all repair people would do for everything in your house. 😊

reviews.author: Kathryn Kylee
reviews.text: I have used Phillip a couple of times for various plumbing projects.  He is Professional, Knowledgeable, Friendly and very helpful.  I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Tressie S
reviews.text:
From start, came out to do estimate within two business days of calling, arrived on time, courteous and professional in the appraisal of the work that needed to be done.

Appointment for install three days later. Had estimates from two other companies, H2Flo was most knowledgeable in understanding what needed to be done at a vastly better price.

To finish, installed the new gas water into garage, removed old water heater from attic in just three hours. Their knowledge and expertise shows in their work. Very pleased.

reviews.author: Joann Shackelford
reviews.text: Reached out to H2 Flow with a drainage problem, They got back to me in a timely manner. Was very professional and reasonable. I definitely will be using them again.

plumbers.name: Simple Service Plumbing, Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 11503 Jones Maltsberger Rd Suite 1139, San Antonio, TX 78216, USA

reviews.author: Sylvia Luna
reviews.text: I used this company due to a faulty water heater. Tristian and his crew came out and he assured me that they would handle the entire process. They would handle the plumbing and he brought in another entity, American Restoration to do the repairs on property loss. They did what they called a packout. Packed out two bedrooms, formal dinning, kitchen, bath, breakfast area. My house is empty. This happened June 9th. Come to find out, Simple Service Plumbing went outta business, I have no clue where my furniture, belongings, are. Per the restoration company, they are taking over the mess that Simple Service created they are trying to get Tirstian to tell them where my belongings are stored and trying to get Tristian to give them the key to whatever storage my belongings are in. So now I have an empty nonfunctional house and no one can tell me where my things are or if I am even getting them back. If they truly went outta business I can certainly understand why. Simple Service is/was a NIGHTMARE. Do Not use them or any company associated with them.

reviews.author: Kajel Shah
reviews.text: I can't tell you enough positive things about Adrien and Simple Service. They truly made it a low stress process.  We had a leaky drain pipe under the bathroom sink.  He was able to come out within a couple hours and tightened up the hose for me.  We really appreciated Adrien's honesty and fairness in his recommendation and pricing and would therefore highly recommend him. It's refreshing to know there are honest people and companies. We own a couple rental properties in San Antonio and will definitely call him the next time we need service. Thank you again!!

reviews.author: Tara Hints
reviews.text: AJ, Jeremy,and T2 really did an excellent job. They were very knowledgeable of their work. They were also very professional and personable. We were very glad that we called them for their service.

reviews.author: Layla G
reviews.text:
I called Tristian Garza to come place a mother board on my water heater. He was a kind gentleman. He had some difficulty installing the mother board and said he would come back next week to try again when he could contact customer support… that was about a month ago. He canceled on me several times. We had an appointment set up for last week and he did not show. The woman who was scheduling the appointments was no longer returning my calls or texts.

The next day when Tristian didn’t show up, I received a called from some gentleman named Tito. Tito explained to us that they no longer do plumbing services as of last week??

I already paid for labor and parts weeks ago, and my water heater is still not fixed. I haven’t been able to use my water since the last time Tristan showed. I was very patient with this company!!! I would not recommend this company to anybody and will be making sure to tell family and friends to stay away!

reviews.author: Matthew Shurtleff
reviews.text: Jerel, AJ, and Adrian were amazing, friendly, and knowledgeable. They were quick and responsive to install our smart water shut-off, whole house water filter, and softener. The completed job was very professional and functional. Highly recommend Simple Service Plumbing and this team for any of your needs.

plumbers.name: C. Lee Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 4315 Hudson Dr, Stow, OH 44224, USA

reviews.author: Jessica Rodriguez
reviews.text:
We had an outstanding experience with Jon and Jonny from C. Lee! They were incredibly professional, kind and committed to getting the job done right. Our natural gas pipes needed serious attention, and they worked tirelessly to make sure everything was fixed safely and efficiently. Their clear communication and friendly attitude made the whole process so much easier. We truly appreciate their hard work and dedication
- highly recommend Jon, Jonny, and the entire team at C. Lee!

reviews.author: Terri Brown
reviews.text: C Lee has been my go-to for plumbing in all the 23 years I’ve been in Stow.  Always great service from scheduling, to install, to clean-up…reliably fantastic.  They today replaced my 24 year-old water heater in a few hours on very short notice.  Easy to work with, fair prices, rock-solid workmanship.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Hannah Betsinger
reviews.text: Tim was great! Very professional, knowledgeable, and he did a fantastic job installing a new gas line and repairing a pipe. I would highly recommend them and look forward to using them for future projects.

reviews.author: Martin Frantz
reviews.text: John was knowledgeable, personable and patient. He answered all my questions and explained everything. I couldn’t be happier with the installation of my water softener system.

reviews.author: Marsha Olesky
reviews.text: Tim was very Experienced, explained what he was doing and why. Very appreciative of his knowledge and work would recommend him for another job and we definitely call if I have any more plumbing issues.

plumbers.name: Aqua Knight Plumbing, Sewer, HVAC Services & Protection
plumbers.address: 2815 Forbs Ave Suite 107 #141, Hoffman Estates, IL 60192, USA

reviews.author: Jeffrey Marinier
reviews.text: Deacon was the most trustworthy and caring contractor I have ever had in my home. He stayed at my house extremely late into the evening to ensure he didn’t leave my home in a bad spot. I felt the pricing was fair, and Deacon and the Aqua Knight team ensured the final solution was seen through. I would highly recommend Deacon and the whole Aqua Knight team. By the time Aqua Knight had resolved the situation, Deacon felt like an old friend.

reviews.author: Tony Bylina
reviews.text:
Lucas from Aqua Knight Plumbing did an excellent job from start to finish. He came out for an assessment and was extremely thorough in his explanations, taking the time to walk me through what was going on and what needed to be done—no rushing, no vague answers.

He successfully replaced our sump pump and also made a strong effort to remove as much of the root intrusion as possible from the clay portion of our plumbing line, explaining limitations clearly and honestly along the way. It was obvious he cared about doing the job right, not just doing it fast.

What really stood out was his follow-up service. When our sink later froze up, Lucas came back and used a smart, practical warm-water approach to safely melt the blockage and get everything flowing again—allowing us to use our dishwasher without further issues.

Professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely helpful. Lucas is the kind of technician you hope shows up at your door, and Aqua Knight Plumbing is lucky to have him.

reviews.author: Donna Perez
reviews.text: Lucas did a great job. Put everything back when he was complete. Explained everything very well. Would definitely recommend him and Aqua Knight Plumbing.

reviews.author: CMA
reviews.text: I cannot recommend AquaKnight more strongly for any and all plumbing needs - this company is the absolute best there is, bar none!  We had a plumbing emergency this past summer, early on a Sunday morning and they seemingly raced to our home to come to our aid!  This company knew we have had some medical issues historically and they were on the job immediately.  Our beloved dog had died just prior to this incident, adding to the already stressful situation.  Daniel really listens to us as customers and has understood certain issues with regard to a medical issue that can be problematic within our home if we get water damage -  and handled it with such empathy and concern.  He explains things thoroughly and provides detail about why certain solutions are recommended.  He is a trusted resource for us and we never have to second guess or feel like we are being overcharged.  We have had the extreme pleasure of work done by Lucas and Matt, as well!  Such knowledgeable plumbers!  Exemplary work by all  of these men and phenomenal customer service.  Who knows their plumbers (plural) by name??!  Great guys!My parents also use this company religiously, too!  Recently, Daniel literally saved us from nearly being scammed by a “handyman” who started to do some work for us with an appliance repair - somehow my husband and I got our signals crossed and yadda yadda yadda, this “handyman” started working on replacing our sump pump.  The pump was completely insufficient in size and we were one storm away from flooding!  The initial part of the job was started by this handyman and tree roots were left in the pit of our crawlspace, which we might never have seen, had Daniel at AquaKnight not checked it out for us.  He discovered the insufficient pump and poor workmanship.  We knew the handyman was also overcharging us based on the product!  AquaKnight to the rescue, but of course!  We terminated the unfinished work by the handyman and had it all redone by AquaKnight!  Daniel spent after business hours and a Saturday night providing us with information on what the best solution actually was, as well as the reasons the other work could prove utterly disastrous and the likelihood of flooding!  The flood could have set off issues for us medically.  Daniel & Co truly care and are experts in the industry.  Caring plumbers?!  AquaKnight goes the extra mile for their customers, without question.  We cannot praise this company enough.  I always feel like a priority.  It feels like family, not a big, impersonal machine of a company.  Most importantly, we trust this company to provide a very important and integral service within our home, our refuge, our castle - and a castle ALWAYS needs a knight, especially an AquaKnight!

reviews.author: Y.S. Rhee
reviews.text: I want to thank Aqua Knight Plumbing, Lucas & Daniel for the amazing work they did for a broken sump pump & backup sump pump. The excellent communication, hard work & service is so appreciated. Lucas & Daniel did such great work & explained everything so well! We highly recommend Aqua Knight Plumbing for your sump pump or any other home service needs!

plumbers.name: Space City Plumbing
plumbers.address: 116 Houston Ave, League City, TX 77573, USA

reviews.author: Billie Richard
reviews.text:
This company is the ONE!!

If you are looking around and trying to make a decision. I can't stress this enough.  Space City Plumbing is a family run company and they treat you like they know you.  They are so helpful, patient and considerate. From the initial phone call, till the clean up, we felt listened to, spoken to like we were important, and we were kept informed on the issue and what work needed to be done.  They also went over options with us which eased our stress.

Isaiah & Brandon were first on the scene and from the get go they were professional, and friendly. After they accessed the leak, they called to get a 2nd crew to assist in deciding what was the best approach to repair the leaking pipe and two outside faucets that it was connected to.

They had to lift several bricks up from my patio and dig a trench like hole to remove and replace the old pipe.  They also replaced the two faucets. After the job was complete, they replaced the bricks and tidied up the area.

I pray I get their names correct and don't miss anyone, because each of these gentlemen deserve to be mentioned in this review. From the first man who spoke to me on the phone and eased my stress level, to those who worked in my backyard completing the job.

Kevin, Micah, Isaiah, Brandon, and Jesus were hard working They worked together like a well oiled machine and were done in time for us to go to dinner!

I didn't say at the start of this review that sadly, Space City Plumbing was not the first company I called.  I googled trying to find one when I noticed the leak it was close to 9pm the day before.  The other company "Roto Rooter" promised to be at my home between 9-10am the next morning.  When they didn't show, or call I was getting concerned.

So after several calls by me asking them why they hadn't called us or told us what was their ETA like they said they would they promised the guy we were waiting on would call us soon with that info...  He didn't.  We got the run around till close to 2pm when he finally called.  He called to inform my husband that he would be there closer to 4pm and we would have to sign a contract that he sent to my email and pay $1000 before he came out.  This was to perform leak detection to find the leak, which we explained we could already see.

After his heated conversation with my husband, we decided to ask our neighbor who she used when she had an issue not long ago.

She recommended Space City Plumbing.  I will never regret cancelling the other company and calling them.  I will recommend them to anyone who asks us "do you know a good plumber" because we do!

reviews.author: Steve R Smith
reviews.text:
Mario and Kobi came out to help install a valve and line to power my generator with matural gas instead of either gasolone or propane. This way, I cam run the generator for several days without having to feed it propane tanks. Huge plus for convenience.

They spent the time to not only get everything installed and hooked up but they also helped get the generator started. It was a little tricky but they stayed until we figured it out.

I really appreciate their attention to detail and safety. This is the second project they've done for us. The other one, Mario helped replace a ball valve in our side water spigot. These guys do excellent work.

reviews.author: Cathy Flammini
reviews.text: I had a major water leak from a water pipe line to spigot in my front yard. I called Space City Plumbing at 7:30 am and they had Isaiah here by 9:30 am. He identified the problem immediately and began work to fix the problem. Old pvc piping was worn and disintegrating causing leaks underground. Then Mario and Koby arrived by 1:30 and dug up the pipes. They worked incredibly hard and were very professional. They added new (up to standard/code) flexible piping and covered with dirt. They even patched back my lawn to make the yard look good still. This is the second time I've used this company for major plumbing jobs on my 1967 house. They do NOT disappoint and I highly recommend them! Koby, Mario, and Isaiah....thank you for the tough jobs you accomplished at my house! You have a hard job but make my life so much better with stressfree, working plumbing!!! Thank you 😊

reviews.author: gabriella canales
reviews.text:
I recently had a leak issue in my home, and space City plumbing did an outstanding job. Spoke with Yesenia over the phone and she quickly sent out help. The repair was completed efficiently, and they made sure everything was cleaned up afterward. I’ve used them for a second time now since purchasing my home. I def recommend!

Fletcher Plumbing, Heating & Air is HANDS DOWN the best company in DE. From the first phone call to the final walkthrough, everything was handled with professionalism, honesty, and care. The technicians arrived on time, explained the issue clearly, and walked me through my options without any pressure. Special thanks to Brian, Andrew, Jordan and Greg for taking care of us.

reviews.author: Tiffany Youngs
reviews.text:
This went from a super stressful situation with nothing but bad news to a manageable break. My furnace is 9 years old so not new but not exactly old. About 6-7 years ago I started having problems with the air being pushed through the vents and had some quick big hvac company come out. The tech ended up banging the life out of this wheel and housing because he couldn’t get it out.

Wasn’t about to have the same company come out after the assault I witnessed (RIP old wheel, motor and housing). After looking at reviews I chose Fletchers and eventually was up and running again. Fast forward to about a week ago, no more air 😭 Just had a new AC unit installed so maybe that’s it… nope. It’s the same issue as before.

To begin I was extremely frustrated, not going to lie. I thought this was fixed. But something ended up slowly coming loose and it all went down hill from there. Brian Fletcher and the super knowledgeable tech Jason helped simmer my anxiety spiraling, explained everything, got down on the floor with me to show me the major damage, and have been honest with me.

Still no air, but the wheel got bent while being shaken around in there so fingers crossed the new one comes in quickly and in tact so the install goes smoothly. Really appreciate the time Brian took with me as a customer. It’s clear that he takes pride in the work they do.

reviews.author: Lynn Robinson
reviews.text: We have been using Fletcher for many years and they have always provided great service. My recent experience was was nerve-wracking with my heater blowing cold air during the coldest days we've had in years. The tech was here quickly, explained everything that was happening and exactly what he was doing to identify the issue and best plan forward. He was professional and personable and I was so relieved to feel that warm air blowing again! I also received a follow-up call to ensure everything was still running properly. Highly recommend this team!

reviews.author: John Collins
reviews.text: We wanted to give props to Fletchers and Chuck Guessford for helping us out with a recent plumbing issue.  Fletchers was able to get Chuck to our house right after New Years for a clogged kitchen sink and much needed sink piping replacement.  Chuck was extremely thorough and professional and most of all did not mind all of our questions. Then Chuck was able to come back out the following week and address our non-critical pluming issues and did a great job, including installing a brand new kitchen faucet that we are very pleased with. reviews.text: Perry came to my house and installed a new toilet in less than an hour. In and out in a flash and now my toilets working better than when I moved in. He’s knowledgeable and efficient. Couldn’t recommend him enough. Thanks Perry!

reviews.author: Pub
reviews.text:
I very strongly recommend Perry’s Plumbing based upon my recent experience where he helped me with a leaking bathtub faucet.
I have a faucet fixture that is over 80 years old.  When a recurring leak worsened recently, I called a big-name local plumbing company, and they said that the fixture was too old and that they would not be able to fix it. The only option was to replace everything completely and cut through the wall costing over three thousand dollars. They insisted no one could repair it, and they charged me $125 after not having done anything.
I checked online and found Perry’s Plumbing. I explained my situation to Perry, and he said to send him a photo, and that he would come by to assess to see if he could repair it. I could tell right away that he was honest and understood that I was not looking to do a major renovation at this time. When he arrived, he took the faucet apart and quickly found a damaged seal and replaced it. He then removed the seat to check to see if it was still in good shape. He found a crack which was likely the cause of the damage to the seal. He had many parts with him to choose from, and he found one that fit. After reassembling everything, the leak was completely gone and has not come back.
He was honest and spent the time to work with an old faucet, saving me over three thousand dollars and major renovation work. He also did not try to do any unnecessary work, such as replacing the parts on the other valve on the fixture which was not leaking. After my experience with Perry’s Plumbing, I will definitely go to him in the future.

reviews.author: Robin Simon
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Perry. We were having a water pressure issue and he was able to diagnose the problem right away using his experience and expertise. He was professional, neat, and clearly takes pride in his work. Highly recommend Perry for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: J Ses
reviews.text: Incredible work by Turé. Walked me through what needed to happen after a pipe burst. Did the work at a much more reasonable price than a competitor. Will be using Plumbing Dr. for all future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Tyler Morson
reviews.text:
UPDATE: The technician who diagnosed my clogged kitchen sink drain was incorrect in their assessment. Upon further reflection, it's silly to think the technician could properly diagnose the issue considering they didn't even turn on the water. What ended up being a vapor lock caused by a clogged drain vent (diagnosed and fixed personally) was originally diagnosed as either a clogged drain pipe or improper drain design because of too sharp a turn in the piping. The MINIMUM estimate to fix what was improperly diagnosed was about $800-900 just to snake the drain. Other estimates for unnecessary work reached upwards of $2,500. Needless to say, I will not be using The Plumbing Dr again.

ORIGINAL POST: Very knowledgeable, and honest with their recommendations. I had an issue with my kitchen sink drain, and they assessed the issue, proposed solutions, and advised on potential alternatives. Not pushy in their sales either, which I appreciated.

plumbers.name: Utah Valley Plumbing - Lehi
plumbers.address: 2584 N Eagle Crest Dr #4115, Lehi, UT 84043, USA

reviews.author: Jason Harris
reviews.text:
I have used Utah Valley Plumbing for years to fix leaks, replace faucets, and other plumbing issues throughout the home.

This time, it was for a huge project—to finish our basement and build a downstairs apartment!

They came out, gave us a free estimate, which we adjusted and promptly accepted, and we scheduled the work to complete our basement. The plumbing was the most important part of getting the apartment ready.

The work completed:
1- We have very high water pressure in Lehi and our old pressure reduction valve had failed. It was causing problems everywhere in our home. The Utah Valley Plumbing Team fixed this problem first. I have added a photo below. They had to find it first because we had mistakenly sheet rocked over it!

2- We had an old plastic manifold to distribute the water to our house. Pretty much all the plastic valves were breaking and couldn’t open or close. It was maddening! So Tyce, our plumber replaced it with an expanded copper and metal valve system. It turned out great.

3- New bathroom shower valve, sink, and bathroom toilet concreted in. They actually did a few more things than I believe they quoted me! Fixing other things too. Tyce, our plumber, was amazing!

4- they plumbed the whole basement with hot and cold water lines to our new apartment washer/dryer area

5- Then plumbed our New kitchen perfectly!

The work and team are better than expected. I have used them for years and their pricing and services are excellent.

I highly recommend Utah Valley Plumbing. These are great and honest plumbers who our family has grown to love as a parter maintaining our home.

Jason
Lehi, Ut

reviews.author: Brad Hoppe
reviews.text: I recently had my water heater replaced by Utah Valley Plumbing.  Tyce R. arrived to evaluate my old water heater which had recently started leaking.  It was around 20 years old.  Tyce gave me quote, and also let me know they could replace it that same day.  He came back that afternoon with all of the parts and did a fantastic job of removing the old water heater and installing the new one.  I am attaching a photo, because it shows the quality of work and pride in his work.  Tyce was very professional, answered all of my questions, took his time, and delivered exceptional finish work.  He also vacuumed up the work area and left it cleaner than when he started.  It is great to work with someone who makes you feel like a customer and not an inconvenience.  Thanks Tyce and Utah Valley Plumbing.
