Not only did he fix the logs, but he also took the time to show me how to light them manually in case of a power outage. It was a pleasure to have such an amazing technician complete the service, ensuring my family stayed warm during the ice storm. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Suzanne Skinner
reviews.text: I’m so happy I found Patterson plumbing. They have been amazing and even able to do same day repairs. Never have had to wait more than 24hrs which is unheard of out here. The nicest team ever. Carlos was so nice and took the time to truly explain to me what was happening. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Wayne Dowling
reviews.text: Carlos was great.  Prompt and focused on getting it right the first time.  Was patient with our house as it threw him some curveballs with a previous remodel that had caused some confusion and issues. They worked through it and stayed late to make sure it was completed   and got us back online.  Strongly recommend!

reviews.author: Rebecca Gunn
reviews.text: Carlos did an amazing job fixing a gas leak in our new home. Came out on a Saturday. Very professional and knowledgeable!!! Strongly recommend.

reviews.author: India Melton
reviews.text: My hot water heater went out, these guys came out and fixed it so fast! I had lots of questions and no one seemed to mind answering. If I have any more plumbing/water issues this is the company I will be calling! Fair pricing and reliable, can't get any better than that!

plumbers.name: KCS Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3239 W Norris St, Philadelphia, PA 19121, USA

reviews.author: Shyamika Langford
reviews.text:
I highly recommend KCS Plumbing for anyone in need of reliable and professional plumbing services. From start to finish, their team was prompt, courteous, and extremely knowledgeable. They quickly diagnosed the issue, explained everything clearly, and completed the work efficiently with great attention to detail.

What stood out most was their honesty and commitment to quality,  no unnecessary upselling, just straightforward, expert service. It’s refreshing to work with a company that takes pride in their work and truly values their customers.

Thank you, KCS Plumbing, for the excellent job and peace of mind! I’ll definitely be calling you again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: E Baker
reviews.text: KCS Plumbing kicks ass! They came on time, cleaned up, and they like cats and dogs. Also, they did outstanding work on plumbing that was original to a 90 year old house! I can't say enough good things! They provided excellent customer service including payment options and super easy to communicate with. From now on, if water goes through it, we will call KCS to fix it!!

reviews.author: Oh Kwon
reviews.text:
Scott and Shawn from KCS Plumbing were excellent.
They were honest, transparent, and very respectful throughout the entire process. They finished the job the right way, worked quickly, and left the job site clean. I highly recommend KCS Plumbing!

reviews.author: Aisha Washington
reviews.text: I highly recommend KCS Plumbing. Their response was fast, their communication was clear, and they took the time to thoroughly explain what was causing our overflow. We truly appreciate their professionalism and the care they showed throughout the entire process. Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Adrienne King
reviews.text: I experienced a leaking valve and called KCS Plumbing. This was my first experience with the company. The intake staff was professional and organized.  I was placed on the schedule for same day service and given timeframe for when service could be provided.. Keith arrived within  2 hours of my call and was very respectful. A full plumbing assessment  was performed to check out any other problem areas. I had ended up having  4 valves changed including the leaking one. The other valves either were not shutting off the water flow or could not be turned to the off position. Keith was very informative on all that was being done. He also educated me on how my plumbing system. What started out as a scary morning was ended stress free by early afternoon.  10/10 service. Would definitely recommend.

plumbers.name: Red's On Time Plumbing
plumbers.address: 8860 Palomar Ave Suite A, Atascadero, CA 93422, USA

reviews.author: Tanya Blodget
reviews.text: Steven called to ask if he could arrive early. He came out the day that I called, was respectful and completed the job in a clean, timely fashion. I don't know how much other plumbers would charge for the same service. I was grateful to have the job done quick and well.

reviews.author: Nicole Subler
reviews.text: The work was communicated clearly and done neatly and efficiently! Oscar was very knowledgeable and patiently answered all my questions. I was particularly impressed that he had us run a load of laundry before he left (issue was replacing the laundry drain), so we were confident that no more issues would arise. We’re very happy with the work he did, and we will definitely be coming back to Red’s for any future plumbing work!

reviews.author: dixie bellefeuille
reviews.text: We were very pleased with the professionalism  of Reds plumbing & coming over so quickly with assessing what needed to be done  & were able to remove & install a new hot water heater the same day!  Will defiantly highly recommend them & will use again.  Thank you to John in assessing & providing the quote & Cabin doing the work!

reviews.author: Terri Martella
reviews.text: Reds is a good plumbing outfit. The gentleman helped out my husband. We needed our water heater looked at. No repairs needed. I asked how much for the service call and was given the amount. But when I received the bill it was an additional service for diagnostics. I wasn’t told about the extra fee. I assumed that the service call was included. Disappointed ☹️

reviews.author: Chelsey Layous
reviews.text: Scheduling with the main office was such a breeze! I was able to get a Scheduling with the main office was such a breeze! I was able to get an appointment within 24 hours of calling. Marino was super friendly and  knowledgeable. He worked efficiently and even explained each step to me so that I knew what to look for should another problem arise. Will definitely be using Red’s again!

plumbers.name: Legendary Service
plumbers.address: 960 Rand Rd Suite 200F, Des Plaines, IL 60016, USA

reviews.author: Josh Murner
reviews.text:
HVAC:

I've had a wonderful HVAC experience with Sean from Legendary.  Last winter, we had our heat go out and he showed up within the hour and made sure to work late in order for us to have heat overnight.  I was very appreciative that he had the problem solving skills to get everything working before the end of the day, especially because we have two small children.  They have a really good warranty on pretty much all of their products and I recommend becoming part of their annual maintenance agreement - it includes discounts on any plumbing and HVAC work needed.

Plumbing:

I also recently had the pleasure of spending a few days with Frank and Dylan from Legendary while they:

1. Hauled away an old tank water heater and replaced it with a new tankless water heater
2. Replaced a rocking toilet with a brand new one
3. Re-piped old galvanized steel pipes with new pex
4. Changed the shower fixture from two knobs to a single shower valve
5. Replaced an old wheel gate valve for the main shutoff with a new quarter turn ball valve
6. Replaced an outdoor hose spigot and kitchen drain basket

Everything was installed correctly and they worked hard to make sure the project was done in a timely manner.  Our water pressure is now incredible and everything works great!  I should also mention that while installing the new pex to our shower, they noticed and fixed a small leak with our tub drain which has likely been leaking behind our wall for awhile.

Since we had such a large plumbing project, Sean made sure to show up periodically throughout the couple of days to ensure everything was on schedule and the work being done was of the highest quality.  While Frank and Dylan did a great job, it also felt good to know that Sean was double checking everything was done well throughout the project.

I highly recommend Legendary Services for both plumbing and HVAC work!

reviews.author: Delwin Johnson
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this company. My heat stopped working at the worst possible time, and they came through. The team installed a brand-new furnace along with a new thermostat and made the whole process smooth and stress-free. They were professional, knowledgeable, and respectful of my home, and they explained everything clearly along the way. I’m in the Mundelein area, and I’m beyond grateful to have heat again. Highly recommend their services. I attached a photo of my new device it’s pretty cool looking and you can control the temp from your app on the cell phone. Thank You again.

reviews.author: Alfonso Flores
reviews.text: Waking up the day before Christmas Eve to a boiler that is not working is not fun.  Fortunately, Legendary responded quickly and Frank Walsh had everything back in order by 2 pm. I called back 2 days later to discuss a minor issue after the install and Sean was attentive and forward our message to Frank.  One word, trustworthy.

reviews.author: Karen B
reviews.text:
Colin was my technician from Legendary and addressed problems with my furnace.
He knew his stuff, was transparent and honest. You could see the pride of ownership in his work and his company’s approach. I have cancelled my subscription with a different company. They were dishonest. Colin showed me my filters which supposedly got cleaned a couple of months ago by that company. They were filthy! What a scam.

I plan to use Legendary for future needs. Thank you!

reviews.author: Margaret Trempe
reviews.text: Colin at Legendary was GREAT! The whole experience with seamless especially for emergency service on a Saturday with freezing temperatures and no heat. Colin was professional communicative and extremely helpful for the entire process. I highly recommend Legendary and I'm happy to now be a preferred customer for yearly maintenance on my heating, air and plumbing.

plumbers.name: AE Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 5672 S Johnson St, Littleton, CO 80123, USA

reviews.author: Allie Schaber
reviews.text: I would recommend AE Plumbing to anyone in need of service. Juan was fast in his response time to my initial inquiry and helped plan for a technician to come out the very next day. Isaac was my tech; he was kind, professional and thorough with his work. When he asked if my water could be turned off via the bathtub water shutoff, I was unsure and told him I could go into my crawl space to turn off the main line, which he quickly offered himself to do. He checked that the drip from my bathtub faucet was fixed multiple times before having me confirm. 10/10 service and will absolutely be my preferred plumbing company moving forward.

reviews.author: Bob Cuculich
reviews.text: Highly recommend this company. Carlos came out, fixed my drainage problem, quickly and efficiently. Very personable. No effort to upsell. Price was as quoted and clearly explained. All in all, such a great experience! So much better than other plumbing companies I’ve used in the past. This company will be my go-to from now on.

reviews.author: Mitch Eckhout
reviews.text: Juan was very professional, the new water heater install turned out great and he was able to fix a floor drain as well! His price was lower than the other plumbers I called and he offered me a better brand than Home Depot offers. 10/10

reviews.author: sherk KDC
reviews.text: Carlos was very prompt.  He was very honest at diagnosing my plumbing issue and fixed it.  He  checked a couple of other things for me too!  Very knowledgeable.  Super nice guy.  Great prices.  Fair prices.  Would most definitely call them again.  Thank you A&E!

reviews.author: Mihir Chauhan
reviews.text: We worked with Juan for gas line installation. He did the job professionally and also coordinated with Xcel energy very well without any followup. I would highly recommend him for any plumbing work.

plumbers.name: Yogi's Plumbing & Drain Service
plumbers.address: 810 Bonita Dr, Encinitas, CA 92024, USA

reviews.author: Ken Lowe
reviews.text:
I had just completed an extensive tenant improvement of an OSHPD3 certified medical and dental clinic in Kearny Mesa with Justin Shane and the Yogis Plumbing crew. Now it was time for the important project…changing out a couple of aged faucets at my North County home.

I moved into this house almost a decade ago. The remodel, "for sale" job that was done to the house I purchased included some very low end faucets. Two of them reached in the point of corrosion that their metal bases at their connection were literally rotting away.

Tim, who also worked on the clinic project recognized my name from my design plans, although we had not met. He was more than respectful, courteous, conscientious and efficient. Tim worked quickly and most significantly did not leave a mess behind. (Please note, not even on a commercial job site did Yogi leave a mess!)

Since my wife and I are planning a kitchen remodel we did not go for a terribly extravagant faucet. BTW—Tim assured us the white grout you see in the image will be clear when it dries. However with the same thought in mind, after the installation of the en suite bathroom faucet, we may just reuse the one installed in the image. It looks pretty good.

We highly recommend Justin and his crew, Yogi Plumbing and Drain Service. We intend to utilize their services on a million dollar home remodel/addition project, that we have under design in Solana Beach.

reviews.author: Patricia Glinni
reviews.text:
Update: Justin came by today to check the damage his technician caused in my bathroom. When confronting he immediately started to get very defensive, telling me that  the damage was already there and that it is corrosion. We clean the drain every week and it was never like that and for fact did not look like that before his technician came. We are aware that underneath on the inside their was corrosion build up, but before his technician came the outside was clean and silver, now it looks like it has been dented and chewed up. They obviously don’t want or like to take responsibility. He tried claiming that the crack that the technician left from changing the bath tub spout was already there before and that it was hiding underneath the old spout. The old spout was the same size maybe a cm bigger and the crack left was between 1/2 to 1inch. When my son pointed that out he quickly changed his answer. You could tell with the way he responded that he was scared to take responsibility for what was caused by his technician. I had to have my handyman come this morning to properly fill the cracks. I will say that they are nice guys but be careful when you work with them they will not stand behind their work and take responsibility when damage has been caused.

So far I did not have a good experience with yogi’s pluming they have not reached out to resolve the problem mean while we cannot use the shower until the overflow is put in right , the technician replaced my faucet and caused some damages a crack around the spout and the overflow has a gap at the top we are afraid water will sip trough and my drain was perfectly shiny before he come to fix my faucet and is now damaged  all chewy up, when I ask the technician what he did to my drain he said he didn’t touched which he is clearly not taking responsibility for it. yogis claim they  are not responsible for that because he come to do the faucet not the overflow and the drain. well I don’t understand why he removed the overflow and didn’t replace right leaving a gap at the top, I  have photos of the faucet before was replaced but I don’t have the photo of the drain. Am very disappointed of their serviced they are really not standing by their work , I really hope they make this right. I Took this photo of my faucet before was fixed to take to Home Depot to see if I could find a match .Here is photos before and after we have paid $600 for this job it should be perfect.

reviews.author: Pete Murray
reviews.text: My go to plumber retired and I've had trouble replacing him until now. Yogis did a fantastic job on a sink I've had other plumbers charge me quite a bit to fix unsuccessfully. Aaron was very transparent about the work he was doing and did great job at a fair price.

reviews.author: Jan Kiehl
reviews.text: Yogi's office staff was quick to respond to our repair needs.  They took thorough notes on our issues, and they and their plumbers were polite and attentive to resolving our problems. The plumbers work was done in a timely manner.  They were respectful and quiet as they worked, and left everything neat and clean. Their work looks to be done well.  Time will tell if it is, but we feel fairly confident in their work.

reviews.author: John V
reviews.text: This is the third time we’ve used Yogi’s.  Eric and his partner did a fabulous job.  Eric is very knowledgeable and explained all of the work that was required.  The job was done professionally - with a fair price.  We highly recommend Yogi’s for your plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Marc Francis Plumbing, LLC
plumbers.address: 1019 Quality Cir, Johnson City, TN 37615, USA

reviews.author: JR Rizvi
reviews.text: The work done by Lawrence from Marc Francis plumbing was on time prepared to do the job and had all items stocked so no matter what I asked him to fix he did right away. I would recommend him and this company for your plumbing needs. They guarantee their work which is hard to find.  I had an expansion tank put in and pressure reducer valve and galvanized parts removed because of lead containment and they rust out quickly. He replaced the two I had. Did a really good job!

reviews.author: robert stykes
reviews.text: I called them on December 23 with a very slow washing machine drain.  They sent Lawrence to look at the job and give me an estimate.  Planned to install a service sink and pump to pump out into main sewer line on December 30.  He arrived promptly on time and Marc, the owner met him here with the sink and pump.  It was more work than he expected, so he stayed and help until he had to go meet an inspector on another job.  Lawrence finished the job and cleaned up everything afterwards.  They actually forgot to install the straps to anchor the piping, so I called them the next morning and they had completed the work before noon on the 31st.  I was very impressed with their work and professional service.  They have another satisfied customer !!   Thanks again Bob S

reviews.author: Heidi Nicole
reviews.text: Marc and his son are AMAZING! Best plumbing experience we have had by far. They are friendly and efficient and did their job professionally and with excellence! They fixed our sink drain perfectly!! Would highly recommend!!

reviews.author: James Ivey
reviews.text: 10 out of 10 would recommend. Lawrence showed up early, was kind & courteous, and very professional. The job was completed quickly and thoroughly with no mess. Will absolutely use again for our next plumbing service!

reviews.author: J A
reviews.text: Extremely professional and knowledgeable. Fair pricing as well! Was born and raised here and they are the best Ive dealt with..our go to for all plumbing needs!

plumbers.name: Esser Plumbing
plumbers.address: 830 Walnut St #1, Elyria, OH 44035, USA

reviews.author: Nima Arabi
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience with Esser Plumbing! They are incredibly punctual, super reasonable, and get the job DONE right the very first time. Seriously—don’t waste your time looking anywhere else. Thomas and Rob at Esser Plumbing went above and beyond for us, and they’ll take care of your plumbing needs just as perfectly as they did ours at Midway Pointe. Highly, highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ed Oley
reviews.text: When calling to schedule an appointment to fix my Outdoor fireplaces gas valve the individual. I talk to was very courteous and worked with me on the time. Travis came out to my house and was able to fix the issue with the gas valve. He was very service oriented very kind And I was very happy with him and his work.

reviews.author: Karen Dano
reviews.text: Travis from ESSER Plumbing was here to fix a clogged drain and low water pressure in my kitchen sink. I am beyond happy and I have to say he was very polite and knowledgeable and did not make a mess! Travis has been a plumber for 17 years, and I trust him! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kevin Villa
reviews.text: Amazing service from Travis. My bathtub was leaking, and he was able to fix it in no time. He handled the job with professionalism and care, and he even arrived on time despite the extremely inclement weather. The price was very fair as well. I’ll be using this company for all my future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Katherine Ferchalk
reviews.text:
Ryan, Travis, Tony, and Charlie of Ray Esser & Sons did a spectacular job!  The closet in the garage is cleaner now than when they got here and the concrete slab they had to cut from the surrounding of our house looks almost like it did before (see pics)!  All four went above and beyond to clean up – even though it had rained and the mud stuck to everything.  They were courteous and conscientious in communication and while physically completing the job.  Far beyond what I had expected and I couldn’t be more impressed with the work they did.  True professionals!

When we bought our house we knew that the cistern had to go and we needed to hook up to rural water.  Finding a plumber, we thought, would be the most complicated part of this process.  Turns out that hiring Ray Esser & Sons has been the simplest and most pain free part of the process.  Ray Esser & Sons came highly recommended by word of mouth from the people my husband works with as well and I now understand why!

Within a week of contacting them they came out, gave us a quote and did two days’ worth of work.  The whole process had one contact person which made communication between me and my husband easy as he was the one who they explained everything to, but I was the one who stayed home to be at the house while the job was done.  I was nervous being here alone and about explaining what was done, but the men put me at ease, did a great job explaining, and even let me video tape the explanation so I didn’t have to remember it all.

Based on my dealings with them thus far I have no doubts that they did the job well and that if something goes wrong, they will stick to their promise to come out and fix it.  I would give them 5+ stars if I could.  It is nice to know that truly professional companies still exist who employ skilled tradesmen and that you can trust what they tell you.  If you had any doubts about hiring this company, I hope this review helps end those doubts.  My husband and I are very pleased with our decision and will call Ray Esser & Sons for any plumbing needs we have in the future – they’ve earned a customer for life.

plumbers.name: Top Notch Plumbing, LLC
plumbers.address: 1425 Amity Rd, Anderson, SC 29621, USA

reviews.author: Tish Dobbins
reviews.text:
Top Notch Plumbing truly lives up to their name! Reign and Trey came out and handled our plumbing issue quickly and accurately. They were professional, efficient, and clearly knew exactly what they were doing.

Not only did they get the job done fast, but they were also wonderful to talk to — respectful, friendly, and easy to communicate with. They listened to what we needed and delivered exactly that without any hassle.

If you’re looking for dependable, skilled plumbers who take pride in their work, I highly recommend Top Notch Plumbing. We’ll definitely be calling them again! 💧🔧

reviews.author: Marie Waters
reviews.text: Our water decided to stop running on Sunday morning during the weekend cold spell.  I left a voicemail for Top Notch describing the problem.  Cole came on Monday morning to assess the issue.  Turns out our water line wasn't buried and was just beneath the sod.  He gave us a quote for the job which we accepted.  Trey and Reign came Tuesday afternoon to begin the repairs.  They found more issues but our quote only slightly changed.  They found out lines to the house were improperly installed when it was built.  About two and a half hours later they had the job down.  We will have to do some resoding when the weather is right but having water was more important.  Also if you are a veteran, they will give you a discount.  They rescued us after two friends spent several hours on Sunday trying to thaw what they thought might be a frozen line but we also had a defective pressure relief valve.

reviews.author: Michele Lockaby
reviews.text: Trey was very knowledgeable and professional. Answered all of our questions and gave us the best option for repairing the outside pipe leak. Price was great and job was done in a timely manner. We will be using Top Notch for all of our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Joseph Moore
reviews.text:
I can’t recommend this company enough! When we started our bathroom remodel, we needed all new shower lines installed, and he absolutely knocked it out of the park. The work was clean, precise, and done with real attention to detail.

On top of that, I accidentally broke my shower drain (total homeowner moment), and he fixed it quickly. He also installed new plumbing lines for our new vanity, and everything works perfectly.

Cole and his team are very professional, reliable, honest, and clearly take pride in their work. It’s hard to find someone you can fully trust in your home, but he’s the real deal. If you need plumbing work done right the first time, this is your guy!

reviews.author: Patsy Bradley
reviews.text: This is the 1st time using them. They answered the call promptly and we were scheduled the next day. Trey and Ellison work well together and got the job done. We had a natural gas line capped off so we could use electric logs safely. We're very pleased with their work and would definitely recommend them.

plumbers.name: Pickwick Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 777 West Putnam Avenue Suite 300, Greenwich, CT 06830, USA

reviews.author: Brian Metkiff
reviews.text: Excellent! Heat went out, I called and Mike was able to arrange an emergency visit from Victor. Victor promptly fixed the issue, explained everything to us, helping us learn more about our house. Nicest guy, saved our butts on one of the coldest nights of the year and during superbowl none the less!

reviews.author: Arnold Gordon
reviews.text: Although the service man came and even early, it turned out that the blockage had cleared without his intervention.  But he was helpful in confirming that all was well with the toilet.  I hope the price for the visit will reflect this.

reviews.author: Alan Gaynor
reviews.text:
Joe is the best and Lewis too!! They identified the issue and fixed it. Joe gave specific recommendations to help avoid frozen pipes. Now I have to find someone to wrap the pipes.
You all are super responsive and first rate!!
Thank you!!
Alan

reviews.author: edward west
reviews.text: From start to finish, I am impressed with Pickwick Plumbing. I was referred by a friend of mine after going on a search for a emergency service call.  Pickwick was able to come next day to fix a gas line for us and kept us in the loop with progress the whole way.  Mike was great!!

reviews.author: David Jakubowski
reviews.text:
Amazing service. Our gear went out at like 9:30 on a Saturday night. Within an hour, victor showed up - another hour, hear back on - rescued our weekend in 30 degree temps!
Great service, great company.  Support local, it's worth it!

plumbers.name: Premier 1 Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 120 E Santa Anita Ave, Burbank, CA 91502, USA

reviews.author: Chareena-Alexa Pascua
reviews.text: The kitchen sink had been backing up for a week and a simple snake wasnt doing anything for the grease buildup in those old Burbank pipes. Alexis in the office was great at setting up everything and it was all on time which started the experience off right. Junior showed up and explained how the hydrojet would actually clear the walls of the pipe instead of just poking a hole in the clog. He was careful not to make a mess under the cabinets and the drains are flowing better than they have in years.

reviews.author: Sharon Garcia
reviews.text: I noticed some weird damp spots in the yard near the main line and was dreading having the whole lawn dug up for a repair. Alexis was great at communicating the entire trenchless pipe repair process and walked me through how they could reline the existing pipe from the inside instead. It was actually pretty cool to see the camera footage of the roots and then hear exactly how the epoxy liner would seal everything up without a backhoe ruining my landscaping. Having someone who actually explains the timeline and the tech behind the fix made me feel way more confident about the whole investment.

reviews.author: Jane Shelton
reviews.text: Junior explained that a standard snake was only going to poke a small hole in the clog and that I really needed a full hydrojetting in Pasadena to actually scrub the pipe walls. He showed me the before and after on the monitor and you could see a huge difference in how much gunk was removed from the main line. It is cool to see a technician who actually has the right high pressure equipment to do the job properly instead of just doing a temporary fix. The drains have never flowed this fast since we moved in.

reviews.author: Genevieve Zendejas
reviews.text: We tried Premier 1 Plumbing for the first time this Tuesday and they were just fine! I know there are cheaper options with other drain cleaning services, but we've used those others before and well it sometimes is not quite right. The other companies guys were not so patient/ professional / knowledgeable or concerned with getting it right.  David and Junior used their camera to inspect my drain pipe, they showed me where the problem began and where it was more serious. They used a special tool to locate exactly where the camera head was exactly how deep!

reviews.author: Youmei Li
reviews.text: Literally had a puddle forming under my water heater on a Sunday morning and was totally bracing for a huge repair bill. This plumber showed up in like forty minutes and it turned out to just be a loose connection on the intake pipe. He tightened everything up and checked the pressure valve while he was here just to be safe. Super honest guy and didn't even try to charge me an arm and a leg for a weekend house call.

plumbers.name: H. Hofmeister & Co. Inc. Plumbing Heating AC Sewer
plumbers.address: 115 Bergenline Ave, Westwood, NJ 07675, USA

reviews.author: Gaetano Travaglio
reviews.text:
I recently had Hofmeister come out to my house to fix a clogged/leaking toilet, and I couldn’t be happier with the service. From start to finish, everything was handled professionally and efficiently.

The technician, Jesus, was excellent! He was very professional, detail-oriented, and thorough in his work. He took the time to walk me through each step of what needed to be done and explained everything clearly. I really appreciated that he didn’t rush the job and made sure everything was fixed properly before leaving. The level of care says a lot about the company.On top of that, the pricing was very fair for the quality of service provided.

I highly recommend Hofmeister to anyone who needs plumbing work, HVAC and Heating services, etc. They’re reliable, professional, and easy to work with. I wouldn’t hesitate to call them again.

reviews.author: Brian Nitzberg
reviews.text:
Shawn from H. Hofmeister & Co. did an outstanding job fixing our basement toilet and ejector pump. The service was fast, professional, and extremely thorough from start to finish. He clearly explained the entire process, walked me through what was happening, and made sure I understood all the details before moving forward.

It’s not always easy to find someone who combines speed with real expertise, but Shawn absolutely delivered. Everything is working perfectly now, and I feel confident in the quality of the work that was done.

Highly recommend Shawn and H. Hofmeister & Co. if you’re looking for knowledgeable, efficient, and trustworthy plumbing service.

reviews.author: Sandra Massaro
reviews.text: I had a recent emergency with my furnace. I called and spoke with Nancy who was very helpful and even came over to reassure me and provide heaters. Harold came over within a few hours and was able to find and resolve the issue. Hofmeister is knowledgeable, reliable, reasonably priced, and takes the time to explain everything to their customers.

reviews.author: Roland K
reviews.text: I reached out for an emergency when my pipes had frozen and we had no hot water or cold water.  They sent Shawn over within half an hour. He replaced the pipes that needed replacing    Reset the hot water heater and guided us in the best way to keep it from happening again. Super happy with the speed and quality of service and cost.  Will be using them for all my future heating and plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Roseann McCarthy
reviews.text: Hofmeister Plumbing is my go to plumber! Nancy is a pleasure to work with and is always responsive. The plumbers show up when promised and their work is meticulous. Hofmeister has done several jobs/projects at my house and I’ve always been 100% satisfied. Most recently, Harold and Jesus installed a new membrane in my shower. They did a fabulous job! I highly recommend Hofmeister for your plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Mission Mechanical
plumbers.address: 4437 Bragdon St, Indianapolis, IN 46226, USA

reviews.author: Coleman Gerstner
reviews.text: Lucas was great at Mission. I appreciate that they send the same technician because I have a unit in a golf bay and he knows how to access it and does everything efficiently and well. Really appreciate the work that Lucas and the Mission team do to help me keep my climate controlled promise to my customers!

reviews.author: Jonathan Noble
reviews.text: Lukas was excellent! Help my family and me get our new thermostat wired properly and got our furnace back up and running, all over the phone. He was extremely knowledgeable, very kind, very patient. Mission mechanical and Lukas definitely are worth their salt!

reviews.author: Brianna jones
reviews.text: Mission Mechanical should add 'MIRACLE' to their name! My furnace went out two days before a bad winter storm hit Indianapolis. I was referred to Mission, and the owner made sure to get me on the schedule for a new install right away (I wish I remembered his name). Chris and his team worked diligently to get my new furnace and AC unit installed just in the nick of time. I have a three year old son, so I appreciated being able to pick him up from daycare and bring him back to a warm home. Chris came out a week later for a quality inspection and everything looked good. Diana in accounting was also a pleasure to work with! She was easy to communicate with and very patient as we worked through my best options for payment. Overall, I'm thankful for the good people at Mission. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text: This was my first time working with Mission Mechanical and I couldn’t be happier! It was easy and quick to schedule the work, they arrived promptly as promised; the tech is polite and knowledgeable and was able to diagnose and repair in short order. The price was fair and the work completed neatly!  Mission mechanical has earned my business from now on!

reviews.author: Tim Kelly
reviews.text:
Kimbra was a pleasure to work with.
She had me scheduled supper fast.
James and Brad where also great. Showed up got to work and had the job complete in a very timely manner.
Was very professional, cleaned up after themselves. I would highly recommend them and your company.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 27 Hunter Rd Ste A, Hilton Head Island, SC 29926, USA

reviews.author: Randy and Deb Johnson
reviews.text: Having clogged toilets is a scary proposition, but we made the right call by calling Roto-Rooter. The receptionist was very kind and understanding and assured us that she would send someone out that same day.  Harrison our tech put us totally at ease. He explained what the problem was, showed us pictures and gave us our options. He is very knowledgeable, confident and the work he did was very thorough and well done.  We would highly recommend Roto-Rooter and especially Harrison!

reviews.author: Jane Smith
reviews.text:
Josh and Ryan were so nice.  They answered all of our questions and kept us updated as they installed the new water heater.  We aren’t familiar with competitive pricing, but the service was excellent and we are  well pleased.
The water mitigation team, led by Ethan, were quick to respond and extremely helpful and knowledgeable.  His team was easy to communicate with and very polite.  Ethan even helped to explain the situation to our insurance company when I called in the claim.  We were very pleased.  I highly recommend Roto Rooter.

reviews.author: Regan Merritt Perry
reviews.text:
We found the clean out you missed on your three visits to our house. To be fair you only missed it the first time and simply never looked for it the next two times you came out. Since the problem was never resolved, it returned a few weeks after you left. So we opened our first clean out. Dry pipe. So we looked for a second clean out, found it & opened it up. Out came several ancient hunks of laundry detergent turned to rocks. You did NOT need to pull the toilet for the snake on your first visit, which included spilling the sewage in the hall and bathroom TWICE! Your estimate of $10,000 repipe offered on the second and third visits was NOT what was needed. The second clean out is about 25 feet from the one you found. Actually in plain view from there. I am including photos of the second clean out and the soap rocks you could not find and did not address. Your guess of a low spot in the pipe was not correct. You noticed we ran the laundry water outside/not thru the septic line. The soap was there over 8 years. The clog was simply NOT found.
We are stunned how lame you are! We fixed the problem ourselves but paid you $650. Go figure!
So, NOT calling you ever again.

reviews.author: Jackie Eby
reviews.text: This was the first time I ever had to hire a plumber! My sewer line was completely blocked! I made that call to Roto Rooter. On a Sunday, the company had their Professional plumber, Harrison at my home. He was so curtious, professional and a pleasure to converse with. He solved the problem right away!! If I ever need help again I will be sure to call them first!! 5 stars for the entire experience. Thank you so much for your fast response.

reviews.author: Buzz Bonds
reviews.text: I had issues with my water heater and had no idea what was causing it. I contacted Chandler Drew  with Roto rooter and he came  and in no time he found the issue. It was a busted water line  I can’t tell you how much it made my life better. I would recommend them to anyone .  Chandler was excellent

plumbers.name: Harms Services
plumbers.address: 34 Alamos Dr, Cottonwood, AZ 86326, USA

reviews.author: Lavon Sargent
reviews.text: Jacob, my technician, was on time for the appointment, and met me with a smile, a handshake and introduction.  I like that!  I showed him the plumbing issue, and he immediately assessed the situation and discussed it with me... in language that a person, NOT in the plumbing business, can understand.  He was courteous, professional, friendly, funny, and very knowledgeable.  It has been a long time since I have had a plumbing contractor get above average marks on all of the above!!  However Jacob... AND the office representative, Renee (sp?) were exemplary!  I am extremely pleased with the service.    The visit today was an 'estimate price' for potential plumbing work, and based on the service I have received thus far, I expect that I will hire them to do the job.  I am confident that the quality of the work will be consistent with everything I have experienced.

reviews.author: Keith Woods
reviews.text: Needed a water heater repair work done. Called Harms Services on a Wednesday and was able to get a technician out the next day in the morning. The technician’s name was Jacob, and he was very friendly, courteous and finished the job quickly. He also shared insights on the repair and how it likely happens. I would recommend Harms Services if any plumbing work is needed.

reviews.author: Jon Elliott
reviews.text: Inspection services for a new (to me) home purchase in Verde Valley. Jason and Eric were awesome! They were prompt, professional, knowledgeable, and answered all my questions. I received itemized estimates and now I just have to prioritize the work I want done. I highly recommend you give them a call!

reviews.author: Gary Woods
reviews.text: Jacob arrived 15 minutes after our request for services.  He immediately understood the problem and what the repair would entail.   He quoted us a reasonable price and the work was completed within 2 hours.

reviews.author: Chris Drozdowski
reviews.text:
Needed two long leaking hose bibs replaced. Called on Monday and someone came the next day to evaluate the job. We agreed on the price and he was able to do the work the same day. I was kept informed every step of the way and the technician was neat and communicative. Couldn’t have had a better experience.

Update: James, the plumber working on our home, said that the pipe to one hose bib had been repaired before and had 2 couplers installed during those fixes. He said that wasn't good and was going to  cut those out and replace the full length (7-8") of copper pipe. Turns out he did not do that and hours after his added repair, one of those couplings started to leak and spray water in our wall - ended up with soaked sheetrock, insulation and carpeting.  Had to turn the water off to the house until they could come out the next morning and fix. THEN James replaced the full length of copper and didn't seem to even remember he said he was going to do that originally. Now this area smells musty and I worry about mold. So -- the fix was done quickly but should never have been needed and I may have mold growing in my wall/carpet and paid full price for the work. Had to turn a 5 star review to a 2 star.

plumbers.name: Plumbing Detectives
plumbers.address: 39064 US Hwy 19 N, Tarpon Springs, FL 34689, USA

reviews.author: Beej Harriel
reviews.text: We had a leak at our Preschool during business hours. Jonny and Jake showed up and quickly diagnosed the issue. It didn’t take long before our drinking fountain was up and running again! Thanks Plumbing Detectives for prompt service!!

reviews.author: Louie
reviews.text:
Like many of you, I’ve struggled to find a reliable plumber. After going through several different companies, I ended up putting off a few projects because I just wasn’t confident in who to hire. Fortunately, my neighbor highly recommended Plumbing Detectives — and I’m glad I waited.

It was a pleasure dealing with the company representative from the start. The office staff was wonderful to work with and kept me informed throughout the entire process, which I truly appreciated.

Jakob, the plumber, did an outstanding job. He was on time, polite, and very professional. His workmanship was meticulous and well done, and he took the time to clean up thoroughly after completing the job.

I would highly recommend this company to anyone looking for quality plumbing services.

reviews.author: Rob Olesen
reviews.text:
Initially I thought the quote was high, but after the work, I knew I had under paid! The work that they did was HIGHLY under  estimated , and they did a prestige job! They did such an impressive job, and left no mess!  I will ALWAYS use you guys! Thank you sincerely!

Also, I had to have a new toilet installed and had Jakobcome out, who was such an impressive, and professional young plumber. So, great! Thank you all so much!

reviews.author: Dr.TuneEmAll
reviews.text: Absolutely outstanding service from Plumbing Detectives! From the first phone call to the completed job, everything was professional, efficient, and stress-free. The plumber arrived on time, clearly explained the issue, and fixed it quickly without any upselling or surprises. You can tell they genuinely care about doing the job right. Clean work, fair pricing, and excellent communication throughout. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Plumbing Detectives to anyone needing reliable plumbing services!

reviews.author: Tison Velez
reviews.text:
Plumbing Detectives is our go-to plumbing company for our property management business. They are local, family-owned, and consistently provide outstanding service across all of our properties.

Their communication is excellent, customer service is top-notch, and they are always professional and reliable. Most importantly, their pricing is fair and upfront—no surprises, which is critical when managing homes and working with owners.

They show up when they say they will, explain issues clearly, and stand behind their work. We confidently recommend Plumbing Detectives to our owners and tenants and will continue using them as our preferred plumbing vendor.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Clearwater
plumbers.address: 13790 Roosevelt Blvd Ste D, Clearwater, FL 33762, USA

reviews.author: Team Rio
reviews.text: Hey my name is nicole, I just want to say big shout out and thank you so much to Damien for coming out and giving five star service on our broken toilet tonight it is currently 11:00 p.m. at night and he's been here for several hours to make sure that we have our toilet working. He's the best plumber that I know who will get the job done he wore shoe covers inside of my house was very respectful and such a nice kid Mr rooter is very pleased to have him he has a heart of a champion way to go Damien and way to represent this company like you do thank you so much Mr rooter for getting the job done same day service was 10 out of 10

reviews.author: Peter Protopsaltis
reviews.text:
Josh and Quintin did an outstanding job during our recent service call. From the moment they arrived, they were professional, respectful, and extremely courteous. What initially seemed like a routine drain repair turned out to be a much more complicated issue due to hardened material from years of non-use, but they handled it with patience, skill, and a great attitude.

They took the time to explain the situation clearly, worked efficiently, and made sure everything was functioning properly before leaving. It’s rare to find technicians who are not only knowledgeable but also genuinely pleasant to work with. Josh and Quintin are true professionals, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them or request them again in the future.

reviews.author: Samantha Horvath
reviews.text: Omer was professional, knowledgeable, and willing to stay as long as it took to ensure the issue was solved. He went over and beyond to make sure my issue was taken care of and to prevent future issues. Highly recommend Mr. Rooter! They also text you the info of your appointment as well as info of your service agent, so you know exactly who will be showing up to your home.

reviews.author: Jovon Garvin
reviews.text: Damien did a great job in helping repair our broken toilet. His professionalism and customer service was next level. I would recommend him for any repair needs. Next level service 10 out of 10.

reviews.author: Hayley Pflug

reviews.author: Cynthia Prokop
reviews.text: Shane was wonderful! He listened to our concerns, responsive, & resolved our septic issue. Tom was great about the cleaning & shared helpful guidance. Great attitude & super knowledgeable. Highly recommend. 👍🏻

reviews.author: Diane Gibson
reviews.text: Very prompt, Shane was so friendly and efficient. I was worried that I would have to have a whole new septic system, but Shane was able to fix everything and locate my septic tank which in 60 years we never knew where it was. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Joe Northrop
reviews.text:
Jason was on time, personable, and thorough.
Answered all my questions. Did a good job. When he was here it was the coldest day of the year so far . He walked my property about 1 acre checking for blockages and probing my lines . He snaked my lines the next day outside using a torpedo heater.
Affordable, gained a new customer from now on.

reviews.author: Michelle Holmes
reviews.text: Jason went above and beyond on the service that he provided. We needed someone to look at our system and give us guidance on what steps we should take to resolve the issue we were having with our septic. He did research into the history of our system and gave us detail notes of his findings. Jason was very polite and professional. We will definitely use him again in the future and recommend him to anyone.

reviews.author: John Marron
reviews.text:
Jason was friendly and efficient. Thank you for removing the roots from my system.

reviews.author: Ronald Becker
reviews.text: Be aware.  My experience with Stilwell Plumbers was horrible.  I was told the crew would arrive at 8:00 am to start on my water line replacement from the meter to the house.  They showed up at 1:30 pm.  In fact the final state inspector showed up for inspection before the crew did. Once the crew showed up late, they were in a hurry to get the job done.  They dug up my front lawn and destroyed my newly replaced sidewalk leaving it a disaster.  I was told that they would return in the spring to fix the lawn and sidewalk.  Never once any means of contact.  All they did was come out and throw hey to hide their sloppiness.  Its now May and my lawn still looks ashamed and my sidewalk stands crooked and is a trip hazard.  I also had to have my basement floor cleaned due to all the mud and dirt that their crew tracked inside.  What was really upsetting is that I had several estimates that were less, but I chose Stilwell thinking I would get a lot better service.  As it turned out I was wrong.  Very disappointed and upset of the final outcome.  Now I have to pay to get my sidewalk and lawn repaired.  The tech did say he was missing the proper tools to the job correctly and I was told that was the best he could do for what he had to work with.  If I would of known this from the start I would have chosen a different company.  I will say they did repair my broken waterline, but in the future if I need a plumber, I will be looking elsewhere than Stilwell.

reviews.author: James White
reviews.text: Lamont was fantastic. Came to the house promptly and had a high attention to detail about his work. He was great at explaining things to me and shared more about services that Stilwell offered. He is the reason we will continue to utilize this company. Shoutout to Lamont

reviews.author: Elona Shannon
reviews.text: Stilwell Plumbing came out really quickly when I needed help, which I appreciated. The plumber was friendly, professional, and knew exactly what he was doing. He got straight to the problem and fixed it without wasting time. Everything was handled smoothly and I didn’t have to stress about it. I’d definitely call them again if I ever need plumbing work.

reviews.author: Diane Fantone
reviews.text: We had several plumbing issues and still well Plumming came out right away to address our needs. Lamount did an awesome job taking care of everything that needed to be done. We really appreciate his expertise and the time he took to fix our plumbing issues.

reviews.author: steven brown
reviews.text:
Stilwell’s team did an outstanding job fixing our plumbing problem.   More specifically, we had an underground damaged/leaking water main pipe, caused by a contractor installing a fence gate.

Although the initial call was made to Stilwell during non business hours, they answered immediately.

A crew surveyed the problem. They were polite and explained in detail the needed repairs.  The cost was reasonable and the repairs were made.

All went well.  Recommend Stilwell for your plumbing job!

plumbers.address: 70 Main St Suite 23, Warrenton, VA 20186, USA

reviews.author: Brenda K
reviews.text:
Very fast service. Same day I called, excellent service would definitely use them again. They worked all day in the pouring rain to replace the well pump in our rental house. Great service,
Thank you so much Clearwater Well & Pump!

reviews.author: ken larrick
reviews.text: Had my well pump go out, two guys come quickly. I can only remember one’s name, Thomas, complete professional. He was knowledgeable, polite and hard working. Fair pricing on parts and labor, they even went back and double checked everything to make sure I got the best out of what this well can produce. If he’s due for promotion it should happen immediately. He gave great advice on what to watch for and wasn’t disparaging toward the existing equipment or companies that were there before him. They have earned Clearwater my business.

reviews.author: Maria O'Brien
reviews.text: I called in as a bit of an emergency because our whole house was without water. Dan was able to get a crew out to us incredibly quickly and they did an excellent job diagnosing and fixing the problem, which was a failed pressure tank. Both men were very professional and knowledgeable. I really appreciated their fast and courteous service, a job well done, and my water restored!

reviews.author: BobCat Patton
reviews.text:
Dan, the owner, visited the site on short notice and discussed the installation of a new 500 ft well pump and line from the well head to a barn and the installation of a pressure tank and 3 outside hydrants and the electrical requirements and assorted other bits for a complete installation. This is my first well installation so I had a lot of questions.
Two employees arrived about a week later and did the installation. It was a full days job but went quickly and efficiently. Everyone could not have been friendlier or more easy to work with. They went out of their way to explain the procedures as they worked.
This was one of the largest expenses I had in the construction process so price really mattered to me. I got 3 bids on the installation. The first was outrageous and the 2nd seemed more normal but still too high for my budget. I considered trying to do it myself but thought I would try one last time to find a professional. I called Clear Water after a google search and never looked back. From beginning to end they were excellent. And I’m glad I didn’t try doing it on my own. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Ben Koppenhaver
reviews.text: ClearWater Well & Pump has provide excellent service for us this year. Bought an older house in the summer and they have been helping us get the well back in tip top shape. They are very efficient workers and reasonably priced. They are a great resource of knowledge aswell. Would absolutely recommend!

plumbers.address: 191 Dillon Ave, Campbell, CA 95008, USA

reviews.author: Theresa Paloma
reviews.text:
Our master bath tub was not draining and nothing seemed to help unclog it. We were referred to Knockout plumbing and they were immediately responsive. Martin came to the house, gave us a quote and his crew was available to do the job on the same day! They were professional, courteous and got the job done quickly. One of the most impressive things they did was to wear shoe covers while in our house to minimize any dirt and debris. After, they collected all their trash and hauled it away.
There was an issue after the job was complete and Martin was immediately available to assist us. He was able to provide a solution and send his crew to resolve it. Overall, they provided excellent customer service and focused on quality to get the job done right. Definitely highly recommended for plumbing needs and would use them again.

reviews.author: Jennifer Keenan
reviews.text: I loved Knockout Plumbing.  They exceeded expectations with communication and I really appreciate this! I would highly recommend them. They did a full replacement of piping under the house, which was built in the 50s.  Top Notch.  I love Martin and Axel - they were great!

reviews.author: Andrea Ai
reviews.text: Professional and knowledgeable crews. I had a project for a whole building repiping for a multi unit residential housing and contacted 6 plumbing companies around. Knockout is the most cost and time efficient repiping company among all of them. Their pricing is reasonable and they know what they are doing. Those guys kept their promises of the project timing despite of working late. They coordinated with the tenants and went above and beyond to ensure for a quality delivery. They take ownership of their responsibilities with the tenants and are very professional. We got all the repiping done with permit on time. Extremely grateful for their services!

reviews.author: 潔妮
reviews.text: Jason and his team worker came to have the free estimate for my crawl basement issues is rainwater seepage . He is professional, easy to communicate with. Best thing is Jason aimed for the root cause, not just the symptoms of current issues having a sincere and patient attitude. Thank you!

reviews.author: Susan Kontich
reviews.text:
Knockout did an excellent job for us and I highly recommend them. We started our journey with an estimate to replace all the vertical and horizontal waste water pipes under our home.  Our house is 70 years old and we noticed cast iron pipes that seem to be deteriorating.  We looked it up and their life rage is about 70 years so we bit the bullet and got estimates from 4 different companies.  They all seemed good but Knockout offered some things the others did not.  They offered a 25 year transferable warranty, they acquired and arranged for permits.  They also put back the dry wall that they had to removed to do the job.  The man that did the texturing did a great job.  He matched the 70 year old texturing style that was in our family room.  I was truly amazed. This sewer pipe replacement, grew to include all the water pipes, and then to replace the sewer line from the house to the street and unknown to use we had a second line that was leaking under our garage floor.  This turned into a really really big job.  It could have been a nightmare but it was not. Martin, Axil and the rest of the crew totally took care of us and our house. Every day I would receive an email telling me when they would be there to work or when an inspection was happening.  They were the most cautious and careful of our house.  They protected my floors, and carpet and walls.  THEY NEVER LEFT A MESS EVER.
I watched them clean, sweep and scrub down our driveway when they had used it as a work space.  They were absolutely incredible.  Clean, neat,  work that was approved by the city and sewer department and great communication with us the entire time. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THEM IF YOU HAVE ANY PLUMBING NEEDS BUT ESPECIALLY IF YOU HAVE A BIG JOB.
THANK KNOCKOUT,  YOUR WORK ETHIC KNOCKED ME OUT.
Susan and Mark Kontich

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 1160 Brickyard Cove Rd Ste 200-11, Richmond, CA 94801, USA

reviews.author: Tina Denetclaw
reviews.text:
Clearing the drain cost more than twice what our local plumbing company would have charged based on cost of labor. Stated estimate for repairing just the broken y-pipe was $6,301;  we paid less than $600 to have our local plumbing company to repair both that pipe and the shower drain leak. Roto-Rooter supervisor told us we needed a $16,000 replacement of our iron plumbing and his technician told us they are required to inform us of the needed work. Our local plumbing company told us the iron piping is old but in good shape and does not need to be replaced.

Roto-Rooter estimated verbally $5,000 to $8,000 for a needed "lake of sewage" clean-up, then showed up the next day to do the work when we had not approved that work to be done. (Wife could hear from the bedroom above the conversation between husband and Roto-Rooter restoration person; husband made it very clear that wife must agree with estimate before any work is done.) Our local plumbing company said the leak was from the kitchen and laundry line of the plumbing and all that would be done is vacuum up about a gallon of water then put down kitty litter for the small and decreasing amount of fluid.

The younger tech had a stern attitude about the work his supervisor said needed to be done (said it was their responsibility to inform us) and expressed a conformational attitude toward wife when she questioned the overpricing. The supervisor was throwing around nonsense numbers. He told us he was already saving us $2,000 on the pipe repair when the discount stated was $671 ($6,301 down from $6,972, a $671 difference). Again, our local plumbing company did the repair for less than 10% of Roto-Rooter's estimate). The Roto-Rooter supervisor seemed friendly, but his words and demeanor felt like sleight-of-hand, high-pressure tactics.

In the past, a Roto-Rooter technician cleared plumbing for us at a reasonable price and was straight forward and respectful. This current experience was much, much different than that.

We won't be calling Roto-Rooter again.

reviews.author: Ramona Marks
reviews.text: I called Roto Rooter because our sewer line needed to be snaked. They arrived within an hour.  Upon arrival the technician agreed that the line needed to be snaked and said that it would cost $500.  I told him that I had a coupon that was offered on RR website for $100.  He went to his van and wrote up a receipt for $590. and said that he could not accept an online coupon, it must be printed. I pointed out that there was nothing stating this on the website.  He eventually offered a $75. coupon that he had with him.  Whatever, the initial $500. amount became $590. I paid $515.  The technician did a good job clearing the line.  I wasn't happy with the coupon discrepancy.  I won't call RR for any future problems.

reviews.author: Jane Chisaki
reviews.text: Excellent service, quality employees, more than satisfactory work!. My faucet was continually running (while shut off) on a Saturday...after making three other calls to plumbers who either do not or could not work on a Saturday of a long holiday weekend, Roto-Rooter came through and arrived within the hour. The plumber accessed the situation, found another major leak, wrote the estimate and with approval was off to fix my issues. It wasn't as easy a fix as anticipated as my fixtures were so old, extension pieces and more were require. Although the water was no longer continuously running, he overnighted the required parts and completed the repair the next day.  Thank you so much Roto-Rooter, you saved my day!

Oceanside, CA

He used the right equipment, worked efficiently, and made sure everything was flowing properly before leaving. You can tell he’s an experienced, licensed plumber who takes pride in his work. The pricing was fair, the service was honest, and the results were excellent.

reviews.author: Dave Fornell
reviews.text: I bought a large 1860s house in Sycamore that had rusted out and cracked cast iron pipe that leaked sewage. Illinois Sewer and Drain used a sewer camera as part of the inspection and found we have two outgoing sewer lines and one was collapsed. They gave me a very competitive bid to connect the broken line with the one that was still working by pulling up the stone floor and rerouting the line across the basement. They were careful not to damage the historic stone work and replaced and leveled them when finished. reviews.author: Milan Desai
reviews.text: Joe L arrived within 2 hours of my evening call and was very respectful and knowledgeable. The price was reasonable and agreed upon up front (no surprises). reviews.author: Jacquelin Lloyde
reviews.text:
I am 94 years old and live by myself, and it can be very difficult for me to manage home repairs. I do not use the internet very much, but Joseph kindly showed me how to use speech-to-text on my phone so I could leave this review myself. I truly wanted people to know how wonderful he was.

For weeks, there was a loud humming noise every time I used the water, and it was driving me crazy. At my age, you appreciate peace and quiet, and the sound was very upsetting.

From the moment he arrived, he treated me with patience, kindness, and respect. I am hard of hearing and move slowly because of arthritis, and he never once rushed me. He took his time to listen carefully and explain everything in a way I could understand.

He didn’t just fix the problem — he checked my whole plumbing system to make sure everything was safe. No plumber has ever done that for me before.

He even had to cut into some of the stucco to do the repair properly, and I was worried the price might go up. It never did. He kept his word exactly. That meant a lot to me.

In my long life, I have met many contractors. Joseph stands out as one of the most honest, hardworking, and compassionate young men I have ever encountered. His workmanship is beautiful, and his character is even better.

If you want someone who truly cares, who does the job right, and who treats you like family, call Allstar Plumbing and ask for Joseph.

Thank you, Joseph. You really are an Allstar.

reviews.author: Gabriel Otte
reviews.text:
We first contacted Allstar to fix a water mixing issue. They came and charged us to diagnose the problem and said that it was a cartridge in one of the showers that had failed that was causing the cold and the hot water to cross over. They then charged us more to fix the problem. So far, so good. They installed the new cartridge and told us that it was fixed.

A few weeks later, we were still having the issue and so we had them come back. Another guy, Jose comes out and says our issue was that actually our recirculator was sending hot water into the cold and that they needed to install a stop valve so that the flow was unidirectional. I once again, double checked whether this was going to fix the problem and they assured me this was the problem. So they charged me another few thousand dollars to redo the piping.

After that, they said that that didn't fix the problem and that it was the cartridge after all and they had misdiagnosed which one of the showers had failed in the first place. So they came back and said it was this other shower that was the problem. So they took out the old cartridge but couldn't install the new one due to some build up. Now, this failed install is causing the shower head to leak constantly. Except, the owner, Sergio now doesn't want to do more work unless we pay more money on a problem they misdiagnosed and a leak they caused in the first place.

Now I have a leak that they are refusing to fix without more money and they still haven't fixed the initial mixing issue. Evidently Sergio has been complaining about how he has already lost a lot of money of this job as a reason for not doing the right thing here. FWIW, they seem like nice guys (at least when talking to them) but from a business and quality of work (not to mention value), I would steer clear from these guys. I'm really disappointed because generally you want to support local businesses. I think this is one of those cases where when pushed to the limit, they won't actually pony up to fix the problem.

reviews.author: Kimberly McCort Cooper
reviews.text:
Last July we hired ABC to scope the sewer main during a home inspection for our first home. They said that the line needed to be jetted so we hired them again to jet the line after we purchased the home a month later. They then claimed that they were unable to jet the line and said they would follow up with an estimate to dig up and replace the line. They charged us $500 for coming out to jet it but said that money would go towards the cost of replacing the line. A few weeks later I reached out regarding the estimate. They sent a guy over who stated the line would bet the city’s responsibility. He said he would get in touch with the city and get back to us. After waiting a few more weeks, I reached out again about the status of this repair. The employee that I spoke with said there was nothing on record about it but she would reach out to the estimator. I asked about having our $500 refunded since we would not be needing them to replace the line. She claimed they did jet the line. I explained to the employee that I have an invoice that states they tried to jet the line but could not because of too many fittings. She argued they did jet the line. I’ll admit it got a little heated. She was pretty rude. She said she would get ahold of the estimator and report back.

The next week our basement backed up with sewage. I got ahold of Roto-Rooter, explained the situation, they said they felt confident they would be able to jet it and that ABC just “didn’t know what they were doing”. He did indeed jet the line, resolving our issue.

To this day I have never received a call back about the estimate or had our $500 refunded. I don’t think they know what they’re doing either.

We originally spoke with Christine to schedule the service and they ended up having availability for the same day.

The technician, Michael, arrived within an hour or two of speaking with Christine. He swapped everything out on both the hot and cold lines from PVC to copper. Michael also added a new shut-off valve on the cold water line, a massive improvement from the flimsy PVC valve. Everything came out professional and clean! We were very impressed by the quality of the work, professionalism of staff throughout the process, and the price we paid for the work.

Compared to other companies we had quoted, Priority 1 was by far the best quality and value; other companies weren't even including the swap to copper. Overall, I highly recommend using Priority 1 for your plumbing needs. We will definitely be using them as our go-to company for any plumbing in the future!

reviews.author: Jennifer McGaffic
reviews.text:
Update after their reply:

Their response had false information. When I initially called about the toilet, it was water leaking IN the toilet (aka running too long). Maybe “leaking” wasn’t the correct word to use but I’m not a plumber. We never had any issues with water leaking on the floor, outside of the toilet. If there was water leaking OUTSIDE of my toilet onto the floor, that would have clearly been the primary reason for the call. The primary reason for calling was to install a bidet in a different bathroom, as mentioned before. I added this on to have them check out the other toilet while they were here for the bidet already. You mentioned the leak was in a different bathroom but that’s not accurate. Your technicians went into that bathroom, assessed the toilet, told me “they do not work on toilets like this and we should just replace it.” They clearly looked at that toilet and assessed the problem. The leak all over the floor and into the next room happened after your technicians left. It may have been a “fluke” on timing, but that leak was NEVER there prior to your technicians on the property. Terrible luck in timing I suppose. In addition, while they recommended we replace the entire toilet, all it needed was a new flapper to stop running and was easily fixed by another company, without replacing the entire toilet.

Next, my initial call to answering service was not threatening. After multiple calls (while our bathroom and adjoining room were flooding) and no call back after almost 2 hours, yes. We were frustrated. Your website advertises 24/7 help and the call service told us they paged you multiple times.  We told the person on the phone that we have recommended many people to you over the years and been great advocates for your company but we will advocate just as strongly against using you when things haven’t been handled properly. We had been loyal customers for 13 years prior to this incident.

Taking responsibility for errors is key when running a business and this is what we hoped you would have done. Had you come the next day, replaced the valve and apologized for the inconvenience, this would have been a non issue. Accidents happen and we understand that. But telling us that it wasn’t your fault and we would have to pay again to resolve an issue that was not there previously is very poor customer service.

Warning!! DO NOT use Jeff's KB&B Plumbing

We had them come yesterday to install a bidet and while they were here I had them check out another toilet I heard was occasionally running longer than it should be. They told me they “didn’t work on toilets like mine and I should just replace it.” After they left, we had a mysterious flood coming from a broken valve at the toilet and we ended up with water all over our bathroom and into the next room.

We called the emergency line 3 times and while the answering service answered, no one called us back. They denied any involvement in damaging the valve, refuse to fix it, and are saying they didn’t do it and it was a coincidence that it happened to break after they were at the house.

The only solution temporarily is to shut the water line to the entire house. We, therefore, cannot use water, have water under our wood floors, and wet drywall as well.

We have used them for various projects over the last 13 years, referred many friends to them, and now we are left with a broken toilet, no water to the entire house (main water line needed to be shut off to stop the flow of water), and a small flood. Come to find out after the fact, 3 others that I know have also had bad experiences with them.

After they refused the fix the problem, we had another company come out to fix their mess and, without hesitation, was able to fix the flapper without any issue as well as repair the broken valve. Both issues Jeff’s KB&B said they could not do.

reviews.author: Andres Burgos
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Working with Jeff’s KB&B Plumbing was one of the most unexpected joys of my entire home renovation experience. Not only did the team deliver professional, high-quality work, but they did so with a level of heart and humanity that’s rare to find in any industry.

This wasn’t just a plumbing install. This was a bathroom transformation designed with accessibility in mind, and Jeff’s personal connection to someone in a wheelchair clearly influenced his thoughtful approach. He didn’t just check boxes — he made suggestions that made my daily life better, like the floating sink that now allows me to roll underneath comfortably and independently. His insight directly contributed to a space where I now have not just one, but two full turnaround zones, dramatically improving mobility and comfort.

Beyond the work itself, Jeff is just a good human. We had some deep and meaningful conversations while planning the project, and he even shared how supporting his team has allowed nine employees to purchase their first home. It’s clear that KB&B is a company that lifts people up — inside and out. I still get occasional motivational texts from Jeff (most recently: “The best teachers are those who show you where to look but don’t tell you what to see.” – Alexandra K. Trenfor), and each one is a reminder of how much this project became about more than just plumbing.

If you want plumbing work done with skill, care, and true character, Jeff’s KB&B is the kind of business you hope to find.
