Alex took lots of photos, showed us the normal pressure readings vs what our AC unit was doing. Then he gave us three options for how to proceed with what needed to be fixed. Everything on an ipad, and we were able to easily use our Visa credit card,
I wish all repair techs were this thorough and nice as Alex was, on a maintenance tune up and/or repair. We would gladly recommend him and Monkey Wrench.

reviews.author: Ralph Morales
reviews.text: Job was Quick. Straight to the Point. Worker was on time. Very knowledgeable and helpful and most of all Professional.  His name on his shirt was Frank. I enjoyed the job being done with No hassles.  Thank you! Mr. Morales.

reviews.author: Latisha Lewis
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Alex. He was knowledgeable, patient, and took the time to clearly explain what was happening with my furnace instead of rushing to conclusions. I really appreciated his honesty, professionalism, and attention to detail. Highly recommend for anyone who wants a technician who truly cares about doing the job right.

plumbers.name: Lake Cook Plumbing Heating and Cooling
plumbers.address: 500 E Main St, Lake Zurich, IL 60047, USA

reviews.author: Michael McCann
reviews.text:
Louie came out to connect our bathroom sink- he was knowledgeable, polite, and trustworthy. We asked about a project we are considering in our laundry room and he took the time to tell us what it would entail, and offered recommendations and suggestions. We will be calling to set up this install in the near future.
Lake Cook plumbing is top notch- great, honest guys and Gianna is the go to person who sets up appointments and communicates when techs are dispatched. Found our new favorite plumbing service! Thank you!

reviews.author: Kenneth Hunt
reviews.text: Our old water heater needed to be replaced. It was leaking and causing a minor flood in the basement. Searched up plumbers in the area and lake cook plumbing was first on the list. They said they could come out the next day, so I was excited! They had to remove the utility room doors, to not keep them longer I said I would put the doors back on myself. They installed a new water heater and the plumber was nice and up front. It cost me $3000. Things were good for about 3 months but the pressure relief valve started leaking. Then a guy named Mike came out, he wasn’t a pleasant person, but he swapped out the gas valve, and we haven’t had a huge problem yet. Today I went to finally reinstall the doors to the utility closet and the bottoms are ripped and torn to where they won’t stay in the tracks and the rail above the door is bent so the wheels pop out. While i am grateful for the initial quick “we can be there tomorrow urgency”, that is the only good thing I have to say and will not use them again.

reviews.author: John Harding
reviews.text:
This company did outstanding work for our family. They worked very hard and actually figured out a way to LOWER the cost after coming up with an innovative solution to our disaster.
Louis and Casey were smart and professional. I will recommend this company to everyone I know.
The owner, Jim Barrett, went above and beyond!  With his detailed explanation of what he found, and personally speaking to our insurance claim’s  person, we were approved to be covered with our home owners insurance!
I cannot say enough about this team of men and will also include Gianna who handles scheduling and was a delight to deal with.
Thank you Lake Cook Plumbing!!

reviews.author: Yiwei Yu
reviews.text: I had to have a water heater replaced a few months ago. When Casey came over to do the inspection and gave me the quotes, I was pleasantly surprised that he wasn't salesy at all. He laid out the options in a very clear way, set the right expectations, and gave me time to think them over. I was fed up with other plumbing companies trying to sell me upgrades I didn't need. One of them even tried to sell me a subscription plan! So I ended up going with one of Casey's recommendations and they were very professional with the work. They cleaned up the basement and I didn't have any concerns.

reviews.author: Professor Kurt DiClementi
reviews.text: I felt very fortunate to have Louie, a plumber with over 20 years in the business, come out to clear the pipes leading out of our kitchen sink. Louie is the gold standard of plumbing professionals. He was very meticulous in the service he provided, explaining everything he was doing. He also ran the bathroom sinks and tubs to make sure that while he cleared the blockage in the kitchen sinks, he didn't push the blockage to plumbing in another area of our home. Upon finishing the job, Louie also offered maintenance advice to ensure we would avoid the same problem in the future, and he let me know about discount coupons I could find if I needed any additional service in the future. I think Louie provided a great value for the service he performed. He was the consummate professional, yet he was very amiable. He made me feel like he was a trusted friend rather than just another customer he had to deal with.

plumbers.name: Pardo & Son Plumbing, Inc
plumbers.address: 171 N Cypress Way #100, Casselberry, FL 32707, USA

reviews.author: Oscar Merino
reviews.text: John and his team did an excellent job. I called them on Monday, and Scott and nate arrived Wednesday morning to do the plumbing work. By Thursday at noon, they had finished and left the work area clean, which my wife appreciated since she doesn't like dust and suffers from allergies. They did a great job keeping the dust to a minimum. I enjoyed working with them; they were responsible from day one, arriving on time and finishing in less than two days. I felt completely confident with them. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Murdoc Gould
reviews.text:
I’ve written many glowing reviews before — but this one truly means more than any prior.

Over the years, Pardo and Son’s Plumbing has handled everything from minor fixes to major plumbing jobs at my properties. Their professionalism — something I value highly — has never fallen short of my expectations. From the very first phone call with their scheduler to the moment the technician finishes the job, their service consistently delivers.

I’ve had the privilege of working with master technician Scott on every service call. From the outset, I’ve appreciated his professionalism, his skillful work, and his calm, reassuring demeanor given the circumstances I presented.

Thank you, Pardo and Son’s — and thank you, Scott. Your work is deeply appreciated.

reviews.author: Richard Koster
reviews.text: Excellent service and value! They were available to help us within about 2 hours when other companies were not. We had a leak in the wall and it was quickly repaired. We discovered the previous plumbing repair (done by the neghborhood handyman) was not done correctly so we had Pardo & Son advise and repair it the RIGHT way. I wish we would have called Pardo from the start. I would certainly recommend this company without hesitation and will be using them from now on. Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Erica Johnson
reviews.text:
I want to Thank Pardo & Son for the excellent job repiping my house.  John & Scott found what the problem was and explained how they would correct the problem.  They were very punctual and extremely reliable.  Their team of workers were exceptional.
I would hire them again.

reviews.author: Taneesha Barnett
reviews.text: Nathan was very professional and personable . He showed up at a good time and made sure he gave me options for what works best for me . The job was done very neat .  I do think the price was high though .

plumbers.name: Noble Plumbing
plumbers.address: 9065 Railroad Ave, Snoqualmie, WA 98065, USA

reviews.author: Greg Regelbrugge
reviews.text:
Noble and Julio Garcia were such a breath of fresh air to do business with, on time, prepared and executed my plumbing ( Water main valve and hot water heater valve and alarm all done top notch.  Believe me I know, my father was a union plumber for 37 years, and Noble did good work.
Will use again as a trusted company.

reviews.author: Ramana Thatikonda
reviews.text:
Eli at Noble Plumbing: Skilled, Fast, and Highly Recommended:

We had been dealing with multiple plumbing issues for quite some time—two problematic hose bibs in the backyard and sidewalk area, plus a persistent leak in our bathtub that I tried to fix myself several times without success. After realizing the DIY route wasn’t solving it, we reached out to Noble Plumbing.

They sent Eli, and he immediately stood out. He did a thorough inspection, clearly explained what was wrong, and returned with the exact replacement parts in under 30 minutes. His understanding of the issues was obvious—he diagnosed everything quickly and fixed it all with precision. What impressed me most was how fast he worked without cutting corners. He was professional, respectful, and extremely efficient from start to finish.

It’s rare to find someone who combines speed, skill, and professionalism at this level. Eli delivered all three. I’m genuinely impressed with the quality of his work and the overall experience. I highly recommend him to anyone in the Snoqualmie community who needs reliable plumbing help.

reviews.author: Stephen Bangs
reviews.text: Noble Plumbing did an excellent job repairing our plumbing leak and installing a new water heater—quick, professional, and reasonably priced. They were easy to work with, communicated clearly throughout, and left everything clean and working perfectly. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Yi Zhu
reviews.text: Thanks for Joey and Josh’s professional work, the final result is super great. We had a bathroom water leakage last month. And after comparing the estimation from two plumbing companies, we finally decided to go with Noble plumbing, they quickly targeted the problem spot and guide us to the next step - water mitigation, we hired another mitigation company to sanitize and dry the moisture. Joey and Josh came back again to install the toilet back. From the whole repair journey, we had learned a lot. The whole leakage target and Repair and mitigation and restoration process are very expensive. We saved around 50% of the total cost by comparing different company’s estimation and find good contractors. Noble plumbing is definitely great choice in the plumbing field. Btw, we also ask them replace an outside wall garden faucet.

reviews.author: Ingrid Kumar
reviews.text: Noble Plumbing was fantastic! They were quick, professional, and did a great job with our bathroom plumbing. A huge thanks to Zephaniah for the excellent service, highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Monkey Wrench Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electric
plumbers.address: 3436 N Verdugo Rd #103, Glendale, CA 91208, USA

reviews.author: Robert Bernstein
reviews.text: Louis was absolutely wonderful! He identified the issues, presented a clear and efficient solution, brought in an amazing restoration professional who acted immediately and repaired/replaced as required and could not have possibly been nicer nor explained everything more clearly. He was amazing and I would not hesitate to refer or recommend him all day long. Thank you Louis!

reviews.author: Peter Koch
reviews.text:
Louis arrived shortly before my scheduled appointment time, which was great. This made it so I didn’t have to sit and wait for four hours.

Luis was hired to flush my 4 year-old water heater. It was straightforward job and it took about a half an hour.

I spoke with Luis throughout the process. He was congenial and service oriented.   He waived the service fee because my previous two appointments were canceled by the company.  It is because of this gesture, I would recommend this company and call them again if needed.

reviews.author: Ash Y
reviews.text: AC went out. Technician came and recommended they do a complete new hvac cause mine was old and running r22 (discontinued). Literally all they had to do was show up and I was ready to get them to install a new system. Got an appt, stayed home from work. No one showed up and no one contacted me to tell me they won’t show up. Not that it matters but they lost my business.

reviews.author: Steven Cole
reviews.text: Louis was very nice. He showed up after the restoration company was here and as it turns out, he wasn’t able to actually make any repairs yet given other work that needs to be done before his. He did not charge me a trip  charge and told me to let him know when he can come back out. I thought it was very nice that he didn’t charge. I fully plan on using him. He left his card and cell number. He was friendly, professional, and my dog liked him too.

reviews.author: Meredith Orlando
reviews.text: I had an exceptional experience in every way with this company. From the initial phone call and booking which was very polite and professional. The tech that came out, Alex, was knowledgeable and kind and explained the problem which required parts ordered. He came back as promised the following day and completed the job on time and at the price quoted. I will be sure to call again when I am in need of plumbing assistance!

plumbers.name: Econo Sewer & Drain
plumbers.address: 2101 Lathrop Ave, Racine, WI 53405, USA

reviews.author: Candy Fugate
reviews.text:
Thank you Santiago!
Excellent service. Excellent price.
I have an old house,  old cast iron pipes inside and out.  My plumbing decided to go out completely,  no draining,  no flushing.  Santiago came out quick,  explained to me how these pipes rust and flake over the years and cause blockage,  he showed me the video of the blockage which was a good distance from the house and not an easy job to fix.  Santiago has the patience of a saint, and the determination of a bulldog! It took some time (old pipes fault, not his) but he refused to give up.  He never lost his cool, he completed the job and  made sure everything was running and draining properly. He gave me good advice how to prevent this from happening again. He cleaned up the mess after... To the point I had to tell him stop cleaning the floor,  I'll get it. Super nice guy,  very polite and knowledgeable. I very much appreciate you Santiago and Econo Sewer and Drain.

reviews.author: Maria Stockdale
reviews.text:
Two technicians came to inspect our drain with a camera and offered a $550 clean-out(including the camera inspection) or $1,200 hydro jetting. We chose the $550 option. After their equipment got stuck and more technicians had to come out, 4 employees spent nearly 4 hours in our basement and told us the line was free n clear & the job was done.  Lie

Two weeks later our drain backed up again. When I called, I was told the service wasn’t guaranteed and I’d have to pay another $550 for them to return. In a condescending way he told me I should have taken the advice of his technicians and done hydro jetting. On their Facebook page, they post they are hiring technicians with no experience necessary/ will train on the job. So their technicians of high experience are always right? That should have been my first red flag. 2nd Red Flag is we didn't realize they are under new ownership.
We were never shown the camera footage they claimed that proved the line was clear. Instead we were told we should have read our receipt that there's no guarantee.

I had to hire another company KSK Sewer & Drain Cleaning who removed a extra large amount of tree roots that clearly hadn’t been cleared. He told me that they never cleared the line completely.  His service is also  guaranteed for 8 months. The service, communication and the lack of accountability by Econo Sewer is beyond frustrating. Do not waste your time or money.

reviews.author: Angela Ramirez
reviews.text: Kevin was fantastic! He was very knowledgeable, friendly, and prompt. He explained above and beyond every detail to the hydrojet process. I highly recommend! Econo Sewer & Drain also has the BEST pricing!

reviews.author: Matthew R
reviews.text: Came home from work to observe a drain pipe in my basement flooding anytime the toilet was flushed. Needed it handled by a professional! Santiago was quick and professional with the job, even explaining regular maintenance with me. Would highly recommend Santiago for any concerns or jobs.

reviews.author: Kim Morrissey
reviews.text: Thank you Justin. Got our slow drains going in less than an hour. He was professional, informative, patient. Once he evaluated the issue took time to explain all of our options. Recommend this service and specifically Justin. Thank you sooo much!!

plumbers.name: Around the Clog, LLC
plumbers.address: 305 Lucerne Dr, Lafayette, CO 80026, USA

reviews.author: Scott Brasington
reviews.text: We used Doug and his company today for the first time. The service was excellent! We had some issues with drains backing up, and some other plumbing repairs. Doug scheduled his visit for the next day, showed up on time, was polite and efficient! The cost was very fair. I highly recommend using Doug, and Around the Clog for any plumbing needs you may have! thanks Doug!

reviews.author: Abi Vega
reviews.text: Doug came out same day on a Saturday, just a couple of hours after I called because of a drain blockage. He worked quickly to solve the issue and we were very pleased with the job. Thank you Doug!

reviews.author: Maureen Christopher Bross
reviews.text:
Doug is awesome!
He has helped us numerous times when we had problems w toilets and our water heater.   Doug installed a new wonderful water heater for myself and our neighbor.  He goes over and above in numerous ways and I cannot give him enough accolades!  Doug is a gem who does first class work!

reviews.author: Mary Windhausen
reviews.text: Doug has done a LOT of plumbing work at our home over the years. Today, he was able to access a drain behind the wall by thinking out side of the box, and a lot of muscle power to cut the old pipe out. His team shows up, they’re on time, complete the work, clean up and have never tried to sell me BS or upsell the work. Doug has integrity and stands behind his work.

reviews.author: Ryan Esch
reviews.text: We were in a real pickle recently, with our buyers requesting a plumbing inspection on the day of closing. We were stressed! I called several plumbers that morning, and Around the Clog was able to arrive first. Their team truly went above and beyond to provide the best overall service we received during our recent move. Our buyers required a signed form at the closing table, and the team at Around the Clog bent over backwards to make it happen for us. Thank you for the incredible service!

plumbers.name: Advantage Plumbing & Rooter Inc
plumbers.address: 2361 Barton Ln, Montrose, CA 91020, USA

reviews.author: Rafi Sepanian
reviews.text:
Advantage Plumbing & Rooter! Truly Outstanding!

Huge thanks to Steve, Kyle, and Jose. Steve answered my call late at night around 10 PM and had me scheduled for 6:30 AM the very next morning. My main sewer line (under the house out to the city sewer) was clogged, and they showed up on a rainy morning without a single complaint and got right to work. Jose was part of the first-day crew and helped get everything started quickly and efficiently.

What really impressed me was how well-equipped and tech-savvy they were camera inspection and tracer on the spot. Kyle quickly found the root cause of the blockage, explained everything clearly, and provided a fair estimate for what turned out to be a major repair. The major job was scheduled for the next morning, and they returned with even more impressive excavation equipment. Oh boy, they were fast, organized, and highly professional you could tell this team knew exactly what they were doing.

They also saved me a lot of money by lining and protecting the clay pipe that goes out to the city sewer, which prevents roots from getting in. That smart solution alone saved me well over $15,000 in potential replacement costs.

The repair was done right the first time, the site was left clean and tidy, and the entire crew was courteous, careful, and hardworking from start to finish.

The job was done perfectly, the communication was excellent, and the whole team went above and beyond.

I highly recommend Advantage Plumbing & Rooter ask for Steve and Kyle!

reviews.author: Harper Haeun Lee
reviews.text: Jose and Mauricio came to replace our super old and dishwasher from who knows when our prior homeowners installed it. They did a phenomenal job, and we are so thankful because they worked with our old kitchen that was outdated and not even the standard dimensions. Showed up on time, consulted with us, tested the dishwasher, and cleaned up. Also gave us helpful tips on maintenance. Thank you Jose and Mauricio!

reviews.author: Monica Shaw
reviews.text: I texted owner Steve at 7:30am regarding my leaking toilet to see if they could come out the same day. He immediately replied with a yes, between 10-12pm. I got a text the Victor & Alonso would be coming out. I received text updates regarding their arrival time. They arrived, immediately assessed the issue, fixed it quickly- in less than an hour, and were on to their next call. As always, Victor and Alonso, were polite, professional, and efficient. Love Advantage!

reviews.author: Janice Holloway
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Advantage Plumbing & Rooter. The team was professional, punctual, and very knowledgeable. They quickly diagnosed the problem and fixed it efficiently at a fair price. Everything was explained clearly, and the work was done cleanly and with care. It’s hard to find reliable plumbing services, but this company truly stands out. Highly recommend them for anyone looking for honest and high-quality plumbing work!

reviews.author: Steve Moon
reviews.text: Great service by Mauricio and Jose! They came in for a water leak, assessed the situation and fixed properly. Everything under 2 hours and at a reasonable price. I was very frustrated but they took care of it profesaionally. Steve the owner was checking in with the team to make sure thinga are going smoothly. I will definitely call them again if I need a plumber.

plumbers.name: Hawkeye Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2320 Sandstone Ct, Burleson, TX 76028, USA

reviews.author: Michael M
reviews.text:
Myles showed up on time, explained what the process, what he was going to do and got to work.
15 minutes later, we were watching full video of our sewer pipes..
Great service,  thank you

reviews.author: Randall Armstrong
reviews.text: Thomas (Hawkeye) is a consumate professional and a great plumber.  Our water heater needed replacing and he showed up on time and had our new water heater installed in no time at all.  We highly recommend Hawkeye for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Craig Oldham
reviews.text: Hawkeye Plumbing, Thomas, offers 5 star service and quality results. He is fair, honest and will not upsell you. He responds quickly. I have used his services twice, one scheduled and an unscheduled emergency weekend call that was fixed within a couple of hours of my call.  He is friendly and takes the time to communicate the problem and what the fix is. Give him a call, you will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Steven Zuniga
reviews.text: Hawkeye is always very responsive whenever we need them. I highly recommend that you use them.

reviews.author: Mildred Tye
reviews.text: Myles arrived quickly after I was told he was on his way. He identified the source of the leak right away, repaired it quickly. It was a good experience.

plumbers.name: My Guys Plumbing, Heating & Air Inc
plumbers.address: 458 Broadway Ave, Bedford, OH 44146, USA

reviews.author: Michelle Davis
reviews.text: Our furnace stopped working around 9pm right before the storm and they came out right away. Jerry was quick, friendly, and very knowledgeable, and had everything fixed fast. We really appreciated the great service and professionalism. We will absolutely use them again for anything we need in the future.

reviews.author: tpdoll
reviews.text: My Guys installed a new furnace in my home in December. It's been working well (hence, the two-star rating). However, I had a plumbing repair on my water tank done by a different company yesterday, and came home from work today to the scent of gas. Naturally, I called the other company and although the tech said he hadn't touched any gas lines, he still stopped by on his way home to check things out. He performed a bubble test on the water tank and furnace fasteners. Turns out My Guys didn't tighten the fasteners properly! I overlooked the mess they left in my basement and yard after installing the furnace, but this oversight was egregious and could have been fatal for my family! Will not use them again.

reviews.author: Melvin Frazier
reviews.text: I have only great things to say about Evan.  He came in said  his name and stated he was here to install my furnace.  He went to work like a engine running.  He dismantled the old and the other gentleman (don't know his name), took it away and brought in the new one.  I went down to take a peek and asked a few questions and Evn answered ever question to my understanding.   When he was done he cleaned up, it looked better then it did before he started.  He was good professional and efficient!

reviews.author: Erik Thoreson
reviews.text: Would highly recommend my guys for any hvac or plumbing needs. I purchased a home one year ago and purchased with intent on replacing system in 2026 or 27. As luckily would have it we started having issues with a 25 year old HVAC system, and it was time to replace. Jerry and his team at my guys were one of a few companies I reached out for quotes and information to replace our system. He came out on a Saturday and went over what we needed and recommended based on our house specs. He went room by room and took measurements for accurate square footage. He was super informative and explained things very well. I have some health problems and discussed with him on allergy filtration systems. By the next week I had a working air conditioner (as we were without AC!),and due to their busy schedule they came out a few weeks later to finish up the furnace and button everything else up.  I really appreciate Jerry and his team by going above and beyond to get our HVAC up and running since we were without any AC/Heat. Would highly recommend them and really appreciate the team over at my guys for our new system! Thanks!

reviews.author: William Pierson
reviews.text: We recently had an issue with our water heater where the gas flow seemed to be surging. I called the installer, Klooz Plumbing, who diagnosed the issue after changing out several parts to the flue. Klooz called the installer of the flue vent system, My Guys Plumbing, Heating, and Air. The My Guys plumber, Greg, came out within an hour and determined that the flue piping in the attic was improperly angled. Within a couple of hours, the problem was solved. Greg did a professional job, working with the Klooz personnel to ensure our issue was fixed and cleaning up afterward. Thank you to My Guys for their prompt attention. We sincerely appreciate it! (Work was done under warranty).

plumbers.name: Integrity Plumbing of the Upstate LLC
plumbers.address: 1011 Old Stage Rd, Simpsonville, SC 29681, USA

reviews.author: John Yeary
reviews.text: We had a water heater blow out in our garage and flooded the new workshop I had just finished. We got a couple of quotes from various companies in the area. When we called Integrity, Russ (Owner), came to our house within 30 minutes. He provided a reasonable quote, and great explanation of our options for replacement. They offer a military/veteran discount. The team that came out later that afternoon included Stephen Libby who was fantastic. After they removed the damaged heater, it was discovered that there was additional damage. They worked with the water mitigation folks from USAA to clean and dry the area. When the general contractor that came to look at repairing the water damaged area would not be able to get someone out for another week, Integrity helped us again. Russ recommended a contractor that he worked with to come do the repairs. Once the walls were repaired and painted, Stephen came back and installed the new heater. He took the time to flush the lines, and make sure everything was in good order. He recommended heater settings and set them for us. The heater works great and the area looks great. I had a great experience from the owner to the technicians, and receptionist.

reviews.author: Laura Brand
reviews.text: I called Integrity Plumbing one afternoon to request a quote on a replacement tankless water heater. Russ, the owner of the company, showed up at our house less than 45 minutes later and gave us a competitive quote. I was very impressed with Russ who really seemed to know everything about Navien water heaters. Integrity Plumbing was able to start and finish the install that very afternoon so we had working hot water by the evening. The new water heater looks and works great, and they were very conscientious to leave the install area better than they found it. Highly recommend this locally owned company.

reviews.author: Brian Thomas
reviews.text:
Thought we might have a burst exterior water pipe so I called Integrity.  Their technician Cole arrived right on time and quickly assessed our situation. Fortunately pipes were in good shape-one was just partially frozen and he gave me tips on how to manage that situation moving forward. I asked about making a payment and Cole said there would be no charge as this was just information and knowledge that he shared on this visit. What other companies would do this? Probably none.
They really live up to their name Integrity in their business.  This was my 2nd experience with them and I can truly say their technicians are incredibly knowledgeable,
professional, and eager to share tips for the average homeowner so they can avoid future problems. They have definitely earned my business for any future plumbing needs.
When I called the day before to schedule the appointment, Beth provided excellent service and communication and even had their Technician Cole call me in advance of his visit to answer a question I had about my pipe situation. If you are looking for a plumbing company you know you can trust, call Integrity!

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Escher
reviews.text:
✨Very Grateful ✨
I had a great experience with Integrity Plumbing! Russ was professional, kind, and really went above and beyond. Not only did he take care of my water heater, but he also referred an electrician I needed, which made everything so much easier and less stressful. It’s hard to find people who are both skilled and genuinely helpful, and Russ is definitely one of them. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: John Rush
reviews.text: DJ and Clayton replaced a few old water heater tanks and replaced with a new Navien Tankless water heater for us.  Pricing was fair vs the other estimates we received. I felt DJ had the best handle on what needed to be done plus were recommended to us by friends who had some work done by Integrity with excellent results.  Had no issues with anything. They were in and out in less than a day and did a good clean install. Definitely recommend!

plumbers.name: The Overall Plumber
plumbers.address: 13733 Hwy 6, Santa Fe, TX 77517, USA

reviews.author: Teresa Phillips
reviews.text: The Overall Plumber did a great job installing our new water heater yesterday! Jay and Andrew came to our house yesterday morning to give us a quote and they were very nice and thorough. We had purchased the new water heater. The quote was very reasonable, the installation crew (JoJo and Charles??) came shortly after and completed the job in less than than 2 hours. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Taylor
reviews.text: Superior Service on Demand! Very impressed with the scope of work completed inside and outside of my home. Have used The Overall Plumber on three separate occasions and the level of professionalism, experience and customer service has always been top notch. From the office to in the field, this company has earned my loyalty with their honest work! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Giovanni Rueda
reviews.text:
Outstanding Service, Fair Price, and Real Customer Care!

We recently had a major water leak at our home. After calling around to several other companies and getting ghosted, I landed on The Overall Plumber thanks to a recommendation from a friend. Boy, was I happy to come across them, if that line does not say it all about my experience. They have an actual human answering the phone. They could not make it the first time scheduled, but they called and left me a voicemail letting me know that the next day I would be their first stop. Jay and James arrived on time, were respectful throughout, and had my household back up and running within two hours. The price I paid was BEYOND reasonable. These are the kinds of companies we should be supporting, and if you are thinking about your plumbing needs, give The Overall Plumber a call and see for yourself why I and many others have given them 5-star reviews!

reviews.author: Liz Ashton
reviews.text: Bathroom remodel project.  The crew removed a jetted tub and surround and prepared the space for a step-in shower.  They did a great job and the 'tile guy' Chris recommended did an outstanding job.  We love our new shower!  We highly recommend the Overall Plumber!

reviews.author: Terri Jean
reviews.text: James and J came to my home to unclog bathtub.  Very professional and sweet.  Highly recommend anyone to call The Plumber!    James and J cam on another appt to unclog kitchen drain.  Again, here on time, very professional,and sweet.  Highly recommend.   Also Makala that answers phone is also very professional and sweet!!!

plumbers.name: Your 1 Plumber
plumbers.address: 13504 Jamieson Pl, Germantown, MD 20874, USA

reviews.author: Charlie Curd
reviews.text:
Pipe burst... Other companies didn't have availability for at least 4 days due to the weather. Your1Plumber had the issue fixed in under about an hour once they arrive which was amazing since we didn't have water access.

The gentlemen who did the work, Wilmer, explained everything well as far as the issue and repairs were concerned.  Prompt. Polite. He made sure to let us know what to expect during and after repair. Oh! I was home alone during the visit and dude wasn't creepy... so, that was kinda great- felt safe. He was pretty patient with my dog, who goes kinda 'Cujo' when company comes, and that was pretty nice since Dog was on my last nerve trying to eat the plumber person again... when will she learn that we don't eat our friends?

Not sure if the price was competitive since we never had this issue before- but according to my bff, chat, it was fair. Included 1 year warranty on work which was a bonus we didn't expect.

10 outta 10 would not want my pipe to break again during a winter snow, but I would call this company again if it did.

reviews.author: Marjorie Carter
reviews.text: We appreciate the prompt service we got  from #1 plumber. They installed our hot water heater 5+ years ago and came today for routine maintenance. They were prompt, cordial and completed their work quickly. We would highly recommend Wilmer if you need that service.

reviews.author: Cheryl Hinsley
reviews.text: Best service ever. I called in the morning and by the afternoon I had a new 50 gallon electric water heater. The service was amazing! They cleaned the area after the repair then explain how to operate the system. I cannot tell you how happy I am with this service. Mario you are number one! It wasn't the cheapest estimate. It wasn't the most expensive either. But I will be happy to pass the number to this business along. I am super duper pleased. Over the moon pleased. Thank you Mario you are the best!!!!!

reviews.author: Romeo R. del Rosario
reviews.text: Wilmer and Jay are awesome!  Very friendly, knowledgeable, and professional.  Wilmer was able to answer our questions with ease and explain different options and considerations. I look forward to having them do additional work on other maintenance issues.

reviews.author: Craig Dixon
reviews.text: Wilmer was the technical plumber that was very knowledgeable and explained the problem. He was friendly and understood the problem and advised us on the best course of action. He and his partner installed the unit the same day. I would recommend Wilmer in any future situations. Great job and keep up the great work.

reviews.author: Ramiz Baig
reviews.text: Krystal answered my call just before midnight and was ready to help for a plumbing issue at my business! She was extremely friendly and positive the entire time and had someone she could get out that same night to solve my problem but I settled for the next morning. Donavan showed up the next morning at 7:30 AM and provided excellent service with great knowledge. He immediately fixed my problem and had my business ready to be open that morning!!

reviews.author: Kathryn Barca
reviews.text: Junior's came to us highly recommended and we have not been disappointed. Junior's has done extensive work in our recently purchased home - everything from deferred maintenance like updating valves, to installing a new drain and faucet in our kitchen, to assisting with the renovation of a bathroom. We chose to supply a new tub, toilet, and sink, and they were very easy to work with when taking the old fixtures out and installing the new ones. The plumbers, especially Chris who we worked with extensively, are awesome - really friendly, punctual, and get the job done, and everyone I've worked with in the office is great, too. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Bettie Nicholls
reviews.text:
I Can't say enough about Junior's Plumbing. My husband has Alzheimer's Disease and He shut the water off to the toilet unbeknownst to me. Mark did not make feel like I was totally stupid. He was wonderful. Then I asked him to look at another toilet for me and turns out I did need it to be repaired. Mark was very professional, gave me an estimate for the work and cleaned up after himself. I will recommend Junior's Plumbing to all of my friends and I will definitely use them again! Michele the lady who answered the telephone was courteous and very helpful in setting up my appointment for the toilet repair. How nice to find a GREAT Company with employees who really care about service and the work that they do!
Bettie Nicholls

reviews.author: Edward Porto
reviews.text: I called on a Saturday morning to a few plumbing companies after my water heater crapped out on Friday night. Most did not answer and one actually said they would send someone out Monday afternoon for an ESTIMATE. I told them I'd prefer to have it installed on Monday. Junior's plumbing did better than that. They said they could do it that very same day. And there was no inflated price as a result. The price was fair and Charlie (plumber) came out that afternoon and did a phenomenal job. He was very friendly and personable and he showed great confidence in his work. I waited a week to leave this review in the event any issues arose but not a single one to be found and the hot water is cruising in my house now. Great job Charlie and Junior's plumbing.  Will definitely call you again in the future if need be.

reviews.author: Bill Farr
reviews.text: Junior's Plumbing Services quickly responded when I needed them as I had a leak in the basement.  The technician Chris was very professional, and quickly handled the problem.  I was so satisfied I arranged to have a second plumbing job done by his company.  Again I was thoroughly satisfied.  The cost was for both jobs were very reasonable!  They followed up with a phone call to ensure I was happy with the work.  I would recommend them to anyone that needs plumbing done!

reviews.author: Stephaney Jackson
reviews.text: Great company and really great people! Very nice staff when calling in to discuss issues. I met these guys while they were working another job and they were kind enough to let me take minutes of their time to ask questions about an issue I was having in my home. They were super knowledgeable and confident that my issue was fixable at a reasonable price. That led to me receiving a business card from them. I called to set an appointment which was super easy. They came out and did exactly what they said they’d do and in good time, which is rare today. My issue is fixed. Safe to say I’m very happy with Pickle Plumbing! Will be recommending!

reviews.author: thelma webb
reviews.text:
I was very happy with the service I received from Pickles Septic Service. The young man that located the septic was knowledgeable about where and how to locate tank. He answered every question I asked and was not upset that I inquired about what he was doing .Kudos. 👍 The technicians that services my tank was on it from the time they pulled up. They help the young man pulled open the cover and immediately access the tank and begin to suction. Thank you so much for your Professional Service.
Archie & Thelma

reviews.author: Alice Freeman
reviews.text: I Highly recommend Pickle Septic Tank & Plumbing services.So we had a clog causing an overflow of water into our basement everytime the washing machine drained. Instead, the Representative told me to call Pickle's Plumbing service and I was thrilled with the Plumbing Service too!  Brody was very courteous and advised me on the status of the repairs and he also completed 3 other plumbing issues while he was there.  My bill was very economical.

reviews.author: Dennon McMillan
reviews.text: Pickle Septic Tank and Plumbing did an excellent job pumping out my septic tank. Setting up the appointment was a breeze and they arrived prior to their scheduled time. If you need your septic tanks pumped out I highly recommend pickle Septic Tank and Plumbing.

reviews.author: Rosy Roberts
reviews.text: These guys are great! They were easy to contact , came out in 2 days, came during the predicted time frame, called me when starting the job. The price is reasonable and he answered all my questions. I highly recommend this company!

plumbers.name: Living Waters Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 1124 W College St, Murfreesboro, TN 37129, USA

reviews.author: Blake Osborn
reviews.text:
Darren and the team at Living Waters were outstanding from start to finish.

Our tankless water heater failed unexpectedly, and I’ll be honest — the sticker price was a little shocking at first. Darren walked us through every option (tank vs. tankless), explained the pros and cons clearly, and helped us think through what made the most sense for our family. He wasn’t pushy at all.

I asked if he would mind giving us a little time to get another quote just so we felt fully confident in the decision, and he completely respected that. We ended up getting a quote from Hiller, and they came in significantly higher. We even had an appointment scheduled online with them that didn’t happen, which put us behind a bit. After comparing everything, Living Waters still provided the better value — and the better experience.

What really stood out was how Darren went above and beyond during the install. He noticed insulation around the unit that hadn’t been properly done with the previous tankless system and corrected it without being asked. That kind of attention to detail matters.

We never felt sold to — we felt guided. Darren helped us focus on getting the best long-term value, not just the cheapest short-term option.

Professional, honest, responsive, and high-quality work. We’re grateful we chose Living Waters and wouldn’t hesitate to use them again.

reviews.author: Meredith Derry
reviews.text: I wish I could give Living Waters Plumbing ten stars! They went absolutely above and beyond and did an excellent job. Darren was so kind, professional and did the job with excellence. We will always call them for any plumbing needs we have. They do the job right. So impressed with this company.

reviews.author: Monica Newnam
reviews.text:

I was impressed with their timeliness.

Jayson was so kind. He came out on a day I was working but my mother was here. He called me to update me on everything. Gave me several options and understood what I wanted and made it happen. He went above and beyond for me. I am very grateful for their quick and kind service.

Great company and great folks!!!

I will absolutely continue using Tony’s Plumbing for all my future plumbing needs, and I’m happy to share his name with my neighbors as well. A trustworthy professional like him deserves to be recognized.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Smith
reviews.text:
We have a 97 year old home and asked Keefe to install an outside spigot. We were remodeling the laundry room and the pipes for the spigot were in the laundry wall. We removed the paneling to give them access to the pipes. We also paid for a boring company to come and bore the hole for the spigot.
Keefe would not give us an estimate for the work because of the age of the house.
They installed the spigot after a couple of hours. They had to come back out the next day because it was installed incorrectly. The laundry room was finished and paneling replaced.
All was well, then winter came...our "frost free" spigot froze. We accept some responsibility because we left a hose pipe connected to it on a night it dipped below freezing. We didn't ask for or know anything about this type of "frost free" pipe nor were we advised on how to care for it. It was Keefe's job to communicate that to us.
They then charged us $135 to come back out and see why the spigot wasn't working. They informed us the inside pipe was cracked and our only option was to rip apart the finished laundry room. We now have a useless spigot after investing over $1500!
We will never use Keefe again.

reviews.author: C R
reviews.text:
It is hard to accurately describe how grateful we are for Local Plumber and for the services they provided for our family.
We recently experienced a water leak that flooded two rooms on the first floor of our home. The water was coming from somewhere underneath a built-in jetted tub, so we demolished the wall around the tub to discover that the water appeared to be bubbling up from under the concrete slab. We had no idea where it could be coming from, but turning off the water to our home was the only way to stop it.
I called a couple of “leak detection” specialty companies that I located online, only to be told they could not come out for one to two weeks. I was almost in tears when I called Local Plumber, but from that very first call they were amazing! Krista was able to send someone to our home that same afternoon, and kept me informed the entire time as to their ETA.
The plumber that responded to our call was John B., and we could tell from the moment we met him that we were in expert hands. He was extremely professional, thorough and knowledgeable as he diagnosed the source of our issue, and he determined that we had a leak in the pipe that runs  underground from our water well to our house. After telling us how he could fix the issue, John B. answered all of our questions and addressed our concerns. He was able to give us a quote within a few minutes after leaving our house, and because we were living with no water, the job was scheduled to be done 48 hours later.
From start to finish their communication was top-notch, and John B. is an absolute perfectionist.
The cost of the job was very reasonable and they guarantee their work.
We are grateful to have found such an amazing company, and cannot recommend them highly enough. Do not hesitate to give them a call!

reviews.author: Mike Stabenow
reviews.text:
My in-laws are in their 90s and needed a water heater replaced.  Monkey Wrench quoted us $5000 which is high, but they were able to do the work almost immediately so we went with them.  They did a great job with the install, and the technicians were very friendly and knowledgeable.  Both bathrooms in the house have valve stems that need to be replaced in the showers, one is leaking quite badly.  The technician who gave us the quote said he'd determine which stems were needed and would call us back the next day.  When he failed to call, I waited a week and then I called the company.  I was told that the tech was in his morning meeting and would call that afternoon.  That was four days ago.

I believe Monkey Wrench Plumbing is competent in their installs and friendly, but they are pricy and don't follow through with their commitments based on my limited experience with them.  I do not recommend them.

If I have any further interaction with them, I will update this review.

New Addition:  Monkey Wrench reads and responds to their reviews which I appreciate.  There was some miscommunication and rather than call me back, MWP had sent me an estimate via e-mail.  $5000 is a lot for a water heater, but $1000 for two shower cartridges is completely insane.

To recap, they did follow through and give me an estimate, however their pricing is absolutely ridiculous.  I just purchased the cartridges for $22 each, install will take me 5-10 minutes each.  Plus another 5 minutes to shut off the water to the house. The estimate MWP provided for this task is exactly $1000 (I am not exaggerating this figure) and states that it includes a quantity discount.  Despite their polite follow-up, I still can not recommend Monkey Wrench Plumbing with this type of pricing.

reviews.author: Mumby
reviews.text:
Adequate work quality, but extremely poor project management and professionalism
I hired this company in July 2025 for bathroom plumbing work with a rough-in inspection. Their quote was competitive with other contractors I received estimates from - this was not a budget option. The work was not fully completed and inspected until February 2026 - over 7 months for what should have been a 1 month project.

Communication and project management issues:
In August 2025, I called the county about an unrelated matter and discovered the rough-in inspection had never been scheduled or completed. Only then was it scheduled for August 6th

The contractor requested my door code for the August 6th inspection but never showed up to provide access to the inspector, nor did they provide the inspector with the code. The inspection failed due to no access
I was never notified of this failure despite being the property owner

The county sent three separate failure notices to the contractor over the following months. None were communicated to me

In February 2026, I called the county again about something unrelated and discovered the August inspection had failed and remained uncompleted for 6+ months

When I proceeded to finish the bathroom based on reasonable assumption the inspection had passed (given months of silence), the contractor attempted to make me responsible for any drywall repairs needed for the delayed inspection

Constant follow-up was required to get basic tasks completed, including reconnecting outdoor spigots that were disconnected during their work

Professionalism concerns:
Left construction debris and trash scattered around the property consistently rather than cleaning up daily

Multiple neighbors complained about loud and unprofessional behavior

Found a bottle of urine left in the yard
Caused $400 in siding damage during work (appears to have been credited)

What they did right:
The plumbing work itself appears to be functional and passed county inspection
When pushed, they did eventually complete tasks and make things right
Final product works as intended

Bottom line: If you hire them, expect to manage every aspect of the project yourself, including discovering through your own initiative when required inspections haven't been completed. The technical plumbing work is adequate, but you will spend significant time and energy on follow-up, oversight, and pushing for basic professional standards. I got 3 bids and they were the highest, but I went with them due to a past experience for toilet that was positive. Would not hire again despite acceptable final product.

No harm done, since the job they were originally were hired for was completed and is still showing results.

reviews.author: Courtney
reviews.text:
I am shocked at the 4.7 review.  I gave one star for getting same day service.  The second star is because the owner seemed genuinely sorry.
First, two guys showed up and had no supplies or tools - well they did have a saw but had to use our battery.
Took 3 holes in my ceiling to find the pipe. He had to go out to buy a standard piece of piping. Installed it using our tools and our extra pvc piping. The repair leaked so he had to go back out again to get more parts!! Took them 45 minutes each time. He cut so much piping off to fix the broken piece that it wouldn't connect to our toilet upstairs,  and he left it like that! We had to install an extension. Charged me $550. I wanted a receipt for proof for our insurance claim. He promised he would drop it off the next day since he didn't have the receipt book with him, of course. After 3 days I called the owner for a receipt and to inform him of our experience. He was going to drop it off the next day, but couldn't. The following day, I just asked him to mail it. After a week i called to follow up on the receipt.  He forgot and would send it that day. Luckily I didn't need it because I still never received the receipt.
The whole experience was something wild. The owner did apologize and I do believe if he was able to come do the job, this would not have been our experience. Hopefully he is able to find better help that is prepared and professional.

reviews.author: Nick Cellucci
reviews.text:
Edit: Owner called and left a couple apologetic voicemails. I appreciate the sentiment. Doesn’t change our experience, but it seems he’s done better for others.

Issue: Sewer drain backup (unresolved by this company)

Pros: Same-day service. I called at 6:30, they arrived at 10:30. They did at least try to solve the problem. Turns out it was bigger than a simple snake could solve, which was the extent of their capabilities.

Cons: Unprofessional, unprepared, and rude. Cash only.

Details: Showed up in 2 sedans, claimed all vans were in the shop. Had some equipment, but were missing multiple tools. Owner Emmett repeatedly interrupted me, dismissing questions and concerns. He was constantly shouting and swearing at his two assistants within earshot of my kid. At one point he wanted me to provide my own labor during a cleanout attempt. He claimed he'd "never failed in 45 years," but was unable to diagnose our problem and made a mess in our basement. Thankfully I had several tarps of my own on hand or they would have tracked sewage across a newly installed carpet.

By the end, he kept insisting that he was pissed off about not solving the problem. Said he'd be pissed if the next plumber we called fixed the problem quickly. I think he was prepared to leave without pay, but I gave him some cash to pay his employees.

Probably the only time I've ever been truly distrustful of a person hired to service my property. Felt like they needed constant supervision.

reviews.author: Brian Rineer
reviews.text: Emergency Rooter Services was extremely reliable – they arrived on time and fixed my clogged pipes. I felt confident knowing a 24‑hour plumber was just a call away. Would definitely use them again for any emergency plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Betsy H

reviews.author: Julia N Snyder

I highly recommend this Palm Harbor business! 10/10. THANK YOU SO MUCH!!! 📢📢

reviews.author: Julia Bergen
reviews.text: Really not sure about the positive reviews. I called to have someone come out to give me an estimate on replacing the trim of my tub shower and possibly valve. I also needed to repair a slow drain in my bathroom sink. I scheduled an appointment and spoke with Angelo. The first thing he told me is that most plumbing companies charge a fee to come out and provide an estimate, but his company doesn't. He then called me at 3 pm to advise me that two emergency repairs came up and he could not come out that afternoon and that he would give me a call later that evening or the following day.  No call, no show, no thank you. I found another company who happily came out to provide an estimate and earned my business.....and....they did not charge me for an estimate.  Scratching my head about all the positive reviews...can only think they are fake.

reviews.author: Joshua W
reviews.text: This is my second time using Wooten and it’s the only plumber I’ll use, especially because they’re locally owned. They are the best plumbing service in Oklahoma. Fast, friendly, reasonable price, highly recommend. Trey was our serviceman and extremely skilled.

reviews.author: Karee Coggins
reviews.text:
They damaged my property when putting in a water heater. They sent two apprentice plumbers without a journeyman supervisor on site, which is illegal. They did not pull a permit or an inspection until I insisted. I'm not even sure if they are going to be doing it, he said he will. We will make sure and send communication with the inspection department for Tulsa county.

The office ladies are nice except for they quoted my repair replacement at $1900 and then whenever the guys came they told me it would be $2400 because they had to remove the water heater door but then when they removed the door they actually just cut my door and damaged it. And they won't make it right or fix it. It's basically just a trim piece and replacing the hinges again And also replacing the siding that they broke but the owner is not willing to fix the damage that his people did.

When I spoke with the owner on the phone, he told me to get a quote to repair it and then he would just take the money off but I had already paid them because I paid them in full but then right after we hung up, he sent me a message and said he wasn't going to. Very sketchy,

The owner said that the door is rotten, which is true. It has a couple of boards that need to be replaced but the door did not fall apart. The guys cut it with a saw. They did not talk to me before they did that. The water heater closet door will not shut now, and since it is on the outside of a double wide mobile home, if the door is left open, wind will blow out the pilot light. Plus cold weather will get to the hot water tank and make it run less efficiently.

The damage is probably $200 or less but the owner is willing to damage the reputation of his business and have a very unhappy customer who paid top dollar for a water heater replacement. They charged me $2,400. The tech said it was because they had to take the door off. So they charge me $500 to take the door off and put it back on but basically all they did was cut it and ruin it.

I am not willing to have a gas water heater replaced in my home by two apprentice plumbers without a supervisor journeyman that is not inspected by the county. I have three small children and I need to make sure that this water heater has been installed correctly and safely by these two brand new plumbers that did not have any supervision.

reviews.author: Jon Anderson

reviews.author: Carolyn Maniscalco
reviews.text: The gentlemen doing the re-pipe were great. They were kind, courteous, thoughtful and caring.  When cutting out sheetrock they were very careful and wanted to save the border in the utility room, which they did.  All clean-up by re-pipe team was great.  The sheetrock repair was ok, but EXTREMELY messy and extending texture way beyond repair spots. I've spent 3 days cleaning up the sheetrock mess scraping texture from floors and off baseboards and doors.  They even got texture on a towel, countertops, cabinets and on light fixtures, and antique furniture. The border in utility room was smeared VERY unnecessarily. The texture over the wallpaper in the hall to the hall shower/bathroom is not only excessive it is measurable in thickness. Splatter on doors both interior and exterior (why the outside of the backdoor and porch and door upstairs (apartment) when there was not sheetrock to be repaired by these doors). Carpet in living room & closet in the apartment.

reviews.author: Christian Franco
reviews.text:
Very good experience. They assessed the job and got to work fast. Started as a 2 day start to finish but realistically it was 4 days. I have new pipes and it feels just fresh. Piece of mind as this old house had past problems with leaks.

I have a two story home with 4 bathrooms. The reason I gave them 4 out of 5 stars is because at the end of the project I still have to find and hire a painter to paint over the patches. And the house has lot of drywall dust. So I have to hire a detailed cleaning crew. For the Amount of money that you are spending you only wish you don’t have to think about those extra details. They could take care of it from beginning to end. I also requested a water test but I have not heard from them yet.

However, I do appreciate their hard work, communication, and professional services. The crew was on time. They discussed their objective and completed the job as promised. I would recommend them. Just keep in mind the extra last steps that you need to take to have the whole finished: painter and cleaning crew. Thank you!

reviews.author: Linda Ryan
reviews.text:
This company has many broken links in the chain of command.  The permit was put in the wrong name and Jessica argued with me that it was my responsibility to change it. This is a falsehood this took my time and I had to call the company repeatedly.  The crew came at inconsistent times and every excuse was made.  My backyard was used as dumpster and they used my electric and did not unplug the items.  The left tools all in the yard and did not pick them up
I requested to speak to the supervisor and he told them in the third day about that issue.  They broke a pipe and did not inform me that they had to and I was told they had to do so to locate the line.  There is no communication and it’s horrible due to the language barrier.  They did replace the flanges on the toilet but used spray foam I reported this to Jessica and she made another excuse stating it’s just temporary.  This is not a correct way to do this and any plumber would know this is a sanitation issue.  I am shocked ant all the issues and the job is still not complete.

I highly recommend Daniel for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Kimberly Gumino
reviews.text:
We had an emergency this week when our older boiler stopped working and the house dropped to 45°F during sub-zero temperatures. Legendary Heating Plumbing and Cooling took our call at 6:30am and had us connected with Sean within minutes.

Sean arrived within hours, diagnosed the issue quickly, and explained the best solutions in a clear and honest way. His pricing was excellent and straightforward. As new owners of an older home, we truly appreciated how he took the time to walk us through our system and explain what we have and how it works.

We were so impressed that we signed up for Legendary’s ongoing maintenance plan, which costs less than what we pay monthly for some apps.

The most incredible part: out of all the companies we called, when Sean arrived we realized he was the last person who had worked on our actual system over 10 years ago. His name was still on the service sticker.

Legendary is exactly the right name for this company. They are now our go-to HVAC specialists moving forward.

reviews.author: Brett Walker
reviews.text:
Let me start with the positive – I had a sump pump issue and they were out first thing in the morning. They diagnosed the issue, replaced the failed components and resolved it. They worked efficiently and were mostly professional. My only complaint is the price and billing practices.

First of all, they bill fixed rate, not time and materials. That’s not necessarily bad, but recognize that if you have multiple services done at once you’re paying their overhead and travel rolled into each of these rates. Second, it means that they are paying for time and you shouldn’t let them rush you. E.g., there’s no need to start a second diagnostic before the first is finished.

My biggest issue is that they did not provide any formal quote for the services or even explain their billing in advance. Verbal estimates I was given were way lower than the actual bill and when I asked for an explanation they refused to give me a breakdown of the costs saying “we don’t really do detailed breakdowns.” I did ultimately get one via email (since I needed it for the insurance claim) but it was also very different than the verbal explanation (different prices per service, not even the same line items).

I did try to negotiate with them after the fact, but they would not budge and insisted I had authorized the work and ignored my feedback that I had never been given a quote for any of it. My advice, make sure you get a quote in writing for any service, including diagnostics, before allowing them to proceed.

Honestly, given all the positive reviews specifically mentioning price, the only explanation I can come up with is that they saw my rather expensive car and figured they could up-charge me and then made up prices after the fact to fit the bill. I really hope that isn’t the case, but it’s the only thing that makes sense to me. That said, here is my whole breakdown so you can decide for yourself if you think $650 to dig a 2 ft hole to the septic tank is a “reasonable market rate.”

Crawlspace Water Removal & Pump-Out: $850.00
Septic Tank Access & Exposure: $650.00
Ejector Pump Replacement (1/2 HP – Installed): $1,250.00
Sump Pump Replacement (1/3 HP – Installed): $975.00
Plumbing Repair – Discharge Line Reconnection: $325.00
Fixture Repair – Master Bathroom Tub Valve: $225.00
Materials, Equipment Usage & Disposal: $323.62
Total: $4,598.62

reviews.author: Jamila Keen
reviews.text: I needed emergency repairs after two frozen pipes burst, and A1 American Plumbing came through when it mattered most. Nick did an excellent job—he showed up at night, quickly found the source of the problem, and fixed it efficiently. His professionalism, knowledge, and calm approach were incredibly reassuring during a stressful situation. Thanks to his fast work, I was able to relax and actually get some sleep that night knowing the issue was resolved. I’m very grateful for the service and would highly recommend A1 American, especially Nick, for any emergency plumbing repairs.

reviews.author: K Mack
reviews.text:
​I had a fantastic experience with A-1 American after my water heater went out 3/22/2026 Sunday. My home warranty company was closed at the time, but once I was able to file the claim on Monday, they allowed me to select an out-of-network provider. I am so glad I chose A-1 American!

​They were able to send a technician, Nicholas B, out the same day (Monday) I called (within a few hours). Nicholas was professional, informative, and incredibly patient throughout the entire process. Before he could even begin the work, he had to speak with my warranty company for authorization. We ended up on hold for nearly an hour waiting for a representative, but Nicholas never once seemed frustrated. Instead, he kept up a friendly conversation and made the wait much easier.
​Once the work was confirmed for the water heater replacement, he quickly picked up the necessary parts and got straight to multiple hours of solo work.

He was efficient and kept a very tidy workspacethere weren't parts scattered everywhere, and he left the area spotless when he was finished.

​I could not be more pleased with the same day service and the quality of the work. I would highly recommend A-1 American and Nicholas B to anyone in need of reliable service!

reviews.author: Jeff3372 Sandford
reviews.text: I contacted several plumbers to replace old galvanized pipe that had failed. No one wanted to go under the house, cut out the old and replace with new piping. Nick was willing and did a great job working in some very tight spaces. I've used A-1 American in the past and will use them again in the future.

reviews.author: Courson McConnell
reviews.text:
A-1 was able to replace my compressor faster and cheaper than other services in the area! They did not require me to pay for their own diagnostic, like every ither service I called, and they were able to work with me on payments for the repair rather than try to get me to finance a new unit.

Outstanding service!

reviews.author: Amy Wharton
reviews.text: Horrible experience, do not recommend. Technician spent 20 minutes diagnosing the problem, charged me over $400 because he looked at 2 units. which was much more than quoted to me over the phone when I made the appointment. Technician should have been transparent when is signed the work order about waiving the 3 day cancelation. Like a dummy i signed because I misread and thought i had 3 days to cancel. He just said sign here, here, and here. He told me the replacement parts and work would cost 18k to have my gas-pack replaced. My realtor told me to get another quote from another company because it sounded high. I did ask the tech about the price of the parts and he to told me he was not privy to that information. He had to run outside twice to make phone calls to the company, probably teying to figure out how much they could take me for. I got a quote from another company and the price was less than half of what I was quoted. I called the company and they said they could only do a partial refund due to the signed contract. Still on the hook for 4k, still cheaper to go with another honest, transparent company. I feel ripped off and taken advantage of because my husband wasn't there. This company claims to support the military and as I military family I am very disappointed with this company.

The plumber was friendly, honest and diagnosed the problem within minutes. Two hours later everything was replaced, including a hose bib that had been leaking for years! The price was beyond reasonable and the work impeccable. Besides the good work, I see Arrow Plumbing supporting non profits all over our community. Give them a call and be impressed like I was!

reviews.author: Eloy Cavazos
reviews.text: Called to get an estimate on a swimming pool gas line that was rusted. Had a technician at my house within the hour. I received a quote that I could not pass up and job was completed by close of day. Job well done and Excellent service. I will definitely use their services again.

The crew was on time and finished the job 2 hours tops. Made sure everything was working properly before they left. ARROW plumbing is great.

reviews.author: Lisa D.
reviews.text: I couldn't be more pleased with Arrow Plumbing and their employees. I have just recently had to take over this kind of thing for my mom and finding a plumber. It was stressful trying to choose the right one since it can be so expensive and she is on a budget. So grateful I chose them. They came that day, got on our roof in the rain and fixed our issue. The bill was so reasonable that everytime I think about it I almost cry, which I did when they told us. Such a relief. Some out there price gouge, especially for seniors, not these guys they are fair, upfront and reasonable. I will definitely be passing their name on to others. THANX SO MUCH!

reviews.author: Jennifer Korn
reviews.text: They were extremely kind, fast and work is beautiful and will last for years. reviews.author: Ryan Lynn
reviews.text: Robert and Diondre did an amazing job on the install! Discord is a professional company through and through. Preston who did the inspection caught that we had CO gases being leaked. If it wasn’t for the financing the company offered, I may not have been able to replace it. When the unit was pulled out the heat exchange was burnt through. The wall was burned too. We are very blessed to have Preston catch that it needed to be replaced. Robert and Diondre had extra issues with getting out the old unit. They had great attitudes and were super respectful and thorough. My wife and child were at home during install and I felt safe knowing that all employees are background checked and professional. Robert and Diondre were super fun to have around. The company also makes sure to double check all their workers via video and pictures. They also do a follow up inspection. Would highly recommend them. You never know what you are getting with an ad in the mail, but it paid off. No complaints and really thankful to fiscor for making my house safe again.

reviews.author: Lauren Thagard
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with Fiscor and their HVAC installation team! From start to finish, the team was respectful, knowledgeable, and true professionals. They took great pride in the quality of their work, paid attention to every detail, and made sure everything was done right. Additionally, they had to repair several problems our previous HVAC installers left behind and is also likely why our last system had to be replaced well before its lifespan. They thoroughly explained how our new system works and answered all of our questions, which we really appreciated. They also cleaned up completely after the installation, leaving our home just as they found it. We couldn’t be happier with the service and highly recommend Fiscor to anyone looking for a reliable and professional HVAC company! Huge thank you to Robert and Diondre who spent a 12-hour day working at our house on the full unit install, the duct repair in our attic, and adding an additional return vent, all to ensure our new unit’s efficiency. Jason was also great, showing up early and checking in regularly. Overall, just a wonderful team that did an exceptional job, under less than ideal circumstances (previous work flaws). Thank you all for the great work!!!

reviews.author: Leisa Boyd
reviews.text: Robert and Alan came out to do some minor repairs and verify work that had previously been done by other techs. They were on time, very friendly, and completely through. They walked me though everything and took the time to inspect each vent and close off some vents that were not being used to maximize airflow in our most used rooms. It was a great experience and I highly recommend Fiscor for their amazing techs.

reviews.author: Ken Brown
reviews.text: Jason, Diondre, Logan and Ryan did an outstanding job installing new “lungs” or ducting for my intake and exhaust system on my HVAC system. They were very professional, knowledgable and explained things very well. My system is working great and I’m happy with the service.

reviews.author: Denise Rose
reviews.text: Robert and Diondrea were my installers on my new Bosch furnace and air conditioning unit! These guys are animals, they were very determined to make sure I had heat before they left, staying until 11:45 p.m., then returning at 7 a.m. the next day to complete the install. Jason, the Field Coordinator stopped in just to make sure I was satisfied. Since my old furnace had completely shut down, Tiffany and Wendy made sure I was on the top.of their schedule, that was phenomenal. I cannot say enough good things about the customer service provided by all Fiscor employees!!! Including Carlis, who was the first tech that helped me with a different concern. Thank you to all!!!

reviews.author: Michelle Reece
reviews.text: We needed plumbing work done soon and they were able to come to the house the same day and completely finish the work that needed to be done.  They came after 6:00 pm pumped the septic tank and made a baffle and was done properly around 8:30 pm. We are very pleased with them!!!!

reviews.author: dubbio55
reviews.text: We had an outside faucet break. Duckett was first to respond, which was appreciated. “We charge $75 to come out but discount it if you want us to do the job.”  Fine. They come out and look at the faucet and pipe and say $500. We needed it done so hesitant but OK. When paying I asked to have that broken down. One explanation was that Google charges them $180 for the search service when someone searches with Google online. We need to pay their overhead. I owned a business and know that’s not the way to cover overhead. Using AI to search for Google fees I find out that the usual fees range from $15 to $50 per lead!  The work was good, hence two stars. But charging me $180 for a $15-$50 charge to them is not right. We needed it done but won’t be using them again.

reviews.author: Daen Campbell
reviews.text:
My son recently inherited a 1945 mill home from his grandparents. The home needs a complete rehab, but we were looking to make it livable until the spring. It’s in a very small town and plumbers willing to take the job are limited.

From the very first phone call late on a Friday afternoon about a big water leak, to the completion of the job, Duckett Plumbing exceeded my expectations.

These guys are so knowledgeable. They provided me with solid options based on our needs and budget.

Wayne was the best! He completed all the work on our very necessary bathroom fixes. New toilet, new shower fixtures and new shower surround. He’s thoughtful of his work and provided the best customer experience. He went so far above and beyond what was requested.

We had some scheduling issues because we were out of town for several days to move, but they stayed in contact to let me know how they’d accommodate the crazy schedule.

Give Duckett plumbing a call. They are fantastic!

reviews.author: Eric Simmons
reviews.text: Highly recommend Duckett Plumbing. David the technician called notifying me he was on his way  and arrived on time. Understood the issue I was having and got promptly to work. Was even able to get me a discount since I had the necessary parts and was doing the same repair on separate faucets. Very professional and personable in his manor.

reviews.author: Kitty Lewis
reviews.text: I had a leak in my kitchen free standing ice maker, of course, on a Sunday night at 7:30pm. The leak was substantial and I was in a panic! I called Duckett Plumbing because their website said that they would respond to urgent situations. I called several places, and Duckett called me right back and service personnel were at my house within 45 minutes. (I live in Greenwood, SC and they were coming from Anderson SC.) William was the service provider and he was wonderful. He quickly got the water off and found the problem. He came even though no businesses were open to provide needed parts. He was able to turn off the water to the ice maker only, so that we still had water. Life saver!! He got the situation controlled last night and then came back this morning to replace the leaking hose in the ice maker and under the house. He was efficient and skilled and very kind. I could not ask for better service! The price was very reasonable considering the timing and how quickly he was able to address the issue. That leak could have ruined my entire kitchen flooring, not to mention that it was also leaking in the crawlspace under the house. I will rate them as many stars as possible!! Great response time!! Great service personnel!! I am so thankful!

reviews.author: Alexa Pack
reviews.text: We've been using One Call Plumbing for years and can't say enough nice things about them!
