Today's visit from Ethan (and initial call with David) was no exception. Thankful for them and highly recommend!

reviews.author: Clara Clark
reviews.text: Our toilets and tubs suddenly started simultaneously not draining well late one night.  Early the next morning we called around and it was clear that One Call Plumbing was the choice plumber.  We were faced with having to have a Main Water Line Blockage fixed, and they made it painless, and even offered financing as an option.  They were professional, kind, as accommodating as possible, and they were able to get someone out within just an hour or two of us calling.  In addition, in comparison to some plumbing companies, they were affordable, and even took into account one of us being a Veteran, and gave a military discount.  Our technician was one of the best dispatched techs I have ever had the pleasure of dealing with.  In a world so focused on instant gratification, and in business to just make a buck, this company did not disappoint.  Would not hesitate to use again and recommend.  I don't leave reviews but this one was worth leaving one for.  Thank you

reviews.author: Joc Davis
reviews.text: Neighbors told me I had a water leak, I called One Call Plumbing.  Very professional and serving from the first moments.  Response time was within 3 hours from first call. Price was very fair for the service that was provided. High recommended

reviews.author: Wayne Corlis
reviews.text: I tecently had U.S. Water Heating Solutions install a new hot water heater in my home, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! From the initial call, their team was responsive, professional, and transparent about options and pricing. The technician arrived on time, worked efficiently, and did a clean, high-quality installation. He even took the time to explain how the new unit works and gave tips for maintenance. Hot water was restored quickly with no mess left behind. Highly recommend them for anyone needing water heater replacement – great service from a reliable, company!

reviews.author: Eleonore Stoesser
reviews.text:
The technician Chris was very timely, polite, and helpful.
We had issues with our water heater putting it smelly sulfer/rotten egg scented water.
The technicians that did initial install left us high and dry.
Through Home Depot we were paired with US water heating solutions for the warranty repair.
As it turns out, we needed a powered anode rod to combat the minerals in the well water.
Chris came out and drained the tank, and bleached it to kill all the bacteria that was left behind.
He returned the following day, installed the anode rod, refilled the tank, and sure everything was in good working order.
Chris was very knowledgeable, proficient, and put our minds at ease.
10/10 will recommend US water heating solutions to anyone needing an install or repairs!!!!

reviews.author: Justin Skaggs
reviews.text: I had a very positive experience from the first phone call to the tankless water heater installation. The tech, Russ, was professional, knowledgeable, timely, courteous, and efficient. Thankful for his work. Based on my experience, I would highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Lisa Brooks
reviews.text: My water heater services 3 apartments. When it stopped working I heard all about it at volume 10. US Water Heating Solutions to the rescue! One of their techs had a hard to find part on his truck and came out to install it on a Sunday! Super nice and knowledgeable guy. Did fast, clean and thorough work. And he used data to determine the problem and confirm the solution - inspired confidence and relieved stress. I had them come back out on a weekday to upgrade one part that was giving the tech some weird readings. All is now well and I'm glad to have these folks on my team should future problems arise. Definitely recommend.

reviews.text: They were fantastic! Todd Chiles was always promt, very professional, and respectful with all of my interactions with him. He and I had several discussions even when he was between other jobs trying to troubleshoot and work through the issues that we were having with our water heater. I would recommend Todd / U.S. Water Heating Solutions to anyone having problems or issues with their water heater.

reviews.author: Debbie LaTerza
reviews.text: Professional friendly service. A+.  Would recommend. We called Oscars plumbing on a Thursday for a leaky toilet we had tried fixing several times but the leak always returned. Friday morning Danny  was at our door.  He quickly showed me the correct way to arrange the flush valve height which fixed the toilet.  Then as a precaution he tested several other water lines around our house for pressure and found our regulator no longer worked.  A quick trip to the warehouse and we had correct pressure by the early afternoon.  Our plumber Danny was friendly, thorough, and walked us through everything he was doing.  He also told us what to look for in case the high pressure caused other damage.  Overall, very pleased with the service and would recommend to anyone needing a plumber to repair an issue in their home.

reviews.text: Justin and his crew provided superior services.  They went over and beyond to ensure every detail was taken care of within a tight deadline. Justin responded to messages in a timely manner and while working, he was kind, communicative and attentive to detail. He and his assistant interacted with a great balance of professionalism and humor making the project less overwhelming for me and providing me with the assurance the job would be done well.  I highly recommend Premier Plumbing.  I believe Justin is truly a man of integrity and skill.

reviews.author: Joey Pannell
reviews.text: “So glad we called Premium Plumbing for our Cullman home! Justin Barbee runs a top notch operation — friendly, efficient, and the work was done right the first time. Won’t use anyone else for our plumbing needs!” And I’m glad I didn’t have to get under there…!!

reviews.author: Jimmy Wells
reviews.text: I had a clogged toilet that I couldn't unstop with my auger. My wife was in the hospital and due to come home the next day. I called them at 8:30 in the evening (open 24 hours a day) and he set up an appointment for first thing in the morning. Two young men came out and managed (with great effort) to unclog it with their auger, clearing out an apparent piece of hard plastic dropped in by a grandchild. Exceptional service, professional work by the employees and much less expensive than I feared it would be.

reviews.author: Alan Dunkling
reviews.text: Outstanding service.  They got me set up with a new regulator and expansion tank and I now have great water pressure.  Both guys did an excellent job at a great price.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 124 S Main St Ste 207, Burleson, TX 76028, USA

reviews.author: David P
reviews.text: I rarely leave reviews but the quality of work provided by Kenneth and Zach warrant a review. I had a significant drainage issue and Kenneth patiently and systematically was able to clean the main line. He was extremely knowledgeable and took pride in his work. He really cared about wanting to help clear the blockage so I could be back in my house. Zach was extremely friendly and did great with the camera and had great communication.

reviews.author: Beverly Collins
reviews.text:
Woke up to water seeping across my family room floor — not exactly how you want to start the day. I called Roto‑Rooter, and Erik arrived quickly to assess the situation. He discovered a leaking underground pipe, and he and his partner, Andres, also found a second smaller leak affecting another part of the house.

They were thorough, professional, and worked carefully to prevent what could have turned into major water damage. They stayed until everything was repaired and made sure the plumbing was fully updated.

I’m extremely grateful for the excellent work Erik and Andres did. I can finally relax knowing the issue is resolved. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kathryn Tooley
reviews.text: Five star. Amazing turnaround time. I was able to get an appointment very quickly. Kenneth explained the pricing and service well.  The repair was finished quickly. Future options were explained. Thanks!

reviews.author: Courtney W
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter Plumbing is my go-to plumbing company. Their service is always quick, effective, and customer-friendly. I’ve had a couple of clog issues over time, and I’ve used them for each one. Every time, I’ve been able to get same-day service, which is incredibly convenient and reassuring. I highly recommend them for reliable and efficient plumbing services. This service Nicholas was fantastic.

reviews.author: Ray Estrada
reviews.text: I don't write reviews very often, but when I see exceptional service, I take note. I have had Roto-Rooter to my house twice over the course of 1 Year because we have roots that block our pipes and roughly every year we need to clear them out. Both times Roto-Rooter delivered. This time, I had the pleasure to meet Nicholas. Nicholas was professional and curteous. His 10 Years  of experience allowed him to quickly diagnose the issue and clear the blockage. You pay the best to have a job well done. You pay subpar prices and you will receive a subpar performance. Roto-Rooter is in a class of itself. I will continue to recommend Roto-Rooter to my friends and family.

plumbers.name: Minuteman Plumbing, Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 100 Garden St, Cambridge, MA 02138, USA

reviews.author: Colson Perkins
reviews.text: It can be difficult finding solid people you can count on to get work done, so I am always grateful when I do. I had the pleasure of working with Aaron with Minuteman Plumbing. He was exactly who you'd want to work with from start to finish. This was for an instant hot water heater service along with some overdue maintenance concerns. Aaron walked me through everything he saw that would be good to fix (corroded pipes, gas and water), some things that could be fixed but likely wouldn't be too big of an issue if not, and was able to knock everything out that day. Pricing was reasonable (I recommend the membership) and the work looks and functions great.

reviews.author: Mel H
reviews.text:
Wayne did a great job for us this week. We needed a sump pump replaced on our outside patio, and we were able to get an appointment within two days of calling, even though it wasn't an emergency.

The day before the appointment, our garbage disposal started leaking and the sink shutoff valves stopped working. They had no problem adding those repairs to the list.

Wayne was respectful and even took his shoes off before entering the house without being asked. He has a friendly, non-imposing demeanor and never seemed bothered when I asked several questions throughout the job. The sump pump and valves he selected were top quality, which I was happy to pay for because they should last much longer than cheaper alternatives. I'm so glad we found this company. They clearly take the time to hire experienced, skilled, and respectful professionals. I wouldn't hesitate to use them again or recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Carolina Villegas
reviews.text:
Here’s a polished, concise review:

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Aaron went above and beyond!
Aaron proactively reached out before the appointment to warn me about a possible delay and offered to reschedule — I appreciated the heads-up. He still showed up on a Friday afternoon with a great attitude and a smile, ready to tackle a big job. Things didn’t go perfectly smoothly, but he kept his cool, problem-solved throughout, and even found time at the end to help me with an additional task.
It’s rare to find someone so reliable, solution-oriented, and genuinely pleasant to work with. Great prices and availability too. Highly recommend Minuteman Plumbing. Now we have a working steam shower!

reviews.author: Paula Murphy
reviews.text: Minuteman P&H has been great from the start. From the  set up of my appointment to communicating all along with any needs or concerns I have had. My technician Jon was very knowledgeable with diagnosing & explaining the potential problems that were happening with my A/C & HVAC system, & what needs  to be done going forward. I would recommend them to all!

reviews.author: Giulio Tomassy
reviews.text: Great service. I called for a heating system that stopped working and I received a call back immediately. I explained what the issue was and within a couple of hours they sent two great guys, Wayne and Ian. They analyzed and identified the problem, made an estimate right away and once I accepted it, they ran to Home Depot to get what they needed. They explained to me the whole work, what needed to be done. I liked that they did not try to sell anything else than the job they had to do (my boiler is really.old, so it would have been easy to push a new system). Spent the whole afternoon working on it and problem was solved. Really happy with the work, the whole experience of interacting with this company and I think the price was also fair. Will definitely hire them again.

plumbers.name: Paramount Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2131 Moon Station Dr NW, Kennesaw, GA 30144, USA

reviews.author: Stephanie G.
reviews.text:
I wanted to take the time to send a shout out to the guys at Paramount Plumbing. We purchased our home when it was stripped down to the studs. While some plumbing was still in place, it was old black pipe with visible cracks, past leaks, and multiple patch repairs from prior owners. We received several estimates and ultimately chose Paramount Plumbing — and we’re so happy we did.

Paramount completely re-plumbed our entire home with 100% new plumbing. They also installed sinks, showers, drains, toilets, vanities, hose spickets...everything. We had changed the floor plan significantly, added multiple bathrooms, an additional kitchen, a pantry with a sink, a main-floor laundry room, and ended up with five bathrooms total. They also jetted our main sewer line, which helped us avoid having to jackhammer the slab — a huge win.

They recommended and replaced our water heater, repaired and replaced gas lines as needed, and even ran new gas lines to our 60-year-old fireplace. Their recommendations were greatly appreciated, and the quality of work was excellent. They also reccomended ways we could save on cost which is a really big deal when you have to do that much remodeling.

Out of every contractor involved in our remodel, Paramount Plumbing was the only one who showed up every day, on time, and completed their work efficiently, timely and correctly. They took the time to do things the right way, and it genuinely felt like they cared about the quality and long-term reliability of their work.

We built a large custom shower with four independent fixtures, and they executed it perfectly. I sleep better at night knowing the plumbing was done right.

They were also the only contractor on our entire project who passed county inspection quickly and without issues. After the challenges we faced with other trades, Eric, Aiden, and Ferman from Paramount were the best part of our remodel experience.

Highly recommend the guys at Paramount.

reviews.author: Jenna Baadshaug
reviews.text:
I am the property manager of a Condominium Association in Atlanta. About a year ago, the association determined that a change was needed regarding the building plumber. A Board Member and I initially met with Nick to tour the building and review its complex plumbing system. Since that time, Nick has served as the primary building plumber, and I truly cannot say enough positive things about him.

Nick is consistently prompt, professional, and clear in his communication. He always takes the extra time—often an additional 5–10 minutes—to thoroughly explain issues and solutions in a way that is easy to understand, which is incredibly valuable when working with Boards and homeowners.

Most recently, the association experienced a significant pipe burst. I immediately contacted Paramount Plumbing, and Nick was on-site within an hour. Upon arriving around 9:00 PM, he quickly assessed the situation and took immediate action. He worked diligently until nearly 5:00 AM, without complaint, ensuring the repairs were completed properly.

Throughout the entire process, Nick kept both me and the Board President fully informed. His calm demeanor, professionalism, and exceptional communication were instrumental in managing a very stressful situation.
I highly recommend Nick and Paramount Plumbing and am extremely grateful for the level of service, dedication, and reliability they consistently provide.

reviews.author: Ashley Kwon
reviews.text:
Nick and Aiden from Paramount Plumbing were great to work with. They quickly figured out the potential causes of my washer drain pipe overflowing in my high-rise condo in Midtown and fixed the issue efficiently. Both were friendly, professional, and took the time to explain what was going on and how to prevent future problems.

I really appreciated the small details too — they wore shoe coverings and gave helpful tips for safely leaving a condo unattended. Highly recommend Paramount Plumbing!

reviews.author: Teresa Green
reviews.text: Called them to come and give me an estimate for replacing my water heater.  Their price was the best. Sosa and Landon arrived on time and went right to work.  Everything was finished and cleared away in just over 3 hours.  Both were professional and very personable.  I would definitely recommend Paramount for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Laura Thompson
reviews.text:
HIGHLY RECOMMEND - Overdue review as I've used this company for over 1.5yrs -  it's a hard world of "who can you trust" yet Paramount Plumbing is the best. I've been extremely pleased by their professionalism, expertise and overall kindness in handling one emergency, and a few service issues.

Fermin uncovered and fixed an HVAC blockage that SLAM Plumbing recommended I spend $1000 and go into the wall to "fix" but wasn't sure if would fix it or not. Unreal.

Fermin and Jason deserve special shout out and recognition for their overall knowledge, expertise and how they helped in the various situations.

Thank you all for being easy to schedule with, quick to action (at least in my experience), great to work with, trustworthy, and overall fantastic company!

plumbers.name: Anytime Comfort
plumbers.address: 2629 Duncan Rd Ste C, Lafayette, IN 47904, USA

reviews.author: Joe Fields
reviews.text: Scott was excellent and knowledgeable. He was familiar with my Aprilaire system. Competitors who have provided services in the past did not have as much information.

reviews.author: Kerry Hardesty
reviews.text:
James from Anytime was able to see us on the same day we called even though it was a non emergency. We had an electrical situation he quickly took care of.
We may be in need of other electrical work in the near future and confident in calling on Anytime again.

reviews.author: Daniel Moreno
reviews.text:
Excellent customer service. We have a new unit that was installed back in May 2025 (old unit had a leak in the system). The  tech guys did an excellent job during installation,  we had to call them today due to the house being so cold. They responded immediately and sent a tech to check the problem. There were some issues with the furnace’s settings only. Now the house is warm again.
Andrew is the tech who did the evaluation before we bought the unit and is the one who came today to fix the issue, always very helpful and willing to provide details of the issues and those were resolved. Kudos for these guys and keep up with the good work.

reviews.author: Ariya Eads
reviews.text: When I called in I was able to get scheduled same day for my furnace repair. The customer service is great and the technician was on time, professional and was able to get me back up and going within an hour. I will definitely be using them from now on.

reviews.author: Dale Sleep
reviews.text:

His crew was on site in a couple of days to do an entire update with electrical ingress - replace electric panel - removal of heating oil system - instillation of a great heat pump - all in one day!!! And their technition wouldn't leave till everything was perfect.  The owner was so impressed and so happy with the new system!!! They went the extra mile and did an excellent job.

reviews.author: Hieu 'David' Nguyen
reviews.text: Exceptional service from start to finish. Frosty responded quickly, arrived on time, and treated my home with respect. He also offered a veteran discount, which I truly appreciated. Frosty is professional, well-spoken, and delivers old-school, reliable service at very fair prices compared to competitors. Highly recommend Frosty for any plumbing needs. Thanks again, Frosty!

reviews.author: Chris Brown
reviews.text:
I went downstairs today to find a puddle under my water heater.  I don’t like dealing with most repair places with shiny vans and commercials on tv with cute kids so I threw it out to Reddit Salt Lake City and Frostys Elite was mentioned and seconded as great to work with and fair prices.  Well within 4 hours here I am looking at a new shiny water heater buttoned up tighter than granny’s britches.  I am  amazed and grateful for the prompt fast response and professional install.  100% recommend this business!

Chris Brown

reviews.text: Frosty was great! Saw him recommend on a review somewhere.  Text him and was able to get it replaced next day.  He was more knowledgeable than anyone I’d expect from a larger plumbing company.  Felt great with him doing the work. Very nice guy! Would recommend him to everyone.

reviews.author: Brett Faust
reviews.text: Frosty is the man when it comes to water heater repair and replacement.  He came in and helped our WH last another 7-8 months with a sensor replacement.  Once the tank started to leak we knew who to call.  Fast professional service, thanks Frosty!

Our new water heater was installed within just a few days and working great so far! Frosty’s very professional and kind. I would absolutely recommend him to my friends and family for water heater services!

reviews.text: I had the pleasure of having an amazing technician named Christian Williams come and help out with my water heater. He was quick and professional the whole time he was here. He even helped me with my kitchen faucet, it was spewing water out of the sides. He went above and beyond with this service! Thank you guys also for getting us in on short notice!!!

reviews.author: Dore Thornton
reviews.text:
Zach was awesome!   The specific drain issue required that we get just as much information needed to figure out my options before committing to a fix. Zach was able to quickly make an evaluation and offer solutions when i was ready to move forward.

As the prospective buyer of the property being serviced, what really stood out with zach was that he was really good at listening to my thoughts concerns about the property. He shared his thoughts which helped me close out a bunch of questions that had been rattling around in my head. Great guy, really helped me out today.

reviews.author: Mark Mauldin
reviews.text: Our house has had many plumbing problems. Franklin Plumbing has been awesome and amazing! Fast! Professional! Personable! I cannot recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Anne Marie Szabo
reviews.text: Branden was professional, efficient and kind. I am thrilled with his decision to complete the work all at once. It’s now working beautifully! Thank you!

reviews.author: Wendy Stokes
reviews.text: Persistent, Professional,  fair and helpful. I’m grateful to have plumbers I can rely on regardless of the issue. Franklin Plumbing has been very good to us over the years.

plumbers.name: Midwest Plumbing Co. LLC
plumbers.address: 8360 Auburn Ln, Westminster, CO 80031, USA

reviews.author: Brett Gallrein
reviews.text:
Short version: excellent workmanship, fast service, best price. I would hire them again and would recommend Midwest Plumbing Co to my friends and family.

Long version: I am completely gutting and renovating my basement. I didn’t feel comfortable laying out the under slab plumbing. My plan was inefficient and I was concerned about getting all the code nuances correct. I decided to hire a licensed plumber to figure out my underslab rough in. I solicited quotes from most plumbing companies that service the Denver metro area that had good reviews on Google.

Midwest Plumbing was the most reasonably priced and had the best ideas. James made me feel comfortable that he could get the job done right and in the time frame I needed.

Midwest Plumbing exceeded my expectations. Not only are they great plumbers but they nail the customer service aspect of the business too. The main floor toilets/sinks/showers could not be used while the basement plumbing was being installed. James came over after hours at no charge to get my plumbing hooked back up and family back in the house sooner than expected after the plumbing inspector approved the work and I could take the new under slab sewer lines off pressure test.

My house is old and of course there were the “normal” amount of unexpected issues encountered when Midwest Plumbing was tying in the new plumbing to the existing plumbing. They had practical solutions to the problems encountered and communicated clearly and professionally during the entire process.

I’ve worked alongside a lot of plumbers - these guys are among the best I’ve encountered. True professionals.

reviews.author: Julia Sivetts
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Midwest Plumbing Co. LLC. If you’re looking for a reliable, professional plumbing company in Arvada, this is the one to call! They showed up on time, diagnosed the issue quickly, and explained everything clearly before starting the repair. The pricing was fair and transparent, and the quality of work was excellent! He handled my plumbing repair efficiently and left everything clean when he was done. It’s hard to find an honest, dependable plumber, but this company definitely delivers!

I highly recommend them for plumbing services, whether you need leak repairs, drain cleaning, fixture installation, or general plumbing work. I will absolutely use them again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Alexander Jones
reviews.text: Midwest Plumbing has been great in helping us fix a leak that came out of nowhere. They were super responsive, scheduled an appointment quickly, and were very friendly. We had multiple issues causing the leak and they solved each one quickly. Would highly recommend their services!

reviews.author: Kent Miller
reviews.text:
I had a great experience working with James and Kalie. From the start, communication was clear and professional, and they showed up on time ready to work. The job itself was done efficiently and with real attention to detail — no shortcuts, no rushing.

They took the time to explain what was going on, walked me through my options, and made sure everything was done right before wrapping up. Pricing was fair and transparent, and the quality of work gave me total peace of mind.

It’s hard to find someone reliable and skilled these days, but this was one of those rare stress-free experiences. I wouldn’t hesitate to use them again and will definitely recommend them to friends and family.

reviews.author: Luke LaConte
reviews.text: If you are looking for a professional, reliable, honest and quality plumbing job done, contact James and Team at Midwest Plumbing. This team went ABOVE and BEYOND to fix a major water leak as well as to diagnose and fix the many plumbing issues we had. James kept us updated consistently throughout the entire process and was able to answer all the questions we had, making us feel comfortable and confident we picked the right team for the task at hand. This team worked quickly, efficiently and cleaned up their work areas. James and Team made sure the job was done to our satisfaction and maintained a very polished and professional demeanor which we really appreciated! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jolene Hourt
reviews.text: This is my second time using Mr. Expert. Called them because my fireplace wasn’t turning on. I thought that my igniter was bad. But Luis is always honest and let me know it was just the switch on the wall. The wires had came loose. Back up and running good! Thanks, Luis

reviews.author: Kevin

Their boiler specialist Louis is extremely knowledgeable and fair with his rates. Valencia, who worked on an emergency pex line repair came to the house in an hour and made a repair quickly. Locally owned and operated plumbers are so much better than national chains. There are other great options in SLC too, but Mr. Expert has never let us down.

reviews.author: Dan Hall
reviews.text:
Second review.

Moved the toilet and bathtub in bathroom and reconfigure drain stack in basement for future  downstairs bathroom. Luis and his crew were awesome! He was very helpful and knowledgeable with all my questions and easy to schedule. We had a problem with the bathtub and he came back to take it out. I had to order a new one(defect) and they came back as soon as I received it and re installed it. I Highly recommend mr. Expert for any plumbing needs. Will be calling them for future projects.

Installed a gas line to a new cooktop. Lowest quote by far that I got and scheduled within a couple days of deciding to do it. Jorge was great to work with and did an awesome job. No complaints highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jim Seckler

reviews.author: Ryan Boehm
reviews.text:
Very thankful and I recommend Your 2nd Opinion Plumbing. I came home from work a couple days before Christmas and had noticed a burnt smell and a water leak coming from my water heater. I called the bigger companies near me in Louisville and was sent to a robot or service advisor in a call center somewhere in the country. Because it was late it the day and the day before Christmas Eve I was told it could be a couple days before I would get a call back. Unreal!
I did a local search and right down the road near my house was 2nd Opinion Plumbing. I did a quick look at the reviews and they were good so I gave them a call. After 2 rings I got a real human to pick up and was surprised to find out they were going to send someone out to check out my problem that same evening. Within 30 minutes I had a technician at my house, Jerry, was able to determine the problem very quickly and gave my a couple different options to go with. After a few checks and balances and questions, to ensure accuracy, I had come to the same conclusion and decided we should switch the old, water logged water heater for a new one. I had figured I would need to wait until after Christmas because the next day was Christmas Eve. No! They wanted and was able to schedule my new water heater installation the next day, about 12 hours away! I was honestly floored and in disbelief because I was unable to get through to the big guys how important a water heater is to a household. These guys got it, and actually made me feel like a neighbor! What started as a nightmare, coming home right before Christmas and having water leaking turned into a breath of fresh air! Can't explain how thankful I am for the whole team and getting my issue fixed. Timely, knowledgeable, and friendly are how I can describe the crew. I was able to make it to family on Christmas Eve morning because these guys got to me first thing in the morning and had everything installed in a couple hours! I recommend you check out 2nd Opinion Plumbing for work needing to be done, or if you just want a second opinion. Thank you!! Recommend!

reviews.author: Paul Foster
reviews.text:
I hired Clean Flo Sewer and Septic for septic maintenance and pumping and they went way above and beyond what I expected. They carefully located and excavated the tank, discovered it was a 1500 gallon with a baffle wall, and thoroughly agitated and pumped it clean. They even handled a fair amount of grease buildup in both the tank and main line by hydro jetting everything spotless.
On top of the excellent cleaning, they added high-quality live bacterial treatments to fight grease, solids, and help the drain field with biomat and hard pan issues. They also installed riser kits on both the inlet and outlet — such a smart, customer-friendly upgrade that will make future maintenance so much easier.
Professional, knowledgeable, hardworking, and honest. They left everything clean and my system running better than it has in years. I highly recommend them to anyone needing septic work. Won’t use anyone else from now on!

reviews.author: Jerry Welborn

Will call them with any other problems.

This company is a rip off!  He then tried to put $1500 of enzymes in my tank to hopefully  fix the drainage issue or an aerobic system for $10000 that may or may not fix it. I found another Honest local company and septic is flowing again. It is a shame a big company is so dishonest. These companies give Honest companies a bad reputation!

reviews.author: Helene Verner
reviews.text:
Price’s Plumbing and Heating
Prompt, Thorough, and Excellent Communication
We use Price’s Plumbing and Heating for all our plumbing and HVAC needs. When our hot water heater suddenly stopped working, we placed a service request that evening. Impressively, Matt (owner) arrived promptly by 9:00 AM the very next day. He conducted a thorough assessment, carefully investigating all possible issues before determining the part that needed to be replaced. The required part was promptly ordered, and by the following day, our hot water heater was back up and running perfectly.
Throughout the process, communication was excellent. We were consistently kept up to date via both phone and email, which gave us peace of mind and confidence in the service provided. The professionalism, reliability, and attention to detail displayed were outstanding. The pricing is fair and they do not proceed without providing you with a written estimate. We highly recommend Price’s Plumbing and Heating for anyone in need of prompt and effective plumbing repairs.

reviews.author: Avi Rynderman
reviews.text: Chris did a phenomenal job diagnosing the issue with my furnace and fixed it within a day. We went from no heat to a fully functioning system within 24 hours of the diagnostic. Chris took the time to show me exactly what was wrong (an easily replaceable limit switch) and happily answered all my questions. I am saving Price’s Plumbing Heating and Air Conditioning in my contacts, and they will be my first call if I have an issue in the future. Thank you, Chris!

reviews.author: megatop412
reviews.text: Very high quality plumbing services for an appropriate price. Matt clearly knows his stuff and does not hesitate to inform you of what is best to fix a nasty plumbing situation. He has been over a couple times this past year to install a main water shutoff, a new water filter line for the fridge, has fixed the innards of both our toilets, and repaired a busted water line from the recent cold snap. 2 years ago we hired them to install a new HVAC system and water heater and Chris did an excellent job installing it. They're very easy to work with, let you know when they're on their way, and clean up after themselves. Can't recommend them highly enough

reviews.author: Donna Kuzma
reviews.text: We’ve worked with Price’s Plumbing multiple times over the past year and have been extremely happy with their service! Chris has been out to our house multiple times… he’s on time, friendly, communicative, and explains things clearly. Happy to recommend and support this local business!

reviews.author: Ashley Jay
reviews.text:
The reason for three stars is the cost point.
Matt and his apprentice that came out today and did the work were professional, knowledgeable and very nice. I was disappointed that it took two trips on two separate days to get the work done. That meant me missing two half days at work. Colton came out yesterday and was also very nice , but said he didn’t have the necessary parts with him to fix the leak. The guys today had to leave and go to the hardware store to get parts before they could get started.
It took no more than 10’ of pipes and fittings. It cost me $1574 .04 to run two pipes from the water softener to the outside pipes to the main line. They did not have to plumb the actual softener. The only parts replaced were near the cutoff valves down. It’s was approximately 3.5’ to 4’ per line.  They did replace 3 cutoff valves, but I have bought them before and know they aren’t terribly expensive. Overall I am happy with the actual work, but not at all happy with the cost.  They do encourage a member ship that cost about $330.00 a year  and gives you a discount on the service and a few other perks, but that ended up only costing about $100.00 after the discount ($236.96) on the work. I usually get more than one bid, and it’s my fault I didn’t, but I can’t change that now. So did they do good work? Yes! Are they super expensive?  I feel like they are for the time it took and the minimal parts needed. Seems like it was way over $500.00 per hour when all was said and done. I might mention there was no digging involved to reach the pipes.
The company is good about telling you who your service person will be and gives you their tracking so you know when they will be there which is a plus.
My name is Angela. I’m not sure why it says Ashley.

reviews.author: Trent Artichoker
reviews.text:

I tell Cody that his estimate is overpriced and excessive that comes out to $400 plus per hour. He supports his estimate with rationalization. I agree because I'm helping a tenant, and they need water.

Cody spends 2.5 hours at the property and at the end takes $100 off because of the time. So, I pay $1,056.25.

$422.50 per hour labor rate is ridiculous. Be wary of this business all

reviews.author: Kris

So when I called United and Tony showed up, I thought "ok better grab my wallet" because I thought it was gonna be expensive! Nope! UGH why did I not call them sooner! Tony came in, started troubleshooting and after years of fear and guessing what the problem was Tony was able to reassure me everything was grounded and I needed to change out 5 receptacles! 5 receptacles! A few hundred bucks later and BAM - electrical was great! Thank you all for your service! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sheri Treece
reviews.text: United had same day availability to replace lights on my house. The technician was timely, polite and knowledgeable. I will call United again for service when i need it. This is my second time using them and I've been super happy.

reviews.author: Jaime Sevilla
reviews.text: Tony the electrician is very professional and friendly. He found out my power outlet(s) problem and fixed them efficiently. I would a 100 % recommend his work to others. Very satisfied!

reviews.author: Eric Landman
reviews.text: Tony came over after 6pm and helped us when all the power was out . Not only did he work quickly and efficiently but also informed of us the problem and what he was doing. Great job overall 10/10

reviews.author: William Moselle
reviews.text: We used united in LA. Great process. Great work. Vig, our electrician, was great in helping us think through some choices. High quality work. Prices seemed reasonable too. Loved how quickly they were able to get the work done. Definitely recommend- ask for Vic to do your work.

plumbers.name: Quickflow Plumbing
plumbers.address: 5052 15th St SW, Canton, OH 44710, USA

reviews.author: Cole Richmond
reviews.text: Had a great experience with quick flow. Very quick response got someone out the next business day for us. Made a pretty crappy situation bearable by actually going through options with us and just made the process easy! Found a break in our line under the kitchen floor which is worst case on a slab, and were very accommodating and helpful with the whole process. Eric, Jameson, and Jamey were great an definitely recommend them for your plumbing needs !

reviews.author: Cynthia Adams
reviews.text: Jamey and Jameson came out on Monday and by Thursday, I had a new water softener and filtration system at a very reasonable price. Jameson and Nate were there to install it and their professionalism was top notch! They cleaned up and were careful to not disrupt other things in the house more than was necessary for the installation. Thank you!

reviews.author: denise synder
reviews.text:
Eric and Nate were great, friendly and professional. When they were done they cleaned up the area and explained what they did. I am happy with their work and work ethic. The day I called they came out and gave a price and came the very next day to do the job. I will recommend them and be the first I call in the future.
Very grateful, Denise Snyder

reviews.author: Desire Rossett
reviews.text: Jamey and Jameson with Quickflow were amazing. They were efficient and arrived on time. Jamey worked with me to find the best possible option with no high pressure sales tactics. I know I picked the right company! Thank you. I would highly recommend QuickFlow Plumbing to anyone who needs a professional and experienced plumber.

reviews.author: Dianna Datkuliak
reviews.text: Eric was honest, thorough and easy to talk to while also very knowledgeable and friendly! I’d definitely recommend him and his coworker Jameson to anyone in need of plumbing assistance. Their service was fast and reasonably priced. Will call them first for future needs! Very satisfied.

plumbers.name: Action Mechanical, LLC
plumbers.address: 195 Industrial Blvd, La Vergne, TN 37086, USA

reviews.author: Jamie Fisher
reviews.text: Excellent service and team! Found and repaired my water leak in a pipe under the sidewalk. Highly recommend! They did such an amazing job with service and getting me taken care of, I baked them an appreciation poundcake 😀 Thank you again to the entire Martin Plumbing / Action Mechanical, LLC Team for going above and beyond!

reviews.author: Patricia Thomason
reviews.text: Have used for plumbing, HVAC, and electrical. My washing machine lines were old, but they found parts and repaired for much less than a replacement. Also had ceiling fan blinking that a different technician couldn't fix, but they took care of it. Most recently my heat went out mid winter. Every time they came out quickly. Techs made sure they left no mess behind. Great customer service, great service, reasonable prices. Will definitely use again.

reviews.author: Jon Remkus
reviews.text: I’ve used these guys a number of times at my commercial property in Nashville. Today, I noticed that I wasn’t getting any hot water. Went  over to the hot water heater and saw that it had failed and was leaking water into the drain pan and out the side of the building. I didn’t have time to mess around with it, so I called them up around noon and by 1:30 they here here and by 3:00 the water heater was replaced and they were packed/cleaned up. Amazing service and excellent pricing.  Tyler, the tech they sent out, was super polite and professional. He was very clean, organized, competent, and efficient. Another great experience with a business that always finds a way to get to prioritize the customer.

reviews.author: Beverly Jarrett
reviews.text: Our technician was very knowledgeable and polite.  He explained everything and answered all our questions.   Wished I had got his name.   I would definitely ask for him next time a repair was needed.

reviews.author: Jim Rheinheimer
reviews.text: Very satisfied! The lead tech definitely knows his stuff! He had someone he was training, and you can tell he was being very thorough! They took the time to be sure that I completely understood exactly what they were doing and why! Will definitely recommend to everyone!

plumbers.name: Water Heater Specialists
plumbers.address: 25546 Seaboard Ln, Hayward, CA 94545, USA

reviews.author: Tiberius Nyantika
reviews.text:
Brian was efficient, ontime and did the job of installing new water heater professionally. Was friendly,explaining every process that is necessary for the longevity of the water heater. He did the job efficiently within two hours and was done.

I will highly recommend the services of this Company. It was a little bit pricey installing a new heater but was worthy it.

reviews.author: Darlene Banas
reviews.text: Brian was very nice. He did a great job! It took less than an hr and even took the old water heater away. So stress free for my dad.Who is 88. Thank you again Brian and happy birthday too!

reviews.author: Khai Linn
reviews.text: They showed up promptly and replaced the new tank at once. The gas control wasn’t functioning properly and they tried to fix it. They come back next morning and change with another new tank and it is working now. Keeping professionalism and easy to talk is my favorite experience with them. Kudos to Sesak V.

reviews.author: Alexander Starostin
reviews.text: 9 years old Rheem water heater leaked at midnight. Called them at 1AM. Was asked to call back at 7AM to schedule repair/replacement. Their technitian arrived by 10AM and by noon I had a brand new heater installed. Very prompt response and execution. Greatly satisfied.

reviews.author: Hayley Blake
reviews.text: I discovered our water heater was leaking and called Water Heater Specialists. They advised me how to shut it off and said they could come that day to check it out. After inspecting it, it was determined the unit needed to be replaced (not surprised as it was very old). Brian had everything he needed in his truck and everything was ready to go in a couple hours. He was friendly, efficient, and did a great job. I will be using them again if ever needed!

plumbers.name: A&J Sewer Service
plumbers.address: 1055 Courtesy Dr Unit D, Wheeling, IL 60090, USA

reviews.author: Drago Glavac
reviews.text: Great company. We have been using them at Voda Express Car Wash for years. Can't say enough how great of a job they do. They service our facility at least twice a year. Hopefully as we grow it'll become three times a year in multiple locations. Always great service and great staff. First class company.

reviews.author: Nicole Henry
reviews.text:
I used their service for grease trap cleaning and it was great. The staff was kind and knowledgeable of the task. It took maybe 30 min of that. I was able to clean my kitchen while he did the grease trap.

I actually signed up for the subscription because the service was so good.

reviews.author: Carolynn Cardone
reviews.text: We've been using A&J for a couple of years now and so far we are very pleased with their services. They have been very attentive, professional, and friendly and we've been very satisfied with their work. The services are not cheap, however, I honestly don't know what the going rate is for these services so I have no idea if the rates would be considered average or not. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Tim Danop Nanegrungsunk
reviews.text:
The customer service was short and condescending.

I called them to make an appointment. Although he used some appropriate customer-service language, his tone was inappropriate. He raised his voice, as if he didn’t want to talk or that I was an idiot. He became frustrated multiple times, such as when I tried to schedule an appointment next month instead of next Monday, when I asked for COI, or when I asked him to re-spell his email address (first spell he already used sarcastic tone and the second time was very frustrated and short). I decided not to use their company service because even the customer service representatives didn’t respect customers and clearly displayed unprofessionalism, what would be the rest..

reviews.author: Homecastle Restoration
reviews.text: We are a Korean restaurant located in Niles(336), and we recently received grease trap service from AJ. They quickly identified our issue and were professional enough to schedule a service visit for the very next day. Their work was incredibly efficient and the team was very friendly. In particular, Emanuel, who performed the service on-site, was absolutely fantastic. I truly appreciate their help!

plumbers.name: Rocket Plumbing Heating and Air Conditioning
plumbers.address: 7740 S 2320 W, West Jordan, UT 84084, USA

reviews.author: Mike Christensen
reviews.text: Kyle and his team are great and I highly recommend them to anyone looking. We found out we had several holes in our heat exchanger and that our furnace needed to be replaced. They were one of the quotes we got for a replace and they were $600 cheaper than the closest bid with a great high efficient unit. They were the only one that offered to get it inspected by the city and pointed out the $300 rebate for the furnace. They did great work and I will be calling again if I need work done.

reviews.author: Ronald Rafajko
reviews.text:
Kyle was great and replaced a hot water heater's leaking ball valve. He found out that the expansion tank had also failed and was full of water (replaced that too).
He was also willing to look at a furnace issue and leaking outdoor water faucets.
He set an appointment time with no four hour window!  Yea! Fast, efficient, best prices in town. Call Rocket Plumbing, Heating, and Air and ask for Kyle!

reviews.author: Marie Sutton
reviews.text:
Bill came to my house to connect a hose for water to my new refrigerator.
He and his son have been my plumber for 3 years when I moved to Salt Lake City.
I could not be more happy to have them in my life when I need plumbing, heating or otherwise.
They are the nicest people to deal with.  They provide honesty, integrity and dependability with their service.
I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a hardworking, trusting plumbing team.  They have helped me many times in the past.  I am more than happy with their services.

reviews.author: Heidi Carter
reviews.text:
I couldn’t get the pilot light to ignite on my water heater. Kyle with Rocket was at my house within an hour of calling. He assessed the situation and gave me options/pricing for repair with the option of replacing if I preferred.  As the water heater was quite old I decided to replace it. The new heater was installed that day. The company arranged inspection/permit with the city. They even hauled off the old equipment and cleaned up.

Fair pricing, excellent customer service. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Diane Dorman
reviews.text: Kyle returned my after hours call and stopped by my rental. He explained the problem with the hot water tank, gave me an estimate and set a time for the following day. He was quick, friendly and easy to talk to. He explained everything and sent photos, since I am out of town. Rocket was fast, reasonable and dependable. They gave me a much needed referral for other work I need done. They will be my go to plumber for any future needs.

plumbers.name: Neighborly Plumbing and Drain Cleaning
plumbers.address: 9764 Granite Hills Dr E, Sandy, UT 84092, USA

reviews.author: Maria Schindler
reviews.text: Mathew and Anson were great. They notified me that they would arrive within the hour. They were spot on. Humored me when I asked them to show me the process of draining my water heater. Professional and kind. Very reasonable price for the service.

reviews.author: Hawkin Saeger
reviews.text:
Had an unfortunate sewer backup a different plumber had helped me fix. That plumber cameraed the lines and told me I needed to tear out my pipes which would have cost over $8K.

I called Neighborly Plumbing for a second opinion. They took a look at the pipes, and hopped down in the manhole to take a closer look. There was a ton of gunk in my pipe and in the manhole causing me issues and they instead recommended I jetted the pipe and get the manhole area clear. I felt a lot more sure about this recommendation and that they had my best interest in mind. Their quote for jetting my pipe was also significantly cheaper than the other plumbing company.

I feel a lot more at ease now that my sewer pipes are clean, and I feel like the work was done for a very fair price. I can't thank Neighborly Plumbing enough for their assessment and work. The only thing that could have been better was faster scheduling. Other than that, they were awesome.

reviews.author: Michael Rogers
reviews.text: My mom’s sewer line backed up and had to be repaired and lined. Neighborly plumbing came out and took care of everything including some unrelated interior plumbing issues that needed to be addressed as well. They were honest, did great work and were amazing to deal with through the entire process. I would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Julie Turpin
reviews.text: Neighborly Plumbing did a trenchless sewer repair for me and saved me $5,000 compared to my other estimates. They fixed the line without tearing up my yard, and the whole job was done fast. Matt and Travis really came through for my family everything works great now.

reviews.author: Cindy Viklund
reviews.text: Nieghborly plumbing came and replaced my sewer pipe after catus plumbing messed it up. So far so good on the plumbing. They were both contracted buy 24 hour plumbing pros. The problem is that they were supposed to replace the lawn that they had to dig up,they said it would be about a week when they return to do that. That was in September and it's now November. They aren't going to replace it until 24 plumbing pays them so my lawn is being held hostage because of that . The city is now involved and if that doesn't work then I'll have to get a lawyer. I paid 24 hour plumbing 15.000 to fix the problem  now it's their responsibility to make things right. Sorry that neighborly didn't get paid  but someone needs to hold people accountable for their word. Come on your not even going to try make this situation better there is no delay . From what I see it's not going to be resolved at any time soon. It took you this long to respond. It's now almost February. Wow , I guess there is no reason to continue this conversation. I know what they said before they left my yard. They lied to me. My word against theirs. You win .

plumbers.name: Reliable Home Comfort
plumbers.address: 1214 W 130th St, Compton, CA 90222, USA

reviews.author: Daah Lek
reviews.text:
We had a great experience with Reliable Home Comfort. From the initial consultation to the final installation everything was handled professionally. We qualified for the HEEHRA rebate and Edison was very knowledgeable about the program. He answered all our questions and worked with us to meet our needs.

They were a bit short staff, but the team worked tirelessly to get our system installed before the holidays. Our home's comfort level has improved significantly, and the system runs great. Would definitely recommend RHC.

reviews.author: Jason Dzubak
reviews.text: The experience start to finish was very professional. Edison answered all of my questions and provided solutions to any outliers. During the install the team was also professional and courteous. Reliable Home Comfort delivered on all their commitments! I would highly recommend Reliable Home Comfort for all your AC and Heating needs!

reviews.author: Chris May
reviews.text: It was recommended by the gas company to clean the soot out of the heater because it put out the pilot. Instead you recommended changing two parts for hundreds of dollars. The pilot was capable of being lit so that wasn't a problem it was the soot. After he left I realized that you should have just had him clean it in like the pilot and if it went out I would call the gas company to turn it off. It was a total waste of money and I have no heat.

reviews.author: Pat Fierro
reviews.text:
Thomas, the lead technician at Reliable, came out to assess the problem with my gas heater. I received an estimate the next day, approved it and he installed the part the following day. He answered all my questions and was very thorough in testing the heater to make sure it was working properly throughout the house. Thomas is very knowledgeable and conscientious as well as very professional and personable. He did a great job for me!
And Reliable installed two mini splits for me a couple of years ago, and Edison and his team did a terrific job. I highly recommend Reliable Home Comfort for your heating and AC needs.

reviews.author: Bahni Turpin
reviews.text:
Reliable Home Comfort fixed my old wall heater that had been problematic for as long as I’ve lived here! (15 years). The tech was very polite and well prepared, as opposed to a tech that came last year who I got off ANGIES LIST who asked ME for a screwdriver!!!!
The RHC tech went above and beyond to insure there were no problems on the roof or in the attic. He was very respectful of our space and brought booties to cover his shoes . Good communication from the company as well.
I did have to wait some time for parts, it’s an old unit and they had to order, but it’s now working well. Thanks Thomas!

plumbers.name: Moore & More Plumbing, LLC.
plumbers.address: 1816 Bissel Ln, Austin, TX 78745, USA

reviews.author: Vivian
reviews.text: Prompt, professional, and skilled! Thank you Josh for doing a fantastic job fixing a few gas leaks in our home and problem-solving along the way. I appreciated the clear communication of the issue and the costs.  Josh really worked carefully and managed to leave the fireplace looking like nothing happened even though he had to remove some grout to fix the leak! He had no problem answering questions and giving updates. Could not be happier with this experience and recommend this company. Thank you.

reviews.author: Natalie Sayers
reviews.text: Josh and Joel did a great job of installing a new kitchen faucet and de-clogging my bathroom sinks. They were professional, efficient and communicated everything they were doing. Joel took the time to explain clog prevention to my son and Josh explained how my last faucet install was not done correctly. The pricing was more than fair, with estimates provided before the work was started. I highly recommend Moore & More Plumbing for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Jamie Rigdon

From start to finish I have been SO impressed with their communication, quick service, and overall kindness! My sellers were equally pleased with Josh’s level of service and I’m thrilled to have found my new favorite plumber!! Plus their after hours call service was top notch! 🙌🏼

reviews.author: Bradley Brewster
reviews.text: Communication is key! Josh was so helpful in sort of diagnosing the issue over the phone and setting the appointment. I called late in the evening and he was quick to respond. Stayed in contact the day of service, and got the job done faster than quoted! Thank you guys for coming to the rescue!

reviews.author: Jannie Vickers
reviews.text: Hi!! My sewer was clogged and overflowing.  I called six different big name companies.  They all said they would come and never showed up then I saw Moore and More.  Josh was at my house  fast  went straight to work. Fixed my problem and even checked all  things that flooding could have caused Free!!!  I had Josh and he's awesome. If you love your home call Moore and More!!!!! Jannie Vickers.  Thanks very much Sir.

plumbers.name: Plumbing 911
plumbers.address: 3416 Crosswind Ct, Medina, OH 44256, USA

reviews.author: Thomas Bishop
reviews.text: Connor was on time, a gentleman,  got right to the job. Did it quickly. Happy it wasn't more serious than it was. He checked it 3 times to be assured the challenge was taken care of. Connor was in and out and handled the job quickly and efficiently.  I would definitely contact 911 plumbing again if needed. Also the receptionist on phone in scheduling was quite efficient, patient and accommodating. Got 5 Stars from me.

reviews.author: Vanessa Silva
reviews.text:
Amazing job! Fair pricing! Didn't try to over sell on things not needed like most of the plumbers I've dealt with have done. He listened to my concerns and addressed them. Very punctual and respectful! And he got the work done quickly!
Very satisfied will be requesting the same technician for any future work! Brandon Becker was amazing!

reviews.author: karen hohl
reviews.text:
Our experience with plumbing 911 was a good experience. They were out very quickly and I received details about our service person that would be coming prior to him calling me to let me know he was on his way. Zach was our plumber that arrived, he was very kind and polite. He took care of our issues in no time. I would definitely use then again. I high recommend them! I would definitely ask for Zach again!
Thank you,
Karen

reviews.author: Jennifer Cleveland
reviews.text: Plumbing 911 is a wonderful company.  They are polite and respectful.  They send texts, with a picture, letting you know who is coming, with a little information about them.  They arrived promptly when they said they would and explained what they needed to do.  The pricing is fairly priced and budget friendly.  They work fast and efficiently. Brandon completed my work and I would gladly have him come back to work on my next plumbing project.

reviews.author: Venessa VanAlmen
reviews.text: Connor came out and he was great!! I got stuck in traffic trying to make my way home to meet him and he was so kind and understanding.  Friendly,  prompt and gave me a few options on what I could do to resolve my issue.  He was very respectful of my home and cleaned up after! My first experience with 911 was awesome!! Will recommend to anyone with plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 4204 Hermitage Rd, Old Hickory, TN 37138, USA

reviews.author: Sidney Gilbert
reviews.text: Great service.  Chris was excellent.  I called to make an appointment within hours they respond we’re at my house.  Very honest and helpful.  Would highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Carolyn Stonecipher
reviews.text: Omar was very professional and responsive.  He was able to identify the problem and make all of the repairs in a timely manner while keeping me informed of the process.  I highly record Roto Rooter.

reviews.author: Janet Richman
reviews.text: The service personnel were very friendly, knowledgeable, and honest. They diagnosed and resolved my plumbing issue very quickly and comprehensively at a very reasonable price. I will not hesitate to call on them in the future for any further plumbing needs. I’m a very satisfied customer with Roto Rooter.

reviews.author: Jim oldham
reviews.text: I needed a drainage issue in my basement diagnosed. The technician was on time, knowledgeable and explained the issues.  His work was priced fairly.  Everyone I spoke with was friendly and understood the joys and challenges of maintaining an aprox. century old house.

reviews.author: athyn galardi
reviews.text:
Roto-Rooter will never see our business again!

My fiancé is currently deployed overseas, and I found myself dealing with leaks in the bathroom alone. After contacting Roto-Rooter on 8/10/24, they sent two men to my home the next day. One was polite (Isaiah), but the other acted more like a pushy used car salesman. He assured me that my insurance would cover the repairs and even pressured me to sit down right then to submit the claim. I trusted that the claim was submitted, as he insisted, but it wasn’t.

The leak destroyed my floors, and their demo team came out to remove them. The salesman promised I would still have a functioning bathroom and could stay in my home during repairs. The demo team, however, told me the opposite—that I couldn’t live there until everything was put back together. Little did I know it would take over 2.5 months to finish this nightmare.

I was repeatedly lied to and disregarded. Roto-Rooter scheduled repairs multiple times, but they never showed. When I called the dispatcher, they said I was never scheduled in the first place, even though I had taken several days off from work to accommodate them. The lack of respect for my time and situation was outrageous!

To make matters worse, I found out my insurance company had never received the claim, despite the salesman’s assurances. After weeks of trying to reach him, my insurance agent finally took the claim over the phone, which took several hours of my time.

While the demo guys were kind, they damaged the toilet in my secondary bathroom during removal. Roto-Rooter had the nerve to charge me $995 to fix their mistake!

It felt like they were taking advantage of me, knowing I was alone while my fiancé is deployed. Roto-Rooter showed a complete lack of professionalism and care for my situation. They won’t be getting a second chance.
.

reviews.author: Joel Damir
reviews.text: I had a 75 gallon water heater replaced and they did a great job. They were quick and cleaned up everything when done. After the water was turned back on most of my bathroom faucets became clogged and they came back and cleared those also. Final price even came in under the quote.

reviews.author: jennifer barrett
reviews.text: Ian did an amazing job replacing the water heater.   He was very kind and extremely knowledgeable.  We will be requesting him on any future plumbing projects!  Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Lucie Neves
reviews.text:
Excellent customer service, he was really easy to work with and did a fantastic job. I asked for a quote on another job that we need to have done. We will definitely use him again thank you so much for installing the doggy wash for me. the dogs are nice and clean already!

He did such a great job that we had him back to install a fireplace. And he happened to notice that our pipes under the house were disintegrated and needed attention so we had him back to do that as well. He is fantastic and multitalented.

reviews.author: K AMann
reviews.text: Darren and Ian were great to work with. Was quoted a much, much higher price by another plumber, who was recommending extensive work which turned out to be completely unnecessary to fix the problem. It is refreshing to work with a company displaying honesty and integrity. I will hire them again and highly recommend Hassle free Plumbing for all your plumbing projects!

reviews.author: Flor Manzano
reviews.text: I recently hired Hassle Free Plumbing for the replacement of my water heater. They were recommended by a friend. The plumbers were punctual, knowledgeable and professional. They worked efficiently and cleaned up after they were done. I was very satisfied by their quality of work.

reviews.author: Lisa Burke

And the office staff was pleasant to deal with.  I would definitely use Alexander Plumbing for any future plumbing issues that arise.

reviews.author: Kevin Dolinar
reviews.text:
Alexander Plumbing is the absolute best in the Harford/Cecil county area.
Quick response. Reasonable prices.
Best plumbers.

reviews.author: Rich Peschek

reviews.author: Laurie Pratt
reviews.text: So happy with Alexander Plumbing services. They were very professional and great prices. I would highly recommend them for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Bernard cox

Price was cheaper than any other company I had come out for an estimate. Definitely will be using this company for all my plumbing needs in the future.

plumbers.name: Rooter Hero Plumbing & Air of San Lorenzo
plumbers.address: 16440 Ashland Ave, San Lorenzo, CA 94580, USA

reviews.author: Julie Jackson
reviews.text: Came the next day, cleared  pipes, used a camara to find out our 67 year old pipes were full of holes. Estimate given and scheduled  2 days later to repipe. All done in one day. Inspected and paid for a few days later. Nice workers. Cleaned up after themselves. Decent price. Happy customers.

reviews.author: Elise Straub
reviews.text:
My elderly mother called this company for a clogged kitchen sink and mentioned that her garbage disposal was leaking. They replaced the disposal and pipes under the sink and charged her $1,700.

They attempted to snake the line for only a few minutes before saying it could not be cleared. Another worker went under the house and told her the pipes needed to be replaced and gave an estimate of $10,000.

I advised my mother to cancel that work. The next day, we hired a different plumber who snaked the same line for about three hours and fully cleared the clog for $225.

Based on this experience and the huge difference in diagnosis and price, I would not recommend this business to anyone.

reviews.author: Kris-Shawn Robinson
reviews.text: David Sanchez was professional, polite, and thorough. Very satisfied!

reviews.author: Don Serva
reviews.text: Very responsive, great communication via phone, text, & email - always knew of status.  Angel Ramirez was courteous and professional, quickly cleared drain and explained warranty and follow up process if needed.  Great price for same day service.  Overall - highly recommend!

reviews.author: yvette hills
reviews.text: We called them for a clogged drain.  Not only did they not fix it (still charged us $50), but they told us our pipes were corroded, which would cost 15K to de-scale and line with epoxy (though they kept dropping the price if we wanted to get started the next day)!  We were wary and ended up calling another plumber.  They snaked our drain in less than 10 minutes and said nothing about our pipes being corroded.  Would not recommend.

plumbers.name: Grizzly Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1025 Robin Hood Dr NW, Cleveland, TN 37312, USA

reviews.author: Sharon Conway
reviews.text: Javen arrived on time and began immediately after evaluating the issue. He was very personable and very knowledgeable.  He gained our confidence quickly. He did a beautiful job installing a new sink and repairing a major leak.  He worked very efficiently and the cost was very fair.  He was a lifesaver for us. reviews.author: dave
reviews.text:
We called about a plumbing issue at our house in Gig Harbor on Wednesday night at 7PM; despite the 24/7 listing on google, there are no night techs on duty, but we were assured that we would be put on the list and taken care of first thing on Thursday morning.

FloHawks called me at 7:10AM Thursday, saying we were second in line for a tech to visit us.
I called back at 11AM to see if there was some kind of ETA; we were still assured that we were second on the list, and the tech would reach out to us as soon as they completed the repair they were currently performing.

FloHawks calls us back at 1PM to tell us that the tech has finished their repair, but needed to go a little out of their way and deliver something to another site, or something of that nature.

I call back at 3:55PM, looking for an ETA. Am told at 4:05PM when FloHawks calls back that the tech assigned to us was in Milton, WA, and was stuck in traffic on their way to us.

I call at 4:40PM. Am told that the tech is in traffic in Tacoma.

I call at 5:33PM. Am told once again that the tech is in Tacoma traffic.

At 6:27PM, FloHawks calls me to tell me that their technician has JUST wrapped up their work on a job in Gig Harbor, and will be out to our house asap. I vent my frustration that it's been all day and FloHawks hasn't arrived yet, and my confusion as to whether or not the tech in question has been stuck in Tacoma traffic for a least the last 2.5 hours, or only 10 miles away fixing something else all day.

I am told that the main office is closing at 7PM, and that the tech will work overtime and call us when he is on the way.

7:48PM. Almost 25 full hours from the moment I first call for help with my plumbing issue. I receive a call from a tech who says they'll be here in 31 minutes. More awkwardly than I would have liked, I inform the tech that I had already called a different plumbing service (at about 7:15PM) to address my issue, and that they were on their way presently.

Now, let me be fully transparent here. I'm ABUNDANTLY aware that was something of an impolite thing to do; inform someone at the last minute, when they were ready to rock and roll, that I was canceling. That exhibits a lack of respect for that technician's time, and the only way I could have been ruder is if I edged and flaked out on them for 13 hours or so- they might have gotten a lot more done, had they not been held in limbo, waiting for an entire day...

reviews.author: Benjamin Pedraza
reviews.text: Had a bad clog on the lines leading to my septic system, that caused water to come up from my sinks after using them (Grease in the lines, I called FloHawks and asked for an emergency inspection on my septic, they gave me an initial ballpark cost and had a tech out only a few hours after my call. They sent a young man named Eli and he was very knowledgeable, skilled an was able to trace the issue efficiently after accessing the cover, he also inspected other items at my request and gave me a reasonable final price well under the 1k+ I'd expected if it was a septic failure. He had my problem solved in about an hour, gave advice on the age of the system (50yrs already) and that it could be a few years before a pumping is actually needed. I would gladly do business with them and him again.

After removing the toilet, he looked and found the issue as he had suspected:

The past contractor who upgraded our bathroom and installed the toilet had put in the wrong kind of seal.

The first photo is two small seals, that don’t seal to fill the gap.

Instead, as shown in photo 2, Jerry put in a 2” wax seal that would fix the problem of air gap, which also  caused a slightly unpleasant smell at times (no leakage of excrement thank goodness! 😅)

Jerry zoned right in on the problem with lazer focus, and did not do anything that was unnecessary.

Some people might say it’s pricey, but I would rather have peace of mind knowing that the plumber knows what they are doing and is fair in the dealings with unexpected add ons.

I also have had the unpleasant experience of witnessing all the problems caused by a  plumber that did not know what they were doing at my parent’s property. Believe me, years of leakage can cause HUGE problems and big $$$$!

I really appreciate the professionalism of these two employees, Katria and Jerry R. as well as  Roto Rooter as a company! Bravo! 👏
