reviews.author: Chad Zuniga
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely incredible experience with All Star Service & Repair, and I have to give a huge shoutout to their technician, Holland. From start to finish, Holland was professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely cared about making sure everything was working perfectly. He showed up on time, explained the process in a way that was easy to understand, and went above and beyond to make sure my system was running at its best.

It’s rare these days to come across someone who takes this much pride in their work, but Holland truly does. He was polite, thorough, and didn’t leave until everything was dialed in and I was 100% satisfied. The difference in comfort in my home was noticeable immediately, and I have complete confidence in the work that was done.

If you’re looking for an HVAC company you can trust, and a technician who treats your home like it’s his own, ask for Holland. He’s a rockstar! Five stars isn’t enough – I’d give ten if I could.

reviews.author: Kelly Harper
reviews.text: Kevin was knowledgeable and professional. He handled the repair of my toilet great, but i do have do call him out on cleanliness and carefulness. There was no effort to clean up afterwards. He left several incredibly obvious grease spots, including shoe prints on the baseboard, and some spots on the hallway carpet. Worst of all, he left some scratches on the brand new vanity countertop that i will not be able to repair. I get that he was running late due to having issues finding the right parts, but cleanup is definitely part of the job.

reviews.author: DAVID MCGRIFFIN
reviews.text: Absolutely recommend Allstar Service. My experience was beyond expectations. Contacted Adam on Saturday afternoon, and was able to get me scheduled much earlier than expected. Technician Ethan arrived exactly on schedule and completed a somewhat complicated installation and needed upgrades to code in my 70 year old house. Very professional work, fair price, great service. I would give more stars if i could. Allstar will be my only call for future upgrades.

reviews.author: Laura Hieb
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about Adam from Allstar Service and Repair. I called with an emergency on my heater. It was blowing only cold air and with the temperatures dropping rapidly, I was very concerned with the pipes bursting. Adam was able to quickly help me diagnose the issue and walked through the steps over the phone on a Friday night. He was patient and incredibly helpful. I highly recommend this honest and upstanding business and won’t hesitate to use them again. They will be my first call!

reviews.author: CaliTcity
reviews.text: I had a plumbing issue that was handled by Travis, and he did an excellent job fixing everything the right way. He was professional, thorough, and even followed up afterward to make sure everything was working perfectly. Adam, the owner, was also great to work with — very responsive and made sure the situation was taken care of quickly. It’s clear this company truly cares about their customers and stands behind their work. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: JB Plumbing HVAC & Construction Division
plumbers.address: 1201 Roosevelt Ave, Reading, PA 19606, USA

reviews.author: beth weckel
reviews.text: We had to wait much longer than we were told we would initially. When the work started it was consistent and the workers were very nice and respectful.  The work completed is extraordinary high quality and beautiful. They said they would be back to finish one part that did not get finished but at the time I am completing this they have still not returned to do that. The length of time that lapses  frequently from what they state will happen and what it actually takes to happen is the only thing that kept me from 5 stars.

reviews.author: Troy Hinke
reviews.text:
Highly recommend. Their technician John got my issue diagnosed right away. I needed a new tankless boiler and they got me scheduled and installed in less than a week.
The entire staff is friendly and no phone robots to deal with when you call.

reviews.author: Gary Double
reviews.text:
Jeff personally came to our home to discuss the emergency need of replacing our HVAC system. No sales pitch, just straightforward information and recommendation. With hours I had a quote and a tenative next day install.
The price was excellent when compared to other companies. Installation and the crew were efficient and knowledgeable.
The best part...LOCALLY OWNED AND OPERATED.
I highly recommend JB.

reviews.author: john adams
reviews.text: JB Plumbing did an amazing job. The guys they sent were super nice people.They were very organized and appeared confident and knowledgeable of their trade, even with the task of multiple projects happening simultaneously. The process from estimate to completion was smooth and they kept me informed from start to finish. Would strongly recommend based on my personal experience with this company.

reviews.author: Neighbor Bob
reviews.text: JB Plumbing HVAC & Construction are great.  They do awesome work and their pricing is very fair.  I would recommend them to anyone looking for a local family-owned business that cares about their customers.

plumbers.name: Flotek Plumbing
plumbers.address: 608 S 1st St, St. Charles, IL 60174, USA

reviews.author: Betsy Wassilak
reviews.text: This review is long overdue. We have used Flotek for a couple years now and in a couple houses. They are always very responsive. Of course things always seem to happen over the weekend. No problem with Flotek. They always respond and will even let you know if it is urgent or can wait. They have replaced an ejector pump, removed an old battery back up and replaced our toilet fill valve and flapper. They seem reasonably priced but I am a believer in sometimes you get what you pay for! Professional and friendly service every time! Thanks Henry and Gabriel!

reviews.author: Cheryl Taylor
reviews.text: A backup in the sewage pipes at my place of business left my customers without a bathroom. I called Flotek at 9:00 a.m., the problem was cleared up by noon the same day! They were happy to speak with my septic guy to gather all info beforehand and find the best solution to my problem. Prices were given ahead of time. Very nice guys, will use again- but hopefully not too soon ;)

reviews.author: Joe Kuryla
reviews.text: I just had a water softener replaced, and about a year ago I had a water heater replaced in the winter around the holidays.  High quality work, easy to get scheduled, great products, and reasonable prices.  Flotek has become my go-to company for plumbing work.

reviews.author: J Matthews
reviews.text: We hired Flotek Plumbing to replace a hot water heater, install a garbage disposal, run a new water line for our refrigerator, and install a new primary sump pump along with a battery backup.  Flotek was very professional and responsive from the initial meeting for the estimate through the completion of the project.  They were prompt and came prepared.  They completed all the work in one day.  Once the installations were complete, Gabriel spent some time going over everything with me.  I have to say, the quality of their sump pumps is fantastic, they are very quiet.  All in all I highly recommend Flotek for any plumbing needs you may have.

reviews.author: victor Vukovich
reviews.text:
Our toilet would not drain properly.
Upon arrival, Gabriel quickly confirmed the main line was clogged.
Wrote up a proposal and explained in detail what was wrong and what needed to be done. No BS. No extraneous explanation.

Yes, an expensive repair but the pricing was fair and the tech was HIGHLY professional and thorough. Plus, per our request, Flotek arrived within less than an hour after we called.

plumbers.name: Paradigm Sewer & Drain Plumbing
plumbers.address: 914 McKinley Ave NW, Canton, OH 44703, USA

reviews.author: Adrian
reviews.text: Mark, Ben, Ryan and the rest of the crew were great! Professional, kind, knowledgeable. They did a wonderful job and kept me updated along the way. Would gladly use their services again!

reviews.author: Dustin Ratchford
reviews.text: Fast response time, quality work at a great price. We use them as well on the railroad I work for to do all of our plumbling needs.Used them multiple times now, crews are always nice and explain everything in detail. Highly recommend calling them for your plumbing needs if you want it done right and at a good price.

reviews.author: Savvy Mom Club
reviews.text: Bravo to this plumbing company that showed up before their time estimate, investigated my issues without passing it off and considering an option for clean up that didnt compromise my finished side of the basement. They found an issue beyond what other companies have found and I'm appreciative of their thoroughness.

reviews.author: Kevin Shephard
reviews.text: Great company with fantastic results. Complete professionals with solutions. My new go to guys!

reviews.author: Rachel Smith
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this company. They responded quickly to my request, arrived on time, and handled the issue efficiently. On top of that, their pricing was more affordable than other quotes I received. Highly recommend for anyone looking for fast, reliable service !

plumbers.name: Intown Plumbing
plumbers.address: 8805 Co Rd 2586, Royse City, TX 75189, USA

reviews.author: Myranda Rockhill
reviews.text: Had a brand new water heater installed by another company. A few months later now, it stopped lighting (gas water heater). We thought maybe we were out of propane. Had the tank filled, still no pilot light lighting. Called Rheem for warranty and they sent out Intown Plumbing. I am SO glad they did! From the moment the appointment was scheduled I was sent an email confirmation with details. The day of service, the following day, I received a link via email to track their location (SO CONVENIENT!) They came precisely in the time window given. I greeted them outside and they were so friendly and professional. They got right down to business troubleshooting our issue and within 20 minutes detected the issue, called the company for a replacement igniter panel (not sure what it's called). They even had it expedited for us which we feel was really going above and beyond for their customer. I can't recommend David and David enough. Truly one of the kindest, most professional companies I've ever had the pleasure of working with.

reviews.author: Heidy Leon
reviews.text: David and David were the technicians who came out to replace my water heater, and they were both incredibly friendly and professional. They did an excellent job and left the work area spotless! My husband scheduled the appointment, and the team was very responsive throughout the process. Customer service was quick, helpful, and overall made the experience smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Trudi Bennetts
reviews.text: Had a positive experience with Intown Plumbing and our service tech, Kyler. He was polite, friendly and efficient in his repair. The price was reasonable and well communicated. We will use them again!

reviews.author: Kalin Nonchev
reviews.text: My experience was not very good. The office that contacted me did not know anything about pricing. Didn't tell me how much service call would be. Service call amount was not listed on thumbtack either. The technician was nice but didn't have the needed part,  and wanted to charge me $4/minute for me to go get it from Home Depot for a $460 labor only repair of a bath tub faucet cartridge. I think a few things are not right with how your company does business. I paid $85 service call.

reviews.author: Domonique
reviews.text: Frank and his partner were very professional and informative regarding my bathroom plumbing. They were able to fit me in on short notice same day. Took them no time to diagnose and fix the problem in my shower. In and out in less than 30 mins. I highly recommend them.

plumbers.name: Marshall's Plumbing & Mechanical
plumbers.address: 116 Richlandtown Pike, Quakertown, PA 18951, USA

reviews.author: Ian Pickarski
reviews.text:
We called Jason on wednesday to replace our thermal expansion tank on our water heater. They offered to be here next day, we did have to opt for friday. Jason was on time, friendly, and was no BS. He came in, fixed the problem, all while being professional. 10/5 stars exceptional,  a breathe of fresh air after using Landis.

As well, the secretary who took our appointment was also very clear and concise, and was very up front with timing and pricing, I really appreciate that transparency.

reviews.author: Grace McGowan
reviews.text: We put in a new kitchen sink but the old drain pipe coming out of the wall would not connect, needed a special fitting. Marshall plumbing was able to come within 12 hours to repair. Work was completed & tested within an hour. Always professional & friendly. Our go to plumber for several years.

reviews.author: sandra simpson
reviews.text: The gentleman that came out, was very knowledgeable about how to repair my heat tape for my pipe tha burst and he replaced all piping for my water purifier that is outside. He worked 3 hours and was kind and compassionate about getting it fixed that day.

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.text: All of the employees at Marshall's plumbing are very professional and very knowledgeable.  The office staff was efficient and clearly understood my plumbing issue.  They send several reminders of your appointment and arrive right on time. After my job was completed a day or so later, I found another small issue and Jason himself came out on a Saturday to fix the problem. Their service is excellent and I highly recommend them. I will definitely be using them in the future.

reviews.author: Liz Schreier
reviews.text: Can't say enough good things about Marshall's Plumbing!  They answered their phone, returned messages promptly, and kept us posted on arrival time.  The plumber that came out was friendly, efficient, and did a great job.  They were also very reasonably priced.  We used them for the first time last week when a shut-off valve in our basement broke in the off position leaving us with no cold water upstairs for bathrooms or laundry.  I never thought I could get someone out on such short notice with all the cold weather emergencies in our area, so I was ecstatic that even though I called at 5 pm, they were able to come out the next morning and get everything working in a couple hours.  Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Five Star Plumbing
plumbers.address: 12410 Julie St, Oklahoma City, OK 73165, USA

reviews.author: Mickey hale
reviews.text: I am very impressed with Scotty and his crew. They worked diligently on my main line root clog until it was open and free flowing. They kept me informed on what was happening through the whole process. They also told me my options for preventing future issues. Overall totally pleased with Five Star's services.

reviews.author: Randy Hines
reviews.text: 5 Star plumbing is a family. Scotty, the ramrod on my job is the brother of the owner. Scotty's crew was a brother, brother-in-law and a nephew. they did a fantastic job. They were the only plumbing outfit that gave me a very, very reasonable price for the work done. They had to knock a 8' long trench in the kitchen to replace 50 year old piece of cast iron sewer line. I could not be more happy with the work. I will not hesitate to contact them the next time I need a plumber. If you want a professional job done right, and at a fair price. Do not hesitate to contact 5 Star Plumbing.

reviews.author: Elbert Thomas Jr.
reviews.text: Five Star Plumbing was great. Adam did a phenomenal job. He was timely, informative, patient, honest, and navigated every issue with professionalism. I will definitely be calling him back if I ever need anything.

reviews.author: David Guerrero
reviews.text: They came out and seen what the problem was. Next time they came back out and fixed all our problems in one day. Thanks very much. I don't have to sleep on the couch tonight. Yay !!!!  Thanks for getting us back online.

reviews.author: Matt Nation
reviews.text: This is the second time I've used Five-Star Plumbing and Adam did an AWESOME job the first time and he and his assistant did the same for this job.  There was a challenge to work through but Adam managed to figure it out and get the job done.  I really appreciate their attention to detail and when the job is finished I know it's correct and won't cause me any problems after they leave.  Great job once again!

plumbers.name: Greater Works Plumbing
plumbers.address: 744 South St #957, Philadelphia, PA 19147, USA

reviews.author: Jess Musti
reviews.text: The whole company was very professional from start to finish. Alexander was amazing. Gave us two quotes that were very reasonable. He started working on the project and discovered more issues that needed to be addressed. A leaning vent stack became full replacement because it was falling apart. Alexander explained everything and showed pictures of the issues as he discovered them. He worked all day making sure the issue was fixed correctly. I would definitely use this company for plumbing issues moving forward.

reviews.author: M. Weightman
reviews.text: Extraordinary customer service. Steph works like a machine, very thorough and very knowledgeable. You can tell he loves what he does for a living. Greater Works Plumbing chose a really great person to represent the company. Repair was fast, efficient and masterfully done. Would definitely recommend you all to family, friends and neighbors. Thank you.

reviews.author: William Harris
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Greater Works Plumbing service! From start to finish, the team was efficient, knowledgeable, and genuinely friendly. Quentin and Nafesse diagnosed the issue quickly and explained everything in a way that was easy to understand. April was incredibly helpful in coordinating the appointment, payment options, and keeping me updated throughout the process.

It’s rare to find a team that combines great communication with top-quality workmanship, but they truly delivered on both. I’m very grateful for their help and highly recommend them to anyone in need of reliable heating or plumbing services in the Philly area. Thanks again guys!

reviews.author: Paul Koppel
reviews.text: Highly recommend Greater Works Plumbing. Alex and his team helped us with a new water heater system plus a few odds and ends, and they had everything fixed within 24 hours of our first call. This was during snowy, icy conditions and in a very tight space for a large water heater, and they still got the job done well. When there was one very minor issue afterward, Alex followed up immediately and fixed it within 15 minutes of our call. April, the company’s coordinator, is also incredibly friendly and accommodating. Great service all around.

reviews.author: elona bell
reviews.text:
UPDATE:

I spoke with April via text several times but to date greater works has not come out to my elderly mom’s residence to resolve her heating issue. There was no confusion or misunderstanding about communication. Based on my experience with GREATER WORKS PLUMBING, it is evident that their priority is on overpricing clients, charging them for every little thing and not following up. As a result of April’s lack of commitment to her text to me,  a reputable company came and resolve my elderly mom’s heating issues.

I DO NOT RECOMMEND GREATER WORKS PLUMBING UNLESS YOU ENJOY BEING OVER PRICED THAN THIS IS THE COMPANY FOR YOU.

Greater works plumbing installed a very small expansion tank to my mom’s furnace to correct the banging sound when heating is turned on. After paying $891 we were told that her heating will cut off because her radiators need to be flushed.So still no heat.  Greater works plumbing didn’t remove her old expansion tank and didn’t follow up on having her radiators flushed. My mom is 85 years old without no heat. I contacted the office and told the situation and was verbally quoted $500 to have radiators flushed. Crazy!!!! I asked for a written estimate and still haven’t received one. I am extremely disappointed with greater works plumbing because from my experience they seem to care more about money than clients.

plumbers.name: Kinsmen Service Pros
plumbers.address: 133 Elliana Way B2, Summerville, SC 29483, USA

reviews.author: James Rivers
reviews.text: This is the 2nd time that I've used Kinsman. The first time, they installed my whole home water system. Today, they replaced for toilets that I purchased. They did an excellent job and I would continue to use their services. I was going to cancel my services with them because I received a quote at half of what they were charging me. But thankfully, the owner told me what to ask for from the other company. And they were not able to furnish proof. While it's  understandable to want to spend less, trust me folks, less isn't always more. We preferred to stay with Kinsman and have the piece of mind knowing that if something went wrong with the installation, they would be able to cover it.

reviews.author: AJ Edwards
reviews.text: Very polite and on time. The caulking in our master bathroom had started to peel. The guys came in and matched the original color of the caulk pretty well , a little mold had built up and they knocked it out. Both gentlemen were polite and had the approval of my GSD/Pit mix dog who enjoyed lots of back rubs from the technicians. Job done well. I highly recommend and I really like the two Lion logos.

reviews.author: Adrienne Chang
reviews.text:
We have been a customer of Melfi Plumbing now Kinsmen Service Pros for over 15+ years and they have always been dependable and professional when providing a service. When making an appointment the customer service is always very pleasant and they make the process  very easy.  They are the best! Today we needed work done on our hot water heater and the tech Nick, who was very professional and pleasant explained to us our issue and gave us options. Needless to say he repaired the unit and finished in a short period of time. We have also had a few emergency situations as well and they did not hesitate to reach us as quickly as possible. I am glad to be a part of the Kinsmen Community Family now and for many more services to come.
Best Regards-
Adrienne

reviews.author: Savannah Sanders
reviews.text:
We are the owners of local water well company, Sanders Deep Well Inc. We run into a lot of customers who need plumbing services rather than well services. We refer Kinsmen to all of those customers. Bryce responds promptly and our customers rave about their services. Customers call back just to tell us how well they did and how prompt they were. Further confirming our decision in the business relationship we carry with Kinsmen. They are an honest, fair, and knowledgeable team. Sanders Deep Well will refer them again and again.
Thank yall for all that you do.

reviews.author: Carol Steele
reviews.text: Kinsmen gave me great and quick service on repairing a leaky faucet and replacing old piping that was also leaking.  The service tech was friendly and kept the area he was working at picked up and clean both before and after the work was done.  I also found the office personal to be very friendly and helpful.  This was definitely a five star job

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 105 Old Epps Bridge Rd ste d, Athens, GA 30606, USA

reviews.author: Qjuana Singleton
reviews.text: I got a same day appointment!! The technician (Tim) was very respectable, knowledgeable, and professional. He got the job done in less than 30 min. I will definitely use this company again if I need a plumber in the future!

reviews.author: Lesley F.
reviews.text: Yet again Roto Rooter came to the rescue for our household. After previous excellent work (thank you Wesley) getting our house on track (excellent mitigation work)after an unexpected flooding they came out late night to fix our toilets . As usual the Roto rooter rep  (thank you Tim) was professional, knowledgeable and reassuring.  And despite the hour the work was done very much to our satisfaction. Yet again they did not disappoint.

reviews.author: Reece Ritter
reviews.text: Wesley arrived on time, and was personable and friendly. He assessed the problem and described it fully and did the repair quickly. He treated our home as he would his own home and left things better than he found them. He will be my first call if we have any further plumbing problems.

reviews.author: Amie Reynolds
reviews.text: Very nice gentleman was knowledgeable, and he was able to fix my problem quickly. He arrived when he said he would and kept me informed. And offered me solutions. So this problem wouldn't happen again, very happy with the service.

reviews.author: Adrian McKinnon
reviews.text: Wesley has been our home twice. The first time was almost a year from today’s date of 11/10/25. He did the exact same repair on another toilet today that he did a year ago. I haven’t had any issue with the 1st service which is why he was called back. I’m glad I was able to be home this time. We had a good conversation outside of what he came here for which and I enjoyed learning about him and his time in the profession. He seemed to be very knowledgeable from doing what he has been doing for decades. I do know if there is a need for future plumbing service, I’ll be calling Wes. I’m glad to be a resident of Jackson County 😂. No photos, sorry Wes.

plumbers.name: Plumberoo
plumbers.address: 3217 Oak Ln, Weatherford, TX 76088, USA

reviews.author: Alex Santiago
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Plumberoo from start to finish. The plumber came by to fix my faucet, which had been acting up because there was a lot of debris built up in the pipes. He arrived on time, was very professional, and took the time to explain what the issue was in a way that was easy to understand. Everything was cleaned out thoroughly, and my faucet has been working perfectly ever since. I’m really happy with the service and would definitely recommend Plumberoo to anyone looking for reliable plumbing work.

reviews.author: Teresa Baird
reviews.text:
Gary from Plumberoo was absolutely outstanding! He came out to our home late Saturday night (Nov. 15th) after I called expecting to reach an answering service — but I actually got Gary himself. Even though he was finishing another job, he headed our way right after. We had clogged toilets, and I was so grateful he was willing to come out so late.

He got everything working again and even ran a camera through our outside pipe, where he discovered a large hole. On Monday, he sent his team out to dig and repair it. We were shocked to find that someone before us had tried to “fix” the pipe using Saran Wrap and a garbage bag! Thankfully, Gary’s team handled everything professionally and correctly.

Their service was excellent from start to finish — responsive, knowledgeable, polite, and fast. They diagnosed the exact issue and had the whole problem fixed within two days. I’m extremely impressed and already saved Plumberoo in my contacts for any future plumbing needs. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Yancy Harris
reviews.text: Outstanding job! Gary was our 2nd opinion on a $27,000 broken pipe nightmare. He arrived when he said he would and got right to work. He got everything unplugged and showed to my satisfaction that we had no problems other than a grease buildup. His pricing was fair and inline with what I would expect. I recommend you use his services.

reviews.author: Zachary Fields
reviews.text: Gary came to the rescue! He arrived efficiently with great communication throughout the entire time he was here. The cost was reasonable with no underhanded pricing. I definitely recommend this guy if you need a plumbing expert in Weatherford!

reviews.author: amanda C
reviews.text: Gary at Plumberoo is like a modern day McGiver. He’s a master plumber who has been in the business for 37 years. He was able to diagnose our water issue out at possum kingdom lake and replaced our hot water heaters and replaced our sink and shower cartridges as well. He did a thorough job and offered impeccable customer service. So glad to of finally found a plumber that I can trust to service our lake house.

plumbers.name: Go Direct Services
plumbers.address: 5500 E 56th Ave, Commerce City, CO 80022, USA

reviews.author: Kayla
reviews.text:
KayGee helped us with a sewer line clean & scope, and he was the best!! Very thorough, knowledgeable, professional, and extremely helpful. He was thorough with the clean, and took the extra time to walk us through the scope and talk us through various options we have to prevent future backups in our sewer line.

Go direct was easy to schedule with online and even had next day availability. Their prices are fair and transparent.

reviews.author: Mary Ann O'Toole
reviews.text: Luis very congenial, hard-working and professional. He is a very pleasant young man. He did two townhouses for me right down the block from each other and worked diligently to get finished before dark. He was not able to get the camera through one of my listing so We are still trying to figure that out, but he did a fabulous job and a wonderful young man

reviews.author: Jennifer Tsogo
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Go Direct Plumbing, especially Luis. He came out and cleared all the roots in our main sewage pipe and was truly astounding at what he does. Luis is extremely knowledgeable, explains everything clearly, and even takes the time to walk you through other options (though honestly, it wasn’t necessary since his pricing is the lowest we found in town). We really appreciated his honesty and professionalism. We will definitely be working with Luis and his team again.

reviews.author: Janet Ramirez
reviews.text: Our home had a series of plumbing issues that required major repairs, and this company did everything it could to help our family through the process. They even worked well into the evening at times to make sure we were taken care of. Luis was amazing—he was responsive, patient, and answered all of our questions. A big thank you to him!- also My name is Shawntel Toliver not sure why its showing a Janet  :)

reviews.author: deepak karlapati
reviews.text: I recently had Go Direct Service replace my sewage pipeline, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. The team was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. They explained the entire process upfront and completed the job on time without any issues. The quality of their work was top-notch, and they left the area clean after finishing. I highly recommend Go Direct Service for anyone in need of reliable and high-quality sewage pipeline replacement. Great job, and thank you for your outstanding services.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 423 Pacific Ave Ste 303, Bremerton, WA 98337, USA

reviews.author: Lea St. Jean
reviews.text:
Everyone with Roto-Rooter provided exceptional service. Between Drew, Tyson, and Craig, my damaged main sewer line was repaired in a quick and efficient manner. Drew came out and did our initial inspection, he was thorough and communicated everything. Tyson was incredibly helpful in explaining his process accessing the main line and his findings. He even offered to adjust the price when our problem couldn’t be resolved that day. Craig was amazing at keeping us in the loop with expectations regarding our excavation and service pipe repair.

I was thoroughly satisfied with the service I got from everyone at Roto-Rooter, I’m hoping not to have another sewer emergency in the near future… but if I do I know who I’m calling!

reviews.author: Keyan Lund
reviews.text:
Dee was awesome, great guy. Talked me
Through what was likely causes for my drains running slowly, cleared them out and ran cameras to prove it. Then tested the drains to make sure what we saw was actually functional. Offered to help with future preventive maintenance and get on a cycle to ensure we stay operating as a company every day. Thanks for help! Plus he was a Seahawks fan so that always adds a little something for me!

reviews.author: Debra Blevins
reviews.text: Very satisfied with the service provided by Dominic. Came within an hour of my call. Very thorough in explaining what was going on, very effectively and sufficiently got the job done! After he was gone, Britton and Clayton stopped by to offer additional service! Great team. Thanks Guys and I enjoyed visiting with them!

reviews.author: Curt Ortler
reviews.text: We have a 100 year old home that requires pipe inspection and cleaning every 5 years. Our tech is Jesse and he has been with us for many years. We ask for him by name when we schedule as he does above and beyond every time. He is very knowledgeable and provided professional tips that have probably saved us thousands in maintenance costs over the years. He truly cares and provides a quality experience every time.

reviews.author: David Lovelass
reviews.text: Seth and Keith were the BEST I have ever had the privelge of working with. Period! They were professional and easy to understand, especially considering the stress I was under to get this problem/ situation fixed and behind me while on vacation.

plumbers.name: Dunstan & Son Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1127 W Main St, Leesburg, FL 34748, USA

reviews.author: Daniel Looper
reviews.text: I called Dunstan (mistake) to check low hot water pressure in the shower. They charged me for the following:  They did not give me an exact determination of the problem. reviews.author: EssenceOfHVAC
reviews.text:
I had a plumbing leak on Sunday, right after Christmas, and was concerned it might be something serious—especially since the house was fully repiped just a year ago by another company. I called this local plumbing company expecting limited availability, but they answered immediately and had a technician out within an hour.

Jason was the technician who came out. He quickly diagnosed the issue, explained what was going on, and repaired the leak efficiently and correctly. The entire process was straightforward, professional, and stress-free.

I own an HVAC company across the state from my home and I have been involved in ownership and operations of several HVAC, electrical, and plumbing companies across the U.S., so I don’t say this lightly—this was excellent service. Responsive, competent, and truly local. Jason did great work and has a strong future in the trade.

Highly impressed with the local service and the professionalism shown, especially on a Sunday right after the holidays, thank you!

reviews.author: Cedar Hill Trucking
reviews.text: I don't do a lot of reviews, but this one i have to. We had some unidentified crud plug all the faucets. Dunstan was recommended, so I called. He isolated the softener,  cleared all the faucets, and was gone in a very short time. When he gave me the invoice, I was shocked at how reasonable the total was. Dunstan is now my vendor of choice whenever I need plumbing services.

reviews.text: After a surprisingly large toilet leak, we gave Roto-Rooter a call and they sent Joe over right away. Joe was awesome. He was professional, thorough, and extremely helpful. reviews.author: David Klingelheber
reviews.text: Plumber sent was friendly, polite, and helpful with addressing our issue.   He was knowledgeable and provided a proper solution.   However, work quote was way overpriced but due to the nature of our issue, I didn’t have the flexibility to allow the issue not to be addressed.  However, while the plumber was a great person, his actual fixes do not represent the price we paid.   Issue 1, I was told not to ever take apart the P trap under a kitchen sink.   He struggled putting it back together with it not leaking.  There was nothing complex with the P trap as I had previously taken it apart and reassembled without any difficulty.   Issue 2, he had to replace a long section of PVC in an unfinished basement.  Rather than dry fitting then final assembly, he glued one end then worked towards the other end.  Since it was already glued at the one end he had to cut a section that was over his head between floor joists.   It was far from a square cut.   Issue 3, he left a pile of pipe waste on our basement floor.   Think this was honest mistake because by this point I think he was behind schedule and was in a hurry to get to the next appointment.  Based on the price alone, I will no longer be doing any further business with Roto Rooter.   Talked to several knowledgeable people, all felt the price seemed excessive.

It’s clear that their business is built on integrity, trust, and genuine care for the people they serve, not just profits.

You can tell they understand how important it is to provide quality work at a price families can actually afford. Whether it’s a small leak, a major plumbing repair, or an installation, they take the time to explain every step, answer questions, and ensure you’re completely comfortable with the work being done.

The craftsmanship and attention to detail are excellent. They don’t cut corners or rush through jobs; instead, they make sure everything is done right the first time. The team is punctual, professional, and respectful of your home — they clean up thoroughly after the job is completed and treat your space as if it were their own.

It’s rare these days to find a company that combines skill, affordability, and genuine care for their customers. This plumbing team embodies all of that and more. I wouldn’t hesitate to call them again or recommend them to anyone looking for quality plumbing services with a personal touch.

reviews.author: R A
reviews.text:
I contacted Mauerhan for a second opinion on my 9-year-old tankless water heater after it displayed an ignition failure error code and stopped producing hot water. Another plumber had already identified the issue as a leaking heat exchanger and showed me visible water leaking inside the unit.

When I called Mauerhan, I clearly explained on the phone that the unit had an error code and was leaking. When their technician arrived, I was not home, but I spoke to him by phone and told him I already knew the problem and that the leak was obvious. He did not attempt any repair and left, stating that the unit was too old, parts were unavailable, and the entire unit would need to be replaced. He said I would receive a quote for a new unit.

I never received a quote or any follow-up. I was left without hot water and had to find my own solution. I contacted a water heater supplier, got a list of installers, and had a brand-new unit installed the very next day by another company.

A week later, I received a bill from Mauerhan for $540 for “cleaning the unit.” This makes absolutely no sense—why clean a unit that is leaking, cannot be fixed, and was never repaired?

When I called to dispute the charge, the manager, James, told me it was my fault for calling them even though another plumber had already identified the leak, and then threatened to put a lien on my house if I didn’t pay.

This experience was extremely unprofessional: no repair, no quote, no follow-up, an unjustified bill, and a threat instead of customer service. I would strongly advise others to be cautious before using Mauerhan.

reviews.author: Trump Tough
reviews.text:
Outstanding emergency plumbing service, Alex at Jared's Plumbing was a lifesaver!

I can’t say enough good things about Jared’s Plumbing. We had a sudden plumbing emergency at our home in Houston that could have turned into a complete nightmare. It was one of those situations where you feel your stomach drop because you know water damage can spiral fast, and become extremely expensive.

From the moment I called, their team was calm, professional, and responsive. They asked the right questions, helped me take quick steps to walk me through. Over the phone Alex walked me through locating the shut-off valve to my home. He showed me how to shut it off to minimize the water damage while we waited. I live in Kingwood and Alex was here faster than I expected. Alex arrived, and he instantly made us feel like we were in good hands.

Alex was courteous, knowledgeable, and clearly an experienced plumber. He didn’t just rush into a quick fix — he assessed everything carefully, explained what was happening in plain English, and laid out the options. What I appreciated most was that he was focused on solving the problem the right way, not upselling or pushing unnecessary work.

The issue was more serious than I initially thought, and if it had continued unchecked, we could have been looking at major water damage — flooring, drywall, cabinetry, maybe even mold remediation. Alex pinpointed the root cause quickly and got things under control. The repair was thorough, clean, and efficient.

What really stood out was how transparent Jared’s Plumbing was about pricing and how they walked me through what I was paying for and why. The final cost felt fair and completely justified for the quality of work and the speed of the response.

In all honesty, I feel like Jared’s Plumbing saved us thousands of dollars in potential water damage. That peace of mind alone is priceless. It’s not easy finding a good Houston plumbing company that combines speed, skill, integrity, and professionalism, but this one absolutely does.

If you’re in Houston area, or in Kingwood like myself and need a really good plumber you can trust, especially in a plumbing emergency, call Jared’s Plumbing and ask for Alex. This Houston plumber is the real deal!

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Terrie Munsey
reviews.text: Lieber Mechanical is now my GO TO COMPANY for HVAC and Plumbing. I was absolutely impressed by Lieber Mechanical's employees. They were honest, hard working and never gave up. Scott worked very hard to get my tankless water heater going. He had to replace the primary heat exchanger and several other parts. He had to order the heat exchanger from Navien which took a couple of days. The first day it took 3 hours, but they only charged a 1 time service fee of $99. I upgraded to a 1 year service contract. The service contract included the service fee, 15% off of services + flushing my tank again in the next 6 to 12 months. It paid for it self on this one repair and I still get a no cost tank flush. Scott returned 2 days later as soon as the recieved the primary heat exchanger. He removed & replaced it, but said he still needed an igniter. Unfortunately, it stopped working again before he could make it back out. I didn't have hot water for several days because of Thanksgiving holidays. No problem though I have a shower in my barn. So, I didn't call them to request an emergency visit. Scott returned for the 3rd time monday morning with the igniiter. It only took a few minutes, but it still would not ignite. After, Scott spent a long time diagnosing why it still would not ignite. He found a tube was blocked by a cap he accidently left in. He was very honest told me what happened. Immediately called his supervisor and told them what happend. He was so apologetic and asked what he could do the make things right. I told him I was just happy he fixed it. He was ready to go above and beyond to make up for a minor mistake. Unlike others who would have tried to cover up their mistake and probably added mored charges to my bill. There were no additional charges. His honesty was was surprising, but wonderful in a world where prices are high and honestly is not very forth coming. I also want to give a shout out to his assistants Brock and Stephen 2 super nice guys. And I want to thank Hillary who took my calls and quickly dispatched Scott the same day I called both times. Everyone I spoke with was super friendly and helpful. I highly recommend Lieber Mechanical.

reviews.author: Katie Jenks
reviews.text:
I had a small drip leak on a fitting connecting two pipes for my hot water supply together. I have galvanized pipes and know that those pipes may cause water pressure issues due to sediment. I asked the plumber if there would be any issues with the galvanized pipe or from the galvanized pipes due to this repair, and if I should consider completely replacing the pipes altogether. They assured me there was no need to do that and that this was an isolated drip leak that I should fix, there would be no impact to the broader system.

Once the repair was done and after they got the water back on, my water pressure was so low that there was only a drip out of the kitchen sink. I asked the plumber what to do and he said “your pipes are galvanized so you’ll have to replace them if you want better water pressure. I told you before I did the repair that this could happen” (which was not true, he said nothing before the repair) and then left us SOL with low water pressure. I found out the next day when I tried to use my dishwasher that it wouldn’t even start anymore because the water pressure was too low.

I called Apex to express my frustration about this since I had explicitly asked ahead of time if we should be considering replacing the galvanized pipes. They sent the same plumber back out to look at what’s going on. He was incredibly defensive and offered no solutions. When I called the office again, they said the owner’s son would call me to further discuss what can be done but I never got a call back.

Ironically, in the end, I (using ChatGPT with no prior DIY experience) was able to repair the low water pressure on my own by changing the T joint at the water supply line in my kitchen and flushing the lines to my sink and dishwasher, but Apex didn’t even suggest that. I would have even considered paying them to fix that but they jumped right to saying there was no solution other than replacing all the pipes and that we were SOL.

For a licensed plumber, I expect more. ChatGPT did a better job solving my water pressure issues than this plumber!!

I was quoted $6000.  which didn't seem unreasonable.  On the day of the service, one man showed up,  Cash, and he got to work.  He was great, but found another issue which would require removing the line from my meter to my house.  So I got another quote for $3000.+ for that. Ouch. Meanwhile Cash finished up the original work in 6 hours total.  I called several times to speak to Ryan who had quoted the job, but was never put through to him, and he never returned my calls.  I'm no plumber, but $6000. for 6 hours of work and some plastic pipes seems high. Finally after never hearing back from Ryan they offered me a credit of $89. for the new shut off that wasn't installed on the first trip since they were going to replace it on the second trip.
Despite the excellent service with the people working in my home, I probably won't use this company again because I feel they were not reasonable about the pricing.

plumbers.address: 1217 Blackhawk Ave, McHenry, IL 60051, USA

reviews.author: Ben Isaacs
reviews.text:
We were in the process of having a bathroom remodeled, and just our luck, our water heater goes out. I was recommended to contact Helton Plumbing by our contractors. I spoke with the owner, Jeremy, who was very helpful in my time of panic. Jeremy was able to give me the information about upgrading to different types of water heaters: tankless, tanked and power vent. What I appreciated was the upfront tasks required to install each one, as well as the pros and cons of each unit. We ended up going with the Navian tankless water heater. I've included pictures of the before and after.

Carey was my technician for the project. I cannot say enough about how magnificent Carey was. Answered all my questions, explained the process, gave me insight on the new product (including gas use, electrical use, rebate possibilities, etc). Additionally, Carey completed this entire task by himself, wasting no time to get the project going - it was an all day task. Carey even recommended a type of recirculation valve in the primary bathroom that will help to heat the primary bathroom faster (it is the furthest away from the water heater, so historically the shower took 60+ seconds to get hot). The recirculation valve and new water heater have the primary bathroom hot in under 10 seconds. It is sorcery.

I am very pleased with the service. Words can't explain how much we are enjoying the new water heater and the constant hot water. Also, the floor space that it opened up is monumental too. I will say that to go from a tank to tankless, it is an investment. It is expensive to make the change. It is definitely worth it - high efficient appliance, lower gas bill and constant hot water. We have young children and always worried about those 'hot pockets' of water in a tank water heater burning one of our kids. The tankless is so consistent I wish our Chicago Bears would take note. Overall, couldn't be happier with how it turned out. If you are on the market for a new water heater, consider Helton Plumbing. They fixed my issue entirely in one day!

reviews.author: Georgia Kelly
reviews.text: I came home from vacation to a leaking pipe and puddle of water on the floor. Helton was able to come within a couple of hours. Carey immediately put my mind at ease. He diagnosed the problem and explained it to me with a photo. He gave me an estimate before he began the work. He had everything he needed to replace the cracked piece of pipe and worked efficiently and professionally. He was friendly and courteous. This was the second time I’ve used Helton and have been 100% satisfied. Julie who took my call was great also.

reviews.text:

They always do an excellent job. Yesterday they replaced three toilets in our house. Their tech arrived on time and looked over our problems and gave me two options to solve it. One- to rebuild the toilet ( new parts) or two- to replace the entire fixture. We opted for replacement. He had to pick up the fixtures an hour away and then come back to begin. He arrived on time and did the job quickly and cleanly. He took the old toilets and all of the cartons and garbage left over from the install to dispose of. If I could give them more than five stars I would.

reviews.author: Bill Spelman
reviews.text: We are relatively new to the area and found ourselves in need of a plumber. I like to shop local and found Helton Plumbing had a lot of happy customers. Unfortunately we now live in a time of horrible customer service, however, Helton is the exception. They are extremely knowledgeable, polite, prompt, affordable and the finished job was done to perfection. I will not hesitate to use them again. Thank You Helton for supplying good old fashion customer service

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.text: Have used Helton for a while for jobs ranging from hot water heater repair, frozen pipes, and one off needs. They give straight forward honest quotes and do great work. Would highly recommend.

plumbers.name: Austin's Greatest Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2210 Melissa Oaks Ln, Austin, TX 78744, USA

reviews.author: Ford
reviews.text:
I was promised to call back from a plumber today about services that were on the bid that I accepted  to be performed at my house that were not completed. I also believe I was charged for the services.

No one has been in contact with me additionally, when the plumber came he left the lock box with the key to my home completely open for anyone to come up and take the key. So far, I am very displeased with my service and how I have been treated.

Update: The owners of this business went above and beyond to make sure that I was taken care of. I genuinely think the above was just a one off and you can trust this company with your business.

reviews.author: Chloe Chen
reviews.text: Huge shout-out to Gary and the team at Austin's Greatest Plumbing! They replaced our water heater, upgraded our system, and fixed a leak. Their communication was top-notch--they proactively called me with part updates and scheduled the repair immediately once they arrived. Professional, knowledgeable, and reliable. Our water system is working better than ever! (Now we can take hour long shower without worrying about running out of hot water 😃🚿)

reviews.author: D H
reviews.text:
We had a pretty complex multi-unit plumbing issue that involved several homeowners and a lot of coordination, and Austin’s Greatest Plumbing handled it perfectly. Star, the technician onsite, was outstanding - professional, thorough, and took the time to explain everything clearly not just to us, but to the other owners as well. He was knowledgeable, friendly, and really took pride in doing the job right.

Also want to mention Rachel, one of the co-owners, who took my initial call and was so easy to work with. She was flexible with scheduling and really helped us navigate the logistics of having multiple parties involved.

This is not your typical PE-owned plumbing shop - it’s a local, owner-run business that actually cares about doing things the right way. Great service, great people, and an all-around smooth experience. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Ashley Council
reviews.text: We had a leaking toilet and Austin’s Greatest Plumbing had someone in the area finishing up a job so Gary was able to swing by within the hour to troubleshoot. He diagnosed the issue right away, explained everything in simple terms, and had the leak fixed in no time. Fortunately for us, it was a relatively easy repair, but we felt informed if it was something else and what our options were. He was professional, friendly, and clearly very skilled. He The whole experience was smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend Austin's Greatest Plumbing.

reviews.author: Pam Campbell
reviews.text: Sean did a fabulous job! We have had many plumbers come and go through our office over the years, these guys are the best so far. Scheduling was easy and the work was done quickly. Very pleased overall.

plumbers.name: Spartan Plumbing and Drains
plumbers.address: 1905 Woods Dr, Beavercreek, OH 45432, USA

reviews.author: Robin Adams
reviews.text: Absolutely awful company to work with. I hired them to come out and find a leak. They gave me an estimate of $18,000 (which I'm now finding is probably twice what I should have paid). They said it was a leaking pipe under my concrete. They jackhammered up my concrete without hanging any plastic up and so my entire house was covered in concrete dust. When they left, they left my front door not only unlocked but wide open (since I had left on their recommendation because of the noise and dust). They also began replacing fixtures and lines in the two toilets and the sinks. They did terrible jobs and had to keep coming back and redoing them. They took out fairly upgraded fixtures and brought in builder basic. In a week there were 16 technicians in my home. 16! And by the time they were finished I had a leaking outdoor spigot, no water to my dishwasher, and a leaking front bathroom toilet. Every time I try to get them out here they want to charge me more money to fix these things. I tried getting a lawyer involved and they refused to answer her calls for 3 weeks so she gave up and didn't bill me (bless her heart). Whatever you do, do not work with these people. They will overcharge you. They will send out incompetent technicians. And then they will refuse fix the work that they left a mess unless you pay them more money.

reviews.author: Dustin Olson
reviews.text:
Update: Initially rather than email, I called on Thursday, November 6 at 4:01 PM to speak to a manager for final resolution. I was told everyone was in a meeting.
I received a call back at 4:41 PM from Josh Ferguson. He was apologetic for the delay of contacting me and admitted he knew some of the situation, but not at all. I requested a refund but he said his financial person was gone for the day and he would check back with me.
Today is Tuesday, November 11 at 4:58 PM. It has now been 3 full business days and I have heard nothing.

I will give you short version(and yes, this is the short version)
TLDR: They try to upsell you, management/leadership are horrible, and customer service is beyond terrible. (Has not always been this way, so is 100% a leadership issue, not the employees).

-I have used this company several times, including the water heater I currently have.
-Techs are great. Very professional and very relatable and honest
-Leadership/Management is unprofessional and not customer service centered
-Even the operations manager (Brayden?) did not follow through with what he said he would do. Told me he was going to look into my warranty personally and then never contacted me back. I only received a random request for an appointment. When I followed up, he said he “wanted to talk to me” yet never actually made an effort to contact me
-Manager Nick tried to sell me a $20,000 water filter/softener system instead of addressing my warranty and tried to claim that was the only way my warranty for my water heater would be valid (I’ve had several techs out and I won’t say which ones, but they’ve mentioned what a terrible manager and person he is)
-Contacted the operations manager with concerns about the water heater repair to the point I had to call the fire department. Rather than send someone out he recommended I contact a chimney repair company.
-a month later it turns out it’s been leaking gas the whole time and only figures out after I bought a detector and inspected.
-several times I was told I’d get a call back and never did and I had to continue to follow up.
-yesterday I called around 9:00 am was told I would get a call back to try and get scheduled today. By 4:00 I hadn’t gotten a call so I(once again) had to call them. I was told everyone was in a meeting. Heard NOTHING back until this morning.
I would never use them again based on their lack of customer service, unprofessional leadership, and outright lack of concern of safety for their customers and only focusing on upsellling.

reviews.author: William Houchins
reviews.text:
We had a main plumbing line blockage at our property caused by tree roots that had damaged the piping. Spartan Plumbing answered my call late Sunday evening and sent a crew (Nick and Jared) out early Monday morning to take a look. From the start, both Jared and Nick were transparent and thorough in diagnosing the problem. They provided multiple quotes and clear options for moving forward with repairs, making a stressful situation much easier to navigate.

The excavation crew (Craig and others) worked quickly and kept us updated each day on their progress. From start to finish, the project took just a few days — Monday through midday Thursday — and now our plumbing is working perfectly again. We’re very grateful for the Spartan team’s professionalism and hard work, and we highly recommend them to anyone dealing with plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Zingo
reviews.text:
Something has changed with Spartan Plumbing in the last couple years. In 2022, we contracted them for a hydro-jet of our main line which was approximately $900. With this, we received prompt service, excellent communication, timeliness, and an overall feeling of good business. Around this time, we also had them install a new water condition and copper piping, which also went well.

In 2025... we had an issue with our sewer line and contacted Spartan. We had an appointment scheduled between 8 and 10 AM. That time came and went, no call, no text, no nothing.  I called, and received some reason about "things popping up" as to why no one showed. I was also told that they may not get to it that day. I explained that this was unacceptable as we had an appointment. They sent out some very young looking guys around noon, who I later found out were not equipped for drain maintenance so they "assessed" the situation, without actually running any water or doing any tests whatsoever and called back to Spartan HQ.

Around 4 PM, they say a team can make it out to our house. They send a team out who looks at our pipe and comes back with a few options. We received a quote for $3000 to perform a hydro-jet service. They agreed to "knock it down" to $2300.  They also offered a drain snake service for $450.  These prices are about three times higher than the local average. Needless to say, Spartan did not get our business nor will they in the future.

Spend your money elsewhere... it seems as though something has changed over in the Spartan back office.

reviews.author: Sir Yes
reviews.text: They charged me 900 dollars to do a simple gas line pressure test.  Were told no insurance.  I still have no gas and this was two months ago cause they took all my money.  Became rude and started huffing and puffing about there time when told I'd like to have another place take a look.  I got a quote just for fun for the twenty foot of gas pipe and water heater they quoted $8000 for both or $5300 for just the pipe.  Guess they want me to buy them nice sprinter vans for them myself it seems.  Just not good people keep scrolling find a company that cares more when somebody was murdered and burnt up next door causing your damage.  This one only cares about buying nice sprinter vans it seems.  It took me two months to write this cause I figured my anger would pass.  Nope I'm more angry as the cold is coming and that 900 would have done the job if I used better people.  Call somebody else. Spartan thinks they're in the movie 300 as they kick customers into the pit.

plumbers.name: V & L Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 13791 Alexander St, Cedar Lake, IN 46303, USA

reviews.author: tracy engel
reviews.text: THANK YOU to Erich from V & L Plumbing.  He was very friendly, knowledgeable, and professional and did an outstanding job with the installation of our new 21" toilet.  He did a fast and efficient job. We will be using his services again soon!  Thanks again!

reviews.author: Warren Ahlgren
reviews.text: Joe did an an excellent job with the installation, which included a few modifications for drainage, and a bit of work removing the old unit (which was rust-locked to the connection point beneath the sink). He explained everything clearly, and even spent a little time giving my wife and I professional advice regarding operation, safe use, and tips to extend the longevity of the unit. Joe was a pleasure to work with, and we would definitely use his services again.

reviews.author: Ron Catania
reviews.text: Had problems with my water heater.  Did a little research and found many plumbing business with less than desirable reviews.  V and L had positive feedback.  So I gave them a call.  My experience was great.  They communicated and delivered in every step of the process.  Kudos to Erich (technician) for his communication, effort and expertise.  He was awesome.  Very happy with the whole process.

reviews.author: Molly Rupp
reviews.text: Erich did an excellent job installing our new garbage disposal! He was friendly, quick, and efficient, giving us advice on how to best care for and provide regular maintenance on it in the future as well. Overall a great experience and would use again!

reviews.author: Terri Sommerville
reviews.text: I had two toilets installed. Erich did a great job and was very personable and polite. I requested his business card for future work I will need done!

plumbers.name: On Call Plumbing, Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 3770 Fernandina Rd, Columbia, SC 29210, USA

reviews.author: Betsy Smoak
reviews.text:
We had a great experience with On Call Plumbing. They were able to get us scheduled very quickly and our technician, Nathan, was kind and did a great job!
We appreciated all he did for us as he went above and beyond. Thank you.

reviews.author: Christie Stemba
reviews.text: Cam came out to complete maintenance on our HVAC system and was very thorough. He explained everything clearly and what our options were. We had him come back to complete the repairs. He took his time and made sure that everything was done correctly and the unit was working. I appreciate everything he has done to get the unit back into top working order. He is a great asset to On Call! Thank you for everything!

reviews.author: Ned Snow
reviews.text: The On Call service person, Alex, came out same day to diagnose our broken AC unit. He did a great job explaining the problem.  And provided a very reasonably priced estimate.  When we decided to go ahead with the repair, Alex was again prompt; he quickly made the repair; our AC unit worked perfect. He was very professional, and he knows his stuff. I look forward to giving my business to Alex and On Call in the future.

reviews.author: S&J Lawson
reviews.text: Nathan helped us out a lot with a leaky shower faucet that was out of my league.  He provided an estimate that was very close to the $$$ number I thought it would be and discussed our options. He was very professional and conscientious about our carpets.

reviews.author: Lynn Robinson
reviews.text: We had a clogged toilet at our office, the only toilet. We needed help fast. Nate Hemmer came to our rescue!! He was professional, on time, and fixed the issue quickly. The price was very reasonable, and the customer service was excellent from start to finish. Everything was explained clearly, and there were no surprises. I highly recommend On Call Plumbing Heating & Air and will definitely use their services again.  THANKS NATE!! …..Also shout out to the ladies in the office. Y'all were very helpful as well.  Everyone should get bonuses!!

plumbers.name: Service 360 Group
plumbers.address: 1665 State Hill Rd Unit 700, Wyomissing, PA 19610, USA

reviews.author: Jason Ziemba
reviews.text: Service 360 was excellent! Tracy in their customer service department was super-helpful and setting up the appointment was easy. Tony, our plumber (who had worked on our home thru a previous employer), was wonderful as always. Courteous, prompt and quickly resolved our plumbing issues in a reasonable timeframe. Calling them was a no-brainer because we had built trust in Tony and knew he could handle the issue(s). We did expect to pay a bit more since this is a bit larger company than your hometown plumber, but the trust we had in Tony's abilities outweighed the cost.

reviews.author: George Buchert
reviews.text:
Charged me $112 (without notifying me prior) to come out to give an estimate. Never provided the estimate in writing. Their email address listed isn't a valid email, and their call in number never resolves to a real person. This company is a scam, and should be avoided at all costs.

Also cut the lock out on my electric meter without notifying the power company.
