I never received any email from them beyond the invoice where they charged me $112. This was the result when I attempted to email them:

reviews.author: Traci Angioletti
reviews.text: I had a 2’fer today. Not only did I need a fixture installed, but my heat was not working. Griff, as always was undeniably the best! In minutes, my heat was working again and he was on his way. I can’t speak enough mind words about service 360 and how professional the entire crew is always. I deal with them on a professional and a personal level and would never choose anyone else. God bless you Griff! (Sorry for the sludge!)

reviews.author: Harlan Kauffman
reviews.text:
Great service! Very knowledgeable! Thank you very much. Highly recommend this company for your electrical needs!
I will definitely hire them again.
I cant thank them enough for such speedy service!

reviews.author: Linda Vondercrone
reviews.text:
I am so happy to have found Service 360! They are true craftsmen who employ honest, friendly technicians and provide exceptional customer service. My experience with them was amazing, even when I faced a difficult situation.

I had to have my boiler replaced and unfortunately ran into some hurdles with a difficult finance company. However, thanks to Terri and Jackie, those financing issues were quickly resolved. I worked most often with Terri, and she delivered amazing customer service every single time.

On the technical side, Rick was beyond exceptional. In fact, every single person I interacted with was helpful and kind. If you are looking for an honest service group with technicians who take pride in their work, I highly recommend Service 360!

plumbers.name: The All Pipes INC.
plumbers.address: 255 Holly Ln, Elk Grove Village, IL 60007, USA

reviews.author: Ryan Rudolf
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend the all pipes inc enough. Major work was done on our house replacing a large portion of cask iron vent stack. The crew sent out was extremely friendly, hardworking, and thorough going above and beyond with their service. They stayed true to their quote and ensured the issue was fixed before leaving. Paying was quick and easy.

If you want a trustworthy plumber who will do things right the first time and go above and beyond what they say, these are the guys for you.

reviews.author: Stela Vasileva
reviews.text: All Pipes did a great job replacing my main shutoff valve and my shower. They did quality work for very reasonable price. I am very impressed with the owner Grigor who provided me with a quick quote and communicated with me timely and professionally through the entire process. I will definitely use them for any future projects.

reviews.author: Barbara Forest-Beriso
reviews.text: Coming into Christmas, our pipes were backing up in our ONLY bathroom. We have a sewer/septic system and tho the septic tank was filling up with a lot of ground water, that wasn't the problem. We tried rodding it ourselves, but we only had a 75 foot rodder and needed atleast 100 feet to reach from the bathroom to the tank. The Saturday after Christmas, we called All Pipes due to all the great recommendations we saw in our local towns Facebook page.  I spoke to Greg, who was super nice! He was able to get us taken care of on Monday morning. On Monday, we met Rey and Jessie. I believe it was Jessie who called on Monday to tell me he was on his way and gave me an ETA. From the moment they came into the house, we found them to be very professional and personable. they respected our home by wearing foot coverings on their boots, and they talked to us all the way thru the process. It turns out we had not one, but two different clogs - they even looked at our plumbing pipes through a camera.  They worked quickly, but they didn't rush.  Two days later we had another company come in and pump out our septic tank and he confirmed the clog.  When my husband told him what equipment All Pipes used, he says that was absolutely the right equipment for the job based off of the size of the clog that he saw when emptying the tank.  I can't say enough good things about Jessie and Rey!  We definitely recommend ALL PIPES and we'll be coming back for our plumbing needs.  Thanks Greg, Rey and Jessie!!!

reviews.author: Peggy Grubbs
reviews.text: Greg came the same day I called to replace my 2 sump pumps and backup pump and batteries that had stopped working. They did an incredible job! Very professional , quick, clean, and the price was the best I found!  Highly recommend The All Pipes Inc!!

reviews.author: Meg Collins
reviews.text: Great service and price. I had a couple of other plumbers come quote me for replacing a sump pump, and they all wanted to charge me extra for replacing the back up pump and the back up battery, too. Those items were working just fine. All Pipes came to my house and just installed what I needed; a nice good quality Zoeler pump at a reasonable price.  I was very happy with them and would recommend them!

plumbers.name: Hill Plumbing & Air
plumbers.address: 438 N Main St, Sumter, SC 29150, USA

reviews.author: Melanie Bittinger
reviews.text:
Hill Plumbing and Air has been terrific to work with.  A few years ago we got a new system and they installed it with no problem.  We had only one problem until now.  I came home the other day  on Wednesday and the system sounded like a plane was taking off.  I made a service call to them and Will came out and took a look at it and said that the motor needed to be replaced because the bearings were bad.  He checked with the office and it was covered under warranty and all we had to pay for was labor.  They were closed on Thursday and Friday but Will offered to come out on Friday if the motor completely failed but it held up till Monday.  So today another great employee named Dray came out and replaced the motor.  Didn't take him no time at all and the HVAC system purrs like a kitten now.  Thank you both for fixing our problem and the prompt and great customer service you provided does not go unnoticed.  Thank you again for getting us back right.  You guys rock!

Melanie

reviews.author: Sow Foong C
reviews.text:
James and Justice came to repair the dripping faucet in my bedroom. They were friendly, professional, patient and knowledgeable. They offered suggestions and options for me to make an informed
decision. Price is reasonable. Will definitely recommend Hill Plumbing

reviews.author: Kaci Nguyen
reviews.text: I had heard mixed reviews about Hill Plumbing, but I wanted to try their service. Honestly, I am very satisfied. Charles was very professional and knowledgeable. He patiently explained what he did and what I need to do to maintain a longer lifespan for my water heater. I would recommend Charles from Hill Plumbing to anyone. Unlike another plumber who came to my house the day before, charged me $160, and still didn’t fix my hot wate

reviews.author: Dennis Junak
reviews.text: Nick came out on a Sunday because my house drains were backed up. Super guy. Friendly, professional and knowledgeable. He wasn’t able to fix the problem then but got us able to use our drains until the next day. He and Jason came back Monday and professionally fixed my broken pipe. They were excellent. Such personable guys and very knowledgeable. They are great guys and were very good at their job. Can’t say enough good things about these two. I have used Hill plumbing off and on over the past 24 years and always get great work.

reviews.author: Howard Cullum
reviews.text: We had a major plumbing rebuild under the house and in the kitchen. Charlie arrived promptly on time and immediately got to work. Cody arrived a little later. They were professional, answered my questions, and completed the work, including cleanup, in a very reasonable amount of time. Charlie reviewed all of the work, including pictures with me when they were done. This was a substantial job completed to our complete satisfaction by two very competent professionals.

plumbers.name: Palisades Plumbing CO
plumbers.address: 16626 Marquez Ave, Pacific Palisades, CA 90272, USA

reviews.author: Naomi Neufeld
reviews.text: We are back in our home after the Fire. I am so grateful to Palisades Plumbing and specifically to Mario for not only the very responsive service to repair our shower, but to provide care and service the way i remembered it from  being a much younger homeowner here in the Palisades.  The quality of his work is excellent, his explanations were clear and the prices are quite reasonable.  This is a strong message to bring our community back.

reviews.author: Vicky Sun
reviews.text:
I was charged a $75 service fee for a technician to simply look at my toilet and confirm there was a crack. He told me the $75 would be applied toward the $350 installation fee if I installed a new toilet with them.

Later, when I called back to proceed, they changed their explanation and said the $350 installation fee was already discounted and the $75 would not be applied. This was completely different from what I was told initially.

Very disappointing experience. The pricing was inconsistent and misleading. Make sure you get everything in writing before agreeing to any service.

reviews.author: Phyllis Truby
reviews.text: This experience could not have been any better.  Of the half dozen or so plumbing companies with which I had contact about snaking out a stall shower drain, Palisades Plumbing Co. and its staff was a  true standout.  Courteous, accomodating, on time, professional, and effective--and a very reasonable price.

reviews.author: Jeanne Ruderman
reviews.text: I highly recommend Palisades Plumbing. They have been my plumbers since the 1980s. The office is very responsive and the plumbers are readily available.  They provide excellent service with a smile.

reviews.author: J. Gold
reviews.text: This is the second or, maybe, third time Palisades Plumbing has serviced the house. Mario Martin shows up - has such a "can do" attitude - is super friendly and, as plumbers go, he keeps things pretty darn clean. That speaks volumes as plumbing is such a dirty job! He's knowledgable and professional, too! Kudos Palisades Plumbing - you're def our go to plumber!

plumbers.name: Alexander Plumbing
plumbers.address: 221 E Chicago St #9, Elgin, IL 60120, USA

reviews.author: Isidro Perez (Sid Perez)
reviews.text: Had them come out and repair a water washer inlet hose that had rusted together. They came out the same day I called, and repaired the issue in less than and hour. They were cheap and affordable and I would highly recommend Alexanders Plumbing for any of you plumbing needs. I've used them several times thru out the years and they never disappoint. The are professional, courteous, and very affordable in their prices.

reviews.author: Alicia Smith
reviews.text: The speedy response and work was amazing. Neil did an amazing job of explaining the work he was doing as well as explaining prevention of future issues. He kept his work area clean. I’m so happy I called them. I believe I found a lifetime plumber for my forever home.

reviews.author: Greg Bowman
reviews.text: We had a sewer back up into our laundry room. I called Alexander Plumbing and they were at our home within the hour! They had the line rodded out and were all done in two hours. AND, they cleaned the floor in the laundry room. Looked like nothing ever happened, all resolved by 11am. I am super thrilled with their work, their character and the decent people they are! Absolutely will call them again - and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Scott Hanssler
reviews.text: Pat is the man, he really came through for me when moving into my new home and had an immediate issue with the hot water heater. Went out of his way to help me over the phone and with a part out of kindness. Not many people/places nowadays would take the time to do this. If I ever have a plumbing issue in the future I’ll only call here.

reviews.author: Marty McGovern
reviews.text: They did a great job; handled all phases of the repair. Explained everything in detail and were prompt  and thorough. We would highly recommend them !

plumbers.name: A&P Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 2542 Pennsylvania Ave, Charleston, WV 25302, USA

reviews.author: Angela Williams
reviews.text: My experience with this company was great from the first phone call to the end of the repair.  Christian and Jay did an awesome job on the repairs I needed. Kept me informed from start to finish. I will definitely call them if needed in the future and recommend them to everyone I know that needs their services.

reviews.author: Jodi Workman
reviews.text:
I wish I could give more than five stars – A&P Plumbing absolutely deserves it!
We had a gas leak emergency on Friday, and the gas company had to shut everything off. We survived the weekend huddled around a kerosene heater in below-freezing temperatures, so when we called Monday morning at 7 AM, we were desperately hoping someone could come out that same day.
By 7:30 AM, Michael was at our door! He quickly assessed the situation and got right to work. We have an old home that predates World War II, so some of the lines and valves needed extra care and attention. Michael took the time to thoroughly evaluate our entire house and did an amazing job bringing everything up to code.
The owner, Brandon, even stopped by to check on us and assure us the job would be completed in a timely manner.
✓ Professionalism – ✓ Work ethic – ✓ Job completion !!!!
Sitting here in our warm house without fear of a gas leak, I cannot express enough gratitude to A&P Plumbing. They turned a scary, cold situation into a relief— now in our speed dial!!

reviews.author: Fran Burgess
reviews.text: Had A&P here today for the fourth job.  This company happily schedules our jobs regardless of the scope. They have done major repairs, such as replacing our main line; to minor repairs, such as reseating a toilet. Today, Michael came to address two leaking shower heads. He called in advance, arrived promptly, and kept us informed as he diagnosed and repaired the issue. A&P is our go-to for all plumbing issues, and Michael is great! Communication is excellent, pricing is discussed up front, and the service is always friendly. We highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Wallace Suttle II
reviews.text: Michael did a great job installing our new hot water heater!  He called before he left Charleston to let us know he was on the way, called when the job was complete and called again several days later to make sure the water was hot!  Great customer service!

reviews.author: Dawn Cottingham
reviews.text: We had A&P provide plumbing services at our rental home and are extremely pleased them. Scheduling was easy and they were able to get to the house quickly and very reasonably priced. David was fantastic to work with and very humble and understanding about needing to repair my botched “do it yourself job” (sigh of embarrassment). We highly recommend them !

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 1111 Western St ste c, Fairfield, CA 94533, USA

reviews.author: Becca Large
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter Fairfield was extremely helpful, polite, courteous, clean, professional, and hard working. Chris and Marty are the best and did everything they could to fix the issue and keep the price down for us. Thank you very much for everything! They careful explained the problem to us and made sure we understand each step of the way. We have been customers for years and will continue to use this company for any future needs!

reviews.author: Carley Judson
reviews.text: We had some work done at our business, and the entire experience was outstanding. Shout out to Doug for his professionalism, communication, and deep knowledge—he walked us through every step and made the whole process stress-free. The team worked efficiently, kept the workspace clean, and did their absolute best to keep everything affordable without sacrificing quality. We truly appreciate the honesty and care. Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: alberto delacruz
reviews.text: About 11pm my kid comes in and wakes me up to tell me bathroom is not flushing and water is in tub.. now! I tried small tricks I know to fix clogged pipes after an hour of that not working. Called Roto Rooter and about 30 minutes later tech Zach calls says he’s finishing a job and can be there in an hour. He gets to my house in about 30-45 min after conversation. Less than 30 minutes after arrival house is flushing like it should. Thank you Zach. Price was expensive but late night emergency callouts are to be expected at this price. Which when I asked around seemed reasonable with after hour plumbing.

reviews.author: John

reviews.author: Nicole Delgado
reviews.text:
If you value clear communication and competence, avoid Black Tie Plumbing. Our experience was a catalog of errors, from deceptive pricing to a botched timeline.
After foundation work from their partner company resulted in four sewer leaks, we met with Ruben on December 22nd to verify the leaks and work needed. He explicitly confirmed twice that two quoted figures were for different levels of work. The next day, the quote arrived with the costs combined, effectively doubling the price by several thousand dollars. After we expressed our concern, Ruben was apologetic and said he misspoke.
We were told work could not start until after the holidays.
What was scheduled as an 8-day job turned into a multi-week ordeal:
1/16: Work began after Xavier scheduled with short notice calling wed 1/13 at 4:25 to schedule for Friday. We had to make many arrangements with work to be available but made it happen.
1/21: After supposedly fixing the leaks, the post-plumbing test failed. They had only fixed 3 out of 4 leaks. They stated they didn't have the correct supplies to finish and it was already afternoon.
1/22: Plumbers arrived with the supplies and realized a "miscommunication" meant excavation was a foot short, delaying work further on fixing the 4th leak. The excavation would have to come out again
1/23-1/30 Weather delays due to freezing temps and us exhausting the arrangements we made with work resulted in days of no work
1/31: Excavation was set to arrive from 830 to 9am. Showed up about an hour after. I reached out to Jessica, who had been a point of contact for updates, but no reponse after I asked when the crew would arrive. The excavation crew took an entire day with zero updates from the office or onsite plumbers. No work on sundays.
2/2: Work was finally completed—nearly two weeks past the original end date. Also apparently the city verifies work by FaceTime? That's odd. We had a leak fixed by a different company and someone came out that was 3rd party to verify the work.
Despite the constant errors, no supervisor ever reached out. Though a supervisor was seen onsite they stayed in their vehicles and when they went in the car they never introduced themselves. The supervisor was also late more than once causing the crew to just wait outside.
To top it off, the company charged the remaining balance to our card without authorization or communication, preventing us from using our preferred payment method.
For a company claiming 25 years of experience, this was "amateur hour." They are disorganized, not transparent about pricing, and lack basic accountability.

Unsafe driving, especially in a company vehicle, for no apparent reason really reflects poorly upon a company. My rating is purely based upon an experience with this company without receiving any plumbing services from them.

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.text:
Positives: Tim had a professional demeanor and the work completed looks to be good. Being out of state, Tim made me feel comfortable with work done on multiple picture text message.

Negatives: Company has high prices compared to competitors. Didn’t carry parts (had to make multiple trips to store). All calculations for fees was done on a calculator on a cellphone with a verbal amount given. Never provided receipts nor has a professional layout of fees or documentation to provide to customer for work completed or to be done. Still not 100% convinced my water heater was bad with the main problem being a leaking pipe.

I recently had a water leak in my garage, laundry room, and bathroom.  I am in the military and out of the state so I had to rely on my girlfriend to take care of the issues. She found Brandon Plumbing online and decided to go with the company. We called during the weekend on a Sunday. We had a guy name Tim come to our house which I believe was the owner. Tim was professional and arrived a couple of hours after her phone call. Tim diagnosed the problem down to our water heater (with water leaking from the bottom of the heater) . Since we live next to Lowes Tim had my girlfriend/brother pick up a water heater from the store and agreed just to charge for the install.  He Initially gave us a set price but once the water heater was installed and the work was down the job costed $200 more than the initial agreed upon installation price due to “fees and parts” he never listed.  Once turning the water on to our house, he noticed we still had water leaking in the same areas and diagnosed the new problem from a patch in our wall and then boiled the issue down to a bad pipe that was once worked on before by my previous homeowner. It was around 7-8 at night so Tim instructed us to keep the water off and he will be at our house at 9AM the next morning to fix it.
The next morning my brother stayed home from work and waited until 1:30 Pm being instructed, “ a different plumber was coming but had to run a few errands first”.  After the different plumber arrived (Stacy) he found the leaking pipe and instructed he had to run to the store to grab parts.  Once he replaced a section of the copper pipe with PVC pipe he turned the water back on to my house and noticed the work he had just done was leaking. Stacy instructed us he had to run to a different job and then back to the store then back to our house.  After being away for 1-2 hours he finally arrived with a gator bite Stainless steel tube and completed the job. After asking for the pricing Stacy stated Tim deals with the prices and will get back to us. The next day Tim arrived at my house and gave us a verbal price for the work of the damaged pipe. The initial price was extremely high he gave us for pipe patch work and asked him to explain where he got his total from. Tim explained various fees, taxes, hourly labor, and also a fee for an initial house call. I instructed him I would not pay the fee for the initial house call when this was a continuation of the work from yesterday.
After everything was said and done Tim verbally told us his work is warrantied and call him if any problems arise. Overall the company seems to do good work just has high prices compared to other local plumbers. If I was home and not out of town I would have shopped around for better pricing but I didn’t want to leave the stress of that on my girlfriend.

reviews.author: N S
reviews.text:
AMAZING SERVICE! Had a random emergency issue in my home today (renter) and after contacting the company, a team of 3 arrived in less than an hour.

It was a big job - but the three workers came, listened, assessed thoroughly, and got right to work.

In the process, two toilets had to be taken out, sewage/water that flooded into two of the showers had to be vacuumed out, lines/pipes had to be cleared out, and all effected areas needed to the be cleaned up afterwards (which was a lot to clean up).

They worked their butts off for hours until everything was done, no complaints or breaks (even though I could tell it was very tiring).

They worked together without issue, communicated throughout (with me and my landlord both/they worked out payment etc with him over the phone for me) and were all super friendly and down to earth as well, which made the whole experience way less stressful.

The company will also be sending another team member out in a couple days to inspect and mar a plan to fix any potential damage as a result of today’s issue if needed.

****TERRENCE, AMAD, and MATT were the 3 workers who did the job today****
Y’all rock!

Thanks again!!

P.S - I do have one small suggestion for management though.

For emergency issues that happen to fall on weekends and that might require someone to come out and inspect for damage AFTER a situation like mine (from water damage) -

Having whatever general documents your company requires the customer/owner to sign before someone can be sent out to do a post inspection - readily available somewhere for them to access and get signed as soon as possible without having to wait until a weekday/when office opens again would be really helpful and avoid any delays.

In my case it’s Saturday, so I’ll wait until Monday, but would have liked that to be done today. It’s not a huge deal, Monday is okay too! But just a suggestion!

Again thank you for the amazing service!!!

reviews.author: Robert Bynum
reviews.text:
On Christmas Day, I had a sewer backup at my house and I was feeling panicked since I had to be some place that day for celebrations. I called Roto-Rooter not knowing if I could have someone come out on such short notice on a holiday. To my pleasant surprise, their dispatcher said they could send someone out In about 40 minutes. In a timely manner, a very nice gentleman named Rick arrived and immediately went to work. Rich was working under some difficult conditions. First of all it was cold, windy, and raining. Second, it was difficult to access the sewer cleanout. It was buried under some dirt and a bush made access challenging. In spite of this, Rich had a pleasant demeanor and when I asked if I could help he said he didn't need it. After an hour of work and some difficulty getting the plumber's snake to go towards the street, he cleared the blockage and the problem was solved.
As a result of this experience, I highly recommend Roto-Router and I want to give my highest commendation to Rick for coming out on Christmas Day.

I also want to add a commendation for Jose Leon who was a second employee of Roto-Rooter. Jose was called to my home by Rick because Jose had a fiber optic cable with a camera that he used to inspect the condition of my sewer line. He discovered that there were roots growing in the sewer line that had caused the backup and Rick returned to my home to with an additional tool to cut out the protruding roots. These two worked smoothly as a team to do the additional work.

reviews.author: Stephanie L
reviews.text: We used their Lubbock location several months ago for a clogged toilet that was backing up into our bathtub. They "ran a camera" and said the line was fine and were able to "clear the clog". Two-three months later, I called them again for the same issue. "Cleared" it, no issues. Two or three months go by again, same issue. At this point, I've begun to suspect the line was not "fine" as we were told. I went with another company. Long story short, our entire sewer line had to be replaced due to corrosion and rust because of age. I asked the plumber then if he felt it could have been caught sooner. He said, possibly, if the original plumber knew how to run a camera and knew what to look for. He also said it was likely the original plumber didn't look carefully enough. Our entire line was cracked with portions completely missing; it's honestly a wonder it didn't leak and cause more damage. The original plumber from Earl's never questioned why there was a solid obstruction in the line. He said it was "just grease and such". Not so the case. Over $6k later and a (repaired) massive hole in our concrete foundation, we have the issue fixed. I will never use Earl's again, primarily because I feel like they could have done more due diligence and prevented us from having to deal with the issue multiple times. I originally left a glowing review, but after this issue, I certainly can't recommend them at all. Clearly, they missed something not once, but twice, in an effort to get done quickly. Maybe if you're hitting something solid and the customer has a repeat issue in the exact same area within a few months, do more digging (literally). Do more investigating. That's what we pay plumbers for. We also have a credit on our account we'd like back out of principle, but since it's less than $10 I don't care to bother with it.

reviews.author: Brad Wanzer
reviews.text: I had a Delta shower cartridge that needed replacing.  Attempted myself but stopped before breaking anything. On Monday morning, he drove 3 hours round trip to Riverhead to get the part we needed. He said he would have driven to Connecticut if need be.  That is what I call dedication!

Ironically enough, I was having problems with my upstairs toilet around that time. It was getting clogged easily. Victor sent his brother, Mike over later that day.

Mike snaked the toilet and came back the following week to hyrdo jet the waste line from the trap and put a special enzyme in the line. He was very thorough and took extra care not to soil the carpet in my basement and wore shoe coverings.

Since then I have not had any issues!

reviews.author: Yungjin Kim
reviews.text:
We recently completed two projects with Five Star, including the replacement of the water line between the main shutoff valve and the house. The cost and quality of their service for that work were excellent, and we had no complaints. Based on that experience, I would recommend Five Star for main waterline leak repairs.

During the water line replacement, I also asked Chris about repairing a leaking bathtub faucet. He said they could send another technician the next day to replace the diverter cartridge. The following morning, the technician arrived and, after a quick inspection, provided an estimate of $471 for the repair. He explained that the work required replacing the shower diverter cartridge, consistent with what Chris had mentioned. Although the estimate was higher than I expected, I approved it, assuming the repair might be complex and because the technician was ready to proceed.

After I shut off the main water for him, I took a short break to have a cup of coffee. Before I even finished it, he had completed the replacement and asked me to turn the water back on for a leak test. The technician was very professional, and the repair was completed within about 20 minutes with good results.

However, I felt that $471 was excessive for the level of labor and complexity involved. I later checked the price of the T809206 shower diverter cartridge and found it sells for about $57 at Home Depot, meaning roughly $410 was charged for about 30 minutes of labor. Because Five Star had previously provided fair pricing and excellent service for the main waterline repair, I did not obtain multiple estimates for the bathtub repair—I relied on my loyalty and trust in them. Afterward, I checked with other plumbers and learned that comparable repairs typically range from $250 to $350, including parts.

This experience was a lesson learned: relying on a single provider, even one with whom you have had good experiences, may not always result in fair pricing. It is always best to obtain multiple estimates before making a decision, regardless of prior loyalty.

reviews.author: James Conley

reviews.author: Ayla Tomlin
reviews.text:
CDS Plumbing is a nightmare. Be ready to manage your own project, check their progress, and call many times wondering why they are destroying your house. While they replaced our sewage line and it works, everything else was disastrous.

I have much more to share and extensive video evidence showing their complete disregard for our home, but Google Reviews won’t accept videos and has a maximum character count which I clearly met.

What they did right:
- Replaced the entire sewage line at a fair price.
- Plumbing has worked so far.

What went wrong:
- Workers left doors/windows open with the A/C running.
- Trash and debris were left everywhere; we had to clean it ourselves.
- Cracked bathroom tiles.
- Dirt and debris from floor work piled onto living room floors with no protection.
- Concrete splattered on baseboards and flooring, causing permanent damage.

The concrete work after plumbing was done by a different company. It was so uneven that floors and laundry room couldn’t be finished. CDS “fixed” it by bringing the same company back, who sanded everything with zero protection. Our entire home was coated in concrete dust on ALL surfaces—furniture, vents, cabinets, clothes, dishes, pantry items, you name it.

Cleanup was brutal. Six family members spent four full days moving out our home, cleaning everything off-site, laundering clothes and bedding, and washing dishes elsewhere. CDS only sent 4–5 cleaners who were reluctant and limited; the cleaning company confirmed CDS minimized staff and refused additional help.

After moving back in, concrete dust continued to come through our air vents and settle on our belongings. Given that I have two children, I requested professional air duct cleaning due to health concerns. The owner was again rude and reluctant.

We never asked for reimbursement for housing, utility costs, or the extra week displaced. Even so, CDS resisted. Dust continued to come through vents, forcing professional air duct cleaning for health reasons. The owner was rude, dismissive, and at one point said he would “not spend another penny,” showing zero concern for our safety or family.

Additional issues:
- A worker failed to reconnect a pipe, flooding our laundry room.
- Bathroom vanity measured incorrectly and is off-center.
- Laundry room vanity installed at an angle; sink leans forward and won’t drain.
- I repeatedly had to inspect the home and property to find unfinished work and leftover debris, requiring multiple return visits.
- Workers smoked marijuana in our backyard twice.

Final thoughts:
Plumbing works, but everything else was handled with zero professionalism. Damage to our home, unsafe conditions, poor workmanship, and dismissive ownership made this extremely stressful. Avoid CDS Plumbing if you value your home, health, or peace of mind.

reviews.author: Lindsey Johnson
reviews.text:
UPDATE: The manager called the seller and is getting her a credit on the plumbing repairs.
As a local realtor, I work with a lot of different service providers, and I truly wish I could say my experience with R.J. Kielty Plumbing, Heating & Cooling was a positive one — but unfortunately, it was far from it.

I needed to coordinate a plumber for a seller who had already moved out of state to South Carolina. The home is vacant, and we discovered a minor leak in the laundry room near the washer hookup as well as an issue with the main water shut‑off valve. R.J. Kielty came out during the week, gave us a quote, and assured us they’d order the parts and be back on Friday to complete the work.

Friday came… and in the middle of the day, we got a call saying the parts weren’t in and they wouldn’t be out until Monday. That was frustrating, but we waited. When they did finally come out, they only sent the sellers a photo of a small portion of the work they did in the laundry room.

When I personally went to the home to inspect, I was shocked. There was a massive hole cut in the laundry room wall — and in the process of removing the drywall, they had carelessly ripped off large sections of paint. They never disclosed this to the seller, and simply left it that way, knowing full well the home is getting ready to go on the market.

When the seller called them, the plumber simply said, “I don’t do drywall, there’s nothing I can do.” No apology, no offer to make it right.

As someone who prides herself on connecting clients with trustworthy vendors, I’m incredibly disappointed. Not only was the schedule pushed and communication poor, but the lack of care — and the fact that they took advantage of the seller being out of state — is unacceptable.

I cannot recommend R.J. Kielty Plumbing, Heating & Cooling after this experience.

reviews.author: Aaron
reviews.text:
$35,000 DISASTER FROM A SIMPLE CLOGGED TOILET!!!

We called "Emergency Plumbing" with a clogged toilet in August 2024. After their plumber visited us, we ended up with THREE ROOMS DESTROYED BY WATER AND SEWAGE, costing $35,000 IN REPAIRS that took SEVERAL MONTHS, and then later getting dropped by our brand new homeowners insurance due to the claim!

"Emergency Plumbing" happily took my several hundred dollars in payment for "clearing the clogged toilet". They have offered no recompense for causing our massive loss. But, to their credit, they did say "sorry" a couple times.

THE FULL, DISGUSTING, DANGEROUS, SAD STORY:

In August 2024 I called about a clogged toilet I couldn't plunge clear. They were able to schedule a plumber for early in the morning.

He tried an auger to clear the clog, to no avail. So, he asked to see the sewer cleanout. We went to the basement, where things were about to go DANGEROUSLY BAD.

He opened up the cleanout and A FIRE HOSE RIVER OF SEWAGE immediately began to spray out onto him and our finished basement. He panicked and asked for garbage cans / bags to catch the sewage river.

My wife brought down some large utility garbage bags. The plumber and I held up and filled about 3-4 large bags of sewage over our heads during the next several minutes before the flow finally stopped and he could cap off the cleanout. He reassured me by saying, "sometimes stuff like this happens". We were both drenched in sewage from head to toe. Some had splashed in my eyes and mouth.

He started to hand mop up the large sewage puddle with some paper towels. I told him "don't bother, this all will need a mitigation company". He replied, "all you really need is some soap and water". Ummm no.

We dried off, shedded clothes and went back upstairs. The toilet still wouldn't drain, so he said he'd drive back to get the larger auger. He asked if I had any toilets upstairs, and I replied yes. He said "OK, you can use your upstairs toilet and shower, just don't use the clogged one down here". He left and I started to shower.

After showering I came back down to the main floor to discover that SHOWER WATER WAS GUSHING OUT OF THE TOILET INTO OUR BATHROOM AND HALLWAY!!! More fun!

In the second panic of the day, I tried my best to dam up the NEW RIVER OF WATER now FLOODING my main level hardwood floors. I ran downstairs to see even more water now soaking many ceiling tiles and raining onto the sauna and floor.

I called the plumber and the head plumber agreed to come join the fun. He arrived, I explain the scene, and he said "Oh no, he should never have told you to use the fixtures upstairs". Oh no!

The first plumber later returned with the larger auger. They managed to clear the clog with it. They did some hand mopping up of the now destroyed first floor powder room, hallway, hall closet, and living room. They asked for a check for several hundred dollars, said sorry for the problems, took my check and left.

The next day we opted for a water & sewage mitigation company, rather than the plumber's recommendation of "soap and water". We then watched much of our house get ripped apart and endured days of loud fans a dehumidifiers.

The insurance claim process and reconstruction took place over the next couple months. We had to cancel our Thanksgiving party, as we were still wrapping up the rebuild by then.In the weeks after the plumbing adventure, I texted and called the plumber, hoping to get some recompense for this disaster, maybe cover my insurance deductible, maybe even my money back? We talked on the phone once and I made my case. He didn't offer anything at all. Haven't heard from them since.

0 STARS - CANNOT RECOMMEND FOR ANY PLUMBING WORK. Maybe the head plumber is good? But whatever junior plumber they sent to unclog my toilet basically destroyed much of my new house. They were arrived on time and were friendly to talk to, though, tiny bonus points for that. ONE QUARTER OF A STAR

reviews.author: Jessica Griffin
reviews.text:
I have been a loyal customer of Al Marino for over 10 years. I have had some issues with them in the past but let them go without complaining. I called them out on 12-15-25 because my thermostate was out and my system was blowing cold air. The guy came out and spent maybe 40 minutes here if that and said there was water in something that he drained and it cost me $84.53. He said it was fixed for now and no explanation to why it happened. Not even an hour after he left, it was out again. I called again costing me $267.50 because it was an emergency call they said. The same guy came out and said a line was frozen. By this time my husband was home and said show me.  The line was not frozen and shot liquid out. The guy said well you need a pump to which my husband said there is one connected to the system. Which seemed like a surprise to the guy. The guy didn't do anything and then left. I didn't even get a receipt for payment for this visit. So $352.03 down the drain for nothing from Al Marino and my system was still out. So my husband cleaned out a trap after the guy leaves and the system worked for several days.
It went out again on 12-20-25. I called Al Marino out again costing me another $267.50 and I told them to send a different guy than the one who came out before. The guy comes out to check the system and says it needs another pump. After he had checked things out and said another pump needed to be installed I asked him if it was safe for me to continue resetting the limit switch to try to get it to work. He acted like he knew something else was wrong with the system other than needing a pump. But he told me that it was fine for me to do that just be careful because of the electricity. I say fine install another pump and he comes back the next day to install a pump we had purchased. Costing me $1066.09. Not 10 minutes after he leaves the system is out again. I called again and the guy comes back looks for a second and says you need a new furnace.
By this point I have spent $1685.62 for nothing and call out another company. They knew right away what the problem was and recommended a new furnace. They also informed me that it was unsafe to use the furnace and not to use it by resetting the limit switch. So I recommend you save yourself time, money and a headache by calling another company.

reviews.author: Irene Chan
reviews.text:
I came to Aurora Plumbing last week to purchase a part for a ventilation fan I was repairing for a client. I installed the part the same day, but it immediately made loud noises and clearly wasn’t functioning properly. Within an hour, I returned to the store with the part, clean and unused, and explained the issue. To my surprise, they claimed the part wasn’t theirs and refused to refund or exchange it.

I was left with no choice but to buy an entirely new ventilation unit from Home Depot just to finish the job. Extremely disappointing customer service and a lack of accountability for the product they sold. In my experience, you’re better off going to Home Depot or Lowe’s where return policies are clear and customer support is more reliable.

Response to business owner:
I decided to purchase the replacement part from your shop, even though it would’ve cost me about the same to replace the entire unit, because I believed it would be less work and a more efficient solution. That’s why I was willing to pay a bit more for just the part.

After seeing your response, I felt the need to share my experience. I returned the item you sold me nothing more, nothing less. Being told that I may have cleaned up an old motor to return it was surprising and disappointing. That’s simply not something I would ever do.

I’ve been a contractor for over 30 years and have always taken pride in doing things the right way especially in the contractor business. This situation left me feeling not only let down, but also unfairly judged. It’s a loss on my end, but I hope this review helps bring awareness so others can make informed decisions.

reviews.author: Courtney Y
reviews.text: Donn was amazing. Professional and explained everything he was doing (I was confused, concerned and a bit nervous and nosy!). Very personable and did great work and clean up work.

reviews.author: Ernie Kelly
reviews.text:
Edit: After seeing the response below I requested photos of the work. I promptly received three pictures of my upstairs bathroom toilet. At this point I have to agree with the other 1-star review. I am thinking the receptionist, Juanita, completely ruined this job for everyone. She failed to cancel my appointment as requested. I don't see any evidence the plumber entered my basement where the described problem was most observable so I doubt the issue was taken down correctly. She recorded my email address completely incorrect so I received no correspondence for three weeks until I was called about non-payment to an invoice I never received. All-in-all I would just avoid this company. I had no idea any work was done or my house was entered for three weeks until I was called for non-payment of services.

This was the single worst home repair situation I have ever dealt with. In short:

1. I verbally cancelled the plumbing appointment at the end of my first phone call when I learned my house was further than they are accustomed to. I said I would call them back with more information at a later date.
2. I received no confirmation through email, phone, or text about the appointment but day of I was called and told their plumber was standing outside waiting.
3. I asked them to let me know about circling back later when the house was accessible. I received no information after this and learned today (three weeks later) a plumber entered my premises that day later on with no heads up.
4. The plumber "reseated my toilet" and the major basement leaks were assessed as fixed. I found later from a different company all cast iron pipes were rusted through and cracked. Water was leaking everywhere but pristine plumbing apparently did no checks anywhere. I am not a plumber but water was splashing everywhere when the toilet upstairs was flushed.
5. Weeks later I was asked why my invoice was not paid. They had recorded my email incorrectly while making the appointment. I had no idea my house was even entered without first informing me and assumed no work had been done.

I find it highly unlikely their plumber did anything to address the issue. The basement ceilings and open studs showed good amounts of moisture and water damage at a glance. Flushing the toilet upstairs sent a large amount of water all over the basement floor. Attached is a photo of my basement pipe completely rusted through. It had been leaking in the walls and ceiling continuously. The plumbers I called after I believed this appointment was cancelled found it immediately and showed me how a hand fit inside the pipe from the outside. To replace all cast iron rusted through pipes was a $10,000 job. I am baffled to pay $400 to pristine plumbing for potentially leaving my house leaking until the problem got even more out of control.

Besides the great work, he is a kind and caring person!

reviews.author: James Moody
reviews.text: Pete did a terrific job for us.  He called me back on a Saturday, we discussed the issue I was having and determined that Monday morning would be fine.  He arrived right on time, diagnosed the issue, explained and discussed the issue, then made the necessary repairs.  All is working perfectly now.  We are very pleased with this first time working with Decino Plumbing and would recommend Decino Plumbing to anyone needing plumbing work.

reviews.author: Steph Mid
reviews.text: Pete came highly recommended and delivered!  We needed our gas starter repaired in our fireplace. Pete kindly dropped by for assessment, gave us a couple options and schedule work a few days later. This allowed us to have gas logs installed by Christmas Eve.  Great experience!

reviews.author: Kenya Teems
reviews.text: Quick response, priced very reasonably. Took extra time and care cleaning up from leak and install. Fixed several leaky faucet s and hot water heater. Would highly recommend. Responded within the hour

reviews.author: Alan Porter
reviews.text: Pete was fantastic. Very professional and quickly repaired a broken pipe outside while it was raining. This was also an emergency due to pipe being broken during tree removal. Response to this unscheduled problem was quick.

plumbers.name: Neighborhood Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3527 S 575 W Suite A, Riverdale, UT 84405, USA

reviews.author: nate raleigh
reviews.text: They did a phenomenal job putting in our bathtub. We were even able to keep our original tile. Very professional and reasonable in price. I will be using them again and recommending them to others. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Team Flinders
reviews.text:
Couldn't be happier with Neighborhood Plumbing's work.
Chad was prompt and communicative.  Not only was his quote very reasonable, but he gave us multiple options to ensure we selected the best water heater and plumbing upgrades for our needs.  Jaden is a rockstar, his work was super efficient and expertly done.  They were both easy to work with and the quality of their work is second to none.
Neighborhood was recommended to me, and I am more than happy to recommend them for any plumbing work you need done!

reviews.author: Deanna Byck
reviews.text: Chad and his team were terrific at at organizing and getting everything done ON TIME and and ON BUDGET for our extensive bathroom remodels. Their work was seamless and they were able to integrate their services with our other contractors. Did I mention they are a delight to work with? Would HIGHLY recommend and use them again and again for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Joey Cathcart
reviews.text: Received very professional service from Neighborhood plumbing. They arrived right on time within the one hour window scheduled! They resolved the leak issues I was having with parts on hand no problem and explained what was going on with the leak and how they were resolving it. They also charge for the work after it is completed (something that every contractor should practice). Highly recommend them for any of your plumbing needs!!

reviews.author: Stephen Pudlock
reviews.text: Chad at Neighborhood Plumbing did a great job replacing our aging water heaters. From the first call and quote to removal and installation the whole experience was very timely and professional. Thanks.

plumbers.name: S & B Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 691 N 2075 W Suite A, Marriott-Slaterville, UT 84404, USA

reviews.author: Amber Heywood
reviews.text: Great company, very friendly receptionists, and talented plumbers! Jason has come out and fixed or installed multiple things in our home. We are very happy with happy with their work. Highly recommend 🙌

reviews.author: Customer Service
reviews.text: There are pros and cons lie everything else. I do believe that these prices are outrageous ($250), we basically took out the garbage disposal and reconnected the pipes because the new sink is too deep. I am very impressed that they called me back immediately after leaving a message and they were able to send someone over the same day; which is amazing! The customer service reps were great. The technician was very nice but since we did not re-install the faucet, we were not able to verify if there were any leaks. After he left I installed the faucet myself and water leaked in two spots where the pipes were replaced. I re-tightened them myself.

reviews.author: Megan D
reviews.text: Great service. We had gas line moved and water lines capped for kitchen remodel. Following the cabinet and appliance install, Jason came back to rehook up gas and water to all appliances. He was very thorough and professional. He was very nice as well. Pricing was very fair!

reviews.author: C W
reviews.text:
Great experience once again with S&B.
They will continue to get our business.
Jason did a fantastic job for us. Very polite, helpful, professional and kind.
He fixed the leak, new pipes and unclogged the drain.

reviews.author: Michelle Dahl
reviews.text: We had a leak coming from somewhere dripping into our garage. These guys were so responsive and QUICK. They found the leak, and repaired the issue as well as 3 other unrelated issues we had been worried about. The techs were so nice, and I would 100% reccomend them. I hope I never am in need of a plumber again, but if I do....S&B  is who I will call.

plumbers.address: 8001 E State Rte 69 STE F, Prescott Valley, AZ 86314, USA

reviews.author: bobdon sanders
reviews.text: Thomas was nice and prioritized and explained the parts and maintenance needed.  We paid $1,400 for everything he recommended but wish he would have voluntarily shown us the old and new parts.  I asked him and he mentioned they were in the truck and could show us if we wanted.  I said thats OK.  Just gotta trust Goettl I suppose...ugh

reviews.author: Joan Griffin
reviews.text: The service technician, Moe, was prompt, professional and cordial.  During his inspection he reviewed the options for further maintenance and upgrade. He gave the pros and cons of each system in regards to my situation and hvac needs.  He was knowledgeable and clear in his presentation.  I felt very comfortable with my decision in going forward with his recommendation.  Thank you. Jg

reviews.author: Debra Horan
reviews.text: We had our yearly maintenance check completed and couldn’t be more pleased with the service. Thomas was extremely knowledgeable, thorough, and took the time to patiently explain what was needed for our unit in a way that was easy to understand. We never felt rushed, and all of our questions were answered clearly. It’s refreshing to work with someone who is both professional and genuinely cares about doing the job right. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jerry Carrier
reviews.text:
Thomas Pride did an excellent job of inspecting our HVAC system.  Upon inspection a bid for replacement of a plenum duct above the HVAC unit was submitted which I may have done in future.   At this time the system works perfectly so no repair was scheduled.   Thomas was very thorough in explaining that the HVAC system was clean and working proper internally.  Part of the inspection was to replace three return air filters.
This will satisfy our warranty with the LENNOX product manufacturer.
Thanks go to Thomas Pride for a job well done.
Jerry Carrier

reviews.author: Brindy Bringhurst
reviews.text: Jaxon was super helpful. Did a full inspection of our system and gave honest recommendations on what is needed and why. Showed me photos and measurements. Very thorough. The office is also very pleasant to work with. They’re the first I call for any HVAC needs in cottonwood.

plumbers.name: Reliant Plumbing - Dallas
plumbers.address: 2702 Manor Way, Dallas, TX 75235, USA

reviews.author: Sofia Romero
reviews.text:
Asa from Reliant Plumbing has been out here a lot over the past couple of weeks, and he’s been great every single time. He’s incredibly kind, always explains what’s going on, is honest and genuinely helpful. Even with repeat issues, he stays patient and makes the process way less stressful.
Booking an appointment is also super convenient. The representatives do a wonderful job getting someone out ASAP, which we really appreciate. Overall, great experiences all around and I know they’ll always deliver 😎

reviews.author: Brittany King
reviews.text:
Outstanding Service from Reliant Plumbing!

Mark and James from Reliant Plumbing came out to replace my water heater, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. They were professional, friendly, and very knowledgeable. They explained everything clearly, worked efficiently, and made sure the job was done right before leaving. The area was left clean, and the new water heater is working perfectly. I truly appreciate their great attitude and quality workmanship. I highly recommend Reliant Plumbing, and especially Mark and James, for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Hannah Allison
reviews.text: James and Mark did an absolutely amazing job on my water heater. From start to finish, they were professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly efficient. They took the time to explain what was going on, answered all my questions, and made sure everything was working perfectly before they left. The quality of their work was outstanding, and they left the area clean and tidy. It’s clear they take real pride in what they do. I couldn’t be happier with the service and would highly recommend James and Mark to anyone needing water heater or plumbing work!

reviews.author: Mickey Vogt
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Mark and James did an exceptional job replacing our water line. From start to finish, they were professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly efficient. They took the time to explain the process, answered all our questions, and made sure everything was done right the first time. The work area was kept clean, and the job was completed on schedule with great attention to detail. It’s clear they take pride in their work. I highly recommend Mark and James to anyone needing water line replacement or plumbing work—top-notch service all around!

reviews.author: Terry Allison

And it turns out that I have had several slab leaks from the research that he done, and he gave us a few different quotes.We went ahead and proceeded with a whole house water supply repipe and i could not be more happy with the services that I was provided. reviews.author: Amy E
reviews.text: The team was great to work with. From their customer service and communications (Samantha) to the actual repair / installation (Tim, Aaron, and Ronnie) we had a wonderful experience. They took the time to make sure we understood the details of the project, worked with us on pricing, were able to promptly schedule within two weeks of the date we committed to the project, and took the time to clean up the site and level out the dirt when they were done. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: The Massey's of Carolina
reviews.text:
The team showed up at our home and were extremely professional and efficient. Thank you Jacob and Josh for being so courteous and informative regarding our plumbing matter. Kudos to you both

Rev. Massey

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.text:
I am a property manager and a member of the Upstate Apartment Association. We contracted this company to replace a sewer/drain line, but instead of completing the full replacement, they only applied a patch. The line was still leaking when they left, and when contacted for warranty support, they declined to take responsibility.

Unfortunately, the level of professionalism and follow-through is not what it used to be. This is what can happen when the person who ensured accountability and results is no longer with the company. I will be sharing this experience with others in the association to help them make informed decisions.

reviews.author: Taurus Cohen
reviews.text:
All we knew was that there was a loud noise and then we could tell water was running from somewhere. My husband called Tri-State and was able to make an appointment for the next morning. Jacob came out and advised us of the issue and gave us a quote. He gave us time to discuss and make a decision while he waited patiently in his work vehicle
There was no pressure at all
We agreed and he went straight to work!! He was super pleasant and easy to work with . So was Barbara when we spoke over the phone. I am 100% satisfied! Thanks Jacob!

reviews.author: Stacy M
reviews.text: Could not be more impressed with the outstanding service provided! Brendan and his co-worker (unfortunately did not get his name) were on the scene within one hour of our initial call which was really just for an inquiry. We had never used this company before and relied only on the overwhelmingly positive reviews. They did not disappoint. Professional, courteous, timely, and very reasonably priced! A welcome surprise all the way around. Definitely recommend to anyone in need! Thank you!

reviews.author: Lisa W
reviews.text: Brendin Rebolini was my repair tech. we had an emergency plumbing issue and he was absolutely fabulous. A really great representative of your company, would hire him again. Great job branding and thank you.

reviews.author: Quimby Unsworth
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience, Bluewater is very responsive. Brendin and Tyler were very patient with all my questions and did not hesitate to walk me through all the steps as I could not understand why my showerhead was leaking. They were very professional and kind, I will absolutely use them again and recommend Bluewater to anyone who experiences any plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Pat Ludlow
reviews.text: Brendon and his coworker showed up when they said they would and made the repair quickly, efficiently, professionally with no mess. Thanks Bluewater Plumbing for a job well done. 5 stars

plumbers.name: Texas James Plumbing
plumbers.address: 12450 Galveston Rd Bldg B, Webster, TX 77598, USA

reviews.author: Jose Chavarria
reviews.text:
Rarely do I ever leave reviews, but this experience absolutely deserves one. When I noticed water coming up through my floor, I called Texas James after reaching out to a couple of other companies that couldn’t make it out the same day. Jayden was the technician who came out, and he quickly untangled my web of DIY plumbing to isolate the leak. He walked me through the issue, explained my repair options clearly, and then got to work.

It turned out I had a leak in the foundation, and Jayden was able to reroute the line to fix the problem. His workmanship was top-notch. He took the time to carefully explain the process every step of the way and even fit me into his already packed schedule because he understood how urgent the situation was.

What stood out even more was that he never once asked me to leave a review—something that seems all too common these days. That alone says a lot about their professionalism. While the repair cost several thousand dollars, the work was prompt, high-quality, and ultimately prevented what could have been a much worse situation. These guys are truly top-notch.

reviews.author: David D.
reviews.text:
Shawn and Tyler were professional and personable technicians who quickly diagnosed the issue with our disposal:  a small spoon had wedged itself into the disposal to where it was undetectable to human touch inside the disposal.  They were able to dislodge the spoon and get our old disposal working again.  We appreciated their honesty to repair the disposal rather than selling us a new one.

I found Texas James Plumbing on the Better Business Bureau with a rating of A+.  My wife and I agree with this BBB’s rating and highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Kimberly Kimmel
reviews.text: Shawn and Nash did a fantastic job of installing the new bathroom faucet! They arrived on time, and got right to work.  Did the job at a very reasonable price.  I'm totally happy with the professional  work they did.  I will definitely use Texas James Plumbing again!

reviews.author: Tony Lentini
reviews.text:
Tex, Jayden, Dylan, Will, David, and Tyler
FANTASTIC JOB BY TEXAS JAMES PLUMBING!  Having bulkhead redone and there was a big water leak nobody could find until Tex arrived and after a thorough search found and fixed it.  Turns out the backhoe compressed and broke a water line and irrigation line underground.  Great job by all concerned.  Honest, skilled, fairly priced.  They had me back to normal in a single day!  They've done other work for me and ALWAYS come through.  THE BEST!

reviews.author: Mike Shaw
reviews.text:
Just had parts replaced in my tub/shower. The technicians were Rolando and Preston. Both were very professional and personable. The response time was incredible and price was reasonable. They worked together as a team and repair went perfect. We were so thrilled since my wife wanted her bath. Master bath only has a shower.
Job was so smooth and seamless from start to finish!  Both Rolando and Preston were very competent. Couldn’t be happier. If you want great service at a great price, call Texas James Plumbing. You won’t regret it!!!

plumbers.name: Integrity Plumbing and Drain Service
plumbers.address: 4050 Benfield Dr Suite 1E, Kettering, OH 45429, USA

reviews.author: R Treadwell
reviews.text:
This company truly lives up to its name! This is our second time using Integrity Plumbing, and once again, they exceeded our expectations. The first time, our bathtub kept backing up despite multiple failed attempts from other companies. Integrity came out, got it unclogged, and we haven’t had a problem since!

This time, Devin from Integrity showed up and did an excellent job fixing our leaky garbage disposal and the pipes under the kitchen sink. He clearly knew what he was doing and worked efficiently. On top of that, he gave us a fair and affordable price!

No other company compares to Integrity Plumbing. Thank you for your outstanding service—you’ve earned a lifelong customer! 😁

**** Once again I want to thank Devin and Jaden on snaking my drain once again and finding a toy plastic car in the drain. Also for installing the new faucet and trap with ventilation under my bathroom sink. Thank you Integrity!

reviews.author: Breezy Ballard
reviews.text: After not having a running sink for over a month! They were called at 7 am in the morning and came out and had it fixed by 12:30 pm!! 5 and half hours to get what we needed done  and that’s including going and buying everything needed done also!! I couldn’t have been more appreciative  of the job they did and how great it works and looks now!!

reviews.author: Chris Spaid
reviews.text: I have one of the new construction condos where IPS was the plumbing installer. I figured I would reach out to them to install a water softener system I bought as they should know the ins and outs of all the piping. I had 3 other plumbers physically come out and quote me. IPS though, said they don’t even need to come out, and emailed me a quote quickly. I accepted and scheduled. 30 minutes prior to the 8-11am window, they said I have to reschedule due to company error. Since I took off work to be present, I asked Teresa there’s any discount I can now get as it’s the company’s fault and not mine, she said nope. Whatever, I rescheduled a couple days later and took off work again. Plumbers showed up, investigated, and immediately were questioning the quote that was given to me, as they claimed there was a lot more needed. The guy said we likely need 4-5 hours of work and it’d be ~$400 to do, and they would need to reschedule.. I said if IPS is willing to break a good deal, as not only did they fail to uphold their original quote, but now I’m rescheduling twice. Teresa very quickly sends me a new quote via email while the plumbers are still here and it’s for $1300! How ridiculous, the plumbers walked out with their tails tucked.. I questioned this yet she blamed the reasoning on me for not telling IPS the water softener system has a salt tank and that there’s not much room for installation as if they didn’t do the plumbing for the place? She offered absolutely zero resolution to make a happy customer after multiple failure points on company’s behalf. I couldn’t warn you enough to stay away from Teresa and this company.

reviews.author: Jennifer Franks
reviews.text: I had an emergency plumbing concern that occurred later in the evening and Integrity Plumbing and Drain was able to come out the same night to diagnose and resolve the issue. They did great work, were reasonably priced, and explained what was needed. Several other local companies were booked until at least later the next day. I highly recommend their service and will use them again for any future concerns.

reviews.author: Gabe Lakner
reviews.text: The crew did a good job installing the new water heater. They were professional and everything is working well now! They were a bit late dealing with other jobs, so the job had to be done the second day. There was a little issue in the end since it took me a while to receive the receipt. Home Depot works with Crew 2 that actually scheduled the job with Integrity Plumbing and Integrity Plumbing just recently started working with Home Depot/ Crew 2. So there was some confusion , but was sorted out in the end.

reviews.author: Raphael Villas
reviews.text: Mike was great. He performed a quick assessment, gave a price quote and finished the job quickly. The tracker to help me gauge his arrival time was not accurate but I called their customer service line and was able to get better details easily. Great service. Thanks!

reviews.author: Jeff Varga
reviews.text: Rapid response sent the most amazing team to replace my furnace and 2 AC units. Justin, Leon and Landon were detailed, honest and somewhat perfectionist in my opinion. I was so happy I went with Rapid over the other 3 quotes I got, they really did a great job. These 3 guys worked very hard for 10 hours, cleaned up any messes and I feel like I made the right choice because of them. I work for surveys in my business and I get rewarded for good surveys, so I hope whomever is in charge of giving these guys accolades, pay raises, bonuses, whatever it might be, that you give it to these guys!!!! They are the reason  I would refer Rapid!

reviews.author: Rick Marrs
reviews.text: Due to the storm, which occurred while we were out of town, rapid response has been to our house three times for plumbing heating and electrical issues. Each time the technicians were outstanding, efficient and reasonable, the HVAC technician Keith, and the electrician Jeremiah, quickly diagnosed our problem, and recommended a long-term solution/upgrade. After researching the recommendation, we determined it was the best solution and had the work done. We were so impressed with their professionalism, promptness, and communication that we signed up for their annual maintenance at a very reasonable cost.

reviews.author: Jack Harvey
reviews.text: Neal did a great job! It was on short notice over a holiday week and he came in and did the work efficiently and I thought that the rates charged were fair. Not pushy at all and gave me some extra advice on how to do a couple things myself that were inexpensive. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: David Pair
reviews.text: We had a great experience with rapid response.  The technician (Neal) came on Saturday and addressed the situation timely.  Neal was very knowledgeable and professional.  We needed a bigger fix and he clearly laid out three options and immediately sent estimates for all three.  We called on Monday and they were able to fix the problem that afternoon.

plumbers.name: Absolute Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2803 Justin Rd, Flower Mound, TX 75028, USA

reviews.author: Taylor Bell
reviews.text:
After a long string of disappointing experiences with other plumbers, our trust was pretty much gone. Absolute Plumbing completely restored our confidence, and we can honestly say we will never use another plumbing company again.

Zane was our technician, and he was exceptional in every possible way. He didn’t just fix our issues, he went above and beyond at every step. When we had trouble receiving emails, he personally called us and even brought printed copies of all receipts, quotes, and repair details so we were never left in the dark. That level of care is almost unheard of these days.

We needed several repairs, including a tub spout diverter, a new shower cartridge, and a valve replacement. Zane came to our home three separate times to make sure everything was done perfectly. Each visit, he was respectful, kind, and incredibly generous with his time. Zane even took his shoes off to protect our new carpet. He explained everything clearly, worked efficiently, and treated our home with care.

Most importantly, he charged a very fair price for all the work he did, especially considering the amount of effort and professionalism he brought to the job.

Absolute Plumbing, and especially Zane, exceeded every expectation. If you’re looking for honesty, skill, and genuine kindness, this is the company you want. We couldn’t recommend them more highly.

reviews.author: Teea Talley
reviews.text: I called Absolute Plumbing for a leak detection.  Office person was very friendly and understanding, listened to my issue and quickly identifed and efficiently scheduled an appointment that fit into my schedule. The plumber arrived on time and explained everything clearly. He was friendly, personable and got the job done efficiently. I appreciated the prompt service and professional manners from booking to the payment step. Price was fair for work comleted.  Highly recommend them for any plumbing needs and will be my go-to plumber for any service call going forward.

reviews.author: Doug Dayton
reviews.text: Absolute Plumbing was honest, efficient and arrived exactly on time. The plumber explained the problem clearly and fixed our leak detection issue with impressive expertise. Communication was great from the first call to the completion of the work. I appreciated their punctuality and professional attitude. Highly recommend this plumbing contractor for any job.

reviews.author: Chris Rice
reviews.text: We scheduled a call on Sunday evening on the website. I was called shortly after 8:00am on Monday and the plumber was there around 10:00. Larry did an excellent job and was very friendly. I would recommend Absolute Plumbing and will use them in the future.

reviews.author: Diego Arroyo
reviews.text: Leaking in my sink caused issues in my house. Absolute Plumbing came out the same day I contacted them and fixed it quickly for a decent price. Outstanding service by Larry, who carefully took care of the plumbing.

reviews.author: Jason Hahn
reviews.text:
I can’t recommend this company anymore. I’ve used them three times. (Water Heater Installation, Maintenance, and to help diagnose a leak) The first installation went great — professional and smooth.

The next two visits were disappointing. I was quoted one price over the phone for maintenance but the technician attempted to charge more in person and had to argue to get the original rate honored while warning me of longevity of a system they had just installed 10 months prior. They also misdiagnosed a leak, charged me hundreds for a fix on a drain that didn’t solve the problem, came back out and misdiagnosed again. They referred me to other companies based on the wrong diagnosis. Then the companies referred didn't even do what the plumber thought the issue was. Our problem turned out to take $10 to solve on our own.

They’ve also called me the wrong name every visit despite correcting them. Really frustrating after such a strong first experience.

Sincerely "Josh Yan" lmao

We would highly recommend them for your repairs and installations...large or small!  Thank You Cornerstone!  Connie Carberry - Concierge Realty Associates

Awesome work and will continue to reach out to cornerstone plumbing first.

I highly recommend this company.

reviews.text: Mr. William Copney did an amazing job! After calling the company, he arrived within 30 minutes. We had an issue with our sink and outside spigot. He walked us through the issue and how he was going to fix it. No complaints at all and would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Beverly Kirby

It took several hours to get service because of numerous other emergencies in the area, but once he got here, Joe Hilton was wonderful. He was professional and efficient and I would recommend him as an excellent plumber.

reviews.author: Allison
reviews.text: We had Will come out for a hot water tank issue, and he did a great job! Corrected many issues and educated us in the process. Really personable, knowledgeable, and would definitely use again. Ask for William Copney!

reviews.author: Allie
reviews.text:
This company installed our water softener and the system leaked resin beads into our entire home. They knew the damage this causes, never told us, and claimed it was ‘fixed.’ Over the next year we had failing appliances, pressure issues, leaks, and now potential mold. They refused to acknowledge any responsibility and even charged us full price for a premature water heater replacement caused by their mistake. This is unethical and dangerous service.

*** Thank you for the reply. I will not be calling. For documentation and transparency, I prefer all communication in writing.

To clarify the situation: we have time-stamped photos of the original installation because we were excited to show our family the “upgrade.” These photos clearly show that the water softener was installed incorrectly the first time. The two connection tubes were reversed. When resin beads began leaking into our plumbing, your team returned, swapped out the softener, and reconnected the lines the only other possible way… confirming that the original installation was backwards. We had to discover this ourselves after reviewing the photos.

At no point did anyone warn us of the long-term consequences of resin beads entering a home’s plumbing system. We were told the issue was “fixed,” yet over the next year we experienced repeated leaks, failing appliances, pressure issues, and now potential mold. I have time stamped documentation of all of the above. My boyfriend even had to take a full week of vacation from his night-shift job to deal with the water heater leak that developed almost a year later… damage that directly aligns with resin bead contamination your technician never disclosed.

Because of the MAJOR installation errors, the lack of warning, and the ongoing issues we’ve had to correct ourselves, I no longer feel I can trust your company to give accurate information or handle this responsibly. That is why I am insisting on written communication only.

At this point, I need clear written answers to the following:
1.	How resin beads entered our plumbing system
2.	Whether the original installation met manufacturer specifications
3.	Why we were not informed of risks, symptoms, or what to look for after bead discharge
4.	What corrective action your company is prepared to take

I will continue communication only by email so everything can be properly documented. I look forward to your written response.
