reviews.text:
Quoted $7,755. Final bill: $12,555 — a 60% increase.

We agreed to move forward with a sewer lining project based on a written quote for $7,755, which clearly described the scope, access points, and installation approach. After spending a half day attempting to place the liner, the company stated they could not proceed as quoted due to “too many twists and turns” in the pipe and required additional access.

They asked me to pay them $4,800 to install 3 new access points required to complete the job.  I'm not a sewer expert by any means but I have watched more plumbers than I can count on my fingers scope my sewer lines with extreme precision.  It was very hard for me to process their argument that this was "new scope" due to "unforeseen circumstances".

Pipe geometry and access constraints are fundamental to sewer lining, and nothing about the condition or placement of the pipe changed after the quote was issued. The contract did not include any change-order terms, yet we were presented with a significant price increase once the project was already underway.

I also suggested the company that we "split the difference" as this appeared to be their error in quoting the job rather than a true scope change, but they declined and also informed me that I should actually consider this a "good deal" since normally they would charge even more for the additional services they would be providing.  Oh - and they were also going to let me off the hook for paying for their wasted materials from their first day of work.  Very infuriating conversation....

While the work was ultimately completed, the pricing process felt misleading and left us with little practical choice but to approve a large, unplanned increase. I strongly recommend getting very explicit, written confirmation of all assumptions, access requirements, and pricing change policies before agreeing to proceed.

reviews.text:
I can’t say enough good things about my experience with Home Service Pros and their exceptional electrical work! In 2019, Greg, the owner, was with a different company that installed two Eaton whole-house surge protectors (one for each panel), which I highly recommend. Years later, another contractor noted that the 40A breakers used, while within Eaton’s specifications, weren’t the recommended choice and suggested upgrading to 50A breakers for optimal performance. When I contacted the company Greg no longer owned, I was extremely disappointed with their response. Thankfully, I had Greg’s personal cell number from the original invoice—a classy touch.

I called Greg, now running Home Service Pros, and without hesitation, he sent over John Newman, one of the most professional and courteous electrical technicians I’ve ever met. John arrived within the promised time window, assessed the situation, and completed the repair with expertise. Not only did he do outstanding work, but he also took the time to educate me about electrical panels and the differences between 6- and 8-gauge wiring—great conversation and insight!

In today’s world, it’s rare to find a business owner like Greg, who truly cares about his customers, and a technician like John, who takes such pride in his work. Thank you, Home Service Pros, for your integrity and top-notch service. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: jing chen
reviews.text:
Home Service Pros delivered an outstanding performance in installing the landscape lighting in my yard.

Their team was exceptionally professional, promptly and clearly responding to all inquiries and maintaining close follow-up throughout the project's duration. They were highly flexible, adjusting the plan to perfectly align with my specific needs and budget.

Brad King, the technician assigned to my project, completed the work in a highly efficient manner and ensured the work area was meticulously cleaned, removing all debris upon completion.

I will definitely look for the help from Home Service Pros  next time.

reviews.author: Vincent Siler Sr.
reviews.text: August was prompt and very polite. He assessed the issue with the shower and provided a detailed explanation of what was needed to fix the problem. Once I decided which option to move forward with, he got to work and had the everything fixed and buttoned up within an hour. I'm very satisfied with the service August provided.

plumbers.name: Kavana's Plumbing and Heating
plumbers.address: 5901 W Corcoran Pl, Chicago, IL 60644, USA

reviews.author: Kevin Bueso
reviews.text:
★★★★★ Highly recommend Kavana (Oak Park)!
I had a great experience with Kavana in Oak Park. They came out and fixed a job that had been done by another plumber after a burst pipe—and they did it the right way.

The service was excellent: great advice, no rush-job work, and they were super easy to talk to. They took the time to explain even the smallest details and helped me understand what to do to avoid similar issues in the future.

Someone you can truly rely on. If you want it done right, give them a call.

reviews.author: Richard Bae
reviews.text:
Kavana Plumbing is a highly trustworthy plumbing company. I worked with Mr. Henry regarding an issue with sewage overflowing into my unit, and he was extremely informative throughout the entire process. He took the time to carefully listen to my concerns without rushing, allowing me to fully explain the situation. He clearly outlined the available options and explained the necessary steps to help prevent the problem from happening again.

I truly appreciate how thoroughly he assessed the situation and focused only on the repairs that were actually needed, without suggesting unnecessary work. He is also very responsive and quick to come out when needed. Overall, it was a very professional and reassuring experience.

reviews.author: rameez baig
reviews.text:
Henry is hands down an amazing plumber. When my radiator burst, it was extremely stressful and I was having a hard time finding anyone who could come out quickly. Henry stayed on the phone with me for over an hour and calmly walked me through exactly what to shut off and where to go so I could minimize the damage and protect my home. That alone was above and beyond.

He then came out, removed the radiator, and properly capped everything off. He was professional, knowledgeable, efficient, and an absolute gentleman the entire time. If you’re looking for someone dependable who truly cares and takes pride in his work, Henry is your guy. I can’t recommend him highly enough. I would absolutely call Henry again in the future. Thank you, Henry, for all your help!

reviews.author: Jeanette
reviews.text: Henry was very honest, which is extremely important to me, and something that’s hard to find. He was upfront about everything, explained the issue clearly, and didn’t try to upsell or add unnecessary work. Very affordable and the quality of work was great. I truly appreciate his integrity and would absolutely recommend him.

reviews.author: EMPRESS T
reviews.text: Selling my home and was started panicking less than a week before closing due to a blockage in the kitchen sink.  Henry spent literally a total of at least an hour over 2 days asking questions to determine if I needed an emergency appointment on a Sat (or one at all) which I was more than happy to pay for.  Based on what he thought was the issue and possible fixes, I felt better and was ok with waiting until Monday.  I let him know my "main" concern with rodding & it causing an issue somewhere else in the pipes which I experienced some years ago when I had the sink rodded. Henry used the less aggressive measure (I forgot what he said he used but it was a snake) and thankfully it worked like a charm. As a single woman who unfortunately have had my share of "crooks", I definitely recommend him and would call again if he services my new location for the job needed.

plumbers.address: 2157 Rich St, Charleston, SC 29405, USA

reviews.author: Jerry Sesame
reviews.text: Spencer came out to fix a dripping issue with my shower where water was constantly coming from the faucet, and he also repaired a couple of faucets around the house. He was on time, professional, and explained what was causing the problem in a way that made sense. I really appreciated how honest he was about the work and pricing. He got everything fixed quickly and made sure it was done right before leaving. Great experience overall — I’d definitely recommend him to anyone needing plumbing work.

reviews.author: Kalleigh Norval
reviews.text: We had a bit of an emergency plumbing situation and a neighbor recommended Blue Collars. From the start, Clayton and the team were friendly, punctual, and clearly had great expertise. They explained everything they were doing at each step and made sure to stick around until the issue was properly resolved (which included some work from the city!). Can’t thank them enough, will definitely recommend and call again if needed!

reviews.author: Bora Yatagan
reviews.text:
I’ve had a great experience working with the Blue Color HVAC department. The team is knowledgeable, responsive, and always willing to help when it matters most. Big shoutout to Andrew, Jordan, Wess, Marc, and PK these guys have come through for me multiple times and truly know their stuff.
It’s good to know you’re working with people you can rely on when you need support. I really enjoy working with this team and appreciate everything they do.

reviews.author: Jonathan Cook
reviews.text: Andrew has been amazing to work with from the minute I reached out to him. He came out the next day to understand the problem with my current HVAC unit, identified the problem immediately with the most cost effective solution, and was extremely flexible on dates for implementing the solution. He was extremely knowledgeable about the humidity problem I was having in my apt and made me feel extremely confident about choosing blue collars for the solution. The communication and working with blue collars has been an absolute pleasure. I highly recommend! Hire an HVAC company you can trust to do high quality work at a fair price!

reviews.author: Michael Kovaleski
reviews.text:
This review is specifically for the HVAC department at Blue Collars.

I manage almost 400 apartments with hvac units that are going on 11 years old.  These are my go to people for major repairs and system replacements.

The HVAC team is extremely reliable, always on time, very professional, and excellent at communicating throughout the entire process. Their work is top-notch and done right the first time.

Shout out to Andrew, Marc, Jordan, Wess, and PK — great people who represent Blue Collar’s HVAC department well.

I highly recommend Blue Collar’s HVAC services.

plumbers.name: Straight Plumbing Llc
plumbers.address: 3035 Rocks Rd, Jarrettsville, MD 21084, USA

reviews.author: Marc Hecht
reviews.text:
During a family emergency, and two weeks after buying the new house, our plumbing decided it was time to back up. After another plumber “did their best” to open my drain line, and tried upselling me to replace the world. I decided to go local.

I called and left a message for Joe. He was so calm about the situation, I instantly felt comfortable with his plan. Get one of his team out to inspect the line. They found that there is a 4 inch root blocking a 6 inch 65-year old terracotta pipe. They opened up the line and assured me things would be fine until the replacement.

We scheduled a day. Unfortunately, rain was predicted and we rescheduled at Joe’s best advice (he truly did not want to trash our lawn).

Today was the day…what an effort! Joe and his team replaced the main drain line, and at his suggestion, the water line. The team was meticulous in their work. Everything was accomplished in a day. Completed way above and beyond my expectations, including putting the lawn back together and reseeding it. The work was done on the exact quoted amount, which I feel was priced accordingly to the professional expert level skills of the team. I cannot thank Joe enough for walking me through this process and truly being a pro that I will trust for any plumbing work. Please support local and go with Straight Plumbing. You will not regret it.

reviews.author: Theresa Varipatis
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Robert unclogging my washing machine's drain.  Before calling this company, another plumber tried to snake the line through the traps, couldn't get through,  still charged me, and suggested my basement floor would need to be jackhammered to reach the pipe.

Robert came with the right tools and knowledge. He properly removed the traps and used the correct equipment to clear the clog.      He quickly identified that the pipe was cast iron and explained how these pipes rust from the inside causing them to close up.  He was able to break through with using the correct tool.
In less than an hour, the drain was completely cleared and he tested it by running the washer to make sure  everything worked properly.
Joe the owner even followed up with a phone call afterward.  After speaking with him, it was clear that he runs his company with integrity and strong work ethics.
I highly recommend this company. If you want the job done correctly the first time by knowledgeable professionals who truly care, this is the company to call.

reviews.author: Chris Holle
reviews.text:
Joe Tull from Straight Plumbing LLC was honestly great to work with. From day one he stayed in contact with me while I was dealing with my insurance company and explained everything straight up. No BS, no upselling, just told me how it was and what to expect.

He told me he’d be there at 8am and actually showed up early ready to get to work. The job was a full main water line replacement, which meant digging up the yard and breaking up concrete inside the house. He got everything done in just a few hours, kept the work area clean the entire time, and made sure everything looked good before he left.

Outside, the ground was dug up, the line replaced, and everything was seeded when they were done. Inside, the concrete was patched and it looks great. For a big job, it was smooth and stress-free.

Very professional, honest, and reliable. I’d definitely recommend Joe and Straight Plumbing LLC to anyone who needs a plumber they can trust.

reviews.author: Stuart J
reviews.text:
ROB Was fantastic !!!!!!!
He was able to fix the problem in a few hours he was very professional and explained the problem. My hot and cold mixing valve was bad.
IF you ever need a QUALITY Plumbers choose Straight Plumbing for fast efficient service.

Update  Joe and Rob came back out today and replaced the water heater they did a fantastic job cleaned up the pipeing it looks really good I highly recommend these guys that do great work

reviews.author: Tom A
reviews.text: These guys are awesome! They installed our spin down, neutralizer and softener system. Everything seems to be working great. I didn't realized this is something we needed until it was installed and we started using it. I have noticed big differences within the house. Our appliances (refrigerator ice maker and water line, dishwasher, washing machine) seem to be running smoother, our skin is not all super dry when we get out of the shower and it seems like it's actually dissolving the hard water stains on the shower head as we use it. So overall I am very impressed with everything. That also includes the super fast next day installation, even coming out the following day to fix the small leak and answering all of my questions about how to maintain the system. I will definitely be keeping their contact information for any and all future plumbing and/or well needs.

reviews.author: Emily Leber
reviews.text: Newberry Plumbing is a great, reliable company for all your plumbing needs. They were professional, on time, and clearly knew what they were doing. The work was done right the first time, and the pricing was fair. It’s hard to find trustworthy plumbers these days, but Newberry Plumbing definitely delivers. I highly recommend them to anyone needing quality plumbing service! Chad is the best!

reviews.author: Teresa Rembelles
reviews.text: Our plumber had retired, and each time that we needed a plumber after that, we were not satisfied. Then our neighbor recommended Newberry. Chad with Newberry Plumbing is great! We are confident each time that he leaves, that the work is done correctly and is high quality. It’s a bonus that Chad is really responsive and arrives when he says he will! We are extremely satisfied!

reviews.author: Lucie Pepe
reviews.text: Newberry Plumbing has worked in my home three times.  In November '25, Chad Jr. replaced a toilet ring whose malfunction caused water to drip from my basement's ceiling.  During the appointment, I asked Chad Jr. to check my hot water heater and was grateful that he noticed a faulty expansion tank which he came to replace in December.  In February '26, I noticed another drip from the basement's ceiling and traced it to a faulty valve under the kitchen sink.  Chad fixed the leak by replacing the valve and replaced the other two corroded valves at the same time.  I noticed both ceiling leaks on Saturday evenings and each time, Chad responded five minutes after I texted him.  Both times, I was given Monday morning appointments and advice on what to do to ensure that further water damage did not occur.  During all appointments, Chad gave job estimates, came on time, did phenomenal work, charged reasonable prices, answered all of my questions, and pointed out problems when I asked him or when he noticed them.  In April, I plan on replacing a leaking outside pipe and faucet and look forward to working with Newberry Plumbing.  Both Chad and Chad Jr. are awesome at what they do, I am grateful for knowing them, and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Allen Hilton
reviews.text: Needed some work done on my bathroom plumbing.  I contacted Newberry plumbing and spoke to Chad.  He was very friendly and knowledgeable.  Once he got to my house he was extremely professional, and got straight to work. I would recommend Newberry plumbing 1000x to anyone looking for a professional licensed plumber 10/10

reviews.author: Pete Klemans
reviews.text: Chad and his son replaced 10 water shutoff valves for us … great job!  Very professional, personable, quality work, good price.  We definitely won’t hesitate to call them again.  A+++

Thank you, Bobby and partner.

Perfect and quickly done, not a week later. Thanks again for a job well done. A+++! I will definitely be callibg you again if i need a plumber. Promise.

reviews.author: Perry Alonso
reviews.text:
I had two, almost 10 years old, 40gal water heaters that both went out at the same exact time. 1st company I called wanted an arm, a leg, a few kidneys, my first born son and the title to my truck. That was a no-go. I found Carey Plumbing through a simple search on the internet for “the best plumbers in Katy.” Scrolled through a few and found Carey Plumbing. Within about 10 minutes of filling out an appointment request on their web site, Mike (The Owner) called. I gave him a brief description of what I needed done and he gave me a quote over the phone with exactly what products he used, what he would do and the price. No gimmicks - just an honest, true to his word quote. I called him back within a few hours and said let’s go! They accommodated my schedule and were able to come out the same day. They arrived around 6p and were done by 830p.
Fantastic service from start to finish. They explained everything they did, talked about the water heaters, and reminded me to fill out the registration online so the manufacturer would increase my warranty.
Definitely recommend Carey Plumbing for whatever problem you have. Professional, friendly, great work, and most importantly honest.

reviews.author: Charles Marino
reviews.text: Highly recommended! They replaced the sprinkler backflow valve. They did a fantastic job and explained exactly what failed and gave advice for future. Quick and professional!

reviews.author: Emily B
reviews.text: Mike has provided extremely reliable and professional plumbing service for us at very competitive rates. I appreciate his work, professionalism, and courtesy very much.

Highly recommend PJ’s Plumbing!

reviews.author: Jeanne Carter

She then updated me with a text to say Scott would be here in 1/2 hour. Scott was amazing! I had used every towel I had cleaning up water but it was still a pond under the sink and on the kitchen floor. He got right in, diagnosed the issue and replaced the cracked water line, even going out to the store to get the exact right part when he wasn’t positive the one he installed wouldn’t leak in the near future. Great job! I am so grateful!!

reviews.author: Craig Nelson
reviews.text: Scott and Connor replaced 2 shut off valves at our home today. Did an excellent job, and good clean up before they left. Great service and reasonable cost. We’ve used PJ’s before and will definitely be happy to use them again.

I appreciate how thorough his repair was. He's definitely a pro.

I like this company a lot and their work.

reviews.author: Angie Cabell

reviews.author: Eli Glass

reviews.author: John D
reviews.text:
Our 13-year-old, 40-gallon water heater was starting to show signs of aging and capacity limitations. After a quick online search for vendors in the area, I came across Plumbing Solutions, a company with plenty of positive reviews. Before calling them, I researched hybrid water heaters that could significantly upgrade our current unit, and I found Bradford White. Bradford White is an American-made water heater that requires a professional installer.

Fortunately, Plumbing Solutions was listed as an approved licensed installer, which reinforced my decision to contact them. Within a day, David Pellot (Master Plumber) arrived at our house to discuss options. After about 15 minutes of conversation, we decided to request quotes for the 65-gallon and 80-gallon models from Rheem and Bradford White for comparison. They provided four quotes within a couple of days (possibly sooner, as I had some issues with email). Due to the hybrid water heater, additional PVC drain lines needed to be installed through our exterior concrete wall. The costs for these larger hybrid water heaters, along with labor, were in line with other estimates I had seen in the area. David, with over 45 years of plumbing experience—beginning in New York—impressed me with his confidence in their ability to do the job right.

On the morning of the scheduled installation window (8:00 - 10:00 a.m.), Reynaldo Cruz and another gentleman arrived exactly at 8:00 a.m.! I spoke with them briefly and then allowed them to focus on their work. I periodically checked in, both in case they needed anything and out of curiosity. Before long, the new, large 80-gallon Bradford White AeroTherm G2 Hybrid Water Heater was in place, and they were replacing all the visible water lines to better accommodate the much larger unit. The only unforeseen expense was an additional charge for redoing the electrical whip so that it would reach the far right side of the water heater. They did a great job and charged me $150 for that work; I don't remember the exact amount, but an electrician would likely charge more. Total cost was around $6,500, but will last 15-20 years, if not more.

After everything was installed, they discussed additional details about the unit, such as how effectively it would remove humid, hot air from the garage during the summer, which essentially cools off the space—awesome! I thanked them for a job well done and commented on how neatly the new lines were installed, which I truly appreciated. It was easy to download the Bradford White app and connect to the unit. Now, we enjoy hotter water that won’t run out during back-to-back usage! Additionally, the Bradford White option ended up being hundreds less than the equivalent Rheem option and is reputed to be the best!

And before I forget, the lovely lady who would always answer the phone when I had a question or submitting payment, was always upbeat, patient, and kind! I believe Hannah was her name.

reviews.author: Gee Foo
reviews.text: Hate to give less than 4 stars to any company, but this can't be helped. My tech arrived on time and was professional. We looked over the area. I told him I moved my shelves to ensure he had enough room, and he said, "Plenty of room," and everything was good to go. He then drained my old water tank with a hose. He called me out to show me that the new unit was dented and he had to get a new one. When he returned and completed the install, I asked about the expansion tank and the water pan, and he stated I didn't need either. I could understand the water pan, but not the Expansion Tank (which was a level of safety to me). He stated he could go get one from Lowe's; I stated I wanted one from his warehouse, not Lowe's. He made a call and stated he would come back tomorrow to install the Expansion Tank. The next day he returned, and there was minimal communication with me. He just installed the Expansion Tank. I came out and asked about turning the hot water higher, and he stated he couldn't due to safety issues (I understood that) and asked him, with the spout turned toward my cabinets, would I have to move them each time I needed to drain the tank? He stated yes. I would have preferred the tank to be turned in a way that doesn't require moving the shelves, but at this point, I wasn't going to make any more suggestions. I just wanted to get this install completed and find a way to get the Water Heater twisted 20 degrees to make room to connect a hose without moving the shelf. Day one, he placed the old unit draining near the driveway, where, when he moved it to go in the truck, some brownish water stained the driveway, and when he left and returned the next day, the stain was still there. I had to treat the area, scrub with a broom to remove it. I don't interpret this as a reflection of the company or a negative reflection on the installer (he just wasn't the guy for me). Would have like the thermostat turned up to 125 degrees but he stated he couldnt do so. The installer and I didn't see eye to eye, which made for a poor installation experience, with me having to figure out how to correct these issues.

Go to going forward and will highly

plumbers.name: Barker Brothers Plumbers
plumbers.address: 2173 N 2000 W #2760, Clinton, UT 84015, USA

reviews.author: Elena Henry
reviews.text: Today I had Barker Brothers Plumbers replace two toilets and three bathroom sink faucets, and the whole plumbing upgrade turned out great. The original toilets were very small and low, so they were uncomfortable for everyday use, especially for my teenage son. We switched to ADA-height toilets because my mom has mobility issues and needed something safer and easier to use without adding any extra toilet seat attachment. The new toilets are a perfect height for her, and now sitting down and standing up is much easier. We also replaced the old bathroom faucets, which had outdated crystal-style knobs and very low clearance. The new high-arc faucets look much more modern and make handwashing far easier since there is finally enough room under the spout. This plumbing update made the bathrooms much more functional and comfortable for the whole family. Brett and Ian were very considerate and professional throughout the visit. They called before heading over and then checked in again when they arrived because they knew I was working from home and did not want to interrupt a meeting by ringing the doorbell. They worked quickly, handled the toilet installation and faucet replacement efficiently, and everything went smoothly from start to finish. I had been concerned that the new toilets might not fit in place of the old ones, but the fit was just right. Very happy with the service, communication, and overall quality of the plumbing work.

reviews.author: Jack Schneider
reviews.text: I reached out to Barker Brothers Plumbers for a quote on replacing a commercial water heater. Not only did Ian answer my call right away, but he also went straight to the site to assess the job and provided the most competitive estimate I received. After speaking with him, I felt confident we were in good hands. We decided to move forward, and the team arrived first thing in the morning to complete the water heater replacement. The work was done quickly and efficiently, just as promised, and our tenants were relieved to have hot water restored without any issues. A week later, I had a clogged drain at another property. I called again, and this time Ian and Brett showed up within an hour. They provided a temporary solution so water could still be used, then came back the next day to fully fix the main line drain, which was a tough job. The work was thorough and done to a high standard. This company has skilled, reliable plumbers who really care about their work. I highly recommend reaching out to them for any plumbing needs. I have been very pleased with their service every time.

reviews.author: Chelsey Wheeler
reviews.text: We recently discovered a leak in our main sewage line at our home in Clinton and were worried it would be really expensive to fix. I was a bit nervous to call a plumber since you never know what to expect, but I remembered that we had used this team before to install our new water heater, and they did excellent work back then. Ian and Brett were honest and didn’t try to upsell us or say we needed to replace the whole pipe when it wasn’t necessary. They arrived right on time, were polite and friendly, and got the job done quickly and neatly. The quality of their plumbing work, their straightforward approach, and their great customer service made the whole experience stress-free. I’m very happy with the results and will definitely call them for any plumbing repairs or projects in the future.

reviews.author: Addison Cervantes
reviews.text: The plumbing team was extremely efficient, professional, and offered fair prices when they came out to Clinton to replace my pressure reducing valve and water heater expansion tank. They also helped adjust some fixtures and installed a new sink for me. Brett was great about working with my schedule and was always quick to respond over the phone. The plumber arrived right when he said he would and treated my home with respect, wearing shoe covers and making sure everything was spotless before leaving. I’m really pleased with how everything turned out and will definitely use their plumbing services again in the future!

reviews.author: Lydia5 C
reviews.text: I needed a gas-certified plumber in Clinton, and I was glad to find a company that could send someone with the right experience. Brett came out to help with a main water line repair to my house and installed a new quality shut-off valve and hose bib. He also disconnected my propane dryer so I could move it out, saving me from having to call a separate propane tech and pay extra charges. Brett was extremely professional and knowledgeable, and you could tell he had many years of experience. He was also mentoring a polite trainee, which made me feel good about how the company invests in its new plumbers. Brett took the time to answer all my questions, showed me different parts for possible future projects, and gave helpful advice along the way. The price for the work was fair, and I appreciated that there was no visit fee for the estimate. The whole process, from my first phone call to the job being finished, was smooth and efficient. Brett used his tablet to give me clear pricing options for the main repair and extra parts, and everything was explained well. I had received another estimate from a different company, and their quote was almost three times as much for the same job. They seemed to price each part as if it was a separate visit, which made their total much higher. It made me appreciate even more how this company trains their plumbers and provides honest, reasonable pricing. Overall, I’m very satisfied with the work done and how the company supports its employees and customers. I would definitely use them again for any plumbing needs in Clinton.

reviews.author: Lauren Long
reviews.text:
Terrible experience. The technician sent was unable to perform the job alone, yet I was billed for their inability to properly staff the service call. My private plumber confirmed their proposed solution to install another pressure valve at the other end was unnecessary, if they had been properly staffed with the appropriate amount of technicians for the job, the job could’ve been completed. I reached out after it was done on February 12, I got no response from the message. I left with Megan at the Cullman office and also no response from their website when I wrote to them as well. I received a bill on March 9 with no communication from them whatsoever, called again spoke with Megan again where she advised me she would get with a manager -  she did call me back this time and said there was nothing their manager can do because the technician had already spent the time. This customer service is unacceptable and I would not recommend this company.

After reviewing the contract with legal counsel, I am prepared to dispute the full leak detection charge based on the terms of the Standard Work Authorization and the circumstances of the service visit.

According to the agreement, the service being purchased was “Leak Detection” with an estimated charge of $424 for two hours of detection time. However, during the visit the technician informed me that he was unable to properly perform the detection process because the gas used to pressurize the line escaped before he could attempt to locate the leak. He further stated that a plumber would first need to install an additional pressure regulator at the opposite end of the line so the system could be filled and tested before the gas escaped. He also indicated that this situation effectively required additional assistance in order to properly conduct the test.

Because the line could not be adequately pressurized, the leak detection procedure described in the work authorization was never actually completed. The technician therefore did not perform the service outlined in the agreement, but instead determined that the system required additional preparation before leak detection could even occur.

The agreement also states that if service is cancelled at the time of arrival, a $150 service call fee will apply. Since the leak detection service itself was not able to be performed, my attorney has advised the appropriate charge would be limited to the service call rather than the full leak detection fee.

Shannon Long
205 NeSmith Road

reviews.author: Gary Streifer
reviews.text:
I hired this company in Sept 2025 to install a sump pump discharge line for $2,200. I was hesitant about running the pipe outside, but was assured by the installer it would be fine, because if installed right,  and being a high pressure line, he insisted I would have no issues. However, the line froze and cracked before getting thru the first winter.  They did come back to look at the issue after I called in the broken pipe, however, they told me a sag in the way the  pipe was installed,  caused the problem.  They then said they fixed the sag, and shouldn't have a problem again. Unfortunately, just two days later, even with the worst of the cold over, the line still froze and cracked again.

After the second failure, I called them once again, they sent a different crew to my house, told me this set up is not going to work,  left the broken pipe there, and told me that for another $1,800 they could reroute it inside the house, but they couldn't guarantee that would work either. I ended up hiring another licensed plumber who said the original installation was done very poorly, with improper pitch and an exterior setup prone to freezing.

I ultimately had to pay twice to correct a problem that should have been installed properly the first time.  This job was done very poorly by them, looks more like a DIY job than a licensed plumber, and they did not back up their work.
