reviews.author: Amy Focht
reviews.text: I called on a Friday morning and spoke with a nice lady who booked a tech to come out the same day between 12-5 pm to replace our sump pump. I told her we already have the new unit. I asked for a ballpark estimate for labor and she wasn't able to tell me that over the phone, which should have been a red flag. She assured me that rhe tech would look at the situation, give me a quote, and once agreed upon, perform the work right then. So..we waited and Roody showed up a little after 5 (the company did text to let me know he was running behind). He looked at the sump pump pit and determined this basic plumbing repair would take him over an hour to do and he doesn't usually use box store products, but he would do it for us, though he would highly recommend their company's commercial grade system. So he went out to his truck to gather quotes. He came back in and told us It would be $615 to replace the pump. For 1-1.5 hours of labor. Guys this is a plumber. Not an anesthesiologist or lawyer. Do not let this company rip you off. Their commercial grade system was over $3k. Needless to say we declined. Maybe we were naive, but we did not realize corporate companies like this charge significantly more than local plumbers. Lesson learned.

reviews.author: Lisa Jeter
reviews.text: Mr. Moonbeck arrived on time and resolved the water heater problem expediently.  I also enjoyed the education he provided about improving the performance of my water heater with preventive maintenance tips.  I would and will likely trust his help in the future.

reviews.author: Carol York
reviews.text: I called Huber Heights Plumbing, 5 Star Home Services for a second opinion after an unpleasant encounter with another company. Amy that I spoke with first was so kind and assured me she would have someone come that night. Chris Sanchez was visibly concerned with the mess the other company had left. He assured me they could help me. Dustin Schmidt and James Ashley were heaven sent. Bless them. They worked so incredibly hard while assuring me things would be all right. It was very obvious that they genuinely wanted to help.The issue was completely resolved without tearing out my driveway or digging up my yard. It was done at a fraction of the cost the other company had quoted me. I am so deeply grateful for your professionalism, kindness and skill. God sends his angels when they are needed. Your company is the only one I will use and the only one I will recommend. Thank you

reviews.author: Ma Bo
reviews.text: Very Professional,  friendly, and timely.  Explained everything and our dogs loved him.  He kept us in the loop and worry free. Would want him for all future repairs!

Once I heard the price, I wanted to call a different company, but then I was on the hook for the 99$ privilege of having the gentleman tell me what I already knew...the line needed snaked.  Lesson learned.  Go elsewhere.  Eco plumbing runs circles around these folks.

Thank you for the great service.

reviews.author: joanne miesen
reviews.text:
Mike was very personable and approached my repipe project with professionalism. He pointed out all the areas of my home that would be affected; I think we only missed one which was in the garage. He did two walk-throughs and really helped me understand what needed to be relocated so his crew would have ample room to work.

Unfortunately, and this is hard to even write since I imagined a much different outcome, quite a few parts of this project are still incomplete as of today and it has been 4 weeks. Mike promised a final walk through and so far he has not reached out. I also feel the crew didn't leave my home as they found it. Quite a bit of debris was leftover (inside and out) and they even drilled a new hole in my bathroom floor when the route should've been through the wall, which was confirmed during the walk-through. And yes, I know changes can come about but no one ever came to me to discuss. They just took the path of least resistance.

Most of the incomplete work I ran across initially I put into a document for Mike to review. He thanked me for that and promised the tasks would be taken care of. Several were not -- which included easy stuff like making sure the new fixtures were properly caulked and also secure within the walls.

One amazing thing his tech Joey did was completely install my new dishwasher. My home was subject to water damage last September and I've been doing dishes in my bathroom because I only have half a kitchen. This was a wonderful surprise.

reviews.author: Scott Melchior
reviews.text:

On top of that, the price was very reasonable. I honestly expected to pay more for such fast service. It’s refreshing to find a company that shows up when they say they will, does quality work, and charges fairly.

I highly recommend Perfect Service Plumbing and Drain Cleaning.

I’ve found my go-to plumber in the future, highly recommended!

Today Eric came out to look at some concerns my home inspector brought up, and after he thoroughly inspected everything he explained to me what my options were. I will definitely continue to call these guys as they have been prompt, honest, and reasonably priced.

reviews.author: lila day
reviews.text:
Eric is absolutely amazing! I can’t recommend him highly enough! He was incredibly thorough, warm, friendly, and an excellent communicator. He quickly identified and resolved the problem. I’m honestly amazed. A 10/10 experience, and I would absolutely recommend him to anyone.

He also efficiently fixed our leaking toilet and garbage disposal. Honestly, so impressed!

reviews.author: Christopher Toole

reviews.text: Don has been doing our plumbing for years. I wouldn't call anyone else. He friendly, very responsive and most importantly very good at what he does. reviews.author: Power Em
reviews.text:
Great service. Found PHI Plumbing and Don via Google searching around locally for a licensed plumber. My house is about 20 years old and needed to replace my 10-year-old water heater which had sprung a leak. I wanted someone local, knowledgeable, and experienced.

Don was great to work with. We spoke over the phone and gave me a general ballpark idea of what it was going to cost me to replace it. After doing the bid dance with a couple of other local companies including going to Lowes to see what their installer would charge, I decided to go with Don / PHI as they were to most competitive and straightforward with me. The other guys kept providing expensive options and up sales.

He was able to get me in immediately and had the material ready to go in his work van. The installation was very quick and was able to get my new water heater up and running. Clean, efficient, friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful.

I highly recommend Don and PHI Plumbing. I got his number ready to go for the next project.

Thanks, Don!

reviews.author: Kunal Teeda
reviews.text:
A completely unnecessary upsell — get a second opinion before using this company

I called Benjamin Franklin Plumbing to diagnose a leaking faucet. The technician took a quick look and immediately quoted me over $700 to replace the entire faucet. No real explanation, no attempt to troubleshoot, and not a single alternative option offered.

What actually fixed it? A $20 cartridge replacement. I confirmed the issue myself and repaired it in minutes. No full replacement needed. No $700 bill. Just a basic part the technician never bothered to check.

This wasn’t just a high quote. It was a wrong diagnosis that would’ve cost me hundreds of dollars for work that wasn’t necessary. That’s a serious trust problem.

If I hadn’t stopped to verify the issue on my own, I would’ve been charged more than 30 times the cost of the real fix.

I won’t be calling this company again, and I strongly recommend anyone reading this to always get a second opinion. A plumbing company should solve your problem—not create an expensive one.

reviews.author: Ryan James
reviews.text: Highly recommended company and services from my experience using Benjamin Franklin  plumbing.  If you are lucky enough to get the technician I had, his name is Ira Miller, then you can feel comfortable and confident that you are in good hands.  Thanks again for the  services provided.

reviews.author: Adam Holmwood
reviews.text:
It takes a lot for me to be compelled to write a poor review. We hired Benjamin Franklin Plumbing (Columbia, MD) on August 29, 2025 to clear a clog in our kitchen sink. The technician was here for about 40 minutes and used a standard Snake K-60 machine (the type you can rent at Home Depot for ~$75/day). The total bill was $650, which was shocking compared to the $350–$400 range that we later learned other reputable companies typically charge for the same service and labor.

I called Benjamin Franklin Plumbing's office three separate times (Aug. 30, Sept. 3, and Sept. 5) asking to please speak with a manager or owner about the invoice. Each time I was promised a call back within 48–72 business hours. No one ever returned my calls. On my third attempt, the receptionist became argumentative instead of assuring me I would receive a call back.

In my opinion, this company overcharged us and then refused to provide any accountability or even a courtesy call back from management. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this company and would advise others to shop around before calling them.

reviews.text:
Paid $19,000.00

I normally do not write reviews, but what happened to Miss Tina, an 87-year-old handicapped homeowner, deserves to be publicly documented. This company took advantage of an elderly woman who could not read or understand the contract she was signing. She trusted them as licensed professionals, and instead she ended up with open holes left in her walls for two years.

Those openings allowed rats to enter her home and cause even more damage. When I finally discovered the problem a month ago, it was obvious the work had been rushed and done without any care. Wires were cut and taped together inside the walls, nothing was properly fastened, and some of the work was simply never completed. Parts of the home were left exposed long enough for pests to move in and out freely.

When we contacted the company for help, the prices they quoted were shocking. A one-day job started at $9,500 before dropping thousands of dollars in minutes. A larger job went from $22,000 to $19,000 with no real explanation. It became clear this wasn’t professional estimating—it was predatory pricing aimed at someone they assumed wouldn’t question it. Another plumber later completed one of these “$9,500 jobs” in a couple of hours.

When their representative finally came out, the solution offered was to simply “patch and paint” over everything. No addressing the rodents, no correcting the unsafe wiring, no accountability. Just a superficial cover-up of the damage their crew left behind. And then we never heard back from them.

Miss Tina relies on others to help her because she is largely blind. She had no way to catch what happened until I stepped in. What’s most painful is that she trusted them. She trusted the explanations, the pricing, and the work—and they took full advantage of that trust.

We have since had an independent assessment done, and multiple violations were confirmed. The entire job will need to be redone by a professional.

This experience has been devastating for her emotionally and financially. No elderly homeowner should ever be put through something like this. If you have vulnerable family members, please think twice before hiring this company.

The photos I uploaded point out that they covered a wall outlet with their hoses making it impossible to access as well as the holes that were left open interior and exterior, also no straps and organized
Code violations, several.

reviews.author: Alex Garcia
reviews.text:
Yesterday I had a major issue with my kitchen sink. It was completely backed up and not draining at all. I tried every DIY trick I could think of, but nothing worked. After reading all the great reviews on Yelp and Google, I decided to give I Love Sewers Rooter and Plumbing a call, and I’m really glad I did.

When I called, Brittany was very helpful and quickly scheduled a technician named Nico. He arrived within two hours, right on time. Nico was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to properly diagnose the issue. He ran a camera down the drain and found a heavy sludge buildup that was preventing the pipe from draining correctly.

He recommended hydro jetting to clear the line. After completing the service, he showed me the before and after camera footage. The difference was huge and the line looked significantly cleaner. My sink is now draining perfectly.

Their pricing was very reasonable and the quality of work was excellent. I will definitely be calling I Love Sewers Rooter and Plumbing again for any future plumbing needs. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kimberly Chan
reviews.text: Our main sewer was backing up repeatedly. Other plumbers kept snaking the line with no permanent results. I Love Sewers came in, ran a proper inspection, and found deep root intrusion. They jetted the line and installed a cleanout so we wouldn’t have this issue again. Everything was done under warranty, and I got full documentation with before-and-after video. That’s how it should be done.

reviews.author: Miklos Brown
reviews.text:
I can’t recommend I Love Sewers Rooter and Plumbing enough! I had a serious issue where none of my drains were working and my whole house was starting to smell. The owner, Carlos, showed up within an hour and immediately ran a camera inspection. He discovered not only a sewage backup, but also tree roots that had grown into my sewer line causing the main issue.

Carlos and his team replaced the entire main sewer line with a brand new, high-quality line that’s up to code, and they also installed a 2-way clean out for easy maintenance in the future. Carlos did an amazing job explaining everything to me step by step, showing me the camera footage, and making sure I understood exactly what needed to be fixed.

The whole process was professional, efficient, and stress-free. If you ever have plumbing problems, I highly recommend calling the I Love Sewers team they saved me from what could have been a nightmare!

reviews.author: Madeline DiDonato
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Outstanding Service from MVP Plumbing!

I can’t say enough great things about MVP Plumbing and their incredible team. We had been dealing with a slow kitchen drain for quite a while and tried everything ourselves — plunging, being extremely careful about what went down the drain, basically only letting water go through it — but nothing solved the issue. Then one morning we woke up and the sink wouldn’t drain at all.

We contacted MVP Plumbing and spoke with Danielle, who was incredibly kind and understanding about how urgent a kitchen sink issue can be. Within minutes she called back and let us know that Jeff, the plumber, would be there between 1–4 PM.

Jeff actually arrived a little after 1 PM, which we really appreciated. He was fantastic — professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain everything he was doing so we understood the issue. It turned out the line needed to be snaked. Mark arrived shortly after to help Jeff, and together they were able to get the blockage out of the pipe.

From Danielle’s quick response to Jeff and Mark’s professionalism and teamwork, the entire experience was excellent. It’s rare to find a company where everyone you interact with is this helpful and customer-focused.

We are so grateful and will absolutely use MVP Plumbing anytime we need plumbing help in the future. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for honest, reliable, and responsive service!

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Keith Kowal
reviews.text:
We engaged Battavio Heating and Plumbing for a plumbing inspection and PM contract, but the experience felt far more like a sales exercise than a service engagement.

During the plumbing inspection, a simple sink sensor issue was flagged. When I asked for a quote, it came back at $500. I told the technician I would handle it myself. Despite that, the invoice later included an additional $80 “diagnostic” charge, which felt unwarranted given how straightforward the issue was. This was a basic sensor replacement that any competent plumber could have identified quickly.

The HVAC side was worse. I emailed the assigned rep multiple times with no response. I eventually had to go through their corporate office just to get the first PM scheduled. Then, the morning of the scheduled PM, I received an email from the rep stating they could no longer honor the PM contract.

The explanation shifted between the system being “more than expected” and not having the personnel to support it now, in a few weeks, or even months. If that’s the case, it’s hard to understand why they would enter into commercial PM contracts at all.

Overall, this was a frustrating experience marked by poor communication, questionable billing, and a lack of follow-through. I would not recommend Battavio for commercial plumbing or HVAC work if reliability and professionalism matter.

reviews.author: Lee Anne Rice
reviews.text: We woke up Easter morning with an alert from our water company that we probably had a major leak based on water usage the last 48 hours. As it was a holiday, we called a company that offered holiday service at no extra charge. Big mistake! Two days later, we still did not have water or a solution. After viewing social media recommendations for plumbing services, we found Fuller Plumbing. Gary came out that day and diagnosed our problem. He had his crew out the next day, and within a couple of hours, we had a new water line and full service. Best of all, his charge was less than half what the other company was charging. We received photos of all the work and clearly saw the new lines and how deep they were laid. The crew was professional and respectful and even offered to carry my groceries while I was walking down our steep driveway in heels. Gary stayed after they left to make sure everything was working to our satisfaction. Two months later, everything is still great! Fuller Plumbing will be our FIRST call in the future when we need plumbing service. They are local and provide excellent, high quality service!

reviews.author: JoAnne Wirtz-Ryan
reviews.text: We have a very steep descent from the road to the house. Our water main line had a leak so we contacted Fuller plumbing to find the leak and repair it. Gary thoroughly evaluated our situation, pointed out to me that with 20 yo PVC it's getting brittle. He also said that with the steep slope it's under pressure from ground movement and vibrations from vehicles, both which are not compatible with PVC as it doesn't tolerate movement well. We knew our neighbor with the same situation  had recently spent 10's of thousands repairing their water main line. He gave me the prices for finding the leak as well as prices for running a new line with a PEX that is flexible and would withstand pressure, vibration and freezing issues. Even though more money than repairing, We chose to install a new line. His crew showed up on time and stayed until 7pm to get it done. He also hired a pressure washer to come the next day to clean the dirt off the driveway. Lastly he never asked me for money until the job was completed. They're very professional and I appreciate that he gave me options that will save me from repeated leaks in the future, unlike my neighbor who spent 3x what I spent with a different company, only to repair a line that has a short life expectancy. I definitely will use them again when I need a plumber.

reviews.author: Josephine Douglas
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about the service I received from Valdez Brothers Plumbing. Here’s what happened: my water heater completely stopped working—not just a pilot light issue, but fully out. Luckily, it was still covered by the manufacturer’s warranty, so I only needed to take care of the plumbing costs. At the time, money was very tight and I was worried I’d be without hot water for days. I reached out after seeing some local recommendations, and Douglas was the plumber who helped me. He was understanding about my situation and even picked up the replacement water heater from the manufacturer’s distribution center before coming out. Douglas explained the whole process to me step by step and gave me a very fair price for the work. Since we’re a military family living paycheck to paycheck, Douglas kindly agreed to wait a few days to deposit my check until payday. I’ve never heard of other plumbing companies in the area being that flexible or accommodating. Later, when I had a problem with leaking pipes due to faulty hardware, Douglas came back and replaced them with better quality parts at no extra charge. I really appreciate his honesty, hard work, and the way he stands by his repairs. If you’re looking for a trustworthy and reliable plumber, this is the company to call.

reviews.author: Bailey Erickson
reviews.text: After our hot water heater suddenly stopped working in the middle of the night, my wife and I woke up to a big mess and lots of water to clean up. We had about 20-30 gallons of water on the floor, which meant a lot of cleanup and extra laundry. We wanted a trustworthy plumber in Orem who was fully licensed, insured, and could help us out the same day. I called a few places, and this company picked up right away and was able to send someone out quickly. Douglas, the plumber who arrived, was on time and explained everything to us in a way we could understand. He found not only the problems we already knew about, but also pointed out some other issues that could have caused trouble down the line and weren’t up to code anymore. Even though I was a bit worried about extra work, I appreciated that Douglas found these issues so we could keep our home safe and up to standard. He gave us different repair and replacement options, and we decided to upgrade to a larger 50-gallon water heater with a great warranty. The next day, Douglas came back and did the installation. He was careful with our home, worked efficiently, and made sure everything was done right. He took the time to show me how to use the new water heater and any other equipment he installed. Douglas was knowledgeable and professional the entire time. Overall, I was really happy with how fast and reliable the service was. Both visits went smoothly, and I would gladly call this plumber again if we ever need help in the future.

reviews.text: Douglas installed a new kitchen sink and faucet for us in Orem. He showed up right on time and was very polite and professional throughout the job. Douglas carefully followed the instructions for both the sink and faucet, making sure everything was put together just right. He treated our project with care instead of just rushing through it. After finishing the installation, Douglas made sure the sink was perfectly level and the seal around it was neat and even. There were no leaks at all, and our new sink and faucet look fantastic. He also cleaned up the area and took away the old sink and faucet, leaving our kitchen spotless. We are very happy with the work, and we will call Valdez Brothers Plumbing for any future plumbing needs. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Laurie Dildine
reviews.text:
My master bathroom sink wasn’t draining, I tried everything I decided to take the pipe under the sink to see what was stuck.  NOTHING I went to the front bathroom water all over the floor and in the cabinet under the sink.  I inherited the house last year after losing my dad.  He was in charge of repairs, back in the day he did things himself.  This was my first big girl issue.  I didn’t know one plumber from the next, I googled plumbers near me Voyager Plumbing popped up with 4.9 stars.  I sent a message about 0700 by 0800 someone called to schedule a guy to
Come out to check out what is going on.  The guy (Arnold) got to the house about 1000.  He cut a little hole in the wall to see what was going on.  Cracked pipe in the wall.  Arnold called the boss (Thomas) to bring the camera over.  What I thought was a little issue was bigger than i could have imagined.  My house is older all the pipes are cast iron and rusty inside.  I told them about an issue that was taken care of in 2014, Thomas showed me what this fix looked like and what it should look like.  Thomas said they can take care of that and all the plumbing or just the the original issues.  He wasn’t pushy just letting me know what was going on which I appreciate.  I told him you’re here just take care of all the pipes.   All the employees who have been to the house have so polite and dealing with my dog barking at them each time they walked past her.  Thomas calls me to let me know the progress.  The guys who are at the house text me to let me know they are done for the day.  Francisco has been at the house majority of the time.  He’s so polite easy to talk and joke with.  If I had a package delivered he was so kind to bring it in the house.  Johnny and Josh have been there to help.   Both are very kind, friendly and they are all hard workers,  Thomas (owner) and Arnold (original guy who found the issue).  I truly wish I could give them a million stars.  They made this overwhelming situation not so overwhelming.  I highly recommend Voyager Plumbing you will NOT be disappointed.

Brandon came out to inspect and give a free quote, and the next morning, Francisco arrived with everything needed to complete the installation. reviews.author: Shaun Schofield
reviews.text:
PHENOMENAL EXPERTICE in plumbing. We had a slab leak caused by a burst in our cold water line the morning after Christmas 2024. Voyager plumbing immediately began to coordinate testing for moisture, abatement for lead/asbestos, packing out, and drying in preparation to execute repairs. By 14 Jan 2025 Voyager, guided by the leadership of Frank Arias, completed a TOTAL reinstall of all hot/cold water lines and drain lines for two bathrooms, kitchen, garage and ALL outdoor water/drain fixtures.
During the process Frank keep us informed of the progress and intent moving forward, further providing pictures.
I can not express how pleased we are with the total install. We took advantage of the opportunity and had Voyager install a tankless ready heater, 5 stage Halo 5 whole house water filtration system, a wash basin in the garage.
PHENOMINAL. The owner Thomas has a solid company that provides superior services.
The photos are small example of how they have perfected their craft!

UPDATE TO RESENT REVIEW:
Again I cannot express the professionalism and service to the customer that Voyager Plumbing exudes. While they had completed the plumbing noted in the pictures, they had one of our showers and kitchen area prepped to finish the “rough end” plumbing once the contractors completed their portion of the reconstruction. Fast forward over a month later and once the contractors have got to a point to allow Voyager plumbing to complete their portion rough end plumbing, the owner Thomas took it upon himself to come and complete the plumbing. Mind you , the Voyager plumbing contract had already been signed as complete.
From my prospective Voyager plumbing holds true to their word and puts the customers first while ensuring the job tasked is complete as specified.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Greg Maupin
reviews.text: We called Voyager Plumbing to come and fix a bathroom sink clog.  The scheduling process was easy and they were very nice on the phone.  Brandon showed up on time after he called to let us know he was on his way.  He provided a quote before work was started and was able to complete the process as quoted.  Very friendly.  Clean vans.  Professional uniform.  Fair price.  I will call them again. I highly  recommend them to be your plumbers too.

plumbers.name: Elite Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3701 Pecan Park Dr, Weatherford, TX 76087, USA

reviews.author: Joe Norton
reviews.text: I have used Elite Plumbing for many years and have never been disappointed nor overcharged. Aaron came this time and worked efficiently in sorting out our problems and making recommendations and repairs. Top-notch company.

reviews.author: Alexandra Hall
reviews.text:
We recommend Elite Plumbing to all of our friends!

We have hired Elite Plumbing twice in the last two years. Brett has done a fantastic job on both of our projects. In January 2024, we redid a guest bathroom, and we converted a single sink into a double vanity. We chose a chrome console sink, so the plumbing is exposed; the drain and water pipes had to be very precisely located. The work was done carefully and thoroughly. The bathroom looks fabulous, and we are very grateful to Elite Plumbing for working on this project with us. They also redid the seal on two of our toilets (they identified and solved a problem that had persisted for years; a problem which other plumbers had missed!).

This week we brought them back out to our home to install a new sink faucet. They had to drill holes in our existing one-mount-hole Kohler sink to make room for our new Kohler faucet (which needed three hole mounts and a sprayer mount).  They drilled the holes in exactly the right place. As usual, the project was done carefully. The faucet looks fantastic, and I know it was not easy to modify our existing sink.

They are professional, on time, and always kind. Hire them!

reviews.author: Frances Sheppard
reviews.text: Brody and his co-worker came in and did a great job on my hot water heater and the upgrades to the code changes.  I am pleased with their work.  It took a while for them to get to me thorough no fault of their own the home warranty company held things up for approvals, but I am satisfied with he work and they guys were professional and got the job done for me.

reviews.author: James Blalock
reviews.text: The guys at Elite plumbing are top notch crew of very awesome professionals. They went above and beyond to fix my plumbing needs. They're very honest and thorough in the work they perform. Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: John Terzian
reviews.text: Aaron did an awesome job with the water heater install and made sure the job was done right. Would love to have him back out for other projects.

plumbers.name: Able & Willing Plumbing & Sewer
plumbers.address: 8126 N 2000E Rd #3, Manteno, IL 60950, USA

reviews.author: Tim Jenkins
reviews.text:
Another job by Able & Willing Plumbing Plumbing and my satisfaction with their work can not be over stated. They work efficiently and are detail oriented. I am particularly impressed with Chris Iguarta and Chris Mrdalj - totally called them Chris and Chris - but seriously, this is about the sixth or seventh job they have done on my house and every time I get a quality job at a decent price. Mostly small to mid sized jobs so far but I am going to need them to jet my sewer lines and replace all the supply pipes in my house and apparently to them that is a "No Problemo boss man"" sized job. These guys are great and have a great semse of humor and kindness with my family. They also clean up after themselvrs which my wife appreciates. Last job was a high end dishwasher install and Chris totally carried the old one out to his truck all by himself and goes "I will put it by the dumpster and one of the scrapper guys will recycle it."
Guys you are a class act, you dont take life too seriously... but you are serious workers with a good future. Good to see home town Kankakee Valley guys making a business here. Wasnt the first time you helped me out of a jam and I and the missus appreciate it!

reviews.author: K9i2a3
reviews.text: The ending of 2025 has been challenge, not being able to trust people being a major factor. I’d gone without running water over a week due to the negligence of a previous “plumber” and I use that term loosely. Exhausted, desperate, yet determined and faithful I went searching the internet for a plumber. I stumbled across Todd from Allied Water Services, I told Todd all I was going through and he got me in touch with Albe & Willing plumbing, shortly after our call, Able does heating too!.  Bob, Chris and Ethan came out the next day, 2 days before the new year and before the new year we had running water again. Not only did I need them for plumbing, I had some duct work that needed to be done. I noticed after the duct work the flow of heat into my den area more than doubled, that was the coldest room in my home. I’d been losing heat in my wall. Appreciative is an understatement. The same day they came out, they were getting to work within 30mins of their proposal, Albe & Willing, I love the name and it’s true! Chis and Bob, professional, knowledgeable and confident men. They knew what they were doing! Ethan, that extra pair of hands, always a great thing to have. The second day another pair of hands showed up to jump in and help out, thanks Mike! I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Samantha Rapson
reviews.text:
Would not recommend!! Still having issues from when they came and “fixed” our plumbing.

Had them out numerous times to fix a leaking toilet and shower. Sometimes they would show up, sometimes they wouldn’t. Amanda was doing her best communicating and I don’t blame her but the workers were not reliable.
The time before they last came, there was an employee who was a retired union plumber. He looked at the previous work done by their other employees and said it would need to be taken out and redone AGAIN. The next time they came to redo it, they sent 4 people including Chris the owner. I was informed that the previous guy was let go, and that my plumbing did NOT need to be redone. We went on with finishing the subfloor, tile, and shower insert.  After it was all done, it took about 3 days and the leak started again. I reached out, and nothing. They did not come back & at that point I didn’t want them to either. I had them at my home at least 6 times doing work that they assured me was correctly done.
I have since had new plumbers come and look at the leak. They found that the new pipes Able put in our shower were never saudered together, and that the new plumbing Able put in for our toilet did not have any glue where the pvc connected.
Save your time, money, and sanity and go somewhere else! If I could give zero stars I would.

reviews.author: Randy Cotton
reviews.text: Highly recommend Able &Willing, they were quick to return our call. The guys took pride in the work they did for us. Chris,Scott and the entire crew worked together well and got the job taken care of promptly. The company owner was very pleasant and answered all of our questions.

reviews.author: Barbara Charbonneau
reviews.text: Highly recommend Able &Willing .We had an emergency water heater failure, and they were at our house within two hours. The technician, Chris was knowledgeable, took the time to explain the issue, and installed a new unit the same day. He kept the work area clean and was very respectful of our home.

plumbers.name: Curtis & Sons Plumbing

reviews.author: Sydney Flynn
reviews.text: I’ve lived in Harker Heights for many years, so I’ve called on plumbers a number of times. I was satisfied with previous companies, but as time went on, I wanted to try someone new for some drain repair work. The last plumber did a solid job, but their prices felt a bit high. Recently, we had a leak in our main water line just after the pressure regulator that needed copper pipe repair. I checked out some reviews online and decided to give a different plumbing company a shot. I called early Monday morning and spoke with the friendly dispatcher. Charles, the plumber, arrived promptly around noon. He worked quickly and did quality repairs, even making a few adjustments to the water pressure regulator as I requested so I could get more storage space in my water heater closet. The charges for both materials and labor were very fair—definitely better than what I expected from other local plumbing services. Even though I have some experience with plumbing myself, it was much faster and easier to have someone like Charles with the right tools and know-how handle the job. This was my first time using this plumbing service, and I’m happy to recommend Charles for anyone in Harker Heights looking for reliable and reasonably priced plumbing work. I felt strongly enough about their great service to leave this positive review.

reviews.author: adrienne serrano
reviews.text: Wayne did an excellent job! We’re in the process of buying an older house and wanted to make sure the sewer main line was in good shape, so we called for a plumbing inspection. The company made it simple to book an appointment, and payment was straightforward. Wayne arrived right on time and even checked out the kitchen line for us. He explained everything clearly, suggested cleaning and hydrojetting options if we move forward with the purchase, and provided a clear quote. We’d definitely use their plumbing services again in the future.

reviews.author: Nancy Schwartz
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Curtis & Sons Plumbing when I ran into a problem at my house in Harker Heights. I accidentally turned off the main water valve and couldn't get the water back on. Turns out the valves were really old and needed some expert attention. Even though I called with barely any notice, Pedro showed up quickly and made fixing the issue his top priority. He worked hard to get everything running smoothly again and made sure I understood what was going on. The pricing was very fair, and I appreciated the honest service. My family and I are very grateful to have our water restored so quickly!

reviews.author: C Duffy
reviews.text: We've relied on Curtis & Sons Plumbing for several years and haven't thought about calling anyone else for our plumbing needs. I first found them through a quick online search when we had a sudden leak in our pipes during a hot summer in Harker Heights. Charles made sure to fit us in that very same day, staying late just to make sure our water was back on. He explained everything clearly, including how we could take care of our pipes and drains to avoid future issues. As new homeowners, we really appreciated all the helpful advice we got, not just from Charles, but from other team members who have come out for regular check-ups, clogged drains, and even an emergency with a water heater. The most recent time, Jerry came out when our kitchen sink got completely blocked. He needed a special part, but managed to return the very next day to finish the job. He was friendly, worked around my busy schedule, and had everything fixed quickly. We’re really happy with the service every time—Curtis & Sons Plumbing always makes sure the job is done right!

reviews.author: Jalen Fleming
reviews.text: Everything is repaired and I’m absolutely thrilled. It has been a stressful week at my home because of a washing machine water line issue, but Curtis & Sons Plumbing came out today and got it handled fast. I reached out as a last option after another appointment kept getting delayed, and even though this was a washer-related plumbing problem, they stepped in without hesitation and solved it in record time. Jerry was professional, kind, and very easy to work with from start to finish. What really stood out was how honest and fair they were. Even after I explained how urgent the situation was, they did not overcharge me and took the time to make sure everything was fixed the right way. They clearly know their way around water lines, drains, and household plumbing connections, and they made a frustrating situation much easier. I could not be happier with the service. If you need help with plumbing, water lines, drains, tubs, toilets, or disposal-related issues in Harker Heights, I would highly recommend them. It was truly an A+++ experience.

reviews.author: JoDee Ramstetter
reviews.text: Eloy was amazing! He was so conscientious and professional. He showed me the video & explained each step thoroughly. Pricing and reliability, professionally, quality, and every aspect every person hopes to get from a company! If you need any of their services, I recommend All Sewer Solutions ALWAYS!

Thank you

I just want to give a big thank you to Terry and Damien for jumping on my request so quickly and handling everything so professionally. Really appreciate their help! Highly recommend their services!

reviews.author: jake hayden
reviews.text: Our hot water heater started leaking and made quite a mess in our utility room. After reaching out to a few plumbers in South Jordan, we decided to give another local company a try. They quickly let us know a plumber would be available within a couple of hours and confirmed the time window. Troy arrived right at the start of that window and got right to work. He took a look at our old 12-year-old water heater and, as expected, recommended a replacement. Troy offered us several options for new units and explained the pricing clearly, without any pressure to pick the most expensive one. Once we chose the best fit for our home, Troy and his helper went to pick up the new equipment and got everything installed in about three hours. They were both friendly and professional throughout the process. After finishing the installation, Troy walked us through what was done and made sure everything was clean and tidy before leaving. We really appreciated the fast response and great service. We had a wonderful experience and would definitely recommend them to anyone in South Jordan needing a reliable plumber.

reviews.author: Nicolas R
reviews.text: I recently needed some plumbing repairs and was very happy with the service I received. From the first phone call, the staff at the call center were friendly and answered all my questions quickly. When the plumber, Troy, arrived, he was very professional and clearly knew what he was doing. He first checked out my toilet and gave me a free estimate for the repair. While he was there, I also asked him to look at a leaking sink drain, and he fixed it right away at no extra charge. For the main job, Troy explained different options to help me save money and walked me through everything he planned to do. I decided to purchase a new toilet for him to install, which ended up costing less. Troy installed the new toilet in under an hour and made sure the bathroom was left clean and tidy. It’s been a few weeks since the work was done, and the toilet is still working perfectly. I would definitely recommend this plumbing service to anyone looking for reliable and honest help.

reviews.author: Brady Jordan
reviews.text: I recently had plumbing work done at my home in South Jordan and I couldn't be happier with the service. Troy and the team were very knowledgeable, friendly, and really knew their way around all the pipes and fixtures. While their prices weren't the lowest, the quality of their work and the fact that everything was finished on time made it well worth it for me. They handled a big job for me—taking out my old gas water heater from the basement, installing a new one outside, and running all the new plumbing lines to connect it to my faucets, all in just one day. They were careful to protect my home, patio, and plants while working, and made sure to keep me updated throughout the process. Troy also went the extra mile to find any rebates or discounts for the new water heater and made sure I received them. Highly recommend for anyone needing a reliable plumber in South Jordan!

reviews.author: Elena Hayes
reviews.text: We recently had our entire sewer line replaced by a local plumbing company. Troy showed up right on time and didn’t leave until everything was working perfectly. This isn’t your typical plumber who might overcharge or cut corners—Troy provided excellent service at a fair price. He really knows his stuff and was always friendly and easy to talk to. Throughout the whole process, Troy kept us updated and explained everything clearly. The project turned out to be more complicated than we thought, but Troy’s attention to detail and dedication to doing the job right were impressive. We’ll definitely call Troy again for our next plumbing job and highly recommend his services to anyone needing plumbing work.

reviews.author: destiny estrada
reviews.text: Troy made time on a Saturday to come out to my home in South Jordan and replace my broken water heater. He was friendly, easy to talk to, and very professional. The price he told me before starting the job was exactly what I paid—no surprises. Troy finished the water heater installation quickly, cleaned up the area, and even took away the old tank for me. While he was here, I talked to him about another plumbing project I need help with, and he already agreed to take care of it. After this experience, I’ll definitely call Troy for all my plumbing needs. Out of all the plumbers I contacted, his pricing was the best, and his work was top-notch. I highly recommend him to anyone in need of a reliable plumber in South Jordan.

reviews.text: Rescue replaced my cesspool! They worked efficiently, professionally and hard. Simply The best!

reviews.author: Peter Mason

Thanks so much for a great job.

reviews.author: Stephanie Giunta

Their transparency and great business ethics struck such a positive chord with my husband and I. They will always be our go-tos!

Quickly scheduled repairs effectively and made the system operational.

reviews.author: Kristin Carden- Wicker
reviews.text: I called dealing with a crushed sewer line at one of my tenants homes. I Explained we are a large corporation and would need to set some things up for billing, but we are looking for net30 billing. Was told everything would be fine and they set the appointment. I got a phone call back stating that they do not want our business. The office manager was rude and talked over me the whole time and would not let me speak. They claim they offer all these payment options but then completely removed our appointment off the calendar and said we are just uninterested with your business, and refused to even discuss other options. They stated it was because they dont offer Net30. She initially told me they offer financing, I asked for more information so that we could apply or work on getting a check request here to the property for them prior to doing the job, and she said that will be unnecessary because they just do not want our business. I am completely dumfounded, I have no idea why you would turn business away like that. I then asked to speak to the owner or office manager and she said she was the office manager and then reiterated that they dont want to do anything to get our business and she hung up on me. So happy all of our calls are recorded, I will be looking into further options on this repair with other conpanies. Run away from these unprofessional People, because seriously, how rude?
