reviews.author: David Otey
reviews.text: We had been dealing with an ongoing problem with the sewer line at our church for more than a year, and we were struggling with the cost of excavation and replacement. King Rooter provided a solution, sleeving the line, at a fraction of the cost. Not only that, but Mario, Kevin, and Robert gained my confidence right away with their knowledge and professionalism. I was nervous about the tight window we were able to give them with the building shut down, but they absolutely got it done when they said they would. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Brooke Walters
reviews.text:
This company is the real deal. They are organized, easy to schedule with, always responsive via phone. I had to cancel and reschedule due to the birth of my daughter and everyone I spoke to was so helpful. Colette is amazing over the phone. Dan is skilled at diagnostic work and repair - he found an issue another plumber missed and had it repaired the same day. Can’t forget Robert helping in the office. He’s a funny, easy going guy that gets the job done!

Also love the technology they’ve employed to allow technician tracking. I knew exactly when Dan would arrive at my home! Call them over any other plumber! They also have the ability to do smoke tests which was difficult to find with many other local plumbing companies.

reviews.author: Kristin B
reviews.text: I’m a repeat customer of King Rooter Plumbing, and once again Al and his team exceeded expectations. I needed an exterior no-dig pipe repair for my sewer line, and they handled it with absolute professionalism from start to finish. The work was expedient, meticulous, and incredibly clean—especially impressive for such a delicate job. Al is reliable, explains everything clearly, and makes sure the job is done right. Knowing the repair also comes with a warranty gives me total peace of mind. I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my plumbing needs. Highly recommend King Rooter Plumbing and Al!

reviews.author: Jared Barborak
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of working with Hugo, and he did an absolutely amazing job! From start to finish, he was professional, punctual, and extremely knowledgeable about his work. He quickly diagnosed the issue, explained everything clearly, and made sure the job was done right the first time. Not only was the quality of his work outstanding, but he was also respectful of our home and left everything spotless when he was finished. It’s rare to find someone who combines skill, reliability, and great customer service the way Hugo does. We couldn’t be happier with the results and highly recommend him to anyone in need of a plumber!

reviews.author: Bill Depper
reviews.text: Al and his team did a great job and thoroughly explained what they were doing. He alerted us to potential issues and was clear in the estimates. We will be working with them again.

plumbers.name: Bay Water Plumbing & Water Systems
plumbers.address: 5676 Lafayette Ave, Newark, CA 94560, USA

reviews.author: Ronnadee
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Bay Water Plumbing today for our new water heater installation. The team was prompt and professional, and everything was completed smoothly. A special thanks to Tommy, who was very helpful and friendly throughout the process. Highly recommend their services!

reviews.author: Kiran
reviews.text: Great service by Alvaro and Team. They installed water softner with RO. Took care of the whole setup with ease and I had a tricky plumbing system, they were able to provide alternate options and completed the work. Really happy with their service!

reviews.author: Kayli Yeh
reviews.text: Anthony came our rescue when we contacted Bay Water Plumbing & Water Systems after receiving an early morning email from ACWD informing us of an unusual continuous flow detected. He spent time checking our meter and trying to detect the leak. He gave us peace of mind after figuring out what was going on with our irrigation system. He was really nice and patient and we highly recommend this company and Anthony and would request their services again.

reviews.author: Mina Santiago
reviews.text:
5 Stars - Seamless Water Heater Installation from Start to Finish!
I couldn't be happier with my new water heater installation! From my initial inquiry, this company stood out due to their incredibly prompt responses and stellar online reviews. Booking an appointment was surprisingly easy; a simple email quickly confirmed a convenient time.
Their pricing was completely transparent, with a clear, accurate estimate and absolutely no hidden fees—a huge relief. Communication leading up to the appointment was excellent; they sent a helpful text notification when Alvaro, the co-owner, was on his way. He was also very responsive to any questions I had.
Alvaro arrived promptly within the two-hour window provided. He was exceptionally courteous and professional, taking the time to walk me through each step of the installation process. The quality of his work was impeccable; everything was neat and tidy. I especially appreciated that he laid down drop cloths to protect my floors and carpet. He also made sure to clean up thoroughly once the job was done (though I did lend a small hand!).

reviews.author: Saisatin Putta
reviews.text: Such a great experience! Alvaro is friendly, knowledgeable, he made the whole process stress-free. The work was done quickly and the quality is top-notch. Highly recommend!

plumbers.address: 4944 Neo Pkwy, Garfield Heights, OH 44128, USA

reviews.author: Jason Magda
reviews.text: I’ve had Garrett from Tri-County Services do plumbing work for me at my house a couple times. I trust them and would recommend them. They jetted a drain the first time and ran water lines for my basement.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Wentz
reviews.text: Chris and his assistant were great. Two very polite gentlemen they explained what had to be  done. They quickly got started. They protected my floor and furniture. The work was nicely done. The cleaning was swift. I am completely satisfied. Thank you so much. I would recommend them to anyone

reviews.author: Debbie Messick
reviews.text: Jesse came out the same day I called for service. He was able to determine my water tank was still under warranty and took the necessary action to get a new one for me. He was very knowledgeable, competent and kind. Great job and thank you very much!

reviews.author: old school gospel Ulmer
reviews.text:
The communication was outstanding.  The response to my request fast and efficient. The first representative called immediately and set up a time for the plumber to come out. The communication through texts and phone called with updated when the plumber would be available. Tri-County Electric Text a picture of the plumber and the time he would be here. Alex T also called to let me know when he was 15 minutes away. Once Alex T.arrived to my house, he was  very friendly and informative on the estimate and services. Alex T. was very caring about the property and he cleaned up after himself with a smile.

I would recommend Tri-County Electric To my friends and family I also give them a rating of 10 stars And they gave a 30 day warranty.

reviews.author: Kevin Watson
reviews.text: Nothing but great things to say about my experience.  I contacted them early afternoon and they came by the same day. Jesse was excellent! Knowledgeable and friendly. He was able to diagnose the issue and repair that same day. I would recommend Tri County electric to anyone!

reviews.author: James Finchum
reviews.text: We recently had to have our furnace & A/C replaced (along with some other plumbing & electrical work) and A&L was great during the whole process.  Every person (and there were many) we worked with both in person and on the phone was courteous and professional.  Additionally, our initial issue with the furnace happened to leave us with no heat on one of the coldest nights of the year and A&L provided us with space heaters to make that night tolerable (and quickly got the new furnace installed the next day).  I would recommend A&L to anyone and will continue to use them for any future needs.

reviews.author: C H
reviews.text: Huge props to this company for excellent customer service, quality work, and pricing that was 20% cheaper than area comps. Brandon and Jacob were excellent. Friendly, professional, transparent, and got the job done quickly! Highly recommend. Bonus - they were so sweet to my cats.

reviews.author: James Erdekian
reviews.text: I wasn't a customer, and or gas furnace died (cracked heat exchanager), they owner and the salesperson came the next day, assessed our needs, and the next business day, our new furnace was installed. We got straight talk and fair price. We got emails and text about when they were coming. They did what they said. Lukas, the installer and his co-worker were fantastic. We called around and many companies said they dont service gasetc. We're very happy w A&L.

reviews.author: Matthew Proujansky
reviews.text:
My experience with A&L Plumbing installing a new Air Conditioning system was excellent. Every employee--Tony who examined my house and quoted the job, Caitlin who managed the project, and Mike and Matheus who performed the installation--had fine social and technical skills and was a pleasure to work with. And Paul, the company owner, has scheduled a "Quality Assurance" visit to check that the system and service meets his standards.

All decisions regarding equipment selection and installation details were discussed with me, and the system has a web interface. If anything goes wrong, A&L and I (on yet another app) will be notified immediately.

A&L's price was not the lowest quote we received, but they were in the ballpark, and their pre and post job service can't be beat!

reviews.author: Hilary Ledebuhr
reviews.text: Really happy I chose A&L for my furnace service this year. They were on time, professional, polite, and quick. Best of all, as a woman I find that often when I call for a service like this I get a lot of mansplaining, but Brandon and Lucas answered my questions without a trace of condescension. Much appreciated!

Did an excellent job. . Christian showed me what was going on and cleaned up everything before he left. Extremely happy and would definitely use him again if the need arises.. Ronny

reviews.text: Justin handled my garbage disposal situation expertly, efficiently, and courteously. He went above and beyond in informing me as how to prevent the problem from happening again, as well as giving me great expert advice on other plumbing issues around my home. 10/10 service

reviews.author: Kevin Green

Secondly, he did detected and repaired several problem areas in our water and sewer lines in our crawl space and efficiently and thoroughly replaced and or repaired sections as needed. This required long hours and hard work in a very tight crawl space. in both jobs Cris and team really went beyond the call of duty to make sure the problems were solved in a very complete way. They also did a great job explaining the relevant options and making good choices. I would recommend Chris, Nestor, Andres and Gabriel very highly for any plumbing work.  Kevin Green

reviews.author: Matthew Scott
reviews.text: Mike Diamond is our go to plumber anytime “life happens”. They have always been responsive, clearly explain our options, and provide quality work.

reviews.author: Keith Billington
reviews.text: Justin was great!  Always on-time, personable, informative and knowledgeable. He was always suggesting the best way to fix my plumbing problem. He explained everything he was doing in detail and did it in a way I could understand. Thanks Justin.

reviews.author: Victoria The Art of Home
reviews.text:

Highly recommend! Service + honesty are everything + so is my reputation as my clients put a lot of trust in me and I take that very seriously!

Thank you so much for making my client happy and relieving us all from a stressful situation.

reviews.author: Simon Wright
reviews.text: Polite, prompt, responsive and reasonable.  What more could  you ask for? They installed our new AC this week. Could not have been happier with the job!  The install was done perfectly! Bobby and the installation crew were friendly, neat and proficient! They went above and beyond. Definitely recommending A1 best plumbing !

reviews.author: Edward Taylor
reviews.text: I am extremely impressed with the service provided by Bobby from A1 best plumbing . When our bathroom pipe froze, he responded promptly. He not only unfroze the pipe but also offered valuable advice on how to prevent similar issues in the future. He was very personable and professional. We will definitely rely on A1 best for all our future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: C P
reviews.text:
Extremely overpriced- padded work estimates by a lot.

We have been having some issues with our kitchen sink that needed it to be re-piped, as well as some other minor work around the house like snaking a shower and bathroom sink.

We had someone arrive about an hour after their original window of 2 hours. He seemed friendly and professional enough.

However, he quoted us $1955 to fix these issues. It seemed incredibly high at the time, so we said we would need to think about it. He sent us an invoice that night. The next day, we sent that invoice to 2 other plumbers who said this company was extremely padding their numbers.

We had another company come out and fix these issues the next day, they charged us $1000 less than what was quoted for the same work.

Pretty annoyed that A1 wasted my time and tried to take advantage of a 9 months pregnant woman. Shame on this company.

reviews.author: Daniel Price M
reviews.text: We had our water heater replaced by A1 best plumbing. Bobby was courteous professional worked quickly. He explained everything that needed to be done. Would recommend his services.

plumbers.address: 3001 US-29, Belton, SC 29627, USA

reviews.author: Jamie Vogel
reviews.text: Willie was scheduled promptly and even arrived early.  He expertly diagnosed where the leak in our crawl space was coming from and advised on the type of repair needed.  How wonderful to have a professional opinion when dealing with water issues because we all to often jump to the worst case scenario which was not the problem. Thank you for your professionalism and the kindness of honesty!

reviews.author: Janet Stone
reviews.text: I’ve used 1-Tom-Plumber multiple times, and each time they’ve done an excellent and thorough job.  Tyler Cantrell, who I’ve used twice, came out today to fix a pipe leak.  He was both personable, professional and thorough.  Tyler explained everything to me, and made a suggestion to preclude the possibility of a future leak in a different area.  This company and its service representatives are wonderful, and I will continue to use them for any plumbing issues I may have in the future.

reviews.author: Joe Labprop
reviews.text: Zach Vaughn responded to our home today 4/21/26 regarding a burst water supply line with subsequent water damage to our home.  Zach was great, He was professional and courteous and his honesty was transparent with everything.  I would recommend 1Tom Plumbing 100%.  I have worked with many contractors on a professional basis and feel assured this company will take care of our needs for this incident.

reviews.author: Darengin
reviews.text: Zach came out at 10:30 on a Tuesday night to fix my multiple toilet backup. Great work. Very friendly. And very capable. Continually pleased with 1Tom! Thank you, Zach!

reviews.author: Micheal Duchesne
reviews.text: Mr. Cantrell is a phenomenal example of what hard work and dedication looks like. Being in the trades myself, it’s not often you encounter someone with genuine drive and sincerity in their actions. Tyler has put in the work to be truly talented and knowledgeable tradesman. He went above and beyond to get a basement leak behind us and provided valuable insight into the issues. Personally, we will not use another plumber.

plumbers.name: Plumbing First
plumbers.address: 110 Sycamore Ln, Townsend, DE 19734, USA

reviews.author: Kevin Woerner
reviews.text: I could not be happier with the services provided by this company. I was having an issues with my tankless water heater which was about 15 years old. I knew it was probably time to replace it. I got a quote from one company and honestly couldn’t believe the price. They told me that their price was on the low side. I knew right from the drop I was going to get a second quote. I was complaining about it at work and a colleague recommended Plumbing First. I didn’t let them know that I had already got a quote. Vinny came looked at everything like the other company did. His quote was more of what I was expecting to pay which was 25% lower than the first. I could tell right off the bat Vinny was an honest no gimmick guy. His work was impeccable, fast, clean, and his experience shows. Very professional and a great sense of humor. Easy to talk to and explains everything. Yum Plumbing First is my new go to for all my plumbing needs in the future. I highly recommend

reviews.author: Dan Smith
reviews.text:
This company, and Vinny in particular, are simply the best. Vinny is highly responsive, reliable, personable, professional, and knowledgeable. His attention to detail and craftsmanship are top-notch, and the work is backed by a 1-year warranty. He is a clear communicator and he lays out the situation (not sales "options"), including the total price, in advance. The price is very reasonable, and there are no surprises.

Here's what's really great: Vinny is there to do the work you need done, NOT to upsell you. Whereas all the big-box-truck plumbers now pull out an iPad and try to convince you that you need some expensive and completely unnecessary upgrade, Plumbing First simply does not do that. I'm really glad I found Plumbing First. I went on a search for a company like this after I had a bad experience with one company and another tried to convince me I need new toilets "because of Middletown water." I'm not a plumber, but I'm also not a complete idiot, and I don't respond well to be treated like one.

reviews.author: Joe Smiley
reviews.text:
The Best!

Out of all the experiences I have had with plumbers over the years, nothing comes close to the quality, professionalism, and customer care that was experienced with Plumbing First.  Thank you Vince, you are the best.  You will be the first to call when needed and will be highly recommended to others.

reviews.author: Joseph Deardorff
reviews.text: Vince replaced two toilets in our home in Middletown.  He gave us good advice as to what we needed, communicated effectively when to expect him at the house, and got the work done in an expert and tidy manner, at a fair price.  A pleasure to find a reliable plumber, so we have already scheduled him for additional  work we need at the house.

reviews.author: Mike DiGiandomenico
reviews.text: What an amazing experience. Vinny from plumbing first is one talented plumber. He answered my call late last night for my emergency and arrived early this morning. You cannot ask for better service. He located the problem less than an hour and corrected the issue within three hours. Not only did he give great service. His prices are phenomenal.

plumbers.name: High Speed Plumbing of Arcadia

reviews.author: Joyce Lin
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Christian, the technician from High Speed Plumbing Inc, who came to fix the plumbing issue in my home. He was punctual, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. He quickly diagnosed the problem and provided an efficient solution. Christian took the time to explain the issue and ensured everything was working perfectly before leaving. I really appreciated his attention to detail and friendly demeanor. Highly recommend his services!

reviews.author: Victoria Thomas
reviews.text: Absolutely GREAT. We have used High Speed a couple of times in the recent past and this company never disappoints. Guy showed up a bit early, gave us a verbal estimate, got right to it, solved all five (5)  household plumbing issues carefully, efficiently and quickly. Utterly professional. Most appreciated.

reviews.author: C J Mandala
reviews.text:
I had a mainline blockage and of course it happened without warning, while all my children were home for the holidays.

When I called, they scheduled a plumber to respond in two hours and he showed up on time.  Christian responded and I must say I was very impressed.  He’s very professional and respectful. Even though I have an easily accessible clean out, the riser was filled with standing water so it was difficult to know if the snake was fed in the correct direction.  He worked okay it and vacuumed out the standing water.  He then had it snaked in no time at all. He remained on site while I ran multiple fixtures to make sure there was no restrictions.  The drain worked perfectly.

Christian earned my trust and I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Nancy Atilano
reviews.text: Jesse was very friendly and communicative and worked extremely efficiently. He told us exactly what to expect and he lived up to those expectations. Our previous plumbing company did not even answer my emergency call. Jesse came two days before Christmas and finished everything. I have a new Company now. High Speed Plumbing!

reviews.author: Selina Mora
reviews.text: We had our whole home re-piped by these guys.   They worked quickly and got the job done in 2 days.  Christian explained what the job entailed in detail and worked hard to get the job done. Juan was very helpful in addressing any concerns we had.  Pricing was reasonable.

plumbers.name: Luca's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 117 E Hoyt Dr #8100, Longview, TX 75601, USA

reviews.author: Reginald Vaughan
reviews.text: Chris did an outstanding job with the plumbing work during my master bathroom remodel in Longview. He was hardworking, polite, and always kept me updated about what he was doing next. Chris made sure everything was cleaned up and ready for the next step in the remodel. I also met Axel at a local tile store, and he helped guide me through picking out the right style and coordinating tiles for my bathroom. Axel was very patient and took time to make sure I would be happy with my choices and that they fit my budget. He even offered to meet me at another store to continue helping with the selection process. Chris has continued working on plumbing throughout my entire home remodel, staying dedicated and making sure each phase is done with care. His positive attitude and plumbing know-how have really stood out. On another occasion, Jonathan came out to restart my water heater. He arrived on time, was friendly and knowledgeable, and even showed me a few easy tricks to restart the pilot light myself if I need to in the future. During my yearly plumbing inspection, Jonathan checked out my water heater and all the plumbing fixtures in my house. He recommended upgrading my old rubber hoses to stainless steel braided ones, and took care of the replacement quickly. Jonathan had also installed my water heater in the past, and I’ve always found him thoughtful and professional. I really appreciate how this company in Longview values quality work and dedicated plumbers. I recommend signing up for their maintenance plan for yearly inspections and service discounts. If you need plumbing repairs or a remodel, I highly recommend this team—they truly care about their customers and deliver excellent service every time.

reviews.author: Destiny Stout
reviews.text: We had a great experience with the plumbing company in Longview. In the same week, chris came out and did a fantastic job replacing our old water heater, which had been in use for about twenty years. he was super friendly, knowledgeable, and made sure everything was done right. chris also took the time to explain what he did and showed us how to use the new water heater before leaving. A few days later, we had another issue when we found a big puddle of water coming from our backyard sprinkler system. We couldn’t figure out where the leak was underground, so we called the plumbing company again. eddie answered the call and was really kind, telling us not to worry and that they would fix it. axel arrived very quickly, in less than half an hour, even though it was extremely hot outside. he worked hard and used his plumbing experience to find and repair a pipe that had been damaged by roots. We are very thankful for chris, eddie, and axel. they were all professional, friendly, and did a wonderful job. We highly recommend this plumbing service in Longview!

reviews.author: Manuel Esparza
reviews.text: we've called on luca's plumbing twice now when we had plumbing problems, and each time they really helped us out. the office manager, chris, was fantastic—super friendly and kept us updated every step of the way. the team was quick to respond and sent a plumber over the same day both times we needed help. both technicians, eddie and axel, were professional and made sure to explain all the work and costs before starting. their prices seemed fair compared to other plumbers we've used, but what really stood out was how great their customer service was. it's a huge relief to have such a dependable plumber, especially when something goes wrong in this texas heat.

reviews.author: Jeffery Daniel
reviews.text: We noticed signs of a slab leak in our living room and decided to call Luca's Plumbing after hearing good things. Axel answered the phone and was extremely friendly, making it easy to explain our plumbing concerns. Understanding the urgency, he quickly scheduled Chris to come by. We were given a clear two-hour window, and Chris called right at the start to let us know when he would arrive. Chris took the time to carefully check everything, explained what was happening, and offered the best solution for our home. The team was professional, honest, and very dependable throughout the whole process. If you need plumbing work done in Longview, big or small, I highly recommend reaching out to them.

reviews.author: Edna Casey
reviews.text: I’m happy to give a 5-star review! Chris was fantastic—he showed up right on time, found the problem with our kitchen drain, and got it working again fast. He also took the time to walk us through what caused the clog, what he did to fix it, and gave us helpful tips to avoid future plumbing issues, all without trying to sell us anything extra. It’s clear he knows his stuff and really cares about making sure customers understand their plumbing. The whole experience with Luca’s Plumbing was great. I’ll definitely recommend them to friends and neighbors in Longview!

reviews.author: Anna Ryzhkova
reviews.text:
We've been using Miracle Plumbing for years, and at first everything was solid and we continued coming back to them. They are a bit pricey, but we thought we were paying for quality. However, things have changed for us in the recent years.

We had a problem with a downstairs toilet where there was a slow leak and water damaged wood around the toilet. MP came and replaced the wax ring, spilling the water all over our wooden floors in the process (this wax ring has been replaced by a few other plumbers before and everything remained dry). It took me hours to clean the floor and even walls after that. They've acknowledged it and even brought over water remediation company that did some treatment (no issues here). However, the leak came back and we called MP again. At this point they recommended that we replace a pipe under the toilet. It was expensive, but we agreed. Pipe was replaced and the toilet installed again. Not much time passes and we see discoloration on the wood floor again indicating a leak. We called them and were told that we are seeing things, this is old discoloration and there is no leak. Discoloration persisted and at some point we saw actual water coming through, but made a mistake of not making a video of it. We called MP again, they came out and told us again that there is no leak and promised that a supervisor will call (still waiting). We saw water again after this (this time we made a video) and just decided to replace the toilet and called a different plumber. When the toilet was removed, we saw that the pipe that was installed by MP is uneven with the floor, one edge sticks above the floor and the other edge is below the floor (photo attached). It is obvious that when the toilet sits on an uneven pipe like this, there will be leaks no matter the wax ring, the toilet was not even stable, you could shake it because of the angle of the pipe to which it is attached. The other plumber brought a level to further demonstrate how uneven it is. Moral of the story is that not only did they make us feel like complete lunatics for "seeing" water, but in the end they did not even do a quality job for which we paid over $1,000. In the end we are out of the money we spent on this pipe replacement and now have to pay someone else do it again to fix the issue with the poor installation, and MP did not offer us to correct it or issue any form of refund (we've informed them of the issue).

The above incident is the one that stands out to me, but in the last few years, we've had complaints about pretty much all of their visits (unfortunately, plumbing issues happen a lot in our old house), from leaving absolute mess to recommending costly replacements of equipment when all that was required is to flip a part that was installed incorrectly (not by them to be fair).

All in all, I would not recommend MP to anyone based on our collective experiences.

He said, “Ma’am, I can’t just show up for two hours and expect to be done right away. It doesn’t work that way.”

I replied that today wouldn’t work, and he immediately hung up on me without allowing me to say anything else or offering to reschedule.

reviews.author: Mike Gould
reviews.text:
My 20-year old heat pump catastrophically failed on a Friday night at 6PM when it was 20 degrees out. Within 90 minutes, a young man named Jacob was at my house diagnosing the problem and explaining the details of the issue to the level I requested (which was thorough). He was incredibly friendly and patient, and walked me through all of the options for both repair and replacement. I opted for replacement.

On Tuesday, Steven and John showed up at 8:30AM with my new heat pump and furnace, only to find out that my hot water heater had blown out overnight, drenching my basement. Not only were they easily able to work around that, but they were also able to get me a new hot water heater and tank to install the same day. Steven followed up later that evening and fixed a thermostat issue that was keeping the new system from working, and he and John came back Wednesday to finish some auxiliary installation stuff.

Steven and John were both exceptionally friendly and clean and polite and professional. The installations are flawless and look better than they did before. I have absolutely zero complaints and nothing but compliments for the both of them. Even the ladies who do scheduling and customer service were great (Skylar was the one I interacted with most).

I gave three stars for cost because this was incredibly expensive and, I assume, the industry average. I didn't have the luxury of shopping around because I didn't want my family to freeze, so I went with what was available at the time. I'm not sure how most people would be able to afford these repairs, if I'm being honest. None of this, however, is any fault of the men and women with whom I interacted, and everything I purchased is working flawlessly.

reviews.author: Mark Johnson
reviews.text:
I don’t write reviews lightly, and I’m extremely difficult to satisfy when it comes to work done in my home. I have obsessive compulsive disorder, and hiring contractors reliably triggers significant stress and anxiety because, in my experience, most crews miss details, cut corners, or leave a mess that I then have to fix myself.

That did not happen here.

Mohammad, Omid, and Eagle from Same‑Day Heating Cooling and Plumbing LLC, contracted through Home Depot, installed a full 3-ton HVAC system at my house, including an additional intake in our dining room, all new ducting, smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors. From start to finish, they exceeded my expectations in every measurable way.

Their attention to detail was exceptional. Communication was clear, consistent, and proactive. They explained what they were doing, why they were doing it, and what to expect next, which matters a lot when you care deeply about precision and control. The workmanship itself was clean, methodical, and professional.

Most importantly for me, they treated my home with respect. Every mess they made was cleaned up. Nothing was left behind. No loose materials, no sloppy finishes, no “we’ll come back later” excuses. When they were done, the job was done.

It is rare for a crew to meet my standards, let alone surpass them. These three did. If you’re someone who values precision, professionalism, and company that employs a crew that actually does things right the first time, I can recommend them without hesitation.

reviews.text:
Burtech Plumbing came out right before Thanksgiving for what we thought was a small leak. They were efficient and worked quickly. While the leak itself wasn’t a big issue, once the ceiling was opened we discovered that all of our copper pipes were badly corroded. They recommended a full repipe of our home.

We have a 4,000 square foot house, so this was a huge project. I got multiple quotes, and Burtech landed right in the middle price-wise. What really stood out to me was how willing they were to work with my specific requests. I had major stipulations, especially that they complete the repipe without visually accessing our kitchen, and they made it happen.

They worked with our timeline, and Jose was incredibly communicative throughout the entire process. I’ll admit I was a bit needy with questions, but he was always patient, understanding, and responsive.

The estimate they gave us was exactly what we paid in the end with no surprise costs at all. The repipe itself was major (60+ holes throughout the house), but they worked so efficiently that it never felt overly intrusive. They were very clean, vacuumed and cleaned up every day, and truly respected our home. We have two young kids who nap, and they even worked around nap schedules so they weren’t in certain rooms during that time.

Overall, I’m extremely impressed with Burtech Plumbing. I’ve already recommended them and will continue to do so without hesitation.

reviews.author: Christian Gallagher
reviews.text:
This review is about 10 days overdue, but I would be remiss if I didn't take the time to write about the exceptional service, care, and courtesy that I have received from Burtech Plumbing during 3 different encounters that included pressure regulator installation, mainline repair and locating (Bill is a wizard at finding a hidden mainline), and installation of plumbing in the front yard.

For the most recent experience, I was provided service by Jaime, who spent a considerable amount of time locating a rather tricky mainline in the front yard at an old home that I recently purchased, and instead of giving in (which many would have) after digging a fairly long trench, he instead went with an experiential instinct to successfully locate the mainline needed to create a T line that would ultimately allow for a hose bib to be placed in my front yard in preparation for future landscaping projects. Not having a hose bib in the front yard, I had to run 100 feet of hose around the house from back to front in order to just water the plants and hose off the deck. Because of Jaime's diligence, expertise, and effort, my life has been made exponentially easier in having hose/plumbing access in the front yard. To top it all off, Jaime ensured that my previous irrigation system mainline was properly capped off and deactivated so that no leaks would occur during the artificial turf installation, which was highly appreciated. And the best part of it all, Jaime was courteous, communicative, and informative in walking me through the process. The final piece that day was the installation of a water conditioner at a great value. Happy to now have my appliances and pipes protective from corrosive mineral deposits.

In summary, I would highly recommend Burtech Plumbing to folks living in the San Diego area, and I plan to remain a loyal customer with the level of courtesy and care that I have received. They are experts at their craft and care about their customers. Thank you so much to Bill and his team. You all are fantastic!

reviews.author: Jordan McWilliams
