reviews.author: Serenity McFarland
reviews.text: Eli and Chase were both amazing plumbers!! They were able to help us clear a big clog in our drain that we have not been able to do ourselves. They are very friendly and personable and I would recommend them if you’re looking for a plumber!! Very honest And great pricing !!

reviews.author: Kellye Wilcox
reviews.text: Chase and Eli came out to unclog our toilet. They were super responsive, very professional, and kind. They worked quickly and efficiently and I’ve never had such a good experience with a plumber until now. If you are in need of a really good, professional plumber in the Davis area, look no further than Mr. Rooter. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: MurrayMax20
reviews.text: Eli and Chase were great. Very professional, had my drain unclogged within 30 minutes and offered me a safer solution to help break up bio mater build ups. Were very upfront about pricing and very helpful in explaining my situation to me. Left the area clean and tidy. Would feel comfortable welcoming them back to work on any plumbing issue in the future.

reviews.author: Boaz Simpson
reviews.text: These plumbers were great guys, very thorough in explaining the procedure. Quick service, I called them and they came to my house to fix the problem within the hour. They snaked and jetted the main sewer drain. They also cleaned up after themselves which a lot of plumbers don’t do. Would highly recommend these guys if you ever need any plumbing issues resolved!

plumbers.name: AllTech Services, Inc
plumbers.address: 244 Airport Rd, Winchester, VA 22602, USA

reviews.author: Hermad seabas
reviews.text:
Nice folks, but sometimes when someone seems too friendly or only all smiles and the usual statements... maybe that says something. 900 for garbage disposal installation, for a 150 garbage disposal that I should have done myself. 4800 for a water softner installation that thankfully I've chosen to do myself for just 1300 for a (research done) great one that everyone recommends.

Others charge half what these guys charge and I get it, they are excellent sales men... find everyway to defend these prices. Then a monthly fee?! On top?!

Nothing excuses the price, especially when it doesnt work properly after installation and fixes of certain things. I made my mistake in a moment of desperation. I wont do it again.

reviews.author: Dick DeVaughan
reviews.text: I am a very happy customer of AllTech. Sydney Janet addressed a minor plumbing issue for us today. He is personable, professional, honest and trustworthy. I enjoyed many conversations w/him during his service call. I highly recommend AllTech to all.

reviews.author: Donna Brearcliffe
reviews.text:
Sidney was great, very friendly and informative! Very thorough with our annual inspection and the one repair that was needed for our hot water heater.

We've used Home Service Doctors/AllTech Services for some time.  Always satisfied with the work done.

reviews.author: Rosa Seda
reviews.text:
Again, I had a great experience with Ali from AllTech. While it was not the least expensive being that my AC was out, at least the issue was found and he was very knowledgeable and personable. Very respectful and experienced. He worked on all my concerns and we will see if they are all resolved but certainly he did a great job getting our unit back up and running.
The noise issue I still have and will have to have him back out but I am sure at some point it can get resolved. At least I hope so for such an expensive unit.

reviews.author: Steve S.
reviews.text: I consistently have top experiences with AllTech including with reaching them my phone, getting quick scheduling, having punctual service visits, and getting competent and courteous service. My tech today, George Matthews, was particularly outstanding in his timeliness, efficiency, and expertise in addressing my water heater and toilet issues. He provided super fast service and fully addressed the problems, and he was also super professional, courteous, and considerate. Huge thanks to George and AllTech!

plumbers.name: Stake Plumbing and Heating
plumbers.address: 145 Sewall St, Boylston, MA 01505, USA

reviews.author: Mark B
reviews.text: Stake Plumbing is fantastic!!  They recently installed all the plumbing in my new 3 car garage & work shop, which included a new complex water filtration system, hot water, sinks, rerouting well lines, and irrigation feeds and external spigots. All their work was to high standards, on time, and competitively priced.  They also stand behind their work.... when a well pump check valve started acting up, they came out immediately and replaced at no charge.   Curtis Jr. is a knowledgeable and  hardworking professional, and a pleasure to work with.  Highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Mukund Lingineni
reviews.text: Curtis Jr. helped replace our water heater and handle a few other tasks. It is very hard to find someone who is customer-friendly, a true small business, and really great at their job. Curtis checks all the boxes. Most of all, he is honest and reliable. I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Tom Taylor
reviews.text: I hired Stake Plumbing for some work as part of my kitchen remodel, including installing new water lines and disconnecting/reconnecting the dishwasher and sink with a new faucet. Curtis’ communication was excellent throughout the entire process, and the work was completed efficiently and with great attention to detail. I highly recommend Curtis for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: John Freeman
reviews.text: Curt installed a new on-demand gas water heater to replace our old tank type. Job went smoothly. I'm very impressed by the communication and effort to getting the job done. There were no surprises.

reviews.author: Troy Kasper
reviews.text: Curtis is well versed in his profession.  Several times during remodeling of our bathroom/walk in shower that he was here, he was continually working.  Advised on several things during that time that became beneficial and more sensible to the layout.  Always cleaned areas where work was completed every time.  Very respectful.   Would be first call if a plumbing issue was to arise.

plumbers.name: GEI Plumbing Services of Spring
plumbers.address: 2814 Spring Dusk Ln, Spring, TX 77373, USA

reviews.author: Buren Brown
reviews.text: Plumbing not working, called GEI. Ran snake and camera into pipes and located a broken pipes under my foundation at my hall bath. Needed a tunnel approximately 20 ft to reach pipe. Once located the repair was completed and plumbing was restored. The crew did excellent work and maintained a clean worksite. Work was completed in a timely manner. A slight language barrier was present with the crew but we worked it out just fine. I would recommend GEI to assist you in all you plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Kay
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with GEI Plumbing, thanks to Sean Hull. Sean was knowledgeable, patient, and professional throughout the entire process. He clearly explained each repair, answered all of my questions, and made sure I felt confident moving forward. The work was affordable, efficient, and exceeded my expectations.

Sean initially came out to fix a small leak but went above and beyond by noticing an issue with my hot water heater. He could tell right away that it needed to be replaced and explained how leaving it could have turned into a very costly repair. As he was wrapping up, he also noticed a problem with an electrical outlet and explained that it posed a safety concern for my home. He would not move forward until it was properly addressed, which showed his integrity and commitment to doing the job the right way.

Sean also relocated my water softener, corrected the piping to access my water panel, and took the time to show me how to properly turn the water on and off to different areas of the house.

This level of professionalism, safety, and care is exactly what you hope for in a plumbing company. Sean is truly the cream of the crop, and I will only be calling GEI Plumbing for my future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Valeria Ochoa
reviews.text:
Everything was great. I called today about a water heater issue and they were able to get it all done today. Estimated times did keep shifting because they were busy but they called me to keep me updated and let me know the new estimated time. I really appreciated them getting me in the same day.

The techs that came were knowledgeable and professional. I would recommend them for your needs!

reviews.author: Heath Vogt
reviews.text: Had somewhat of an emergency and they showed up in less than 40 minutes. My technician was Daniel and he was crazy nice, super polite and very professional. He explained what was happening, how he was going to fix it and gave me a price. Couldn’t have been a better experience; considering the circumstances. As a homeowner having the right people and companies available to  help with issues is invaluable. Theses guys are my plumbers for life!!

reviews.author: Beatriz Sosa
reviews.text: I am so glad to have worked with Idan. He was prompt at scheduling and was an expert in resolving my issue. Their team showcased professionalism and skill. Transparent pricing and clear communication made the entire process hassle-free, especially since I was unable to be physically present. They've restored my faith in reliable plumbing services. Highly recommended!

plumbers.name: Love Thy Plumber
plumbers.address: 5007 Victory Blvd Ste C #233, Yorktown, VA 23693, USA

reviews.author: T Barnes
reviews.text: Jorge was in my neighborhood and I needed some work done, I saw the truck and gave him a call and he was able to see me right away. He is the nicest guy you will ever meet amd so professional.  He let me know what the issue was and how he would resolve it. He followed up the next day to see how things were going . I would definitely recommend him for all your plumbing needs. I plan on setting up my early maintenance schedule with him because he is great and true to his word. 10 out of 10 stars for sure.

reviews.author: Rob A
reviews.text: Best plumbing experience in over 30 years as a homeowner! Jorge’s communication was outstanding and extremely courteous. He arrived on time, provided an on-target estimate, and fixed our broken toilet flange professionally and quickly. He left the floor cleaner than when he arrived. He’s obviously an expert in his field! Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Sherry Vitale
reviews.text:
Love Thy Plumber,  YES I DO!  Jorge, Owner Operater, responded to my call and scheduled me immediately. Jorge and his team were very professional, explained everything thoroughly and the price was extremely fair,  even left me coupons for next time.
Thank you Love Thy Plummer!

reviews.author: Charmin Gordon
reviews.text: Jorge from Love Thy Plumber is phenomenal!!! He was prompt, well prepared, maintained a clean and organized work space, very detailed, professional and most important honest!!! I thought I needed to replace my commode, but all I needed was a new fill valve. He could have swindled me to purchase a new commode, instead he showed me what was causing the problem. He also conducted a water leak test on my shower valves and piping. Installed the fixtures  showing me step by step the process. I am beyond grateful, Love Thy Plumber is bar none the best company in Hampton Roads and I will definitely hire again for any future issues.

reviews.author: Angeli Chesson
reviews.text: I was referred to Love Thy Plumber by my neighbor. Jorge was everything she told me about him quality, service and value. I was even able to ask questions about water heater and kitchen sink issues. He was very helpful and patient answering my many questions. To anyone in need of a great plumber I highly recommend Jorge with Love Thy Pumber!

plumbers.name: Master Plumbing Services LLC
plumbers.address: 51 Lyons Rd, Fleetwood, PA 19522, USA

reviews.author: Joe Wilmer
reviews.text: I called Jesse about 2 leaking outdoor faucets.  He came out the next day and made the repairs.  Jesse explained everything in detail, price was fair, and the work was done right.  I’ll definitely use him again for any plumbing needs in the future.

reviews.author: Lisa Suppan
reviews.text: We were in an emergency situation where both toilets in our home backed up and were completely unusable. Jesse was able to squeeze us in the same day and quickly resolve the issue. He was prompt, professional, and incredibly informative, taking the time to explain what happened and offering helpful suggestions to prevent it from happening again. We truly appreciated his expertise and responsiveness. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sean Weaver
reviews.text: I called yesterday, we had noticed a puddle gathering by our water heater. Jesse came out today to inspect and fix both the pressure release tank as well as installing a pressure valve to the intake line. He explained everything in detail, was up front about costs, really prompt in servicing our water heater, and overall so friendly. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Anthony Nguyen
reviews.text: Jesse is super friendly and helpful. We’ve called him twice now — once for a water softener replacement and again for an emergency service right after Thanksgiving. He was prompt both times and clearly explained every step of the process. If you need a reliable plumber, he’s the one to call!

reviews.author: scott lopez
reviews.text: Jesse did an amazing job. I called him because my septic pump in the basement was backing up and he was very willing to talk to me about my problem and help diagnose the issue.  He showed up promptly. He was able to fix everything and get us up and running again. We are very appreciative of everything he did. He didn't take advantage of us and his pricing was very fair. Thanks again Jesse!

plumbers.name: Lanthorn Plumbing
plumbers.address: 110 Virginia Ham Dr #205, Suffolk, VA 23434, USA

reviews.author: Jenna Nabilah Jennings
reviews.text: Zach came out the same day I called to take a look at the kitchen sink we bought to replace our old one. He was super kind and swapped out the sink, ran the new drain lines, and reinstalled the garbage disposal same day. Looks great and is all watertight. Would recommend! Thanks Landthorn and thanks again Zach!

reviews.author: Bill Moore
reviews.text: We had a major plumbing problem that required the replacement of ALL of our hot and cold plumbing in our house. Matt and Robby worked nearly every day over the holidays to get it done. They had occasional help from Keith, Paul, and others but 90% of the work was those two. They respected our house by minimizing the cuts in the drywall and also ensured that all the pipes in the attic were completely insulated. We waited for two months and plenty of cold weather to verify and every line is still functional and dry on the outside. We would recommend this company and Matt & Robby specifically to anyone else needing plumbing work!

reviews.author: Pat Brewer
reviews.text: Lanthorn Plumbing - Excellant Customer Service and Highly Trained Technicians. I have been calling Lanthorn Plumbing for our house almost 12 years and they havn't let me down yet. They even take care of my gas house generator and any other project I come up with!  I call no one else because they can do it all with the care and trust we all look for.

reviews.author: Dennis Cruz
reviews.text: Nice company and Joe & Zach sent were prompt, professional and respected my requests to wear shoe covers in the house. They did great work, provided an honest up front cost and did all as promised. Would call them again for any of my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Donald Goldberg
reviews.text: The technicians arrived, performed the repair need. They were pleasant to work with. They were professional I. They did not waste anytime in completing the job. I hope they will come back and do some electrical work that I need.

plumbers.name: Ihn Company
plumbers.address: 633 Cecelia Dr, Pewaukee, WI 53072, USA

reviews.author: Randy Cadotte
reviews.text: I have used Ihn Company for approximately 25 years.  They have worked on projects at my personal home and for other projects professionally.   They always provide timely, detailed proposals.  The price is competitive, scheduling is quick, and the quality of work has always been high.

reviews.author: Russell De Lap
reviews.text:
I had a water heater replaced. I was given a global charge of $3,295.00. Thought it was expensive (as did many of my friends) but I needed to replace it. I was not given any options of water heaters as well (the water heater was $2,250.00).
Being so expensive I called the company and requested an itemized  report.
I was there when the technician started and when he finished. He worked 2 hours no more but the report stated 3.5 hours worked. At $199.95 and hour thats a lot of money. I asked several times to talk with someone who I could discuss the overcharge with and was told someone would but it never happened.
I value the money I make and honestly I was ripped off (thats how I feel knowing I was overcharged intentionally).

reviews.author: Robyne Schumacher
reviews.text: Excellent Service.  Professional Staff from the first call ... all the way through to the end of our Project(s).  Multiple Plumbing Needs were addressed, by several Ihn Team Members.  We were taken care of in a timely manner, by highly skilled individuals; and would Recommend Ihn Company to Family & Friends!

reviews.author: Scott Taylor
reviews.text:
I did some research before starting my basement remodeling project. Had several companies come to provide me a quote. I learned more from Jim, the owner, about things to look for than anyone I had met with. I needed an egress window installed and I learned that they are also Master Plumbers, Radon Specialists, and Foundation Experts. I found that by hiring The IHN company I was able to get all of these services provided for my basement remodel.

They were able to secure my basement from any future moisture migration along with providing a complete sump pump re-build. I had my Radon system moved during this portion of the basement remodel. The men were polite and asked if there was anything I needed before they left for the day. They cleaned up after each days work and were punctual the following morning. The workmanship far exceeded my expectations, not to mention the one source with a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Kari Southern
reviews.text: My husband and I were referred to the IHN company for some basement water issues we were having. We ended up needing our entire drain tile replaced. I was happy with how quickly they could get out to do the assessment, and I understood that it took roughly a month to come out and do the work. What I was really disappointed with is after we spent over $8K doing this work, they left my basement a disaster with broken tile all around and did not clean up after themselves. I would not have expected everything to be pristine, but these pictures show that little to no effort was done. I had to badger them with repeated phone calls for DAYS to even get in touch with someone. While they did offer to come back the following week and try and "touch up", we could not afford to wait as we had already postponed putting our house on the market. My husband and I spent an entire weekend cleaning up their mess. My last email asked in a very nice way for a small refund to compensate us for the cleanup work we had to do. That was two weeks ago, with of course - no response. The drain tile is working great, but I'm sorry to say I would NEVER recommend this company after they left my basement in this condition.

plumbers.name: Douglas Cooling Heating Electrical Plumbing
plumbers.address: 8752 Helena Rd, Pelham, AL 35124, USA

reviews.author: Wayne Zeek
reviews.text:
Jeremy from Douglas K&S Heating, Cooling and Plumbing did an outstanding job installing a new water pressure valve and cutoff valve in my home. From start to finish, he was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly friendly. He took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all my questions, and made sure I felt confident about the work being done.

What really stood out was Jeremy’s attention to detail and pride in his work. The installation was clean, efficient, and done right the first time. On top of that, his positive attitude and easygoing personality made the whole experience stress-free.

It’s not often you come across someone who combines top-notch skill with genuine friendliness, but Jeremy does exactly that. Without a doubt, he’s the best plumber in the area—maybe even the world. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him to anyone needing plumbing work.

reviews.author: ironmanbobby
reviews.text: I’ve done business with Douglas since they operated as K & S Services. I’ve had 2 systems in that time, the last they installed for me 3 years ago. The techs are always friendly and professional and they keep my system running flawlessly. I’ve also used their plumbing service and it’s just as good. I strongly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Mike Freeman
reviews.text: Called Douglas because of a sudden issue with the heat not coming on and they had a tech (Jonathan) out within the day to look at the system. Diagnosed the problem quickly and after we discussing my options with Mason at the office and with Jonathan decided to go with a repair though we did discuss a future replacement as my system is 18 years old. Jonathan came back the next day when the parts were acquired and within a few hours had the system up and running as good as ever. Excellent service, communication and overall a pleasure to work with. Only one place to call when it's time for a system.

reviews.author: Ann White
reviews.text: Jeremy was very knowledgeable and polite. We appreciated his plumbing expertise. He arrived when he said he would. When he finished, he left the work area clean and tidy. He provided several options and explained the pros and the cons of each. All-around good experience!

reviews.author: Robert and Susan Stewart
reviews.text: Douglas recently installed our new Mitsubishi heat pump system. The whole experience was smooth, from the initial discussions about our needs, through the quote and installation. The new system is a huge improvement over our old cooling/heating unit. The Mitsubishi is whisper-quiet while maintaining a comfortable temperature. We were also please to see that our power bill dropped by around 25% during its first full month of operation. Couldn’t be more pleased. Highly recommend the team at Douglas.

plumbers.name: Gregory's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 322 E Main St #4600, Batavia, OH 45103, USA

reviews.author: Shelley Summers
reviews.text: Jacob is hands down the best plumber I have ever worked with! He installed a new whole house water filtration system and softener for us, and the quality of the installation was top-notch—everything looked neat and professional. I’ve lived in different places with similar systems, and this was by far the best plumbing job I’ve seen. Jacob also replaced our kitchen water filter, serviced our on-demand water heater, and took the time to teach us about all the plumbing features in our new Batavia home, without charging extra for his advice. I am extremely impressed and truly grateful for such excellent service from Gregory's Plumbing.

reviews.author: Tanya Bullock
reviews.text: The plumber was able to schedule my appointment quickly and showed up on time. Donovan came out to replace my old shower valve and ended up updating all the pipes leading to the shower head as well. He made sure everything was nice and secure, so nothing wobbles anymore. Since my house is pretty old, he even raised the shower head to a more comfortable height. The work was done really well and didn’t take long at all. The price matched what I expected, with no hidden costs or surprises. Overall, I’m happy with the service and would recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work.

reviews.author: lydia chavez
reviews.text: I'm really glad I went with my gut and chose Gregory's Plumbing for my plumbing needs. When I called, the office staff was friendly and respectful, picking up right away and making me feel comfortable. Even though my issue wasn't an emergency, they were able to schedule an appointment quickly—just two days later. I appreciated getting a confirmation call when the plumber was on the way, so I knew exactly when to expect them. Jacob was the plumber who came out, and he was fantastic. He had a great sense of humor, which made the whole experience easier, and he knew exactly how to fix my slow-draining sinks. Everything was explained clearly, with upfront estimates and honest communication about what to expect. If you're looking for a reliable plumber who does quality work and treats you right, I highly recommend reaching out to this company.

reviews.author: Clara Kirk
reviews.text: We woke up to find our basement flooded because our water heater had cracked overnight. We called a local plumbing company right away, and they responded quickly and acted very professionally. Donovan came out to inspect the water heater, explained everything clearly, and gave us a fair price for the replacement. He was friendly and made us feel comfortable throughout the whole process. Jacob, who was helping him, was also very polite and respectful when he introduced himself. Both of them took great care to protect our home while working. We were so glad to have hot water restored the same day. We will definitely call this plumbing team again if we need help in the future.

reviews.author: Veronica F
reviews.text: Gregory's Plumbing provided top-notch service when I needed several plumbing updates after moving into my new home in Batavia. I reached out based on their great reviews, and I’m glad I did. Jacob and Donovan came out to help finish a plumbing project I had started myself but ran into trouble with. They showed up right on time, which I really appreciated. Both Jacob and Donovan were very friendly and took the time to explain each step of the work so I understood what was happening. They replaced my kitchen sink, installed new shutoff valves, hooked up the dishwasher, and swapped out my garbage disposal. They also took care of the shutoff valves for both toilets and even fixed a small leak on the main water line. Everything was completed quickly and looked perfect when they finished. The price for all the work was fair, and I felt like I was getting honest advice the whole time. Later, I scheduled another appointment because I was having issues with my hot water tank. Jacob said he’d try to repair it first to save me money. When the water heater suddenly failed and started leaking everywhere, I called for help right away. The office was very understanding about the emergency and had Jacob and Donovan at my house with a new tank in less than half an hour. Once again, the work was done fast and professionally. I highly recommend them for any plumbing needs in Batavia. The prices are reasonable, the plumbers are trustworthy, and they don’t try to upsell you on things you don’t need. Overall, I am very happy with the service and the results!

plumbers.name: Abend Services
plumbers.address: 407 Bon Air Ave, Baltimore, MD 21225, USA

reviews.author: Audra Russell (Audra)
reviews.text:
I had a slow leak in my toilet that was starting to come through the kitchen ceiling—stressful to say the least! I called Abend Services and they came out the very next day. From start to finish, the experience was fantastic. Communication was clear and timely, and the technician was friendly, professional, and took the time to thoroughly explain the issue and how it would be fixed. They diagnosed the problem quickly and were completely transparent throughout the process. I truly appreciate the excellent service and peace of mind. Highly recommend!

EDITED TO ADD: they saved the day again. Our house was built in 1954, so there are bound to be things that come up. I woke up to water coming from under my stove. Called Abend at 4:37 AM and Katie answered. Richie and Mike were here a few hours later. Showed me what needed to be done and what the price would be before they started and they were done within an hour.

Abend is definitely on speed dial for this old home!

reviews.author: Margaret Henn
reviews.text: They were quick to respond and the technician was very nice.  However, they were unable to clear the clog in the sewer line.  I understood that, but they never followed up and 2 emails were sent.  They only responded to 1 of the email, otherwise they ghosted us.  We hired another local plumber who did the work needed to repair the sewer line.

reviews.author: Brenda Witten
reviews.text: We were very pleased with Richard Koontz. He was very professional and knowledgeable. Everyone at ABend is very easy to talk with and seems willing to help.

reviews.author: Philip Whitebloom
reviews.text: See the pictures below. Upon discovering that my water heater burst, I immediately called ABEND Services (5:30AM) because of my prior positive experiences with them. They answered the phone and had a technician out to my home before 8:30AM. They sized up the problem and went into action. They were meticulous in making sure all details were being addressed. Especially getting the new water heater down the stairs and they old one back up the stairs with no damage to my property. You can see in the pictures the installation very well done. They cleaned up afterwards. It was like they were never here. Don't skimp on what's important. Call the best. I did.

reviews.author: Benita Murphy
reviews.text: I had a leak coming from my toilet and of course, I called Abend Plumbing. When I tell you this is the most professional, knowledgeable and courteous company. I can go on and on. Richard Koontz was the plumber they sent out. He arrived on time. He put his shoe covers on fixed the leak. But then he found another leak that I needed to take care of but I wasn't prepared financially. When I tell you, he showed so much empathy and professionalism. Before leaving he cleaned up and vacuumed. I mean, this guy was the best. Thumbs up all the way for Abend Plumbing.

plumbers.name: Gem City Plumbing Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 683 Miamisburg Centerville Rd #211, Dayton, OH 45459, USA

reviews.author: Jon Bergstrom
reviews.text:
I would like to take this opportunity to give a big thanks to Gem City Plumbers.  We were faced with a failing hot water heater, but also decided to do a major investment which included a new water softener, whole house carbon filter, and a new sump pump.  Of the three quotes we received, which were all pretty close, GCP provided the best options for our needs.  As well, they were the only company of the three that actually followed up after a couple days of sending the quote.  Not being pushy sales people, but a courtesy call in case we had any questions.  That was just another reason to go with GCP.  The total time for installation, was roughly 8 hours or so.  It was a pleasure having Brayden in our home.  He was very professional and did an outstanding job with the space that was available for him to work with.  I definitely would recommend GCP for any and all of your plumbing needs!  Here are before and after pics.
Thank you again.
Jon

reviews.author: Ben Ausdenmoore
reviews.text:
I had Brayden as my on-site technician and he was fantastic. Very polite, informative, and diligent on keeping things as clean as possible. It was a water heater removal and installation, not a clean process but at the end my HVAC area looks better than it did when he started and the new lines are very well done (moved from tank to tankless).

The overall process was excellent and very easy going. This included reaching out to Gem City Plumbers via the online form, getting a response the very next business day, and even getting multiple responses on the same day as additional information was needed to get the quote worked out.

Kudos to the whole team on a well run company that provided service that felt very customer centric and moved much faster than other places that I requested quotes from. Some haven't even responded at this point after the first contact.

reviews.author: La'Quita Lanier
reviews.text: I explained what I was experiencing. He went and checked it out. Explained everything he was going to do. Fixed it all within 2 hrs. Very respectful of our home, even cleaned up after he fixed the problems. Even checked something else out he had seen at no extra charge. Come to find out it wasn't turned all the way off. I really respect his honesty.

reviews.author: Richard McGregor
reviews.text: Gem city responded same day to a water leak on my second floor. They did a thorough search of the problem area before deciding carving into my dining room ceiling was the only way to find the leak. Once found it was fixed in just a few minutes.

reviews.author: NANCI LINDHOLZ
reviews.text: Justin was amazingly helpful in getting an ASAP inspection for my listing and also getting the repairs done in a matter of days at a more than fair price (and thousands, yes thousands!, of dollars cheaper than the original inspector.)  My sellers and the new buyers are very happy!! I will recommend Gem City to all of my real estate clients from now on!

plumbers.name: Carolina Water Heater & Plumbing Service Inc.
plumbers.address: 3047 Argent Blvd, Ridgeland, SC 29936, USA

reviews.author: Phil Harris
reviews.text: The guys were terrific!  They were very friendly and professional.  They offered me good advise and recommended an ionic descaler which would pay for itself in just a few years.  I purchased the descaler.  I highly recommend Carolina Water Heater and Plumbing Services!

reviews.author: Chris Borges
reviews.text: Having experienced their great work previously for a new hot water heater, it was a no-brainer to contact them again for a clogged garbage disposal drain pipe. Within a few hours after contacting them, Dan quickly found the issue and all was fixed!! Prices are reasonable too. Thanks Dan. Glad to see you again.

reviews.author: Michael Weiss
reviews.text: I have used Carolina Water Heater & Plumbing Service Inc to perform the annual maintenance on our tankless water heater once before, and called them again to perform the same service. Gave them a call, techs came out within a few days, and did an amazing job. True professionals for a great price.

reviews.author: Dan Wade
reviews.text: Drew and Gary were polite, friendly, and very professional.  They treated my home as if it was their home.  I truly appreciated their careful attention to install my new tankless water heater correctly, and clean up after the job was finished.  I would use them again in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Joan Clifton
reviews.text: Cleaned and descaled 3 tankless water heaters.  The techs were very knowledgable and took the time to answer our questions.  Only thing I wish they had done was let us know they needed a gate pass, as I could have provided them with one at no charge.

plumbers.name: Accurate Air Solutions, LLC
plumbers.address: 6737 E Hwy 80, Abilene, TX 79601, USA

reviews.author: Jennifer Rogers
reviews.text: My pipes froze from this last storm and I had Accurate Air Plumbing came out to fix it.  Thank you Jay S and Dillon F for their awesome service! They showed up  quickly and immediately got to work fixing it. They actually took the time to talk to me and explain what the problem was, how they were fixing it and what I can do to prevent it from happening again. Most services come in, do whatever and want their money.  NOT THESE GUYS! They were so polite and even offered to take off their boots so they didn't track snow and mud through my home. AND, they did not drain my bank account! I want them to know how much I truly appreciate everything they did. If you want service where someone comes into your home and treats you like a human being and not just money in their pockets, I promise you will truly appreciate and actually enjoy Accurate Air Plumbing come to your home. Thank you from the bottom of my heart and keep up the awesome work!

reviews.author: Becca Coleman
reviews.text: Walter from Accurate Air is consistently professional, incredibly knowledgeable, and always willing to go above and beyond. Even with a completely full schedule, he still made time to come out and take care of an issue that had everyone in a bit of panic. His dedication, reliability, and genuine willingness to help made all the difference. Thank you, Walter you’re a phenomenal plumber and truly a bad*** asset to the team. We also experienced an emergency lateral drain line issue in military housing that resulted in two families being displaced. After scheduling and coordinating with Walter, he promptly sent out Duran and Trey, and they were absolutely AMAZING. Both were highly professional and went above and beyond, even working past normal hours to ensure the job was completed properly. They carefully cautioned off the area until work could resume and restored the site as if it had never been touched. This is truly a remarkable team, and I would HIGHLY recommend Duran and Trey for ANY job and will definitely be using Accurate Air again in the future.

reviews.author: Donna Mcadams
reviews.text:
I am very pleased with the customer service from Accurate Air Solutions. Ricky was knowledgeable and professional. And prompt!
I have made arrangements for additional work to be scheduled next week.
It seems that these guys can take care of a multitude of problems. They are just what we’ve been searching for and I’m appreciative of their expertise.

reviews.author: Melissa Lara
reviews.text: We’ve had nothing but great experiences with the plumbing department at Accurate Air Solutions. Walter and his team are extremely professional, dependable, and always receptive to our needs. Walter consistently goes above and beyond to make sure the job is done right. Their pricing is fair, and they’ve earned our trust—this is the only plumbing company we work with.

reviews.author: Jason Skinner
reviews.text: Brandon Whitley will be the ONLY tech I will ever request.  He is professional, honest and technically savvy.  I called for a possible thermostat issue.  Brandon showed up promptly when he said he would, he listened to my concerns carefully and without hesitation dove right in to diagnose my issue.  He did not pressure me at all, did not hurry me and did not try to guide me into a needless purchase.  he was honest and went above and beyond when checking to make sure everything is perfect with my system.  Great tech, keep him on your staff at all costs!!!!!

plumbers.name: H.C. Edwards Plumbing Company
plumbers.address: 3851 FM 663, Midlothian, TX 76065, USA

reviews.author: Dillon Lamb
reviews.text: Professional, fast, honest, and straightforward.  This is a family company with that is communicative and thorough. I have used them three times and had three good experiences including once being not charged because there was a simple solution to the problem that Jason simply pointed out to me. Good people that you will feel good about using!

reviews.author: Stephen Capler
reviews.text: Came out late on a Sunday night, I had a leaky water heater, he replaced the whole thing same day, was quick and was honest and direct on his quote. Did great work and my family was back taking hot showers. They did a great job. Appreciate you for all your help

reviews.author: Brian Voigt
reviews.text:
This is the second time I’ve used H.C. Edwards Plumbing Company for repairs on our property. The first time was a major issue with our sewer line to the City and the other was due to a burst pipe due to freezing temps.

Jason communicates swiftly, consistently and clearly. He does a great job whether big or small. He takes the time to provide details of what needs to be done and what ended up having to be done after the work was completed.

There’s never been a surprise with the costs of his services and he clearly communicates them.

I highly recommend H.C. Edwards Plumbing Company.

reviews.author: Josh Cole
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a plumber in the Dallas area, let me save you the time and effort of finding the right man for the job. Jason, with H.C. Edwards Plumbing is incredible. He was thorough, no BS and all around stellar at his job. The difference in pricing from other services I had looked into was night and day— let alone the quality of service.

I made the mistake of reaching out to corporate owned plumbing services. They came to my house and told me that on top of clearing my pipes, I needed double clean outs installed. The price I was quoted was unbelievably off-putting— hence why I decided to shop around.

I reached out to Jason and explained the issues we were having and what the plumbers had told me. He quotes me for the same services for less than half the price. Jason comes to my house, identifies that we do in fact have double clean outs installed, then proceeds to clear the blockage in the pipes in a timely and efficient manner.

He truly went above and beyond to make sure the issue was resolved on all fronts— no cut corners.

Save your time and money and utilize this amazing family operated plumbing business. I cannot tell you the relief I feel after having him come by.

reviews.author: Sherri Brown
reviews.text: We needed emergency pipe repair due to a leak under our bathroom sink and Jason saved the day. He arrived 20 minutes after our call, quickly assessed the situation and got right to work. He was very professional, experienced, and expeditious. Thank you so much H.C Edwards Plumbing!

plumbers.name: Plumbing Doctor
plumbers.address: 955 Business Park Dr, Dixon, CA 95620, USA

reviews.author: Bev Tamplen
reviews.text: This company was fantastic.  Macario, Juan, and Sergio came out right away, explained everything thoroughly and completely.  They were here for 5 days to make sure everything was done.  The job was well done and they left everything better than when they got started.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: D T
reviews.text: Ron quickly diagnosed the issue I was having with my washing machine flooding. He was very meticulous in fixing the hosing and drainage and making sure everything was placed properly back so I didn’t have to do that. He was nice to talk with as well!

reviews.author: Diane Emmrich
reviews.text: I had a leak under the kitchen sink. Called plumbing Dr at 9am and by 2pm it was fixed. Raul was our plumber that came out, he was knowledgeable, professional, efficient and answered all my questions. We have used Plumbing Dr for years with exceptional service.

reviews.author: Cory Cooper
reviews.text: Very pleased with the service and results. Troubleshooting with the camera found a unique problem in our lines. The hydrojet was needed for our cleanout. We now have a clear lines and a much better understanding of our plumbing if future problems arise.  Everyone was very professional and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: TG Throwaway
reviews.text: Ron H fixed my clogged drain and was very helpful and courteous. He took the time to explain how he was going to fix the problem, and how I could avoid similar issues in the future. I made the appointment at 7:30 am and my drain was fixed by 12:30.

plumbers.name: Imlay Plumbing
plumbers.address: 779 N 2325 W, Cedar City, UT 84721, USA

reviews.author: Kristin Woolsey
reviews.text: My water heater had been leaking for a while. I contacted Imlay Plumbing and they came out right away. They replaced the water heater quickly, efficiently, and at a reasonable price.They had to move the old one, filled with sediment, up my basement stairs. The new heater is amazing, works great, and it's even strapped to the wall now, which I should've had done years ago. The whole area is spotless. I'm so impressed by their service, friendliness, and I can rest easy not having to worry about the leak anymore!

reviews.author: Dennis Henrich
reviews.text:
I was first recommended Imlay Plumbing when I moved to the area in 2018, and they’ve been the only plumbing company I’ve recommended to friends and family ever since — and here’s why: they are honest! No hidden agendas, no surprise costs — I truly feel that they care about their customers.

Multiple coworkers suggested them, and my first experience was when I had water hammer in my walls. The plumber who came out was punctual, professional, and efficient. He replaced my pressure reducing valve, didn’t waste time or run up the bill, fixed the issue, and answered all of my questions. I felt completely comfortable having him work in my home.

Since that experience (I have had other great experiences), I’ve recommended them to my family, friends, and acquaintances for years, and it’s no surprise that they’ve all had great experiences too. The reason is because they are good at what they do and they are honest with their business. Simply put they won't take advantage of you.

I don’t write many reviews, but I wanted to share this recommendation with anyone reading. They will take care of you, and you won’t have to stress about who to call for plumbing issues, they are honest! Thank you to all of Imlay plumbing for always being responsive and kind.

reviews.author: Jonathan Smith
reviews.text: Imlay Plumbing was fantastic. We were serviced by Austin and Bryan. Great guys that worked efficiently and effectively to get the job done!  Very courteous and professional. Would definitely use again and recommend to anyone interested in great service and exceptional quality work.

reviews.author: David Hewett
reviews.text:
I had Imlay's Excavation team out to install three new water Service connections which included trenching the road, installing the meter pit, valving and a hot tap on an 8 inch water main.

The two leading the team (Justin & Luis) as well as their other plumber who's name I didn't catch were all professional, efficient and knowledgeable.

They were careful when finding the water main searching with precision and patience. They left the site nicely compacted after trenching, the road in better condition than it started and the Residents property in a clean and tidy manner. To such a point that the resident was ecstatic of how they had rearranged all the rocks.

Thank you for all the help and I look forward to using you again in the future.

reviews.author: Sharron Grodzinsky
reviews.text: Jason and Omar did an amazing job with our new water heater. They worked diligently, cleaned up, and were polite and professional. Jason was friendly and respectful. Could not have asked for a better job!

plumbers.name: Lickity Split Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2600 Klondike Rd, West Lafayette, IN 47906, USA

reviews.author: Sarah Wood
reviews.text: Josh came on time, fixed my main drain and got be back in about an hour to be able to utilize our toilets, sinks, showers etc! I was a new customer today, as my usualplumber was out of state, will be utilizing this service from now on! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: John Smith
reviews.text: Not a great experience.  Called them to get a price to change a Valve.  They don't charge hourly like a reputable plumber they charge on project pricing which is concerning. I had previous quotes for 600.  This company showed up and said 1300.  If I wanted to run 10 total feet of PEX that would be an additional 400.  Then somehow the added 2 numbers were 1800?.  Not sure where the extra 100 came in.  He said running 4ft of PEX inside a hollow interior wall was "hard".   I politely thanked and said we would not be interested.  He said if I got a quote a few hundred less to call and they would match.  Overall I did not get a good impression for honesty and fair pricing.

reviews.author: Addie Sweet
reviews.text: Josh is very responsive, thorough, and goes above and beyond. He has worked on two houses for me and has been quick to respond each time. I really appreciate his business and expertise!

reviews.author: Thomas Schmidt
reviews.text:
They made it easy to set a time and date for the review of issues and schedule the work.  Then were on time and had the correct tools and parts to do the work.  For me they were the epitome of  good repair work and professionalism.

Also replaced a bad toilet shutoff valve.

reviews.author: Macarena Guerrero
reviews.text: We have worked with Josh three times already and we will keep working with him. He has been able to come on the same day, his prices are fair and his service is very thorough. Highly recommend.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 5501 US-280 Ste 106, Birmingham, AL 35242, USA

reviews.author: LaTrice
reviews.text: Julian was my service provider today and I just want to say that he is amazing and he made sure that the work was completed in a timely manner and he walked me through every step of his work he had to complete. Very friendly dependable and was on time for the consultation and back out the next morning. Thank you for your service and I will be making other appointments for future work that we had discussed.

reviews.author: Jenna Sisson Saturday
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter completed service at my home today, and the experience was exceptional. We had a major water leak caused by a busted pipe, which resulted in significant water coming through the ceiling and flooding downstairs. Ronald was meticulous in identifying the source of the problem, clearing the affected lines, and fully stopping the leak. He conducted a thorough quality assessment and walked me through a detailed Q&A to ensure everything was fully resolved and understood. His professionalism, clarity, and attention to detail were outstanding. I would highly recommend both Ronald and Roto-Rooter to anyone dealing with a serious plumbing issue.

reviews.author: Steve Thomas
reviews.text: The company was very responsive and came out the first time within hours. I had called a local plumber 5 times and never heard back from the after leaving a message each time. The problem I had was more extensive than it first appeared but the issues I had were fixed within 48 hours.

reviews.author: Leigh Doud
reviews.text: Very professional service by Julian and his Tech.  When we had to switch plans to fix the problem they spent so much time and attention to all the details to make sure everything was perfect when the job was complete. Highly recommend Roto-Rooter and especially Julian.

reviews.author: Jazmine Alejo
reviews.text: Honestly some of the most down to earth people on one team. Rosario and the team made sure to answer ANY questions I may have had and made the work fun. I felt like it was the end of my world and they helped me see the bigger picture. I’d call them everytime they are needed. Thank you to the team for their hard work and dedication. My favorite restoration team lol

plumbers.name: Jack L Woods Plumbing Co Inc
plumbers.address: 130 E Home St, Westerville, OH 43081, USA

reviews.author: Robert Ramsey
reviews.text: First off, let me state that my Father was a plumber with his own business out on the West Side of Columbus in the Brookshire Addition. My Dad always gave 100%, his work was the very best, and his standards were stellar, as many of his former customers would attest. So, when i see or need plumbing work done, I definitely know what to expect in quality and fair pricing! Today, we had a current waterline leak in the basement repaired; fifty-six-year-old copper plumbing needs tender care and maintenance, you know. Experiencing a couple of pinhole leaks in our water supply, we called upon Jack L. Woods Plumbing Company, Incorporated located in Westerville to take care of the situation. Previously, they expertly installed a new water heater in our basement which has been totally dependable since installation a few years back. Our repairman, Barry, was professional, on time, and did a superb repair to remedy our current situation. In addition, he repositioned a current shut-off valve close to the main shut-off valve, to make certain we have a complete shutdown of water  in case of future plumbing needs. I cannot recommend this thirty-five-year-old company enough! They give the very best in service for your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Amanda Grissinger
reviews.text: Larry should be fired or not allowed to answer the phones. Rude, impatient, condescending, and just plain heartless. He actually made me cry he was so difficult to talk to. Don't have someone who has shitty people skills talking to customers. Also why do I have to give you my address, phone number, email and name after you were already at my house and did work? Does your company not own a computer? You can't pull up a previous job using one of those pieces of information? I don't understand why I had to repeat all this information again just to have you come back to do more work. Especially after I never received an invoice for the initial service I received a few days prior. How did you expect to get paid if I hadn't called back? Now the guy who did the work at my house was fantastic, which is why I left 3 stars instead of 1. I think his name was Dave but I'm positive. He was not only kind and professional, but he fixed our problem in just a few hours and did an amazing job. He was very knowledgeable and experienced and we had confidence we were in good hands with him.

reviews.author: Charlotte Hyland
reviews.text: Matt did a great job, right on time and let me know when he was on his way. Nice guy, got my drain cleared out and left the area cleaner than when he got there! Definitely recommend Jack Woods Plumbing!

reviews.author: Michael Chambers
reviews.text: They sent Dusty out to take care of a couple plumbing issues I had. He did a fantastic job and was very efficient time wise. Very happy with the service!

reviews.author: Jeremy Glotz
reviews.text: If you want them to catch your house on fire and turn your life upside down then call them, otherwise stay away from these people.  No accountability for what they did either to our lives and 6 months of you know what to get our life back.  Negligence was involved with someone you sent that should have had a mentor.  Ironically he had a mentor on another job the days following our house fire caused by him.  This is the work you get with Jack Woods on a simple spigot repair.  They don’t even deserve a 1 star, but at least people in our neighborhood know not to call them again and have made sure of that.

plumbers.name: AA Plumbing
plumbers.address: 6701 Dixie Hwy, Fairfield, OH 45014, USA

reviews.author: Terina Faig
reviews.text: Had a bathroom remodel/upgrade done. Daniel was great, very professional. He showed up everyday when he said he would, kept his work area very clean and tidy, gave a recap of the day and what to expect the next day, and was flexible and accommodating with changes. We would absolutely have him return for future projects!

reviews.author: Deborah Price
reviews.text: Oh my goodness! I am so grateful for AA Plumbing. I had a difficult toilet install on my basement level. . The trained technicians from AA PLumbing were professionals courteous and knowledgeable about every aspect of the bathroom sink and toilet installation. The job was completed within a timely manner. The technicians cleaned up once they were  finished. I  really appreciated the technician providing me a hands on walkthrough inspection of the work done with clarity and to my understanding. I would definitely recommend AA Plumbing to anyone who wants a residential or commercial project. Completed.

reviews.author: Anthony Billups
reviews.text: I absolutely recommend AA Plumbing! Fast service ,Professional,and great quality work. Other companies past plumbers I tried never completely fixed my issues. But AA Plumbing makes sure work is completed and top quality. Great prices too. Call AA you won't be disappointed. I am so glad I found them. Ask for Samuel Dillion , excellent work!

reviews.author: Joe Burling
reviews.text: I've used AA Plumbing twice now and can't recommend them enough. The plumbers that have come out all care very much about getting the job done right, not doing more than they need to, and helping me avoid overspending. The entire process, both times, was pleasant, responsive, cost efficient, and gave me confidence. They will be the only plumber I call moving forward.

reviews.author: eric venturino
reviews.text: Never used them for plumbing services but after nearly be ran of the road by one of their drivers and watching him weave through traffic recklessly changing 3 or 4 lanes at a time going over 90mph I can safely say ill never be using a company that employs people with such a reckless nature towards the public.

plumbers.name: ABREEZE Plumbing & Drain, LLC
plumbers.address: 2610 Stratfield Dr, Cumming, GA 30041, USA

reviews.author: Ellie Nelson
reviews.text:
Cannot say enough great things about David & his team. We were out of our house for 2.5 months while we had extensive repair/renovations going on. Once we came back, we started having major plumbing issues only to find out we needed our entire main sewage line replaced (50+ years old) as well as our main plumbing in our basement (existing was back pitched).

David and Sean did a phenomenal job explaining everything to us, coming up with a solution that was better than we expected, and quoted us reasonably for the work being done. They were able to complete the job in a day, left our property looking like nothing ever happened, and made us feel taken care of throughout the entire process.

They’re knowledgeable and passionate about what they do. They will be the only plumbers we call moving forward. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tina
reviews.text: David and his crew are top-notch. They came fast in an emergency and they got the job done no matter how long it took.  They are pleasant efficient, and go above and beyond always. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Tim Bellante
reviews.text:
I can't say enough great things about the service we received from David and Dan! From start to finish, they were professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly thorough in fixing our plumbing issues.

They replaced our pressure regulator with a high-quality dual-chamber brass model, ensuring that our home's water pressure is set within a safe range. They took the time to explain everything and made sure the installation was done with precision and care. Knowing that this upgrade protects our faucets, toilets, and appliances from potential damage gives us great peace of mind.

In addition, they quickly diagnosed and repaired a pinhole leak in our main-level bathroom ceiling. The leak was coming from a 3/4” PEX A waterline, and they expertly cut out the damaged section and made a seamless repair. Their efficiency and skill prevented what could have turned into a much bigger problem!

Lastly, they also replaced our thermal expansion tank, which had failed and was full of water. They didn’t charge us for this replacement, which was an unexpected but much-appreciated bonus!

The quality of their work, the high-grade materials they used, and the 1-year warranty they provided on their repairs truly set them apart. If you're looking for honest, skilled plumbers who take pride in their work, look no further than David and Dan. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Aleena Akbar
reviews.text: Truly professional. David took the time to explain what was causing my plumbing issues. I look forward to working with him for all future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Brian Taylor
reviews.text: I highly recommend ABREEZE for anyone looking for a dependable and honest plumber. David and his team are top notch!

plumbers.name: Bumble Bee Plumbing
plumbers.address: 10178 Heytesbury Ln, Sandy, UT 84092, USA

reviews.author: C
reviews.text: So it's been a week or two, and I am still very happy with everything! I had originally called because the water heater was making weird noise, not an emergency. Zach still showed up the next day, found the water pressure was really high, my house regulator had failed, and I had several pipes nearing failure too. He had his team out within two days, Natalie made scheduling and managing change orders a breeze via text, we got very helpful notifications the day of from their CRM, and Virgil and Seth took the time to do everything properly. I'm entirely happy with Bumble Bee!

reviews.author: Kent Edman
reviews.text: So glad to find an honest and fair local plumber.  Locally owned and operated.  Not part of the Venture Capital firms that overcharge, and upsell.  Zach was great to work with.  I've had them come back multiple times for other projects and everytime the pricing was fair, they were quick and professional and so easy to work with.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Chad Harward
reviews.text: Bumble Bee Plumbing is exceptional! I’ve had them take care of multiple plumbing repairs. They are professional, clean, and have fantastic communication. Their customer service and customer experience is top level. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Matthias Ruckle
reviews.text: Our service with Bumble Bee was great. The plumber was on time, polite, knowledgeable, and communicated the issue very well (even drew pictures). And the price for the service was excellent. Would definitely use them again for plumbing issues!

reviews.author: David Colburn
reviews.text: Seth and Virgil were a delight to work with. They arrived as promised and did the work in a quality and timely manner. Very responsive and were able to accommodate a quick turnaround. Will definitely use and recommend to others. Price was competitive and reasonable for the drain installation in the laundry room. Also their office actually makes an effort to keep you informed the entire time from quote to completion. Highly recommend.

plumbers.name: Sampson Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 1209 Lakeland Ave, Bohemia, NY 11716, USA

reviews.author: Duke Daly
reviews.text: He took the time to answer all of my questions, kept me informed every step of the way, and made everything as smooth and stress-free as possible. His attention to detail and commitment to excellent service really stood out. I highly recommend Joe to anyone looking for someone they can trust and rely on. Thank you, Joe, for a great experience!

reviews.author: Erica Boni
reviews.text: After years of different plumbers trying to figure out why my basement smelled, Sampson Plumbing and heating figured it out. The crew was great with creating a plan for venting our basement fixtures appropriately along with mitigating risk for smells in the future. They were quick and efficient with their work and I am really happy I can go in my basement again and not worry about smells anymore. I highly recommend Sampson Plumbing for any job, especially a job that can be tricky and needs someone to think outside the box

reviews.author: Jovel Nunez
reviews.text:
I had Sampson Plumbing do a gas conversion on my home in Merrick.

From getting the permits issued to dealing with my GC they handled everything professionally and in a timely manner. My GC even said they did the job well - he was impressed. There were some times where they had to come back unexpectedly but they were always super responsive and returned quickly.

Nicole, RJ and Joe were always available to answer any questions we had.

We would highly recommend for all plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Robert Kelly
reviews.text: Sampson Plumbing is a top notch company. They are consistently prompt, neat, and excellent plumbers. I've used them 3 times and I was completely satisfied with their work. Highly recommend !!!

reviews.author: Kathy K
reviews.text: I have used Sampson Plumbing for many years both in my elmont home and sayville - always quick efficient and competitively priced. The owner Joe Sampson is very knowledgable.  Would recommend them 100%

plumbers.name: Marine Plumbing Service, Inc
plumbers.address: 2550 Sandy Plains Rd Ste 225 #413, Marietta, GA 30066, USA

reviews.author: Kenny Marus
reviews.text:
We hired Marine Plumbing Service after our home flooded due to a bad repair by another plumber, which resulted in a full gut of the house. From day one, Nick Marine and his team were outstanding.

Nick identified multiple plumbing issues that were high-risk or not up to code and worked with us honestly and within our budget. More importantly, he treated my wife and me like family during an incredibly difficult time.

We were never just another job. The care, integrity, and kindness shown by Nick, his crew, and even his family helped us put our home back together. We are deeply grateful and cannot recommend Marine Plumbing Service highly enough.

reviews.author: Sharon F
reviews.text: Nick and his crew were quick to respond to my shower handle problem. While here they checked the system including water pressure, hot water tank, and known pin hole leaks in the copper piping. A summary was sent shortly after the appointment. The canister for the shower was already on the truck so they were able to fix it in less than 30 minutes. All are very personable and friendly and I was very pleased with the whole experience. They came highly recommended by my neighbor who has used them for many years not only for problems, but remodeling projects as well

reviews.author: David Cicco
reviews.text: I’ve used Marine Plumbing Service for a lot of my projects the last few years. Tony and Nick are top tier pros. They do it right and they have better knowledge than anyone else you’d have out for a job. Along with Ryan and Najee who always complete any job to a professional and exceptional standard. Marine Plumbing has a standard, that standard is always to code, above and beyond, and always the honest choice. Bottom line, if you want it done right, call Marine Plumbing Service!

reviews.author: Paul W
reviews.text: I no longer have to continue my seemingly endless search for an honest, experienced, hard working, knowledgeable plumber who does things the right way. I highly recommend contacting Marine Plumbing and guarantee you will end your search, too, if these are important values to you. Nick and his entire team CARE and do excellent work. The attention to detail, listening to your needs, and focus on quality of work and materials is second to none. I can’t say enough good about Nick and his entire crew. They’re simply awesome… and a joy to talk to as well. I will be using them for everything I possibly can in future!

reviews.author: Tony Blanca
reviews.text: I received a text message from Tony at Marine Plumbing to ensure my hoses were disconnected due to the impending freezing temperatures. I truly appreciated this gesture, especially considering the hectic nature of my life lately, which didn’t require any additional stress from a burst waterline. As I was walking around the house, I noticed water leaking from my tankless water heater, which was a clear sign of an issue. I promptly sent a text message to the Marine Plumbing team, and they promptly determined that my unit needed replacement. The following morning, the skilled technicians from Marine Plumbing arrived at my home and began the necessary repairs to restore my water supply. The new unit is larger and more efficient, and I’m thoroughly impressed by the exceptional craftsmanship and dedication displayed by the team. They finished the work and he had decided out of the graciousness of his heart, that he was not going to charge me for the work done on the water faucet. My mother had just fallen and broke her hip on Tuesday evening, and I was a little out of sorts with everything and my mom and I don’t have a lot of free money laying around but with the water pouring out, it was absolutely necessary that we get this fixed. reviews.author: Cammy
reviews.text:
Tub to shower retro fit in a house built in the 50's. I had a visit with Don the owner for preliminary estimate one day after calling. In a week we finalized a contract during another visit when I chose trim for fixtures, door and surround color and design. I was given a start date two weeks hence.

I changed my mind after the original color choice, no problem. Work began when scheduled and continued until completion. It took seven days. 2Plumbs Up handled the permit and inspection scheduling. 3 inspections: plumbing rough after demo, walls screwed and taped right, drain pan no leak overnight. I also had an exhaust fan installed. This required a crawlspace man for sewer connection, an attic man to install and vent the fan and an assistant for the project manager and primary installer, Gerardo. All showed up at the right time for their part, so company scheduled well and communicated well with a text when the crew was on the way with picture of who was coming.

The crew, always on time, were polite and responsive to my questions, concerns and requests and cleanliness needs. Pictures shots are before, demo, and after. My job, beyond paying, is to paint the freshly textured areas above the shower. Five stars says it all. Well pleased.

reviews.author: Sandy Besso
reviews.text: 2 Plumbs Up did an excellent job remodeling our bathrooms. The service is kind and courteous. The men worked very hard and were intuitive to our wants and needs. Thank you to Loren, Rob, Carlos, owner Don and the others who made the remodel seamless. Thank you.

reviews.author: Todd Bull
reviews.text: Steven Campbell from JR Putnam came to our house as part of the club membership we belong to where we pay $14.95 each month for maintenance. We've always utilized JR Putman for the biannual air-conditioning and furnace maintenance check-up program ever since they put the system in 13 years ago. Earlier this week we had some clogging issues in the main drain. Steven came in and through a series of skilled steps he diagnosed we had a clog near the street, but unfortunately still on our property. He found the clean out trap near the street, but it only provided access from the trap to the street not from the trap to the house. Tomorrow we'll have the JR Putman team dig out the clogged portion to determine what the issue is (we have some large trees in the area), fix it and install a new two way clean out trap so in the future we can access the main drain both ways. Steven even set us up with financing so we'll pay not interest if we pay off the note in a 24 month period. Every step of the way Steven kept us informed and showed us what his camera was seeing. It stinks we have a new $3200 debt to retire in 23 months, to avoid interest, but this system will be upgraded. We are not the first house on this block to experience a similar issue.  Steven Campbell is a real professional.

reviews.author: Darlene Daniels
reviews.text: Thank you, Don, and staff for my shower remodel. I love the flex stone shower and definitely the new shower floor. The staff were very professional and courteous. They made sure I understood how the project was going and what was going to take place the next day. I am a very happy and satisfied customer. If you need a shower repair/remodel, call 2 Plumbs Up Plumbing and Remodeling.

reviews.author: Liron Man
reviews.text:
Rob was at our house twice, he’s very professional and humble. Gives some good advices too.
I checked a few other places before booking with 2PU and they seemed to have a very fair pricing.
Definitely recommending.

plumbers.name: Laury Heating Cooling & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 923 Haddonfield Rd, Cherry Hill Township, NJ 08002, USA

reviews.author: Robert Schumann
reviews.text: Early morning on Christmas Eve, three service technicians arrived to install a new heating system in my home on North Main Street, Mullica Hill. My old system failed the previous Sunday morning. After an emergency call that Sunday December 21st, Matt diagnosed the heater and with Dave determined that making repairs that could not be guaranteed was not a good option, the only decision was to advise me to replace. So, three days later, Eric, Alexander and Jalen arrived on Christmas Eve. They were extremely courteous, taking time to listen to and answer my questions. I went into the basement maybe five times during the seven-hour installation to ask if they needed anything. What I observed each time was a team working together, focused on what needed to be done. As a 40-year customer of Laury, I want to thank those three gentlemen for their skills and professionalism. And to Matt, DJ, Dave, the Office Staff, Eric, Alexander, and Jalen – a sincere thank you. 40 years and counting with Laury – never had a complaint, only compliments.

reviews.author: Deborah Kangas
reviews.text:
Mo was the worker. Very nice, professional man. I have a clogged in my sink pipe, under my house. I have grease in the line, thats been there for awhile. Moe worked very hard, trying to break it up, Unfortunately it wouldn't budge. The weather doesnt help, being so cold.Moe, is a Great worker, personable ,Laury's is my go to company, for all, Heating, Plumbing, and Cooling. I rate Laury's a 5 Star Company
.

reviews.author: Diane Coveleski
reviews.text: We have been clients of Laury Heating for 20+years.  We have always received good service from them.  Recently, e have had a young man named Josh come out to service our heater.  Josh is amazing.  He was able to get our thermostat back on line when no one else was able to.  He also explained to us how we could do it ourselves.  We are not technically savvy.  He is very thorough and was able to identify why we were having an issue with our  heater.  He also made us aware of things that could be an issue in the future.  Josh has a fantastic personality (even our dog likes him) and we want Laury to make him the tech that comes out to our house for all services.

reviews.author: Cire728
reviews.text: We have used Laury Heating in the past, they continue to provide great service. Our technician Tom was excellent, he was knowledgeable and courteous. I asked him several questions and he patiently answered them and had our heat pump back up and running in no time.

reviews.author: John Kurtz
reviews.text: Disappointed with service.  Came out multi times.  Broke my heater with was leaking fluid. Finally supposedly fixed it. Heater goes back out three days later. Charges me again. Another Dispatch dispatching fee on Top of more parts. My first two bills never even got a proper invoice so I don’t even know what they did. For all I know they replaced the same thing again and charge me again. Or did My pump get stressed out because of the leak. I don’t know. Called multiple times no response. Honestly, more of a headache than it’s worth. If they fix my heater properly, the first time I would have no problem paying but multiple visits multiple parts. Honestly, I would just go somewhere else and we’ll be in the future

reviews.author: Victor Reyes
reviews.text: Great service, very fast service, caring and very affordable. CTX guys are very knowledgeable and work very professional. CTX came to our home to give us a quote when we where away from home and they are truly trustworthy and responsible people. My wife and I are very thankful with CTX for helping us out with our water heater disaster. CTX explained everything to us and anwer all of our questions. We truly recommend CTX for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Jason Robinson
reviews.text:
I had a bathroom faucet leak turn into a small flood at 7 PM on a Friday—classic timing, right? Called CTX Maximum Plumbing in a panic, and they actually answered and had someone out within about 90 minutes. The tech (think his name was Chris?) was super professional, explained exactly what failed and why without trying to upsell me on a bunch of extras. Fixed it cleanly, left no mess, and the price was fair for after-hours work.

This is the second time I've used them (previous was a water heater replacement last year), and both experiences were excellent. Responsive, honest, skilled, and they stand behind their work. If you're in the Belton / Temple area and need a plumber you can actually trust, these guys are the real deal. Highly recommend!

Would definitely call again without hesitation. Thanks for saving my floor—and my stress levels! 🚰

reviews.author: Misty Janicek
reviews.text: Highly recommend CTX! Chris was helpful and friendly from the first phone call until the job was completed to our satisfaction. Thanks, Chris!
