We really appreciate how prompt they were and the guys are very friendly too.

reviews.author: Quang Ho
reviews.text: Our backflow preventer had a crack and was leaking. Found out a day before we had to go out of town. Chris was able to squeeze us into his schedule and got it fixed by the afternoon. Price was fair and service couldn’t have been better.

plumbers.name: Jake the Plumbing Pro
plumbers.address: 1410 Dragon St STE 716, Dallas, TX 75207, USA

reviews.author: skylar ramos
reviews.text: Javier from Jake the Plumbing Pro did a fantastic job when my whole house was backed up in Dallas. I had already called another plumber before, but they couldn’t figure out where the main access line was. Javier used his plumbing know-how and found the right spot to dig by understanding how the pipes run from the crawlspace to the city line. He quickly located the main access, dug it up, and cleared the blockage. While working, Javier noticed the pipes under my house were sagging, which caused all the sewage to back up. He showed me the problem and explained that the pipes were being held by flimsy plastic straps. He spent hours under the crawlspace fixing the slope and replaced the old supports with sturdy metal straps, even giving me a 10-year warranty on the work! Javier went above and beyond by checking the rest of the house for any issues. He fixed my low water pressure for free, and also saw that my sink faucet had buildup, so he cleaned that out at no extra charge. He even raised my water temperature for free and made sure the sewage access lines are now easy to find in the future. I’m really impressed by his knowledge, fair pricing, and how much he cared about getting everything right. Definitely the best plumber I’ve worked with for quality, expertise, and kindness.

reviews.author: Cayden13 F
reviews.text: We reached out to Jake the Plumbing Pro for a second opinion when we weren’t sure about what another plumber said about our plumbing system. Luis and Javier came over, quickly found what was really going on, and gave us honest advice. As someone who asks a lot of questions, I felt comfortable the whole time—Luis and Javier took their time explaining how everything works and made sure I understood each step. I now feel much more confident about my plumbing system and really appreciate the time they spent with me. We’ll definitely call them again for any plumbing issues in Dallas, and they’re our top choice for future needs!

reviews.author: Donna Huerta
reviews.text: I had a leak at my meter box in Dallas. I called Jake the Plumbing Pro and was able to get an appointment within two hours. They really care about their customers, and even offer priority service and discounts if you've used them before. After the repair, the office followed up right away to make sure I was happy with the work. Luis arrived sooner than expected, quickly figured out the problem, and carefully dug around the water line without messing up my yard. He fixed the leak in about 40 minutes. Luis was friendly, professional, and made sure everything was working perfectly before leaving. I’ll definitely ask for him again for any of my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Angel Sharp
reviews.text: I had a plumbing emergency late on a Friday night during Superbowl weekend, and it was extra stressful because we have a cancer patient at home. While a lot of other plumbers didn’t even respond to my emergency messages, this company actually answered the phone right away. Luis, the plumber, stopped by my house on his way to another job just to make sure everything was okay. He fixed the issue with our tub faucet quickly and did a better job than I expected—the faucet works better now than before it broke. The service was fast, friendly, and honest, and the price was very reasonable. I’m really impressed and highly recommend them if you ever need a plumber.

reviews.author: Katherine Moss
reviews.text: When we started looking for quotes for our bathroom remodel, Jake the Plumbing Pro came highly recommended for the plumbing work. Javier came out to check everything and quickly noticed that the shower drain hadn’t been hooked up right by the last contractor. He also pointed out a few other things that needed to be fixed to meet building codes. Javier and Luis helped us get everything scheduled fast, and took care of all the repairs we needed, not just the shower. They arrived on time and finished the job quickly, making sure everything was done right. The work was very professional, and now everything runs smoothly. We’re happy with how everything turned out and will definitely call on them again for any plumbing repairs or upgrades. Highly recommend for anyone needing a reliable plumber!

reviews.author: gloria vega
reviews.text: We suddenly had no hot water at our house in Paramount and it was a big problem for us. We called Chavez Plumbing & Rooter Inc. and Eli came out the same day. We’re really thankful for the fast help and would definitely call them again.

reviews.author: Cynthia Leon
reviews.text: Katherine was so kind and understanding she sent a technician to my home and he was so polite and kind. They gave me a quote and I told them I have to gather money from my kids to have this done. They understood and told me if I would like it done to call. Well I called and again Katherine was so understanding I told her that I'd like to have them come back and hook up my new stove. They needed to replace the old valve with a new one. reviews.author: Paul Bunch
reviews.text: I'm very happy with the service Brenneco provided to review the cleanout  of a sewer line in West Lafayette, and to provide recommendations for a solution.  The technician who we met (Mike) was very friendly, knowledgeable of what he was seeing, and thorough in his recommended solution.  Very prompt, friendly, showed up a few minutes before the scheduled appointment, and had the quote generated within minutes of getting back in his vehicle.  I definitely recommend Brenneco!

reviews.author: Andrew Daigle
reviews.text: Max and Mike removed my old water heater and installed a new tank less water heater. They did a good job and were friendly and professional. While I think it was still a little pricey, it was still cheaper than Anderson heating and air conditioning.

reviews.author: Parab
reviews.text:
I’ve been a loyal customer of Brenneco for several years, but my recent experience was highly disappointing.

Misguided and Poor Follow-Up: After Brenneco's service, the remediation technician complained the water heater job was not done properly. I brought these concerns with Brenneco expecting them to hear me out and provide guidance. Instead, Becky asked me to share documentation and qualifications for the remediation technician—a misdirection that wasted my time and failed to address the actual issue. This approach felt dismissive and unhelpful.
Decline in Service Standards: As a repeat customer, I expected the same high-quality service I received in the past. Unfortunately, this time, both technical work and customer support fell short of expectations.
Inconsistent Discount Policy: As a returning customer, I was previously offered discounts on two occasions. However, I was recently informed that there is a "no-discount policy," which contradicts my past experiences.

I hope they take this feedback seriously and work on improving their policies and service quality for future customers.

reviews.author: Alex Quinn
reviews.text:

reviews.text:

When I called to discuss the work we needed to be done, Becky was very helpful and gave us more confidence in our decision to use Brenneco for our plumbing needs. She even matched us with the employee she felt would be most suitable to work with us. When Mike Winger came out to do the work he was professional, courteous and did the work flawlessly. We would have Mike back to do any future repairs we might need. Brenneco’s rates were very competitive and the final charges were as quoted. No surprises. Brenneco is a 10!

reviews.author: Ray Felder
reviews.text:
Professional, knowledgeable, and courteous.

My technician, Branden, quickly diagnosed the issue and walked me through the best solution. He scheduled the repair at a time that worked for me and completed everything in under three hours—far faster than I expected.

He and his helper, Preston, did excellent work replacing the hot water line and made sure everything was cleaned up afterward.

Loving the improved hot water pressure.

Thank you,
Rodger

reviews.author: Melissa Szymanski
reviews.text: We had a main water line break that had us without water for days. We have a third party insurance policy for our exterior water line. They contacted Aero Plumbing to complete the repair. Each person at Aero was thorough, patient, and had the “we will make this work” attitude that you want to experience when without water! In particular, Brandon and his supervisor were able to communicate with the third party to make sure all services were covered. Brandon completed this job with encouraging words, “Our job is to make sure you have running water, and you will by the end of today”, regardless of whether not the third party was going to cover it or not. They understood that the customer (me) came first. I cannot recommend them enough! And…they followed up next day to make sure everything was running smoothly and to assure me that all services were covered. Well done, Aero Plumbing, and Brandon!

reviews.author: Shelley Grier
reviews.text: Wonderful! John, Brandon, Preston… all the guys that had to do the driveway repair… Leah that took so many of my calls and kept me very informed… can’t thank them enough!

reviews.author: Kay
reviews.text:
I would like to highly recommend Aero Plumbing, a family-owned business that recently provided me with outstanding service. Although this was my first time working with them, they came highly recommended by the handyman services I use regularly.
When I contacted Aero Plumbing, I was very concerned that I had a major plumbing issue. The guest bathroom commode had been leaking intermittently for about three weeks, and I could not identify the cause of the problem. Aero Plumbing responded quickly to my call and arrived promptly to assess the situation.
The team immediately found the source of the leak. They discovered that all the internal components in the toilet tank had been installed incorrectly, with some parts placed upside-down. Without hesitation, they went out to purchase the necessary parts and completed the replacement efficiently. The repair was done in no time, and I was extremely relieved and pleased with the results.
Brandon and Reese, the technicians from Aero Plumbing, were outstanding. It was clear that they took great pride in their work and were genuinely proud to be part of the Aero Plumbing family. Their professionalism and dedication stood out throughout the entire process.
It is a great relief to know that I now have an excellent plumbing company to call whenever needed. Aero Plumbing is available 24/7 for emergencies and they also guarantee their work, giving me added peace of mind.

reviews.author: Cherie Tolley
reviews.text: This company is terrible!!! Their technician was totally unprofessional and incompetent!! He came out and first tried to tell us the leak was under the concrete slab. When we told him we knew the leak was in the wall he became argumentative. Turns out the leak was in the wall and then he said he couldn’t fix until we had ductwork removed. We called an AC guy who said there was no reason for that. Then the Aero technician came back out he didn’t even try to fix the leaking pipe which was exposed and had easy access and left without turning the water to the house back on. Their service manager John did call and attempt to correct the situation but we had already called another plumber. The second plumber came out and said it was no problem to fix and ductwork was not in the way. I will never use them again and will be letting everyone I know not to use them. It may have been the technician but he is the face of their business in the field.

reviews.author: Linda Kleckner
reviews.text: Our water heater broke late in the day. Ron walked me through shutting off the gas and the water and then directed me on how to drain it before he got there. It minimized the damage and he was able to install a new water heater the next day. Ron is always quick to respond and offers great service at a fair price. We have been using his company for over 10 years for a reason. He and his company are terrific!

reviews.author: Dawn Nowakowski
reviews.text: If I could leave a review for more than 5 STARS I would. In all aspects of business this Company is top notch!! I will definitely be using Ron and Tristan again and again and most likely again! I'm new to the area, and I am so thankful for the referral I was given to use them for all my plumbing needs.How does one achieve and more importantly , Maintain a 5 star status? By excelling in every aspect of the plumbing business!

reviews.author: Anthony Cerrito
reviews.text: Ron responded quickly, was out fast & I didn't have to do a thing. He got me a better water heater for the same price installed as some cheap one I almost bought with half the warranty. He picked up the water heater for me, brought to me and took the old one away. Made it stupid simple for me & removed all the stress from the situation.

reviews.author: Petey Urukalo
reviews.text:
We had a plumbing issue with low water pressure and called A.C.T Plumbing and spoke with the owner Ron and he came out the next morning and got the kitchen sink that was clogged working again. It literally took him two minutes and the pressure was back good again and we were so excited. We asked Ron how much we owe him for his work and he said nothing. It only took a couple of minutes and he didn’t charge us for anything and in this day and age you don’t see that too often so kudos to Ron for being honest and willing to spend his time helping people he just met. We stored his number for future plumbing jobs and plan on passing along his information to anyone that needs a plumber. We Highly recommend Ron and A.C.T. Plumbing to everyone.
Thank you Ron for your Help!

reviews.author: Dolores Alex
reviews.text:
I called A.C.T because I had a problem with a brand new hose for my sump pump that wasn't connected right.

Water was shooting out from the base of the hose. I did ask my landscaper if he could install this brand new hose for me because i was in a pinch and he said yes.  He said he would charge me $60 for a very simple job.

However...i needed this done so i paid him $60 to do this. A couple days later when we had some bad rain i was outside and noticed the  hose was shooting out water of the base of the hose.  The same thing that happened to my old hose that i needed to replace with the new hose.The only difference was the old hose actually had a split in the hose (because it was old) so I needed to buy a new hose.

When A.C.T. came out he told me right away the landscaper didn't tighten the hose in a couple spots leaving water to shoot out from the base of the hose.

Prior to all this i did called the landscaper to tell him what happened he told me it wasn't an emergency and it could wait.  That didn't make me very happy because i paid him $60 to do the job right and when i told him what happened he didn't at all seem alarmed and couldn't be at my house for about 3 days. I was shocked.

Thats when i talked to my neighbor and they recommended A.C.T. and i can see why... he was excellent, and charge me a trip charge which I felt was very fair. He came out on a Sunday and he fixed the problem, and above all done it right the first time.

The purpose of this review is to solely let people know that there are good trusting, reputable companies that truly care about their customers.

A.C.T. the owner Ron did not hesitate to come to my aid to help me out
ASAP and fix the problem.

Easy fix...however, the problem was the landscaper he did not tighten the hoses.

Next time ill go with the professionals.

Thanks to Ron for all his help it meant the world to me.  Now I can sleep knowing the job was done right the first time.

Thank you Dominic We appreciate you!

reviews.author: Dominic Wilder
reviews.text:
Jeff The Plumber is top-tier from start to finish. Every single person I interacted with are true professionals and class acts. Andrew, Eric, and Joseph all clearly know exactly what they’re doing skilled, efficient, and respectful every step of the way.

The quality of work, attention to detail, and overall customer service is outstanding. It’s rare to find a company where everyone you deal with is this solid. If you want plumbing done right the first time, Jeff The Plumber is a team to call. Highly, highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ellen F
reviews.text:
First, I'd like to say I have used Jeff the plumber at least 3 previous times at my home and was satisfied with each service person who came to my home and the job they did.
This last time I had to wait 2 weeks for my appointment and needed 3 things addressed.  The person who answers the phone asked for pictures to be sent for the basement faucet so the plumber would know what parts were needed ahead of time.
The plumber was sitting in his van until I went out to greet him.  I asked him if he saw the pictures I sent and he didn't know what I was referring to.  When I explained he said he did not.  I showed him the 3 areas starting with replacing the outside faucet that dripped.  He asked where it was leaking from.  I said at the faucet.  He seemed reluctant.  I said ok lets go to the easy one and took him to the bathroom faucet that just needed tightened.  The final job was the faucet at the washtub in the basement and the job that they wanted pictures for.  He was really trying to convince me to change the open /close valves instead of replacing the faucet and I told him I didn't want to open and close them every time I did laundry.  I said I wanted the faucet replaced and maybe those valves will have to be as well.  He asked if I had gotten a quote-did I know how much that might be?  it could be $500-900.
The bottom line is this fellow didn't appear to want to work from the moment he showed up (first appointment)
I said to him it seemed like he was not interested in working today and he could go ahead to his next job. He seemed surprised and tried to say he'd do the work, he just didn't know if I knew what all it may cost.  I said no thats ok, he could go on to the next job.
I called the office and said I waited 2 weeks for a plumber who didn't want to work.  She put me on hold and then said the supervisor would call me.  Guess what, he never did.  I gave him ample time before writing this review.
It is too bad that one plumber can wreck a good customer relationship, but worse that the staff isn't interested in good customer service.  If the supervisor had called and given me a reasonable explanation for the situation we could have rescheduled with someone I have worked with before because of my past history with them.
However, it wasn't worth it to them to call me so I have a new plumber.
I called the new company who's name starts with an F, has red vans out of Cuyahoga Falls and they came two days later.  Mike A. had a friendly disposition, said not a problem to everything I showed him, did an excellent job, and was quick.  It was a night and day experience.

reviews.author: Carlina Croston
reviews.text: Cannot speak any more highly of this company. They came out quickly and took care of my water line leak in less than an hour. Customer service was great and the pricing was more than fair. I won’t be calling anyone else for plumbing work.

reviews.author: Kevin J

Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Marc Ras
reviews.text: Kyle Gatti was really great. Very responsive. He gave me a good ball park estimated price for the job and also gave me an estimated time of arrival for when he'd arrive after he was done with another job. He even followed up with a call when he was on his way and gave be an ETA down to the minute. Very courteous and professional and left everything very clean and he fixed the problem fast all the while I was in between zoom meetings.  I'll definitely use Gatti Plumbing again I'm the future. Thank you!

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text:
Lots of great service for others, but not for me it seems. Two guys came out (plumber and helper) to move and connect a washer and gas dryer, relocate a sink in the laundry 3', replace a toilet, and clear a drain associated with my gutter drainage system. Ultimately, the sink was relocated, the appliances were set in place (not fully connected yet), and the outdoor drain was cleared. I paused the remaining work scheduled for the next day due to the poor performance of the plumber (helper was fantastic). At the conclusion of the work, the plumber failed to turn the hot water back on, left a sopping wet towel in the laundry room with water everywhere, put a decent sized scratch in my wood flooring when transporting the appliances, and left a stain on my carpet.

I called Kyle (owner) to explain the situation and asked him to send another plumber out to finish the job. He then said the initial charge of $1,500 was too little and he should have charged $2,500 (they actively worked for 3.5 hours). He had no issues with the state the plumber left my home in, kept coming back to that I should pay the full $1500 even though the work wasn't finished, and kept using an analogy that if I go to a restaurant and get bad food I should tell the server while he's there. I mentioned that I didn't notice the issues until they left, and as I had an issue with the plumber notifying the owner was the correct course of action. Kyle refused to send someone out to finish the job and said I could hire someone else. At no time did Kyle offer an apology or consideration for what I experienced. When asked directly if this quality of work is what he expects out of his staff, he said yes.

The office staff truly deserves recognition as well. Lauren, Zach, and Linda were communicative, organized, and completely on top of their game. Scheduling, updates, and follow-up were handled smoothly, which made the entire process stress-free.

It’s clear this company values quality workmanship and customer service. If you’re looking for a reliable, professional plumbing and filtration company, Water Fixers is the one to call. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Elisa Ramirez
reviews.text:
We had a plumbing issue that needed attention and called Water Fixers based on a recommendation. I’m glad we did. They responded quickly, figured out the problem, and explained what was going on in a way that was easy to understand.
The repair was done efficiently, and the technician was respectful of our home and time. Everything felt very professional from start to finish.
I would confidently recommend Water Fixers to anyone needing reliable plumbing help

reviews.author: loungeattire
reviews.text: Alex with Water Fixers is amazing! He installed a water shut-off quickly and explained how to use the app. Extremely professional. If I ever need a plumber, I am calling Alex directly. Thank you so much!!!

plumbers.name: Afford A Rooter Plumbing
plumbers.address: 10860 N Dover St STE 2300, Westminster, CO 80021, USA

reviews.author: Byron Boyle
reviews.text: Afford A Rooter did a great job replacing a short section of sewer that was still the original clay pipe from the property line to the main sewer line. I got several quotes for the work and Afford A Rooter was the most affordable. They showed up on time and completed the work in a few hours. Their communication was clear and timely. I would definitely recommend these guys!

reviews.author: Martin Davis
reviews.text: When you wake up to the septic alarm instead of your alarm clock, you know you’re in for a tough day. We immediately contacted Affordable Septic and they had their tech at our home a bit later that day, AND the kept us informed of when they’d be there. They were able to diagnose the problem (failed pump) and gave us some simple guidance about using our plumbing while they acquired the necessary parts. The next day the came out and did the repair. When they tested the repair, they found another issue (broken pipe before the distro valve). This type of thorough testing saved us from having another unknown problem down the road. They made that repair, and all was good in the world again. Their quick response, their excellent work, and their thoroughness, really made us comfortable with a company that we were using for the first time. I’d highly recommend Affordable Septic and their services.

reviews.author: Bernie Gehris
reviews.text: Cast iron sewer lines under my basement floor were failing and sewerage had started backing up in my floor drain. Simply cleaning it out no longer worked (I tried multiple times with companies). I checked with a big name company and got a quote to replace the failing cast iron lines. It seemed quite high. A friend recommended I contact Afford-a-Rooter, and I’m so glad I did!  Trevor gave me a quote that beat the other company by more than a third. He said his crew could do it the following morning. At 8:30 the crew arrived and completed the work in a few hours. Crew was courteous and professional and left my basement cleaner than when they arrived. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Anita Dawson
reviews.text: I hired Afford A Rooter to replace a broken sewer line, after getting a quote from a reputable plumbing company. This company that gave me a quote, wanted to actually do a partial sewer line repair to fix the problem.Contacted afford a rooter shortly afterward ,and within the same day , they came out and inspected my problem and gave me a quote to replace the entire sewer line for a little bit more than the previous price from the other company. The decision was the smartest and best choice for the problem at hand, and the price was right for me, with no extra hidden costs. Trevor and his crew were very punctual and professional. Job was completed and  inspected , cleaned up, street and sidewalk repair done within a few hours the same day. Follow up the inspection and completed job within a few days. I really appreciate the job quality and timely responses from this company. I would definitely recommend this company to anyone who wants the job done right and fast, and a great price.Thank you guys for a great job. Sincerely, Stephen Dawson.

reviews.author: Jaime L
reviews.text:
I contracted “Rooter Plumbing” for a complicated main water service line repair and was very satisfied with the results. The owner clearly explained the work that needed to be done, and provided a fair, transparent estimate. The crew was very professional and knowledgeable, showing their professionalism and expertise throughout the project. They showed up on time and the quality of their craftsmanship was excellent, everything was installed flawlessly, and the work area was left spotless.
I now have peace of mind knowing my plumbing is in excellent shape, and I wouldn’t hesitate to call them again or recommend them to anyone in need of a reliable master plumber.

plumbers.name: Superior Plumbing
plumbers.address: 912 Hidden Oaks Dr, Burleson, TX 76028, USA

reviews.author: Marie Long
reviews.text: I had a gas leak and was quoted $2000 more than I could afford! So then I called Superior, they came in quickly. Gave me a wonderful price. They got to work and got the job done so quickly and efficiently. Plus they were super professional and nice. I would definitely call them again.

reviews.author: Doris Jean Langston
reviews.text: Adam came out for my spring checkup. He was very nice and polite. Knowledgeable about my HVAC system. Showed me pics and what needed to be addressed. Great customer service!

reviews.author: Garrett Motley
reviews.text: Skip handled our plumbing repair quickly and professionally. He arrived on time, clearly explained the issue, and completed the repair efficiently without any upselling or unnecessary work. The quality of workmanship was excellent, and everything was left clean and functioning properly. I appreciated his straightforward communication and fair pricing. I would absolutely recommend Skip for any plumbing repair needs and would use him again without hesitation.

reviews.author: Eric johnson Eric
reviews.text: Outstanding service from start to finish. They responded quickly, showed up on time, and diagnosed the issue with my water heater right away. The repair was done efficiently, everything was explained clearly, and the pricing was fair with no surprises. Hot water was back the same day, and the work area was left spotless. Professional, honest, and knowledgeable—highly recommend to anyone needing water heater repair.

reviews.author: Jerry Hawk
reviews.text: Jose from Superior HVAC  performed a spring maintenance check in my unit.  He was extremely knowledgeable and explained the process.   I highly recommend Jose and Superior AC and Heat for your HVAC needs.

plumbers.name: Royal Flush Plumbing of Athens
plumbers.address: 4015 Atlanta Hwy, Athens, GA 30606, USA

reviews.author: Brooks DenBesten
reviews.text: Chris Mayta was extremely helpful with me and the issue we had with our drain line. Very  professional and I could tell he actually cares about the customer and not just making another stop. Will definitely call and ask for him again!

reviews.author: Luke Verble
reviews.text: We had a water line burst inside our kitchen wall. The tech that came out was able to quickly assess, get us a quote, and was able to repair with minimal demolition which was much appreciated. We were really surprised at the affordability of the repair, and both the tech and the office were all super friendly. Would definitely recommend giving them a call if you need work done.

reviews.author: AmberABCg
reviews.text:
This is my third time using Royal Flush Plumbing in the last five years…they perform quality work at competitive prices, and Troy delivered fantastic service today (a SUNDAY) when I had a plumbing emergency that easily could have cost thousands.
Troy clearly explained what was going on, and what steps (and costs) might be needed to fix the problem.  Here is where Royal Flush earns my trust EVERY TIME…they fixed my drainage problem on the first try, with the least expensive option!!
They could have taken me for a ride by doing unnecessary work, and I never would have known, but HONEST, EXPERIENCED plumbers like TROY keep me coming back to Royal Flush because I know the job will be priced fairly and DONE RIGHT!
Thank-you, Royal Flush Plumbing!!!

reviews.author: Farwah Sheikh
reviews.text: Troy from Royal Flush Plumbing was incredible to work with. He replaced our water heater and made what could have been a stressful situation feel smooth and straightforward. He showed up on time, was courteous and honest throughout, and his work was done with great attention to detail. It’s clear he knows his craft and genuinely cares about doing it right. We’re really grateful we found someone this dependable — would absolutely call Troy again and highly recommend him to anyone in the Athens

reviews.author: Caitlin Curole
reviews.text: These guys were by far the most affordable. They were also friendly and very knowledgeable! Couldn’t recommend Garren more! We will call for him again!

plumbers.name: Blessings Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 1236 Jensen Dr Suite 101, Virginia Beach, VA 23451, USA

reviews.author: Kenneth Miller
reviews.text: I have been using Blessings for around 7 years now.  Not every visit has been excellent, but this hot water heater install was one of the excellent ones.  Technicians were polite, professional and efficient.  I want to give Scott a shoutout.  He was mentoring a younger plumber and I listened to his teaching and providing guidance to this next generation of Tradesman and his patience, and detailed instruction was impressive.  This is the type of encouragement and instruction that the next generation needs.  My last experience with Blessings was completely different.  An apprentice plumber and a master plumber showed up and the master plumber's treatment of the apprentice was horrendous, bordering on hazing.  I told Scott about that experience and he said that master plumber was no longer with the company.  I am glad that Blessings has the right people on their team and creating a learning environment for those that will carry the torch.  AI will not be able to replace the trades.

reviews.author: Paul Klementowski
reviews.text: Had a shower valve leaking in wall,  Contacted Blessings Plumbing in the late afternoon on a Monday. They were able to dispatch a Plumber that afternoon ,  He was able get in the wall, install a couple of cut off valves that afternoon in order to get my water turned back on and then returned next day to replace the valve. Mike was prompt, courteous and professional.  I would highly recommend Blessing Plumbing (and Mike) for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Gretchen Hardy
reviews.text: Wow! What a wonderful experience with Blessings Plumbing. Dakota was prompt and immediately went to solving our problem. Sarah in the office was so helpful and professional. So happy we follow the 2 recommendations we got from other customers. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Judy Keating
reviews.text:
This was my first visit with using Blessings. I called at 11am and James got to me by 2pm same day.
What an appropriate name for your company. Blessings is a blessing for all plumbing needs.
I had a leaking water heater and
Tech James was very knowledgeable and explained all water heater repair issues.
Would recommend Blessings to family and friends for their plumbing needs.

reviews.author: rodney walker
reviews.text:
Contacted Blessings Plumbing after hours! The next morning. Scott, the Tech was here at the time he indicated.

Explained that this was not the first time we have dealt with this issue with the laundry drain backing up from the kitchen. Went to Home Depot and poured concentrated drain opener down into the laundry drain. WRONG!!!

Approximately 40 feet of drain had been replaced and still had the gurgling sound after that.

Efforts were made by Scott to snake the drain from a Valve that had been glued at the original installation. After cutting the Sheetrock to visually see what was going on, the plumbing was installed incorrectly and no TRAP was never installed 🫣 that would have been his access location for the snake. No wonder we couldn't find one😲.

Scott informed me what he was going to do and why explained to resolve this issue we've been having for eight years. FINALLY, we can have this issue resolved. His work area was very clean as he worked on the plumbing issue from start to finish. He drove from VA Beach to Chesapeake which, is approximately 25 minutes without traffic issues.

Blessings Plumbing Company are truly Professionals. Polite and courteous! Listened to our issue and resolved it to perfection!

My wife, especially my wife, truly appreciate repairing the drain because it wasn't repaired before. Someone who looked at the problem and knew why we were having this issue for so long.

Thank You very much,
Rodney Walker

plumbers.name: Leo's Plumbing 24 Seven
plumbers.address: 23804 Cork Oak Cir, Murrieta, CA 92562, USA

reviews.author: Nate Muzquiz (Nate)
reviews.text: Called Leo in the morning and he and Nick were on site within hours same day to solve our problem. We were looking to have a dog bathing tub hooked up in our garage, both hot and cold water and the drain tied in to a clean-out on the other side of the wall. Leo's pricing was fair, and they got to work right away. Within hours we had everything dialed in, and he was communicative throughout the job to make sure things were as we intended. We will definitely be calling Leo's if ever have any plumbing needs in the future.

reviews.author: Cristina
reviews.text: I noticed what appeared to be a slab leak in the early evening and Leo’s Plumbing was able to come out quickly to asses the issue then returning the following day to do the repairs.  Turned out it was a slab leak & he brought Nick & Julian with him to complete the job as quickly as possible. They were all very competent & polite.  Cleaned up after the job too.  Loved that.  All is perfect now.  So happy I didn’t need to use my homeowners insurance. 😁

reviews.author: Maria Jose Zolotoff
reviews.text: Leo and son are great! I have known them for 7 years now, since we moved to Temecula. They are always respectful and knowledgeable of their work. I called them because I noticed water coming out from the ground and thanks God they were able to come and fixed it same day. Thank you for the great job!

reviews.author: Marie
reviews.text: Love Leo and Nick! I can always trust them and they do the best honest work! Thank you so much! We have been going with Leo’s playing for the last 10 years. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Shawn Barrett
reviews.text: Had sewer backup into my bathtub and shower. Called Leo, he and Nick were at my place within a hour. They diagnosed the problem, explained exactly what had to be done, and completed all work quickly and efficiently. Super professional and knowledgeable!! Was also extremely happy with the more than fair bill I received for his services. If you’re looking for or in need of a plumber, look no further. Do yourself a favor and call Leo, you’ll be glad you did.

plumbers.name: Tony's Drain & Sewer Cleaning
plumbers.address: 302 S Lake St, Aurora, IL 60506, USA

reviews.author: Jason DeLancey
reviews.text: We used Tony's to do annual rodding of our sewer line for roots in the pipe. Mike came out, was very professional and friendly. He took time to explain the work he did and why he did it and explain everything he found and the condition of our sewer line. He asked if we had questions and took the time to answer and explain. The price was better than many places we called and the work was thorough. We will use Tony's again and would recommend.

reviews.author: frank matthew
reviews.text:
My nephew referred me toTony's Drain & Sewer Cleaning after his extremely positive experience with them a couple of years back.
From my first contact, the service and professionalism was outstanding. It is so difficult to find people to trust these days and I would have zero hesitation recommending Tony's to family and friends alike. My email was responded to very quickly and the appointment was set with an extremely competitive quote up front before they even came out. We had a very difficult tree root issue invading our pipes and we dealt with Mike, Noah and George, three fantastic guys that were friendly, honest and unbelievably hard working. They employed their Hydro Jet service to clean out our drainage pipe and spent a lot of extra time to make sure things were done right. Mike explained everything and always involved us in every step of the process.
We are planning to have them back to put in an outside clean out
in the near future. This is a first rate company with wonderful, conscientious and knowledgable employees. Amazing experience.

reviews.author: Jesus Perez
reviews.text: Outstanding service and price!  I have annual maintenance service for my sewer line to get rid of roots.  The staff person was on time, kept the service within the estimated reasonable price range, and made several good suggestions.  Will definitely call Tony's again for future services.

reviews.author: Heather Roskopf
reviews.text:
We had a major clog in our main drain line and couldn’t use any water without it backing up — very stressful situation. We called Tony’s Drain & Sewer, and Mike came out to help.
Mike was professional, knowledgeable, and explained everything clearly from the start. He cleared our main drain and then performed a camera inspection to make sure the line was fully open and to check for any additional issues. Unfortunately we have some more issues we need to address, but we have draining water for now. I really appreciated that he took the time to show us what was going on inside the pipe — it gave us real peace of mind knowing the problem and how to resolve it fully. The whole experience was smooth and efficient.
Highly recommend Tony’s Drain & Sewer — and definitely ask for Mike!

reviews.author: Tara Quade
reviews.text: My sewer lines back up every couple of years with my 100+ year old home due to tree roots in the lines. I have used Tony’s on numerous occasions and they always come quickly and are very efficient at resolving the issue! They also provide a warranty on their service. I would definitely recommend them.

plumbers.name: Sargent's Plumbing & Drain
plumbers.address: 605 W Oakland Pl, Broken Arrow, OK 74012, USA

reviews.author: J Allen
reviews.text: I DEFINITELY HIGHLY RECOMMEND SARGENT’s PLUMBING!!! Andrew and his team of two arrived on time. Kept me posted every step of the way , including En route process. Arrived about 15 minutes early. Very Professional, knowledgeable, courteous, friendly, polite, respectful. My old water heater 20 years old and on its last leg. I heard him conferencing with the team about process . Difficulties encountered but handled with shear expertise. Cleaned up as the work progressed. He even gave me a VERY SIGNIFICANT DISCOUNT FOR BEING A SENIOR CITIZEN AND ALSO BEING ON TOTAL DISABILITY. I offered to pay the entire cost, but he refused and insisted on the discount for me. It was very much appreciated!!! There are few companies who honor their word and do PRISTINE WORKMANSHIP !!! He also insisted on showing me his Plumber’s license, his apprentice did the same . He also had one young man in training who did none of the technical work, but observed and Andrew taught as he went through the process, including the unexpected circumstances. I LOVE THIS PLUMBING COMPANY!!! I will never use another! I cannot say enough ! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND ANDREW SARGENT PLUMBING.

reviews.author: Rosario Termini
reviews.text: We had non emergency blockage that was creating an unpleasant, sulfuric smell in our hall bathroom. Alex & Alec got out to us within less than 24 hours. They snaked the line through our clean-out, did a thorough check of everything, & took care of the issue in less than an hour. Alex answered all my questions, offered helpful info, & was genuinely courteous. We are very impressed with Sargent Plumbing & will both recommend them to others & use them in the future for our plumbing needs! You guys are awesome, thank you!

reviews.author: Elaine Claxton
reviews.text: I was extremely impressed with service I received from Sargent's Plumbing & Drain (Tulsa, OK). I spoke with Andrew & he was very accomodating and helpful.  On one of the worst snow storms, her in Oklahoma, I was completely shocked (in a good way) that I was informed that I would have a service man at my house in just 1 hour. "ALEX" came and couldn't have been more polite, patient and extremely professional, diligent and knowledgeable about the problem at hand. He was thorough and task focused. Thank you to this amazing, friendly and excellent service! E. Claxton

reviews.author: Ken Lane
reviews.text: Sargent's has become my back-pocket to-go plumbing service. After ONG flagged my busted and shoddily-installed water-heater and iffy gas line situation in a flipped home I bought, I needed a solution ASAP. Armed with a skimpy budget and no time to spare, I actually asked AI to scour review pages and user-generated forums for the most trustworthy plumber in the area and Sargent's was apparently the undisputed people's champion. I got quotes from them and 3 other plumbing companies, though Sargent's were the only ones that would actually come out to my house rather than just high-ball me over the phone. I approved their quote (which just happened to also be the lowest) on the spot and Alex and Alec immediately started draining my old tank and off to grab my new tank in minutes. About 2-3 hours later (including parts fetching), I had a brand new water heater installed. They gave me a full rundown of every step of the process, relighting protocol, and all other info I needed. They gave me a handful of business cards that will definitely be gone soon to everyone I know.

reviews.author: Christy W
reviews.text: This will be my go-to plumbing company from now on! I had a water leak and my Daughter highly recommended them after using their services multiple times. She contacted them and they were out (late on a Friday evening) within an hour ready to get things fixed. I was an emotional mess due to the emergency situation but they did everything they could to help me and I can't thank them enough! They fast, informative, respectful of me and my property and left everything tidy at the end of the job. I hope you don't have an emergency like I did, but if you need to call a plumber, these are your guys!

plumbers.name: Parks' Plumbing & Sewer, Inc.
plumbers.address: 8121 Lawndale Ave, Skokie, IL 60076, USA

reviews.author: Patricia Ansuini
reviews.text: Great company and we were assigned two of their best, Greg and Christopher, to re-plumb all the hot water pipes in our house from very old and corroded galvanized pipes to copper. They worked hard and well and Greg, the lead, kept us informed all along the way. At the end of 1.5 days we had gleaming copper pipes that Greg "toured" us through and that included 2 new shut-off valves. We most heartily recommend Parks' Plumbing & Sewer and will call them when we replace our lead water line and for any other plumbing needs.

reviews.author: jay zhang
reviews.text: Nathan and Joe were very professional and did a great job installing a new water heater, kitchen faucet, and outdoor spigot. They were on time, came in our house with shoe protectors, explain their work in detail before starting, did an excellent job and cleaned up everything before leaving. Couldn't be more satisfied with the service. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Brenda Bonomo
reviews.text:
❤️ Working with Parks Plumbing!!
Have done large & small jobs. Always efficient, honest, fairly priced. They are an exceptional company!!! Love Mathew, Reggie & Mike.

reviews.author: Max Martineau
reviews.text: Nathan and Michael came to my house to do a sewer line rodding and were awesome. Professional, polite and efficient. Would absolutely recommend!

reviews.author: Juan Aguirre
reviews.text: Best investment, parks installed in front of my home 2 cast iron check valves and a sump pump. Shortly after installing, a storm hit and flooded the neighborhood but me! Two years later I had them do an inspection and everything was passed with flying colors! You can’t put a price tag on quality work, best investment ever! Thanks again!!

plumbers.name: SnoFalls Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 201 W North Bend Way #100, North Bend, WA 98045, USA

reviews.author: Joshua Suman
reviews.text: Alan was amazing - super quick and professional service. The office was also awesome with quick scheduling and clear information. Good value on the service and felt like I was getting a true estimate on derives. The value was great and very happy with the end result!! Will be using them for all plumbing needs and recommend to any fellow Valley residents!!

reviews.author: Justin Livingston
reviews.text: Steve at SnoFalls did a fantastic job on fixing our leaking pipes and replacing all the old and out of date valves in our house. Very professional service and so pleased with the turnaround time. It pays to go local, thank you very much!

reviews.author: Aprille Balangue
reviews.text: Our 20-year-old water heater started failing, and we needed a quick replacement. SnoFalls Plumbing delivered fast, top-notch service! Ryan Dill arrived for the assessment with a replacement heater on hand, ready to install. His work was clean and efficient, completing the removal and installation in under two hours. He also shared some simple annual maintenance tips to help extend the heater’s lifespan beyond 15 years. I’m very impressed with their professionalism, friendliness, and quality service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Timothy Pullen
reviews.text: Ryan came to my house today and I thought he was just going to take a look and tell me what it would take to replace my damaged water tank, and especially as it needed the temporary removal of a stacked washer dryer. Ryan is an extremely knowledgeable, friendly and highly capable plumber, and did a fantastic job indeed. As an aerospace power electronics Chief Engineer  myself, and as somebody who has seen a lot of different plumbing challenges, Snofalls Plumbing is a top notch company with superior customer service and technical expertise. I say this very seriously and look forward to Ryan updating my bathroom with a new bath.

reviews.author: Elaine Morse
reviews.text: I was referred to SnoFalls Plumbing by my neighbor I called on Friday and they were available on Monday. They repaired an exterior faucet that was leaking. Made an easily patchable entry point from the interior wall for access to the faucet. No messes. And very minor touch-ups for us.  He even checked out our water heater when he turned the water back on again. I appreciate the good service and good pricing. The young woman who handled initial call and payment was a joyful and friendly person too. So nice doing business with companies like this. Thank  you!!!

plumbers.name: AA YES Plumbing inc
plumbers.address: 710 65th Ave a, Schererville, IN 46375, USA

reviews.author: Ellyn Boyle
reviews.text:
YES Plumbing has been an absolute game-changer for our home! From the very first call, their team was professional, friendly, and truly invested in helping us improve our house for our family’s comfort. We signed up for their Sustainer Service, and I can’t say enough good things about it — regular check-ups, preventative maintenance, and prompt attention to any little issues before they became big problems.

They went above and beyond, explaining everything clearly and making sure we understood how to keep our plumbing system running smoothly. Thanks to their expertise, our home is not only more functional but also more efficient, which means peace of mind for us and a safer, more comfortable space for our family. I can’t recommend YES Plumbing enough — they’re exactly the kind of trustworthy, skilled professionals every homeowner hopes to find!

reviews.author: Tiffany Jordan
reviews.text: Yes! Plumbing quickly resolved an accounting issue that was an oversight on their part and refunded the club fee quickly.  Customer Service is good even though I could not afford to continue with the club that they had as the pricing increased.

reviews.author: Nilden A.
reviews.text:
I took a chance on this company for a basic  kitchen sink snaking - paid the $79 service fee to secure an appointment and declined the work after the gentleman told me it would be $800 when he arrived the next day!  What a racket for a 45 min/1 hour task. Posting this because they refuse to give you any indication of approximate cost when you call (like most other companies do)...

I may not have posted this review, but the gentleman also tried to convince me I needed someone who has at least a 100ft line to clear my drain line, which I know is absolute B.S.

In any event... if you like their work great, i simply wouldn't recommend it.

Revised my review and upped to two star because they did reach out to me and appologize for the service not being a fit.

reviews.author: Joyce
reviews.text: Dan always discusses options and makes recommendations that are helpful to whatever plumbing problem he encounters. Once a plan of action is chosen, he efficiently carries it out. He is personable and pleasant to work with.

reviews.author: Kimberley Kwiecinski
reviews.text: This company is great! My ejector pump was making strange sounds and was on its last leg. I called Yes! And within 2 hours, Mark called and I had an appointment scheduled for the next day. Dan is so personable and did a great job explaining everything to me and replaced my pump. We found I had some water coming from the ground and he went the extra length to try and figure out where it was coming from before he left. I would recommend Yes! Plumbing to anyone. I am a part of their premium club so it was nice to use my plan money towards my repair. The price you pay is worth it for great service and your piece of mind. Thank you Dan!

plumbers.name: Rhino Rooter Plumbing Sewer & Drain Inc
plumbers.address: 6937 Muricatia Dr, Orangevale, CA 95662, USA

reviews.author: Luke Morrison
reviews.text: Our main line at our office was clogged & toilet not flushing.  Other plumbers quoted us five grand!  RHINO came out right away the same day and was able to jet our line clear for a fraction of that price saving us thousands!  Super professional, highly knowledgeable and customer service oriented. I would recommend them to my mom. Thank you guys for saving the day.

reviews.author: Richard Sonne
reviews.text: Ryan at Rhino Rooter has been fantastic. He took care of all our issues and upgrades promptly and we feel very confident about his work. He did a great job explaining everything as well. We will certainly be calling him again next time we need a plumber.

reviews.author: Megan Michelle Hanley
reviews.text:
Ryan at Rhino Rooter was a total lifesaver. We went all Sunday without being able to use any water due to a main sewer line clog. A large chain plumbing company spent an hour trying to fix it with no luck and then quoted us $2,000 for the next steps.

We called Rhino Rooter for a second opinion, and Ryan came out late on a Sunday, quickly cleared the clog, and charged only a few hundred dollars. He was professional, honest, and efficient. We’ll absolutely use him again and highly recommend him to anyone needing a trustworthy plumber.

reviews.author: Alex Hengl
reviews.text:
Just stepped out the shower, steam still in the air,
Wifey ’bout to hop in, towel wrapped in her hair,
Then the tub start talkin’, made a gurgle so foul,
Black water bubblin’ up — yeah the vibe turned vile.
Wouldn’t drain down, just sat there mean,
Lookin’ like a swamp monster audition scene,
Midnight crisis, who we gonna choose?
Scrolled through the numbers with the midnight blues.
Rhino Rooter pulled up, no delay,
Cheaper than the rest but elite in every way,
Polite, professional, punctual king,
Midnight plumber with the heavyweight swing.
Snaked that drain like a beast unleashed,
Camera down deep where the darkness reached,
Found tree roots creepin’, underground thieves,
Marked the yard up clean like blueprints on leaves.
We couldn’t even find where the plumbing ran,
He mapped it out faster than a drafted plan,
All done quick, no stress, no fuss,
Turned a plumbing nightmare into trust.
Gave us magnets, stickers — business on deck,
Now his name on the fridge, showin’ respect,
Midnight savior when the pipes went wild,
Rhino Rooter came through — problem exiled.
Best in the business, hands down truth,
From disaster to laughter in a single smooth move,
When the drains start bubblin’ and the water turns mean,
Call the rhino — keep your bathroom clean.

Third and subsequent attempts started looking like a toddler playing with Lincoln Logs.  Bottom line – water is flowing again, after at least 7 repair attempts.

Called Power Plumbing – “if you’re not satisfied, we’d be happy to come back out and redo it”.  It would take cutting out more drywall, baseboard, and more of the original copper piping and replace with Pex and Pro Pex fittings, all outside of original quote.

reviews.text:
I first used Jerry back in 2023 for a garbage disposal repair and was impressed by his responsiveness, thoroughness, and willingness to explain everything. He made sure the installation was done right and took time to educate me on any recommendations. Very personable and professional.

Of course, you never need a plumber until it's an emergency. Long story short, I had a handyman attempt a fix, and one issue turned into a much bigger problem: incompatible parts, leaking water, sheetrock damage, and a water heater that still wasn't working. I immediately called Jerry this morning, and he arrived in less than an hour.

After examining everything, he gave me two options. With the holidays and this being a very unexpected expense, I wasn't prepared to pay for a full water heater replacement. Jerry understood and offered to check on parts for a repair instead. He was able to locate everything needed, and that same day, he and his assistant had my water tank assembly repaired and working.

I am so grateful for his honesty, expertise, and quick turnaround. As a loyal customer, I will absolutely continue using Lone Wolf Plumbing and recommending Jerry to family and friends. If you need a plumber you can trust, call him!

reviews.author: Danny Garcia
reviews.text:
I contacted Lone Wolf Plumbing on a Saturday morning regarding a leaking water heater. The call was answered promptly, and technician Jerry arrived at my home the same morning—impressive responsiveness on a weekend.

I explained the situation: a noticeable leak from one of my two water heaters (both approximately 12 years old), located in the attic. Jerry conducted a thorough, professional inspection and clearly outlined the available options. The most budget-friendly immediate fix was to replace the leaking connections. However, he also noted that one unit was in significantly worse condition overall, while the other showed clear signs of wear on the connections.

After quoting a new water heater and confirming availability through his trusted vendor (also working that weekend), we discussed the pros and cons at length. I ultimately asked if it would be feasible to replace both units rather than patch one and risk another failure soon after. Only at that point did Jerry share his honest professional opinion—that replacing both was the wiser long-term decision—which aligned perfectly with my own thinking and gave me added confidence in the recommendation.

Jerry then coordinated with his partner (who was on standby), and the two of them completed the full replacement efficiently and professionally:

- Drained both tanks and analyzed the sediment/deposits that came out (very informative)
- Carefully removed the old units from the attic
- Installed two new water heaters
- Retrofitted and modified connections to integrate seamlessly with the existing PVC plumbing framework
- Installed new drip trays
- Performed pressure testing to verify no leaks

I was able to observe the entire process and the final installed assembly, which looked clean, code-compliant, and built to last. The work was finished in a timely manner, especially critical with a freeze warning approaching the Katy area.

This was one of the best plumbing experiences I’ve had. Jerry remained even-keeled, transparent, knowledgeable, and genuinely customer-focused throughout—no upselling pressure, just straightforward expertise and honest advice. The team’s weekend availability, attention to detail, and quality of workmanship were outstanding.

I highly recommend Lone Wolf Plumbing—specifically Jerry—for anyone needing reliable, professional plumbing service in the Katy area. Thank you, Jerry!

Would definitely call again and refer to friends/family.

reviews.text: Zach and Jared went above and beyond to address some previous existing deficits in our heating and cooling functionality of our heat pump/mini split system.  Their thoroughness and professional approach to rectifying the issue was impressive.  Also I have found Mouradian to be extremely professional in handling more standard plumbing issues. Their plumber who installed 2 toilets was extremely professional and removed the old toilets without the usually high costs of other companies.  Mouradian has very fair costs and their staff are professional including Angela who schedules the appointments.  She is courteous and kind.

reviews.author: Paul Brydges
reviews.text: Mouradian Plumbing responded quickly to my water heater failing. Angela called me back within a half hour after I called and took down all the technical information needed for a new water heater replacement. She said the plumbers will be there with a new water heater in 2 hours. The plumbers removed the old water heater and installed the new one in about an hour. Great service and very professional . I highly recommend Mouradian Plumbing

plumbers.name: The Drain Guys
plumbers.address: 8041 Cessna Ave Ste 100, Gaithersburg, MD 20879, USA

reviews.author: Andrian Goodum
reviews.text:
I had my sewer line replaced about 4 months ago for nearly $18,000, and unfortunately the experience after the installation has been very disappointing. The cleanup was poorly done, the concrete work was subpar, and it caused my vinyl flooring (installed after)to no longer sit properly. I reached out two weeks ago through their messaging system and received no response. Additionally, my front yard continues to sink, which suggests the ground was not properly compacted after excavation. I now have to constantly re-compact the area myself. For the price paid, I expected far better workmanship and follow-up. Fixed my sewer problem thanks but left me with two other issues

RESPONSE: I’m sorry but for $18,000 I don’t think it’s to much to ask to smooth out a small area of concrete just like how it was in the first place. Reverting back to saying “our contract says” is a pretty poor example of customer service.

reviews.author: Tracey Crawley
reviews.text: I really recommend this company. These young men are smart and intelligent. I felt safe with them working in my home. Here are pictures of what they resolved. My grandkids put a toy in the toilet and I had a rotten trap pipe that needed replaced.

reviews.author: Hanser Bonzer
reviews.text: This is the second time at our place with The Drain Guys, both times with Chris. Very knowledgeable and always professional. Both times he was there within 24 hours of us needing him and fixed broken pipes quickly on our old house. This last time he gave us invaluable tips to help avoid having similar problems in the future. Reasonable fees and yes, I would 100% recommend The Drain Guys!!

reviews.author: Mark Prysler
reviews.text:
The Drain Guys is the best kept secret for pipe replacement.  I went through two crummy plumbers who charged for camera work and didn't know what was going on with my drain.  Called The Drain Guys and was glad I did.  This team had master plumber Jay, along with his team, Parker and the rest of the crew to correctly solve the issue.  The team provided insight on each part of the job, arrived promptly and even worked late.  Job itself was extremely clean and was smart in terms of the geography of where my pipe needed to be.  I now feel safe with a long term pipe in my property.
I highly recommend this crew for your plumbing needs.   Excavation can be a dirty job but these Michaelangelos made it look like a work of art.

reviews.author: Caroline Chang
reviews.text:
I had sewage issue and one plumbing company that said they could do the job came out and almost dug my front yard out to resolve it. I got a second opinion from the Drain Guys and they promptly informed me that the repair was actually in the city side of the property and that they were responsible, saving me thousands of dollars.

I had a separate sewage issue under my basement and they were so efficient in diagnosing and fixing the problem. Tricia from customer service is really excellent and I appreciated the crew that came out to help resolve our issue.

plumbers.name: All Week Plumbing
plumbers.address: 258 Semel Ave #2559, Garfield, NJ 07026, USA

reviews.author: Francis J Mercado
reviews.text: I have a tankless water heater and I called this company because they were on the list recommended by Rheem our tankless water heater. They came to my house and checked the unit and gave me charged $1000 for removal and &1,400 for installation. I knew it was too much but I was desperate since I called 2 companies and they don’t deal tankless. So I had them removed and it only took less than 30 mins. I brought the old unit to the store for exchange because it’s still under warranty. I share to the store about it and I was told the charge was too much. So the shop gave me plumber and he charged $400 for installation. I was very happy because I now have a trustworthy plumber. Please don’t use this company they will rip you. They don’t care for their customers who are just making a living.

reviews.author: Angela Sklavounos
reviews.text: Frank did a great job installing my water heater. Friendly, knowledgeable and friendly with any questions asked. Would recommend him to get the job done.

reviews.author: Daniel K
reviews.text: I guarantee you that you will come across no better HVAC repairman then Sam in Garfield. I scheduled an appointment for the next day and this guy calls me the same day on a Friday night and fixes the unit in 10 minutes!! All I can say is Holy Cow, You Are Awesome!! Along with being a lifesaver after showing me how juicey and ready to blow that capacitor was!!

reviews.author: Jessica Camacho-Moore
reviews.text: Situation resolved, would love for charge to be cheaper,  rep was respectful and on time, after prior rep attempted to arrive way after window time on day before

reviews.author: Tooba Ahmad
reviews.text: I've used All Week Plumbing twice and both experiences were great. The owner is very friendly and quick to answer the phone. I called for a kitchen sink clog when they were about to close but he sent one of his guys anyways. Ronnie came within half hour and did a great job. I would 100% recommend!

reviews.author: mark wong
reviews.text: It’s hard to find good service these days. We had toilet clogged couple times by my father and because of his mobility and senior challenges at 91 he can’t make it to another floor in time to get to another restroom in house. Mike was excellent both times in coming to fix the problem quickly. Mike was great to work with and standup guy. Just wanted to post a shout out that would highly recommend to call them.

reviews.author: Wyatt Estanol Trocme
reviews.text: Didn’t receive an invoice after original work. Even got a call from the company stating that they had issues with emails getting through and asked if a paper copy would work best. Never got anything. Then he texts with an updated price that’s 75$ more than originally discussed without ever sending me my original invoice.

reviews.author: Sarah Sprister
reviews.text: Needed someone quickly to help with sewer backup. Appleton Drain and Sewer arrived within the hour and had everything fixed within 30 mins! Someone has to do it!

reviews.author: Mike Schwab
reviews.text:
Mike and his co-worker were very timely, thorough, and professional.  Our kitchen sink, bathroom sink, and bathtub were draining slowly and now are free flowing.  My wife is smiling everytime she runs them.
Mike S.

reviews.author: Justin
reviews.text: My tub was clogged and my landlord called this company. These gentlemen were efficient and friendly! 10 minutes and my tub drains beautifully! Thank you

reviews.author: Jo Marty
reviews.text: I called Black Lake Plumbing because I had some kind of leak happening in my bathroom surrounding my toilet and I didn't know the exact cause. Chris was able to fit me in within a few days and came over to assess the problem. I ended up needing a new toilet and he installed that for me same day. The customer service was amazing, and the pricing was good as well. I will definitely call them for future plumbing issues! Thank you guys!

reviews.author: The GZone!
reviews.text:
The GZone's Review of the Black Lake Plumbing of Olympia, WA:

II recently had Black Lake Plumbing come out to repair a water leak near the water meter in front of my house. This leak had been causing me hefty water bills for the past three months, and I hadn’t even realized it until a professional leak detection company helped me identify the issue. Once I knew about the problem, I contacted Black Lake Plumbing, and they were quick to respond.

The team did an excellent job with the repair. They were very knowledgeable, courteous, and professional throughout the entire process. They did an excellent job and explained in detail the work performed — Ed & Tom are very knowledgeable, courteous and thorough. I appreciated their expertise and attention to detail in resolving the issue that had been causing as well as costing me so much.

While they’re a bit on the pricier side, you definitely get what you pay for with Black Lake Plumbing. The only reason this is a four-star review instead of five is that "they don’t offer Veterans Discounts", which would have been a nice gesture. Despite that, the quality of their work made it well worth the cost. Overall, I would highly recommend Black Lake Plumbing for anyone in need of reliable plumbing services in the Olympia area. It was well worth it!

Respectfully, G *my personal experience.

reviews.author: Dustin Field
reviews.text: I contacted Black Lake Plumbing for some small residential plumbing repairs and installation of a home well-water filtration system in Rochester. Chris the owner spent the entire day installing the water filtration system I purchased online to include adding pipes under the home to ensure the system performed properly. When he realized the pre-filter provided with the system was inadequate, he drove back to Olympia to purchase the correct pre-filters for the system. He was incredibly meticulous and ensured the system was properly installed. His customer service and thoroughness were incredible and greatly appreciated. He is also a big supporter of Veterans which I also greatly appreciated. He did such a great job that I have already contracted him to do some more work at our home. I am a lifetime customer of Black Lake Plumbing because of Chris's impressive efforts and amazing workmanship. Contact Black Lake Plumbing for your plumbing needs and you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Ashley Porter
reviews.text:
Highly recommend. Communication was quick, professional & so was the work performed. Grateful they were able to fit us in for a home-sale inspection item.

Thank you!

reviews.author: Arlene Gardner
reviews.text: I was very pleased with the service provided. He was prompt, knowledgeable, and worked very efficiently. I would recommend Black Lake Plumbing to anyone needing plumbing services.

Jose on the other hand was not only very professional,  but my wife felt very comfortable with him and his explanations as to what was going on. My wife called me at work and said she was so glad we contacted Mike Diamond Plumbing. She was so happy with the process and how Jose conducted himself she said when we call for other services she said she would request Jose and his helper. We are more than pleased with Jose's help and service. Can't say enough.

reviews.author: Barbara Butters
reviews.text:
Awesome company. We’ve used Ark for a couple of years for various plumbing issues and would highly recommend. Jenny is great with scheduling and following up. Ark is a family-owned business and I would highly recommend over a large or franchised business.

reviews.author: Dorian Girard
reviews.text: Look no further, you’ve found your plumber!  Jason and team are the whole package.  Experienced, knowledgeable, reliable, trustworthy, professional and courteous. reviews.author: Betty Silguero
reviews.text: I have hot water once again!!! Thank You Ark Plumbing! The big box companies had been out and could not fix the issue. Ark plumbing came in and fixed it!! Ark Plumbing was knowledgeable, professional! I recommend them!

reviews.author: David Teply
reviews.text: During a recent freeze, we had a pipe burst and water was spraying everywhere. While the City of Cedar Park was quick to shut off the main, Ark Plumbing was the true lifesaver. After reaching out to three other plumbers who never called back, Ark showed up around 6:00 PM. They replaced the hose bib and restored our water in about 10 minutes! They saved us from being without water for days and did it for a very fair price. I can’t recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Michael Malish
reviews.text:
Professional, Transparent, and Customer-Focused

ARK Plumbing really impressed me from the start. I reached out to three different plumbing companies in Austin, and ARK was the only one that used actual diagnostic tools to assess the issue rather than just giving a guess. That alone set them apart in terms of professionalism and attention to detail.

They provided same-day service for the evaluation and gave a clear quote on the spot. Their pricing was right in the middle of the three bids I received, but the value they offered was far above the rest.

What stood out most was how thoughtful they were about the entire customer journey. From the first call to the way they structured their quote and approval process, everything was clear, easy, and focused on the customer. A company that makes it easy to say yes makes a real difference, especially when you’re dealing with the stress of a plumbing issue.

I’m happy to recommend ARK Plumbing to anyone in Austin looking for reliable, transparent, and customer-first service.

plumbers.name: BP Plumbing

reviews.author: Spencer Rand
reviews.text: Jullian was the definition of professional and respectful! He was the exact right man for the job! He explained everything clearly and in depth! His workmanship is second to none!! If I ever have another plumbing need I will be calling BP and asking for Jullian personally!!

reviews.author: Cindy Olsen
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Jullian Ayende. He showed up right on time, was very professional, and did an excellent job replacing my hot water heater. Everything was explained clearly, the work was done efficiently, and the results were great. I’m extremely happy with the service and would highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Rachel Stiltner

No more $400 water bills for us!!!

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.text: Randy did a great job with installing our tankless & water filtration system. We will be calling BP plumbing if we have any issues in the future!

reviews.author: JustAnotherUserName

reviews.text: Anthony A with WhizPro Plumbing was a  professional, friendly, knowledgeable technician. He explained everything before and after completion of the work. Cleanup all areas when finished. We and our dog love him.  The work was excellent!!

reviews.author: lynda curtis
reviews.text: Dylan did a great job fixing and replacing my shower head. He showed up on time, was very professional, and made sure the job was done right without making a mess. reviews.author: Missy Barnett

reviews.author: Edward Huerta
reviews.text: My wife and I are very pleased with the work that Whiz-Pro had done for us , replacing our main water supply line from Meter to Home... they were knowledgeable, honest and very professional… I will recommend them to others with small or Large jobs. Thank You all for such a great job. Blessings and Shalom.

reviews.author: BethAnne Whaley
reviews.text:
Anthony and Jonny saved the day, at a time in my VA loan and inspection/appraisal cycle during which decisions and deadlines had to be made and met, respectively; all reports/estimates having to be  accurate and fair, and communication prompt and efficient between me, WHiZPRO, both my buyer-agent and the seller-agent realtor, and my mortgage lender. It has felt like a race against time!  Yet, Cole, expertly manning the WHiZPRO phones made this easy for me:  with his help, the plumbers came: on time, dressed in stylish, clean new uniform shirts, and arrived onsite as promised- doing what they do best- ensuring and/or restoring a family's reliable access to well/city water and connections to septic/city sewer.

I am most impressed, and even joined their program, as it was fair and reasonable for my home-buying and future homeowner needs!
