reviews.author: Angelina Giordano
reviews.text:
Nate was great right from the start—welcoming, friendly, and very easy to communicate with. He was able to get me scheduled quickly to check a water heater leak and even said he’d call later in the day if he couldn’t get it looked at sooner—and he actually did.

When the technicians arrived, Justus and George were just as excellent. Overall, this was the best customer service I’ve had in a long time. I would give them extra stars if I could. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kari Wooten
reviews.text: Amazing work from Nate, Justus, and George! The shower/tub install was quick and flawless, and I appreciate how communicative and kind everyone was through the process. I will definitely be calling them again next time I need a plumber.

reviews.author: Michelle Alekseyev
reviews.text:
Nate was really kind on the phone and Justus was efficient in completing the work. Justus was very thoughtful and helped educate me on each part of the process. Justus worked quickly and cleared our drain in under an hour despite the challenges of an older plumbing system.

Plumbing issues are never pleasant, Nate and Justus made it a bit easier being timely, kind, and honest.

Flat rates for most projects. Declogging is hourly though!

reviews.author: Dixie. Staggenborg
reviews.text: I'm incredibly happy with my new shower. Nate and his team were all friendly and courteous. They kept all mess completely contained to the bathroom. Every  question and concern I had was quickly addressed. My remodel was scheduled and completed fast and the results are absolutely perfect. I had this project done while I was dealing with a life changing medical catastrophe. I needed a walk in shower instead of a tub and I needed it fast. Principled Plumbing made my life so much easier. A million thanks to their team.

reviews.author: Matthew Mcgann
reviews.text: Nate and justus are great! I have worked with them on multiple projects and have always got professional results within timing, price and quality. I highly recommend principled plumbing!

plumbers.name: Reeg Plumbing
plumbers.address: 641 Madison St, Oak Park, IL 60302, USA

reviews.author: John White
reviews.text:
I had a main line / sewer backup and called Reeg Plumbing. Even though they had a packed schedule, they still made the effort to fit me in the same day, which I really appreciated.

My main points of contact were Chris and Dionna, who were both incredibly pleasant and easy to talk to on the phone. They communicated clearly, kept me informed, and made the whole scheduling process smooth and stress-free.

My technician, Dave, arrived exactly when he said he would, quickly diagnosed the issue, and had everything resolved in under an hour. He was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to share helpful tips to prevent future problems.

I’ve worked in property management previously
for many years and have dealt with dozens of plumbing companies across the country. This was honestly one of the best service experiences I’ve had to date. The entire team was fantastic.

They even referred me to another excellent company to help with a completely separate issue I’m dealing with, which shows they genuinely care about helping their customers beyond just the immediate job.

Highly recommend. Outstanding service and a great team all around.

reviews.author: Jonathan Spalink
reviews.text: This is a great company! From the first interaction over the phone to job completion, Reeg was great. My old water heater died and they were able to give me a competitive quote over the phone, walk me through what the job would look like, and complete the job first-thing the next morning. Krystof was knowledgable and answered all my questions, was in and out in less than 2 hours, and left the area cleaner than when he started. Very happy with them and their work, and will be calling them again when I have another plumbing problem!

reviews.author: Deb Harrington
reviews.text: We had a punch list of repair needs, but finally made the call to Reeg when we had a leak in a basement pipe.  My interaction with Chris on the phone was diagnostic and spot on— I took photos to send to him and he had enough info to schedule what was needed.  Scottie was on time and he really knows what he’s doing, which is great when you’re paying hourly.  He also worked with us on options that resolved our issues, but ended up being less expensive.  Big kudos to Scottie and we’ve always had a great experience with Reeg Plumbing.

reviews.author: Arlene Miner
reviews.text: Brett arrived on time, he was professional, and promptly went to work. He answered all my questions and completed the job. He then cleaned up the area quickly. Brett is certainly an asset to Reeg Plumbing. I will look forward to the next project we have in mind. Thank you Reeg!

reviews.author: Joe V
reviews.text: We have used Reeg Plumbing 3 times and have had great experiences with them. Most recently we noticed a leak in our 17-year-old water heater. Spoke to Chris on Thursday and had a new one installed on Monday by Krystof. He was done in a couple of hours and cleaned up any mess made. As it was not leaking fast Chris felt it would be fine for a few days. Reeg is our "go to" plumbing company. We highly recommend them!

plumbers.name: Free Flow Plumbing and Drains
plumbers.address: 3813 S Sweet Escape Dr, Washington, UT 84780, USA

reviews.author: Brian Ewell
reviews.text:
Coy at Free Flow Plumbing and Drains was amazing!
We live in Salt Lake and have a property in St. George.
The main sewer pipe backed up into the house.
They replaced the pipe in record time. My tenants were very happy and appreciative.
We communicated by phone/text.
Coy was extremely responsive answered all of my questions mostly before I asked them.
He provided before, during, and after pictures/videos. It almost looks like they didn't even dig.
I would trust him with any Plumbing job!
Thanks Coy!
222 555

reviews.author: Wendy Pulsipher
reviews.text: I needed to have 3 faucets replaced.  Free Flow Plumbing gives excellent service and they are very knowledgeable.  This is the 3rd time I have had them come to change out some things and fix some of my plumbing issues.  I am so impressed with their efficiency as well as the care they take in doing the work.  I HIGHLY recommend them for your plumbing needs and issues!

reviews.author: Gary Stark
reviews.text: Coy and team recently came to my home for a job. I feel they went above and beyond with helping me get everything resolved and then some.  It's nice to find a plumber that takes the time and genuinely cares about customers.

reviews.author: cory lowder
reviews.text: I have to say I have never met a greater plumbing family than Free Flow. These guys show up with the greatest attitudes to do some of the dirtiest work and they do it with a smile. Coy is my first call for all my plumbing needs and his crew knocks it out of the park everytime, leaving me and my customers happy.

reviews.author: Shea M
reviews.text: Hands down the best plumbing company in Southern Utah. Their promptness and attention to detail is extraordinary. Julia is so punctual and goes above and beyond and Coy is very knowledgeable and honest!

plumbers.name: Butts Plumbing
plumbers.address: 174 Lear Rd, Avon Lake, OH 44012, USA

reviews.author: Derek Kaple
reviews.text: John came out and installed a new hot water heater today.  Pricing was fair, and John was professional, friendly, prompt and overall great.   Thank you Butts Plumbing and John.  You have my business going forward!

reviews.author: Roman Hawrylko
reviews.text: Samuel from Butts installed my two new replacement sump pumps and optimized the piping as well. Looks and works excellent. Services call price was very reasonable. Will use them for all my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Evan
reviews.text: We have used Butts Plumbing twice now - both times Sam came out and did an excellent job. Super helpful, arrived on time, did the job at a reasonable price and even offered some tips and suggestions moving forward with our bathroom remodel. Thank you, Sam!

reviews.author: Amelia Patterson
reviews.text: Called and requested a waterline to be installed for an icemaker in our fridge. An older guy came and measured. He never called and never came back. I would give zero stars if I could.

reviews.author: Adam Ciarrone
reviews.text: Excellent response time from the company, they sent tech Collin out same day as my initial call and we had the work scheduled quickly. Collin was professional, personable, and enjoyable to work with. Butt's quote was also half of another local company, and they even went above and beyond to help install parts of my sink that were not on the original request. They will be our go-to plumbing service going forward.

plumbers.name: Bueno Plumbing and Rooter
plumbers.address: 4954 Rue Calais, San Jose, CA 95136, USA

reviews.author: Lisa Torres
reviews.text: My parents needed some piping fixed under the house which was causing a water leak. I messaged Kevin Bueno personally and his office called us within 10 minutes to setup an appointment! They were fast and efficient with their work! Edgar came out quoted them for the job and came the next day to fix the issue. We will be using Bueno Plumbing for any future needs and will be recommending him to anyone who needs a plumber! Thanks again Kevin for helping my parents out!

reviews.author: Columban Heo
reviews.text:
Update: The technician arrived about an hour late but was thorough and found an additional crack another company missed. However, after missing two appointment windows with no proactive communication and providing a much higher-than-expected quote, we decided not to move forward.

This company missed both of my scheduled appointment windows.
They didn’t show up yesterday during the time they promised and only contacted me after I reached out first. They said they would come first thing this morning, but again, they failed to arrive during the stated window and provided no update. This wasted my time and came across as very unprofessional. I cannot recommend them based on this experience.

reviews.author: Vic B
reviews.text:
I had a leak in a 30 year old copper pipe going to my pool filter. Spent 3 days talking to about 6-7 plumbers to get an estimate. 2 of them showed up in person and one gave a quote over the phone by responding to a picture of the leak. First one gave a quote of almost $1000 and would not provide details on how exactly they will fix the leak. Second one gave an almost double quote but also suggested replacing the entire buried pipe for unknown 1000's of $$ more. Third one gave a quote in the same range but could not schedule the job for weeks. Finally, we got Edgar from Bueno Plumbing. Showed up on time, assessed the job requirements in detail, gave a competitive quote 15 minutes later in writing and scheduled the job 2 days later.

The work was done in an extremely professional manner and on time. It took him about 3 hours to finish the job. You can see the before and after pics below. This is how a professional service experience should be. The job was guaranteed for a year. I would not look at any other plumbing service in the future.

reviews.author: Blaine Cuykendall
reviews.text: We've used Buenos services several times in the past couple of years.  Always happy with their people and performance.  Today, Kevin quickly cleared a difficult clog in the toilet -- after 2 days of my amateur attempts.

reviews.author: Sarah Walker
reviews.text: Extremely impressed with their leak detection technology. They found a hidden pipe leak behind our wall that two other plumbers missed. Saved us a fortune in potential water damage!

plumbers.name: HEP Plumbing
plumbers.address: 223 E Center St, Kingsport, TN 37660, USA

reviews.author: Jen Milam
reviews.text: Very prompt after hours service.  Air conditioning was not working, and Patrick got it working and cooling the house in a very short time.  He was extremely courteous and friendly.  He took the time to explain what he was doing, the repair that was needed and several recommendations to extend the life of our unit.

reviews.author: Virginia Greene
reviews.text: Ray was excellent to work with and very professional at his job I would recommend him to any one to do there plumbing

reviews.author: Nicole Storie
reviews.text: Robert and Malik arrived this morning to repair our drainage lines. They completed the job and exceeded all our expectations. They completed the job in less time than expected and everything is working great. Robert explained all the issues and how they would be fixing them very clearly and answered all questions we had. I would definitely recommend these two to anyone. Thank you both and thank you to HEP for taking care of us!!

reviews.author: LK
reviews.text: I couldn’t be happier with the service I received. Ray showed up on time and was extremely professional, and clearly knew exactly what he was doing. He explained the problem in a way that made sense, fixed it quickly, and made sure everything was working perfectly before leaving. The work was clean, efficient, and fairly priced. It’s hard to find reliable tradespeople these days, but this company absolutely delivered. I would highly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work done and will definitely call them again in the future.

reviews.author: Jaime Dunn
reviews.text: Jimmy B, Aaron Lee, and Josh Butler did an amazing job installing my new electrical panel and a/c in less than 8 hours. I can’t believe how hard they worked in such a small space and worked so well together. Really impressed with them and how hard they worked and how quickly they finished the job in 88 degree weather. All three were so polite and also funny, but most of all professional!

plumbers.name: The Right Brothers Plumbing & Drains
plumbers.address: 59 S Main St Suite B, Centerville, OH 45458, USA

reviews.author: Kyle Schetter
reviews.text: Chad and Lance did some proactive plumbing for us today; proactive meaning, upgrading dated plumbing areas within our home that posed a potential risk. Chad and Lance were professional and personal.  They were clean with the work they completed. Their work was efficient and of high quality.  We've had work done previously with The Right Brothers and also end up pleased with the outcome.

reviews.author: Beryl Boggess
reviews.text: They returned my calls quickly. Let me know ahead, what time they would arrive. Nate was professional, informed, and skilled. He Spock highly of Right Brothers. The job was completed quickly, properly, and with out mess. I will definitely be using them in the future as needed.

reviews.author: Dillon Stevens
reviews.text: I noticed the inlet leaking on my water heater nipple. I called Buckeye and scheduled an appointment for the next day. Scheduling was easy and they worked around my schedule which changes frequently. Unfortunately the repair required the installation of a new water heater. These gentlemen worked until nearly 10pm installing a new water heater so I wouldn’t have to go without water over the weekend. I won’t forget the professional and efficient work they did. Recommend these boys all day.

reviews.author: Jill
reviews.text: Kind and professional. I love my new water softener!! You have a customer for life. Thanks!

reviews.author: Jim Jasinski
reviews.text: On time, friendly, worked efficiently and did the work we agreed upon with no hiccups along the way.

plumbers.name: Able Plumbing | Residential | Commercial | 24/7 Emergency
plumbers.address: 1217 N Meyer Ave, Seabrook, TX 77586, USA

reviews.author: Johnny Truesdale
reviews.text: I recently had a water leak in an upstairs bathroom. Able Plumbing came out and made the repair. A mistake was made, and the water leak was worse. Water damage was made to the downstairs ceiling below the bathroom. Juan, from Able, came out and made the proper repair and surveyed the damage. No argument from him. He called me the next day and had the drywall people lined up. All of the repairs and painting was done to our great satisfaction. He was personable and professional. He was easy to reach by phone or text and answered all of our questions as they came up. Every company can make a mistake. What the company does about their error is what defines the company. Chris, Juan and  Able Plumbing stood by us, ensured us they would do the right thing, and they did. We will call them in the future when we have plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Jalina Schexnayder
reviews.text: We needed to get our water heater replaced and got quotes from a couple of plumbers locally around the Seabrook area. First competitor wanted to charge us $7k to replace our tankless water heater. My husband called Able plumbing and received a quote for around $3k to replace it. You can imagine who we went with. Juan came out to our house and was AMAZING. He communicated every step of the way, was professional, knowledgeable and so patient with all of my questions. We will absolutely be using Able Plumbing for anything we need in the future.

reviews.author: Kevin Grayson
reviews.text: Abel Plumbing come out to the house and gave me a free estimate of the work that I needed. They was a lot more affordable than the other companies that I got estimates from so I decided to let them do the work. They did an excellent job,  walked me through each process, provided me with pictures before and after and cleaned up after they completed the job. All of my plumbing system is working properly now thank you Mr Juan and Kaitlyn @ Abel Plumbing.

reviews.author: Freddy Garrett
reviews.text: I highly recommend Able Plumbing. I bought a water heater at the big orange and the plumber they wanted me to use quoted me an enormous amount. So I went with Able instead and the final price was less than half of what the big orange plumbers wanted. My new boiler is working great. Able did a solid job.

reviews.author: Shane Reaux
reviews.text: We’ve used Able before for a clogged drain on Christmas (2019) due to our 2yr old at the time putting a plastic down the toilet, still not sure how it made it into the line as it was from his ball pit, haha, they were there the same day and removed it! Just last week we had a leak on our main line running into the house. The plumber came straight from another call during his lunch break and removed the damaged pipe and installed a new one. We would like to thank Clay Yarborough for performing an outstanding job. Great customer service, professionalism and great pricing! We recommend them for all your plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: AquaPro Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1116 Wilkes Ln, Lake Zurich, IL 60047, USA

reviews.author: Wyatt Brice
reviews.text: From start to finish, the plumber was exceptionally knowledgeable and efficient with our sump pump installation. He arrived about 15 minutes early, ready to tackle the job. His attention to detail and commitment to quality were evident throughout the process. The installation was seamless, and he took the time to explain everything thoroughly. I now have peace of mind knowing my basement is well-protected. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Helen Peyton
reviews.text: Facing a sudden leak in my kitchen, I was relieved when a skilled plumber arrived promptly. He quickly diagnosed the issue and had the pipes repaired in under an hour. His professionalism and efficient work left me thoroughly impressed. I appreciated his clear explanations and dedication to ensuring everything was in perfect working order before leaving.

reviews.author: Braeden Alessandro
reviews.text: Discovering a mysterious wet patch on the living room floor had me baffled. I called in a plumber, and their detective-like skills in leak detection were impressive. Within 45 minutes, they pinpointed the leak's origin with precision. They explained every step, ensuring I felt informed and confident about the process. The efficiency and clarity in their work turned a potential headache into a smooth resolution. Highly recommend for anyone needing a sharp eye and quick fix!

reviews.author: Ivan Elisabeth
reviews.text: The plumber arrived promptly and expertly installed our new water tank with impressive precision. He took the time to explain the system and answered all our questions, ensuring we felt comfortable. The entire process was smooth, efficient, and completed in just under two hours.

reviews.author: Korbin Chana
reviews.text: Having a reliable water heater is a game-changer, and I couldn’t be happier with the installation. The plumber arrived promptly, worked efficiently, and explained everything clearly. It’s been a month, and the hot water is steady. Highly recommend for anyone needing a seamless installation experience.

plumbers.name: The Fair Plumber LLC
plumbers.address: 668 E Northwest Hwy #4, Mt Prospect, IL 60056, USA

reviews.author: khrystyna tykhanska
reviews.text: I highly recommend this plumbing company for their quick and professional repair service. The technicians arrived on time, identified the issue right away, and fixed it efficiently. I am very satisfied with their work and will gladly use their services again.

reviews.author: Lindsey Witting
reviews.text: Rolando and Thomas did fabulous work at our house. We weren’t able to use plumbing on one side of our house and they fixed it. They were super professional and would recommend them to anyone. Thank you guys so much!!

reviews.author: Sarah Rodriguez
reviews.text:
Never calling The Fair Plumber again. We used them years ago and spent over $6,000 to replace an outdoor pipe, so when we started having a similar issue, we called them back. They did come out quickly, which I appreciated.

However, they quoted us $17,000 to replace about 20 feet of piping. Thankfully, a friend encouraged me to get a second opinion. Another company came out within an hour, used a different tool, flushed the line, and resolved the issue for $900. I cannot believe I was almost pressured into paying $17,000 for a problem that was fixed for $900.

To make matters worse, the manager was very unpleasant when I told him I wanted to check with another company. Extremely disappointing experience. I would not recommend The Fair Plumber.

reviews.author: Rafal Pachur
reviews.text: The Fair Plumber did a great job installing my Navien tankless water heater. The installation was smooth, and the new system works perfectly. I really appreciate their quality work and attention to detail. Highly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing help!

reviews.author: Armando Gomez
reviews.text: Great experiences  with the fair plumber  they replaced a water heater in one of my properties a couple of months ago and when the water heater in my house went bad I knew who to call . Highly recommend them for any plumbing needs!

plumbers.name: McG Krush Plumbing Solutions
plumbers.address: 1610 W Polo Rd, Grand Prairie, TX 75052, USA

reviews.author: Juan Otero
reviews.text: Quality work performed,  the plumber has experience and a very professional positive attitude willing to find solutions for any issues. They were honest and left everything better than before. Highly recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Theresa Hollis
reviews.text: McG Krush plumbing was referred to us and they really came through for us when our water heated was leaking.  Chase found the water heater we wanted, gave us an estimate and came out within a few days to get the water heater installed.  It was so easy to work with them and they did what they said they would do and got the job done.  Thanks for the 5 star service!  Would definitely recommend their services and would use them again!

reviews.author: Shirley
reviews.text: Roger was so helpful & good at his job! He explained everything & was able to take care of our leak quickly. He also gave us a bunch of tips to prevent the same thing happening again which we appreciated. I would totally recommend 100%

reviews.author: Darlene Rodriguez
reviews.text: They did an awesome job. They were very quick ro response to my inquiry and fast at setting up the repair date. They came by when the roads were still icy and got the job done in a couple of hours. If you're looking for plumbers they're the ones you want.

reviews.author: AJ Ailey
reviews.text: Great work and knowledgeable skilled guys..Roger and Chase came out and found my leak under my home and gave me all my options and at that point I knew they were the ones to hire. Then Sam came out and did an excellent job repairing my leak and explained and showed me what was going on and showed me the repairs once completed and verified no more leaks. These gentlemen did an outstanding job and strongly recommend!!

plumbers.name: CPR Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 7204 Bradford Pl, The Colony, TX 75056, USA

reviews.author: Eric Oberto
reviews.text:
In a profession riddled with overcharging and price-gouging for their highly in-demand services (“as the norm”), CPR is the most reasonably priced plumbing service in The Colony.

They don’t try to trap you by charging a fee just to show up; whether they do any work or not. I really appreciate Chad for his “NO NONSENSE” approach to earning the potential customer’s business. Their pricing is transparent, upfront, and usually below the competition’s quotes (not by a landslide, but I’ll take it).

I first used them in 2014 to replace my hot water heater and their quote was below the competition. In addition, the quality of the install was on-point. Finally, he talked me out of buying a more expensive unit (that was recommended by a different plumber) and educated me about why his recommendation had more value. It’s rare when a plumber talks you into spending less money! NOTE: The hot water heater is still working well as of today.

His son-in-law Chis came out to my house yesterday to replace a shutoff valve. He followed right in-line with where Chad left off in 2014.

It’s impressive to see that the same company values are still intact 11 years later!

I recommend choosing CPR for all of your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Amy Montero
reviews.text: I don't normally write reviews because I'm persnickety and can be brutally honest to a fault. However, after getting a referral to CPR Plumbing, I had to write this review for the benefit of other homeowners in the area that are in need of quality plumbing services. Their level of professionalism and attention to detail is outstanding, and the piece of mind you get from knowing that the job is done right makes the entire experience easier to navigate. We had an emergency plumbing problem right before the impending snow/ice storm and it was, to say the least, super stressful considering the timing and inconvenience this caused. CPR went way above and beyond to get this HUGE job done in just under 2 days, while racing against the weather, and their level of service and knowledge made this situation about as stress free as it could be. I asked an annoying amount of questions during this process. CPR assured me they were honest and credible plumbers and that they had expectations for a high quality of work without exception. I found this to be absolutely true! Thank you so much for coming out in the dark and the cold, after working on other jobs all day, to get our project done!

reviews.author: Mariann Daley
reviews.text:
After losing my husband, I lost my ring and was devastated. I thought it had fallen into my bathroom sink and called CPR Plumbing. Chris returned my call within minutes and came out within a couple of hours in The Colony, TX.
He checked both sinks, and when it wasn't there, he didn't give up - he found the ring on my bed and was genuinely happy as I was. He was kind, professional, respectful, and truly cared.
Chris refused to charge me, saying finding the ring made his day - but it absolutely made mine. Customer for life. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Robin DeSimone
reviews.text: I have been a fan and loyal customer for 20 years. One more time CPR saved me when I sprung a gas leak from my stove.  I love their responsiveness, kindness and service.

reviews.author: Xavier Lopez
reviews.text: First experience with CPR Plumbing. Chris was professional, approachable, reliable and clearly explained everything throughout the process. The work was done quickly and efficiently, and the overall service exceeded my expectations. I would definitely use CPR Plumbing again in the future. Highly recommend them, you cannot go wrong!

plumbers.name: Perfectum Construction and Plumbing
plumbers.address: 18711 Capella Ln, Gaithersburg, MD 20877, USA

reviews.author: Kira Brover
reviews.text:
Over the past five years, the Perfectum team has successfully completed a wide range of projects at my home. Their work included painting the entire house, replacing the roof, and installing a new HVAC system.
They also handled a very complex repair involving a broken sewage line that was pinched between an HVAC duct and a structural support beam, which caused my basement to flood. Perfectum managed the situation professionally at every stage—performing water mitigation, thoroughly drying and disinfecting the area, and completing full flood restoration. This included replacing the entire bamboo basement flooring, repairing damaged drywall, and repainting the space.
The quality of work, attention to detail, and professionalism throughout every project have been outstanding.

reviews.author: george blond
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Perfectum for quite a few years and have always had a great experience. On one occasion, I couldn’t winterize my back hose bib. When Vadim, the owner, arrived, he quickly realized that the original internal shut-off valve installed by the builder also shut off cold water to my kitchen faucet.
Vadim carefully analyzed the piping and was able to install a dedicated shut-off valve in a very tight ceiling space. Thanks to that solution, I can now properly winterize the back hose bib. Over the years, Perfectum has also fixed multiple pinhole leaks, replaced my toilet, and changed my kitchen faucet.
Fair pricing, excellent workmanship, and they always clean up after the job. I highly recommend Perfectum.

reviews.author: Natalia Farrar
reviews.text:
I’ve used Perfectum Construction And Plumbing on multiple occasions in different houses, and they’ve always delivered excellent service.
Last time I had a toilet that was leaking in my crawl space for a while and  completely  destroyed my subfloor and the floor joists. Since these guys do structural work as well they replaced all of them. They also relocated my HVAC ducts,  installed a smaller window and replaced all the bad framing. It was very convenient that I did not have to call a bunch of different companies to do all these jobs. They completely remodeled my bathroom and it was done quickly and efficiently. Very happy with the results!

reviews.author: Howard Sumka
reviews.text:
I first used Perfectum Construction and Plumbing in 2021 and had a great experience. Vadim replaced my water heater, pressure reducing valve, and the main water shut-off valve. He came on short notice (water heaters are always an emergency) and advised me to replace the pressure valve and the main shut-off. His work was very professional. It was clear that he insists on doing things the right way. When he replaced the water heater, he also rearranged the Rube Goldberg water lines that fed our furnace humidifier.

Just a couple of days ago I had Vadim and Peter come back to install a new kitchen faucet and a new garbage disposal with an air-button system. They also fixed a couple of our toilets that were leaking, and capped a gas line that we no longer use since we replaced our gas range with an electric one. They paid attention to the details, and they left the work site clean and neat.

I trusted Vadim’s recommendations for replacement fixtures, and he shopped for them, checking first with me before he made the purchases. If you're looking for a dependable local plumber who does quality work and stands behind it, I highly recommend Perfectum Construction and Plumbing.

reviews.author: Rob Snowhite
reviews.text:
We have been working with Vadim for well over a decade, and he is truly the person you call when you want the job done right. He is often the one fixing inferior plumbing work that others couldn’t get right the first time. He’s excellent with water heater installations, dishwashers, and any plumbing project that requires skill and attention to detail.

One experience really stands out. After installing a brand-new water heater, Vadim noticed a leak coming from the anode rod on top of the unit — a factory defect. Instead of leaving us without hot water or asking us to wait several days, he immediately took action. It was nearly 9:00 p.m., and he rushed to Home Depot, arriving just a minute before closing. He returned the same evening and completed the repair so we wouldn’t be left stranded.

That level of dedication says everything. Vadim genuinely cares about his customers, stands behind his work, and goes above and beyond to make sure the job is done properly.
Highly recommended.

plumbers.name: P & S Plumbing Honolulu
plumbers.address: 1714 Homerule St #1, Honolulu, HI 96819, USA

reviews.author: Sherry Dela Cruz
reviews.text: I am so blessed by P & S plumbing Honolulu! I found a slow leak in my apartment. My maintenance man found the problem and called P & S Plumbing Honolulu. To my surprise they came the same day, and was an hour and fifteen minutes earlier than they promised! That was impressive to say the least! Aaron and Mike were professionals in every sense of the word! They were very kind and respectful! Twenty minutes later, they were done! Wow! And they cleaned up to! They are truly a BLESSING! reviews.author: Joe O
reviews.text:
I discovered I had an underground water line leak when I noticed my meter was still running with all the water shut off inside the house. My usage had spiked from about 9,000 gallons a month to 27,000 gallons. There was a pool of water in my front yard and I even had ducks showing up, which should tell you how bad it was. I reached out to a few plumbers in the area and Arrowhead was one of the first to respond.
Derrick, the owner and a Master Plumber, came out to assess the situation. He was upfront about all the options, from a patch repair to a full line replacement, and explained the pros and cons of each without pressuring me into anything. He always took my opinion into consideration. The estimate was fair and clearly written. He sent the invoice via both text and email, and offered multiple ways to pay.
The crew showed up on time Wednesday morning. They finished at a reasonable time, which seemed quick to me for a full water line replacement from the meter to the house. The workers were all really nice and professional.
Before he left, Derrick was very thorough. When the job was finished I was excited and ready to use the water again. I tested everything and it was working as expected. It would have been easy for Arrowhead to just pack up and leave at that point, but Derrick took the time to make sure I was well equipped to check pressure and plumbing in my home. He actually found that I had toilets that needed to be rebuilt and were still running water. I had no idea they were leaking or even how to check for that. He made sure I was a more informed homeowner before leaving.
I highly recommend Arrowhead Plumbing. Top notch company with amazing customer service. Derrick is knowledgeable, honest, and genuinely cares about taking care of your home. I expect to use him for any future plumbing needs. If you’re in Gwinnett County, call Arrowhead.

Also, he gave me safety advice about moving the black tool cabinet away from the water heater or at least 2ft. I am going to have it moved to the shed. I can’t begin to say how pleased I am with the work of Arrowhead Plumbing. I converted a family room into an in-law suite and needed installation of a sink as well as a washer/dryer connection. The team came in and assessed the situation and gave me a fair estimate for the work.  Because those connections did not previously exist, they had to drill into the floor, and remove part of the sheetrock to connect the pipes.

I won’t lie, not having used Arrowhead in the past, I was a bit nervous.  My fear quickly dissipated when Mr. Bell took his time to explain what was happening and tested the pipes to ensure that there weren’t any blockages before they proceeded to close up the floor.

After using the washer/dryer for a few times, I can say I have not had any issues with it. I would like to give a special “thank you” to Paulino, who connected my sink and garbage disposal. He quickly informed that I needed to add an electrical switch and socket for the disposal. Again, he went to his van, and grabbed an extension cord to show that the disposal worked. plumbers.name: H2Flo Plumbing and Sewer LLC
plumbers.address: 161 Ontario St, Frankfort, IL 60423, USA

reviews.author: GianPaolo Vernazzani
reviews.text:
When you’re in an emergency situation, you don’t have time to research the best company or the best price. You go with your gut and cross your fingers.
Just a few days before New Year’s Eve, our sewer drains started backing up in the house. Thankfully, we realized quickly what was happening and stopped using water. At first, we thought the issue was limited to one bathroom, but it turned out to be much worse.
I started calling several companies, including one I had worked with earlier in 2025. It was Sunday night, and no one answered at first. A few minutes later, H2Flo called me back. Within 30 minutes, two young plumbers were at my house assessing the problem.
They used a camera to inspect the sewer pipes and reached a conclusion almost immediately. The cast iron pipe coming out of the house and connecting to the main sewer line was likely broken and misaligned. Because of this, there was little to no flow, and a large amount of wipes (!!) had accumulated in the gap, blocking what little space water still had to pass through.
They tried removing some of the blockage, but explained that the pipe needed to be replaced and that they would need an excavator. Since they had to rent one, they couldn’t continue that night and would return in the morning.
After they left, we realized that their initial cleaning had actually helped, and the drains were working again. Still, we were very careful with water usage that night, afraid the issue could come back.
The next morning, they arrived (a bit later than planned) with the excavator and got to work. The entire job took about 3–4 hours. They did a great job, worked efficiently, and were very clean and professional inside the house while replacing the pipe.
The other plumber I had worked with in the past later told me he could have done the job for less money. Maybe that’s true — but H2Flo answered an emergency call on a Sunday night, temporarily restored our drainage so we could use water again, and then completed a high-quality repair the very next day. That peace of mind is worth a lot.
In the end, I’m very happy with the work and glad I supported a local, family-owned and operated business. Thank you very much, H2Flo!

reviews.author: Justin Lowen
reviews.text:
We've had Smith & Sons out a few times, and the initial repairs have been prompt and a decent price, but all the repairs seem to have recurring issues.  Toilets with wax rings that fail just a month after warranty.  Our latest repair from August 2025 for Quarter Angle turns failed and once again they were ready to charge as we were out of warranty.

We contracted a plumber today to take a look at the repair and he reported they had used the original compression fitting, replacing only the valve component.  In the process they had cracked the compression nut and it was slowly weeping behind the valve. We did not notice as we hardly use that bathroom.

The warranties are too short with S&S, and the onus is put on the homeowner to make sure the work is done right.  This seems like a clear defective install (why was the compression fitting not also replaced?) and not a "wear and tear" problem.

reviews.author: Scott Jaklin
reviews.text: Ryan & Kevin installed my hot water heater today.  Very professional service when other contractors promised me same-day service and could not come through.  Kenosha Plumbing came through and got the job done for me!  We were without hot water since Thursday.  Thanks again guys!

reviews.author: Renee D. Murphy-Hughes
reviews.text:
Kenosha Plumbing was recommended to me by my nextdoor neighbor who used them 1 month ago when their sump pump flooded their entire furnished basement.

Pete, the plumber that came to our house to fix/replace burst pipes was more than excellent. The company scheduled an appointment for us on Monday when called on Sunday when they were actually closed. He had it all fixed in just a couple of hours! He explained everything in detail to us & advised us of other things that should be eventually replaced when we can afford to. The heating company that replaced our water heater & furance 5 yrs ago used CSST on the gas lines  (not up to code in WI) and they should have used hardpipe black iron specifically for gas. We would have never known that!

He gave us time to check all the faucets, toilets & showers to make sure the lines cleared out and we had full water pressure. When flushing the main toilet there was a gush of water that came out. The prior plumming company had pulled the water line to the toilet out, which they did not have to do & so all the water flushing burst out. Pete corrected that as well by moving the line back to the wall & put it together so the toilet could flush normally without dumping water on the floor! He was here over 2 hrs (including not charged for time to dump the big water buckets we had brought over when we didn't have water, since we are disabled and cannot lift anything over 8-10 lbs.

The work was totally up to par, the leak fixed without having to break into our new surround shower we had installed for my safety.

His disposition was kind, mild and honest. Many companies take advantage of seniors and charge more for things not needed or do shabby workmanship. We have unfortunately come across many & then have had to pay other companies to get the proper fixes that should have been done in the first place.

Kenosha Plumbing's charge was extremely reasonable and $500 less than the original plumbers who left without fixing the 2nd leak!

They even referred me to the company "Attention to Detail" to have proper insulation and repair work done to put back the drywall removed for access to the pipes.
I have not yet used them but will call for a free estimate shortly this week.

With total confidence I highly recommend that anyone needing plumbing work done go to Kenosha Plumbing to have their issues corrected. Free estimates too. Local Business with pride, skill, honesty and affordability!

reviews.text: I had a ceiling leak that I was really worried about, and Kenosha Plumbing was absolutely fantastic from start to finish. plumbers.name: Clover Contracting: Plumbing, HVAC & Air Purification
plumbers.address: 44679 Endicott Dr Suite 300, Ashburn, VA 20147, USA

reviews.author: Zach
reviews.text:
We received quotes from a lot of HVAC companies and ultimately used Clover. Ryan did an awesome job at helping us figure out the issue with our Furnace - blower motor and inducer was bad. Since the unit was so old (20 years old) we went ahead and replaced that. We noticed major corrosion on our water heater and I asked them about fixing the dryer exhaust pipes in the wall because somehow that was crushed.

Long story short we replaced the furnace, water heater and they fixed the damaged dryer exhaust pipe in the wall. They even replaced/fixed all the old gas and water pipes hooking up to the furnace/water heater.

They did an awesome job. We added on some extras like the Honeywell air filtration system and the extra home air purifier with a humidifier for the home. This has helped tremendously with allergies, and dry nose during the winter.

I only have the “after photos” but compared to before it looks 100% better, our furnace works great now. The piping system is still complicated but they made it way better than before.

Also want to say thanks for the muffins.

reviews.author: Andrew Potocko
reviews.text:
I called 6 different businesses in my area for quotes to have my broken and leaking water heater replaced. Clover hands down had the best value AND the best customer service experience! I was blown away!

While most companies charge for a quote or require a technician visit, Clover offered me a free, no-hassle quote over the phone by simply sending a few pictures (which they offer for certain services). I initially spoke with Lizzie on the phone who helped me get the process started. She was extremely helpful, understanding, and responsive with my primary call and follow up questions. She also walked me through their many guarantees and signature service benefits.

After choosing Clover, they were able to schedule me for next day service to quickly have my water heater replaced. The service technicians (Austin and Ricky) were incredibly professional and walked me through everything they were doing. They are clearly knowledgeable and highly trained in their craft and we’re well equipped to answer any questions I had.

I highly recommend Clover and will plan on using their services again if needed!

reviews.author: Marcus Singleton
reviews.text: I hired Clover Contracting for some plumbing work at my home, and overall, I had a very positive experience. The plumber arrived on time, quickly identified the issue, and explained the repair process in simple terms. They fixed a leaky pipe and also checked the water heater to ensure everything was running smoothly. The service was professional, and the pricing felt fair for the quality of work. The only reason I didn’t give a full 5 stars is because the cleanup could have been a bit more thorough, but I’d definitely call them again.

reviews.author: Shivasish Sindiri
reviews.text:
On Jan 16th I called CLOVER HVAC service because my HVAC was shutting down and home wasn't heating. They sent two technicians to home in short time. They observed the code 31 or 13 flashing on the carrier HVAC and told me it’s the pressure switch that is faulty. Since they claimed they were licensed and experienced technician I trusted them and paid $478 in total ( $99 for the visit  + $379 advance payment o replace the pressure switch for next visit ). After they left, the HVAC system was working, blowing hot air but doesn't take break when indoor temperature reaches thermostat set temperature. (This is quite dangerous for multitude of reasons). It was like furnace inside the home. I called them to visit home and check. They suggested, I should attempt to fix while they instruct me how to do it on phone. WHAT A WORST IDEA. JUST to keep my property safe I attempted it with lot of hesitation and fear of the furnace. Then I see the furnace started accumulating water quite close to the electric/mother circuit board. I was scared because its basic electrical 101, water with active current is a worst scene. They came back on the same evening and fixed it. I was really unsatisfied & frustrated and called their office and ASKED THEM "PLEASE CANCEL MY NEXT SERVICE OF REPLACING THE PRESSURE SWITCH" because of their inexperience and the mess. They told me that they will refund that day visit cost $99 and will send a senior technician to do "FULL SYSTEM DIAGNOSTIC CHECK AND IF AT ALL NECESSARY, THEY WILL REPLACE THE SWITCH". I didn't like the idea but I finally agreed after they repeatedly declining to cancel the next appointment with them. Then the senior tech came and couldn't really pinned down the issue and replaces the pressure switch without concrete evidence. The HVAC ran fine for 4 days and on fifth day it started flashing the same error code 31 or 13 . I called them and they sent same senior tech again as soon as they could. At this visit he claimed he did what he should have done in his earlier visits . i.e HVAC 101. ANY LICENSING SCHOOL WOULD TEACH THIS, WHENEVER HVAC FLASHING PRESSURE SWITCH CODE YOU SHOULD
1) OPEN THE BLOWER FAN, CHECK FOR ANY CLOGS, DEBRIS AND CONDENSATE LIQUID? THEY DIDN'T DO THIS. NOT EVEN TOUCHED IT.
2) CHECK EXHAUST, INTAKE AND DRAIN PIPES TO CHECK FOR ANY CLOGS. THEY DID EXAMINE THIS.
3) CHECK THE ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS FOR ANY ISSUE. THEY TESTED THIS.
WHY DIDN’T YOU CHECK THE BLOWER FAN?? WAS IT TOO SIMPLE AND DOESN’T COST MUCH TO CUSTOMER?

The HVAC stopped working again for the second time and this time knew I will be a total fool if I call them because $379 + three CLOVER technicians + four visits couldn't fix it . Either they knew what was the problem and they choose not to operate and scam me by replacing a well-functioning part or they don’t know above point (1).  By looking at the below attached pictures and not doing HVAC 101 point (1), you might be convinced the first case is likely true. i.e they wanted to do something which would bring more money and not doing simple cleaning which could have done during their first visit for just $99.
After waiting for two cold nights a  genuine technician came and said there is nothing wrong with old pressure switch (he tested it by replacing it) or another component. AND just the ducts and pipes needed further cleaning. IT has been a couple days it’s working.

I called them for a refund since they claim "MONEY BACK GUARANTEE” if their service was unsatisfactory. SINCE YOU COULD FIX THE PROBLEM AND DIDN’T DO THE BASIC CHECK IN YOUR FIRST VISIT YOU SHULD REFUND. They tell me, they already gave $99 discount and cannot offer any further discount. I WANT TO REMIND; YOU GAVE ME $99 BECAUSE YOU PUT MY WHOLE HVAC AT RISK BECAUSE OF THE WATER LEAKING FROM THE EXHAUST PIEPE. IT WAS YOUR FAULT. YOU DIDN’T DO A FAVOUR TO ME. Now I am asking for refund because even after four visits and charging me $379 you couldn't fix the issue AND REPLACED A WELL FUNCTIONING PART WHICH WAS TOTAL UNNECESSARY.
You break my confidence and trust.

reviews.author: Jacquie Burian
reviews.text: Clover Services was one of very few responses I received (and were extremely quick) to respond to my request for an estimate to repair (but most likely replace) my elderly father's old boiler system from the 1970's. They arranged for one of their best technicians to evaluate the system as soon as possible and he spent a lot of time analyzing how best to replace and dispose of the the old system.  Their prices were competitive and the total amount was exactly what we expected it would cost to replace.  The company went above and beyond to get the equipment ordered and installed as quickly as possible so my father would have heat in time for the cold weather. This was not an easy job and not one that many companies wanted to attempt - but Clover Services, Ryan and all of their technicians took this job without hesitation and worked hard for two days to get it done. Ryan, the lead tech, was extremely professional, communicative and friendly (as was Wendy in the office) and they both made sure I understood the estimate, the timeline and all that the job entailed. They also treated my father and his home with dignity and respect. They did a fantastic job and I wouldn't hesitate to hire them again!

reviews.author: Luis Torres
reviews.text: Called up Vera Plumbing on Sunday afternoon for a clogged bathroom sink. I was able to schedule an appointment for Monday at 11 am the next day. It was beyond a regular taking apart of the P trap. The trap had to be opened and snaked into the shoot that travels below the house. It was filled with hair and oil.  I work 6-7 days a week so I dont have that kind of time to fiddle around on my only day off. Andrew the plumber was awesome. He came in and knocked it out in 30 minutes. He also helped me out to replace an old faucet. Left the sink looking like new! You get what you pay for, although not cheap, their plumber is professional and very skilled. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Joseph Hoscheid Jr.
reviews.text: Diego came out to install a faucet for me and was very helpful and professional. Fair and upfront prices before work started. reviews.author: Trushar Patel
reviews.text: I am a member of PHACE Club at Expert Plumbing which is worth it for the inspections and the service discount.  When I have issues, this team always takes care of the problem quickly.  The experts they send are always courteous and knowledgable, explaining the issue to me and also recommending other items that could be of value/service to me.  Today Jim and one of his colleagues came to fix a rusted out valve on my water meter, and replaced the angle stop on one of my toilets.  The team at Expert Plumbing coordinated w/ the city of Naperville to shut my water off.  Naperville arrived on time, and Expert was there early to set up.  Everything went off w/o issues, Jim and his colleague completed the work quickly, and everything looks and works great.  Thanks for the help, the leaky valve was driving me crazy.

reviews.author: Margaret Hahn

reviews.text: Professional. Analyze before jumping in. Went above and beyond, emergency service. Highly recommend. Also, years ago, installed a huge 100 gallon hot water heater - a size not everyone would handle.

reviews.author: Edwin George

Jim and William definitely put the expert in Expert Plumbing.

reviews.text: Drew from Premier Plumbing came out to fix the gas line interfering with my new range installation. He was punctual, very pleasant to work with, and did quality work. Happy to report I can now successfully open the dishwasher without also having to open the oven door!

reviews.author: John Ballinger

reviews.author: Renee Laclaire
reviews.text: Do not look any further than this company... they are absolutely AMAZING!!! Its been cold, our furnace went out and every place we called either couldnt fit us in for literally over another month or more plus on top of that some companies had 'attitudes' like we were a 'bother' but not Premier. He worked us in the very next day... next day, 2 young men came out after an already very long day for them but they still had huge smiles and great attitudes! They were friendly and very patient with our questions and explaining what was wrong, what they were doing and what we could do for ourselves in the future. reviews.author: tina mogavero

It didn't take long for him to diagnose the issue and fix it. So happy I called them. Great company. I highly recommend Drip drop.

reviews.author: Tebe Williams
reviews.text:
Jordan explained everything and was very very thorough.  Figured out an issue that several other plumbers could not.

Showed me how to replace a cartridge myself in the future to save expense as well.

Really happy with the service!

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: I'm astounded that there's still service this good these days.  I woke up to water all over the house and they were there, same day, to resolve the problem.  I felt like I was dealing more with close friends than a service provider.  They were friendly, honest, and I truly felt like they wanted the problem resolved as much as I did.  I can't say enough good things about their incredible customer service and I the price was great.

reviews.author: Jim Settecase
reviews.text:
After 17 years our water heater gave up the ghost. I had a few people in to look at it and give me prices. I had had good experiences with Drip Drop a few times so i called them.   Shaun came over and listened, really listened before spouting his bit.

finally, after i was done talking he patiently discussed my need. I ran some ideas by him, and once again he listened. He was a good listener.   After talking for a while a light went on. You need a tankless water heater?  I do?  yes. I've had one in my own home for 15 Years and never had one problem. I already knew i would not be getting another seventeen years out of any new hot water heater.  his realization to my problem galvanized me into action!

Yes, he was completely right. A tankless heater was exactly what i needed. "And we'll put it right here!" Get your electrician to give me a low voltage outlet right here on this wall.

I got him. Got the outlet. Shaun worked like six men. He got it done in one day, swept up, cleaned up and got his money.

he made it easy for me to get the proper solution for my flooded basement.  But more than that. Shaun was really much more than a plumber. He was a good friend I just hadn't met yet.

it goes without saying he was honest, fair and articulate.
I think he would be successful in whatever he chose for a career. I was just fortunate enough he chose plumbing.

the tankless unit takes a bit longer to get the hot water up to the second floor shower. But it gets there. i have more room in my basement. Now I'm thinking about taking out the chimney and putting in a dance floor. Dances ten cent a piece, open till 12, closed on sundays.  So, yeah. if you want plumbing done right, a a fair price call drip drop. If you want a prince to come do the work tell Karla you want Shaun to come over.

best fishes,

Frankie Chocolate
West Chicago

reviews.author: Josh D'Anna
reviews.text: The team at 24-7 Plumbing really works hard to take care of their customers. Service is always very responsive and staff is friendly and knowledgeable. I recently had a sewer issue at my house and the team was out at the house later that evening to help with the situation. Unfortunately the initial work was not able to clear the line and we needed to dig a new sewer line to connect to the main but the team was in constant communication with progress. Although it was a large job, the team got the work done quickly and I felt well taken care of the entire time. I would highly recommend them if you want a quick response to heating/cooling/plumbing concerns and want to be well taken care of.

reviews.author: Kaitlin Koenig
reviews.text: James (the owner and tech) was great! They were at my house within a few hours after I noticed leaking on Sunday night. I wanted to see if my warranty company would cover anything, so I didn't proceed with the services at that time. After the warranty company tech was unable to clear the main line clog, I called them back. James came to the rescue after hours and was able to fix the issue in 1 hour. After I didn't have running water for 3 days, I was so relieved. James was friendly, knowledgeable, and answered all of my questions. I would definitely recommend this company!

reviews.author: Owen Groves
reviews.text: Incredible experience with Clint and 24-7 plumbing! On the first day we'd owned our new home we found a leak coming from the second floor. 24-7 was quick to dispatch even though it was late in the evening, and Clint was quick to find and fix our problem with faulty washing machine hookups. He recommended a long term fix and was able to come back out to make the final repair. They were very reasonable priced (even for an emergency after-hours visit) and the whole process was extremely professional. Highly recommend 24-7!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Curley
reviews.text:
I highly recommend using 24-7!! My water heater started leaking in the middle of the night. Brandon answered my call and came out right away to help drain the tank and sent someone out first thing in the morning to install a new one. They were very professional and did a great job. I can’t thank them enough for the quick response and great service.

I have used 24/7 for multiple jobs over the past year and they have provided exceptional service each time. Both Juan and Aaron have been out to help me and they are incredibly knowledgeable, informative and easy to work with. This is the place to call if you need any type of plumbing work done.

plumbers.name: Prestige Plumbing, Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 11 John St Ste A, North Aurora, IL 60542, USA

reviews.author: Crystal Smith
reviews.text:
We had great service today from Mark C.  We woke up the first day in our new home to find that our water heater was not working properly.  We weren't expecting we could find someone to install a new one on the weekend but Prestige had great reviews and weekend hours.  Mark answered right away this morning, let us know of their promotions and said he could be there by early afternoon.
He was prompt and had everything needed to complete the job. He explained in detail what he needed to do to complete the job detailing the expenses.  He also inspected our dryer gas line (we're having a new dryer delivered Monday) and repaired it as well.  We were extremely pleased with his service.  Just an awesome job and by 5 pm he was finished, everything was cleaned up and upgraded for safety.
I would recommend him and Prestige Plumbing without hesitation.  We are so thankful he was able to come out on the weekend!  Thanks, Mark!

reviews.author: James Wodka
reviews.text:
I worked with Mark C. on my water heater. Mark was very professional and cordial both over the phone and while he was out here doing the work. They were able to get it back up and running almost immediately. I will definitely use Prestige again.

EDIT:
A few days after initially repairing the water heater, I couldn't get the heater lit, again. After fiddling with the igniter I could to get it lit, albeit briefly, so that I had enough hot water to shower. I called Prestige and left a message to have someone call me to walk me through opening the new, redesigned front plate so I could attempt to clean the inside. This was on 1/7. I didn't get a call back on 1/8. I called again and left messages on 1/9 and 1/13, with no return calls either time. By the evening of 1/13 my water heater was no longer working at all. I have had the water heater replaced, and because of this poor customer service I went with another company. That's $1,300 that could've been Prestige's if they took the time to make a single phone call.

reviews.author: Steve Wittenborn
reviews.text: Five years ago Prestige installed 2 water heaters in my home.  Today, one of them wasn’t able to keep the pilot going.   Called Prestige, they came out, fixed it in 30 minutes.  Parts still under warranty and was only charged a minimal fee for labor.   Courteous, fast, knowledgeable work.  Very happy.

reviews.author: Vijay Shah
reviews.text: Was not impressed. Father & Son came to my home within a few hours of my call for service on my water heater.  They arrived at the time they said and they called when they were on their way. Took a very quick look at my water heaters and although they got one pilot on, they swiftly decided I needed new heaters.  Quoted me over $3500 which I felt was too high.  They charged me $135 for coming out and lighting the one pilot. They could not get my second heater pilot on.  I immediately called another service company who arrived to my house within 1 hour and told me he could replace them for $2300 (the specs of the heaters and the install were the same, trust me, I went over the details).  This service guy from the other company was able to easily ignite the heater that Prestige could not.  When I asked the second service company what I owed him for coming out and getting this pilot on, he told me...NOTHING, call me when you need to replace them, but for now you're good"........My opinion of Prestige is that they are probably good at what they do, but you will likely overpay or worse get ripped off

reviews.author: Eva Balek
reviews.text: Your service is way above the other plumbing, heating and cooling services.  I have been a customer for the past 20 years and have never had a complaint.  Today was yet another time when I needed your immediate help and there you were within the hour.  Your work is always neat and efficient but what I appreciate the most is the quality of work in every job no matter how small.  Thank you for always being there.  This time I am enjoying my new and cutting edge hot water heater.

plumbers.name: Water Tight Plumbing & Sewer
plumbers.address: 2004 Horizon Ct, Zion, IL 60099, USA

reviews.author: Marcus Bernardy
reviews.text: I have spent YEARS looking for a reliable and trustworthy plumber in Lake County. My search has FINALLY come to an end! I had some water damage from a bad water heater and some valves that needed to be brought up to code. Steve was extremely professional, forthcoming and up front! On the day of the work, everyone arrived on time and were extremely polite throughout. New parts were priced and recommended to me before any work was authorized. Pricing at the end matched what was quoted to me over the phone, and all at a very competitive price! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ray Clark
reviews.text: I called up in a panic because a sump pump alarm was going off.  They walked me through a few steps I could check and see if I could resolve the problem without a need for a service call - they got me back up and running.  Long story short, I don't know of many companies nowadays that take the time to give you a hand rather than just come out and charge you.  This is exceptional.  I would recommend them to anyone needing plumbing service - I will be calling them the next time I have a need and recommending them to my neighbors and friends.

reviews.author: Allison GN
reviews.text: We had a toilet issue and Steve and the crew came out right away. They were able to assess the situation and take care of the problem so quickly. I was so impressed with the guys how professional they were. The new toilet is beautiful. Great job! Definitely will call you again!

reviews.author: Audrey Nannenga
reviews.text: I called Water Tight Plumbing & Sewer after finding gas leaks in our pipes to the water heater and dryer. (Who knew you needed a plumber for a gas leak? Not me.) I called Steve, the Owner, who had his guys to my house within the hour. Bill and Chris made all the repairs in a timely fashion. And came back the same day at no charge after the gas company turned the gas back on to make sure everything was good. They took great care of me and my house! Thank you Water Tight Plumbing & Sewer!

reviews.author: Jonathan Eisner
reviews.text: Outstanding service from start to finish! The team at Water Tight Plumbing did an incredible job. Their workmanship was truly exemplary, and it was clear they take immense pride in what they do. They were professional, knowledgeable, and left the work area spotless. I've found my go-to plumber for any future needs. I highly recommend them—they deserve every one of these five stars!

plumbers.address: 417 S Arlington Heights Rd Suite 100, Arlington Heights, IL 60005, USA

reviews.author: Jane Hamidi
reviews.text:
Geoff is the best plumbing technician out there. Great communicator and very knowledgeable about all aspects of plumbing. He was able to turn the water back on using the 1.5 water key. Previously the Chicago department of water refused to come out to turn the water back on.
I highly recommend Geoff to anyone who needs professional and reliable plumbing technician.

reviews.author: Osmalyn Walton
reviews.text: Jose Guerra was back in our home installing a water heater, and refitting new pipes in order to bring up to code. Once again truly satisfied customers we are. Jose is a true professional. He made sure to answer all our questions. Took his time to explain product, and made sure we were truly satisfied customers. Should we have any additional concerns he made sure to let us Know Rocket, and the company will be there to answer them and put our minds at ease. He’s the best of the best.

reviews.author: L Y
reviews.text: This is my third time working w/ Luis. I really love that Rocket has the same person come out to you. It's like building a relationship with your barber. They get to know you, they know your house, they  know what your preferences are and what questions you may have--or maybe it's just Luis and he's a very thorough guy. I don't know. I hope I never have to find out. Before he goes Luis tells me exactly what I should to do upkeep the system to prevent future problems. I've never had a problem or had to call him back after he's finished with the work. Never have had to redeem a warranty on anything he's installed. It's the way our nation was built: by vocational programs and blue collared hands. Solid. Predictable.

reviews.author: Stephanie D
reviews.text:
I noticed some water damage on the ceiling below my upstairs bathroom.. I started my search online for a new plumber and chose rocket plumbing because of all the positive reviews I was seeing- the reviews aren’t wrong.

I called in the late afternoon, the receptionist was very kind, helpful, and she was able to send a plumber out the next morning. The plumber, Geoffrey was professional, knowledgeable and patient (I had probably a million questions throughout the whole process since I was communicating the situation with my husband over text, he is the one who typically takes care of these things).

He very quickly identified the leak and to my surprise when i asked if it was a possibility to fix the issue the same day he said yes, and only left to go get the new toilet/replacement parts that we ended up having replaced- he did offer us multiple options to fix the issue at very different price points which was fantastic. And has extremely clear communication with every decision that needed to be made.

Unfortunately after he removed the old toilet he found how badly damaged some of the old plumbing in the floor was, and it became a much larger job than originally anticipated (due to a very poorly done repair in the past by a different plumber/company)Geoffrey still made the commitment to have the work finished the same day and spent most the day seeing this through while still keeping the cost very reasonable.

he even vacuumed, swept, and removed any trash/debris from the job when he was finished. And left contact information for a carpenter (to repair the damaged ceiling) and a restoration company to come look at any potential mold issues from the leak.

My husband and I are very pleased with the work that was done, and will definitely be using Rocket plumbing in the future.

reviews.author: Kevin McGurn
reviews.text: From booking through Vicky, to service by Trevor, Jo-el and Hugo, everyone was great on my line jetting and basin drain. Hard working, good communication no BS or upselling. Line trouble identified and will work with them and the city to rectify it. A pleasant surprise to find Rocket Plumbing.

They provided a balanced comparison of various units, helping me make an informed decision based on long-term value. Exceptional service and technical authority.

reviews.author: Candice C

reviews.text: Nick was very professional and explained what was going on with my hot  water heater thoroughly.  I would definitely request him next time I need services! A+ Sevice!

May I add this was while arriving at the subdivision/location of his service call. I know who I won’t be calling or recommending. I can’t imagine this person coming into my home.

reviews.text: Highly recommend Adam, and his fine crew, at Fast Drains Plumbing.  They are fully insured, reliable, and very reasonably priced. Work to replace my entire exterior water line was done quickly, neatly, and precisely completed.   I'll definitely be using Adam's services again whenever I have future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Joe Flores

The whole process went very smoothly. I would recommend. Fast Drains for anyone that needs an affordable, reliable and same day plumbing service.

reviews.author: Brandi Hatch

We couldn’t have asked for a better experience and will definitely use Fast Drains Plumbing again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Joey Schihl

reviews.text: They came out on a Saturday at 10pm and were amazing, good prices, very friendly, fast paced. We had water back to our house within 15mins. I highly recommend

reviews.author: Ariel
reviews.text: I had these guys do a simple water heater install to replace my previous one that lasted at least 20 years and it lasted 2.5 years. They used flex metal inlet and outlet connectors (that I think is what failed) vs copper lines, put on a thermal expansion tank that wasn't in the most stable position and when I called them to replace it they wanted to charge me $1,000 plus more for shut off valves and thermal expansion tank replacement etc.... AND they would not give me ANY warranty on their labor.  Well, I can tell you I went with Bernie's Plumbing, got a year labor warranty, got all the bells and whistles - copper inlet and outlet pipes, thermal expansion tank, 2 shut off valves and the best service ever for $850 total.  How dare you mess with customers like that.

reviews.author: Teresa Miner
reviews.text: Colorado Green Plumbing is an exceptional choice for all your plumbing needs. From the moment I called to get quotes, the entire process was incredibly smooth, swift, and spotless. Even before I made the payment, they offered me a discount for paying with a check, which was a delightful surprise. I thoroughly enjoyed working with this company and will definitely be returning for any future plumbing requirements!

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.text: We've used CO Green a few times for our HVAC and a toilet issue. Everytime CO Green techs are great--kind, smart, and willing to explain the issue and fix, and Guy in particular is above and beyond with customer service. Y'all are the best!

reviews.author: Victoria G
reviews.text:

Their staff was incredibly friendly and professional…. A huge thank you specifically to Paul and Nate for the stellar service you provided.

reviews.author: Cindy Bingham

reviews.author: Jimoh Braimoh
reviews.text: Cedar Park Plumbing was fantastic! They showed up on time, were super friendly, and explained everything clearly. The job was done quickly and at a fair price, and they left everything neat and clean. I really appreciate how easy they made the whole process. Highly recommend!

He kept me informed through every step in the process. I highly recommend Cedar Park Plumbing and Josh for any plumbing work needed.

reviews.text: Josh was wonderful! After four plumbers/HVAC specialists came out to tried to swindler me, Josh was honest, caring, and took the time to listen about the issue, and fixed the problem. reviews.author: Nursel Koigeldieva
reviews.text:
I’m very satisfied with the service from JetPipe. Nick fixed the problem quickly and professionally. He was efficient, knowledgeable, and handled everything with great care.
Thank you for the excellent service. I highly recommend JetPipe and Nick to anyone looking for a reliable plumber.

reviews.author: J J

This is our first time working with Jet-PIpe.

We were lucky to find Stefan with his great crew to fix our bursted main water pipe, which was fully replaced with whole new copper pipes below the ground and finish it nice and clean!

Thanks to all three of you, now we have nice and fresh pipes for water again.

Much appreciated

Owesome!!!

reviews.author: eric h
reviews.text:
I recently hired JetPipe for a full sewage line replacement, and I couldn't be more satisfied with the experience. From start to finish, the team was professional, efficient, and incredibly informative. Stephane, the owner, was responsive and transparent throughout the process, making sure I understood every step. Although the city permit took a little longer than expected due to the city staff being busy, JetPipe stayed on top of the process and kept me informed throughout. Once the permit was approved, they completed the job on time and with great care. On top of all that, the price was very reasonable for the quality of work and service provided. I highly recommend JetPipe to anyone in need of reliable, high-quality plumbing work!

reviews.author: Tom L
reviews.text: Our garbage disposal broke so we called up a few plumbers and JetPipe was the quickest response we got.  Nick was the plumber that arrived, he assessed the work needed, purchase similar GD unit for us and fixed it all within 2 hours.  Great work!

plumbers.address: 1575 US-411 Suite 206, Cartersville, GA 30121, USA

reviews.author: Tanya Zeman
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Rapid Plumbing. I reached out regarding leaks in our kitchen ceiling, and they were able to come out promptly to inspect the issue and provide an estimate for the repairs. Our technician, Ryne, quickly identified that the leaks were coming from the roof and fixed the issue with our plumbing inside as well.

He was punctual, respectful, and polite, and did an excellent job preparing the work area and cleaning up once everything was finished. The repairs were completed thoroughly, and we were very pleased with the results. I would highly recommend Rapid Plumbing for any plumbing needs and will definitely use them again in the future.

reviews.author: Madison Collins
reviews.text:

Super friendly. Explained all my options. Provided clear quotes. All around great experience.

reviews.author: Wayne Hobdy
reviews.text: Expect ON TIME, competent, and courteous service from Rapid Plumbing. I’m so glad my technician Ryne came, I was unsure what to expect, but I feel confident that he could quickly diagnose my garbage disposal problem. He did better than that, he put my mind at ease, and put into action a quick fix, and saved me money in the process - and I so appreciate that.  If you’re lucky enough to get Ryne, I highly recommend Rapid Plumbing for no stress same day repairs.

reviews.author: Ryan Weldon
reviews.text: Rapid plumbing is correct!  I called them on a Saturday and they came out the next day (Sunday).  They gave me a window of time they could come out and came at the beginning of the window with a call prior to make sure I was ready.  The service crew, Rayne and another, were clear about the issue and made sure I knew the price prior to fixing the problem.  They have me up and running for a busy Monday in my office.  Thank you!

reviews.author: Taylor Norton
reviews.text: I am extremely pleased with the Amazing work that was provided. Wonderful customer service. Great price. Very friendly. And made everything look great. We changed from an older model tub set. due to a leak in the old valve and the manufacturer also doesn't make anymore. To a more modern up to date up code shower set. This Makes my shower look so much better and he did a great job on the clean up.

plumbers.name: PlumbPro Plumbing, Heating & Cooling
