plumbers.name: Accurate Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7595 Fishel Dr S, Dublin, OH 43016, USA

reviews.author: Elizabeth Martinez
reviews.text: Excellent service. They answered the moment I called and checked what the problem was with the leak in my house. They identified the problem instantly, answered all my questions immediately, and gave me two different solutions. Besides, they took care of arranging the permits and inspections required for the drain damage and water leak, and they left my house looking like nothing had happened. Thanks to everyone, to Vicente and all the guys.

reviews.author: Tom Borowski
reviews.text: Mike and his team at Accurate Plumbing do an exceptional job of diagnosing plumbing problems and fixing them efficiently. They are very professional, knowledgeable and ethical. In addition, their service is very reasonably priced. I was very impressed with Joe who was recently at our house to fix a difficult bathroom leak. Not only did he identify the issue but he did a great job in fixing it and gave me some excellent suggestions for insuring less problems in the future. This is a great company!

reviews.author: Johnny Durand
reviews.text:
Great experience with Accurate Plumbing. Kameron was quick, friendly, and knowledgeable. He noticed our sump pump wasn’t working, which could’ve turned into a big problem.

He had a new sump pump installed in under 30 minutes and also checked our low water pressure and gave some helpful recommendations. Very professional company. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Josh Funk
reviews.text: Accurate Plumbing will be my new go to for all my plumbing issues. They were super thorough and addressed an issue that multiple other plumbing companies failed to catch. The staff was friendly and on time and again I cannot under emphasize how thorough they were. If the other companies were even half as thorough I wouldn't have to be redoing the drywall in my dining room for the second time.

reviews.author: B LG
reviews.text: Was incredibly impressed with the professionalism from these plumbers.  Kameron came to re-install a toilet that a prior plumber had installed to a rusted flange (which then failed within the year).  He was precise with the original quote and charged an incredibly reasonable price.  Referred them to my best friend and she had them out a couple days later to fix her toilet and clear some drains.  I would highly recommend this company.

plumbers.name: 1st Choice Plumbing, Flood & Restoration
plumbers.address: 4083 Oceanside Blvd Suite K, Oceanside, CA 92056, USA

reviews.author: Eric Dickens
reviews.text: First I’d like to start out by saying that 1st choice plumbing is Awesome! Everyone is very respectful and very good at what they do! I’ve had a hot water heater installed, a whole A/C and furnace put in and as of lately they did a complete bathroom remodel because I had a shower pan leak from the previous owners trying to DIY the downstairs bathroom and didn’t hot mop it. First choice took care of everything including setting up and scheduling all subcontractors. They were able to work around my schedule and always showed the upmost respect when working at the house. First choice is always looking out for your best interest. They are able to figure out the problem and work with the customer on figuring out the best solution! The expertise and superb customer service you get from First choice is top notch. I will always use and recommend them for any plumbing , heating/Air, and flood & restoration needs! Thank you first choice for being #1 at all you do!!

reviews.author: Jenielle
reviews.text: 1st Choice Plumbing came to help us twice now for pipe leak. The last time they came, it was pouring rain. Matt and his team drove all the way down from Oceanside to South Bay  regardless of the weather to get the pipe leak fixed. We had to get our kitchen restored. It took months for the insurance to resolve the issue. Matt stayed true to his word and helped us get our kitchen back. He had different team of experts from painting, cabinetry, and countertops. They were always on-time, very professional and hard working. They were even ahead of schedule. You could tell that they really took pride of their work-they were detailed oriented just like me! It shows! They care about their customers as if we’re part of their family. They’ve been in business for 18 years! I HIGHLY recommend 1st Choice Plumbing!!! Thank you Matt and team!!!! We are beyond grateful and happy with your work!

reviews.author: Alex Heinz
reviews.text:
I was referred to 1st Choice Plumbing through a friend and I couldn't be more impressed with their professionalism, expertise, and overall quality of service.

From start to finish, 1st Choice Plumbing exceeded my expectations in every way. When I initially contacted them about my plumbing needs, I spoke with Michael who was incredibly knowledgeable and helpful. He took the time to listen to my concerns, explain the various options available to me, and ultimately helped me decide on the best course of action for my home.

When the team arrived to do the work, they were punctual, courteous, and very respectful of my property. I truly appreciated how they took the time to walk me through the process, answering any questions I had and making sure I understood exactly what was being done.

The quality of their work was exceptional, and it's clear that they take great pride in their craft. They installed new plumbing in my master bathroom, laundry room, and main line, and the difference is truly remarkable.

Overall, I cannot recommend 1st Choice Plumbing enough. They are truly experts in their field, and their kindness, professionalism, and attention to detail set them apart. Thank you again 1st Choice, I'm sure I'll be calling you soon for the guest bathroom remodel!

reviews.author: Arash Fotouhi
reviews.text:
1st Choice Plumbing re-piped the entire house for me prior to moving in and they did a great job. They were quick to come to the property and provide an estimate and they started work the day after closing. The job was done sooner that I expected even though it was around the Thanksgiving holidays and the cost was exactly the amount they quoted me in the estimate. I would come by the property every day and I could see that the quality of their work was outstanding. When the work was done, I had brand new PEX pipes through the entire house (with copper pipes within a foot of the outlet connectors), brand new shower heads and faucets, a brand new regulator, new laundry connectors, new icemaker, etc, and they also installed new pipes from the city main to the garage. At the end, the dry wall and matching paint looked immaculate and they put back all the dirt they had dug in the front lawn (to get to the pipes) and they put back the grass and everything looks exactly like it was before. They also recommended I replace my really old water heater and they gave me a great price on the labor and parts. The plumbing job passed all inspections and we quickly got a permit from the city.
In addition to the quality of their work, Michael and Matthew are great people and a joy to work with. I'm glad I have met them and I will be calling them in the future for any plumbing and gas pipe issues. They are very knowledgeable and explain everything clearly and they are super nice, friendly, honest, and reliable.
I highly recommend 1st Choice Plumbing.

reviews.author: John H
reviews.text: I have used First Choice Plumbing for two complete home renovation projects and most recently to install a whole house filtration system. Mike has done his work with great professionalism and care. I will continue to use FCP for all my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Lynn Lorenson
reviews.text: Thank you Quandt Plumbing for saving Christmas! We had a drain plug two days before Christmas Eve dinner,  Quandt made time to come out, were right on time and fixed the problem.   The repair man was also very nice!

reviews.author: hdrk88ci
reviews.text: In may Quandt came out to do the plumbing work for a bathroom remodel.  Most things went well but after they reinstalled the toilet within a couple days performance was substantially degraded.  I did my due diligence as the home owner trying to figure it out with no success.  I lived with it for 2/3 months hoping it would resolve itself but it became challenging.  I then contact Quandt and they were quick to deny responsibility without even taking a look at it.  It was an existing toilet which is about a year old.  If I would have known of their policy to do the work and deny responsibility on workmanship due to it being an exiting fixture that when reinstalled has significant performance problems I would have went another direction.  The rest of the project I am happy with along with their communication and timing with other contractors.  I mean if you have to charge a little more to make sure something was configured correctly and work is warrantied then do it.

reviews.author: shane skifstad
reviews.text:
From my experience they don't do good business!!!

I know what the home warranty states yes I pay the first hundred. But when u come in for 5 min and say u need ur septic pumped and that's it and still charge 100 dollars for that to me that's bad business.
And just to let u know that wasn't the problem the pipe was clogged so that tells me ur company isn't really that good at plumbing

reviews.author: oE Chewie
reviews.text:
TLDNR: If there was a 6th star, they've earned it. You call professionals for a reason and Quandt Plumbing is as good as you'll ever get.

Needless to say, Quandt came out because I had a clogged sewer that Roto-Rooter was unable to fix (filled with gravel). The issue came down to needing to replace my main sewer line from inside to outside my house. After finding out that I hadn't been able to flush a toilet for the last 5 days, Quandt contacted and coordinated with Wally Schmid Excavating and came out the next morning. In a matter of 7 hours, Quandt removed part of the concrete slab, using hand tools, dug a hole 6ft deep to the broken sewer line, and drilled a hole through the concrete wall. They ran a new sewer line out of my house, filled the hole back in, and replaced the concrete that was removed. They did all of this without causing any damage and left no mess! I can't thank Quandt enough for giving my family (wife, 3y old son, 2y old son) back the use of our home. If you need plumbing done, you want Quandt Plumbing to do it.

reviews.author: Chris Haddock

reviews.text: I had to call  after hours for an urgent issue, and I was really impressed with their quick response. Great customer service from start to finish…highly recommend!

reviews.author: Matthew Hallman
reviews.text: I am an association manager in the Williamsburg area. Chris and his crew were phenomenal. They were very responsive, and did not leave until the problem was fixed. We even met with the building owner and explain the situation thoroughly. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: S V
reviews.text:
I recently contacted Stemmle Plumbing of Hampton Roads for leak detection services and was scheduled for a service visit. The plumber, Q, was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain everything clearly. I have no complaints about his service—he did his job well.

However, my issue lies with the dispatch process. When I initially called, I clearly stated that I had already had previous assessments done and that I needed leak detection. The receptionist quoted me $125, and based on what I shared, I was under the impression that this fee was for the actual leak detection service. Instead, when the plumber arrived, I learned that the $125 was just for another assessment—one that ultimately confirmed what I already knew. I was then told that leak detection would be an additional $2,500.

Had the dispatch accurately communicated what I had already explained, this unnecessary visit and charge could have been avoided. Whether this was an oversight or a common practice, I highly recommend that future customers double-check with dispatch to ensure that their request is properly understood and that the pricing quoted aligns with the actual service they need.

Again, I appreciate Q’s professionalism, but I am disappointed with how this was handled on the front end. I hope the company considers refining its intake process to prevent similar issues for future customers.

reviews.author: Natalie Leiberg

reviews.author: Thomas Johnston
reviews.text: Best experience with a plumber to date! Most excellent service and knowledge was top notch. Called for estimate and an appointment was set-up. Very satisfied with and happy with the service provided by Vincent Plumbing & Heating!!

reviews.author: Tom Orlowski
reviews.text: Jeff & his team completed a large project that included replacement of all our old galvanized pipes as well as a number of smaller things. Will not hesitate to work with Vincent Plumbing in the future.

reviews.author: Randy
reviews.text: The service from Vincent Plumbing was excellent! They replied to my request for an estimate right away, along with a lot of helpful insights. The service was done on time and the installation was very clean. I’m a little OCD, so I was pleased to see how neat and tidy their work was. They also left the area spotless. I’ll definitely be using them should I need any other plumbing services in the future. Thank you!

plumbers.name: Clog Heroes Plumbing, Sewer & Drain
plumbers.address: 2706 Lafayette Blvd, Fredericksburg, VA 22408, USA

reviews.author: Victoria Ye
reviews.text:
I was referred to this company through the Stafford Talk Facebook page and I’m really glad I called them. My well has been struggling due to the severe drought in our area, so I needed Stafford County water run from the county meter at the road to my home.

Austin came out while it was still icy, took measurements, and had a quote back to me the same day. He offered a reasonable military discount and very fair pricing. We had received other quotes ranging from $5,000 to $16,000, some missing necessary work and others trying to run copper the entire distance from the road to the house (which would have been extremely expensive). Austin gave a straightforward, honest quote that beat the competition.

There was about a week delay due to snow and permitting, which was understandable and not their fault. Once everything was approved, they completed the job quickly. Communication was great the entire time with clear updates and follow-ups.

What stood out the most was the pride the plumber took in his work under the house. The piping was installed very cleanly and neatly, clearly done with long-term durability in mind.

Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Linda Obis
reviews.text: Clog Hero’s is aptly named! They are my hero’s for sure. Muddy water backed up in my well and my house faucets were running red mud. The professional and knowledgeable folks from this company quickly diagnosed the issue. As a result of all the rain and snow the aquifer feeding my well was compromised. They cleared out my hot water heater and water tank and installed a state of the art water filtration system. Their response to my urgent call was quick and effective. I highly recommend Clog Hero’s and will never use anyone else. I am a completely satisfied customer! Thank you, Jessy and Jared.

reviews.author: Shah Mehrabi
reviews.text: Clog Heroes in Fredericksburg, VA, provided excellent service. We were able to get a quick appointment, and the technician arrived right on time. The staff was very knowledgeable, professional, and familiar with the city of Fredericksburg's codes and the permit process, which gave us additional confidence. They explained the issue clearly and addressed our concerns. So far, everything is working well. Highly recommend their service.

reviews.author: Rachel Killeen
reviews.text: I really appreciate Jared honesty. He took the time to explain the issue and gave me options without any pressure. The work was done perfectly, and everything is running smoothly now. Outstanding service from start to finish. It’s hard to find trustworthy plumbers — I’m so glad I found this one! Truly professional and highly recommended.

reviews.author: Keldin
reviews.text: Clog Heroes installed a new sump pump system at home in Fredericksburg before we got all this snow. I'm so glad I did! In the past I would have been dealing with pulling water out of the crawlspace but not this year. After the snow and ice started melt I went to check the crawlspace and see how the sump pump was working and wow! Crawlspace was dry as a bone. These guys really did an amazing job! From start to finish they were professional, educated me each of the options, and install was super smooth. Thank you Clog Heroes!

Prompt, reliable, communicative, and thorough. I wouldn’t hesitate to use Justin and his team again!

reviews.author: Ivan Borovikov

He stopped by on a Saturday night, accessed the situation and 1st thing Monday had estimates for a new hot water heated and it was installed by mid day on Monday - could not be happier.

reviews.text: Told Plumbing is an honest company! Kelly came out and took a look and told me it was just backed up and he cleaned it out and got it back to working condition.  If i have any other plumbing problems I'm going back to Told! Kelly and Jon are awesome!

reviews.author: Julio César Acosta
reviews.text: Fast and quality service from my initial call to the end of service. Kelly  came to our house today and as scheduled and did a fantastic job. Helping us with the dishwasher, the master shower, the water filter and a toilet. He knew how to solve every issue and was very professional.  Very happy either way the service.

reviews.author: Chad Clayson
reviews.text:
Update!
After my original review told plumbing reached out and apologize and said that it was a training error and they wanted to make things right so they did refund me back to the original amount discussed on the phone. Took a lot for them to do this, which is why I went from one star to three.

Completely dishonest! Scheduled to have them come and jet out the main sewer line. Was given pricing per hour and was told I would have a 15 minute heads up call before they showed up. Came home from work to see them already in front of the house before our scheduled time just standing there and they started working when I showed up. Within 35 minutes, they were done and had left so I thought everything was great. When I got the bill, not only was the hourly price higher than what I was told on the phone, they also charged me for 2 hours plus a loading fee. When I called in they said it’s because the truck gps clocked in for one hour and one minute at our house so we had to pay for a second hour. I told them I have doorbell camera footage of the guys just sitting in front of the house and not even working more than 30 minutes so I’m not paying for that time. After going back-and-forth, she called me back later and said they would only charge for one hour of work but I still had to pay for the guys to load the truck before they came to our house (which I was never quoted or told about) and the higher hourly rate (which they misquoted on the phone). Obviously, they don’t care about being trustworthy or honest, they’re just trying to get as much money for each job as they can. Look elsewhere and don’t trust them, in my opinion.

reviews.author: Shea Conroy
reviews.text: The service at Told Plumbing was great! Everyone that I interacted with was kind and helpful. I recommend them to my friends and neighbors all the time because I was very impressed with their work.

plumbers.name: Chase Brothers Plumbing
plumbers.address: 6329 Dixie Hwy #1150, Fairfield, OH 45014, USA

reviews.author: Bryan Krause
reviews.text: I needed help installing a whole-house water softener and filter that I had already bought myself. After calling around Fairfield, I found that most plumbers only want to put in systems if you buy the unit directly from them. Thankfully, this company was happy to help with just the installation. Their prices were fair—not the lowest in town, but definitely not overpriced either. Talking with them was simple and straightforward; every time I called or left a voicemail, they got back to me quickly, usually within a day. They also gave me a free estimate, while other plumbers in the area wanted to charge just to come out and look. On the day of the job, Dillon arrived right on schedule, got straight to work, and made sure to tidy up everything before leaving, even taking out the old boxes and trash. The final bill matched the estimate exactly, with no surprise charges or extra fees. After the installation, I noticed the overflow connection for the salt tank hadn’t been hooked up. reviews.text: Our kitchen sink backed up and it was a huge headache. We almost got talked into replacing our whole septic system by another plumbing company, who insisted we didn’t have a grease trap. Luckily, we called Chase Brothers Plumbing and spoke with Isaiah. He called us back right away after we explained our situation, and he was surprised to hear what the other company was suggesting. Isaiah assured us that we did have a separate grease trap connected to our kitchen sink, and we definitely didn’t need a new septic tank. That was a big relief since everything else in our home was working fine except for the kitchen sink. Isaiah took the time to explain everything over the phone and was very understanding about the stress we were feeling. Even though his schedule was full, he still managed to come out that same day to help us out. He told us, “I stand by my work and will fix it,” and he really meant it. He got our sink working again, installed two new clean outs, and gave us a warranty on the new pipes. His prices were much better than any other plumber we’ve used before, and he was honest and upfront about everything. We’re an Army family and know the value of trust and reliability—Isaiah fits right in with that. He works hard and often by himself, so sometimes it takes a little patience to get in touch, but it’s definitely worth it. It’s tough to find someone this dependable these days, and we’re completely satisfied with the service. We’ll be sticking with this plumber from now on!

I've seen the glowing reviews for this company, and I get it – they must excel in some areas. But after my recent experience, I won't be giving them my business, and I feel compelled to share why.
I called for a straightforward quote: remove my old, broken water softener, haul it away, and install a brand-new identical model that I had already purchased and was sitting right in my garage. No need for them to supply anything – just labor for the swap. The representative quoted me a jaw-dropping $1,200. I double-checked, emphasizing it was only for the plumber's time and effort, no new unit required. She didn't budge: "That's the price for our plumbers."
Stunned, I shopped around and found another local company that handled the entire job – removal, haul-away, and installation – for just $300. Same quality work, same day, no drama.
This isn't about haggling; it's about transparency and fair pricing. If they're charging four times the going rate for basic labor, that's not customer-friendly – it's exploitative. I'll stick to the honest competitors who value trust over upselling. Proceed with caution if you're calling for a quote!

reviews.author: F Rosario
reviews.text: I recently needed help with my sewer line and was glad I called for professional plumbing services. Kristopher and his crew were fantastic from start to finish. From the first phone call, Kristopher showed real expertise and made sure I understood every step of the process. He patiently answered all my questions and explained how the trenchless sewer lining would work. They used a modern blue light trenchless system, which meant there was no need to dig up my yard or cause any mess. The whole job was done quickly and efficiently, and my property was left just as it was before—no disruption at all. In a place like Colorado, where pipes can freeze and cause trouble, it’s important to have plumbers who really know what they’re doing, and Kristopher’s team did a great job making sure everything was ready for the colder months. What really stood out was Kristopher’s attention to detail and his commitment to customer satisfaction. He kept me updated throughout the entire project and clearly takes pride in his work. The finished result was excellent—my sewer system works perfectly now, and I feel confident that the repairs will last for years to come. Kristopher was friendly, professional, and genuinely cared that I was happy with the job. If you’re looking for trustworthy and skilled plumbers for any sewer or drain issues, I highly recommend reaching out to Kristopher and his team. Their quality of work and dedication to their customers are top-notch.

reviews.author: Eddie Holder
reviews.text: When I found water in my basement coming from the relief valve pipe, I wasn’t sure what was going on or why it was happening. I called Eddie's Plumbing to come check it out and help me fix the problem. Even though I’ve used their plumbing services in Englewood for years, I was still impressed by how quickly they got back to me and scheduled a visit. Kristopher arrived right on time and was very friendly and professional. He immediately figured out what needed to be done and explained that this type of plumbing issue is pretty common and easy to fix, which really helped calm my nerves. He let me know that I hadn’t done anything wrong—it’s just normal wear and tear, like with any appliance. It was raining heavily that day, but Kristopher made sure not to track mud into my home by politely asking to use the basement door. He finished the repair efficiently and took the time to walk me through what he had done, explaining the pipes and their function in simple terms. I’m truly grateful for all the times they have helped me out with plumbing problems. Kristopher is very knowledgeable, and when I mentioned that my sister also uses their services and is always happy, he immediately remembered her and her husband. It’s nice to know they value their loyal customers. I look forward to calling them again for my annual plumbing tune-up in the fall. I highly recommend their reliable and friendly service to anyone in Englewood!

reviews.author: antonio gill
reviews.text: After a slab leak in our home, our insurance suggested we look into a whole house repipe. I reached out to several plumbing companies in Englewood for quotes. A coworker recommended a plumber they had a good impression of during the estimate, even though they didn’t use them for their own job. Out of all the plumbers, the pricing here was the most reasonable. During the walkthrough, Erick was professional and honest—he didn’t try to push any unnecessary plumbing work or upgrades. That made me feel comfortable choosing his team for the job. It took a little time to get on their schedule, but once the work started, everything moved along quickly and efficiently, even when they ran into some unexpected challenges behind the walls. What really stood out was when Erick personally removed a kitchen cabinet to make sure the new pipes had the best possible route, which meant we didn’t end up with any extra holes in the kitchen. After everything passed inspection, the team put the cabinet back and it looked even better than before. The city inspector even commented on how well they insulated all the hot water lines throughout the house, which is important here in Colorado, especially with our colder winters. Erick originally estimated the job would take about a day for the repipe and another day for patching, but mentioned it could be two days each. In the end, it was two days total—still much quicker than many contractors I’ve worked with before. If you need a whole house repipe or other plumbing services in Englewood, I definitely recommend this team for their fair prices, skill, and attention to detail.

reviews.author: Drew Trujillo
reviews.text: the plumbers are always in high demand, but i highly recommend them! i always ask for their service through my home warranty plan. they are honest, reliable, and get the job done right every time. their work is fast and the quality is excellent. recently, i had a stubborn clog in my kitchen sink. another plumbing company sent by the warranty company said the sink was inaccessible and tried to charge almost a thousand dollars to fix it. the technician didn’t even bring proper tools—he didn’t have a drain snake or anything to actually try to clear the clog. i called the plumbers for a second opinion, and they were happy to help. timothy showed up with all the right equipment, quickly took apart the sink pipes, found the clog, and had everything flowing perfectly in about 15 minutes. my sink is working great now! these plumbers are always professional, show up prepared, and really care about getting your plumbing fixed without overcharging. i appreciate their excellent service and would recommend them to anyone looking for a plumber.

reviews.text: Richie came to replace my kitchen sink, disposal, and faucet along with updating the piping from my kitchen to the basement. He'd previously done other work on my house, and I appreciated having him come again because I trust him and knows he does good work. Everything was installed correctly. His work was clean and professional. He made sure I liked how everything turned out, and I do!

reviews.author: Terra Nicole Hansen Franco
reviews.text:
Rickie (or was is Richie) was absolutely fantastic. He was very helpful, kind, and polite, and he communicated clearly with us the entire time. We originally called him out for an issue with our shower, but he also took the time to check our water heater and inspect all the plumbing throughout the house, including the bathroom and kitchen sinks. He kept us informed of any potential issues he noticed along the way.
What really stood out was how well he explained his process. Since the exact issue wasn’t immediately clear, he walked us through the order in which he planned to try different fixes—starting with the least invasive and least expensive options first. He was upfront about the likelihood of needing a more costly repair and made sure to get our approval before moving on to the next step if something didn’t work. We never felt rushed or pressured.
He also made sure we felt satisfied before leaving, was great with our dog, and wore shoe covers to protect our floors, which we really appreciated. Overall, Rochi was extremely professional, friendly, and clearly very capable. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience.

reviews.author: Sandman Marketing
reviews.text:
Eric’s Plumbing is the real deal. I had a nightmare main sewer line issue and got a bunch of quotes—Eric’s was easily the best price, and the quality didn't suffer for it. They drove all the way out to Ogden and just knocked it out.

They even helped me out with a few extra things while they were on-site, which I really appreciated. No stress, no hidden fees, just great work. If you’re looking for someone honest who won't overcharge you, these are your guys.

It’s rare to find contractors who are honest, efficient, and respectful of your time and money. I truly appreciate the professionalism and integrity shown by Tim and the team at Thomas E. Clark Plumbing. I highly recommend supporting this local company.

reviews.text:

Additionally, when they have been out for work or estimates for us, they have also caught legitimate issues that have altered how we want to do things (1. we asked for an estimate for an upstairs laundry and they noted our water supply and sewer drain diameters actually wouldn't allow for it from a code perspective; no other plumber we asked to come out even checked, 2. we had our sump pumps replaced by them and they noted the drainage into the pit was abnormal, scoped our line, and noted a possible crack in our sewer where it met the foundation (this was also verified by other plumbers).

All in all, 5+ stars for Lakeside. Would use them over all of the big names in Chicagoland area.

reviews.text: The technician arrived early on Saturday morning and was able to clear a clog in the waste line that had caused a toilet to overflow and a bathtub to back up. reviews.author: Jodie Ridley
reviews.text: I had another company come out and wanted close to $5,000 to do less work with lower qualify materials then what I had done by Staten Plumbing at a VERY reasonable price! Brandon and Josh were knowledgeable, friendly and were able to get me a quote for less than I even expected that went towards the cost of repairs. I couldn't be happier with the quality work! They were straight forward which as a sales person myself is very important to me. As a young women and first time homeowner they didn't try to take advantage! I won't do business anywhere else moving forward with my new home. If you need repairs call Staten ask for Kaitlyn and get with Brandon and Josh! Great people, great work without the crazy price tag!

reviews.author: Nicholas Perrusio
reviews.text:
I hired Staten Plumbing to make some improvements to my HVAC system. During the work, one of the workers fell through the ceiling into the garage. On his way down he grabbed the HVAC drain line and it snapped at two places. While they did repair the drain line at the places where it had broke and also fixed the sheet rock, it was discovered months later that the force of the drain line being broken pulled it away from the unit at the main connection. This went unnoticed until sometime in July at the peak of cooling season when a huge water stain appeared on the ceiling in the garage under the HVAC unit. When I went into the attic I found the disconnected drain line which was leaking straight on to the wood platform under it. When I spoke to Staten, first I was told they’d fix it but it was only goodwill but don’t believe they had anything to do with this. While they did fix the drain line to address the leak, the owner refused to do anything about the ceiling other than slap a coat of paint on it. Damage like this can’t just be painted over, the sheet rock needs to be cut out and replaced especially if there could be mold underneath considering this leak was ongoing for months before it was bad enough to be noticed.

In the end, the owner would not do anything further than offer to apply a coat of paint. Overall very disappointed with the handling of this situation and not taking responsibility for what was clearly their fault. They got my money already and that’s all they care about.

In the event the drip pan cracks, the leak would damage the subfloor. With pan not fitting flat to floor and no silicone seal around the drip hole underneath the drip pan are two concerns I have. The technicians were professional and efficient. If you’re looking for quality work at a great price, this is the team to call.

reviews.author: Megan Fitzgerald
reviews.text:
The technicians at Cinch Mechanical are excellent!
Over the past four years, I’ve had several of them provide service in my home. They have completely replaced my sewage line from my upstairs bathroom to the foundation. They have also replaced toilets and they’re coming out to replace a tub on 12/29. Everyone that I’ve worked with has been knowledgeable, patient, courteous, honest, transparent, and respectful.
They truly are a model business.
I am so grateful to have Cinch Mechanical as a resource that I can depend on year after year.

reviews.author: Kayla Saddler
reviews.text: Cinch Mechanical is awesome! They’ve been so easy to work with, flexible, and available for everything I’ve ever needed. I’ve used them for everything from snaking clogged drains/pipes, replacing hot water heaters, and septic related things, in multiple homes. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kyle Fletcher
reviews.text:
This company was a nightmare to deal with from start to finish. Not only did they fail to complete the job, but the work they did finish still had issues and potential for leaks. When I pointed this out, instead of addressing the problem, I was accused of “nitpicking.” The truth is, I was simply expecting them to finish the job properly and fix what they had already damaged during their first visit.

To make matters worse, the front office staff — particularly Jeanie — was shockingly rude. She raised her voice at me multiple times and spoke to me like I was the problem for asking reasonable questions. Rather than taking any accountability, they constantly blame the customer and even get defensive if you give them anything less than a perfect rating.

It’s clear they care more about their online image than the quality of their work or how they treat people. I strongly recommend avoiding this company unless you want unfinished work, poor communication, and a lot of unnecessary stress.

reviews.author: Anthony Johnson
reviews.text: The Cinch Mechanical team came through my bathroom renovation and didn’t an excellent job installing a freestanding tub. The only crew I allow into my house or rental.

plumbers.name: Plumbing Management Services
plumbers.address: 5290 Douglas Rd, Oswego, IL 60543, USA

reviews.author: Giovanna Ecker
reviews.text:
I would like to sincerely thank PLUMBING MANAGEMENT SERVICE, LICENSED for their extraordinary and timely response following a burst pipe inside the wall in my bathroom on the 4th floor, which caused serious leaks to the lower floors. The HOA held me responsible, declaring that the damage originated from my apartment. Fortunately, after prompt emergency assistance from the company: Plumbing Management Service, who intervened promptly, it was discovered that the water leak was caused by corrosion of the main piping separating from the joint. Wheather from the vent increases on the roof allows water and moisture to enter the vent stack and drain down, but it was escaping through the separated joint into the wall, causing water damage inside my bathroom, the adjacent bathroom, and the entire condo unit below.
Therefore, thanks to the professionalism and precision of COMPANY PLUMBING MANAGEMENT SERVICE, after identifying the leak with meticulous precision and minimizing demolition of the cladding, the work was carried out to perfection: the pipe was replaced, leak tests were performed, and the wall was impeccably restored. I recommend this company for their professionalism, quality, affordability, honesty, punctuality, cleanliness, and above all, reassuring service in a highly stressful situation. Highly recommended for complex jobs, especially for condominiums.

Thank you for your excellent service

Giovanna E.

reviews.author: Jason Guthrie
reviews.text: All of the positive reviews are absolutely spot on for Wacker Plumbing. They are incredibly friendly and responsive right from the get go, but more importantly, they make a real effort to make you feel like they are in this with you. Some service providers come in and can be condescending, make you feel like you are responsible for the problem or you should have known better. Wacker isn't like that. Jamal (who I highly recommend you request if possible, he is absolutely phenomenal) came through once, took a look at everything, and got to work. As he was leaving, he told me he did his best to fix a leaky valve, but he thought it was likely to fail pretty soon. Sure enough, I called the next day to say that the hot water had indeed stopped working again. Not only did the person answering the phone know who I was and what the issue was, they had called ahead to order the necessary replacement parts without me asking, and Jamal could be back out the next day to replace the valve, no extra service charge for the second visit. Everyone else can do what they like...I'm happy to say I have a go-to plumber! Thanks, guys...we really appreciate the service.

reviews.author: Sharon

reviews.author: Hatsie Charbonneau

And even though I have a number of friends and contacts who own or work for other plumbing companies, we will continue to rely on Wacker Plumbing because they are the BEST!

reviews.author: Steve Rose

Compared to before, the faucet runs much more smoothly and the water flow feels noticeably stronger and more even. reviews.author: DeVonya Madsen
reviews.text: I had the BEST experience with Speirs plumbing. I had a faucet leaking in my tub and thought this was a bit more complicated this time. He looked at the situation and explained what we had thought, he was going to have to do some additional alterations with the pipes. He fixed the leak on his first visit so it wouldn't be dripping while we waited for items. Within the week he was back and handled the additional changes. He chose great parts and I now have a wonderful shower back as well. He was kind, professional and had my best interest front and center. I can't say thank you enough!!

reviews.author: Ashlee Sheehan
reviews.text:
I've had these guys come out twice in the last few months. The first time was a great experience, worthy of 5 stars! He took his time, answered all my questions and was super helpful, as well as the apprentice (super impressed with him too). So when it was time for a new water softener, I called them first. I guess I should've requested that original plumber because the plumber they sent was clearly experienced, but left the job a little unfinished. He didn't have the anchors to clamp the pipes to the wall and told me I could just go buy some. He also said they bring two bags of salt to fill it, but later, I realized our new bag of salt was gone and the softener was very low. When I called and asked about the problems with the anchors and salt, I was assured he would've put the two bags in! I was told they would send him back with the anchors - which I appreciated.

But when he came back to do the anchors, I asked about how much salt he put in and he said he didn't have any on the truck, so he just used our bag. So now I need to go buy salt because it's super low, which is very frustrating. And if I called and asked for salt, they might bring it, but that's not the point. The point is that the plumber was fine leaving it unfinished, and that's really disappointing.

Although this experience wasn't great, overall people have been nice, especially the woman who answers the phone. I'm just disappointed in the shortcuts taken on a very expensive job.

reviews.text:

I would absolutely recommend them for any size job to anyone needing plumbing help.  A tier 1 company with genuine heart and honesty behind their products and service!

He provided me with some long term solutions and estimates regarding the coming months/years so that I could begin planning for similar issues in the future. He was kind, patient, informative, and diligent considering I needed his services on a Sunday evening. Based on my research, his pricing was very competitive considering the time of the week.

Thank you Keith Jr.!

reviews.author: Jon G

His pricing was good and fair.  The work was done as quickly as possible and was quality work.  Cleaned up everything nicely.  I will use them again and recommend them to everyone.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Bautch

They were right on time the day the work was scheduled to be done. Their crew was very polite and did a fantastic job. They cleaned everything up, it was left spotless! I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND them! But for the amount of money I was willing to spend, I deserve better customer service and Job satisfaction I was looking for. I called Dimitri and told him about the escalation. Dimitri did not handle the situation like a true professional. I became really uncomfortable with Lenny and his anger. He demanded Payment with a very rude demeanor.  $435 should be more than enough to cover hot and cold water hoses, and hot and cold water pipes. reviews.author: Dan Podsedly

They twisted their schedule around some unpredictabilities on our part. What else could one ask for?

reviews.author: Andrew Bednarz

reviews.author: Carolyn Stocco
reviews.text: I cannot say enough about This company. Every time I’ve used them I’ve been nothing but completely satisfied. I’ve also received compliments from my tenants that the plumbers are always professional, kind and very Skilled at what they do. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Sue C

He arrived right on time, determined the leak was from the refrigerator line, pulled out the fridge to find the culprit and started the heater flush so I could get the chance to clean under the fridge before he repaired the leak & put the fridge back in place. While the flush was continuing he repaired the leak and moved the refrigerator back. Once the flush was complete he checked all the faucets to make sure all was performing right. He asked if I needed him to check on anything else and was very tolerant of all my stupid questions. I cannot say enough good things about him and the company in general.

reviews.author: Jacqualyn Irmen
reviews.text:
I cant tell you enough good things about Mario, his office help to his plumbling crew just everyone. We have been using midcity for years.
Since I became president of a 49 unit association I new they could help us out when we needed it and they have by   saving  us a couple thousands just on one thing.

If you are thinking about calling someone else. What will it hurt to try them.
THANK YOU MIDCITY!!!!!

Very professional and the price was right. I highly recommend them.

plumbers.name: Ziegler Plumbing & Sewer
plumbers.address: 15324 Warwick Blvd A, Newport News, VA 23608, USA

reviews.author: Mike T
reviews.text:
I recently purchased a business and was having issues with the grease trap. I was very pleased to learn that Ziegler Plumbing and Sewer had previously serviced the site and was already familiar with the history of the system.

Ashley in customer service quickly confirmed that my location was an existing service site, which immediately gave me confidence that I was in good hands.

James (I believe that was his name) was quick, knowledgeable, and already familiar with the property. He took the time to bring me up to speed on the service history, explain what had been done in the past, and walk me through how to properly maintain the system moving forward. He was thorough, efficient, and clearly knew exactly what was going on and how to correct the issue.

From customer service to the technician, the entire experience was professional and reassuring. I would absolutely recommend Ziegler Plumbing and Sewer to anyone dealing with grease trap issues.

reviews.author: Ryan Maitland
reviews.text: Had Chris out to the house to give me a quote for a hot water heater replacement. Super nice guy and very professional. He ended up quoting me roughly $1900 for the job. Shook hands and said he would have someone send me the quote the next day. Fast forward to the next day and the quote I get is nearly $900 more than what we shook on. In speaking on the phone now I’m being told there is a lot of “extra work” that needs to be completed. I’ve never written a review on a company in my entire life, but this just felt incredibly shady to me and has now also delayed me in being able to get it replaced. I would not recommend the company after this experience

reviews.author: Pamela Monroe
reviews.text: Probably the best experience in a professional job. Chris, my plumber, spent 3 hours trying to get rid of my 3 major clogs. He never gave up. Nicest of guys. If all your plumbers are this great you have a bunch of winners. Thank you

reviews.author: Darlean Basuedayva
reviews.text: I received my current monthly water bill and it was very expensive.  I know I probably had a leak somewhere. 2 toilets had been running 24/7 since April.  Rich from Ziegler came the same day I called.  He diagnosed the  problem right away.  He told me I needed new components for the two toilets.  They were able to get a guy out on Thursday, Oct 2.  Dani was his name.  He was so courteous, professional and changed the components in the toilets.  Then checked the water meter to show me, no water was running.  I appreciate the quality of people from the company and the great service they give.  I hired them before and will only call Ziegler for my plumbing needs.  Thank you.

reviews.author: Brandon Waltrip
reviews.text: I used Ziegler for issues related to toilets that would not fill. I called on Tuesday and they had availability the next day. Workers were quick and efficient. The bill was appropriate for the service. I will definitely use them again in the future.

plumbers.address: 75 Virginia Rd, White Plains, NY 10603, USA

reviews.author: Richard Woodrow
reviews.text: Drain saver could be renamed life--savers.   We had a sudden backup in two upstairs toilets and shower.   We called our plumber who referred us to Drain Saver.  Within less than an hour Fernando and Richard were at our house, assessing the problem, and fixing a badly backed up main pipe that caused flooding downstairs.  It was a bear of a job they did quickly, professionally.   They were delightful and remarkably clean.  I recommend them without reservation.

reviews.author: Aafia Chaudhry
reviews.text: I had a sewer drain outflow block that caused flooding inside my home. Emergency Sewer and Drain were amazing. They sent Ben and team to my house in under an hour which I appreciated given the flooding and back up. The crew worked diligently and carefully given that my house has old plumbing. They carefully assessed if the blockage was towards the catch or away from the catch and cleared the blockage in the sewer and in cleared the outside air vent. Ben knows what he is doing and they worked efficiently with the right equipment to get the job done. The pricing was very reasonable for the work and I would highly recommend for plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Steve Jackson
reviews.text: From answering service to actual plumber/service visit, a very professional service. Always polite, courteous, explains necessary work, cleans up thoroughly, and professional. Have used a number of times for various work, and would not hesitate to call again.

reviews.author: AnnaMaria Kanakaraj
reviews.text: Using ES and D for over 25 years. Recently had several things done, Benjamin and Juan hard working and very skilled. If you need a plumber don't hesitate to call this company!

reviews.author: Howard Dunscomb

reviews.author: Randall Elliott

Since my utility closet has a tricky set up the furnace positioning made removal and installation complicated, but Geoff was able to explain everything to me and also communicate with my preferred HVAC contractor to make sure everything was done right and could be repaired as needed. I appreciate the time taken to answer all my questions and remedy the situation. I was impressed with how clean things were left once the job was done.

reviews.author: RzUp
reviews.text:
I contacted Redbeard Plumbing, LLC to repair an internal water pipe that was leaking and had caused a great deal of damage to my basement. I was in need of getting someone out fairly quickly bc my water had to be turned off to prevent further damage. I spoke with Sam and shortly after I was assigned a plumber who was scheduled to arrive within hour. Donovan arrived and immediately diagnosed the issue. He thoroughly explained and demostrated exactly what needed to be done.  He worked on the pipe inside, as well as changing the hose bib outside (despite having to walk through ice). Within a couple hours my repair was completed and I had running water again!
Donovan also provided information on options for future updates to some of my dated equipment which I appreciated. I highly recommend Redbeard Plumbing, from their customer service to their actual plumbing skill. I would definitely contact them again! Thank you!

reviews.author: j B
reviews.text: It’s hard to find genuine, honest professionals these days. Sam was extremely professional, knowledgeable and transparent about the plumbing needs and what to expect. He provided quality services with excellence and was a pleasure to work with. I highly recommend his services and would use him again.

reviews.author: DB Carey
reviews.text: These guys have a 5 star rating in all of their reviews for a reason.  I had an emergency situation and called Tuesday morning.  Fortunately for me they were finishing up a job nearby and were at my house in about 30 minutes.  They were able to diagnose the problem quickly, quoted me a price and started right away. They explained everything clearly as they were working and made suggestions about other things they noticed  (that didn't need immediate repair) as they went along. Sam & Donovan did great work and they will be the first I call in the future!

reviews.author: Eric Hedges
reviews.text: Had a pipe break for my shower and I called this company at 830am. At 11am they were here and spent 3 hours repairing the leak and making it as good as new. Great company and decent price for repair. Would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Jared Rodriguez
reviews.text: Sam explained the process to me and his employee did a great job as well. Just waiting on the final steps for the permit and everything is good to go. Would recommend and use in the future.

plumbers.name: Robbie's Plumbing Service INC
plumbers.address: 14915 US-301, Dade City, FL 33523, USA

reviews.author: ann johnson
reviews.text: Robbie's was called at 7:30am.  They arrived at 9:30am.  Quick service!  Immediately fixed a main water pipe to house.  I kept adding jobs:  undersink "J" pipes, clogged drain, new kitchen faucet.  Craig was extremely patient, polite and efficient.  He knows what he is doing!!!.   Top of my list to use again.

reviews.author: Howard Creps
reviews.text:
Robbie was hired to do an entire replumb of a mobile home. He did a partial amount of the work, I don't even think it was half, which happened to be the master bathroom and it was not done correctly. My floor got flooded twice with brown water because the slope on the pipes he installed was not good enough to pull everything down as it should have been.
Then when it came to the other portion of the work that I prepaid for by the way, it just did not get done so I was ripped off for thousands.
I also had to go through probably at least 20 delays. Excuses that ranged from relatives dying to being in the hospital or a traffic accident happened etcetera every excuse in the book. Then towards the end of things he would flat out make an appointment with me, not show up, not inform me that he wasn't showing up and when I reached out to him he would tell me he was on another job. So I asked him why are you at another job when you're supposed to be here and I get no good or legitimate answer, he got my money and blew me off.
Then there was one thing and one thing only changed from the original plan, which was doing nothing more than adding one single pipe which was only something like 10 ft long and tying it into the rest of the system. it did not span the entire length of the mobile home or anything like that it was just a 10-foot section added and that single addition, he charged me I think it was $1,500 or $2,000 to add this one pipe. Which is one of the pipes that was not put in correctly. it was not at the right angle and everything backed up But he knew that I had already purchased the hot tub so I guess since he thought he had me by the balls he'd overcharge the crap out of me.
I've now had work done by an actual Pro and everything works great and I will be proceeding with a lawsuit against Robbie's plumbing. I have also reported him to every agency I could find out there that had to do with fraud and scams.
If anybody else has a situation like this, feel free to reach out to me and maybe we'll even get a class action thing going. You can find me on Google or Facebook and other social media with the same name I'm posting this under.
I also want to point out that when researching his company there are two registered companies through sunbiz with two different addresses but the same Robert Westmoreland as owner, and both of those addresses are based out of either Dade City or plant City Florida. But if you look at the department of Business and professional regulation website he has an address registered in Chiefland Florida which is where I'm at and this incident occurred and it is this address that is tied to his license number.
Since I will be sending him legal mail I had to figure all of this out and it looks to me like number one he's not updating the information on sunbiz as he should as a professional and number two I've seen similar situations and learned the hard way before that this is usually done purposely to cause confusion in a situation just like mine. Making things unclear and muddying the waters so that it's hard to even properly get ahold of the guy but he does still have the same phone number. There is also no Google listing like this for his Chiefland address. So everything on this listing and the other one is actually old and outdated but I'm still posting in hopes that people see it.
His business listing on Google implies that this is a family-owned and operated business. However I'm a little unsure if that's true. Sometimes he had an assistant with him but this was not his son this was some hired help. Plus I just can't see his wife going along with what he did to me unless she's in on it also and likes to con and scam too.
Happy holidays. Be careful everybody and check the better Business bureau for a credit to the companies through them which his company is not by the way

reviews.text: I recently had a problem with my kitchen sink drain getting clogged and backing up, even though I’m always careful about what goes down the pipes. reviews.author: Rebecca Bullock Jarrett
reviews.text:
We have used After Hours in the past and have always gotten fantastic service, although I should note that my husband usually does the easy plumbing jobs. My husband is currently remodeling our bathrooms. In an attempt to be a sweet, loving wife, I suggested he call After Hours when he discovered that the shut off valve (pretty sure that is what he called it) to one of the toilets needed to be replaced. And, here is where I made my big mistake, I told him to have After Hours install our 2 new faucets (including 2 new p traps) in the sinks in the 2 baths as well. He kept saying that he could do, but I insisted because the tile job hasn't been fun. We noticed one sink was leaking at the p trap that night. I told him to call After Hours back but he said it was was easier to fix it himself. Then last weekend, I discovered the one in my kids' bathroom had been leaking a good bit (thankfully, I had put all my painting supplies in there including a very absorbant dropcloth). At that point, even though my husband could fix it, I insisted he call After Hours because we paid over $700 for this service. The next day, the original plumber returned, said he tightened the seal, and, less than 5 minute in our house, left. Within 5 minutes, we saw it was still leaking. The owner came two days later and insisted it was our brand new faucet and replaced it with another new one that I have. Guess what?!? He leaves and the p trap is STILL LEAKING!! I am not a plumber - heck,  I am not even handy - and even I can tell where the leak is. I cannot for the life of me figure out why After Hours will not admit that they bought very cheap, crappy p traps, but they will not. So my trying to be a good wife has backfired. And my husband gets to keep pointing out that he would have done it right the first time for a lot less than $700.
Edit: It was the p traps that were leaking.  Changing out the p traps wouldn't have stopped the leak if it was a faulty faucet.  Additionally, you changed the faucet, and we still had a leak. Thus far, I haven't asked for a refund, but I am about to do.
Mistakes happened. It is how you handle it that matters.

I am grateful for their honesty, for the repairs they made, and for the way they treated me in this situation. They always took my complaint seriously. They were a strong advocate for me and dealing with the various players to get the repairs made at no charge to me.

reviews.author: Cindy Giovacchini
reviews.text: Cant give them enough compliments. From the moment I called, I knew I was being handled. I was told by another company that I needed a new blower, but their business was so unprofessional, I wanted a second opinion. I'm so glad I did. The other company said I needed a new blower for a thousand dollars, but they never checked the inside thermostat. I called fresno plumbing and AC, and it turned out to be the thermostat. Fresno Plumbing inspected, diagnosed, replaced the thermostat and completely serviced the unit, all the same afternoon, for $260. Can't say thank you enough!

reviews.author: Cassondra Reyes

reviews.author: Denna Kuffel

reviews.author: Andrea

reviews.text: Jeff is awesome. I developed a couple of problems with my water heater yesterday. Called Complete Plumbing at 4 PM and spoke to Jeff. plumbers.name: Doug Herrell Plumbing, Inc
plumbers.address: 498 Thomas Barbour Dr, Melbourne, FL 32935, USA

reviews.author: Derek
reviews.text:
We recently had our home in Viera repiped by Doug Herrell Plumbing, and the entire experience exceeded expectations.

My wife and I decided to move forward with a repipe as a preventative measure after seeing multiple neighbors deal with broken pipes and significant water damage, especially following the harsh winter of 2025. We wanted to get ahead of the problem rather than react to it.

Like most homeowners, we gathered several quotes, and Doug not only provided the most competitive pricing, but also the most complete package. His quote included permitting and county inspection, as well as drywall repair. Jeff, who handled the drywall, did outstanding work (see photos).

On installation day, I’ll admit we were a bit uneasy seeing multiple openings cut into the walls, but Doug and his team immediately put us at ease. They were professional, communicative, and walked us through each step of the process. Even more impressive, they completed the entire repipe in just about 5 hours with great efficiency. They also replaced some shower hardware we’ve been wanting to add included in the install, and added a loop in our garage for a soft water system install we’re getting done as well. Not to mention, an added shut off valve for the fridge water system in our pantry, so we don’t have to move the fridge to shut off the water line. This was great as my mother-in-law snowbirds in the winter.

The process ended up being far smoother than we anticipated, largely due to Doug’s organization and experience. Amy, who handled all the backend coordination and paperwork, also made everything seamless from start to finish. The county inspection passed the same day as well! And Jeff finished the drywall in a few hours the following day.

If you’re considering a repipe and want a reliable, local company that delivers quality work at a fair price, Doug Herrell Plumbing is an easy recommendation. My wife and I now have peace of mind knowing our pipes are new and clean.

reviews.author: Jackie Hobales
reviews.text:
From having no running water to discovering a huge water bill and a major leak, it was such a relief to find Doug Herrell Plumbing, Inc. They came out promptly and gave me a competitive estimate. Doug clearly knew exactly what he was talking about, and even though they were the highest bidder, I took a chance—hoping they would deliver exactly what they promised.

I’m happy to say they absolutely did.

I can honestly say they did a fantastic job.
100% satisfied and highly recommend Doug Herrell Plumbing, Inc.!

reviews.author: VICKI TAYLOR
reviews.text: After 3+ slab leaks, and scouring the internet, we called Doug Herrell Plumbing for help! Doug came and explained all that is required with a whole house repipe as well as giving us a fair estimate. Most companies will take 2-3 days just for the repipe. Doug, his son and crew were here May 21, were done in 6 hours and made the experience not so terrifying. Amy was a tremendous help and willing to answer any questions, no matter how many times I bugged her! Yes, you will have a lot of holes and ours wasn't the easiest job. Jeff Snyder did a fantastic job on the dry wall repair as well as skip trowel on the ceiling. We still have to paint but with a 25 year guarantee, we are very satisfied with their kindness and work!

reviews.author: Georgine Roach
reviews.text:
The past 5 years we've been having hot water pipe leaks under the slab of our house. This year we finally decided to have the hot and cold water pipes repiped after 2 more leaks popped up this month. So we had Doug Herrell plumbing come out last week to do the repiping of the water pipes. They did an amazing job. They were so professional and polite and the whole team worked really well together and very efficient and they cleaned picked up after themselves. We were very pleased with the work that they did and they put us at ease with the whole process. I was pretty stressed out in the beginning of the job, but towards the end of the job I was less stressed. I would definitely recommend Doug Herrell Plumbing for any plumbing problems. Also Jeff Snyder who works with Doug Herrell plumbing doing the dry wall repairs did an amazing job as well. It was a wonderful experience.
Thank you so much Doug and your family and crew.

reviews.text: Doug and his crew showed up on time. They were very efficient and friendly, made very little mess, explained everything they did and did quality work. I highly recommend Doug Harrell Plumbing to anyone that needs repiping.

I will be using Cox Construction and Plumbing for all my future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Cody
reviews.text:

He gave me multiple options on getting it done, which came with separate estimates. He told me some guys would be by after lunch to get started.

That same day, after lunch time, the guys he talked about came by and got to work and knocked it out within a couple of hours. Also, they got it done without tearing up as much of my wall as I originally thought they would. They were highly professional throughout the process. I was impressed with how quick my issue was taken care of, and with how well they did the job.

I would recommend using this company for your needs. I even had questions after the work had been done. The lady I talked to on the phone, that scheduled me originally, was very helpful on getting me the answer I was looking for. reviews.author: Jason Blackmon
reviews.text: As an apartment community manager, I have been working with Fletch Barney for years and they are always my first call for plumbing issues. reviews.author: Laura Matarazzo
reviews.text:
I am extremely pleased with the work from Fletch-Barney to fix the plumbing problems at my house! I have had this issue for years where backup/clogs were happening almost every two years. Victor and Nate came out and took care of the clog that day but also assessed my bigger plumbing problem and talked through my options with me, which I had heard from another plumbing company nearly 2 years prior for nearly double the cost that Fletch-Barney charged.

Victor was very knowledgeable and provided the most comprehensive explanation so I could really understand what they needed to do. He answered all my questions and "what if's" that made me feel comfortable to have him come back and do the job. In my case, the "if that doesn't work, we'll have to do..." ended up happening after digging up my front lawn to uncover that Plan A was not going to work. Victor reassessed and brought out the "big guns" - the owner, and they assured me that drilling into my foundation would resolve my problem from happening again. It turned out to be a much bigger job than what I originally expected, but Victor and Nate made sure that I was fully functioning and my yard was back to order before they left that night - they even brought in additional guys to make sure they could get done before it got super late. All the work and communication they did really eased my mind and reassured me that I made the right decision to use Fletch-Barney.

I will definitely use them again and recommend them to others.  Their excellent customer service and very fair pricing set them far apart from the others, no doubt.

reviews.author: Chris Wood
reviews.text:

The crew was fast, efficient and they explained everything through the process including me in the decision making.  Much appreciated!  Oh, and after having to dig a hole in the yard they took care in fixing things back with care.

I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Fletch-Barney for any of your plumbing needs.  Quality at a fair price and above all honesty!  Hard to find a company with these values these days.

reviews.author: Kathy D

The technician was knowledgable, efficient and super personable!  Hot water was restored timely and with wonderful service!  I will definitely use Fletch-Barney for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Michele May
reviews.text:
Extortion!  Rude office manager.  Do not use!

I am getting my shower redone and had the whole wall open for the shower kit to be replaced.  When I called I asked how much it would cost.  Olivia said it is $225 for the first hour, she asked a technician who said it would take approximately an hour with the wall completely open.
-An hour into my scheduled arrival time I was called and told they needed to reschedule until the next day.  That was a wasted hour of my travel time and inconvenience!
-The next day the truck arrived with 2 guys, a plumber and an apprentice.
-The plumber asked if I wanted to have the showerhead raised higher and I said sure.  I asked if it will take an hour and he said maybe an hour and a half.  *******I was not given any other estimate on cost so I assumed $225*1.5 hrs + the cost of pipe. ****

MY INVOICE WAS $710, PLUS $35 IF I WANTED TO USE A CREDIT CARD!!!

I was charged for 2 people, 2 hours + material and some other ridiculous thing.  I didn't receive a written nor emailed invoice so I can't itemize the extortion.

reviews.author: Danny Jimenez
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️I had been dealing with slow-draining water for a while. I first called someone out to snake the line — no success. Then I called a big-name company to hydrojet it, and even they couldn’t get it done. My clay main line had shifted with major root intrusion in multiple spots. They told me my only option was to dig up the entire line and break up my driveway.

I did my own research and learned about the trenchless pipe-bursting technique. I have no idea why the other companies didn’t mention it, but that’s when I found GR Plumbing — and after seeing their reviews, I gave them a call. Now I see why they’re rated so highly.

Gonzalo — the man, the myth, the legend — came out to assess the situation and confidently told me he could handle it. I asked about timing, and he delivered. His team showed up before the start time with their equipment, explained everything step-by-step, and got right to work. Before I knew it, they were digging, showed me the shifted section of the line, and started preparing the entry and exit pits for the trenchless pipe bursting.

Let me tell you — the entire team was professional, polite, and fully hands-on deck. When I say team, I mean they had a full roster working on my house. The project was completed much sooner than I expected, and the best part? Gonzalo made sure we had a functional restroom the entire time.

What impressed me most was that Gonzalo was there personally overseeing the whole project. That speaks volumes about how this company operates. I had a few questions throughout the process, and every single time I called, he answered and explained everything clearly.

GR Plumbing is the company you want for trenchless sewer repair. I can’t thank Gonzalo and his entire team enough for the work they did. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: We had a big problem with our drain pipes under our slab home here in Englewood. pretty much all of our 2' pipes and main sewer line needed to be completely relined, so they used pipe bursting to fix it. i called Miller Family Plumbing & HVAC and they were super quick to respond and walked us through the whole process. before starting any work, they explained each step and made sure we understood what would happen. all the inspections and paperwork were handled fast and smoothly. once the job started, they called every morning to let us know the schedule and which plumbers would be coming that day. everyone on the crew was really professional, friendly, and positive about the job. they always cleaned up before leaving each night and made sure our place was safe. i've worked with quite a few contractors, and honestly, this was the best experience i've had. ruben called every day with updates and answered all our questions without getting annoyed. micah really knew his stuff and took the time to make sure we understood every part of the job before they got started. craig and the rest of the crew worked so hard for two weeks and did an amazing job. if you need a plumber in englewood, these guys are top notch. you can tell they care about their work and their customers. highly recommend!

reviews.author: Peyton Howe
reviews.text: As a new homeowner in Englewood, finding a reliable plumber was a little overwhelming since I wasn't sure what a fair price looked like for plumbing work. When my main sewer line got clogged over a holiday weekend, I knew I needed someone to snake the line right away. Some plumbers I called either wouldn't give me a price over the phone or wanted to charge an extra fee just to come out and look, which made me nervous about hidden costs. Most quotes I did get were higher than I expected, with additional service call charges. When I reached out to another plumbing company, the person on the phone was really friendly and even offered some helpful advice to see if I could handle the clog myself before sending someone out. They gave me a clear price for snaking the sewer line right over the phone, with the honest note that it could be more if there was a bigger issue. They also let me know I could save money by waiting until after the holiday for service, which I appreciated. Tristan, the plumber, called ahead in the morning and arrived right on time. He was polite, worked efficiently, answered all my questions, and checked that every drain and toilet in the house was working perfectly before he left. The final bill was actually less than the original quote, which was a great surprise. The whole experience, from the customer service to the quality of the work and the price, was fantastic. I’m extremely satisfied and now have a go-to plumber in Englewood. If I ever need plumbing help again, I know exactly who to call!

My family has used Eli and his team for for over a decade and a half for our plumbing needs. And this time was no different. Our water heater quit on us Saturday night. Saturday night!!! Eli and his team, came back in a timely manner look at it, and determined that everything was still good and that we just needed a new trim. CA

reviews.author: G G
reviews.text:
We called this company to fix a leaking faucet. They couldn’t come immediately, which was perfectly fine. They eventually came out to inspect it, and normally you would expect a simple on-the-spot quote or repair. Instead, we were told they needed to “prepare a quote.” Slow, but okay — we waited.
The next day, we still hadn’t received anything. No quote, no update, no communication. We called back, and were told again that they were “working on it.” Hours passed, still nothing. When we called a third time, the person who answered said, “Our plumber is in the field, we’re waiting for him to return so we can prepare the quote.”

I asked if they could give a ballpark price over the phone and to provide a timeline as we needed this fixed.

Her response — in a careless tone — was:
“If you need this faster, then you need to contact somebody else.”

So I did.

[If it takes this long just to provide a quote — which is how they make money — I can’t imagine how long it would take if a warranty issue came up.]

To the owner: if this is how your front office handles customers, it’s costing you a lot of business.

reviews.author: Drail F
reviews.text: I had one of the biggest plumbing companies in the Allen area "diagnose" and "quote" a repair to a gas leak on the outside of my home. Under their advice I needed to cut my driveway to run a new line. I did get my driveay cut open and trenched. I couldnt get the original company to come lay the gas line to finish the work. We were without gas for cooking, bathing or heating the home for nearly a week. Red flag, after 2 days of calling to schedule the gas line nobody called me back until 4 days later. By then James had saved the day. I called James and he actually answers the phone. Not some office person who doesnt know anything about plumbing or an AI assistant and if he doesnt answer he calls you back quickly. He came out within an hour and within a few minutes was able to tell me the problem which was some unions that were leaking, essentially a simple fix. He ran a pressure test on all lines and the house and even fixed an error caused by the last technician from the other company. The first company wanted nearly 15k to excavate, replace a gas line and replace a quarter yard of concrete trench out of the driveway. I opted to hire out the concrete and trenching to save money and have them do the line which thankfully James informed me was completely unnecessary, but the original company wouldnt even respond to my request to approve the work! I essentially had my driveway cut open and excavated for no reason which was a costly mistake on my part. I wish I had just called James first. Its sad these days that some of these other plumbers and companies will take advantage of uniformed homeowners. Any company that pays plumbers commision should be avoided. Im thankful I found James Plumbing, he is honest and truly cares about his customers. He made it his mission over 3 days to run the proper pressure tests, do the repairs, run the tests again and meet with the city inspector to make sure we got our gas back on. People dont play games just call James Plumbing. Im glad I know I have an honest tradesman I can call in an emergency who wont inflate a repair, give me the safest most cost effective solution to my problem and follow through with his work. His solution was more than 12x less than the big company. Thanks again James!

reviews.author: Josue Diaz
reviews.text: Bought a house. James has been here over the last few years doing work. He's installed new lines, toilets, and unclogged sewer lines. Trust him to be honest and do good work.

Not only did he replace the hose bib perfectly, but he surprised me by seamlessly mortaring the brick afterward without me even asking. When I came out, everything looked flawless, and the pricing was more than fair. Would highly recommend.

I will definitely use them again for any future plumbing needs!
