reviews.author: Vincent Saunders
reviews.text:
I can't say enough good things about Lucy, Derrick, and the fantastic team at Dam Plumbing and Drain! From the moment their technician arrived, we felt valued and understood. He was not only friendly but also took the time to thoroughly explain the plumbing issues we were facing and outlined each step of the repair process in detail.

It turned out that some pipes installed on the exterior of our home had no UV protection, and after getting baked by the Florida sun, they became almost undetectable misting machines, creating a flood we couldn’t ignore. To make matters worse, our water softener had seen better days and was doing more harm than good.

Thanks to Dam Plumbing and Drain, we now have a brand-new softener system, and they did an amazing job patching our pipes. Their team is incredibly efficient, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about their customers. The best part? Our water bill, which used to hover between $350 and $400 a month, just dropped to an astonishing $83! That's right, you read that correctly. This alone speaks volumes about their service.

If you're looking for reliable plumbing solutions, I wholeheartedly recommend Dam Plumbing and Drain. They truly deserve a Grade A for their exceptional service! Thank you, Lucy, Dan, and the team, for everything

reviews.author: John Loiudice
reviews.text: I recently had plumbing issues where my toilet would clog regularly.  I checked several companies online and spoke to a few. I chose Dam Plumbing because there wasn’t a trip fee and they were very responsive. Chris arrived on time and explained potential costs before doing any work. He inspected my line and the issue was with my toilet which had the Flushmate assist feature which was crating the problem. He offered me low cost alternatives such as replacing the valve or possibly the tank but I’ve had problems with this toilet since a few months afternoon installation. He recommended that I replace the toilet which I decided was the best move. I was very pleased with his professionalism and he was able to replace the toilet although it was afternoon on a Friday. It was done at a reasonable price. Chris, as well as Lucy at the office went above and beyond to make sure I was satisfied with the results.  I’ll definitely be using Dam Plumbing in the future and I highly recommend them for any one looking for quality service.

reviews.author: Lindsey
reviews.text: Elias was very knowledgeable and solved our heating issue quickly! He was friendly and helped us to understand how the furnace works and how he identifies the issue. reviews.author: Kate Brewer
reviews.text: Do not hire this person for a ductless minisplit system, he is dishonest and work is below industry standard.  He installed the system incorrectly, including 4 leaks in the copper lines, and did not detect the leaks upon installation.  After those leaks were fixed, his leak detection system continued to be inaccurate, and he cut holes in my new drywall to try to locate leaks behind the drywall that did not exist.  He refuses to pay to fix the drywall damage.  He installed the drains wrong for all 7 ceiling cassettes, which resulted in water backing into all the unites.  One unit had a large electrical explosion from the water, which could have caused a house fire.  He accidentally cut my new PEX water supply line and water poured into my basement.  He did not correctly install the clamps for two drain fitting, where the clamps were just on the pipe and not the fitting itself, resulting in additional leaks.  I had to hire another company to get my system working, as Uli said there were leaks in the condenser unit and line, which did not exist.  He wanted to charge me over $2k to replace a new condenser that was not damaged.  Instead of paying the bill for the new company to diagnose what he misdiagnosed, he hired an attorney.  Dishonest in other regards as well throughout installation.

He spent lots of time explaining things and answering questions. I’ve used multiple different local established plumbing companies in the past and will bring all future business to Remedy based on customer service, technician experience and pricing.

reviews.author: Veronica

They got out here quick (leaking toilet) assessed the problem, came back the next day and finished the job. Left everything clean and tidy.

reviews.author: Brian Cooper

My teenage son accidentally released the toilet scrubber head into the toilet, and our Kohler bidet toilet auto-flushed as my son stepped away to get gloves.

Other plumbers tried to scam me by claiming they needed to remove the toilet and didn't offer to try a toilet auger.

Even though it’s been a really stressful time in our lives, Slone’s has made this a great experience. We will be doing business with them for years to come and definitely recommend their awesome work!

plumbers.address: 2 Burlington Woods Dr #100, Burlington, MA 01803, USA

reviews.author: Kathy Petillo
reviews.text:
Chris from North Point Plumbing and his team (Yeury and Jesus) did a fantastic job fixing a complex plumbing issue for us. Our upstairs bathroom's straight, 22 ft long, 55-year-old cast iron drainpipe leading to the main drain stack corroded and sagged over time, causing wastewater to backflow multiple times. Chris's estimate for replacement of the old drain line with PVC beat several others and included necessary extra work that the others didn't. Chris completed all this in one day but found that replacement of the drain line alone did not provide sufficient pitch for adequate drainage along the entire length. He determined the toilet drain stack would also need conversion to lower-profile PVC to achieve the correct drainage pitch.
This added some extra scope to the job but altogether the cost remained within budget. I'm very grateful for Chris's attention to detail and resolution to get the job done right. Throughout the project Chris and his team were friendly, polite, and conscientious, and left my house clean.  Most importantly, my home's drain lines are completely functional again.  I absolutely recommend Chris and his team for any household plumbing needs and will be seeking their services again when needed.

reviews.author: Risa Weber
reviews.text: Chris and Yeury were extremely professional, knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful. They walked me through all their steps and explained how the systems worked. They understood the sense of urgency and made all efforts to ensure I received exceptional service, especially working with the sales team to order parts overnight   They cleaned their area and made sure to triple check all of their work, checking every faucet, shower, and heating element. I was extremely pleased with the consultation and the repairs they performed. I highly recommend North Point for all your plumbing needs, and when possible, request Chris and Yeury. Thank you for your VIP service.

reviews.author: Todd C.
reviews.text:
Chris from Martinez Plumbing installed a new Rheem 50-gallon electric water heater for us and did an excellent job. The installation was very clean and professional, and he took the time to answer my questions about the system and maintenance.

They arrived a little later than the original time window, but Chris communicated clearly and the work itself was done carefully and professionally.

During the installation he also replaced our old expansion tank and a corroded shutoff valve. The piping work was neat and well organized, with clean copper connections and proper installation of the expansion tank and valves. Everything looks very professionally done and the system has been working perfectly since the installation.

Chris and his assistants were courteous, knowledgeable, and clearly experienced. I would definitely recommend Martinez Plumbing to anyone in the Wilmington area looking for reliable plumbing work.

reviews.author: Tyler Charron
reviews.text:
Chris and Yuery were fantastic!! Showed up at 7:30am on a Saturday without hesitation. Needed the water heater replaced, plus the venting needed to be brought up to code.

The job was done in 2 hours on the dot. They were polite, no bs, and left the place cleaner than they found it!

HIGHLY RECOMMEND and will be reaching out for any future help I may need.

reviews.author: Nicholas Reilly

Thank you so much Martinez plumbing!

reviews.author: Drew Pearce
reviews.text: After calling for an estimate, Budget Plumbing came out to make a much needed repair today. As usual, Tom and Sean did an excellent job.   Tom assessed the situation, explained what was required to make the repair and confirmed the estimated cost.  He and Sean worked together, finished the job promptly, and everything looked great.  They inspected the work, tested the system and as a courtesy, inspected the plumbing for a shower drain as well.  The cost ended up being exactly as estimated over the phone and in person.  No up-charges, no surprises.  We have used Budget many times over the years.  They do quality work, at a reasonable price, promptly.  They also clean up behind themselves and leave things better than they found them.  We couldn’t be more pleased to do business with Budget!

reviews.author: David Payne
reviews.text: Budget Plumbing is among the most reliable service providers I have ever used. I have trusted their services for over 25 years, and they have consistently demonstrated exceptional professionalism. They are always punctual, respectful of my property, and prompt in addressing any issue. Their workmanship is consistently excellent, and they reliably resolve problems correctly the first time. I highly recommend Budget Plumbing without reservation—they are simply the best in the industry.

reviews.author: Tyler Hiebert
reviews.text:
Jeremy Gellersen from Valley Plumbing Heating & Cooling was absolutely outstanding! He responded quickly and arrived at our home the same day we called about a leaking pipe behind the shower wall.
From the moment he stepped inside, Jeremy was incredibly respectful of our home—careful with our belongings, using drop cloths and booties, and leaving everything spotless when he finished. He took the time to thoroughly explain what was causing the leak, walked us through the repair process step by step, and answered every question with patience and clarity. No rush, no jargon we couldn’t understand—just honest, informative communication.
He expertly accessed and repaired the leaking pipe behind the wall, and the job was done cleanly and efficiently. We’re so grateful for his professionalism, skill, and genuinely kind demeanor. Jeremy is a true professional and we wouldn’t hesitate to call him again or recommend him to anyone needing top-notch plumbing service.
If you want great work done right the first time, ask for Jeremy Gellersen—you won’t be disappointed! 5 stars all the way.

plumbers.name: Mile High Drain
plumbers.address: 1835 W Union Ave 10 & #11, Englewood, CO 80110, USA

reviews.author: Tonya Milligan
reviews.text:
⭐️ 1-Star Review

We had Mile High Drain come out on Christmas Day to address a drain backup. We paid for emergency service and were told the issue was resolved. Unfortunately, just a few days later—by Friday—we had another backup in the exact same drain.

When we contacted the company, we were told it would cost another $175 emergency fee just for them to come back and check whether the original clog was fully cleared. There was no willingness to inspect their prior work or stand behind the service we already paid for.

In my opinion, standing behind your work means at least verifying whether the original issue was properly fixed—especially when the same problem returns within days. Being charged again just to see if the clog was actually cleared feels unfair and disappointing.

Based on our experience, I would not trust this company. I recommend reading the other one-star reviews carefully before hiring them.

Also notice the owner doesn't respond to the reviews.

reviews.author: Lisa-Renee Swazer-Smith
reviews.text:
On Christmas morning, we had a severe plumbing backup at my mother’s home. Every drain in the house was affected. We called Mile High Drain Cleaning Inc. for help, expecting a professional solution.
Instead, we were met with astronomical fees just for an initial assessment, followed by even higher charges to “fix” the problem, totaling over $750.00. We paid because the situation was critical. Shockingly, the same issue returned the very next day.
To make matters worse, we hired another plumber who resolved the entire problem for less than $100, and it’s been working perfectly for over a week. This proves Mile High Drain Cleaning Inc. did not provide the service we paid for.
Warning: Think twice before hiring this company. In our experience, they overcharge, fail to fix the problem, and then charge again without delivering results.

reviews.author: Shawn Kizzar
reviews.text: Joel and Joey were very professional. They kept at the clog which turned out to be a massive root with long extensions. The back up happens every year. I believe this will take care of any issues now. I can't thank you enough.  They cleaned up and kept the stairs covered to minimize the mess.  I highly recommend Mile High Drain Cleaning.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Kron
reviews.text: We have been using Mile High Drain for 20 years and have always been pleased with their service. They are always, thorough, efficient, friendly, and professional. Joel and Eric arrived on time, got straight work, and were finished in two shakes. Terrific fellows! Thanks for the great work.

reviews.author: Joy Zimmer
reviews.text:
I’ve had repeated issues with Mile High Drain. They came out in February to perform a main line cleanout. About a week later, our main line backed up even worse and caused damage to our basement. They returned to scope and clean the line again, assuring me the problem was resolved, but I didn’t receive much of an explanation. Unfortunately, our main line backed up again in August.

When I asked to speak with a manager for a more professional assessment of why this continues to happen, the company just sent another technician. I later called the office, explained the situation, and asked for someone to follow up with me—but I never heard back.

We typically have our main line cleaned about once a year, but never three times in six months. I would have expected clearer communication and some real insight into why the backups keep occurring. As professionals, they should be able to explain the underlying issue, not just provide repeat cleanouts.

For these reasons, I would not recommend Mile High Drain.

plumbers.name: Comet Plumbing & Sewer Co.
plumbers.address: 100 S Murphy Ave Suite 200, Sunnyvale, CA 94086, USA

reviews.author: Rebecca Collins
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about Andrew and Comet Plumbing. Tree roots had broken into the sewer line causing a backup. I spoke with four different plumbers and Andrew was the only one who didn’t try to add on to the job with extra services such as digging a trench the entire length of my yard and replacing the full sewer line.  The PVC line just needed to be repaired and roots removed from one section. Andrew was very honest and did a beautiful job without uprooting my entire yard. His fee was totally reasonable and he was extremely careful with the plants surrounding the area that needed repair. At the same time he  was punctual and got the job done quickly and, thankfully, with zero stress to me. He also left the job site clean and neat. The permit was signed off and the work immediately approved by the city with no problems. I highly recommend Andrew and Comet Plumbing.

reviews.text: The work was done as planned, on budget, and passed inspection no problem. The work needed was clearly explained. His was the lower of two quotes I got for the extensive work needed, and he was always happy to pause and explain what was happening.

reviews.author: Ahmed Tawashi
reviews.text: Great service from Comet Plumbing. He was super busy but still managed to come over the same day I called and do a faucet install.  I provided the faucet, but not the hoses - not to worry, Comet had all the parts that were not included. The shut off valve needed replacing, and they had that ready to go as well. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Christine Lin
reviews.text: Andrew from Comet Plumbing was wonderful! He helped install two clean-outs and fixed a root infested pipe for a reasonable price (plus nice discount). I’ll definitely be using them again!

reviews.author: Rick Robledo
reviews.text: Comet plumbing did a excellent job at my home . A fair price, competent, knowledgeable, efficient , clean and professional! Thank you Andy, I will be calling you for future issues if needed.

plumbers.name: Alexander and Sons Plumbing & Hvac
plumbers.address: 318 Charles St, Fredericksburg, VA 22401, USA

reviews.author: Ruffles Gruber
reviews.text: I searched around trying to find places to install a hot water heater as mine was leaking. I had already made a purchase of one and some of the plumbers were quoting fairly high prices. Some would not install it unless it was their heater. I reach out to this company through a friend of mine. After some conversation a quote was provided over the phone which was unheard of with the other companies. The price was high just in case other work needed to be done which I understood. They showed up fairly early on the day of the install. The install was done fairly quickly. After they left approximately 10 minutes later my little one decided to give the cat a bath. I got called into the kitchen where I see a river of water flowing through the living room, bathroom, and both adjacent bedrooms got hit a little bit. The crawl space was flooded. I called them back and they were there within minutes. I realized they were still in the community but they still responded that fast. It was learned that a pipe had burst which they fixed and it was not related to the hot water heater being installed. They left again. Unfortunately the hot water heater was not actually heating up. They came out the next morning and replaced a heating element which appeared to be really old. Especially in a new hot water heater. They replaced the heating element with a better one, and a new one. Now everything is working fine. They did really good work on this and there were things that were not their fault. This is the first company I'll call if I have any other/further issues at my residence. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Erik Pettersen
reviews.text: We had worsening problems of drippage from the shower head in our master bathroom and needed to have the cartridge replaced Aaron and his assistant Trayvon arrived at the promised time and completed the cartridge replacement in about 30 minutes, minimizing the time that our water was shut off.

reviews.author: Anthony Mcneill
reviews.text: Service was efficient and very reasonably priced. Employees were very professional and paid a great deal of attention to detail.

reviews.author: Heidi Hubbell
reviews.text:
Professional, high quality and friendly Service at a great price!
We called short notice to get a leak fix under our bathroom sink. The office got us a quick appointment and kept us informed of when the guys would be coming and if they were being delayed. The office is very friendly, professional and helpful. The guys came and it was a much more difficult problem to fix. The told us upfront the cost to fix the problem which was very reasonable. They spent an1.5 hrs doing the repair by actually replacing the very old drain pipe and installing a new one that they tailored to fix the sink. They did a great job, were professional, friendly and work very hard to solve a problem that didn't have an easy or quick fix in a short period of time. I will absolutely recommend them to everyone and will from now on make them my go-to plumber. Thank you everyone from the office to the guys in the field.

reviews.author: Steve Moore
reviews.text: I can not say enough about this company.  It all started with Jennifer's attentiveness and professionalism when trying to schedule an appointment.  Unlike the larger companies I contacted. she answered the phone right away and responded with much more urgency and kindness. She went out of her way to make sure I got the date that I needed and the correct equipment.  The installation technician Jay arrived on time and was equally efficient, friendly and efficient.  I would highly recommend this family owned company over their larger competition.

plumbers.name: Allstar Plumbing Experts
plumbers.address: 709 Little John Cove, La Vergne, TN 37086, USA

reviews.author: Sam Moxley
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough great things about Allstar Plumbing Experts! From start to finish, the experience was seamless. Nicole’s customer service is absolutely awesome; she was friendly, responsive, and made scheduling everything incredibly easy. You can tell she genuinely cares about customers and making sure things run smoothly.

James and the rest of the team were quick, professional, and clearly knew exactly what they were doing. They showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and got the job done efficiently without cutting corners. It’s such a relief to work with a team that’s both skilled and respectful of our time and home.

If you’re looking for reliable plumbing experts who deliver top-notch service, I cannot recommend Allstar Plumbing Experts enough!

reviews.author: Linda Glover
reviews.text: I needed a kitchen faucet replaced and after calling around to different plumbers I had someone come out because their service fee was the cheapest but when he got here and gave me the quote he wanted over $800 to install a simple kitchen faucet I sent him on his way. Luckily All Star Plumbing had also gotten back with me and while their assessment fee was not the lowest their pricing ended up being the best and Christopher and Bradley were very quick to get my faucet installed and make the Minor Adjustments needed to set it to my satisfaction and I couldn't be more pleased and it cost me $150 I would highly recommend I'll start Plumbing for their honest and fair pricing and good service

reviews.author: Tanya Sykes
reviews.text: We  had a water leak we could NOT locate, and it was a gusher. We were racking up those water bills. We finally got American Leak Detection out and they located it. Apparently this is a BUSY time and it was going to be a while before they could do the repair. They graciously referred us to their trusted partner, Allstar Plumbing Experts.  These guys worked so hard yesterday, working in the dark till about 9:30 to ensure we’d have water this morning. They came back today to clean up and sow some grass seed. They did end up having to saw through the aggregate, but this could have been sooo much worse. James charged me a fair price and was very helpful. We’re thankful the leak wasn’t in our slab (old house) and that these guys have been wonderful to work with. I highly recommend both services should you need them, but hopefully you won’t! Just another thing to be thankful for this season.

reviews.author: Julie Phillips
reviews.text: Highly recommend All Star Plumbing and James. We had a major burst pipe under our foundation and James was able to correctly diagnose the problem (multiple other plumbers could not) and fixed it with very responsive, professional service. He did excellent work, cleaned up after himself and was on time. He really stands out for great communication and quality. We obviously used him for our next project- a basement bathroom addition. He went above and beyond to make sure everything was correct. We recommend him to all our friends. I trust his work and his advice.

reviews.author: Chris Champion
reviews.text: James gave me a estimate, and was able to replace my water heater in the same day, even though they were busy from the extreme cold and recent ice storm.

plumbers.name: Wave Plumbing & Heating-Hayward Plumber
plumbers.address: 2416 W Tennyson Rd #258, Hayward, CA 94545, USA

reviews.author: Joy Schelin
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Wave Plumbing. They replaced my water heater and did an excellent job. Their pricing was very competitive, they were easy to work with, and communication was clear and consistent from start to finish.They also replaced a toilet for me. I am extremely happy with the quality of the work they provided. They also addressed some of my other plumbing concerns and explained the ins and outs of plumbing to which I am very  grateful for. I would definitely recommend Wave Plumbing to anyone looking for reliable plumbing services.

reviews.author: Ngoc T Dang
reviews.text: My landlord reached out to Wave Plumbing and Heating after the water heater at our condo started to make rumbling noise like a running motor. Once we sent them the pictures, video, and description of the issue, their plumber provided a ETA and he showed up on time. He ended up replacing the whole water heater due to severe leaking signs which took him around 7 hours. Even that, he stayed late to ensure we fully understand what needs to be on the look out for the next couple days and steps to take in case there's sign of leaking or strange noise.

reviews.author: Yulei Aung
reviews.text: I was in need for plumber on Sunday morning. He picked up my early morning call. Told me will be there between 10:30-11:30 and he showed up within the time frame. Unclog the toilet. Recommend me to get a new one and of course explained why I should replace. I have dealt with other plumbers they said the same thing to replace but do not give reasons. But I like the way he approaches the issue. I have decided to replace it. His cost for plumbing job is below market for emergency Sunday . Thank you and I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Shameel Hassan
reviews.text:
I recently had a kitchen faucet installed and couldn’t be happier with the service! Fareed was on time, professional, and very knowledgeable. He explained everything clearly, worked efficiently, and made sure the installation was done perfectly. The area was left clean, and the new faucet looks and works great.

Highly recommend for anyone needing quality plumbing work, excellent service from start to finish. I am also a repeat customer due to the quality of job he did.

reviews.author: Samara Holmes
reviews.text: I had Wave Plumbing & Heating come out to replace my sink, and they did an excellent job! The work was quick, clean, and professional. I’m really happy with the result and will definitely call them again for future plumbing needs. Highly recommend if you need a reliable plumber in the northern Cali area with reasonable prices.

plumbers.name: Bukowski Plumbing Inc.
plumbers.address: 14 Stiles Ave, Maple Shade, NJ 08052, USA

reviews.author: Jennifer Buongiorno
reviews.text: I wish I could give this review 10 stars. Robert is without a doubt the most honest man and plumber I have ever had the pleasure of meeting. He does the absolute best work and communicates with the customer to tell them exactly what’s going on and how he will fix it. Since moving to my new house, I’ve had to call in for two emergencies and he was able to come same day within an hour. It is clear how knowledgeable he is and there is literally no plumbing issue that he can’t do or fix. It’s very clear he cares about what he does and wants to ensure safety and happiness for all of his customers. He’s incredibly responsive, follows up, and makes sure he gets the job done right - every single time. His two sons, Dylan and Jesse, are also wonderful. If you live in the New Jersey area, this is the only plumber you should be using!!!!

reviews.author: Michael Baker
reviews.text: Rob and his assistant were excellent! I called for an issue with my shower and they were at my door WITHIN ONE HOUR. They were able to resolve my issue quickly and efficiently. I will definitely call them again for all of my plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Jay Lo
reviews.text:
was told by two other “big name” plumbing companies in the past few years that eventually my main drain will need to be dug up and replaced bc they hit roots while snaking from the inside of the house...
last week at 11:30pm my basement flooded after my kid and i showered (yuck!) called around the next morning and Mr. Robert and his son were out within the hour and solved my issue in about an hour once arriving literally from the street. pulled out a plug and everything has been draining perfectly ever since.
10/10. fast. friendly. helpful.

reviews.author: Dana Zambito
reviews.text:
Great experience with Bukowski Plumbing!
The main sewer line in our home was clogged.
We first called a large national chain in for service.  They attempted to snake the line, which was unsuccessful.  That evening another individual was called out to view the line with a camera, which detected roots blocking the main sewer outlet.  This was followed with quotes that required replacing the sewer line on our property, and removing pieces of concrete in the driveway costing >$10,000!

The next day we called Bukowski Plumbing.  Robert answered both my and my husband's questions over the phone and he was out to our house in the early afternoon.  He snaked the line and successfully removed the roots within 30 minutes!

He was professional, timely, explained everything, and was very funny!  If you live in the Cherry Hill area, I highly recommend Bukowski Plumbing.

reviews.author: Roger Garrett
reviews.text: Called Robert this morning at 8:00 AM about a P trap leaking from my garbage disposal that was installed by another big name company. I sent him pictures of the problem so he knew what he was dealing with. The trap was installed wrong and the company wanted to charge me to come back out to look at it since I bought the disposal and they just installed it. Robert and Dylan arrived at 9:15 and they re configured the trap with heavy duty PVC. It's now actually out of the way so we can have easy access to items underneath the sink and it doesn't leak. Robert explained everything  in detail. Then I had him look at the vacuum on the bib outside and he replaced that as well. It wasn't part of my original call as I just happened to remember the outside issue. I will use Bukowski plumbing for now on, we are extremely satisfied them.

plumbers.name: Budget Plumbing & Rooter
plumbers.address: 135 N 100 E, American Fork, UT 84003, USA

reviews.author: Chris Horton
reviews.text: Budget added drains and lines for our new basement bathroom, kitchen, and washer/dryer setup. They did an amazing job at a price that I couldn’t get close to anywhere else. I’m super happy with the job and professionalism

reviews.author: Summer Dutson
reviews.text: Our old boiler finally gave out and we had no hot water in our home! Budget plumbing took good care of us and got things taken care of quickly. They did excellent work, were very professional and their quote was much less expensive than one given to us by another plumber. Our old boiler was large and the boiler room was cramped and hot and it was a mess for them to deal with, but they worked all day and late into the night determined that we would have hot water in our home the next day. I was very impressed with their service and will highly recommend their company to everyone.

reviews.author: Maddie Howell
reviews.text: Called and was able to make an appointment for the next day when I wanted. I was given a 4 hour window of when they could show up, and no one ever showed up or called. I called in and they were very polite and called the plumber and got back to me. We ended up rescheduling for the next morning. I the same issue with no show and no call. Called back in and they promised the plumber would arrive in an hour. He showed up about an hour and a half later. He was very polite and friendly and resolved my issue quickly. I’m glad it wasn’t an emergent problem because I did enjoy the service, I think just poor communication.

reviews.author: CJ Jensen
reviews.text: Technician Michael , and his crew were very nice and professional. He fixed my leaking shower valve very quickly. I will for sure put Budget Plumbing on my speed dial.

reviews.author: Bryan Bird
reviews.text: I had a leak form in a copper pipe coming out of my recirculation pump on my water heater and my normal plumber was out of town so I called Budget. They were really responsive and came within a few hours. The young technician tried hard but never ended up making the repair work. I had to leave before he finished and left my adult son home with him. The tech said the leak had stopped but when I checked a couple of hours later it was still dripping (Much better than the initial spray, I'll admit). Anyhow after letting them know that the issue persisted, I was still charged full price for the visit and will end up having to make another payment to my plumber for a full repair. To their credit they did offer to come back and try again, but I would prefer to have someone with more experience make the repair. Overall they were responsive and nice, their technician was just not very experienced and ended up not solving the issue.

plumbers.name: Sunset West Plumbing & Rooter Inc.
plumbers.address: 12004 W Ohio Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90025, USA

reviews.author: Kasey L
reviews.text:
CONDO OWNERS DO NOT USE. I contacted Sunset West Plumbing on Monday February 23rd re: plumbing repairs. I was very clear that this was for a condo. I was assured my concerns would be addressed and I had an appointment scheduled for Wednesday February 25th.

On Tuesday February 24th I called the office to request licensing/insurance information for the HOA board (a standard request). I was assured it would be provided prior to my appointment on the 25th. They did NOT send me this information.

Today (the 25th) I received a call from the office an hour before my appointment informing me they were unable to come due to their technician being out sick. She offered to refer me to another plumbing company. I asked if it would be possible for them to come tomorrow (it wasn't an emergency). She placed me on hold and then came back to inform me they "no longer service condos." I found this very suspicious given I had called less than 48 hours ago. I asked her if this was because I asked for the licensing/insurance information and she claimed "the business changes and we go back and forth." VERY VERY SKETCHY.

reviews.author: julio gasson
reviews.text: Sunset West Plumbing really saved the day this time. A few months ago they worked on our shower valve and did an amazing job with extending it to get our Shower handle in a new position in our newly remodeled bathroom. Their team was professional, courteous, and did a tremendously detailed job. Fast forward a few few months, and the shower had just begun being used again by new tenants, and noticed a trickle drip from the shower head. I called Sunset West and without hesitation their team was back out to diagnose and repair the issue that was occurring. The tenants in the place had not used the shower and after Sunset West did some light tinkering, they were able to resolve the trickle drip in the shower head and the shower was once again usable. Their work was amazing, they’re professional, and we really really appreciate the attention to detail. We’ve done so forest and now replace our original plumbers with Sunset West and will use them for all of our needs going forward.

reviews.author: isela Dijamco
reviews.text:
Five-Star Review for Sunset West Plumbing

We had an emergency water heater issue, and Sunset West Plumbing came to the rescue! They were able to assess the situation and get a new water heater installed and running within 24 hours. This is the second time we’ve used them for a plumbing issue, and once again, they exceeded our expectations. Their professionalism, responsiveness, and efficiency are unmatched. It’s clear that they truly care about their customers and take pride in their work. We highly recommend Sunset West Plumbing to anyone in need of reliable and high-quality plumbing services!

reviews.author: Christopher Bates
reviews.text:
Others here seem to have had a good experience. Me, not so much.

I tried to stop by their Ohio Ave. location in person, at 2:00 in the afternoon on a Monday, and... there was nobody there.

Then I tried to contact them via their website, and... nobody answered.

Finally, I called them. After several attempts, I got someone on the phone. I asked them if they could come by and give me an estimate on several jobs, and the person was annoyed and said they would charge me for that, because "their time is valuable." I said that I am located just 2 blocks from their Ohio Ave. location, and I only need 10 minutes at most, and they put me on hold and then came back and said they'd rather refer me to a different plumber.

reviews.author: 坂元七菜
reviews.text: We had water-dripping problems from the faucet in our bathroom, so we called Sunset West Plumbing & Rooter as we always do. Jay and his partner came on time and changed the parts for both quickly and throughly. Sunset West has been in business for over 35 years. There are many plumbers in Los Angeles, but it is important to hire someone you can trust, like Sunset West!

plumbers.name: J.F. Whitlow Jr & Sons Inc. Plumbing, Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 703 Confederate Ave, Portsmouth, VA 23704, USA

reviews.author: PAUL JOHNSON
reviews.text: Had a leaky sewage line under the house that had been chewed by rats! It was real hard to work down there as I have done some repairs in the crawl space myself but this one was out of my league. A fellow named Rudd came by and did a great job. I have used this company several times and have always felt that they did a good job and it never seemed overpriced.

reviews.author: Michelle Starnes
reviews.text: I have used J.F. Whitlow’s service since 2020 and they always have the most friendly and professional techs. They take the time to listen and understand the issue, to diagnose and explain the solution. They’ve worked on plumbing and HVAC systems for me. I’ve never been disappointed with their service and repairs and highly recommend them!

reviews.author: George Ross
reviews.text: We came home from a short vacation and found a leak in our kitchen ceiling, saw that the water was actually coming from the door frame. J.F. Whitlow sent two young men named Lee and Gabe. Excellent service, they took the time to figure out how they were going to reach and fix the problem. I had 2 other companies come one would not even attempt to and the other said he needed to get his boss to assist. I tell you Lee and Gabe attacked the problem and fixed the leak. Big Praise to both of you. Job well done. I would recommend them if ever in need.....

reviews.author: cindy payton
reviews.text: I really don't  think they deserve one star  more like no STAR.. they took advantage, and they said I needed a new water heater .. they broke a part and turned off the water line to my showers, which was on before they came . Two other plumbers said my water heater didn't  need replacement. The issue was something  else.. when I tried to talk to Karen, she over talked me. The first plummer who came immediately  took pictures  stating that my WH needed replacement  too old. Will i know it wasn't  too old, and so did the other plumbers. However, the warranty  company  didn't  go for it and told them to put the part on that was recommended by the first company.. They put  the part on and broke another part, turned off the water, and insisted that I needed a New 4k water heater according  to the estimate they sent. Luckily, i called another company, and they found the deception and dishonesty.  J.F. Witlow  is not to be trusted they own me for breaking the part. I HAD TO REPLACE WITH MY OWN MONEY!! TAKING LEGAL ACTIONS.

reviews.author: Elisabeth Moore
reviews.text: I am so grateful for JF Whitlow! They were instrumental in identifying issues with our HVAC that 3 other contractors missed. We have a home warranty that wanted to bandaid a significant issue and Dylan worked tirelessly to get the system properly replaced. It was an antiquated 25 year old HVAC that needed replacement but warranty would only repair, costing us more time and money. After 3 seasons of dealing with a/c issues, Lee, Gabe, and Dylan at JF Whitlow finally brought the relief we needed. HVAC was replaced and we finally have cool air again! Thank you JF Whitlow. Shout out to Erin working at the front desk and keeping us informed and scheduling in a timely and professional manner. Highly recommend!!!

plumbers.name: Planet Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1012 E Bayview Blvd, Norfolk, VA 23503, USA

reviews.author: Nathan Vaden
reviews.text:
Planet Plumbing is absolutely the best, any plumbing needs I my need I will always use Planet Plumbing.
Thank you so much Jack.

reviews.author: Lisa Gates
reviews.text: The owner Jack Reed has been helping us for 10+ years with some tough issues with plumbing, leaks, and most recently a water heater install. I am leaving this review for several reasons. I knew I could trust Jack and his team when we had a plumber come that wanted to tear out our existing bathroom tile to replace a part in the shower handle and I thought that can't be that difficult and way too much work? I asked Jack to come and look for a second opinion and of course he was able to replace one part without tearing into the wall. So we gained much respect for him and his team that day. Since then they have always showed up when we needed them and even when I have been in panic mode they have assured me it will get done. They only do the work that is needed and never talk you into doing anything that is not. We appreciate Jack, the owner, Jack and Luke his sons for being so kind and patient with us. If you want a plumbing team you can trust start here first!

reviews.author: John Frame
reviews.text: The crew was fast. Prompt on arrival, quick to get in the issue, with a fast resolution. Excellent customer service with very friendly happy employees. Will always call Planet Plumbing.

reviews.author: Jonathan Elder
reviews.text: Jack always does a good job, and gets to it within a day. No long wait times. Just charges by the hour, no paying for him to show up and then give you some ridiculous price

reviews.author: Thierry G. Dupuis, MBA - Realtor
reviews.text: I can't say enough about my experience using Planet Plumbing. They were quick to schedule an appointment and their price beat everyone else I called for an estimate. Jack Reed who came out to do the installs was awesome, polite, quick and knew his stuff. As a local Realtor, I'll definitely be using them again and referring them in the future. Thank you for a job well done.

plumbers.name: Nick's Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 1227 Kimberly Ln, Glen Burnie, MD 21061, USA

reviews.author: Mark Mercurio
reviews.text:
I recently had Nick from Nick’s Plumbing Services out to my home, and the experience was excellent from start to finish. He listened carefully to the concerns I’ve been dealing with for years and immediately got to work diagnosing the problem. It didn’t take him long to discover the real issue: the sewer line in my yard had been improperly graded toward the house instead of toward the county line in the street.

Nick explained the situation in plain terms, walked me through what needed to be done to correct it, and provided a fair and straightforward quote. He scheduled the work, arrived on time, and completed the job efficiently and professionally.

It’s clear Nick knows his craft and takes pride in doing things the right way. I’m very satisfied with the service and would recommend Nick’s Plumbing Services to anyone who needs an honest, skilled plumber.

reviews.author: jean torres
reviews.text: Needing the expansion tank replaced at my house I got Nick's number from a friend and what a service! The whole process was easy, fast and very affordable with Nick's Plumping Services from the first call, to setting an appointment, to the job being completed and my issue getting resolved. Would definitely recommend 100% and I know who I'll be calling for future plumbing issues/projects.

reviews.author: R B
reviews.text: I called Nick because my toilet started leaking in the late afternoon. He came over that same evening to check out the issue and was able to identify the problem and give a fair quote. He fixed the issue the next afternoon and it took him no time at all. He was fast, efficient, and very tolerant of two kids talking his ear off. The repair fixed the issue and it looks better than before. I will absolutely call Nick for any issues in the future.

reviews.author: Shaun Mahoney
reviews.text: Nick was referred to me from another vendor. He visited my rental quickly, gave me a quote and his recommendation. He replace the hot water heater on schedule did some extra items and ran a very clean work area. I was very impressed and highly recommend Nicks plumbing! Kudos Nick!

reviews.author: Brent Murrell
reviews.text: We’ve used Nick’s Plumbing for years. They are super responsive and the pricing is great. Its easy to tell that Nick takes pride in his work and he is super easy to deal with. Ill continue to use their services! Highly recommend.

plumbers.name: Zoom Drain Birmingham
plumbers.address: 109 43rd St S, Birmingham, AL 35222, USA

reviews.author: PeakSeason Inc.
reviews.text: MarDarius did an outstanding job! He was polite, cooperative and he he knew his stuff. Nobody likes plumbing problems but when you get service that makes you appreciate what was done for you and the effort that was directed to you it makes a bad plumbing day better.... it is a positive thing! I would highly recommend Zoom Drain for both a fair price and outstanding service. (and I start out from the personal position of "I hate plumbing") When you leave a bad plumbing day feeling positive - you are using the right company

reviews.author: John Bragg
reviews.text: Tim did an unbelievable job for me. He was efficient, courteous and picked the most cost effective option to help diagnose my problem. Michael contacted me before and after to follow up and referred me to someone that could help with an additional issue. I could not be more impressed.

reviews.author: Ariel Brooks
reviews.text: Mardarius and Tim did a fantastic job for me and I would definitely recommend them to anyone. They got here fast and figured out what was wrong and talked to me thru each step so I was informed. Will definitely call them back in the future.

reviews.author: Gary Wheat
reviews.text: Tim was very professional, friendly, and thorough during my service line cleanout. He even recommended some ways to prevent future clogs and maintain my line myself, which I appreciate. The system they use is very modern and low-impact on your property. I highly recommend this company for sewer service line cleanout.

reviews.author: Markeciua Rue
reviews.text: Michael explained the process very fluently and explained the game plan that would be executed by the team. Mardarius and Tim were professional and transparent and walked us step by step to getting our drains cleared and back functional. The drain clearance they performed on our commercial job site was swift and efficient. If you have any drain issues, ZOOM DRAIN COME HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!

plumbers.name: Jif plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 7648 Quivas St, Denver, CO 80221, USA

reviews.author: Warren Linn
reviews.text: Jose is a stand-up guy! He was incredibly prompt to respond via text after hours and came for the repair the next day. He offered me a discount and was flexible on all fronts, it was a great experience. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Lisa Hinderlider
reviews.text: Was referred by a friend to JIF Plumbing as I needed to get a drain snaked. I really try to find good service companies that are locally owned to support small businesses. His quote was higher than the 99.00 rooters all over the area but I took a chance. Jose is an excellent tech. He gave me great information about plumbing issues as well as preventative steps. He is trained and fully understands all aspects of his job. He is not just a guy who was trained by another guy who had.no proper training. He was quick, efficient and cleaned it all up to my satisfaction.You get what you pay for. 10 out of 10.

reviews.author: Julia Zoukhri
reviews.text: Jose was the best! We had a leak in our crawl space and he came out to inspect it. He initially advised that we recaulk our tub to see if that would help. When we told him the issue persisted, he was able to come back and figure out the issue (a lose pipe behind our dry wall). He quickly repaired it and our leak is gone!! He was friendly, thorough, and communicative. He explained everything that was going on and what needed to be done. I will definitely use Jose and the company again in the future and cannot recommend him enough!!!

reviews.author: Deborah Terada
reviews.text:
Jose came and diagnosed our problem within minutes. He was very polite and professional, all the while keeping me informed of the course of action for the repairs. I would highly recommend JIF Plumbing.

reviews.author: risa anav
reviews.text:
It never fails how your house decides for an emergency right at a big holiday.  Our 65 year old plumbing line from the water main to the house gave way and was leaking water from under our landscaping, down our driveway, and into the street Wednesday late afternoon before Thanksgiving.   I googled emergency plumbers in our area.  Luckily, Julio (Shark Plumbing) was nearby and was able to come by in 10 minutes.   It was a substantial project to replace the line with copper pipe and would entail digging a trench through our front landscaping. He was knowledgable and able to give us a detailed explanation of the job and relevant codes.  Julio gave us a fair quote for an emergency job and told us that it would look like he was never there. I was thinking, 'we shall see.'

He connected a bypass Wednesday evening to stop the leak and let us have water.  Then 8 am Thanksgiving morning he came out with his crew and started digging.  They were organized and moved the mulch and garden drips, dug the trench to have minimal impact to my plants. They got everything dug (heavy wet clay) and the pipe laid before only turning off the water for the final connections. We were only without water for about 2 hours.  He was great with communication and his crew were hardworking, clean, and worked with minimal disruption to us.  I was cooking a turkey inside.  When they were finished around 3 pm, I was amazed at how my front yard looked.  They did indeed put it back together as if they were never there.  They took all garbage away with them.  The copper front connections looked great.  They even repaired the small drywall that they had to cut open to run the connection into the garage.

My experience with Shark plumbing was extremely positive and I only have praise for their work and professionalism.  They saved our Thanksgiving.  I appreciated their work and hope they were able to spend the evening with their families.

reviews.author: Jill Aceves
reviews.text:
Can’t say enough about this company!
He came recommended by my sister, and did major plumbing at my moms.   We were hearing water running when we had nothing turned on??
Julio, (the owner), came in right away and after checking everything, gave us an estimate on Repiping our home, (which was way over due).  During the repipe they found we as well needed sewer pipe replacement, which we were not thrilled with.  But after showing us photos,  and actual leaky pipes, we needed to get it done as well.
His team of plumbers, were Extreemly polite, considerate. Worked in sync, lot’s of communication the whole time.  Julio, checked in on everything, equipment,  pipe fittings, the digging process, always asking us if everything was ok!! reviews.text:
My water heater went out today, so I wanted a local independent plumber. So I called Micah's.
I was quoted $2000.00, I said no, I went a brought a new 50 gallon gas water heater and new water and gas fittings for $700 @ lowe's (10% veteran discount).
What is going on now day's $1,300 for labor!!
That's a sin...........
I'm 65 and with the help from my neighbor we were done by 12 noon.
Christian touting Micah's honest plumbing needs to go to confession.

reviews.author: Travis Brimner
reviews.text: Spoke with Jenni at Micah's Honest Plumbing and she informed me that they don't service city of Dallas addresses typically. The conversation would normally end there, but she graciously offered advice on how to hire a comparable plumber to avoid price gouging of the large private equity-backed players in the Dallas market. She also pointed me to Locke Supply (they too were excellent and helpful) as a great resource where I was able to purchase a Bradford White water heater directly. I took her advice and was able to get my entire project (a hot water heater replacement) completed for $1,700 by another vendor (I've reviewed them as well), which included the hot water heater, labor, City of Dallas permit, auto-stop/leak detector and a few misc valves and pipe fitting. Thank you Jenni for taking 10 minutes to offer the most helpful advice...above and beyond!

reviews.author: Rick Hollmer
reviews.text: Just did business with Micahs Honest Plumbing for the first time.  Absolutely great experience.  We had a collapsed sewer line under the house and our tenants were unable to use the property.  Micah and Jenny did a great job, not only with the repair, but helping to prioritize to get the tenants back in the house as quickly as possible.  I very highly recommend Micahs Honest Plumbing and will be using them for every plumbing job in the future.

reviews.author: Alana
reviews.text: Unbelievable. Definitely a bright light in a dark world of people trying to overcharge and hustle you. Not only did they help us get through the night without having to pay for an after hours fee, but they can early the next day fixed our problem and walked us through step by step to figure out how to solve on our own in the future. Great people, great price, highly recommend. So great that they feel like an old family friend. ♥️

plumbers.name: Custom Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 902 Columbia Ave, Lancaster, PA 17603, USA

reviews.author: Susan Allen
reviews.text: We have used Custom Plumbing for many years so this review is quite overdue. On every single call, the service has been impeccable, the prices fair, and the plumbers honest and caring. Never any overselling and true kindness from the whole staff. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Abigail Buckwalter
reviews.text: Custom Plumbing & Heating has come to our house twice for plumbing issues. The owner, Barry, is very caring and was willing to have his workers come to the house as soon as he could. They did an amazing job with a sump pump installation. They took time to explain how it works and made sure I understood the work that was done. They also came to look at an issue with our bathtub leaking and Mason was very detailed with informing me what the issue was. I would highly recommend this company to anyone in need of prompt and thorough work done by professional and caring workers.

reviews.author: John McGrann
reviews.text: We can't say enough good things about Custom Plumbing & Heating. We had a hot-water heater fail unexpectedly. We called them, they came out promptly to look at the situation, and we had a new heater installed quickly and for a very fair price - thank you!

reviews.author: Dion Betts
reviews.text: Mason, Jared and George were polite and expert. They replaced all water lines in my house and made other needed upgrades and repairs. The cuts needed in the drywall were exact and clean. They keep work areas spotless. They rechecked everything several times and made sure I was happy with their work. They do not upsell and I believe the pricing was very fair.

reviews.author: Laura Fiester
reviews.text: Custom Plumbing & Heating did an amazing job! Mason, George and Jared were terrific! They were knowledgeable, professional, friendly and worked efficiently to upgrade the plumbing in our entire house! They were fantastic!

plumbers.name: D and D Drain
plumbers.address: 1901 N Moore Ave #17, Moore, OK 73160, USA

reviews.author: Sara Jones
reviews.text:
Does not know how to pour concrete. Price was quoted at $1200-$1500 to fix the crooked pipe and replace the cast iron flange that we had already cut off, we paid close to $2000 for them to bust up our concrete and add a PVC attachment and flange. Pipe is still crooked and now the left side of where the toilet should sit is a half an inch higher than our original foundation and the front of it is about a quarter inch lower than the original foundation area.
They offered to come out for free if we had issues, but what can we expect from someone who doesn't understand how to use a level.
Pictures include the starting point, which is the circler and the end result which has the level on it. The blacked floor is the original foundation level.

reviews.author: matt newton
reviews.text:
We called D and D drain in need of installing a waterline for our fridge. We've been in the house for almost a year and had bought a fridge for the house not realizing we didn't have a waterline/faucet for the fridge to connect to. Upon calling they seemed very professional, upfront and communicated well on got me on the schedule. Even offered to come out and take a look at what I needed installed at no charge. Some places were charging $80 just to get an estimate.

The plumbing was installed and is running fine. My issues began when they left my house and left the box for the line connection behind my fridge looking as pictured in the photo. I reached out to them explaining my concern and that this so far was my only issue with our experience. I was greeted with responses of "we don't do drywall work" "we don't trust anyone to outsource and pay for it to be done."

As the conversation took place I voiced my concern as I felt this was left undone and didn't look professionally installed. I had worked in trim carpentry for a couple years and when mistakes were made we fixed them. Didn't just leave them for the customer to foot more money to have someone else repair them.

I'm unsatisfied with how this situation was treated after the fact. Communication with them has been timely but the issue is left unresolved.

Will not be using them again. And honestly surprised I'm not seeing more bad reviews. Hopefully they aren't deleting them to maintain face.

reviews.author: Bon M
reviews.text:
We were experiencing a bad clog in our bathroom which resulted in water coming up in the shower when the bathroom sink would run and the water was draining VERY slowly. We tried snaking ourselves and used Liquid Drano MAX w/ boiling water flush to no avail. I finally gave in and decided to call a plumber.

I usually let Google reviews guide me to the right professionals and chose D and D Drain because of their stellar Google review score and affordability/honesty seemed to be common themes within their reviews, two qualities that mean the most to me when having someone work on my house. Robert was literally at my house within an hour of making the call and had the clog gone an hour after that - for an affordable price to boot!  He was kind and courteous and did a great job cleaning up afterward. Will definitely be using D and D again for any future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Kai Carver
reviews.text: I called to get an appointment for a kitchen sink installation and some updates done to some pipes under the sink. They were able to get us worked into their schedule fairly quickly and never once hesitated when the job ended up being a lot more than anticipated (we have an older house with kind of rough plumbing). Dustin was able to get all the pipes and fixtures up to date and the sink installed even while having to make changes due to unforeseen issues. They are very quick to communicate and kept us involved with every step. Will definitely use again!

reviews.author: Katie Howell
reviews.text: Our tub and toilet were not draining in the only bathroom we had. We had company staying with us and were panicking trying to find a same day plumber to come fix our drains. They were out within 2 hours of the call and had it fixed in less than 20 minutes. They are very kind people and knowledgeable about what they do. We will be keeping them in our back pocket for the next plumbing issue we have.

I could not possibly recommend Carr Plumbing higher, they are The Best !!! Thank you and your team Tom for the Exceptional Service!

reviews.author: Amanda Bush

Loved his attitude and he was very kind to my grandmother which is hard to come by these days. We really appreciate you all being so kind and courteous but most importantly honest and fantastic prices. Thanks again for the wonderful service bob!

reviews.author: Allen Williams
reviews.text: Guy in your white van Cut me off in traffic,  no turn signal merging two lanes over almost swiping the nose of my vehicle. Then flips me the bird multiple times. Hope the plumbing is better than the driving!!! Unprofessional

reviews.author: Melissa Spooner Your Local Realtor
reviews.text: I am a local Realtor and I've worked with a lot of plumbing companies over the years and I can tell you, these guys are the most Honest and Reliable! R. Carr plumbing is a keeper and has made it on my recommended vendor list. A BIG THANK YOU to Justin! He saved the day, he met me within an hour after another company cancelled on my buyers at the last minute! And I cannot forget to mention, FAIR PRICES!

reviews.author: Poppa Bear
reviews.text: If I could put zero stars I would. . . I thought only roto rooter would have tried to pull what these guys did. . . A main clean out is about a hundred to 130 for almost every place you call. . . Not these folks. . . I dug a path for the machine due to the snow. . . Dug up the clean out. . . Set everything up in advance to make their job super easy. . . The guy gets here and informs me a drain snake is 550 bucks. . . THATS INSANE. . . . Then they demanded 100 bucks for a trip charge. . . Which I get totally . . . They probably get told no alot given they are 500% higher than the average plumber. . . Then they proceed to take the hundred bucks and drive off with no reciept and no invoice. . . . I've been a contractor for 30yrs and aside from roto rooter I've never encountered such a horrible predatory ordeal. . . I would not recommend these folks for services due to the insanely high prices they charge for menial tasks . . .

reviews.author: Paula Delapasse
reviews.text: French Drain was obstructed with roots and cleared by the technician.  I appreciate his honesty and help!

reviews.author: K
reviews.text: Victoria in the office was very accommodating and polite. And Mr. Rubke- well first of all the man put on booties!! Already scores points. Then he carefully addressed all our concerns and fixed our clog. I would 1000% recommend this company again!!

reviews.author: The Point
reviews.text: Well done and on time. Both Guillermo (the Plumber) and Elijah (the HVAC tech) were professional and courteous. I would highly recommend them to anyone seeking 5-Star service

reviews.author: Joseph Eckert
reviews.text: Guillermo Rubke was our tech that came out to give us an estimate today on a new sump pump & battery backup. He was very thorough, knowledgeable, and answered all our questions. He gave us several options to fit our needs. We will definitely be considering Five Star Home Services for our future home projects & maintenance. Thanks again, Guillermo!!

reviews.author: Stephen Lyles
reviews.text: Raven with Sunrise was fantastic. From the start,  everything was well communicated and fast or timely. I was extremely impressed with the whole process. I even signed up for Sunrises Monthly subscription and consider them my Plumber. They Did A install of a Gas Heater just days before our snow and ice and also did all that comes with the subscription.  I highly recommend Sunrise and their whole team.

reviews.author: Jay Toteno
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Sunrise Plumbing to anyone that is looking for a company that operates via honesty and integrity!!!! Raven was service professional that came out to my house and I am so thankful for him as I had what I thought was a little issue ended up being a two day repair issue with many obstacles to overcome!! Raven came up with a call to action plan and implemented it and after two full days of service, finally my toilet/plumbing is working like it should be!!

I also like to thank Mandy for her professionalism and kindness over the phone and assisting on making sure that all my needs and repairs got handled as well!!

This is a great company here and they have all star team and anytime I need any plumbing services they are my go to team forever!!

Thank you again Sunrise Plumbing!!

reviews.author: Sarah Lilly
reviews.text: Matt at Sunrise Plumbing was a lifesaver for us! We had a mysterious leak that appeared on New Year’s Day and we were having difficulty finding someone that could come out and look at it asap. Matt came within 30 minutes of calling and quickly diagnosed the issue as a pinhole leak in copper pipe. He was able to replace that section of pipe and resolve the issue within 2 hours. Extremely professional, affordable, didn’t charge extra for an emergency visit, and he cleaned up after the repair was made. I have had some not so great experiences with plumbers in the past, and I am SO relieved and grateful to have found a company that I can depend on.

reviews.author: LB
reviews.text:
My wife noticed our downstairs toilet was flushing slowly. I replaced the internal parts, but it didn’t help, so we called Sunrise Plumbing based on their consistently great reviews.

Raven arrived on time, asked a few questions, and checked under the house. We have a septic system with a grinder pump, and he quickly found the problem—a broken connection and failed float valve. He gave me a written estimate, and after doing some research, I found the price to be fair. Most importantly, I never felt like he was trying to take advantage of the situation.

He also suggested adding an alarm that would alert us if the float valve failed again, which showed he was thinking about preventing future problems—not just fixing the current one.

Raven is a veteran, and we had a great conversation. He’s professional, knowledgeable, and easy to work with. I would absolutely recommend Raven and Sunrise Plumbing.

reviews.author: Jessi Fenno
reviews.text:
We had a spigot break during the cold weather, and it ended up leaking inside our house. It was incredibly stressful, but this plumbing company responded quickly and handled everything professionally from start to finish. They diagnosed the problem right away, explained what needed to be done, and repaired it efficiently.

The technician was knowledgeable, courteous, and made sure everything was fully fixed before leaving. We really appreciated how quickly they were able to stop the leak and prevent further damage.

Highly recommend them for anyone needing reliable, responsive plumbing services—especially in an emergency!

plumbers.name: Izzy Plumbing
plumbers.address: 843 Via Esteban #4, San Luis Obispo, CA 93401, USA

reviews.author: Arla Negrete
reviews.text: Our customer toilet backed up. I called just before 9 AM and was told a technician would be out between 10 and 12 the same day. Anthony arrived just a few minutes after 10. He assessed the situation, offered me some different options, and he was done before 11. Problem was solved. He was on time for a last minute call, polite,  thorough,  knowledgeable about the possible cause and remedies, and he was fast. Will definitely call again for future plumbing issues. Thanks again.

reviews.author: Chris Dutton
reviews.text: The  salesmen showed up and started telling me he was going to sell me a $900 toilet when I wanted to only to reset. I showed  him where the crawl place space was and he wanted to charge me $540 to completely check it out. He didn’t want to do it himself. The other company I got a quote from did all the diagnostics for free. Finally I was going to have to split the bill with the neighbor in the condo above. He starts to tell me that was not going to be a good situation. Finally he tries to tell me for this brilliant sales person to come look at  our project was going to cost $85. Not unless you tell me up front. Wouldn’t use these guys  if they were the only plumber.

reviews.author: Thomas Worth
reviews.text: I was led to believe by another plumber I had to dig up my driveway to replace my water service pipe.  I wanted a second opinion so I had worked with Izzy Plumbing in the past and called them.  Izzy and Frank met me at my property on High St. in SLO with 3 1940 cottages.  One cottage was having water pressure problems.  Izzy asked if we had any plumbing work done recently.  I had a new hot water heater installed with new water values and hoses.  Izzy suggested we check the gate value that feeds the cottage.  Frank checked it and confirmed it was not open all the way thus reducing water pressure.  We had the tenant turn on his sink and flush the toilet and the pressure was great…problem solved!

reviews.author: Diana Gudino
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Izzy Plumbing! They were very responsive & helpful from start to finish. I had a mainline blockage & Anthony came out quickly & took care of it using a hydro jetter. The team was very professional & efficient. Great quality work, would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: William Nevins
reviews.text: Frank was great working with on our multiple tasks! We did notice some water , we believe, coming from the new sink drain. Will let you know if I can see any more leaking. But may not be a problem.

plumbers.name: Repipe Solutions Inc
plumbers.address: 21074 Brazos Dr, New Caney, TX 77357, USA

reviews.author: Ayse Gurpinar
reviews.text: I had an exceptional service from Repipe Solutions, Inc. The initial process talking to Cowboy, understanding the process was very useful. Then the team of guys came to my property. Cole, Adam, Chance & all the others were excellent. They not only knew what they were doing but also doing it fast & good. I not only had them repipe the whole house, but they also installed 2 water heaters as well as a Halo water purifying system. Their work was impeccable; the guys were extremely professional. I was so impressed to see young people like them. I thought they did not exist anymore. Thank God there are still some in TX. Their price was also better than any other plumbing company. I had 4 bids & Repipe Solutions, Inc was the best in every which way. I definitely recommend them. Don't even hesitate or think twice, if you need to repipe your house or replace or new of water heaters, or water purifying systems, anything plumbing just call them.

reviews.author: Kim P
reviews.text: It's been a year since the work was complete.  It was great peace of mind not to worry when we had our last freeze.  The work done on my 2 story house was very professional and done in a timely manner.  The workers were on time, informative/knowledgeable and helpful to me.  I had several quotes and I was sold on "Repipe" mainly because of the $$$, time allotted and presentation of seller.  He was very convincing.  Not sorry in the least!!  Highly recommend "Repipe Solutions"

reviews.author: Greg Canney
reviews.text:
We had our home re-piped starting January 12th 2026. All in all, we are very pleased with the results. From our initial meeting with Steven to the final maid service.
The re-pipe took a day. Sheetrock and paint took 2 days. They had over 60 repairs to be made. The guy did a great job matching paint and texture. On day four they sent a cleaning service who also did a great job. Lot of dusting and mopping.
We had one hiccup with our kitchen faucets water pressure. They sent their guy out a couple of times to try to fix it, but apparently some debris got up into the unserviceable part of the faucet. It was not a super big deal because the faucet has a lifetime warranty And we received a replacement within a week. Again, Repipe Solutions sent someone out and installed the new faucet.
We made this decision based on the fact that we've had multiple pipe breaks In the very old CPVC we had.
After 3 days of freezing temperatures, nothing froze. Had we not done this I'm sure our water would be turned off right now and we would be waiting for repairs to be done.
Feels good to have that stress off of our shoulders.
Go out and get you a couple of bids and then contact Repipe Solutions.

reviews.author: Albert
reviews.text: Repipe Solutions did and excellent job! My wife and I were pleased with the price and the professional service we received. All holes created were closed and paint matched to perfection. If some didn't point out to you where the hole were made you wouldn't know. We got all new water line and they removed/replaced the old galvanized pipe.

reviews.author: Brenda Lang
reviews.text: This was scary to me at first because the repairman had to cut through my Sheetrock but to my total amazement it was done so seamlessly. They pinpointed where each cut had to be made, they coordinated with each other as they ran the flexible pipes through the ceiling in the house, bathrooms and garage. They used insulated covers for all of the new pipes. It was just amazing to watch. They were very neat and respectful of furniture and appliances. The only hiccup was the day for having my Sheetrock replaced, the order wasn’t sent in. However,  they came and did an excellent job and passed all inspections.

plumbers.name: Ted's Plumbing

reviews.author: Wesley Grant
reviews.text: They were quick to respond to my message and arrived to give a quote the same day. They arrived the next business day with all necessary equipment and parts to complete the repairs.

They cleaned their mess up and collected payment and provided digital and paper receipt within the hour!!!! Reasonable Pricing and EXCEPTIONAL Professionalism !! 10/10 definitely recommend. Thank you all again.

reviews.author: Pam Long
reviews.text: Dobry and Gage were very polite and respectfull. They quickly assessed our shower faucet issue and were very quick and professional about getting it remedied.  I am very satisfied with their work.  Will call them again for any other plumbing issues in the future.
