reviews.author: David Garber
reviews.text:
When you have an irrigation leak that has flooded your crawl space, you're not exactly thriving. Firkus Plumbing was recommended by another Plumbing company who was too busy. I called. They scheduled me for the next day. They found the broken pipe. Fixed it. Explained that whomever landscaped the home was at fault. They were kind and patient, explaining everything in detail. They did the whole job in an hour. I just got the bill and was surprised that it wasn't higher. Firkus Plumbing is a great value and I highly recommend them.

If only I had known to call them and check the irrigation before this happened. Let this be a warning to all who read this. Landscapers are not licensed Plumbers. They do not have to build to code.

reviews.author: Denise
reviews.text: Firkus Plumbing  for my septic to sewer change and decommission of my septic tank was an outstanding business to  hire. They worked as fast as they possibly could to do a job like mine. Casey and Gage the 2 young men who were under my house were real troopers, who worked in that very confined space to hook every thing underneath the house  which was complicated buy a bathroom addition. Jason Firkus Gave me a "Cheat" sheet that made it easy to know exactly what permits I had to get. a great company and crew to work with

reviews.author: Rod Wimer
reviews.text: In November, I was belatedly advised by the City of Bend that I had a long duration leak.  After frantically searching my entire home, property, and adjoining properties, thankfully I did not find any evidence of leaked water.  Based on the strong referral of several friends, I contacted Firkus Plumbing.  Jonathan promptly came to our home and determined that the leak was likely in our service line.  While still onsite, he contacted American Leak Detection and scheduled a survey that confirmed the exact location of the leak in the service line.  Thereafter, Firkus mobilized their equipment, excavated to expose the leak and repaired it.  We were fortunate that the large volume of water leaked apparently went straight down deep and into the ground at the source, which is what Jonathan surmised on his original site visit.  At Jonathan’s strong recommendation, I had him install a Flo by Moen in line home leak detection apparatus, which continuously monitors our home for leaks and will automatically shut the water off if it detects one.  I would highly recommend Firkus Plumbing and gladly give them a 5-star rating for their expertise, promptness, courtesy, and follow-up!

reviews.author: CA O
reviews.text:
Great experience! Needed to hook up to city sewer and decommission old septic tank. Casey P and Gauge G did a terrific job, endured my unending questions, and left my yard looking well. Great communication. Very personable crew. Thanks guys.....would work with you again anytime!!!

Cheryl O.

reviews.author: Debra Pedersen
reviews.text:
We had a water leak between our upstairs master bathroom and our living room. Water was flowing out of our living room ceiling. We were connected to Firkus via an after hours emergency plumbing line.

Pros- the two workers they sent were kind and courteous.

Cons- everything else. I walked them through all the areas we discovered. They zoned in on a toilet that was not related to the leak. I questioned this as their theory did not make sense. An old rubber ring in the toilet could not lead to the level of water that was actively leaking from our living room. He said he knew it was the toilet because it was running. I pointed out that it was filling because the water had been shut off for 24 hours and was just turned back on. I was told that the plumber had “a plumbers ear and did not hear any water flow after replacing that ring”. They said it was all taken care of and left.

The issue was not resolved and the leak continued with further damage to my subfloors and tile in the bathroom. We then called a different plumbing company. That plumber discovered the issue within 5 minutes; a failed expansion tank on our water heater had caused the connection under our master vanity to break. He fixed both the tank and the lines under our vanity within 30 minutes.

We’re human, we don’t always get it right, but I really hope that Firkus invests in more training and education for their team so that no one else has to learn this the hard way. We are now working our way through a $30,000 restoration.

reviews.text: Thank You so much for the speedy, professional help with our drain. Keyshaun is a fantastic tradesman, and was able to repair our clogged drain in a very efficient amount of time. reviews.author: Annie W
reviews.text: We had two drains clogged and the drain doctor came out within 24 hours of our call. We were given no time range of when they would come and it was a complete surprise when they showed up (woke us up at 9am to the door knocking). The guy was helpful and nice, he unclogged the drains quickly. We were charged $195 per drain.

reviews.author: Carla Castellucci
reviews.text:
I had a very unprofessional experience with Drain Doctor.

I waited approximately two hours for the technician, Martin, to arrive. When he did, he walked directly into my home without showing any identification or introducing himself. I was handed a document to sign regarding potential pipe damage and was then told a higher price than I had originally been given, which appeared to be due to a lack of communication within the company regarding the original quote.

During the visit, the technician, Martin, repeatedly shouted “HELLO” whenever he needed something. Martin was not able to unclog the drain and had to leave to go to another job. I was told I would be contacted and another technician would be sent. Before leaving, Martin stated that I already had his personal phone number and suggested I contact him directly for future preventative drain work outside of Drain Doctor.

After he left, I observed a mess all over my kitchen floor and cabinets, scratches on our wood floor, and damage to the entrance of our home, which appeared to have been caused by his tools.

Since I was never contacted, I reached out to the company two days later, and spoke with a supervisor named Hector. He stated he had meant to contact me but something had come up. When trying to recount my experience, Hector was clearly laughing. He went on to accuse me of interrupting him; although he hadn’t allowed me the opportunity to explain what had happened without ridiculing me. When I told him he was being rude, he called me rude and said he didn’t want my business.

Based on this unprofessional experience, I would not recommend Drain Doctor.

reviews.author: Thalissa Sautai
reviews.text: Was sexually harassed by one of their drain techs in my own home right after he called me a “country bumpkin.” Wish I was making this up. When I called the manager to report him and asked what they were going to do about it he said “I’ll have a chat with him to get his side of the story.” So look out ladies! Safety is not a priority for their female customers. I suggest calling literally any other drain service so that a pervert doesn’t show up to your house and say things like “I want to taste you”

They sent the tech to wet vac my flooded cellar and offered no other help or compensation. Be careful when hiring this company!

I would absolutely hire Salisbury Plumbing again.

Brian called in minutes and made the call to come help us instead of leaving more work for the oncall after hours technician and going home early on a Friday.  Shows up and just gets right after it and even while answering questions and talking through everything.  Super professional and willing to talk through options moving forward with find a solution.
Great work and appreciate  the willingness to help.

reviews.author: Lindsey Richards
reviews.text: Honestly, we didn’t have the best experience, but the service was friendly.   The follow up afterwards  was very much appreciated and we would consider using Roto again, especially due to their quick response time.

reviews.author: Chris Sperry
reviews.text: They were on time, knowledgeable and did the job efficiently.   This is the 2nd time I’ve personally used them and both times I had an excellent experience.    The online scheduling experience is easy and very user friendly too.

reviews.author: Matt Hagin
reviews.text: Brian was professional and knowledgeable, he found two areas of concern and addressed them both.

reviews.author: Jenny Abegg
reviews.text: Bravo! I had an amazing experience with Roto-Rooter. I required their services over New Years they were very easy to reach despite the holiday—all the technicians were super great to communicate with and very kind. We ran into an issue with my crawl space opening being too small, and they were so reasonable with how they handled the visits and payment. I highly recommend Roto-Rooter—both customer service and their work was impressive!

plumbers.name: Zeh Plumbing Heating and Cooling
plumbers.address: 1157 W Main St, Waynesboro, VA 22980, USA

reviews.author: Linnea Leffler
reviews.text:
I interviewed 3 companies to replace my gas furnace, gas hot water heater and add a heat pump. The Zeh rep, Josh, seemed to me to be the most knowledgeable, farsighted, ethical and confident. Their quote was very reasonable.
Today they finished the work and I couldn't be more pleased. The crew worked nonstop while they were here, they were very polite, safety minded and gave generous time to review everything. They took cleaning up after themselves seriously. Zeh was recommended by a friend of mine, and I'm so glad that she did.

reviews.author: Will Lowrey
reviews.text: Our water heater crapped out and I called Zeh for help. They scheduled us for the very next day and Pat showed up right in the time window we were told. He was really pleasant and knowledgeable and I enjoyed speaking with him while he worked. Within a few hours, he had replaced our water heater in the crawlspace and we had hot water again. Great experience and Pat was awesome. Thanks, Zeh!

reviews.author: David Smith
reviews.text: Heat pump stopped working 12/26. Called and technician arrived about 2 hours later. I knew I was the second stop so no problem. He diagnosed problem and fixed it. I highly recommend them. Used them when I lived in the area before. Excellent work always.

reviews.author: eileen f
reviews.text: I only write reviews if something unexpectedly good or unexpectedly bad happens.  Happily, I am writing about a wonderful experience I had with Jennifer, Gene, and James from Zeh Plumbing in Waynesboro.  My heat went out on Thanksgiving evening – the start of a streak of the coldest temperatures of the season so far.  They were here the next day on a major holiday weekend.  Of course, everything was working perfectly when the experts showed up, but I was told to call again if the system failed.  Like I knew it would, fifteen minutes after Gene left, the system failed.  Jennifer dispatched Gene, who was back at my house within half an hour.  He was quickly able to diagnose and temporarily bypass the problem so I could have uninterrupted heat until a part could be ordered.  James came out this morning and made the final repair.  Everybody I dealt with couldn’t have been friendlier or more professional.  Thank you, Zeh!

reviews.author: D S
reviews.text:
Really professional work starting with Josh.    Josh reviewed my old system inside and out.  He came by twice that day, once to flip a switch under the house that the previous hvac guy doing an estimate turned off and left off by mistake.  Timing made it look like Josh may have flipped something, but he came back within an hour and showed me where the previous estimate had done this.  That showed me that Zeh would stand behind their work, even making sure that Josh did not cause the problem.

I dealt with Jen in the office and she was always really helpful getting questions to Josh as the job was getting closer.  Josh would get back within hours with an answer and Jen would relay.  Josh is definitely technical and knows hvac systems.

Brandon may have finalized the design but I was given 3 options, the best for this small place was the one chosen.  I had 4 good companies come and give me estimates.  I thought Zeh was competitive and they are local, which was high on priorities for this job.

Great, professional local company.  They completed the job over two days of steady, hard work.  Brandon came by on day one and had one guy with him I think.  Those guys did an amazing amount of work on day one.  Brandon showed up on day 2 and told me another crew would be finishing up the next day.  I wish I had the names of the guys on day 2, again, professional, hard working, detail oriented.  The system is very quiet, well done install.  My heating bills may have gone up slightly, my cooling bills are cut in half with the gold system.

All 4 companies that came to do estimates were good.  Zeh will not show up in matching coveralls with a logo, but they will show up ready to work and do a great job.  They did it for me.
It has been about 10 months since the system was installed.  NO issues at all, until I decided to replace the 6 month filter.  Newer, high efficiency systems, or at least my system requires a 4 inch, pleated filter replaced every 6 months.  You are going to pay up to 80 bucks a filter, but twice a year if you are following guidelines.  I like my hvac so I will be replacing it 2x a year.

Final reason why you should use Zeh. I climbed under my house a few weeks ago to replace my filter myself.  I ordered a new filter that Zeh gave me the name and number for my install so I ordered one to save a few bucks.  I crawled up under the house but  I removed the wrong panel to replace the filter.  I thought Zeh had forgotten to install a filter.  I did call back after watching a youtube video and said I think I am just stupid.  They said we are still coming and will take a look.  Gene came by and took my filter, quickly replaced it and showed me how it works.

So, quality work, competitive price, local business, excellent people, excellent service.  Get your estimates, but definitely try Zeh.

I give Zeh 5 stars.

plumbers.name: Top Tier Trades
plumbers.address: 410 Rosedale Ct, Warrenton, VA 20186, USA

reviews.author: Bill Drury
reviews.text: I highly recommend Top Tier Trades for plumbing work. They installed two new faucets and replaced a set of older shutoff valves in our home. I spoke with Dane to review the project, and he scheduled Ethan and Jonathan, who arrived on time and were friendly and professional throughout the job. They completed the work efficiently, tested everything thoroughly, and reviewed the finished work with us to make sure it was done correctly. The pricing was reasonable, and we are very pleased with the quality of their work. I would definitely use Top Tier Trades again and recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Kevin DeMoss
reviews.text: Excellent communication and professionalism!  Dane was great answering questions for me and working with me to set up a time that was convenient.  Toby came to my house for installation and communicated what was to be done and finished earlier than expected.  This is who you should trust!

reviews.author: John E. Burchell Jr.
reviews.text:
Water leak in downstairs plumbing.  Required repairs as well as inspection for other possible issues and cause.  Team Ethan and Jonatan were very knowledgeable and helpful.  Also gave us some good advice on prevention of problems given issues we had.

Very pleased.  Excellent work ethic.  Thank you.

reviews.author: Bridget Hussey

He installed a brand new toilet so quickly and did it with such professionalism, respect and kindness. His assistant Jimmy was also great. I truly enjoyed my experience with Rescue Plumbing and would recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Vanda Berman
reviews.text: Rescue Plumbing was amazing. We thought we had a leak in the building and they came out right away. Logan took the time to listen and talk us through all the possibilities and options available to us. He was very knowledgeable and respectful of our space.

reviews.author: Cat Amaro

The two guys (did not get their names as my husband was the main point of communication) were so kind, professional, fast, and efficient. Thank you!

reviews.author: Jeanne Steadman
reviews.text: I can highly recommend Craig at Rooterman! We had a serious plumbing issue of a burst  pipe because of the extreme cold and he went above and beyond! to fix everything. He worked so hard and was so professional, knowledgeable and kind! Craig is the best!

reviews.author: Lynne Brown
reviews.text: We have a great plumber who has taken care of our needs so well, but was out of town and no one was available with his group for an evening emergency. He recommended Rooter Man and we are very grateful he did.  Our building, with multiple renters, had 6 commodes stopped up.  Drake spent 2 hours climbing on the roof and unclogging those commodes.  He would not leave until he had flushed each of those commodes multiple times to be certain everything was working perfectly.  His patience, professionalism and determination were amazing and we greatly appreciate him solving our issue before anyone arrived for work this morning.  We highly recommend Rooter Man.

reviews.author: Devin Theobald
reviews.text: Had a leaking hose bib. Couple of appliances on their own field line. We wanted an additional hose bib added to our garden about 60’ from our home. Craig did an amazing job. We could not be happier. He replaced both hose bibs and older no freeze lines. He did an absolutely beautiful job on our hydrant at our garden. I know it’s just a hose pole, but it really adds to the farm/garden aesthetic of our small family farms Craig’s idea. And he was right. It’s better  in a freeze, and it looks and performs great. My little daughters love opening it up to weather the garden and chickens. Craig got the sink drain and clothes washer off their own field lines and tied to our septic. If it rained heavy, we could not run the dishwasher or clothes washer. Now we can. Craig always had a smile on his face. Was informed, confident, honest, and I felt like he really wanted to do a good job for us. Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: M.G. Sturm
reviews.text: I love this company, keep their number on speed dial, when plumbing needs arise. Be it for outside faucet needs, water lines to be extended for garden irrigation or inside when toilets leak, not flush or one needs help with new installation. They are wonderful, knowledgeable, quick, professional, and their rates are reasonable.

reviews.author: Heather
reviews.text: We’ve now used Terry’s services 3 times and are so grateful to have found a plumber who is honest and fair! He’s come out quickly, and been thorough and able to solve each issue that we have had. We greatly appreciate you Mr. Terry and will (and have) recommended you to all of our friends. Thank you!

reviews.author: Jason M Perez
reviews.text:
Terry was awesome.  He was professional, courteous and fair.

We had an issue with a toilet bubbling up when the shower would drain on the other side of the house and he immediately knew it was a venting issue and the places to look.  He explained how to fix it and charged a very reasonable amount.

It is so nice to have someone that has been in the trade their whole life and actually knows what he is talking about.  I recommend him to everyone!

reviews.author: Carrie Chatneuff
reviews.text: Our upstairs bathtub started leaking into the room below a few days before several house guests were due to arrive. Terry came over to look at it immediately, and returned the next day and fixed it. We are so appreciative! Terry was knowledgeable and friendly, and clearly explained the issue and what steps were required to fix the leak. We will certainly call Plumbing Central again. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Katsura E
reviews.text:
Update on 12/08/2023:
I have changed to one star and the reason is today our water line busted. It happened before back in July, and the new plumber told us it was because they used so called shark teeth connector under the ground. That part should be only used indoor! Now after 3 years, our water line began to break. This is ridiculous, I was wondering why suddenly they stopped answering my phone and email as well. Your action is not acceptable! First, you should know those shark teeth are not suitable for underground, second, you should not treat your customer like this.

Update: for some reason, since 2020, we can’t get in touch with this business. We called no answer, left VM but no follow up. Sent email but still no feedback. We don’t know what’s going on here. Very strange.

Original review:
I will give 10 stars to Kerrie if I could. We tried DIY but couldn't get the compression sleeve out from the pipe. Kerrie was busy with another customer for their sewer and came to our house after that. He looked tired but still promptly got the work done, because the valve I purchased was not the right one, he needed to go out to buy for me. The price is also very fair, my water line cost only half of my friend told me which he was charged. Today he did two pieces of work and the charge is less than quotation I got from another company this morning for one work. Notice there's difference between work hours and after work hours.

Please try to use his service. I always frank to no matter good ones or bad ones as you can see my other reviews.

reviews.text: I love the folks at Plumbing Central and I have personally referred a family member and a friend that have also have received exception service and treatment.  The owner, Terry Davies spoke to me on the phone politely and came out himself the same day as called each time and gave a free estimate for the projects.  Work was completed promptly as promised.  Honest, reliable, master workmanship and affordable.  I will use and recommend Plumbing Central again.

reviews.author: Jacob Simmons

Brian is very professional and honest in him communication with me. I hope to work with him in order to help solve some of his gaps in his operations.

With that being said, I would highly recommend anyone who needs plumbing services in the Wimauma area to reach out to Reedy Plumbing. I'm confident they will provide great service.

reviews.author: Beatrice Botbol
reviews.text:
Wish there was an option for below 1. They lie to the elderly, waist weeks of delay to an emergency situation and only come clean when asked for specifics. My elderly mother has had what started as a small leaks coming out of her driveway for the last 8 months, it is now more steady. After going back and forth with her association for 6 months she contacted Reedy directly to come look and fix the issue, even willing to pay for it directly. At the first appointment they stated she would need to hire a sonar company to determine the depth and what pipe is leaking. She hired Hydrascan and on October 29th they indicated it was the water main over 6 feet deep. Reedy stated to my mother they would file a claim with the county to be present upon work since it could be their issue. She called 2 weeks ago to see if the county had responded and if a date was set yet for work. The concern being if it's a main line it could explode and the continued erosion under her driveway that could cause a collapse. 2 weeks ago Reedy indicated they had not heard from the county but would follow up and contact her back. This morning, she contacted them again for an update but this time requested the application # filed with county so we could follow up directly. It was only then they admitted they had never filed anything with the county and "would not be able to do work due to extent of the project" WHAT!! Why have you waisted 6 weeks of valuable time and possible extreme danger to my Mother? I will be filing additional grievances regarding this incompetent company!

It won't allow me to respond to your review response. But ask Stacy in your office who refused to give me the contact information for the owner when I requested it 3 times. She just wanted me to email her.

I sent a contact request with my information on your site.

reviews.author: Michael Rush
reviews.text: I have had the pleasure of working with Reedy over the past 4 years and they are extremely professional and honest people. I look forward to working on more projects with them in my new home we just moved into. Keep up the great job!,,

reviews.author: Harold Swanson
reviews.text: Clint came by this afternoon and installed our carbon filter for the home. He was polite, knowledgeable, and patient. He explained everything to us, and made sure the job was complete with no leaks. Sandy is the office is equally as helpful. Thanks guys, great work.

reviews.author: Diane Cataldo

Reedy Plumbing exceeded our expectations and it is without hesitation we would recommend them for all your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Holly H
reviews.text: Saving Grace plumbing was an absolute pleasure to work with. They installed a new water heater for me, and the entire experience was smooth and stress-free. The team showed up on time walked me through what needed to be done, and handled the installation with professionalism and skill. Everything was installed neatly tested thoroughly and they made sure I understood how to operate the new system before they left, they were respectful of my home, cleaned up completely, and the pricing was fair for the level of service they delivered. If you’re looking for a trustworthy plumbing company, saving Grace plumbing is it I’m grateful for their excellent work and will not hesitate to call again for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: David Marsh
reviews.text: We had Timothy put in a filtration system for our house and couldn’t be happier. They showed up on time, everything was reasonably priced and looked great. You can tell they take pride in their work, Highly recommended if you’re looking for a great plumber who cares about what they do.

reviews.author: Derek Gammon
reviews.text:
We had an issue with our hot water heater today, and Saving Grace Company went *above and beyond*! Our old unit was over 20 years old, and it required a lot of extra work to remove the old one and install the new one — but he handled it with such professionalism and skill.

He came out the very same day we called, which speaks volumes about their customer service. He was kind, respectful, and explained everything clearly. You can tell he truly cares about the people he serves, not just the job.

The installation was done beautifully, and everything is working perfectly. We are so happy with the whole experience and extremely grateful for his quick response and excellent work.

If you need a trustworthy, efficient, and kind professional for your home repairs, **Saving Grace Company** is definitely the one to call! Highly recommend!

reviews.text: Highly recommend Saving Grace!  They took great care of me when installing and new hot water heater.  They were professional and came out the same day to install.  The techs worked hard and provided quality work.  I’m grateful.

Any of your plumbing needs make sure to use these guys they are highly recommended..

reviews.author: Joshua Hammon

While that wasn’t doable on a Sunday, he offered to cap the problematic water line so we could turn our water back on. He was in and out in 90 minutes and was reasonably priced. Also, Ben is super friendly and easy to talk to.

While I am submitting a claim through my insurance, I will keep Ben’s number for all future plumbing work. I highly recommend Save 2day and Ben!

Our house had a simple issue, a sink handle that would leak onto the counter. Diagnosing, replacing, and checking the sink's cartridge ended up taking 4 visits and costing over $800. We will contact them again for our future need.
Thanks much.
Andrew

They know their craft and will suggest multiple solutions if you are budget conscious.  They also have high integrity, and will not “sell” you work you don’t need.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Robert Santos
reviews.text:

And we were blessed that they sent Luis into our lives that day.  We'd tried others repair folks for similar issues, but Luis just made us feel super-comfortable with his knowledge, thoroughness, and professionalism.  We had a multi-day job, but Luis somehow made us feel at ease, explaining the problem, answering our questions, and just being upfront with us and how he wanted to get to the root of the problem.

Since that emergency, we've called on Shepherd's for HVAC duct work, pipe replacement.  And this week, Luis and Aaron came out and did a difficult kitchen faucet replacement, fixed leaking AC drain pipe, and installed an ice maker outlet box on an existing wall, flawlessly and quickly - so quickly, I barely had time to offer them water!

Thank you Shedherd's and THANK GOD for Luis!!!!

reviews.author: tom baird
reviews.text:
Plumbing Dudes did an excellent job re-piping our master bathroom and we’re very pleased with the results. The cost was reasonable, they completed the work within the timeframe they originally estimated, and everything has been working perfectly.
The foreman, Jason, was professional, knowledgeable, respectful, and consistently on time, which made a big difference during a project like a re-pipe. Based on our experience, I would confidently recommend Plumbing Dudes to anyone who needs plumbing or re-piping work done.

reviews.author: Joshua Vargyas
reviews.text: Found these guys while searching for plumbers near me in Burbank after our kitchen sink started gurgling like crazy. Arman was the one who came out and he actually took the time to show me how the previous homeowner had used the wrong size tailpiece which was catching all the debris. He did a great job cleaning out the pipes and even adjusted the bracket under the sink so it wouldn't rattle anymore. It is the little things like that that make a difference because most people just want to get in and out. I will definitely be calling back and asking for Arman if we have another clog.

reviews.author: Makena
reviews.text: Needed a water heater installation immediately. I did not have time to mess around with multiple quotes so I just went with these guys based on their high ratings. They got a technician out to my house within a few hours and he had the old tank swapped out before I even finished my afternoon meetings. The communication was clear and they sent me a text when they were on the way which made it easy to plan my day. Everything is working perfectly now and the area was left totally clean.

reviews.author: Charlotte Meier
reviews.text: I don’t have time to mess around with a kitchen sink that fills up every time I run the dishwasher for five minutes. The team was great at customer service and got someone out here for hydro jetting clogged drains before the weekend started. They explained how the high pressure water actually scours the grease off the pipe walls instead of just poking a temporary hole in the gunk. It was handled quickly and professionally without leaving a single drop of water on my floor.

reviews.author: Michelle J
reviews.text:
Arman was great. My outside pipe near the meter was spurting out water and it was getting worse by the day. I couldn't afford the major work needed to fix, thousands of dollars. These guys put their heads together, made multiple trips to secure materials needed for a righteous fix that saved me thousands of dollars literally. Solid professionals and great communication. Going forward, Plumbing Dudes
are my #1 choice. And they are local too.

reviews.author: Kenyatta Lucas
reviews.text: I have used Puzo twice and they have been exceptional and professional. Mr. Mung fixed my home’s leaking issue in the evening without hesitation and left me as the homeowner with a sense of peace. Recently I had a water heater expansion issue and and he fixed it within an hour and even had time to fix my garage disposal. I would definitely recommend Puzo Plumbing!!!

reviews.author: Troy Graves-Abe
reviews.text: Great plumber. reviews.author: claudie West

reviews.author: Desiree Christian
reviews.text: I had my sewer line professionally lined, and the whole plumbing service was as smooth and stress-free as possible. Leonard and the crew were quick to respond, kept me updated through each step, and explained the sewer repair process clearly. While the work was underway, the plumbers paid close attention to detail and were very respectful of our home and schedule. They wore gloves, removed their shoes, and made sure not to bring in dirt or leave marks on the walls. The sewer lining work was finished in a clean and professional way, and I was able to watch the camera inspection afterward to confirm the pipe looked right and was flowing properly. It was clear the team cared about doing the job correctly from start to finish. I would gladly recommend this plumbing service to anyone needing sewer line repair or pipe lining.

reviews.author: Ray Rocha
reviews.text: Roger responded fast to my first call and quickly figured out that the water heater needed to be replaced. He explained the plumbing issue clearly, shared helpful recommendations, and showed photos of similar installs so I knew what to expect from the new setup. We went over the options, pricing, warranty coverage, and all the details of the job, which made the whole process easy to understand. I was comfortable waiting until Monday for the installation because of how professional and thorough Roger was. On install day, Ernest came with him, and both did an excellent job. They handled the water heater installation smoothly, kept everything organized, and made sure the new tankless unit was up and running properly. They also took time to explain the work that was done and answered my questions. Very happy with the service and would highly recommend this plumbing team in Castle Rock.

reviews.author: Sarah Potts
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Lewis Brothers Plumbing & HVAC when we ran into two plumbing issues at home—a leaking kitchen faucet and a backed-up garbage disposal. Roger came out quickly both times, arriving right on schedule. He found the problems fast and took the time to explain everything he was doing, so we understood what was going wrong and how to keep it from happening again. Roger was professional, honest, and really knew his stuff. The prices were fair and reasonable, too. We were very happy with the quality of the work and would definitely recommend this company to anyone needing plumbing help around the house.

reviews.author: Sara Fernandez
reviews.text: Lewis Brothers Plumbing & HVAC is the best. I wanted to stop wasting money and water from a toilet tank that kept running, and the old toilet was well past its prime. After finding a special offer and talking through my options, I chose a great 2-for-1 deal and ended up with two brand new toilets installed. I am very happy with the whole experience. Derek and Ernest were professional, friendly, and patient with all of my questions. They explained the plumbing work clearly, handled the toilet replacement smoothly, and finished everything on time. The installation looked great, everything worked perfectly, and the area was left clean when the job was done. I would definitely recommend them for any plumbing repair or toilet install you need.

reviews.author: giovanni fields
reviews.text: i help manage the facilities for an outdoor education camp and retreat center in castle rock. one friday morning, my team and i found that the water heater in one of our buildings was leaking badly. we had clients arriving that weekend and the building was also booked for the whole next week. our usual plumber had retired, so we really felt stuck without a reliable option. after searching around, we noticed great reviews for a local plumbing company. their service went above and beyond what we expected. within 20 minutes of calling, derek from their team reached out and was able to come out the same day. derek was professional, straightforward, and made the process simple for us—couldn’t ask for a better experience. they even managed to install the new water heater the next day, which was amazing since i thought we’d be without hot water for several days. the quality of the plumbing work was top notch, and everything has been running smoothly since. so, if you’re in castle rock and need a plumber fast, don’t stress. these folks truly deliver great service. i would definitely call them again for any plumbing needs.

He took the time to make sure he completely diagnosed and solved our problem thoroughly; and for the first time in a long time, I feel like the problem has been truly solved. And furthermore, he taught me a lot about how the plumbing works on these old houses, and I feel much more confident in how to prevent and manage problems like these in the future. I highly recommend Marcus at Charge Plumbing and definitely plan on using his services again in the future - although hopefully I will be calling for just maintenance and preventive work rather than for an actual basement flood.

reviews.author: Todd Leister
reviews.text: I called and spoke with Kurtis about my main line backing up and let him know I had leakage around a toilet. I asked how fast he could come. He quickly arrived, let me know the price if it was a main line issue, and proceeded to fix the problem.  He was extremely polite and efficient.  I would definitely recommend him for any plumbing needs. He is also looking for a new flapper for me to help prevent this issue from reoccurring.  Glad I called him. Another City plumber I tried calling first had an AI person answer my call and schedule me initially.   Then a human called me back and said sorry, the AI is overbooking us, and we can’t get to you today.  Glad I didn’t have to deal with that with KDP. Will definitely be adding KDP to my contacts in my phone for future problems.

reviews.author: Summer Chen

I really appreciate Kurtis and Mike — they’re a great team: professional, efficient, and easy to work with.

reviews.author: Tim Aitken
reviews.text:

I will state they do warn you you are charged for their drive time, but in many cases like today we didn't have a choice cuz other companies were over booked or didn't see our situation as enough of an emergency, and we have no way of knowing how long they will take for even simple jobs.

I would not recommend this company.

reviews.text:
American Home Shield Home Warranty assigned Blue Ridge Mountain Plumbing to repair a faucet in my house. When the plumbers showed up they diagnosed the problem, and told me the faucet needed a trim kit replaced. Normally a $300 fee.

But the plumbers told American Home Shield that they could not diagnose the problem.

So American Home Shield denied the claim.

How can you diagnose the problem, and not be able to diagnose the problem, at the same time?

I called Blue Ridge Mountain Plumbing several times asking them to fix the error. They would not help me.

American Home Shield tried to call them multiple times, but they would not answer the phone or return calls.

So I initiated a 3-way call with American Home Shield and Blue Ridge Mointain Plumbing.  As soon as the Plumbing company associate realized American Home Shield was also on the call... CLICK... they hung up.

That's interesting...

Why did the plumbing company refuse to tell the warranty company about their error? Why would they refuse to even talk to them? Why wouldn't they talk to me?

HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE. JERKS.

If you don't want to do contract work for home warranty companies, then get off of their list of contractors.

Finally last week a friend of mine looked at my faucet, went to Lowe's, bought a $12 handle, installed it in five minutes, and now it works great! No trim kit needed after all.

It makes me sick when contractors take advantage of home owners' lack of knowledge and try to screw them over. Disgusting.
------
MY REPLY TO YOUR REPLY:
American Home Shield denied my claim BECAUSE YOU LIED AND TOLD THEM YOU COULD NOT DIAGNOSE THE PROBLEM.  You just admitted that it needed a trim kit, THAT IS A DIAGNOSIS. And as you read in my review,  I DID CALL the warranty company. But you WOULDN'T answer their calls. Why did you hang up when you realized they were on a 3-way call with us??? Answer those questions please.

reviews.author: Tywanna W
reviews.text: I just recommended them to a friend of mine and realized I wanted to give them a public review. He installed a shower for me in the 2000s. He and his son are very honest, very upfront with the pricing, friendly, thorough and most importantly honest. From the cost to when they say they will be there they are honest. reviews.author: Dale M
reviews.text: I wish I could give more than 5 stars for the plumbing service I received. My water heater started leaking and even caused some damage to the ceiling. I was worried because my attic is tough to reach, but Frederick and his team figured out a straightforward solution that saved me a lot of money compared to what another plumber suggested. The crew returned promptly to install the new water heater, and they were extremely professional and friendly. They took the time to explain everything they were doing and also replaced an old pipe that had just been patched up before. I’m very happy with the quality of work and highly recommend this plumbing team to anyone needing help with water heater issues or plumbing repairs.

reviews.author: Jorge Whitehead
reviews.text: After moving into my new house in Spring, I knew the plumbing needed an upgrade with new pipes. I reached out to Emergency Local Plumbing, and Jacob came out to give me an estimate. He was upfront, clear about the work that needed to be done, and made the whole process easy to understand. He told me how long it would take and what the price would be, with no surprises. Every day, the plumbers arrived right on time and got straight to work. They were professional, respectful of my home, and made sure to keep everything neat. I had my cat in a spare room, and they were very careful not to let her out, always checking with me if they needed to go in there. The job finished exactly when I was told it would, and the final bill matched the original quote. The quality of the pipe replacement was top-notch—I can't even see where they made any cuts in the walls. The crew cleaned up everything, taking away all the debris and leaving my house spotless. Overall, I highly recommend this team for any plumbing needs. They're honest, reliable, and do excellent work.

reviews.author: Sandra Kane
reviews.text: We had a great experience when we needed plumbing help in our home in Spring. We discovered a leak near our refrigerator, and even though the plumbing company was really busy, they managed to fit us into their schedule. Donovan, the plumber who came out, was very professional and quickly found the problem with the water line. He not only fixed the leak, but also installed two shut-off valves to help prevent any future issues. This was our first time using their plumbing services, and we were so impressed that we plan to call them again whenever we need a plumber.

reviews.author: Preston Fleming
reviews.text: When our water heater stopped working, we needed a plumber to install a new one. Our home is a bit older, and right away Clinton explained that a tankless water heater would be the best fit. He clearly walked us through the whole process over the phone, making it easy to understand what was needed. From that first call, I felt confident choosing Emergency Local Plumbing. Later, Donovan came by to check out our old water heater. He was very polite and respectful, and just like Clinton, took the time to make sure we understood everything step by step. It meant a lot that both plumbers were so thorough and made sure we were comfortable with the process. They not only matched the price we got from another plumber, but actually beat it, saving us a good amount of money. While other companies said it would take a while to get to us, Clinton and Donovan arranged to come out the very next day—even on a Saturday. They worked carefully and made sure the installation was done right. You can really tell they care about their work. Donovan answered all our questions and explained everything with a lot of pride. The whole job was done quickly, and we were extremely satisfied. I highly recommend this company to anyone in need of a plumber. One more thing: when they went to pick up the water heater from the store, it turned out the model we needed was out of stock. Instead of making us wait, they upgraded us to a better unit at no extra charge. That’s some of the best customer service I’ve seen. Overall, we were very happy with the experience.

reviews.author: aria alvarez
reviews.text: i've called emergency local plumbing a few times now for help with a leaking bathtub faucet, a water heater replacement, and a stubborn clogged drain. each visit, clinton showed up quickly and handled everything with real professionalism. he patiently explained my options and next steps in a way that made sense. i’ll be reaching out to them for any plumbing work in the future. the team is reliable, gives clear estimates, and always provides solid service at a fair price. i highly recommend them to anyone needing a trustworthy plumber!

reviews.author: Mandy Real
reviews.text:
I baught my 1956 house 10yrs ago. My goal was to resell before my roof or galvanized plumbing cost me a leg. Unfortunately, time was not on my side as I recently heard a drain leak under my house. I called several companies for an inspection/quote.
(Forgive me if I get your name wrong) REY was so honest, patient, trustworthy and informative with his recommendations. He took his time educating me as a homeowner with "do's and don'ts". He answered all my silly questions of "why's" and "what if's" and patiently put up with my indecisiveness. He even crawled under my house a second time to give me more options. Rey showed integrity and assured me my supply lines were ok. He showed me i have replaceable screens in my faucet-resolved my water pressure issues, lol. And He showed me pics of the holes in my drain pipes.
After weighing the pros & cons, i decided to replace all my drain pipes for peace of mind, not knowing when or where a new hole might develop.
I was so stressed with the economy right now with companies taking advantage of hard times and ridiculously upcharging customers... Not W.K.P., their pricing is VERY reasonable & fair!
I sleep so much better now knowing I got all new pipes and I didn't have to take out a loan for it. And I take comfort in knowing I know exactly who to call incase of a plumbing emergency. I will definitely be requesting Rey from WKP every time! THANK YOU WKP.

reviews.author: Dan Simon
reviews.text:
I do not recommend Avon Lake Plumbing after the experience I have had with them.

Avon Lake Plumbing won our business in December 2023 via a quote that was, at best, inadequately thought out. At worst, it was a bait and switch tactic. Specifically, they quoted us $5,000 all-in to fix a cracked pipe underneath our basement floor, repair a backwater (aka backflow) valve underneath our front porch, AND rough-in a basement bathroom. We eagerly scheduled this job as this was an extraordinarily competitive quote. What has transpired since then has been very unpleasant.

When the owner (Dennis) arrived with a large crew to start cutting into our floors and started camera-ing our sewer lines, the price started jumping up. Suddenly it would cost $4,500 to fix the cracked pipe, $6,000 to rough-in the bathroom, and $6,000 to install a new backwater valve. We called that project off and regrouped.

We decided to have Avon Lake Plumbing install a new backwater valve on our main sanitary sewer line in 2024. When we had questions during the process about whether our storm sewers were connected to the sanitary sewer, Dennis responded defensively but reassured us that he would camera the sewer lines ahead of time, that the sanitary sewers are separate from the storm sewer lines, and that "It will work exactly like it should and you won't flood".  When we asked about maintaining it, he told us it doesn’t need to be maintained as long as the flap is opening.

Another company camera-ed our sewer lines in late 2024 and noted the backwater valve was holding water. We contacted Dennis directly to lodge a warranty claim.  After finding out that there was an issue with the valve due to incompetent installation, Dennis stopped taking our calls. We have reached out to Avon Lake Plumbing countless times. We have called Dennis directly, and we are sent straight to voicemail every time.

Imagine our surprise on 7/29/2025 when water started coming into our (now finished) basement through the sanitary sewer lines during a heavy rain. This is the exact issue we paid Avon Lake Plumbing thousands of dollars to prevent, and which Dennis explicitly guaranteed would not happen.

If trying to call Dennis directly is bad, calling the Avon Lake Plumbing “office” isn’t any better since all the messages they take for Dennis seem to get lost and we never get a call back. The one time the office didn’t lose our message and Dennis promised he would come look at his faulty work, he never showed up! When we finally got through to him, Dennis offered many explanations and after-the-fact disclaimers for why his plumbing work is subpar (none of which were mentioned before he accepted our thousands of dollars).

The most alarming of his disclaimers was that a downspout might be tied into our sanitary sewer line. Such a suggestion on his part exposes his lack of adequate diligence, including a lack of proper dye testing and camera inspection prior to installation. His offering of this excuse amounts to an admission of negligence on his part for installing a backwater valve on a sanitary sewer line without doing an adequate inspection. Completely unacceptable business practices by Avon Lake Plumbing. There were other excuses offered...but the reality is that Avon Lake Plumbing installed a faulty backflow valve and happily accepted over $5,000 for below average work and are not willing to do anything to make it right. Stay away!

Prior to posting this review, I shared these points with Avon Lake plumbing and asked them for satisfactory resolution. That has yet to occur.

Speaking of reviews, please note that as of 8/1/2025, one of the five star reviews on this business is from the Avon Lake Plumbing office manager (it uses their actual name). Several of the other five star reviews also appear to be fake. The other negative reviews more closely align with my experience- the surliness, lack of professionalism, the "it's your fault" attitude. Please think twice before engaging with this organization.

reviews.author: Richard Novak
reviews.text: Beaverton Plumbing installed our new kitchen faucet. A week later it came loose from the counter  BP came back and tightened it. A week later it came loose again. Also found that the faucet was attached to the quartz counter top which was flat. He got it tightened in 15 minutes.

reviews.author: Ed Snajder
reviews.text:
We have been using Beaverton plumbing for years, they were always the fastest, fairly priced, most professional and thorough shop we've worked with. We've called them for all kinds of jobs, fixing valves, leaks, replacing water heaters etc. A couple of years ago when fixing a leaky valve, they warned us our galvanized plumbing was just about at the end of its life. Sure enough, this year was the year that we needed to have everything replaced.

We called Derek, he came over to look at everything, and turned around a competitive quote very quickly. We decided that since we were already replacing all of the water, this would be a good time to also replace some of the old bathroom parts, and we worked with his supplier and got everything scheduled and ordered.

The galvanized water replacement was first, the team was, as always, super polite, professional, and wouldn't hesitate to stop and discuss what they were up to. You can stay in the house while they are working (but it is quite loud sometimes), and they turned the water back on before leaving daily so we were never without running water for more than a few hours. They planned  out the project so there was always one working bathroom and shower. Once the galvanized piping was replaced, the delight was immediate - great water pressure, the water tasted 100X better, and, of course, no leaks!

In retrospect it totally makes sense, but at the time, I was surprised at the amount of holes in the walls as a result of removing all of the bath stuff and piping in the house, and was wondering if I should have gone with GC to coordinate everything. Fortunately, Derek knows a lot of skilled people, and he set me up with a sheetrock expert, where in the end, the repaired areas look better than than it did originally.

After getting through the water replacement and going into the bathroom upgrades, we hit a delay with one of the bath parts that would have set the project back quite a bit. Derek, again, was on the ball, and went over several options with us, ultimately guiding us to working with NW Total Home on bathroom tiles over the fiberglass insert that was on delay. I couldn't be happier with this move, the bathroom looks fantastic. Derek was super thoughtful about his advice, shared what he did with his bathroom, and gave me a couple of options for shops to work with. While this switch did delay the scheduling a bit, Derek and his team were super flexible and worked around the scheduling dates of the other contractors. As soon as a contractor finished, his crew would be in the next morning.

His crew must like working there, there were guys that came in that had worked on some of our galvanized issues years before. They were a pleasure to have in the house, and would stop and discuss options to make sure everything was perfect for us. Little things, like adjusting the shower head height, or the best place to relocate the toilet (we had to move it over from the shower to be code compliant). They would share pros and cons, and tell you how they would do it in their own home. They would give us a heads up via text when they were on their way. When "old house" stuff came up as they removed the old bathroom parts (like weak subflooring), they did the extra and made everything better than they found it.

I thought needing our roof replaced was a big job, but that was Little League compared to replacing all of the water in your house. Beaverton Plumbing AKA New System knows their stuff. I would absolutely use them again, though, I don't feel like I am going to have any water problems for quite a while, I might just need to invite them to BBQs.

reviews.author: Renae Strong
reviews.text:
It was my experience with this company that unless you enjoy being lied to and scammed you should call an honest plumbing company.
I was quoted $225  an hour for my kitchen faucet to be replaced and that it wouldn’t take more than an hour. The plumber (Ben) arrived on time at 9am but spent 15 minutes in the back of his van rearranging it. Little did I know I was being charged for this time. He didn’t being the work until 9:15. He was finished by 10:00. He then told me that he needed to write out my receipt in the van, he did not come out the van until 10:30. ( I thought he was eating some lunch or something). He then charged me an additional $176.00 for the extra half an hour that he spent “writing out the receipt” which should have taken him 2 minutes. He said he worked from 9-10:30. In reality he worked 45 minutes.
I can’t think of a more blatant scheme. I then spoke with the owner and he straight out told me I was lying when I sat on my front porch and watched Ben dilly dally in his van. Had I known that I was being charged $176 for this I would’ve definitely approached him and asked what was taking so long. Be aware. This is a very low game they play.
.

reviews.author: Bridget M
reviews.text: *AVOID* Cost me thousands of dollars because they did not want to do the job assigned by my home warranty company, American Home Shield. MacLin Plumbing CO. was assigned to my service ticket regarding my leaking hot water tank. As many Texas residents, my gas water tank is in the attic. When MacLin came to look at the tank, they told me that due to Texas regulations, they needed 25 in. clearance to get the new tank up in the attic, my clearance was only around 24 in., so I would need to provide the clearance in order for them to complete the job. They told me they do not provide access and my only other option would be a tankless water heater, which would not be covered by the warranty and cost thousands more. As a first time home owner that knows nothing about this stuff, I trusted that the plumber would have the experience with attic tanks to advise me honestly on my options. When I proposed if I could remove the attic stairs myself, which would give the necessary 25" clearance, he refused, and said it would not be safe for his men. Foolishly, I took his word that this was my only option, and agreed to their service provided I gave them 25" access. After consulting multiple people, and two plumbing companies about this, I not only realized it would be structurally impossible to carve out the clearance MacLin supposedly needed to complete the job, but also both plumbers told me their team would simply remove the pieces of wood trim to give enough clearance to complete the job. I was pressured to sign the service contract on the spot, then after getting my second opinions, AHS refused to allow me to reassign a new plumber to the service ticket, my only option was a cash out for far less than it would now cost me to replace out of pocket. A neighbor recommended Proven Plumbing. I called at 8:30am on a Friday, they showed up within an hour, & returned to do the job on Monday. They had NO problem cutting the wood trim to make enough clearance for the tank, even replacing it after the job was completed. I HIGHLY recommend using Proven Pluming for your water heater needs, especially if it is in the attic.

reviews.author: angelin abraham
reviews.text: I just had a simple service from them through my home insurance company. My plumber, Jerry Hamlin was early, quick, quiet, clean and considerate to wear shoe covers and not mess up my floors. He was also kind enough to give me some advice for future repairs. Never had a bad experience with this company!

reviews.author: Christina Dienner
reviews.text:
I had a very troubling experience with this plumbing service. A plumber came to our house on a Friday to address an issue covered by our homeowner’s insurance. He identified the problem and said a crew would return on Monday. I didn’t sign any paperwork at that time, and despite asking him to call my husband for approval, no call was made. My husband left multiple messages that Friday during business hours and no one from the office followed up with him.

On Monday, a crew arrived, completed the work, and left without any paperwork or prior communication. Later, the plumber contacted my husband demanding payment, but we requested the paperwork first to ensure insurance coverage. The plumber agreed but still did not provide the necessary documents.

Things escalated when the plumber showed up at our house unannounced, banging aggressively on the door for ten minutes while I was home alone with my children. Feeling threatened, I called my husband. He spoke to the plumber, who then threatened him over the phone stating “he better pay or else”. He stayed on our property for 45 minutes.

My husband contacted the office, which stated that this behavior was unacceptable and that the owner would follow up. However, we never received any communication from the owner.

The unprofessional and aggressive conduct was deeply distressing. If you value respectful and transparent service, I would strongly recommend looking elsewhere.

reviews.author: Cari G.
reviews.text:
A plumber came to my home WED, saw the drywall damage in the ceiling that’s coming from the upstairs bath; plumber goes upstairs to the bath, sees a saturated bath mat, tells me it’s a sloppy shower and leaves. He doesn’t even cut into the drywall to see if there is the possibility of a plumbing leak.
THURS I pay to get the drywall cut out and mold is discovered - too much mold to be caused by a ‘sloppy shower.’ This has been growing over time and we’ve only been in this home 4 weeks. Contractor says he has never met a plumber that didn’t cut drywall to see what’s going on behind it.
Today/FRI, I called my home warranty company (AHS) to find out the status of Maclin coming back and finding the leak only to discover Maclin has cancelled the follow up service call. I’m so frustrated I don’t want another Maclin employee in my home. AHS has found a different plumbing company for me.🤞

reviews.author: Uma Shankar Yadlapati
reviews.text: My warranty company sent MacLin Plumbing to address an issue with my water heater. Matt from MacLin Plumbing arrived the next day, right on time. He was professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. He replaced a part on one water heater and adjusted the connections on the second one. Matt also provided helpful advice on what to look for in the future. Overall, it was a five-star service!

plumbers.name: Goode Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2216 Lee St, Evanston, IL 60202, USA

reviews.author: Rafael Flores
reviews.text: I recently had my tankless water heater replaced and was very impressed with the entire experience. John Lackemacher, my main plumber contact, took the time to answer all my questions and worked with me to ensure the project stayed within budget. He was attentive to my concerns and helped put my mind at ease throughout the process. The plumbers on site were professional, courteous, and able to clearly explain each step, providing helpful details along the way. They performed custom work tailored to my specific setup and executed it flawlessly. The attached warranty gives me great confidence in the installation, which is especially important as I have tenants. Highly recommended for their professionalism, skill, and customer service.

reviews.author: Blooming Properties
reviews.text: Francisco was great and was very determined to get rid of a tough clog which he did and cleaned up well afterwards.  He was on time and had a great demeanor.  Plumbing companies need to be more transparent with their pricing especially when you ask about a specific service over the phone.

reviews.author: Vanessa Sanchez
reviews.text: Jon H was great! He did an amazing job explaining what was going on (I have no clue about anything plumbing). I highly recommend him for all plumbing services and will be contacting him again in the future if needed! Thank you.

reviews.author: Pamela McKenzie
reviews.text: This is my second time working with Goode Plumbing and all three technicians were great. This was also my second time working with Nick, and he is the best. I really appreciated that he patiently explained everything to me, answered all my questions (sometimes more than once!), until I clearly understood all of my options. I also appreciated that he gave me multiple quotes at different price points, so I could make an educated decision about investing more upfront, or putting off some work until later. The day after the shower repair, I had a general contractor patch up the wall and install an access panel, per Nick's recommendation. Even the GC said "they did really good work". I hope I don't need them for a good long while, but I will be calling Goode for my next plumbing need.

reviews.author: Charles Rose
reviews.text: We requested a service call on Monday morning and a technician called us before noon. He came, routed the pipe, cleaned up and was gone in an hour. Frank , our technician, was very professional and informative. Would recommend him and Goode to everyone.

Pedro identified the problem and provided me with multiple solutions for me to choose from to fit our budget and timeframe. I opted to have him replace our faucet this evening, and he and his supervisor, Hector, worked to get us a replacement faucet in an even better brand to ensure longevity. Pedro replaced the faucet, cleaned the area thoroughly for me, and was done in less than an hour and half from his arrival! All while I fed, bathed, and put two toddlers to bed. Total lifesaver. Thank you Pedro and team for taking excellent care of our home and family this evening. It is so appreciated.

reviews.author: Alexander Odum
reviews.text: We reached out to Gurrero Plumbing because of the good reviews and we see why now. Pedro was very quick and professional. He even took time explaining everything clearly and concisely. 👍

reviews.text: Guerrero Plumbing is the only plumber I will call. I have used their services twice: Once for a leak in the feed to the laundry sink and once for a leak in the shower. They always make high-quality repairs. They are honest, reliable, efficient, a great value.

reviews.author: John Pritchett
reviews.text: I may have posted only 1 or 2 reviews for various services over the years, but my wife and I felt this one was well deserving of mention. a big thumbs up for Rodrigo and the Rooter Man Plumbing service for turning a nightmare sewer drain situation into a successful, minimally invasive project to give us peace of mind for years to come. In a time when many services will charge a fee for just showing up or giving a quote, or using special equipment, Rooter Man did all of that free of charge and showed me the problem areas inside our plumbing, using live video and gave us a comprehensive plan with options so we could deal with the critical issues first and save the less pressing ones for a later date. These guys had to work in a very tight space in order to avoid destroying both landscaping and hardscape in the front of our home and took great care to keep it all intact and put it back the way it looked before they arrived. We are very happy with their work and will recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Rachel Workman
reviews.text: Chad was seriously awesome. Very helpful and knowledgeable. You can tell he was filled with expertise and was very customer oriented. I appreciated all of his hard work!!! Thank you for helping us out. It was quick and easy.

I will definitely use him again in the future.

Honest good work to the entire staff at Hines Plumbing.  I recommend then for your plumbing needs and wants for an honest price.

reviews.author: Melissa Griswold
reviews.text: We hired Hines plumbing to finish our basement. They were easy to schedule, showed up on time, worked efficiently and were professional. I also hired them to clean out the tankless water heater. They do a great job, Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Julie Sopata
reviews.text:
I needed a rough in done for a commercial business.  Matt was professional,  focused, did the work in a timely fashion, and had great suggestions for my ADA restroom!

I'd give 10 stars if I could!  Thanks Matt!  Great job!

reviews.author: Tracy Perry
reviews.text: How many ways can I say "thank you" to Jack and Sam?!  In the middle of the night our main water pipe burst and city had to turn off our water.  Jack and Sam came early morning to help assess situation and recommended a restoration company to begin damage assessment and repair.  Once that was done, they came back in the afternoon, fixed the pipe and waited for the city to come turn the water back on to be sure all was well.  They didn't leave until they knew the job was good and our pipe was secure and we were safe from another flooding disaster in our crawl space.  They were both so kind, thoughtful, good-natured and knowledgeable  - I will absolutely recommend Hines Plumbing to anyone needing a fantastic plumbing company and while I hope not to need them again in this type of situation, I absolutely will call on them in the future for any updates/remodels, etc.  Thank you so very much, Jack and Sam!

reviews.author: Pat McBride
reviews.text: I heard noises coming from my outside well. My usual plumber wasn't responding to calls. I called Barber Plumbing, they sent someone out and they discovered the issue immediately. They discussed the problem and cost with me before arranging to dig the pump out for repair. They dealt with all the rocks around, did the repairs on the pump and refilled the area they dug up. I don't remember the cost, but Barber Plumbing was quick to assess, repair and restore. Awesome company, very professional and upfront with work to be done. I plan to use them again. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Lesly roberts
reviews.text: I had a frozen pipe which split.  I had water pouring into my family room from the ceiling.  I called Barber Plumbing and Jordan was over within 3 hours.  He added a shut off valve to stop the water and we could still have water in the rest of the house.  He cleaned the mess from the ceiling collapse.  He will be back to reroute the plumbing so we won't have this problem again.  Barber Plumbing is the only company we will use.  They do great work at a great price.  They are knowledgeable, friendly, clean and reliable.

reviews.author: Pat Cook
reviews.text: Jordan services my heat pump twice a year.  I find him to be professional, thorough, and very personable.  I’ve never used them for plumbing needs but would if needed.  I highly recommend this family run company.

reviews.author: Matt Snyder
reviews.text: Barber Plumbing does quality work at a reasonable price.  They communicate the workplan and keep you informed of what they are doing and why.  I recommend them to friends.

reviews.author: John Clayton
reviews.text: Jordan Barber does a great job. The job is done correctly the first time around! Not only is he and his brother quick to be at your service, but the prices are unbelievable too. I wouldn’t recommend anyone else for your HVAC and Plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Julie Anne Pipke
reviews.text: They came out same day I called, got the job done and cleaned everything up, I was very pleased as always when I have called them for a job. These days you don't know what to expect from a cost perspective, so I was pleased when he handed me the bill. No it wasn't free, but less than I had imagined. The man was friendly and got things done without any problems. This business has ALWAYS come through for me and everyone I have sent their way.

reviews.author: Caitlin Gonzalez
reviews.text: Dave and his crew were fabulous to work with! From our initial call for help all the way to the end the entire team was responsive, timely, respectful and kind. They cleaned up and answered all of our questions! We could not have asked for a better experience for our unfortunate situation.

reviews.author: Jason Stenglein
reviews.text: Had a significant "plug" somewhere in my condo.  Ryan was so diligent and so thorough in resolving the problem; very impressive.  Had 2 other upcoming jobs and he took the time to explain all my options.  Just a terrific company that's quite obviously very well managed.

reviews.author: Laura Mouradian
reviews.text:
***UPDATE- DRY BASEMENT DURING MKE FLOOD OF AUG 2025***

Went above and beyond REPLACING my entire sewer line last fall from the middle of Cleveland Ave to my house. They also installed a sump pump and replaced my main floor drain. The guys were very respectful and kept me up-to-date on what was going on each day. I’m very thankful they cared about making sure it was done well and done right. Not just done. *MMSD does offer grants which helped pay for a portion of this due to me having a Palmer valve they could seal off; however, this grant was 100% taxable and I owed quite a bit at tax time. Wagner did warn me about this.

reviews.author: Me4623
reviews.text:
I had a damaged sewer line and these guys are the absolute experts!!  And at a reasonable price!!

I had a sewer backup during Christmas and another local plumber totally lied and took advantage of me by charging my 3x the going rate.  During that evaluation, it was revealed that my sewer line was broken.  There was no way I was going to hire those crooks!!  A 2nd plumber came out, looked at the break, and sent me a contract to charge me $23,000 to fix the crack!!  Are you freakin' kidding me!!!??   How stupid do you think I am!!!

So I searched around and found Gene Wagner Plumbing who has been in business for 60 years. I ended up hiring them.  They worked with my city to get permits, called the utility company to flag out the lines, and then showed up promptly at 8:00 AM on the day of work.  I told the 3 guys that I was really jittery about this since they were going to rip up my lawn, they had to dig 10' down to get to the sewer line....very stressful!!  They reassured me that they do this every day and they would take good care of me.  And they did!! They know what they are doing.  Very efficient.  Their price was very reasonable considering the huge equipment they had to use and the hours they put in.

On Day 2 the city inspector reviewed the hookup and give the OK that the work had been done correctly.  The supervisor took photos of the sewer line hookup and sent them to me as documentation.  They filled up the hole....and amazingly the hole was only 3.5 ft wide which was very narrow considering what they were doing - it shows they know how to do this type of work.  They did a very good job of cleaning up before they left.

Other neighbors gave reviews whining that their fees are excessive which included travel time.  No, neighbors, their rates aren't unreasonable - I've been the victim of crooked plumbers who charged huge fees.  Plumbers are expensive.  Get over it!!  Gene Wagner charged me a reasonable fee and they did a great job.

reviews.author: Kim S
reviews.text: Tony did a great job replacing our old faucets along with repairing the lines and installing new shut-off valves. He was friendly and professional, arriving on time and immediately focusing on the repairs. Thanks Tony!

reviews.author: Jimmy Thomas
reviews.text: This is the first time I’ve had a very positive experience with a plumber, taking the time to explain the problem, first of all, assessing the problem clearly and rectify the problem. I was able to get service the same day, as a matter of fact, within three hours of making the call I was able to get service and my problem was rectified. Tony was very respectful of My Home. Making sure he did not track debris and dirt into my house. Made sure the area that he was working in was covered. Actually cleaned up after he was finished. Tony showed me where there is an existing issue that will cause a problem in the long-term if we don’t get it repaired. Very positive experience, highly, highly recommended. We will be using them again.

reviews.author: Janet Griffin
reviews.text:
I had an emergency. I had a leak of my main water valve. As the evening went on it got worse, the leak turned into spraying off and on. My carpet was getting wet, the water was running down my wall.
I called several so called emergency companies, but to know avail. Even Constellation Home where I have a plumbing and electrical  warranty. They couldn't come until the next day. So, I called HOSANNA Plumbing, basically the last phone number I had. After I explain the situation, Tony said he would come out.
He asset the situation and told me what he needed to do and how long it would take to fix the leak. The leak got fixed and my piece of mind was restored.
Tony was very professional  and amicable. I really appreciated his willingness to come out so late.
As far as the cost of the job, everything these days are expensive to me. But, that was probably the cost. It took him 2 hours to complete the job.
I have already told several people, if they need a plumber, especially in emergency situation, to call Tony of HOSANNA PLUMBING.
Thank you Tony for coming out. I appreciate you!

.

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Hosanna Plumbing & Drain LLC. Tony fixed a leaking bathtub pipe that was causing major damage in my home, with water leaking through the wall. He quickly identified the issue as a damaged copper pipe and fixed it efficiently. I was very impressed with his knowledge, professionalism, and how quickly he solved the problem. Tony was respectful, took great care of my property, and clearly cares about his work and delivering quality results. I highly recommend him and the business.

reviews.author: Lindsay Evans
reviews.text: Excellent service and price. Tony will be my first choice for any future plumbing jobs. He and his partner came out the same day to snake out two backed up drains.
