I cannot recommend them enough.  I will always use them for my plumbing needs in Lampasas.

reviews.author: Tami Hurst
reviews.text: We had a plumbing leak and John at McCarther Plumbing came out right away and got straight to work. He was knowledgeable, efficient, and worked diligently until the issue was fully resolved—even staying into the evening to make sure it was done right. His pricing was very reasonable, and his professionalism really stood out. We truly appreciated his dedication and would absolutely recommend McCarther Plumbing to anyone needing reliable plumbing service.

reviews.author: Shelly Denning
reviews.text: I am the Treasurer of the School Creek Baptist Church in Lampasas, TX.  We have used McCarther Plumbing a few times for our plumbing needs, and they have ALWAYS done a fantastic job!!!  Very reasonable and professional.  I would definitely recommend them to everyone!!

reviews.author: Jenne Mendiola
reviews.text: Eric and Aiden came today to look at my toilet.  Eric was recommended to me by my contractor. Eric is very professional and he was knowledgeable in all the plumbing issues I had. He took the time to make sure each issue was fixed correctly. I will definitely be calling them again for more plumbing projects. I feel like they are trustworthy, honest and professionally ethical. I will be recommending them to everyone I know.

reviews.author: Mitzi Hebert
reviews.text: We had a plumbing issue on Christmas Eve and called for service.  The young man came out and fixed our issue within 30 minutes.  He was very polite and professional.  We will definitely use them again.

plumbers.name: Matthews Plumbing Service
plumbers.address: 195 E Stearns Rd, Bartlett, IL 60103, USA

reviews.author: Alex & Jen Galuszka
reviews.text:
I recently had Matt from Matthews Plumbing Service out to help with my ejector pump, and I couldn’t be more impressed. It’s rare to find someone who combines expert knowledge with such a genuine, personable approach. He clearly knew exactly what he was doing, diagnosing the problem quickly and explaining the fix in a way that made total sense. Matt stands by  his products and his work.
What really stood out, was the service he was punctual, professional, and thorough. Beyond the technical work, we had a great conversation while he was here; he’s just a truly kind, down-to-earth, and decent person who takes pride in his craft. It’s a relief to find a plumber you can trust both for their skills and their character. Matt will be the only plumber I will be calling and recommending to family.

reviews.author: Dan T
reviews.text: I was doing laundry last night when my sewer backed up filling my laundry room floor. I called Matthews Plumbing this morning, Bryan was fantastic to deal with trying to get somebody out to my house today. Matt came out this afternoon. He also was great, explained to me my options, and what he had found when he was done. Both guys really seemed to care and explained everything. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Allyson Rinchiuso
reviews.text: Matt was extremely prompt and professional. He arrived on time, was able quickly identify the leak in our upstairs plumbing and fixed it right away. His prices were extremely reasonable. Very happy with the service. We would use this company again.

reviews.author: Ned Mansour
reviews.text:
Amazing service and great Company all around.  I had the opportunity to work with Mathew directly.  He came immediately to trouble shoot my tankless water heater - 1 day later he installed a new Navien S2 - and we are very happy customers.

- excellent pricing
- very professional and friendly
- took time and cared for home like it was his own
- would recommend 100% 5 star

Thank you again!

reviews.author: Chris Roberts
reviews.text:
Matt did a great job for us. We initially called for help fixing a leaky faucet. After taking a look, Matt recommended a replacement rather than a repair and gave us great info to make our decision — but never pressured us to go one route vs the other. The work was done quickly with zero mess to clean up after Matt was finished. The price was very reasonable, too…less than we would have paid for installation from Lowe’s or Home Depot and we feel the work is much better.

We prefer to hire local businesses so we are thrilled to have found someone local that we can trust. We will definitely use Matthews again and will recommend them to our friends and family.

plumbers.name: ABC Plumbing, Sewer, Heating, Cooling & Electric
plumbers.address: 1544 45th St #1c, Munster, IN 46321, USA

reviews.author: LaTonya Woodfaulk
reviews.text: Tony was very professional and did a fabulous job. He went above and beyond to make sure everything was working on my furnace. He told me the year that it was made. He also checked my AC unit and told me a year that that was made and made me feel very comfortable with everything that he did. He’s a wonderful technician & he’s very passionate and caring about the work that he’s doing which makes a big difference. I would like to recommend him to anyone that’s getting service done or a tuneup. Also, I want him to return to do all my other tune ups & maintenance in the future. I can’t thank him enough!

reviews.author: Pamela Johnson
reviews.text: Mr. Jesse Yeargain was the ultimate technician. He was pleasant. He was smart and knowledgeable. He was so very accommodating.  He took time to explain the issues to me and my family members. Showed us the different parts that Were not working and why. Carefully made sure the heat vents were prepared for the work to be  done to prevent further damage. Jesse was prompt and constantly answered all of my concerns and questions. I joined the ABC CLUB per my request. For my family being in a house with no heat for almost two weeks, we were very happy with Jesse's demeanor and understanding of our dilemma.  His knowledge of a boiler was so grateful to us since so many other companies I had called didn't work on boilers. We were need help and he delivered it with no problem. Going above and beyond to give us his expertise immediately.  Mr. Jesse Yeargain was a blessing for our family in trouble. I pray if we ever need any future assistance we will get another technician with a heart for the job and the customer. He is amazing. Thank you ABC.

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.text: Extremely helpful and knowledgeable. Diagnosed problem quickly and accurately. Scheduling the appointment was easy and fast same day. My technician was very professional, personable, and explained things clearly. This was my first time with ABC, I was skeptical but know I will use them again in the future.

reviews.author: Carrie Portis
reviews.text: Mr. Tyrell and Mr. Reigus was very polite and explained everything in detail. Didnt rush through visit without explaining everything. Recommended different options and explained about those in detail. Explained why getting  certain things done were better overall.  Made sure to keep floor clean. Great customer service. Showed me everything not just talked about issues. Would recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Wally Budzielek
reviews.text: Aiden Moran, our technician, was one of the most polite, courteous and professional individuals we’ve had the pleasure of dealing with.  He pinpointed the problem immediately and made absolutely certain it was repaired correctly before he left.  You have a real gem of an employee with Aiden and hope you take good care of him.  Aiden is the definition of customer service satisfaction!

plumbers.name: Gaithersburg Plumbing Pros
plumbers.address: 30 Orchard Dr, Gaithersburg, MD 20878, USA

reviews.author: Jessica R.
reviews.text: We were extremely pleased with the top-notch service we received from Gaithersburg Plumbing Pros, particularly thanks to Berto's reliable and friendly demeanor, as well as Christopher's expert handling of the toilet replacement, which included installation of a new flange and shut off valve. From scheduling to completion, the whole experience was seamless, timely, and professional, leaving us feeling confident in the team's ability to tackle any emerging plumbing issues, whether unexpected or routine.

reviews.author: Barton
reviews.text: We  noticed  dampness  in  the  basement  wall.  Antonio  did leak  detection  and  found  a  hidden  pipe  issue.  He  repaired  it right  away,  saving  us  from  bigger  damage.  I  was  very thankful  for  his  thorough  work.

reviews.author: Valentyn Stadnytskyi
reviews.text:
Short story: The worse service I have ever received. Lower than industry service with higher then industry level charge. Just stay away and find someone trustworthy. I looked into other low rating reviews and there seems to be a pattern of misleading customers with prices and later charge way over.

Long story: Plumber came to check my water heater. He did not check anything except flushed the heater, a $50 job if you with other plumbers. When I asked about the anode rod, he told me it was a return plug for commercial use of the heater. He had no idea what else needs to be inspected and checked in the water heater. Also he had no idea how much services cost, so while I reported that not everything was checked, plumber said he does not handle billing. Promised me it will be all sorted out over a phone with billing. I made huge mistake and accepted the job. So plumber came spent 30 minutes and rushed away home, it was his last call for the day. No wonder he did not want to check the rest. Very unprofessional. However, this is not it… while job was barely done, I was charged full price $500 for a 30-min job. After seeing the charge I got in touch with the plumbing company. Oh man… how unprofessional they are: it takes several emails and phone calls to actually get someone to respond.

And I forgot, he did not close the drain valve properly so I had to get someone to finish the job.

Note, They have refunded portion of the charge after a lot of back and forth. It still was $300 to drain the water heater.

reviews.author: Todd Krusey
reviews.text: Christopher was responsive and very thorough in diagnosing my problem. He came out the same day and thoroughly explainedwhat needed to be done. He was on time, very professional and left my house clean. I will definitely use Gaithersburg Plumbing pros in the future.

reviews.author: Veronica Cannon
reviews.text: Had an emergency situation and Gaithersburg Plumbing Pros had a technician at my home first thing in the morning.  After an evaluation the technician promptly resolved the issue.  Excellent attention provided by this company by the technician and from Christopher of their office!

plumbers.name: Captain Rooter Emergency Plumbers
plumbers.address: 1252 W Chicago Ave, Chicago, IL 60642, USA

reviews.author: James Gilbert
reviews.text:
Jesse waked away from the job without finishing...as soon as he received the final payment of $8400 CASH.
He installed a toilet without a cover to the tank.
One of the workers left the basement door open on the coldest day of the winter, resulting in a burst copper pipe and 2 inches of water in the basement. He did not come close to completing the job he was paid to do and less than 24 hours later, the sink he installed leaked.
His response: "I'm not going to be bullied because I did you a cash favor." Would you call $8400 cash a favor to the customer or a way of evading taxes? You make the call.
I have attempted to contact him on his business and personal line to secure the name and contact information of his bonding and insurance company...he hung up on me and does not return text messages.
Do yourselves a favor and DO NOT DO BUSINESS WITH THIS MAN OR HIS COMPANY. Nefarious and shoddy at best.

reviews.author: Monica B. Anthony
reviews.text: Just wanted to take a moment to commend Oz for a job well done. He came right in explained everything, and was determined to  leave with results. He was very professional, concerned, and determined. If you need a honest plumber who will fix your problem please ask for Oz. Thank you!

reviews.author: Mark Matich
reviews.text: Oz came not long after I requested a "Pro" online. Roxane called before I even got off line, and had a Tech coming soon. Oz did a great job, fixing the tank leak on the toilet. He had a great work attitude, and customer care attitude. I would call them again.

reviews.author: Ankit
reviews.text:
Captain Rooter—gotta love the name! Feels like you’re the superheroes of plumbing emergencies in the area. The local visibility and quick response approach seem to really resonate with people.

Just a thought—couldn’t find a dedicated website when I searched. Having one could help folks find you faster during plumbing crises and even help show off the solid reviews and trust you’ve built.

(Just an observation—I'm a web developer and often help businesses like yours create a simple online presence that works as hard as you do.)

reviews.author: Ashley R.
reviews.text: Gabe has done a lot of work for me and is always professional, knowledgeable, and on time. Will definitely hire them again!

plumbers.name: S. J. Eaton Plumbing and Heating
plumbers.address: MAILING 485, 485 Penns Dr, Selinsgrove, PA 17870, USA

reviews.author: tina prowant
reviews.text:
I am so pleased. I will be using your services from here on out. You are very reasonable and very helpful.  Your son was very professional and considerate to take his shoes off after walking in the snow. He took time to show me where the leak was and give me options.  He was understanding and I have already shared your good work with my neighbors!! I look forward to hearing back from you on my split system.  Thank you for your professional job and your business being helpful not greedy.
I had a different hvac contractor in the Lewisburg area come in the beginning who was very greedy.  They charged me an outrageous amount of money and did nothing. You guys are the best!!

reviews.author: Thomas Dahlmann
reviews.text: I called S.J. Eaton for help with a clogged basement drain. My call was made after 1PM. I was told that I would be put on the service list and they would call me when a serviceman would be available. At 2:43 I got a call saying that they were on their way! Chris arrived shortly after that, He went right to work and resolved my clog in short order. Chris was friendly and professional. We will recommend S.J. Eaton to our friends.

reviews.author: Brianna Campbell
reviews.text: Sj&eaton are always readily available for emergencies or typical updates needed in home with heating and plumbing. They are wonderful and I refer them to anyone I know in our area for there plumbing and heating needs!

reviews.author: Margie Brown
reviews.text:
Best place ever fast reliable, experienced workers ,great prices ,I really can't say enough about this company, I go never even think about going elsewhere.
Thank you S.J.Eaton.

reviews.author: Chris Adamsky
reviews.text: Totally unprofessional and poorly trained.  Tech came to my house to diagnose water heater for coverage under my home warranty.  Upon arrival tried to install new water heater in spite of my clear verbal instructions to the office about needing approval. Tech then claimed he didn’t know how to diagnose problem and water heater was just old.  Tech then claimed there was no power to unit and I needed to call an electrician.   However upon checking when I returned from work I found with a tester there was indeed power to the unit(see photo).  Also tech left a puddle of water in my basement.   I called to complain about the service and was greeted with a very rude and condescending secretary, who tried to speak over me and then hung up when I would not put up with it.  I was very frustrated but did not curse, I wanted my complaint to be heard.  Her lack of customer service skills would have her fired from most respectable companies. I do not recommend this company and will tell anyone I come in contact with to avoid them at all costs.

plumbers.name: Home Service Pros - Quality Sewer & Drain
plumbers.address: 5817 2nd St S, Arlington, VA 22204, USA

reviews.author: Anu B.
reviews.text: Awesome service. Cody came and fixed my sink and drain in literally 5 minutes. It was an amazing experience. Will definitely use them again. Greg is super helpful.

reviews.author: Blaire F.
reviews.text:
A++ Highly recommend.
This company went above and beyond for us. They were out here twice this week to fix a slow drain, install grab bars for safety, install a new kitchen faucet, and install a garbage disposal. They were fast, expert, personable, respectful, on time and as promised. We highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Jennifer Funk
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with this company from start to finish. They were very responsive and easy to coordinate with leading up to the appointment, which made the whole process smooth and stress-free.

When Guido, the company rep, arrived, he was right on time and incredibly knowledgeable in his trade. He was also pleasant, professional, and easy to talk to — someone who clearly takes pride in his work. What really stood out was how honest and down-to-earth he was. It never felt like he was trying to upsell me or make a buck off unnecessary services. He genuinely seemed to care about helping and providing the best solution for my needs.

It’s rare these days to come across a company that is both skilled and trustworthy, but this one definitely delivers. The level of customer service, transparency, and professionalism was top-notch. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, honest, and high-quality service. I wouldn’t hesitate to use them again in the future!

reviews.author: Theresa Chavez
reviews.text: I recently had Home Service Pros Plumbing come out to fix a shower leak, and I couldn't be more impressed with their service! The team was professional, efficient, and very knowledgeable. They quickly identified the issue and fixed the leak with precision. What stood out to me the most was how they took the time to educate me about the overall condition of my home's plumbing. They pointed out other areas that needed attention and explained what repairs might be needed in the future, which was incredibly helpful. I truly appreciate their transparency and honesty. I’ll definitely be calling them again for any future plumbing needs. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Gmail - PHFS VA
reviews.text:
Very pleased with the service. From the first contact, they were willing to help us. They assigned Guido Miranda, who proved to be an expert and excellent professional, committed from start to finish to delivering an effective solution to the problem, of the highest quality and at a very reasonable price.

On the first visit, he performed the technical diagnosis, and that same day, they delivered the quote, providing several alternatives, which Guido thoroughly explained to allow us to make well-informed decisions.

After accepting the quote, they purchased the required components, and Guido himself implemented the solution, ensuring everything worked perfectly and leaving the area clean and organized. He also took the time to explain recommendations for proper use and maintenance of the system.

We are very satisfied and highly recommend them.

plumbers.name: Causeway Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 4215 Bainbridge Blvd, Chesapeake, VA 23324, USA

reviews.author: Jakob Johnson
reviews.text: Company has some friendly guys that move pretty QUICKLY on a 50 Gal PV . But man, as a fellow plumber they didn’t follow code or cleanliness procedures. They left my living room carpet dirty,  didn’t use any drop cloths or booties & they also left PVC shavings all over my floor. To top it off they moved all my tools out the room and didn’t put them back in place & randomly took off my hvac unit door . Also they left black iron pipe for the gas line loose and didn’t even run pipe for the TMP.

reviews.author: Rasnic Contracting, LLC
reviews.text: Excellent customer service from the office manager, technicians, and the owner. It’s rare that you find honest contractors with fair prices who also provide quality work! Thank you Causeway for helping us with our latest commercial project. We couldn’t have done it without you. We highly recommend this company for all of your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Chris Nance
reviews.text: Our family had a water leak and I called the owner of Causeway plumbing for some help on a Sunday. Unfortunately, he was out of town however he had someone at the house in less than 20 minutes. The communication was great, the service was excellent and the craftsmanship was superb. I would highly recommend Causeway plumbing for any of your plumbing needs.  Great job guys!

reviews.author: The Real Heisenberg
reviews.text: This is my first time using Causeway at the recommendation of a friend and I could not be happier. I called them for emergency service on this holiday weekend and the response time was amazing. Jesse showed up, quickly diagnosed the problem and fixed the leak in my garage. I usually don't post reviews but felt compelled to do so this time as I was truly impressed!

reviews.author: Jimmy Swindler
reviews.text: Your reps came to my son's new to him house in Hampton to help solve a water and sewer issue and we couldn't have been more pleased with the experience.  From Susan in the front office, and her efficiency in calling and scheduling, to Jesse and Logan, the techs who showed up and were infinitely wiser than their years, the whole experience was actually enjoyable.  We were told up front what you would do to solve the issues and how much it would cost and then you did it and solved the issues in a professional, efficient and incredibly friendly fashion.  A great experience and if I could sing I'd be singing your praises.  But I can't so I'll post this instead. ;)   Signed, one extremely happy and satisfied customer  :) Jimmy S.

plumbers.name: Glenn Plumbing Co Inc
plumbers.address: 481 E Whitner St, Anderson, SC 29624, USA

reviews.author: Collin Bryant
reviews.text: Can’t say enough good things about Glenn Plumbing.  Patrick and Matt helped us out big time at our business.  We had a plumbing issue that shut us down.  They got to us quickly to identify the issue and minimize down time.  Great honest local people.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tom Richey
reviews.text: I came home today to see a Glenn Plumbing truck parked partly in my neighbor’s parking space and partly in mine. When operating in a condo community, one should have the common sense and courtesy to park in one space — and preferably not in a space reserved for residents. This was extremely inconsiderate, I had to get out of my vehicle on the passenger’s side because of the way this vehicle was parked.

reviews.author: Eddie Mattison
reviews.text:
I just got off the phone with Patrick, from Glenn Plumbing.   I very much appreciate his time and patience with calling me back.   I have been educated, and I am surprised and disappointed.

First, the good.   The gentlemen who came out were professional and got the job done quickly and tightened the pipes back carefully to avoid leaking and adding cost to the job.  Very good.

The bad:   I was quoted $110/hr plus travel over the phone.   Glenn Plumbing will agree with that.   We live 14 minutes from their office (we are outside the city).   The brought in a machine and ran a snake for a clogged line and had it open in 30 minutes.   Then they went out to the van, did paperwork, I guess for 5 minutes and took off.

I got a bill for $202.   "Wha...?"   I went to their office and talked to, I  believe, the owner.  He talked AT ME.   And would not even consider negotiating the bill.   Frustrating, insulting, in my opinion.   (The office had sent me a one-line bill, so I didn't know what I was even charged for.   He said they'd send me an itemized bill, which they did.)

I called Patrick, his son.   Patrick was nice enough to call me back and explained that sometimes a job takes a while (climbing on roof or under the house, and they have to account for that.  I told him ours was a simple snaking of the line),   Also he said, that when its anything over 1 hour, they round up 30 minutes, including travel time.  I believe, with getting back to the shop, it was an hour and 10 minutes, so they rounded that up.   I also paid for their gloves, using their machine, and "excessive mileage."    (I had to ask about that too, since we are only 14 minutes away.  He said with gas prices high, they charge more for anything out of the city.   We are about 7 minutes outside the city.   They charge $10 for that.)    He said that's the business and they have to charge, and they have been in business since 1914, and I should ask other plumbing companies what they charge:  "its comparable."

I told him that since I was quoted $110 an hour over the phone, and I got a bill for $202 for 30 minutes of work (probably 1 hour and 10 minutes total work and travel time -   14 minutes from the shop), that he should not be surprised that I am a little surprised.  That's MY perspective.   He did negotiate the "excess mileage" and credit card fee (which is already on the bill) if I pay in cash or check.   .....Ok....

I told him again that I am surprised and disappointed by this bill.  (I honestly don't believe it made much difference.)   I will do better homework next time, and go to another plumber.

reviews.author: Ernest Hanshaw
reviews.text: So my wife called Glenn Plumbing to perhaps detect a drainage issue to our septic tank. The “ Technicians” drilled a 2” hole in lead pipe to septic system and used a snake to unplug. They said it was hitting something? Umm that was the cement block in septic!  I called another plumber and they emptied the septic tank and placed a riser for easy visibility to view tank level And they noted possible drain field issue . Received quotes for drainage field replacement and in process of repair. So,  I received a bill for 361 bucks from Glenn plumbing originally for them only to drill hole in my drainage pipe to septic “ 15 feet” from tank.  I contested the charges but paid. So today, I received yet another bill from Glenn Plumbing for 110 bucks from them “ I didn’t ask them to” take off 8 bolts from a riser which they they didn’t install just to tell me the septic tank was full again .? 10 minutes work ..No kidding. So $ 471 total to these guys for absolutely nothing to improve or solve anything . My new contractor is repairing drain field “AND “ the pipe that was drilled open under my deck and replace with a “ per code “ clean out .. this should have been addressed in the first place .Bottom line to this company. Don’t accept jobs that are not in your skill set. I have pictures of the “ work” ..

reviews.author: Jae Ellison
reviews.text: We needed a new hot water heater. Called another plumber, got an expensive quote, and it would be over a week until they could do it. Thankfully, I called Glenn Plumbing for a second opinion. They got me a quote within 45 minutes that was nearly half of what the other plumber quoted and they had it installed by 9 am the next day! Very pleased with my experience with Glenn Plumbing!!

plumbers.name: Pipelining Northwest
plumbers.address: 20825 SE 232nd St, Maple Valley, WA 98038, USA

reviews.author: S C
reviews.text: Great quality, speed, and price, will definitely hire again for plumbing needs! They were able to fix an unforeseen slow leak I found after unhooking my washing machine in preparation for a flooring installation. Steve responded very quickly to my 4/5 AM request on their website, and I was able to make an appointment for the same day. Jon fixed the leak (which involved cutting the drywall and installing new shut off valves) and also looked at some other minor issues while he was there. He confirmed that my tub faucet didn't have a problem, and he was able to get my kitchen sink sprayer to fully work again by cleaning out some debris that got lodged in it. Everything works perfectly now, and I didn't have to delay my renovations or worry about doing a temporary fix.

reviews.author: Robin
reviews.text: The best decision I’ve made!  I need to share my recent experience with Pipelining Northwest on an extensive repair I needed for my home.  I had some overflowing gutter drains and received a quote from another contractor.  I knew a 2nd quote was needed.  I found Pipelining Northwest and they quickly came out and assessed my drain issue.  The Owner, Cody Harris,  provided a detailed description of the damage and what needed to be done to repair in easy to understand language.  Quote for the work was 2/3 less than I was quoted by the other plumbing company.  I agreed to move forward with repairs.  All workers were professional, skilled, and each day left the work site safe and as clean as possible.  Project Management for the work was exceptional and communication thorough.  As the work progressed, based on my needs, additional areas needed repairs.  Bottom line - it is reassuring to see companies out there that are fair, skilled, and really put the customer experience at their forefront.  Well done Pipelining Northwest!  I highly recommend and would trust working with them in the future.

reviews.author: Ero Moldovan
reviews.text:
I had Pipelining Northwest come out because I was dealing with clogged water lines and they helped fix what they could. Later on I ended up having to use someone else for the well pump side of things, but overall I had a really good experience with these guys.

Derrick, John, and Cody were all good people to work with. Easy to talk to, straightforward, and didn’t give me that feeling that they were trying to squeeze every dollar they could out of me or create extra problems just to make the job bigger. Unfortunately that’s pretty rare nowadays.

There was an issue from the original visit that they came back out multiple times to fix and make right, and they handled it professionally every time. Nobody acted annoyed, nobody tried avoiding the situation, and nobody tried turning it into some huge extra ordeal. They just came back out and worked through the problem until it was taken care of. That honestly meant a lot to me because it showed they actually stand behind their work instead of just doing the job and disappearing afterward.

I’ve dealt with companies before where the second something unexpected happens, suddenly the price keeps climbing, new “issues” magically appear, or you start feeling like you’re being worked over instead of helped. I never got that feeling here. These guys actually seemed to care more about solving the problem than trying to see how much money they could get out of me, and that’s getting harder and harder to find nowadays.

There’s a reason they have 5 stars on Google. I’d definitely call them again in the future if I ever need plumbing or pipe work done and I’d feel comfortable recommending them to other people too.

reviews.author: Kristina Murti
reviews.text: Excellent service from Pipelining Northwest for a sewer relining. My old concrete sewer line was 80 years old.  Twice in the last 6 years I had very expensive projects to replace segments due to massive tree roots.  I decided it was time to just reline it.  This was an expensive project but needed to be done. I had 3 bids.  All the vendors assessed my sewer line the same.  I went with Pipelining, their price was a little less.  I am a single woman and I felt respected through the process and not mansplained or talked over. My questions were answered. Thank you to Austin and the team. They also did a great job on cleanup, it was like they were never here, despite having to do some digging!

reviews.author: David von Wolffersdorff
reviews.text: Pipeling Northwest recently lined our 60 year-old sewer pipe. They were a pleasure to work with. The business is owned by Steve and Cody Harris (father and son). They are very reliable, knowledgeable  and trustworthy. We also dealt with their foreman, Rene, who was very knowledgeable, and helpful. I would highly recommend them.

plumbers.name: TJM Sewer and Plumbing
plumbers.address: 31W070 Rohrssen Rd, Elgin, IL 60120, USA

reviews.author: Robin Fomusa
reviews.text:
I hate to leave a bad review, especially for a local business, but I’ve given TJM Sewer & Plumbing plenty of time to fix things to no avail. On December 26, I paid a $125 estimate fee and was quoted $4,500 to replace a pump and tank and redo plumbing. I was told the $125 would be credited if we moved forward. When the work was done, they determined the tank did not need to be replaced, yet I was still charged the full $4,500 and the estimate fee was not deducted.

Shortly after installation, the pump was not functioning properly. When I asked them to return to fix it, they attempted to sell me a whole-house filtration system instead of addressing the issue. I declined. They later blamed our problems on an issue with the well and claimed they could not fix it. I hired a well contractor who resolved the problem in 30 minutes without touching the well, leading me to believe there was never an issue with the well.

I requested an itemized invoice, which did not align with the work performed. Based on labor and materials, the job appears significantly overpriced (almost double). I formally requested a partial refund on January 12 and followed up multiple times, most recently on February 6, and have received no response.
I am incredibly disappointed with the lack of response and professionalism. I’ve also since been informed that they were never even licensed to have done the work they performed. I am sharing my experience in hopes that it can save someone else the headache and loss of money.

reviews.author: Andy Jeser
reviews.text:
TJM Saves the day!  Todd, Chris, and the TJM team were outstanding.    We had an excellent experience with TJM.

We  noticed strong sewer gas odor on a Friday morning.   Todd and Chris quickly came out and determined we had a broken sewer pipe. They were back at my house Saturday morning with a big crew to fix the issue.

Our repair was very involved.  It was big and extensive repair.  It  required saw cutting our driveway, opening the foundation,  and major excavating to access the broken pipes and fix the issue.      Todd, Chis, & crew had our plumbing fixed that afternoon.    They were back Monday to finish things up and closed things out with the inspector.

TJM was honest, professional, knowledgeable, delivered on quality, and was priced fairly.

My family and I were in a very bad spot with an unexpected broken sewer pipe that required major repairs.   TJM walked us through every step and did their best to help us out during a stressful situation.   No matter how many questions or issues we had-  Todd always took his time to address our concerns.  He wants to help and he does great work.

I 100% recommend TJM for any plumbing and sewer job.      They will get the job done right.

reviews.author: Gina Postelli
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with TJM Plumbing. They were right on time. They were knowledgeable and efficient, finishing everything they said they would in 2 hours. And that included an unexpected trip to Home Depot to ensure they had a part which would not leak. He charged exactly what his estimate said he would charge. I would call them again for any job in my home.

reviews.author: Neil Hollister
reviews.text:
Very happy with the initial visit, was with in the hour.  They promptly put camera in sewer line and quickly identified the problem to the 61 year old Cast main sewer line.  They had to break through concrete slab to replace all cast.  Messy job but needed to be done!

I will be using them again to install a tub!

Highly recommend TJM!!!!

reviews.author: Eric W
reviews.text: Man this company is the BOMB! I called and got same day service. Chris and Christian showed up and diagnosed my issue with 10 mins and had my kitchen sink and 1st floor toilet fixed with the hour. 2 issues only $400.  THEY DIDN'T EVWN WAKE MY SLEEPING KIDS. HIGHLY RECOMMEND

reviews.author: Andrew Pilcher
reviews.text: We were so grateful that Gabe saved us with a next day repair. He did fantastic work and was very helpful. We will be hiring him with all our future plumbing needs. Can’t recommend enough!

reviews.author: Brandon Kimbrell

reviews.author: Daniel Cogswell
reviews.text:
I’ve been consistently impressed with Garvin’s Plumbing and Sewer. Their response time is incredibly fast, they diagnose problems accurately, and they get the work done quickly and efficiently. Every time they’ve come out, the experience has been smooth and professional from start to finish.

Grayson, the plumber who helped me most recently, was especially friendly and informative. He took the time to explain what was going on and what needed to be done, without any pressure or unnecessary upselling, which I really appreciated.

What really stands out is the value. The pricing has always been more than fair, especially considering the quality of the work and how quickly issues are resolved. Plumbing problems are stressful, but working with Garvin’s never is.

They’ve helped me several times over the years, and it’s always been a great experience. Reliable, honest, fast, and affordable. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Nick Welch
reviews.text: With a clogged shower and kitchen sink time was of the essence and Garvins was able to respond up into the mountains to Netherland within just a few hours. reviews.author: Rachel Doss

We had our line backup again about a week after their most recent visit and the return visit was covered under the conditional warranty they offer on their services. We would absolutely recommend the team at Garvin’s to anyone in need!! Wes was our most recent hero and provided excellent service, recommendations and left my home cleaner than he found it. Thank you!

Good Bros Plumbing swooped in like the heroes they are. I called, got an appointment first thing the next morning, they came out, assessed the situation, grabbed the parts, and had us back in business before lunch.

Highly recommend them… especially if you’re like me and occasionally believe YouTube makes you a licensed plumber.

Cost $250 and of course I wish the price was lower but am very thankful to have a drain that is free and clear! My family will be using Drain Savants again in the future!!

reviews.author: Melissa Hendrick
reviews.text: I always love supporting local merchants in my area and CPS didn't let me down.  I recently received a water bill that was 4x the prior month, with not add'l water usage.  I called CPS and the very next day they sent Luke and Jared out to test for leaks.  The guys could have jumped straight into a more expense test with the main box, but instead they were methodically, went water device by water device (ie, sinks, faucets, washing machine, each toilet to see if any of those were leaking - also finding the fittings to my toilets were original to the 1983 house (which I had them replace - for a reasonable price).  The last test proved (we hope - havent' received a bill yet) was a leaky toilet. Yet they went ahead and then tested the main controller, first the house then the irrigation system. Fortunately no pressure change - so all was good (whew!). Best of all Luke explained all the way through what he was doing and spoke in a way I could understand what he was doing.  CPS management these guys are awesome.  Beverly thanks for booking me so fast!!! Cheers CPS, keep up the great work!

reviews.author: Brielle Valle
reviews.text: Yikes. Unsure HOW Snyder's has good reviews. Dave Snyder/the company cost us over $30K. They incorrectly installed an AC unit in 2021. Every summer since we have had MOLD. They oversized the unit (AKA did not take measurements to ensure accuracy) and they cut a hole into the ductwork (I think it's called a cheat grate) which caused incredible static pressure issues. So a $8,670 unit/install in 2021 had to be pitched in 2025. Terrible. What's more, when I raised my concerns I was completely dismissed in 2021 (I have documentation). And after copious dollars spent to try to fix the issue (from credible companies) the answer was to strip the unit and do it correctly. Mold issues, static pressure issues, condensation, etc. Just a train wreck. No issues now that we had it replaced and it's not oversized (used a different company, obviously). I should also mention they were clueless about our complicated radiant heat system. We burned a ton of cash trying to fix it with Snyder's and then had to hire a credible company to get it right. Lit (a lot of) money on fire. RUN AWAY! (Photo is of one vent -- ALL vents had mold. I had to get my soft duct replaced too. INCREDIBLY UPSETTING.)

reviews.author: Luis Lozano
reviews.text: I contacted Reliable HVAC after discovering water leaking from my furnace/AC. Assuming a faulty condensate pump, I requested a repair. Ian responded and replaced the pump. I was overcharged for incomplete work and left without an actual solution. When the issue continued, I investigated further and discovered a block of ice had formed around the evaporator coils. All of this was visible and diagnosable with basic HVAC troubleshooting, which the technician did not perform. If you’re seeking truly reliable service, I recommend looking elsewhere.

reviews.text: I felt compelled to leave this review as I never had such a great experience when it came to resolving plumbling issues. Hunter was extremely professional, easy to communicate with him, personable, very knowledgeable.  They never asked for a service call fee, he immediately told us the price, recommended a better product.  We immediately said to go ahead and within 45 minutes he was back with a new water heater.  He promptly installed it, hawl the old one out to take with him and cleaned after himself. He was prompt and efficient. reviews.author: Paul Marinucci
reviews.text:
Reliable HVAC and Plumbing is absolutely fantastic!!  From the moment I called and spoke to Alex who arranged the service call and she scheduled their tech I knew I was in the best of hands. reviews.author: Allykat500
reviews.text:
If I could give 0 stars I would. It started last night when my punch guy/handyman cut a stub out line for my whole house water filtration system. The line was Pex material and he didn't have the proper tools to make the connection.  It's a new construction house so I wasn't concerned that there wasn't water running to the house last night but wanted to line up a plumber for today (I'm the builder). I called Conroe plumbing and described the situation.  The lady on the phone scheduled the appointment,  said it would be $125 trip charge, $85 for each additional hour and $35 more if they brought a "helper"....then said she would get a plumber to call me to make sure they could do the work. 90 minutes later he called. I told him the situation and even texted him a photo of the pipe. He said no worries, they had the tools, and it would take one guy less than an hour. The next morning on time a young man showed up with a "helper". I showed them to the garage and he began looking at the pipe. From the onset I knew I was in trouble. This kid knew nothing and the helper knew even less. They made 3 trips to their truck, then a 25 minute phone call to their office telling someone over the phone all about the job and asking what to do. He walked back into the garage to tell me the repairs would take all day, because he DIDN'T HAVE THE TOOLS so he had to go back for the right tools and parts, and because it was so complicated he would be charging me $700. Please see pictures below. I told him "no thanks and have a blessed day". $125+ tax = wasted. I then called Moore plumbing supply and talked to them. I drove over purchased 2 shark bite connectors and a section of CPVC (I paid for 10 feet but only needed about 2 feet). Total cost $58 and time taken in the garage to bring water back on by myself = 15 minutes. I'm sure they have helped a lot of people in the community but I shudder to think of the lies and the costs.

Update: Today the owner contacted me and apologized for the experience.  He stated that there was miscommunication between himself and his worker and wanted to make the situation right. He has offered to refund the trip charge and even went so far as to hold a meeting with his staff using this as a "teachable moment" and vowing to offer more value to his customers. Even though my experience wasn't good their response let me know that was an isolated event and they will work to do the right thing.

First and foremost, scheduling an appointment with Poons Entities was a breeze, and they were incredibly punctual. Anthony and his team understand the importance of timeliness, and it was evident in their prompt arrival, which is something I truly appreciate in a service provider.

The workmanship displayed by Poons Entities LLC is simply outstanding. Anthony and his team showed unparalleled expertise in addressing my plumbing issues. They tackled the problem efficiently, and the results were impeccable. It's evident that they take great pride in their craft, and it shows in the quality of their work.

Moreover, the level of customer service I received was exceptional. Anthony and his team were attentive, courteous, and answered all of my questions with patience and clarity. They made sure I was fully informed throughout the process, which added to my peace of mind.

In conclusion, I can't recommend Poons Entities LLC and Anthony Bennett enough. If you're looking for a plumbing company that offers top-notch customer service, punctuality, and outstanding workmanship, look no further. Anthony and his team are the experts you can trust. I'm incredibly satisfied with their services and will definitely call upon them for any future plumbing needs. Thank you, Anthony, and the entire Poons Entities team!

plumbers.name: Seabreeze Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 507 Center Dr E, Beaufort, SC 29902, USA

reviews.author: Marlon
reviews.text:
I had a plumbing emergency on a weekend, a Sunday night to be exact. I went down the list in Google calling place after place with emergency services only to be gaffed off until I came across Seabreeze.

I got a rapid response and everything explained to me upfront. My tech was Ben, an outstanding tech that actually Listened to me. He wasted no time getting down to business and figured out the issue was with my septic tank set up.

Granted he could have took the easy route and took advantage of the emergency situation but instead was a true professional and presented me with ALL my options both expensive and cost effective.

Repairs were quick and expertly done. I was scheduled promptly for a follow up to complete the full repair.

Overall, there was substandard pipe that was installed causing issues as well as a deteriorating baffle. Not to mention all the digging and and heavy lifting. My issue was not only fixed but left noticeably better than its been since buying the house.

Side note: I have had multiple plumbing services come out and NONE OF THEM were even close to the service I got from Seabreeze.

reviews.author: Natasha Stojanovski
reviews.text: Seabreeze Plumbing truly came to the rescue! I had several plumbing issues that needed attention, and after struggling to find someone available in a reasonable timeframe, Ben stepped in and made the whole process stress-free. He responded quickly, came out ASAP, and handled everything efficiently and professionally. It’s hard to find reliable, honest service these days, and Ben exceeded my expectations. I’m extremely grateful for his promptness, quality work, and professionalism. I highly recommend Seabreeze Plumbing to anyone needing dependable plumbing services!

reviews.author: Steve Takacs
reviews.text: I was finishing up a DIY flush on my Rinnai water heater, when I turned the hot water shut off valve back on the handle broke off.  I contacted Seabreeze Plumbing immediately (after normal business hours) and by extreme good fortune Ben was only five minutes from my home.  He assessed the situation, had the parts needed in his truck, and completed the repair within an hour.  The price he quoted was very reasonable.  Ben is a very pleasant individual.  My experience was exceptional.  Thank you Ben

reviews.author: Nat Cannady
reviews.text: Woke up to a serious leak on Saturday am.  Called our regular plumber who was out of town.  Found Seabreeze on the internet who offers after hours service.   Called and Ben was here within 90 minutes.   He found and repaired the leak inside a wall quickly.  A very skilled technician with the right tools and knowledge.  Also,  very pleasant, organized and personable.  I would definitely recommend him and am grateful for his service.

reviews.author: John Ellsworth
reviews.text: I was very impressed with Ben's jobs today. First off, he arrived well within the two hour scheduled period. Secondly, he installed a new shower fixture in no time, and then went on to fix a problem with our kitchen disposal that came about after we called him regarding the shower. Third, the price he charged for everything was more than fair.

reviews.text: We’ve used Schmeltz Plumbing for several jobs. Damien is knowledgeable, efficient, dependable, and does great work. He even went above and beyond to get our water running and we are so grateful! We would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Julia O
reviews.text: Damien was beyond professional and a very fair price. His work was efficient but done perfectly. I am so glad I came across this company on Google when searching for someone to help me out of a situation I put myself in.

reviews.author: Deborah Thomasson
reviews.text: Very professional. Showed up the next day after I called with a need for a new Hot water heater. Showed up when he said he would and took care of the hot water heater. He also looked at a drain problem and scheduled for the next day to come fix that for me as well. Very pleased with the promptness and professionalism.

reviews.author: Ayla Thompson
reviews.text:
Had a plumbing issue arise that needed immediate attention. I called a few places & Damien at Schmeltz Plumbing was able to get out there same day! My line was clogged and creating an overflow of some pretty gross stuff on the side of my house. Damien came in, diagnosed the problem & got to work. Finally after an escapade of digging —finding tree roots as large as tree trunks on top of the pipes we realized the problem was going to be more extensive than we initially expected (common with old homes). Damien was a trooper the whole time!
Damien was very professional and friendly —even answering all of my questions.
Damien also took the time to explain what caused the clog and ways to manage it in the future. The price was reasonable, and I was very happy with the service! I would definitely recommend Schmeltz plumbing to anyone in need of plumbing services!

I will end this review with this— it is SO HARD to find reliable, honest, caring people to do work. Damien’s customer service definitely surpassed my prior experiences!

reviews.author: Gwyn
reviews.text: My experience with MenWon was fantastic. Aaron was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. I called him on a Thursday and my repair was done by Saturday afternoon. He took a look at the issue on Saturday and had the repair completed, all in under 3 hours. Aaron replaced copper piping connected to the water heater that was leaking for a fair price, and did not attempt to upsell me on services when I asked him a few questions about other plumbing issues. I will definitely be using MenWon for any future plumbing work. Anyone looking for a reliable, professional, and local to Worcester plumber, I would highly recommend you choose MenWon.

reviews.author: Deb Hinkle
reviews.text: Aaron is professional and kind. He always follows through, cleans up(!), and offers reasonable prices for important work. MenWon has helped me out twice and I will always have their number handy.

reviews.author: Melinda Cyr
reviews.text: I needed to have my leaking kitchen faucet replaced.  Aaron came out the same day I called, gave me a reasonable estimate and performed the work.  He was friendly, professional and knowledgeable.  I will be calling him again as well as recommending him to my family and friends.

reviews.author: Alyssah
reviews.text: Really happy with the service provided. We called about an issue and he came the same day and spent time fixing the problem for a reasonable price. We’ve had his help in the past for another house too. We highly recommend 10/10!

reviews.author: Jake Babineau
reviews.text: Menwon plumbing is responsive and affordable while delivering quality results. You will not be disappointed with the entire experience from faucet to drain!

reviews.author: John Hartmann
reviews.text: Extremely unprofessional. I hired Plumbing Ministry to install a Moen automatic water shutoff in my new home. The technician was given access to my home before we moved in. A month later, I was inspecting my crawl space and noticed that my $700 sleeping bag was in the corner where the installation had been done. It was covered in dust and had a hole in it. The technician had clearly taken it from my belongings and used it as a pad while working under my house and left it there! The technician is the ONLY person who had access to my crawl space since the home was purchased, but Plumbing Ministry denied that their employee did this and refused to compensate me for the loss.

reviews.author: Arjmand Yousefian
reviews.text: I recently had sewer drain replacement work done by  The Plumbing Ministry , and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From start to finish, the team was professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. They explained the process clearly, completed the job on time, and made sure everything was done right. The quality of their work really shows, and they left the area clean when finished. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable plumbing services!

reviews.author: Deborah W.
reviews.text:
I called the Plumbing Ministry from a referral, and I am so glad I did.
They came to inspect my sewer lateral, only to discover that a previous sewer job one year prior (by a pretend plumber) was not up to code. Image how disappointed I was over the large amount of money literally down the sewer.
The Plumbing Ministry came and made the repair, did my sewer lateral, and it passed both the City & EBMUD standards. The staff was always timely, courtesy, respectful, and hard working. KUDOS to Louis and his team!!

reviews.author: Seido Karasaki
reviews.text:
EDIT: ***See the owner's response. Note the total lack of empathy or ownership for the mistake. Do you really want to do business with plumbers who don't even try to help when something goes wrong, especially when it affects somebody who had nothing to do with the job? I would encourage everyone who is thinking of hiring this company to think twice - read all the negative yelp and google reviews to see what you're really getting into when you hire the Plumbing Ministry. One review even notes that the only positive reviews are from real estate agents who want the bare minimum done. I would highly encourage anyone reading this review who has had problems with the Plumbing Ministry to reach out to the El Cerrito City Department, Better Business Bureau, California Department of Consumer Affairs, and California Attorney General's Office to file a complaint.***

My neighbors hired the Plumbing Ministry to do some plumbing work. This involved the company coming on July 24th and digging up the pipes in the street area between my neighbors place and residence. They then proceeded to accidentally cut our cable and wifi service line, which resulted in a brief interruption to cell service. As of today, July 28th, the wifi service still has not been fixed.

The Plumbing Ministry has not offered to resolve this situation in any way whatsoever. They first tried to deny they had anything to do with it, but after confronting them, they told me they would contact the office and the right people to get this fixed. Since I had not heard anything from them and no work had been done to restore access, I called the office number for the plumbing ministry. I talked to the owner who was apathetic at best, denied all wrongdoing by stating that our cables were unmarked (which does not seem like a reason to cut them in the first place), and told me that there is nothing they can do.

Wifi may seem unimportant to most, but as somebody who works remotely, I find the apathy and the lack of ownership taken by the Plumbing Ministry to be appalling. I believe my experience to be indicative of the work they perform and the service that they provide as a business.

reviews.author: Samuel Sutton
reviews.text: Sewer lateral replacement. Dug out the wrong place at first and ruined a huge section of my yard. The driveway repair was awful and is already cracking. Took multiple days for them to finish the job with a huge hole in my driveway. Didn't care to make it right when asked either. Stay away.

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.text: Clear Creek Plumbing was amazing! I had a complicated plumbing issue that another plumbing company was unable to fix. The other company said I’d need to tear out a tile wall to find the problem, which I’m sure would have been a lot of time and money and inconvenience at our home. I was referred to Clear Creek Plumbing for a second opinion. The guys were all so nice and smart, and really wanted to solve the problem without tearing down the wall. They worked really hard to solve the problem, and they did it! They found the problem and fixed it without tearing the wall down! I’m so thankful to them and will definitely use them for any future issues. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sterling Stolle
reviews.text: I needed a new water heater as mine was old and starting to fail. I reached out to Colton, and he was extremely responsive and professional. He came out promptly to inspect the unit, provided a clear and detailed estimate, and was able to schedule the replacement the very next day. During the process, he identified some necessary code updates and thoroughly explained everything, ensuring full transparency. The entire experience was smooth and professional. Highly recommend and will definitely use his services again in the future!

reviews.author: Tara Ballenger
reviews.text: I had an obstruction in a sewer line, and no other plumber would talk me through the issue or give me any kind of ballpark to cure. But Colton at Clear Creek was up front and explained what he thought the problem likely was and what the most affordable solution would be. Nathan, the technician who did the work, was very friendly, cleared the obstruction, and the final price was exactly as Colton had predicted. So rare to find an honest plumber!

reviews.author: Naomi Thomas
reviews.text: Had shower draining slowly so I called these guys. The arrived on time, were very friendly and was able to fix the issue. I have really long hair and my hair catcher didn't catch all of it, so it collected and slowed the drainage down. 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.author: Liv
reviews.text: Just had a big water leak in my garage and Matt and Justin came out promptly and got it fixed within minutes. They even went as far as to clean up the water with a shop vac! Absolutely recommend this company to anyone who has plumbing needs. Justin and Matt have been so amazing!!! I know I’m in good hands when Justin and Matt are here!! Thank you clear creek for always having great prices and great workers that do great jobs!!!

plumbers.name: Frontline Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1618 Old Hwy 14 S, Greer, SC 29651, USA

reviews.author: Kristine Mezger-Ashbaugh
reviews.text: Matthew and Will were extremely professional and did an awesome job installing new toilets. I will always work with local small businesses before corporate America. Honest. Dedicated. Positive. Enjoys the profession. Definitely keeping contact handy for future issues.

reviews.author: Frank Crone
reviews.text:
Matt came recommended to us by our son-in-law whose grandparents paid an astronomical price for a service that once investigated by Matt , was mostly temporary fixes at an inflated price. Matt worked with his elderly grandparents and repaired and replaced it permanently for a fraction of the cost.

We decided to do a bathroom remodel in our older home and were shocked at the 100k price tag. My wife, via TikTok, YouTube and other platforms decided she could do it at a fraction of the price. Until we met the plumbing issues. Enter Frontline and its owner Matt. Matt cane by at a moments notice to discover the problems and immediately cane up with cost-effective solutions and gave a quote that we couldn’t refuse. I might also add my wife “added” a few more things out of his comfort zone-an electrical add on. Instead of subbing it out, he added it in (he can do it, just not a preference of his) at minimal cost. That’s great business folks. He came as scheduled and promised and delivered phenomenal work. So much so, a friend, about to do a new residential build, saw the work, and immediately asked for his card not even knowing the value we were given. Just based upon his promise to come when agreed (it was during the ice storm) and  doing high-quality work. Now my wife can continue on with her project.

Folks there are  far too many scammers out there. Matt is not one of them. Great work at a great price. We look forward to him coming out this summer to add a pool heater and run the gas lines to it on our 26,000 gallon pool. I trust this company 100 percent. I recommend them double that.
Dr. C

reviews.author: Caleb Anderson
reviews.text:
As a builder in the Upstate South Carolina market, having a dependable plumbing contractor is critical. Frontline Plumbing has been a strong partner on our new construction homes in Greenville, Greer, and Spartanburg.

They understand modern plumbing systems, tankless water heaters, whole-home filtration, gas piping, and full residential rough-ins. Their work is clean, inspections go smoothly, and homeowners are always impressed at final walkthrough.

Frontline Plumbing brings professionalism and craftsmanship to every build. We look forward to continuing to work together.

— Elevate Homes

reviews.author: John Thomas
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough great things about Matthew Johnson and Frontline Plumbing! From start to finish, the experience was absolutely top-notch. Matthew was professional, honest, and incredibly knowledgeable. He showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and took the time to make sure the job was done perfectly.

What really stood out was his attention to detail and the pride he takes in his work. He didn’t cut corners, and he treated my home with respect—cleaning up everything before he left and making sure I was completely satisfied.

It’s hard to find someone you can truly trust, but Matthew is the real deal. Fair pricing, excellent workmanship, and outstanding customer service. If you need plumbing work done, Frontline Plumbing is the company to call. I won’t use anyone else!

Highly recommend to anyone looking for reliable, honest, and high-quality plumbing service!

reviews.author: Troy Scott
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with Matthew Johnson from Frontline Plumbing. While my family was on vacation, our 9-year-old water heater started leaking. When we arrived home and discovered the issue, we called Matthew immediately—and he responded very promptly.

Matthew took the time to thoroughly explain all of our options, from a more budget-friendly repair route to higher-end replacement solutions. After reviewing everything, we decided to upgrade to a tankless water heater, and we could not be happier with the result.

His professionalism, honesty, and knowledge made a stressful situation much easier. If you’re looking for a true professional, Matthew Johnson with Frontline Plumbing is the way to go. You won’t find anyone better to assist you with your plumbing needs

I would definitely recommend asking for Jared if you need plumbing work done.

reviews.author: Cammy Richardson
reviews.text: Parker is so wonderful! He's helped us so much a couple times! Andrew came today as well and he was great!! We are super happy with them both!!

reviews.author: Miki Chyung
reviews.text: We recently had the boiler for our hydronic system replaced by Mniska at Afterglow heating and plumbing.  There are not many heating specialists knowledgeable of the complicated hydronic systems in our area, so we were very happy to have come across someone who was able to diagnose the problems we were having and come up,with the best options for repairing it.  We are very happy with the work he did for us.  The cost was reasonable and he kept us informed throughout the process.  It ended up taking longer than we anticipated due the complicated nature of our system, but Minsk’s made sure to clear his schedule so that everything would be done in a timely manner and we could have both hot water and heating back!  I would recommend Mniska and Afterglow Heating to anyone who is in need of an expert in the hydronic system!

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.text: We highly recommend the services of Mniska Lamb at AfterGlow Plumbing & Heating systems.  We had a carbon monoxide situation a few months ago and called on Mniska to investigate and correct the problem as well as update our aging hydronic heating system.  Mniska did an excellent job and, over the past few months, we've been enjoying our updated heating system.  Heating can now be programmed in separate areas of the house which is wonderful because the rooms where we spend the most time are heated without having to heat the entire house.  The system is now tankless (see picture) so we don't have a huge water tank sitting in our small utility room.  Mniska impressed us with his attention to detail, neatness and cleanliness in all aspects of his work.  An excellent communicator, he responded promptly to all of our questions via text and/or phone, even after hours.  Mniska is extremely knowledgeable and kept us informed of what he was doing and why.   He did everything he could to minimize any disruption of service during the course of the project.  We trust Mniska and would absolutely hire him for any future heating needs.

reviews.author: Paula Adduci
reviews.text: Afterglow Heating did a phenomenal job of replacing and upgrading my boiler system. It’s not your typical heating unit, it’s a hydronic radiant heating system, but Mniska knew exactly what was needed. He was able to come out immediately and assess, clearly explaining what my options were. They worked long hours to get my hot water and heating back online as quickly as possible, and in just 2 days, I was all set and warm again. I really appreciated the time he took to determine my needs, and to explain every step. Especially the last parts where we tested all the elements on the Viessmann unit, made sure everything was connected and working properly. (Photo note: all those shiny copper pipes did get jackets to insulate them, I just loved the way they looked before it was done) I would not hesitate at all to recommend Afterglow!

reviews.author: John Mapel
reviews.text:

Although he already had a full day scheduled, he want the extra mile to fit us in, including driving across town to procure a hard-to-find part and staying until 8 pm to make sure things were properly running again!
Mniska is patient, thorough and a pleasure to work with. We recommend him wholeheartedly for all plumbing and heating work!

reviews.author: Wen Lee

reviews.author: Karen DiMaina
reviews.text:

He assured me that if those didn’t work, he would come out that same day to fix the issue, going above and beyond to ensure it would be taken care of that evening.

Definitely calling him again for any future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Dave Martin
reviews.text: James Rice is a great plumber, clearly very knowledgeable and a clear communicator. We had a great experience with him this morning and the bill was perfectly reasonable. Also he’s really nice, and he was able to come out quickly. Would definitely recommend this firm!

reviews.author: Rich M
reviews.text:

I spoke with Mark, who is very friendly, accommodating, knowledgeable and offered real fast service and almost any date I needed, even as quick as the next day! I had asked him how much to install the hot water heater if I had bought it first and he gave me an hourly rate which far surpassed and was much cheaper than the flat rate other plumbing businesses quoted me. They came out today and he sent his man, Kirby, to install it. He did a really professional and quick job, only 2 1/2 hours of labor. He gave me the impression he was very professional and also knowledgeable and said he’s been doing this job 23 years. He was also a very friendly person.

All I can say is from today’s experience, Rice Plumbing certainly lived up to their 5 star rating!

If you’re in search of a plumber that is professional, experienced, and has very good prices, and offers quick service, then I highly recommend this outfit. Make them your first and only choice. Don’t even waste your time looking online for other plumbers.

reviews.text: I am very satisfied with the work. Easy to schedule the appointment. Jonathan was very professional. He worked quickly and got all the jobs done in 90 minutes. He left all the work areas very clean. I think Rice Plumbing provides a great service at a fair price.

reviews.text:
[Update 7/23] The folks at Planet Pluming went above and beyond to help address the issue at my house and help explain the work. Their follow-up two technicians were exceedingly professional and thoughtful and tidy. They helped locate the main sewer line issue and repair a separate issue that had come up during the first visit, all against the cost of the original visit. I so appreciate their follow-up, flexibility, and stellar customer service. I'll look forward to working with them again in the future!

[Original 7/21] I've used Planet Plumbing for years and have always been happy with their service and prices--and have widely recommended them. But my technician today over-stressed my system, leaving gray water pouring in my basement (for me to clean up), left a mess in my shower, was not able to fix a dripping bathroom sink faucet, spent several hours trying to clear a mainline without camera-scoping it first--taking out my toilet in the process (which didn't seem to have any issues). For $750, I got: one new bathtub spigot (that had only a minor problem before), a still-dripping bathroom sink, no improvement or information about the sewer line that is still prone to backup, and messes I need to clean up. I never leave reviews, but I am extremely disappointed in the service, price, and lack of communication about the process and options during the project. When it's hard enough to find time and money for the essentials, this is a super-frustrating experience.

reviews.author: martin loroima
reviews.text:
I own a rental house in Cedar Park and I had an emergency with a couple of projects that needed to be fixed ASAP. First, my water heater is in the attic and my tenant informed me that there was no hot water in the whole house. The second problem was that when the tenant flushed the toilet there was water backing up to the bathtub. He tried to use the plunger to see if he could get the toilet unclogged but after spending almost an hour trying to unclog it he finally gave up.

All this happened over the weekend and I was out of town. I needed a plumber ASAP cause the tenant had some visitors and he was already frustrated. After calling multiple plumbing companies in the area nobody was available or they simply did not pick up the phone.

Finally, I found Cedar Park Plumbers and I was surprised they picked up the phone at 8pm on a Saturday. I explained what was going on and within 30 minutes they sent a plumber out to my property. He took pictures of the water heater and sent them to me explaining that it was an old unit and needed to be replaced. My water heater has an expansion tank and he gave me a detailed explanation of why I needed another expansion tank.

After that, he ran a camera to find the problem of the clogged line and found some tree roots in the sewer line. The toilet paper could not go through and got stuck causing the clog. He read his machine to remove the roots and unclogged the line. He told me that that was a temporary solution but once you have roots in the pipe they will grow again to the point where they can brake the pipe much worse.

Anyways, he had a brand new water heater and also installed it and the same night he fixed the 2 problems that were causing stress. I’m very very grateful to Cedar Park Plumbers for their availability and for helping me solve these 2 problems. I highly recommend them.

reviews.text: I was in need of an emergency plumbing company and they were the only one that picked up the phone. They even came on a weekend. Thumbs up

reviews.author: P C Kenar
reviews.text:
Have a serious sewer or water line issue? These are the guys. They are the best! They were not daunted by an issue of long standing regarding a broken sewer pipe that was causing issues well beyond unpleasant.

Other companies did not seem to know how to solve the issue without massive unnecessary work. They couldn’t even find where the breaks in the pipe were. All they did was tell us how long the run is, like I didn’t know that, how it’s an old pipe, also not news, and that they couldn’t really give a quote. Calumet City came out, identified two breaks and their exact locations within an hour. Other companies couldn’t even figure out how to scope the line, and did not understand that the line had two clean outs. They didn’t know what that was in the backyard, and said it would have to go. It didn’t and it is an integral component to the system. It’s the second clean out for an unusually long run. And they believed me when I said there was a broken rodder in the line, and they identified that it was the cause of the breaks in the first place. And that had to have happened a long time ago. We’ll never know just who did the damage.

They prepared a very fair quote in a very timely fashion that included all aspects of the work. This included the entire job, like new concrete, and even the garage door weather strip, so everything is as it was. Other companies only really offered recommendations for most of the work. These
other companies also wanted open-ended contracts, so they could charge whatever they wanted. Do people really not understand what could result by signing a contract like that?

It was well worth living with an issue until we found a company, the right company, that knows about old, and new, sewer and water lines. So glad we did wait, even if it was unpleasant.

The team leader and team were terrific. They are all knowledgeable, arrive on time, friendly, have a sense of humor while doing pretty unpleasant work. And they took the time to explain what was going on before, during, and after.

Understand, there are many companies that will tell you issues like an old broken sewer line will cost tens of thousands, maybe more. And from what was actually done that solved this long standing problem, those companies would not only have cost me well over treble the cost, but would have caused a whole lot of damage, and maybe the building. They said they’d need to tear out part of a fence, tear up a large established garden, and tear up the concrete floor of a large garage. One company wanted to completely reroute the entire line and tear up the basement, the long driveway and the newly done street and new sewer and water lines. They didn’t even know where to get an excavator of the proper size. And all they need to do was look from that second clean out they didn’t understand to find the problem. They wouldn’t do that when I asked them to. They gave excuses as to why they couldn’t.

Thank you Calumet City! I am so glad that the city I live in uses your company to service the city’s water and sewer lines, and sent you guys to fix an issue they had with our water feed.  And though the city didn’t tell me you were coming, your team looked to find me until they found the owner, before they started. With two large buildings, that took some looking.  I am so glad the guys did.

What a pleasure working with you was. And no “Hey Little Girl, what’s on your little mind.” Thank you for the respect and honesty.

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ If I could give 10 stars, I would — but my septic tank already overflowed once this week.

R&R Pumping LLC came to our rescue when our septic decided to act like a grumpy toddler and refuse to do its one job. Not only did they pump it out (with the precision of a surgeon and the bravery of someone who clearly isn’t paid enough), but they ALSO fixed our clog — which, judging by the smell, was sent straight from the depths of Hell itself.

The man didn’t flinch.
Didn’t gag.
Didn’t run.

He just looked at that mess like, “Not today, Satan.”

Next thing we know — BOOM. Everything’s flowing like a mountain stream again. I swear the house sighed in relief.

Professional.
Fast.
Affordable.
And probably needs therapy after seeing what came out of that tank.

If you need someone who handles septic disasters without judgment, hesitation, or a hazmat team… R&R Pumping is your guy. 💩🚛💨

Highly, highly recommended!
