reviews.author: living my spirit 12
reviews.text: I called Trapmasters on a Monday morning after my laundry and kitchen sink backed up.  I was hoping to get someone the same day since it was a very inconvenient situation for my elderly parent.   Kenny came over in an hour and was very courteous, professional and personable.  Kenny explained the issue and what he was going to do to correct it.  He was cautious to keep clean while working.   We did ask about another sink issue while he was there and he was able to assess the problem and let us know how he could fix it and an estimate.   Kenny fixed that sink problem as well.  We are very pleased and will call again if we have any plumbing problems.   I highly recommend.   Very grateful.

reviews.author: Tommy Bodamer
reviews.text:
Exceptional service! Kitchen and laundry drain completely stopped up on Sunday. I almost called one of the larger companies in the area that the insurance used when our basement flooded a few years ago, but I had just seen a post on Facebook recently of someone asking for recommendations.  There was a majority of the responses recommending Trapmaster. So, with that info and the fact that they are located here in town, I decided to give them a try. I was not disappointed.

Im a late riser, so I wasn't up to call until almost 11am. Said they would be out by 3pm. Arrived at 2. He did a quick inspection and grabbed his equipment. Had everything opened up and flowing good within about 30 min.

Then came the bill. (No, I didn't ask for a price before hand. Im more of a you're here just get it done type. Don't have the patience or the energy to call 10 different places for estimates just to save $50.) Knowing what the insurance paid for the last guys and knowing what other friends/family have paid in the past for similar services, I had a ballpark price already in my head. I was very surprised when he gave me the total and it was less than half of what I was expecting.

Response time: A+
Price: A+
Professionalism/politeness: A+
Cleaning up after/during: A+

Will definately use again if ever needed and will be recommending to all.

reviews.author: Julia McMeans
reviews.text: Incredibly grateful for Trapmasters who, from start to finish, were an excellent help when I really, really needed it. From the initial phone call with Dan, to Kenny coming out, all encounters were professional and courteous. Kenny and his assistant worked hard to resolve the serious problems in a way that were both economical and effective. I highly recommend Trapmasters.

reviews.text: These guys are awesome. Finding a good plumber can be stressful, but I’m glad I found them because they’re my go to now. They showed up early and finished everything in about an hour. reviews.text:
I can’t say enough good things about Hot Water Doctor. From the first call to the final install, the entire experience was smooth, professional, and stress-free. They showed up on time, explained all my options clearly, and replaced my water heater quickly and efficiently.

The technician was knowledgeable, friendly, and super respectful of my home—no mess left behind. The pricing was fair and transparent, with no surprise fees, and the quality of work was top-notch. Best of all, I had hot water again the same day 🙌

If you need a water heater replacement and want honest service, expert work, and great customer care, Hot Water Doctor is the company to call. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: kim lindner
reviews.text: Shane was a pleasure to work with! I called for a quote and just sent photos and info on tank size. He was able to come out and fix it so fast! I would definitely recommend him to anyone!

reviews.author: Cathy Sampson
reviews.text: We were extremely happy with the new hot water tank Shane installed and we were especially impressed by Shane’s work ethic and professionalism. Our tankless system never worked properly and didn’t deliver hot water to the kitchen which resulted in untold gallons of wasted water running the tap full blast till it heated up. It was loud, inefficient, and costly. Shane swapped out the tankless with a traditional, energy efficient hot water tank and circulating pump. It’s practically silent, we have hot water immediately, no more cold shower blast when someone flushes, and no more wasted water! Shane was in and out in under 3 hours, was really friendly, was very careful about navigating heavy tanks up and down our stairs as well. We felt the cost of the system change was very reasonable and will us save is money right away. Thanks Shane!

reviews.author: Victoria Burk
reviews.text: My hot water heater was going on a early Friday morning in October and made many calls and no one called me back but one and was very expensive and couldn't put a new one in until Monday. I googled again Saturday morning as now water was leaking out. It showed Hot Water Doctor and they were open so I called and talked to Shane. He could do it in a couple hours with no extra charge for a Saturday install and a better price! Shane got the old one taken out, put the new one in and two connection valves. Very clean and honest! Recommend him BIG TIME! It says Appleton but he lives here! CALL SHANE!!!

reviews.text:

Tony Moser

reviews.text:
When we moved in we had roaches, and there was evidence of previous serious infestation. They painted over roach feces all throughout the apartment and painted over a penny in the window seal before we moved in. The window in the kitchen has a hole in it since day one so I have it taped up because they said they don't have replacement windows. There is no glass in my peephole just an open hole to outside. There is a huge gap around the door so The apartment isn't insulated at all. The towel rack was broken leaving a hole in the wall, which they never fixed. They patched the sheetrock behind the toilet and it looks like a 5 yr old did it. The cabinets are broken, and some won't close. Many times we have been without hot water and heat or air. Also there is 2 pools which are never open. After 7 months of living here we ended up with bed bugs when the neighbors moved in. The office said bed bugs was excluded on pest control in our rent contract and told us we would have to pay 475$ to get our apparent treated. Maintenance is awful. Our A/C unit has been leaking into our hall right outside my daughter's room for about A week. We had to heat our apparent with our oven during the winter because we had no heat and it was 34 degrees outside. We had to buy a window unit when it got hot because we had no A/C till June. The grounds are trashed. People let their dogs use the bathroom just anywhere they want to. The office is closed half the time so its hard to even catch them. Every month for 4 months now we have had to go to the office to find out how much our utilities are. They were bought out about 4 months ago and can't seem to calculate our utilities since then. I would never rent here again or recommend this place to anyone.
The apartment is big for the money and its quite and safe here but that's about all I can say for it.

After disassembling the toilet , he advised that there was actually some other part broken as well . He showed me exactly what he was referring to and said he was prepared to take care of that also. He wanted me to know it was going to cost a little a little more and I appreciated him advising of same before beginning the work. He took care of both issues efficiently and very effectively with little to no mess upon his departure. My toilet and sink have been leaky and not usable for months and now , they are back to working perfectly,  without a single issue.  I used Bob's plumbing for the longest time and then, for no real reason, called a few other places instead. After being so disappointed , I remembered Bob's and called and set this appt. After having the experiences i had with other companies,  I won't call anyone but Bobs Plumbing for my plumbing needs and will request Brenden as well. MAC Plumbing have gone above and beyond for us and come through every time.

When we had a major house project, they handled all our plumbing and worked extremely well with our other contractors. They even recommended people to handle jobs that weren't in their wheelhouse!

They have also let us know when a project could be solved without more invasive or expensive solutions!

I absolutely recommend them for large or small plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Joel Jacobs
reviews.text: Have always received amazing service. Above and beyond. MAC are always very clear about what they are doing and why, all the while giving us the available choices. We have had major emergencies and minor inconveniences repaired by MAC and have never had any issues with their handling of any of it. Would strongly recommend

reviews.author: Nancy Garcia
reviews.text: I’ve been using MAC Plumbing for several years now. They are affordable, honest, and always deliver the best possible outcome. I recommend them to all my family and friends, and I highly recommend MAC Plumbing to everyone!!

reviews.author: David Leavitt
reviews.text: Highly recommend MacPlumbing!!  We hired them to come and clean out our pipes after a renter had put stuff down the drain that didn’t belong.  They were able to fix the problem and it was affordable, there was no comparison to the other plumbers!

reviews.author: Real Recovery Guy
reviews.text: Our experience with Miguel was nothing short to fantastic. Not only did he fix it right the first time but the price point he came in at was fair and reasonable. I would recommend his honesty and his workmanship before anyone else.

plumbers.name: Loves Plumbing
plumbers.address: 10940 SW 79th Ave, Tigard, OR 97223, USA

reviews.author: haily todd
reviews.text:
I called Loves Plumbing on a Saturday when my old water heater stopped working, and they came out the same day — even on the weekend! Kyle was professional, friendly, and explained everything. He recommended upgrading to a tankless water heater and even installed it in my garage that same day. The new system works perfectly and I finally have endless hot water again!
If you’re looking for fast, reliable water heater repair or replacement near Tigard or Beaverton, I highly recommend Loves Plumbing. And be sure to note that this Loves Plumbing has a black and pink truck, with owner Kyle. There is another Loves plumbing that people are getting confused with.

reviews.author: Kevin Daniel
reviews.text: Kyle was great to work with. I had to replace my second floor toilet because the tank had a big crack.  He was punctual. He was detailed in his work to install the Toto Drake toilet. Great communication overall. I highly recommend to contact him for your plumbing needs. I will certainly continue to use his services.

reviews.author: Charles Fleming
reviews.text: Kyle at Love's plumbing was great to work with and got me a new water heater installed quickly. Communication was very easy, I really appreciate that he offered options I could try myself and did not just push me into a costly repair that I might not have needed. When it came time to do the work he got the work done to my satisfaction, answering all of my questions, and explaining things very well. Overall he has great customer service and I would recommend his service.

reviews.author: Adele Gunter
reviews.text: Great experience with Loves Plumbing! Kyle did an excellent job fixing my bathtub faucet that wouldn’t stop leaking. He quickly found the problem, replaced the worn parts, and made sure everything was sealed and working perfectly before he left. Very professional, knowledgeable, and friendly. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Ben Gumbiner
reviews.text: I have partnered with Kyle on plumbing issues as part of restoration work through Voda Cleaning & Restoration. His communication was great and he was professional and thorough in his diagnosis and repair. Highly recommend for your plumbing needs!

plumbers.name: Crawford Mechanical Services
plumbers.address: 9464 Jersey Mill Rd, Pataskala, OH 43062, USA

reviews.author: Rishi Bhanot
reviews.text: We found a hole in the exhaust of our furnace and had to turn it off in the middle of winter while we had a full house for Christmas.  Crawford dispatched their technician (Hunter Myers) and he was at our home within an hour.  Hunter was polite and professional and most importantly got us up and running that morning.  Cannot thank you enough!

reviews.author: Mindfulness in Motion
reviews.text: We had an unexpected emergency with our furance. It could not be turned on until it was fixed. We were just about to leave for Christmas with my whole family. Hunter came out right away, got us up and running in about 2 hours. We didn't have to change our plans and the grandparents got to see their grandkids! I am so grateful for Hunter's hard work.

reviews.author: Diane Serpas
reviews.text: Tankless water heater. First off Crawford called back immediately after leaving a voicemail. Chris scheduled a time to come out and see where he can put the tankless water heater in. And remove the existing water heater. After all was done, he thanked us and said he would send a estimate. He sent the best estimate around. Plus it was very detailed. We proceed with him and we are very happy to do business with him. He and his helper are very well informed about all that we have to ask about. Well's and everything. His wife is a gem. If you are looking for a honest person to do work on your house. Please consider this company. You won't regret it. You don't find many people who are just humble people like them often.

reviews.author: Douglas Waters
reviews.text: Hunter came out to install a new shutoff valve in my kitchen as well as install the new faucet. He was knowledgeable, friendly, and efficient. He also informed me of what he was doing and why it was needed. 10 out of 10 would recommend to anyone needing plumbing work done.

reviews.author: Carlisle & Ruffing
reviews.text: CMS worked with us on an unconventional and large commercial project. I can't say enough about how they were willing to adapt and overcome to make the project a success. Communication at every level was seamless. Their technicians are polite and fun to be around. We are looking forward to working with you guys on some more conventional projects moving forward. Thank you so much.

plumbers.name: Cox Plumbing Co. Inc.
plumbers.address: 616 E Broadway, Waukesha, WI 53186, USA

reviews.author: Ellyn Lem
reviews.text: We have used Cox plumbing for 16 years and have found them to be reasonable in terms of price and reliable. I really like how they stand by their work. There are less plumbers now, so Jeff is really busy handling all the service calls he gets. But we really appreciated that he took care of replacing our water heater on Friday of a holiday weekend, which was really kind of him. People can trust the work that he will do for them. Might need a little patience since he is so busy, but that in itself is a good sign. He is busy for a reason.

reviews.author: Sabrina Schaefer
reviews.text: Our water heater started spraying water out of it on Tuesday evening. I called Jeff Wednesday morning, explained the situation, and he made his recommendation to replace our dated unit. We had a new water heater and hot water before 3pm that day. Jeff was responsive and pleasant to work with. Even when I felt like I was being annoying, he did not seem annoyed. His price was reasonable and he was very clear in his communication of what to expect. I will absolutely be using him again for all my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Chris Clark
reviews.text: Jeff the owner of Cox Plumbing is amazing at what he does. My Plumbing is 70 years old and outdated and Jeff was very professional helping with removing a very stubborn clog that caused my basement sink to back up with sewage. I have a very happy family who now is able to use the shower and run water as needed thanks to Jeff! Please be patient with him as he is a very busy man and a one man show. HE IS definitely worth the wait! He was very educational on telling me what pipes needed to be replaced along with how he would handle replacing them. He is a master of his craft and I look forward in knowing that he is our neighborhood plumber and Available when needed!

reviews.author: Sheri Beyer
reviews.text: Jeff is Wonderful! He helped me with my emergency plumbing snaking need and got it done in a timely manner! Professional and good at what he does! Will definitely use his services again!

reviews.author: JP C
reviews.text: I called Jeff at midnight, I had a tree root clog in my basement drain. Water was backing up into my basement everytime we used the toilet or sink. I called him at 12 he was here by 1230. He was very friendly, knowledgeable, and very professional. He worked very hard and got the job done fast. Thank you Jeff for your fast response and hard work. We will definitely be using your services again!

plumbers.name: Purdy Plumbing Repair and Mechanical Services, LLC
plumbers.address: 10421 Burnham Dr, Gig Harbor, WA 98332, USA

reviews.author: Elaina Smith
reviews.text: Chris from Purdy Plumbing was amazing! He listened to my concerns, heard what our family needed, provided options, and had the best estimate out of 5 companies. Chris was by the far the best of all the companies that we spoke too. He was honest, fair, and did the job right. I cannot express my gratitude enough. Thank you!

reviews.author: Ronald Carlsen
reviews.text:
I learned of Purdy Plumbing from the man who handle the landscaping for our HOA community. Our association had a couple of septic system field line root issues. We got quotes from two other known Plumbing companies before we knew about Purdy and the first quote was out of sight and the second was only have way out of sight. We contacted our landscaper about a plumbing company and he suggested Purdy. They came out and inspected the situation and found the problem and gave us a quote that was reasonably high, but much more inline with reality. Two technicians came out and dug up the two problem areas and took care of the roots and repaired the breaks in the lines. They then checked with a camera line 100 feet up and 100 feet down the pipe to make sure there were no other breaks. They left the repair sites, pristine.
Because they did such a great job and were somewhat affordable, I called them when I needed my tankless water heater serviced and a complete kitchen sink and faucet plumbing redo. One of the same very nice technicians (Richard Sherman) who helped the HOA was the one who arrived to help us. Four hours later the jobs were completed. I had everything out to go under the kitchen sink cabinet to thorough clean and when I opened the doors, it was spotless, just like new.
There are 21 other homes in our little community and I plan on letting them know about Purdy Plumbing Company. You can’t find a more honest and professional group of people.
Ron Carlsen

reviews.author: Jenifer Diegel
reviews.text: Purdy Plumbing has always been great to work with.  This time our tankless water heater went out and needed a replacement.  Chris researched units that would fit in the space and that are high quality. He did an excellent job on the install.

reviews.author: Dwayne Hummel
reviews.text: Outstanding service.  Richard was our team member from Purdy Plumbing, and he was professional, courteous, friendly, knowledgeable and a skilled tradesman.  His work was exemplary and he went above and beyond the call to ensure we had an accessible way to get to the new shutoff valve he installed.  My wife and highly recommend Purdy Plumbing as an outstanding, trustworthy, and professional source for all plumbing repairs.  Very timely and helpful.  "Don't Get Durdy, Call Purdy"!

reviews.author: Bryan Sampey
reviews.text: The other day Kash with Purdy Plumbing came to our apartment to do service on our water heater. He was very friendly and knowledgeable. He performed service carefully and throughly. I originally had the water heater installed 9 years ago by Purdy Plumbing and Jason did a very good job with the installation. My experience with Purdy Plumbing has been very positive and if I need future plumbing service that company would be the first one I’d call.

reviews.author: billthem4n !
reviews.text: Very personable person. But they came out twice and didn't fix my toilet. They charged me a lot of money for not fixing my toilet either time.  I will not be calling for their service again or recommending them to anyone. Unsatisfied with the results.

reviews.author: Matthew Mortensen
reviews.text: Was quoted an estimate of 350, Taylor came out and had the job done in less then 30 minutes and only charged me $187. I’d highly recommend them, very affordable, very knowledgeable, and very professional!

reviews.author: John Sperger
reviews.text: Water heater died over the weekend. Called early Monday, they were here by Noon and had it fixed by 3PM. They did have to go back and get a water heater for me but that was expected. Could not say how appreciative I was to get hot water again so quickly.

reviews.author: George Petersen
reviews.text: We needed a new toilet installed and I stopped at the office the girl said I would get a call for the quote. Got a call soon after. They would order it came a few days later to install it. Very quick and professional. Would definitely recommend R&R Plumbing.

reviews.author: Jennifer Kenas
reviews.text: When you own a business in a small town, how you conduct yourself in public matters. Today, I personally witnessed you driving in a manner that put our community at risk—running red lights, cutting people off in the roundabout, and exceeding the speed limit along 9th Street. This kind of behavior not only reflects poorly on you, but also on your business. Actions like these make me unwilling to support or recommend your services. Please remember: you represent more than yourself when you’re behind the wheel.

plumbers.name: Space Coast Plumbing Inc

reviews.author: Stephen
reviews.text: Really recommend this company. Jake was extremely helpful with my purchase of an ice machine when I needed help with the install. He offered his expert recommendation what to get and helped me tremendously. I'd use Space Coast Plumbing for anything. Very helpful, police, and professional. Thanks again.

reviews.author: Dr. Robin Z Miller
reviews.text: Jake is AMAZING!  I needed an expansion tank attached to my wall for the water heater (for compliance with my homeowners insurance).  I honestly did not know who to call, so I went on Google!  Space Coast Plumbing was at the top of the list with a 5 Star rating which is a rarity.  Jake answered immediately and was there within no time.  No overpricing....just honest and genuine and very fair.  I could tell he was good people.  Jake did a fantastic job and I have already recommended him to anyone that needs a plumber.  He will by my only go to plumber from here on out!

reviews.author: Michael Priest
reviews.text: Space Coast Plumbing helped resolve my sewer blockage by discovering that AT&T had pierced my lateral sewer line when installing fiber optic cables in my neighborhood.  This meant that AT&T would be 100% responsible for the cost of repairs!  I would highly recommend Space Coast Plumbing to anyone looking for fast, professional, and thorough plumbing services.  Thanks again for all your help!

reviews.author: Tomiko Watts
reviews.text: Our experience with Jake at Space Coast Plumbing was great! He got back to us in a timely manner and was able to come check out our plumbing issues AND fix it that same day. We really appreciated his professionalism and timeliness with him. Oh and everything is fixed up great in our house!

reviews.author: Vincent DeVita
reviews.text: Jake from Space Coast Plumbing did an excellent job replacing my old AO Smith water heater. He installed a new Rheem unit, added all new copper fittings, including new expansion tank, plus it had a better warranty than my old unit & also more energy efficient too. Cleaned up & took my old unit all done very efficiently in less than 1 & 1/2 hours. Highly recommend them.👍👍

plumbers.address: 1128 Algonquin Rd, Lake in the Hills, IL 60156, USA

reviews.author: Karen Smith
reviews.text: Michael is terrific! Quick response. Knowledgeable. Friendly and extremely fair. Professional,  respectful, direct. Follows through and truly cares. Love this company.  Can't say enough good things!!

reviews.author: Paulette C
reviews.text: Friendly Plumbing is a wonderful company.  We had a leak in our storage area and were so worried about what was happening.  I called Friendly Plumbing and Michael was here the next day.  Looked at the issue and told me all I needed was an end cap on a vent pipe and he wouldn't take any payment from me. So nice to work with an honest company.

reviews.author: m m
reviews.text:
I had an emergency water heater issue on a Sunday and called Friendly Plumbing.  Even though they were technically closed, they answered my call, gave me instructions for safety until they could arrive the following morning and provided me with warranty information on the unit within minutes of us talking

The next day when Michael arrived he knew within minutes what the issue was, explained why it malfunctioned and had the faulty parts installed.  Because of the previous days water leak, the unit wouldn’t stay lit because everything was still wet so we set up a large fan to dry it out and he returned later to finalize the repair.  Michael has done other work at my home over the years and it’s always done meticulously, professionally and  of course Friendly!  He’s a plumbing genius!  Fortunately for me he installed a floor drain years ago in the utility closet and that saved my adjoining room’s flooring during this incident

From start to finish this company was amazing- made a tough situation much easier to navigate. Highly recommend them for sll your plumbing needs

reviews.author: Nany Michael
reviews.text:
Total ripoff! I hired them to take a look for a partially clogged toilet. A guy came and asked, if I wanna remodel?!!! I said no
He said; well, it will cost you $825!!!
For what?!! He said we will remove the whole toilet and unclogged.
I told him it’s just a partial clogging. He said:” I know but that’s our price”!!
Total RIPOFF

reviews.author: Susan McKinney
reviews.text: I cannot speak highly enough of Friendly plumbing. The owner is so conscientious. He resolved my tree root drain clog quickly and competently, left the area spotless,  and even resolved an additional issue I had with low water pressure in my faucet. He was also so personable and polite. I would hire him any time.

plumbers.name: Mass Pike Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 100 Front St suite 401, Worcester, MA 01608, USA

reviews.author: Allan Pires
reviews.text:
Doing business with Evan was a satisfying experience! He came to rescue me when I most needed. Long story short: The pipe connection to my water heater burst on a cold Friday night around 10:50pm. Instantly I was left with no hot water in the house. I contacted Evan first thing Saturday morning, after seeing all his great reviews. He promptly showed up, diagnosed my water heater with rusty pipes, and gave me a fair estimate. Evan replaced my water heater and all the plumbing connections on the same day.
From now on I’ll be Evan’s customer for all my HVAC/plumbing needs. Thank you, Evan! Keep up the outstanding work!
Allan Pires

reviews.author: Nicole Ruf
reviews.text: Evan has been our go to Plumber for a couple years now. He is very responsive with communications and he always makes room for us in his schedule. We feel confident and safe with Evan as our plumber. He is respectful, trustworthy and reliable. He has been able to diagnose all our problems and fix them same day or within a couple days. If you are looking for a reliable plumber for any of your plumbing problems or emergent needs Evan is your guy. He will show up, ready to figure out how to help your family best, he will communicate clearly, and he will get the job done in a timely manner.

reviews.author: Gigi Moise
reviews.text: Evan was dispatched to my home due to my toilet not working properly and bathroom sink clogged . He arrived on time and went straight to work. He was attentive to the situation . Explained every step of the way . Even caught a leak I wasn’t aware of. 🫣Identified the problem and remediated as quick as possible. I couldn’t be more happy with the service. If you’re looking for prompt, professional, knowledgeable  and overall positive experience look no further then Mass Pike Plumbing and Heating. Tell them Gigi sent you .

reviews.author: Maria “Ma”
reviews.text: Evan is highly efficient and dependable. I was having serious issues with my steam heater and three of my radiators. The work done was professional and there was a thorough explanation given. All my questions were answered and I'd have to say I'm 100 percent confident.

reviews.author: Stefanie DePaul
reviews.text:
Evan Ryan & Mass Pike Plumbing & Heating are THE BEST! Evan is one of the hardest working people I have ever met in my entire life. I met Evan years ago and whenever I have any issue with my plumbing, Evan is there right away! Evan has installed a rainforest showerhead for me. Evan has come on a Sunday and fixed a clogged kitchen sink that was full of crushed egg shells in the garbage disposal. (he also taught me that the garbage disposal is for crumbs and not for actual food!) Evan has come to my office and unclogged a toilet on a Sunday. He is also installed plumbing for a washer and dryer at my office. He always gives a fair price and he always cleans up after himself and leaves the place nicer than he found it.

I highly recommend Evan and Mass Pike plumbing and heating! 10/10 Recommend! 😀

reviews.author: C Sanders
reviews.text: I needed my bathtub drain replaced, and the job was done perfectly. Matthew was very clear in explaining each step of the work and what everything would cost. I would absolutely use their plumbing services again. Matthew also quickly came to fix a valve under my kitchen sink that was needed for a new dishwasher. He arrived on time and finished the repair quickly. The whole team worked smoothly together, making sure everything was installed without any problems!

reviews.author: Alec Roberson
reviews.text: I was really impressed with the service I received from Alex & Sons Plumbing. When I called, the person answering the phone was friendly and answered all my questions about installing a new water heater. They gave me a fair price and scheduled the install right away. Nolan came out to my place in Littleton and did the installation quickly and without any issues. He was very polite and easy to talk to. As someone who has run a business myself, I really appreciate when a company treats customers well and makes the whole process smooth from beginning to end. I couldn’t be happier with the job they did!

reviews.author: sarah flynn
reviews.text: After a week without water in my kitchen, I called for help with a new faucet installation and was amazed when Nolan showed up at my Littleton home within the hour. I had been left without a working faucet, but Nolan was friendly, reassuring, and clearly knew his way around plumbing repairs. He quickly got everything installed and made sure the job was done right. It was a huge relief to have my kitchen back in working order, and I feel very fortunate to have found such a reliable plumber. I know who I’ll call the next time I need any plumbing work done!

reviews.author: Abby Dorsey
reviews.text: From the moment we called, Robert was very helpful and quick to answer all our plumbing questions. We were in the process of buying a home and needed a plumber to inspect a problem with the pipes before closing. Robert handled scheduling our appointments and sent confirmations right away, making everything stress-free. Nolan was the plumber who came out, and he was professional and showed up on time for both the inspection and the repairs. He explained everything clearly, fixed the plumbing issue fast, and gave us peace of mind before moving in. We are very happy with the inspection and the repair work done. If we ever need plumbing or drain services again, we will definitely call them.

reviews.author: maria morris
reviews.text: I had a burst hot water pipe at my rental property and needed a plumber fast. Even though I wasn't in town, John and Nolan showed up just an hour after I called and worked late into the night to fix the problem. They explained everything to me in simple terms and made sure I understood what was going on, which really helped ease my worries. They even handled the paperwork for the water damage clean-up with my insurance. I'm really happy with how quickly and professionally they got my plumbing issue sorted out.

That is a professional and a kind man.

reviews.author: Monika H
reviews.text:

I thanked him for finally showing up and send him on his way. Then I called Carlos. From the first call he was very responsive. I called that same night and he arrived the next afternoon.
He even sent me a google map link to follow him as he made his way to my house, which I thought was really helpful. Carlos explained my options and then got to work unclogging the drain under my house that was causing a back up in my shower and toilet. I'm glad I called him, he was very professional, responsive and reasonable.
The next time I have a plumbing issue, Carlos will now be my go to. I would recommend him to friends and family.
Definitely deserves 5 stars.

reviews.author: Laura Z
reviews.text:

Scott asked about the log set we bought and immediately recognized it. He explained the installation options, as well as the need for a permit and inspection afterward. They were extremely helpful, and we decided to have them handle the installation at a very reasonable price, which included the permit.

They were easy and pleasant to work with, very responsive, and clearly knowledgeable. Highly recommend, and we would definitely use them again. Thanks, Scott and Leo!

reviews.author: Stephen
reviews.text: We had an issue with one of our showers where the water wouldn't stop flowing. Leo came out on the morning of Friday after Thanksgiving to repair it. Luckily he had the part needed and was able to fix it in less than a hour. He was also kind enough to switch the water cables on our washing machine to fix that because cold was hot and hot was cold. We need a new faucet for the kitchen and once we get one picked out, we will be scheduling an appointment to get that installed. Great service overall.

reviews.author: Nancy Hurwitz
reviews.text: Called on a Saturday morning (between Christmas and New Years) and a service man was here by 2:00pm.  The service man  knew exactly what the problem was and how to repair it.  In a very short time we had hot water again.  We highly recommend Fairfax Plumbing NV for any plumbing problem. We will certainly will use them for all our plumbing needs.  Very reasonably priced especially during the holiday season.

reviews.author: Aras Troy
reviews.text: Scott and his screw did an incredible job identifying a leak coming from our small bathroom and gave me a great price to not only solve the problem. I was very happy with the quality of the work and the options he gave me, see the pictures below for how much it transformed. The work included replacing some of the rotted floorboards, replacing the shower pan, adding a niche in the wall, mounting a medicine cabinet, replacing the toilet, sink, floor, and tiling. The work started promptly and Scott was always available for questions. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Steve Shimko
reviews.text: My 86 year old grandmother paid $5,000 to have a 150 foot section of downspout pipe that goes to the street replaced. We had a technician out initially to try and snake the drain. The tech worked for 20 minutes with a hydro jet and decided that the pipe was broken underground. They charged $500 for a 20 minute service. He then told us that another tech would be out the following day to run a camera and locator through the pipe to decide what further action needed to be taken. That tech was there for another 20 minutes and did nothing but right a quote for having the pipe replaced. He initially told us that it would cost $3,900 dollars, he then spoke on the phone with a supervisor who told us that it would cost an additional $4,500 to have it fixed. So that’s how we got to $5,000. We were told they would call the day before before they came to do the work which they did not. They did the work in 1 day. It wasn’t a small job, but hardly worth $5,000.  They left a huge mess  of boulders, roots and broken concrete on my grandmas yard and told her that it would “settle out in 5 to 8 months” and that they weren’t landscapers. For 5k they could’ve tried harder to clean up their mess. They also took $20 worth of corrugated pipe that I had temporarily rigged up so that her basement wouldn’t flood. Sure, she now has a good piece of pipe in the ground but I’m pretty unhappy with the way they treated my grandmother and her property. They didn’t cover the concrete that they put in and it rained on it. The day after, my grandma is almost in tears because of the way they left her yard.

reviews.author: Patrick C
reviews.text: Caleb and Jacob are awesome! Got the job done efficiently and for a great price! Will recommend to anybody!

reviews.author: Tucker Deloach
reviews.text:
I questioned writing this review, but I feel like it has to be said. I have used Keith’s twice in the last month. The first time was AMAZING. Great service, quick, great work. The second occasion, everything opposite. I had a sink drain that broke when someone tried moving a table, so I asked if they could repair it, and prevent it from happening again by updating the piping to code where there is clearance from the floor and the drain pipe. I was told by them that it wasn’t code the way that it was. They fixed it same day which was great. I wasn’t on site to review the work, but I was told it was fine so I didn’t have anything to add.

Next day, I was called to remit payment. I was told my bill was $322. The first time I used them for two broken sink drains at a different location and it was $175. I politely asked for a breakdown because it wasn’t adding up, and was told that I was being charged for 2h 15m of labor and $62 in parts. I told them I don’t think that was accurate, so I told them I would like to review my camera footage and call back and they had no issues with that.

After reviewing my footage, 1st guy came in from 1:15-1:18 to look at it. Then, from 1:37-1:40 2 different guys came in and back out, then they came back in from 2:00-2:17. All in all, a total of 23 minutes inside. Now, I understand drive time factors in, they probably also were getting the parts together outside and making everything work. So let’s say 15mins drive time there and back plus an hour at the site. That is 1 1/2 hrs total. Still overcharged at least 45 minutes in my book.

What I was originally told was that it was drive time, then I was told that I paid $120 for the first guy to come out for 3 minutes to look at it and call someone else to come and do it. Not sure why first guy has to come seeing as it was a very small task, but I digress.

When I first called voicing my concern I was told I had to talk to the office manager, no problem. She called me back next day since it was almost 5. I told her what I said above, politely, and her response without any hesitation was “I understand. If you have a problem with your bill then we can just disregard it and you can take any future business elsewhere.” What? I’m telling you I think I was overcharged and there was a mistake and your immediate response is to write me off? Regardless, I told her either way I was going to pay bill, but all I wanted to do was get an explanation on how 23 minutes turned into 135 minutes of labor. No reasonable explanation or reevaluation was given.

Not to mention I didn’t complain about the quality of work I received a it was a patch job. For ‘parts’ I was charged $62. I received a 6inch piece of rubber piping to connect my two broken pvc pipes that I didn’t throw away, and 2 clamps to tighten it down. On top of that, the pipe was put in the exact same position it was before, so if the same instance occurred it would just break the same exact way. Once again, I digress.

The issue is that I was immediately told that I was wrong and if I didn’t like it I could go elsewhere. There were multiple different ways, better ways, to handle that minor complaint I had. I felt disrespected. Especially when I could have, and obviously should have just done this myself for $15 and 20 minutes of my time.

Feel free to review the pictures below and make your own conclusion if you think it was worth $322 for someone to slap 2 pieces of broken pipe together with a piece of rubber hose and clamp it down. Would you have $322 for this?

reviews.text:

I think it’s beautiful too!?

___________

I had Josh come out a second time to look at a new vibration issue and it turns out the water pressure adjustment valve was the culprit. It provided 65lbs/in2 and was not adjustable. My shower DTV control has a rating of 45lb/in2 MAX and the higher pressure was the cause of the knocking. Josh arrived and had a sense that this may be the issue and even brought a new pressure adjustment valve. We tested everything first and then replaced the adjustment valve. I had a great experience with Freddy and his team at Freedom Underground at my Menlo Park residence.

It was a hairy situation where I needed to install a new sewer line down a shared driveway and into the public street. Various permits and inspections from the city as well as the sanitary district were needed, I had some concerned neighbors to deal with, and we had to do it in a way that protects a large heritage tree right near the work.

Freddy was extremely patient and creative during the scoping process. He understood the requirements and concerns of all parties involved and offered different solutions based on what the needs were. He and his office manager Fiona did a good job of managing all the admin stuff as well. I never felt like the team didn't know what they were doing or didn't have a plan.

Once the job started, Miguel did an excellent job managing the work and the team. His communication was great and he quickly corrected course based on any concerns or requirements raised. Miguel was a good foreman.

I felt in good hands the whole time and I thought the team was very diligent in cleaning up each day, keeping me updated on progress, etc. I'd definitely work with them again.

reviews.author: Mahmud Ischanov
reviews.text:
My 60 year old galvanized main water line pipe decided to spring a leak one cold Saturday evening... I had to scramble to turn the water off at the meter. As soon as I did, I started calling around plumbers that could come out quick to help me fix the pipe, as i had no water in the house of 5 people. No showers, washing hands or using toilets.
4 guys came out, Freddy from Freedom was 2nd lowest offer. What sold me on his quote was that he was going to use a trenchless tunneling system called the HammerHead (minimize trenching and destruction of 50 feet of my yard) and the fact that he suggested that he install a pressure regulator without being asked (unlike the other plumbers). The pressure regulator is important because after replacing a 60 year old corroded galvanized steel pipe with brand new copper line, the water pressure in the house could go up dramatically, causing damage to appliances and pipes in the house. Freddy even agreed to install a Flo by Moen leak detection system at no additional charge.
I am glad I decided to go with Freddy, his guys showed up on time the next morning, as agreed. His crew of guys (Christian and 4 others) worked non-stop, tirelessly and professionally. I could definitely tell the guys take pride in their work, they all did a fantastic job.
I would recommend Freddy and Freedom Underground, they are awesome!

“Five stars for Felix and Drain Guys — honest, skilled, and truly exceptional service.”

Felix and his team at Drain Guys did a fabulous job. They repaired our sewer line and replaced the clean out, digging about eight feet down with care and precision.

I first noticed the soil around my old clean out starting to sink. Felix came out quickly, scoped the line with a camera, and clearly explained what was happening and why it should be fixed. He never pressured me, and I chose to move forward before a bigger problem developed.

During the repair, Felix taught me about the installation and how the system works. As a lifelong learner and DIY type, I really appreciated that he and the crew took time to explain each step.

Photos (Before and After): Felix explained how the backfill, or ‘spoil,’ settles naturally after a deep repair. It may look like extra soil now, but it evens out as it compacts.

The team was professional, courteous, and left everything clean and organized. I’m very grateful for their honesty, skill, and pride in their work. Highly recommend Drain Guys to anyone in the Greater Chicagoland area.

We’re so grateful for the professionalism, expertise, and honesty that Drain Guys provided. Highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Ellen Spertus
reviews.text:
We were disappointed with our most recent experience replacing the faucet and under-sink hot water heater in our kitchen.

First, I requested an appointment online. The form said we would hear back within a day; we didn't. I called to schedule an appointment, and they told me someone would come by 8-9 AM the next day, provide an estimate, and do the work if I approved the estimate.. After 10 AM, they called to say they had an emergency and would call me back in a few hours with an updated time; they didn't. I called the next day and was told someone would come 10-11 AM; they didn't, and we didn't receive a call this time. I telephoned again and was told they would call back to give me a new appointment time; they didn't. A plumber did come by when I was out; fortunately, my husband was home.

The plumbing work seems to have been done well, although a circuit breaker tripped because of where the water heater was plugged in. The plumber took away the old faucet and heater (good) and also the box with the new items, including the documentation and receipt (bad). I asked my husband what the work cost, and he said the plumber said that we would be invoiced, so we didn't get an estimate first; granted, I could have told my husband to request one.

reviews.text:
This company is the real deal. Within fifteen minutes of my initial call, I was in contact with Marshall, which immediately demonstrated their responsiveness and professionalism.

My first experience with Collin’s Plumbing involved obtaining a quote to replace the shutoff valves in my home. Another company had quoted me $13,000 for the job, but Collin’s Plumbing provided an estimate of $1,800 and even offered practical advice for a potential DIY approach. Their honesty and transparency made a lasting impression.

In my most recent experience, Marshall assisted me with a thermal expansion tank issue, where I believed I had stripped the copper pipe connection to the water heater. After exchanging a few texts to assess the situation, he patiently walked me through each step to resolve the problem. When I asked what I owed for his expert guidance, he told me it was on the house.

Only a few hours earlier, I was stressed and expecting another costly plumbing bill in the range of $500–$1,000. To have the issue resolved so quickly—and at no charge—was an incredible relief and a genuine testament to their integrity.

Collin’s Plumbing has consistently exceeded my expectations through fair pricing, responsiveness, and honest service. I highly recommend them to anyone seeking a trustworthy plumbing company. Keep up the excellent work, and may Jesus continue to guide your business. God bless.

reviews.text: We have used and trusted Stay True Plumbing for over 20 years.  We are seniors on a fixed budget. We asked them to replace our powder room toilet with a better quality toilet (Kohler). They quoted $650 to replace and install. What we got was the lowest grade Kohler toilet on sale for $200 retail, it cost less for them. It would have taken less than 20 minutes to replace. But Randy kept going back and forth outside (to do what, I have know idea) making it seem longer to install probably to justify $450 installation cost.  We are very disappointed in them and will not recommend or use again.

reviews.author: Samantha Yang (Sam)
reviews.text: Called and got serviced the same day. Randy was super nice and helped us with our kitchen sink! Thank you again Randy!

reviews.author: L T
reviews.text: I called the office very friendly staff, Shirley was about to get me on the schedule immediately! As a first time homeowner with my very first issue I was very stressed, but she was able to ease my mind. I had to pay a $50 non refundable fee but if you use their service it applies to it. I always love to support small business owners first, I will be calling them anytime I have an issue that requires plumbing. Randy was very kind, professional & very knowledgeable. They also came as promised at the time slot which was also another plus!

It's my 3rd time using this company and I don't trust any other company for my plumbing needs. I'm very pleased with the service.

reviews.author: Taylor Miller
reviews.text: Called Gomach plumbing late one evening to look at a sewer repair. Showed up next day ready to repair. Job was done in a timely fashion and best price I could find anywhere around.

reviews.author: Lorraine Hegedus

reviews.author: Larry Luther
reviews.text: Luke did an exceptional plumbing repair job for us. He was able to fit us in and provided a top notch service. We highly recommend Gomach Plumbing.

reviews.author: Chief Oshkosh

reviews.author: Dawn Keegan
reviews.text: These folks were contracted via my property management company. The entire process was easy despite having tech issues on my end. I had at least three different tickets which were fixed perfectly and quickly. What a great change of pace!

reviews.author: Rex Hofer
reviews.text: My insurance filed for this company to assist twice. First time was decent, second time they state they don’t do anything with insurance tried to bill us to even come look them refused looking at anything on very basic problems. This took about 6 phone calls because they disconnect on me or say they will call in X time & don’t.

reviews.author: nenedinaliii
reviews.text: Called them and was told they would come yesterday as long as I was home, and I stayed home for hours until late in the day and they never came. Very unprofessional. This isn’t the first time they’ve done this. The plumber seems to pick and choose if he feels like going out and fulfilling work orders, either that or the lady on the phone who schedules the appointments just lies. That was on a friday and now they’re closed for the whole weekend and can’t get anyone out until monday. Unfortunately they are the only ones that know my apartment units plumbing situation, given it’s a really old apartment complex not too many plumbers know how to fix clogs in my area. But if you are lucky and able to find a different plumber who can fix your issue don’t waste your time with this unreliable company. If it was up to me they would get 0 stars.

reviews.author: Neariah Hernandez
reviews.text: My rental company hired them to come fix our toilet. They were unavailable 4-5 days after the order was submitted. They never said what time they'd show up just that they'd be here Monday. No courtesy phone call. Just a couple of guys that showed up. They damaged our toilet by scratching it with the snake they used. Seem like a couple of amateurs. Will tell our property company not to use them again.

reviews.author: G
reviews.text: Absolutely the worst plumbing company I have ever dealt with. When scheduling my appointment I asked for a call ahead to ensure that someone would be there and the lady said of course no problem. Had a time frame between 12-6. Well the day of got the call saying that our plumber was on the way and would be there in about 15-20 min. An hour and a half later the plumber finally showed up and then it took another ten minutes before he actually knocked on my door. When I let him in showed him the issue he told me it would be a super easy fix and he would be in and out quickly. I went back to cleaning so I wouldn't bother him and noticed he got real quiet peaked around and kid you not he was sitting on my kitchen floor playing a video game on his phone. Finally got up and went outside to get some things and there he proceeded to continue playing games or texting and taking personal calls while on the job. A call that should have taken about twenty minutes took him an hour and on top of it all left an absolute mess under my kitchen sink. If I had the choice of what plumber to use it would not have been these guys.

plumbers.name: Convenient Plumbing
plumbers.address: 200 South Dr, South Elgin, IL 60177, USA

reviews.author: Ami Engel
reviews.text:
The team at Convenient Plumbing is great. I have used them for years to help with all kinds of needs, large and small. They are responsive and strive to educate you when they are doing repairs so you understand the need. They won’t do a repair if it is not warranted, and they will talk you through those situations as well.

We have had their help with our toilet, the outdoor spigots, the ejector pump, and our water heater. They even did a camera view of the pipe that goes out to the street.

I appreciate their service and certainly recommend their services to others!

reviews.author: Jeremy AmRhein
reviews.text: Had a great experience working with Convenient Plumbing.  They turned my Thursday night nightmare into an early Friday morning solution.  My water heater broke down and Ed and his son Jeremy came the very next morning to diagnose the problem.  After a discussion about the cost to repair versus the cost to replace (10 yr old heater), I decided to replace the unit.  They replaced the unit within a few hours.  Fast, efficient and honest.  Straight forward communication, no upselling or pressure.  Rare to find these days.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Joe F
reviews.text: We just had Convenient Plumbing fix an issue with our ejector pit backing up. They were upfront about all charges and options to resolve the issue. They were  amazing, professional, and speedy. Great work, great company.

reviews.author: Leo
reviews.text: They are now my go to plumbing company. Called 3 different plumbers. Ed called me back within minutes and stopped by within 15 to take a look at what needed to be done. Quoted me on the spot, scheduled to have the village shut off the water a few days later and was here a few minutes after the water was turned off. Ed and Jeremy worked quickly, explained everything and answered all my questions. They did a great job and I will definitely recommend them to anyone needing a professional plumber.

reviews.author: Carlos Durand
reviews.text: Had recently needed our ejector pump replaced, called and was quoted properly over the phone and the work was done within 2-3 hours of me calling, and here I thought I was just going to be calling to schedule! Walked me through what was done and some tips with the new pump, highly recommend for anyone in the Fox Valley area that is looking for both reliable and speedy plumbing service!

reviews.author: Jana McNally
reviews.text:

I noticed a one star review and I believe they must have the wrong company because they reference an office woman and there is no office woman with this company. When you call you get directly connected to the plumber (a male).

reviews.author: DK 13
reviews.text:

I really appreciate that!
Honest, helpful and kind person, what’s why in any future project I’ll call them and also recommend to everybody.

reviews.author: Jim Becker
reviews.text: When I needed help with an important plumbing issue, I called All Suburban for the first time. The person on the phone was professional and within 1 hr, two pro's showed up and did the job quickly and at a fair price. The guys that did the work were outstanding and explained things perfectly to me. I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Nancy O'Brien
reviews.text: There should be a 5 star option as that is what All Suburban Plumbing deserves. A leaky water heater required a visit from them. It needed to be replaced. All Suburban determined it was still under warranty and took care of getting a new one and installing it in less than a day. The only finger I lifted was to dial their number and you should too if you are in need of their services. Prompt, kind, solid, trustworthy people. Thank you All Suburban!

reviews.author: Hollie R
reviews.text: I had used this company for 2 small jobs previously and everything was fine.  Had them come back out to rod a bathtub drain and this was absolutely the worst service experience.  After the team left, I was cleaning up (they don't cover their boots), and when I went rinse out the tub, water started flowing through the ceiling in the bathroom below as a hole had been poked through my pipe.  I immediately called the company but as it was 5pm, they couldn't send anyone until the next day.  When the office called the next morning, I asked would their insurance cover the work given what had occurred, the office woman tells me "don't start with me, we don't have to send anyone out." This cost me an insurance claim, my deductible, and months of repairs.

plumbers.name: GTX Plumbing

reviews.author: Kristi Carney
reviews.text: GTX Plumbing was AMAZING! They came out so quickly to help us with plumbing issues and provided outstanding service. Their team is always incredibly prompt, professional, and a pleasure to work with. We truly appreciate how fast and efficient they were — highly recommend GTX Plumbing to anyone in Georgetown!

reviews.author: Lahari
reviews.text: Five stars!!!! We had a burst spigot during the freeze, and they were absolute lifesavers. They actually FaceTimed with us yesterday to assess the damage and give us peace of mind when no one else could make it out. Then, they braved the icy roads today to complete the repair. Professional, kind, and incredibly helpful.

reviews.author: Christina Bhatti
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about GTX plumbing. I called them for an emergency when the company my home warranty works with couldn't make it.

reviews.author: Michael Skawin
reviews.text: I have utilized GTX since the big freeze. reviews.author: Jimmy Voyles
reviews.text: Very impressed with professionalism and installation quality of our Gemline KDC filtration system.  Thank you Christopher and Cesar!

reviews.author: Helen Van
reviews.text: I contacted Plumbing & Rooter Service on a Sunday evening because our kitchen sink was clogged and stuff was coming back up. They diligently worked at it since the clog was pretty far down (we live in a condo building). He was also able to work with my building manager to make sure that they understood what the problem was. I can't recommend this plumbing service enough. Very happy with the result and how much the service costed.

reviews.author: Wai Wai
reviews.text: Found them on yelp to fix garbage disposal. They also found the pipe was cracked and fixed it with reasonable price. Very satisfied with their service and i highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Andrew Nguyen
reviews.text:
Antonio and his team helped me repair a disintegrated drain pipe from the bathroom sink. The pipe had corroded through, and the bathroom sink was unusable.

He quickly scheduled time for the consultation, answered all of my questions, gave a competitive estimate, and quickly followed up. He also scoped potential issues that he may run into with the fix so I would be aware and could plan it out.

When he began work, he made sure to consult with me before expanding any scope of work, and he and his team were very respectful and professional while I was working from home on meetings that day.

I am very pleased with the work and craftsmanship of the output. I would absolutely work with him again.

reviews.author: Susan E. Baranowski
reviews.text: Antonio was prompt in his response to get us help and Joseph was very thorough and professional when he repaired our shower faucet.  We were so grateful for their prompt response and ability to fix our urgent situation. Would definitely use and recommend in the future.

Their plumbers are down to earth dudes who study and know their skills. I trust no other company to do any of my plumbing but Dueys. They are the #1 plumbing company in the Kempner & Cove area🏆.

Of course, nobody loves plumber expenses, however, it needed to be done and you sent us Daniel Zuinga with very good workers.  We are still in contact with Daniel for a few things here and there and recommend him very highly.  He knows his job and is very good with people.  HE IS A KEEPER!!! Thanks and HAPPY NEW YEAR!!!
Arwed and Eva Swenson.

reviews.author: davidearlewatson

I have found my new plumbers and will be recommending them to everyone I know.

reviews.author: Mike Bausch

Gabriel even noticed that my water lines to my water heater were crossed by the previous plumber from a big box store and he fixed that. The office staff is extremely courteous as well, and they were able to give me set appointment time and not a half-day window. I would highly recommend Accurate H20 Plumbing for all your plumbing and gas related needs.

reviews.author: Lei Shi
reviews.text:
Sean is great! Very polite, patient, and careful.
He responded to my Google map message early in the morning, visited my home to inspect and scope the job, and gave me a reasonable estimate right away. The main job was to disable the moisturizer in the HVAC. Sean inspected the pipes, and suggested removing the needle-like valves that control water flow into the moisturizer, because they tend to fail. He also spotted a potential leak at a T-shape junction, and offered to replace that part altogether. The photos show the final result, very clean and well-installed.
Overall, a perfect experience although! Highly recommend AAA-Able!

reviews.author: Miguel Sulit
reviews.text:

When Sean arrived, he was very courteous, professional, and polite.  He is clearly very knowledgeable about his field and explained my problem to me in a way I could understand.  The fix went very smoothly and I was charged a reasonable rate.

I cannot recommend these guys enough.  Thank you again!

reviews.text:
They were responsive, fair pricing, quick and clean. They got me out of a bind when an under slab hot water line broke. Update…

Well I take it all back. They did come and fix my water line. They drilled multiple holes thru my cabinets after the first 2 were in the wrong place. They were not clean holes. I specifically asked for the water lines to be clearly marked for hot and cold and be surfaced mounted. They were not and now you hear water lines banging against my cabinets when you turn the hot water on and off. I have 2 clear lines unmarked and not a red and blue pex. So trouble shooting can be difficult. I’m going to have to repair the cabinets and have another company come fix the plumbing lines and install the correct way. reviews.author: Justin Gonzales
reviews.text:
Back in March, my partner and I noticed a leak from the ceiling in our bedroom. We had a handyman recommended by family work on it. His work held up until it started leaking again 6 months later. Before we could get a hold of him, we came home one night to the bedroom completely soaked, water all over the floor and pouring from the leak spot. We wanted a 2nd opinion immediately and was recommended a plumbing guy from my partner's boss. It turned out to be Hektor.

What we appreciated about Hektor off the bat was being able to attend to us immediately, considering it was later in the evening. He thoroughly inspected the situation and tried to narrow down the problem to its source. Turns out our previous guy was doing terrible patch-up work, and it was only a matter of time until it would fall apart.

Hektor and his crew came back the next morning and started working on our ceiling. It turned out to be an even bigger job, as he had to open up a good portion of the ceiling and even had to redo the shower above us. Despite this and the job taking multiple days, Hektor was friendly, transparent, and honest about everything. He and his crew worked quickly and even cleaned up very well after themselves. And his rate in the end was reasonable, considering everything he did.

Never have I had an experience before where a handyman was so communicative and straightforward. I'm very confident his work will hold up. Highly recommended!

Roger was efficient, thorough, and did a fantastic job. I'm very happy with the service!

reviews.author: Anea Kamahele
reviews.text:
I called Shawn originally in May 2025 when I believed there was a hot water line issue in the foundation of my home, purchased in July 2024. It felt like the tile floor in one of the bathrooms had radiant heat. The water heater was in a direct line to where I believed the pipes might be located. Since I knew there was no radiant heat, the culprit seemed to be a hot water line leak.

I'm fairly new to Greenville and didn't have experience with any plumbers. I researched local plumbers on Google, and Selbe Plumbing had all 5 star reviews, across the board. I called the number, and spoke to Shawn, who came out the next day. He diagnosed the issue as a foundation leak, gave me instructions on how to turn the water heater off when not in use, and provided a quote the same day. He'd recommended digging under the house to repair the leak, which seemed the way to go at that time.

Fast forward through an entirely too busy summer, and I finally called Shawn to come back out. He was immensely patient as I peppered him with questions and attempted to understand the options available to fix the problem. I could see the wheels turning in his head throughout various stages of the project, and he kept me in the loop about everything he was thinking or recommending. Ultimately we decided to reroute the water line through the attic versus the foundation because Shawn believed there were likely more leaks than just the one he found in the access area by the tub.

Shawn's 5 star reviews are legitimately earned. He's professional, prompt, knowledgeable, and has impeccable follow through. It comes, therefore, as no surprise that his work product is another reflection of why his reviews are so good. His pricing was more than fair.

In an age where independently owned, small businesses are being replaced by much larger companies, this locally-owned business by a business owner who knows the Greenville area is a gem.

reviews.author: Harry Kay (Mr Sauer Kraut)
reviews.text: Our seven-year-old electric water heater gave up the ghost (internal electrical short complete with melted wiring and charred insulation) on January 19, 2026. An electrician diagnosed the problem, and recommended AJ DeWolfe, Master Plumber, and owner of Wolfpack Plumbing. I contacted AJ, and he scheduled us for a new water heater installation the very next day. AJ arrived, quickly disconnected and removed our old water heater, and he then installed a brand-new, slim Bradford-White electric water heater. We had hot water restored within half an hour! AJ is friendly and hard-working, and he did a fantastic job. We are grateful to have AJ recommended to us, and we plan to use Wolfpack Plumbing for all our future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Aisa Purak
reviews.text:
A few weeks ago, almost a few days apart, I had no hot water in the house. Then the filter on kitchen sink faucet broke. Then the  kitchen faucet started leaking water as well. To add to this list, my garbage disposal stopped working and started leaking water into the cabinet under the sink. I had to put a bucket beneath my sink. Three failures in a short time. But of course, the main problem was the fact that I don't have hot water.
I went to the a different plumbing company we talked about pricing and next day they sent their worker to my house. The technician came and I showed him what needs to be fixed.  He inspected and analyzed the malfunctions and fixed the problems. Since I personally don't understand either issues or repairs, I simply wanted to get hot water, garbage disposal and faucet to work again. The technician finished his job, I paid and tipped him and he left.

Unfortunately, within a few days my garbage disposal started leaking water again and making a strange sound when I turned it on. I was about to call the company and asked them to send their technician again to fix the issue.

However, I had the good fortune and pleasure of meeting and working with the owner of Wolfpack Plumbing, whom I heard was an excellent and responsible plumber. I asked him to inspect the water heater system and garbage disposal, which he did. The water heater system was completely corroded and the outlet where it was plugged in was not working due to the leaking water. The situation was very dangerous and could have caused a fire. So, he suggested that I urgently change the water heater, because it is dangerous to keep it on any longer since it could cause a fire with tripping the breaker constantly.  AJ, the owner of Wolfpack Plumbing, changed and made the water heater work. In fact, he went to the store and bought much better water heater unit with better efficiency. He worked quietly and neatly. When he was done with installation, he thoroughly tested the water temperature.

The garbage disposal had to be reinstalled because the machine was not installed properly by the first technician and therefore it leaked water. All in all, the first plumbing company only installed the kitchen faucet properly. AJ was able to fix the poor quality work from the first company.

Due to the thorough examination of the problem, precise diagnosis of the problem and finding an adequate solution to the problem, I wholeheartedly recommend the company Wolfpack Plumbing for all your plumbing jobs.

I would like to take this opportunity to thank AJ, the master plumber and owner of the company, once again for his precise solution to the problem with the water heater and garbage disposal.
Aisha
