reviews.author: Mary Beal
reviews.text: Joe & Eric from ABLE TECH did a excellent job! Had a issue with drain back up & they were able to find & fix the problem.  Very professional & neat. Thank You

plumbers.name: Mike Ingrilli Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 237 S Curtis Rd, West Allis, WI 53214, USA

reviews.author: Joe Thomas
reviews.text: I never write reviews, but my recent experience with this company prompted this.  I’ve been a loyal customer of this plumbing company for about seven years. We own an older home in Elm Grove and have relied on their services many times over the years. However, I was very disappointed with my most recent experience. The cost to clean out my sewer line was nearly double what I’ve been charged in the past. When I called the office to ask about the price increase, the person I spoke with was extremely rude and even told me that I would be blacklisted. After years of being a repeat customer, this was disappointing. Based on this experience, I can no longer recommend this company.

reviews.author: Nick Lemke
reviews.text: I would stay away from this company.  They are dishonest and the customer service is appalling.  They bait and switched me on a hot water heater and then charged me $250 to come back and stand in my basement for 15 minutes to "look" at an issue I was having with it.  Unsurprisingly, standing there looking at the tank for 15 minutes didn't fix anything.  After the visit I called the office to see about next steps and was berated by the owner's daughter.  She insulted where I live and said "they do not need anyone in Milwaukee's business".  Shocked by her behavior I let her know I'd be leaving a review to which she plainly said she'd discredit it in the response section.  Beware!

reviews.author: Brad Ingram
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Mike and his team.
Prompt , professional and knowledgeable. Joe is a pleasure and I won’t use anyone else.

reviews.author: Dennis Fehrer
reviews.text:
Came out to open clogged sewer lateral.Have used them beforewith good results,Advised them Ihave 150 feet of lateral.Plumber ran 105 feetuntil drain opened and stopped.Was charged $546 dollars for one hour at residence plus travel time
$298 for labor,$49.00 mobilization fee,and $200for machine use.My fault for not getting an estimate up front.This is more than double what i have paid in the past with other vendors.I will not use them again.The machine charge is ridiculous,

reviews.author: Katherine Riemer
reviews.text: I've had them over to fix issues that were causing a leak from my kitchen sink.  They had the parts on hand, got it fixed quickly, and correctly the first time. Would definitely recommend.

plumbers.name: Flush Plumbing & Heating Inc.
plumbers.address: 1758 Park St STE. B, Castle Rock, CO 80109, USA

reviews.author: Eileen
reviews.text:
The service from Flush Plumbing was very efficient and I believe they did a good job.  However, their rates are extremely high.

The plumber worked for less than 1 hour and we were charged $430.00 in labor costs to replace a toilet wax ring and fix 2 bathroom faucets.  The washer costs for the 2 faucets totaled $242.00.

The owner said they do not charge by the hour, but by the item and we needed 4 washers for each faucet.

Total bill was $682.00 which was double what I was expecting.

reviews.author: Akell
reviews.text: Phillip and Mike assessed some issues in our old house today that the home inspector did not catch- We knew there were some issues, but not how deep it went. They were very thorough, took their time, and gave us more than one suggestion for fixing the issue. We appreciate their time and expertise!

reviews.author: Aaron K
reviews.text: This company has fixed the inadequate work of multiple plumbers at my home. They are punctual, skilled, attentive to detail, and easy to work with. They also work closely with plumbing manufacturers to provide warranty repair more than their competitors. They are not the cheapest but they are great at their jobs. And in the case of potential plumbing leaks, you may get what you pay for. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jennifer Lovig
reviews.text: Highly recommend! We received a water bill stating we used 78,000 gallons of water, and after some investigating, we found my daughter's toilet was running. Mike and Mike came out, confirmed the issue was with 3 faulty parts and were able to fix the problem on the spot. They had great communication, were even able to show up before my appointment window, and the pricing was very fair and reasonable! I will be calling them for all our future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Carey Clawson
reviews.text: We were billed over $400 just to have a new faucet installed, which we promptly paid. Several weeks later it was wobbly and began to drip so we called back to have it tightened up. With a simple turn of a wrench the problem was solved, however, we later received yet another bill for an additional $75! By email I explained that we didn't think that was fair nor did it match the promise on their website: "We provide a 1 year warrant on our workmanship!" The owner, Darrin, replied with an argumentative, rude response - not once, but twice... choosing to lose a long time customer who will no longer be recommending them to others.

plumbers.name: Extreme Plumbing N.Y. Inc.
plumbers.address: 3048 Merrick Rd, Wantagh, NY 11793, USA

reviews.author: rebecca greenwald
reviews.text:
ABSOLUTELY FLAWLESS!!

My contractor referred me to both Jason and Justin. They were super quick to respond and very professional. We were experiencing a significant issue tonight and they came in less than an hour. They immediately diagnosed the issue, came up with an affordable resolution, and had it resolved in no time. They were super patient and very caring humble people. Without a doubt will use their services moving forward and would certainly recommend to anyone out there in need. Thanks again guys! :)

reviews.author: Beth Stern
reviews.text: Extreme Plumbing rescued us from multiple plumbing emergencies, the latest on Christmas Day. Jason and his father arrived Christmas afternoon to clear a blockage in our trap and was pleasant and professional despite working on a major holiday. They diagnosed our problem effectively and efficiently and left us with all plumbing systems in good working order. Highly recommend Jason, his Dad and their wonderful assistant, Alberto. Thank you for a job well done even during a holiday!

reviews.author: Efrain R Raymond P
reviews.text:
The services of Extreme were engaged to resolve an issue with our heating system.  Justin and Jason(Jr.) arrived to do the job and were fantastic.  They were professional, courteous, friendly, engaging and most important, very knowledgeable about the work.
They were efficient without being rushed or careless, making sure everything was good before they left.  Overall, an outstanding experience for a disgruntling situation.   We will definitely engage their services again when the need arises.

reviews.author: randy scalise
reviews.text: In this day and age in an emergency situation to reach a plumbing company and have them send someone to your home in 15 minutes is unheard of but thanks to the professionalism, promptness and expertise of the team at Extreme Plumbing that is exactly what happened today. Thanks to Christine, Jason Jr, and Alberto they got to me in 15 minutes and solved the problem in the same amount of time. Yes, they are that good! Need a great plumbing company this is it look no further. Thanks to the team!

reviews.author: nick napoli
reviews.text: I called Extreme Plumbing when water was coming from my ceiling and walls. They came out the same day—within just a few hours! The team, which included Jason and Alberto, was incredibly professional. They explained every step of the process so I knew exactly what needed to be done. They diagnosed a major clog in my sewer line and fixed the issue efficiently. Afterward, they made sure to clean up everything. I was really impressed with their level of service, and I highly recommend Extreme Plumbing to anyone in need of a reliable, fast, and professional plumbing company!

plumbers.name: Waterworks Mechanical Inc.
plumbers.address: 20 Sycamore Ave Ste 4006, Medford, MA 02155, USA

reviews.author: Jovana Sljivancanin
reviews.text: We had a great experience with regards to replacing a leaking kitchen faucet. Peter was very prompt to respond, knowledgeable, kind and very careful to leave our space neat and clean upon completing the work. We'd warmly recommend his services.

reviews.author: mark kowalski
reviews.text: Waterworks was very responsive and arrived at our home in less than 90 minutes from our initial contact. The professional that arrived was Peter. He was expert and very thorough and in addition he was very amiable. Of course, Peter fixed our problem. I would contact Waterworks for any of our plumbing/ heating needs in the future. I will add that our need occurred on the day before New Year’s Eve so during a holiday period and they were still very responsive.

reviews.author: Vincent Giacalone
reviews.text: I had a persistent slow drainage problem with a sink in my apartment and Peter did a fantastic job fixing this. In 2 hrs he was able to replace an old section of pipe, clear obstructions and have the sink working better than it ever did during my time living there. I will be saving Peter's contact info for all future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Mareg K
reviews.text: Peter came to inspect my water leak and immediately found the issue. I’m glad I found his contact on Google. He was also very friendly and easy to talk to.

reviews.author: Liu Hua
reviews.text:
Peter from Waterworks Mechanical was incredibly responsive when we reached out to have our water heater replaced. He arrived on time, was very professional, and clearly takes great pride in his work. He even installed an extra gas line valve that wasn’t originally included in the quote—at no additional charge. The pricing was very reasonable as well.

I highly recommend Peter to anyone looking for honest, fast, and professional plumbing or heating services. I’m already planning to schedule my boiler service with him before next winter. Thanks again to Peter!

plumbers.name: Above All Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1709 S Fretz Ave #130, Edmond, OK 73013, USA

reviews.author: Huan Nguyen
reviews.text: I gave them a call about my rusting water heater and they scheduled me for a replacement within a couple days with their sister company, Water Heater Man. Juan and Kyle did an awesome job and the installation of a new and updated heater went very smoothly. I would definitely reach out to these guys again!

reviews.author: Mike Mills
reviews.text: I called them for a shower faucet leak.  They ended up installing a new single handle faucet and I must admit that they did a good job even if it was a bit pricey (which I paid in cash).  Problem was that they knocked 6 tiles off my shower wall.  I was told they would send out a tile setter to fix it in a couple days. well, after I think it was 5-6 days, I emailed them and they ignored me with no response.  I waited until the 8th day and called them.  I was told they was aware of the problem and that they would contact Mike the Plumber and if he hasn't contacted a tile setter that they would and call me later that day which they didn't do. The faucet was installed on the 7th and here it is the 17th and I've heard nothing.

reviews.author: S W S
reviews.text: I can’t believe what just happened. Our boiler packed up on Thursday, we hadn’t been able to wash or shower for 4 days. The Insurance Company finally got it’s act together and got us a fantastic plumber – these guys. All the way from Edmund to our home in Norman. Then in one hour they got the unit inspected and their office sorted out the Insurance Company and in another hour they had collected and installed our new boiler. Incredible. Thanks Jeff and Randy! Thanks super efficient back office!

reviews.author: Kevin Walls
reviews.text: Daryl and his team are the kind of people you hope to hire!  These guys did a great job and stand behind their work. In my case, a utility company doing work on same location, caused damage that didn’t reveal itself for months. When I asked Daryl to look into it, he uncovered the damage and repaired it because they warranty their work. Never mind the finger-pointing blame-game between the gas utility and THEIR contractor (who I believe ultimately caused damage during their work), Daryl was mission focused on my behalf. Many, many thanks!

reviews.author: Valere Hull
reviews.text: This is an excellent company! Matt was the technician who worked diligently to fix my sewer line problem. He was knowledgeable, efficient, answered my questions patiently and completely, and was very pleasant! The work was done competently, and the charge was very reasonable. I will most definitely use the company again and also request Matt.

plumbers.name: EZ Flow Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1914 W Howard Ln, Austin, TX 78728, USA

reviews.author: Truitt Adams
reviews.text: Sorry Batman and Robin but James and AJ are the REAL dynamic duo! I had a major clog in my mainline, called a plumber from Taskrabbit, he came out and made the problem worse! Called E Z  Flow the next day and James/ AJ were at my house at 11am sharp. James came in, assessed the situation and told me exactly what the issue was, remedies to fix it and the overall cost with no fluff. Jame and AJ got right to work and were very professional and kept me abreast of their progress. James is a straight shooter (which I like), and has a great personality to boot. AJ worked diligently and I could tell he knew what he was doing by his confidence. By 12:30pm the issue was resolved and James and AJ drove away like hero Cowboys at the end of a Western. The price for the job was VERY reasonable and didn’t make me sweat. PLEASE use E Z Flow Plumbing for any plumbing issues. They are the best hands down!

reviews.author: Donnie La Press
reviews.text: Awesome work Mo at good price. Redid my old leaky pipe w/new pex and swapped mixing valve. Also helped woth drain pipe.

reviews.author: chuck lindsey
reviews.text: Bill at EZ Flow replaced a leaky water heater for me. Quick responses, clear communication, honest assessment, fair price and now I have hot water! What more could you want? I’m happy to have found EZ Flow as they’ve gained a new customer from me.

reviews.author: Phong Cao
reviews.text: fantastic experience. got a bradford white hydrojet 50 gallon 10 year warranty installed with the best price in the area - beat 40+ other plumbing shops here in Austin. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Sam Lundin
reviews.text: This company is excellent.  Bill is a good man.  God bless his family and his company.  My water heater broke, and I was in a bind.  I was geographically outside of the zone he normally covers in terms of distance.  But he heard my baby crying in the background (unrelated matter) and he was willing to go out of his way to help my family.  He had no obligation to do that, he did it out of the kindness of his heart.  America was built on the backs of good men like Bill and his company, who help other fellow Americans in times of need.  His positive intentions touched my heart, and I am deeply thankful to him for it.

plumbers.name: Hardy Plumbing | Emergency Plumber, Drain Cleaning, Pipe Repair, Tankless Water Heater Repair and Replacement in Timonium, MD
plumbers.address: 5 Ballyhaunis Ct, Timonium, MD 21093, USA

reviews.author: Brent H
reviews.text: Hardy Plumbing installed our new hybrid (electric heat pump) water heater and our water leak detector auto-shut off (Moen Flo) and did an outstanding job.  The plumbers were on time, courteous, professional and left no waste—a combination rare to find these days.  I absolutely recommend Hardy Plumbing for anyone.  They have also served my friend with the same level of professionalism and effectiveness.  I don’t think you can go wrong with them!

reviews.author: Cristin Hickey
reviews.text:
Justin and Amanda at Hardy Plumbing were great to work with! Amanda is very thorough as office manager.  She listened to my whole story over the phone about my aerator on my faucet sink.  I sent her pictures  of the problem so she could show Justin the pics ahead of time. Justin was very kind to not charge me for this job.  I told him how last year the main water pipes had burst on my street in 3 places in a span of just 1 month.
After that my water pressure hasn't really been the same. He showed me how silt was forming in my aerator on both sides of my sink faucets.  So frustrating. Justin replaced the aerator and now I'm getting water back in the faucet.  Thank you to Justin and Hardy Plumbing! I will be using them for all my plumbing needs in the future. Also a  side note-He was very professional and even took off his shoes when he entered my house as he saw that I was wearing slippers. What a nice gesture of respect.  😊

reviews.author: Adithya Peruri
reviews.text: We had them come out for a booster pump installation and I was overall pleased with this experience. From the customer service at the phone, the on-site evaluation, to assessment and completion of the project thoroughly and neatly done. I would highly recommend this team for plumbing work .

reviews.author: T K
reviews.text: Awesome company, great work, and very professional technicians.  Had a plumbing emergency, and they came same-day and fixed the problem at a very fair price.  Will definitely call them for my next job!

reviews.author: John Nikirk
reviews.text: We had Hardy Plumbing install a line and regulatory to connect a propane tank to our range in the basement. Wayne was knowledgeable and efficiency. He explained everything he was doing and verified that the line was working properly. He was punctual and neat. We would recommend Hardy Plumbing and plan on using them as needs arise in the future.

plumbers.name: Rayne Plumbing & Sewer Service, Inc.
plumbers.address: 517 Madera Ave, San Jose, CA 95112, USA

reviews.author: Nate Fieger
reviews.text: Excellent company excellent plumbers. Out water heater ruptured in the middle of the night and we had a plumber contacting us with next steps almost immediately at 2am. Greg, our plumber went above and beyond trying to get our hot water back as soon as possible and as cost effectively as possible and we can’t thank him enough for that. Great communication and a quick install. Can’t see us using anyone else for our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Noah Fiedel
reviews.text: Rayne has serviced our small complex several times. I called last night with a blocked storm drain and they did a great job. Bill called me back (from their answering service) in 5 minutes, we discussed the problem, he gave an estimated charge, and he arrived in under an hour. He was able to find + fix the problem (roots in the drain pipe) in about 15 minutes, and then spent the full hour cleaning as much of our drain piping as possible. Bill was clearly an expert at what he was doing, gave good advice on what preventative maintenance we should do in the future, and after this experience I'd recommend him + Rayne to anyone.

reviews.author: Phyllis Lynch
reviews.text:
Our plumber, Caesar, was excellent, very knowledgeable, and honest about what we needed to be done.
We did not have to wait for him to come and the fees are reasonable.
thank you Rayne Plumber Service.

reviews.author: Zana Ames
reviews.text: They answer the phone when you call. They can schedule you pretty quickly and if warranty work is needed, they can generally fit a time in between other jobs to come back & take care of your plumbing needs. Reliable & Friendly customer service!

reviews.author: Ljiljana Lily Toholj
reviews.text: First I had problem with pipe leaking at my rental unit so I called Rayne Plumbing and they send Amy. She resolved that super quick. So next time I called I asked for her but she is not longer with Rayne Plumbing. They send Raudel and he was able to find problem and fix it same day.  This time I called Rayne  to send someone to replace my water heater. Fred come and he did job super quick. He was really  professional. I recommend Rayne Plumbing to all my friends and they all had good experience. Five Stars Deserved!!! Thank you!

plumbers.name: GTO. Plumbing and rooter
plumbers.address: 3640 Chanslor Ave #5, Richmond, CA 94805, USA

reviews.author: Sonya Roland
reviews.text:
Manolo and his Son of GTO provided EXCELLENT SERVICE! They were professional, courteous, respectful of me, (a 64 year old Woman, home by myself), our home and property and worked relentlessly to resolve our plumbing issues. Manolo provided me with easy to understand explanations about the problems with our system, what was required to resolve those issues and of his work at each step of the repair process. GTO also provided photos of the work/repairs to my roomate, via text, as he was at work and not able to be here  while they were in our home  both diagnosing the issues with our system and completeing the necessary repairs. This was crucial as my roomate was responsible for overseeing the process and providing payment on behalf of our landlord who lives several hours away. Manolo's documentation was so thorough that our landlord was able to sign off on the repairs and the payment at each step of the repair process! They resolved our issues in a more than timely manner and took great care to thoroughly clean up our property after finishing the repairs to our system.
I CANNOT RECOMMEND GTO MORE HIGHLY!!!

In a world where fewer and fewer 'professionals' take pride in their work and deliver fully on promises made, GTO/Manolo and his Son unequivocally stand head and shoulders above and they do so with GREAT INTEGRITY!! Moreover, as a Woman, it was refreshing to be treated  as someone who is not only as capable as any man of understanding issues related to plumbing and home repair, but who also has the ability to make competent decisions with respect to resolving those issues. It was WONDERFUL working with them!! Don't hesitate! When you have plumbing issues, CALL GTO!!!!

reviews.author: Aislynn Palos
reviews.text: We had a great experience with this plumbing team. They were incredibly nice, prompt, and professional from start to finish. They arrived on time, clearly explained the issue, and handled everything efficiently and cleanly. It’s such a relief to work with people who are both skilled and genuinely kind. We would absolutely recommend them and will definitely call them again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Malaika Stoll
reviews.text: Highly recommend! We got three estimates for replacement of lateral sewer line and some internal pipe re-routing for our older home in Lafayette. GTOs price was half of one of the other estimates and about $5000 lower than the other. GTO was very thoughtful and creative in their approach-- for example helping to save a tree over the sewer line.  The team was very communicative and professional. It was a difficult job and they got it done for an amazing price.

reviews.author: Eric Hernandez
reviews.text: I had a gas lick at my restaurantand I called GTO plumbing and Manolo was here the same day and fixed the link the most professional way possible. Also the price was great and service A1.

reviews.author: Anne Rogers
reviews.text: GTO came out the same day I called when my kitchen sink and laundry room were backing up. They were prompt, courteous, and Very professional. They gave me a quote upfront and showed me what they were going to do. I appreciated their attention to detail. I wholeheartedly recommend GTO Plumbing for any of your needs.

plumbers.name: Eddie B. Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 211 Carriage Ln, Delran, NJ 08075, USA

reviews.author: Cassandra Figueroa
reviews.text: Fair pricing and dependable. Brian and Tommy do great work. They explain everything in detail in advance, and always clean up after themselves. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jon Klein
reviews.text: Jim N. did a great job. Had a serious leak and he came at the earliest time he could, only a couple of hours wait time. Very professional. Knew what was needed to fix the shower problem. Explained it clearly. Would highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Janelle Culver
reviews.text: I guess it depends on who you are how well of a job they do.  I have frozen pipes the guy walked around for 10 minutes saying it was nothing he could do.  Another guy blew the heat gun on the pipes for a hour.  The other guy said well I'm here for a hour because I have to charge you for the hour.  They left me with frozen pipes.  they did not use any tools to determine what area was the coldest to blow the heat gun, they just blew the heat gun in one area and left.  very disappointed waste of money.

reviews.author: Roxana Maciejeski
reviews.text: Very experienced ! Found and fixed my frozen pipes very fast. Definitely saving them on my list of great service !

reviews.author: R Hazell
reviews.text:
Very knowledgeable Plummer with excellent skills. Jim was able to answer all of my questions and was very patient and professional. The job was done in a timely manner and my new hardware installation works perfectly!!
Thanks so much!! 😊

plumbers.name: A & R remodeling & repair
plumbers.address: 115 Lloyd Rd, Georgetown, KY 40324, USA

reviews.author: kris lenzini
reviews.text:
Well...I sure couldnt find a plumbing or electrical license for them. Required for moving pipes installing drains inside foundation foot print. Plus water heaters who's doing the electric and plumbing.

So...I called the number on their website to ask.

Call was Answered as hello. I mention I was trying to reach a plumber maybe I have the wrong number sorry.  Answer: No worries click.

I'm out!! I don't want a do it yourselfer no permits no inspections guy. I need someone who understands building codes and corrects this do it yourselfer mess at my house.

Let me add harassjng is a crime. Nice message she sent me.

Let me point out no...they did no work. And they never will. Because when your website brags about services that clearly require both a Plumbing and Electrical license and possibly an HVAC License...I expect to find one.

But I gave them the opportunity to answer questions and tell me they use a licensed Sub. Instead they dont answer the phone as a business nor acknoledge they are a plumber when asked.

And she doesnt like my review. Wait until the Plumbing and Electric board gets a hold of them.

Respond here but do not send nasty messages also!!!
PS I said nothing about them doing footers (her message).  I said inside the foundation (the house). Drain layers can work up to the foundation (outside). Plumbers can work inside. Licensed plumbers.
Just so we are clear...I have 85 million in completed construction on my resume. I absolutely know what requires a license and permit.

reviews.author: Rick Maynard
reviews.text: Ashlee and Ryan did a great job with our project. They were so quick to respond, and then were in and out of the house before we even had time to speculate on how long the work was going to take. Very friendly and the rate was reasonable. I recommend them highly.

reviews.author: Bobbi Poston
reviews.text: A & R were fantastic with our bathroom remodel.   They turned our terrible 90’s bathroom into a beautiful space with large shower and freestanding tub.   Great communication,  attention to detail, quality work with very reasonable pricing.   Their primary focus was on doing the job the right way and making sure that the customer was satisfied.   I would give them 10 stars if I could and would definitely recommend them my friends.

reviews.author: Shaun Lendrum
reviews.text: Ashlee and Ryan were outstanding in their response to our call and the plumbing work they did for us. Their diagnosis of our problems and subsequent repairs carried out were of the highest caliber and at a more than reasonable cost. We have no hesitation in recommending A&R and will definitely use them again for any of our future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Ben Lovell
reviews.text: Ashlee and Ryan did high-quality work for a very reasonable price.  We had a slow, periodic leak that occurred when we ran our shower.  They were able to diagnose the issue, repair the leak, replace the hardware, and repair the tile/grout so that the repair work was undetectable. They were both very pleasant to deal with and responsive to our needs.  We will definitely call on them for future projects!

plumbers.name: The Plumbing Physician
plumbers.address: 123 2nd Ave S Ste 230, Edmonds, WA 98020, USA

reviews.author: Matt Dawson
reviews.text:
We’ve used The Plumbing Physician multiple times now and they’ve officially become our plumbing company of choice for our property management business. They’ve handled everything from a toilet repair and kitchen drain cleaning to installing a new water line for an ice maker and replacing a main water shutoff. Every single visit, Conal has been our plumber, and he’s consistently professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly reliable.

The service is always top-notch, the entire team is friendly and easy to work with, and pricing is fair and right in line with Seattle market rates. It’s rare to find this level of consistency and trustworthiness in a service provider. Every time I have called they have made it out to our properties quickly. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Felicia D’Angelo
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough about this awesome team! Every single person I worked with within this company were amazing! They were quick to come out and look at my job, and as the job progressed (2 bathroom remodels after a leak..), they were responsive to the changes needed and were happy to help mitigate and update plans.
The full scope of work took 3 months- but that was due to all the issues with the job (and no reflection of them)- but they were patient, kind, and professional! Not to mention the work was spotless, and their recommendations were on point!
Prior to this job- we had a plumbing company (and an annual servicing plan and a discount) which we quickly abandoned after our first consult. We are so happy we did! We have found our plumbers, and have done nothing but recommend people to them since!
You made a stressful situation manageable and we appreciate all the work you did!

Work performed:
Tub installment, toilet replacement, toilet resetting, sink hook up, sink and toilet pipe replacement, shower trim kits- literally every part of the water process in 2 bathrooms.

reviews.author: Lisa Nelson
reviews.text: I want to add my five-star review for this amazing business. Our family met them at the Edmonds 5K on July 4th, and I am so glad they were there. They came to do a couple of installations at our place this fall. In every interaction I had, every person went above and beyond to ensure that we had a great experience. We had a tough install, and Conal was creative and thoughtful in making it work. They are professional and reasonably priced. I'm thrilled that we've found a place that takes such excellent care of its customers. We will be using them for all of our plumbing needs at home and at our dental office!

reviews.author: robert brenner
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Plumbing Physician. We had a slow pinhole leak in a copper pipe in the kitchen ceiling. Above that is a tub and Conal was able to adapt well in order to replace the pipe with the leak. Overall it looks great and no more leak. Before and after photos attached. Thank You. Looks solid.

reviews.author: E Stewart
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Brad replumbed my entire house in 2014 and Conal just came out and replaced a hose for the kitchen sink. They’ve always been extremely professional, reliable, and honest and do a great job. Shayli manages the office and she’s always a pleasure to work with as well. 5 stars all the way!

plumbers.name: Mason & Son Plumbing & Heating Inc.
plumbers.address: 13646 Warwick Blvd, Newport News, VA 23602, USA

reviews.author: BreDon
reviews.text:
We were having some HVAC issues and another company came out and recommended we that we replace everything for thousands of dollars.

reviews.author: coolmandude1000
reviews.text: I just wanted to say thank you to Malisa & Kirk Sr., Kirk Jr., Matt, and Dan from ALL NITE SEWER & DRAIN CLEANING LLC plumbing & contracting. I live in a 99-year-old house in Hamilton, Maryland, and during the Super Bowl, we lost all water service to our house. Our 99-year-old water line just decided it had enough and ruptured underground. I went to turn on our shower at 10:35 PM to give my 25-year-old nonverbal autistic son a shower like I do all week long. I turned on the shower valve, and no water came out, just a hissing sound. I went downstairs and tried the sink in the basement right next to our main water supply line entering our house. Same deal, just a hissing noise. I went outside to our water meter and opened the cover (yes, I'm a contractor) and could hear the water meter clicking away and water rushing through the meter at a rapid pace. I was able to turn off the water meter to save more water being wasted into the ground. On Monday morning I started to call plumbing contractors. I called, I think, 7 plumbing companies, and the first 3, no one even answered the phone or even had a voicemail to leave a message. The next 3 plumbers all said it could be 10-12 days until they could actually replace our water line in our yard. I called the 8th plumbing contractor, who said he no longer offers water line replacements; however, he knew a plumbing contractor who could help me out. He asked me to text my information, such as my name, phone number, and address to him. Within 8-9 minutes, I received a call from a very caring and down-to-earth Malisa from ALL NITE SEWER & DRAIN CLEANING LLC, a local plumbing contractor. She asked me to send as many pictures as I have and a video too, if possible. I had already taken pictures of my yard and made a video describing where my water line was run to and what would need to be done to replace my water line. I would say within 20-30 minutes she contacted me back and said the estimate/quote would be in my email. I opened my email to find a well-drafted, computer-generated estimate, and the price was great. I accepted the proposal and was on schedule to have our water line replaced. 2 days later, a crew of 4 very nice gentlemen arrived at our house at 8:30 AM. Kirk Sr., the boss/foreman, and Kirk Jr. and Matt & Dan. They arrived with 3 vehicles and a backhoe and wasted no time getting to work. I have a very nice lawn of Zoysia grass and was very concerned about having the middle of my yard dug up. So the guys at All Nite Sewer & Drain Cleaning dug a very clean ditch next to my driveway and ran a new ¾" copper water line into the side of my house. This saved my yard and my garden in front of the house and having to cut into my concrete floor under my front porch. What a huge relief, and in spring I will add Zoysia grass plugs into the 20" wide path along the driveway to repair my lawn as good as new. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND calling ALL NITE SEWER & DRAIN CLEANING LLC for any type of plumbing repairs or water or sewage pipe replacements. They came to our rescue when the other 8 plumbing companies could not. They offer very fair prices and have the tools, equipment, and years of experience to get the job done ASAP. Thank you again, Malisa, Kirk Sr., Kirk Jr., Matt & Dan, for the excellent service. I would offer a 10 STAR RATING, but Google only has 5-star reviews lol. Cheers, everyone.

reviews.author: Blake Buck
reviews.text:
I had sewage backing up into my basement and ended up needing to replace the sewer line, as well as needing to add a sump pump and sewage ejector in my basement.

I took my time to vet multiple local companies, collect estimates, and then worked to bring MSD to the table as well.

Of the companies that I received quotes from (ASI, Danhauer, Blackburn and Davis, and a friend that had his master plumber’s license), Blackburn and Davis beat the competition by a good margin.

Pros:
The employees that came out were kind, patient, and professional. They took their time to involve me in updates and progress reports.

Missi was very kind and patient with the multiple calls I made to the office throughout the project. She and Jeremy worked with me to ensure that my expectations were met, and provided documentation that I requested as well.

Work seems to be executed well, and upon request the team was able to ensure that my yard was satisfactorily put back together after excavation, and worked to clean up in the basement prior to departure. The team also came back out once to re-level some concrete work as well.

Cons:
Because of the size of the company, and at times being somewhat short handed, communication and the project itself took a little longer than planned.

**However, because of the size of the company and the philosophy of the owner, you also get a more than fair price in a market where larger companies collectively seek to gouge the customers in this city (Danhauer), or offer off-the-wall plans to fix the problem that ultimately would either fail, cost too much, or don’t make sense (ASI) when reviewed by other companies.**

So in summary: good things come to those who can be patient. Based upon my experience, I would have no reservations recommending Blackburn and Davis. I will also use them in the future.

He even told me the original clean out was put in backwards so sometimes the toilet tissue and what not can grab the edge and clog that area, he said it was a very easy fix, and could also come back to repair that if need be. 5 stars, would recommend to anyone needing big or small jobs.

reviews.author: Felix Carlo Cavan
reviews.text:
I called AA-Anthony's Inc Plumbing & Sewer at 7 AM because our basement floor drain was backflowing. The woman who answered the phone was warm, courteous, and professional. She told me she’d check on the plumbers’ availability and call me back, and true to her word, she called within minutes and got us an appointment that same afternoon.

Justin arrived right on time and immediately made a great impression. He introduced himself, thoroughly inspected both the inside and outside of the house, and clearly explained what was causing the issue along with my options. He worked efficiently and had everything resolved in under an hour. The price he gave was fair, especially for the high level of quality service and quick turnaround.

From start to finish, the experience was smooth, professional, and stress-free. Justin’s expertise, efficiency, and excellent customer service left me highly satisfied. I highly recommend AA-Anthony's Inc Plumbing and Sewer.

reviews.author: Mateusz Kulesza
reviews.text: Tony did a great job installing a new water service in our building. Tony was very responsive, knew what needed to be done, and handled the entire project in an excellent manner. I often feel the need to meddle and supervise as I generally do not trust people to touch my things. However, given Tony's professionalism and experience, I trusted him to take care of the job and all the details without meddling.

reviews.author: Jim Ratcliff
reviews.text: My neighbor and I previously hired Tony for a plumbing project and were so impressed with how quickly he responded and was able to change out two leaking outside spigots and install a sink on the spot without advance notice.  He was so professional and a wonderful person to be around.  When my neighbor called me mid-day Friday to tell me she had water leaking in her basement, I determined it was coming from behind the wall under the kitchen sink.  She called Tony who came out and immediately knew what was going on and told us the drain pipe was probably rusted out, what it would take to fix it and estimated cost.  Based on the estimate and our past experiences, we immediately agreed to going forward with the repair.  He started at 3:45 on Friday and at 5:00 I told him that if he needed to be somewhere he could finish it on Saturday morning.  He arrived first thing in the morning and finished the job.  He went over and above what was originally the drain set up and made it better.  He is such a wonderful person to be around, explains what is going on and keeps you advised through the whole process.  I would not use any other plumber and strongly recommend his services to anyone in need of any size plumbing job.

I would recommend River Valley Plumbing to my family and closest friends. They do a wonderful job!

reviews.author: Jenna Staffaroni
reviews.text:

After a google search and several failed attempts with other businesses wanting money up front or pushing it off until the next day, I was able to get ahold of the office worker at River Valley.  She asked lots of relevant questions and actually listened to what was happening.  She had a strong suspicion of the problem and knew it might be an easy fix and had the plumber, Terry, call me. Within minutes he was able to talk me through a simple fix that had my water back!

Not only did River Valley Pluming save me hundreds of dollars by avoiding an emergency call, but also hours of stress and anxiety suffering with no water and potential frozen pipes!  Next time anything plumbing related requires assistance I know they will be my first and only call!

reviews.text:

reviews.text: Complete Plumbing has installed a Water Heater in the past (2021) and now it has gone bad. reviews.text: Mr Odom came to my rescue and repaired my gas fireplace. The pilot light would not stay on and other companies told me it couldn't be repaired but I didn't believe that. reviews.author: T P
reviews.text:
In April of 2024, I contacted this company to complete some plumbing work in my newly purchased home which came to a total of $1,440. He was tasked with removing the old water heater and installing a new one. As well as replacing a tub drain cover, replacing two bathroom faucets, and installing new shower trims in my main and guest bathrooms. I brought all of the materials that needed to be replaced/installed.

Long short short, my guest bathroom tub was damaged with chips and burn marks when this company was trying to install a new tub spout. When I asked to be refunded the cost ($150) of installing the shower trims, the owner only refunded me $125 and stated, "Refund even though I do not owe you."

After this whole ordeal, I had to get another plumbing company to come out and assess everything that this company did. An expansion tank was installed because this company failed to do that.  It took me a year to get the money and time to finally fix the damage. In order to fix the damage to the tub I had to get a resurfacing company. Who also fixed the drain gasket because it was installed wrong by this company. It cost me $1,400 to get my tub fixed and resurfaced. Now, I have to get the new plumber to come back and install a new tub spout, which will cost me more money.

A $1,440 job in 2024 with Perfecto Plumbing has now cost me an additional $1748 (and counting) since.

Update: The owner might want to delete his reply because I have the text messages and more images to confirm what I have stated here. If he would like I do not mind posting all of the text messages. No, I did not want him to return to my house a THIRD time to fix anything after he damaged my tub trying to fix his first mistake with the original tub spout. I did refuse to talk to him on the phone after he damaged my tub because I only wanted to communicate via text in order to have a record of our conversation because I did not trust he would tell the truth (case in point his reply). Lastly, he NEVER refunded me 50% of the total cost of the invoice that would have been $720. He only refunded me $125. He originally offered to only refund me $100. You read that correctly...$100 for damaging my bathtub.

reviews.author: Vasileios “Bill” Siokos
reviews.text: Personal Experience and Opinion: If there was the option to give 0 stars, I would have done that. We had water coming down to the attic from one of the plumbing vent pipes. MRC plumbing came to our house, and we were told that the leak was in the roof boot itself. We replaced the caulking in the boot itself and even added additional peal-and-seal tape around it. However, on rainy days, I could see with my own eyes (even though I am not a plumber) that one of the pipe joints was problematic. We called MRC plumbing again and mentioned to them that the leak may be from the pipe joint. However, we were told one more time that the issue is the roof boot. Finally, we had a different plumber coming out today and was able to diagnose that the issue was the pipe joint, not the roof boot. The attached picture shows part of the pipe that was taken out and the fact that it was not even sealed properly, hence the water leak.

reviews.author: Sarah Howell
reviews.text:
I don’t usually write long reviews, but Gordon the Plumber LLC deserves this one.

Our families have known each other for many, many years, and one thing has never changed: they give more than they take. They show up. They help. They care—about people, not just business. That kind of integrity is rare these days.

Gordon the Plumber is a true family-run company, and you can feel it. The owner’s sons work alongside him, and it’s honestly a beautiful thing to see. When I called with a plumbing issue (because of course it happened at the worst possible time), Gordon didn’t hesitate—he had his son, Gordon, out to us before I could even look at my schedule. That alone shocked me in a world where customer service is quickly dwindling.

The situation was stressful, but they worked with us, explained everything clearly, and made sure we had what we needed in record time. No pressure, no runaround—just solid, honest help when we really needed it.

If you’re looking for a plumbing company that truly loves this community, treats people right, and stands behind their work, this is it. We’re grateful not just for the service, but for the kind of people they are.

Highly recommend Gordon the Plumber LLC. Every single time.

reviews.author: Megan Uribe

I had Brad come service it, and he was absolutely polite, broke down to me what could be happening and told me he can set me up with a technician to check out what's going on. I had an appointment for that day but I received a call from someone in office to let me know their technition was at an emergency and wanted to let me know they were sorry for the inconvenience. They helped set up an appointment for me for today in the afternoon . To two gentlemen Bobby and Rosie came to check out what's going on today and to check my lines. They were so kind and really explained to me what's happening. I was charged a service fee for today, but if they come out and do the work that I'm quoted for they throw that amount into the total for the quoted job as well!!I've gone through two different company's and let me tell you I have no regrets with finding and calling Tidy Tank. They are a sound company and are for their customers. I can say with confidence I am getting great service for what I'm paying for!! Quality service, offer technicians to trouble shoot issues, communicate, and answer any questions without hesitation. The past two places I've gone through they came in came out wanted money. They didn't want to discuss with us about the look of our tank, anything!!! They were just standoffish, and you do not get this with Tidy Tank!!! Give them a call and schedule a pumping, you won't regret it at all!!!

reviews.author: matthew anderson
reviews.text:
My family and I highly recommend Tidy Tank!

Couldn't be happier with the service.  Got a call when the technician was 30 mins out and he showed right when expected.  He was very knowledgeable, able to answer all my questions about our system. Anyone who has septic knows the anxiety around keeping your system in good working order. Tidy Tank's service gave us great piece of mind and they will be the number we call for future tank dumps or if, God forbid, an issue should arrise.

reviews.author: Pat Vichotka
reviews.text: This company is the best. From their customer service to their technicians.  They are personable, truly interested in your problem and will try and get it fixed as soon as they possibly can. I would highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: Zec Jagmin
reviews.text: Great experience.  Would highly recommend.  We were in the process of selling the house and as part of the sale a septic inspection was needed.  Our system passed the inspection in October and then failed in March due to seasonal water.  Same inspector (not Tidy Tank) both times.  This company (again, not Tidy Tank) that completed the inspection was not an actual installer/servicer of septic systems but rather just an inspector used during the buying and selling of real estate.  Tidy Tank came in and saved the day!!!  Tidy Tank helped me identify that my system was not in need of a $23k - $30k full replacement as the original inspector deemed necessary in his report.  But rather a $4k repair to get the system back up to peak operating performance.  Thank you again for your thorough assessment and solution to address the problem.  Refreshing when companies take the time to assess the problem and not just look for the large ticket sale.  Will definitely be referring you to our friends and family!!!

reviews.author: Barbara Graniczny
reviews.text: Great service! Highly recommended

plumbers.name: The Plumbing Two
plumbers.address: 107 Buena Ventura St Apt 80, San Pablo, CA 94806, USA

reviews.author: jennifer baker
reviews.text:
Rick from The Plumbing Two is hands-down the most responsive and reliable plumber we’ve ever worked with. He’s saved us on two separate occasions and has completely earned our trust.

When we had a major leak, Rick showed up the next day—on a Sunday—and quickly discovered the issue was far more involved than anyone had realized. We’ve had plumbing problems for over 15 years that no one could properly diagnose, but Rick and his crew tracked it down. They opened up the ceiling, rerouted pipes, cleared clogs, and replaced sections that were rusted and corroded. For the first time in over a decade, everything works exactly as it should.

The leak had caused significant water damage, so we had to bring in a restoration company. We were leaving town the very next day, but Rick completely handled the situation. We trusted him with a house key, and he coordinated daily visits with the restoration crew, keeping us updated through frequent texts. His communication was exceptional.

Rick also personally showed up to the appointment with our insurance assessor, explaining everything, and sharing videos and photos.

Every time a new issue came up, Rick managed to get a full crew onsite immediately. He and his team were professional, respectful, and detail-oriented—cleaning up after themselves, protecting our belongings, and treating our home with care.

Later, when the restoration company couldn’t reassemble things or reconnect our washer and dryer, Rick and three of his crew were back at our house within 90 minutes. He personally made sure everything was reattached, tested, and leak-free before leaving.

Rick truly goes above and beyond. He’s responsive, friendly, and absolutely dedicated to getting the job done right. If you’re looking for a plumber who cares and delivers quality work, The Plumbing Two is the company to call!

reviews.author: Alexander Ha
reviews.text: I noticed I had raw sewage coming out into the backyard at around midnight and contacted The Plumbing Two because they were one of the few plumbing services I found that operated 24 hours a day. Rick arrived and cleared out the blockage but informed me that I had a larger issue than just the initial blockage. The sewage pipe was offset which required them to dig down 5 feet and perform a spot repair on the pipe. They found roots growing inside pipe as well and were very transparent about the whole process. All of this was accomplished in less than 24 hours and I’m very satisfied with their service and knowledge. I’ll be contacting them again on any of my future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Grace Agbekoh
reviews.text: Rick and his team were fast and fantastic. I would definitely use him again and reccomend  him to others. He answered and responded promptly to my call for assistance. He was able to assess and fix my leaking and loose pipes same day and in a couple hours. His service was awesome , communication excellent and price point great.

reviews.author: jay heady
reviews.text:
Just hire them!

Ricky is amazingly responsive, almost too responsive if that's even possible. It's so difficult to get anyone to respond these days that Ricky's interaction is really unbelievable.

He evaluated the job correctly and stuck to his original estimate.

Ricky's on the job communication was just as good. He sent pics and video of the entire job and the work looks great, and the water is flowing great.

On thing to keep in mind is they wanted to use zelle only and charged 4% to us a credit card. Not sure that would have made a difference to use them but it was a small surprise.

Thank you, The Plumbing Two!

reviews.author: Mr. C
reviews.text:
I have hired Rick on two occasions and have always been satisfied with his work. When I discovered water leaking from the garage ceiling, I immediately shut off the water and contacted The Plumbing Two. Rick responded promptly the same day to evaluate the issue and quickly identified the source of the leak—a faulty pipe within the drywall. This was a significant project requiring removal and replacement of the damaged section with new copper fittings. Not only did they resolve the water leak efficiently, but the wall repair was completed to such a high standard that it appeared as though no work had ever been done.

The most recent repair addressed a leak emanating from the PVC pipe waterline connected to the hose. I contacted Rick, who responded promptly within thirty minutes. He replaced the PVC pipe with copper, which was the appropriate material for the situation. Rick consistently demonstrates outstanding professionalism and craftsmanship, taking the time to thoroughly explain the circumstances and present available options.

Thank you for delivering outstanding service

plumbers.name: Emergency Plumbers LLC
plumbers.address: 3898 Carlton Dr, Chamblee, GA 30341, USA

reviews.author: Victoria Spurling
reviews.text: Everyone knows how it feels when your toilet is filling up with water when it should be emptying the water!! I tried to take care of the problem myself dumping dish detergent and hot water in the bowl. Then came the plunging but the problem only got worse bc it wasn’t a clog but a pump problem. Thank heavens for Nick with Emergency Plumbers who came to my rescue within 45 minutes. After snaking drain he realized it was a sewage pump problem. Once we located pump the rest was easy. Now thanks to Nick😇 my bathroom is back in business to help our flow continue for decades to come!

reviews.author: Brent Hill - Realtor
reviews.text:
Horrible service, you can tell they're trying to rip you off!!!

I asked for general price and described the issue of a drain clog where the floor drain is accessible, where the water isn't draining, and the clean out that's roughly 5' away is clear and dry (so the clog is in the middle somewhere). He gave me the price of $75 to look at it and then will quote full price but roughly $300-400 to snake if no toilets need to be removed in order to snake it. I said that no toilets need to be removed, once again it's accessible, and I agreed to the $75. Thinking maybe he didn't hear my first explanation of the issue, I went to explain that I'm hoping and thinking it should be relatively easy and thus on the lower end of his quote, maybe even less, since it's a small run and no toilets or fixtures need to be removed but also that is a new building and barely used, but also, I understand that what is found will ultimately control the final price.

Apparently just saying that offended him!! I guess they want to get in and then make up reasons to jack up the price because this guy then went on to say that customers don't get to have any say in what their prices are. Then said based off how I described the job, it'll cost me $700! But of course, could be more. I was shocked and said what happened to the $300-400 and he said it sounds like a $700 job. I'm like what's happening right now, who talks like this. He then goes on to insult me saying that I don't have any money, I'm broke, I need to go and figure out how to make money to afford him before I call, and so on. Well, I guess not everyone can screw people over to make money like he does but clearly he makes too much.

No one should work with people like this, they clearly have the intention of pushing the price up and overcharging. They want stupid people that don't know anything about their problem so they can screw you over!!

reviews.author: Michael Nation
reviews.text: Tried to charge me $800 for the exact same work, or very similar, they did for me for $450. When I challenged, the tech (exact same tech!) came down to $600 and then to $550. So the work became $250 less expensive in the course of 5min? In fact, he started saying things that simply were not true to justify the inflating pricing. I pulled up his prior invoice to prove to him he was incorrect in his bizarre justifications. This was NOT a matter of not all jobs are the same. I clearly understand that. This was an attempt to gouge. Hate to leave this review because they’ve done stellar work for me in the past, but don’t try to cheat your repeat customers. I’ll call you back when you standardize your pricing. Actually I probably won’t. Got the work done for $410 by another firm. Disappointing…

reviews.author: Rouslana Zafirova
reviews.text: Excellent experience with Nick! He was efficient and professional and didn't hesitate to provide us with expert knowledge when we had more detailed questions.

reviews.author: Jennifer Bergwall
reviews.text: Great Service! We had a emergency problem in the middle of a Saturday. Called and they had someone out within the hour. Tony came and fixed it for us. He did a great job. The price was fair and reasonable, especially for a Saturday afternoon. Would highly recommend and use again!

plumbers.name: Simon Plumbing Inc Mokena
plumbers.address: 8513 W 191st St Suite 27, Mokena, IL 60448, USA

reviews.author: James Du
reviews.text: I had a water heater emergency and Simon Plumbing was able to get a plumber out to me that same day. The plumber (I think his name was Tony) who did the work was thorough, answered all my questions about the issue, and gave me tips on what to watch out for in the future. Everything's been working fine for a week now and I'll know what to do next time...but if that's not good enough, I'll know who to call (Simon Plumbing).

reviews.author: Robert Von Borstel
reviews.text:
Extremely happy with the replacement water heater that Simon Plumbing installed.  Their service team were very professional,
courteous and answered my questions during the install.  The final work was excellent.   Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Dean Yaeger
reviews.text: Extremely satisfied! My 14 year old water tank went out Saturday and I took the coldest shower ever. Couldn’t find anyone to come out on the weekend or even return calls. After spending an hour researching and calling plumbing companies Monday morning and  getting incredibly high prices, including one company who wanted $350 extra to change pricing for converting  75 gal to 50. Luckily, I stumbled upon Simon plumbing, locally based in Mokena. I called, spoke with the representative  who quickly gave a very fair and competitive price but wasn’t sure if they could come out the same day. She asked if I had leak or hot water. Nope to both. She called back and said plumbers would be there between 11-1p. Josh and Chance arrived promptly at 11 and completed the Job. by 1245. I’m impressed with the quality, cleanliness and price fairness. Josh showed me the extra copper piping , flue metal and 1/4 turn refrigerators water valve and hook up I added.  He charged a very reasonable additional charge. I also learned that Josh is third generation of this company started by his grandfather. Thank you Simon Plumbing Mokena!

reviews.author: Dan Durkin
reviews.text:
I am very happy with Simon Plumbing in Mokena.  They had great response times when I needed them 2 days in a row on different projects. Very knowledgeable and reasonably priced. What more can you ask for in a plumber?

I will absolutely continue to work with Simon Plumbing in the future.

reviews.author: Amy G
reviews.text:
We have used Simon Plumbing twice this last month and are extremely happy with both services we received.

The first time we called we had a pipe freeze. We woke up to no running water. Called Simon and they came out that morning and resolved the issue. Pricing was fair and both guys that came out were knowledgeable and friendly. They did a great job and got our water working in no time.

We called Simon back out to replace our kitchen faucet. I left a message and got a call shortly after, and scheduled me. Adam came out and completed the job. Adam was very professional and did a great job.

I highly recommend Simon, they do great work at competitive prices.

plumbers.name: Norm's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1325 173rd St, Hammond, IN 46324, USA

reviews.author: Julius Mancilla
reviews.text: I talked to a lot of different plumbing places in town but from phone call to finishing up the job Norms plumbing was a fantastic experience. I needed my outside spigot and inside water shutoff replaced. They were friendly on the phone and actually took the time to hear me explain my issue. They were able to make it to my house the next day even though they said it would take two, which shouldn't be expected but is awesome! When they came by, they started working quickly and got it done in no time. On top of it all they were extremely nice, we talked the entire time and they charged me what felt like a fair price for the amount of work. If you need a plumber, call Norms! They are the only ones I will call from now on!

reviews.author: Nathan Eagan
reviews.text: Highly recommend Norm's plumbing. We were experiencing our showers and toilets draining slow/backing up. Called out a number of other big companies that all went straight to quoting us thousands of dollars to install a clean out to rod our sewer line to the main...Brandon came, addressed the situation and figured out the blockage was inside the house. Rather than taking advantage of a homeowner that was in a bad spot, Brandon took the time to figure out where exactly the problem was and fixed it for a couple hundred bucks. While he was here he also addressed a number of other minor issues. This company has been around for a long time and it's evident why, they treat people with respect and don't take advantage of people in need. Don't waste anymore time searching for a plumber you can trust, call Norm's. You'll never search for a plumber again.

reviews.author: fred kwandras
reviews.text: Great service and arrived at house 2 days early when they had an opening! Brandon listened to my issues, assessed the situation and went to work. He was done within the hour and water was flowing again! I have a new plumbing outfit to handle all future issues! Very reasonable prices! Thank you

reviews.author: Jameson Jurek
reviews.text: I just had a major plumbing issue with my sewers, norm's was so professional and helpful in getting the city involved. as it turned out it was actually a city issue caused by a city contractor.

reviews.author: Elisa Polak
reviews.text: I had an emergency where my sewer pipe had a blockage flooded my whole basement. I called first thing when they opened and they sent someone out same day. Not only fixed the problem but educated me on what the cause may be and how to prevent it in the future. Very reasonable pricing as well. I look forward to using them again in the future to get new plumbing soon. Thank you sooo much.

plumbers.name: Universal Plumbing & Rooter
plumbers.address: 2662 Kendrick Cir, San Jose, CA 95121, USA

reviews.author: Alejandro Fernandez
reviews.text:
Amazing job installing a new water heater. My old one was having scary misfires after 13 years, and Martin was able to come quickly ans fix it the same day. He suggested replacing it given its age and also replaced the existing lines and exhaust vent.
Will definitely call Universal again, thank you!

reviews.author: sharon mamola
reviews.text: This is the second time that I have used Universal Plumbing and had the pleasure of working with Martin both times.  The first time I had ghost flushing toilets which I had TWO different plumbers address and it wasn't until Martin came out that the problem was finally corrected.  This time around I had a leaking garbage disposal, which was replaced by Smart Plumbers previously.  I hadn't  noticed the leak until a can which I kept under the sink for cooking grease disposal was full when I took it out.  I was confused and then I realized it was water.  I didn't bother with Smart and just called Martin.  I scheduled for today, got a call and he arrived.  Upon inspection he said that it had not been tightened properly. Seriously!?  He told me he could tighten it but I opted for a new one.  I appreciated that he didn't  come out and say it needed replacement.    Super nice people and great work.  Sometimes it's better to go with the smaller guys.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Manish Kasotiya
reviews.text: Martin was very professional and discussed options on my plumbing job. He suggested the best option from point of view of functionality, asthetics and cost. Once aligned, they were very quick and got the job done. Highly recommend him and his team.

reviews.author: Amy Hoefer
reviews.text: Martin was great to work with. He took the time to communicate with me and show me photos to verify all the work that was done. Everything was cleaned up and completed in a timely manner. I highly recommend Martin and Universal Plumbing.

reviews.author: Arthur Woo
reviews.text: Martin and Manuel from Universal plumbing were fantastic! They helped work around an issue with third party scheduler via Lowe’s that kept dropping the ball on our toilet installation appt. They were friendly, knowledgeable, did great work, provided good advice for future and fair pricing. Will definitely keep them in contact list for future jobs. Recommended!

reviews.author: Mark Harman
reviews.text: Piper Plumbing was very professional and efficient. The service tech was informative and actually taught me how to repair the water heater myself should the issue reoccur. Also. I called them and they showed up very quickly

reviews.author: M Hope
reviews.text: I bought a water heater from Lowes a year ago. Called the water heater company and they referred me to piper's plumbing. I talked to Chris. He was very professional and helpful. He came out the same day i called. He had the water heater fixed up and going in no time. I would definitely use chris and piper's plumbing again.

reviews.author: Donald Swoopes
reviews.text: I called Piper’s Plumbing for a water issue and they arrived expeditiously, which was amazing. Also, the repair was done in a timely fashion with consideration of my availability. Additionally, the technician took the time to explain how everything work to be a more informed homeowner.

reviews.author: Andre Boyer
reviews.text: CHRIS DOES A GREAT AND PROFESSIONAL JOB. HE EXSPLAINED EVERYTHING SO I COULD UNDERSTAND AND HE MADE SURE THAT I DIDN'T HAVE ANY QUESTIONS OR CONCERNS BEFORE HE STARTED WORK AND AFTER HE FINISHED THE JOB.

reviews.author: SFernandez13461
reviews.text: Chris came out very quickly when we had a broken pipe and had it fixed in no time. We recently hired him again, and, once again, he showed up when he said he would and did a great job. We’ll definitely be hiring him again

reviews.author: Karmarie Martinez Moya
reviews.text: Doctor Rooter 911 was incredibly professional, helpful and honest. They arrived promptly when I had an emergency plumbing situation and fixed my clogged drain quickly. I appreciated how reliable and knowledgeable the plumber was, and the price was fair. I’m excited to call them again for any future drain cleaning or plumbing needs.

reviews.author: MPLGRR
reviews.text: We had water in our basement on a Sunday. The plumbers arrived within about an hour and solved the clogged floor drain quickly. They clearly explained what was going on and options for prevention and maintenance going forward. For an emergency on a Sunday, the cost seemed reasonable.

reviews.author: Dmitry Zinger
reviews.text:
Dr. Rooter 911 was great! They came out within an hour on a Sunday on very short notice and fixed my clogged basement drain quickly and professionally. John and his associate were both incredibly helpful, pleasant, and polite. They explained everything clearly and made sure the issue was completely resolved before leaving.

Communication was excellent — they were very responsive through Angi’s app and over the phone. It’s rare to find such prompt and professional service these days. Highly recommend John and his guys!

reviews.author: Sally Morgan
reviews.text: I was very pleased with Dr. Rooter's  promptness, effectiveness, and affordability.     Seriously, the least stressful interaction I've ever had with a contractor.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: John Bloede
reviews.text: I wasted 3 days trying to find a grey water tank without any luck. John and Jacob found it in less than an hour. They were great to work with. I would definitely recommend them.

plumbers.name: All Clear Plumbing
plumbers.address: Hamilton Township, NJ 08619, USA

reviews.author: Will Kraemer
reviews.text: Everyone at All Clear was wonderful! They were able to get to me quickly and fixed my issue. My house sat vacant for more than a year and the sewage line dried up. Being in the house and using the plumbing caused a big backup. Shawn identified the problem and had us back up and running within an hour. Honest, easy to work with, and fairly priced. Would 100% recommend!

reviews.author: jason .wang
reviews.text:
Good LORD, it took me a day and a half to find the correct "All Clear Plumbing..." I suppose it's a popular term of art in the biz.

Anyway - Shaun and Paul came by to undo years of food gum/gunk/grease in the kitchen pipes. Really great guys, Shaun explained everything thoroughly and neatly and thanks to him I am an expert in "pitch" and "ABS" and "bellies" etc. Dirty shitty ABS out, fresh new glistening PVC in. They came, they saw, they conquered. [Well more like SHAUN came, saw, left, came back two days later with Paul, and then conquered.] This was solid service. Very friendly office staff on the phones and my invoice arrived in my inbox minutes after S&P cleared out. Military discount too, yahoo.

You hate to call a plumber unless you're dialing for "elective surgery," but either way - these two were solid. Their instructors/mentors should be proud of them. 5/5 recommend.

reviews.author: Forest Friend
reviews.text: We had what ended up being a costly plumbing emergency last week.  I woke up to find “dirty water” on the top of our dryer, as well as surrounding it.  Shaun came out immediately, which was very much appreciated.  He checked inside, as well as outside.  He quickly determined it to be an even bigger problem: our septic.  He didn’t charge us for coming out, which I am very grateful for.  He just asked that we remember All Clear Plumbing the next time we need a plumber.  We absolutely will!  You absolutely will have our continued business.  Thank you!

reviews.author: Shelley Seymour
reviews.text: Had a broken toilet on Monday morning that went dead. Called All Clear Plumbing. They answered my call and sent a plumber and fixed my problem before noon. Very efficient and not overpriced despite the emergency nature of my call. Highly recommend and would call them again.

reviews.author: Nancy Hilton
reviews.text: Found water in the middle of my basement floor. Could not figure out where it came from. Basement ceiling dry. Next day washed  dishes and checked basement.. Found water shooting out from pipe for washer drainage. Called  Eagle Plumbing. They came right out and advised me to call All Clear for clogged sewer pipe . Fabian and his partner came out  within 2 hours, snaked the pipe and now everything draining as usual. So quick, so efficient , courteous and reasonable.. I recommend them 100% ! Great company and people.

plumbers.name: ProFix Drains & Hydro Jet🔧
plumbers.address: 9163 Algeroma St, Bellflower, CA 90706, USA

reviews.author: Yulian Amador
reviews.text: Literally dreading the thought of a whole house repipe but the old galvanized pipes were starting to turn the water a weird color in the mornings. The crew was super chill and actually got the new lines run through the walls with way less cutting than I thought they would have to do. It is totally awesome to finally have actual water pressure in the shower again and not worry about a pipe bursting behind the drywall. They cleaned up all the debris every afternoon and were super respectful of my space the whole time.

reviews.author: Lauren Ashley
reviews.text: Our main water line sprung a leak and it was such a inconvenience when you don't have proper running water. After finding this plumbing team that services my area in Newport Beach, I decided to give him a call. He was very responsive and was the first out of 3 plumbers to arrive next day in the AM. He was very easy to talk to and didn't try to up sell like the other ones. His quote was fair and I didn't feel like I was getting ripped off. I would call Greg back if I need any plumbing services in a heart beat!

reviews.author: Jayla
reviews.text: The guest bathroom was out of commission for three days because the shower wouldn't drain at all. Mention Mark how he came dow to Cerritos to fix our clogged drains and he got right to the point without trying to sell me on a whole new plumbing stack. He pulled out a massive clog and checked the exterior cleanout just to be safe. It is good to have a reliable guy to call who actually shows up when he says he will.

reviews.author: Ashley castillo
reviews.text: Our main line was backed up bad and Greg really saved the day by getting a crew out here on such short notice. I wasn't expecting anyone to be available for at least a week but he managed to squeeze us into the schedule for some much needed hydrojetting in Bellflower before things got even worse. The guys showed up exactly when they said they would and didn't waste any time getting the equipment set up or making a mess of my driveway. It is rare to find an owner who actually answers the phone and follows through these days so I am definitely keeping their number for next time. Would you like me to generate another review using the Tuesday "Relieved" style for a different service?

reviews.author: harasha Jones
reviews.text: The old tank finally died and I just needed a new one in the garage without any hassle. I called Profix and they actually got a crew out here to handle a full water heater installation within the same day which is rare for Los Angeles. No long winded sales pitches or hidden fees at the end of the job. They just swapped the units out and made sure the pilot light was solid before heading out. Solid work and I would definitely use them again if another appliance gives up.

plumbers.name: Super Star Plumbing
plumbers.address: 6447 Clara St, Bell Gardens, CA 90201, USA

reviews.author: Robo Piedra
reviews.text: Whenever you need an honest, fair, experienced & friendly plumber... look no further... SUPER STAR PLUMBING... is our to go to... now join the club & make it yours too... Now Let's Rock! 😉🤙🎸💨🎼🎶🎵

reviews.author: dizle ran
reviews.text: We had a real good experience with super star plumbing.  My grandma had requested to call them and they arrived same day to fix a pipe with roots at front yard. The plumber miguel was real knowledgeable and was able to make everything work again.

reviews.author: Mehdi Rashed
reviews.text:
If I could give Zero star to these guys, I would do it for sure.
I wanted to change the faucet on my bath tub, so I called them and asked for a quote.
They came to my house and checked it out and told me the pipe behind the wall needs to be changed to a smaller diameter.
I told the guy I don’t want it, so leave it as is. But he insisted on trying something else without my consent.
So, he broke the pipe that goes inside the wall.
He apologized and told me that he can’t fix it, because they don’t do tile works. But he said that he will contact me and will give a discount to repair the damage HE CAUSED!

I’m still waiting for their call…

reviews.author: Empress De Alkebulan
reviews.text: I needed a new shower installed and I was informed by a friend that she got her shower installed by Super Star plumbing! She showed me the work that was done and after that, I was sold! They did a beautiful job on my bathroom that I show everyone that comes to my home! Great job, Super Star plumbing! You are my go to for all of my household plumbing needs! 💜

reviews.author: A Garcia
reviews.text: I’m a happy customer and am so glad I called Super Star Plumbing for 2nd opinion and an  estimate to have sewer (about 45’ ) line replaced. Miguel and team did a great job. All dedicated and hard workers (worked 11hours non stop)! Miguel was easy going person, very knowledgeable, gave me a competitive quote, addressed all my needs and concerns and much more to a more than satisfactory level. All that we talked about on this service call he took care of. I didn’t have to remind him of any of them. Impressed with his post follow up and even took care of a minor issue that was not part of the main work done. I will definitely call them again  and refer them ( I have used their services a few times for sewer clean out and happy then). Thank you Miguel !

reviews.author: Sondra Hanson
reviews.text: Rapid Rotter has been my go-to plumber since 2016. I own several rental properties, and having a dependable plumber has been essential to keeping my business running smoothly. They have been extremely responsive during emergency calls, accurately diagnosing the issue and making necessary repairs quickly. I highly recommend Paul and his team for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: kyler massey
reviews.text: I gave Rapid Rooter a call to see if they could repair a faulty water heater. Paul provided the best customer service I have received in the better part of a decade. I would have no hesitation in recommending Rapid Rooter to anyone in need of some plumbing work done.

reviews.author: Kimberley Keirsey
