reviews.author: Amanda Hietpas
reviews.text:
I used Ogden to address a clog in my main sewer line, and I would NOT recommend them. While they were friendly and very quick to respond, they were also expensive and ultimately ineffective. They sent two guys out (at $120/hr, each) that took 2 hours to run a snake through my main sewer line pipe one time. This restored water flow through the pipe and I was told there was no indication of there being a bigger problem. Ogden diagnosed the clog as likely being due to 'flushable' wipes that I have since stopped using.
TWO WEEKS later, the same problem resurfaced and Ogden refused to stand behind their work. I was told that they would need to send two guys back out, at $120/hr each, and run a camera through my sewer line.
In other words, when the service I paid $600 for proved ineffective, the only option they gave me was to pay another $400 for them to use a method they deemed unnecessary two weeks prior, in order to diagnose a problem that they told me they fixed. To be clear, this would have meant paying Ogden $1,000 for nothing more than a diagnosis.
In the end, I contacted a different company that ultimately resolved the problem using the exact same snaking method/equipment - but at half the cost with a 90 day warranty. This other company offered a likely diagnosis that was not mentioned by Ogden, and clearly explained how to prevent reoccurrence. It's also worth noting that this other company, who did not charge by the hour, sent one worker that snaked my main sewer twice in half the time it took two Ogden workers to do it once.
To sum it up: I would not recommend Ogden for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Brian Davis
reviews.text:
Ogden Plumbing installed my father-in-law's first hot water heater over 25 years ago, and this year it stopped working. Paul was able to come the day after it stopped working and efficiently installed the new one. We were thankful for the 24-hour phone line so we could get the message quickly.
The following week we had an appointment for the rest of the plumbing needs in the house. My father-in-law really liked working with Paul, and requested him. Paul came right on time and worked to replace the kitchen faucet, switch the water hoses for the washer, and replace toilet tank plumbing. We were thankful for the efficiency and quality of his work. It is so pleasant to have the right temperatures in the washer, the toilet flushes so pleasantly, and our kitchen faucet fills the sink in under a minute! Thank you for being our home plumber!

reviews.author: Scott Pietila
reviews.text: FANTASTIC service from Ogden! Had a water heater leak over the weekend, and Ogden was the only one of four calls I made who responded with a strong action plan, and had their team out first thing Monday morning with a new water heater. Royal, Steve, and Chris were all outstanding - thorough, knowledgeable, and very high quality of work. I highly recommend Ogden!

reviews.author: Dean Ressler
reviews.text: Always great! Our family has been using Ogden for years. They are responsive, show up on time, do great work and clean up after their work. Great customer service.

reviews.author: Nancy Stachowiak
reviews.text: I am very pleased with the work Steve and Justin did at my home. In addition to my original request they also fixed a few other problems that I had. I would recommend them for your plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: PM Plumbing & Mechanical
plumbers.address: 6008 Mt Vernon Way, Mt Pleasant, WI 53406, USA

reviews.author: Robert Greening
reviews.text: I reached out to PM Plumbing regarding a water leak, and Paul responded right away. He quickly diagnosed the issue, even though it was a tricky one, and explained exactly what needed to be repaired. His team arrived the very next day to complete the work. They were professional, thorough, and took great care to protect our kitchen cabinets throughout the process. When they finished, the space looked just as clean as when they started. The cost was very fair, especially given the exceptional quality of service. I would highly recommend PM Plumbing to anyone in need of reliable plumbing help.

reviews.author: Tommy L
reviews.text:
Great service! The 2 guys that showed up very nice and respectful.
Good communication , let me know what they had to do and showed me what was the problem.  Fixed it . In a good reasonable time even though it wasn't any easy fix. At least it didn't look easy to me.
Put everything back and cleaned up as if they were never here.
Works great. Will call PM plumbing if I ever need anything else!
Thank you.

reviews.author: Zach Christensen
reviews.text: Paul and his team are a great group of professionals who are able to innovate when faced with challenging plumbing situations. Their pricing is fair and reasonable, using quality materials and made sure I was satisfied every step of the project.

reviews.author: Miroslav Crnjakovic
reviews.text: Paul and Michael were AMAZING! Honest salt of the earth people. Paul was quick to come out for a free estimate and gave me a truly fair deal. I did my homework and looked for additional quotes. Paul is who I'm sticking with for any future plumbing needs. Michael worked on my entire kitchen sink, disposal and dishwasher hookup, fridge water line, bathroom tub & sink plus 2 outside spigots. He listened, offered advice and best of all did a phenomenal freakin job VERY neatly! 100% recommend them!!!

reviews.author: Bonnie Christensen
reviews.text: Always call Paul at PM Mechanical for your plumbing needs.  He and his employees are neat, clean, fast, efficient, professional and, of course, knowledgeable!  I recently had a pipe leak in the basement. After a quick text and photo of the problem, his employee was at our home fixing the leak.  PM Plumbing & Mechanical is great!  Thank you, Paul.

plumbers.name: Extra Care Plumbing, LLC
plumbers.address: 4000 Eagle Point Corporate Dr, Birmingham, AL 35242, USA

reviews.author: Jamie Carpenter
reviews.text: We called our plumber (SpencerDennis) after receiving $90 water bill. Spencer came out the day of the call and we searched for the possible leak under concrete driveway. Spencer referred to a company from B’ham that specializes in locating water leaks under concrete. The next day I searched our property high and low for water standing and found it near our carport in the supply line from the meter. Finding the spot was not Spencer’s fault it was mine because I told him I thought it was under the concrete due to water standing. Spencer promptly returned that day and made the repairs as needed. His professionalism and having the tools and parts needed on his truck is why we use his service. I think the term used in the service industry is “you get what you pay for” if you need a plumber call Marble City Plumbing. Oh by the way the water standing in the driveway was where our oldest grandson washes his truck twice a week 😂

reviews.author: Geneva Payne
reviews.text: They were quick and responsive. Andre knew what was wrong quickly and had us fixed just as quick with good products. I appreciate that they were able to get out here the same day I called. The price was good . And I will be calling them again when I need a plumber

reviews.author: Lauren Mathews
reviews.text:
It's always terrifying to have something go wrong in the middle of the night that you can't fix yourself.  I woke up to a running shower at 1am, and nothing was working to make it quit.
Thankfully, Andre answered the cry for help and showed up to the rescue!
Got the water shut off and a plan in action, and he was right back at it this morning.
Now I have a spiffy new shower handle, nothing is leaking, he cleaned everything up after himself and was such an absolute professional.  Prices were very reasonable for the work performed as well.
I will definitely be calling again for my plumbing needs!

reviews.author: N Turner
reviews.text:
Extra Care plumbing did an amazing job! Mr. Andre was prompt, professional and very thorough.  He explained everything he was doing and put our minds at ease! We only use Extra Care Plumbing!
We highly recommend this company for all your plumbing needs, you will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Emma Duncan
reviews.text: Unfortunately (for me) I was in need of a plumber three times in one week for three separate issues. Extra Care Plumbing was able to come out fast and took care of all of my issues at a super reasonable price. Andre was so knowledgeable and told me some extra things to look out for. Highly recommend and these will be my go to plumbers from here on out.

plumbers.name: Piper Plumbing Inc LLC
plumbers.address: 21 Mathews Dr #5, Hilton Head Island, SC 29926, USA

reviews.author: Lauren Dooley
reviews.text: We had a main water leak under our driveway and several other plumbers suggested a scope of the sewer line. I called Piper for another opinion and they identified the problem of a faulty connector right away and made the repair. They saved us money and time and we could not be more satisfied. Shawn was knowledgable, and explained everything during the process. I will recommend them going forward!

reviews.author: Tara Gowen
reviews.text: I had a leak and called Piper Plumbing. The lady was so nice on the phone and they got right out to me within just a few hours. They did the job in less than half the time they originally thought and saved me so much time and money. I really appreciate the kindness, and promptness the technicians had. Will definitely be using them in the future if needed.

reviews.author: Wade Pearson
reviews.text: This friday night my property manager called and said I had a leak behind the wall.  We got in touch with Piper and they got out there finishing around midnight.  I got the bill today and it was IMO quite reasonable for after hours work.  I would definately use them again.

reviews.author: Joan Gathro
reviews.text: Piper Plumbing came to fix a continually running toilet, we thought we needed new internal parts. Andra Swan the plumber, examined the toilet and determined the existing internal mechanism was perfectly fine, it simply needed to be tightened. He then did another minor repair for us, since it would be parts ($8.00) only added to the existing service call. Awesome job! We used Piper Plumbing for all of our previous plumbing jobs, including changing out our hot water heater. They do awesome work at reasonable rates and we have always been extremely satisfied with their price and quality of work.

reviews.author: Eli Goldowsky
reviews.text:
I could not recommend Piper Plumbing more highly from every aspect of professionalism and expertise in the services they provide. The friendly and courteous personnel of Vivian and Becky to the expertise of the entire staff of plumbers, namely
Roy and Sean. All respond immediately at any hour or day and
can provide service to complete any task required.
Thank you Piper Plumbing.

plumbers.name: Alamo Sewer & Drain
plumbers.address: 17 Winston Ave, Newport News, VA 23601, USA

reviews.author: Mark Mahn (AD2S-AN2O)
reviews.text: I have been using Alamo for years. George and Brenden are the best!  They are throwbacks to when people did a good job, the right way!  Good guys!

reviews.author: Sharon Smith
reviews.text: They came right out and got the drain working and scheduled to come back after Christmas to fix the section of the sewer line that needed to be replaced!  Quality work.  I will hire them again!

reviews.author: Kristin Liberty
reviews.text: Is it normal practice to throw your trash in you're clients neighbors trash can? Wich is illegal here btw, not even bagged. How lazy. If you want to stay friends with your neighbors don't hire these guys. Not to mention the nasty smell of what was thrown in there. I was curious why my dog suddenly so interested in the can.

reviews.author: Stephanie Dixon
reviews.text: LOVE Alamo S&D.  It's a father/son team and they work hard!  We get the son, Brandon, most of time.  He is AWESOME!  We love Brandon.  Solved our problem, didn't even want to charge us a lot. He's such an honest knowledgeable savior!  Call Alamo for any/all your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Shirley Widlacki
reviews.text: We have called Alamo twice and both times received extremely prompt, courteous, and professional service. Brendan serviced us both times on emergency calls and we couldn't be more pleased with his work. Alamo responds quickly and gets the job done. I highly recommend!

plumbers.name: MIAMI SERVICE PLUMBERS | Emergency Plumbers in Miami
plumbers.address: 5390 NW 72nd Ave, Miami, FL 33166, USA

reviews.author: Betty Chavez
reviews.text: I thought my Water Heater was completely dead but Miami Service Plumbers came to help me and change both elements and thermostat, No need to buy a new one. Thanks to the super professional and reliable technicians that i met.

reviews.author: Luis Ravelo
reviews.text: Great experience from start to finish. The team was professional, on time, and fixed our water heater quickly. They explained everything clearly and charged a fair price. Clean work, no hassle. Highly recommend for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Pedro Monzón
reviews.text: Excellent service! Miami Service Plumber did an impeccable job at my home. They were punctual, professional, and very efficient. They solved the problem quickly and left everything clean and in perfect condition. I will definitely recommend them and call them again in the future. Well-deserved five stars!

reviews.author: Mario Lopez
reviews.text: I want to thank Miami Service Plumbers for the perfect performance and amazing job on my new drain filed. Looking forward to be you forever costumer.

reviews.author: lilliann98@gmail.com lili1998
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Miami Service Plumbers. They were quick to respond and arrived on time. The plumber explained the issue clearly and fixed it efficiently and the price was fair. I recommend this company for all your plumbing need.

plumbers.name: Jerry C Plumbing and Drain Services
plumbers.address: 504 S Curley St, Baltimore, MD 21224, USA

reviews.author: Chantiera Cooper
reviews.text: Very Great Customer Service. Response was within minutes, came out same day and explained everything to me in full detail. Very polite and professional as well. This will be my go to plumbing service going forward. Thank you for the wonderful service 😊

reviews.author: T. Rob Astle
reviews.text: Jerry was  very prompt, professional, and affordable. We had a problem with a toilet. Because of poor service that was provided (or really  not provided) by another plumber we were left without a working toilet. Jerry was able to fix the toilet the next day. We were very happy with the job and plan to hire him again!

reviews.author: ryan j
reviews.text: Jerry is fantastic. He explained everything he was going to do during the installation of my water heater, was happy to answer any and all questions I had, and didn't cut any corners. His prices are extremely fair and I would encourage anyone to at least get a quote from Jerry before going with another plumbing company.

reviews.author: Kin Chung Choo
reviews.text:
Absolutely fantastic service from Jerry C Plumbing — couldn't be happier!
Had a leak that was stressing me out big time, and honestly I wasn't sure who to call. So glad I went with them. They showed up on time, were super friendly and professional, and got straight to work diagnosing the problem. No runaround, no upselling — just honest, quality work.
The plumber explained everything clearly before doing anything, which I really appreciated. The repair was done quickly and cleanly, and he even double-checked everything before leaving to make sure there were no other issues.
Pricing was fair and exactly what was quoted. This is the kind of service you hope for but don't always get. Will 100% be calling them again for any future plumbing needs and recommending them to everyone I know. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kori Trawinski
reviews.text: Very pleased with Jerry C plumbing service. He professional and very knowledgeable. My plumbing problems were resolved in a timely manner. Highly recommended!

plumbers.name: CORE Plumbing & Drain Cleaning
plumbers.address: 6339 Charlotte Pike Suite 1394, Nashville, TN 37209, USA

reviews.author: Nathalie Devot
reviews.text: Core Plumbing is a top of the line company. Their customer service is by far one of the best I have experienced. Caitlin (the dispatcher) was friendly, helpful, knowledgeable, and compassionate. She went above and beyond to assist us in our water heater tank emergency. Michael (the technician) was AMAZING!!! He did a great installation for the new tank and he even came back the following day to make sure everything was working as it should!!! Thanks to them, we finally have running water and hot water!!! Thank you 😊

reviews.author: Stephanie Stanton
reviews.text: Moved into a newly remodeled rental home in East Nashville and was having issues with hot water and water pressure. Eduardo arrived and was amazing! Walked me through what was causing the challenges (incorrectly installed fixtures and dirty water lines) and he corrected on the spot. All said and done in an hour. So impressed with the professionalism and service.

reviews.author: Maureen L
reviews.text: Highly recommend CORE for their professionalism and attention to detail. Very happy to learn that not only are they amazing plumbers but Eddie is top-notch at drywall and spackling. Will definitely be looking to use them again in the future!  Competitively priced as well.

reviews.author: Stead Fast
reviews.text: Michael is awesome!!! He saw me at a gas station. I had a flat tire. He stopped everything he was doing to change my tire for me. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Elena Morales Snavely
reviews.text:
Rick was very helpful.
Had issues getting a tech out due to property management but they made us a priority, answering our call late at night and coming out first time in the morning to help with a clog that rendered all of our showers, upstairs bathrooms and washer unusable, sending water into the floor and walls.
They came out promptly and identified and removed the clog before testing everything. They did an excellent job and the repairs were very professional.

plumbers.name: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1455 Valley Center Pkwy Suite 170, Bethlehem, PA 18017, USA

reviews.author: M B
reviews.text: Initially, I was very satisfied with this company for a hot water heater they installed. I’m now trying to set up an appointment for “Ben Franklin maintenance plan“ I purchased when I bought my hot water heater, but there’s no answering of the phones, at all. I tried every phone number. I waited  on hold multiple times during a two day period. I finally made an appointment online and they never showed. I received a confirmation text and email saying that they would be there but they never showed. They were great a few months ago, but I don’t know what happened to them, hence my very BAD review. Beware!! You probably wouldn’t be able to get a hold of them anyway.

reviews.author: K Washington
reviews.text: A 12 yrs experience plumber arrived 2x an stated he was unable to install my newly purchased sink. He insisted that it couldn't be done and insistes for me to purchase a facet along with a amother new sink. So today the drain remains slow exiting and clogged. The price that was paid was outrageous for the service that was supposed to be completed.

reviews.author: Michael Perry
reviews.text: Benjamin Franklin plumbing did an excellent job clearing out my plumbing clean out. My technician was very experienced and explained everything to me. He also educated me on the other systems at my home. I highly recommend Benjamin Franklin plumbing. Thank you for the great job. Also the office staff was excellent.

reviews.author: JD Aeon
reviews.text: This past week l had my house sump pump replaced. They came in as scheduled and did an excellent job! As l also have some other jobs to be done such as replacement of sinks and toilets, they offered me membership on their services and products sort of club which comes with discounts and other benefits associated to products and services, etc. l was pleasantly surprised and quite pleased! They get the job done and keep you informed of all possibilities.  My special thanks for the two polite, efficient and nice professional plumbers they sent to my house! Cheers!

reviews.author: Jay Volk
reviews.text: Justin was Awesome!  Very helpful, worked hard, and was done in a timely manner. The cost was a bit more than we hoped, but the work came with a multiple year warranty so it's all good. We'll be using them for any and all plumbing needs from this point forward.

plumbers.name: Ray's Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 948 Estes Ct, Schaumburg, IL 60193, USA

reviews.author: Jerry Mcwilliams
reviews.text: Parked next to one of there vehicles at a Menards in Glendale Hts,IL and there driver put a dent in my passenger rear qtr panel, I called and talked with there phone staff and was told i would get a call back, well that never happened of course. Take ownership when you damage someone's vehicle!

reviews.author: Peter
reviews.text:
Purchased an AC and Furnace from Ray's for my parents home because they touted their warranty on April of 2021. Today November of 2023, the furnace would not heat, so we called for service. Under the impression that the warranty should cover all labor for 5 years, and parts for 10, we thought this should be covered. Instead, they arrived (charged 78 dollars to drive to our home) then charged my parents156 dollars to diagnose the issue, then charged them 82.80 to clean and test the flame sensor. So they were charged 316.80 for a unit that is fully covered under warranty, less than two years old.

I would avoid doing business with this company as there are hundreds of HVAC companies that stand behind their products. This was my mistake for choosing Ray's for my parents HVAC needs. The company I chose for my own home doesn't charge me a penny to do service on my unit as that's what the warranty was for. If it inoperative, they take care of it as it should be. Ray's does not have that level of service.

reviews.author: Laura Michalak
reviews.text: They came to our rescue just in time!!  Our furnace was just about to quit all together and they came out the same day to install a new one. Very efficient and friendly installers, did a great job. Would definitely use Ray's again and recommend to everyone.

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.text:
Worked with Marshall and Dan, they repiped my entire home with all new copper.

System has great pressure, in and out in a day! Absolutely recommended to anyone needing to transition from galvanized to copper.

reviews.author: Carrie
reviews.text: Ray's Plumbing did an amazing job replacing my old A/C unit. The installers were polite, thorough and kept me updated throughout the process. Thank you for the friendly, high quality, and affordable service!

plumbers.name: T. Lenard Plumbing & Drain Inc.
plumbers.address: 206 Crenshaw Dr, Murfreesboro, TN 37128, USA

reviews.author: Jonathon Hobstetter
reviews.text: We had an issue with our water heater and bathroom plumbing after the freezes that occurred this winter. He was very nice on the phone, but when we set an appointment he rescheduled several times. When he finally arrived to assist, he did fix the water heater. When working on the shower, he told us we needed to order a part off Amazon to complete the repair. Once the part arrived, he never came out to finish the job. He was paid in full at this point. We reached out several times to confirm a time which he never came through on. It has been months. Finally, he stopped answering completely.

reviews.author: tammy miller
reviews.text: Todd was very quick to get us scheduled and was here the next day. Our hot water heater was installed quickly with a lot of attention paid to our wood floors, general neatness, etc. We hired him for a second job of disconnecting a water softener system which required under the house crawling around. While under the house he discovered a potential disaster where a wire holding up a copper pipe was wearing through the pipe, about to open the pipe. He corrected it while under the house. So he was very aware of all the plumbing system not just what he was called in for. Great guy, Great service. Thanks Todd.

reviews.author: Jaylyn Shanklin
reviews.text: Todd did amazing same day service at my house. He was very kind, and helped me very quickly. I had a leak in an outside faucet & the pipes under my house were shaking. He fixed the leak and secured the pipes for an excellent price. He is my permanent plumber.

reviews.author: Kellye Johnson
reviews.text: We had no idea of what plumber in the area could fit us in on a holiday weekend and this was the first place we called. After telling him our issues, he said he could come the next morning, then called back and said he could come that very night if that was okay. Heck yes! Super friendly and knowledgeable! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Matthew Kroeger
reviews.text:
Todd is just the best.  I called the first company about a bad smell coming from my water and they quoted me $2300 to replace my water heater over the phone without even looking at it.

I called Todd and he said he would come check it out.  Told me I had a few more years at least with my water heater and flushed it to kill the smell.

Todd is an expert and a professional and he absolutely earned me a s a customer for life.  I cannot recommend Todd enough. :)

plumbers.name: Reliable Plumbing & Sewer Service Inc
plumbers.address: 9013 Peachtree Dr, Tinley Park, IL 60487, USA

reviews.author: John Gutierrez
reviews.text: We called Reliable Plumbing about an issue we were having with the  pedestal sink faucet in our bathroom and John from Reliable came out to check out the problem and after he was finished he found several additional issues with the sink and we decided to remove and replace it with a new vanity sink which we agreed on after he explained the other issues he found with the original sink... John was very professional, knowledgeable,     and a nice guy, he also explained everything he was doing and he even replaced the two shut off valves for the sink which were very old and after he was finished with the installation it looked beautiful. Oh and I forgot to mention that John was even nice enough to help us pick out the new vanity.We would definitely recommend and use Reliable Plumbing  again.

reviews.author: Kevin Gordon
reviews.text: John and the team at Reliable Plumbing are professional and knowledgeable. They resolved a stubborn kitchen sink drain clog that was too far down the pipe for me to access and now it drains like new. Thank you Reliable Plumbing!

reviews.author: Susan Quillin
reviews.text:
I was referred to Reliable plumbing by a neighbor who had a good experience. Contacting the company & scheduling an appointment was quick & easy. The plumber arrived on time, as promised. John "diagnosed" the problem with my outdoor water spigot & promptly corrected the problem. I was happy with his services & glad to be able to resume watering my flowers! I recommend his company to others in need of an experienced plumber.

Sue (Tinley Park)

reviews.author: Andrew Edborg
reviews.text: Had a plumbing emergency not too long ago and could not get any plumbers out. Was Referred to reliable plumbing by a buddy and called. John the owner was super helpful and got to me almost immediately.  John was very knowledgeable and delivered quick efficient quality work. He was able to solve all the issues I was having and was very fair with his price. I highly recommend reliable plumbing for any plumbing services.

reviews.author: Natalia Zecca
reviews.text: Just had Reliable out to fix a leak under my kitchen sink, and they were AWESOME!!! Super friendly and easy to talk to, the plumber showed up when he said he would (which was not too long after I called!), and got the issue diagnosed quickly. He explained what was going on in a way that actually made sense, and the whole thing was fixed way faster than I expected. No trying to upsell you or use a ton of jargon so you don’t even know what you’re paying for. No mess left behind either, which I really appreciated. You can tell they actually care about doing a good job. 10/10 highly recommend Reliable Plumbing!!!

plumbers.name: Joey’s Plumbing
plumbers.address: 132 Frank Ln, Keller, TX 76248, USA

reviews.author: Sean Taylor
reviews.text: Posting this review on behalf of my parents who have had various unrelated plumbing issues the past year. Joey’s Plumbing has been incredibly professional and personable in their responses, especially in emergency situations my folks have had. The Joey’s Plumbing team has gone above and beyond to fix our issues all for a very reasonable price. Our gratitude for their very quality service cannot be overstated.

reviews.author: Stuart Gans
reviews.text: We had to shut our water off on Christmas because we had a leak inside the wall behind the sheet rock. I called Israel the morning after Christmas, he came right out, and fixed it. He was also very reasonable on the price. I will be using Joey's Plumbing again in the future. I absolutely recommend them !

reviews.author: Andy
reviews.text:
Israel is amazing and very professional.
Came out next day to fix a hose bib that I tried to fix but didn’t want to deal with any issues that could’ve transpired.
Very fair pricing and quality service.
A+

reviews.author: Debra DeBusk
reviews.text: We had a terrible leak under the kitchen sink due to pipe separation.  I came home to clean new pipes in a better configuration.  We also had a toilet with a broken seal that was replaced. Once the appointment was set, the serviceman kept in touch via text or call.  Very friendly. Paid using Zelle. Easy peasy!

reviews.author: Matthew Simmons
reviews.text: Awesome experience! Joey’s Plumbing showed up right on time, figured out the problem fast, and had everything fixed up without any hassle. Super easy to work with, explained what was going on , and the price was really fair. I’ll definitely be calling them again next time we need a plumber. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Poseidon Plumbing
plumbers.address: 970 Quail Cir, Brighton, CO 80601, USA

reviews.author: Rebecca Phillips
reviews.text: Owen was the technician sent out - 5 stars for him. He was polite, respectful, diagnosed and fixed the issue very quickly while explaining to me what was going on, as well as next steps should I notice the problem come back and how to reach out to AHS. The company also reached out quickly to schedule my service. The only downside to my experience is that the morning of my scheduled appointment I got a text that their truck was having issues and they'd have to reschedule so it did push my appointment back a week, which luckily I didn't have an urgent issue or a gushing leak, just a slow leak that was manageable until they could come out.

reviews.author: B58
reviews.text:
The technician and employees were professional and performed their jobs to a satisfactory standard. However, their customer service was outrageously unacceptable. I had to have two things done to the my house, which one they completed (water heater), and a clogged sink, which they advised would require a jetter. The water heater we payed for which was around 1200.00$. The price we were given was around 350 for the jetter, as shown in the picture. When we went to schedule to have it fixed they upped the price and gave an excuse why they increased the price that wasn't part of the original agreed price. I still agreed to have to pay the new price at around 550 but advised this was unprofessional and they responded with denying me service. Completely unprofessional way to bargain with customers on price when there was a set price that they gave and then still deny service when there where called out on it. Also know when it comes to communication with them it is very difficult due to them not answering calls or texts. You can read other negative comments before mine to verify this.

Overall when the work was conducted it was done satisfactorily and professionally by their technicians.

There customer service needs improvement and is unsatisfactory due to bargaining price with customers after it was already agreed apon and then denying service because of reason unknown besides being called out on how unprofessional the way they treated us was.

reviews.author: Samantha Snellbaker
reviews.text: Craig was the tech who visited my condo and ket me tell you, I have never felt so respected while he was fixing my leaking tub! The professionalism was amazing! He explained everything he was doing and was on time and so nice to work with! I didnt feel like an idiot as he explained things. I can not recommend Poseidon plumbing enough and I will 100% be calling them again with any other issues I have with plumbing. If I could give more stars I would. Thank you so much Craig and Poseidon Plumbing!

reviews.author: Kaite M. G.
reviews.text:
No hot water for the past 4 days. I understand there was a holiday in the middle but it’s supposed to be a “priority”. Can’t get a call back to schedule anything. As others, AHS sent us to them for our hot water tank and a slow drain. They came out a day later, checked things out and haven’t heard back since.

When I checked the app with AHS today it’s been marked as “service completed” which is a complete lie. Tried to call again to figure this out as I have an 8m old and we are trying our best.

Willing to change review after clarification from the owner but until I have hot water to sterilize my babies bottles, do dishes and take care of our hygiene I can only give 1 star on this so far.

reviews.author: K. Hardin
reviews.text:
I’m seriously impressed with Poseidon’s fast and professional service. They worked around my schedule, which is rare these days. Craig—the technician they sent—showed up right on time with a great attitude and got straight to business. He listened, checked everything I mentioned, explained the problem in plain language, then grabbed the right tools and handled it without wasting a minute. Clean work, no mess, no excuses.

I’ll be calling Poseidon again for anything plumbing in my home. Quality service like this still matters.

– BiggDaddyToo, because quality and craftsmanship still matter.

plumbers.name: San Diego Emergency Plumbing & Leak Detection
plumbers.address: 1192 N Johnson Ave, El Cajon, CA 92020, USA

reviews.author: Mitch S
reviews.text: Couldn’t recommend these guys enough. They were super communicative about price and what it would take to fix a gas leak to my bar b que. We ended up capping the line. First time he never showed. Then he called and wanted to come at 4 pm. Second time he said he would be here at 10 am. He got here at 230 pm. Did not let him in either time, I go to work in evenings.Third time, again no call, no show. The man can barely walk, seems to be in a daze, and confused. And what he did bring for helpers were extremely sketchy. Dude looked like he needed a fix.Stay away from Mr. Cheap.

reviews.author: Kathryn Buck
reviews.text: My experience was AWFUL! I called him out for a blocked sewage line drain. He came out with his crew that night and fixed the blockage which was great, but 3 days later, on a Saturday afternoon, the blockage returned. When I called him back for his "30 guarantee" on the pipes to come back out and fix the blockage he assured me that he would be out later that evening. I called an additional 4 times, of which he never answered or returned my calls. I called Sunday morning and he assured me he would be out between 12-4. At 5:30 he finally answered his phone and said he was working elsewhere but would be over shortly. At 9:00 he assured me he was on his way...  at 11 he said it was too late. He assured me he would be at my house on Monday between 10-12. He showed up right at 12, but charged us to fix the drain. I would be okay with his work IF he had answered his calls OR kept his word, but he is unreliable at best. Good luck if you actually want the work done in any form of a timely manner.

reviews.author: Colleen K
reviews.text: Small nonprofit organization. Middle of the afternoon - Needed emergency drain service. Tried some of the "bigger" companies, and they couldn't send someone out.  Contacted Mr. Cheap, and they said someone would be there in an hour.  A little over an hour later, service arrived and didn't leave until drain was cleared.  Explained costs up front and provided status updates while work was in progress.  Technicians were knowledgeable and professional.  And did not "price gouge" because we were in a pickle.  Technician even called next day to follow up.  Will be using them on a regular basis.  Highly recommend.

After looking for it with camera and listening to the pipes he told me that he had to open up the wall, probably in more than one place. He was able to find the leak in first attempt, and fixed the leak with minimum damage to the house. Amazing job.

reviews.author: Teresa
reviews.text: Couldn’t be happier with the service! From the initial call the service was top notch. I was given an appointment right away and the  tech Sergio was experienced and knowledgeable. He immediately found the problem and did a great job to get it resolved. I highly, highly recommend.

reviews.author: Cathie Gill
reviews.text: Very satisfied with the company and would highly recommend. They were very knowledgeable and efficient. We had a crisis and they responded immediately and worked rain or shine. reviews.text: The laundry room faucet wouldn’t shut off properly. I contacted this service for assistance. They replaced the faulty cartridge and tested everything. The issue was resolved quickly. Great and dependable work.

reviews.author: Miah Krista
reviews.text: A loose shut off valve under the sink started dripping slowly. I called this service right away. They replaced the faulty valve and tested the pressure carefully. Their dependable repair work truly impressed me.

reviews.author: Jonathan Azaria
reviews.text: Low shower pressure had become a daily annoyance and I called their tech to inspect it. After checking the pipes, they found sediment buildup and cleaned the line. The solution noticeably boosted the water flow. Everything feels balanced now. A very reliable service experience.

reviews.author: Jamari Damarion
reviews.text: The basement drain overflowed unexpectedly one evening. I called their crew immediately. They cleared debris from the main line. Proper drainage was restored without delay.

reviews.author: Bobbie Holt
reviews.text: C&C did a plumbing inspection on my home recently.  The team was very professional and explained everything they were doing.  They drained our water heaters, inspected all of our faucets and drains.  They found two problems if left undetected could have been serious down the road.  We are very happy we called them and would recommend C&C Plumbing very much.

reviews.author: seth thompson
reviews.text: Did alot of searching for water heaters and checked different companies, C&C was the best price around. They answered all my questions and were very professional. Install seemed pretty quick and looks top notch. If you're have a tough time deciding on a plumber this is the one. Thanks again C&C!

reviews.author: Don Zangara
reviews.text: Unfortunately my experience with C&C was their lack of business practice concerning their pricing.  Customers should be advised upfront that there is an automatic charge of $220 per hour which starts with their drive time.  I guess that starts when the employee gets into their vehicle.  When you set your appointment they should explain their billing per hour policy.  At the Job Site they called me to say the hot water tank would have to be changed.  I ask for an estimate, he said about $2,100.  I really don’t think he wanted to do the work because from my experience a 30 gal electric water tank cost about $550 and would take about 2-3 hours to exchange.  This does not add up to $2,100.  They need a better business practice to inform their customers before the job—their hourly rate, trip charges and when the clock starts and stops so the customer can make an informed decision.  All customers make sure they advise you upfront about pricing or find a company that will disclose their billing practices so there are no additional surprises.  You will pay $220 minimum if they get into their vehicle and drive to the job site.  Most companies give you credit if they do the job, C&C does not, $2,100 was not even a fair or good estimate for a 30 gal water heater.

reviews.author: Jonathan Davis
reviews.text: C&c have usually been pretty good but I called them for a simple tub spout leaking yea simple, could have done it myself now I will since they have not, I was told by the technician that the valves were bad and he replaced the seals on the valve and would give me an estimate on fixing it correctly, I never received an estimate and three months later tub leaking again, was told that they will not warranty the fix because the valves were bad, well 300& later I have to fix it myself, do not waste your money, literally call anyone else for your plumbing need like Chris Dawson he has fixed all there mess ups for a fraction of the price that is all steer clear people call Chris

reviews.text: This was a awesome experience.  They came immediately and did the quote.  The price was the BEST IN RACINE!  They completed the work so quickly and quietly I didn't even realize they were there.  I definitely recommend this company for any and all plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Christina Torres
reviews.text: We had an exceptional experience with John Conner Plumbing! From start to finish, the team was extremely professional and showed great respect for our home, making sure they left the work area cleaner than they found it. Their attention to detail resulted in quality work that fixed our issue perfectly. We were also thrilled that their quote came in well under their competitors' estimates. Highly recommend John Conner Plumbing for reliable service and great value!

reviews.author: G Den
reviews.text: Recently we had to have lead lines changed in my MIL historical home in Kenosha.  We had gotten two quotes, being of equal value. The reason we decided to go with John Connors was John's professionalism.  John arrived at exactly the set time.  He spoke with my Husband on how He would go about re routing the lines that were well over 100 years old. He took his time and explained the entire process thoroughly.  Johns receptionist stayed in contact with us and was kind when we called with questions that arose. John's team of men were kind and thoughtful as they carried out the very intense work of drilling through 18 " cement foundation block in the basement. After they finished the lead lines, John fixed a sink faucet and a slop sink faucet at a very fair and reasonable price.  A previous quote that we had from another plumber, quoted those jobs out at three times the amount that John charged. The jobs were all completed on time and budget. Fast forward, a couple of days later, we found a spigot leaking outside of the house (it had nothing to do with John's previous work), so since we appreciated his professionalism, we called John and asked what would be the soonest He could come and fix it for us.  We sent a couple of pictures, and John showed up, 30 minutes later with materials in hand. We have decided that John and His crew will be our forever plumbers now!!  After dealing with many different plumbers through the years, we are very thankful that Kenosha had John on their list as a lead line professional. We never would have met John and His great crew, without Kenosha providing that list of potential plumbers.

reviews.author: Patty Friss
reviews.text: I have a tankless water heater that needed maintenance.  I used John in the past and I stand by my word when I say that I would recommend him for plumbing needs.  Sylvia was great at scheduling me an appointment and sending me copies to sign for the estimate.  When the job was completed, John checked all water faucets, from shower, bathtub, sinks and kitchen sinks.  He is dog friendly, and a nice guy overall. Thanks, John, see you next spring.

reviews.author: Fred Burton
reviews.text: Shraga, from Harrisburg Plumbers, did a great job replacing some shutoff valves and an outdoor spigot.  This is the second time he's done work at my house.  The first was a crisis situation with a pipe break in the basement.  Both times he exceeded my expectations in every way.  Shraga is very professional and easy to deal with, and very reasonably priced.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Madiya Nieves
reviews.text: Shraga is the best! Very professional and knowledgeable. He gave me a simple but detailed explanation of everything and was very patient with fixing my tub drain.

reviews.author: Mo Moe
reviews.text: EXCELLENT CUSTOMER SERVICE!!! Back in this freezing February we had, my hvac system was having issues causing my electric bill to be over $50 a day. I was going on vacation for a month so wanted to turn the heat off during this time but needed my water and water heater turned off and pipes drained to be able to do this. I called Shraga to see if he could do that and he said he could but the only issue was that he was booked until Friday. I told him that was ok and that I’d just leave the heating on for the next few days till Friday. Shraga then called me back a few hours later and told me that his childhood buddy Joni was in a similar line of work and that he would actually be able to get to me the next day and do it for me. I told him I felt bad that he wouldn’t be getting the business but he said it was no problem and that he understood that it would cost me more than $200 in electricity to wait for him till Friday so he would rather get it taken care for me as soon as possible. He was willing to lose out on the $ to help save me $. It’s hard to find that kind of honesty these days and I really appreciated it. He got me in contact with his friend Joni who was also amazing. Joni came and took care of it the next day, did it for the same very fair price that Shraga had quoted me, and even took the time to explain how I could do it myself if I wanted. Both Shraga and Joni were extremely friendly and helpful. I 100% recommend anyone with plumbing needs to give Shraga a call!

reviews.author: Chris Robbins
reviews.text:
Timely response convenient to my scheduling needs. Shraga spent a considerable amount of time trying to diagnose my issue...as per Murphy's law the leak magically disappeared when the plumber looked for it. However I had some other odds and ends to get his advice about so he patiently and diligently checked them all out. In the end all I needed was an estimate for a faucet installation.  Despite spending over an hour at my house he refused to charge me extra for anything. He's professional,  knows his stuff, kind and patient.  I look forward to having him install my new kitchen faucet and now I know who to call when I have plumbing needs without fearing for my wallet.  I recommend him highly.

I'm glad there is a good plumber where I live.

Jim was professional, courteous, and fair. We are happy with the work and we would use Jim again.  In fact, we have used Jim two other times in the past for other issues and he has been outstanding.  We recommend Jim to our family and friends.

Jason was very communicative, informing me of the arrival times of his workers and checking in regularly to see if I had questions. The cost was very reasonable.  This was my first experience with Huntsville Plumbing, and I was thoroughly impressed. I will definitely use their services again for future plumbing needs and highly recommend them.

Jason responded immediately and was easy to work with. He spent time assessing the situation and explored all options.  He felt there was a good possibility he could make the repair without pulling the tub.  He went to work and successfully fixed the leak in the copper line.  Very grateful for what he did, and saved me a lot of time, headache and money!  Would give a 100 stars if possible!

reviews.author: Katrina Mucker
reviews.text:
Revised: I was going to update my review and rate higher because the issue was mostly resolved but the company’s reply is false!!!
I tried to contact them to address concerns via email Dec. 18th. Only AFTER I gave them a one star review on Dec. 31st, the owner called and texted me that same evening. We had a phone conversation.
The billing issue I had was related to a “new program/billing system” they’re using. That’s not mentioned anywhere in their reply. Tell the whole “story”.
The labor rate on the final invoice was still higher than what the owner told me via a telephone conversation we had.
And yes, I was aware of the credit card or ACH fee. However when paying, I still had to pay for both CC and ACH fee because you can only pay in full and BOTH were on the invoice.
I went ahead and paid to be done with the situation but please don’t come on here with false replies.

BEWARE!!! Shady billing practices!! (Also operates under Foundry Construction Group; that’s who’s billing me anyway)

Initial invoice had a charge for the Service Call Fee although work was completed with them.
Second invoice took off the Service Call Fee and then added the parts, lol.

And there’s an additional Credit Card Fee or ACH Fee; neither can be adjusted when trying to paying the invoice.

Repair time/“truck and labor” cost: 2 hours ….$300+/hr! Pretty wild considering the backfill job was subpar.

Wouldn’t recommend them to anyone. And I’ve yet to receive the pictures of the work/repair.

reviews.author: Bobby KF5GTX
reviews.text: Houston and his staff are amazing! I called after ONG found a gas leak and he came right out and found the problem. Once it was repaired, ONG came back out and I still had a leak. So, Houston came back out and repaired the leak and it has been working very well ever since! I would highly recommend Story's Plumbing & More, LLC for anyone who has a gas leak or plumbing needs. He even added a teacher discount to my invoice which made the service so affordable! Thanks Houston and the staff for an amazing experience!

reviews.author: Nita McClanahan

I will be calling Story Plumbing if I need a plumber in the future.

reviews.author: Stacy Lopez

I would recommend them 100 percent! Prices are reasonable and service is exceptional.

reviews.author: F'lesson Wood

Stan seems to always be available to answer calls when they come in and it is really nice being able to get a hold of them easily. We are very satisfied with the work and service this company provides. Thank you!

I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Sandy Schroeder

reviews.author: C

The team was fast, professional, and incredibly easy to work with from start to finish.  They ended up saving us nearly half of what we were originally quoted, and the quality of work was excellent. reviews.author: Danny Findley
reviews.text: Pipe Pro Solutions is exactly who you want to call for any repairs or plumbing needs.  They scheduled us quickly, arrived on time, and completed the job at a very fair price.  The crew was professional, courteous, and extremely efficient from start to finish.  Couldn't ask for a better experience!

reviews.author: Mark Rivera
reviews.text: As a first time homebuyer, learning my main sewer line needed replacement was overwhelming, but Pipe Pro Solutions made the process easy. The team was professional, knowledgeable, and patient, clearly explaining everything during the free estimate and answering all my questions. Excellent service from start to finish I highly recommend Pipe Pro Solutions and would absolutely use them again.

I had an ongoing issue with tree roots clogging my main sewer drain, and their team handled it efficiently from start to finish. They were easy to work with, knowledgeable, and their pricing was very reasonable compared to other quotes I received. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Erin Monahan
reviews.text: The team at Pipe Pro Solutions was professional, efficient, and handled a big job with ease.  They clearly explained every step of the process, which we really appreciated.  After comparing multiple quotes, theirs was by far the most reasonable.  We’ll definitely be calling them for any future plumbing work!

reviews.author: Nick Mendoza
reviews.text:
UPDATE: 11/18/25
Honest and reliable.  Yes, Anthony from Plumbing Boys has helped us out from some large problems.

The entire house has been updated with new pipe. The main line to the service has also been redone. The showers were backing up. I ran water and had snaked the drains.  The problem was intermittent.

Anthony came with his camera and gear and diagnosed the issue within 20 min.  WOW! The issue was at the connection between the ABS pipe and the 6” city service.  Anthony gave me options that itself is really appreciated.

I highly recommend Anthony and the Plumbing Boys for any of your plumbing issues.

We are very happy with the work that Plumbing Boys did for us.

The house was built in 1929. We needed to relocate the water heater to the exterior to meet new code requirements.  Anthony came to give us a free estimate.  They were able to fit me in within a couple of days.

Plumbing Boys finished the entire job in two days.  A water heater enclosure was installed. All supply lines were relocated with new shut off valves. The enclosure was weather proofed and attached to the home. Excellent work!

I highly recommend Plumbing boys for your next plumbing need.

reviews.author: Steve Morris
reviews.text: I was looking for a reputable and reliable plumbing company, and I found it. Moved from out of state and read some reviews about these guys and thought I should give them a try. Gary was incredibly knowledgeable and helpful. He quickly figured out how to fix my problems. Repaired two toilets and flushed my tankless water heaters. Price was fair and Gary was professional and friendly. I have found my plumbing professionals. Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Megyn Bell
reviews.text: Tony and his crew did a great job replacing our sewer. The job required going under a sidewalk which took skill not to break the concrete. Tony came out personally to make sure the job was done right which I appreciate. I also appreciate that he explained the intricacy of the job.

reviews.author: Bryan Bai
reviews.text: Plumbing Boys was super clutch for me on Christmas Eve. We are hosting Christmas dinner tomorrow, and our gas wasn't working. I called dozens of plumbers, and only Plumbing Boys was able to help me get the gas working again. Thank you! Will be the first number I call next time I need help.

reviews.author: Jodie Serror
reviews.text:
I called Plumbing Boys with a Plumbing emergency on a Sunday - they responded immediately and were able to send someone out within of few hours. Basically, my sewer line had backed up and partially discharged into my backyard.

Jonathan came out and found roots in my sewer line to the City line - he cleared everything with a hydro yet and capped the line that had overflown in the backyard. Great work and I have had no issues since.

As particular highlight he came out and a few days later to give me a video of the cleared line to submit to the City for a discount. I appreciate he went the extra mile and he did such a great job on Sunday to clear this up.

plumbers.name: Hotline Plumbing
plumbers.address: #1, Burbank, CA 91505, USA

reviews.author: Jared White
reviews.text: We needed a new water heater, so we got quotes from several plumbers. We thought we had galvanized pipes, but Hotline Plumbing was the only one who knew we actually already had copper pipes (there were just some pieces of exposed galvanized pipes, that they also replaced with copper!). They gave us a great price. Mauricio and William are the best. They explain what they’re doing and why, they do everything the right way, and they went above and beyond. They don’t try to upsell you on things you don’t need. They did a beautiful job and you can tell they take pride in their work. They even fixed some things that previous plumbers had done incorrectly. We’ll be using them for all our future plumbing needs, and I’ll be asking for Mauricio. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sherri Madrinan
reviews.text: I originally found Hotline Plumbing on Yelp a year ago and they helped me with installation of our bathroom sink and replacement. Just this past week, I was able to immediately contact Jiovanni (Owner) and he had Mauricio come out to check our Washing Machine Leak, they arrived promptly within the scheduled time frame. Mauricio and his team were in and out in 30 minutes, he quickly assessed the issue and fixed it. Highly recommend this company and their team, they are amazing! Thank you again!

reviews.author: Steven Ethington
reviews.text: I am so impressed by the quality of work done by Mauricio and William. Hotline plumbing had done a big job for my sister so I was hoping they could help us as well. Right from the start, Hotline plumbing was quick to respond to our quote request. Not only was the quote better value than competitors, they were able to come out on the weekend based on our schedule. They replaced our old water heater with tankless and also swapped out the sink and shower/tub hardware with matte black. All jobs were done so well. We were especially impressed by the small things they did like ensure they wore shoe covers inside our home and also taking the time to explain our various options. I will definitely be going back to hotline plumbing in the future and have recommended them to our friends and family. From start to finish we knew we were in good hands with Mauricio from Hotline Plumbing!

reviews.author: Ricardo Valverde
reviews.text: Hotline Plumbing did a great job with our main shut-off valve replacement and kitchen drainage pipe repair. Their tech was punctual and knowledgeable for the estimate, which was very competitive. While there was a scheduling hiccup on the initial day (our appointment wasn't in their system), Giovanni quickly stepped in and made sure someone got out to us that day to handle the shut-off valve, which was crucial for our HOA coordination. The rest of the job was completed by a friendly and skilled tech the next morning. Despite the minor scheduling issue, Hotline Plumbing rectified it promptly and provided excellent service. We're happy clients and highly recommend them for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Lucy Bhanu
reviews.text: I had a plumber from my home warranty company come out to address a whole house plumbing stoppage. He told me I needed a cleanout installed and was going to charge me something like $2700. I called Hotline, and they were going to charge substantially less. Geovanni fit me in same day. He sent Mauricio out who called me and let me know that the cleanout was already installed and so he was able to snake out the stoppage for a very reasonable rate - saving me thousands of dollars. They are honest, professional and skilled. I highly recommend this company.

plumbers.name: E & A Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 1610 Conrad Dr, Green Bay, WI 54313, USA

reviews.author: Megan Carr
reviews.text: I got dishwasher from Whirlpool that the delivery guys were unable to set up so my grandpa called around a few places and settled on A&E plumbing. They came to the house in a clean good looking van with some pretty serious looking tools and a very professional attitude. These guys saved the day! The experience we had dealing with the guys that came to deliver the dishwasher and the experience that we had with A&E was very different. I felt confident the entire time that these guys knew what they were doing, I knew we were in good hands. I was surprised to hear that they are a small business with just 3 guys working for them! The price was amazing and the service was top notch. One of the guys that came was Scott, I don’t know what the other one’s name was but they were both great. If I could give 10 stars I would!!

reviews.author: Brian Lowery
reviews.text: Scott and his crew are the best plumbers I've ever had work on plumbing issues in my home.  They are extremely responsive, professional and knowledgeable.  They have fixed tub leaks, main line issues, replaced kitchen faucet, installed a garbage disposal and secured the dishwasher.  I wouldn't call on anyone else in the Green Bay area.  Scott and his team are people you can trust.

reviews.author: Drew Oudenhoven
reviews.text: Scott is amazing to work with! Had a hot water line leak today and was concerned as it was a holiday. He got back to my message within minutes and was able to get out to fix the issue by the afternoon. Really appreciate his work and being able to sacrifice his time to help us out. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Anna Anna
reviews.text: My main water valve started leaking. I called so many places and no one was able to change it or even come look at it. I needed someone asap bc my water had to be shut off. Got referred to Scott by someone from Nextdoor and I’m so glad bc he came within the next few hours, knowing how bad I needed someone. He replaced my main water valve at such a reasonable price! Very happy with his services, highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.text: Scott and Andrew installed a new Sump Pump system and two 1.6 GPF Kohler toilets that I couldn't find in stock anywhere.  They did a great job at a great price.  Thank you E&A Plumbing!

reviews.author: Korey Forbush
reviews.text: So glad to have found these guys.  Ive used them for plumbing and now hvac.  They added ac to my house and put in a heat pump and new furnace and we absolutely love it!  The whole process from start to finish was so much better than I've had in the past with other contractors.  If you need hvac or plumbing, this is the company!

reviews.author: Tara McAnally
reviews.text: I had my sewer lines brought into the 21st century with resin lining and my out of code sump pump plumbed properly. Money aside it certainly beats having to dig it up when its beyond fixing. Everyone that entered my home... I do wish I had all their names... were professional to the core. Travis fixed me up with a very acceptable offer for both jobs to be done together. All of the gentlemen who came to work were so courteous. These days this is a rare commodity. They showed up when the said they would, they gave me a progress report and the plan of action for the next day each evening before they left. And my yard was put back together like nothing happened.  I am very please with the work they all did. Digging by hand in the middle of winter is no small feat. Thanks so much

reviews.author: Matt Hatch
reviews.text: Kellem was very professional, got the job done quick and didn’t try to upsell me on anything. Recommend them for sure! Will use themagain in the future! Price was awesome especially for the quality of work!

reviews.author: Angela Bennett
reviews.text: We had them install a new furnace, AC unit & thermostat. We are so happy with their work! We have a nice even temperature in our home now on the main level & basement! They were kind, funny, cleaned up everything & did amazing work to upgrade our system!

reviews.author: Roy Schank
reviews.text: We had them replace both furnaces and AC units. They did a great job at a reasonable price. It was somewhat complicated as one of the furnaces was in the attic. They kept everything neat and clean. Highly recommend their services for any HVAC work needed.

plumbers.name: All Phase Plumbing
plumbers.address: 8417 Washington Blvd Ste 125, Roseville, CA 95678, USA

reviews.author: Kelly Grace
reviews.text:
My dad was a Master plumber so my standards for a great plumber are HIGH😀 but Rod and the whole team at All Phase have never once disappointed me. Dealing with repairs is one of the most frustrating aspects of home ownership and All Phase always goes above and beyond to make repairs convenient, pain-free and done right the first time.
Recently a very expensive brand's air switch (the countertop button to turn on the garbage disposal) broke. I contacted them and they made me jump through a bunch of hoops to figure out what part I needed. I got on the phone with Rod, texted him some photos of the issue and he helped me identify the part to order for the repair.
The company bungled sending the correct part not once, but twice. 🥴 Each time Rod went to bat for me on the phone. The third time he stood in my kitchen on the phone with their customer service to resolve the parts issue and finally got a whole new air switch ordered to make the repair. That's professional level service, intervening to speak for me when things get overly technical.
📲Do yourself a favor and put All Phase in your phone under Plumbers. You just took the pain and frustration out of any plumbing issue you'll ever have.✅

reviews.author: Niki Woodard
reviews.text:
I've used All Phase for a few jobs, and have been pleased with the results of each. Most recently, they installed a new bathroom in my garage (see before and after pictures). Brandon completed the rough-in in a week. All checked out great with the inspection and he finished the rest of the job pretty quickly, with excellent results. I'd been trying to find a more affordable way to transform my garage, and this was a great solution. I coordinated separately with the electricians and pulled the permit for the work myself to save some money. Brandon is super easy to work with, professional, and seems to thrive on finding solutions to tough problems. The office staff are extremely helpful too -- Ami is the best.

Prior to this work, Brandon replaced the old, rusty copper pipes in the house with pex pipes. It was a dirty job and he was a champ! He's also helped clear several drains and sewer blockages over the past 6 years. I knew I could trust him with the bathroom install. So glad, it looks great and is now the best bathroom in the house.

reviews.author: Vince Schiavo
reviews.text: Fantastic.  Did not charge a "show up" fee to come onsite and provide a quote. Gave a very reasonable price quite and did the work on the spot.  Did an outstanding job.  Cleaned up the work area. Couldn’t be happier.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Matthew Zarzeka-Flores
reviews.text: I absolutely whole heartedly recommend All Phase Plumbing to anyone looking for a responsive, thoughtful, professional, and competitively priced plumber. Any time I called them they answered. Not infinite rings, not pushed to voicemail. An actual humanbeing answered the phone and helped me with my questions. Eric came by to inspect a draining issue we were having and was extremely thorough and answered all of my questions and concerns. He was extremely prompt in delivering a quote and they came in below another plumber who inspected the same issue. When it came time to do the repairs, Eric and Yuri did a fantastic job of explaining what their plan was and what they expect to find. And when the sith got more complicated, they did everything they could to explain their findings and show me exactly what they need to do to fix our issue. They went above and beyond to take great care in taking out my flooring and digging a hole in my foundation. It was a scary site to see two holes in my floor, but when they were all done with their work, it looked as though they were never even there. I would trust Eric, Yuri, and All Phase for all of my future plumbing needs. They are a great team and I can't recommend them enough.

reviews.author: L B
reviews.text: From intake through to project completion the entire team was actually great. They were responsive, on time, and we felt comfortable with them working in our home the entire time. Our tankless water heater was in serious need of maintenance that was overdue and it was giving us problems. They diagnosed and fixed the issue and the water heater is working great now. Our shower had a leak in three spots also fixed with no issues. We also replaced two toilets to more water efficient plumbing. We worked with the owner on this project and everything was done well. I just can't recommend them highly enough- also their price point is reasonable and competitive. Thanks to this team. We highly recommend them and will certainly call them again whenever we need them.

I use them strictly on my personal home as well as weekly with my clients. Super responsive, unbeatable workmanship, and very fair for the value they provide.

High recommend for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Tiffany P

He was efficient, cleaned everything up when he was done, and just a really nice guy. I am so impressed with Chad and his team and they will definitely get my business going forward.

reviews.author: Robert Johnson

reviews.author: Adrienne Breznau
reviews.text: This company was recommended by my realtor. I reached out to get a quote for gutter cleaning which was returned promptly and was reasonable. I did have to call to follow up to get on the schedule due to a technical glitch but they were able to get out a day early. Alex did the work and he was professional and quick. I would definitely call them again.

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.text: Almost satisfied. Muhammad was gracious enough to accommodate my emergency request for drywall repair while he was already booked at another job site in town at Liberty St. However, after he applied a second coat of mud to the drywall of my bedroom (which required 60 minutes to dry) he left but never returned to finish sanding-- leaving me with a sanding block. I had to finish the job that I paid him (cash in advance) to do. Lastly, he provided me with free consultation on painting the drywall.

reviews.author: Bren Russ
reviews.text: The wind ripped the top off of our aluminum awning. They took the awning down quickly - probably less than 20 minutes. They recommended we keep the flashing on to protect the siding from rain damage. They were on time, in fact, a few minutes early, courteous and payment was easy using their cell phone app. 10 out of 10 highly recommend.

reviews.author: Gora Sudindranath
reviews.text: Muhammad and team did an excellent job on building out a bonus room in my basement. Work was completed on time, the team was hard working and trustworthy, and the finish quality was very good. I wouldn't hesitate to work with A2 Handyman again.

reviews.author: Robin Kahler
reviews.text: Muhammad and his team were outstanding from start to finish. They communicated clearly and promptly, arrived on time, and worked efficiently throughout the entire project. Their professionalism and trustworthiness stood out, and the quality of their work was excellent. I highly recommend them without hesitation.

reviews.author: Jordana Campos Gtz
reviews.text:
Sly was wonderful!

Sly was so great to guide me over the phone and ask me to send him photos.
He explained to me what the problem could be and showed up to my house late at night, he spent some time with a flashlight, looking at a way to stop the leak while we made a decision to fix the situation.

He was kind and professional and understood my emotional state due to the stressful situation.

reviews.author: TheCander1312
reviews.text: S&L plumbing did our shower/tub remodel and did an excellent job. Blake and Sly were awesome. Always on time and friendly. Great at communicating and explaining everything. We love our shower/tub and will use them again. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Angie P
reviews.text: I had Sly come by to help replace my water heaters and water softener. He's awesome and very professional. This is the first time I've ever had a plumber come by to test the hardness of my water to ensure we got a softener that worked for us. He was so thorough. You can tell the man takes pride in his work. I'm immunocompromised and Sly was very accommodating. 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.author: Peggy Ann Williams
reviews.text:
I contacted Sly at S&L Plumbing with a plumbing issue I was having.  Sly spent time with me to understand the problem  and got it resolved with professionalism and in a timely manner.

I am grateful for the peace of mind to have a trusted plumber who does great work.

Highly recommend Sly and S&L plumbing!

reviews.author: Brooklyn Williams
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about Sly. He has come to help us multiple times. He is available as soon as we need him. He is so knowledgeable, thorough and helpful. 10/10 recommend.

plumbers.address: 1707 W Main St, Duncan, OK 73533, USA

reviews.author: Chad Girnus
reviews.text:
Had the bathroom faucet shutoff valve snap off and had to turn the water off to the house. Dismuke plumbing was the only company I contacted that was able to have someone out not just the same day but within a couple hours.

Mike was fantastic and respectful. He got the parts we needed and had it fixed, total time including getting the parts was about an hour. He even closed up the street shutoff valve and brought the key to the porch.

Best part was that they didn't charge an emergency fee. Just a normal trip charge, parts charge and 1 hour labor. So much less than what I was expecting.

Thanks Mike and Dismuke plumbing for a fantastic job!!!

reviews.author: Darci Merritt
reviews.text: Early morning call the day before Thanksgiving, they answered and got back with me on a time for the same day. Unfortunately, we needed a new water heater. They picked it up, installed it, updated pipe and fittings, and cleaned up afterwards. Quick and efficient. Thankful they were able to help us out. Would definitely recommend and use again.

reviews.author: Charm'n Culberson
reviews.text: Used these guys twice... Will NOT use again! I had actually considered using them again.. called about 6 times back to back only to have my calls be fwd to voicemail. Fiance called right after I did and got answered..(her number was blocked soon after they realized she was my fiance). I've always paid my bill and never had an issue with them... The only reason I considered using them is because they were cheaper than the rest... Im starting to realize why now .... Called a different company to do the job right ....

reviews.author: Dylan Wolf
reviews.text: Just bought a place from a flipper real estate group and was basically blind on layouts ,surveys, permit history, repair history, or serviceability and within a week my well quit on me. They came out the same day, and the service guy was quick and efficient and ID'd the problem almost immediately. Went and got part needed and returned and had it fixed all within 4 hours of me calling. Then only charged me 200 because it was Xmas time! So glad we chose oklahoma and this area, so far every professional service we've used has been courteous, prompt, and willing to work to help in payment and all around nice people. Never would have got that level of service in my home state of Texas! Highly recommend this business!

reviews.author: Jonny Lawrence
reviews.text: I got a fast response, came out the same day to look at a newly purchased fix n flip home. The price I got was for a few leaks, but as we tore into the walls, of course more was needed. Replaced all galvanized plumbing, new valves; to kitchen, bathroom, laundry and out door hoses. Plus made great suggestions that I didn't think of. Stayed till 6pm to get the water on and without electricity! Great company, can't suggest them enough.

plumbers.name: ASAP Plumbing
plumbers.address: 33502 Dickens Cir, North Ridgeville, OH 44039, USA

reviews.author: Bryan Barley
reviews.text:
Had a main sewer line back up.
Henry showed up on time.
He was very informative ,walked me through every step.
Very upfront about pricing.
He was also very conscientious when it came to clean up after the job was completed.
Highly recommend ASAP plumbing and Henry.

reviews.author: Tony A
reviews.text: You guys must do a lot of business to turn a customer away . I called today to setup an appointment the guy that answered said the boss will call me back within 1 hour , that never happened never got a call back from anyone. Shame on you guys

reviews.author: Matt LaFleur
reviews.text: ASAP Plumbing did an outstanding job installing our new tankless water heater! From start to finish, their team was professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. They arrived on time, explained the entire process clearly, and completed the installation flawlessly. Our new system works perfectly, providing endless hot water while being more energy-efficient. We couldn’t be happier with the service and highly recommend ASAP Plumbing to anyone in need of reliable and high-quality plumbing work!

reviews.author: Carolyn Dignan
reviews.text: This company did a great job on our water heater replacement. Service was prompt. Was told window of 1-4 and was here around 2:30pm. They gave my husband a military discount. Additionally, we talked with the plumber for a while after and found out we had commonality in living in NC and the military background. I would recommend them to anyone in Avon in need. Very down to earth!

reviews.author: Greg C.
reviews.text: The ASAP team replaced and installed our dishwasher and garbage disposal.  They were very personable and walk through everything that needed to be replumbed (previous plumber did not do it correctly which we assumed as such) to bring into code.  They did an excellent job, cleaned up after the work and hauled away the old dishwasher.  Everything works.  They were very economical when compared to all other plumbers we have used!!!  And guess what, they call you back......we plan to have additional work completed by ASAP.  Hire ASAP for anything plumbing.
