plumbers.address: 58 Albe Dr F, Newark, DE 19702, USA

reviews.author: Greg W.
reviews.text: I have hired this plumbing company 3 times now: 2 smaller jobs + 1 larger job (replacing a water heater), and I was very happy with the prices and quality of all 3 jobs.

reviews.author: Arlene
reviews.text: Responded on same day we called with emergency leak in ceiling. They were professional and explained diagnosis and answered all of our questions. Job was completed quickly and cleanup was thorough at a very fair price!  Will Def use their services again. Alex and D'Angelo were great!  They even provided name for a drywall person who is coming out tomorrow!

reviews.author: colleen smith
reviews.text: Honesty Services was recommended to us 2 years ago after a large issue with our sewer pipe.  We were so happy with them after that experience that when my kitchen sink started acting up, I was less stressed knowing that I had someone to call that we were more than happy with, with a much larger issue.  Another amazing experience.  They are nice, professional, quick, knowledgable and was able to resolve the sink issue and did a last minute requested add on for us as well.  The price was fair and I cannot recommend them enough.  Its so hard finding an honest (no pun intended) company now a days, so feeling confident about having a plumbing company I trust and appreciate so much really does make things much easier!  Thank you!!!!

reviews.author: Jim Collins
reviews.text: Bought a fixer-upper, which requires more fixing than we realized, and Honesty Services has been there for us on numerous occasions now and done a great job on everything from valve replacements to wax ring replacements to emergency pipe leak repairs, etc. Will continue to be my first call when plumbing issues come up.

reviews.author: Josh Cole
reviews.text: Danny and his team are great. I have had them out a couple of times to unclog our sink line and they always do an excellent job. They fixed a broken exterior faucet and recently installed a new sink and faucet in our kitchen. They are very professional and always do great work for a decent price. I highly recommend them. You won’t be disappointed with these guys. They do great work.

plumbers.name: NW Sewer & drain
plumbers.address: 1223 24th St NE, Salem, OR 97301, USA

reviews.author: Oscar Herrera
reviews.text: NW sewer and drain is your best option out there. Called a few places and they were all trying to over charge me even just to come out and check out the problem. Alex took his time and didn’t leave until the problem was fixed. This is the type of company you want to support and do long term business with. Not only is he good at his job but he is also a great guy I would highly recommend!. Thanks, Alex I appreciate your business.

reviews.author: Laura Al-Muhtaseb
reviews.text: Excellent professional and courteous service! I called after having maintenance do several plumbing repairs in my apartment. They were never able to clear it completely so I took matters into my own hands and called NW Sewer and Drain. Alex was quick to answer the call and took less than an hour to fix a recurring problem that wasn't fixable by two other professionals in the months prior. Next time Alex will be my first and only call, thank you!!!

reviews.author: Charlotte Deibert
reviews.text:
This was the first time using NW Sewer & Drain, and we are very pleased & satisfied with the work that was done. Alex was able to come the same day that I called. We needed a storm rain drain checked out. He arrived with all the equipment needed to see inside our drain, he invited us to watch the video screen as he treaded the scope down the drain pipe, he was very knowledge and answered our question. Alex explained everything he did through the whole job. We were very impressed and please with the work that he did. Very straight forward with recommendations and suggestions. I have had dealings with other sewer & Drain companies which I would never recommend or use again. I highly recommend NW Sewer & Drain in NE Salem, OR and will call them again for any repairs or home inspections. It is always great to add another repair company to my list of trusted home repair businesses.
Charlotte D

reviews.author: Tia Smith
reviews.text:
I'll be honest, I never wanted to have to call someone to fix home issues. My husband is a Jack of All Trades. But our problem was/is bigger than him. So, rather than go with a big name business that's in all 50 states, we'd rather go with a local business with only positive reviews.  There are literally no stars lower than a 5 for this company!
To start, basically all of our plumbing is connected and clogged! 2 bathrooms and 1 working toilet are not a good time. We contacted Alex, through Google Maps of all places! No calling involved! His responses were quick and he was very friendly and professional throughout the entire conversation. He was free to come out the same night. He even stayed super late to continue working on the clogs!
I truly appreciate the time, work, and sweat that he's put I to making sure this doesn't happen again! His #1 goal is to make his customers happy, not making a bunch of money. I'll also add, his prices are so reasonable! Not cheap, but definitely not expensive at all!

If you're in Salem, OR and you have a clog, NW Sewer and Drain is the place to contact for sure!

Thank you Alex!

reviews.author: Mary Oldfield
reviews.text: Alex was very knowledgeable and fit me into his busy day. He was fast, efficient, and personable. Will absolutely call for future plumbing issues and highly recommend! Thanks again Alex

plumbers.name: Urquhart Plumbing Co. Inc,
plumbers.address: 1520 E Siesta Dr, Florence, SC 29505, USA

reviews.author: Samantha Mayes
reviews.text: Oh my goodness! Urquhart Plumbing and their techs Justin and Mitchell are absolutely amazing! It has been crazy cold and raining and our water heater stopped working while we were out of town and our son was there with no hot water and poor thing was taking ice showers.  They came out super fast. From my first call to repairs complete was an hour and 7 minutes! We unfortunately called a different company first that came out and refused to even try and diagnose the problem and wanted to charge us $2500 to replace it. Not Urquhart, Justin, and Mitchell. They found the problem quickly and repaired it for less than other companies charged to even come out to look at the problem. I can't say enough good things about this company, Justin, and Mitchell. If you are wondering if you should call them, the answer is, "YES!!!"

reviews.author: Jackie Foster
reviews.text: I highly recommend Urquhart for plumbing work!  I called on a Monday morning and got four plumbing problems fixed by lunch!  Scott came out to diagnose and fix all four issues!!  He was courteous, professional, and was very helpful by answering all of my questions about the work!  One of my problems was a leak from my 51 year old Delta shower faucet that I had been afraid to let anyone touch!  On the opposite side of the shower is the mirror that covers the whole wall of the main bathroom!!  Scott knew exactly what to do and fixed it without any issues!!  (A huge relief!). He also corrected the two faucet handles on my sink that were improperly installed!  He diagnosed and fixed my master bathroom toilet problem in five minutes! He also replaced the cracked flange and installed new parts to stop the leak at the base where it attaches to the floor.  He was very efficient and I am very pleased with his work!!  Thanks again Scott for your excellent work!  You are the BOMB!!!

reviews.author: Ann Pierce
reviews.text: Excellent same day service.  Customer service was great from scheduling with Brenda through installation by very competent installation team.   Would highly recommend and will use again.

reviews.author: Mary Sherfesee
reviews.text:
Like another review I saw on here, the woman in the office you have to go through to get appointments is rude and unprofessional.  Got my first appointment fine.  Had no problem with the two men who came and diagnosed my problem.  My issue is a belly in my pipe that was overlaid by a concrete patio before we bought the property.  Fine, we'll cut the patio in half and put a channel through the middle.  Workers say no problem, we have a construction group in the company that can do it but will take 3-5k PROBABLY to do it.   I'm good with that.

Call back two weeks later to schedule and the woman first says ok,  we'll schedule it, but i can't tell you when, someone will call you the day of. I let her know we'll be out of town at some point and really need to know when, but fine.  She calls back 30 minutes later and says no, they can't do it, I need to get a contractor.  I ask if she can help me find one.  I'm new in town.  Yes, by this point, I'm heated.  She basically tells me it's my problem and she won't help me.  Not can't,  won't.   So, like another review, I now have a diagnosis and a willingness to spend a blank-ton of money to fix it and this woman is going to cost this company money, because, once I get someone to break up the concrete, I dang sure will think twice before going back to them.

Real shame because I really appreciated the two workers who actually did the work.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Baylor
reviews.text: Love these guys - specifically Scott and Mitchell. They respond quickly, arrive when they say they will, and are *great* at diagnosing and explaining what's going on. They helped me understand the 'why' behind the problem with my 2 leaking toilets, so I feel confident that I won't encounter the same issues in the future. They stand behind their work and have fair prices.   Really glad to have found the company and will use them for all my plumbing needs going forward.

reviews.author: Donald Breinholt
reviews.text: We had a hot water heater that stopped working. They came the day we called and were back with a new one the next day. The young man who came was friendly and  professional. He explained what he was doing, and got things installed quickly. Would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Tammy Ayers
reviews.text: We had a couple of tubs set, a new sink installed in a remodel, and a sump pump changed out as well as new electric fuses and plugs for the mini kitchen remodel. Double L’s communication system was great. I received a text for my appointment time and when the technician was on his way. The Nick is a good guy. He was honest fair and talked is through the entire process. I will definitely be using their services in the future.

reviews.author: Rex Waddington
reviews.text: The servive by Alex to install our water softener was professional, I didn't know Alex was an apprentice plumber but he knew what he was doing.

reviews.author: William Hobson
reviews.text: A Panguitch Lake location made the job difficult,  Double L Plumbing and Electrical came through with flying colors, even for follow up site visits.  I would recommend them!

reviews.author: Chris Wamberg
reviews.text: We had a water heater issue and was initially scheduled with another plumbing contractor who had to cancel our appointment due to a family emergency.  We found Double L Plumbing and Electrical, who had an opening to schedule service call. Alex arrived at our cabin in Duck Creek and troubleshoot the problem very quickly. He was educational on what happened and explained very thoroughly what needed to be done.  He fixed the problem and hung out for 20 min to make sure no further issue with water heater.  Alex was fantastic and I would highly recommend their service.

plumbers.address: PO Box 1746, Silverdale, WA 98383, USA

reviews.author: Shayna McKinnon
reviews.text: I called first thing on a Monday morning, fully anticipating to leave a message regarding a leaking pipe. I was delighted to speak with Dave directly and arrange a time to meet that very morning. The crew arrived; triaged the situation, ordered parts, communicated with me throughout the project, fixed the main issues as well as additional concerns with the water heater and expansion tank. The professionalism, knowledge, kindness, communication and affordability demonstrated were phenomenal and greatly appreciated.  I look forward to working with the team again on any future projects and will readily refer to friends, family and the Kitsap community.  Thank you!

reviews.author: Stephanie Ray
reviews.text: Sewer Rat saved the day! A few weeks ago, we had a clogged kitchen drain and Dave and his crew came over and fixed the problem the same day. Well, last night it got clogged again (we live in an old house and the drain lines aren't optimal, to be diplomatic) and they came over today and unclogged it from the roof vent. What's especially appreciated is Dave worked us in during a big project, and he stands behind his work so today's visit was covered under the last one. An honest, excellent plumber is a great thing to have on speed-dial and Sewer Rat is just that. Thanks, Dave and crew!

reviews.author: Tasha McWhorter
reviews.text: I just want to put out there that The Sewer Rat is by far the best plumber that I’ve come across in Bremerton(Kitsap County).  Responsive, professional and punctual.  They literally came and fixed an issue that could have cost thousands for under $500 and educated me on ways to prohibit future issues.  Being a home owner, you may come across some shady people trying to get as much money out of you as possible.  Especially if you’re not knowledgeable of certain issues and fixes.  Dave is so kind and knows what he’s doing.  He’s literally a master of his trade.  I highly recommend him and his business.  Honest businessman.

reviews.author: sean rudisill
reviews.text: Great company! They have helped us in the past with an issue with our washing machine drainage. We recently had a bathroom with drain issues with the toilet and shower. They showed up and found two major issues. They not only fixed the problem but they moved our drain access and made it easier to access. The end price was obviously more than quoted, but was still an affordable price for the amount of work done. Thank you Sewer Rat!

reviews.author: Watt Lane Holdings
reviews.text: Cannot recommend them enough to those who want an honest plumbing service. Quotes are fairly priced and they are responsive when an immediate fix is needed

plumbers.name: Plumbing Innovators Inc
plumbers.address: 6322 Old Plank Rd, Fredericksburg, VA 22407, USA

reviews.author: Statues Of Poverty
reviews.text: Here is another honest review...this is for Plumbing Innovators and their team of honest and professional technicians, installers, office personnel....especially those I personally had the absolute pleasure of meeting and conducting business with, Thomas, Austin, Dillon, Hunter, Carol and Angel. These folks were friendly, knowledgeable, attentive, and honest. Which is something that really rates high in my book. I had used Plumbing Innovators twice in 1 week, first was a burnt up septic control box that needed immediate replacing...then 3 days later I was in need of a new water heater...not just any water heater, mine was propane and was a special kind that was super expensive. Plumbing Innovators, gave me their FREE estimate on both water heaters, propane versus electric, and we decided the better option was much cheaper to convert propane to electric. Which, in my opinion, shows they were not in this to rake in the most money, they genuinely cared and sought to make the best decision. This shows character and integrity. When it came time for the septic power/alarm box to be replaced, I was shown step by step why and how it needed to be replaced. Not only had it burnt up and caused an alarm that could not be reset, but the unit was extremely out of date using baseball sized lead counter weights for the floats. The warranty that Plumbing Innovators have on all of the items that I have had replaced are matched by none. The technicians were prompt to arrive when they said they would. They also call ahead to ensure that the customer is available. They have extremely competitive pricing, great warranties, fantastic customer service, new and up to date materials/appliances...all because they want the best for their customers. I most definitely recommend Plumbing Innovators and I will continue to use their services. Extremely satisfied customer here. Thank you, Thomas, Austin, Dillon, Hunter, Carol and Angel....you guys ROCK!

reviews.author: Nathan Johnson
reviews.text: Came home from work to what I expected to be a Septic nightmare. I knew exactly who to call. Plumbing Innovators answered the call early in the morning and had a crew at my house super quick. The crew was amazing! Knowledgeable, professional, and honest. They had me all fixed up in less than an hour! Plumbing Innovators will always be my first and only call for any plumbing needs! They should be yours too!

reviews.author: Dan Miller
reviews.text: I called about my leaky 75 gallon gas water heater the morning of New Years Eve. Carol was very pleasant to speak with. She scheduled me for that day, with the time that worked for me.  The technicians Rikki and Clay removed the old one and replaced it (same size/brand, newer model) in just a few hours. Great guys - no salesman stuff. Quality workmanship. Great price. Thank you all.

reviews.author: Jason Bartlett
reviews.text:
Once again, during a time of crisis when we had no water, Dillan, Melvin, and Thomas responded the same day. They quickly identified the issue and explained it thoroughly. They were extremely knowledgeable, professional, and trustworthy, and a pleasure to work with.

Although parts were required, they graciously returned at 7:00 p.m. and worked in the cold to ensure our water was restored. This marks the third time in five years that we have used their services for unrelated issues, and each time they arrived the same day and resolved the problem. None of these were simple fixes.

Thank you all for the outstanding service. We are customers for life.

reviews.author: Joe Rock

Super Happy with Benjamin Franklin and will continue to use them for my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: aaron randall
reviews.text: I bought a new house on 11-12-24.   On 11-13-24 I had Red Plains install a water softener and filtration system.  I had to use Red Plains to keep the warranty for the plumbing since they did the plumbing on the house.  When they installed the system they did not check the water pressure.  On 2-6-25 the canister on filtration system exploded and was notified that water was running out the garage.   Red Plains came out and said the canister had frozen.   I tried to explain that that the canister did not freeze.   The plumber replaced the canister.  On 3-14-25 the canister explode again.  I called Red Plains and told them that it was due to high water pressure.   Red plains was getting ready to replace the filtration system but they could not get the one they wanted.  The checked the water pressure at it was at 150psi and it should be about 70psi.   The plumber told me that I need a PRV and would be responsible for the repair.   I did some research and learned that the water pressure in my neighborhood should be between 110 and 130 psi and should have had a PRV.  The builder also used another company and they installed PRVs.   Red plains did install the PRV and the Builder paid for it.   I requested Red Plains to rep replace the water softener since I don't know what kind of damage to the water softener with double the water pressure.  Angela emailed "We feel that since the inline filter was there it protected the water softener from any damages that could have occurred."   To me they can't guarantee me that there was no damage.   She also emailed, "there is nothing wrong or caused any damages that would be an issue at this time for us to replace your water softener."  I am not concerned with at this time my concern is after the warranty is up.   I expect a softener to last longer than 18 months.   I spoke to a couple of water softener companies and the check water pressure before installation and high water pressure can cause damage to other parts or could place stress on the tanks.   The water softener should have been installed with high water pressure.   Red Plains would extend the warranty from 12 to 18 months.

reviews.author: Justin Manning
reviews.text:
They destroyed my yard putting in a sewer line.  Hit every line in the yard whether it was marked or not, broke my fence, and then covered everything up and pretended like they didn't hit anything.  It took weeks to undue all the damage they did.  They take no responsibility for their actions.  They don't return calls, they refused to come out and discuss the situation.  Would highly recommend finding another company to do business with.

Most everything said in their response is a blatant untruth.  Specifically, the communication with DJ.  He did not communicate with me at all.  I attempted to track him down daily, every conversation ended with unkept promises.  He never called back.   They did not send someone out to reset the fence.  That absolutely did not happen.  They never attempted to communicate or solve any of the issues that led to my frustrations.  I don’t know who the owner is, but he never spoke with me.  Horrible company, never do business with them

reviews.author: Matthew Fong
reviews.text:
Some guys from Red Plains Plumbing came out to clear a slow washer drain but they just managed to get their snake stuck in my washer standpipe. Instead of apologizing and figuring out how to fix it, they claimed that this happened because of my drain and they would have to go straight to digging up the sewer line for $7,000 to $10,000! I told them I would not be doing that and asked for other options so they said a supervisor would call me back and left, abandoning their snake in my drain which was now completely clogged and backed up into my washer and kitchen sink...

Fast forward through a couple of days of frantic calls to Red Plains which they didn't even bother returning and I called another plumber for emergency service. They were NOT complimentary and let me know the snake should not have been put through the washer standpipe and its four 90 degree turns, should never have been forced in until it knotted up, and after they removed it that Red Plains had used the wrong kind of head on the snake which was broken off inside the drain! What was just a slow drain was now a serious issue and I had spent over $700 but was much worse off than I started!

I want to support small businesses like Red Plains because they're supposed to care more about their customers.  Unfortunately with Red Plains, they weren't able to provide the resources,  professionalism, and knowledge that a larger company would.  Their office manager called and tried to help figure out a way forward but must have been overruled because a return visit to fix the problem lasted less than 15 minutes and Red Plains sent me an email saying there was nothing they could do.  When I tried to find out what happened (again leaving many messages with no return calls) they just told me I should go with another plumber!

Following their advice, I called a larger, more reputable company and what a difference it made!  In less than the time it took Red Plains to get their snake stuck and block up my drain, the experienced plumbers found exactly where the head of the snake was lodged in the Y with a nearby floor drain, sent a camera down the floor drain to look at what it would take to remove the stoppage, and cleared the stoppage through a nearby cleanout that the Red Plains plumbers had just ignored! Instead of defaulting to the most destructive (and expensive) option, the new plumber had the tools and experience to correctly diagnose the problem and figure out a way to fix it where Red Plains couldn't. To cap it all off, Red Plains flatly refused to refund the charges for their "drain cleaning" which started this mess (be careful with all the fine print they put in their invoices which make you wave their liability for damages they do) so this was a costly lesson for me.

In the end, what it comes down to is that you want to work with a company who will do what they say they will and help you even after they make a mistake. Based on what happened to me, I want to warn everyone that company is not Red Plains Plumbing.  If you're considering hiring them then I hope the same thing doesn't happen to you too!

reviews.author: Beckie Leonvega

We will absolutely recommend and use this company again.

reviews.author: Reuben Vazquez
reviews.text: Fast and reliable service. I had a plumbing issue and he resolved it quickly. Very nice and professional. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Christopher Gordon
reviews.text: I'm going to start off this review by quoting one of the greats: "Great things come to those who wait."  With that I will say I'm glad that I waited for Mr. Judd to show up and did not choose to go with somebody else. Mr. Judd was very professional very knowledgeable and didn't quit until the job was done. He even offered some very good and useful advice. He even got my washer to drain that has been stopped up for 7 years. If you have any plumbing issues this is the guy that I would undoubtedly recommend to anybody. Thank you Mr. Judd!

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.text: Judd was recommended to me by my brother and my sister whom both used his services. He is awesome and quick at what he does! Not only that but very reliable and very reasonably priced! I will use again and will definitely recommend!

plumbers.name: Clean Care Sewer Specialists

reviews.author: Felice Thompson
reviews.text: Tom was fantastic! He showed up the same day, was friendly, professional, and clearly knew what he was doing. He fixed my leaky sink quickly and efficiently, and provided reasonable pricing for future work, if needed. The whole experience was smooth and stress-free. Truly exceptional service! I’ll absolutely call Clean Care again and highly recommend this company to anyone needing quality plumbing work!

reviews.author: Dennis Brancato
reviews.text:
Where do I begin….I contracted Tom to take a look at a repair to my sump line that another company had done in August. After getting a bad information and problem solving from KBI,  I contacted Tom to take a look and provide me with another opinion. He not only quickly understood the situation but identified the problems. He and his colleague Al were able to re-repair the KBI job that was very poorly done but also were able to confirm and identify an issue with the sump line out in the parkway area that KBI had initially identified. KBI wanted to charge me $3800 to dig and fix the line in the parkway without any other options or discussion regarding utility lines. .  Not only did Tom identify the issue but was diligent in immediately contacting JULIE and the Village to have them mark the utility lines and discuss concerns with the gas line impeding the sump line. Nicor came out the following morning and confirmed the damaged sump line that Tom had seen with his line camera. Turns out the gas company had damaged the sump line at some point but they immediately took action to dig it and repair it. I can’t stress enough how awesome it was to work with Tom and his colleague Al to get the repair and resolution so quickly and more so appropriately!!!   Also kudos to Nicor for and the Village of Lake Villa for their fast response and resolution.
Highly recommend this company!! 5+ ⭐️

reviews.author: Chris Brenner
reviews.text: Had a clogged kitchen sink drain and a poorly installed P trap and drain pipe that needed to be redone. Tom was quick to respond to my phone call, quickly provided a quote (which was lower than another provider) from a couple of photos and came out as quickly as he could. Job was done quickly and final cost was well under the quote as it didn't take as long as expected. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Nina Mae Vidal Howard
reviews.text:
Heavy April showers bring May flowers, but they can also cause your sewer to back up and sump pump to fail at the wrong time. Thank goodness Tom was referred to us by a good friend, Kevin. Tom was able to come out when we needed him. The existing sump pump, which was already installed prior to us moving in a little over a year ago, had failed to work when we needed it to. Tom assessed the situation and even went above and beyond by going out to find the right sump pump for us and any additional parts needed.
He explained everything he was doing and what needed to be done to help keep it maintained. Very kind, professional and efficient. Please do not hesitate to contact Tom if you ever need a professional plumber. Thank you Tom from the Howard Family.

reviews.author: Kevin Ramirez
reviews.text: Tom is the best! Honest and reliable. A different company quoted me 5K for a fictitious sewer line crack and Tom inspected and discovered it wasn't.  I'm so happy I found him!

plumbers.name: Walker Tradesman Plumbing
plumbers.address: 31 Windmill Cir # B, Abilene, TX 79606, USA

reviews.author: Jennifer Rominger
reviews.text: I needed a plumber last minute after work. Apparently after 4pm in most of town, is "after hours" for plumbers. I am a teacher and do not even get home till after 4. I called several different companies and was just shocked at the price to just get someone out here. Finally came across Walker and the sweetest woman answered the phone and told me she would try and get someone out..and she did! Leo the technician was fantastic and also very knowledgeable. He gave us some great tips about our system and what we can do to avoid this in the future. They charged one flat fee for the call and the work combined. Walker will be my go to from now on.

reviews.author: Jim Teigen
reviews.text: We have used them for years.  Why?  They come when you call, and help with emergencies.  This time, both our water heaters went out on the same day.  Called and they were there within 3 hours.  Very courteous.  respectful of property and our situation.  Advised of lunch break, how long they would be gone and when to expect them back, and they arrived early.  My Wife and I trust them, and they always address me be name [on the phone or in person].  They may have a new name, but they still are the Great Plumber Company my family relies on.  Thank you.

reviews.author: Frankie McPherson
reviews.text:
1 review
2.0 star rating 1/2/2018
They did show up at the scheduled appointment time, however, it took them over an hour to write an estimate. For a water leak under house, pier and beam, repair small leak on water heater line and to replace all valves in house. Once I accepted estimate, just for the leak under house and to repair the water heater, they had to leave to get parts. Came back, it took them less than 10 under the house to realize they didn't have all necessary parts to fix leak under house. So they had to leave again, for another hour. They came back and 5 minutes later the leak under the house was fixed. Then they decided the pipes under the sink were leaking and needed to be replaced. Funny how they had never leaked previously but what am I to do, I was at their mercy. Of course that upped the price. AND, the didn't have p-traps, so they left for another hour to go get p-traps. When they finally finished and left, we discovered they hadn't relit the pilot light on the water heater. So, yes they had to return. So, $925.00 later, everything does seem to be working but the price was astronomical and the fact that they had no parts on their truck was ridiculous. I would never recommend them.

reviews.author: Tyler Selhorst
reviews.text: Walker Tradesman Plumbing has been at my house four times over the past three years. They are always available to assist and are very professional when they arrive. The three plumbers I have interacted with are intelligent and willing to discuss the issues at hand to help resolve in the future. It seems as though plumbing issues always happen when you least expect them and Walker is always available to help resolve those issues.

reviews.author: Jack Hardcastle
reviews.text: Steve came within an hour of our call on a Saturday.  He was very polite and forthcoming about the cost and diagnosed it quickly, and did the repair in a timely manner.  Have used WTP multiple times and never felt bad afterwards...high recommendation.

plumbers.name: Orem Plumbers & Drain Cleaning
plumbers.address: 1178 S State St, Orem, UT 84097, USA

reviews.author: Kennedi Rudy
reviews.text: The water in our home was making strange noises in the pipes. Their team inspected the system and found loose mounting brackets. They secured everything properly. The banging sounds have completely stopped.

reviews.author: Theodore Zain
reviews.text: Early one morning, we discovered our toilet overflowing. I contacted their team immediately. They handled the blockage quickly and sanitized the area. Everything was back to normal in no time.

reviews.author: Isai Kamila
reviews.text: The bathtub overflow leaked during long baths. The technicians replaced the gasket, sealed the connections and tested thoroughly. They explained the cause and gave maintenance tips. The tub now fills safely and the team was professional, courteous and careful.

reviews.author: Lindsey Cristopher
reviews.text: Water occasionally backed up from the shower drain with a glugging sound. The plumber found a partially blocked vent that was affecting airflow. He cleared the vent and flushed the entire line. The shower drain worked quietly and smoothly once he was done. Great understanding of plumbing airflow issues.

reviews.author: Archie Adams
reviews.text: This service stood out for its calm and organized approach, with each step handled professionally. Minor enhancements were made to support better performance and the results were confirmed before completion. The overall experience felt dependable.

plumbers.name: Monkey Wrench Plumbing, Sewer & Drain

reviews.author: Zack Myers
reviews.text: Carlos was great! I have an old home (built in 1908) & he added a shut off valve for my gas range at a very reasonable price. He also caught that I had a loose vent on my water heater & he fixed it free-of-charge. Highly recommend Monkey Wrench & I plan on using them on all future plumbing projects! :)

reviews.author: J G
reviews.text: We Love Monkey Wrench Jerry and Tony came and replaced the main drain in our house and they did awesome work. I would post a photo but am technically challenged lol but it looks great. Have used them in the past and will continue in the future best prices and very honest just what you want for repair/ home improvements. Thanks Monkey Wrench

reviews.author: Kalen Abraham
reviews.text: They came out to repair the sewer line for my neighbor to discover it’s a joint line and connects to mine. They came over and asked if they could cut out a section of my driveway to access the line I said that was fine then the plumber assured me they would fix the spot they cut out and it would look fantastic better then before. We exchanged contact info and he would let me know when they would be out to do it. They came out fixed it and then left it for a little to make sure they addressed the matter. Week later they came out and finally fixed the driveway. Or so I thought a week passed and it started to rain after two hours I go out to find that the slab they laid was now sinking 2 inches and had a massive hole under it making it useless. It appears they just put dirt back in the hole but didn’t pack it so when it got wet it washed out and sunk down. That section of the drive way is useless and it is where I usually park. I text the plumber that set it up all with pictures of what it looked like and he told me he would send his guys out asap to address the matter I let a week pass and texted him checking to see when they picked a date. I was ignored it’s now been another week with no response. I’m writing this review to warn others of what kinda of work they do and promises they will make to you and not uphold.

reviews.author: Cindy Hall
reviews.text: Carlos Luna is a jewel to work with. Completed job as he said and very efficiently. He explained things well

reviews.author: Craig Poland
reviews.text:
Carlos is awesome! He was polite, professional and friendly. He cleaned up the little mess he made (no questions asked) and did a good job fixing the issues we were having.

reviews.author: Kristal Castro

reviews.author: Christopher Eargle

The van that they showed up in does have a different company name on it, but it's the same company.  I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Derek Smoot
reviews.text:

The technician was very professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain exactly what was going on with my system. Overall, the service was prompt, honest, and very professional. I highly recommend the team at Dulles Plumbing, Heating & Air to anyone needing reliable HVAC service.

reviews.author: Andrew Colon

I would recommend this company for all your plumbing needs.
-Andrew

I was really impressed by the problem solving and ingenuity from him. Due to complications the project went into the second day and Dulles Plumbing group did not hesitate to finish it properly on the next day. I would definitely recommend these guys. One of the best experiences I have had with a plumbing company.

reviews.author: Jake Yezzi
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent Service and Professionalism

I recently had a leak in the water line between the meter and my house, and Dulles Plumbing did an outstanding job troubleshooting and fixing the issue. From the moment I contacted them, their team was responsive, professional, and knowledgeable.

They quickly identified the problem, explained the necessary repairs clearly, and completed the work efficiently with high-quality craftsmanship. I highly recommend Dulles Plumbing to anyone in need of reliable and professional plumbing services!

reviews.author: Matthew Fitzgerald
reviews.text: Dulles plumbing did a great job replacing a cracked toilet for us.  They were fast, courteous and professional.  Pricing was very fair. Thank you for helping us with our plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Andres Vanguardia
reviews.text: TMK Plumber Pflugerville is the best in the business. They will tell you what the problem is and they will give you a quote without trying to sell you more or take advantage of your plumbing needs. I recommend them

reviews.author: Mike Kennedy
reviews.text: I had a great experience with TMK Plumber Pflugerville. Their rates were super competitive (another company tried to charge me 3X what TMK charged). They were able to help within hours of my initial call, and Irvan was super knowledgeable and friendly.  I won't hesitate to give them a call in the future when I need a plumber I can trust.

reviews.author: Mr. Brian
reviews.text: Beware of them scam. I called them because I had a sewage backup at my house in round rock. I called and they sent a plumber to come to my house. The guy who came looked like he did drugs and was super rude. He wanted 600 dollars to clear my clog and after me telling him it was too much money and I would pass he started insulting my family about how he drove all this way for nothing and was cursing all over my face in the driveway. Keep in mind on their website they claimed free estimates. After long talks he wouldn't leave and then said he could do it for $475. I agreed and he used his auger to try to clear my pipe. While he was clearing my pipe he started to complain that it was only for 45 minutes of work and if I wanted him to continue clearing the pipe he would have to charge more. What a sketchy business practice. Keep in mind he was smoking all over my face at the same time. After 15 minutes he said he couldn't clear my clog and still had the means to charge me $475 for 15 minutes of nothing. Keep in mind the whole time he was smoking in my face with all his drug smell and kept insisting he would have to dig my pipe up for $5000. Later in the day I called a different plumber who was able to clear the clog with their augur for only $175 dollars that took them 2hr+ because of a plastic piece was stuck in the pipe. What a scam, I never seen someone so willing to scam and rudly smoke in customers faces. I don't why this place has so much good review but they got to be fake. Keep in mind they put their location on google maps as the northtown mud apartment but they aren't even there. A locaton for them doesn't exist. Whatever you do if you call them expect a crazy rude drugged plumber to come to your house to scam you. They guy the sent me he drove a white chevy truck. Just be careful if you call I got scammed by them and the guy was rude and smoked all over my face. Better off calling someone else.

reviews.author: Aiyana Franco
reviews.text:
When I discovered a foundation water leak I called several plumbing companies to come asses the issue and within 2 hours of the initial call TMK was at my door.

Edwin, Benny (the plumber and his team) checked all the boxes for being professional, courteous, on time, knowledgable, economical, all my questions were answered, the crew cleaned up, follow up was excellent and most importantly they fixed the water leak.

They went above and beyond and for that I am grateful.
Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jill Lara
reviews.text: I had 4 other plumbing companies bid on a pluming project for my house. I needed to reroute the plumbing lines. The best prices was from TMK. They sent the main technician with 2 helpers and finished the project in 2 days. I'm very pleased with them

reviews.author: Austin Cooper

We will definitely be going with them again if the time comes.

reviews.author: Clyde Fowler
reviews.text:
We chose Plumbers of Greenville because of their name.  It communicates confidence.  And these fellows have the right to be confident.  I am recommending Plumbers of Greenville to everyone that wants to remodel their bathroom.  They excel in every aspect of the project.  Scheduling, finishing on time, quality of work,  quality of their subcontractor's work, and experienced suggestions was excellent.  They clearly defined when we were responsible to select  our fixtures, tile, and glass.  We have never experienced this level of professionalism with a contractor.  We offer this recommendation with no hesitation.
Clyde and Debbie Fowler

reviews.author: Francisco Reyes

reviews.author: Alejandro Rios
reviews.text: Pablo and Ross were very professional in planning and executing my project in a professional and technical manner. They are the best contractors I have worked with in many years. reviews.author: Jan-Hendrik Pretorius
reviews.text: Ross was responsive, professional and extremely accommodating. plumbers.name: Valley Plumbing
plumbers.address: 137 Mesa Dr, St Albans, WV 25177, USA

reviews.author: Leah
reviews.text: Thank you Valley Plumbing! My sink recently fell into my bottom cabinet, and they came out and fixed it!

reviews.author: Savanna Vance
reviews.text: These guys did a great and quick job! I couldn’t recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Frank Hardin
reviews.text:
I called Valley Plumbing due to having a clogged main sewer line. I called them after a few days of trying to troubleshoot this myself. By the time I called them, the whole system was very backed up. They were able to send someone out the same day. I called at 0830 and they were able to get someone scheduled and at the house for that afternoon.
They worked for 3 hours until they (and myself) were happy with what they had to do. At the 1.5 hour point they thought they had it and were packing their equipment up, when we found something else. With no complaining they just went back to work for another 1.5 hours. They were very professional, thorough, and knowledgeable. I will definitely use them again if ever I need plumbing services.

reviews.author: Jayne Hanstine
reviews.text: I highly recommend this company.  They did an excellent job.  They came the same morning I called for service.  We expected to have a new tank installed, but they were able to repair the old one.  We appreciated their honesty… they could have replaced the hot water tank just to make more money.  The repairmen were very nice and professional.

reviews.author: David Murphy
reviews.text: They came out to fix leak and replaced two valves. There was much corrosion to hot water side that was ignored. It was still leaking so I called them back. They replace corroded copper and charged me 3 hours work for 1 hour and 50 minutes work saying they knocked off $40 dollars off the third hour. My guy doing the construction work laughed at the fact that they couldn’t even level the valves.

plumbers.name: 1st Fresno Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7225 N First St # 101, Fresno, CA 93720, USA

reviews.author: Lucille Ella
reviews.text: After comparing a few quotes for pipe repair, we chose this company. Their evaluation felt thorough and not rushed. The repair was completed within the estimated timeframe and the results have held up well. I would consider using their service again if needed.

reviews.author: Camille Jaliyah
reviews.text: Booked them for water heater installation after our old unit failed. The consultation covered sizing, recovery time, and energy use, which helped us decide. Installation took a few hours, and hot water was back the same day. The team worked efficiently and answered questions patiently.

reviews.author: Dillon Archer
reviews.text: Scott came out to check our water heater because we thought it might need replacing. We were prepared for a big plumbing bill, but Scott carefully inspected everything first. He was completely honest and let us know that a replacement wasn't needed yet, which was a relief. Scott also took the time to explain how the water heater works and even adjusted the temperature to make sure it was safe for our home. He was friendly and knowledgeable, and we really appreciated his honesty and the time he spent helping us understand the system. It's rare to find plumbing companies that care this much about their customers, and we are grateful for the great service.

reviews.author: Owen Lawson
reviews.text: I highly recommend this plumbing company. They gave me a free estimate and kept in touch with great communication throughout the process. From Scott in the office to Pedro and his assistant who came out for the job, everyone was friendly and really knew what they were doing. They installed a new water heater, a water softener, and a whole house filter for me, plus took care of a few smaller plumbing fixes. Their advice was helpful and made a big difference. Now I have great-tasting water from every tap and feel confident my appliances are protected from hard or corrosive water. Excellent service and quality work!

reviews.author: Brianna Scott
reviews.text: Had a great experience with this plumbing company in Fresno. They’re a local family-run business that really cares about doing quality work. Todd was my plumber—he was very professional, polite, and really knew what he was doing. He made sure everything was working perfectly before he left and even double-checked his work. Their prices were fair compared to other places. I’ve definitely found my new go-to plumber. Highly recommend giving them a call!

reviews.author: Kaye Cannon

reviews.author: Oriana Godbee
reviews.text:

The employee sent out told me they would call me to schedule when they would return to start the work after a week I called them to see if they were still coming out to do the work we agreed on. They quickly stated they were coming out the next day and did. The employee sent out at that time "completed" the job in two days.
The unfortunate part is they only completed the job to the point of connecting new pipes to old pipes under the house while I paid for ALL NEW PIPES TO BE RAN, avoiding replacing the pipes to the dishwasher entirely, not replacing any of the pipes to the hot water heater, not replacing the pipes to the washer in the laundry room and not connecting the house up to the main at all after I paid an additional amount for that to be done.
In 2 years I and the other home owner have called repeatedly to be given dates when the job would be handled only for no one to show up to the home. Myself and the other homeowner have been told that we were not answering the phone when called or not allowing voicemails to be left or that the other all around was not cooperating with the owner of this business. We are told the other refuses to set a time or date which sounds very odd since we both want the work completed. We have been unable to even live in the home due to this hold up. We can not finish closing in the shower/tub in the bathroom due to the pipes not being done. We can not rebuild the laundry room due to the work not being done and taking up the floor was the only way to access the pipes going into the home.
Being polite gets us no where and being up front and blunt with the owner that we have paid the entire 6,000 dollars for the work and need it completely in a timely manner means nothing.
I have my receipts from the business stating what I agreed to and it is obvious to the eyes what has not been done on the list. Appointment after appointment have been scheduled by the business owner and yet he is unable to show up and if someone is sent out they are only able to take pictures of the work that is not completed or done wrong.
I truly hope he does not continue to run his business like this so that others are not ripped off and unable to live in their homes. The idea that I should pay another company to come out and complete the work is ridiculous since this business took the full amount for the job.
I now have been left with finding ways to take legal action.

reviews.author: Aaron Popke
reviews.text:

You'll be able to tell immediately when you meet Anthony, the owner, that he puts honesty and integrity as a top priority above anything else. Some contractors or plumbers may try to add on unnecessary work or upsell for items that really are not needed, but Anthony is different. I felt like both Anthony and his team treated my job like they would if they were doing work for someone in their family - and it showed in the quality of the work, the grade of materials used, and the overall professionalism displayed.

Anthony was very communicative and if I had any questions/issues, he really wanted to go above and beyond to make sure I was 100% satisfied. He's one of those people that can not leave a job knowing that something wasn't done right or that someone is unhappy. He will put that as a priority and make it right.

Because of that, the overall experience has basically given me a plumbing contact for life. I will be calling Peak Plumbing for anything plumbing related from now on - and you should too!

reviews.author: Tiff Mond
reviews.text:
Let me preface by saying I am 100% sure the other 5 star reviews are generated by AI as they all sound the same and have only one review in their history.

I had a plumbing issue with a leaking boiler  in the middle of the night that was flooding the apartment below ours, and these guys were one of the few that answered, which was appreciated. We turned off the gas and water valves ourselves to stop the leaking and scheduled for someone to come between 7:30-8, but the plumber didn’t show up til 9am. When I called a earlier than that, they said the supply store didn’t open til 9 and they were looking at boilers, which made no sense to me as they didn’t even know we needed a replacement yet, plus why agree to 7:30 if that’s the case?

When the plumber arrived, we told him what was going on, and because there was no visible water on our floor, he said it couldn’t have been the boiler, even though sediment was everywhere. He didn’t seem to listen to anything we said, and went to our downstairs neighbor’s apartment for 2 hours to cut holes in their ceiling to see where the water was from, even though we told him the dripping was happening from the boiler. His colleague arrived and looked at our boiler as well. Then the original guy insisted it wasn’t the boiler and started looking under our fridge. I asked several questions and he point blank ignored me. They were the most unprofessional plumbers we have ever worked with. Finally we turned the gas and valves back on and the dripping sound from the boiler returned, and only then did they finally concede it was the boiler, 3 hours later. A more experienced team would’ve asked us to do that right away . We were charged over $700 between the investigation, fixing a coupling in the pipes below us, and the ceiling work in the neighbor’s unit. Insane. On top of it all, the plumbers left the neighbor’s apartment a mess and we had to call the main line 4x before they assigned another plumber to come clean it up. Each time we called we were given different reasons why they hadn’t returned yet (“they’re driving to the supply store”, “they’re at the supply store” etc etc) but in the end the original guys never even came back. Maybe some of the other 67 plumbers from this company are sharper and more professional, but overall I would not recommend. We ended up working with another plumber to install the water heater and it was night and day.

reviews.text: There was a big leak under my kitchen sink, and water was spreading fast. The plumber came quickly, turned off the source of the problem, and fixed the pipe quickly. reviews.text:
Rapid Flow fixed a leaking plumbing line in a commercial office building I bought last week (water heater safety relief line). They did the repairs for the previous owner the day before closing. Upon closing and taking ownership I got a good look at their work and Rapid Flow’s fix was to cap the discharge line on the domestic water line pressure relief!!!! The building has no other safety means to protect an over pressurization. THIS IS AGAINST PLUMBING CODE!!! I called the owner and he said because it has another plumbing violation, he felt it was ok and felt no obligation to protect his Georgia Master Plumbers license and said he’d fix it per code if somebody paid him to do it the right way. As a licensed General Contractor myself, my response would be “LET ME FIX IT IMMEDIATELY” to protect by business, my name and license. Not Jeff, he kept referring to the fact that the existing violation was there instead of taking accountability for HIS work.

In short, a non-restricted Master Plumbing license holder installed plumbing against code, got caught, wants more money to make it right…which they failed to do the first time out…They got caught because I’m a commercial GC and Mechanical Contractor and know the code. How many installs have they worked on and violated code, but didn’t get caught because the owners don’t know the code like I do?

reviews.author: Tony Tobiasz
reviews.text: We had a client of ours (new home owner) call Precision Plumbing to address an issue concerning noisy pipes at the home she just purchased from us 2 weeks ago.  The home was a total remodel with new plumbing, etc and did not have anyone living in it for 6 months.  The Precision plumber suggested to the client that since the home was new and not in use for some time, that the client call us (we were out of state) to find out who did the initial plumbing to verify if/where the venting was for the bathroom and to see if it was properly completed.  It should be noted that we hired certified, licensed plumbers who we, as building contractors, used in the past to perform our work.  According to the client, the Precision plumber stated "he did not feel comfortable tearing out walls" to see where the vent/s were located.  Needless to say, the client freaked out, picturing her entire new bathroom ripped apart.  He proceeded to pull the toilet to see if there was a clog.  No clog.  By the way, to reset a toilet, Precision charges $250 for 30 minutes of work.  When I called the Precision office to question the amount of the bill ($622.45), the office person stated that $250 was their standard charge for resetting a toilet "because they were a licensed shop."  Regardless, the noise issue was not resolved (according to the invoice).  In fact, the Precision plumber stated to the client that he had to "re-pipe" the water feed line to the toilet because the toilet was originally plumbed with hot water instead of cold, and, according to the written statement on the invoice from the Precision plumber, it was "a major safety risk", and told the client that the toilet could explode.  Yes, he told the lady that the toilet could explode.  Really?  Nowhere on the invoice addressed the time the Precision plumber used to basically NOT FIX THE ISSUE, although still charge the client over $600!  Ridiculous.  The client reached out to us right after this fiasco and we immediately contacted our plumber to resolve any issue she was having.  According to our plumber, all he did was pour water down the utility drain (which was not being used) and the sound went away.  He said it was absurd that the Precision plumber instilled a sense of panic to the client when he was there.  Very unprofessional.  We have been home remodeling for over 20 years in Wisconsin, having worked with all facets of the building trades.  I have never, ever, had to write a negative review such as this that reflects the incompetence and recklessness associated with this individual and company.  Unfortunately, it was well deserved.

reviews.author: Sam Razo
reviews.text:
This is a locally owned family business. Joey, one of the owners, was very friendly and easy to talk to. They are competitively priced. In fact, when talking to the owner, you don't feel like they're trying to nickel and dime you out of your money. On several occasions, to my surprise, Joey talked me out of unnecessary repairs, even though it would have meant more money for their business.

We had the sewer lines and supply lines replaced and re-piped. This is a big labor intensive job. I called around to four other plumbing companies for estimates and Rieck Plumbing offered the best prices, by far. Shockingly, most plumbing businesses won't be bothered to do this kind of work because there's more money to be made doing simple service calls and less hassle.

To be critical, I would have to include that Rieck Plumbing's biggest weakness would have to be poor communication. This project would take several weeks. On many occasions, I didn't know if I should expect plumbers to show up that day or not because one of the phases had been completed. Also, we were never given an option to choose between copper and PEX pipes. It was assumed that we wanted PEX because we showed concern over the overall cost. You will need to be proactive in asking questions, getting clarification, and letting them know what your preferences are. The good thing is, their staff is more than happy to answer questions and they don't make you feel like you are burdening them with your inquiries. Also, I wish they would have installed the PEX lines more thoughtfully . Perhaps higher up where they would be out of the way for future projects that involve accessing my attic.

It's worth mentioning, that the plumbers working in my house, Nick and Jose, were completely professional and trustworthy. They weren't snooping around the house or taking things that didn't belong to them. *Cough* Oliveira's *Cough*

Overall, I would recommend Rieck Plumbing. They are competent, hard working plumbers. They're reasonably priced. Over the years, I've used many different local plumbers.

reviews.author: Jackie Watson

reviews.author: Brett Avenriep
reviews.text: Wes and his team are top notch!! So happy with every aspect of my experience with Wise Choice Plumbing!! I had a gas line put in for my patio extension so I can connect a grill and fireplace and they did an awesome job! I had the details of exactly what I needed and he quoted me over the phone with a great price and came out to do the work a couple days later. It was completed in one day and the inspection passed with flying colors the next. Thank you Wes and the rest of your team for being an honest, fair and professional contractor that does what they say they will do!! I highly recommend Wise Choice Plumbing!! Brett

reviews.author: Thomas Fitzmaurice
reviews.text: Wes was beyond awesome! I had a toilet flange ring that needed replaced, I had another local plumbing company quote me over $800 to jackhammer the whole flange up and replace it, ruining my 20 year old tile floor which I have no replacements for. I called Wes and texted him a picture of my issue, Wes said he can replace the ring for a quarter of the price of what the other company quoted. Wes came the next day, and with ease replaced the flange ring AND installed the new toilet I was going to change out. Will absolutely use his services if needed again!

reviews.author: Dianne L
reviews.text: Very professional, fast and reasonable, I highly recommend Wes. I'm so glad to find someone that I can trust to do a good job. I've been telling all of my neighbors that I can recommend a great plumber if they need one.

reviews.author: Leslie Alexander
reviews.text: Wes has been over to my house a couple of times in the last few years to fix a few of issues that I’ve had he always been on time. He’s always been extremely knowledgeable, and he was always been super nice and courteous. He always talks me through my nervousness, explaining what it is he’s doing, and it’s always been reasonably priced

plumbers.name: Sammons Plumbing

reviews.author: Kim Proctor
reviews.text: My daughter called and they said the plummer could be there the next day late morning. We understand they are busy and run into problems, but to not call to let her know is poor communication. My daughter did call back at the end of that day and talked to the lady at the shop and she responded that she would call her back. No return phone call that day and a whole day has passed since without a returned phone call. I am very disappointed as my mother used  Sammons when she owned her house without problems.

reviews.author: Jeanne Mayer
reviews.text: Sammons installed a pump in our family cottage 13 years ago and today (a Friday) it stopped. We called at noon and they came over as soon as they were done with lunch and fixed it. Amazing. Our weekend was saved!

reviews.author: Patrick Lesage
reviews.text: I went to two other plumbing places and no one knew what I needed. Wanted me to go home and get the serial number and make and model from the toilet. Could not find any of that went over to Sammons plumbing the wonderful lady at the desk looked at the parts and said oh that’s a Mansfield, here are the parts you need and my wife and I decided there’s no other place to go but they’re so knowledgeable and kind. Thank you so much Pat and BJ.

reviews.author: Crystal Buss
reviews.text: I've been using Sammons for all my plumbing needs for at least 10 years, maybe longer. They've taken care of me through a couple of water heater replacements, toilets, fixing leaky showers and other basic plumbing needs at two different houses over the years.  They've always been pretty quick to send out their plumbers, emergency issue or not. I've always had good service.

reviews.author: Brooke Sjoquist
reviews.text:
Sammons has saved the day at our house a number of times. Always professional, kind and deliver the best quality service for a great price. We appreciate them and our dogs love them!!
We’ll be lifelong customers and recommend this awesome company to all of our friends and family.
Thank you Sammons crew!

plumbers.name: Superior Plumbing

reviews.author: Beverly & Michael Sumner
reviews.text: Bobby came in and took out my old toilets and put in 2 Brand new toilets, he did an awesome job and did it within a two hour window. I give Bobby five stars because he did a great job and cleaned up after himself. thank you, Bobby for making me feel like a valued customer. I would recommend this company anytime.

reviews.author: Angela Davis
reviews.text: Bobby is such an amazing plumber. We were truly blessed to have him come out and fix out kitchen plumbing issue. He is very smart and friendly. You need more employees like him. I will recommend Your company superior plumbing and ask for Bobby to anyone. Great job. One happy customer 😀

reviews.author: Diane Gottschalk
reviews.text: I would highly recommend Superior Plumbing to all who are in need of great service with a great price for plumbing repairs.  Specifically Bobby and Mike, they were utmost respectful, thorough, efficient, and tidy.  They went over and beyond our expectations.  There was a leak under the driveway and we had the line replaced to the house.  We paid as much or half for what the other 3 quotes were but was able to get a whole new line versus breaking up the concrete and fixing a section.  This was our main concern.  Although, inside the house only one person was able to shower at a time due to water pressure.  Now that we have a new line to the house with a new PCV, we can actually have more than one source of water running at a time.  We are free to wash dishes and have someone take a shower.  Really, cannot express the gratitude for these guys.  Spectacular job!  Thank God something told us to pump the breaks and get one more quote.

reviews.author: Teddy
reviews.text: Great service and fair price. Bobby did a great job with the quote and installation of my water heater and toilet.

reviews.author: Emma Weigle
reviews.text: Bobby did an excellent job fixing our garbage disposal. It had clogged and I couldn't remove the clog myself. He was very kind, quick and efficient and offered us a military discount. Worth every penny!

reviews.author: Max Y
reviews.text: John ist the best, old-school, transparent, and direct, which I value. He is fairly priced and responsive.

reviews.author: Denise Phillips
reviews.text: I've used Max for past 40 years. Yes sometimes he takes longer than you want but he is a busy man. He doesn't try to cheat people,  he doesn't over charge. He does good job. He knows his stuff. So you can wait till he gets there or you can pay high prices to get it done in your time. I vote Max's...

reviews.author: Jonathan Yoshida
reviews.text: Let me start from last week. I called Max to see if I can get a quote for a price comparison. Max provide the info, then hung up.  At the time I thought okay, maybe he had a bad day. So I called again and this time I schedule for a repair next week, the only reason I decide to go for his service was price which was affordable and he was nearby. Max had said he would be there in the afternoon but didn't specifically say until I asked. Then he respond through text "three o'clock" but arrived at six. Max and his assistant to come over to fix the leak. He did decent job. Then for some reason he spit the inside of kitchen faucet hose which was weird. At the end, everything was working fine until a day later the water flow of the faucet stopped. I think he might have left whatever he used to clog the pipe to stop the leak. Anyway Max and his assistant were nice. But I don't think I going to ask for there service again.

reviews.author: Arthur Green
reviews.text:
The Gentlemen Mr. Max and his Associate did a Outstanding job on Resetting both toilets. They were prompt and respectful.
The reviews I saw previously  was not true. The Man was nice and showed a real passion for his job.The price was cheaper than most Plumbers would charge.
He educated my Tenant on ways to keep the sewer system from getting bad.
I Highly recommend  Max Plumbing.
Thanks!

reviews.author: Andy Anderson
reviews.text:
Had a pipe busted underneath the house and water running into the street. Max and assistant arrived on  the scene, diagnosed the problem and fixed it.  Charged a reasonable amount and everyone satisfied.  He and his assistant were likable and I would recommend them to everyone.

Probably one of the few plumbers around that will get under a house and fix problems

reviews.author: Joe Joe The Circus Clown
reviews.text:
If your company’s work is anything like the behavior of your drivers, I wouldn’t trust you to paint a fence, let alone handle a professional job.
Absolutely disgraceful that someone representing your business drives like a maniac, tailgating and endangering others on the road. A quick look at your reviews shows years of the same complaints so clearly this isn’t an isolated issue, it’s a company problem.
Either you condone this reckless behavior, or your drivers are out of control. Either way, it’s unsafe, unprofessional, and unacceptable. If your team is in that much of a rush, maybe they should sign up for DoorDash instead.
Do better, though based on your track record, I won’t be holding my breath.

I'm grateful for their work.

reviews.text: We love partnering with the Hartwig team! They are so easy to work with - always great communicators and very informative.

reviews.author: Kaytlin Sanders

I was contacted within the next hour and informed he would be coming right then! The two men that arrived were very nice and did an awesome job in no time! I honestly don’t have 1 complaint. Great services and great prices. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Richard Barbosa
reviews.text:
Mere words could never express the level of service that was provided.  Truly amazing.  From my initial emergency call to job completion 2 hrs later.  And to top it off quality parts and workmanship were implemented.
Finally, a bill that was beyond reasonable.  By far the best experience I have ever had with any type of repair contractor.  Take my word you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Mimi Bee
reviews.text: First time using Ira for plumbing! Had leak spring up and he was here to fix it after he finished another job! Wife kept in contact to let me know when he would be here! Great service, friendly, and affordable! Most def recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Ruby Little
reviews.text: Thank you for your Speedy and Professional Service. I was Really In a plumbing Jam. Dwayne listened to my issues and took Excellent Care of Getting The Job Done. Definitely recommend and you have a for sure Customer for any and all my future plumbing needs. 10/10 Rating ⭐

reviews.author: Noah Corrado
reviews.text: After dealing with a few crooked companies in Tampa, that price gouge and have hidden fees, I found Drain Flo. Dwayne is by far the most honest and reliable plumber in Tampa. He is a man of his word and does high quality, efficient work. He goes above and beyond to ensure you are satisfied with his work. I highly recommend Dwayne & his team of experts.

reviews.author: Wes Schaaf
reviews.text:
We had a plumbing emergency in the middle of the night on a Friday, and after calling nearly 20 other plumbers, I found Drain Flo. One phone call was all it took at nearly 1:30am for Dwayne came to our house. When he got here, he immediately went to work diagnosing the issue and working out a fix.

The fix he proposed wasn’t an easy one. It required him to be uncomfortable and work in a tightly-cramped area (how our house was constructed made the repair nearly inaccessible).

Instead of going with an expensive fix that required the removal and reinstallation of our water heater, Dwayne chose a repair that was less expensive and more physically demanding on him in order to help stay within my family’s budget.

That’s the kind of man he is. Dwayne didn’t have to work out a creative and cost-effective solution for our family, but he did it because he’s a good man and runs his business in the most honest way you might imagine.

I cannot speak highly enough of his service, demeanor, professionalism, work quality, and- most importantly for me- his moral compass.

Dwayne has found himself a new customer and an evangelist for his business. I cannot recommend him highly enough.

Thank you Dwayne.

reviews.author: Kyle Ohrt
reviews.text: Dwayne is GREAT! It can be hard to find good quality honest people to hire for a job but Dwayne is just that. He came and gave me a free quote for the job I needed done, best part he was able to come within an hour. (reasonable pricing) After a few days I called him back to schedule an appointment and he came the same day. I would 100% recommend drain flo to any and all of my friends and neighbors for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Jase

Overall, I would not recommend this company due to the lack of professionalism displayed by their staff.

reviews.author: Katherine

reviews.author: Maxime Fischer-Zernin

reviews.author: Carol Moore

reviews.author: Daniel Weatherly

I called Plumbing Professionals of Florida and they performed a free inspection and quote. At no point did they ever try to upsell me anything. They painted a completely different picture than the first guy. They were very honest in their findings and the quote was well priced. After the job was done they provided video footage. I will always use them in the future.

reviews.author: Maria Tsongranis

reviews.author: Lloyd Braden

reviews.author: Curt Bush
reviews.text:

Whether it's been Ryan, Dave, or Russell, each time they've come out, they've exceeded my expectations. Not only are they incredibly fast to respond, but they also get the job done right the first time.

You can tell he really takes pride in his work and cares about doing right by his customers. I’m so glad I found him and will definitely call him again for any future plumbing needs. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Essentially Esther
reviews.text: My kitchen sink started leaking randomly one day and a good friend of mine recommended Mitch who also did work for him and his family, very well from what how he described it. Mitch came that same day I called him and fixed the problem, such great service. He's so nice and kind and such a pleasure to work with. Then the next month sadly my boiler broke and I did not have any heat or hot water for weeks, it was a very hard time for me. It was an old brand and the parts weren't common and were available overseas so it wouldn't benefit me to fix it so I decided to just replace the whole system. I called Mitch and he and his team replaced everything with a Navien system and I was so pleased and satisfied with all their hard work. He actually finished the installation coincidentally on my birthday so that was nice. I included a picture of the finished product showcasing his high quality of work. I would highly recommend MF Mitch Plumbing to anyone looking for any and all HVAC services. He is definitely someone I will always reach out to for future work because of the amazing quality of work and professionalism he provided me.

reviews.author: Anne Kisiel
reviews.text: We cannot say enough good about Mitchell Plumbing!  We called late Thursday afternoon after hours, as our water tank burst a leak, and we had been working with our heating company for 2 days between a service call and a “sales” call to get a quote for a new tank.  Mitch called us back literally less than one minute after we left a message, and asked us to forward pictures of the tank .. half hour later he came back with a quote $1,000 LESS than our own heating co with whom we have a service contract and with whom we have been doing business for well over 10 years!   He made arrangements to order the tank first thing in the AM… then he and his helper showed up and expertly did the installation!   All quite amazing response considering we never used this company before!   He took care of us promptly and professionally on a Friday afternoon!   Definitely keeping his card for future needs!  HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

reviews.author: Robert Levin
reviews.text: Hi Everyone - I hardly ever sit down and write a review, either pro or con.  I will be brief then.    His name is Bobby.  This plumber was absolutely terrific, from start to finish.  I live in a fairly large garden-style condo complex, and should I need work done, it must always be by a licensed professional.  Bobby helped me with the installation of a hot water heater, a toilet, and a dishwasher.  Every detail in each process was done with great care.  It took a while for each installation - but he made sure everything was perfect.  Time and effort, very well spent. Honest, and exceptionally fair priced too.  Thank You Bobby - for everything.

reviews.text:

reviews.author: donna hook
reviews.text: Mr. Rooter returned to my home, today 10/28/25 at my request to do a hydro-jet cleaning the drain in my basement.  Uriel arrived on time and explained to me the process involved.  Due to the accumulation of matter over the years it was a bit more difficult and after using the cable (snake) to break through and then utilizing the hydro-jet he completely cleared my drain.  He even had me go outside and i could hear the water and feel the air that was being emitted from the street trap/vent,  the gismos that we all have in front of our homes at the curb, which indicated that my pipe was open and cleared.  Having my drain hydro-jet cleaned was a new experience for this senior.  My washing machine d rain hose empties directly into a pipe and not my sink as it had done prior to a change and not able to attach a lint collector on the drain hose.  I asked Uriel if it would be to my benefit if I switch the drain hose to drain in the sink so that a lint collector would be attached, thereby avoid having  lint accumulate in my pipes.  He agreed that this would help.  So -my recommendation for anyone who has drain issues or other plumbing issues call Mr. Rooter, they have friendly, courteous and helpful technicians who will resolve your problem.  This senior citizen is very grateful for Uriel's excellent service.

reviews.text: Mr. Harris prepared a leaking pipe in ground at my Sister house.   It hook about 3 hours.  He found the leak and  fixed.  The price was very reasonable considering the amount of work.  Great Job.

reviews.author: Marco Olivares
reviews.text: Absolutely outstanding service! Mr. Harris and the team was professional, punctual, and went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. You can tell they really care about their work and their customers. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality and reliability. Will definitely be coming back for future projects!

plumbers.name: Glendora Plumbing & Heating
