reviews.author: Baharak Hosseinzadeh
reviews.text: We’ve had a great experience with this company every time we’ve reached out to them.  Great service, and knowledgeable people.  Thank you!

reviews.author: Gianella Salazar
reviews.text:
This morning my husband called me at work and told me there was a major problem with our plumbing (I won't say what exactly but it was not pretty). A coworker who lives in Glendora gave me GP&H's number. She told me her family had used their plumbing service for years and always had a positive experience. I called at 9:15 am, spoke to Mike, explained the emergency and he said a plumber would be at my house at 10am. That sounded too good to be true but I waited. At 9:50 I got a call from Bryan and he was at my house by 10am! What??!
Yes!
By 10:15, the job was done! Bryan was knowledgeable, pleasant and enthusiastic.
My coworker was so surprised when I told her everything had been fixed right away, it felt ss if she had just given me the number. What a great referral.
Mike had quoted a price over the phone and that's exactly what was invoiced, no extra fees, nothing! Best service around.
Great service and honesty!! Thank you GP&H!

reviews.author: Louie Aguilar
reviews.text:
I called Mike yesterday after noticing water was seeping out of my flooring. He was on time, kind and cared enough to detect the issue!

He was honest about the work including having to break flooring to get to the pipe but also provided some options of clearing the run off for now until the bigger issue can be addressed.

He even took the time to fix the water heater issue I was having which caused only cold water to come out of one of my showers.

It’s just heart warming to meet good people who don’t try and scam you out of money and actually take pride in their work.  I don’t often put reviews unless I get exceptional service and this was definitely one of them.

reviews.author: Shaun Hansen
reviews.text: After several horrific experiences with other plumbers - a family friend shared Glendora Plumbing & Heating contact information with me. If any of you are in a situation like me, I hope you see this review. This is one of those companies that you will share with everyone you know, and wish the best for. These folks are technically proficient - but more than that, they are straightforward and honest. Trust me, if you have anything plumbing related you need to give them a call. These kinds of businesses are a rare gem that you can feel confident in using.

reviews.author: Tonya Nickens
reviews.text: I called Glendora Plumbing late on a Friday afternoon because my water heater was not working.  Mike told me he didn't have time to complete the repair but he did tell me me about how much it should cost for the repair and I appreciated that.  I called around to other companies and since it was late on a Friday not many were answering the phone.  One place that answered   told me my water heater was not repairable and that I needed a whole new unit!  I remembered how sincere and friendly Mike sounded so I called him back and explained what this other company told me.  Mike actually changed his plans and said he'd stop by to take a look at my water heater.  And he fixed it in about 20 minutes!!!   Thank you so very much Mike.  If you need honest and dependable service call Glendora Plumbing!!!

plumbers.name: NYC Emergency Plumber & Sewer
plumbers.address: 17 Cleveland Pl, New York, NY 10012, USA

reviews.author: Benjamin Brooks
reviews.text: A few days ago, our laundry room drain started overflowing. I contacted a plumbing expert to inspect it. They cleared the clog and cleaned the line thoroughly. The drain now works smoothly.

reviews.author: Trevor Alexis
reviews.text: At first it seemed like a small drip, nothing urgent. A few days later it turned into water collecting under the sink. The plumber checked everything properly and replaced the damaged part instead of doing a quick fix. Since then, the cabinet has stayed completely dry and I’ve stopped worrying about it.

reviews.author: Jamie Guillory
reviews.text: As soon as we noticed inconsistent hot water in the shower, I contacted their specialists. They replaced the mixing valve and tested it carefully. The temperature now stays steady.

reviews.author: Brenda Samuel
reviews.text: I noticed a slow leak under the guest bathroom vanity. I called their team for help. They replaced the corroded pipe and sealed the joint. I’m very satisfied with their careful and reliable work.

reviews.author: Austin Roberts
reviews.text: I contacted NYC Plumbing for a toilet that flushed weakly. Their plumber adjusted internal components and checked water flow. The flushing power improved significantly. The change has been consistent.

reviews.text: Best plumber in Lawton by far! Needed a plumber to come look at my leaking spigot in my front yard. Called and they were at my house within 2 hours. Friendly, professional, and got the job done quickly.

reviews.author: Donna
reviews.text: Always does a great job and remembers 4 years later what they did to help with pluming the last time we had an issue. They know their stuff and have been doing it a while. They also show up pretty quickly after they have been called. I would and am recommending them to friends and family.

reviews.author: Joshua Looney
reviews.text: Service was great, had them replace my water heater and they did a great job. Next day service was what sold me first.  Father and son were working and they are a hoot to watch. I will be returning for any service in the future for sure!

reviews.author: Amanda Lawson
reviews.text: Lucas did a wonderful job! Our plumbing issue was on a Saturday and he came out and fixed everything for us. Then he made sure that everything was working great before he left too! I would recommend him to anyone that needs a great plumber! Thank you for your hard work!

reviews.author: Mary Taub
reviews.text: We had a plumbing problem (sink backed up; flooding from the water heater closet; bathtub not draining properly etc.) I called some of the "name brand" plumbers in the area and either: got an answering machine, no answer, or was told I would have to wait 4 (four) days until someone could come. When I called STEELE Plumbing, I was able to speak with a human being and he came with an assistant later that day.   He was able to quickly determine the problem and fix it right away! Also, he recommended a solution that was less expensive that what I thought I would need. Quick, professional, effective, and reasonably priced! Any issues in the future, I am definitely going to call him first!

plumbers.name: C&M Plumbing and Heating
plumbers.address: 403 Concord Ln, Lafayette Hill, PA 19444, USA

reviews.author: Debra Brink
reviews.text: Joe arrived as scheduled, diligently worked on all four of the plumbing issues I needed help with until everything was resolved, cleaned up after the work was done and charged a fair price for the materials used and the skilled work that was done. The jobs he completed were installing a frost free Bibb and replacing the ancient and corroded inside and outside spigots for my hose, replacing two shower heads, replacing my bathroom sink stopper, and detecting and fixing a leak under my toilet, which ended up being quite involved. I now have a piece of mind which is priceless. I know I'll call them again when the need arises and will also  refer them to friends and family when they're in need of a plumber. Don't hesitate to contact C&M Plumbing; you'll be happy you did!

reviews.author: Phil Glatts
reviews.text: I was in a pinch with water softener issue. C&M responded quickly with a time they could be here to resolve and stuck to it! Completely professional, explained everything and resoled my issue quickly and the first time. I'll be using them going forward for any of my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Alexis
reviews.text: We had a busted pipe in our bathroom extension and needed a toilet replaced upstairs. Guys were punctual, personable and did a wonderful job. Very reasonable prices as well. We definitely recommend them, and we will be calling C&M for future projects.

reviews.author: Robert G
reviews.text: Both Joey and Kevin were personable,  professional, and punctual. They did an amazing job on replacing two toilets, installing shower fixtures and two sink faucets. They were respectful of my home, and did the work at a very reasonable price.  They did a great job cleaning up and now my bathrooms have new life. We have no complaints on any part of this process and will use them for future plumbing needs. I'm very happy with the results!

reviews.author: Megan Downing
reviews.text: We had a sudden leak coming from our upstairs bathroom going into our downstairs powder room and Kevin was incredibly helpful and responsive. Given that it was a holiday weekend coming up he still took the time to keep me updated and get me on the schedule as soon as possible. I truly appreciate how professional he was and he made me confident that he would figure out the problem and fix it as efficiently and cost effective as possible. I also was really thankful that he gave me an accurate window of the time and also let me know he was a half hour out, arriving right on time. I'd highly recommend them if you're in need of a plumber.

reviews.text: Just had Bear repair a slab leak in my bathroom. They did a great job, very professional and a reasonable price. I highly recommend them

reviews.author: Claire C
reviews.text:
Great experience start to finish!

Our hot water heater was leaking and we called a few plumbers for quotes, which Bear was able to provide quickly over the phone. They said the soonest opening in their schedule was a couple days but they could see if anything could be moved around to fit us in sooner if we moved forward.

After going over all our quotes we ultimately decided on Bear based on price and product. When we called them back they were already working on moving their schedule around, ultimately fitting us in the next morning. The installers arrived in the expected time window, explained everything thoroughly, came in right at the quoted price, and left zero mess. We'll definitely give them a call for future plumbing services.

reviews.author: Galaxy Rose
reviews.text: So I was completely out of water, zero pressure on my well tank and Bear was the only plumber to return my calls, after contacting 3 others multiple times and no one would call me back, Bear got me a tech out the next day after I called. They fixed a faulty pump wire, barely charged me anything, and gave me an estimate for a new tank that was the cheapest I’d heard of since 3 years ago. Highly recommend using this company

reviews.author: Shane Fallen
reviews.text: Let me just start out saying I have worked in restoration for 20 years. I have ONLY called Gary Lester, and Bear, anytime I have a plumbing issue. The professionalism and integrity Gary offers is second to none. Integrity is the single most important quality I look for when subcontracting work out. Bear will never try to upsell work. They do what is needed and really try to save the customer as much money as possible while offering superior quality craftsmanship. If all contractors operated in the fashion Bear operates, there wouldn’t even be a need for reviews. 10/10 recommend. Thanks Gary!

reviews.author: Dale Kirby
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Bear Plumbing.  Our water heater failed, and Bear rescued us with the same high quality brand unit in one day.  Called in the morning and by dinner we were back in hot water!  Excellent response time and workmanship! My new plumbing company is Bear.

reviews.author: M M
reviews.text: Very responsive, fair pricing. Very frank about what issues you may have and the best solutions (instead of beating around the bush).  Came on time as agreed, provided quality service.

reviews.author: wes eminger
reviews.text: Highly recommend this company! They came to our house a few months ago because we had standing water in our yard. They quickly repaired the problem and billed me for it later. Yesterday we found out a different pipe right next to where they were working had deteriorated too. We called Mr. McBride up and him and his crew were at my house the next morning. He and his crew fixed it for us for free! They truly care about their customers and understand how expensive it can be to continuously have to pay for plumbing repairs. Very thankful! He said he really appreciated our family’s service to our country through the military and were happy to help us out! Now I can’t promise free work but I can guarantee a job well done! Great guy. Great company.

reviews.author: David P
reviews.text: After trying a couple of other companies, and having one try to charge $1500+ just to break out the excavator over a pipe that I myself found was only 3in deep, I saw Gary McBride off of hwy.80 and gave them a call. They've now fixed multiple broken pipes on my property and even the one time they legitimately had to use the excavator it was less than $1500. Their guys have been honest, shown me the issue before fixing when possible, and just handled their business when I didn't have time to come to the property myself. Since I've started using them I've sent a  few neighbors their way and everyone has thanked me for it. Can't suggest them more highly.

reviews.author: BARBARA TOWLES
reviews.text: Called to have plumber come out and replace non-working disposer. David arrived and proceeded to run all the tests we had done and came to same conclusion -- " new disposer".  Upon taking off old disposer he noticed a wire had come loose and fallen down inside .  He reattached wire- did a test run and then proceeded to put existing disposer back in place.  We really appreciate the honesty , it would have been very easy to put in new disposer and we would never have known!! Older people are often taken advantage of, nice to know there are still honest people in the world!! We have used them before and will again if situation arises.Diane was super helpful as well in sending someone out quickly.  Thank You!

reviews.author: Sally McNair
reviews.text: I had a serious backup in my drains and after calling literally a dozen plumbers, I finally got lucky. They even cleaned up the bathroom before they left. They really saved the day for me, and I don’t know what I’d have done if the hadn’t been able to help. Highest recommendation.

reviews.author: Rachael Ivanovic
reviews.text:
Stop searching and hire The Tim’s. 100/5 stars. If you need someone who is honest, does great work, is extremely knowledgeable, goes above and beyond AND has fair pricing, you found them.

We are SO lucky we found them. Our situation sucked but it could have been way worse (and frankly, 5x the cost). They communicated at every stage of the project, explained what was going on and what to expect and prepare for. They worked in single digit weather, early mornings/weekend/late nights, did everything possible to limit the cost, and really went the extra mile to complete the job although they had to move their schedule around.

We had a leak in a pipe in the yard. It became urgent when we started to get water in the basement. They moved their schedule around, got the permits, rented the equipment, etc in the matter of about a day. Most people would have told us “oh well you’ll have to wait”, but the Tims CARE and that’s the difference. When they identified another issue, they already had the plan of attack in motion. Although they told us it was most likely impossible, they worked literal magic so that we didn’t have to replace concrete that was poured this past year, saving us a lot of money, stress, and time. Overall, they did EVERYTHING they could to take care of us and our situation, and made a really stressful situation as pain free as possible. I cannot even begin to express how grateful I am.

reviews.author: Mark Whipple
reviews.text:
Drain Masters was recommended to me by two friends at the gym for what I thought was a plugged toilet drain line.  They came by within a day of my call, diagnosed the problem at no charge, and told me I could fix it myself, or have them repair the issue at what I thought was a pretty reasonable price.

I elected to do it myself to save the money as it was a pretty simple fix.  They were honest and comfortable to deal with.  I will definitely be calling these guys again for any plumbing issues I have.

Their in-depth knowledge and attention to detail truly set them apart. The owner is caring, honest, and extremely professional, and we never feel taken advantage of, something that is very important to us as business owners.

reviews.author: merhawi temnewo
reviews.text:
I’m not a plumbing expert, but I trusted AllSTAR Plumbing to fix my issue as promised. They gave me a quote and assured me the house would be fully usable. Unfortunately, I was disappointed with the outcome. After hiring a different professional plumber, I was told that AllSTAR’s work had actually worsened the plumbing issue and improper materials were used. In the end, the work did not meet the professional standard I expected.

A few days after I posted the review above, the owner called me and demanded that I take it down, threatening to sue me if I didn’t. I was shocked by the call. During the conversation, he used profanity and made offensive remarks about my background, including calling me a foreigner and saying I didn’t know what I was talking about.

I found this behavior completely unacceptable and unprofessional. I am a proud American, and no customer should ever be spoken to this way. The call was recorded. If anything, I have clear documentation of harassment and intimidation. What a shameful way to treat a customer.

I did Construction myself for 15 years and Cathy and her team have always been some of the hard-to-find honest hard working folks out there. Plumbing was never my forte and Cathy is my go-to when I need plumbing done. Thank you, Cathy and Team, for always doing me right! I have seen some negative reviews on here and my guess is everyone had a bad day now and again, but the reviews I have seen have not been my experience and if they ever were or are I will share, but Cathy and her whole team have bent over backwards and always came through for me even in a pinch...

reviews.text: We've been customers for several years now, and our issues, big and small, have always been addressed professionally and quickly by Southtown. There contact staff are top shelf too!

reviews.author: Cael Nathalia

reviews.author: Yvonne Grace

reviews.author: Matthew Gasper
reviews.text:
Totally disappointed with the cost of the installation of a new water heater. Inspection to confirm leaking, that will be $242.67. Cost of new water heater $787.63 that includes three adapters. Cost of unit from Home Depot $439.00.  Model # in photos. Roughly 80% markup. That is after the installer bought the wrong heater and had to get the proper size. Labor for roughly four hours $893.33, for a job that should take about two hours at the most.
Associated Plumbing doesn't even a person answering the phone. Message is "We'll call you the next business day", that's at 3pm on a Wednesday.

I was going through my property management firm hoping for some oversight but apparently that did not happen.

reviews.author: Caleb Suszko
reviews.text: Mike and Team are straight shooters. Thanks for all you do!

reviews.author: Cheyenne Dougherty
reviews.text: Overall great experience! When I initially called, I was worried after several steep quotes. I spoke to Vicky, she was extremely polite and understanding. She got me an appointment the same day. When Tim & his coworker arrived to my home, they were also very polite & understanding. I could tell that they weren’t trying to take advantage of me and wanted to ensure they got the job done!

reviews.author: Melanie Sunday
reviews.text: I own 201+ rental properties in the Bay Area, a commercial building in Tampa and have used them for my personal home as well!  They are quick to respond and have always given great service.  Prices are very good.  They respond to after hours calls promptly!  They have responded and scheduled same day service in most all cases.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Candase Parker
reviews.text:
Came in January to unclog toilet. Did not finish the job & needed to come back next day. Never came back. Wax ring was not on toilet and toilet was not caulked to ground. I called next day to get job finished and no response. I called another company and they came out and completed the job. Then today Associated Plumbing called saying that I had an outstanding $300 bill and needed to pay it immediately. They never in the past SEVEN MONTHS called, emailed or sent a mailed invoice until today (July 26th!).  But today they were demanding money over the phone immediately.  I explained that the job wasn't completed and that this phone call today was aggressive and terse and the first time I am hearing of a bill due. I am not giving you my card information over the phone for an incomplete job that was SEVEN months ago with no prior billing or communication. I needed them to provide me with proof that they finished the job and proof that they had contacted me previously regarding the invoice. He then hung up the phone on me.

Edited to add in response to the owner: please provide the invoice and prior attempts to contact as I requested on the phone today. I have never stated that I will not pay, just that I will not give you personal information over the phone and that I need the invoice, photos and prior proof of contact. You have not responded to me regarding this request directly, instead choosing to only respond to my google review. Instead, you are THREATENING to send a customer to collections PUBLICLY as a response. Do you not see that this is terrible customer service? This is, in fact, showing exactly what I am stating in my review and will hopefully be enough proof for the next possible customer to STAY AWAY.

plumbers.name: Priority Plumbing
plumbers.address: 13820 Kidd Rd, Conroe, TX 77302, USA

reviews.author: Traci Bellomy
reviews.text: Had a Pressure relief valve and other plumbing issues that had to be fixed to sell house. Priority Plumbing came in and did a GREAT JOB!  They were EXCELLENT to work with. They basically did the installation and repair the same day.  They left work area outside in PERFECT shape.  I will be calling Priority Plumbing for every plumbing need going forward.

reviews.author: Lillyan M
reviews.text: We had a leak from the upstairs bathroom. My mom called Greg and he sent out Brandon and Chase within minutes. They were friendly and knowledgeable; they didn't even mind me looking over their shoulders and asking questions. Brandon explained everything with a lot of detail to us about what was going on. They were quick and courteous and helped to take the stress of it off my mom. I'm super grateful to Greg, Brandon, and Chase. Thanks guys you're epic!

reviews.author: MrsDee
reviews.text: Pipe busted at 11a.m. this morning; called Greg and within the hour he sent out Brandon and Chase. Epic guys! They found the issue, fixed it, and had my water back on in a few hours. Brandon explained everything. They will definitely be my go to plumbers from now on!

reviews.author: Brad McDonald

Greg (the owner) worked with me on getting his team out to me. His prices for work and equipment were more than fair. When Brandon and Chase arrived, honestly it was like seeing old friends again. They were so personable, friendly, taking the time to educate and explain what they were doing and why as well confirm any work prior to doing it. I am so grateful for finding them. Thank you guys

reviews.author: Steven Biddinger
reviews.text:
Super Brothers was great and I'd recommend selecting them as your vendor. Their estimate was provided quickly and accurately, even without coming to the house. I really appreciated that they included eligible rebates in the quote that ended up saving us more than we would have going with another vendor and they did all that work for us!

The installation team was on time, professional, and efficient. We were very happy with their work and the new electric heat pump water heater has been working great so far!

reviews.author: william maldonado
reviews.text:
What an outstanding technician Andrii was.

For context - my 87yo Nana lives far enough from me that it's quite difficult for me to regularly go do house maintenance for her. I'm a mechanical engineer, but plumbing is one those things I will not do because failure causes huge damage. But I'm also always worried someone is going to take advantage of my Nana since I'm paying the bill and not there to ask questions. I considered going low tier low cost no-name contractor because money is tight during the holidays.. but I took a chance with Super Brothers Plumbing.

Andrii - our plumber - went above and beyond and was extremely patient with my Nana and my elderly mother. He gave a quote which I approved - and then according to my mother he did a a couple extra things around the house that he noticed were fixes he could do in the moment. Bravo! As man trying to care for his family but works full time and can't always be there, that is invaluable thing he gave my family.

The level of professionalism, the quality of the repair, and courtesy that Andrii provided to my Nana (I am always hesitant to have someone come in the house when I'm not there) was refreshing and I will continue to use Super Brothers Plumbing for all future repairs because of this.

Great work guys, 10/10. Someone give Andrii an award :)

reviews.author: Greg Lyons
reviews.text: Kitchen sink was backed up. I checked the trap and removed the clean out plug under the sink. Plumber run auger down the pipe and cleared the blockage. Was on site for 1 hour+travel time? I did contact 4 other companies but didn't even get a call back from 3 and the other could not come out for at least a day. Called Super Bros and they got someone out within a couple hours. Price was high but problem solved. Super Bros changed out my water heater a few years back and I had forgotten about them.

reviews.author: Kevin Smith
reviews.text: Great experience! Super Brothers installed a commercial water heater on short notice, over the holiday even. Everyone we worked with was helpful and friendly. Thank you Super Brothers!

reviews.author: Louise L
reviews.text: Love this company!  Jimmy came out to replace my garbage disposal, and he did such a terrific job (not to mention that while he was working, he was also sharing some pretty funny stories).  He also took the time to answer some questions about a tub faucet I have, and he saved me some money because what I was going to do would not have been conducive to the end result I was seeking.  I really appreciate how responsive, courteous and professional he was.  I'll definitely reach out to this company for any future plumbing needs.  Thanks for a great experience!

reviews.author: Linda Mcintosh
reviews.text: Elliott took care of plumbing issue at our home.  We got same-day service. Irv, the employee who did required work was polite, personable and efficient. We were impressed and called him back for more work the following week.  Prices were very reasonable.

reviews.author: Howard Packer
reviews.text: No hassle, got the job done quickly and efficiently.  Would have been there an hour after my call had I been able to be home.  Jimmy showed up on time, easily fixed what turned out to be a very minor problem and explained a LOT of things to me about plumbing that I didn't know.  Good guy and good service, will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Krayne Porter
reviews.text: I have a possible backup or vent problem in my drain line connecting my sink and washing machine. I wanted to support a local business, so I checked them out. Great ratings, good history, and a BBB grade; looks perfect! Called to ask their professional opinion and to possibly schedule someone to take a look. I was nothing but friendly, but I got nothing but a sour, snide attitude. When he said "we don't do washing machines", I thanked him and ended the call. Not professional at all.

reviews.author: Jeannie
reviews.text: Called this gentleman for service just to get a lecture. The guy from the water company was nicer and more helpful. I’m sorry if you were having a bad day. Obviously if I’m calling you the last thing I needed was a 15 minute lecture and you wasting my time trying to find a plumber. Luckily you’re rating will be higher than Roto Rooters!

plumbers.name: Aqua Fresh Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1185 Nicklaus Ave, Milpitas, CA 95035, USA

reviews.author: vicki shepard
reviews.text:
Firstly, I call them and they responded right away on a Saturday night. He was sent the order by my Home Warranty company.
We had a broken shower valve, the water wouldn’t completely shut off. We had to turn off water to the whole house.
He came on Sunday morning!!!!!
A broken valve stem stuck inside the wall, he was very resourceful and knew his craft.
He got it out and replaced with a new valve stem he had with him, even had a handle that would work, love that he came prepared.
Peter is an awesome plumber, very courteous and helpful!!!
Recommend him highly!!!

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.text:
I’m in the Bay Area, and I had an issue with a clogged kitchen pipe. The drain wasn’t draining properly, so I called a plumber to take a look. The plumber came over, snaked the kitchen pipe a few times, but it didn’t help at all. He tried four times, but still no luck. After waiting for a week, my home warranty company managed to get in touch with Peter from Aquafresh.

Peter came over, understood the problem quickly, and suggested we snake the main sewage line in the garage to clear any blockages. He was really helpful. He cleaned the pipes and snaked the line to remove the clogs. Then, we ran hot water for a few minutes, and Peter made sure everything was working fine.

It was a huge relief for us, as we were without a working kitchen and unable to cook for a whole week. Peter resolved the issue in just 10 minutes. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Vineet Mathur
reviews.text: Peter from Aqua Fresh is a gifted plumber. I was assigned to them by First American Home Warranty after the first plumber screwed many things. Peter took care of installing a new faucet, taking care of a leak, and fixing a long standing issue with the shower head which many plumbers couldn't do earlier. I will surely call him for future work.

reviews.author: Seabella
reviews.text: Aqua Fresh Plumbing is amazing! They changed our leaking water heater in a very timely manner — professional, efficient, and reliable from start to finish. They showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and got the job done right the first time. It’s hard to find plumbing services that are both honest and affordable, but Aqua Fresh delivers on both. I highly recommend them for any plumbing needs — top-tier service all the way!

reviews.author: A C
reviews.text: Aqua Fresh Plumbing did good work replacing my garbage disposal and shower diverter. Pete was professional, clean, and notably reliable - he showed up on time despite traveling from San Jose to San Francisco on a challenging game day when street parking near Oracle Park was nearly impossible to find. His persistence in finding parking showed real commitment to honoring the appointment. Both installations are working properly. I would recommend Aqua Fresh Plumbing for their reliability and quality work.

plumbers.name: Van Rite Plumbing Inc.
plumbers.address: 2229 Double Q Rd, Green Bay, WI 54311, USA

reviews.author: Dan Schmidt
reviews.text:
My wife and I recently selected VanRite Plumbing Inc. to replace our lead water supply line in Sheboygan. From acquiring an estimate to watching them dig to seeing the last road cones get removed, the experience was positive and efficient.

Ryan let us know when work was going to begin, and everything we could expect along the way including when workers would need to access our home to complete the replacement.

The team's efficiency amazed us. They arrived promptly in the morning and got down to business. We were impressed by Ryan and his team and their dedication to making sure we had a good experience.

We would like to thank everyone involved for their professionalism to ensure we were satisfied at the conclusion.

Great teamwork, VanRite!

reviews.author: Mitchell Michiels
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with VanRite Plumbing Inc. to replace both our sanitation and water laterals. From start to finish, the entire experience was positive and hassle-free.

First and foremost, the team's efficiency amazed me. They arrived promptly in the morning and completed the job within half a day. I was truly impressed by their dedication and hard work.

Ryan, from VanRite Plumbing, went above and beyond to ensure that all my questions were answered and that I felt comfortable with the entire process. He visited our house multiple times, patiently explaining every detail and addressing any concerns I had. His willingness to teach and guide me through the process was greatly appreciated.

Moreover, Ryan took the time to thoroughly explain any potential issues that could arise, even though the chances were minimal. This level of transparency and honesty demonstrated their professionalism and commitment to customer satisfaction.

Lastly, at completion, they took great care to tidy up after themselves, leaving no mess behind. It was evident that they valued not only their work but also the overall experience for their customers.

I highly recommend their services to anyone in need of plumbing work.

reviews.author: Patti Pitzen
reviews.text: Our cast iron sewer lines were deteriorating, Van Rite came, relined our pipes. Had a few set backs, the pipes were that bad, but they got the job done! Lee and his crew were great! Very professional and nice! Would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Amanda B
reviews.text: Ryan and his team were excellent to work with from start to finish. From the initial contact, communication was clear, professional, and prompt. They explained the process thoroughly and provided a fair and transparent estimate. The work completed demonstrated great attention to detail and was completed exactly as promised.  VanRite was reliable, courteous, and highly skilled.

reviews.author: John Groth
reviews.text: Our home sewer pipe had completely disintegrated and we were getting constant backups into our basement. We opted for a pipe relining rather than a whole floor demo. I was skeptical, but these guys are pros. They were incredibly responsive and professional. The relining was not cheap but compared to a complete remediation it was a money and time saver. They made the best of a crappy situation, were total pros and I 100% trust them. If I could give 6 stars I would.

plumbers.name: Solution Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1810 Baker Dr, Tomball, TX 77375, USA

reviews.author: trashman101
reviews.text:
My experience & review is sadly very similar to the one posted three weeks ago. We logged the job yesterday (7/19) & the receptionist said the plumber would be out between 3:00 & 3:30. Nobody showed up. Called just after 4pm to ask for an update. Told that a big emergency job had come up after we had initially called & he was stuck on that & they'd call us back by 5pm to tell us what was going to happen. We didn't receive a call & when I called them at 5:30 it went straight through to voicemail. No further communication was received after that.

This is obviously a rough time for the proprietors but as the last reviewer said, communication is the key. If someone had called us yesterday to say that he couldn't make it that evening we would have understood completely & rescheduled for today if possible. Unfortunately we had to go with another service.

reviews.author: Kathy Chernicky
reviews.text: Outstanding, excellent service! Joey and Alexi are very trustworthy! There are many companies out there today that will rip you off. Not Solution Plumbing! As a Senior, I can assure you, they will give you a reasonable price and their workmanship excellent!   A great Company!

reviews.author: Leslie Hart -Hair
reviews.text: We have called on Solution Plumbing twice now and have been more than pleased on both occasions. Our service provider Joey arrived the same day we placed our call for water leaking from a hot water heater. He quickly assessed what was wrong. He offered options including the costs and expected longevity of our choices.  His work was thorough, explained fully to us and the price was very reasonable. We will continue to rely on Solution Plumbing for any plumbing issue in the future.

reviews.author: Nintenja Master
reviews.text:
Gave me a time for arrival. When the end of that window drew near I had to call to get an update. Was told they were finishing up and would be there in 45 minutes. 2.5 hours later I called and, asked what was going on. Seemed irritated and said they would be there in 45 minutes. Never showed up or called.

I get it if you have a rough day but communication is important.

Reasonable price,  knowledgeable, on time.  Solution Plumbing will be in my contacts for any plumbing problem!

We met many hurdles during the project, however, we resolved this hurdles in the most amicable manner. Their plumbers, in particular, Mr. Ben Hambrick, Mr. Lee Pennington and Mr. Hap Warren are awesome! They are thorough with an excellent knowledge of plumbing. They do not take any shortcuts and finish the job the right way. I was recommended this company by my neighbor who got a big sewer job done from this company, and she had very similar experience. I have no hesitancy in recommending this company for your project (big or small). Good Luck with your project!

Ben from EPW reviewed our drain line replacement project. Our casita emptied into main drain at 3 separate spots and the main house into another all together.  No other company I spoke with had figured this out.  I know if we had gone with another company, we could have had a plumbing mess on our hands. EPW was meticulous along the way to make sure each system was connected appropriately.  The repipe also went smoothly - no more rusty water or exposed pipes!!  Thanks a million.  They also offered good follow-up services when I had questions.  We will be life long customers!

reviews.text: Tri-Cities plumbing solutions have been my solution for every plumbing problem for the last 12 years. He is not only good at what he does he's honest as the day is long. And I can guarantee you his prices are more than fair. Nobody but James and his crew touch my pipes.

plumbers.name: Flow-Pro Plumbing, LLC
plumbers.address: 214 Azalea Square Blvd, Summerville, SC 29483, USA

reviews.author: Hana Hilal
reviews.text: Neal did all the plumbing for my home downtown which was a full construction job. He did an amazing job no issues and I’ve been in my home 3 years now. Very experienced! Even if it’s just declogging a drain. His pricing can’t be beat!

reviews.author: John Ticknor
reviews.text:
Working with Neal was incredible from start to finish, the word 'Pro' is in the name and it shows. He was an absolute professional in every way possible. He was communicative, on time, up front about the work, and transparent with pricing.

Neal installed a new water heater, replaced a broken hose bib, and repaired a cracked irrigation system pipe in an afternoon and I couldn't be more pleased with his work. I'll be referring all my friends to him for any type of work, and will absolutely call him again for any future needs. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Eric Hubrich
reviews.text: Neal came out yesterday and replaced my water heater. He was professional, personable, and insisted on top quality work. I had the pleasure of his company as he worked and discovered that he has and will continue to refuse work where a low standard is requested or expected. His work when completed was extremely well done. I don't know about you, but these are the results I want and he is the plumber I want to do work for me.

reviews.author: moth Gunnells
reviews.text: Neal with Flow Pro Plumbing unclogged my kitchen sink . He was very professional and his customer service is awesome. I had 2 plumbers come out prior to his visit and they said I would have to get the lines jetted for $1000.00. He unclogged my sink in the first 30 min and did not over charge . He also gave me advice on how to keep it clear . He will be the first person I call in the future.

reviews.author: Caryl Hickel
reviews.text: Neal provided outstanding, professional service, kept me informed of what was happening, and completed all work in a timely manner, including an additional job that I requested at the last minute. This service was particularly helpful because I was arranging it remotely from 500 miles away for my sister who knows nothing about plumbing issues. Neal was very professional and courteous with my sister as well. On top of all that, he was also reasonably priced for the services provided. I can't recommend him highly enough.

plumbers.name: Drain & Heating Solutions
plumbers.address: 5 Sullivan St, Burlington, MA 01803, USA

reviews.author: Maya Abramson
reviews.text: Adding more fabulous reviews for Eddie from plumbing and heating solutions as he called me a few times to coordinate service, and came on  Saturday to help me out ! Can’t say enough about Eddie ! He is so kind, knowledgeable, trustworthy and goes out of his way to help and assist … Eddie also  came to help me find the serial number of my garbage disposal in case it breaks! As I saw people write: ‘Eddie is your man’ and he deserves all the praise in the world.

reviews.author: Kate Hendrix
reviews.text: Excellent service, knowledgable, and trustworthy. Eddie was kind enough to come check out an outdoor drain that’s been backing up & to give me a tutorial on the full system, potential courses of action, and pros and cons, including what he would do if it were his own home—all for no charge and on the same day I contacted him. Professional, on time, kind, and funny too! Will absolutely call him again for any plumbing needs & highly recommend him to others.

reviews.author: Jerold Gelfand
reviews.text: Eddie just finished replacing a faucet on our bathroom sink. The project was not straight forward and required a skilled plumber to work through challenging obstacles. Eddie is very talented and stayed within the quoted budget. On top of that, he is thoughtful and a pleasure to speak to. I will definitely be calling Eddie again the next time we have any plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Jen Breen
reviews.text: The best experience I've ever had hiring a plumber. The owner, Eddie, was warm, kind, and friendly. His assistant, Simon, did a wonderful job replacing my garbage disposal and master bathroom faucet. Prices for labor were more than fair, and I appreciated him reaching out to me to confirm before the appointment. He really does care about his customers, and it shows. Will definitely hire him and his company again for future projects!

reviews.author: Tao Pan
reviews.text:
Eddie was able to fix a very tough blockage of our bathroom sink. I know this is a hard thing to fix because my husband who is extremely handy failed to fix it. My husband pushed a 25ft snake all the way out and couldn't find the blockage. And our sink which was never clogged for the 12 years we lived here was completely blocked overnight.
Eddie was able to clear it for us with a trick here and there. He is also a very pleasant person to talk to.
Compared to those corporate like companies, he also only charged a very small price for his good work.

plumbers.name: All Family Plumbing And Remodeling
plumbers.address: 321 Cary Point Dr, Cary, IL 60013, USA

reviews.author: Lisa Lonigro
reviews.text: John and his crew were great! My sewer line was full of roots and starting to back up into my house. The company that I had been using for the last 3 years refused to come out because they said I didn't live in a convenient enough location for them to continue to service me. Then I was in a bind, but John talked to me, I explained my situation and how the other company kept me waiting almost 3 weeks and then refused to come. John came the next day to help me out. He did a wonderful job and now I have peace of mind and no more sewer back up. They were quick and efficient and very helpful. They even checked my water heater for me because it was turned up to high, so they turned it down to a safer level for me for no charge. He has a new customer in me. Thanks All Family Plumbing!

reviews.author: Kathrine Clarke
reviews.text: Amazing service! We called Thursday evening and they were able to send someone Friday morning. The plumbers (Don and Shawn) were so helpful, clean, and determined to find the problem. They stayed calm and kept great humor throughout the call. The service operators were super nice and friendly too.

reviews.author: Mark Paulsen
reviews.text:
I recently had a water spigot installed (Aquor Water Systems V2) in my backyard by All Family Plumbing, and I couldn't be more pleased with the service! From start to finish, the experience was exceptional. They were prompt, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable.

The installation itself was seamless, they worked efficiently, and they left no mess behind. The new spigot functions perfectly, and the quality of the work is evident. It’s clear that All Family Plumbing takes pride in their craft and strives for customer satisfaction.

I highly recommend All Family Plumbing for any plumbing needs. Their skill, reliability, and outstanding service truly deserve five stars. Thank you for a job well done!

reviews.author: N E
reviews.text: I have used All Family Plumbing for years, they always do a stellar job. One time they came to the house because I had a problem with my kitchen faucet - turns out it was a loose screw, literally. 🤦🏻‍♀️ They refused to charge me! Another time the owner, John, replaced the piping under my kitchen sink . For years I’d had problems with the pipes coming loose and leaking due to the way the original pipes were placed. John reworked the piping and told me if I ever have a problem again he’d fix it for free. That was 10 years ago. Love these guys!

reviews.author: Eric Thrasher
reviews.text: Our gratitude to John and All Family Plumbing And Remodeling cannot be overstated. When we experienced a major water line issue in our home late this evening, they responded promptly and professionally. Their expertise and dedication were second to none, and they quickly diagnosed and resolved the problem to ensure our main water supply was restored for everyone in the house. Their dedication to customer satisfaction was truly remarkable. We highly recommend  John and All Family Plumbing And Remodeling for all plumbing needs, as they provided excellent service during our major water line issue.

plumbers.name: Adams Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 3333 TX-351, Abilene, TX 79601, USA

reviews.author: Becky “Becky Hooker” Smith
reviews.text: We had the BEST experience with Adam's and we won't ever go back to who we were using, or anyone else. We are 100% happy with our experience and would recommend Rick and his crew over and over. Great people.

reviews.author: Doug Hickson
reviews.text: We have used Adams plumbing for over 4 years now how our residential and commercial needs. They have always been more than fair in pricing and always top quality workmanship. Customer service and professionalism has been above 5 star each and every time.

reviews.author: Tony
reviews.text: I had called adams plumbing for a burst pipe after this recent freeze. They were very prompt, fair with the price and did good work. What I appreciate above all else was they called to tell me they broke a pipe while fixing the burst one and fixed it free of charge, thats honest and professional. They could easily of just said they found another broken pipe and charged me but they didn't, I will recommend adams plumbing to anyone and will happily do business with them again.

reviews.author: Megan Hutchison
reviews.text: These guys go above and beyond! Fast, kind, trustworthy and knowledgeable. Five stars honestly isn't enough!

reviews.author: Pennilisa Esquivel
reviews.text: I used Adam's plumbing a few days ago. Not only was everyone super friendly they answered all of my questions and made me feel so comfortable. Great customer service. Fast appointments.  Speedy service! I would definitely recommend!

plumbers.name: Callahan Plumbing & Electric
plumbers.address: 1235 Humbracht Cir, Bartlett, IL 60103, USA

reviews.author: Kevin wantroba
reviews.text: Charlie and the team did an extremely thorough job when fixing the backup in our sewer. They identified the blockage with a camera and made sure it was all flushed out. They answered all my questions and gave me updates on their progress the entire time. It doesn’t get any better than Callahan Plumbing and I highly recommend them. Thanks again!!

reviews.author: A B
reviews.text:
What can I say that is not redundant of what you have read on these reviews for Callahan Plumbing...

Outstanding!  Incredible!  Life and House Saviors!  Dan and crew are outstanding!  They have replaced my water heater and sump pump at different times.  They are proficient, on-time, unbelievably knowledgeable and extremely fair when it comes to cost.  They are very family oriented and great ppl!

reviews.author: David Hornor
reviews.text:
When you’re searching for a plumber, what do you look for?
I was looking for a local family-owned business because I like to support the small business owners in my community.  Next, I wanted a quick response from a tradesman who could provide quality work at reasonable prices.  Finally, I wanted someone who would show up when they say, do the work they quoted, and complete the work with no add on expenses.  Sounds like too much to hope for doesn’t it.
Wow, did we hit the jackpot with Callahan Plumbing.  All the above, and more.  From the first call asking for a quote on our kitchen remodel project, to the final visit to connect the sinks and faucets, Dan was great.  He was always on time, extremely polite, and totally professional.  His work reflected a philosophy that our home was respected as if it was his own.
Without question, we will call Callahan Plumbing for any and all our future plumbing work and encourage you to do the same.  Your trust will be well placed and your money well spent.
As stated on his truck, “We get it right the first time”.

reviews.author: Stephen Vitello
reviews.text: When you have a sump pump problem, it's usually an emergency.  Callahan Plumbing understood and they were here an hour after I called them.  Dan Callahan and Gary assessed the issue, explained what they needed to do to get things right, gave me a fair quote on the job before they started and were done in 45 minutes from arriving.  This was a great save with a great local company.

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.text: My mom and I needed a toilet fixed and a shower unclogged. Dan and Richard arrived 10 minutes before the arrival window which was nice. Dan is very intelligent and personable. He explained in great detail what he needed to do to fix the toilet as well as the cost associated with the service. He also looked at the shower and said it was in fact not clogged. I appreciate that he didn’t try to fix something that wasn’t broken just to make the extra money. Highly recommend Dan and will be using him in the future!

plumbers.name: Lee Whiteaker Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2100 Co Rd 152, Georgetown, TX 78626, USA

reviews.author: Vito F
reviews.text:
I can't believe I hadn't reviewed these guys yet after all of the good work they've done for us in the last two years. I really enjoy working with RC. He's been to our house multiple times, both for bathroom remodel projects that included tub/toilet replacements, and water heater replacement. I've worked with lots of contractors, and they are one of the few that I've worked with that I trust, and consistently offer the best combination of service and pricing. No high pressure upsell's or doom and gloom stories about your plumbing; just honest dialogue about the best options for your specific situation.

More recently Mason came by to replace our water heater. He was on-time, polite, knowledgeable, and did good work replacing our water heater. I checked in throughout the job, and noticed that cleaned as he worked, leaving everything in better shape than it was when he got there. Great communication throughout the process.

I can't talk this company up enough, you can trust Whiteaker Plumbing for your home plumbing needs.

reviews.author: H Smith
reviews.text: Excellent service by Mason at Whiteaker Plumbing.  Honest, clear reasonable pricing, good communication.  He was on time, cleaned up even in my garage and did a great job.  Explained everything to me. They will be my go to plumbers in the future.

reviews.author: craig lewandowski
reviews.text: I would definitely recommend Whiteaker Plumbing.  Mason the plumber was very personable & explained how things worked as he went along.  He took special care to make sure everything was fine until the next day when the final hookup would be made. He cleaned up after the job & went out of his  way to get the part we were missing for  one of the jobs.  Thanks to RC for recommending a countertop man or this job wouldn't have been possible.

reviews.author: Silverhawk
reviews.text: RC came out the day of my pipe breaking. He repaired it quickly and did an outstanding job. Thank you RC for your professionalism and expertise. This is the second time I have used Whiteaker Plumbing in 3 years and RC did both jobs with a 5 star service. I will be calling again the next time I needs plumbing work.

reviews.author: Barbara Colvin
reviews.text: I have used RC Walker with Whitaker Plumbing personally off and on for years. Whitaker Plumbing is on my referral list for my real estate clients when they ask for a plumber. The service is top notch and they are reasonable in prices. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Darek Koczwara
reviews.text: Mark has done several plumbing projects for me in the past  ranging from replacing water heater to remodeling kitchens and bathrooms. Very professional and timely service, we pass all inspections the first time. His crew is very knowledgeable and clean, I strongly recommend this plumber for any size job.

reviews.author: Alexandria Danzy
reviews.text: Retro plumbing inc has sent skilled plumber really fast. their pipe repair was very quick clean and reliable. Great service I will be recommending to anyone .

reviews.author: Kashayla Bowens
reviews.text: Retro plumbing inc fixed a small leak under our sink in glenview, quick visit and no mess left behind ,exactly what we needed.

reviews.author: Daniel Heger
reviews.text: This plumbing service exceeded my expectations. They repaired a burst pipe, checked the entire system, and left me confident that my home's plumbing is finally in reliable working order again.

reviews.author: Paul Morton
reviews.text: This plumber did a amazing job fixing my pipes! The service was fast,professional,  and affordable. Highly recommended!

plumbers.name: Liberty Plumbing
plumbers.address: 4264 Entre Ct #D, Chantilly, VA 20151, USA

reviews.author: Justin Steverson
reviews.text: The plumber that was sent was very professional, friendly, knowledgeable, and fixed the problem. We used Liberty on two different occasions, and both services were very reasonably priced. We will definitely use them again, and I would also recommend them.

reviews.author: Matthew Brennan
reviews.text: I had something backing up my lateral sewer line between my house to the street, causing a sewer clog backing up to my house. I called Liberty on a Friday evening and they mobilized that evening to attempt to clear my sewer (thank you!). Unfortunately it wasn’t that simple but Liberty and their professional techs identified the location of the clog (a piece of PVC) and came up with a plan to remove and replace it. They were transparent, competent, and timely, and they fixed my sewer. This was a month ago and everything is running smoothly. I highly recommend this company. Their staff who worked at my house were top notch!

reviews.author: Rahim Johnson
reviews.text: Very professional and great customer service. The technician Todd was very knowledgeable and friendly. I really appreciate his honesty on the situation. I will definitely be calling Liberty back upon any other issues.

reviews.author: Jay Conklin
reviews.text: Friendly, easy to reach and schedule an appointment. Plumber came out, assessed the situation and came up with a good solution to our broken toilet flange (which was more complicated than normal). Liberty was recommended to us from someone within our community and glad we went with them.

reviews.author: Amorette Gwynn
reviews.text: Liberty Plumbing worked with me on an emergency plumbing problem recently and they went above and beyond. My husband and I actually needed to leave town so he could get some medical care and they worked with me to take care of the job when we were away. They quickly worked to schedule a time to come to our house when someone could be there (leaving me to focus on my husband), quickly took care of the problem and simply provided the best customer service I have experienced in a very long time from service providers. I rarely make recommendations and would recommend them without hesitation.

plumbers.name: Monkey Wrench Plumbing, Sewer & Drain
plumbers.address: 6928 S Jefferson Cir, West Jordan, UT 84084, USA

reviews.author: Alexis Moon
reviews.text: I’m not sure if this company just replaces equipment? We called because our pilot light wouldn’t stay on in our water heater. The gentlemen who came out didn’t even touch our water heater…he said “it needs to be replaced.” My husband told him that he had looked up that it could be the thermocouple and he said well “if I touch it, it will cost you $190.” Well, it was the thermocouple which is $10! So just a word of caution if you think something is broken and can be easily fixed call a handyman not this place.

reviews.author: Kyle Malmstrom
reviews.text: When looking for a plumber you can trust. Call Monkey Wrench Plumbing. The best in the business…. Ask for Kyle, beer disappoints.

reviews.author: Shandon Robertson
reviews.text: Carlos was incredibly professional, kind, and upfront and honest. He completed the work on the same day and showed me his work, explaining what had been done and what would be done next. I highly recommend Monkey Wrench and will definitely be using them again, requesting Carlos’s services once more. Thanks!

reviews.author: Joanna Larson
reviews.text: Love Monkey Wrench! Great communication, personable technicians , quality work. 5 stars!

reviews.author: Carly
reviews.text: Wes did a wonderful job installing my sink! He let me know when he was arriving and finished fairly quickly. Very professional and would recommend to others and will use for future projects! Thanks so much!

plumbers.name: Allstar Pro Services
plumbers.address: 25851 Walter Lee Dr, Athens, AL 35613, USA

reviews.author: Paige Ott
reviews.text: Allstar Pro Services did an excellent job installing my new hot water heater. They were on time, professional, and extremely knowledgeable. They were most importantly QUICK. The installation was done right the first time, with no problems two weeks later. I’ll definitely be using Allstar Pro Services again and recommending them to friends and family!!!!

reviews.author: Rhonda Newton
reviews.text: My tankless hot water heater was not working, I called at 8 am and had a response from Lance, the technician 15 minutes later on a Sunday morning.  He was able to come out in around an hour and quickly isolated the issue and had it fixed within 10 minutes.  He also took the time to explain what happened and what I should look for and do if it happened again.  Highly recommend this company and Lance, very prompt, professional and proficient service!

reviews.author: Sunrise Gervais
reviews.text: Called early today about a blocked drain line and within an hour Zach showed up and troubleshooted the issue. Unfortunately for me and this ole downtown Athens Historic home, we have more than a simple drain fix.  He gave me options that helped me determine what to do next. Most importantly he was HONEST..I say this after getting another company (George’s) to give me a quote and let me tell you they were way outta the ballpark and didn’t offer the same solution. Because I’ve done plumbing and have unblocked lines before personally I knew Zach was being upfront. Thanks AllStar for providing reasonably priced honest and quick service! Thank you Zach!

reviews.author: Angel Cook
reviews.text: Called Allstar for help when I noticed my slab floor was unusually warm. Jack came out and recommended a third party to detect the exact location before he just started in tearing up floors. He came back as soon as we got our report and had the slab leak fixed quickly and efficiently. They are fair and honest! Will definitely use them for all our plumbing needs. Highly recommend Allstar!

reviews.author: Gracie Green
reviews.text:
Would not recommend, hands down one of the worst professional experiences I've had. We hired all-star to do a tub/shower replacement and they completely installed an incorrect unit (wrong style and wrong size). When I informed them of the mistake I was basically told it was my fault and they only agreed to fix their mistake because I had text messages showing where we clearly communicated the unit we wanted/needed with the technician. It took a month for them to come back and replace the tub/shower and they left a hole in my brand new shower walls that I now have to fix to prevent water from getting into my wall. Save yourself the headache and call someone else for plumbing services.

Edited 7/21/25
Updating this review and improving the rating from 1 star to 3 stars. After the folks of All-Star Pro Services read my above review they called and asked for an opportunity to fix their mistakes and they were more willing to fix their mistakes this time around rather than trying to play the blame game. They sent in a team from their sister company All-Star plumbing and we were very pleased with the level of professionalism and the quality of the job. Still disappointed that a job that should've taken 1 visit took 3 and that my bathroom was a construction zone for 2 months but I do appreciate that the company had enough integrity to make sure the job was done right no matter how many attempts it took.

plumbers.name: Butcher Plumbing llc
plumbers.address: 706 W Main St, Grafton, WV 26354, USA

reviews.author: James Smith
reviews.text: Honest, reliable, knowledgeable, and fair prices. But the most impressive things about Craig are his communication skills, his empathy, and the respect that he gives. I’m a disabled veteran who has a couple of disabilities that most people have never heard of or can imagine. Without any hesitation, Craig showed consideration, respect, and willingness to get the job done while providing all of the accommodations towards me because of my disabilities. Craig has my full respect and trust.

reviews.author: WRP WRP
reviews.text:
Will never call another plumber again! I’ve been through all the plumbers, small and big companies around NCWV and they’re either over priced ( charging me for just coming out?!!! Why is this common practice? Like to see how people would react if doctors charged you for just showing up to their office)
Not only are the prices more than fair, Craig and his guys are extremely personable, knowledgeable, and professional. Explaining everything along the way until the job was done. Amazing work ethic as well as being nice and kind people. They can handle small and bug messy jobs. We had a really nasty messy job that only a real plumber could handle. I can’t say enough how grateful our family was to find them. We didnt mind paying the money because the job was big but they did not take advantage of our situation. Top notch and just a classy group of guys! Dont call anyone else!

reviews.author: Sarah Casteel
reviews.text: Guys are very nice!! First time we called for a suspected plumbing clog. It wasn't a clog, we needed our septic drained so they didn't charge us the full $200 service charge. Second time we called we thought we had a water leak under our house; we did not have a leak under our house so they didn't charge us anything. Will definitely be calling these guys back for any plumbing issues in the future and CANNOT recommend them enough! 100% family owned and operated!

reviews.author: Shane Snodgrass
reviews.text: Outside sewer line replacement. Craig and Duane were very professional, and very reasonable price wise. They kept me informed and showed me progress along the way. Any issues that came up, they would stop and immediately tell me, and there were a few, not any fault of theirs. I plan on having other plumbing work done and will use again. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jeremy Marcum
reviews.text: We used Butcher a while back to replace some valves in the house and clear a sink. Very nice and professional! Having them out again today for a separate issue.

plumbers.name: New Image Plumbing & Rooter
plumbers.address: 1527 E Washington Blvd, Pasadena, CA 91104, USA

reviews.author: nataya mn
reviews.text:
Exceptional service from New Image Plumbing. We faced a sudden flood at 5:30 PM, and Pierre managed to have everything under control and repaired within the hour. The turnaround time was impressive, and the quality of work was spotless.
What truly stood out was his professional guidance; Pierre took the time to clearly explain the situation, identifying what required immediate action and what could wait. Even for an after-hours call-out, his pricing was incredibly fair and transparent. Truly a seamless and stress-free experience during a chaotic situation. Pierre is a true professional.

reviews.author: Natasha Chu
reviews.text:
I wish Google would let me give 10 stars for New Image Plumbing & Rooter. I almost never write reviews, but they truly earned this one.

We had a sewage backup at our commercial office — easily one of the worst types of surprises — and they were onsite in under 2 hours from my call. That alone was a huge relief.

Pierre, the owner, showed up himself. He was incredibly friendly, straightforward, and easy to communicate with. While his technician handled the repair quickly, Pierre walked me through what was happening and provided transparent pricing before every step. They ended up snaking both the main sewage line outside and the bathroom drain pipe.

And here’s the part that really stood out: it was late on a Friday, the building janitor was unavailable, and we were left with a mess to clean. Without me even asking, Pierre stayed and helped me mop and clean the two bathrooms and the lobby. No complaints, no rushing — he just genuinely cared about helping us get the space back to normal. I’ve never seen a contractor go that far for a client.

A situation that could’ve been incredibly stressful ended up feeling manageable because of how much effort and care he put in.

If you want a plumbing team that’s responsive, professional, and sincerely invested in helping their customers, I highly recommend New Image Plumbing & Rooter. Huge thank you to Pierre and the team!

You’re officially our go-to plumber from now on!

reviews.author: Johanna Kammerer
reviews.text: I'm so glad I found this local company! They were able to come out the same day after I called in a panic since we had no hot water. They replaced an old/dysfunctional water heater with a tankless system the next day. Also noticed some old pipes that were leaking that they repaired. Amazing customer service from the office staff to all of the team- Pierre, Refugio, Pedro and Pedro have all been super nice, trustworthy and do good work. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: John Michael Higgins
reviews.text:
The service experience I had with New Image Plumbing was exemplary in every detail.  From my initial call to New I mage all the way through to completion and payment, the experience was expert, pleasant, honest, dignified — even friendly and amusing.
It goes without saying that the team fixed my problem perfectly and set me up for even better plumbing in my future.
I had an emergency plumbing failure, a back-up that was caused by a damaged line to the city.  From my initial call to Tina, ON A SUNDAY  NIGHT, to my initial assessment with George (about whom I cannot summon enough praise—I consider it an honor to have met him, quite apart from any plumbing problem I may have had).  That goes for the rest of his whole staff as well.
Hiring New Image was the smartest thing I have ever done for my home maintenance and my real estate investment.
The job was a big one, and so was their success in setting it right.
I recommend New Image in the highest terms and without a single qualification.  A big Thank You, to the whole superb team.

reviews.author: Michael Brown
reviews.text: When my wife and I purchased our new home in February 2024, we knew it would be costly to renovate the home, since nothing had been done to it since it was built. NIP came out, provided a quote, even gave me style options and recommendations for the vision we had. We were worried about cost but NIP helped us from A to Z, not only identifying areas we could adjust to make our budget, but they completed everything way faster than expected. Our contractors couldn't even keep up because NIP was so fast and efficient lol. Our place looks amazing to us and our guest, we've had no issues, no call backs, and have recommended NIC to multiple friends and family since. Everyone has been satisfied. Thank you so much NIC we will for sure call you for any future plumbing request.

plumbers.name: Barkley Plumbing Contractors
plumbers.address: 1346 Bolte Rd SE, Cullman, AL 35055, USA

reviews.author: Cecily Miner
reviews.text:
We are so thankful for Barkley Plumbing Contractors. When you find someone who is not only great at what they do but also genuinely good people — you hold onto them.

They’ve always been dependable, honest, and fair. No pressure, no upselling — just solid work done the right way. You can tell they take pride in their craft and truly care about the families and businesses they serve.

It’s hard to find contractors you can trust, and Barkley is absolutely one of those rare ones. They show up, they communicate, and they get the job done well. We’ve felt completely taken care of every time.

If you need plumbing work done and want someone reliable who treats you like more than just another job, call Barkley Plumbing Contractors. Grateful to call them friends and our go-to plumbers. 💛

reviews.author: Donovan Wilson
reviews.text: I contacted seven plumbing companies for quotes and they were the only people to respond promptly with a fair price. Good communication, good price, and good work completed in one day.

reviews.author: Alan Rudicil
reviews.text: I would first say to anyone reading the reviews to really look at all the critical reviews and ask if you want to be that customer.  My experience is that Barkley Plumbing was called by me to come out and fix a leaking shower head that would not turn off.  4 workers came to my home and completed the repairs in approximately 15 mins. All that was needed was a Delta Shower Cartridge, yet I received a bill in the mail, (not at the time of service, and never got any price info from the workers- that should have been my red flag) several weeks later for $410.00.  Materials - 200.00 for parts that included, a shower cartridge, fill valve and flapper, then 210.00 for labor. Upon receiving this puzzling bill, I responded asking how they came up with this amount, let alone how a fill valve and flapper work in a shower? In my initial response, I did say I would pay as soon as Barkley Plumbing could answer my questions and send me an itemized bill with the breakdown and how they came to the amount of labor that they were charging. I then got a revised invoice that changed the labor to 135.00, and the same materials were now 127.00 that included the cartridge, fill valve and flapper, and still no response as to how the fill valve and flapper work on a shower. For 9 months I received a bill asking me to pay and I would reply, yet they would not respond to my simple question about how those two parts work on a shower head. Finally after 9 months, I sent an email stating that this would be my final attempt to settle this and would be happy to pay, but it was my final attempt, only then did I get a reply that they would take off the charges for parts that do not fit on a shower, but on a toilet (that was never called about nor worked on) and in this reply, I was threatened with a collection agency if I did not pay. Well, I paid, and now I am just giving a friendly heads up to those that are searching for an honest plumbing company, look elsewhere, Bark-ley Plumbing is not it. It is not just me who has had this sort of experience, once is a mistake but several is a scam. The 4 workers that showed up? They were nice and professional and were in and out with a completed job. It is the billing and communication that I warn potential customers about. My documented experience is still considering the BBB.

reviews.author: Taylor B.
reviews.text:
Take your money elsewhere. Don't get me wrong, they did a good job. They were prompt to get here and they did work fast to compete the job in a timely manor. When I asked the man on site what the charges would be so I could pay for their services, he said he didn't have any tickets on him and didn't know how much it would cost so they would send a bill in the mail.

When the bill came in the mail I was in shock at the price. I called to ask how they come up with their price for service and I got the run around. They don't charge by the hour nor do they charge by the job. I guess they make it up as they go.

Not to mention charging me for parts and materials that they bill to the gas company that I have to pay there. Yes, the materials are billed to me from the gas company. So for their parts and materials I have to pay for them twice on top of their insane labor cost.

I don't mind paying someone a fair price for their services. I would like to keep my arm and leg that they are charging though.

reviews.author: David Hudson
reviews.text:
The 2 times I have used this company, they have been on time and done great work, at prices that were probably comparable to other companies.

Ordinarily, I would give at least a 4-star review. But I'm giving a 1-star review now because I've been waiting a little over 3 weeks just to talk to someone about a plumbing issue at a rental property I own. I have called each week and talked with a lady at the office, and she tells me they are really busy but that she will tell them to call me soon as they can.

The plumbing issue isn't urgent, but I need a 5 minute conversation with someone who does the actual plumbing work, to help determine what my options are. I explained that to the lady I spoke with.... that for now, I only need a short 5 minute or less conversation so I can give at least some kind of response to my tenant about what's going to happen next (and hopefully an idea of when).

All I get are excuses about how busy they are. After 3 weeks of trying and waiting, I'm no longer buying the idea that any plumbing company is so busy they can't find the time to have a 5 minute phone conversation with an existing customer.

reviews.author: Eric Curtis
reviews.text:
A rental main septic line was backed up.  Carnahan's snaked the line from inside the house all the way to the septic tank and left.  There was no improvement and they came back the next day to snake from the septic tank all the way into the house and left.  He provided a 25% discounted rate for the second snaking.  Sill no improvement so we brought in another vendor.  They snaked the line and were unable to get all the way through.  A camera showed a root ball blocking most of the pipe as well as a significant blockage 2/3 of the way from the septic line.  The line was hydrojetted and the hydro cleared the root ball (about the size of a softball) but was unable to get past the second blockage.  The line was dug up and an 18" section of 4" clay pipe was found to be mostly full with cement (leaving about 1 3/4" opening in the clay pipe).

It's possibly an artifact of how snaking is done, but I'm surprised the snaking was considered successful and made it past the blockage.  I'm leaving 2 stars - 1 for quick response (same day of call), and one more star for being polite when I called to provide this feedback.

For a quick fix, Carnahan Drain Cleaning might work for you.  But in my case they were unable to fix the problem, assumed twice it was fixed, and I was charged twice despite there being no way it could have been fixed.
