reviews.author: Amy Liu
reviews.text:
I had the worst experience with this company. They sent a technician to our house for an estimate for air duct cleaning. The technician was extremely aggressive and pushy, moving my furniture without my consent to find the vents. He forced me to call my husband (who was at work) twice to sell his service. He unscrewed the metal grille on the ceiling and left it hanging while doing all these, and then, while he was measuring the size of the grille, still having it hanging up there, the grille fell on my cabinet top and caused a dent!  Then, he was not apologetic by saying it was not his fault!!

I dislike people who fail to take responsibility. I called the company complaining about this, and the company promised $50 for the damage repair. It was not enough, but I was fed up with it and agreed. And you guessed it, the money never came!

reviews.author: suzanne mack
reviews.text: I recently used ATC for some plumbing issues I had and I was very impressed and excited to find someone I can trust.  The person who came out was named TJ and he was prompt, efficient and incredibly knowledgeable. Most of all the price was very, very reasonable. I would highly recommend them and intend to use them in the future.!

reviews.author: bareyb
reviews.text:
Easiest repair experience I’ve ever had!

Called our friend Marianne who manages some properties for us over at Hill & Company and asked her who she uses for heating and cooling (Property Managers always have the best people) and she gave me the number for ATC.

This was a little before Noon. By 1 PM Dylan from ATC was at my door and by 2:30 he was done and we were back up and running. The pice was extremely reasonable too! I couldn’t be happier. This was by far the fastest and easiest repair experience I have ever had.

reviews.author: Radu Gabu
reviews.text:
We used them several times for hvac and plumbing. Prices are 1-2 stars (sky high); work on plumbing is 5 star. Work on hvac 3 stars.
On hvac: they came in several times, misdiagnosed the issue; then finally called the manufacturer. They should have done that day 1. Worst of all, charged us for all
times they came out, so for all their incompetence.
On drainage: all good work.
On fixing a pipe: took them 6 (!) hrs to fix a   fracture on the water main coming in the house. Main was made of pvc. And charged $145/hr for it. At $145/hr you fix a broken pipe muuuch faster.
Maybe many plumbers are the same, but I cannot believe that every homeowner around the peninsula can fork out $1000 for a small pipe break!

reviews.author: Nate Gaylinn
reviews.text: Tim is the best repairman we've found for A/C, furnace, and plumbing issues. He's particularly good at giving very detailed and easy to understand explanations for what he sees and the work he wants to do. This makes it much easier to trust that he knows his stuff and is doing the right things. He's also very observant and proactive. Last visit, he noticed and trivially fixed something unrelated to the main visit which I was going to ask him about, before I got the chance to bring it up. He's the best! I trust and depend on him.

reviews.text: I’ve used Young’s  Plumbing for 20 years. Now with a new name, LALONDE COOLING, HEATING AND PLUMBING, same great people and same phone number!  Chris Robinson has taken care of my plumbing and air conditioning for years. He and his team are so knowledgeable and are some good people! Will continue to call upon them for the future. Good news! reviews.author: David Tallent
reviews.text:
I Have used this company for over 20 years for my plumbing issues at my house.
For the longest time it was a flat $100 to unclog main drain then went to $125 last couple times I used them.
I called for service to unclog slowly drain line
The guys came out unclogged line in 30 minutes then kept walking back and forth and messing with machine for unknown reasons
I thought nothing of it an waited in house
When they finally brought me the invoice it was $257 for a simple drain unclog .
Apparently now they charge $150 an hour plus a $30 machine fee, so they going to milk it for as long as they can .
That’s how they operate now…
It doesn’t benefit to use local anymore .
I will never use them again and TOLD THEM SO .
Please, Call anyone but Young’s Plumbing.
Don’t get ripped off by this company .

**Years ago ,My father said
never hire someone to do a job by the hour, you will get screwed every time. **

reviews.author: Earl Aguas-Alzner
reviews.text: I have a problem with my kitchen sink not draining properly. I called Young Plumbing on Monday. Told them the problem, and that I had already tried to snake the drain myself. They told me that they would had an opening for after lunch on Tuesday. I said okay. They didn't arrive until 4:05 PM. They brought their snake machine in for the kitchen sink. I had also said that there was a problem with my bathroom sink being a slow drain. The person on the phone said that they charged by the hour, and to bring up the sink and any other issues while they were here. I did. He fixed the slow drain in the bathroom sink. It was just dirty. I also had him look at my toilet not flushing the way that I thought it should, he told me that he didn't like the aftermarket handle mechanisms. He just changed it without asking. Now the kitchen sink I was just told that there is mud in it and that was all. No further trouble shooting, no estimations, nothing. They were gone by 4:40. Charged me for the whole hour, plus the flushing mechanism that I didn't ask for and the snake machine. $180 later and my sink wasn't put back together ( I had taken it apart myself ), he even said that he didn't like the plumbing drain pieces that I had under the kitchen sink. So nothing truly fixed, no estimations, no trouble shooting, here less than an hour but charged for the full hour. Won't be using these folks again.

reviews.author: Skye Grams
reviews.text:
This was one of the best home improvement experiences I’ve had.

From the beginning, Reservoir was transparent about pricing, warranty coverage, and exactly what to expect. There were no surprises, and every question was answered clearly before I made a decision.

The installation team was professional, knowledgeable, and meticulous. It was clear they knew the product inside and out, and the quality of the work and instruction they provided reflected that.

The heat pump water heater itself has exceeded expectations. It replaced a 20-year-old electric water heater and the difference was noticeable immediately. Hot water availability improved right away, even with multiple people using hot water at the same time and the app provides excellent visibility into system performance.

One feature I didn’t expect is the ability to monitor my well system’s water pressure through the app. It’s a simple but useful way to keep an eye on the health of the pressure tank and well pump.

Between the actually water heater, the installation, and the customer service, Reservoir delivered an outstanding experience from start to finish.

reviews.author: Jonathan Cohen
reviews.text:
I’ve had a great experience and can’t recommend them enough.

I knew nothing about water heaters before finding out I needed to replace mine. I found out about Reservoir through a connection to a current employee, and I pestered the team with a ton of questions about their product. I also price-shopped other water heaters and installation quotes.

I settled on switching from gas to a heat pump water heater for usage cost savings and energy savings. A big value of Reservoir is that they’re transparent about the all-in installation price. In contrast, getting quotes out of plumbers was a nightmare. It was a couple thousand dollars of labor for the ones who did get back to me, meaning the net upfront cost of a Reservoir is similar to or less than other HPWHs.

The installation team and support team were both very professional throughout the process. It was exciting to experience the instant water feature firsthand, and I’m looking forward to seeing the energy savings roll in.

reviews.author: Jason Turgeon
reviews.text:
I'm an early adopter of reservoir. I was in the market for a new water heater anyway, and I wanted a heat pump heater but was having a hard time justifying the cost. Reservoir is exactly the same price I was quoted for a dumb heat pump water heater, with some compelling bonus features.

First, it's a smart device in ways that are actually useful. It tells you water and energy use, has freeze and leak protection built in, and has a "party mode" for times when you have a crowd and don't mind sacrificing a little efficiency to make sure you have ample hot water.

Second, it comes with a hydronic pump that recirculates the hot water so you always have hot water (in practice, not full temp, but warm enough) mere seconds after you turn on the tap. I measured and it took about 90 seconds to get hit water at my kitchen sink with the old heater. It's only a few second now to get water warm enough to comfortably wash dishes or hands, and fully hot in 90 seconds.

Installation was very professional, the crew was great. Took about 5 hours including wiring and hauling out the old unit.  Looking forward to  using this for many years to come.

reviews.text: We had Reservoir Home install a smart water heater to replace our old electric hot water heater because we wanted something more efficient. The reservoir is definitely saving us money. It’s easy to use, but I appreciated how they walked me through setup and how to use the app. Definitely recommend.

reviews.text:
Second time I’ve used Ben and he was excellent again. I had a leaky hot-water connection to my washer and water was spraying everywhere (a DIY attempt made it worse). Ben immediately understood what was happening, gave me a quote on the spot, and the final price matched the quote exactly. He arrived right at 7:00am and fixed the issue quickly and professionally. He’s been a plumber for 15+ years and owns the company, so it’s great working directly with the owner/master plumber. Reasonable pricing, great communication, and quality work. Highly recommend.

1st review
Ben was fantastic. He was quick to respond, up front about his pricing and on-time. I was very impressed by his knowledge and his willingness to do a better than good job. Would I hire him again? Absolutely. A good guy, a good job, and good pricing. Just what you’re looking for in a plumber. And he cleaned up after himself!

reviews.author: CR Frazier
reviews.text: Our son just bought his first house and wouldn’t you know it, the first night we spent there, the sewer line backed up and overflowed. On a Sunday morning, we called Whitestone Plumbing. We randomly picked them because they were close and it looked like the owner was actually the person doing the work. In fact, Harley(Ben), the owner answered our call and said he would be there in less than 2 hours. Remember, this is Sunday morning. He arrived early, did not charge extra for a weekend call and quickly found the issue using state of the art equipment. He got us up and running quickly and scheduled a day to come back and fix the problem (roots in the sewer line). That was done just like he said he would and we didn’t even have to be there. Harley was very professional, did what he said he would do, when he said he would do it and we feel his prices were very fair. We are from a small town and have grown to expect this kind of service. We never expected to find this in a large metropolitan area, but that’s exactly what we got with Whitestone Plumbing. We highly recommend this business and will not hesitate to call again for our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Nemerow
reviews.text: This was the best experience I’ve ever had with a plumber. I accidentally broke my PRV valve while trying to adjust my home’s water pressure and found myself in a bind on a Sunday. Whitestone Plumbing responded quickly and arrived within an hour of my call. The plumber was knowledgeable, efficient, and fixed the issue right away. The pricing was very reasonable, and the service was outstanding. I highly recommend Whitestone Plumbing to anyone looking for a reliable, honest, and professional plumber.

reviews.author: Maxwell Spadafore
reviews.text:
Harley responded to my issue very quickly. He came on a Saturday and was there within just a couple hours of my original phone call. He was polite and professional, and got right to work fixing my water heater. He helped me to understand what was going wrong and how to avoid it in the future. It ended up being hard water buildup on my heating elements causing issues with my emergency switch shutting off the water heater and breakers tripping.

After a few days, I noticed the issue persisted, so I called him back. He came back same day and replaced the thermostat free of charge. That seemed to have done the trick. Very happy with my service. I highly recommend Harley and will be using him in the future for any other plumbing problems I have.

He also came upstairs to check the water and put covers on his shoes before he stepped on my carpet, which was a great touch!

When he quoted me the price I was honestly shocked. I have had this problem fixed once before and had to pay significantly more than the price that he quoted me. It was because of this price that I asked him to come look at some new construction that was going on in my house and have him quote me a price. Again his price was significantly lower than many plumbers I’d had over. I approved his quote and the work began the following workday.

Two days later my new construction that I’ve been dreading doing on my own was completed and the work was quality.
All of Jerrod’s plumbers that came to my house were respectable and enjoyable to be around. They answered all of my questions as quickly as they were able to find answers.

I have already recommended Jerrod with DNA plumbing to others, and will be recommending him to future clients as well.

Adam F. Davis

reviews.text:
Good Guys Sewer and Drain is a standout company

Their dedication to a positive customer experience is evident from the initial phone call.  They were  upfront about the cost of the service. And they came right out the same day .They were respectful of my home. They cleaned up after the job was finished. Their integrity is a major asset, as is their honesty and kindness.  I would definitely call them again. You would not be disappointed if you called them for any sewer drain issues you may be having. You can trust they will take care of you.

reviews.author: Justin Henry
reviews.text: The ultimate best and greates sewer company i have ever dealt with. Karl and Lyle are outstanding workers. We were provided with our options after they diagnosed the problem. And on top of it I got a great deal compared to other companies. We went with the hydro jet option and we were glad. I will always refer The Good Guys to anyone who has a problem. reviews.author: Scott
reviews.text: I had a clogged kitchen sink, I thought I could use a snake and do it myself.  It didn’t go so well the snake got stuck and twisted and wouldn’t come out. I called Charlie at The Good Guys sewer and drain. Charlie had the guys out right away the next day, inserting a camera to see what was going on. The outside drain pipe was frozen. I assisted with however I could with Charlie’s guys and was very much appreciated. My pipe was thawed using a hot steam machine and whoosh here comes the water. Everything was put back together properly and the snake pulled out with no force. 5 stars great service is what your looking for then call Charlie at The Good Guys sewer and drain.  Thanks Charlie and your crew.  Scott B

reviews.author: Fred strong
reviews.text: I had one guy over to replace my tankless water heater, and without really trying to trouble shoot at all, he just said, they are cheaper to replace than to fix and quoted me $2800. Mike came, and actually spent some time , looking up info on the model and found that it took 2 - 40 amp breakers and one double breaker  (which was unlabeled) was tripped/malfunctioning... Long story short, $225. He could have easily sold me a new water heater, but he did the right thing., I'll never call anyone else, he is honest and if he does not know, he finds out. He has integrity, and that is so rare in private contractors, (and he knows his rock and roll!).

reviews.author: Sum Lau
reviews.text:
Secondhand time hiring them!
Highly recommended

Hired them six years ago to replace a new sump pump.  called a few to get estimates, they were the only one that will use a real sump pump instead one of those that you can get from homedepot for the same price!

He showed up on time, took his time and explained what he was doing.  the funny thing is, he said that the backup sump pump/pipes were connected probably by a handyman man or homeowner.  when I asked him to install a new backup system he told me that he wont have time today as he has other appointment asked me to schedule another time

Upon him finished, he told me, he actually re-piped everything for me.  because he wanted to install it as a plumber so he uninstalled the backup pipes/sump lump and redo both the main and back up for me lol saved me a few hundred!

Hired them six yrs later, this time to unclog a basement floor drain!

He was polite, professional, respectful, answer your answer and know what he was doing

The funny thing was, it probably took him two mins to unclog the drain but his setup time and clean up time was much longer lol

Upon finished the unclogs, he asked me for towel, a bucket of water and some wipes so he can show me the pipe is unclogged + he can clean up the area

Overall, they are amazing!  I would hire them again but hopefully not 😊

reviews.author: David Migliore
reviews.text: I just wanted to take a minute to detail the high end professionalism and excellent craftsmanship this particular company has displayed throughout my almost 20 year business dealings with them.  First off this is a second generation establishment and credit due to the original OG Mr. Lee Pearson. He has taken his time transitioning this company to his son Leth as I understand it.  Leth has been equally as professional and qualified. AT&T Plumbing is fair, detailed and straight forward. Leth has taken the qualities his father instilled in him and expanded upon them. His team is 1st rate. Shoes off at the door, I’ve personally seen them carry multiple water heaters up and down stairs while making sure first and foremost they do not damage my home. The installation was quick and precise. I’ve used them to install heaters in my personal garage which turned out perfect for Chicago winters. They have worked for my company when other plumbers were perplexed and confused what the issue was to backing up toilets. They came back 4 times finally breaking up concrete and finding an old antiquated piece of pipe that was leaking underground from the 70 year old building They fixed the pipe, hauled out all the insane amount of broken concrete from jackhammering. I have to take a second to compliment AT&T’s associates Logan and Scott. They hauled bucket after bucket of broken concrete for 8 hours up 2 flights of stairs then brought back pre mix concrete bags and finished with a concrete slab that looked perfect when finished.  I would recommend this company to anyone who is sick of dealing with plumbers who don’t show up, don’t accurately quote jobs and can just generally not be counted on. The owner will always answer the phone once a quote is established and they are always willing to go the extra mile. Merry Christmas guys and thanks again for being a company Northwest IL Suburbanites can count on when your professionalism is needed.

reviews.author: Janet Ferguson
reviews.text: No, I was not satisfied with your price — nearly $400 ($394) to unstop a kitchen drain!  That was ridiculous!  Refusing to give an estimate over the telephone is only a way to be non-transparent about the cost of service.   You wait until you are at the location and the frantic homeowner is in front of you, then you spring a price-gouging number.  The homeowner agrees to whatever the cost out of desperation.  Thank God I refused your service and called around and found a small plumbing company who quoted a price over the phone. The quote for my simple clog job was $169.  He came out, did the work (in 15 minutes), and I was a very satisfied customer.  I understood if the job proved to be more complicated, the cost would increase — that was fine.  You should consider that approach.  Your customers will appreciate knowing in advance to not waste your time or their’s.

reviews.author: Ariel Aguilar
reviews.text: Chad did an excellent job we had some complications & mind changing & he never complained or got frustrated. He did a quality installation & everything works great. We even asked him to fix our ice maker line to our fridge which was not scheduled & got that done too. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Gary S
reviews.text:
Let me tell you about how refreshing it was to find a company who focuses on customer service and relations rather than profit margins.

On the week of Christmas I had my line from the house to the municipal sewer break and we were unable to use water because the water would not be able to drain from the house.  I called three plumbers: 1) Plumb Rite 2) Knights Mechanical and 3) The 24HR Plumber.

One company quoted me $1200 for the repair and would not be out for a week.   That's a long time for a family of 4 with two young kids.

The other company quoted $600 but wouldn't work in the rain which we had a lot of during this time.  They also refused to come out unless I paid time and a half because of the Christmas weekend (even though Christmas was on Friday).

Then there is the 24HR Plumber.  They came out on Saturday to look at the problem and by Monday the 24HR Plumber was on site and fixed my sewer line.  It was drizzling, it was cold and it was a mess and the 24HR Plumber did it with a smile on their face; not to mention the final bill came out cheaper than the other two companies.

The plumbers Damon and Mark were fantastic and was a pleasure to work with.  I --FINALLY-- found a plumber that I can trust not to screw me with outrageous charges.

Thank you guys - you're a life saver!

reviews.author: wes pinkley
reviews.text:
We had an impossible clog in our kitchen sink. Ian came out and had everything flowing again in fifteen minutes, removing mysterious items from the pipe, including a diaper wipe. I would have never fixed that.
After the job, he cleaned the area better than he found it, and also gave me tips on how to prevent future clogs.  In the process of the repair he discovered poorly installed pipes and corrected the problem as part of the flat rate service call.
He is honest, and does not try to sell you unnecessary services.  His prices are quite reasonable.  I highly recommend 24HR Plumber.

reviews.author: Doug Rice

Highly recommend, and big thanks to Pablo, Olasco, and their hard-working crews, for being so responsive in such a difficult time!

reviews.author: Anthony Wise
reviews.text:
Very professional staff. The were observant of COVID protocols (mask and distancing). I was informed that as soon as parts were available, I would be scheduled for repairs to my pipes. They walked the entire house inside and outside, checked the water pressure at my well tank, etc.
I would highly recommend this team for any plumbing job!

reviews.author: finkjm
reviews.text: The purpose of this note is just to recognize Olasco Plumbing for your  help and professionalism following the 2021 Texas Freeze event.  During this period, it was impossible (outside of Olasco) to secure a qualified plumber.  Olasco Plumbing(Pablo) consistently communicated with us while we were in the process of locating a replacement tankless water heater.  Once the water heater was located, Pablo quickly responded and agreed to an installation date and showed up early on that date to perform the installation.  I can't tell you how much this type of communication/service meant to us during an otherwise chaotic time.  Great job Pablo, Olasco Plumbing!  We will be calling again the next time we need service.  Thanks for your hard work.

plumbers.name: Pallan Plumbing, Inc
plumbers.address: 661 Bandera Dr, Camarillo, CA 93010, USA

reviews.author: Jesse Mota
reviews.text: We have used Pallan Plumbing many times for sinks, water heaters, clogged drains and fixing sewer lines to septic as well.  The pricing is great and the service is excellent. The repair areas are always left clean and organized.  They are very trust worthy.

reviews.author: Christina Moskala
reviews.text: Highly recommend Shon at Pallan Plumbing! First off he is a small family local business from Camarillo, and you can tell he cares about serving his community. He responds to phone calls and texts quickly. He is not pushy and patiently explains what is going on. We had a water leak and didn’t know where it was coming from. Another plumber came, charged a lot for diagnostics, and was wrong. Shon is willing to get in there and do what needs to be done to actually locate the leak. He is very timely. He went above and beyond and gave us great recommendations that he noticed about our house plumbing. He seems very knowledgeable, friendly, fair pricing, professional, and just generally very helpful. He will be our go-to plumber going forward.

reviews.author: Eloise Mansfield
reviews.text: Pallan Plumbing came when they said they would & had the water heater bought & installed within 3 hours. All work was done & cleaned up. I will definitely call them again when a plumbing job is needed.

Shon resolved our issue and restored our kitchen sink back to itself - restoring our ability to function in our kitchen -  in no time. Thank you Shon!

reviews.author: Mike Miller
reviews.text:
Shon was  very responsive, did excellent work on several systems, and was very reasonably priced.  Highly recommended.
Mike Mulhern

reviews.author: DK
reviews.text: Needed a new water heater and should have called Big State right away, unfortunately I called another company out first who quoted a replacement WAY too high. I was told a tech would be out in the morning to get me squared away with a new 50 gallon tank at what I thought was a more reasonable price. Cody showed up and was eager to help. Turned out the new 50 gallon tank would not fit in the tight space the previous tank had been incorrectly installed. Longer story short Cody got me hooked up the same day with a tankless system after I inquired about it versus the traditional tank. I appreciated her was determined to get the new tank to fit and didn't try to up sale me. Glad I have a new go to plumbing company

reviews.author: Katie Hightower
reviews.text: Cody and Jacob were absolutely awesome. We had a horrible experience with MDO trying to get a new range installed and it was a nightmare. reviews.author: Benjamin Boling
reviews.text: Cody is amazing! Honest, reliable, and knows his stuff. I wouldn’t recommend using anyone else for your work plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Sydney Reneau

reviews.author: Bree Fitzgerald
reviews.text: Lawhorn did a fabulous job working with us on our remodel! Moved the water heater to a whole new room, fixed various other water and gas leaks they found along the way, plus much more! They collaborated and communicated with my contractor to make sure everything was done smoothly. Skip and Kassandra are awesome! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Alex Crapo
reviews.text: Super happy with my new tankless water heater! Over the last couple months this company has helped me on several projects in my new home with great results. I really appreciate the extra effort that went into fixing the old venting and running pipe so that I can keep an eye on the relief line for the unit. Can not recommend them enough.

reviews.author: K L
reviews.text: Awesome company, came out to check on my water heater I've been having issues with. Gave me a diagnosis on the water heater and an estimate if I wanted to replace it. The technician Skip was extremely helpful very understanding and answered all questions I had. I highly recommend this company for anyone's plumbing needs. 10/10 service.

reviews.author: Jessie Weber
reviews.text: We were notified by the town of Prescott Valley that our water usage exceeded 500 gallons two days ago and 900 gallons the day before. I called Lawhorn Plumbing and was greeted by Kassandra.  I asked her if they would be able to accommodate an emergency same-day service call. She said she would check and promptly called me back within five minutes. Within one hour the owner, Skip, was at my house.  He did a thorough diagnosis of all of my bathrooms, toilets, and outside spigots.  He then proceeded to run a test of usage at the water main.  It was the determined that the issue was with the water meter. Skip proceeded to correct an issue that I was having with low water pressure on one of the outdoor spigots by clearing the sediment and adjusted the water level on both of our toilets. The total cost was more than reasonable for the education and prompt,, courteous, and outstanding customer service that I received. We have found a new plumber for life andI cannot recommend this company enough.

reviews.author: A Rebmann
reviews.text: Can’t say enough about this company! Lawhorn does an amazing job! They are the only company we ask to do our repairs. Since moving out of state l, we have had a few issues come up at our home in Prescott Valley. Kassandra got us scheduled in a timely manner, kept us updated on the price, and progress along with photos of the repair. The communication from this company is top tier! Any questions were answered quickly by either Skip or Kassandra. All of their crew have been amazing. I loved that they also recommended a local landscaper to fix our property after the repair. Love supporting small family owned businesses!

reviews.author: Bart M

reviews.author: A S
reviews.text: Honest, hard working, trustworthy and professional. I have used Marques a couple of times now and never been dissatisfied. Good rates, won't try to upsell you and will tell you straight. Best local plumber I have ever dealt with.

reviews.author: Chris Hurst

reviews.author: Gary
reviews.text: We had a water main leak in the basement. Cameron diagnosed the issue as a faulty repair done 4 years ago by another company. If that had been done on the previous repair, I wouldn’t have had the problem again.  The company dealt with dealing with permits and inspections.  They did the work yesterday and did a great job.  Also want to thank Chris and Wyatt for their invaluable work.  I’ve dealt with the electrical side as well and received great service from them as well. I will be calling R&T Yoder for my future needs.

reviews.author: Michael Boes
reviews.text: Cameron Rung did an amazing job! He really knows his stuff and explained everything in a way that was easy to understand. I’ll definitely be calling again if I ever need plumbing work and would highly recommend Cameron to anyone!

reviews.author: Bill Rice

reviews.author: Anthony Davis

Our main water line repair did end up costing us a good amount, but what stood out most was how honest FasTrak was throughout the entire process. There were no surprises, no upselling, just straightforward explanations and quality work.

It’s hard to find companies that are this professional and trustworthy. FasTrak has definitely earned our trust, and they’ll always have our business moving forward. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them.

Tech showed up and basically was not there to try and help me figure out what to do. I had to pull out of him every bit of information. He then basically said that Home Serve would not pay $$$ for anything he could do to troubleshoot the unit , so it was pointless for him to do anything.

He said gas units don't need cleaning but he'd do it for $200. I saw the oil furnace get cleaned out for 3.5 hrs and the bill was $250. This makes no sense to me. Holiday wasted my time bc they are only about making $ not helping people which in my opinion is not the kind of place that I want to call 🤙 when I need help with heating my home. What is wrong with this place and the people who treat others in this manner? Go elsewhere and keep trying new places until you find some people who are human and humane. Not 🚫 HOLIDAY. Nope keep looking..

reviews.author: Oriana Dougherty
reviews.text: Mr Kevin Smith came out to my house today to do some upgrades and changes to our radiators/ boiler system. He was a delight, as was his team member Terrence. reviews.author: Bill Ulivieri

Trustworthy, punctual and good workmanship.

Highly recommend

reviews.author: susanna johnson
reviews.text: This is my 4th project using The Plumbing Smith and I just want to compliment both Reed and Kevin.Today I had a kitchen sink and a faucet installed. Reed was punctual and courteous and did an amazing job, he also took the the time to repair my outside faucet. The price was very reasonable, I'm very thankful to have such fantastic plumbers in our area...I would give them 6 stars if I could!!

reviews.author: J D
reviews.text: Do NOT hire him. I had already figured out the issue but he didn't want to listen to me until he saw it for himself after testing.  That caused water to back up in the sewer pipes.  The plumber Kevin Smith attempted to rod my main sewer line unsuccessfully.  He created a mess of sewer water all over my garage and left it like that.  He told me he thought 2 pipes were misaligned and 1 was sagging so I needed a camera to see into the pipes since he couldn't get his rod through.  That was going to be an extra cost and he was going to have to come back with his "$10,000 camera" (another hourly charge too).  Then he said he would have to cut into my garage floor concrete and dig down to get to the pipes, which was going to be $6000 - $7000!!!  He cut into a sewer pipe in my basement capped 1 side and left the other side open.  Which connected to a toilet and had sewage coming out onto my water heater, and plastic pipe bits he left all over.  He left it dripping onto the water heater. Didn't clean it up after I asked him to.  He and his assistant broke my light switch and water heater.  He left a huge mess and didn't clean it up.  I got another plumber to come out the next day.  He was easily able to rod the sewer line to clear it, fixed the pipe Kevin cut, and told me Kevin was probably trying to scam me.  I asked for a refund and Kevin kept talking over me and cutting me off. He did not fix my issues and caused further damage.  He charges $150 hourly, $300 for main sewer rodding, and tried justifying due to his time.  Do NOT hire him!

reviews.author: Douglas Hobyan
reviews.text: WARNING!!!!!!!! WARNING!!!! WARNING!!!! Brief summary... Besides showing up 1.5 hours before i had them scheduled. I had to hurry home (30 min from where I work), my wife already signed a contract. By the time i got home damage was done.  They have you sign a contract before they do anything making you reliable for their equipment if it gets stuck, broken, or lost in your pipe. You pay them $279.99 up front and they will get give it back if you get their equipment back with in  48 hours. He said he felt a blockage with his camera and tried "pushing" through it. He double up his camera and broke the chord trying to retrieve it. Told me there was a problem with my pipe. Hired a contractor to come get his camera out. Dug down 10 feet to where the location of the camera was and cut the pipe. The pipe was not plugged or damaged. John got his camera stuck in a perfectly straight pipe. The total bill was $2100 for the excavation and repair. I did not get refunded my $279.99. Do not use this company!!!!!!! You have to pay for their carelessness and negligence. I have never heard of a business where you have to pay to retrieve their equipment.

reviews.author: A. Morris

reviews.author: Nathan
reviews.text:
5 Stars
This company went above and beyond. They showed up exactly when they said they would, explained everything clearly, and delivered top-quality work. Pricing was fair, communication was great, and the final result was even better than expected. I’ll absolutely be using them again and recommending them to friends and family

reviews.author: Reno Swiger
reviews.text: Webb Heating and Cooling was a very pleasant, positive, and satisfying experience. My partner and I just bought our first house and less than 2 months in the home, the furnace broke. We sought out a few businesses for quotes and Webb was the ONLY company to respond in a timely manner and treat us as if we were their priority, while no doubt managing many more customer/service calls. In fact, the night that Ethan (Webb associate) came out for the quote, it was 2 hours past closing time. But since he was tending to another emergency service call, he STILL came to work up my quote that evening after the fact. That goes to show they will not leave you hanging. They called back the next day with the official quote and allowed us to pester them with many questions and concerns prior to accepting their business. They were far more interested in making sure we felt heard and understood over them making a sale. That kind of customer service is rare. After some thought and discussion, my partner and I decided to replace the air unit as well, seeing as how the furnace and air unit both were around 20 years old. Something noteworthy to mention, when comparing the size options of the air unit and/or the possibility of even adding new returns in the home, Webb did not act fast to just agree with what would make them the most money. Dustin (the manager) made sure to explain how he would go about deciding whether that would be necessary or not. He also mentioned that he would not do anything that he did not feel good about, (even if that means they would have made more money), and he meant it. When we signed the deal, they moved fast. So long as the equipment was available they said it would only take a few days (luckily it was in stock). They have since come (day after installment) to check in with the installation and make certain we were satisfied with the outcome. Any company can say they will be there, but actions speak louder than words. And Webb exhibited loyal, trustworthy actions throughout our experience with them. THEY EVEN go ahead and register your equipment as a complementary service so that it is all set up and ready to go when you finalize payment. Its the little things that make people feel like they are more than just another customer, but a fellow respected human just seeking to be treated fairly and honestly. Thank you Dustin, Jason, and Ethan for your great service!!! I would recommend this business to anyone and everyone!!!

reviews.author: Alan Barr
reviews.text: I've been a customer with Webb Heating & Cooling for years and I've never been disappointed.  They recently installed a new furnace and AC system for me in less than a day.  Fantastic work.  Fantastic price.  Fantastic people.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Brian Vorselen
reviews.text: I was very impressed with the young man sent to service my air conditioner. It was having a hard time keeping up with the heat. I was skeptical at first because he looked unexperienced but he completed a thorough cleaning of the unit, even going to get my hose from the garage because I am handicapped, and tested and recharged the unit, explaining what he was doing along the way. I could tell immediately the system wasn't struggling to pull air and was running smoothly when he left, and the house was immediately cooler. In my opinion, the unit is running fine for a 30 year old unit. You have a new customer in me. Thank you.

reviews.author: Rich M
reviews.text: We purchased a house over 100 years old with a boiler and radiators.  At the time of the purchase we understood the system would have to be serviced as only a few of the radiators had heat.  As the weather started to get cooler the boiler did kick on but was not working right.  Then we had the bad no heat at all.  We called Webb Heating and Cooling.  They sent two guys out.  It turns out that we have a closed steam heat boiler and an expansion tank in an upstairs closet.  Webb Heating and Cooling were able to get the system up and running like a dream.  I am so please with their knowledge, work ethic, explaining to us how to do normal service so we don't have to call in the professionals to do standard service. One last but so very important part is they were a great value for the time that were here,

reviews.author: Adrian Mosness
reviews.text: Home Pro responded to me quickly. They were able to accommodate my schedule  and were on time. They explained my options and were efficient in repairing the hot water heater. They were friendly and professional.  Pricing was fair. I appreciate  doing business with an honest small business. I will definitely  recommend  Home Pro to friends and family.

reviews.author: kimberly kosofsky
reviews.text: Ian and his co worker were so great! Super nice guys. They got a call night before and was my house the next day at 10 am to install my new water heater. Really appericated it guys!

This company is barr non the best company that I have ever had the pleasure of using! Fast professional service and very attentive.  I recommend you give these guys a call for all of your plumbing and heating needs!!!!

reviews.text: I had an amazing experience with Home Pro today! I needed a new water heater, called yesterday, they were out this morning and were so efficient and pleasant to work with. I will certainly hire them again!

reviews.author: Javier Pulido
reviews.text: They were quick, polite, and friendly. At first I thought it would take a couple days to find the time for the install but they were able to get it done the same day. And for anyone worried about LBGTQ safe businesses in the current climate, the guys who did the work are safe and trustworthy.

reviews.author: May King
reviews.text: I got 3 quotes and Frazier was the only reasonable one. Hometown wanted to charge me $3500 for the water heater. Tommie's plumbing wanted $2500. Fraizer charged me less than $1700. He did such a good job. I had him fix my leaky toilet, fix a drain, a faucet, and put in our new toilet and bidet. He is a good Christian man with reasonable prices without an overinflated marketing budget. I am going to get a reverse osmosis filter in soon and Andrew Fraizer will be the one who gets my business. I highly recommend him. A good honest Christian man is rare nowadays. I don't have to worry about him ripping me and my family off. 10 stars.

reviews.author: Christ Tailor
reviews.text:
If I could give negative stars, I would.
This man is flat-out dangerous and has no business doing any kind of installation work. I paid him $11,000 to install a water heater, and what he did was beyond unacceptable — it was straight negligence. He drilled screws directly into the water heater, didn’t even bother to shut off the water, and ended up flooding my entire property. The amount of damage he caused was unbelievable.

When I confronted him and asked for a refund, he tried to play games saying he’d “pay in installments.” He never paid a single dollar back. I had to take him to court because he refused to take responsibility for the disaster he created.

This isn’t just bad service — it’s reckless, unprofessional, and totally dishonest. Do NOT hire him under any circumstances. He will take your money, ruin your property, and leave you with the mess.

reviews.author: Harsh Tailor
reviews.text:
If negative stars were possible, this man would deserve all of them.
Hiring him was one of the biggest mistakes I’ve ever made. I paid him $11,000 for a water heater installation, and what he delivered wasn’t just bad — it was dangerous and completely incompetent. He drilled screws directly into the water heater, didn’t even shut off the water, and ended up flooding my entire property. The damage was unbelievable.

When I asked for my money back, he tried to play it off saying he’d “pay in installments” — which, of course, he never did. I had to take him to court just to even get him to respond.

And the worst part? He’s now posting on Facebook and Google Maps pretending he did a perfect installation, lying to everyone to look professional. In my personal opinion, someone who works like this shouldn’t even have a license, and the person he brought with him didn’t seem licensed at all.

This is not a contractor — this is someone who will take your money, ruin your property, and then lie about it.
Do NOT hire him under any circumstances.

reviews.author: Andrea Huff
reviews.text: I used Frazier Plumbing to fix a leak on my toilet & wow! I assumed my project would at least require an hour of time, maybe a little more, but nope! The team from Frazier's were in & out in literally 20 minutes! The work was perfect & they were also very tidy leaving my bathroom as it were when they arrived! They were very professional & were super efficient, as well as very affordable. I would definitely use them again for any future plumbing issues! And of course, I would recommend them to friends & family!

He arrived quickly, was friendly and professional, and clearly skilled. He was the 3rd plumber I called for the job, and his quote came in at half the price of the others. A couple of weeks later, I called him again for a different plumbing issue. He fixed it effortlessly and charged a very fair price. It’s so refreshing to find someone skilled, honest, & dependable. You won’t go wrong hiring Jeremy, truly.

reviews.author: Ben Marshall
reviews.text: Called around looking for plumbers Thursday morning. Couldn’t get anyone to come out until Monday unless I wanted to be charged “emergency” prices. Since I had cleaned up the water, started the drying process, and gotten the water turned off to the problem area it was not an emergency because the damage was already done. I just needed to find and repair the leak. Couldn’t visually find the problem, so I figured the leak was behind the wall (damn). I decided to call in some help. Initially, I had to leave a message with Mr. Grisenti, but he called me back quickly. Sadly, he let me know he did not provide services in the Bristol area. HOWEVER, he took the time to help me accurately diagnose the plumbing issue over the phone! He even gave me some handy tips of how to diagnose and repair the issue more efficiently. End of story: I had the plumbing issue repaired myself before Monday came. Now I’ll use the next couple weekends to replace flooring. Lol.

reviews.author: Kiersten Stallard
reviews.text: After calling literally over 25 companies to come out an assess a job and no one calling me back, Mr Grisenti did call me back same day, came out on Friday which he scheduled on Tuesday, was early and completed the job that needed to be done. He was very nice and professional throughout and I just really appreciate him for being prompt and doing what he agreed to do as we all know it’s very very hard to find a good worker out there willing to complete jobs or willing to do what they say they will. Thank you. I will certainly use you again.

Pete is awesome!

The technician they sent to repair that was great and fixed it properly.  We had them come back out to deal with an issue with the hot water heater.  These guys did a horrible job, left the job with the hot water heater off and also left the water softener off which we were unaware of until our water turned brown and smelled bad.  We went an entire month with rusty water until we discovered the issue.

reviews.author: Cari Rodriguez
reviews.text:
We reached out to L&S for an urgent water leak at one of our rental properties. They responded promptly, provided detailed information, and proved to be very reliable.

Not only did they repair the leak, but they also had their team start the drying process immediately. We are truly grateful to have found a company that handles everything from start to finish.

We highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Viktoria Rethmeier
reviews.text: Had this company install a new HVAC in 2021. It was a horrid experience. I wrote out the complete ridiculous story on yelp at the time. I have had frequent issues with the system since then. Attached below is an invoice from today’s repair job with some of the errors L&S had made, my generator is damaged from the get go because of their incompetence. Save yourself from a similar experience and don’t hire these clowns.

reviews.author: Julius Goh
reviews.text: My shower valve got stuck in the open position so I called around for a plumber.  None of them could come on the same day except L&S Turnkey Plumbing.  John came at the allocated time and did a good job in replacing the cartridge.  The cartridge was stuck hard but he could remove it easily.  His work was clean and fast.  With 25 years of experience, I could tell he knew his stuff.  His cost IMO is quite reasonable.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jack Groshans
reviews.text: Excellent service from John & L&S.  We had 3 separate leaks, and the L&S team completed all the repairs on time and as promised.  Really appreciate their  skill and professionalism in resolving our slab and mainline leaks, as well as their friendly manner.

reviews.author: Mark Kalinowski
reviews.text:
L & S TurnKey is now my "go to" plumbers (and heating & air con repair)!!!
Great people, great service at a great price!!!

I walked out of my front door on my way to work and discovered a flooded front yard with the water coming out of the ground below the main water pipe that feeds my house.  I turned off the water at the street and did a search for reputable plumbers in the area.  I found L & S Turnkey Plumbing on the list with glowing reviews and a BBB A+ rating.  I called immediately and spoke with Chris Consentino who understood the magnitude of the problem and sent Cesar to the rescue.  Cesar arrived right when Chris told me he would and took a look at the problem and gave me his plan to find the leak and fix it, with an initial estimate.  30 minutes later he showed me the problem and readjusted the estimate, LOWERING IT BY $150 DOLLARS!.  He didn't overprice the initial estimate, he just revised it because the problem wasn't as bad as expected.  After a quick trip to the local hardware store, Cesar promptly fixed the leak and cleaned up the work area.  It's very rare to find a company that cares enough about their customers to give them a fair price for the parts and labor.  L & S TurnKey is now my "go to" plumbers!

reviews.author: Valarie Shepherd
reviews.text:
Lovett
I don't usually take the time to do reviews, but I feel compelled to do it now because of the outstanding integrity that this company and its employees have demonstrated. I didn't personally hire lovett for problems with my plumbing; however my daughter just lived through two years of backed up waste clogged pipes, and broken pipes while the property owner of the park refused to take responsibility for paying for the repairs and insisting that my daughter come up with thousands of dollars to fix a mess they insisted was caused by my daughter and her family. I am so impressed with Lovett Inc. plumbing company because even though they are contracted by the manufactured park owners for plumbing issues, they are honest and fair to the homeowner. Thank you David and Greg for being the absolutely honest and fair business owners who finally got my daughter squared away and for finding the root of the problem and fixing it! I recommend this company with no hesitation!

Charlie and Ryan were in and out on Friday in less than 4 hours to remove the old and install the new Boiler. I would 100% recommend him. I couldn’t have asked for better service. 💯

reviews.author: John Moruzzi
reviews.text: Our hot water tank was ready to go on a Saturday morning. Lovett plumbing and heating responded in 5 minutes after I called and left a message. Charlie and I discussed options. He could have been on site in 15 minutes to replace our old tank, however we decided to go with a tankless system. Charlie and Ryan showed up on time Monday morning and completed the job in under four hours. Being in the service industry myself, Lovett Plumbing and heatings response time, quality , service and professionalism are top notch. Outstanding job! Thank you!

reviews.author: Caroline
reviews.text: All that has been said is true - Charlie is a reliable professional. He responded to our inquiry promptly, came the next morning to replace our water heater, and we had our hot water back within an hour. 100% would recommend calling him for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: George Chen
reviews.text: Charlie replaced my water heater this morning and did a very nice job. He responded to my call quickly and offered me the fair price. He also is very pleasant person to talk to and answered my question patiently. I have an steam boiler which looks very old but still works. Several plumbers kind of push me to replace it. I couldn't tell what year the boiler was installed. I showed it to Charlie and he said he will find out the age of the boiler for me. He also said if it works well why replace it, no push to replace all all. Charlie is a very reliable professional and I will certainly come back to him and recommend Charlie to my friends in the future.

reviews.author: Juliana Marin Villamil

reviews.text:
While I cannot say that they do good or bad work.  they have never actually showed up to work on our plumbing, I have tried to schedule 3+ times and either never gotten a contact back, or Today they never showed up or called about the scheduled appointment. Just left us sitting there all afternoon.
We purchased a new home in Sedona 12-2-24. I called (left message) and submitted an online Service request the second week of December. Never got a return contact.
Just before Christmas I spoke with Jerry, whom remembered the homes previous owner and they system he serviced, to get the water filters for the home replaced as they are way overdue. He said he would get the availability on the filters and call me back to schedule. I replied no problem, please just order all 4 of them and let me know when you can get to it.
I called back Late January and left a message. No response
I spoke with Jerry Monday 4-14, asked about getting the filter replaced, they are making noise and could possible have another issue. Jerry told me he would look up the parts availability and call me back in the afternoon.
No call back Monday  or Tuesday.
I called and spoke to Jerry this morning (Wednesday) and he says he can be there with the filters in 1.5 hours. This was 10:30 am. I told him the name of the contact person at the house and he said no problem.
Now it is 4pm and still haven't heard from anyone and no one arrived at the home.

I have no idea if they do good service or bad, but if it is this hard just to get a call back or a service appointment that someone actually shows up to, I will just find someone else. It would have been nice to use the people that evidently installed and serviced the original system, but Im confident a new company will figure it out.

reviews.author: Escobar
reviews.text:
Stepping on wet carpet and seeing swollen base board at 10pm isn’t ideal. I spent hours cleaning up and cutting out wet drywall and flooring. I traced a leak that ended up under the slab.  I am well rounded and can fix many things around the house but I know when I need a pro. The next morning I called 4 major plumbing companies. Not a single one of them called me back so I decided to head to Home Depot and pick up some supplies.
That trip was worth every penny and more.
The vehicle I parked next to was AQUAMAN PLUMBING!  On his day off Tib showed up to my house within 30 minutes.  He listened to all the steps I took and checked all lines, meter etc. the leak was so slow it was not registering from the meter.  The rear hose bib was cut and capped isolating and stopping the leak.  I asked lots of questions from running a new line, changing from copper to pex, adding bibs, water pressure (90-92psi) and adding a PRV from the meter.  Tib answered all without missing a beat.  He noticed I had installed a water softener and made some adjustments to the overflow lines.  He mentioned the benefit of having a filtration system pre softener and potential layout of bypass and cutoff incase of leaks or maintenance.

We discussed 3 items with 0 sales pressure.   Tib, Raul, Andre and Tata (grandfather) showed up and tackled all 3 tasks.  Tib advised he would be back the following day for a 30min to an hour visit to check connections and button everything up.  I had to delay an additional day. Tib and Andre returned and I am going to say this was a godsend.  The water heater flex line was leaking, and had been leaking since we bought the house 4 years ago or longer!!!  The line was barely screwed on, no sealant tape, no pipe dope just hanging on by a thread and prayer.  Cut off the gas, sealed up and checked all gas lines inside and out.  Thank you again for your prompt service and attention to detail.  You saved us from a disaster and we are very grateful.

10/10

reviews.text:

reviews.author: margarita pacheco
reviews.text: I am a tenant in a home I've lived in since 1997.The landlord has been great and has used this cesspool company since I've moved in this home. During a brutal winter this year, where the temperatures have gone below zero,  a pipe bursted in my living room a couple of weeks ago. It was brutally cold outside. Houses all over Long Island were experiencing pipes being frozen and bursting. I immediately turned off the emergency boiler switch and called this plumber, Mike, who became extremely rude over the phone, telling me he couldn't help me because he was overwhelmed dealing with another customers emergency. So I hung up and we had to call the fire department, because we couldn't turn off the water to the house and it was actively flooding, not only my living room, but my basement with hot boiling water. They had us evacuate the house for fear of electrical issues with the water flooding and had us shut off the electricity. The Fire department found the pipe that bursted in the living room and told us to have the landlord repair it. Telling me this same issue was happening all over the Island because of the severe cold. One of the firemen had to leave and go straight to her home because of the same issue with the pipes frozen. Roughly an hour later, Mike shows up, while my landlord was here, showing up after the fire department did their investigation and left, and proceeds to tell my landlord that I was responsible for the leak because I somehow, magically with my mind, isolated the heat from my living room, freezing my pipes on purpose 🤬 Like what is this man even talking about??? I have children in my home sir. And my oil heating tank had 3/4 of oil in it, plenty of oil, almost full. I had the heater on in my home, because it was so cold. My children have asthma. I've lived here for 28 years. NEVER HAVE I EVER been a magician where I can isolate one room from my thermostat 😑Unfortunately, this home is not high tech. The thermostat has NEVER been changed or upgraded, is extremely old and dated, so there is no way humanly possible for me to isolate the heat from coming to my living room or any other room, for that matter. It's all one system  😤 This plumber, Mike, went into my basement and touches the boiler and screams out how cold it is. Trying to insinuate that I never had the heater on. He showed up a little over an hour after I originally called him and is wondering why the boiler is cold when its in my basement where its 6° outside, the boiler switch turned off and electricity was shut down and you're wondering why its cold??? I'm extremely upset that this man came in, accusing me of deliberately freezing my living and causing the pipe to burst when I had absolutely nothing to do with it and telling my landlord trying to get me in trouble. He even pointed to a space heater I was using, like, give me a break!! THERE IS NO HEAT IN MY HOUSE, OF COURSE I have a space heater 🤬 Just outrageous! I will never use this company again and I will make sure my landlord knows it! So Mike, I would love for you to explain how I magically turned off the heat specifically to the living room? We had a real plumber come in the very next day here and fixed the broken pipe in the living room. Everything works great and no other leaks. Mike had suggested to the landlord that the problem was much bigger and it wasn't. Making it seem like it was a bigger job with leaks throughout the house. What a joke! I am highly offended that this man would do this. Like I said, I've been here since 1997. I'm a mother. I'm not here trying to go against my own interests by ruining where I've lived for over 28 years as a tenant!!!!!! Like, how dare you!!

We also replaced our gas regulator to ensure it was not the problem. When they showed up about 2 hours late (we were their first appointment) they checked several things and told us that the issue was the regulator. They stated that the plunger wouldn’t stay out after they had messed with it. This was never an issue prior to them messing with it and it was a brand new regulator! Since they swore it was the issue we had them replace it and brought the regulator that was just purchased back to be checked. The store owner verified the regulator worked perfectly and that it was not the issue.
We have tried, since then, to contact them and even went into their office and have yet to talk to anyone other than the secretary. This has been going on for 2 weeks as of tomorrow. My husband has since fixed the issue we was having by adjusting the pressure coming from our gas well to our house regulator with support provided by our well tender and it turned out to be a free fix, unlike this company that wouldn’t even stand by their overpriced work by talking to us when the issue they claimed to have fixed by replacing something that was brand new and charging us 4x the money to do it resulting in a still unresolved issue. I recommend to NOT use their services because they have no issues with screwing over people and are incredibly unreliable!

reviews.author: Darius Hill
reviews.text:
This was a frustrating, disappointing experience—especially because my mother is a returning customer who spent over $2,000 with this company last year.
This year she had a main drain backup and called them to have it snaked/cleared. The tech didn’t clear anything. He removed the exterior cleanout cap, said the main sewer was blocked (which we already knew from the backup), and then referred her to another company to do the actual work.
They charged $40 anyway and labeled it: “check outside c/o, main sewer blocked.”
That’s not a service. That’s stating the obvious and sending a senior homeowner elsewhere.
I can’t speak to motive, but the whole interaction felt dismissive and like she was being taken advantage of. Save yourself the time and call a company that will actually clear the line you asked them to clear.

reviews.author: Kyle Lade
reviews.text:
Webster's Plumbing is REASONABLE, KNOWLEDGEABLE, FAST, AND HONEST! I will definitely be calling them again! I'm the maintenance super at a care facility in Iroquois county. We have been looking for a good plumber that does commercial plumbing for awhile, and Webster's Plumbing is that company! I called them late afternoon about a toilet leaking around the base and a clogged floor drain. The person I spoke with was very helpful, and got his guys here the very next morning! The two men that came were very nice and worked together great! One went to work on our toilet, and the other started the drain. They both worked fast, but still managed to take time to explain what they were doing and why they were doing it. Then they both started working to unclog the drain. They unclogged a drain that 2 other plumbers couldn't get! Then it came to the bill, I WAS SHOCKED in a good way! I was expecting a large bill, instead I was handed a bill that was half of what I was expecting it to be! They charged service fee for the long drive here, and STILL was way cheaper than I expected!
(Note: they were upfront about the service fee for drive time. That was the first thing they said when I called. I 100% knew there was a long distance fee before they came! The driving fee was cheaper than I expected as well!)
The best part is they don't do just plumbing! They do plumbing, heating, cooling, and electrical. For a maintenance super at a facility like ours having a contractor that does all that makes my job so much easier! Webster's will absolutely be my first call from now on!
It's so hard to find a good plumber that does residential and commercial plumbing, heating, cooling, and electrical... and it's even harder to find one that is fast, reasonable, and knowledgeable! I would recommend them to anyone! Thank you all so much, I will be calling again soon!

reviews.author: Samantha McCarthy
reviews.text:
I was referred to Webster’s by Jared from Hamande Sewer. I cannot say thank you enough to Webster’s!

Last year I had different company come out to replace a pipe and spigot that had burst to my outside garden hose. I chose that company out of desperation to get a job done sooner and didn’t do my research before I had them do the work. Needless to say the issue happened again less than a full year later due to their error, and they refused to take responsibility. I asked Jared for a recommendation for a company that could do the job right, which led me to Webster’s.

The two men who came to do the job (Jason and Mason) were excellent in explaining what was wrong, what they needed to do and went above and beyond to make sure everything was right. They were friendly, left no mess behind and they were very thorough. I’m thankful they were able to fit me in and the prices were very reasonable for the excellent work they did. I’ll be happy to call this company back should I need work done again!

Thank you! 😊

The technician was pleasant, professional, and the price was fair! I will be calling them again.

I will be calling another plumber that knows how to agree on a date and time without complicating the situation so they don’t have to work. If you don’t want to work on a Sunday just say so.

They were super kind and helpful. Excellent service! !

reviews.author: Saydur Rahman
reviews.text:
Thank you Freddy and your team for their quick response to the clogged sewer pipe and repair. After all these many years, a section of the sewer pipe was severely clogged. Snaking did not help. Even hydro jets don't help. The clog lies under the concrete carport.

Freddy explained everything in detail before the job began. They are definitely worth recommending.

reviews.author: Erica Guimarães
reviews.text: The plumbing company was professional, clean and concise. There were no problems or hassles. My sump-pump was in bad shape and old. I live on the river waterfront and wind and rain can be a problem. The sump pump is excellent. I would use them again and again. ! ! !

reviews.author: Yassine Yassine
reviews.text: Cesar has been the most professional plumber that I have dealt with. Water heater went out. I would highly recommend him in any situation.

reviews.author: Ben Sances
reviews.text: We had a problem with our toilet and the person who answered was very helpful in setting up a time. Didn't give a crazy 8 hour window like some places do. He even asked me what time worked best for me. Nam was our plumber and he called about 20 mins before arriving. He checked the sink, the shower as well as the toilet to narrow down the problem. He explained the possible issues and gave an estimate before starting the work and luckily it did not require removal of the toilet. Overall, we felt like they were very professional and good at explaining things too. Please keep up the good work!

plumbers.name: Norm's Plumbing, Heating and Supply, INC
plumbers.address: 2629 Spruce St, Boulder, CO 80302, USA

reviews.author: Charlotte Obermeier
reviews.text: Norm’s plumbing is exceptional!  Ernie, Doug and Samantha have taken care of our plumbing and heating needs for generations. They are such good, honest people!  Their work ethic is amazing. They have shown up and fixed our plumbing and heating issues at all times of day and night. They are best!

reviews.author: Graham Davis
reviews.text: Norm’s Plumbing is highly professional, they give you an accurate quote before starting the work, and clean up after the job so that you don’t even know they were there. Norm’s has a terrific crew working at this small family-owned Boulder business. While other companies price gouge you because they can, Norm’s rates are reasonable.

reviews.author: DJ Cultifader
reviews.text: Norm’s provides unmatched service that’s difficult to come by these days. Extremely friendly and dependable small business folks that I’d repeatedly give my business to. Being in unincorporated Boulder county, most other companies won’t even consider making the trip (yet some still advertise on their website…) My most recent experience with Norm’s was my third and consisted of a leaking water heater. Samantha and Ernie understood the urgency to get the problem resolved and performed the job after hours to have me up and running 24 hours after the problem began. They also came in 20% less than what I had been quoted. I had spoke with another local company before hearing back from Samantha as this was an emergency that I needed addressed ASAP. The other company took all my info and was supposed to call in the morning but straight up ghosted me. Norm’s really care about their customers and I hope they continue bringing this level of excellence for years to come.

reviews.author: Ron Spalding
reviews.text: Ernie of Norm's Plumbing is the consummate professional! He installed a replacement high efficiency hot water for me in the most efficient and timely manner. Ernie informed me that according to code I needed an expansion valve which I completely forgot about. He went out, got the part and finished the job quicker than I expected. I have used Norm's Plumbing in the past and it is my go to plumber for all my work. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Lisa Kistner
reviews.text:
Ernie and Samantha were awesome. It is hard to find experts in construction who both know their field and bring empathy and professionalism to the job. Our boiler went out Friday afternoon. Samantha returned my call, got Ernie in touch, and helped me trouble shoot through FaceTime. We ordered parts. They started work on Monday when it arrived. When we found that our boiler needed replacing, they gave us the best deal and squeezed us in to get it back working as soon as possible. When the weather turned cold this week, they came with electric heaters in case we needed them if they couldn’t finish in time. They did finish in time by staying late.
This is a 3rd generation family company. And a pioneer family company. They truly care about their work. Refreshing to see!

reviews.author: Kenya Aurora
reviews.text: A small leak developed behind the refrigerator water line. I contacted their experts to handle it. They replaced the brittle tubing and tested the pressure carefully. Everything is secure now and their work was thorough.

reviews.author: Samuel Torres
reviews.text: Brighton Plumbing resolved an issue with inconsistent hot water at fixtures. Their plumber flushed the system and corrected buildup. Water temperature stabilized afterward. The improvement has held up well.

reviews.author: Christopher Hernandez
reviews.text: The outdoor drainage line was blocked with debris. Their crew cleared it thoroughly. Water now flows away from the house properly. Professional and efficient service.

reviews.author: Canty Aaron
reviews.text: An unpleasant odor kept coming from the bathroom drain despite regular cleaning. The plumber found that debris was trapped deeper in the pipe where surface cleaners couldn’t reach. A thorough cleaning removed the buildup completely. The smell hasn’t returned since.

reviews.author: Jazlene Donna
reviews.text: Water pressure feels balanced across every tap after their specialists team replaced the aging regulator and checked the system.

reviews.author: Melissa Fox

The plumber took apart the faucet in 15-20 min.. could have part the part back on in less than 1 hour. Now you tell me if that is fair or a BAIT AND SWITCH. reviews.author: Ashley Burns
reviews.text:

No hassle. No waiting around. No runaround or shady upsells like we’ve dealt with before. They were straightforward, honest, and actually fixed the problem the first time. What a relief to finally find a plumbing company that does exactly what they say they’ll do.

From here on out, we’ll only be using 5 Cities Plumbing for any plumbing issues. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: RJordans Gaming
reviews.text:
They replaced a faulty bathtub mixer cartridge on Jan 14, which began leaking at an alarming rate on Saturday Feb 21 (good solid flow as the valve failed to close). Couldn't reach them all weekend. Spoke with them Monday morning, kept saying they were sending someone out, then delayed multiple times and never came, said Tuesday first thing... no show / no call. Around 11am, I received a hostile phone call from the owner, Chad, accusing me of trying to get free work, refusing to pay, and pissing him off with multiple phone calls. Not sure how he arrived at any of those conclusions. I had simply asked the receptionist if they would guarantee their prior work (which was paid promptly on the day of service btw).

Chad did eventually come out on Tuesday around 11, pushed past me at the front door and began demanding payment immediately before performing any work. I asked him to communicate with the home owner (who I had standing by on the phone), which Chad refused to do. Instead he left abruptly hurling profanity, yelling insults, and speeding away. Chad wouldn’t budge on his 30-day guarantee policy, even though the bath valve was becoming increasing difficult to fully shut-off since well within the 30-day window. Meanwhile my bathtub had now been hemorrhaging probably hundreds of gallons over 3 days.

So my issue was not fixed and I was a bit shook by the unhinged way the owner suddenly raged quit. I called another plumbing service who came out in less than 1-hour and replaced the cartridge for $280. They also confirmed that Five Cities Plumbing had installed the prior cartridge incorrectly. Won’t be using this company again.

reviews.author: John B
reviews.text: Great, honest plumbing service. My wife was staying at my elderly mother’s house in the retirement trailer park across from the Pismo RV park and the drain clogged up. I called Roto Rooter and without even looking in the clean out access, they said it needed to be hydro jetted from the mobile home to the street. They quoted me $2,750 !! I told them no thanks and called Five Cities plumbing. They sent two guys out, they looked at the clean out and determined it was between there and the house. They ran a snake up and cleared the drain and were done in about half an hour, start to finish. I was happy to pay their $215 fee. Can’t thank or recommend them enough!!

reviews.author: Jia Guo
reviews.text:
The guy Chilo came because we had asked to fix a sewage drain caused by roots and dirt stuck in the storm drain for years caused by the previous house owner. We agreed on a $300 since the pipe went straight, but at the end he asked for $400 even though spent a total of an hour cleaning the pipes. The worst part is after he left it was still clogged with a bunch of roots throughout the pipe that we had to get out ourselves.

Before he left, he also misinformed us about a misalignment in the pipes and asked us if we wanted to fix it for $900. We opened it up ourselves to find out that there was no misalignment but a bunch of roots clogged that was causing what he though was the misalignment.

That was a total scam.

reviews.author: Maxwell Mina

reviews.author: Bob S

I highly recommend Roots Plumbing & when I need plumbing service in the future, I won't hesitate to call again.

reviews.author: Christine Sommer

He was always upfront and honest with his work and had very fair pricing.  We highly recommend him and plan to use him for any further projects!

reviews.author: Melanie Moretti
reviews.text: I had an emergency toilet overflow into my downstairs. Eddie came out and cleared the drain the same day. It's been running smooth since. Fair price and Ed was beyond great to work with. Absolutely recommend them for any plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Dennis Massott
reviews.text: I’ve used Roots plumbing for numerous jobs (big & small) over the past 10 years at my houses. Great plumber, great work, great prices, great guy!!

plumbers.name: Ryno Plumbing LLC

reviews.author: Jenni M

reviews.author: Jan Burgess
reviews.text: We have used Ryno Plumbing on several occasions and would highly recommend them to anyone with plumbing needs. I found them to be professional, courteous and reliable.

reviews.author: Eileen Clark Williams
reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience with Ryno plumbing! They responded quickly to our service request and arrived on time, which I really appreciated. The problem is now completely fixed, and everything is working perfectly. I highly recommend Ryno Plumbing for their reliability, expertise, and excellent customer service!

reviews.author: Natelye Blackwell
reviews.text: Had my Water Heater flushed by Ryan and his colleague. Reasonably priced for the service provided. Arrived before appointment time. Process explained throughly to give me a better understanding of how important it is to have this service done annually. Repeat customer!

plumbers.name: AnD Maintenance Plumbing Co

reviews.author: Stacey Brodsky

Didn't mind me calling when I had questions during the quote period and was just overall an awesome guy! I would highly recommend Dustin and AnD Maintenance for all your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Donna Martin
reviews.text: Prompt, courteous and they cleaned up everything when they were done.  Very professional.  We use AnD Maintenance for all our plumbing and propane needs.

reviews.author: Jessica Marsee

reviews.author: J C T

Justin was also very responsive to all our questions, offering helpful and thorough answers. We couldn't be happier with his professionalism and reliability. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Donna Wilmot
reviews.text:
Now this is the company you want for all of your plumbing needs. The owner knows how to communicate and kept me informed and updated throughout the process. From recommending what was needed, to providing a written estimate, timely arrival the day they came out, until they finished the job.
Very respectful of the customer and extremely thorough in the work they do. I highly recommend AnD. We have already discussed using them for plumbing in our home build.

reviews.author: Michelle Morris

reviews.author: Thomas Rios
reviews.text: Great work at a good price.Workers are very detail with work and awesome customer service.i would use this company all the time for any of my work that’s has to get done.

reviews.author: Kareem Martin
