reviews.author: Hailee Carrasquillo
reviews.text: Excellent service! The plumber was professional, on time, and fixed the issue quickly. Everything was explained clearly and the pricing was fair. I’ll definitely use this company again and recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Mari Arro
reviews.text:
They fix my dad heater and they did a great job they left everything nice n clean
I will hired them again

plumbers.name: Exact Plumbing
plumbers.address: 305 E 4th St, Sanford, FL 32771, USA

reviews.author: J J
reviews.text:
We recently had to have our main sewer line replaced.  We called numerous plumbers for quotes, and from the high to the low, they varied by more than $4,000.  Jason's team came in on the low side, which if I'm being honest, made me a bit skeptical of their bid.  After exchanging a few emails, we decided to hire them.

Jason's team showed up first thing on the following Monday and had the job done several hours later the same day.  We ended up having an open trench in our front yard for about a week, but that was mostly due to the fact that there were some permitting/inspection issues arising from the challenges with COVID-19 and local government operations.

Exact will be my go-to for future plumbing concerns.

reviews.author: Mark mancia
reviews.text: I had a garbage disposal that was not working right, and only 18 months old (just past 12 mo warranty).  I spoke with Jason, the owner of Exact Plumbing and he suggested I approach the maufacturer for a free replacement, and then he would install the replacement for free.  I got the free replacement, and Jason lived up to his word, and sent a tech quickly to install it at no charge.  I was impressed with this customer service and the quality ot the tech and install!  I would highly recommend this company to anyone needing a trustworthy and resonably priced plumber.

reviews.author: j pap187
reviews.text: I hired Exact Plumbing to replace my Gas Hot Water Heater. They are very professional, do excellent work using high quality products, and are very reasonable on price. I would definitely use them again and recommend them to friends and family. Jason and Steve keep up the good work.

reviews.author: regine filemon
reviews.text:
A good friend referred me to Exact Plumbing and am I glad she did! The owner Jason is the most courteous and professional you’ve ever dealt with. My BR was clogged and I had to turn off the water through the entire house to avoid a catastrophe. I called exact plumbing, Jason was awesome over the phone, they were on time for the job, they worked on it quickly and before you know it, I was back to business.
I’ll be forever grateful to Jason and the test of the crew. You can’t go wrong by choosing this company. THEY ARE THE BEST!

reviews.author: Joan Creem
reviews.text: We had a major sewer pipe blockage and couldn't use our bathrooms. Exact Plumbing, who we had never used before, was able to send Steve out right away. It was a difficult job but Steve worked diligently until it was cleared. Efficient, knowledgeable, hard working team. Very fair pricing. Can't get much better than that BUT it did.  It clogged again a week later, not their fault, but the owner of the company, Jason, sent Steve right out again. He brought an even longer electric snake up on the roof again and worked another hour or so to clear it. JASON DID NOT EVEN CHARGE US TO COME BACK. That was unexpected, especially since it wasn't their fault. We HIGHLY recommend them.                                                          Thanks guys! Bonnie and Brian Goulet

plumbers.name: Whest Koast Plumbing
plumbers.address: 4625 Ottawa Ct, Rocklin, CA 95765, USA

reviews.author: Philip McAdams
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Kevin today! He was very knowledgeable, quick with his repairs, and also had really great customer service. I learned a lot about my system from visit. I previously had Roto-Rooter come out and they didn’t have the parts needed and I felt like overall they were trying to scam me. Kevin is a really, really great plumber with the needed parts, needed knowledge and great prices. I will be back!

reviews.author: Ma Joh
reviews.text: Highly recommended and would hire again. Their work is top notch and their rates very reasonable. Explained what was wrong and how they fixed it. Even though I’m handy around the house there are things you need a pro to do, and that’s these guys. Thanks Charlie and Kevin!

reviews.author: sharlotte birkland
reviews.text:
Charlie is my hero! He answered my call after midnight.  Sent a great guy
(Kevin) to fix our plumbing emergency! We are so grateful for his excellent customer service and quick response time. We highly recommend Whest Koast plumbing!

reviews.author: Catie Beckwith
reviews.text: Great service.  We had a broken shut off valve and it seemed like all plumbers were booked for  48 hours; not ideal.  Whest Koast got to us within 24 hours and were professional, answered all my questions, and did great work.  I will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: idgy baby
reviews.text: They did a great job. I had a blockage in in the lines and he was able to come the next day. I had had another company come the day before and they did everything wrong, didn't fix it and damaged part of my plumbing. Charlie knew exactly where my problem was and was able to fix it while I was out of town.  Very professional and knowledgeable.  Price was reasonable but most importantly he was able to fix it easily.

plumbers.name: B&E Plumbing Services LLC
plumbers.address: 1311 SW Cornish Ave, Lawton, OK 73505, USA

reviews.author: Toby Hood
reviews.text: I would not ever use this company. When my house was built less than a year ago. We have had nothing but problems. Then we try to get a water softener. They did not install the plumbing for a water softener. Now we are having to pay thousands of dollars to get one installed.  DO NOT ISE THIS COMPANY!!!!! I will be posting this on face book to. Also the head plumber had told me if I bought a citrus wet softer he would install it he never came back. So now. I have a water softener that I can’t use. So if any needs one at a discounted price let me know on face book.

reviews.author: Ehren Painter
reviews.text:
I called another plumber who wanted to halfass the solution to my water leak and charge me 10 grand, then after giving me the estimate and saying they could start immediately, went on vacation.

So I called B&E. They were out the same day (no charge for an estimate) and actually found the leak and fixed it all at once, all for a fraction of what the other guys quoted. AND did another quick job without any fuss.

Love these guys, would give 6 stars if I could. Maybe 7.

reviews.author: Deanna Elling
reviews.text: My warranty company assigned B&E. B&E never contacted me and would not answer or return my calls. I do not recommend this company!

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.text:
I called and the owner was very thoughtful and wanted safety for my gas line. Troy and the owners son were very polite and willing to show me what they were doing. The green solution showed bubbles smaller and the psi went down slightly. Each time Troy tightened it and then left on no more than 20 minutes instead of the hour to detect smaller leaks.

They were so friendly so I put on me and distraction that hot water heater was not turned back on. They came back out and had to turn the gas on. Then when it was time to run the heater they had not turned that back on. My physical symptoms returned when after weeks I closed my windows with dizzy and apneas skyrocketing I kept the heat on but opened windows and only slight improvement so I turned off heat. I called and asked the owner to explain what they did as my trust demolished after they dealt with bubbles by tightening the connection to my meter and had to pay to have my heater turned on. No response in 2 days. They got their 250 and they are done. For those 2 who had honest reviews, I will read all before choosing.  Communication and making good on your word does not exist.

reviews.author: Nicole Bolinger
reviews.text: Absolute professionals!  These guys came in and saved the day when the water heater in my rental went out.  Troy and Colton were the techs who helped remove and replace the water heater.  They were friendly and professional.  Alisha and the gentleman she was with (I didn't catch his name) were both wonderful to work with as well.  I highly recommend this company!

plumbers.name: Johnson’s Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 902 SE 2nd St, Lawton, OK 73501, USA

reviews.author: Lucinda Kamradt
reviews.text: Johnson's Plumbing will always be my first choice. They have helped me with sewer issues, plumbing issues, frozen busted pipes. They are always professional, reliable and reasonable on their prices. I would rather wait for them to come out than to use someone else.

reviews.author: Daniel Threlkeld
reviews.text: Johnson's Plumbing is absolutely fantastic! We had a few plumbing issues...rusted / bad toilet flange, clogged shower drain, and an issue with our shower head. They came out within a few hours of calling. Brandon and Chris were awesome!!! Fast, professional, and locally owned. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: gwen andreas
reviews.text: Called them at 4pm, came out at 1 pm next day, Brandon did an excellent job getting our drain cleared out, only took 45 minutes or so to take care of it. Very professional,  made sure everything was flowing as it should. Cleaned up after himself, and disposed of the mess. Definitely will be using them again if needed.

reviews.author: David Schultz
reviews.text: I am very satisfied with Johnson's Plumbing customer service and their technicians (Brandon and Colten). They were very professional, and Brandon was highly knowledgeable of what was needed to get the job done!!! I will recommend Johnson's Plumbing to anyone that needs any plumbing service completed.

reviews.author: Nicole Anderson
reviews.text: They actually did a great job of coming out and doing the job. They were even quick about it. But, they left dried facial matter and toilet paper by the back door and sidewalk outside our business. We asked them to come hose it off, because we didn’t have one, and they said they would come back. They never did. I called 3 days later and was told they would come that day, but they didn’t. I called the next day to talk to the owner (surely it was one of the workers that left excrement and tissue by our back door and was not coming to clean it). He had the receptionist call me back to tell me the realtor company would have to be the one to call them. I’m just disappointed at the unprofessionalism.

plumbers.name: Barwick's Plumbing

reviews.author: Rebekah Hipp
reviews.text: We had a clog and needed to find our septic tank, CJ came out and did a great job! They have the snake with a camera to check to make sure your pipes are looking good too. The ladies answering the phone was super nice and helpful!

reviews.author: Ruby Hopkins
reviews.text: Excellent Service!  I highly recommend anyone needing Barwick's Plumbing.  CJ was sent to my home.  He did a great job fixing the problems.  In addition, he has remarkable interpersonal skills.  Thanks Barwick's Plumbing.

reviews.author: William Ferrell
reviews.text: Two young men arrived and went to work immediately. They soon had the leak fixed and even repaired a poorly installed air conditioning vent. They were kind enough to let us know we need to get the air conditioning company back for a proper repair. We have put Barwick on our list "first call" companies.

reviews.author: Jason Prater
reviews.text: I called this company 2 days ago because my house drain has a blockage that needs to be addressed.  The girl told me she didn't know if they could get there that day but "he" was in Florence. She got my name and number and told me she would call me back.  I still haven't been called back. They evidently don't want my 125 per hour plus 75 to use the machine.

reviews.author: Mike McCauley
reviews.text: Guy arrived on schedule, went straight to work. His first fix didn't have the desired effect, so instead of playing around with it, he simply replaced the entire part. The whole event took 35 minutes. Will use them again if something else breaks.

plumbers.name: Pinnacle Plumbing, LLC
plumbers.address: W1734 North St #400, Green Lake, WI 54941, USA

reviews.author: Seth Murphy
reviews.text: Called because kitchen sink clogged they sent someone out right away which is only reason for 2 stars. "unclogged" using auger. Clogged again two weeks later because clearly it was still clogged downstream. Called had someone come back out, charged me more for the second service did the exact same thing, but recommended I buy some industrial grade drain unclog off amazon... Save yourself time & headache, either figure it out yourself or pay a different company.

reviews.author: Vicki Duhr
reviews.text: I highly recommend Pinnacle Plumbing.  Skilled and friendly professionals.  Todd arrived as scheduled, diagnosed the problem (recommending the best and least expensive solution), and let us meet and greet Charlie, his super cute new puppy-work partner, who was waiting quietly in the van; a few days later, Jeremy showed up, also as scheduled, with the required part and to do the repair.  We are grateful Pinnacle was readily available and plan to use them for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Shannon Hardy
reviews.text: We bought an older home about a month ago and there were several issues with the drain lines. Bennett fixed us up very quickly, and we are very pleased with his work and the rates. Todd fit us into the schedule very quickly as well, which was much appreciated!  Their rates are very reasonable as well! I highly recommend them for your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Trevor Vandehey
reviews.text: I needed a plumber for a remodel job. Todd was very quick to give a fair estimate on the project. Every time I called Todd was quick to respond. Bennett came out to do the work and did a fantastic job in a timely manner. I would highly recommend Pinnacle Plumbing to anyone looking for a plumber!

reviews.author: Ripon Baptist Church
reviews.text: We had a water leak issue that forced us to shut the main water off to the building and needed it fixed before our Sunday Services. Pinnacle was the only Plumbers that made us a priority so we could use our building on Sunday. They were very understanding of our situation and got the job done promptly. The called me back within 30 min of leaving a message and they were very easy to work with.

plumbers.name: PJ's Plumbing
plumbers.address: W294 N6359, Wallschlager Way, Pewaukee, WI 53072, USA

reviews.author: Mitchell Sherman
reviews.text:
I’ve worked with PJs several times over the last couple years and they have been great. They have been available when I needed them and communication has been great. Their technicians show up on time with well equipped trucks and the knowledge needed for the job.

I am in a similar trade and in the same area, but I recommend PJs to my customers when I am unable to get there quickly enough and they have come through every time.

reviews.author: Helen Lantz
reviews.text:
I have used Paul and his team at Pjs Plumbing service a couple of times and have been very happy with their service.  The first time I used them was earlier this year and it was for an urgent sewage leak.  They were prompt, knowledgeable, and showed great communication letting me know what the problems were and how they would troubleshoot. They were very mindful of keeping the area clean during the repair. They even went the extra mile by using Clorox to clean up after themselves. Not only was their service effective, but their pricing was also very reasonable, especially compared to other companies in the area.
Given my positive first experience, I decided to use them again just last week when one of our water heaters leaked in the basement.  Having Paul’s cell number saved in my contacts, I called him in the morning to discuss the issue.  I sent photos and they arrived and replaced my water heater by the end of the day.  I highly recommend PJ's plumbing service for anyone in need of a reliable and professional plumber.  They will be my go to plumbers in the future.

reviews.author: Kelly Sandbach
reviews.text: Fair pricing and great service. We had a tankless water heater fail and got a replacement in 2 days. Install took half day and they cleaned up well too.

reviews.author: Meredith Locke-Guttu
reviews.text:
We had them plumb our new construction home, complete with a 1 yr warranty. We discovered an issue 6months ago where the hot water wasn't consistent in our bath and showers. Paul sent out someone 3 times, each time performing a simple fix and saying "if it's still not working right, just let us know".

The 4th time they sent out the vendor who sold the hot water heater, without my knowing; suddenly I got a call from a company I'm not familiar with, telling me they're coming out to look over the heater. Would've been nice to get the heads up, Paul.

Still the hot water was running cool after 15min. My husband finds that a check valve doesn't seem to be working properly. I message Paul and he tells me it's not the valve but no one had assessed it.. 🤔 He then says to contact my builder (which he knows is impossible at this point for separate reasons). He won't return calls or emails. I put a pin in this for a couple months to work on more pressing things.

I just contacted him and he was so quick to reply and friendly! Turns out he forgot who I was and asked for my name number and address and scheduled someone for the next day, 2hr window. No one showed, called or emailed. My best guess is he pulled up our file and promptly decided to ghost us. I called and emailed multiple times to no reply. I took hours out of my day for them to come and fix this issue and they didn't show.. what a trashy move. Completely rude and unprofessional and our warranty is still good for another 2 months. We paid him in full and he did not hold his end of the bargain. I'm reporting him to every bureau and vendor we used.

Oh, and we hired a real reputable plumber who came out day-of, and he verified the check valve was stuck and is fixing it as we speak. Save the headache and find someone else... this guy is too busy taking people to collections and making up arbitrary numbers (per the other reviews)😂

reviews.author: Michele Stamn
reviews.text: PJ's is definitely the most professional plumbing business that I have encountered...and I have needed to call on plumbers quite a few times, as an "older" home owner of nearly 25 years.  PJ's has always been great about getting someone out to diagnose and solve our plumbing issues as soon as we call.  Their staff is responsive, polite, and works well together, to get the job done!  They are great about explaining what they are doing and why.  We have had PJ's to our house multiple times, and will continue to call them for any plumbing issues we encounter in the future!  I would definitely recommend them!

plumbers.name: Power Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 223 Granada Dr Ste b, San Luis Obispo, CA 93401, USA

reviews.author: Melanie Rojas
reviews.text: Our water filtration system broke and started flooding our home. We called around to find a reliable plumber, but had two bad experiences. We then called Power Plumbing and Brayden put us in contact with Bobby. Right away over the phone, Bobby was walking us through how to turn off the Refrigerator valve, but it was stripped. He was very patient as he walked us through how to turn off the water temporarily until they could come out. They arrived quickly, and Bobby was able to fix our issue for a third of the cost that we were originally quoted. We have been so pleased with the service and the professionalism. We would recommend Power Plumbing and use their services again.

reviews.author: Ross Sprague
reviews.text: There is a reason that when my year old neighborhood has a plumbing issue, that you see Power Plumbing trucks pulling up for the fix.  They are fast, honest, and reliable.  I recommend them when you have a plumbing issue in the SLO area to call them first.

reviews.author: Martin Brown
reviews.text: The best plumber in SLO County. We used them for years for commercial and residential repairs and installs and never had any issues. They are reliable, trustworthy and do the job correctly the first time without a question. Very communicative and honest. I highly recommend them to anyone who needs any plumbing work done on their house or building. The only plumbing company you'll ever need.

reviews.author: Joan Valencia
reviews.text:
WOKE UP TO A DISASTER IN A STORM . Shocked  to find hot steamy water feverishly mingling with cold stormy rain water...what the... Water heater died. Saturday. Called most of the places opened on weekend Listed online got only vmail.

UNTIL the angel of a dispatcher, Jim answered the phone. A real live human being voice from a human mouth in real time!!! He let me know Kevin would be out within an hour. He was here in 45 minutes!!

I suspected the estimate to be 75% more being a small town and a weekend. SWEET. Way cheaper than what my brother paid for a new furnace in this area on a week day with an appointment with another company A year ago.

Kevin the Plumber, was extremely professional and efficient; plus my dog liked him. I now Have a rocking "Star Wars" type water heater with lots of fancy things like an oil catcher so if it ever explodes it won't poison the water on our planet. One year labor guarantee and six year furnace warrantee.

I have found my bff plumbers. Happy Valentine's Weekend!!

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.text: Everyone I spoke with Dave, Patrick and Robbie, at Power Plumbing were kind and respectful! I will refer anyone needing plumbing, heating or air work to Power Plumbing!

reviews.author: Alijah Jonathan
reviews.text: Very satisfied with their service. The technicians were knowledgeable and explained everything clearly. The work was done smoothly, and the results exceeded my expectations.

reviews.author: Julienne Higgins

He explained what was wrong, offered helpful advice for preventing future issues, and made sure the workspace was spotless when done. I was impressed by how organized and well-prepared he was. Truly a dependable and skilled technician for any plumbing repair.

reviews.author: Nathalie Rodgers
reviews.text: My experience with a plumbing service was really great. The guys who came to do the job were super friendly and really seemed to care about what they were doing. They did a great job, sticking to the estimates they gave me but also leaving me quite impressed with the quality of their work. I mean, I kind of figured that plumbing was plumbing, but they came and made it look easy and like it was going to last a long time.

reviews.author: Willie Basso
reviews.text: Excellent experience overall. The plumber was very cooperative, skilled, and made sure the problem was fully resolved.

reviews.author: Ashley Alvarez
reviews.text: Top-quality service. They used the right tools and techniques to fix the problem properly. I really appreciate their effort and professionalism.

plumbers.address: 104 Lloydwood Dr, West Columbia, SC 29172, USA

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Hardin
reviews.text: Would highly recommend this company. My husband and I will be using them for all future plumbing issues. When our hot water heater bit the dust on some of the coldest days of the year, they came out the NEXT day to install a new hot water heater (complete with a new enclosure) and haul away our old unit. They were extremely reasonably priced - something we were so appreciative of considering we have a new baby. They worked quick - did the entire job while my husband and I were at work one day. We got to come home to hot water and it was glorious. Can’t recommend these guys enough. We are Knight’s Plumbing customers for life now. 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.author: Tamika Singleton
reviews.text: This is a family owned business that care about their customers and stand behind the work they do. Prices are very reasonable. Mrs. Knight is a sweetheart and took care of me from the first phone call through installment. I had questions about my water heater install and she answered all of them so patiently. She even sent a plumber (Jeff) out that same day to look at my hot water heater to make sure I didn't need anything additional to ease my concerns. Jeff, the installer/ certified plumber, was so kind, knowledgeable, very prompt, and professional. He was timely with the install. The job was done beautifully, very neat and clean. I highly recommend Knight's Plumbing, you won't regret it!

reviews.author: MP Rich442
reviews.text: I'd like to thank Knight's Plumbing for their friendliness, prompt arrival and professional demeanor. Everyone was pleasant to deal with, from Bonnie in the office to the service techs Chris and Daniel. Upon their arrival they quickly went to work and had the sink and shower clog cleared in no time.They were very pleasant as they went about their task. The price was very reasonable too. I will use Knight's again should the need arise.

reviews.author: Ernesto Lopez
reviews.text:
I recently had a clogged kitchen drain and called several plumbers to get price quotes and see who could handle the job on a Friday. One company offered a firm price of $325, but I continued to shop around. My wife contacted Owens Plumbing and decided to give them a try after they told her the visit would cost $39.99 to assess the problem and provide a final price.

However, once the technician arrived, the “final” price to resolve the problem suddenly increased to $500. I felt this was unreasonable, especially since the average cost to unclog a drain in Joliet is typically around $300. When I voiced my concerns and mentioned another quote I had received, the technician offered to reduce the price to $400. Ultimately agreed to proceed since the plumber was already present, and waiting until Monday to resolve the issue was not practical

Although the drain was eventually fixed, I was disappointed with the lack of transparency at the time my wife made the appointment. I believe pricing should be clearly disclosed up front especially for a common household service request, for example: a standard clog costs one price, rodding up to the first 25 feet is another, and additional work or rodding per feet costs extra. Clear pricing prevents frustration and surprises.

To make matters worse, I was also told there would be an additional fee for paying by credit card, another unexpected cost. To avoid it, we ended up paying by check.

In my opinion, business should be conducted with honest and upfront pricing, without hidden fees or last-minute changes. While the unclog repair was completed, the experience left me feeling misled and dissatisfied. Would I hire Owens again? I’m not unsure, probably not. Their pricing is on the high side, and since you don’t receive firm pricing until they arrive—and by then you’ve already invested time—it puts the customer in a difficult position, which is unfair.   I’m glad the issue was resolved, but I definitely feel I overpaid for the service.

reviews.author: McKenzie Raven
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ **Five-Star Review for Jordan**

We were initially quoted **$3,500** by Action Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electric to install a gas line for our new stove, so we reached out to the contractor who built our home addition for a referral. He sent us to Jordan, and we are so grateful he did. Jordan’s pricing was extremely fair—our total came out to around **$600**, which made perfect sense considering our exposed ceiling, easy access, and the fact that the gas line was less than four feet from where it needed to be installed on the floor above.

Jordan was personable, efficient, and incredibly respectful of our home. We were shocked—in the best way—when he **cleaned up after himself**. We’re simply not used to contractors leaving a spotless workspace, so this was an unexpected and very welcome surprise.

After the line was installed, we reached out to Jordan again because we noticed a gas smell outside. It was nowhere near the work he had done, but we wanted his expert opinion. Within **30 minutes**, he arrived, located the source of the gas smell, and discovered that our **70-year-old meter had a leak**—something that needed to be handled by Dominion Energy. He gave us the correct phone number, and within an hour, we had a brand-new meter installed.

Jordan absolutely did not have to investigate something unrelated to his work, yet he did—quickly, thoroughly, and with genuine concern for our safety. He even checked back in later that evening to make sure it had been resolved.

Jordan is extremely knowledgeable in all aspects of home systems—**gas, water, plumbing, HVAC**, and beyond. He communicates clearly, works honestly, and goes above and beyond what is expected. We would trust him with any project in our home. Highly, highly recommend!

I'd like to thank Gatlin Plumbing for the exceptional plumbers sent to my house today (12-8-25) to snake my drain and replace my kitchen sink. The two excellent plumbers are Robert and Noah, they were great. Gatlin Plumbing is my only call from here on.
Thank you very much for being able to come out the same day. A customer for as long as you are in business.

reviews.author: Terri Shebish
reviews.text: Fixed my sink that had plagued me for 5 weeks. Jeff is an angel! Was on time, worked quickly, inexpensive, and just seemed like a nice guy! Sooo happy I don't have to plunge out my sink anymore. 😂 Go with Gatlin!

reviews.author: John Yanek
reviews.text: I had another plumber out for a clogged main and he was gracious enough to tell me he didn’t have the right equipment and suggested I call Gatlin, because he was certain they would be able to do it if anyone could. Not only did they get the clog fixed in a very timely and professional manner (they were here about an hour after I called and I live 40 mins from their shop), but Eddie was about as good a guy as you’re  gonna find and super knowledgeable about what he was doing as well. My first and only call for future plumbing needs will absolutely be Gatlin! If you have plumbing needs, call the courteous, professional, knowledgeable folks at Gatlin and be confident it’ll get done without them trying to do extra work you don’t need. Oh, and I was also very pleased with the price!

reviews.author: Anna D'Amore
reviews.text: I’ve used Gatlin a couple times over the years and their guys are always really fast and professional! my sump pump battery was tripping an alarm after the power came back from all the storms last week, and it took maybe an hour to get it fixed with the guy that came out. grateful for this place!

reviews.author: Christine Robbins
reviews.text: Rob was so nice and did an amazing job! Free flow  environmental quoted us twice the price as Gatlin and wouldn't guarantee it would even fix the problem after a couple hours of trying to figure out the problem. Rob from Gatlin comes into check out our plumbing issue and took less than an hour. Their quote even included replacing our water heater. We were very pleased with the work Rob did. Definitely saving their info for future issues.

plumbers.name: D & N Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2417 N Rd, Gardendale, AL 35071, USA

reviews.author: Phillip Hathcock
reviews.text: Doesn’t get any better than D&N Plumbing! If you want the job done right at a fair price call these guys and you’ll be in great hands!

reviews.author: Brian Walding
reviews.text: I have used D&N for both my home and office plumbing needs for close to 15 years on probably 10 or so different calls.  They are always professional and on time.  They do a great job explaining what they are doing and why they are doing it.  Once you find a great plumber like D&N, you make sure to keep their number handy.  They've handled issues with septic and installed a booster pump in addition to more routine services.  They are consistently great.

reviews.author: Stan Roth
reviews.text:
A true credit to thier industry, took over a previous plumbers failed attempt at plumbing my personal residence. They have exceeded my expectation in all aspects of the project.

True Professionals.

reviews.author: Christian Terrell
reviews.text:
We have used D&N plumbing consistently for more than 8 years. They have completed just about every type of plumbing project imaginable, from leaking faucets to home remodels. Most recently, they worked us into a busy schedule, arriving just 30 minutes after my initial phone call and completing an installation within an hour.
Nathan and his team of experts are very knowledgeable, and do their work efficiently and effectively, with great care and attention to detail. They communicate well. They are polite and friendly. And most importantly, they are honest! D&N plumbing has never disappointed!

reviews.author: Dale DeLoach
reviews.text:
I called on a Monday afternoon with the little smell of gas around the water heater. She was very friendly and helpful. She worked me in for the next morning. Two guys came out and were friendly and fast. The truck was loaded with parts and looked like they could just about fix anything while they were there.
I will use them again!!

plumbers.name: Brant Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 2726 S Childs Rd, Kearneysville, WV 25430, USA

reviews.author: C Norris
reviews.text: We need an afterhours call. Mr. Brant responded promptly and took care of the issue. He was professional and reasonably priced. We would highly recommend him to anyone needing a plumber.

reviews.author: Alisa Tripp
reviews.text: Terry was awesome! Very professional and conscientious. I had a leaking water heater and he was able to fit us in to his busy schedule. He replaced the tank, added an expansion tank and even cleaned up after himself. The price was very reasonable and he was also a very nice person! I will recommend Brant Plumbing to everyone I know!

reviews.author: A Steiner
reviews.text: Terry was great to deal with! There were several "24 hour plumbers" that I  tried calling, and Terry was the only one who  answered  his phone. He calmly addressed the situation,  and came out quickly. I'm  very happy with my new water heater, and Brant's Plumbing service and prices.  I would definitely  recommend  them!

reviews.author: Linda Musgrove
reviews.text: I called a few 24 hour service companies and two never called me back and one said the he would be here between 2-6 and at 5:20 a lady called and said they didn't server the area. I called Brabdt Pluming in Kerneysville and spoke to Terry and he came right out. What a wonderful person to work with. I belive God put him here knowing we were in desperate need of getting the issue resolve as soon as possible. I will call him when ever I need any plumbing done and highly recommend him. He is absolutely a caring person. Thank you Terry, you just don't know how we appreciate meeting people like you. GOD BLESS YOU

reviews.author: Amanda Greenacre
reviews.text: Terry was an absolute star! Our water heater went out mid day on a Tuesday. He came to check it out same day and had it replaced and everything was in great working order on Wednesday morning. Highly recommend as his pricing was very fair and he was an all around nice guy!

plumbers.name: Whitfield Plumbing & Drain
plumbers.address: 66 W Mt Pleasant Ave Ste 527, Livingston, NJ 07039, USA

reviews.author: Danna Caillagua Catota
reviews.text: Before we listed our house for sell, we were aware that we'd need to upgrade our septic field and drain system. New York Plumbing made me so happy. They were very reasonable and arrived on time. Their original estimate was even lower! Although we had his mobile phone number, we did not need to contact the owner. Joelle performed the first visit and dropped by numerous times throughout the entire project. All of the staff was wonderful to deal with. He regularly checked in with us to update the status and made one last courtesy check to make sure everything was up to our satisfaction. Flavie's leadership of the team was a real pleasure. He listened to us carefully.

reviews.author: mai tran
reviews.text:
Pascual was upfront with the price and time required to finish the project. He ran into an unexpected problem, but his expertise and craftsmanship prevented any delays.
I will continue to return for all future plumbing problems because of his professionalism, great customer service and great personality.
Alan's partner is also of the same fabric; they make a great team.

You both did a great job!

reviews.author: Carlos osvaldo Castedo nogales
reviews.text:
Keno & Ethan, Exceptional Plumbers!

Keno and Ethan came to me for a plumbing concern and I could not have been happier. Kenoâ€™s expertise was apparent from the very moment he showed up. He identified the problem quickly and explained the solution to the client in plain English. Then he worked efficiently to correct it. His professionalism and detail-oriented approach were excellent.

Ethan, Ethan's apprentice, was eager and hardworking. Keno had him follow his instructions closely, and Ethan was willing to lend a hand wherever needed. He is clearly being guided by one of best in the industry.

The two of the worked well together, quickly completing their task and leaving it spotless. Their courteous and respectful attitude made the experience completely stress-free. Keno & Ethan will be my first choice for all plumbing needs in the future. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Gabriel Zambrano (Señor ceviche)
reviews.text: A great company to work for. They were able to get me an appointment the very same day that I called. They even called and bumped it up earlier in the morning! Stratton had a great attitude and was very professional. He got my drainage unclogged in no-time! I'd give 20/10 to anyone looking for a reliable, competent plumber.

reviews.author: Moeez Imran
reviews.text: It is hard to find words to describe the service that Paul provided. He was punctual and he also helped me to locate a leaky pipe above my basement. Very neat and went the extra mile to provide us with peace of mind. The guys will definitely be recommended again! Thank you so much for removing the stress from my shoulders and giving me peace of Mind. These guys are amazing !!!!

plumbers.name: Anchor Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 1470 Abbott Dr, Elgin, IL 60123, USA

reviews.author: Sophia
reviews.text: I’ve been working with Jeff in the past few years. He is courteous and professional. He’s very responsible and always comes in on time. He also explains to me about the work when I have questions and makes sure everything is as clean as possible. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: James Levin
reviews.text: Great family business that takes really good care of their customers. I take no credit for finding them - we were fortunate to come across Anchor because they had installed the plumbing for the prior owners of our home. We've now had them help us with a few things, including swapping our water heaters with tankless. Great service, great communication. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Tami Zielke
reviews.text: Best Plumbing experience I have ever had! Right from the first phone call I was treated with friendliness and professionalism. Once my appointment was made, Jeff was right on time, he identified the problem and even took the time to explain what work was needed and why. He did quality work and his price was very reasonable. If you want a Plumber who is honest and stands by his work, I highly recommend Jeff and Anchor Plumbing.

reviews.author: Gloria Helin
reviews.text: Jeff and his son have been my plumbers for four years now. I highly recommend them. They always respond when I call. They are efficient and always know what is wrong. I have called other plumbers that you have to wait to call you back or they never respond. Others have left a mess for me to clean up. Their prices are comparable to other plumbers and what they charge. -Debbie Helin-Wetzel

reviews.author: Pam
reviews.text: Had a problem with big problem with a drain backing up and overflowing gallons of water. Called Anchor. They came, unplugged our drain and were gone all within about 90 minutes. They also gave us some very helpful information on ways to better maintain our drains and septic system. Will call them again for any plumbing issues!

plumbers.name: Dickinson Commercial & Residential Plumbing
plumbers.address: 4260 Industrial Center Ln NW, Acworth, GA 30101, USA

reviews.author: YaBoy Sean
reviews.text: Couldn’t be happier with the service and efficiency of this company. Tanner is a super knowledgeable guy and does things the right way! I have the upmost confidence in referring this company, specifically Tanner, to anybody for any plumbing job! Thank you Dickinson’s and Tanner!

reviews.author: Christina C.
reviews.text: We couldn’t be happier with Todd Barth’s work! He installed a new water heater and completely overhauled our plumbing system around the water heater, which was in terrible shape. His pricing was very fair, especially compared to other companies that tried to overcharge us. Todd was professional, respectful, and incredibly efficient—he got everything done quickly and with great attention to detail. What stood out most was how patient and helpful he was in explaining everything to us. We highly recommend Todd for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Cynthia Henson
reviews.text: I had Dickinson Commercial & Residential Plumbing install a new sink and faucet in my kitchen and also replaced a shower knob for me. Todd came out and did a fantastic job! Very thorough and professionally done. I highly recommend Dickinson Commercial & Residential Plumbing for any of your plumbing needs. 100%!!!!

reviews.author: Larry Whitten
reviews.text:
Todd from Dickinson installed a two way clean out on an irrigation system in my yard. These guys are great! Price was affordable, communication was excellent and the work, which involved the use of a small tractor, was done with respect for my property. I highly recommend!

Larry W
Kennesaw

reviews.author: Tanner Henke
reviews.text: We had a couple of companies come out to see about doing a repair on a shower valve and Dickinson was a bit cheaper then the other quotes we got. We went with them for the repair and they did a fantastic job. It looks great and functions so much better than what we had. Highly recommend for quality and friendly service.

plumbers.name: Lindenhurst Plumbing Inc.
plumbers.address: 1110 Vista Dr, Gurnee, IL 60031, USA

reviews.author: Ben Herman
reviews.text:
We had no fewer than 7 plumbing issues that needed addressing including three leaking faucets, two showers that needed repair to increase water flow and repairs and upgrades to our flood control system.  Joe was able to successfully deal with all 7 of the issues we knew about plus he identified and corrected two other plumbing situations involving our water heater before they too because a problem.

We could not be more pleased with the work that Joe completed in our home.  He arrived on time and took care of everything in far less time then anyone expected and as a result what he charged us was more than fair.  I have never seen a plumber work as quickly and efficiently as Joe who has now become our go to plumber when ever we need any plumbing service.

reviews.author: Craig Sinclair
reviews.text: Joe is a rare find in the world of contractors. He is professional, responsive and has a great demeanor/personality to work with. He provides excellent service and value and I feel fortunate to have found a plumber that I will TRUST to work on any project that I ever have.  I highly recommend Lindenhurst Plumbing for all of your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Hajime Takamura
reviews.text:
Joe did a great job to replace and install a sump pump recently for us.
Worth mentioning that he came on time, completed the job within an hour as estimated. In addition a pleasant surprise for us was the cleanliness of his work   We  certainly  valued  his  service  and  would  recommend  him to anyone.

reviews.author: Jeff Antonetti
reviews.text: Joe came earlier than planned.  Nice having someone so prompt.   This clog went beyond my ability to repair since, it was a couple dozen feet down the line.   He was able to repair the problem and suggested a redesign of the piping to prevent it from occurring again.  I love it when a technician thinks outside the box.  I recommend Joe for your next plumbing job.

reviews.author: Joe G
reviews.text: We used Lindenhurst Plumbing recently and we would highly recommend them to anyone who is in need of plumbing work.   As others have said, Joe is very punctual and does great work, and left the area as clean as when he arrived.  I will be referring him to family members whenever they’re in need of a plumber and I’m positive I’ll use him for future projects.

plumbers.name: AAA Design Plumbing Schaumburg
plumbers.address: 741 Crest Ave, Schaumburg, IL 60193, USA

reviews.author: Cynthia Hudziak
reviews.text: We needed a plumber FAST for something we broke on a Sunday!  Vlad was able to instruct my husband with a quick fix until he could get here.  Work was quick & correct.  I highly recommend & will use them for a new project shortly.

reviews.author: Michael Malvin
reviews.text:
Vlad is a pleasure to work with. Extremely accommodating, professional, communicative, and flexible in working with your schedule. And he of course does the job right.

I could not provide a stronger recommendation, and I will be reaching out to him for anything I need in the future!

reviews.author: Aswin Srinivasan
reviews.text: I'm having my bathroom redone and we're contracting AAA Design Plumbing for, well, the plumbing. Volodymyr has been an absolute professional and his work has been fantastic so far. Got myself a new go to plumbing company for the future.

reviews.author: Colleen Harden
reviews.text: Volodymyr is simply the best!  I usually don’t write reviews, but I felt the need to.  I had an emergency situation where the shower handle came off in my hand.  Water was spraying everywhere.  Vlod came out rather quickly and had the part ready to install.  He is efficient, knowledgeable, and super friendly! I will only use him from now on and recommend him to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Christle Stezskal
reviews.text: Volodymyr was a huge help when a tenant reached out about their water heater not working. After another larger company got too busy to get to us that day, we called him at 4:00 and he was able to come over within the hour to do the repair. Communicated well and at a fair price. Thanks!

plumbers.name: The Cedar Park Plumber
plumbers.address: 401 Buttercup Creek Blvd #1206, Cedar Park, TX 78613, USA

reviews.author: Milexis Molina
reviews.text: Outstanding service—why can’t every company be this easy to deal with? From scheduling to completion, everything was smooth and stress-free. They communicated clearly, showed up on time, and handled the job with skill and professionalism. I truly appreciate how simple they made the whole process. Definitely a company I’d call again!

reviews.author: Manuel Herrera
reviews.text: You can tell they are experienced and licensed plumbers who truly care about quality work. I will definitely use their plumbing services again.

reviews.author: Yucibel Blanco
reviews.text: Very reliable service. They arrived on time and handled the situation professionally. I appreciate their honesty and attention to detail.

reviews.author: Yesika Perez
reviews.text: These plumbers are truly dependable—every time they come out, I know the job will be handled the right way. It’s a relief not having to worry about anything with them.

reviews.author: Angel Villafranca
reviews.text: The plumber checked everything thoroughly and explained what needed attention. I value their transparency.

plumbers.name: Ask Bill's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1101 Halsey Dr, Leander, TX 78641, USA

reviews.author: Carole Ann
reviews.text:
When my garbage disposal broke, my
neighbor recommended Ask Bill's Plumbing.  She had used them recently, and was very happy.
So I called.  They were able to get out toy house right away. . Very professional. They did excellent work. And did it quickly. The price is fare, and service superb.

reviews.author: Faye Campbell
reviews.text: I called this plumbing company because the house pictured is 1 block away from me, and with the pictures of the kids, it seemed like he would be down to earth.  Not to mention that the reviews seemed good.  When I called the number, it was an "umbrella company" All-State Plumbing out of Austin.   They charge $139 to come and "diagnose".  I emptied under the sink before he arrived.  When he got here, he didn't do anything.  Not one thing.  Literally tells me it will cost $489 to run the cable.  I ask him if that will fix the problem, at which point he says "let's hope".   I paid the trip charge (if I had thrown it in the trash can I'd be in the same spot), and passed on their services.  I wish I could have gotten to the original company that I called.

reviews.author: natalia medrano
reviews.text: Great plumbing company. They went above and beyond. They replaced my water heater but also helped me replaceing a outside faucet. Recommended

reviews.author: Kristina Camacho
reviews.text:
Came at 9:45pm! Very kind, quick, explained everything to me over the phone and again in person. Ben was very patient and had almost all of the parts already in his truck even though this was a last minute call.

The price for the emergency service was incredibly reasonable as well.

Thank you very much. I appreciate you!!

reviews.author: Tim M
reviews.text: I needed a plumber on Thanksgiving Day and Ask Bill's Plumbing sent someone out. I was pleasantly surprised at the cost considering it was a major holiday. They did a good job and didn't try to upsale me.

plumbers.name: A Reliable Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 2221 N Pleasant Ave, Fresno, CA 93705, USA

reviews.author: heidi dwelle
reviews.text: I would definitely recommend A Reliable Plumbing. They came out to the house within an hour of my call and had the shower fixed in no time. They are polite, honest and knowledgeable in what they do!

reviews.author: tim Arquiette
reviews.text: This is the 2nd time Ive used A Reliable Plumbers.  Both times they were out the next day. Diagnosed problem and got right to work. Manual was the main tech and Albert was awesome. I cant say enough good things about this company,thier employees and fair pricing. I highly,Highly recommend them

reviews.author: Claudia Nayares
reviews.text: I want to give a million thanks over to Manuel and Albert from A Reliable Plumbing. They showed up after I contacted my own home warranty (who were no help at all) and assessed my plumbing issue and solved it! They were super knowledgeable and even gave tips on other areas of my home. I highly recommend contacting them if you have an issue with your plumbing :)

reviews.author: Steve McGill
reviews.text:
Manual and Albert fixed my leach line and fixed our kitchen faucet. These are good people and I can’t give them enough praise!
I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Norma Dorado
reviews.text: On 12/20/2021 we awoke to huge mess in our garage!  Our water broke and only 4 days to christmas, we  called All Britton plumbing and they were booked solid and couldn't come for a week!  The lady referred us to A Reliable plumbing, these men were amazing they came and replaced our water heater quickly and water back on!  Thank you Manuel and crew, for quick and friendly service.  As for pricing we feel it was fair for a new water heater

plumbers.name: Kenfield Plumbing
plumbers.address: 9414 E 161st Ave, Brighton, CO 80602, USA

reviews.author: Mardene
reviews.text: I was impressed with how punctual Kenfield Plumbing was; the plumber arrived exactly on time and got to work right away. The job was completed efficiently and the team was courteous, making me feel comfortable with the whole process. Their trustworthiness showed when they explained the water heater replacement options clearly and did the work at a fair price. I will definitely call them again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Tom Serra
reviews.text: Kenny is a great person and an excellent plumber. He is personable, thoughtful, and detailed with his work. I called multiple plumber companies for quotes, before finding Kenny, and Kenny beat the best price without question on all jobs. Kenny completed three jobs for me so far; several valves installed, a water heater installed, and a complex re-piping job. He goes above expectations to ensure everything is correct, before he leaves. Additionally, Kenny is a Master Plumber (and business owner) showing up to complete the work. No other company is providing that great quality of service for the best price in town. You can feel confident the work will be done right without breaking the bank.  I cannot say enough good things about Kenny! Call Kenny once and you will have a reliable plumber for life.

reviews.author: Darrell White
reviews.text: Our ancient water heater was expiring and Lowe’s sent over Alan from Kenfield Plumbing to install the new one. Alan was quick, incredibly efficient and delightful to work with. He double-checked that all was working perfectly. We have NO reservations about referring Kenfield Plumbing .

reviews.author: Clarke Watson
reviews.text: Great experience with Kenny! I called about my water heater going out, and within 24 hours I was enjoying a hot shower with the new tank installed and the old one removed! Great quick service, and nice guy to chat with as well.

reviews.author: Nate Brown
reviews.text: Awesome work done by these fellas, extremely professional. Kenny replaced my water heater and he was very quick and also super easy to chat with… very nice guy! This company is awesome! Happy I stumbled upon them. I very much recommend them!

plumbers.name: Southern Plumbing & Heating Inc
plumbers.address: 435 E Burnett Ave, Louisville, KY 40217, USA

reviews.author: joel lobb
reviews.text:
Excellent Service and Professional Workmanship!

They did an outstanding job! They arrived on time, quickly diagnosed the problem, and fixed it  quickly and offered pointers if it tears up again.

They were respectful of my home, kept everything clean, and explained exactly what they were doing every step of the way. Just really down to earth guys they you can trust. Small local company that does not try to upsell you and you can just trust them on what they say.

I highly recommend Southern Plumbing  to anyone looking for dependable, high-quality plumbing service. I’ll definitely call them again for future work.

reviews.author: Linda Mance
reviews.text: These two Plumbers are great at their jobs & efficient. Especially the lead  plumber, I think his name is Tom. Saved my leaky floors. Pleasant, hardworking & honest.Answered all my questions. The customer service clerk on the phone was great too. Thank you all!

reviews.author: C. S.
reviews.text:
Although the two Customer Service Representatives that I spoke with were helpful beyond measure, my plumbing was out of commission to the point that I couldn't use water in my home at all for four days. A service call had been submitted and accepted by Southern Plumbing and I was expecting Southern Plumbing to send a technician the same day. It wasn't until the day after the service call was submitted and accepted by Southern Plumbing that a technician was sent to my home. I was not able to use water in my home until the fourth day when Southern Plumbing finally sent someone to my home. Then, when they started the job, it took the technicians an hour to find the location of the issue considering there aren't very many entry points for the issue that I was having.

I am very appreciative for them locating and correcting the issue, although, I am unhappy with the timeframe that it took them to get to my service call and to locate the issue.

reviews.author: Mike Pascal
reviews.text: Outstanding service. Saved my families butts on Christmas Day! Reasonably priced, fair, hardworking, honest. Plumbers name was Tom, if I remember correctly. Great guy, deserves a raise.Tom has been working for these folks for over 30 years. That speaks volumes. A++++

reviews.author: Chris Flaherty
reviews.text: The employees were helpful and made the process of ordering a toilet tank lid very easy. I have bought items from them both in person and online and they have been equally efficient either way.

plumbers.name: Lynch Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 3713 FL-580, Oldsmar, FL 34677, USA

reviews.author: Tracey Pearce
reviews.text: Lynch Plumbing did a Fantastic job at a reasonable price.  They fixed my Garbage Disposal instead of telling me I needed a new one, they removed a piece of jewelry from the bathroom sink and fixed the leak in my outdoor water softener system.  They came back about a half hour later to make sure there were no leaks where the pipes had been replaced.  They even left me a garbage disposal key and showed be how to fix the disposal if the problem happened again.   I will definitely call them again for any plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Kerry Strong
reviews.text: We have 2 water heaters and we noticed a small leak at the bottom of one of them so I called Lynch Plumbing to get a quote to replace it. They were a good price and replaced it the next day. Their work was impeccable. They had also replaced our other water heater approx. 8 years ago and it's still running like a champ. We are very pleased.

reviews.author: Sara Lynn
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Lynch Plumbing in my Oldsmar Home this weekend!! I called around 10am when I came back from morning errands to a flooded kitchen, two kids in tow and a dinner party I was to host that night!! Frantic, I called Lynch Plumbing and Louis, bless his heart, was ringing by doorbell by 12-15p that day! ( on a Saturday!) within about an hour Louis had me fixed up and even cleaned up my flooded kitchen floor for me!!! Thank you Lynch Plumbing and Louis for truly saving my day!!! I’ve already told ALL my neighbors how great, reliable and trustworthy you are!! I high recommend Lynch Plumbing!

reviews.author: Crystal M
reviews.text:
Lynch Plumbing was called to replace a garbage disposal. Upon entering my home Vinnie was SO RUDE if I had not been in shock at his statements, I would have asked him to leave immediately. I did try and call the owner or office manager and a Louis blew me off explaining that he is a good Plummer and in 2017 we should not take stuff so personally.  Vinnie's comments were personal, very personal -too bad Lynch Plumbing lost a customer and several more since I tell everyone I know NOT to call these people for anything!
Louis is not the owner/office manager but could use some customer service training as well.
Lynch Pluming are not the only plumbers out there-be warned!

reviews.author: Sharon Jacobson
reviews.text: I would happily recommend Lynch Plumbing to friends, family and neighbors.  Mr. Lynch is very reliable, honest and trustworthy.  He arrives on time and provides fair pricing for the work he does.  I'll definitely use Lynch Plumbing again for any additional plumbing services needed in my home.

plumbers.name: Upgrade Plumbing Services, Inc.
plumbers.address: 108 Highland Rim Dr, Columbia, TN 38401, USA

reviews.author: Brittney Mason
reviews.text: Highly recommend! They were quick to get us what we needed and were in communication with us the entire time. Very competitive pricing!

reviews.author: Billy Aycock
reviews.text: Highly recommend.  Able to quickly get in contact and get a competitive quote.   Also able to quickly get tankless water heater installed and running.

reviews.author: Amanda Merlin
reviews.text:
10/10 would recommend to anyone in need of plumbing service. Jeremy was an absolute savior! Hot water heater went kaput 2 weeks into a new home. Had a guy from my community come out and take a look. Fixed one part just to realize I needed another part that wouldn’t be in for a few days. The local guy didn’t have connections to assist in changing this scenario and told us we, unfortunately, would have to wait it out. Mind you, it’s dead of winter and the night time temp is in the teens. Cold plunge showers are not feeling great this time a year. I couldn’t wait days, so I googled and found Upgrade and gave it a shot. I called Jeremy in a near panic over having to wait out days more for hot water. He was incredibly kind, understanding of our plight, and dedicated to getting us water that day. He listened and gave us options. We ended up opting for a whole new water heater instead of fixing another problem just to potentially find a new one. He and another worker came out that evening and installed a new system after hours! After two days of no hot water, it was beyond amazing to get it back.
Jeremy was incredibly professional, Knowledgeable and a pleasure to do business with. You don’t come across service like that often. As I said 10/10 would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Darren L
reviews.text: Upgrade plumbing is the best!  Jeremy and Elijah have done multiple jobs at our house and each time was a great experience.  They've updated plumbing in our remodeled kitchen and a new powder room and most recently added a dog wash station in our basement. I highly recommend Yetti Plumbing!

reviews.author: Brett Adkinson
reviews.text: I was referred to Yeti plumbing by a friend and when I called I got Kyle the owner, I explained that I thought I may have a two fold issue in that it appeared I may have had the water heater go and that there appeared to be a clogged floor drain also. Kyle agreed to come out after hours to look at the issue, it turned out that I had a sewer back up which he routed on the spot and also informed us that the water heater did not need to be replaced. There are really no words to express the relief of not only having the issue fixed in a timely manner but the honestly and helpfulness we experienced. It's rare to find people not looking to take advantage of a bad situation but I can say that is exactly what we got from Kyle and Yeti plumbing, I won't use anyone else going forward and would recommend trying this company for any of your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Isaac Melton

reviews.text:
Ever have a great start to a day, and in a split second everything just goes down the drain? Well it wasn’t going down the drain for me; it was being pumped out of my basement sump pump. That’s when I knew I needed help. I called Big Apple; best thing I could have done!  They were out to my house within a hour!! He took a look where the main water was coming into my house and pointed out to me where the water leak was coming from. He explained that it could be in the cement or in my yard…. Either way he could get it back into operation the same day!

Long story short…. He showed me the issued piping, and I opted to have a brand new pipe installed from the water main to my house. They just dig out a hole around the water main now and don’t have to trench and dig out the whole yard.

I couldn’t have asked for a better expert or quicker response!

Thanks for saving the day!!!!

They were extremely experienced in locating the connection inside the wall, cut through the sheetrock in the garage, and quickly connected new piping to existing inside the wall, and sealed the opening in the sheetrock with a cover, so no need for additional repair costs for covering the hole in the sheetrock!! Since purchasing my home in 2017, Frank J Klein & Sons has been my trusted partner for all heating, cooling, and plumbing maintenance. Their reliability and professionalism have always impressed me, which is why I’ve recommended them without hesitation for years.

Recently, I entrusted them with my first major renovation project as a homeowner: replacing my entire AC system. From start to finish, the experience exceeded every expectation. As soon as I approved the work, they had it scheduled and completed within a week. The crew arrived promptly, completed everything in one day, and left my home spotless. I felt completely confident in the quality and care put into the job.

I didn’t price shop this project, but I did ask around. Multiple landlords and homeowners who had similar work done told me the price I received was very fair—and I wholeheartedly agree.

What stood out even more was how respectfully I was treated throughout the process. As a first time homeowner, I truly appreciated how thoughtfully they listened to my questions, explained things clearly, and made sure I felt heard from beginning to end. That level of attentiveness speaks volumes.

If you're looking for a team that's efficient, respectful, and delivers high-quality results with integrity, Frank J Klein & Sons is the one to trust.

reviews.author: Nicholas Martin
reviews.text:
Working with BHS has been incredibly frustrating from the start and should have thrown up red flags. After paying my 50% invoice down it took me nearly three weeks and a threat of a refund to get a response. We scheduled that the guys would be there at 8am, they didn't end up showing up until 10:30 with zero communication from anyone. I ended up messaging Bruce to find out what was going on. They then had to leave about an hour and a half after showing up because they didn't have the supplies needed.

Part of the work being done was re-running the condensate line from flexible tubing to PEX. The guys only ended up doing a portion of it and terminated it back into the floor drain which was not what was communicated with Bruce. I explained things and they extended it but kept the drain pipe outside of the wall. I have no idea why. They didn't end up putting the little colored washers on the new washing machine hookups either. Since the PEX is white I couldn't tell which is which.

I spoke with Bruce in person about it and he let me know he'd come and fix the issues and I tried to work with him and let him know that since the condensate drain was working he could come out and fix it the following week instead of trying to squeeze me in.

Over a month later Bruce finally ended up having to come back out to fix the issues that the guys left. The tubing to my condensate pump was not tightened properly and ended up leaking water everywhere in my basement. Thankfully we're going through a remodel and there was no flooring or anything down but it soaked all of our belongings down in that area. He ended up having to make a return trip to fix that issue and finally fix the condensate pump tube that was outside of the wall.

Keep in mind, the guys were originally there to do the work on July 17th 2023, it didn't finally get fully resolved until Tuesday, September 5th 2023.

Through this entire process I've been incredibly reasonable and tried to be flexible and I've been taken advantage of at every turn. I paid over $2200 for half my invoice for all the plumbing work which also included a shower install too. The last time the manufacturer of the shower heard from Bruce was Sept. 5th. My whole project has been waiting on him to get the one piece shower ordered and delivered.

I followed up with BHS via text message on Oct 31st requesting my invoice to be updated and that I'd like to cancel any remaining work due to the previous experience we've had. I did not get a response. I sent a follow up email on Nov. 2nd and I also have not gotten a response to that either.

I don't take lightly to writing one star reviews but the lack of ANY communication, professionalism, so many apologies, and frankly being treated like I don't matter as a customer has caused this one.

He is invited back to do more work! I highly recommend Tony! Quality work! Great price! I He is awesome and I can’t wait to do more business with him!! see you soon!

reviews.author: Sharat Jonnalagadda
reviews.text: Tony is an amazing guy that offers master plumber expertise at a very reasonable price. Anyone reading this review, I strongly advise you to get a quote from this man. reviews.author: Erin R
reviews.text: Tony is a true professional! He is knowledgeable, fair, and really personable. I have used Bluegreen Plumbing twice now, once for replacing a sink disposal and once to replace a toilet. Both times there ended up being more work to be done than originally thought and Tony was honest and upfront about it both times and prices were very reasonable. I can absolutely say I will never use another plumber! Even my dog, who does NOT like strangers in the house, immediately took to Tony!!

reviews.author: Matt McConville
reviews.text: Tony was great!! He was kind, courteous and explained in detail the problem and what the solution would be.  He was efficient with my time and budget conscience about the work.  Highly recommend him for any and all plumbing needs! Fair and honest work is hard to come by these days, Tony is one of the good ones!

plumbers.name: Integrity Plumbing Solutions
plumbers.address: 9001 N Dixie Dr, Dayton, OH 45414, USA

reviews.author: Jung Jun
reviews.text: Great service and reasonable price. Integrity Plumbing Solutions came quickly and fixed my issue. Their price was 3 times cheaper than  quotes I got from other companies. If you need honest plumber, give them a call. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Jonathan LeGault
reviews.text:
Started out pretty disappointed and confused with this company. Had someone come out to give us an estimate for multiple items to include toilet swaps, relocating a toilet to opposite wall in bathroom, sump pump update/re-route, laundry bucket drain install, routing new eater lines for a sink, hooking up a water softener, relocating a water meter, installing a shut off valve on the main incoming water line, and fixing a leak on the sewer drain where the toilets connect. After we figure out our budget and prioritized what we needed done first, we asked them to come out and focus on the toilet swap, leak and an additional minor leak on a whole house filter connection (drip once about every 2 minutes). They updated the estimate to reflect the focused work, scheduled an appointment time, and a technician came out to do the work. I went over the job tasking with him to confirm what we wanted done as he relayed that he was not informed of everything that needed to be completed beforehand and that he was not equipped with enough materials. I asked him if he needed to see the estimate that was sent us and he said no.  He also relayed that he was not sure how to fix the leaking piping as it needed to be updated in a way that was up to code and he would need to speak with his boss who is a master plumber to make sure he was doing it right. Ultimately he would not be able to do the work for us that day and would need to reschedule. I told him that it was ok with me and that we wanted it to be done correctly in one shot versus having them come out multiple times to fix things. After he left, I called their office and scheduled a new day to have their technician come out to do the work.

A few days later we then received a phone call from their office sating that looking at the job, "it is significant more work than they anticipated and that they are not willing to do the work." I then called their office today and had a conversation to understand what the issue is. They relayed that they feel that they would need to update more of the piping to make sure it is up to code and and not willing to do the work on old piping, so I would need to find a different plumber who is willing to get the job done for us. I told them that that is unfortunate because I was never not willing to have things updated and up to code. I am a customer who was willing to pay to have the job done correctly and it just seems that they are just not wanting to do the job... I also stated that they just lost a customer because of that. This includes recommendations as well.

With that being said, I gave them a poor review based on things such as:

- Bad communication
- Not willing to do the work
- Confusion
- Lack of wanting to be paid
- Lack of education/experience from technician to get the job done
- Lack of preparation

but then the owner called and they admitted that there was miscommunication between team members and they should have just called me to clarify what we were seeking as a customer. They stated they were under the impression that we were not willing to have things updated to code. I corrected that issue to state that we actually relayed multiple times that having things up to code was exactly what we were seeking as what we currently have is creating issues. We wanted things done correctly one time without having someone come out multiple times to fix things. We came to the concluded that we may consider them again as we go through an estimate process again with other plumbers.

Well, we gave them a second chance and glad that we did. They made things right and did a very professional job in a timely manner. Overall, we are very happy with all of the work. Thank you Tim, Mike, and Thomas for all of the assistance at our house.  This was a lesson in communication and Integrity Plumbing did their due diligence to fix things. We plan to use them for future projects and recommend them to others in the area!

reviews.text: I needed work done on 2 of my shower shut off valves (1 was immediate need / the other i requested, to prevent another immediate need) I regret not getting the name of the gentleman who did the work. reviews.text:

I don’t usually write reviews but I felt that this experience could benefit others who may be in a similar situation in the future.

reviews.text: My sewer broke and  Cupco came out and explained everything. I’m so happy with the work they did and the price. Unlike large corporations, they don’t try to get you to pay for more than needs to be done. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jackie Wishau
reviews.text: I cannot recommend the Cupco team enough! I recently moved into a townhouse after living in a condo for the last 10+ years and have NO IDEA what I’m doing when it comes to most home issues! After discovering an unpleasant odor coming from my basement (which I thought might be a sewage issue) I started with another company whose recommendation was that I needed to spend $5k to “hopefully” get to the issue. I called Cupco for a second opinion and they were able to come out the next day. They spent nearly twice the amount of time diagnosing the issue and gave me the confidence that I did not actually need the work suggested. While I’m still trying to figure out the cause of my issue, I can confidently say plumbing is not the cause. What’s more, Chad was able to give me some suggestions for some non-plumbing things I might want to look at and provided me recommendations. I was a bit worried what my final bill would be after the extensive investigation work they did, but it ended up being less than the first company I called! While I hope I don’t have any new plumbing emergencies, I know that Chad and Cupco will be my first call.

reviews.author: Erica Hendrix
reviews.text: The plumber who helped us is truly skilled and pays close attention to detail, turning even complicated plumbing work into something impressive. A while back, they installed a tankless water heater at my home, ran new lines to a couple of radiators, and added more plumbing for the new rooms we were building. Most recently, I needed help at a job site when a gas line was accidentally damaged. The plumber came out quickly and had everything fixed in just over an hour.
