The pricing was fair—much better than what you’d expect from some of the bigger companies, especially when you need help fast. Also, I appreciated how upfront and honest they were if any issues came up during the work. Highly recommended for anyone needing plumbing services!

reviews.author: Fred Cardenas
reviews.text: No one wants to find out from the water department that their home has a water leak, but if it happens, I highly recommend calling a professional plumber right away. We’ve relied on a great plumbing team several times—they’ve helped us with everything from replacing a hot water heater to fixing a leaking sink drain. Most recently, they handled a big job by replacing most of the plumbing under our house and installing a new water line from the street because of multiple leaks caused by the dry weather. The plumber and the crew were very knowledgeable and easy to work with. They really take pride in doing the job right, and you can tell they care about quality. We felt confident that the work would last a long time, especially since they took the time to fix a lot of quick, temporary repairs left by previous owners. Our home was built decades ago and had several different types of pipes underneath, but the plumbers figured it all out and made sure everything was updated and working smoothly. The crew arrived on time each day and made sure to clean up after themselves. They were polite, respectful, and did excellent work. If you have an older home, especially one with complicated or outdated plumbing, I definitely recommend this team—they really know what they’re doing when it comes to old pipes and tricky plumbing setups. Throughout the whole project, the lead plumber kept us updated and even stopped by to check on the progress. While the prices aren’t the cheapest, they are very fair for the quality and professionalism you get. I’m happy to pay for a job that’s done right by licensed experts. We’re very satisfied with the results and would gladly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work.

reviews.author: Alan Ross
reviews.text: I was really impressed with the plumbing service I received in Commerce. After I called, a technician got back to me very quickly and was able to schedule an appointment sooner than I expected. The plumber arrived with advanced equipment and clearly explained the process of finding the leak. They quickly located the problem and had a crew come out to fix it within the week. I appreciated the fast response and how helpful everyone was. The whole experience was smooth and made dealing with the leak much easier.

reviews.author: M Wright
reviews.text: I had a plumbing emergency at my home in Commerce and after calling several other places with no luck, I reached out to Plumberland Emergency Plumbing Land Commerce. A technician arrived at my door within an hour, which was impressive considering how urgent my situation was. The technician quickly found the main issue, and then returned first thing the next morning right on time. As they started working, they discovered that my water softener had broken, which sent chemicals and sand all through my house’s plumbing. The team worked tirelessly all weekend, carefully draining and flushing every pipe in my home. They replaced any damaged lines and valves, and fixed everything that had become clogged in the toilets and showers. Any appliances that were broken were swapped out for new ones, and they made sure the pipes were fully cleaned throughout the house. The workers were extremely professional, knowledgeable, and took a lot of care with every step. For all the work and hours they put in, the price was very fair. Compared to the other companies I called, this team was much more responsive and respectful. They worked with a real sense of urgency and made sure everything was in perfect working order before they left. The technician even took the time to explain what I should do for regular maintenance and how to handle things if another emergency comes up. I am extremely satisfied with the service and will definitely use them again for any plumbing needs. My home’s plumbing now works perfectly, and I have total peace of mind. Highly recommended!

Other people had told me that my pipes had collapsed under the foundation of my older home, but when the technician arrived, he quickly found that the real issue was just clogged pipes. Since then they have replaced three boilers and two more water heaters for us. Nick and Ray seem to treat all their customers like family!

reviews.author: Richard Densel
reviews.text: We have used Contemporary Plumbing & Heating at our non profit organization in Wayne. Would Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Marc Baumann
reviews.text: Contemporary is the best! Ray, Nick, and the rest of the team are top notch! Andre was incredible to work with on our repairs and did a great job. We will absolutely use Contemporary again for all of our plumbing needs. Keep up the great work!

reviews.author: Denise DeVaughn
reviews.text: We used Contemporary Plumbing to convert our home from oil to gas.  The conversion was seamless. reviews.author: Amy Rosen
reviews.text: Just used M&M Precision to replace my old boiler and hot water heater and I could not recommend them enough. From start to finish, the experience was excellent. They are extremely thorough, quick, knowledgeable and left everything spotless when the job was done. Everything was explained very clearly and they made the entire process stress-free. Very professional and trustworthy. If you’re in need of a boiler replacement, look no further.

reviews.author: Douglas Haber
reviews.text:
I called M&M Precision for what I understood to be an estimate visit for boiler work. The crew was professional, the estimate seemed fair, and everyone I dealt with was pleasant.

However, after the visit I received a $161.85 invoice labeled as a “trip fee” / diagnostic charge. No fee was mentioned when scheduling the appointment, and the company website clearly says: “Contact us today for a free estimate.”

When I called afterward, I was told the “free estimate” wording only applies to new systems, but that distinction was never explained beforehand and is not clear from the website.

Not disputing their right to charge trip fees, but the lack of upfront disclosure was disappointing.

reviews.author: Kevin R
reviews.text: Highly recommend M&M Precision Plumbing & Heating. Max and his team replaced my boiler and water heater and did an outstanding job—efficient, knowledgeable, and very clean. Couldn’t be happier.

reviews.author: brian rose
reviews.text: True professionals. I will only call M&M from now on. My boiler broke over night they had someone there by the morning and it didn’t cost me an arm and a leg. These guys are great 5 star.

He’s trustworthy, honest and his prices were great compared to local companies. Couldn’t have been happier with our decision to use his team and will continue to recommend them going forward. You would think a courtesy call to simply say we are booked up right now, you might want to seek another plumber. So much for good service, more then likely a blessing, if they will disrespect you with a very simple matter I can only imagine how poor the quality of work would be as well.

reviews.author: Denise Setchell

reviews.author: Ramona Abbott
reviews.text:
Phenomenal job! The plumbing work needed in our home was extensive. Replacement of pipes and upgrading a system that was 100 years old. We needed work done that was well outside our ability. We wanted to add a bathroom in the basement and a laundry room where there wasn’t any. ‘WOW’ Salyer, made it happen.
They were extremely knowledgeable and answered every question we had. The team of technicians that worked in our home were amazing. They had to dig and were in a small space but cleaned up daily their work area. We were so impressed by the quality of the work, time, and cost of this project.  Thank you Salyer for your excellent service.

reviews.author: Jennifer Hill
reviews.text: I would have given a zero but not an option. I have used Salyer many times over the years. I was transferred by a gentleman to a scheduler. The woman that answered told me she was on a chat laughing and slurping a beverage. Very unprofessional and did not call me back until this morning. Sadly, Salyer this one interaction spoke volumes of your customer service representative. Same woman called me today to schedule. Already found someone else.

reviews.author: Tamara Scott
reviews.text: Be sure to ask if they are sending a licensed plumber to your home. They charge licensed plumber prices but may send an apprentice, alone. I agreed to their pricing, expecting a plumber. Came out quickly, but sent an apprentice alone. Sump pump was bubbling up in floor drain of crawl space. 5 hours of looking for the problem, there was no answer. $850. Had them back out to install back flow valve to stop water from coming up in drain, another $650 and alone apprentice. I have nothing against apprentices, they have to learn, but should be working with a licensed plumber in person. After $1500, hope the problem is solved. The apprentice was very respectful.

reviews.author: James
reviews.text: It’s hard to find a company that you’re impressed with, which is why I’m writing this review. First and foremost this is a family company, which has roots in the region for 100 years. How cool is that? Them being in business for that long tells you they’re doing something right. I called Salyer plumbing early this year as my water main broke. They came out that day to do an assessment. The person that came out was friendly, courteous, and empathetic. He told me to expect a call later that day, which I did. The owner called me and explained everything and sent over quotes. She was very understanding and answered every question I had. This meant the world to me as I’m a first time home owner and this was all new to me. The crew came out did a wonderful job without destroying my yard. Other companies wanted to dig out the yard while Salyer could do most of it with a small hole. I highly recommend this company. Support a local family owned business, you won’t regret it.

reviews.author: Meagan Burda
reviews.text: ARE YOU KIDDING ME! Do not call anyone else!!!!! They are amazing!! Such a stressful morning went to the basement and almost broke my neck when I slipped on the water that was quickly filling my basement. It sounded like a waterfall behind the wall! Terrifying!!! Cathy was extremely sweet and helpful on the phone, took care of EVERYTHING! They were at my house in literally like 5 mins! I’m not from here and so I have no experience with any companies. After frantically calling other places and they were all unable/unwilling to help until the next day… I thankfully found Salyer to the rescue!! The two magician plumbers Jake & Rob were amazing and fast!! And put my mind at ease!!! Literally thank God for Salyer.

reviews.text: Greg at Plumbing Solutions bled out my radiator lines, added bleeder valves, and he answered my myriad of questions. My rooms were then much warmer and more comfortable. His pricing was better than the others I called, and he arrived on time. He is my #1 go-to plumber from now on!

reviews.author: Mark Hofer
reviews.text: Greg at Plumbing Solutions has provided us with incredible service.  He has quickly dealt with a number of plumbing emergencies for us. Greg is professional, reliable, and flexible in meeting the needs of his customers!  We highly recommend him for all your plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Joe P

Greg was at my house first thing in the morning...explained what he was doing and why, and was very pleasant.  Greg completed the job quickly and at a very fair cost especially on a holiday. I would HIGHLY recommend Greg and Plumbing Solutions!

reviews.author: Adam Dabb

He is a really knowledgeable plumber and he takes the time to ensure his work is done right. Had I called a much larger company and deemed it an emergency call, they would have tacked on an additional emergency charge, but he didn’t charge any more than his normal rate, which was more reasonable than other plumbers I have used in the past.  I have found my regular plumber for future needs!

reviews.text:
A reminder that good people still exist.

This week I had a plumbing issue at my house and called Alert Plumbing, a local family-owned company. After two days of hard work, Raul Ochoa and his son completed the repair.

During the job we talked. I shared that I recently lost my wife and am now raising two teenagers on my own. When I asked for the total, Raul said, “Dan, you have enough on your plate. This job is on us. Take care of yourself and your kids.”

I insisted. He refused.

In a time when life feels overwhelming, their kindness meant more than they will ever know. They didn’t just fix a plumbing issue — they reminded me that compassion is still alive and well.

They have a customer for life.

Thank you, Raul and Jose.

He outlined the best case and worst-case scenarios for our repair. No fault of his team, they encountered the worst case resulting in a two-day job becoming a four-day job. Kyle came to our home, within an hour, on his day off, to explain the circumstances encountered and the next steps. Ultimately, a portion of the concrete slab had to be broken out in our basement. Had we selected a competing vendor, that vendor would have been required to bring in a third-party vendor to complete this extra step. This would have resulted in a longer duration of the repair at a higher cost. His on-sight team of three were conscientious, professional, friendly, well trained and enjoyed their work. To satisfy my curiosity and knowledge, Kyle and his team were very patient and thorough in explaining each step of the process, the technology involved, and the equipment used. I could say much more about my satisfaction. I will conclude by simply saying I am glad I chose Kyle and his Seal Pipe team. I highly recommend them.

During the repair they identified another issue that definitely needed rectifying and only cost us $200 now, but would have cost us thousands later (B Box, which offers access to the water shut off valves, was improperly buried under a foot of dirt, packed with soil, and had no cap. reviews.text: We needed our stand pipe replaced.  Drew's plumbing had the best quote, was friendly, flexible and did an excellent job.  Also gave me options to save some money on the project. I have used other plumbers in the past but Drew's will be my first pick going forward.

reviews.author: Matt Roberts
reviews.text: If you are in need of a reliable, courteous, and reasonable plumber, I will tell you there is no one better than Drew's Plumbing.  I have used Drew's Plumbing multiple times, and they will always be my first choice.  They go above and beyond to ensure you are taken care of.  When I had questions, Drew's was there; when I was in need of service, Drew's was there; when I had an emergency, Drew's was there.

plumbers.name: Angler Plumbing
plumbers.address: 37 Dempsey Dr, Newark, DE 19713, USA

reviews.author: Pam Gilmore (Pamdora)
reviews.text:
I've been using Angler Plumbing for over 10 years now, and I can honestly say they are one of the most reliable and professional companies I've ever worked with. Whether it's been routine maintenance, emergency repairs, or bigger plumbing projects, their team has always shown up on time, treated my home with respect, and delivered top-quality work.

What really stands out is their consistency. After a full decade, the service is just as dependable and thorough as it was the first time I called them. Their plumbers are knowledgeable, friendly, and always take the time to explain the problem and solution in a way that makes sense.

It’s rare to find a company you can trust year after year, but Angler Plumbing has earned that trust many times over. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Alex Mili
reviews.text: Prompt, efficient and clean. My kitchen sink stopped up during the holiday weekend, and the plumber came the same day that I called for service. They fixed the problem, and they were very clean. They put tarp down on the kitchen floor to make sure that the splash from the unclogging didn’t get on the floor, and they even clean the inside cabinets with bleach spray to make sure there was not a drop of splash from when they had to unclog the drain. Plumbing can be messy work, but they make sure that the work area is immaculately clean when they’re done.

reviews.author: Chris McKnight
reviews.text: Angler Plumbing will be my go to for work. I have used them twice now and got nothing but great service. First time was to replace a broken outdoor faucet. The second time was to replace water shutoff valves and install the utility tub in our basement laundry area that was never in the house. They also cleaned up the garbage design of drain pipes from previous owner. Rob and his crew are great at what they do.  Highly recommend calling Angler for all your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Living My Life Infused
reviews.text: Wouldn't waste my time . They might be good at a job, but their professionalism when addressing " distracted " drivers and the fact that one, breaking the law, and two, when confronted about it, driver became very belligerent and rude, instead of admitting fault and putting down the phone while he was driving. Figure if he, they are going to allow something so simple to be disregarded, that probably will muss something or disregard something on a job.

reviews.author: James Warrington
reviews.text:
I hired this contractor to replace a leaking pipe from my tub drain  to the down flow pipe. They replaced the Bathfitter drain with a cheap imitation and in the process cracked my fiberglass tub. I did not request that the drain be replaced and they refuse to stand behind their inferior work.

This is what Angler Plumbing's cheap imitation drain they installed in my $7500 Bathfitter tub looks like after a year of use. Again... IF you value the worth of your home, DO NOT hire this plumber to work in it!!

plumbers.name: Blue Sky Plumbing & Drain Cleaning HVAC Service
plumbers.address: 19 Grace Ave, Clifton, NJ 07011, USA

reviews.author: deepanshu saini
reviews.text: Blue Sky Plumbing & Drain Cleaning HVAC Service delivered an excellent overall experience! Their team was professional, punctual, and very knowledgeable. They quickly identified the problem and resolved it efficiently without any hassle. The communication throughout the process was clear and honest, which made everything stress-free. The quality of work was top-notch, and they made sure everything was cleaned up properly afterward. Pricing was fair and transparent. If you need reliable plumbing, drain cleaning, or HVAC services, this company is a solid choice. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Gunnar Mauricio
reviews.text: Great service and excellent workmanship! The team arrived on time and handled the job efficiently. Their attention to detail and commitment to quality really stood out. Would definitely use their services again.

reviews.author: shiva afshar
reviews.text: These guys are great. they were timely, courteous, professional, friendly, and quick. my new go to company for any plumbing issues. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Kyle Hewitt
reviews.text: Al is awesome! I had a leaking pipe and he helped me fix it in 5 minutes at a reasonable cost. Very quick, understanding and professional. I'm glad that I didn't look at the previous review or I would have missed out on impeccable service and much needed plumbing tips. I highly recommend  Blue Sky Sewer & Drain Cleaning to anyone who needs plumbing repairs.

reviews.author: Nur hey
reviews.text: I called blue sky plumbing at 1am for an emergency plumbing .. came out did the job and fixed my drain.. clean work and every great workers. They helped me move things around and were really nice. When I write a review i really mean it. And this company came out and did the job right and fast. Never had a problem. They said they will be their in less then and an hour and came right away. My drain was a mess and they fixed it. Thank you for have great service.

plumbers.name: Tucker Plumbing & Leak Repair
plumbers.address: 1300 Rollingbrook Dr Ste 328, Baytown, TX 77521, USA

reviews.author: derlis tuares
reviews.text: After a bumpy beginning to obtain a contract that was clear and to schedule the work, we were very pleased with the workers. Michael and Hector worked hard, were on time, and did a great job. Hector even suggested a tile that was different from the one I had in mind, but which I love. The new tile and vanity look great in the bathroom. They tried to match the texture paint in the dining area. This was no easy task. Once we paint this, it will look even better.

reviews.author: Abdon S
reviews.text: Duy was great, he came out at 1 AM when our toilet and tub backed up and flooded the bathroom. He recommended a restoration service, which we are also happy with, to deal with the damage and kept in contact with us and them while working with us. Our clog ended up being a lot more complicated than expected, but Duy kept us up to date and let us know everything he was doing beforehand. His prices are fair and reasonable, though any plumbing problem is going to be an expensive endeavor. On top of all of that, he is very nice and personable and kept our dog happy! We are very happy and recommend him to anyone and everyone that needs plumbing done.

reviews.author: Gon
reviews.text: The response time was excellent. The office staff was able to answer all my questions. They asked for photos and contacted my plumber. I received an estimate immediately. They were friendly and quick to return my calls. I felt comfortable sharing the experience of the plumber. Cameron was very courteous and thoughtful. I was very impressed with his willingness to assist me. He put booties on over his shoes, and used a mask. He worked fast and efficiently. He fixed bolts for two toilet tanks and two flappers. He also replaced a kitchen faucet cartridge. The price for quality and time was fair. Cameron has done a fantastic job. I highly recommend his services to anyone in need of plumbing.

reviews.author: Josia Kings R.
reviews.text: Blair and team went out of their way to quickly and efficiently assist my wife and myself with emergency repairs after an unexpected water pipe burst. While we were on holiday, they helped me remotely gain access to the house and ensure proper isolation of water. This ensured that no further damages would occur. They performed repairs on the Saturday to provide running water for my family. The service was 10/10! Would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Anita Lotte
reviews.text: Extremely professional service! Ray called to let me know ahead of time that he was on his way. He was super friendly, super helpful, did a great job not only fixing our issue but explaining everything along the way. He gave us a free inspection for the rest of our plumbing to check for issues that we might not know about. Very knowledgeable and gave us some very helpful suggestions to avoid further plumbing issues. The price was very reasonable as well. 10/10, will use again!! :D

plumbers.name: Wolf Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 2146 Chinnabee Rd, Munford, AL 36268, USA

reviews.author: savanah clay
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Tim from Wolfe Plumbing today! Super sweet snd informative. Told me everything he was going to do beforehand, how loud it would be because the baby was asleep, and what to use to help prevent the issue from happening again. Worked fast and had the issue resolved in no time! 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: Newman
reviews.text: Hunter came out on a emergency gas leak tightened all our fittings and re doped them replaced the faulty bushing and was very professional while doing it. Very pleased with the job that was done. Would call them 1st!

reviews.author: Jennifer Allison
reviews.text: We are new home owners and have bought our dream home.   It had set for over a year before we bought it. It has come with some issues  and we choose Wolf Plumbing since we were new to the area.  We have used them twice and they have been Awesome and fixed both of our issues.   They explained in detail what was going on.   I  trust them to handle any of our future Plumbing issues...

reviews.author: Donna Stormes (Stormy)
reviews.text: This is the second time that I have used Wolf Plumbing and I wouldn't use anyone else. They came out the same day I called  and beat any other prices around. I highly recommend them

reviews.author: Amber Styles
reviews.text: I’m extremely happy with the service. They came out and unclogged my toilet as soon as they could, and the customer service was really amazing. My toddler tried to get in their way as much as possible, they were extremely patient. They were in and out and went the extra mile for customer service!

plumbers.name: MG Property Management & Associates , LLC / DBA : Phoenixville Plumber
plumbers.address: 550 Bridge St, Phoenixville, PA 19460, USA

reviews.author: Alex H
reviews.text:
Rarely give bad reviews unless I feel like it can help someone else out.

Hired Matt with MG or Phoenixville Plumber initially to do a sewer scope. Paid him in full and he only did half of the scope and said he would come back and perform the rest later (not even sure how that makes sense).

Scheduled multiple times with Matt to come back and he no showed  3 more times. Complete waste of time and money.

reviews.author: Philip Montanez
reviews.text: Worked with Matt to help fix a leak in our basement. Very professional and provided great communication throughout, as he kept me up to speed every step of the way during the repair process. Would highly recommend for future projects.

reviews.author: Shannon Bowman
reviews.text: We had an urgent plumbing emergency in our basement. I called some plumbers in the area and Matt was the only one to actually answer the phone. He got us a quote right away and was out the next day to get the job done.  He was very efficient, professional, and fairly priced.  Will definitely use his services in the future.

reviews.author: Joshua Bacon
reviews.text: I had a sewer line at one of my rentals and used Matt to scope and jet my sewer line we eventually replaced my trap and removed the air vent. I was pleased and I highly recommend Matt and his team they do good work at a reasonable price!

reviews.author: Nancy Coe McLane
reviews.text: Excellent 24hour service... Matt talked me through shutting off the well pump to stop pipe leak in my house.  His calm professional and clear direction made it easy for me to stop the immediate water flow.  He was able to offer plumbing repair service as soon as tomorrow!  Highly recommend this local company for plumbing needs!

plumbers.name: Rick Wilson Plumbing
plumbers.address: 14151 Anatevka Ln SE, Olalla, WA 98359, USA

reviews.author: Thielsen Garcia
reviews.text: The best! Adam works fast and charges fairly. The kind of small family business that you feel good supporting. They do all kinds of work except unclogging drains. We had a leak between our water meter and our house that was driving up our water bill like crazy. Adam and crew happily cut through our asphalt driveway and dug down to the water line, patched it, and gently filled in the hole in under two hours. Total cost was 20% the quotes I received from other companies.

reviews.author: Lynette E
reviews.text: During the recent freeze, I had a burst pipe, and Adam and David came out at 8pm at night to fix it.  Prior to calling, the best I'd been able to get with anyone was a week away!  Can't imagine how I would have lived for a week without water!  They were quick, professional and very reasonably priced.  Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Benjamin Arbeeny
reviews.text: I had a sudden loss of water pressure this morning so I reached out and left a message to multiple plumbers. Adam from Rick Wilson Plumbing called right back while he was in a crawlspace working on another project.  He was able to diagnose the problem over the phone and walk me through a procedure to get everything working again! Ended up being an $8 pressure sensor switch. Thank you so much for your help Adam! I had plumbers lining up to come and do a service call so you likely saved me several hundred dollars. You guys are now my go to plumbers. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Jordan Cartwright
reviews.text: Thank you to Rick Wilson plumbing! Our pipes froze during the freeze like everyone else. He answered the phone at 7:15am on Saturday and gave us tips to try and thaw everything ourselves. We called midday asking more questions and he was happy to answer and help how he could. By 3pm we decided nothing we were doing was helping and needed a professional. He was here by 5:30pm. We ended up having a frozen well head and cracked pipe in the pump house. He thawed everything, fixed the pipe and insulated the well head. Everything was fixed within an hour. We have water! and he was as pleasant as can be even though he was going on 12 hours of working and had 6 more stops after us! 😳 I hope we don’t have anymore plumbing issues but if we do, I’ll 100% be calling Rick Wilson plumbing.

reviews.author: Andrew Hampton
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good about Adam and Axel from Rick Wilson Plumbing.  Our water heater had been out for almost a week (turns out, 12 years is a good long life for their species).  Another plumber strung us along for several days only to let me know on the day he was supposed to be there, after I asked when he would be there, that he wasn’t going to make it.  I called Adam, who said he could replace it the next day, for cheaper than the other guy, for a much better water heater.  He texted me the next day to let me know he was going to be EARLY.  He and Axel showed up, replaced the water heater, brought everything up to code, and hauled the old one away in just a little over an hour.  Efficient, honest, friendly, and punctual.  We will be calling Rick Wilson Plumbing again if we need anything else.

plumbers.name: 1st Rate Service Plumbing
plumbers.address: 753 Maleta Ln, Castle Rock, CO 80108, USA

reviews.author: Michael Baird
reviews.text: Travis is the absolute best!  He has done a few plumbing jobs for us, including replacing our hot water heater recently. He is professional, extremely knowledgeable and most importantly, does absolutely great work!  I recommend him to all my clients and he always gets rave reviews!  Definitely recommend him to anyone looking for a plumbing job done right.

reviews.author: Cindee Sperry
reviews.text: Our water heater stopped working. We called another company that came out quickly but tried to charge us over 7K for 50 gal. water heater or over 11K for a tankless one. Just from a quick google search I knew I could buy a top of the line for much less. I called my brother who's a master electrician to ask his opinion. He told me to tell the guy to get out of my house. The guy in my house said, "Well, we have to make money." My brother gave me Travis's name/number instead... His company name is 1st Rate Plumbing Service. Travis is his own guy with no employee's so he gets very busy. He was backed up for days but he still made it to our home; Parker to DEN in a reasonable time. He saved us THOUSANDS of  dollars! He even did the install on a Sunday with one of his son's assisting. He went above & beyond and we greatly appreciate it. I'd give him 10 stars if I could.

reviews.author: Billie Ann Wicks
reviews.text: I'm so happy to have found a plumber you can trust. First, Travis returned my voicemail in a timely manor. Scheduled an appointment to come install newly remodel kitchen. He then sent a text message to confirm our appointment time that day! Travis has gone above and beyond. Thankful for finding someone you can trust from start to finish. Thank You!

reviews.author: Brian Cox
reviews.text: I am completing a major bathroom remodel in 3 bathrooms. Travis was amazing to work with. His attention to detail is superb. Everything was completed better than expected. He was never even one minute late from the times he said he would arrive. Great to work with. Creative solutions to tricky problems. 5 stars on every aspect of his work!!

reviews.author: Beth Seeman
reviews.text: I can't recommend Travis highly enough!  I had a leaky kitchen faucet and called a big company first.  I left 2 voicemails and waited 1 1/2 hours for a return call.  In the meantime I called Travis who answered on the first call and was able to come out the same day to replace my faucet.  He went above and beyond by meeting me at the store to find a proper faucet replacement!!   He also fixed an issue with our p trap and a caulking issue behind the sink.  I honestly couldn't have been happier with his work ethic,  professionalism,  craftsmanship and his prices were extremely reasonable.  I highly recommend 1st Rate Service Plumbing and Travis!

plumbers.name: Freedom Plumbing Pro Rooter
plumbers.address: 3912 Hidden Meadows Dr, Gainesville, GA 30506, USA

reviews.author: Ashley Patrick
reviews.text: We recently bought a house and had an unexpected flood. We reached out to Freedom Plumbing to pump the septic tank. Cory and Josh were very helpful and answered all of our questions. We are extremely grateful for their quick response. We will definitely utilize their services again in the future.

reviews.author: Helen Elizabeth
reviews.text: My bathroom flooded Sunday night. Chris and Corey stayed until 4am getting my bathroom fixed. The sweetest guys. A true blessing

reviews.author: Jason Sosebee
reviews.text: Josh and Chris came to our house to unclog a drain. I can tell you that these guys went ABOVE and BEYOND, and if you saw what they went through you would certainly agree. This drain clog was one for the record books, and was an absolute disaster, but Josh and Chris hung in there to the end. They both had a great can do attitude through the whole thing and finally saved the day. I'm really glad I came across their contact on Google. I would definitely recommend them to anyone with a drain problem at their house or business. Thanks guys! I would post some pictures, but I can assure you that you don't want to see them.

reviews.author: Cory Gates
reviews.text: Best of the best these guys showed up and showed out!! There prices were very reasonable and they were very responsive and honest! Would highly recommend

reviews.author: christos kallinteris
reviews.text: Stand up company Jason and the boys are amazing and they do buisness the right way will never use another plumbing company for my restaurants.

plumbers.name: T & J Plumbing & Sewer Services Ltd
plumbers.address: Toledo, OH 43614, USA

reviews.author: somniax0x
reviews.text:
I would like to express my concerns regarding the repeated visits for measurements related to the ongoing project. The technician, John, exhibited a rude and condescending demeanor during our phone conversation. He attempted to assert that there had only been one visit for measurements, despite my presence during each visit, and a different technician completing the measurements each visit.

I inquired whether this would be the final visit, to which he responded yes, unless I requested additional work. It is important to clarify that I did not initiate this contract; Neighborhood Works did. They retained your services for the repair of the drain and the restoration of the drain cover that was removed from my basement floor by your employees. Therefore, your organization is compensated to complete the agreed-upon job.

This is not a case of me demanding or requesting additional work. If the issue had been resolved adequately during the initial visit, further measurements would not have been necessary. For each visit I have been forced to leave my place of employment early to accommodate your visits for a matter that has spanned several months. Moreover, I find it unacceptable to be met with an unfavorable attitude when inquiring about the need to continue taking the same measurements repeatedly. In the future, when it actually IS my decision on who to hire for my plumbing needs, I will never use this company again.

reviews.author: Janine Movish
reviews.text:
Prompt. Professional. The first employee could not figure out the leak, and he called his partner who came to assist and they fixed it together. A month later, there were still some issues. I was scheduled for the same day, and since it was under warranty the work was completed at the same time (additional work/ Pipe cleaning). Without charging anything additional.
The only thing I would recommend is that the first time they provided their services, they did not run water in the bathtub long enough to figure out there was still a blockage. If this was done, they would not have had to come out a second time.
That said, I would recommend this company.

reviews.author: Jason Bonnicksen
reviews.text:
Called the company for a free estimate. Customer service on the phone was great. HOWEVER, when the technician arrived for my estimate, he started to dig-up my yard without permission; never inspected our sewer main to determine the problem;  yet quoted a price for cleaning out the blockage (causing our sewer drain to backup). Quoted price was $150 HIGHER than their competitors (who's customer service was as if not more personable). Technician did not represent his company well -- was rude, disrespectful, and had the appearance of a dirt-bag.

I cannot speak for T&J's quality of work. I was turned-off by their technician, and therefore cannot recommend the company.

reviews.author: Laura Hasyn
reviews.text: Jacob from T&J Plumbing did an OUTSTANDING job replacing my backup sump pump!  He was on-time, professional, and honest about pricing and options. T&J were hired after one plumber admitted he was not qualified for the job and plumber number 2 (Roto-Rooter) flooded my basement. T&J were quick to respond to diagnose and provide an estimate and completed the work within 48 hours. I would highly recommend T&J for any of your plumbing needs! (Also, Roto-Rooter was twice as high for half the work that T&J did!) Your best bet is to hire small, local companies! Thank you, Jacob!

reviews.author: Andrew Poore
reviews.text: Expensive, but worth it. They actually have giant power washers in their trucks so they can fully blast out your clogged pipes. We used to call Drain Doctor, but they just snake the pipes. That works for about a year until that small hole they open with the snake gets clogged again. The power washers also make for short service calls. Drain Doctor would come out for 2-3 hours while T&J only needed 45~ minutes. Even though it’s expensive, you should still tip these guys. It’s a gross, dirty job and they deserve a little extra. 🤝

plumbers.name: The Plumbing Source
plumbers.address: 29275 Auburn Dr, Lake Elsinore, CA 92530, USA

reviews.author: Yvette Rivas
reviews.text: The Plumbing Source responded quickly to repair the broken shower faucet handle.  Very friendly and professional.  I will definitely call on them again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: William Herbert
reviews.text:
It was great finding Rick at Pops Family Plumbing for replacing my hot water heater. With the variety of high and low prices and stories of local not so honest plumbers I was able to finally find a plumber that I was comfortable with.
It's nice to find someone that takes pride with their craft and that is a straight shooter when giving a price for what you need. I have already given his number to a couple people I know and they her very happy as well.

Thanks Rick

reviews.author: Tom Marambi
reviews.text:
First, Shannon was very kind and professional the moment I made the call to request service to replace my water heater thermal expansion tank that had busted.

Second, she, kept her word when she told me Rick would be on site in a few hours. Sure enough Rick arrived on time and was very kind and professional as well.

Third, was Rick very skillful at his trade and adhered to California's recent mandates of wearing a mask and social distancing. He replaced the H2O heater thermal expansion tank and as such restored hot water at the house.

Last, Rick was very reasonable when it came down to repair costs.
I would definitely do business again with "POP's Family Plumbing" and recommend them to my family and friends.

Thanks,

reviews.author: Joshua R
reviews.text: Best plumber in Lake Elsinore. Rick and his team will go above and beyond for you.  We used them for the plumbing in a bathroom remodel and were very pleased. Prompt, clean, and quality workmanship. I'd recommend Rick and his team to anyone.

reviews.author: Michelle Cervantes
reviews.text: We were thankful they made themselves quickly available to fix a leak we were having.  They were professional, respectful, and knowledgeable. I will call on them again when in need of a plumber. Great service overall and we highly recommend them.

plumbers.name: MEP Home Services
plumbers.address: 640 Warrior Dr Ste 113, Stephens City, VA 22655, USA

reviews.author: Denise Conley
reviews.text: I overslept the arrival of my service technician by 30 minutes or so (I work 2nd shift at my job), which was horrifying for me.  But he was so nice that he stayed in my driveway that entire time.  He was kind and understanding.  I wish I had gotten his name!  He figured out the problem with my AC and fixed it quickly.  I will definitely be using MEP again in the future (and setting multiple alarms to make sure I'm awake and up).

reviews.author: Steve Taylor
reviews.text: MEP provides timely and responsive customer service. Our HVAC system in our new home is just a year old, and when we recently had an issue with the A/C just towards the end of the warranty period, MEP sent a tech out the next day who quickly identified and fixed the problem. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ service!

reviews.author: Theresa Horn
reviews.text: I had a long list of plumbing issues as well as a list of unreliable, formerly used, plumbers. MEP Home Services handled my problems in a friendly and professional manner. I am pleased with the outcome and will hire them again, happily deleting all previous plumbing contacts from my phone.

reviews.author: joe boyd
reviews.text:
The plumber from MEP was professional, courteous and helpful. He performed our repair in a timely fashion.
All in all a good representative of the company.

reviews.author: Deborah McCormick
reviews.text: Professional, thorough and performed in a timely manner. Noah was knowledgeable about his work and was a delightful plumber. MEP is always my first choice in plumbing!

plumbers.name: Kirkland and Shaw Inc.
plumbers.address: 5 Adams St, Burlington, MA 01803, USA

reviews.author: Tim McCarthy
reviews.text: "I recently had Kirkland and Shaw install a new heat pump system, and the experience was top-notch from start to finish. They were incredibly thorough during the initial walkthrough, ensuring the units' design efficiently leveraged the challenging layout of my home. They were professional, respectful of my property, and kept everything tidy while they worked. If you're looking for a local team that is reliable and fair with their pricing, I highly recommend them for any HVAC or plumbing project.  Kudos to Steve and his team.

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text: We have found our plumbers in Kirkland and Shaw. We'd been looking for our go-to plumbers and heard good things about Kirkland and Shaw. We needed a backwater preventer installed and Paul and Demetri (and one person whose name I don't know) did great job. Paul was our point person and was very responsive and careful about doing the job right. Demetri and the other person did a great job with installation and cleanup, and handled the complications very well. They gave me advice about next steps needed due to the complications, and were honest about the limits of their knowledge on the subject. But they did get me a pointer to someone who specialized in what we needed.  This was a top-notch job and I so appreciate their clarity and honesty.

reviews.author: Charles Hatvany
reviews.text: We have been having problems with old cast iron sewage pipes leaking over the years.  The last two situations were handled by Kirkland and Shaw.  We had a plumber on site the next morning each time, They knew what was needed and did in quickly and well.  Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Valerie Levitre
reviews.text: During this heat wave, we were reflecting on how appreciative we are of the mini splits that were installed last year by Kirkland and Shaw. Not only where they competitive in price, but they were thorough and professional in the installation and maintenance of the units. They were attentive to our concerns and the desires We had to meet the design of our house. They were respectful of our property and of us while completing the job. Next We would highly recommend Kirkland and Shaw.

reviews.author: Stuart May
reviews.text: I've been a customer for a few years now.  I feel I get good, honest service with quality work on my natural gas furnace and related equipment.  I've had regular annual service, burner replacement, plumbing and control board updates.  The team are responsive, and the price very competitive.  I am a happy customer.  Thank you Kirkland and Shaw !

plumbers.name: Able Plumbing & Drain Service Inc.
plumbers.address: 15 Lakeview Dr, Mundelein, IL 60060, USA

reviews.author: Monica W
reviews.text: Ron was able to come out the same day and replace some old pipes that were causing a gas leak. The cost was fair, and the tech from the gas company who came afterwards and looked at it said he did a great job. We definitely will call him again in the future if we ever have a need!

reviews.author: Pat Donahue
reviews.text: Able Plumbing is a great company! We had a defective water valve (couldn't shut off water), Low water pressure, outside water source inoperative, rust build up in water pipes. Ron arrived exactly on time, analyzed problems, replaced old parts, flushed rusty pipes. done in less than 2 hours, fair price. Highly recommend this Company.

reviews.author: Jenny Schroeder
reviews.text: Could not be more pleased with this company and my experience. I used them for a new sink, garbage disposal and faucet installation. I also had all of the copper pipes under the sink replaced and modernized. I had a good feeling about them from the beginning. They were quick to respond and answered the phone on the first try, came the very next morning to give me an estimate and then worked my project into their schedule just a few days later. My plumber showed up when he said he would, did quality work, worked quickly and efficiently, left areas clean and neat, was very professional and to top it off he was just a generally nice guy. I also love giving my business to someone local and not a big corporate outfit. Seriously great job! This was my first time using them and they will definitely be my first call if I need a plumber in the future.

reviews.author: Dylan “Shawdog” Shaw
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Norm Le Blanc
reviews.text: The Quality was poor and so were their public relations.  I am a plumber in Arizona, visiting my sister in Lampasas. She is a new resident in Lampasas alone with her handy-capped husband.  Sanders plumbing were hired to put in a "clean-out" at their residents.  As soon as I saw the job, I recognized some problems with their workmanship.  The standpipe coming from the ground was not straight up and down (ugly).  This standpipe was for the washer drain.  The size of the pipe should have been 2in and it was 1 ½.   The vent ended under a window with a “under counter” quick vent.  In the house, behind the washer, there was not a “P” trap.  Sewer gases was venting into the house.  I questioned the plumber (the “master plumber”) about these deficient issues.  His answer was that he had to check on who had done the work and would get back to us.   Two week passed before we saw anyone from Sanders Plumbing and that was because we called several times and insisted.  Sanders bill stated that work included the hooking up of the washing machine (previously a “gray water” drain) to the main sewer line.  The return trip Sanders Plumbing “father” quoted a price of $800.00 to make the job right.  The first part of the job, the putting in the “clean-out”, was billed at $900.00 after a discount.  As a plumber from another location, I thought that price was steep, that was not the issue.  Sanders, you have a reputation in Lampasas (as I heard it) “the highest priced and the worst plumber in Lampasas”.  You need to change the direction you have taken.

reviews.author: Sylvia Napolitano
reviews.text: Wow!  These guys rescued us late on a Friday night when our sewer was backing up into our showers.  I called around for estimates and everybody else, if they even worked weekends, wanted to charge exorbitant fees for weekend work.  Unfortunately, I've had to work with many plumbers over the years, and Juan stands far above them all in terms of communication, honesty, and friendliness.  It turned out that our sewer pipe had deteriorated because it was so old.  He was able to stick a camera through the pipe and show us pictures.  He gave us several options and wound up replacing the pipe and adding two clean outs.  Again, their prices were the best.  I'm so glad we found him!  He's my go to plumber for life.

reviews.author: shane rasmussen
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 Stars – Saved the Day on Memorial Day Weekend!

Huge thanks to Juan Alcantara from Fix-It Plumbing for coming through when we really needed help! Over Memorial Day weekend—of all times—my mom’s sewer backed up and caused a mess. We were honestly expecting to wait until after the holiday to get it looked at, but Juan showed up fast and ready to work.

He was professional, friendly, and explained everything clearly. Within no time, he had the sewer unclogged and flowing smoothly again. You could tell he knew exactly what he was doing. It was a huge relief during a stressful weekend.

I Can’t thank Juan and Fix-It Plumbing enough for going above and beyond. Highly recommend them to anyone in need of a reliable plumber—especially when it’s an emergency!

---

Shane Rasmussen

If you need professional, trustworthy plumbers who take pride in their work, I can’t recommend DeChamps highly enough.

reviews.author: Alora K
reviews.text: Called homeland on a Saturday night for my parents due to the plumbing backing up the washer drain and the hot water drain. It flooded a couple different parts of the house. When we called an talked to their dispatch they said they would be available to come out with in the house and the weekend rate would be $175 service fee. They said we would get a quote when the tech Martin came out and they did not charge an hourly rate but charged by the job needing to be done. Martin did arrive within the hour. He got out the shop vacuum to pull out the water from the hot water tank drip pan and got out the rooter to start working on this clog. He didn’t say we would have any additional charge at this point. He tried the drain at the hot water tank and missed. Then tried a clean out drain outside and was unable to get the clog so he resorted to the washer vent drain. At that point he was able to remove the clog. When the time came for the bill it was $135 service charge and another $371 to remove the clog! That was a shock! He never said there was another charge, he never gave us a quote. He said the $371 was an hourly rate for his time out here not by the job. So the communication we had from dispatch and the communication we got from Martin was completely different! We won’t consider this company in the future. We don’t like surprises .

reviews.author: Mark F
reviews.text: Due to my own recent experience today, I will personally never use Ralph (Above All Plumbing) as a plumber again, as he walked off the job just as it got started. I had asked him to swap a toilet out in my son's bathroom. My son was super excited about this new toilet and was watching him closely, as he started to drain the toilet. My son is a very curious boy and loves to know how things work and why people are doing certain things. I then asked my son to move back and give Ralph some room to work. After I said this, Ralph stated, "yeah, I don't like an audience", which I replied, "well, I'm paying for this, and my son likes watching." My son then says, "yeah, even I might be a plumber one day". At this point, Ralph left the bathroom, took off his gloves, grabbed his stuff, shook my hand, and proceeded to leave. When I asked Ralph why he was leaving, he stated that he doesn't get paid for people to watch him. I then clarified to him that we are paying for the "service" not paying to "watch" him. With that said, he is inside my house performing a service that I am paying for, so asking someone to not watch him is actually a tad concerning to me. If someone was building a house and hired a framing crew, would the framers stop and tell the homeowner, not to watch them work? If someone had painters in their house, would the painters ask the homeowner not to watch them work at all? I understand giving him some space to work freely, and that is why I asked my son to move back to begin with. So much for a plumber helping our society to attract younger children into the Plumbing trade. In my opinion, this was not a professional example to set in front of my 10-yr old, that watched him walk off the job like that. Very disappointing to say the least.

reviews.author: Stav P
reviews.text:

When he arrives he diagnoses, explains the issues, and goes over pricing in relation to the problem. And he always shows up on time or even earlier.
Yesterday he helped me out with a huge septic piping and tank issue.  Referred me to a great company who took care of issues he legally wasn’t licensed to handle and is following up with the last of the work he is licensed for.
I went from having an issue where my ability to use my bathrooms was impossible to fully functional in the same day.
If you have plumbing needs and you don’t contact Frank at Integrity Plumbing you are doing a serious disservice to yourself 😎👍

From shoddy work to theft to not making good on errors caused us to became quite calloused when hiring. You won't have that concern with Integrity plumbing. Quite honestly, Frank is probably thinking more about the job than you. An added bonus is that honest businessmen like Frank know honest people in other trades that you may need. Now you are on the path to happy home ownership. A word to the wise. A clogged toilet in 3 full bath  home does not constitute an emergency. In this culture of me myself and I...if you think any busy contractor is not going to ask for a little patience you are sorely mistaken. Hang in there and wait for the best. You will not be let down.

Then he only spent 5 minutes tops on the toilet. I asked him what he did and he said "I plunged it".    Well....I plunged it too, and it would work ok for a day or two. reviews.author: Barbara Crosswhite
reviews.text:
Tim was very nice. He came the same day I called. He told me that they are a new family business and his son was with him.
The female pex fitting on the cold water was leaking. Tim replaced the fitting and charged me $634.09.
I was shocked over the bill.
The hot water pex fitting was leaking now. I was too afraid to call him to fix that one because I couldn't afford a total of $1,268.18 for the sink.
So, I talked with the plumber at Ace Hardware & he explained how to replace the fitting. I purchased a Sharkbite fitting and a cutting tool for $30.00. I replaced the other fitting. It was the same fitting that ATH replaced.
I spoke with other plumbers, friends & business friends  I know.
THEY TOLD ME THAT I WAS TAKEN ADVANTAGE OF.  The cost to replace that fitting  should have only been around $200 to  $300.

I see the 7 other reviews and they he saved the day. It doesn’t makes sense.

reviews.author: Tee Xie
reviews.text:
We started with a sour dough caused drain clog, ended up with Jason finding that our septic filter has been placed at the wrong places and the water is not going from the first tank to the pump tank, then figured out the clog is worse than we thought and took multiple hours of drain snake to clean the main pipe out.

It was definitely stressful / hard work, and during multiple points we were genuinely worried, but Jason kept pushing and explained to us how things work.

Eventually we fixed both the septic and the sour dough clog over two days, as well as replaced a sewage pipe that wasn't done properly.

Jason will be our plumber of choice going forward!

reviews.text: Jason is so amazing!!! He did his research before coming out and was very communicative throughout the whole process. Super nice and wonderful to work with! Not to mention his prices are unbeatable!!! Thank you Jason! We will definitely be calling him back for all our plumbing needs and also for a bbq!!

reviews.author: Anita Brentin
reviews.text: If I could give Jason 100 stars I would! I had been turned down by other plumbers not wanting to take on the job. When Jason returned my call, I was feeling a bit overwhelmed. Jason gave a quote and said he could start in the morning. Jason and his assistant worked hard for many hours. He found that rhododendrin and tree roots had taken over all the pipes. They cut out roots and replaced pipes. In the end he got everything replaced and working for many years to come. Even though it was so much more work than he anticipated he still only charged my mom what he had originally quoted. Jason @ Drain-Rite Drain Cleaning will always be my go to plumber. I can't recommend him enough! Thank you,  Jason!

I contacted Matt to do a simple job at a friends house who is destitude and 70 years old. The poor woman is 70 and hasn't had a dishwasher in nearly 30 years. And at her age tends to two adult children in their mid 30's that have mental health issues.
So I bought her a new fridge because hers was only maintaining temps in the low 40's. And I bought and installed a used dish washer for her. I just needed a drain line and hot water connection installed under the sink.
I asked Matt if he could just give me a ball park figure for the job. I sent him pictures of the existing plumbing and he quoted me between $400 and $600. I thought it was a little high. But I was willing to pay it just to get her a washer.
I did however, text Matt and asked if there was anyway he could keep as close to $400 as possible. He texted back and said "if your under some budget restraints, maybe you should call another plumber". Well, at the time I couldn't find another plumber to do work in union.
So i told him it wasnt a matter of money. I has plenty of funds. It was just a request to do whatever he could to maybe cut a corner here or there to maybe save a couple of buck.
So what does he do yesterday when he was SCHEDULED to do the work? Doesnt show! Doesnt call! Doesnt return my texts or my calls asking if he got hung up some where and when he might show up. Thats just B.S. and if I wher anyone reading this review id steer clear of this clown.
P.S.  I did find another local plumber that was out today and quoted $300 for the same work.

reviews.text:
We are really happy we used Super Service Heating and Air Conditioning. For context, our furnace wasn't starting up and had already had 2 well-reviewed companies in the area who looked at it. By the time we reached out to Frank, we were thinking that our furnace had to be replaced and asked for a quote for installing a new one. Frank stopped by to make sure that the new furnace could be swapped in.

While he was there, he took a look at the boiler and the AC unit too, and pointed out various information about the system that I found useful as a new owner of the home. He then ask me if I want him to run diagnostic on the furnace to see what the underlying problem is. It didn't take more than 10 minutes for him to figure out that the issue was with one of the sensors (apparently a weird quirk with one of the common furnace brands). He then ordered the part and, the next day, Omar stopped by to install it. The furnace was back up and running no more than 24 hours after Frank took a first look at it.

Very impressed with the service, their knowledge and how quickly they were able to identify and resolve the issue. Above all, we value their honesty and have trusts in their recommendations. We will be using their service for all of our cooling and heating services for our home.

reviews.text: I would not recommend Giffin Plumbing.  We went without a master bathtub for over 6 months before it was finally defective.  We eventually got a new tub. reviews.author: CandiceDaniel Lanning
reviews.text:
We used Giffin Plumbing when building our home. His staff did a great job and we were pleased. Just under two years after being in our home, our tankless water heater stopped working and we could smell the natural gas coming from it along with a lot of water running out of the condensation line. My husband trouble-shot the problem and called Giffin to come and take a look at it. He returned our call and told us to call the manufacturer of the hot water heater. We immediately did so, but the manufacturer refused to talk with anyone but the plumber. So we called Giffin back on 6-8 instances to help us move forward. On a couple of those times he said he would send someone out during the day to look at it. We would make ourselves available and at home for someone to come, and they never did. The manufacturer said we needed to unplug our hot water heater so it would not run until someone came to run a diagnostic on it. We are almost 3 weeks out of being able to use our hot water heater properly. At this point Giffin is no longer answering or returning our calls (all calls and conversations have been respectful and courteous--no animosity at all).

Giffin promises a lot but delivers little. On big jobs he's more available --but disappears on the small ones or the repairs.

We have hired someone else who was able to come in yesterday and run a quick diagnostic {took all of 30 minutes max} and the part was overnighted and will be installed tomorrow. It's a very simple repair--something my husband could do--but for warranty sake it must be a licensed plumber. It's been a very frustrating ordeal and hard to understand why we weren't prioritized.

Giffin has had several health problems within the last year and we've tried to be mindful and respectful of that. Still--if you aren't going to be able to help someone, please let them know that you don't have time to help them so they can move on. It's not a wise way to run a business.
