However, just a few days later, my system failed again, leaving me without air conditioning in 90-degree heat. I reachede  out and was informed that my appointment was for the next day; however, no technician appeared to fix the issue. When I followed up with another call, they confirmed my place on the schedule for the following day. This service is awful, and I demand a refund if no one arrives as scheduled since it’s clear the system wasn’t repaired correctly.

reviews.author: Work Done
reviews.text: Good job on patching a hole in my tire, though the price billed 40$ was higher than the one he gave me on the phone 30$

reviews.author: Shay A
reviews.text: this place is crazy, said i have to pay for the tech as soon as he gets in his truck!! are you crazy.. then had the nerve to say "well someone has to pay them" i replied yes your company not me, i pay for work/labor. not his regular business hours. ) $176 a hour starting from the time he gets in the truck...)

reviews.author: guy grover
reviews.text: tough job and Gordon (expert plumber) kicked ass.  I've owned rentals for 35 years in North Oakland and Berkeley and I've used this company several times.  no issues.  Most likely the bad reviews come from weenies that have no clue how hard being a plumber really is.

plumbers.name: Encinitas Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2772 Roosevelt St # 2124, Carlsbad, CA 92008, USA

reviews.author: Emma O
reviews.text: Horrible Communication. Called twice after my scheduled appointment. No show. Finally got a call back. The owner shouted and cursed at me. Said he was a "Christian Man". Why even bring that up? I am a believer but, that has nothing to do with a leaking toilet seat. I went somewhere else obviously, and with a more affordable company. His rational to fix for cheap was the same cost to replace with new. Peace of mind goes a long way. Thanks anyways Tim, have a good day.

reviews.author: Slime Sisters
reviews.text: Tim was so responsive in helping us with our kitchen sink.  He was kind, explained things well and didn’t over charge us.  We would love to use him in the future and recommend him for all your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Ryan Lake
reviews.text: Had a second slab leak in 2 months. Not satisfied w the previous plumbing company I reached out to Encinitas Plumbing and the service was night day. Tim went well beyond the previous company I used and actually found out why we were having the problems instead of just fixing them as the came up. Haven’t had an issue since. Would HIGHLY recommend Encinitas Plumbing

reviews.author: joseph nevares
reviews.text: The pilot light on our water heater went out so we called these guys. We called a few places but they were not available until future dates. We decided to try contacting these guys and they were able to get someone over the same day. The gentleman showed up on time and got straight to work on diagnosing our problem. He was able to figure out the problem and attempted to locate the needed part for us so he could repair our water heater. Unfortunately the next day he informed us the part was out of stock everywhere, including the manufacturer. He offered to order us a new water heater and install it but my brother came up with an alternate solution to our problem so we went with that instead. We were not charged for the visit and I was very pleased with their punctuality, honesty, and the effort that was put in even though we didn't end up hiring them for their services. I wish I knew the name of the gentleman who came to our place. Thank you for your time and effort!

reviews.author: Lynda
reviews.text: Excellent service. Arrived as scheduled and ready to start work. Pleasant to deal with as Tim converted a regular wood burning fireplace to a gas log insert setup. Would highly recommend this company.

plumbers.name: R J Pascone Plumbing Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 910 Borton Landing Rd, Moorestown, NJ 08057, USA

reviews.author: B1234
reviews.text:
RJ and Tony are the professionals you want working in your home! They are owner operators and provide quality and honest service the other guys can’t match. Give your hometown plumber a call and you will see what I am talking about.

My basement flooded and Tony made it to my home within an hour of me calling. He had multiple pumps set in place to remove the roughly 6-8 inches of water in the basement quickly to reduce the damage to my home. I was not expecting that and thought I would need another contractor to remove the water. He had everything he needed to repair the well water supply line on his truck saving time and money. Tony was professional and cared about my home as if it was his.

reviews.author: Gabriella Pascone
reviews.text: RJ and Tony are professional, prompt, and knowledgeable. They are without a doubt the best plumbers to call for any job. RJ and Tony take their time doing things the right way and do a magnificent job every time. They care about the integrity of their work and don’t take shortcuts. Because their quality of work is unmatched I recommend this company to everyone!

reviews.author: Kaitlin Collura
reviews.text: A failed DIY plumbing attempt ended in our main house water shut off valve breaking and leaving us without water to the entire house just days before Christmas! RJ Pascone answered our call for help when no other plumber did and sent Tony to save our Christmas. Tony was prompt, professional, courteous and did a great job to restore water to our house in no time. We were very satisfied with our experience and will be using them again for all of our plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Jane Potter
reviews.text: We have worked with RJ. Pascone for about 25 years years.  They do most of our plumbing projects in the field and handle our personal plumbing needs as well.  They are professional, timely, honest, fair, and they are just great guys!  I would and do recommend them for any simple to complex plumbing job you might have.

reviews.author: Christina
reviews.text: RJ and Tony were great to work with their quality of work is amazing. They have high standards and exceed them! Trustworthy, honest, reliable, and genuine. Always highly pleased with my experience when RJ and Tony do work for me.

plumbers.name: Casselberry Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 3540 S US Hwy 17 92 f, Casselberry, FL 32707, USA

reviews.author: Jasper Hamilton
reviews.text: Absolutely impressed with the tap repair service I received from them. My kitchen tap had been dripping for days, and the plumber came right on time. He was able to fix it quickly, and now the tap works like new. I’ll definitely call them again for any future plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Ryder Barrett
reviews.text: The plumber arrived right on time and quickly fixed my leaking sink. He was polite, professional, and explained everything clearly. The pricing was fair, and the entire experience was stress-free.

reviews.author: Declan Northwood
reviews.text: We had a strange smell and damp spots in our basement but couldn’t find the source. This plumbing service’s leak detection team found the leak in no time, fixed the issue, and even cleaned up afterward. The technician was so professional and explained everything clearly. I am so relieved!

reviews.author: Basil Mcdonald
reviews.text: Plumbing problems were discovered by a new home inspection. After reading the report, he made all the necessary corrections in a single day. incredibly trustworthy and open.

reviews.author: Elaine Howard
reviews.text: They installed the toilet and it is installed properly but they quoted me one price and charged me another.  First of all Casselberry Plumbing Services is NOT the name of the company.  My invoice says Central Florida Plumbing.  The person that quotes the job is now claiming to be the dispatcher and not a plumber.  They will add a fee to take the old toilet away.  They added a fee of $20 just to put a different handle on the toilet rather than the one that was on the new toilet.  Not to purchase it but just to put it on.  It would take a 15 year old 5 minutes to do that, it is not worth paying $20 to have the guy that is there do it.  I am hoping the install is done correctly.  I guess I will have to see how it holds up!

plumbers.name: Hiller Plumbing, Heating, Cooling, & Electrical
plumbers.address: 5335 Peavine Rd, Crossville, TN 38571, USA

reviews.author: J Smith
reviews.text: Be very careful with this company.  They try to upsell you every time they come for just maintenance.  I was a 'member' and was still charged a trip charge. I will use a professional company from now on.

reviews.author: Donna Kocher
reviews.text: We needed a gas line ran for a new gas stove after moving from another state. Made the call they came out that day to check. Found it to be a little bigger than just a gas line. Found a water leak in our crawlspace. Three techs ended up contributing. They were here all day. But all up and running. Would definitely call again and recommend!

reviews.author: Candy Godlewski
reviews.text: So I wouldn’t give them even this. How do you talk to a company for months receive a estimate for plumbing and then decide to call me an hour or two before coming to do the work and state we lost our well license so can’t do it. The government is making us do more learning in order to work on them. Yep so they think that I’m stupid but corporate companies get lead was from the government for things like this. So I’m glad that they make a big name for them selfs and all the positive reviews for them must be nice. As for my positive part is that they didn’t get my money since they like to profile their clients.

reviews.author: Chuck Schmidt
reviews.text: Customer for life…how’s that for a beginning.  I needed a plumbing repair made on a Sunday because I needed to go out of town in the morning.  Other plumbers advertise 24/7 emergency repairs but try calling them and see if they answer or call you back.  Not only did Hiller’s answer they they fit me in, gave me the repair window, showed up on time and performed the repair in a quick professional manner. Communication through the entire process was exceptional. They did not take advantage of the situation and gave me a fair price.  They earned my trust and now have me as a customer for life.  Great job to all of you at Hiller’s!

reviews.author: Kenny Pollock
reviews.text:
This is the second time I've used Hiller, first was for electrical and water heater change out, this time was electrical.  I must say the are the Best!  Highly trained employees, very professional, they always explain in laymen terms what the problem is and what they did to fix it
I highly recommend them for any of their services.

Thanks Kenny and Pam

plumbers.name: Banda Plumbing Inc.
plumbers.address: 268 Norwell Ln, Round Lake, IL 60073, USA

reviews.author: Conrad Arteaga
reviews.text:
-

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I have had the pleasure of working with Jobe and his plumbing company, and I can’t recommend them highly enough! From the moment I contacted them, Jobe was professional, friendly, and incredibly knowledgeable.

He arrived on time, assessed the situation quickly, and provided a clear explanation of what needed to be done. The work was completed efficiently and to a high standard, and Jobe took the time to ensure everything was functioning perfectly before he left.

What stood out to me was his commitment to customer satisfaction; he answered all my questions and made sure I was comfortable with the services provided.

If you need a reliable and skilled plumber, look no further than Jobe and his team. I’ll definitely be calling them for any future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Dianne Smitter (Dianne)
reviews.text: Wow used Banda for the first time and that was the best decision I have ever made.  Not only did they come out quickly, but the work they did was just excellent, they cleaned up everything afterwords and just did a excellent job.  If you are looking for a wonderful plumber, please call Banda, you won't be sorry.  I just called Banda plumbing for the second time in a few months and called at 3:00 a.m. because we had no hot water,,  Joe came right out and fixed the problem right away.  How wonderful is this man and his company.  For all of you that are looking for a plumber that is fantastic and knows what they are doing and does it best reasonable priced, call Banda plumbing.  You won't be sorry.

reviews.author: D Leist
reviews.text: Great service at a fair price. We had a water pressure issue. Joe came right out and adjusted our existing equipment with no need to replace it. Joe was polite and professional. I would highly recommend Banda Plumbing for any Plumbing needs you may have.

reviews.author: Roberto Anselmi
reviews.text:
Contrary to many other contractors; Banda arrived to my house punctually on time and did the job quickly & nicely. For sure I call him back when I would need his service.
Rob

reviews.author: DirtyBulker
reviews.text: My experience with Banda Plumbing was excellent. I originally hired them for a large bathroom remodeling project that another plumber botched, and he did a wonderful job. I am a difficult customer (a perfectionist a.k.a have OCD) and I did not find anything at all that needed to be corrected or changed. Not only the work was clean and professional but Job's work ethics are flawless. Very responsive to every call or text (a trait very hard to find among contractors) and he shows on time to appointments. I also hired him for another 2 large jobs since then, and the quality of the service was excellent every time. I highly recommend him for any plumbing need.

plumbers.name: S & B Plumbing
plumbers.address: Sumter, SC 29150, USA

reviews.author: Richard Allen
reviews.text:
Hot Water Heater Went Out! These guys were great, on time, on the spot,
and the prices  were right. The owner himself took care of my job... he knows his stuff.  I'll be using them again for all of my plumbing needs. I don't about that one star bandit making stupid comments about this company, but they're wrong. This is a good company.

reviews.author: Bobby Cartrett
reviews.text: Quick, fast and professional service provided by Steve and his team member.  Gave detailed explanation of what needed to be done before completing repair/replacement of outside faucet.  Professional job.  Highly recommended for your plumbing needs.  Thanks Steve.

reviews.author: Lisa Davey
reviews.text: Fast response friendly professional. We will use Steve again.

reviews.author: Lew Barron
reviews.text: I had an emergency hot water heater situation and Steve (the owner) himself came to the rescue. He picked up and replaced my water heater since we were without hot water for more than 3 days.

reviews.author: Cody Rea
reviews.text: DO NOT USE these people. We used them and they took advantage of first time home buyers. They were always late and very unprofessional. Dont expect any courtesy calls either. You will end up wasting time and needing to call someone else.

plumbers.name: J H Bollweg & Sons Inc
plumbers.address: 28W321 Warrenville Rd, Warrenville, IL 60555, USA

reviews.author: Matt Leakakos
reviews.text:
Terrible services! I’d stay away from them. Jeff came out to replace my water heater but after starting to take it apart, found it he wasn’t able to complete the work. He then continued to “put it temporarily back together.” I then had to pay $295 for items that he broke and or couldn’t be put back on the water heater. I now hired a professional plumber to come out and complete the job professionally and to code.

Jeff was incredibly rude to not only myself but my mom as well.

reviews.author: Brent Etzel
reviews.text: The plumber responded to my message within 2 hours and was at my home within the hour.  I had a pipe blocked deep in the plumbing from my kitchen, and he had It fixed in about half an hour.  Friendly & professional, and the price was just as I expected.  Pro tip: don't put eggshells in your garbage disposal.

reviews.author: TYLER AND MELISSA LUHM
reviews.text: The owner of the company listed A bunch of plumbing tools on a online auction website I purchased the tools for a very inexpensive price that he wasn’t happy with he made that very well known when I got there to pick them up it was obvious he stole some of the tools back and when I confronted him on it he blamed it on his brother and still won’t make good on the deal he made even though I paid him …I got robbed by a 70 year old man I can’t imagine what kind of plumbing work he robs people on if he can’t make good on simple deals

reviews.author: Jon Wilcox
reviews.text: These guys always do a great job at a fair price. I'd recommend them highly!

reviews.author: Hans Pohlmann
reviews.text: These people are very thorough and competent and charge reasonable prices. Highly recommended.

plumbers.name: ALL-PRO Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3441 Ironworks Rd, Georgetown, KY 40324, USA

reviews.author: Susan Garrison
reviews.text:
Called All Pro because of a blocked drain at about 10:00 am.   Was told they would be here within the hour.   Called back later and said they got held up and would be here by 4:00 pm.  Still no plumber at 4:00.  Called again and was told they were in Frankfort and headed our way.  Frankfort is approximately 25 minutes from our home.  They finally show up at 5:45!  They work for 45 minutes and charge $315.00 (which includes at senior discount).  When we question the price Chris tells us it's an extra $75.00 for service after 4:30.  At no time were we told about the extra charge up front.  Chris also wanted to check all the plumbing in the rest of the house to make sure everything was working ok.  When we refused he smarted off.  Chris was quite unprofessional and stated it was fine with him if we weren't a repeat customer.  Kept saying he and his coworker didn't set the prices. They refused credit card payment and pushed back about taking a check for payment. He preferred cash.   Needless to say he took a check.
I would NOT recommend this company!

reviews.author: thc audio
reviews.text: The company is very fast to respond and the gentleman that worked on my house, name was Ronnie, very good attitude, actually knew what he was doing .. will recommend to other

reviews.author: Dean Ousley
reviews.text: Hard workers, I had a big issue, Water everywhere!!. They got everything back to normal x100 and it was at a fair price. Recommend

reviews.author: Cameron Hamilton
reviews.text: The plumber on the job did great. Very fast service, very effecicient. Really knows how to lay the pipe.

reviews.author: Sherri Honican
reviews.text: Jeff from All Pro Plumming did a wonderful job was on time and very nice.

plumbers.name: Schneider's Mechanical LLC
plumbers.address: 17 N Chestnut St, Lansdale, PA 19446, USA

reviews.author: Patty McIntire
reviews.text:
I called on a Friday and they came out the following Tuesday. The office manager and  Bill Schneider and his apprentice were all polite. They were on time and accommodating and conveyed pricing in advance.

The on/off knob to an outside faucet was leaking even when the inside knob that turned the water on and off was turned all the way to the right. This would normally be an easy fix but the knob  could not be removed (70 year old house) so a segment of copper pipe needed to be replaced along with a new valve. They installed a lever and the new pipe. Took about half an hour - $135 minimum plus $40 for the parts.

I will use them again.

reviews.author: Sharon Herman
reviews.text: Schneider's is wonderful to work with. We had  a new heater replaced last year. Excellent service and good price. Bill has been our plumber for many years. He is terrific.

reviews.author: Gloria J. Pinsker
reviews.text: Bill from Schneider's came to repair our upstairs bathroom toilet. We know Bill from when he worked for another plumbing company, and he was always great to deal with. Service was fast, efficient, and honest. Pricing was in keeping with most other plumbing companies.

reviews.author: Sudip Dhingra
reviews.text:
Called Schneider's three weeks ago for a leak in the roof of a kitchen. Said the leak was from third floor bathroom, and it was sealed.

Leak returned at the same spot. Called them back and said will send out a plumber between 1 - 130PM. No one showed up, so called them back. Said plumber was stuck on another job and won't be there for another hour and a half. No heads up, and when told I should have been given a head's up...said 'ok'.

No apology, no concern for the customer

reviews.author: tina
reviews.text: I initially did an online request with Donnelly's but it took them forever to respond to me so I called Schneider's and the receptionist said she can have someone out within the hour.  The gentleman that came out was quick to identify the issues, fixed what was needed to be repaired and wrote up a detailed explanation on the invoice (which I have to turn into my landlord).  The only reason for the 4 stars is the pricing.  The labor fee and cost of installation was a bit much.

plumbers.name: Better Rooter
plumbers.address: PO Box 1936, Valparaiso, IN 46384, USA

reviews.author: Brian Fattore
reviews.text: I can’t express how wonderful a plumber and a man Phil has been to me and my family.  He has provided the same level of service at my house as at my son’s, aunt’s, and mother in law’s houses.  His laid back personality is highlighted by dry humor, wit and sarcasm.  Although I hate having plumbing problems - it’s a joy to see Phil.

reviews.author: Bobby Maginas
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Phil from Better Rooter.  Talked directly to him instead of a secretary and he came out on the same day.  He helped locate a septic tank lid, unclog a clog, and replace a leaky shower valve on a rental I own for a fair and honest price.  When I need a plumber I will be using him again.  Thanks!

reviews.author: Philip Drumond
reviews.text: Phil was extremely friendly, extremely affordable, and extremely knowledgeable. We will definitely be calling him if we have any plumbing needs in the future! I highly recommend him and his company.

reviews.author: Joseph Coates
reviews.text: Phil came out the afternoon I called to help with my septic backup.  Recommended a septic pump and was able to free up some debris, fixed a toilet, and was very reasonably priced.  I will use him in the future.

reviews.author: Jennifer Millard
reviews.text: Phillip does an excellent job each time. Trustworthy and no nonsense. Kind. Fair. Phillip doesn't waste your time, and doesn't cut corners. Very thankful to know I can rely on him. Couldn't recommend him more.

plumbers.name: Barr's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 334 Walnut Hill Rd, Bristol, TN 37620, USA

reviews.author: GLAY NATION
reviews.text:
My late wife was very sick, and the plumbing people that put in a walk-in shower(thru Medicare), did a good  job(I’d thought).
2 yrs after her passing, I started getting backup thru the toilet and the shower!
The gentleman came out and found out the people who’d put the walk-in shower had used a coke can to connect the pipes under my mobile home!!
It was a terrible mess.
It was pouring the rain, the yard was soaked, and all the backup on the ground, this wonderful man,cleaned out all the backup, put a tarp on the ground and with his bad back fixed everything.
And only charged me a little over $200!!
Found out in conversation he had a little church, and was the pastor there also.
All I know he was a gift from God on that horrible day.
This company is getting a call from me Monday to fix a problem I have here at my new house.
Don’t let these big slick over priced companies near you.
Barr Plumbing is the best.
God bless them.

reviews.author: Teresa Finch
reviews.text: Excellent!  He came out on Saturday, and the charge was reasonable.  I would definitely use him again!!  Also, does handy work and will call on him for that, as well.

reviews.author: Angie Christmas
reviews.text: Mark is an excellent plumber. He also does carpentry work and odd jobs.  Very reasonable rates and very reliable.

reviews.author: Kristina barr
reviews.text: He's a great plumber,"even if he is my dad"..he does the job right & easier on ya pockets than most..

reviews.author: Kristina Barr
reviews.text: He's the best,and don't try to rip ppl off..

plumbers.name: Yore Place! Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 608 E 2nd St, Newberg, OR 97132, USA

reviews.author: John Buerkle
reviews.text: I needed an uncommon under-the-sink drain part which was only available at plumbing supply stores out of town. When calling Yore Place! Plumbing in Newberg, hoping they might have the part, I reached Curt who happened to be at a plumbing supply store. He said he didn't have the part in his inventory, but if I sent him a picture of it, he would get it while at the store and I could pick it up from him when he was back in town. What a very nice thing to do for a perfect stranger. Sure enough, he let me know when he was back in town, I picked up the part at Yore Place! Plumbing, and was good to go with replacing the part. If ever you have any plumbing issues, Curt at Yore Place! Plumbing should be the one to call.

reviews.author: Megan Read
reviews.text: Nothing but great things to say about Curt with Yore Place! Plumbing. Super fast to respond and show up! Not only did he remove the clog in the drain quickly, but he provided me with the knowledge of parts to replace and how to avoid future issues like this. Great customer service and professional attitude. Thank you Curt!

reviews.author: John Laney
reviews.text: Great Local Plumber! -- I meet Curt doing the remodel work on a Local Down town property. He does high quality work and can do much more than plumbing.   If you need a solid plumber or local handyman he is the guy to call.

reviews.author: James White
reviews.text: I contacted Curt Saturday morning. We had two units in Newberg without water. City shut off the water because if a leak. Our emergency service called 15 other plumbers Friday afternoon and no one could come out, not even at double time. Curt said he would be there between 10-12 that day. He warned me he couldn’t guarantee he could repair the issue. He found the issue got, got the water working and all for $150! Thank you Curt. He will get more of my plumbing business.

reviews.author: Sara DeMaster Smith
reviews.text:
We had a leaking hot water line in our crawl space, discovered by an A/C maintenance technician.  My husband didn't think it would require a lot of work, but didn't have the time to figure out what pieces he would need to fix it.  All the "major" plumbing places were booked out 5-12 days, and we were headed in vacation the next business day.

Curtis Leonard of Yore Place fit us in the same day, even offering to deliver the necessary part and explain how to do it ourselves to save money!  Such a nice guy.  I just had him do it for us (it was indeed a quick fix), and he said my husband could call him later with any questions.  The other available plumber wanted to charge an extra $100 "crawl space fee", even though the crawl space is almost big enough to stand up (we live on a hill).  Curtis charged us less than half of that quote.  He will be my first call the next time we have any plumbing needs, emergency or otherwise!

plumbers.name: Works Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 17650 W National Ave, New Berlin, WI 53146, USA

reviews.author: Greg Gorak
reviews.text: We are a General Contractor here in Milwaukee and use Works Plumbing for a variety of projects large and small. Justin is reliable and fair. His crew are knowledgeable, respectful and clean up afterward. My clients clients rave about their services. You will too.

reviews.author: Nick Ertman
reviews.text: I highly recommend works plumbing. Our Lateral Line from our well broke, they did a great job getting us back up and running quickly. Will definitely be using them again with any other plumbing needs!

reviews.author: LAN
reviews.text: Works Plumbing completed a new plumbing system for me two years ago, recommended by one of my contractors. The entire process was excellent, great communication, high quality workmanship, and a fair price. Everything has been working perfectly ever since (fingers crossed!). I highly recommend Justin and his team.

reviews.author: Jerry Geiss
reviews.text: I had Works booked to replace a pipe in my basement floor. I was told they could come the end of the following week. At the end of the following week, I was told he would be delayed until Tuesday or Wednesday of the next week. Since I didn’t have working plumbing, I told him I would be leaving town for the weekend and returning Monday. On Monday morning while I was still away, he calls telling me he could come that morning. I was in an area with poor cell coverage and got his message 5 hours later while traveling home. I returned his call only to get voicemail. When we finally got in touch with each other, I found out he was now delayed until Thursday. I also found out he knew about the opening on Monday on Saturday. If he would have called Saturday, I could have been home for Monday. So, I hired someone else. I don’t know about how good his workmanship is, but the communication skills suck.

reviews.author: Jordan Koscielniak
reviews.text: Our water heater pilot light went out and I couldn't get it to reignite.  I called Works at 10AM and they had it fixed by 12:30PM.  They asked me for pictures of our water heater which I sent to them via text and they were able to relay the pictures and issue to a technician in the field who diagnosed the problem, picked up the part they suspected needed to be replaced, and came by to install it ASAP.  Their resolution worked and now we have an operational water heater again.  I appreciated the fact that they asked for pictures to try and solve the issue remotely (instead of waiting to physically come by and diagnose it) and that they got someone out by us ASAP.  Incredible service and they didn't try any sort of upselling of any kind. We also used them to replace a water heater at our old house and they were professional, efficient, and on time back then as well. Couldn't recommend Works Plumbing enough if you're ever in a bind for your plumbing needs, especially for water heater issues.

plumbers.name: ANP Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 10014 Holly Rd, Mechanicsville, VA 23116, USA

reviews.author: Hunter Holden
reviews.text:
Rob came highly recommended to by a family member who had recently worked with him. He kindly agreed to come out to take a look at a property I am purchasing and evaluate the level of repairs needed to the plumbing under the bathroom, as well as give an estimate on the replacement of an alcove bathtub. Rob was very responsive to my communication requests and always got back to me within a few hours. When he met me out at the property, he was on-time and very friendly and respectful. He evaluated the situation inside as well as from the crawlspace, and even made me aware of some other things he noticed while he was there. I find him to be very knowledgable and experienced, but also trustworthy and moral which can be hard to find these days. He additionally quoted me a couple hundred dollars less than other contractors/plumbers, which is always a plus! I look forward to updating my review about the quality work I know we will receive when ANP assists us in repairing our new home once we close. Thanks Rob for your help and professionalism!

EDIT: Rob completed the work on my home and we couldn’t be happier. He was on time and everything was completed in the described timeframe. I’ve called on him for a couple of other things recently and he’s always prompt and willing to help. We can’t recommend him enough!

reviews.author: Brenda Grant
reviews.text: I do not like to write a negative review, but I feel I must to help others who may be experiencing the problems we had.  After reading the positive reviews, we contacted The Plumbing Doctor to help figure out why both toilets were running quite often.  He came on July 26 and even though my husband stated he had already replaced the flapper, the representative said this had to be the problem and purchased a new flapper.  He charged $145 for the service call and $20 for the flapper we did not need and ordered another flapper for the other toilet.  The flapper was not the issue.  We had to be the ones to always call and find out where the part was.  My husband finally convinced the representative it was not the flapper, therefore the representative ordered another part (what part we do not know).  After being told again the part was on back order, and the plumber thinking we might consider replacing both toilets (house is only 4 years old) because the plumber was unsure what the problem could be, we decided to take matters into our own hands. We contacted the water supply company which came out to make sure our water pressure was good.  They suggested we replaced the float in each toilet.  My husband went to Lowe's -- purchased two floats on Tuesday -- replaced both floats on Wednesday, and as of today (Friday- September 6) no more running toilets.  Therefore if you have running toilets, replace the flapper---if that does not work---replace the float--and if still doesn't help, I suggest calling a different plumber.  We received no service for the money we paid.

reviews.author: Michael Das
reviews.text:
TLDR: Hire this company; they are friendly, reasonable, and extremely honest. You want people like this in moments of worry and confusion. They will not take advantage of you.

The reason there aren't more reviews is because these brothers, Ottie and Don, are very old school. They don't demand reviews, they don't have a giant organization behind them, and they completely focused on being good to their customers. When you call the number, you'll have to leave a message because they don't have a huge staff. But they'll call you back because they care about people who need their help.

I had the pleasure of working with Ottie. I don't know much about houses and I was extremely nervous I would need extensive repairs/troubleshooting. Ottie took the time to explain what he was doing, work through possible solutions with me, and utilize his decades of experience to diagnose the issue. He stayed to walk me through basic maintenance for other parts of my home and really put our minds at ease. His price was incredibly reasonable given the amount of work and explanation he gave us.

We look at these reviews because we're worried we'll get overcharged by some faceless organization who views us as a bunch of dollar signs. Things are expensive for average Americans. We want a little bit of safety in a world with prices spiraling out of control. We were so lucky to be recommended Salmon Plumbing and Heating because they're just good guys doing good work. I don't know the person reading this but I'm going to give you a little luck: try these guys. Explain your problem, give them some time to respond because it's just two brothers, and, most importantly, come back to write a review after they do a good job.

They're old school good but they deserve a little new school reward; let other knows how good Salmon Plumbing and Heating are.

reviews.author: Alyssa Daugherty
reviews.text:
As a new homeowner, finding the right repair people for various things has been tough - it's hard to know you're getting a good deal when you've never paid for that type of service before.  I had a main sewer line clog over the holiday weekend and knew that I needed my sewer line snaked.  Several plumbers that I called prior to Redi-Rooter would not quote their prices for a snake over the phone.  They needed to send someone to diagnose the problem which would cost  $85+  for the "service call."  And no - that price would not come off the price of the actual work.  Those that would estimate a price came in around $250 with an additional $85-100 "service call charge."

I called Redi-Rooter on Labor day and the person I spoke to was very friendly and helpful, offering tips to see if we could work around the situation ourselves.  He offered us a price over the phone (much less than previous quotes without the service charge) for snaking our sewer, with the obvious caveat - could be more if there are bigger problems.  He offered to send someone that day, or if we could to wait until first thing Tuesday, he could save us at least $45 dollars, avoiding the holiday rates.  (We opted for the cheaper Tuesday option)

The plumber called at 8:15 am, prior to showing up at my door, and was at the house by 8:30 as promised. They were polite, efficient, answered all my questions, and were done within an hour, after making sure every drain was draining, every toilet was flushing, etc.  The final price actually came in less than what I was quoted over the phone!!  (And was a fraction of the previous quotes I had gotten from other plumbers)  I was 100% happy with the customer service, actual service, and the price!

Thanks so much!  I hope I don't have to call you any time soon, but if anything plumbing-related happens, Redi-Rooter is my new go-tol!

reviews.text:
The person on the phone was nice and waived the $59 dollar before 6pm service call fee.  After 6pm its $99.  They asked me to write this review.  I just needed someone to hook up my new condensor fan motor for my ground level outdoor central air.  Just a simple wire job.  I had given up after some bad instructions and not being sure about the wires I was tracing for the new motor.  I really didnt want to burn anything up trying, so I called All Hours.  They were able to get a tech out same day.

He quoted $280 to wire my fan and compressor to the switch and capacitor.  I denied service, but he did me a favor and said he would help me get started by putting wires in the right place.  Long story SHORT he "plugged" my compressor onto the condensor coil and then plugged my fan into the capacitor like an extension cord into itself!  Granted, he was using reference photos and notes to help me out, however, when he plugged the breaker back in, he used the sound of my compressor shorting out to try selling me a new AC system.  I agreed to buy a new AC system knowing something wasnt right.  Another guy was called to help me out.

The sales/supervisor as the first guy called him, saw that I had figured it out before he got to my house to set me up with a new $5000 to $10000 dollar AC system.  When he got there, I told him what the last tech had done and that I was able to get everything running.  This second tech was cool.  He cleaned up the unused wires from the old fan and checked on a few things.  He said my system still had life in it and that he didnt want me to think poorly of the company.  I didnt pay anything in the end for their services.

AC systems are modular.  There is no need to replace an entire system if you can change a few cheap parts.  You dont need special tools unless you sprang a refrigerant leak or ACTUALLY need a new compressor.  YouTube is a great way to learn how to fix things.  Just use your brain like I should have.  If you need professional help, always get second opinions.

Thank you second guy for making things right!!

reviews.text:
Abel plumbing was contracted out by our home builder. My husband had found numerous mistakes that Abel plumbing was doing during the course of the building process. Called Abel plumbing to make them aware of problems, did not have the courtesy to return my phone call to talk about the problems. Instead the secretary called me back asking me what the other plumbers said because they were not aware of the code changes. I expect professionals to have professionalism and keep up to date on their expertise; I'm expected to at my job. Not impressed with Abel and we have contacted the BBB regarding the experience we have encountered.

In response to Abel Plumbing LLC initial review response to review.  There is no blame cast toward Abel Plumbing for the mound system.  The discharge from the water softener did not help the saturation of the mound.  Which was not only from our water usage.  Related to our septic tanks and mound system being placed when it was to wet, not correct machines.  It caused our holding tanks to be under water almost constantly.  This in turn caused our mound to be saturated.  In our opinion when the homeowner catches things in a home build from a licensed plumber that has to be fixed prior to passing inspection, that is a problem. Our spare bathroom cast iron tub was not secured properly, this had to be addressed 3 different times before it was adequate for placement of tile. 3.) reviews.text:
I go down to the basement and notice that it is very wet down there but no puddles. Next child is now in the shower and I am watching water come up out of the basement drain - my septic is over flowing.
I called a rooter company and they came out, dug up my front yard and pumped my tank, filled the hole and went no further with any kind of diagnostic before telling me that my entire system needs replaced and it was going to be in the $20k range. My yard was left a hot mess after they were done, requiring a weekend to level the area and lay seed and straw - I needed a second opinion. Absolute Plumbing came out and, unlike the other company, they actually took the time to inspect my system to discover that my distribution tank was sludged up and not allowing flow into the drain field. They dug up and replaced the distribution tank (because it was also breaking down) and confirmed my drain field was fine. They even let me see the finished work after the tank was installed. During the whole process they demonstrated that they were there to do the job right. They were professional and communicated with me throughout the entirety of the job. Once they were complete they made sure that my yard was in good order, the dirt was packed down nicely, my driveway swept clean and they even put down seed and straw.
God forbid I have any more issues in the future, but I will be a returning customer should that be the case.

reviews.author: rich wilson
reviews.text:
I have been dealing with a slow draining kitchen sink and dishwasher for approximately 18 months.  I have contacted other plumbing services, but they would only snake the drain (which worked for a day or 2).    I called Ray expecting the same treatment, but thankfully they did not want to patch the problem, they wanted to resolve it.

From the initial consult to starting to work, it was just a few days.  Ray's team examined my piping and realized the builders did not put enough of a "fall" in the piping to allow for any refuse to flush out .  The end result was replacing about 40 feet of piping.  When Ray showed me the pipe after it was removed, it was almost completely blocked.

It has been about 5 weeks not and the sink and dishwasher are working better than I could have imagined.  I will absolutely use Ray and his team for future project (or issues).

reviews.text: On a Thursday night we had an irrigation line shut off valve get crushed by a delivery driver backing out of our driveway. I was able to cap the line but still had no water pressure coming into our house after, so we were without water that night. On Friday morning at 7:30 am I began calling plumbing companies to see if we could get someone out same day. Brian called me back and we were able to talk through my issue for about 20 min. He gave me his word that he’d be out late afternoon but had a jam packed day. Brian kept his word and arrived to our house on a Friday afternoon. He and Cody were able to flush out our water lines in reverse to remove all of the silt and sediment that had come into the system when I cut the water off at the meter the night before. I also elected to replace the pressure reducing valve while they were here. Brian made sure to give me an estimate of our cost as soon as he was able to figure out what might be going on and he kept me updated the entire time of what he was doing, I appreciated that. We’ve used two other plumbing companies in recent years that I have been dissatisfied with. I will be calling Brian and On Point again for our home’s plumbing needs. reviews.author: Robert Phair
reviews.text: I am fundamentally a DIY home maintenance guy, but you have to know when a job is beyond your skill set. Recently, I needed to replace the whole-house water filter that protects our tankless hot water heater. The filter cartridge housing had seized to the head and no amount of leaning on the filter wrench would allow me to open it for my annual DIY filter replacement. I made an appointment with Mike Counsil Plumbing, Bobby Mata and Nestor Godoy came out to do the inspection and estimate. I asked Bobby if the install could be done with unions on both sides of the new filter to make my DIY service jobs easier. These guy know their profession. Bobby agreed immediately and on the appointed day, Pablo Segovia was here to remove the old filter and install the new one.  Pablo was prepared and skilled. He saw immediately we needed more room and did not hesitate to install a new shutoff valve to make the required room. All of this was done at the cost of the initial estimate. Every DIY homeowner knows that every job entails surprises. Bobby and Pablo both took the surprises in stride and Pablo had the expertise to finish the job on schedule and on budget. The new filter works great. One recommendation: Ask your technicians for their business phone numbers, so you will be able to identify their calls and texts among all the spam that seems to fill a "modern" life.

reviews.text: i honestly don’t know where i’d be in my home renovation if it hadn’t been for West New York Plumbing And Heating. we have an older home with plumbing from the 60s, and after another plumber broke my cast iron drains under the slab during a high-pressure water jet, i called them for help. scott and bryan came out right away, showed me exactly where the pipes were damaged, and explained everything before getting into the details of the repair. once i understood that a full re-pipe was needed, they gave me a price that was almost $1000 less than two other plumbing companies, and included more prep and finishing work. they also went above and beyond by helping me with all the paperwork and photos i needed for my insurance claim, which eventually got paid. in the office, levi was super helpful and guided me through the whole permit process, while bryan, their technician, showed up early and stayed late to finish the re-piping in less than a month, even with a couple of stops for inspections (which passed with no issues). after finishing the plumbing, they even recommended a great concrete contractor who patched up the slab perfectly in just half a day. since then, they’ve handled everything in my house—copper pipe repairs, installing new fixtures, fixing the hot water tank, putting in new cleanouts, and replacing all the valves and traps. all the work passed inspection without any problems. as someone who works as an insurance adjuster and deals with contractors all the time, i can honestly say their work is the best i’ve seen. i’ve already recommended them to others, and everyone has had the same great experience. if you need a plumber, don’t waste time looking—just call and talk to levi.

I Googled “emergency plumbers” and Big B’s had the highest ratings and lots of them. I was hesitant to go with a company I’d never heard of but gave them a call. They said they could have someone out that afternoon and sent me a picture of the tech who would be arriving with a short bio. I was lucky enough to get Ryan Witowich. He quickly and professionally diagnosed the issue (slab leak) isolated which pipe was leaking, showed and explained everything in terms I could understand as he did his job, and talked to my husband so we could make the decision on how best to move forward with repairs and ensured we were “stable” to use water through the rest of the weekend. We had a team of about 10 show up punctually Monday morning to begin work to replace all of our pipes and get them off the slab. These guys are amazing! They knocked out the whole project in under a week with drywall and stucco guys done, and everything cleaned up. Everyone we worked with were absolute professionals. These are 100% the people you want when you have a plumbing emergency.

reviews.text:
I wish all contractors were as trustworthy and transparent as MK Plumbing.

My fiance and I are first time home buyers of a 100-year-old house. We had some plumbing issues shortly after moving in. Our handyman, who replaced some carpeting, offered to address our broken tub stopper and slow draining tub. Well, it resulted in water leaking through our living room ceiling. At that point, we had another plumber come in who did a patch job without telling us it was a patch job... the leak returned 8 hours later and he refused to come back. We were left feeling stranded and hadn't had a functioning shower in days. Not knowing where to turn, we tapped some neighbors for recommendations based on personal experience.

That's when we finally found MK Plumbing. Matt and Tyler showed up to diagnose the issue. They repiped our tub drain/trap and corrected the work done by the previous individuals in less than two hours. They took the time to explain the problems and how they addressed them. Their work was comprehensive; they went above and beyond to make sure our tub and drain were water tight. They were also very reasonable and, most importantly, so very kind and respectful of our home. Now, I recommend MK Plumbing every chance I get.

Thank you for assuaging my fears and restoring my faith in contractors. You guys are the best! We look forward to calling you for all our future plumbing needs! Happy Holidays!

We had a very bad experience with this plumbing service.  The only thing good I can say is that the technician they sent out, Edel, was very nice and polite. They advertise a 'free estimate" and then charge $150 for the first hour and $125 for every hour thereafter of work.  We have a tankless water heater, and after the technician looked at it for 2 hours, we were told that the circuit board was bad and that we owed $250.  That was before any work was done to fix it.  When I asked what the "free estimate" included, I was told that the "free estimate" was them telling me that they charged $150 for the first hour and then $125 for every hour thereafter.  That's the first time in my life that I've heard a "free estimate" being defined that way, and I'm an old woman.  Then we had to order the part ourselves and have it delivered to our house.  The part cost us another $180.  So we paid them the $250, and when the part was delivered to our house, we installed it ourselves since it came with instructions and we didn't want to be charged another $125 an hour for them to fix it.

I would not recommend this company to anyone.  Not only are they overpriced but are the most unprofessional business I have ever had the misfortune to deal with.

reviews.text:
Do not hire them, I repeat DO NOT BOTHER CALLING THEM TO GIVE YOU A QUOTE. This place is a scam.

They are a middle man for other plumbers, the one they sent me was called Flow Plumbing.

I was told that there would be a charge of $125 to have a technician come and troubleshoot my leak. The plumber arrived and took a look then told me that he could troubleshoot and it would cost $650 but the cost would roll into the final repair bill.

He ends up putting 3 holes in my wall which were just a hammer to the sheet rock. Getting wet sheet rock everywhere, he finally found the leak then quoted me a cost Of $3200. His cost only included replacing the pipe and not opening or closing the hole in the ceiling with sheet rock.

Afterwards I told him that I wanted to get more quotes but he charged me $1000 instead of the $650 that I had agreed to. I ended up disputing the $1000 back to $650 which he reluctantly repaid.

In speaking with another plumber the $650 “troubleshooting fee” was total BS. Also the repair itself including hiring a sheetrock contractor was well below $3200.
